A method includes receiving a bitstream obtained by encoding the image; dividing a first coding block into a plurality of second coding blocks; generating a prediction block of a second coding block based on syntax information obtained from the bitstream; and reconstructing the second coding block based on the prediction block and a residual block of the second coding block, the residual block being obtained by performing a dequantization and an inverse-transform on quantized transform coefficients from the bitstream. The first coding block has a recursive division structure. The first coding block is divided based on at least one of a quad tree division, a binary tree division or a triple tree division.
assignee: B1 Institute Of Image Technology, Inc.

title: Blocking agent that suppresses virus propagation, synthetic nucleic acid encoding blocking agent, and method for treating and/or mitigating virus infection by using blocking agent
abstract: The present disclosure provides a blocking agent that suppresses the propagation of viruses, a synthetic nucleic acid encoding the blocking agent, and a method for treating and/or mitigating virus infection by using the blocking agent. The present disclosure achieves the effect of treating and/or mitigating virus infection through various experiments.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method of the semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a stacked structure including conductive layers and insulating layers alternately stacked with each other in a first direction, a source layer, and a channel layer passing through the stacked structure and being in contact with the source layer. The channel layer includes a first region and a second region, and the first region is disposed between the source layer and the second region, and a first thickness of the first region is greater than a second thickness of the second region.

title: Enhanced ue response to mobile terminated (mt) emergency calls
abstract: When a UE (e.g., cellphone) is disconnected from an emergency call (e.g., 911), the PSAP may call the UE back to finish obtaining information. This return call should also be treated as an emergency call, using the SOS APN for faster call connection and higher priority than normal phone calls. To accomplish this, the P-CSCF inserts a flag into the mobile terminated (MT) session invite, which identifies the return call as being an emergency call. The AMF recognizes this flag and inserts a flag into a paging message for the UE (if in idle mode), or a session modification message for the UE (if in connected mode). The UE then inserts a flag into a session request message when answering the call from the PSAP. The wireless network recognizes this final flag and connects the UE to the PSAP using the SOS APN.

title: Reducing packet loss associated with endpoint location changes
abstract: Packet loss associated with endpoint location changes can be reduced using the technique described herein. In one example, a system can receive a data packet from a sending device, where the data packet is intended for a destination endpoint. The system can determine that a location of the destination endpoint changed from a first location to a second location. This location change might normally result in loss of the data packet. But, based on receiving the data packet and determining that the location of the destination endpoint changed, the system can generate a notification indicative of the location change. The system can then transmit the notification to the sending device. Based on this notification, the sending device can retransmit the packet’s content to the second location to prevent data loss.

title: Processing device, processing method, and storage medium
abstract: A processing device includes an oscillator to which a branch unit including an input unit and an output unit is connected, an input circuit for inputting a first signal wave for controlling an oscillation state of the oscillator to the oscillator via the input unit, a reading circuit for reading the oscillation state of the oscillator, which is connected to the output unit, and a mixer for mixing a second signal wave that is a wave having a phase opposite to a phase of a reflected wave of a first signal wave mixed in the output unit, with the first signal wave between the output unit and the reading circuit.

title: Picture Tile Attributes Signaled Per-Tile
abstract: In encoding a picture, comprising a plurality of tiles, into a bitstream, a method and apparatus is provided for signaling the tile attribute values per-tile, using a compact syntax. These embodiments signal per-tile attribute values. The tile attributes may, for example, be in the form of a set of tile syntax elements (one syntax element per tile attribute), or for example in the form of a set of flags to enable or disable the usage of the tile attributes. These embodiments provide freedom for an encoder to assign the tile attribute values per tile, or per any subset of tiles in a picture, and the attribute values are signaled in a compact syntax at least once. A corresponding method and apparatus for decoding a picture is also described.

title: Pipes having topographic inner structures
abstract: A pipe includes: at least two pipe shell segments each having an inner wall, an outer wall, and a peripheral abutment surface, which are placed on one another in an accurately fitting manner so as to form abutment lines to form a pipe portion; topographic structures on the inner wall of the pipe shell segments; and a coating on the outer wall of the pipe shell segments over the abutment lines with a coating surface.

title: System for curb cap size selection in an exhaust fan
abstract: A system for manufacturing a fan with a curb cap having a sidewall for coupling to a roof curb. The system comprises a data collection device having a display configured to present first, second, and third curb cap options with first, second and third curb cap sidewall dimensions which are numerically different from one another and configured to interface with different first, second, and third roof curbs. The system further comprises a user input device in communication with the data collection device and operable by a user to select either the first, second, or third curb cap option, a data storage device configured to store data relating to the selected curb cap option, and an assembly subsystem configured to receive the data and at least partially manufacture the fan with the curb cap having a sidewall at least partially defining the sidewall dimension of the selected curb cap option.

title: Performance and thermal management for artificial intelligence (ai) appliances
abstract: Systems and methods for performance and thermal management for Artificial Intelligence (AI) appliances are described. In an illustrative, non-limiting embodiment, an AI appliance may include: a Systems-on-Chip (SoC); an AI accelerator coupled to the SoC; and a memory coupled to, or integrated into, the SoC, where the memory comprises program instructions stored thereon that, upon execution by the SoC, cause the AI appliance to: determine that a module is coupled to the AI appliance; and change a thermal setting of the AI appliance based, at least in part, upon the determination.

title: Ion beam deposition system for ruthenium thin films
abstract: Methods for forming a low resistivity ruthenium (Ru) thin film that include depositing ruthenium onto a substrate via ion beam deposition with assist ion beam in a process chamber having reactive and noble gas species therein. The substrate is at at least 250° C. A resulting thin ruthenium film has a thickness of no more than 30 nm, a resistivity less than 12 μΩ-cm and a crystalline structure comprising grains having a (0001) orientation. The resistivity will differ at different thickness; for example, less than 9 μΩ-cm for films of 50 nm and thicker, less than 9.5 μΩ-cm for films of 35 nm and thicker, less than 11 μΩ-cm for films of 20 nm and thicker, less than 15 μΩ-cm for films of 10 nm and thicker or less than 20 μΩ-cm for films of 2 nm and thicker. The grains have a mean grain size at least three times the film thickness.

title: Managing electric vehicle charging through a smart meter
abstract: A system and method for remotely managing electric power transfer comprising a power source, an electric vehicle charging device configured to transfer electric power from the power source to an electric vehicle, and a smart meter device coupled to the charging device on one end and the power source on another end. The smart meter device is configured to control the electric power transferred by the electric vehicle charging device (EVSE) is provided.

title: Smart Fusion and Processing of Data Tables
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for aggregating data from multiple data tables based on matching row headers. A first data table includes a plurality of first rows associated with respective row headers, and a second data table includes a plurality of second rows associated with respective row headers. A matching process is performed to compare the row headers of the first data table with the row headers of the second data table to identify one or more matching pairs of row headers, each pair including a row header corresponding to a first row in the first data table and a row header corresponding to a second row in the second data table. Based on the identified matching pairs, an aggregated data table is generated. For each matching pair, the aggregated data table includes an aggregated row comprising one or more cells from the corresponding first and second rows.

title: Sole structure for article of footwear
abstract: A sole structure for an article of footwear having an upper includes a cushion member and a chassis. The cushion member includes a first series of lobes alternating with a first series of recesses along a length of the cushion member. The first series of lobes and the first series of recesses extend along one of a medial side of the sole structure and a lateral side of the sole structure. The chassis is disposed between the cushion member and the upper and includes a series of first supports alternating with a second series of recesses. The supports of the series of first supports are aligned and in contact with respective lobes of the first series of lobes and the second series of recesses are aligned with the first series of recesses.

title: Damage-targeted treatments of disease
abstract: Methods of treating viral infectious diseases such as coronavirus disease 2019 and other diseases causing organ damage in a subject are provided. Treatments include administration of a targeted retrovector to the subject. Among the effects of these treatments is the lessening or prevention of complications of the disease, particularly those arising from pathogenic immune responses.

title: Device centric methods for managing spatial anchors in 3gpp systems
abstract: Device centric methods for managing spatial anchors in 3GPP systems are described herein. In one aspect, a method can include receiving, by an extended Reality and Media services (XRM) client of a UE, a spatial anchor request, wherein the spatial anchor request comprises a request to register a VAL client to the XRM client; and sending, by the XRM and in response to the spatial anchor request, a response comprising an identifier of a spatial anchor the VAL client is registered to, a representation of the spatial anchor the VAL is registered to, or both.

title: System, Method, and Computer Program Product for Automatically Preparing Documents for a Multi-National Organization
abstract: Provided is a system, method, and apparatus for automatically preparing documents for a multi-national organization. The method includes generating a document preparation workflow based on multi-national organization data for the multi-national organization, the document preparation workflow including a sequence of nodes based on multi-national organization data and rules data, the multi-national organization data including at least one multi-national organization chart and transactions associated with the multi-national organization, configuring at least one node of the sequence of nodes by identifying at least one role associated with the at least one node of a plurality of roles, and executing the document preparation workflow by automatically performing a plurality of actions associated with the sequence of nodes based on the multi-national organization data and the rules data.

title: Generalized artificial intelligence power aware traffic management as a service
abstract: Aspects of the subject disclosure may include, for example, obtaining, from a plurality of gNodeBs in a mobile communication network, network load data and user equipment battery data for user equipment attached to gNodeBs of the plurality of gNodeBs, predicting a respective battery impact metric for a respective user equipment based on the network load data and the user equipment battery data and based on received traffic throttling levels and corresponding traffic volume, forming a predicted battery impact, and dynamically adjusting traffic throttling parameters in the mobile communications network based on the predicted battery impact and network congestion, thereby optimizing network performance and mitigating battery drainage. Other embodiments are disclosed.
assignee: At&T Intellectual Property I, L.P.; AT&T Technical Services Company, Inc.

title: Relay station in wireless lan system
abstract: For example, the technical feature of the present disclosure may relate to a method performed in a wireless local area network (WLAN) system. For example, the method of the present disclosure may comprise a step in which an access point (AP) station (STA) transmits a detection request frame to a relay STA. The detection request frame includes control information for a non-AP STA detection procedure performed by the relay STA, and the non-AP STA detection procedure may be performed on the basis of a physical protocol data unit (PPDU) transmitted from at least one non-AP STA to the AP STA. In addition, according to the method of the present disclosure, the AP STA may receive, from the relay STA, report information regarding the non-AP STA detection procedure that has been performed by the relay STA. In this case, the report information may include information regarding at least one non-AP, which has been acquired by the relay STA.

title: Robot path planning method, device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: This application provides a robot path planning method, device, electronic equipment, and medium. The method comprises: constructing a planar graph of the area to be worked on, and using a preset partitioning algorithm to partition the planar graph to obtain multiple work partitions, and determining the work order of the robot in each work partition; determining the bow-shaped path parameter and path baseline in the first work partition when moving according to the work order to the first work partition among multiple work partitions; controlling the robot to move in the first working partition based on the bow-shaped path parameter and path baseline; when moving to the next work partition of the first work partition, determining the bow-shaped path parameter and path baseline of the first work partition as the bow-shaped path parameter and path baseline of the next work partition; determining the starting route of the next work partition based on the path baseline, bow-shaped path parameters, and boundary information of the next work partition; controlling the robot's movement in the next work partition based on starting route and bow-shaped path parameter.

title: Electrode for lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing electrode for lithium ion battery
abstract: An electrode for a lithium ion battery includes a current collector foil, binder particle groups, and an active material layer. The binder particle groups are attached to a surface of the current collector foil. The active material layer is arranged on the surface of the current collector foil. The active material layer contains active material particle groups. The binder particle groups are scattered within an interface between the active material layer and the current collector foil.

title: Acid mixing system
abstract: A system for mixing a liquid with a powder into a solution batch includes a hopper ( 20 ) into which said powder is deposited, the hopper ( 20 ) having a powder outlet ( 22 ) therein. A mix tank ( 60 ) is also provided having a liquid supply inlet ( 62 ), a recirculation inlet ( 64 ), and a solution outlet ( 66 ). A mix pump ( 40 ) that is in fluid communication with the solution outlet ( 66 ), the powder outlet and the recirculation inlet ( 64 ) operates to mix and transfer the solution.

title: Arm Attachment For Retractor And Retractor Blades
abstract: An apparatus for holding a retractor arm including a connector attachable at a free end of a support arm. The connector including a housing extending with a receptacle, a holder block movably disposed in the housing, and a bumper block movably disposed in the housing. The holder block adjustable between a retracted position where a tip of the holder block is outside of the receptacle and a holding position where the tip is at least partially within the receptacle. The bumper block being biased in an expanded position such that the holder block is held in the retracted position by the bumper block and movement of the bumper block from the expanded position to a compressed position releases the holder block. The connector is adapted to receive a post disposed on a retractor arm, the post being loadable into the receptacle to cause the bumper block to move.

title: Positive Electrode Active Material, and Positive Electrode and Lithium Secondary Battery Which Include the Same
abstract: A positive electrode active material including a lithium transition metal oxide in a form of a single particle, wherein the lithium transition metal oxide in the form of a single particle includes an outer boundary forming an outline of the particle and an inner boundary formed in the particle, and satisfies the relationship that 0<length of the inner boundary/length of the outer boundary<0.4. A positive electrode and a lithium secondary battery which include the positive electrode active material are also provided.

title: Reducing network load and lead time for signing a package manager file
abstract: Techniques for signing a package manager file are disclosed. An example method includes receiving, at a signing client, a package manager file and a signing request to cryptographically sign the package manager file. The package manager file includes a header and a payload. The method also includes inspecting the header of the package manager file to determine whether the header includes a digest comprising a hash of the payload. Responsive to determining that the header does include the digest, the method also includes sending the header from the signing client to a signing server without sending the payload, and receiving a signed header from the signing server.

title: Btk degrading compounds
abstract: Provided herein are heteroaromatic compounds which target BTK proteins for ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation. Also provided herein are methods for using said compounds for the treatment of diseases.

title: Inner liner and vapor deposition process chamber
abstract: An inner liner includes a first guide and a second guide disposed opposite to each other between an intake side and an exhaust side of the inner liner, and/or, an annular groove provided at an outer peripheral wall of the inner liner and located below a transfer port of the inner liner. A first end of the first guide and a first end of the second guide are located at the intake side of the inner liner, and a second end of the first guide and a second end of the second guide are located at the exhaust side of the inner liner, the intake side and the exhaust side of the inner liner being opposite sides of the inner liner, and a distance between the first guide and the second guide gradually decreases from the intake side to the exhaust side.
assignee: Beijing Naura Microelectronics Equipment Co., Ltd.

title: Method of thermally conditioning a child safety seat installed in a vehicle
abstract: A method is provided for delivering thermal comfort to a child seated in a child safety seat installed in a rear seat of a vehicle. The method includes determining whether a child safety seat is present or installed in the rear seat. A vehicle controller and/or vehicle climate control system activates or adjusts one or more vehicle thermal effectors positioned adjacent to the rear seat of the vehicle, to thermally condition a region of the vehicle in which the child safety seat is located.

title: Systems and methods of mounting a camera for monitoring an item storage area of a facility
abstract: A mounting system to mount a camera for monitoring an item storage area of a facility includes a first housing containing a camera that captures the item storage area's field of view, and a second housing containing a battery pack that supplies power to the camera. An electrical wire connects the battery pack to the camera. A bracket is mounted to an item storage structure, with a front leg supporting the first housing at the front of the structure, and a rear leg supporting the second housing at the back of the structure. The body portion of the bracket connects the front and rear legs, allowing the electrical wire to travel along it. The positioning of the battery pack behind the item storage structure protects the battery pack from potential impacts by machinery at the front of the structure, ensuring that the camera and battery pack remain functional and secure.

title: Convertible lavatory systems and methods for an internal cabin of a vehicle
abstract: A lavatory system for an internal cabin of a vehicle includes a monument defining an internal chamber. The monument includes a contoured wall configured to conform to at least a portion of a shape of one or more passenger seats. First and second toilets are within the internal chamber. The first and second toilets can be staggered in relation to one another. A stowage chamber is within the internal chamber. The stowage chamber is configured to retain emergency equipment. A pedestal has one or more portions that are shaped to provide additional space within the internal chamber.

title: Multi-layer sheets with flow channels
abstract: A cooling panel for an electronic system requiring cooling, includes a first sheet with a first hole pattern and a second sheet with a second hole pattern different from or offset from the first hole pattern. The first sheet and the second sheet overlap to create a multi-layer sheet. The first hole pattern of the first sheet and the second hole pattern of the second sheet partially overlap to create a flow path longitudinally along a length of the multi-layer sheet. A flexible cover surrounds the multi-layer sheet and has a fluid inlet opening and a fluid outlet opening.

title: Compositions and methods for modulating gls1
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to compositions and methods for modulating levels, transcription, splicing, and/or translation of one or more RNA transcripts (e.g., mRNA transcripts) in a cell or subject. The disclosure is based, in part, on isolated nucleic acids that bind to mRNA transcripts of genes involved in psychiatric diseases and disorders, for example glutaminase (GLS1\ which is the enzyme responsible for producing glutamate in the central nervous system (CNS). In some embodiments, compositions of the disclosure are useful for treating psychiatric diseases or disorders, such as schizophrenia (e.g., treatment resistant schizophrenia), Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), or neuroinflammation.

title: System and method for delivery of therapeutic agents and treatment of fecal impaction
abstract: Systems and methods for treating fecal impaction are described. A fecal impaction treatment system includes a distal portion configured to be positioned adjacent to an anus of a patient, a fluid delivery pathway including a disimpaction fluid outlet configured to deliver disimpaction fluid toward fecal material, and a waste pathway including a waste inlet configured to receive the disimpaction fluid and fecal material affected by the disimpaction fluid. A therapeutic-agent source may selectively supply a therapeutic agent so that the disimpaction fluid delivered through the disimpaction fluid outlet includes the therapeutic agent. A macerator may be positioned along the waste pathway to reduce a size of fecal material transported through the waste pathway. A waste reservoir may receive the disimpaction fluid and fecal material from the waste pathway.

title: Fuel injection device
abstract: One embodiment of a fuel injection device according to the present disclosure is provided with: a casing in which a fuel injection hole is formed at the leading end thereof and a fuel passage is formed thereinside; a spool including a needle valve that is disposed so as to be movable along the axial direction of the casing by the operation of an electromagnetic actuator and that is capable of opening and closing the fuel injection hole, and a drive piston that faces a pressure control chamber in communication with the fuel passage; and a pressure reduction flow passage formation member having formed therein a pressure reduction flow passage that has an opening formed in a facing surface facing a piston surface and an outlet port to be opened and closed by the operation of the electromagnetic actuator, and that is in communication with the pressure control chamber. The piston surface has a protruding part that protrudes to the opening side, and the pressure reduction flow passage formation member has an inclined surface that is inclined so as to have a diameter which decreases from the opening along a direction away from the piston surface. The protruding part has a linear contact portion capable of linearly contacting with the inclined surface and closing the opening when the piston surface moves to the other end side.
assignee: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Engine & Turbocharger, Ltd.

title: Engineered type e botulinum neurotoxin for therapeutic and cosmetic applications
abstract: Serotype E botulinum neurotoxin (BoNT/E) is one of the major causes of human botulism and paradoxically also a promising therapeutic agent. However, the molecular mechanism by which BoNT/E recognizes synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2A (SV2.A) and 2B (SV2B), but no closely related SV2C, as its neuronal receptors has been challenging to resolve. The Inventor, surprisingly, was able to obtain crystal structures of the receptor-binding domain of BoNT/E (H C E) in complex with SV2.A. These structures reveal that H C E engages both specific peptide fragments and an N-glycan of SV2A, as well as SV2B in a similar manner. Structure-based mutagenesis and functional studies demonstrate that both the peptide- and glycan-based associations are essential for SV2A/2B-mediated cell entry of BoNT/E and for its potent neurotoxicity. Thus, the engineering of BoNT/E variants for new clinical applications is described herein.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Reflective phase shifter for use in phased arrays
abstract: A system, comprising a device including a circuit configured to produce a phase shift in a reflected signal, wherein a plurality of switchable phase bits are situated in parallel relative to one another within the device, wherein each switchable phase bit operates on a fraction of incident signal power, and wherein reflections from all parallel bits are recombined into a single signal reflected from the phase shifting device; and an antenna, wherein the antenna is a single antenna or an array of antennas.

title: System and method for authenticating digital media integrity using backend microdata analysis
abstract: A system and method that authenticates the integrity of digital images and videos by analyzing backend microdata to detect alterations, filters, or AI-generated manipulations. This system provides a comparison of the original and modified states of digital media, assess the authenticity of the content, and confirm the identity of depicted subjects, providing a critical tool against misinformation and unauthorized media manipulation.

title: Robot control using return data
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus for robot control using return data. One method includes maintaining return data that records outcomes of past robot actions, in which the return data maps each observation-action pair to a respective return, the action in each observation-action pair being an action that was performed by the robot in response to the observation in the observation-action pair and the respective return mapped to by each of the observation-action pairs being a return that resulted from the robot performing the action in the observation-action pair; receiving a current observation from one or more sensors of the robot; determining whether the current observation matches any observation identified in the return data; and in response to determining that the current observation matches a first observation identified in the return data, selecting an action to be performed by the robot.

title: Dicentra plant named '17001GR1'
abstract: A new and distinct cultivar of  Dicentra  plant named ‘17001GR1’ is disclosed, characterized by bright green foliage with red flowers. Plants are large, robust, and vigorous. The new cultivar is a  Dicentra , typically used for ornamental horticulture purposes.

title: Imaging device and electronic device
abstract: An imaging device that has an image processing function and is capable of operating at high speed is provided. The imaging device has an additional function such as image processing, image data obtained by an imaging operation is binarized in a pixel unit, and a product-sum operation is performed using the binarized data. A memory circuit is provided in the pixel unit and retains a weight coefficient used for the product-sum operation. Thus, an arithmetic operation can be performed without the weight coefficient read from the outside every time, whereby power consumption can be reduced. Furthermore, a pixel circuit, a memory circuit, and the like and a product-sum operation circuit and the like are stacked, so that the lengths of wirings between the circuits can be reduced, and high-speed operation with low power consumption can be performed.

title: Methods and Apparatus for Performing a Wing Bend Test
abstract: A method for performing a wing bend test on a vehicle wing may involve: (i) positioning a plurality of inflatable bags underneath an underside of the wing, wherein each of the plurality of inflatable bags is configured to, when inflated, apply an upward force to the wing, (ii) installing measurement tools for measuring parameters of the wing bend test, wherein at least one of the parameters includes an upward force applied by the plurality of inflatable bags on the wing, (iii) for each of the plurality of inflatable bags, controlling a pressure of the inflatable bag via a pressure control system, (iv) utilizing at least one of the measurement tools, measuring the upward force applied by the plurality of inflatable bags on the wing, and (v) based on an evaluation of the measured upward force, adjusting the pressure of at least one of the plurality of inflatable bags.

title: Method and system for remote control of smart gas terminal and storage medium thereof
abstract: A method and a system for remote control of a smart gas terminal and a storage medium are provided. The method includes: obtaining user data authorized for usage by a user; determining, based on the user data, residence information of the user; determining, based on the residence information, whether the user is resident or not; obtaining user physical information authorized by the user in response to the user not being resident; monitoring whether the user is resident in a future time period based on the user physical information; remotely controlling to open the smart gas terminal in response to the user being resident in the future time period; remotely controlling to close the smart gas terminal in response to the user not being resident in the future time period; and obtaining information related to an opening or closing status of the smart gas terminal, and storing and processing the information.
assignee: Chengdu Qinchuan Iot Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Systems and methods for the generation and usage of authentication images in conjunction with low-resolution print devices
abstract: Systems and methods applicable, for instance, to the generation and usage of authentication images. In one aspect, unauthorized attempts to duplicate authentication images can be thwarted. In another aspect, there can be provision for authorized authentication image generation using low-resolution print devices.

title: Systems and methods for controlling a supply of multiple gases to a plasma chamber
abstract: Systems and methods for supplying multiple gases are described. One of the systems includes a gas adapter having a plenum. The system further includes a first gas line coupled to the gas adapter for transfer of a first process gas to the plenum. The system includes a second gas line coupled to the gas adapter for transfer of a second process gas to the plenum. The first and second process gases are transferred while maintaining temperatures of the first and second process gases. The gas adapter mixes the first process gas with the second process gas under vacuum to generate a gas mixture for supply of the gas mixture to an inside volume of a plasma chamber.

title: Lock
abstract: A lock includes a housing assembly, an actuatable lock assembly and a latching assembly. The actuatable lock assembly is positionable in at least a closed orientation and an open orientation. The latching assembly further includes a latch, a cam and a motor. The latch, having a cam profile, is movable between a locked position and an unlocked position. In the locked position, the actuatable lock assembly is maintained in the closed orientation. In the unlocked position, the actuatable lock assembly is positionable into an open orientation. The cam is rotatably mounted and has a first follower configured to intermittently coact with the cam profile of the latch, to, in turn, move the latch between the locked position and the unlocked position. The motor is coupled to the cam. Actuation of the motor causes rotation of the cam, resulting in movement of the latch between the locked and unlocked positions.

title: Battery carrier for vehicle and mounting method thereof
abstract: In certain examples, an apparatus includes a battery carrier for a vehicle supporting a battery. The battery carrier may include a bracket supporting both edges of the battery; a roof frame coupled to an upper portion of the bracket; and a stopper inserted into the bracket to prevent escape of the battery in a horizontal direction.

title: Terminal, base station, and communication method
abstract: According to the present embodiment, a terminal comprises: a control circuit that specifies a second resource having a frequency allocation size different from the frequency allocation size of a first resource scheduled by a control signal; and a communication circuit that receives or transmits a signal by using the second resource.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Corporation Of America

title: Hydrogel substrate as a platform for biological material
abstract: The present application relates to hydrogel substrates for growing biological materials, including but not limited to plants, fungi, and bacteria. In some embodiments, the present application provides a platform for optimizing growth of a biological material using a hydrogel substrate in various forms. In other embodiments, the present application provides methodology and compositions for growing a biological material, such as a plant, in a hydrogel substrate blend comprising hydrogel substrate and one or more of soil, coco coir, peat moss, rock wool, wood, wood chips or mulch, wood fiber, processed wood fiber, tree fibers, hemp, bamboo, tree bark, sand and grit, perlite, pumice, clay, vermiculite, biochar, natural or processed raw material, and/or synthetic material. In other embodiments, the present application provides methodology and compositions for growing a biological material, such as a plant, in a hydrogel bonded plug, wherein said hydrogel bonded plug does not contain any synthetic adhesive or glue.

title: Clean room floor opening detection
abstract: A method include: generating three-dimensional data of the interior of the cleanroom from a ranging result using electromagnetic waves; comparing a height of each part of the interior of the cleanroom indicated by the three-dimensional data, with a predetermined reference height; and detecting an opening in the floor from which a floor tile has been removed, based on a result of the comparing.

title: Methods and systems for configuration and enrollment of image capturing devices using artifical intelligence (ai)
abstract: A method and system for configuring and enrolling one or more image capturing devices are disclosed. The method comprises receiving, via at least one processor, at least one input request from a user; determining, via the at least one processor, a position and a placement of the image capturing devices based at least on multimedia data captured by the image capturing devices and at least one input request, using a video cognitive module; generating, via the at least one processor, a configuration data sheet for the one or more image capturing devices based at least on one or more data sets and the position and the placement of the one or more image capturing devices, using an AI module; initiating the configuration and the enrollment of the one or more image capturing devices based at least on the generated configuration data sheet using a camera module.

title: Electrode assembly gripper and electrode assembly transport system
abstract: An electrode assembly gripper is disclosed. In some implementations, the gripper includes: a first gripper on which an electrode assembly is disposed; a second gripper disposed to face the first gripper; and a main body including a support portion supporting the first gripper and the second gripper, and a moving portion capable of relatively moving at least one of the first gripper and the second gripper, wherein the second gripper includes a gripper base connected to the main body, a contact portion capable of being in contact with the electrode assembly, and a hinge part providing a rotational motion to the contact portion.

title: A catheter for delivering medical therapy to a remote site in a body
abstract: A pre-bendable wall section of a catheter is manually pre-bendable by a physician along a longitudinal pre-bending range close to the catheter's distal end. The pre-bendable wall section comprises a pre-bendable skeleton, which is an interrupted tubular reinforcement wall having a microfabricated cut pattern. The pre-bendable skeleton comprises a number N of right-handed helical struts, wherein N≥2, N left-handed helical struts, a plurality of ring-shaped struts and, at each ring-shaped strut, N angularly equally spaced connection nodes. At each connection node a ring-shaped strut, a right-handed helical strut and a left-handed helical strut are interconnected. An overall skeleton cut-away ratio of the pre-bendable wall section in said pre-bending range is between 45% and 85%. The pre-bendable wall section has well-balanced omni-directional bendability and high shape retention. The catheter can be made efficiently, and can be designed with favourable properties as to flexibility, torquability, pushability and lumen integrity.

title: Monitoring device, storage medium storing computer program for monitoring and method for monitoring
abstract: A monitoring device has a processor configured to decide to mitigate an allowable criterion that allows a driver to perform an action other than operating a vehicle when a first condition in which a vehicle operated automatically travels on an expressway with a single lane and a second condition in which there is no point at which another vehicle can enter a traveling lane of the vehicle within a first reference range from a current position of the vehicle in a traveling direction are satisfied than when either one of the first condition and the second condition is not satisfied.

title: Systems and methods for roof recommendation based upon cumulative weather damage
abstract: Systems and methods for roof recommendation based upon cumulative weather damage is disclosed herein. An exemplary computing environment includes one or more processors; and a memory storing executable instructions thereon. When executed by the one or more processors, these instructions may cause the one or more processors to: receive roof data from an electronic device and/or database indicating at least a geolocation of a roof, obtain weather data for the geolocation of the roof indicating the weather over a period of time at least near the geolocation, determine a roof recommendation based upon the roof data and the weather data, and/or generate a roof recommendation signal indicating the roof recommendation.
assignee: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company

title: Combination of fuel cell and all solid state battery stack for a vehicle
abstract: A combined fuel cell and battery unit. The fuel cell and battery are contained in a common housing having tensioning plates for applying a clamping pressure to the fuel cell and battery. Flow passages for the flow of coolant circulate coolant around the fuel cell and the battery.

title: Bark stopping method and bark stopping device
abstract: Disclosed are a bark stopping method and a bark stopping device, which relate to the technical field of pet equipment. After a barking sound of a dog is identified, a repellent sound wave is emitted toward the dog for a first preset duration, and then the emission of the repellent sound wave is stopped and whether a barking sound exists within a subsequent first preset time period is judged. If the barking sound exists within the first preset time period, whether a frequency of the repellent sound wave has crossed a preset first threshold is judged, and if the frequency of the repellent sound wave has not crossed the preset first threshold, the frequency of the repellent sound wave is adjusted according to a preset rule, and the repellent sound wave is emitted toward the dog again for a second preset duration.

title: Method and device for cleaning and sterilizing contact lens using electrochemistry
abstract: A method and a device for cleaning and sterilizing contact lens using electrochemistry. The method includes: pouring normal saline into care chambers and an auxiliary chamber, a cation exchange membrane being provided between the care chamber, first electrodes and the auxiliary chambers and second electrodes being provided inside the care chambers, third electrodes being provided inside the auxiliary chamber, and contact lenses being provided inside the care chambers; connecting the first electrodes serving as a cathode and the third electrodes serving as an anode to a power supply; and then disconnecting the power supply, and connecting the power supply to the first electrodes and the second electrodes and, under the action of an electric field force, the degraded denatured proteins move towards the electrode carrying opposite charges to those of themselves.

title: Light-emitting element with standing wave generator and associated optoelectronic device
abstract:
The present invention relates to light-emitting element ( 10 ) including:
         a conversion material ( 14 ) suitable for converting a first radiation within a first spectral band into a second radiation within a second spectral band, the second spectral band being distinct from the first spectral band, and   a standing wave generator within the first spectral band, the standing wave generator including a two-dimensional photonic crystal ( 26 ) suitable for generating a standing wave within the first spectral band, the photonic crystal ( 26 ) being formed at least in part by light-emitting diodes ( 12 ) suitable for emitting within the first spectral band.

title: Load cell with roberval structure having anti-offset function, and weighing device
abstract: A load cell with a Roberval structure having an anti-offset function, and a weighing device are disclosed. The load cell includes strain detection elements mounted on an elastic element, which includes a loading portion for receiving a load from a connector, a fixing portion for fixing the elastic element, a strain generation portion for converting the load into deformation, and a parallel guide beam for transferring the load and keeping the loading portion translational when loaded. The strain generation portion includes first and second hollow cavity bodies symmetrically distributed vertically relative to each other. The loading portion and the fixing portion are respectively located on left and right sides of the strain generation portion. The parallel guide beam is located at upper and lower portions of the strain generation portion. A center of rotation and a geometric center of the strain generation portion coincide when the load cell with the Roberval structure is loaded.
assignee: Mettler-Toledo (Changzhou) Precision Instruments Ltd.; Mettler-Toledo (Changzhou) Measurement Technology Ltd.; Mettler-Toledo International Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.

title: Hardware assisted Page Migration in a Multi-Dielet Processing System
abstract: A hardware mechanism at each dielet of a multi-dielet processing system is aware of engine page-table binds at all the dielets, thereby providing accurate traffic notifications to software (e.g., a unified virtual memory driver) for on-demand page-migration between system memory and GPU memory. The mechanism broadcasts binding information to access counters on each dielet so the access counters are able to correlate engines requesting memory access with bound virtual memory pages and generate corresponding informative notifications. A flexible multi-dielet counter clear capability enables software to clear access counters.

title: Method and system for automated generation of user interface
abstract: Various methods and processes, apparatuses or systems, and media for automated generation of a user interface that is tailored for an individual user based on user-specific requirements by using a trained model are disclosed. The method includes: identifying a user; accessing a standard action statement structure that relates to actions that is associated with the user; determining a corresponding action verb and a corresponding action object associated with each respective action; determining a corresponding outcome verb and a corresponding outcome object associated with each respective action; constructing a respective sentence that includes each respective action, the corresponding action object, the corresponding outcome verb, and the corresponding outcome object; providing each respective sentence as an input to a generative artificial intelligence (AI) model that is trained to generate a user interface; and receiving, as an output from the generative AI model, a user interface that is tailored for the user.

title: Adjustment to multi-phase clock to reduce skew variation caused by power rail bounce at onset of burst of data
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for adjustment to multi-phase clock to reduce skew variation caused by power rail bounce at an onset of a burst of data are described. In accordance with examples as described herein, a memory system may be configured to reduce skew variations between a multi-phase clock and a differential clock caused by power rail bounce during a burst write operation. The memory system may include circuitry including a block of detection/pulse generation circuitry configured to detect a leading phase of the multi-phase clock at an onset of a burst write operation and generate pulse signaling that is indicative of the leading phase. The circuitry may further a block of adder circuitry that is configured to determine, based at least in part on using the pulse signaling, one or more timing adjustments that compensate for the skew variations.

title: Motor control apparatus and vessel propulsion system
abstract: A motor control apparatus provided for each of motors that drive respective propulsion units is characterized by including a switching circuit, a control signal generation unit that generates a control signal for the switching circuit, a control-speed calculation unit that calculates a control speed based on the control signal, a control-speed-reduction determination unit that determines control-speed reduction in the case where the control speed is the same as or smaller than a control-speed threshold value, and a control-speed-limitation requesting unit that requests to limit the control speed of a switching circuit in another motor control apparatus, in the case where control-speed reduction is determined. In addition, a vessel propulsion system has a plurality of the motor control apparatuses, a plurality of the motors, and a plurality of the propulsion units.

title: Method for controlling the properties of biogenic silica through integrated thermal and oxidative processing
abstract: A method for producing porous amorphous biogenic silica from siliceous plant matter through a three-element control architecture. Removal of non-siliceous inorganic flux constituents is maintained as a safety constraint preventing flux-induced sintering, crystallization, and pore collapse. Calcination temperature serves as the primary control variable, determining temperature-history-dependent surface-area plateaus in the range of 200-500 m 2 /g based on the complete thermal profile including ramp rate, peak temperature, and hold time. Peroxide-mediated oxidative intensity serves as a secondary variable applied only during pre calcination oxidative treatment and governs carbon-pathway partitioning between in-situ combustion and peroxide-mediated pre-volatilization of organic carbon away from silica structures, wherein higher peroxide intensity reduces the molecular weight of carbon compounds so they volatilize before combustion, thereby avoiding localized overheating at carbon-silica interfaces and preserving the native pore structure. The resulting silica exhibits an expanded dispersibility continuum including in-compound breakup, wherein particles undergo further dispersion during mechanical incorporation into matrices.

title: Systems and methods of artificial intelligence-based sepsis prediction
abstract: The present disclosure encompasses systems and methods for determining the presence of sepsis in an individual or the risk of developing sepsis in an individual at risk therefore, including within about 24 hours of acquiring measurements and/or information of one or more factors associated with the individual. In specific embodiments, one or more input features, such as one or more demographic, patient assessment, vital sign, hematological laboratory measurement, chemistry panel measurement, and/or sepsis-associated biomarkers may be utilized in generating an output, such as a quantitative value, that indicates whether or not an individual is at low risk, medium risk, high risk, or very high risk for the onset of sepsis.

title: Database double write monitoring
abstract: Techniques for database double write monitoring are disclosed. In an example method, a computing system receives indications of first and second database writes to respective first and second databases. The computing system determines a time interval between the first and second database writes. The computing system, responsive to the time interval being less than a predefined threshold time interval, determines a difference between the first and database writes based on a comparison of the two database writes. The computing system, responsive to the difference indicating that a double write error has occurred, generates a double write error object including information about the first and second database writes. The computing system outputs an instruction to an issue tracking system, based on the double write error object, to cause automatic correction of the double write error.

title: Flexible cup bung for self-aligned sealing within a drafted channel
abstract: Described herein are embodiments of a bung comprising a flexible cup cavity on its sealing side among other features, wherein the bung can maintain a seal with the walls of a channel that has a non-uniform diameter across its length. A bung as described herein can be used with an independent force actuator to generate kinetic energy in either a liquid or a gas, inside a closed system such as a self-contained, single-use medical device, for example.

title: Phase locked loop circuit with time interleaved phase frequency detectors
abstract: A Phase Locked Loop includes a digitally controlled oscillator (DCO), an integer number M of Phase Frequency Detectors (PFDs), M Time to Digital Converters (TDCs) connected to the outputs of the M PDFs respectively, a first frequency divider configured to generate M frequency-divided reference signals shifted in time by one period Tr of the reference signal from each other; a second frequency divider configured to generate M frequency-divided feedback signals shifted in time by one period Tf of the feedback signal from each other; a third frequency divider configured to generate a feedback signal to the second frequency divider; a digital processing unit configured to generate an output signal per cycle of the reference signal based on received signals from the M TDCs; and a loop filter configured to generate a control signal to the DCO to adjust the frequency of the output signal generated from the DCO.

title: Battery cell, battery, and electric apparatus
abstract: A battery cell includes an electrode assembly and a housing. The electrode assembly includes a negative electrode plate, where the negative electrode plate includes a negative electrode current collector and a negative electrode film layer disposed on at least one side of the negative electrode current collector and containing a negative electrode active material. The housing accommodates the electrode assembly, and the housing includes a side wall, where the side wall surrounds the electrode assembly. The negative electrode active material includes element silicon, the housing is a cylindrical structure, and a surface density of the negative electrode film layer is less than or equal to 10.5 mg/cm 2 .

title: Plasma Treatment Method for Improving Battery Cell Insulation Defects and Secondary Battery Manufacturing Method Comprising the Same
abstract: A secondary battery includes: an upper pouch case having a metal layer and a polypropylene coating layer formed on a lower surface thereof, wherein the polypropylene coating layer is plasma surface-treated; a lower pouch case having a metal layer and a polypropylene coating layer formed on an upper surface thereof, wherein the polypropylene coating layer is plasma surface-treated; and a battery cell having leads having a metal layer and polypropylene coating layers formed on upper and lower surfaces of the leads. When the upper pouch case and the lower pouch case are sealed by heat fusion, the upper and lower surfaces of the leads are each heat-fused between the upper pouch case and the lower pouch case. In the pouch sheet which forms the upper pouch case or the lower pouch case, plasma surface treatment is performed on a sealing region and a temporary adhesion region near the sealing region.

title: Method for accelerating general matrix multiply for quantization model based on codebook, and computing device therefor
abstract: A method for accelerating general matrix multiply (GEMM) for a quantization model based on a codebook, includes generating at least one input segment by reshaping an input activation vector, generating a partial sum book (Psum book) including partial sums corresponding to respective codes in the codebook of the quantization model by performing a matrix operation between the codebook and the at least one input segment, retrieving the partial sums corresponding to the respective codes included in a code matrix of the quantization model by referring to the partial sum book, and generating an output vector corresponding to the input activation vector by using the retrieved partial sums.

title: In-rush current limiter
abstract: Apparatuses and devices in heating, ventilating, and air conditioning systems are described. A device can include a rectifier including a first input interface configured to receive a first input signal and a second input interface configured to receive a second input signal. The device can further include a half-wave path configured to convert one of the first input signal and the second input signal into a half-wave output. The device can further include a low-pass filter (LPF). The device can further include a circuit connected between a rectifier in the power supply and the LPF. The circuit can include a plurality of resistance paths. The circuit can be configured to receive the half-wave output from the rectifier. The circuit can be further configured to, based on a current of the half-wave output, pass the half-wave output through one of the plurality of resistance paths.

title: Rechargeable battery and module of the same
abstract: A rechargeable battery, including an electrode assembly, a case accommodating the electrode assembly, a cap plate coupled to an opening of the case, the cap plate including a first vent, and an insulation member having a second vent, the insulation member being between the electrode assembly and the cap plate, the electrode and the cap plate being inside the case.

title: Aluminum Nitride Powder
abstract: An aluminum nitride powder, in which a cumulative volume 50% particle diameter (D50) in a particle size distribution measured with a laser diffraction scattering-type particle size distribution meter is 0.3 to 1.0 μm, a proportion of particles of 0.20 μm or less is 10% or less in volume frequency, a ratio of the D50 to an average primary particle diameter (Dp: μm) of 500 particles observed with a scanning electron microscope at a magnification of 20,000 times, D50/Dp, is 1.0 to 1.4, and an average circularity is 0.7 or more.

title: Filter device and imaging apparatus
abstract: A filter device includes: a first disk including a first neutral density filter; a second disk that is disposed to face the first disk in an optical axis direction, and includes a second neutral density filter; and a motor that gives a driving force to the first disk to rotate the first disk. In the filter device, an interlocking mechanism that enables the second disk to rotate with rotation of the first disk is provided. In this configuration, the first disk and the second disk are rotated by a single motor, and the filter device and an imaging apparatus can be made smaller in size with the reduced number of components and the simplified structure.

title: Compiler-Inserted Quiesce Vertices in Control Flow Graphs for Reconfigurable Processor Arrays
abstract: A method, system, and computer readable storage medium for operating an array of reconfigurable processing units with compiler-inserted quiesce boundaries. A compiler transforms a control flow graph of data processing operation into a transformed control flow graph by inserting into control flow graph additional vertices configured to sample whether a quiesce control signal has been received and to cause execution to wait at quiesce boundaries when the quiesce control signal has been received. Configuration data generated from the transformed control flow graph is loaded into the array to configure the array into execution fragment resource groups (EFRGs) that execute respective execution fragments. During execution the quiesce control signal is distributed to the EFRGs. In response to the additional vertices sampling that quiesce control signal has been received, execution waits at quiesce boundaries. The compiler may insert additional vertices in response to compiler directives, command-line options, or a configuration file.

title: Power Washer Assemblies and Methods
abstract: A pressure washer assembly that is operable in multiple modalities includes a pump assembly that communicates a pressurized flow to an unloader valve assembly. The unloader valve assembly includes a first unloader valve assembly and a second unloader valve assembly this is downstream of the first unloader valve assembly. The first unloader valve assembly is configured to generate a first pressurized fluid flow and the second unloader valve assembly is configured to generate a second fluid flow that operates at a considerably lower pressure than a pressure associated with the first pressurized flow. The first pressurized fluid flow is suitable for pressure washing operations whereas the second pressurized flow is suitable for lower pressure or soft-wash, or soaping, operations associated with use of the underlying pressure washer assembly.

title: Real-time multi-language transcription with collaborative editing
abstract: A computer implemented method of and system for processing multi-language audio data that includes a first audio segment that corresponds to a first language and a second audio segment that that corresponds to a second language. First transcript data is automatically generated for the first audio segment, including text representations of a first group of one or more spoken words, and timecode data. Second transcript data is automatically generated for the second audio segment, including text representations of a second group of one or more spoken words, and timecode data. The first transcript data and the second transcript data are combined into a transcript document that can be accessed together with the multi-language audio data at a client device.

title: Scale factor estimation device, scale factor estimation method, and storage medium
abstract: A scale factor estimation device for estimating a scale factor, which is a correction value used when detecting a physical quantity representing a motion state of an own vehicle based on information output by a vehicle sensor mounted to the own vehicle. The scale factor estimation device includes: a first physical quantity acquisition unit configured to acquire a first physical quantity calculated based on the information output by the vehicle sensor, a second physical quantity acquisition unit configured to acquire a second physical quantity calculated based on satellite positioning information of the own vehicle, a reliability estimation unit configured to estimate the reliability of target data including the first physical quantity and the second physical quantity, and a scale factor calculation unit configured to accumulate data and calculate the scale factor based on the target data estimated as having a high reliability by the reliability estimation unit.

title: Knee protector
abstract: A knee protector mounted to a structural vehicle body member includes a first portion, a second portion, and a third portion. The first portion extends rearwardly from the structural vehicle body member. The second portion extends rearwardly from a rear end of the first portion and has a lower rigidity in a vehicle front-rear direction than the first portion. The third portion is secured to a rear end of the second portion only at an upper portion of the third portion and extends downwardly from the upper portion. A rearward surface of the third portion extends from the upper portion to a lower portion of the third portion and is disposed to form a load input surface to which a load from an occupant's knee is input.
assignee: Nissan Motor Co., Ltd.; Asteer Co., Ltd.

title: Methods for coating removal
abstract: Methods are provided herein for coating removal. In some embodiments, the methods can be used to remove an environmental barrier coating (EBC). The methods of coating removal described herein can be used to remove a coating from a component using chemical digestion of the coating by a liquid reagent in a closed vessel. The chemical digestion is performed in the closed vessel at elevated temperatures and/or elevated pressures. Heat is applied to the closed vessel to achieve elevated temperatures to accelerate the digestion reaction. In some embodiments, heating is accomplished by applying microwave energy to the closed vessel.

title: Emotion filtering system
abstract: This system acquires voice data in real time with an acquisition unit and converts the voice into text with a conversion unit. An emotion recognition unit analyzes the text data and classifies emotions into positive, neutral, and negative. When a negative emotion is detected, a filtering unit adjusts the tone and pitch of the voice and converts it into a rational voice. Furthermore, a generation unit omits or summarizes irrelevant utterances and extracts only important information. An output unit provides the filtered and generated voice to a user, enabling the conversation to be continued in a form with reduced stress.

title: Transcatheter implantable blood pump and methods therefor
abstract: A transcatheter blood pump implantable within a subject's lumen defined by a subject's lumen wall. The transcatheter blood pump includes an impeller having an axis of rotation, a shroud having a first shroud end portion, a second shroud end portion, and a shroud internal passage extending between the first shroud end portion and the second shroud end portion, the impeller disposed within the shroud internal passage, an electric motor configured to rotate the impeller, the electric motor having a first motor end portion and a second motor end portion, the first motor end portion coupled to the second shroud end portion, and an electric driveline configured to transmit operating power to the electric motor to rotate the impeller. The electric driveline extends along at least one of the shroud and the electric motor and is coupled thereto.

title: Systems and methods for updating the configuration of a cloud service
abstract: The present disclosure facilitates improving the operation of a cloud service by updating its configuration information and its resource requirements. The resource utilization of the cloud service can be monitored, and a decision logic module can determine whether action is required. When action is required, an update can be prepared and applied, and notifications can be generated about the condition and its resolution. Resolutions can require correlation of multiple cloud services to provide real-time access to information that is not otherwise available to a single entity. Resolutions can be learned and predicted in a number of ways using a predictive engine.

title: Modeled conversions for a connection network system
abstract: Modeled conversions for connection networking are described. A method comprises generating a first input vector comprising a set of sequence features for a group of entities using a transformer layer of a machine learning model, generating a second input vector comprising a set of identity profile features for the group of entities using a generative artificial intelligence layer, receiving a third input vector comprising a set of conversion features, concatenating the first input vector, the second input vector, and the third input vector into a concatenated vector, normalizing the concatenated vector to form a normalized vector, projecting the normalized vector to form a projected vector, and generating a first metric based on the projected vector using a multi-gate mixture-of-experts (MMOE) layer of the ML model, the first metric comprising a value indicating whether there is a deterministic entity level conversion event for a group level conversion event.

title: Smoking substitute system
abstract: Disclosed is a smoking substitute system having a device comprising a controller configured to receive a command to enter a safety mode and, in response, disable at least one function of the device.

title: Magnetically actuated rising stem valve with physical position indication
abstract:
A valve including a magnetic actuation mechanism providing torque-limiting capabilities and physical valve stem position indication. A drive shaft of the valve is surrounded by a first magnetic array within a fully sealed pressure vessel. A second magnetic array is positioned outside of the pressure vessel and surrounds the fully sealed pressure vessel. The first magnetic array and the second magnetic array form a coupling mechanism. When the second, outside magnetic array is rotated, the first magnetic array is caused to move, actuating the valve. 
     Importantly, the second, outside magnetic array includes a physical position indication system able to determine the position of the valve.

title: Zoned electro-optic element
abstract: An electro-optic device includes a first substrate and a second substrate that face each other to define a gap. A lower electrode is segmented such that it defines a plurality of electrode segments including a first electrode segment and a second electrode segment adjacent to the first electrode segment. An upper electrode is segmented substantially the same as the lower electrode. An electro-optic medium is disposed in the gap between the lower and upper electrodes and switchable between states. A control system receives an instruction to switch the electro-optic medium in the first electrode segment and applies a higher electric potential and a lower electric potential to the first electrode segments. A high and low intermediate electric potential is applied to the second electrode segments, the intermediate electric potentials having an average electric potential equal to an average of the higher electric potential and the lower electric potential.

title: Optical device and projection device
abstract: An optical device includes a light-collecting element disposed on a first side of a virtual plane and a wavelength conversion element including a substrate, a wavelength conversion layer, and a counterweight structure. The substrate includes a geometric center and a wavelength conversion region surrounding the geometric center, and a top surface of the substrate is located on the virtual plane. The wavelength conversion layer is disposed on the wavelength conversion region. A first distance between the light-collecting element and the wavelength conversion layer is less than a second distance between the light-collecting element and the top surface of the substrate. A top surface of the wavelength conversion layer is located on the first side. The counterweight structure is connected to the substrate and located on a second side of the virtual plane opposite to the first side. A projection device including the optical device is also provided.

title: Unified test and debug chiplet architecture
abstract: Technologies for a unified debug and test architecture in chiplets is disclosed. In an illustrative embodiment, several chiplets are integrated on an integrated circuit package. The chiplets are connected by a package interconnect, such as a universal chiplet interconnect express (UCIe) interconnect. Each chiplet includes several debug nodes, which are connected by an on-chiplet network. One of the chiplets, referred to as a package debug endpoint, acts as a link endpoint for an off-package link, such as a peripheral component interconnect express (PCIe) link. In use, debug messages can be sent to the package debug endpoint over a PCIe link. The debug messages can be routed within the chiplets and between chiplets, allowing for the debug functionality at each debug node to be probed using a common protocol. In this manner, chiplets from different vendors can be integrated into the same package and tested using common software.

title: Electric motor having a stator housing
abstract: An electric motor includes a stator housing, and the stator housing has cooling fins. A holding plate is fastened to a first cooling fin of the stator housing and to a second cooling fin of the stator housing, the first cooling fin is mutually spaced from the second cooling fin, and an oil reservoir is fastened to the holding plate.

title: Machine learning for determining reference signal to be used by a ue
abstract: An apparatus comprising: means for performing, using a first set of reference signals and during a failure detection cycle, failure detection of a functionality associated with a machine learning model; means for receiving an indication of a second set of reference signals from a network during the failure detection cycle; means for measuring the second set of reference signals during the failure detection cycle; means for performing, using the second set of reference signals and during the failure detection cycle, failure detection of the functionality associated with the machine learning model.

title: Electrical converter with bypass safety
abstract: An electrical converter comprises conversion modules, with input nodes connectable to distinct sets of secondary windings of a transformer, and output nodes that connect distinct modules. For each module, a rectifier connects the input nodes to a DC bus, and an inverter is connected to the DC bus to supply the output nodes. A bypass circuit, in case of a fault, can connect the output nodes of the module to each other. A crowbar element, in case of a fault, connects the positive and negative pole conductors of the DC bus to each other, before activating the bypass circuit. A plurality of fuses are each placed in series with a respective rectifier element of the rectifier, to open rapidly when the crowbar element intervenes.

title: Semiconductor Structure
abstract: The invention provides a semiconductor structure, which comprises a plurality of magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ) elements. Seen from a top view, the MTJ elements are arranged in an array, at least one second contact structure is located in the array arranged by the MTJ elements, and at least one first mask layer covers a top surface and two sidewalls of each MTJ element, when seen from a cross-sectional view, a sidewall of the first mask layer is aligned with a sidewall of a second metal layer which is disposed below the second contact structure.

title: Secondary battery manufacturing system and method of generating roll map using the same
abstract: A method for generating a roll map includes: inputting search parameters of coordinate-associated measurement data, which is collected on the basis of the measurement of an electrode sheet and includes raw measurement data; and outputting the coordinate-associated measurement data on the basis of the search parameters. The search parameters include a start coordinate and an end coordinate that indicate a portion of the electrode sheet from which the coordinate-associated measurement data has been collected.

title: Aumano: Automatic Mail Notification System Using ESP-NOW Protocol
abstract: The invention provides a wireless mailbox notification system utilizing an ESP32-based transmitter and receiver, designed to alert users when their mailbox is accessed. The transmitter, powered by a rechargeable lithium polymer battery, includes a mercury switch that detects tilting when the mailbox is opened. The system communicates using the low-power ESP-NOW protocol, sending a signal to a receiver equipped with a visual LED indicator. The receiver is powered by a wall outlet and visually signals the user when the mailbox has been accessed. With deep sleep functionality, the system conserves battery power, allowing for up to 4 years of operation on a single charge. The system provides a simple, energy-efficient solution for mailbox monitoring, offering enhanced convenience and peace of mind for users without requiring frequent battery replacements or network setups.
assignee: Alan Kazemian; Jane Kazemian; Joe Kazemian

title: Weight sorting quantization error reduction
abstract: Systems and techniques are described herein for data processing. For example, a computing device can determine, based on characteristics of weights from a first matrix representation of a set of weights of a machine learning model, sensitivity levels of the weights; adjust an order of the first matrix representation to sort a subset of weights from the set of weights based on the sensitivity levels of the weights; process a portion of the first matrix representation associated with the subset of weights to adjust one or more weights from the subset of weights; and update the first matrix representation with the adjusted one or more weights from the subset of weights.

title: Multiple choice decision engine for an electronic personal assistant
abstract: To simplify assisting a user in their day-to-day activities, a communication for performing an action may be sent to a user in the form of a query, where the query includes the most likely set of choices for the action arranged in a group of dichotomous (e.g., yes/no) or multiple choice answers. In this manner, a user may respond to the query by simply selecting one of the dichotomous or multiple choice answers. Historical logs of past actions, responses, queries, and so forth, may be used to predict future user actions or needs, and to formulate future queries for sending to the user. These techniques may be implemented, for example, through a remote coordination server or directly through a user's personal electronics device.

title: Module mounting structure and electronic apparatus
abstract: A module mounting structure in which a module including a module board and a chip on the module board is mounted on a substrate, the module mounting structure comprises  a cover that covers a front surface of the module;  a relay connector board between a rear side of the module and the substrate; and wherein the cover, the module board, the relay connector board, and the substrate are in a stacked relationship, wherein the cover includes a cover rectangular portion and a cover bulging portion, wherein the module board includes a board rectangular portion and a board bulging portion, both of which are positioned to correspond with respective positions of the cover rectangular portion and the cover bulging portion.

title: Call classification through analysis of dtmf events
