The pottery base material contains at least a plastic raw material and feldspar, and is characterized in that the feldspar includes first feldspar having an average particle diameter in the range of 5.0-20.0 μm and second feldspar having an average particle diameter in the range of 2.0-4.0 μm, and the average particle diameter of the plastic raw material is in the range of 0.5-6.0 μm, wherein each of the average particle diameters is an arithmetic average of particle diameters and mass distributions measured by the sedimentation method. The pottery base material can provide a high-quality pottery having a complicated or characteristic shape and high designability in a stable manner.

title: Vehicle lower portion structure
abstract: A vehicle lower portion structure has: a suspension member; a battery disposed at a vehicle rear side with respect to the suspension member; a first protected portion disposed between the battery and a vehicle transverse direction central portion of the suspension member; a second protected portion disposed between the battery and an outer portion that is at a vehicle transverse direction outer side with respect to the vehicle transverse direction central portion of the suspension member; a first protecting member connecting the vehicle transverse direction central portion and the battery; and a second protecting member connecting the outer portion and the battery.

title: Flow cytometry nanoparticle event detection and evaluation from fluorescent response data
abstract: Blank flow cytometry data is analyzed excluding a portion of background signal data values for setting a minimum signal threshold requirement. Blank flow cytometry data is analyzed for setting a minimum peak width requirement. A detection condition for identifying stained nanoparticles from analysis of flow cytometry fluorescent response data includes a minimum signal threshold requirement and a minimum peak width requirement.

title: Implantable Medical Device Without a Wire-Wound Coil Configured to Receive Wireless Power from an External Charger
abstract: Implantable medical devices (IMDs) are disclosed which are capable of wirelessly receiving power from a magnetic field to power the IMD or charge its battery, but which do not use a wire-wound coil for magnetic field reception. The IMD can include a case housing control circuitry for the IMD, in which at least a portion of the case is conductive, with a case current formed in the conductive case portion in response to the magnetic field. The IMD includes power reception circuitry inside the case, and includes various examples of first and second electrical connections used to divert at least some of the case current as a power current to the power reception circuitry, thus allowing the power reception circuitry to use the power current to provide power to the IMD or to charge its battery.

title: Wide terminal resistor
abstract: A wide terminal resistor includes a carrier, a resistance layer, first and second inner electrodes, an insulating protection layer, and first and second outer electrodes. The resistance layer is disposed on the carrier, and includes a resistance functional area, and first and second electrode areas on opposite sides of the resistance functional area. The first and second inner electrodes are disposed on the first and second electrode areas. The first inner electrode includes a first body, a first pedestal, and a first bump. The second inner electrode includes a second body, a second pedestal, and a second bump opposite to the first bump. The insulating protection layer covers the resistance functional area and portions of the first and second inner electrodes. The first and second outer electrodes respectively cover the first inner electrode and the first electrode area, and the second inner electrode, and the second electrode area.

title: Method, Apparatus and System for Network Energy Saving
abstract: A wireless device may receive cell DTX DRX configuration parameters for cell(s) and a first configuration parameter of a first uplink logical channel indicating that arrival of data of the first uplink logical channel triggers a wake up request. The wireless device may determine, based on the cell DTX DRX configuration parameters, a network energy saving state for the cell(s). The wireless device may transmit, in response to arrival of data of the first uplink logical channel, a wake up request indicating a request to exit the energy saving state for the cell(s).

title: Information processing device, information processing method, program, image processing device, and image processing method
abstract: An information processing device includes: a sensor output estimation processing unit that estimates, on the basis of spectral reflectance information of a target subject and spectral information of a target light source, a sensor output that is output spectral information in a case where a spectral sensor has sensed the target subject irradiated with light from the target light source; and a derivation processor that obtains, as a computation algorithm of band-narrowing processing that is processing of estimating spectral information for a larger number of wavelengths than the number of output wavelengths of the spectral sensor on the basis of the output spectral information of the spectral sensor, a computation algorithm that minimizes an error between a wavelength characteristic indicated by post-band-narrowing spectral information obtained by executing the band-narrowing processing based on the sensor output and a wavelength characteristic indicated by the spectral reflectance information of the target subject.

title: Method and apparatus for video understanding, device and product
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method and apparatus for video understanding, a device and a product. The method comprises generating, by an image encoder, a plurality of image features based on a plurality of frames of a video. The method also comprises generating, by a multi-frame modality aligner, a visual token based on the plurality of image features, the visual token comprising a dynamic feature among the plurality of frames. Moreover, the method further comprises generating, by a language model, an understanding for the video based on the visual token.

title: Interconnect substrate and method of making the same
abstract: An interconnect substrate includes a core layer made of glass having one surface, another surface opposite the one surface, and a first cut-out located on an outer side of the one surface, and a first insulating layer disposed on the one surface of the core layer, wherein an inside of the first cut-out is empty.

title: Method for predicting chlorite growth based on microbial activity
abstract: The present application discloses a method for predicting chlorite growth based on microbial activity. The method includes: S 1 . generating a comprehensive data set by performing dynamic quantification monitoring of microbial activity and synchronous acquisition of environmental parameters based on a geological environment monitoring system; S 2 . establishing a kinetic model of microbial influence on chlorite nucleation and growth based on the comprehensive data set and molecular dynamics, and constructing a standardized training data set; S 3 . constructing a spatiotemporal prediction model of microbial activity based on the standardized training data set; and S 4 . dynamically updating and performing error correction on the spatiotemporal prediction model of microbial activity to obtain a final spatiotemporal prediction model. When prediction results indicate abnormal changes in chlorite growth rate or crystal morphology, a warning mechanism of the geological environment monitoring system is triggered, and monitoring frequency and sampling strategy are automatically adjusted.

title: Modular Battery Systems for Aircraft
abstract: A modular battery system includes an array of battery modules arranged in at least one stack. Each battery module includes a plurality of battery cells and opposing sides configured for electrical coupling, with a first side having positive and negative receptacles and an opposite side having corresponding positive and negative plugs. The plugs and receptacles are configured to enable adjacent battery modules in a side-by-side relationship to be electrically coupled through positive and negative connections such that the battery modules are connected in parallel. The array includes a first plurality of battery modules having battery cells of a first type and a second plurality of battery modules having battery cells of a second type different from the first type, enabling integration of differing cell characteristics within the modular system.

title: Loudspeaker assembly comprising multiple-drivers
abstract: A multiple-driver loudspeaker, for converting electrical signals into acoustic sound, comprising a plurality of driver assemblies, each driver assembly including a pair of drivers arranged on a common central driver axis bisected by a driver midpoint lying between the drivers, the plurality of driver assemblies including: a first group of driver assemblies in which the midpoint of each driver assembly lies on a perimeter of a first circular plane; and a second group of driver assemblies in which the midpoint of each driver assembly lies on a perimeter of a second circular plane; wherein the first and second circular planes each extends around a common central planer axis.

title: Channel usage policy for narrowband frquency hoppers
abstract: Channel usage for narrowband frequency hoppers may be provided. A plurality of channels in a network environment may be determined for Peer to Peer (P2P) traffic. A usage mode for each of the plurality of channels may be determined. The usage mode may provide an indication of a class of a medium access type recommended to use each channel of the plurality of channels. The listing of the plurality of channels and the usage modes associated with the plurality of channels may be provided to a plurality of client devices of the network environment.

title: Moisture meter
abstract: A moisture meter includes a moisture meter body  2  including a housing  20  and a mass detection unit accommodated therein that detects a load, a pan receiver  25  attached to the mass detection unit on an upper surface of the housing  20 , a sample pan  26  removably placed onto the pan receiver  25 , a cylindrical windshield wall  29   b  provided around the sample pan, and a cover portion  4  that is openably/closably provided on the housing, has accommodates a heating light source therein, covers the sample pan  26  in a closed state, and defines a heating chamber. The windshield wall  29   b  has a surface thermal reflectance of less than 50%.

title: Fuel additive composition and related methods
abstract: The invention relates to a fuel additive composition and a method of enhancing the properties of fuel. The composition includes a hydrophilic absorbent, a lubricant, an octane adjuster, an trialkyl benzene, a dispersant, a polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon, a fatty acid methyl ester, petroleum distillates, a mineral oil, and an elastomeric polymer. The method involves adding the fuel additive composition to the fuel, where each component performs a specific function to improve the fuel's properties.

title: Generation of maxillofacial imaging volume with motion
abstract: Various aspects of systems, methods, and related aspects to generate a maxillofacial imaging volume with motion, from a three-dimensional (3D) extra-oral x-ray system, are described. One example technique includes: obtaining imaging data of a patient, captured during movement of an upper jaw and the lower jaw of the patient; establishing a motion model that defines an expected movement of the upper jaw relative to the lower jaw; segmenting the imaging data into at least an upper jaw segment corresponding to the upper jaw and a lower jaw segment corresponding to the lower jaw, based on the expected movement defined by the motion model; performing motion artifact correction separately on the upper jaw segment and the lower jaw segment; and outputting an imaging volume that includes an artifact-corrected representation of the upper jaw segment and an artifact-corrected representation of the lower jaw segment.
assignee: Markus Hülsbusch; Susanne MAUR; Christian Beckhaus

title: Method for task processing, electronic apparatus and storage medium
abstract: A method for task processing, an electronic apparatus and a storage medium are provided. The method includes: determining a first computing density level for processing one task or a plurality of tasks; gradually increasing a computing density of a computing unit for processing the one task or the plurality of tasks to the first computing density level within a first time period before processing the one task or the plurality of tasks; processing the one task or the plurality of tasks by the computing unit; and gradually reducing the computing density of the computing unit to a second computing density level within a second time period after completion of processing the one task or the plurality of tasks.

title: Solar rail rapid install design
abstract: Methods and systems are described herein for coupling a plurality of solar module frames to a torque tube via a rail. The rail includes a plurality of rotatable clamps configured to rotate from a first, open position to a second, closed position. When the plurality of rotatable clamps are in the second position, the plurality of rotatable clamps are placed over each of the solar module frames thereby securing the plurality of solar module frames to the rail, and thereby the torque tube.

title: Vipr2 antagonist peptide
abstract: A method for treating or preventing central nervous system diseases in a mammal comprising administering a therapeutically effective amount of a cyclic peptide of formula (17), or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt or prodrug thereof, that activates VIPR2, wherein the cyclic peptide comprises an amino acid sequence represented by c[X 1 -Pro-X 3 -Tyr 4 -Leu 5 -Pro 6 -c (X 7 —X 8 -Leu 9 -Cys 10 ]-X 11 )—X 12 —X 12 , wherein X 1  is cysteine, Mpa, or D-cysteine; X 3  is selected from N-methylglycine, N-methylalanine, azetidine-2-carboxylic acid, proline, hydroxyproline, dehydroproline, pipecolic acid, serine, or lysine; X 8  is tyrosine, proline, or arginine; X 7  and X 11  are selected from combinations of basic and acidic amino acids; and X 12  and X 12  are each leucine, isoleucine, or norleucine, the peptide forming a bicyclic structure via a disulfide bond and an amide bond, and optionally having modified termini.

title: Electronic device and method of operating the same
abstract: An electronic device obtains, based on a neural network, a feature corresponding to an object from at least one frame among frames corresponding to content, detects the object from another frame of the content based on the obtained feature corresponding to the object, and performs an image processing on the object or an image surrounding the object such that the object is distinguished in another frame in which the object is obtained.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method for semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a first lead, a second lead, a third lead, a semiconductor element, a sealing resin and a coating layer. The sealing resin has a bottom surface and an outer side surface. The bottom surface of the sealing resin is formed with a recess having an inner side surface. The second lead includes a reverse surface exposed at the bottom surface and a side surface exposed at the outer side surface. The coating layer contains a metal element and covers the reverse surface and the side surface. The recess is located between the first lead and the second lead. The second lead and at least one of the first lead and the third lead have inner end surfaces exposed at the inner side surface.

title: Input queue masks for processing commands
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for input queue masks for processing commands are described. The memory system may implement a bitmask to indicate which input command queues include commands and are associated with credited QoS scheduling table entries. For example, a logical operation may be performed on a bitmask indicating which entries of a QoS scheduling table include credits and a bitmask indicating which of the input command queues of the memory system store commands. The results of the logical operation may indicate which of the input queues store commands and are associated with an allocation credit. Rather than accessing each input command queue associated with credited QoS scheduling entries, the memory system may access input command queues indicated by the result of the logical operation.

title: Systems and methods for real time deepfake identification in virtual meetings
abstract: An authenticating application sends instructions to a device application to cause a device to generate and emit a signal in response to receiving access credential of a user to a virtual meeting. Subsequently, the authenticating application receives in real time from the virtual meeting, audio-visual data associated with the access credential. The authenticating application searches the audio-visual data for the signal. Responsive to finding the signal in the audio-visual data, the application categorizes the access credential as authentic and allows the access credential into the virtual meeting. Responsive to not finding the signal in the audio-visual data, the authenticating application categorizes the access credential as unauthentic and rejects the access credential from the virtual meeting.

title: Silicon-carbon negative electrode material and preparation method therefor, negative electrode plate, electrode, and power consuming apparatus
abstract: The present application relates to the field of batteries and provides a silicon-carbon negative electrode material and a preparation method therefor, a negative electrode plate, an electrode, and a power consuming apparatus. The silicon-carbon negative electrode material includes porous carbon and silicon particles attached to pore walls of the porous carbon. A crystal phase exists in the silicon particles and a degree of crystallinity is at least 90%. An average grain size of the silicon particles is less than 4 nm. The silicon-carbon negative electrode material can enable batteries to obtain both good cycling stability and high first coulombic efficiency.

title: Method for decelerating a vehicle combination
abstract: A method is for decelerating a vehicle combination including a tractor vehicle and a trailer vehicle. A tractor vehicle brake control unit determines a total braking force, which is to be applied jointly by a trailer brake system and a tractor vehicle brake system, when a desired deceleration is received. The brake control unit causes the trailer brake system to apply a trailer braking force and determines a tractor vehicle braking force taking into account the currently effective trailer braking force and adjusts the tractor vehicle braking force by actuating the tractor vehicle brake system. A brake control unit is for the tractor vehicle of a vehicle combination. In order to achieve the desired deceleration more quickly, in a first braking phase after receiving the desired deceleration, the tractor vehicle braking force is initially adjusted to a higher braking force level than is provided according to the braking force distribution.

title: Archaeal peptide recombinase – a novel peptide ligating enzyme
abstract: The present invention relates to the provision of new means and methods for enzymatic peptide-peptide ligation. In particular, the present invention provides a novel family of transpeptidase enzymes, herein subsequently also referred to as Adriase (Archaeal Peptide Recombinase), transpeptidase or polypeptide recombinase. The members of the Adriase family, which are characterized by an N-terminal DUF2121 domain with an N-terminal serine or threonine residue were surprisingly found to recombine and ligate substrate peptides in a sequence specific manner via a short DUF2121 recognition motif. This way, compounds like proteins, synthetic compounds and/or whole cells may be linked specifically as long as they contain the motif or the parts thereof recognized by an Adriase enzyme. The ligation reaction described herein can be used to engineer novel molecules in a modular way, with broad applications in both research and pharmacology.
assignee: MAX-PLANCK-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der Wissenschaften e.V.

title: Traveling state determination apparatus and vehicle
abstract: A traveling state determination apparatus configured to be applied to a vehicle includes a memory and a control processor. The memory is configured to hold vehicle behavior data acquired by a vehicle sensor configured to detect a behavior of the vehicle. The control processor is configured to determine swaying of the vehicle during traveling, based on the vehicle behavior data held in the memory. The control processor is configured to perform: a first determination process of determining the swaying of the vehicle, based on a change in a distance of the vehicle with respect to a division line provided on a road surface on which the vehicle travels; and a second determination process of determining the swaying of the vehicle, based on the vehicle behavior data, when the division line is not detected.

title: Bending mechanism and endoscope
abstract: A bending mechanism extending along an axis from a first side to a second side includes a first tube bendable by a wire being pulled, a cylindrical first guide disposed in the first tube along the axis to guide the wire, a second guide coupled to the first tube to hold the first guide, a second tube disposed along the axis closer to the first side than the first tube, and a third guide disposed in the second tube along the axis. The first guide is inserted into the third guide and extends beyond a first-side end of the first tube to an intermediate position in the third guide. A portion of the first guide inside the third guide has, when the first tube is straight, a length sufficient to maintain a first-side end of the first guide inside the third guide even when the first tube is bent.

title: Power supply generator assist
abstract: The disclosed system and method reduce on-chip power IR drop caused by large write current, to increase the write IO number or improve write throughput and to suppress write voltage ripple at the start and end of a write operation. The disclosed systems and methods are described in relation to stabilizing the bit line voltage for MRAMs, however, the disclosed systems and methods can be used to stabilize the bit line voltage of any memory configuration that draws large currents during short write pulses or, more generally, to selectively assist a power supply generator in supplying adequate power to a load at times of large power consumption.

title: Faucet toy implementing circulating water outflow
abstract: A faucet toy implementing circulating water outflow includes a base and an upper cover. A faucet and a water leakage piston are arranged on two sides of the upper cover respectively. A first valve mechanism, a second valve mechanism, a water pump mechanism, and a waterproof switch mechanism are arranged in an inner cavity defined by the base and the upper cover. According to the present application, functions of turning on the faucet for water outflow and pressing the water leakage piston for water draining can be implemented, and not only can internal and external bidirectional waterproofing of the power supply mechanism be implemented, but also the technical problem that water outflow from the faucet is intermittent due to air inclusion during water pumping can be solved.
assignee: Goldlok ZhiChen Cultural Creativity (ShenZhen) Co., Ltd.

title: Method and apparatus for transmitting or receiving scheduling information based on hyper block structure in ultra wideband wireless network system
abstract: Disclosed are a method and apparatus for transmitting or receiving scheduling information based on a hyper block structure in an ultra wideband (UWB) wireless network system. The method performed by a first device in the UWB wireless network system, according to an embodiment of the present disclosure, may comprise the steps of: generating, by the first device, a first information element (IE) including information about a block structure configured in one or more ranging blocks and a second IE about scheduling in the block structure; and transmitting a frame including the first IE and the second IE to one or more second devices. Here, the second IE may include an element including scheduling information based on a ranging block unit in the block structure, for each device.

title: Detecting errors in device identification
abstract: A first connected device is identified based on a first data transmission to a first customer-premises equipment of a network. A second connected device is identified based on a second data transmission to a second customer-premises equipment of the network. In response to detecting additional data related to the first connected device and the second connected device, it is determined whether one of a false negative identity error or a false positive identity error was made in identifying the second connected device based on the second data transmission to the second customer-premises equipment of the network.

title: Integrated circuit structure with backside via
abstract: An integrated circuit (IC) structure includes a gate structure, source/drain epitaxial structures, a front-side interconnection structure, a backside dielectric layer, and a backside via. The source/drain epitaxial structures are respectively on opposite sides of the gate structure. The front-side interconnection structure is on front-sides of the source/drain epitaxial structures. The backside dielectric layer is on backsides of the source/drain epitaxial structures. The backside via extends through the backside dielectric layer to one of the source/drain epitaxial structures, and has a maximal lateral dimension larger than a lateral dimension of the source/drain epitaxial structure.

title: Methods and apparatus of local illumination compensation model inheritance for video coding
abstract: A method and apparatus for inheriting LIC parameters are disclosed. According to the method, an LIC (Local Illumination Compensation) prediction candidate with inherited LIC parameters inherited from the LIC parameters of the inherited block is derived. The current block is encoded or decoded using a candidate list comprising the LIC candidate, wherein when the LIC candidate is selected for the current block, a predictor for the current block is generated by applying the inherited LIC parameters to a reference block. According to another method, a merge list consisting of LIC parameters of spatial neighbouring blocks, non-adjacent neighbouring blocks, temporal neighbouring blocks, and history-based blocks is generated.

title: Scalable agentic framework for enterprise artificial intelligence
abstract: The disclosed system addresses these limitations by providing a system and method for automatically generating an agentic framework, including the agents within that framework. The framework organizes and governs the behavior of agents that independently or collaboratively interact with machine learning models, retrieve and process information, and execute tasks in an adaptive and context-aware manner. Agents generated with a specific role, enabling them to perform specialized functions such as task decomposition, response refinement, external tool integration, or decision-making. Agents are also associated with machine learning models appropriate for agent-related tasks. By using direct preference optimization using both agent output and critiques of agent output in connection with large language models and ground-truth systems for accuracy validation, the framework iteratively improves the function of lower-complexity machine learning models.

title: Recess gate and interconnector structure and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present application provides a semiconductor device and a method for preparing the same. The semiconductor device includes a substrate having an active region; a recess gate structure disposed in the substrate and intersecting the active region; a bit line contact including a polysilicon stack and disposed on the substrate; a conductive pillar disposed over the substrate and electrically connected to the active region; a landing pad disposed on the conductive pillar and electrically connected to the conductive pillar; and a stack of dielectric layers disposed over the substrate and laterally surrounding the bit line contact. The polysilicon stack includes a first polysilicon layer and a second polysilicon layer disposed over the first polysilicon layer. The second polysilicon layer is in direct contact with the stack of dielectric layers.

title: Methods and compositions targeting LINC01929 to increase antigen presentation
abstract: Among other things, in general, specific anti-cancer immune cell responses associated with enhanced T cell killing (including increased antigen presentation, production of tumor-associated antigens by cancer cells, and increased PD-L1) is achieved by targeting a specific long non-coding RNA (lncRNA), the ENST00000592405.3 transcript, such as with, e.g., antisense oligonucleotides or siRNA.

title: Apparatus comprising a plurality of resonant tunneling diode elements, method of manufacturing such apparatus, method of operating such apparatus
abstract: An apparatus comprising a plurality of resonant tunneling diode, RTD, elements and a synchronization signal source configured to provide an optical synchronization signal to the plurality of resonant tunneling diode elements.

title: Method, device, and computer program for three-dimensional measurements in a skybox
abstract: There is provided techniques for 3D measurements in a skybox image rendering environment. The method is performed by a controller. The method comprises obtaining an indication for a 3D measurement to be made in the skybox image rendering environment. The method comprises identifying a start-point and an end-point in a panoramic image between which the 3D measurement extends by identifying opposite edges representing perimeters, or parts thereof, of the object. The method comprises determining a distance between the start-point and the end-point as a function of a first depth map corresponding to the start-point in the panoramic image and a second depth map corresponding to the end-point in the panoramic image.

title: Display substrate and display apparatus
abstract: The display substrate includes: a base substrate having a display region and a peripheral region surrounding the display region, the peripheral region including a pad region on one side of the display region; first selection units on the base substrate and in the peripheral region, each first selection unit including an input end and output ends; pads in the pad region; adapter lines in the display region, one end of each adapter line being connected to a corresponding pad, and the other end being connected to the input end of a corresponding first selection unit; first data lines in the display region; and data lead-in lines in the display region, one end of each data lead-in line being connected to the output end of the corresponding first selection unit, and the other end being connected to the corresponding first data line.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.; Beijing Boe Technology Development Co., Ltd.

title: Content claiming
abstract: As the number of applications developed by the organization increases, the computing resource costs for storing and maintaining applications may also increase significantly. The disclosed content claiming system provides a solution to reducing computing resources necessary to maintain and store content that is no longer needed by allowing users to claim ownership over content and confirm whether the content is still in use. For example, in the disclosed content claiming system, a user initiates the process of content claiming by accessing a user interface associated with a content claiming application, wherein the user interface displays a listing of content currently maintained by the organization. The user may then select unclaimed content objects based one or more preferences and provide attestations regarding ownership and usage. Content claiming helps organization make informed decisions regarding continued storage and maintenance of content.

title: Systems and methods for orthopedic implants
abstract: A system and computer-implemented method for manufacturing an orthopedic implant involves segmenting features in an image of anatomy. Anatomic elements can be isolated. Spatial relationships between the isolated anatomic elements can be manipulated. Negative space between anatomic elements is mapped before and/or after manipulating the spatial relationships. At least a portion of the negative space can be filled with a virtual implant. The virtual implant can be used to design and manufacture a physical implant.

title: Self-propelled road construction machine for handling paving material in a paving direction and method for operating a self-propelled road construction machine
abstract: A self-propelled road construction machine, in particular a road finisher or a feeder, for handling paving material in a paving direction with a pulsation device configured to execute a pulsation mode in order to cause a pulsation movement of at least one swivel part in the activated pulsation mode. A method for operating a self-propelled road construction machine, comprising activating the pulsation mode.

title: Declaration-based data routing for analysis modules
abstract: An embodiment receives, at an analytics service of a telemetry manager platform of an information handling system, from an analytics requestor, an analytics request comprising a datatype identifier. An embodiment requests, from a data service selected using the datatype identifier, data fulfilling the analytics request. An embodiment computes, using the data received from the data service in response to the requesting, the datatype identifier, and metadata of an analytics plug-in, a data quality score corresponding to the data received from the data service. An embodiment computes, using an analytics plug-in and the data received from the data service, an analysis result. An embodiment forwards, to the analytics requestor, the data quality score and the analysis result.

title: Threaded Part, and Contactor
abstract: A threaded part includes a body having first and second sides, a threaded hole extending perpendicularly through the body from the first side to the second side, and at least one groove formed in the body. The is configured to fit into a contactor pocket with the first side oriented toward the terminal screw, and the threaded hole oriented toward the terminal screw, and the at least one groove extends from the first side toward the second side of the body such that a depth of the at least one groove is less then a thickness of the body and the at least one groove extends over at least a thread of the threaded hole.

title: Optimizing the flow characteristics of liquid cleaning compositions
abstract: The present invention describes a hard surface cleaning composition comprising at least one acidic source in an amount ranging between 4% to 20% weight and at least one superwetting agent in amount ranging between 0.001 to 5% weight, wherein the composition is adapted to provide a contact angle ranging between 5 to 30 degrees when it is applied on hard flat surfaces.

title: Multilayer electronic component
abstract: A multilayer electronic component includes a body and an external electrode. The body includes a dielectric layer and an internal electrode alternately disposed with the dielectric layer. The external electrode includes a metal layer in contact with one end of the internal electrode, and an electrode layer disposed on the metal layer, the electrode layer including a conductive metal and glass. The body includes a groove portion in which the one end of the internal electrode is spaced apart from one surface of the body. The metal layer includes a first region disposed in the groove portion and a second region disposed on the one surface of the body. In a cross-section of the body, a length along which the first region and the one end of the internal electrode contact each other, is less than a length along which the first region and the second region contact each other.

title: Fish Stick Assembly
abstract: A fish stick includes a light emitting component, such as a lighted tip, near the leading end of the fish stick. The lighted tip includes a curved lens that directs some light around an attachment piece at the end of the fish stick and generally in  0 the forward direction parallel to the longitudinal axis of the fish stick. The fish stick may be made of a phosphorescent material and stored in a lit container with an LED and reflective surfaces. The fish stick may be made of multiple rods that are threadably engaged with each other and include a spring biasing element that increases the coefficient of friction between the threads of the rods. The fish stick may also be made of multiple rods that are threadably engaged with each other via collars.

title: Multiple Vertebra Tracking
abstract: In some embodiments, the invention refers to a method of image guided navigation. One non-limiting method comprises the steps of: equipping multiple vertebra bodies with patient localizers, segmenting the image data into vertebra body areas wherein segmentation may be performed manually or automatically, for instance by means of a segmenting neural network, and, instead of or in addition to, generating and storing a single, global coordinate system transformation during the patient registration process. In some embodiment, an individual coordinate system transformation for each localizer or vertebra body, respectively, is generated and stored.

title: Self-Contained Artificial Intelligence (AI) Executable to Automate Model Hosting, Deployment, and AI Life Cycle
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI) system generates a self-contained AI container packaged as an executable that can be installed on client devices or computing infrastructure. The AI container envelopes a set of components capable of performing one or more processes related to machine learning operations, including data collection, data processing, feature engineering, data labelling, model design, model training and performance optimization for underlying hardware, model deployment, and model feedback monitoring, and the like in a local environment of a client device or cloud environment of a computing infrastructure. The AI system packages the self-contained AI container as an executable that can be installed on client devices of any hardware configuration or operating system.

title: Compositions and methods of use for modified release minoxidil
abstract: The compositions and methods provided herein include a pharmaceutical formulation for oral administration comprising a daily dose of a modified release formulation of minoxidil or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. Also provided herein are pharmaceutical formulations for oral administration comprising a daily dose of a modified release formulation of minoxidil or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and one or more additional active agents. Also provided herein are methods of treating hair loss by administering to a subject in need thereof a daily dose of a modified release formulation of minoxidil or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. Further provided herein is a kit including a slow modified release vehicle comprising oral minoxidil or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

title: Membrane electrode for alkaline water electrolysis for hydrogen production and preparation method therefor, and electrolytic cell
abstract: The present disclosure provides a membrane electrode for hydrogen production by alkaline water electrolysis, a preparation method therefor, and an electrolytic cell. According to the method provided by the present disclosure, a membrane electrode with catalyst layers uniformly and firmly adhered to the surfaces of a membrane can be obtained via a direct coating and hot pressing. The membrane electrode is endowed with good stability, and the obtained membrane electrode exhibits a significantly reduced overpotential for water electrolysis. The method comprises the following steps: directly applying a catalyst slurry (catalyst slurries) onto both sides of a membrane, followed by drying and hot pressing the catalyst slurry (catalyst slurries) to form catalyst layers on each surface of the membrane to obtain the membrane electrode. The membrane is selected from a porous membrane or an alkaline anion exchange membrane; the catalyst slurry comprises a binder solution and a catalyst, wherein the binder solution is one or more selected from a perfluorosulfonic acid resin solution and a perfluorosulfonic acid ionomer dispersion, and the mass concentration of the binder solution is 5% to 30%; and the mass ratio of the binder solution to the catalyst is 1:1 to 4:1.
assignee: China Energy Investment Corporation Limited; National Institute Of Clean-And-Low Carbon Energy

title: Apparatus for producing an object by means of additive manufacturing
abstract: An apparatus for producing an object by additive manufacturing including a process chamber for receiving a bath of material configured to be solidified, wherein a surface level of the bath of material defines an object working area. A support positions an object to be produced in relation to the surface level. A plurality of solidifying devices are configured to solidify a selective part of the bath of material and operate in substantially the entire object working area. A controller individually controls each of the plurality of solidifying devices such that each device can operate on in a different part of the object working area. A method for producing an object using the apparatus.

title: Leakage Detection Device, Leakage Detection Method, and Related Computer System
abstract: A leakage detection device for a computer system includes a detection current generation circuit, coupled to a power line of a motherboard of the computer system, configured to generate a detection current; a voltage detection circuit, coupled to the power line, configured to detect a voltage value of the power line; and a control unit, coupled to the detection current generation circuit and the voltage detection circuit. When the computer system enters a first operating mode, the control unit controls the detection current generation circuit to output the detection current to the power line and controls the voltage detection circuit to detect the voltage value of the power line. This process determines a voltage variation curve of the power line relative to the detection current. The control unit then determines whether a leakage event occurs on the motherboard based on a voltage slope of the voltage variation curve.

title: Riding Jeans
abstract: A riding garment having an outer portion of a high density fabric weighing no less that 3 pounds per square yard and including no more than 2 percent elastomer that may include an inner support portion configured of a low density fabric weighing no more than no more than 3 ounces per square yard attached to a waistband fabric to reduce the coefficient of friction lessening clinging or folding of the open torso portion when worn. A feature of the riding garment includes one or more outer pockets disposed downwardly from a first opening in the outer layer and at least one cell phone pocket disposed underneath at least a portion of the periphery of the outer pocket to obscure and enhance security of a stowed cell phone.

title: Rotor Disc Device for Repelling Grinding Media for an Agitator System as Well as an Agitator System for Mechanical Activation and/or Grinding of Organic and/or Inorganic Substances and/or Mixtures of Substances in Chemical, Pharmaceutical, Food and/or Building Materials Applications
abstract: A rotor disc device for repelling grinding media for an agitator system, the rotor disc device including: a base disc, which has a disc thickness and a plurality of slot-shaped recesses, wherein the plurality of slot-shaped recesses each extend along the entire disc thickness, and wherein the plurality of slot-shaped recesses each have a slot width of about 90% or less of a diameter of the grinding media to be repelled, wherein the slot width is aligned perpendicular to the disc thickness; and a form-fitting connecting means, which is firmly connected to the base disc and is designed for rotationally fixed mounting on a stirrer shaft of an agitator system. Furthermore, the present invention creates an agitator system with such a rotor disc device.

title: Electronic device, electronic device system, and intonation control method
abstract: An electronic device includes at least one processor. The at least one processor: acquires: first pitch data corresponding to a pitch specification operation by a user on an operating element; syllable data that includes a plurality of syllables; and an intonation note level for each of the plurality of syllables, the intonation note level being specified by the user from among a plurality of intonation note levels corresponding to a respective plurality of pitches; generates voice waveform data corresponding to the each of the plurality of syllables based on second pitch data obtained by changing the first pitch data according to the intonation note level for the each of the plurality of syllables; and causes a vocalizer to vocalize based on the voice waveform data.

title: Display device
abstract: Disclosed are a display device and a pixel control circuit. The display device includes: a display panel having an arrangement of pixels, and each of the pixels may include: a light emitting element comprising a plurality of light emitting units connected in series through a common node; a driving transistor having a first electrode connected to a high potential driving voltage through a first node, a gate electrode connected to a second node, and the second electrode connected to an anode electrode of the light emitting element through a third node; a compensation transistor connected between the second node and the third node and configured to receive a first scan signal through a gate electrode; a switching transistor connected between a data line and the first node and configured to receive a second scan signal through a gate electrode; and a common node reset transistor connected between the common node and a common node reset voltage and configured to receive a third scan signal through a gate electrode.

title: Memory with fail indicators, including memory with led fail indicators, and associated systems, devices, and methods
abstract: Memory with fail indicators, and associated systems, devices, and methods are disclosed herein. In one embodiment, a system includes a plurality of memory systems and a host device. At least one of the memory systems includes a fail indicator connected to the host device via a side channel of the system. The host device is configured to detect an occurrence of a failure on the at least one memory system and to initiate activation of the fail indicator. The side channel can be an I2C or I3C side channel. The fail indicator, when activated, can provide a visual indication of the failure. For example, the fail indicator can include an LED that can be activated to emit light and provide an indication of the failure. A color of the light can correspond to a type, occurrence, or location of the failure on the at least one memory system.

title: Manifest-based app risk evaluation engine in a security management system
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer storage media for providing manifest-based app risk evaluation using a manifest-based app risk evaluation engine of a security management system are described. Manifest-based app risk evaluation refers to the process of analyzing an application's manifest file to assess security risks by examining manifest-based security factors of the application and assigning a risk score to guide deployment decisions. The manifest-based app risk evaluation engine enables manifest ingestion and validation, security analysis and risk scoring, and classification with reporting. In operation, a manifest associated with an application is accessed. The manifest is analyzed based on a plurality of manifest-based app risk evaluation rules. A risk score is generated for the manifest based on a plurality of manifest-based security factors that correspond to the plurality of manifest-based app risk evaluation rules. A risk report associated with the application is generated. The risk report is then communicated to a client.

title: Semiconductor device and method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a semiconductor chip having a first chip surface facing a first side of a first direction and having a second chip surface facing a second side of the first direction. A first electrode terminal faces the first chip surface in the first direction, and a second electrode terminal faces the second chip surface in the first direction. A bonding material of solder bonds the semiconductor chip and each of the first electrode terminal and the second electrode terminal. The bonding material includes first and second bonding materials. The first includes a first bonding layer bonded to the first chip surface. The second includes a second bonding layer that bonds the first bonding layer and the first electrode terminal. A weight proportion of lead in the second bonding material is less than a weight proportion of lead in the first bonding material.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba; Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation

title: Container lid with scale
abstract: A storage container for spices, herbs and other consumables has a removable airtight lid with a built-in digital scale on top and a recessed storage compartment on the bottom to hold a humidity stabilizer which controls the humidity inside the container to help preserve the material stored in the container. A protective cover in the form of a flip top lid covers and protects the digital scale. A weighing tray is removably stored inside the protective cover where it is detachably secured by a pair of arms or by magnets. The tray can be selectively detached from the cover and placed on the scale to hold the material being weighed. The tray has a handle and a funnel for dispensing material from the tray in a controlled manner.

title: Substance-in-blood concentration measurement method
abstract: A substance-in-blood concentration measurement method for measuring concentration of a substance in blood of a living body, includes placing the living body that includes a measurement target portion inwards of an epidermis, irradiating the measurement target portion with a laser beam, optically forming an image of light reflected from the measurement target portion onto a photodetector using a first lens between the measurement target portion and the photodetector, and receiving the reflected light with the photodetector and detecting intensity of the reflected light. Prior to optically forming the image, the method includes adjusting an optical path length from the measurement target portion to the photodetector so that the light reflected from the measurement target portion forms a focused image on the photodetector. The photodetector is a two-dimensional infrared sensor array in which a plurality of light receiving elements are arranged in a matrix on a light receiving surface.

title: Image processing method, image processing device, and image processing program
abstract: An image acquisition device includes a relationship calculation unit that calculates relationship data between pixel values in an image and a statistical value of the pixel values, and a parameter setting unit and a filter processing unit that process an image to be processed. The parameter setting unit and the filter processing unit specify the statistical value for each pixel of the image on the basis of a pixel value for each pixel of the image and the relationship data, set parameters of an edge-preserving smoothing filter for each pixel of the image on the basis of the specified statistical value, and process the image using the edge-preserving smoothing filter in which the parameters are set for each pixel of the image.

title: Method and system for surgical planning
abstract: Some embodiments are directed to a method enabling surgical planning using a 3D model. A visibility specification may be determined for displaying the 3D model, the visibility specification comprising a rendering mode for the multiple segmented anatomic structures in the 3D model, wherein the rendering mode for the multiple segmented anatomic structures may be determined from the anatomic structure of interest and the zoom level.

title: Improved detection of surface features on manufactured parts on a production line
abstract: A system for vision-based inspection of manufactured parts on a production line includes an image renderer that generates multiple synthetic camera images of a part utilizing a CAD model of the part by simulating the inspection environment and the one or more cameras based on randomization of a number of operational and environmental parameters. An image labeler generates annotations i the synthetic camera images by automatically detecting nominal surface features on the part in the synthetic camera images. An image blender randomly superimposes background textures and/or artifacts on a part surface, which are obtained from a set of real images, on the synthetic camera images. Subsequently, a model trainer uses synthetic camera images with the generated annotations to train a machine learning model for detecting nominal surface features on real images of manufactured parts on the production line.

title: Polymeric Film and Method of Making Same
abstract: A polymeric film has an orthogonal length and width. The polymeric film includes a substrate and a plurality of fins extending away from the substrate and substantially coextensive with the substrate along the length. The fins are arranged across the width. Each fin in at least a majority of the fins includes a first portion extending from the substrate to a tip of the fin opposite the substrate; and a second portion extending from the tip of the fin toward or to the substrate. The second portion is attached to the first portion proximate the tip and separated from the first portion proximate the substrate along at least a portion of the length. The first and second portions have different respective first and second compositions.

title: Subcutaneous anti-HER2 Antibody Formulations and Uses Thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a highly concentrated, stable pharmaceutical formulation of a pharmaceutically active anti-HER2 antibody, such as e.g. Trastuzumab (HERCEPTIN™), Pertuzumab or T-DM1, or a mixture of such antibody molecules for subcutaneous injection. In particular, the present invention relates to formulations comprising, in addition to a suitable amount of the anti-HER2 antibody, an effective amount of at least one hyaluronidase enzyme as a combined formulation or for use in form of a co-formulation. The formulations comprise additionally at least one buffering agent, such as e.g. a histidine buffer, a stabilizer or a mixture of two or more stabilizers (e.g. a saccharide, such as e.g. α,α-trehalose dihydrate or sucrose, and optionally methionine as a second stabilizer), a nonionic surfactant and an effective amount of at least one hyaluronidase enzyme. Methods for preparing such formulations and their uses thereof are also provided.

title: Space optimization between sram cells and standard cells
abstract: A method includes laying out a standard cell region, with a rectangular space being within the standard cell region. The standard cell region includes a first row of standard cells having a first bottom boundary facing the rectangular space, and a plurality of standard cells having side boundaries facing the rectangular space. The plurality of standard cells include a bottom row of standard cells. A memory array is laid out in the rectangular space, and a second bottom boundary of the bottom row and a third bottom boundary of the memory array are aligned to a same straight line. A filler cell region is laid out in the rectangular space. The filler cell region includes a first top boundary contacting the first bottom boundary of the first row of standard cells, and a fourth bottom boundary contacting a second top boundary of the memory array.

title: Storage device
abstract: A storage device includes a memory cell that includes: a first conductive layer; a switching layer; a third conductive layer; a resistive layer; and a second conductive layer in this order. The switching layer includes: a first oxide of a first element selected from among Al, Si, Ge, Zr, Y, Ta, La, Ce, Ti, Hf, and Mg; a second element selected from among Al, Zn, Sn, Ga, In, and Bi; and a third element selected from among Te, S, Se, and Sb. The switching layer includes first, second, and third regions. The first region is between the second and third regions. The sum of the atomic concentration of the second element and the atomic concentration of the third element in the second and third regions is greater than the sum of the atomic concentration of the second element and the atomic concentration of the third element in the first region.

title: Survival analysis as spot reliability measure
abstract: A method for selecting cloud computing spot instances that comprises collecting spot node lifecycle data, wherein the spot node lifecycle data comprise node creation times, node deletion times, interruption events, and node duration information; performing survival analysis on the spot node lifecycle data to generate survival functions that estimate probabilities of spot node interruptions over a specified time period, wherein the survival analysis utilizes right-censored data handling to account for nodes that are deleted before interruption occurs within the specified time period; calculating reliability metrics for different combinations of instance types and geographic regions based on the survival functions; filtering available spot instances in real-time based on predefined criteria the reliability metrics to generate a candidate list of optimal spot instances; and automatically selecting and integrating a spot instance from the candidate list of optimal spot instances for use based on the reliability metrics.

title: Velocity information neural exchange (vine) architecture
abstract: A Velocity Information Neural Exchange (VINE) Architecture is disclosed as a new frequency-based internet that utilizes healthier electromagnetic frequencies for the human body, enabling high-velocity resonant information exchange. The system includes a Quantum Transceiver Antenna (QTA) having a layered matrix of antenna pixels generating toroidal geometries operatively coupled to a Transceiver Discriminator (TD) assisted by an AI engine, able to simultaneously broadcast and receive a spectrum of frequencies. All information entering the VINE—is categorized into seven resonant neural pathways, (ECO-HEAL) Education, Communication, Open Market, Health, Energy, Arts and Entertainment, Lifeline (emergency response) encoded with Electromagnetic Holograms (EmH) for specific frequency bands, and assigned to designated resonant channels for broadcasting. The VINE provides children and adults with safe access to education, health, energy, shopping, communications and media by rejecting advertisements, profanity, offensive and irrelevant content while segregating information onto dedicated frequency bands for enhanced speed and precision. Methods for resonant information exchange are also disclosed.

title: Method for producing polycarbonate beads
abstract: The invention describes a method for producing polycarbonate beads using a chain extender. The polycarbonate beads have a low bulk density and are suitable for the production of moulded parts with good surface properties and good mechanical properties.

title: High current and low profile power connector
abstract: Electrical power connectors with compact depth, increased current capacity, and increased heat dissipation. An electrical connector includes one or more subassemblies each including a metal block. Fasteners engage cavities at a first surface of the metal block to couple an electrical terminal to the block. Other fasteners engage cavities at a second surface of the block to couple a conductor (e.g., a cable or busbar) to the block. The cavities at the first and second sides of the block (and their fasteners) are arranged with footprints that overlap each other. Because depth of the connector along its mating direction is partially determined by the fastener footprints, the depth of the connector is reduced by providing overlapping footprints. The width of the metal block may be large enough to receive the length of both sets of fasteners, so that the footprints can be overlapped without physical interference between fasteners.

title: Composite cathode active material for dry manufacturing process for secondary batteries and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a composite cathode active material for secondary batteries and its manufacturing method, which are for manufacturing a dry electrode for secondary batteries in a process-efficient manner. To this end, a method for manufacturing the composite cathode active material according to the present invention may include mixing carbon nanotubes and a cellulose-based organic matter with a first solvent to prepare a first solution, irradiating the first solution with ultrasonic waves to disperse the carbon nanotubes and the cellulose-based organic matter, introducing a second solvent to the first solution, the second solvent not being miscible with the first solvent and having a different boiling point therefrom, and mixing the second solvent therewith, to prepare a second solution in a pickering emulsion state, introducing a cathode active material to, and mixing the same with the second solution to prepare a first slurry, removing an internal solvent of droplets forming the pickering emulsion from the first slurry to prepare a second slurry, separating a solid-phase material and a liquid-phase material from the second slurry, and heat-treating the separated solid-phase material.
assignee: POSTECH Research and Business Development Foundation; Unist(Ulsan National Institute Of Science And Technology)

title: Optical sensor module having band-pass filter and process monitoring system having the same
abstract: In an optical sensor module having a band-pass filter and a process monitoring system having the optical sensor module, the optical sensor module includes an optical detecting part, a transmission filter part and a filter holder part. The optical detecting part has at least two optical detectors spaced apart from each other. The transmission filter part is disposed over the optical detecting part and has at least two transmission filters. The filter holder part is disposed over the optical detecting part, and the transmission filter part is mounted on the filter holder part. The transmission filters are spaced apart from each other and respectively disposed over the optical detectors. The transmission filters are disposed with different angles with respect to an incident light.

title: Hdac6-inhibited human regulatory t cells
abstract: Disclosed are compositions and methods for preventing graft versus host disease (GVHD) or allograft rejection in subjects receiving donor cells. Also disclosed are methods enhancing regulatory T (Treg) cells for use in preventing GVHD. Also disclosed are methods of suppressing alloreactive donor cells in a subject receiving transplant donor cells that involves adoptive transfer of the treated Treg cells. Also disclosed are enhanced Treg cells produced by the disclosed methods that have been engineered to express chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) polypeptide cells.
assignee: H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center And Research Institute, Inc.

title: Data transmission method, and base station, terminal, device and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of mobile communications. Provided are a data transmission method during a random access process, and a base station, a terminal, a device and a storage medium. The method comprises: receiving a random access preamble, which is sent by a user terminal; and sending a random access response to the user terminal, wherein the random access response comprises uplink grant information, the uplink grant information comprising configuration information of the number of repeated transmissions of Msg3, such that the user terminal determines the number of repeated transmissions of Msg3 according to the configuration information of the number of repeated transmissions of Msg3. By means of the method, the configuration of the number of repeated transmissions of Msg3 can be realized without adding additional signaling overheads, thereby improving the resource utilization rate.

title: Systems and methods for dynamic vehicular machine user interface
abstract: A vehicle is provided. The vehicle includes a plurality of sensors including a first sensor and a second sensor. The vehicle also includes a vehicle controller. The vehicle controller is programmed to (i) identify a current driver of a vehicle based upon information from the plurality of sensors; (ii) access a driver profile for the current driver; (iii) determine a vehicle familiarity level of the current driver based upon the driver profile; and (iv) present one or more items on a user interface based upon the driver's vehicle familiarity level.

title: Managing data transmissions with selectable modes
abstract: Methods, devices, subsystems, systems, and techniques for managing data transmissions with selectable modes are provided. In one aspect, a computing system includes: a host system, peripheral component interconnect express (PCIe) devices, and a PCIe controller having a PCIe switch coupled between the host system and the PCIe devices. The PCIe controller is configured to: set a mode of the PCIe switch to be a first PCIe mode using first mode data, and transmit, under the first PCIe mode, first data between the host system and at least one of the PCIe devices, and set the mode of the PCIe switch to be a second PCIe mode using second mode data, and transmit, under the second PCIe mode, second data between the host system and one or more first PCIe devices and third data between the host system and one or more second PCIe devices.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device employs first scan signals having a turn-on level that determines when pixels receive data voltages and second scan signals having a turn-on level that determines times for initializing anode voltages of light emitting elements in the pixels. An active period in a frame period is from a time when the pixels receive an initial first scan signal at the turn-on level to when the pixels receive a last first scan signal of the turn-on level. A blank period in the frame period is from when the pixels receive the last first scan signal at the last turn-on level to when the pixels receive an initial first scan signal of the turn-on level during a next frame period. The blank period is at least as long as a cycle in which each of the pixels receives the second scan signals at the turn-on level.

title: Sealing cap for container sealing and mason jar
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sealing cap for container sealing and a Mason jar, including a Mason jar body. A bottle mouth is provided at a top of the Mason jar body, and an accommodating cavity is formed inside the Mason jar body. The sealing cap is connected to the bottle mouth, and a through hole communicating with an interior of the Mason jar body is provided on the sealing cap. An air sealing valve is also connected to the sealing cap, and the air sealing valve is placed at the through hole to prevent air outside the Mason jar body from entering the Mason jar body through the through hole. By providing the through hole at a sealing cap middle, air circulation is performed between the inside of the container and the outside through the through hole. A one-way breathable membrane is attached to the through hole.

title: Lung airway bypass stent and method for implanting and using the stent to treat emphysema
abstract: A method for implanting a stent in an airway of a lung includes forming an opening in a wall of an airway of the lung and advancing a delivery tool through the airway wherein a distal end region of the delivery tool includes a catheter on which the stent, in a compressed configuration, is mounted and a sleeve extending over the catheter and stent. Also the distal end region of the delivery tool is advanced from the airway and at least partially through the opening in the wall of the airway and into lung tissue adjacent the wall. The stent is positioned in the opening by manipulating the distal end of the delivery tool. The sleeve is moved or the catheter is advanced to move a first flange of the stent to extend from the sleeve and be positioned in the lung tissue and to allow the first flange to at least partially expand from the compressed configuration. The sleeve is further moved or the catheter is further advanced such that stent is beyond the sleeve and the stent further expands from the compressed configuration into an expanded configuration.

title: Pharmaceutical containers including high cte sealing assembly encircling outer surface of container
abstract: A sealed pharmaceutical container includes a shoulder, a neck extending from the shoulder, a flange extending from the neck, and a sealing assembly. The flange includes an underside surface extending from the neck, an outer surface extending from the underside surface, the outer surface defining an outer diameter of the flange, and an upper sealing surface extending between the outer surface and an inner surface defining an opening in the sealed pharmaceutical container. The sealing assembly includes a stopper and a metal-containing cap securing the stopper to the flange. The stopper includes a sealing portion extending over the upper sealing surface of the flange and covering the opening, and a rim extending at least partially along the outer surface of the flange.

title: Medium- and long-term prediction method for electric vehicle charging load in consideration of orderly charging strategy
abstract: The present application discloses a medium- and long-term prediction method and system for an electric vehicle charging load in consideration of an orderly charging strategy, including: predicting a number of electric vehicles in a region, collecting daily driving mileage and power consumption mean values of the electric vehicles, and calculating a charging amount of the electric vehicles in a prediction year; determining, based on a Monte Carlo simulation method and travel patterns of the electric vehicles, a typical charging load curve of the electric vehicles in the region to be predicted; correcting the typical charging load curve of the electric vehicles in the region to be predicted according to an elasticity coefficient and a charging price in the prediction year; and obtaining the final electric vehicle charging load in the region to be predicted in the prediction year.
assignee: Electric Power Research Institute Of Hainan Power Grid Co., Ltd.

title: Cellular uptake of functionalized dna nanostructures
abstract: Described herein are DNA nanostructures (DN) functionalized with proteins and methods for cellular uptake. Cellular uptake of such DNs is linearly dependent on the cell size. The protein corona determines the endolysosomal vesicle escape efficiency of DNs coated with an endosome escape peptide.
assignee: Arizona Board Of Regents On Behalf Of Arizona State University

title: Automated External Defibrillator Device with Synchronized Cardioversion and Methods of Use
abstract: An automated external defibrillator system includes shock generating electronics, an electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring circuitry, and a controller for controlling operations of the shock generating electronics and ECG monitoring circuitry. The controller is further configured for receiving and analyzing ECG signals from the ECG monitoring circuitry, predicting timing of QRS complexes associated with the ECG signals, and directing the shock generating electronics to deliver an electrical shock in synchrony with the timing of the QRS complexes so predicted. In embodiments, the controller directs the shock generating electronics to deliver the electrical shock in synchrony with an R wave of the QRS complexes so predicted. In embodiments, the controller analyzes for ventricular fibrillation (VF) associated with the ECG signals, predicts a trend in VF peaks, and directs the shock generating electronics to deliver the electrical shock in synchrony with a VF peak according to the predicted trend.

title: Fuel cell
abstract: A fuel cell includes an end unit located adjacent to a cell stack. The end unit includes: a current collecting plate that is made of a conductive plate and has a current collector being a tongue; an insulating tray with a plate shape that includes a receiving recess that receives the current collector; an end plate that is made of conductive plate; and an end-side sealing that seals a gap between the receiving recess and the current collector. The current collecting plate, the insulating tray, and the end plate are stacked together in this order, starting from the cell stack.

title: Synthesis, fabrication, and surface hardening of complex refractory alloy materials
abstract: A complex refractory material includes at least four or more elements that have at least one miscibility gap, a spinodal microstructure, and a boride layer. The at least four or more elements comprise niobium, tantalum, tungsten, molybdenum, zirconium, chromium, vanadium, titanium, rhenium, iron, hafnium, and manganese. The at least four or more elements can undergo spinodal decomposition. The complex refractory material can undergo surface hardening by an ultrafast boriding process. The complex refractory material can have high hardness and toughness.

title: Retrofit microgrid interconnect device (mid) into square d common service entrance device (csed) panels stacked with main breaker
abstract: A method of retrofitting an electrical panel includes removing a main breaker from an interior, wherein the interior is installed a panel housing of the electrical panel. The method includes removing a first line strap from connecting a first line bus of the interior to a first line of the electrical panel and removing a second line strap from connecting a second line bus of the interior to a second line of the electrical panel. A microgrid interconnect device (MID) is installed onto the interior in a position formerly occupied by the main breaker. The main breaker is connected in electrical series between the first and second lines of the electrical panel and the MID.

title: Apparatus and method for manufacturing secondary battery
abstract: An apparatus for manufacturing a secondary battery according to various embodiments of the present disclosure may include: an electrolyte injection unit coupled to an injection port of a preliminary battery cell including a first electrode and a second electrode to inject an electrolyte; a power unit connected to the first electrode and the second electrode and configured to apply a voltage while the electrolyte is injected into the preliminary battery cell; a pressure control unit configured to regulate a pressure within the preliminary battery cell while the electrolyte is injected into the preliminary battery cell; a heating unit disposed on one side of the preliminary battery cell to heat the preliminary battery cell; and a control unit configured to control the application of voltage by the power unit.

title: Image positioning control method and system
abstract: A method of controlling an image positioning error in an optical system is described. The optical system comprises a first component, a second component and a third component arranged in an optical path of the optical system. The method comprises:—determining an image positioning error of the first component and feeding through of the image positioning error of the first component to a control loop of the second component to at least partly compensate the image positioning error of the first component; and—determining an image positioning error of the second component and feeding through of the image positioning error of the second component to a control loop of the third component to at least partly compensate the image positioning error of the second component.

title: Optical member driving mechanism
abstract: An optical system is provided, including a first movable part for connecting an optical element; a first base, wherein the first movable part is movable relative to the first base; and a first driving assembly for driving the movable part to move relative to the first base. The optical system further includes a light quantity control mechanism for controlling the quantity of light entering the optical element. The light quantity control mechanism further includes a base seat and a light quantity control assembly at least partially movable relative to the base seat. The optical system further includes a second driving assembly for controlling the light quantity control assembly.

title: Trajectory-Governed Reasoning Control in Persistent Cognitive Systems
abstract: A system and method for trajectory-governed reasoning control monitors reasoning trajectories through a geometric cognitive substrate in real time for epistemic coherence. A cognitive dynamics engine computes geodesic trajectories through a latent manifold under goal potential field influence. An epistemic connection on the manifold assigns transition-specific phase values encoding evidential consistency independently of semantic distance. A phase monitor accumulates epistemic phase along active trajectories, detecting coherence failures including phase drift, discontinuities, and holonomy descriptor conflicts. A loop classifier categorizes closed reasoning paths into coherent, drift, and inversion regimes, enforcing consolidation permission, corroboration requirements, or consolidation blocking respectively.
