abstract: The present invention relates to a combined massage structure comprising massage beads, spring body insulating holders and massage hole seats, wherein each of the massage beads includes a massage structure, a connecting member and a spring body, the massage hole seats are disposed on an massage base plate, the spring body insulating holders are arranged inside the massage hole seats, a twisting spring at one end of the spring body is snap fitted in the spring body insulating holder, and the other end thereof is connected with a straight spring arm cavity formed on the connecting member with a clearance therebetween, the massage structure is fixedly connected to an end of the connecting member opposite to the spring body, and the massage beads protrude above the massage base plate. The present invention also relates to a suspended triboelectric nanogenerating massage bead.

title: Camera Calibration Using Feature of Vehicle
abstract: A method includes capturing a first image of a feature of a vehicle using a first camera that is attached to the vehicle. The first image indicates a first transform between the first camera and the feature. The method also includes capturing a second image of an environment of the vehicle using a second camera that is attached to the vehicle. The method also includes determining a pose of the vehicle within the environment using the second image, a second transform between the second camera and the feature, and environmental information. The method also includes performing an action based on the pose of the vehicle within the environment.

title: Pharmaceutical compositions for clinical nutrition
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a pharmaceutical composition for providing phosphorus to an adult or pediatric patient, wherein the composition is an aqueous solution of sodium glycerophosphate which by virtue of an improved process for producing the active pharmaceutical ingredient and the pharmaceutical composition is characterized by a low amount of free phosphate, a low amount of SGP-related substances and by a low amount of aluminum. The pharmaceutical composition is used in clinical nutrition, preferably in the preparation of nutritional formulations by compounding. The compositions can further be used for preventing or correcting phosphorus deficiency (hyperphosphatemia) in said adult or pediatric patients.
assignee: Baxter International Inc.; Baxter Healthcare Sa

title: Method and apparatus for determining the section thickness of histological sections and determining the concentration of biological substances in histological specimens
abstract: The invention relates to a method for determining a section thickness of a specimen section in medical histology. In a further aspect, the invention relates to a method for determining the concentration of a target substance in a tissue contained in the specimen section, in particular for the diagnostic determination of the concentration in medical specimen sections. In a further aspect, the invention relates to an apparatus for measuring the section thickness of a specimen section and optionally for determining the concentration of a target substance in the specimen section.

title: Platform-agnostic data storage and retrieval in a multiplatform computing environment
abstract: A data storage system instantiates a graph data structure to store platform-agnostic atomic data units of organization-owned content in a multiplatform computing environment. Each atomic data unit can be accessed by any platform in the multiplatform computing environment and may be included in or referenced by any document, object, or other platform-specific data structure.
assignee: Atlassian Pty Ltd.; Atlassian Us, Inc.

title: Methods and apparatus for multihop layer-2 ue-to-ue relay unicast routing
abstract: A wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU)-to-WTRU (W2W) relay is configured to determine multihop connection information, and to provide a local WTRU ID for and end-to-end (E2E) source layer-2 ID (source WTRU IDa) and a local WTRU ID for an E2E target layer-2 ID (target WTRU IDa) to the source remote WTRU and a second W2W relay. The W2W relay is configured to store a route entry from the source WTRU to the target WTRU and from the target WTRU to the source WTRU in an L2 relay routing table, to create a next-hop WTRU ID mapping table, to receive a first packet from the source remote WTRU that comprises the source WTRU IDa and the target WTRU IDa, and to determine an egress link based on the source WTRU IDa and the target WTRU IDa in the SRAP header in the first packet and the L2 relay routing table.

title: Interface display method and related device
abstract: This application provides an interface display method and a related device. The method includes: when an electronic device is incapable of accessing a mobile communication network, displaying a first window in response to a user tap operation on a first icon on a first page. The first window includes a first option for connecting to a satellite. In response to a tap operation on the first option, a communication connection is established with the satellite, and a service corresponding to the first icon is executed.

title: Pixel circuit board, display device, and method for manufacturing pixel circuit board
abstract: A pixel circuit board ( 1 ) includes: a first power supply line (14) provided in an inactive area ( 10 ); a first power supply transistor (T 5 ) provided in an active area ( 30 ) and connected with a pixel power supply line ( 32 ); a first control line (En) extending from the inactive area ( 10 ) to the active area ( 30 ) and being electrically connected with a gate electrode (DG) of the first power supply transistor (T 5 ); and a first protection transistor (T 16 ) provided in the inactive area ( 10 ) and electrically connected with the first control line (En) and the first power supply line ( 14 ).

title: Channel estimation in communications
abstract: An apparatus ( 104 ) is disclosed, which may, based on an initial channel estimation of sounding signals ( 1301 ), perform channel extraction ( 1302 ) by extracting a propagation channel into a dominant resolvable cluster channel model and a residual channel model. The apparatus ( 104 ) may use the dominant resolvable cluster channel model as an input to precoding ( 1302 ) with a channel model precoder.

title: Polymerizable fused tricyclic compounds as absorbers of uv and visible light
abstract:
Described are polymerizable fused tricyclic compounds of formula I: 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     wherein R 1 , R 2 , R 3 , m, n, t, and rings B, C, and D are as defined herein. The compounds absorb various wavelengths of ultraviolet and/or visible light (such as high energy visible light) and are suitable for incorporation in a variety of products, such as biomedical devices and ophthalmic devices.

title: Drill bushing retention
abstract: A drill machine may include a drill deck having an opening for performing drilling operations. The drill machine may also include an outer bushing with a first flange and an inner bushing configured for being sleevably arranged within the outer bushing. The inner bushing may include an outer peripheral surface and a second flange arranged on a top end thereof and extending radially outward beyond the outer peripheral surface. The drill machine may also include a bit basket configured to retain the outer bushing and a deck wrench configured to retain the inner bushing. A method of drilling operations where the position of the inner bushing or sleeve is retained by the deck wrench is also provided.

title: Redox with Relative Hydrogen Sensors and Method
abstract: A gas treatment system may include a reduction unit, oxidation unit, sulfur removal unit, aqueous metal chelant stream and an rH sensor. The reduction unit may contact an influent gas stream with an aqueous metal chelant stream and release a treated gas stream separate from the aqueous metal chelant stream. The oxidation unit may be downstream of the reduction unit, and the oxidation unit may contact an oxidation stream with the aqueous metal chelant stream. An aqueous metal chelant stream may circulate from the reduction unit to the oxidation unit and downstream of the oxidation unit through the sulfur removal unit to the reduction unit. A system may include an rH sensor operatively connected to the aqueous metal chelant stream.

title: Apparatus and method for liquid application to a sheet material
abstract: An apparatus for liquid application to a sheet material is provided, the apparatus including: a nozzle configured to spray a liquid on a sheet material arrangeable below the nozzle; and a concave shield arranged around the nozzle, the concave shield including a collection channel provided at an inner periphery of the shield, the collection channel being arranged to run circumferentially along the inner periphery of the concave shield, and at least one drain hole being arranged in the collection channel and configured to drain collected liquid from the collection channel.

title: Bulk feeder
abstract: There is provided a bulk feeder including: a feeder main body, a track member detachably attached to the feeder main body and having a supply region which opens upward for supplying a component to be collectable; a shutter provided to be openable and closable on the track member and configured to close an opening of the supply region in a closed state; a movable member provided on the feeder main body to be movable in an opening and closing direction of the shutter; and a coupling section configured to couple the shutter and the movable member by attraction of a pair of magnets respectively provided at facing positions of the shutter and the movable member when the track member is positioned at a predetermined attachment position at the feeder main body.

title: Media collection generation and privacy mechanisms
abstract: Systems and methods described herein relate to generation of media collections in a messaging system. The media collection may be created by the user, other users, or an entity. Example embodiments further allow users to set access criteria through privacy settings assigned to one or more media content items themselves, as well as to a media collection, such that some or all of the media collection may only be viewed by users authorized by the user sharing the media content item or media collection (e.g., only to one or more users designated by the user as a “friend”).

title: Suspension device for ground rover mobility
abstract: A suspension device for a ground rover vehicle includes a pair of front wheels, a pair of center wheels, and a pair of rear wheels provided on a vehicle body. The suspension device includes main leaf springs disposed along a forward-backward direction of the vehicle body on both sides along a vehicle width direction of the vehicle body, the main leaf springs being pivotally connected to lower sides of the vehicle body, and to which the front wheels and the center wheels are connected. The suspension device further includes a sub-leaf spring disposed along the vehicle width direction at a rear of the mobility body, fixed to a rear lower part of the vehicle body, and to which the pair of rear wheels are connected.
assignee: Hyundai Motor Company; Kia Corporation; Inha University Research And Business Foundation

title: Linking of communications device subscriber identifiers for fraud detection
abstract: Briefly, example methods, apparatuses, and/or articles of manufacture may be implemented to detect and/or prevent fraud that involves a communications device. The method may include transmitting, from a client computing resource to an authenticator, a subscriber identifier suspected of participating in a first fraudulent transaction. The method may further include obtaining, from the authenticator, one or more subscriber identifiers previously or subsequently assigned to the communications device by a communication services carrier.

title: Methods and systems to optimize glucose monitoring using voice analysis
abstract: A method for monitoring a subject’s blood glucose level, comprising: receiving a voiceprint from the subject; correlating the received voiceprint to a determined blood glucose level for the subject, using a predefined correlation model; determining, by comparing the determined blood glucose level to a predetermined acceptable blood glucose level range for the subject, whether the determined blood glucose level is outside the predetermined acceptable blood glucose level range for the subject; and generating an alert when the determined blood glucose level is outside the predetermined acceptable blood glucose level range for the subject.

title: Auxiliary scanning and data correction apparatus and method for edentulous implant impressions
abstract: An auxiliary scanning and data correction apparatus and method for edentulous implant impressions are disclosed. The apparatus includes an arc-shaped base plate configured to conform to the tooth bed and palate of an edentulous patient; and the arc-shaped base plate is provided with a slot configured to accommodate scan bodies on implants. The data correction method includes: performing virtual segmentation on composite data according to the number of scan bodies to obtain segmented composite data segments corresponding to the number of scan bodies; finding correction standard data of an apparatus according to an identification number of the apparatus, and correcting the segmented composite data segments to obtain a corrected scan model; and assisting in implant treatment for an edentulous patient using the corrected scan model.

title: Adjustable fully upholstered chaise lounger
abstract: An adjustable fully upholstered chaise recliner is provided. The chaise comprises a stationary outer frame coupled to a platform. The platform is configured to move between a first position and a second position while the outer frame remains stationary. A cushion is coupled to the platform and is fully upholstered to the platform such that a cover material encloses the cushion and the platform. Movement of the platform causes one or more bending portions of the cushion to bend. The chaise further comprises one or more cords, each extending through the cushion with a first end coupled to the cover material and a second end coupled to the platform. The cords are configured to pull on the cover material such that movement of the platform from the first position to the second position does not result in bunching of the cover material near the bending portions of the cushion.

title: Integrated chip and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: An integrated chip including a photodetector and a transfer transistor, a source follower transistor, a first overflow transistor, a first LOFIC (lateral overflow integration capacitor), a second overflow transistor, and a second LOFIC. The transfer transistor includes a first source/drain coupled to the photodetector. The source follower transistor includes a first source/drain coupled to a supply voltage terminal, a second source/drain coupled to an output terminal, and a gate coupled to a second source/drain of the transfer transistor. The first overflow transistor includes a first source/drain coupled to the gate of the source follower transistor. The first LOFIC includes a first electrode coupled to a second source/drain of the first overflow transistor. The second overflow transistor includes a first source/drain coupled to the gate of the source follower transistor. The second LOFIC includes a first electrode coupled to a second source/drain of the second overflow transistor.

title: Ceiling basemat water reduction through strategic use of pressing and vacuuming
abstract: Water-felting systems and methods with significant energy savings and carbon emission reduction for producing ceiling tiles with improved green strength, the methods including: felting a green ceiling basemat on a foraminous wire conveyor; drawing water out the green ceiling basemat by free drainage; compressing the green ceiling basemat with a first press to a first caliper; compressing the green ceiling basemat with a second press to a second caliper, the second caliper being the final caliper for the green ceiling basemat; after the final caliper has been achieved with the second press, drawing water out the green ceiling basemat by applying suction generated with one or more vacuum boxes operably connected to a set of vacuum pumps; and drying the green ceiling basemat in a dryer.

title: Cathode material and battery
abstract: Provided is a cathode material and a battery. The cathode material has a mass content of free nitrate radical represented as Q ppm, where 10≤Q≤100. In a particle size number distribution curve of the cathode material, the cathode material has a first characteristic peak and a second characteristic peak, where the first characteristic peak is located within a range of 0.1 μm to 1 μm, excluding 1 μm, and the second characteristic peak is located within a range of 1 μm to 4 μm. The cathode material simultaneously possesses excellent high-voltage resistance performance, structural stability, and cycling stability performance.

title: Communication system, information processing apparatus, and display control method
abstract: A communication system includes a first information processing apparatus including first circuitry and a second information processing apparatus including second circuitry. The first circuitry receives a wide-view image captured by an image capturing apparatus in a case where the first information processing apparatus starts participating in communication, accepts an operation for specifying a predetermined area in the wide-view image, causes a first display to display the predetermined area, and transmits first point-of-view information for specifying the predetermined area after the operation is accepted. The second circuitry receives the wide-view image and second point-of-view information in a case where the second information processing apparatus starts participating in the communication after the communication has already started, the second point-of-view information being based on the first point-of-view information, and causes a second display to display the predetermined area specified by the received second point-of-view information in the wide-view image.

title: Determination device
abstract: A probe includes a substantially columnar probe main body configured to detect an impedance of a bearing by coming into contact with a measurement target surface of the bearing, a housing having therein a sliding hole extending in an axial direction, the housing being configured to accommodate the probe main body disposed in the sliding hole, an abutting portion provided at a distal end portion of the housing and configured to abut against the measurement target surface of the bearing, and a biasing spring disposed in the sliding hole of the housing and configured to bias the probe main body in the axial direction with respect to the housing, the abutting portion includes four protrusions protruding in the axial direction, and when viewed from the axial direction, the four protrusions are respectively positioned at vertices of a rectangle centered on a central axis of the probe main body.

title: Communication method and apparatus
abstract: The present application relates to communication methods and communication apparatuses. An example method includes: receiving, by a second node, first information respectively corresponding to at least one first node; determining a reference unit based on the first information respectively corresponding to the at least one first node; and sending second information to each of the at least one first node. The first information includes information about the at least one first node and sensing information corresponding to a sensing link, the sensing information includes information about N scatterers and/or information about M scatterer groups, N and M are positive integers, and the at least one first node is a receiving node of a sensing signal on the sensing link. The second information indicates a location calibration value of each scatterer of the N scatterers and/or each scatterer group of the M scatterer groups relative to the reference unit.

title: Apparatus and method for selecting congress chair in blockchain distributed consensus
abstract: Disclosed herein is an apparatus and method for selecting a consensus congress chair in blockchain distributed consensus. The apparatus receives a consensus message from a consensus congress chair node for distributed consensus of a blockchain, proceeds with the distributed consensus based on response messages of participating nodes to the consensus message, determines a participating node that does not transmit the response message to be a faulty node, and selects a new consensus congress chair node based on the position values of the faulty node and normal nodes in a block.

title: Door body assembly for embedded refrigeration apparatus and embedded refrigeration apparatus
abstract: A side-by-side door body assembly for an embedded refrigeration apparatus includes a pair of box doors and a pair of door panels. The box doors are rotatably connected to a refrigeration body configured to be embedded in an accommodating space defined by a mounting body. Each door panel is movably mounted on a corresponding box door and is configured to move in the width direction of the box door. Each door panel comprises a first interference position and a second interference position. When the box doors are in the closed position, a gap δ is formed between the end faces of the door panels on the opening side, and a gap δ′ is formed between the hinge-side end face of each door panel and the corresponding side wall of the accommodating space. The gaps δ and δ′ are each greater than respective preset movement distances γ and λ before the interference positions exit the accommodating space.
assignee: Hefei Midea Refrigerator Co., Ltd.; Hefei Hualing Co., Ltd.; Midea Group Co., Ltd.

title: Phototherapy device for inhibiting or preventing alzheimer's disease
abstract: A phototherapy device for inhibiting or preventing Alzheimer's disease. The phototherapy device includes a support mechanism and an array of near-infrared irradiation units. The support mechanism forms an accommodating space for a subject's head and supports the array, which is configured to emit near-infrared light into the accommodating space. When the subject's head is positioned in place, the array forms an irradiation spatial range covering at least the anterosuperior cranial, the cranial vertex, together with the left the right lateral cranial region. The time-averaged total radiant power incident upon the calvarial surface of the subject's head is at least 27.5 W, and the spatiotemporally averaged irradiance over each region is 35-230 mW/cm 2 . Irradiation is delivered to an outer thin layer surface adjacent to the hair or scalp.
assignee: Danyang Huichuang Medical Equipment Co., Ltd.

title: Crossarm assembly and power transmission tower
abstract: A crossarm assembly includes: a fitting assembly; a first insulator having an end connected to the fitting assembly; a second insulator having an end connected to the fitting assembly, the second insulator being located below the first insulator; a first hinged member connected to another end of the first insulator, the first hinged member being configured to connect a tower body of a power transmission tower, and the first insulator being rotatable relative to the tower body of the power transmission tower; and a second hinged member connected to another end of the second insulator, the second hinged member being configured to connect the tower body of the power transmission tower, and the second insulator being rotatable relative to the tower body of the power transmission tower.
assignee: Shanghai Shemar Power Engineering Co., Ltd.

title: Channel utilization information for an operating bandwidth
abstract: This disclosure provides methods, components, devices and systems for providing and using channel utilization information (CUI) which includes CUI for the primary channel and granular level CUI for each secondary channel in an operating bandwidth. In some aspects, a network device may use the CUI to improve the performance of any combination of a device association process, an operating bandwidth reduction process or a process to select an optional primary channel in a non-primary channel access (NPCA) scheme, among other device and network actions.

title: Systems and methods for image processing
abstract: A method for image processing is provided. The method may include: obtaining an initial image; and generating a target image by processing the initial image using a trained image processing model. The trained image processing model may be generated by training an image processing model using one or more training samples. Each training sample of the one or more training samples may include an image pair generated based on a sample image.

title: Electronically releasable apparatus
abstract: An apparatus may be configured with one or more cables forming loops external to a housing of the apparatus and retained by a one-way locking mechanism disposed within the housing. The one-way locking mechanism may allow movement of the cable(s) in a first linear direction (e.g., to decrease a length of cable forming the loop) while preventing movement of the cable(s) in a second linear direction (e.g., to increase the length of cable forming the loop) unless and until an electromechanical component actuates the mechanism to release the cable, thereby allowing movement in the second linear direction. The cable loops may wrap around corners, protrusions, etc., of valuables to prevent removal from the apparatus. The apparatus may include an anchor mechanism to prevent removal of the apparatus from an anchor surface.

title: Cross link interference (cli) configuration and measurement
abstract: Some aspects of this disclosure relate to apparatuses and methods for implementing cross link interference (CLI) measurement indication. For example, a user equipment (UE) includes a transceiver configured to enable wireless communication with a base station and a processor communicatively coupled to the transceiver. The processor can be configured to receive, using the transceiver, a configuration message from the base station indicating a plurality of cross link interference (CLI) resources. The processor is further configured to receive, using the transceiver, an activation message from the base station activating one or more of the plurality of CLI resources. The processor is further configured to perform a CLI measurement during at least one CLI resource of the activated one or more of the plurality of CLI resources.

title: System and method for continuous retrospective evaluation of interactions
abstract: A system for continuous retrospective evaluation of interactions includes a first user interface operated by a first user. The first user interface generates a recording of the first user during an interaction with a second user. The system also includes a second user interface operated by the second user. The second user interface includes a second-user-interface display that produces a playback of the recording to the second user after the interaction has ended, and includes a second-user-interface annotation tool actuated by the second user. The second-user-interface annotation tool continuously records an affect rating of the second user during the playback.
assignee: Honda Motor Co., Ltd.; Cornell University

title: Resiliency against nrf failure in a 5g network
abstract: The technology disclosed herein enables resiliency of routing between NFs when degraded 5G NF topology information is provided to an SCP by an NRF. In a particular example, In a particular example, a method includes receiving, at the SCP, responses from a plurality of Network Function Repository Functions (NRFs), wherein the responses indicate availability of NF topology information across an NRF set. The method further includes determining, based on the responses, that at least one NRF of the NRF set is providing degraded NF topology information. The method also includes receiving, at the SCP, an NF service request from a consumer NF. The method includes augmenting the degraded NF topology information to create selection NF topology information. The method then includes selecting a producer NF to service the NF service request using the selection NF topology information, and transmitting the NF service request to the producer NF.

title: Compositions for modulating plant growth and stress tolerance, and methods of use thereof
abstract: Provided herein are compositions comprising itaconate for modulating root growth in crop plants, and/or suppressing root growth in non-crop plants, and methods for treating said plants thereof. Further provided herein are methods for engineering the progeny of parent plants to have increased growth under control and stress conditions, by treating the parent plants with compositions comprising itaconate, selecting for parent plants that have increased growth under control and stress conditions, and then generating progeny from these itaconate resistant parent plants.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Method and device for reducing power consumption of base station in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transmission rates. A method performed by a UE in a wireless communication system according to the present disclosure comprises the steps of: receiving a first signal, including cell discontinuous reception (DRX)-related information about a first cell, from a base station; and identifying a cell DRX non-active period on the basis of the cell DRX-related information, wherein a second signal may not be transmitted to the base station in a slot corresponding to the cell DRX non-active period.

title: Generating portraits according to relighting schemes using diffusion models trained on synthetic image data
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and methods for generating, utilizing a diffusion model, digital images depicting portraits relit according to a new lighting scheme. In particular, in some embodiments, the disclosed systems generate, utilizing a diffusion model, a first noised image based on a first digital image comprising a portrait of a subject and based on an environment map defining a new lighting scheme for the subject. In addition, in some embodiments, the disclosed systems generate, utilizing the diffusion model, a second noised image based on the environment map and a text prompt comprising a description of the subject. Furthermore, in some embodiments, the disclosed systems generate, utilizing the diffusion model, a new digital image comprising a relit portrait of the subject by combining the first noised image and the second noised image.

title: Allocating resources in a cell
abstract: Methods and apparatus are provided. In some examples, a method of allocating resources in a cell is provided. A first proportion of resources in the cell are allocated to a first radio access technology (RAT) and a second proportion of the resources in the cell are allocated to a second RAT different to the first RAT, and the cell supports resource partitioning of resources of the first RAT for one or more groups of one or more networks, network slices or User Equipments (UEs). The method comprises determining, for individual groups, one or more respective proportions of the resources for the group based on the resource partitioning, and determining, for individual groups, one or more adjusted proportions of the 0 resources based on the one or more proportions of the resources for the group and the first proportion of the resources of the cell allocated to the first RAT. The method also comprises allocating the resources of the cell based on the one or more adjusted proportions of the resources of the cell for individual groups.

title: Method for controlling electrolytic device and electrolytic device
abstract: According to one embodiment, there is provided a method for controlling an electrolytic device including a cathode electrode that contains metal ions and reduces carbon dioxide, and an anode electrode that oxidizes water to generate oxygen, the method including an acquisition step of acquiring information on a potential of the cathode electrode and a potential of the anode electrode, and a control step of controlling the potential of the cathode electrode or/and the potential of the anode electrode such that the potential of the cathode electrode is less than the potential of the anode electrode when the potential of the anode electrode is equal to or less than the potential of the cathode electrode.

title: Fin structure for increasing performance of ferroelectric memory device
abstract: Various embodiments of the present disclosure are directed towards an integrated chip including a fin structure extending vertically from a semiconductor substrate. The fin structure continuously extends laterally along a first direction. A ferroelectric memory stack overlies the fin structure and continuously laterally extends along a second direction that is substantially perpendicular to the first direction. The ferroelectric memory stack includes an upper electrode overlying a ferroelectric layer. The ferroelectric layer extends along opposing sidewalls and an upper surface of the fin structure.

title: Ai-based system and method for multimodal element-oriented, layered graphic design
abstract: A data processing system implements receiving a user request to lay out multimodal design elements in a graphic design; applying a first generative model to categorize the design elements based on their content attributes in an initial layer and at least two pre-defined layers; applying a second generative model to sequentially process the layers until rendering a final composition image, by: processing the initial layer into an initial image, and for each of the pre-defined layers: encoding content attributes of each design element of the layer and a precedent image into combined embeddings, projecting the combined embeddings to match a hidden state dimension, predicting position and size attributes per design element of the layer based on the combined embeddings, and rendering a composition image based on the position and size attributes; and displaying the final composition image.

title: Overlay measuring method and system, and method of manufacturing a semiconductor device using the same
abstract: An overlay measuring system includes an electronic optical system configured to irradiate an electron beam onto a sample on which an overlay mark having designed overlay values is formed, and configured to detect electrons emitted from the sample, and a processor configured to acquire a voltage contrast image of the overlay mark from the electrons detected by the electronic optical system. The processor is configured to obtain a defect function from voltage contrast image data of the voltage contrast image, the defect function changing according to the designed overlay values, and is configured to perform self-cross correlation on the defect function to determine an overlay.

title: Fixing structure and camera device
abstract: A fixing structure and a camera device are provided. The fixing structure is configured to fix a camera. The camera includes a first portion and a second portion. The first portion and the second portion are located on different sides of the camera. The fixing structure includes an outer housing, a bracket and an inner housing. The outer housing includes a first snap-fit hole, and the first portion is snap-fitted in the first snap-fit hole. The bracket is rotatably connected to the outer housing. The second portion is rotatably connected to the bracket, and the second portion is connected to the outer housing. The inner housing includes a second snap-fit hole. The first portion is snap-fitted in the second snap-fit hole. The inner housing is connected to the outer housing. The present application solves the problem in existing camera fixing devices where cameras tend to sag because of rotation.
assignee: Lei Pan; Global Media Industry Group Co., Ltd.

title: Automated quality evaluation in compliance policy generation
abstract: A method, computer system, and a computer program product are provided for generating a description from synthetic data by obtaining inferred code and data to determine accuracy. The inferred code is parsed to determine an inferred code template and an inferred description template. A plurality of code template sets is then obtained and compared it to the inferred code template. It is then determined as when any of said code template sets are a close match to content of the inferred code template. A plurality of seeds is then extracted from the inferred code template and any of the code template sets that were determined to be a close match to the inferred code template. A description template corresponding is obtained, and a new description is then generated from synthetic data using said plurality of seeds and said corresponding description template.

title: Methods and compositions for amplification and sequencing of genome and epigenome
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods and compositions for the approximately simultaneous amplification of closed chromatin region DNA and open chromatin region DNA. The present disclosure further provides methods of producing a DNA library for analysis of open chromatin region DNA and closed chromatin region DNA approximately simultaneously and methods of identifying a DNA sequence variation or an epigenetic modification in a sample. Aspects of the present disclosure further relate to a DNA library produced by the methods of the present disclosure.
assignee: Board Of Regents, The University Of Texas System

title: Heater assembly with a curved surface
abstract: A heater assembly for an aerosol-generating system is provided, the heater assembly including: a heating element to vaporise a liquid aerosol-forming substrate; and a porous body to convey the substrate to the heating element, the porous body having a liquid absorption surface, a heating surface, and at least one side surface extending from the liquid absorption surface to the heating surface, the heating element being located on the heating surface, the heating surface being convex in one or both of a first transverse direction and a second transverse direction, the first transverse direction being orthogonal to the second transverse direction, the heating surface having a width that is different from a width of the liquid absorption surface in a same transverse direction, the porous body having a shape that tapers along the entire length thereof, and the porous body including a porous ceramic body or a porous glass body.

title: Document scanner
abstract: Systems as described herein may include document scanning to identify problems with the documents. A document scanning system may determine a scope of a document scan. The system may initiate a silent mode of a browser application and send a request to access an enterprise document repository. The system may be granted read-only access and determine page elements associated with a document within the scope. Based on the page elements, the system may use a machine learning model to determine an indication of one or more problems with a document. Accordingly, the system may generate a health report for each document within the scope of the document scan.

title: Adapter device for a sensor device, adapter arrangement, adapter system, measuring device having adapter device and sensor device, and method
abstract: An adapter device, method, adapter arrangements, adapter system and measuring device. The adapter device can attach a sensor device having a first sensor part and a second sensor part to a pharmaceutical fluid conduit. The adapter device includes a first adapter part and a second adapter part. The first adapter part has a first sensor receptacle for the first sensor part and the second adapter part has a second sensor receptacle for the second sensor part. A fluid conduit receptacle is arranged between or formed by the adapter parts to receive the fluid conduit. The first and second sensor receptacles are arranged on the first and second adapter parts on sides facing away from the fluid conduit receptacle. Contact elements of the first sensor part and the second sensor part engage in or extend through through-openings for direct abutment against the fluid conduit in a planar manner.

title: Electronic device
abstract: The present description concerns a device comprising a voltage regulator comprising first and second branches comprising first, second, and third transistors, the control nodes of the first transistors of the first and second branches being coupled together, the control node of the third transistor of each first and second branch being coupled to the junction point of the first and second transistors of the same branch, a fourth transistor, and a fifth transistor, the control nodes of the fourth transistor and of the second transistor of the first branch being coupled together to a node of application of a set point voltage, the control nodes of the fifth transistor and of the second transistor of the second branch being coupled together to an output node of the regulator.

title: Drive mechanism for positive displacement pumps
abstract: A novel embodiment of a drive mechanism for use in a pump, for example, of the type that would be used in a wearable drug delivery system, comprises, a cylindrically-shaped slider element configured with a channel on a circumferential surface thereof defining one or more zig-zag-shaped tracks therethrough. One or more pegs are engaged within the tracks, such that a back and forth longitudinal motion of the slider element along a radial axis of the cylinder causes movement of the pegs along one of the tracks through the channel, thus providing a movement of the pegs around the circumference of the cylinder which imparts a rotational motion to a header element disposed co-axially with the slider. The header element is in turn connected to a gear train, for example, a planetary gear box, which is coupled to the pump via a linkage or other type of mechanism.

title: Cartridge with ceramic structure in communication with air passage and cavity
abstract: The cartridge includes a housing, an air passage and a vent hole defined within the housing, a reservoir defining a cavity configured to contain a pre-vapor formulation such that the pre-vapor formulation surrounds the air passage, the vent hole being in communication with the cavity and with air that is external to the reservoir, a ceramic structure in communication with the air passage and the cavity so as to receive the pre-vapor formulation from the reservoir, and a heater configured to vaporize the pre-vapor formulation in the ceramic structure.

title: Display device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A method for manufacturing a display device includes: providing a display unit including a plurality of pixels; and providing a color converter on the display unit. The providing of a color converter includes: forming a light blocking member including a first opening; depositing a metal thin film on the light blocking member; forming a metal layer including a second opening overlapping the first opening on the metal thin film by using an inkjet etching method; forming a liquid repellent cover layer on the metal layer; and forming a first color converting layer including first semiconductor nanocrystals and a second color converting layer including second semiconductor nanocrystals in the first opening and the second opening, respectively.

title: Mobile sand slurry delivery system
abstract: A flow system is used to mix and transport a slurry of sand and water in support of a hydraulic fracturing operation that is to be conducted at a well site location. The flow system utilizes lay-flat hose to transport the slurry under motive force provided by one or more centrifugal pumps. The lay-flat hose may be constructed in total lengths exceeding several miles in length and may be provided to place a mobile mine in fluidic communication with the well site location.

title: Single Lid Trash Container with Lid Inward and Downward Flipping Mechanism
abstract: Single Lid Trash Container with Lid Inward and Downward Flipping Arrangement A trash container is equipped with a lid inward and downward flipping arrangement which is configured to drive the lid to rotate about a flipping axis of a lid to selectively flip up the lid to an open state that the lid is positioned in an upright manner with only an upper portion of the lid extending above the container cover upwardly and a lower portion extending within the inlet opening of the container cover, and flip down the lid to a close state that the lid is positioned flatly to cover the inlet opening.

title: Updating Fabric Parameters Of Network Devices On A Fabric-Wide Basis
abstract: A system receives a request to execute an update to a fabric parameter. The request includes a fabric attribute. The system identifies a fabric, in a network model, that corresponds to the fabric attribute. The system generates a configuration template that includes the update to the fabric parameter. The system uploads the configuration template to multiple network devices of the fabric. The multiple network devices, respectively, receive the configuration template and execute the update to the fabric parameter based on the configuration template.

title: Enhanced Spatial and Material Processing Architecture for Computer Numerical Control Operations
abstract: A system and method for enhancing computer numerical control (CNC) operations through integrated spatial and material processing capabilities. The system combines real-time spatial capture using multiple scanning modalities with material property assessment and dynamic process optimization. The architecture comprises multi-modal scanning systems, real-time spatial processing, material characterization capabilities, and adaptive control optimization. The system implements comprehensive spatial mapping through coordinated scanning devices, processes captured data through parallel computing pipelines, and maintains dynamic spatial and material models for process optimization. Advanced algorithms enable real-time adaptation of manufacturing parameters based on detected material properties and spatial conditions. The system supports integration with CAD/CAM systems, enables dynamic optimization of material utilization, and maintains comprehensive quality monitoring through continuous spatial and material assessment.

title: Cooling Device
abstract: A cooling device for directing airflow to a user who is sitting in a chair having a back rest and a pair of arm rests includes a housing that is couplable to the back rest of the chair. The housing has an interior space. A processor is electrically coupled to a motor. A vent and a hole each extend through the housing. A fan is operably coupled to the motor. The motor rotates the fan. The fan is positioned adjacent to the vent wherein rotation of the fan draws air into the housing through the vent. A tube is positionable to extend outwardly from the hole. The tube is flexible and extendable to position the tube along an associated arm rest of the pair of arm rests whereby the tube is positionable to direct airflow toward the user while the user is seated in the chair.

title: Apparatus for Manufacturing Electrode Assembly
abstract: A supply unit for supplying a plurality of sheet-shaped objects, a cutting unit for cutting sheet-shaped objects into cut objects, and a first transport unit that includes a transport path for transporting the cut objects is provided. The plurality of sheet-shaped objects are cut in a state of being obliquely inclined downward toward the first transport unit.

title: Shift device
abstract: A shift device includes: a shift body having a shaft body that is rotatably supported; plural projecting portions projecting out from the shaft body; and a mechanism portion provided at each of the plural projecting portions.

title: Process for Producing a Precipitated Silica from Plant Ashes, Precipitated Silica and its Use in Tire Applications
abstract: Provided herein is a process for producing a precipitated silica from a plant ash. Also provided herein is a precipitated silica, which can be obtained by said process, and its use for preparing a filled elastomeric composition or a tire part and/or a tire.

title: Display panel, method for manufacturing the display panel, and electronic device having the display panel
abstract: A display panel includes a circuit layer, a planarized circuit insulating layer, a groove circuit insulating layer, a groove formation unit and an anode electrode. The circuit layer includes a transistor. The planarized circuit insulating layer is disposed on the circuit layer and has a lower contact hole defined therein. The groove circuit insulating layer is disposed on the planarized circuit insulating layer and has an upper contact hole and a groove opening defined therein. The upper contact hole overlaps with the lower contact hole. The groove opening exposes a portion of an upper surface of the planarized circuit insulating layer. The groove formation unit is disposed in the groove opening. The anode electrode covers at least a portion of the groove circuit insulating layer and the groove formation unit, has at least a portion disposed in the lower contact hole, and is electrically connected to the transistor.

title: Systems and Methods for Inferring Biological, Environmental, Ecological, and Therapeutic States from Optical Interaction Dynamics and Multivariable Longitudinal Monitoring
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for inferring biological, environmental, ecological, therapeutic, industrial, agricultural, or physiologic states from optical interaction signatures and temporal optical interaction dynamics obtained through multivariable longitudinal monitoring. One or more imaging devices or sensors acquire optical interaction data associated with biological matrices, environmental samples, atmospheric systems, industrial processes, or other monitored environments. One or more processors extract quantitative optical interaction features—including Global Edge Coherence (GEC), Localized Edge Dynamics (LEDyn), speckle evolution, aggregation kinetics, and related metrics—and integrate these features with environmental variables, geospatial data, biologic measurements, therapeutic history, and longitudinal multimodal datasets using machine-learning and probabilistic inference engines. In certain embodiments, the system receives and processes structured Digital Twin Manifests (DTMs). The resulting probabilistic inferences support closed-loop adaptive monitoring, real-time therapeutic-response assessment, distributed smartphone-based environmental intelligence, environmental digital biomarkers, and proactive recommendations across laboratory, clinical, ecological, manufacturing, and extraterrestrial applications.

title: Anti-mesothelin (msln) single domain antibodies and therapeutic constructs
abstract: The present disclosure provides anti-MSLN single domain antibodies (sdAb), as well as constructs comprising the sdAbs. The constructs include multivalent antibodies comprising any one of the sdAbs, such constructs including bispecific T-cell engagers (BiTEs), bispecific natural killer cell engagers (BiKEs), and trispecific killer cell engagers (TrikEs). Also described are chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) for CAR-T and CAR-NK therapy comprising any one of the aforementioned sdAbs. Uses of these molecules in the treatment of cancers (in particular, solid cancers) are also described.

title: Model management method and apparatus
abstract: A model management method and an apparatus, and relates to the field of communication technologies, to reduce a data security risk of an AI model in the wireless field. The method includes: obtaining a first communication data set used for updating a first machine learning model, and sending a second communication data set to a model training function entity. The first processing policy includes a first loss threshold, and the first machine learning model is used for managing a wireless communication service. The second communication data set is obtained by performing a processing operation on suspicious data in the first communication data set according to the first processing policy, and the suspicious data is wireless communication data whose loss value is greater than the first loss threshold.

title: Systems and methods for switch driver for power converter for electric vehicle
abstract: A system includes a power converter, wherein the power converter includes: a switch including a control input; a current source configured to provide a current control signal to the control input of the switch; a voltage source configured to provide a voltage control signal to the control input of the switch; and a resistor connected to the control input of the switch and the voltage source.

title: Oven
abstract: An oven according to the present invention includes: a body having a cooking chamber provided in the body; a heat source in the cooking chamber to heat the cooking chamber; and a drawer device under the body, and including: a drawer case having one or more holes in the upper surface of the drawer case; and a plate covering the one or more holes and forming a gap between the plate and the upper surface, wherein the gap is configured to allow a flow path through the gap for air in the drawer case to be supplied to the heat source through the one or more holes.

title: Semiconductor protection device and electric power conversion device
abstract:
This semiconductor protection device includes: a first determination unit which outputs a first output signal when gate voltage of a semiconductor switching element has exceeded a predetermined first threshold; a second determination unit which outputs a second output signal when the gate voltage has exceeded a second threshold greater than the first threshold; and a third determination unit which outputs a third output signal when a value based on voltage of the semiconductor switching element or a value based on a value of current flowing through the semiconductor switching element during a period in which the semiconductor switching element is turned ON has exceeded a third threshold. 
     Determination operation of the third determination unit is activated by the first output signal, and a short-circuit state of the semiconductor switching element is detected on the basis of a logical conjunction of the second output signal and the third output signal.

title: Buffer management
abstract: In various examples, systems and methods are disclosed for a two-dimensional (2D) dynamic bucket pre-processor that enhances the efficiency of machine learning model training on GPUs. The 2D dynamic bucket pre-processor includes a bucket stratification optimizer that configures a 2D bucket buffer for performing stratified 2D bucketing by organizing data into first-tier and second-tier sub-buckets, and a batch size optimizer to identify optimal batch sizes that fit into GPU memory. During training of a machine learning model, micro-batches comprise data served from selected sub-buckets to a model training platform. Organizing data into first and second tiers based on sequence length dimensions minimizes padding and ensures efficient GPU processing. In some embodiments, the 2D dynamic bucket pre-processor may perform 2D bucketing as a dynamic process that streams data into the 2D bucket buffer, as micro-batches of previously bucketed data are being served to execute training steps of a model training process.

title: Electronically Insulating Thermal Connector having a Low Thermal Resistivity
abstract: A heat sink component can include a body including a thermally conductive material that is electrically non-conductive. At least one first terminal can be formed over a first end of the body. At least one second terminal formed over a second end of the body. The second end of the body can be opposite the first end of the body in an X-direction. The heat sink component can have a length in the X-direction and a width in a Y-direction that is parallel with the top surface and perpendicular to the X-direction. A ratio of the width to the length can be greater than about 1.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to control an audio collection unit configured to collect ambient audio around a user, control an audio signal processing unit configured to remove noise from the collected audio and to extract important audio from the collected audio, control a bone conduction transmission unit configured to transmit the extracted important audio directly to an inner ear of the user by bone conduction, control a position information acquisition unit configured to determine a current location of the user, and control an information provision unit configured to acquire, based on the current location of the user, at least one of weather information, traffic information, and discount information of commercial facilities in a surrounding area of the current location, and to provide the acquired information to the user.

title: Quantum teleportation driven system configuration
abstract: A system can: identify, by a first quantum computing device a state change of a quantum state of a first qubit at the first quantum computing device based on an occurrence of a quantum teleportation of quantum information to the first qubit; receive, by the first quantum computing device, classical information associated with the quantum teleportation; determine, by the first quantum computing device, a control action for the first quantum computing device based on the classical information and the quantum state of the first qubit subsequent to the state change; and implement, by the first quantum computing device, the control action to control the first quantum computing device.

title: System and a method for managing inventory
abstract: There are provided methods and systems for managing inventory of inventory items in a storage area, and for automatically carrying out an action in response to a change in at least one inventory item in the storage area.

title: Character recognition system, character recognition method, and recording medium
abstract: A character recognition system includes a recognition unit for recognizing a character included in an input image by using each of a plurality of character recognition models different from each other, a determination unit for determining any of a plurality of recognition results as a most likely recognition result by using a determination model based on the recognition result by each of the plurality of character recognition models and image feature information indicating a feature of the input image, a revision unit for revising the most likely recognition result based on a revision operation by a user, and a retraining unit for retraining the determination model by referring to training data including information indicating a revision content for the most likely recognition result, the plurality of recognition results, and the image feature information.

title: Optical Anti-Counterfeiting Element and Optical Anti-Counterfeiting Product
abstract: The disclosure provides an optical anti-counterfeiting element and an optical anti-counterfeiting product. The optical anti-counterfeiting element includes: a substrate; and a micro-structure layer, a plane where the micro-structure layer is located has at least one principal line, the micro-structure layer comprises a plurality of reflective structures along an extension direction of the at least one principal line; a side of each of the plurality of reflective structures away from the substrate is provided with a reflective surface, and a plane angle of a dihedral angle formed by the reflective surface and a surface of the substrate is an inclination angle; wherein inclination angles of all of the plurality of reflective structures in the extension direction of the at least one principal line at least include a variation period. The disclosure solves the problem in the related art that a dynamic feature of an optical anti-counterfeiting element is not easily recognized.
assignee: Zhongchao Special Security Technology Co., Ltd; China Banknote Printing And Minting Corp.

title: Systems and methods for disclosure validation
abstract: Systems, apparatuses, methods, and computer program products are disclosed for disclosure validation. A method includes determining an applicability status for digital content indicating whether a required disclosure applies to the digital content, and determining a disclosure inclusion status for the digital content indicating whether the digital content includes a candidate disclosure. The method also includes, in response to determining a disclosure inclusion status that indicates that the digital content includes the candidate disclosure, determining a conformity status for the digital content that indicates whether the candidate disclosure conforms to a set of styling requirements, determining a digital content status for the digital content based on at least one of the applicability status, the disclosure inclusion status, and the conformity status, and causing presentation of the digital content status.

title: Semiconductor package and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A semiconductor package includes: a first redistribution substrate; a semiconductor chip provided on the first redistribution substrate; a molding material molding the semiconductor chip and the first redistribution substrate; and a second redistribution substrate provided on the molding material, wherein the second redistribution substrate includes: at least one redistribution line; a metal pad; and a dielectric layer molding the at least one redistribution line and the metal pad, wherein the dielectric layer includes a marking region on the metal pad, and the metal pad includes a plurality of concave portions.

title: Semiconductor package structure and method of forming the same
abstract: A method includes: forming a first device region including a first semiconductor substrate; forming a first interconnect structure over a first front side of the first semiconductor substrate, wherein the first device region and the first interconnect structure form a first semiconductor die; forming a second device region including a second semiconductor substrate; forming a second interconnect structure over a second front side of the second semiconductor substrate, wherein the second device region and the second interconnect structure form a second semiconductor die; flipping the second semiconductor die and bonding the first semiconductor die with the second semiconductor die at a bonding region between the first interconnect structure and the second interconnect structure; and forming a third interconnect structure on a backside of the first semiconductor substrate, wherein the of the third interconnect structure includes a capacitor between two adjacent metallization layers of the third interconnect structure.

title: Data packing for power and area-efficient memory structures and performance-efficient decoding of encoded data
abstract: A system for packing data includes a controller configured to receive compressed data. The compressed data includes data items and qualifier bits for the data items. The controller is configured to discard the data items designated as invalid by the qualifier bits. The controller is configured to generate data type bits specifying data type information for the data items designated as valid by the qualifier bits. The system includes a buffer. The controller is configured to store the data items designated as valid by the qualifier bits and the data type bits in the buffer. A system can include one or more decoders configured to decode encoded data and output literals, lengths, and distances.

title: Input method, device, and storage medium
abstract: Described herein are input techniques. The input techniques comprise displaying an input interface and an auxiliary input object in response to receiving an input request. The auxiliary input object is associated with an input instruction. Dispay of  the anxiliary input object comprises displaying the auxiliary input object that comprises a first object for operating the input interface in response to a distance between the input interface and an operator being less than a first distance, and displaying the auxiliary input object that comprises a second object for operating the input interface in response to the distance between the input interface and the operator being greater than a second distance. The second distance is greater than the first distance, and the second object is different from the first object.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Systems and methods for stationary power generation using hydrogen and ammonia co-fuels
abstract: The present invention relates, in general, to a stationary power generation system that includes an ammonia supply system, an ammonia cracking system, an internal combustion engine, and a generator. The ammonia cracking system includes an exhaust cracking unit and an electric cracking unit arranged in series. The exhaust cracking unit utilizes engine exhaust heat to crack ammonia, and the electric cracking unit utilizes electrical power to crack ammonia during startup or when exhaust heat is insufficient. Hydrogen resulting from ammonia cracking is supplied to the engine as a co-fuel with ammonia from the ammonia supply system. The internal combustion engine drives the generator to produce electrical power for a load, facility, grid, or microgrid. In some embodiments, the system includes a power system for the electric cracking unit and a fast start system configured to improve startup speed and system readiness.

title: Screening method for compound inducing autophagy
abstract: Provided is a screening method for searching for a new autophagy-inducing compound. In the present invention, a new autophagy-inducing compound is searched for using at least one of the following characteristics: (1) having high binding affinity for DEAD-box RNA helicase; (2) approximating DEAD-box RNA helicase and p62 to promote interaction; and (3) promoting droplet formation of DEAD-box RNA helicase and p62.

title: In-motion track stiffness change detection
abstract: A system and method for railway track condition monitoring detects track stiffness variations using dynamic responses obtained from in-service trains. Field data is collected while a railcar is in motion along a track using at least one accelerometer attached to a railcar axle box. Associated GPS information of the railcar is synchronously recorded. The collected axle box acceleration field data is processed for dynamic response analysis using hybrid signal processing to detect the track stiffness changes in the rail system. The hybrid signal processing algorithm identifies and classifies the track stiffness changes from multiple directions, such as vertical and lateral acceleration records obtained from the onboard sensors.

title: Hybrid seal for electrochemical cell
abstract: A bipolar plate of an electrochemical cell includes a metallic anode plate, a metallic cathode plate, a bead region, and an elastomeric bead. An interior side of the cathode plate faces an interior side of the anode plate. A portion of the interior side of the anode plate at the bead region is spaced from a portion of the interior side of the cathode plate at the bead region. The elastomeric bead includes a first portion and a second portion. The first portion is disposed at an exterior side of the anode plate at the bead region, and the second portion is disposed at an exterior side of the cathode plate at the bead region. The elastomeric bead and the bead region are configured to cooperatively resist compression forces experienced at the bipolar plate.
assignee: GM Global Technology Operations LLC; Proton Energy Systems, Inc.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device includes: a digitizer disposed under a display panel, where the digitizer includes an upper layer divided into a first non-foldable portion, a second non-foldable portion, and a foldable portion overlapping the foldable area, where a plurality of holes are defined in the foldable portion, and a lower layer including a first plate and a second plate spaced apart from each other along the first direction so as to define a space therebetween in an area overlapping the foldable portion, where the upper layer includes a base layer, first loop coils, second-first loop coils disposed in the first non-foldable portion, and second-second loop coils disposed in the second non-foldable portion, where the lower layer includes a third-first loop coil disposed in the first plate so as to overlap the foldable portion and a third-second loop coil disposed in the second plate so as to overlap the foldable portion.

title: Systems and Methods for Communicating with Secondary Users of a Transportation Service
abstract: Systems and methods for communicating with secondary users of a transportation service are provided. A method can include obtaining a request for a transportation service including an aerial transport of a first user from a first user device associated with the first user. The method can include generating a first multi-modal transportation itinerary for facilitating the aerial transport for the first user. The method can include obtaining data indicative of a second user that is to travel with the first user for at least a portion of the first multi-modal transportation itinerary and determining a second multi-modal transportation itinerary for facilitating the aerial transport for the second user. The method can include communicating passenger itinerary data indicative of the second multi-modal transportation itinerary to a second user device associated with the second user.

title: Transapical removal device
abstract: Devices and methods for removing a valve clip which is pre-positioned on a heart leaflet, the valve clip including a delivery catheter having a distal end portion configured to be positioned near a heart valve; a grasping tool deployable from the distal end portion of the delivery catheter, the grasping tool configured to grasp and manipulate a valve clip from an implanted condition to an elongated condition, wherein the valve clip in the elongated condition has an elongated width less than an implanted width of the valve clip in the implanted condition; and a removal tool extendable relative to the distal end portion of the delivery catheter, the removal tool configured to at least partially surround the valve clip in the elongated condition and to remove the valve clip from the heart valve leaflet.

title: Emissive metasurface for efficient color conversion
abstract: An emissive metasurface comprising a nanostructured dielectric component and an emissive system, wherein the nanostructured dielectric component comprises a plurality of metaatoms, and wherein the emissive system is configured to absorb and emit light in the visible range, and wherein the metaatoms are configured so that they resonantly match with the frequency of the light absorbed and emitted by the emissive system, is disclosed herein.

title: Methods And Systems For Operating A Wireless Industrial Edge Cloud System Comprising One Or More Base Stations
abstract: Various embodiments of the teachings herein include a method for operating a wireless industrial edge cloud system with a first radio base station. An example includes: setting up a communication link between the first radio base station and a terminal; and using the terminal as an additional second radio base station.

title: Communication methods and apparatus and storage medium
abstract: A communication method is performed by a first device, and includes: sending indication information, wherein the indication information indicates an artificial intelligence (Al) functionality, and the Al functionality is used for a beam prediction.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Vehicle interior display device
abstract: A vehicle interior display device allows a driver to visually recognize a display that functions as a guide to appropriately adjust a relative position of a steering wheel to the driver according to the driver's physique. On a meter of the vehicle interior display device, first lines and second lines are displayed inside a rim of a steering wheel. The first lines are displayed to be disposed along an inner circumference of the rim and away from each other on left and right sides in a vehicle width direction. The second lines are displayed to be disposed away from each other on the left and right sides in the vehicle width direction. The second lines are connected to the first lines via respective connection portions. The connection portions are displayed at positions in the vicinity of the inner circumference of the rim, respectively.

title: Intelligent Rideshare Matching System
abstract: A system for facilitating fulfilling experiences during rideshare travel opportunities, the system matching individuals in shared rideshare trips based on availability, destination, mutual interests, user preferences, etc., employing AI-driven matching algorithms and machine learning protocols to enhance the matching functionality in real-time, and employing integration with third-party social media and travel services platforms, communication features to facilitate ongoing connection between rideshare companions, and feedback functionality to train and improve the system through machine learning algorithms and AI functionality.

title: Semiconductor module and method for manufacturing semiconductor module
abstract: A semiconductor module includes: a semiconductor device that includes n pads; and a mounting substrate that includes n lands corresponding one-to-one to the n pads. Each of the n pads is joined by solder bonding material to one of the n lands corresponding to the pad. When among the n pads, Pa denotes an area of a closest pad that is closest to a center of the semiconductor device and Pb denotes an area of a farthest pad that is farthest therefrom, and among the n lands, La denotes an area of a closest land corresponding to the closest pad and Lb denotes an area of a farthest land corresponding to the farthest pad, Pa/La is less than 1 and Pb/Lb is greater than 1, or Pa/La is greater than 1 and Pb/Lb is less than 1.

title: Image processing apparatus, method for image processing, and storage medium
abstract: An image processing apparatus for generating a virtual viewpoint video includes a first viewpoint determination unit arranged to generate a camera parameter of a first virtual camera based on an input value from a first input device, a playback-position determination unit arranged to determine a playback position of a virtual viewpoint image based on the input value from the first input device, a first-video generation unit arranged to generate a first virtual viewpoint video based on the first virtual camera and the playback position, a second viewpoint determination unit arranged to generate a camera parameter of a second virtual camera based on the input value from the first input device and an input value from a second input device, and a second video generation unit arranged to generate a second virtual viewpoint video based on the second virtual camera and the playback position.

title: Data transmission method
abstract: In a data transmission method, user equipment (UE) route selection policy rule information that includes a traffic descriptor and a backend UE descriptor included in the traffic descriptor or the UE route selection policy rule information independent of the traffic descriptor is received. The backend UE descriptor includes traffic description information and a route selection information, and the traffic description information indicates one or more of a backend device type, a domain descriptor, an Internet protocol descriptor, or connection capability information. In the method, whether the UE route selection policy rule information matches a backend UE connected to the terminal device is determined. In the method, when the UE route selection policy rule information matches the backend UE, communication between the backend UE and a mobile network through the terminal device is configured based on the backend UE descriptor.

title: Electrical connection unit
abstract: An electrical connection unit includes a structure configured to face an external cooler, an electronic component, and a heat dissipation member. The electronic component is disposed on a side opposite to the external cooler with respect to the structure. The heat dissipation member is disposed on a side opposite to the external cooler with respect to the electronic component. The heat dissipation member includes a fixing portion protruding toward the electronic component. The structure has an opening facing the fixing portion.

title: Event cluster
abstract: Particular example embodiments described herein can provide for a system, an apparatus, and a method to help enable the creation of an event cluster. In an example, the system, apparatus, and method can receive a communication related to an event from an electronic device, create a cluster for the event if the cluster for the event has not already been created, where the cluster is associated with a specific public safety answering point (PSAP) operator at a PSAP, add the communication to the cluster, and send the communication to the specific PSAP operator.

title: Package structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A device includes a semiconductor package including a first side and a second side opposite to each other, a substrate coupled to the second side of the semiconductor package, and a lid coupled to the substrate and the first side of the semiconductor package. The lid includes a first surface and a second surface opposite to each other, the second surface faces the semiconductor package, and the first surface is flatter than the second surface.

title: Multiple different scatter symbol merge evaluations
