The multi-layer stack is etched (i) at each concave region to form a depression through the inert layer and in the first resin layer, (ii) at each convex region to form a pillar in the second resin layer, and (iii) to expose a surface of the inert layer around each of a plurality of final discrete regions. A first primer set is selectively attached in each depression, and a second primer set is selectively attached over each pillar.

title: Apparatus and method of handling conditional handover failure
abstract: A method of managing conditional reconfigurations performed by a user equipment (UE) includes performing, by a higher layer of the UE, a removal or a maintenance of conditional reconfigurations upon a completion of a mobility-related process. The completion of a mobility-related process may include one or more of the following: receiving an indication from a lower layer of the UE that an execution of a lower-layer triggered mobility (LTM) cell switch has been successfully completed, successfully completing a RACH procedure towards a target cell during an execution of a LTM cell switch, receiving the indication from the lower layer of the UE that the RACH procedure towards the target cell has been successfully completed during the execution of the LTM cell switch, executing an LTM procedure, executing a CPA, CPC, a SCPAC, or a CHO, or completing one or more of CPA, CPC, LTM, SCPAC, or CHO processes.
assignee: Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd.

title: Advanced thermal management systems with hydrocarbon-coated aluminum cooling chambers
abstract: A portable temperature-controlled storage system comprising a payload chamber having hydrocarbon-coated aluminum walls, the payload chamber comprising either a continuous non-ribbed geometry or an integrated ribbed geometry, a thermoelectric cooling assembly thermally coupled to at least a portion of the aluminum walls, a phase-change thermal buffer positioned thermally proximate to the payload chamber, a temperature sensor positioned within the payload chamber, a controller coupled to the thermoelectric cooling assembly and the temperature sensor and configured to regulate the thermoelectric cooling assembly to control payload temperature, and a rechargeable battery configured to operate at least the thermoelectric cooling assembly and the controller.

title: Image processing system and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium for recording image processing program
abstract: The image processing system comprises an information extraction circuitry configured to extract, from one frame image or a plurality of temporally continuous frame images, local information which is information about a predetermined area or each object in the frame image and time information corresponding to the frame image, and a scene identification circuitry configured to identify a user's desired scene based on the local information and the time information extracted by the information extraction circuitry.

title: Articulating user interface
abstract: An articulating user interface for an appliance is disclosed. The user interface can be located along a front face of an appliance and may be articulated between a closed position that may be flush or substantially flush with the front of the appliance and an open position where the user interface projects from the front of the appliance and is oriented at a forward angle relative to the front of the appliance. The movement of the user interface may be motorized and the articulating movement of the user interface may be guided by cooperating hinge assemblies located at opposite ends of a user interface shell that carries various electronic components of the user interface. When in the articulated open position, a touchscreen front panel of the user interface may be presented to a user for inputting setting to or otherwise operating the appliance.
assignee: Bsh Home Appliances Corporation; BSH Hausgeräte GmbH

title: Aeronautical conveying and dropping device
abstract: An aeronautical conveying and dropping device for a missile to be released, comprising at least a frame, a hook capable of retaining the missile to be released, a deformable parallelogram mechanism having an axis secured to the frame, two axes secured to the hook and a free axis arranged in the frame, a first cam mounted so as to rotate about an axis fixed in the frame and having a position for locking the deformable parallelogram mechanism by contact with a bearing mounted on the free axis of the deformable parallelogram mechanism, and an unlocking position, and a member for preloading the first cam in the locking position.

title: Organic mixtures, and uses thereof in field of optoelectronics
abstract: An organic mixture includes a first emitter E1 and a second emitter E2. A formulation contains an organic mixture, and at least one organic solvent. An optoelectronic device contains an organic mixture and a formulation. The optoelectronic device, in particular the organic electroluminescent device, includes the organic mixture in its light-emitting layer, thereby exhibiting long device lifetime and narrow emission spectrum.

title: Humidifier wet-pack assembly
abstract: A wet-pack assembly includes a water panel, a scale control configured to surround the water panel on at least three sides, and a distribution tray disposed on a top portion of the water panel and coupled to the scale control via one or more joints. The one or more joints prevent separation of the distribution tray from the scale control. The wet-pack assembly also includes a feed tube extending from a basin formed within the scale control to the distribution tray, where the feed tube is structured to direct water flow from the basin to the distribution tray for recirculation to the water panel.

title: Recurrent neural network-based user identity misappropriation prevention from public domains and connections
abstract: Web browsing security is realized through use of a recurrent neural network (RNN) capable of creating a plurality of layers comprising web browser session wrappers, which overlay the actual user session. In this regard, the RNN creates hidden layer(s) and a final layer overlaying the last hidden layer which is exposed to the website and or domain. The RNN implements homomorphic encryption to systematically encrypt the session data and/or user data associated with the actual user session and stored or accessible to the various session wrappers. Once unauthorized use/tampering is detecting in the final layer, the RNN can reconfigure/add to the existing hidden layers and/or the homomorphic encryption can re-encrypt the session/user data is each layer/session wrapper.

title: Over-the-air self calibration for phased array antennas
abstract: A method of calibrating a phased array antenna is provided. The method includes obtaining a first coupling measurement associated with a first over-the-air (OTA) path between first and second antenna elements, obtaining a second coupling measurement associated with a second OTA path between a third antenna element and the second antenna element, obtaining a third coupling measurement associated with a third OTA path between the first antenna element and a fourth antenna element, wherein the third OTA path is reciprocal to the second OTA path, obtaining a fourth coupling measurement associated with a fourth OTA path between the third and fourth antenna elements. An antenna lattice comprises periodically spaced antenna elements including the first, second, third, and fourth antenna elements. The method includes determining a phase correction factor or a gain correction factor between the first and third antenna elements based on the first, second, third, and fourth coupling measurements.

title: Electronic device and operation method thereof
abstract: An operating method of an electronic device includes: obtaining a first interaction cost consumed in a case that menu items arranged according to a context-based arrangement method are selected, and a second interaction cost consumed in a case that the menu items arranged according to a count-based arrangement method are selected; and arranging the menu items according to a selected one of the context-based arrangement method or the count-based arrangement method, based on comparing the first interaction cost and the second interaction cost, wherein the context-based arrangement method arranges the menu items, according to a value resulting from applying at least one weight value to a number of selections for each menu item, based on at least one context at a time at which an arrangement request is received.

title: Transport device, in particular backpack
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a transport device, in particular a backpack, comprising at least a partially concave back section, a carrying system arranged on a first side of the back section, which is attached with at least one carrying strap, a bag arranged on a second side of the back section opposite the first side, which is formed by a first side section, a second side section opposite this, a front section opposite the back section and spaced apart from the side parts, a lid part, and a bottom section, wherein the bag together with the back section defines a storage space, and at least one receptacle extending substantially in one plane for receiving at least one substantially linear or flat transport object, wherein the receptacle is arranged inside the bag, wherein the receptacle is arranged with its upper or lower region on the back section or in its immediate vicinity, and the receptacle is arranged with its lower or upper region, respectively, opposite the upper or lower region, spaced apart from the back section in the direction of the front section, thereby forming an at least partially wedge-shaped first storage space between the back section and the receptacle.

title: Two-sided model training
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate to an apparatus for two-sided model training. The apparatus, such as a UE determines a first set of parameters characterizing an encoder model of the apparatus based on a first set of information. The UE determines a second set of parameters characterizing a decoder model of the apparatus based on the first set of information. The UE transmits a second set of information to a second device, the second set of information is usable to determine a decoder of the second device, and the second set of information is determined based on the first or the second set of parameters. The UE receives, from the second device, feedback information representing the decoder of the second device. The UE updates the second set of parameters characterizing the decoder model of the UE based on the feedback information representing the decoder of the second device.

title: Flow-based image generation model with velocity refiner block
abstract: A computing system including one or more processing devices configured to compute a generated image at a flow-based image generation model. Computing the generated image includes, in each denoising iteration, for each noised image patch, processing the noised image patch at a first transformer branch to compute a first latent velocity representation. At a velocity refiner block, computing the generated image further includes computing a latent acceleration representation based at least on the first latent velocity representation and computing a refined latent velocity representation based at least on the noised image patch and the latent acceleration representation. Computing the generated image further includes processing the refined latent velocity representation at a second transformer branch to compute a second latent velocity representation, and denoising the noised image patch based at least on the first and second latent velocity representations. The one or more processing devices output the generated image.

title: Analog and digital communication system for interfacing plain old telephone service devices with a network
abstract: An analog and digital communication system establishes a connection between a plain old telephone service (POTS) device and a destination device. The system includes a customer appliance that includes multiple ports, an internal power source device, a subscriber identification module (SIM) card, an electronic control unit, an analog to digital convertor, and a processor device. At least one of the ports are operably connected to the POTS device. A controller communicates remotely with the customer appliance via the network to provide routing of the telephone call between the POTS device and the destination device. The controller is configured to at least one of transmit the telephone call or receive the telephone call via a closest public switched telephone network (PSTN) handoff or via an internal customer appliance network establishing a connection between the customer appliance and a second customer appliance.

title: Communication device and method for adaptive saw filter bypass
abstract: A method for adaptively selecting a signal path in a communication device is disclosed. The communication device includes a first path including a surface acoustic wave (SAW) filter and a second path that does not include a SAW filter for receiving a signal. The method includes detecting a power level of a reference signal derived from a received signal, wherein the received signal is received through one of the first path and the second path; detecting an interference power of the received signal; detecting a quality of the received signal; selecting a path from the first path and the second path based on at least one of the power level of the reference signal, the interference power of the received signal, and the quality of the received signal; and using the selected path to receive a subsequent signal.

title: Image forming system and control method for image forming system
abstract: An image forming system includes a print head, a medium transport section, a display section that displays information, an input section that receives an input, and a control section, wherein the control section calculates a printable number of sheets of a medium based on power supply information including information that indicates a capacitance of a power supply, displays, on the display section, information that indicates printing cannot be completed when the printable number of sheets is smaller than an input print sheet number, and displays, on the display section, information that indicates printing is possible when the printable number of sheets is equal to or larger than the print sheet number.

title: Methods and apparatus for affiliate interrupt detection
abstract: Methods, apparatus, systems and articles of manufacture are disclosed for affiliate interrupt detection. An example method disclosed herein includes determining whether a first time period of a first audio signal corresponds to a first affiliate interrupt period based on whether (1) a first type of watermark is detected in the first time period of the first audio signal, and (2) a second type of watermark is detected in the first audio signal outside the first time period but not in the first time period of the first audio signal, and determining whether the first time period of the first audio signal corresponds to the first affiliate interrupt period when watermarks are not detected in the first time period of the first audio signal based on comparison of first signatures with second signatures representing a corresponding first time period of a reference audio signal.

title: Subblock based motion vector predictor with mv offset
abstract: A method of video decoding includes receiving motion vector (MV) offset information of a current block in a current picture from a coded video bitstream. The current block includes a plurality of subblocks to be coded with a subblock-based temporal motion vector prediction (SbTMVP) mode. Motion information of a subblock in the plurality of subblocks is determined based on motion information of a corresponding subblock in a collocated block in a collocated reference picture. The collocated block is collocated with the current block and is indicated by a displacement vector (DV) of the current block. Updated motion information of the subblock in the plurality of subblocks is determined based on the motion information of the subblock in the plurality of subblocks and an MV offset of the current block indicated by the MV offset information. The subblock in the plurality of subblocks is reconstructed based on the updated motion information.

title: Internet of things-based intelligent management system for an industrial and commercial photovoltaic power station
abstract: Provided is an Internet of Things-based intelligent management system for an industrial and commercial photovoltaic power station, including: a data collection unit configured to collect real-time data of the photovoltaic power station; an edge computing node built-in with a fault prediction model and an anomaly detection model and configured to perform fault prediction and anomaly detection on the photovoltaic power station according to the collected real-time data of the photovoltaic power station, and select an optimal maintenance plan according to results of the fault prediction and the anomaly detection; and a cloud server configured to construct and train the fault prediction model based on a deep belief network, and construct the anomaly detection model based on a density-based spatial clustering algorithm. The intelligent management system effectively reduces power generation losses and high maintenance costs caused by sudden faults of the devices, and achieves maximum maintenance benefits for the power station.
assignee: Huaneng Power International Inc. Anhui Wind Power Branch

title: Thermal stress monitoring system and method thereof
abstract: A thermal stress monitoring system includes at least one wearable sensor adapted to be placed on a human subject. The at least one wearable sensor is sensitive to changes in spontaneous blood volume oscillations and is configured to generate output signals. A processing subsystem receives the output signals and measures baseline spontaneous blood volume oscillations at a time when the user is not exposed to a thermal stress environment and subsequently measures the exposed spontaneous blood volume oscillations at a time when the user is exposed to the thermal stress environment and determines a thermal stress injury based on changes in the measured exposed spontaneous blood volume oscillations from the measured baseline spontaneous blood volume oscillations.

title: Concept for enhancing parallel coding capabilities
abstract: A video encoder is disclosed that is configured to encode a slice of a current picture into a data stream by partitioning the slice into rows of Coding Tree Units (CTUs), select a CTU dependency offset for the slice out of a plurality of CTU dependency offsets, the CTU dependency offset indicating a minimum CTU offset between consecutive CTU rows to be obeyed by a decoder when decoding CTU rows in parallel, and signal the CTU dependency offset in the data stream. The CTU dependency offset is selected based on a slice type of the slice.
assignee: Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der angewandten Forschung e.V.

title: Non-acoustic sensor based audio logging control related applications
abstract: An apparatus includes a non-acoustic sensor configured to generate a non-acoustic sensor signal and one or more processors configured to receive the non-acoustic sensor signal, determine, based at least in part on the non-acoustic sensor signal, whether a start event indicator is generated, and remain in an idle mode when the start event indicator is not generated.

title: Additives for redox mediated flow batteries
abstract: In a redox mediated battery system having a half-cell connected to a vessel containing an insoluble solid substance which is present as a bed of granules or other porous mass and which is converted between first and second states during charge and discharge, the electrolyte liquid includes a solute capable of causing elastic turbulence in the liquid, while the flow paths for electrolyte liquid through the porous mass of insoluble solid substance are configured to compel changes in direction of flow thereby inducing elastic turbulence in contact with the insoluble solid substance. Elastic turbulence may also be induced in the half-cell.

title: Methods, compositions, and kits for inhibiting formation of adapter dimers
abstract: Oligonucleotide pairs for reducing adapter-dimers in a sequencing library according to aspects of the present disclosure include: a first and a second blocker oligonucleotide, each comprising: i) a blocker oligonucleotide 5′ portion at least 8 nucleotides in length and ii) a blocker oligonucleotide 3′ portion at least 1 to 20 nucleotides in length and comprising a first oligonucleotide 3′ terminus, wherein at least 1 of the 1 to 20 nucleotides is a non-naturally occurring nucleotide analog; wherein the first blocker oligonucleotide 3′ portion and the second blocker oligonucleotide 3′ portion are equal in length and complementary to each other; and wherein the first blocker oligonucleotide 5′ portion and the second blocker oligonucleotide 5′ portion are both complementary to the 5′ end portion of the 3′ adapters.

title: Financial Market Prediction System: Methods and Systems for Enhanced Financial Forecasting and Market Movement Prediction Using Recognition Science
abstract: A financial market prediction system is disclosed for enhanced financial forecasting and market movement prediction using a recognition-based analytical framework. Market data associated with a plurality of financial instruments is processed to determine dependency values and pairwise coupling quantities. A bounded recognition-based transform is applied to the pairwise coupling quantities to generate transformed coupling values, and a recognition-based financial network data structure is generated using the dependency values and the transformed coupling values. One or more derivative quantities associated with at least one target market variable are determined, and the bounded recognition-based transform is applied to one or more modifier inputs to generate transformed modifier values used to produce a predictive output. In certain embodiments, sentiment inputs, risk inputs, and asset-evaluation values are processed to generate bounded sentiment outputs, bounded risk outputs, and allocation outputs. The system outputs machine-generated market forecasts or market movement predictions.

title: Control method for culture device, and control method for culture device in association with cell culture
abstract: A control method for a culture device for cells that are continuously cultured in a culture environment acquires, at a predetermined timing, a process variable PV of a culture environment with an existing set variable SV and an analytical variable AV of a culture solution c. A function F, derived by machine learning, is used for calculating a new set variable SV for resetting the culture environment using the process variable PV and the analytical variable AV. The new set variable SV is calculated on the basis of a desired target variable TV of the culture solution by using the function F, inputting the new set variable SV, and performing the culturing, wherein the function F that is used is derived as needed by machine learning, with a latest process variable PV and a latest analytical variable AV that are acquired at a predetermined timing.

title: Low-loss superconducting motor and design method thereof
abstract: A low-loss superconducting motor and a design method thereof are provided. The low-loss superconducting motor includes a vacuum chamber, a stator component and a rotor component are installed in the vacuum chamber, and a protective cover is arranged between the stator component and the rotor component; one of the stator component and the rotor component is equipped with an ordinary conducting coil, and the other is equipped with a superconducting coil, the superconducting coil is applied with a direct current, and the ordinary conducting coil is applied with an alternating current. At the same time, the design method based on the above superconducting motor is also provided, the above-mentioned low-loss superconducting motor and its design method are adopted, and the air gap between the stator component and the rotor component is small.

title: Display device and electronic device including the same
abstract: A display device includes emission areas including light emitting elements, respectively, an encapsulation layer on the light emitting elements, a reflective polarizing member on the encapsulation layer and including a wire grid pattern which, among incident light from outside the display device, transmits light having an optical axis in a first direction and reflects light having an optical axis in a second direction orthogonal to the first direction, and an absorptive polarizing member which is on the reflective polarizing member and transmits the light having the optical axis in the first direction together with absorbing the light having the optical axis in the second direction.

title: New sporeless pleurotus strain
abstract: The present invention relates to the development of a new sporeless  Pleurotus  strain designated FiBABH-334, a representative culture thereof having been deposited at the Collection Nationale de Cultures de Microorganismes (CNCM), Institut Pasteur, 25 rue du Docteur Roux, 75724 PARIS Cedex 15, on Mar. 21, 2023, under the CNCM Accession Number I-5939. This sporeless  Pleurotus  strain displays an excellent yield weight of the harvested crop and a very good shelf-life of the mushroom products. The present invention also relates to cultures obtained, descended, or otherwise derived from this strain. More particularly, the present invention relates to cultures comprising at least one haploid set of chromosomes of said strain, especially to monokaryons thereof or to F1 hybrids produced by mating this monokaryon with a second  Pleurotus  line. The invention further relates to methods of use of the cultures described hereinabove.

title: Injection molding device and mold opening and closing device
abstract: An injection molding device includes an injection unit, a mold opening and closing unit, and a control section, the mold opening and closing unit includes a toggle fixing section, a fixed mold attachment section, a movable mold attachment section, a crosshead, and a toggle section, the toggle section includes a plurality of pivot sections, a first member, a second member, and a third member, each of the pivot sections includes a pivot shaft, the first member, the second member, and the third member each include an insertion hole into which the pivot shaft is inserted, at least one of the plurality of pivot sections includes a bearing provided between the pivot shaft and the insertion hole and a plurality of protection members that are provided between the pivot shaft and the insertion hole arranged side by side with the bearing in an extending direction of the pivot shaft.

title: Flow meter
abstract: An acoustic flow meter determines a flow rate of a fluid flowing through a measurement channel by transmitting acoustic signals through the fluid. The flow meter includes a flow tube having a wall enclosing a flow passage extending along a flow tube axis between opposed ends of the flow tube. In use, parasitic signals derived from the acoustic signals propagate through the wall, between opposed ends of the flow tube. The flow tube includes formations spaced along the flow tube axis on an exterior of the wall, the formations include at least one pair of formations that are axially spaced apart along the flow tube axis at an interval corresponding to half of a wavelength of a parasitic signal. The formations delay propagation of parasitic signals to an extent that each parasitic signal propagates slower than a corresponding signal propagating through fluid in the flow passage.

title: Automated Process for Intermediate Orthodontic Digital Setup Generation
abstract: A method for generating digital setups for an orthodontic treatment path. The method includes receiving a digital 3D model of teeth, performing interproximal reduction (IPR) on the model and, after performing the IPR, generating an initial treatment path with stages including an initial setup, a final setup, and a plurality of intermediate setups. The method also includes computing IPR accessibility for each tooth at each stage of the initial treatment path, applying IPR throughout the initial treatment path based upon the computed IPR accessibility, and dividing the initial treatment path into steps of feasible motion of the teeth resulting in a final treatment path with setups corresponding with the steps. The setups can be used to make orthodontic appliances, such as clear tray aligners, for each stage of the treatment path.

title: Real-time signal strength mapping for spectrum reuse in a ran multicast
abstract: A method for increasing a number of UEs serviced by a cell comprises having a plurality of RUs provide either the PRACH or PUCCH data for every connected UE to a DU. The DU extracts signal strength information for each UE, from each RU, to determine which RU the UE is under. With this done, the DU calculates path loss deltas between each UE to every RU servicing the cell. By applying a threshold to the computed path loss deltas, the DU determines which UEs may be subject to spectrum reuse.

title: Coalescing separator insert, coalescing separator, and process for manufacturing a coalescing separator insert
abstract: A coalescing separator insert for separating liquid from a gas flow includes a first coalescing separator body made of a first coalescing separator medium arranged around an air-permeable support tube supporting the first coalescing separator body. A second coalescing separator body made of a second coalescing separator medium is arranged in a gas flow direction downstream of the first coalescing separator body concentric to the first coalescing separator body and is wound at least in sections into a multi-layer winding. The second coalescing separator body has at least in sections at least two layers of the second coalescing separator medium arranged overlappingly relative to each other in the gas flow direction and connected to each other at least in sections for fixation of the multi-layer winding. A coalescing separator is provided with the coalescing separator insert and a method of manufacturing the coalescing separator insert is provided.

title: Beamform modification capturing side conversations
abstract: Techniques for modifying beamforms capturing side conversations are described. In implementations, a computing device obtains a default gaze direction of a user during a communication session, such as an audio call or a video call, and captures audio of the communication session from a default microphone beamforming area. When the computing device detects a gaze deviation of the user relative the default gaze direction, a modified microphone beamforming area that expands beyond the default microphone beamforming area in a direction of the gaze deviation is formed. Then, the computing device captures the audio from the modified microphone beamforming area.

title: Computer-implemented method
abstract: A computer-implemented method for configuring a robot is provided. The method comprises: receiving a 3D virtual representation of at least a portion of a physical object, receiving target toolpath information indicating a region of interest in the 3D virtual representation, identifying a plurality of reference points in the region of interest, the reference points corresponding to locations on a surface of the physical object, for each reference point, calculating a vector extending from the surface of the 3D virtual representation at the reference point, and determining a waypoint which is at a stand-off distance from the surface of the 3D virtual representation along the vector; and connecting each of the waypoints to determine a toolpath for controlling a moving arm of the robot to operate on the physical object.

title: Electrode precursor composition
abstract: An electrode precursor composition for an alkali metal ion secondary cell. The electrode precursor composition includes a polymer-electrolyte gel matrix phase, a dispersed phase including an electrochemically active material, and a conductive additive. The conductive additive includes a tubular carbon material as a majority component. A method of producing an electrode of the same composition, an electrochemical secondary cell that includes the electrode, and an electrochemical energy storage device that includes the electrochemical secondary cell.

title: Intelligent automatic start/stop for vehicle engines
abstract: Examples described herein provide a method for intelligent automatic start/stop for vehicle engines. The method includes receiving data from a sensor of a vehicle. The method further includes performing a perception task based at least in part on the data received from the sensor of the vehicle. The method further includes determining whether an internal combustion engine of the vehicle is stopped or started. The method further includes, responsive to determining that the internal combustion engine of the vehicle is stopped, determining whether to start the internal combustion engine based at least in part on the perception task. The method further includes, responsive to determining to start the internal combustion engine, starting the internal combustion engine.

title: Sewer cap monitoring system
abstract: The present disclosure provides a fluid monitoring device comprising a transmitter housing attached to an underside of a cap, configured to accept a cable and comprising alignment features that index the housing to the cap. The device includes a printed circuit board (PCB) within the transmitter housing, comprising a battery, microprocessor, and transmitter for wireless communication with peripheral devices. The device also comprises a linkage and sensor assembly with a capacitive sensor, wherein the linkage tethers the sensor assembly to the transmitter housing via the cable. The microprocessor interprets capacitance readings from the capacitive sensor and, upon detecting readings above a threshold, instructs the transmitter to transmit a flood signal.

title: Foam body for sensors used with pedestrian safety
abstract: A vehicle includes a body (e.g., foam body) designed to compress in response to an applied force. The body includes cut out portions to reduce the amount of applied force required to compress the body in order for the body to compress and become detectable by a sensor. The body may be attached to a bracket and a lamp carrier, with the bracket providing stiffness and facilitation of the compression of the body.

title: Semiconductor structure and method for manufacturing the same
abstract: The present invention relates to semiconductor technology and provides a semiconductor structure employing optical interconnects and a method for manufacturing the same. The structure comprises: a photonic wafer carrying a plurality of photonic integrated circuit (PIC) chips, each having a first waveguide; an optical interposer carrying the photonic wafer and including a second waveguide; a plurality of analog electrical chips, each connected to at least one PIC chip; and a plurality of digital electrical chips, each electrically connected to a corresponding analog electrical chip. On the optical interposer, PIC chips arranged in a first direction are optically connected through the first waveguides, and PIC chips arranged in a second direction are optically connected through the second waveguides. This configuration enables integration of more computing and storage units, with optical interconnects providing seamless data exchange and improved system energy efficiency.

title: Medium conveying apparatus and computer-readable non-transitory medium
abstract: A medium conveying apparatus according to one aspect of the present disclosure includes a feed roller to separate and feed a medium, a conveyance roller located downstream from the feed roller in a medium conveying direction to convey the medium fed by the feed roller, a processing device located downstream from the conveyance roller in the medium conveying direction to perform predetermined processing on the medium conveyed by the conveyance roller, a single driving source to generate a driving force for rotating the feed roller and the conveyance roller, and control circuitry to control the driving source. When the medium has not reached a predetermined position at a predetermined timing, the control circuitry controls the driving source to change a rotation speed of the feed roller on a condition that a trailing end of a preceding medium has passed the processing device.

title: Analysis device and analysis method
abstract: An analysis device includes: a device holder configured to hold a microchamber device; a light source configured to irradiate the microchamber device with light; one or more aspheric lenses placed such that the optical axis thereof is substantially parallel to a normal line of a first surface of the microchamber device; an imaging apparatus configured to image the microchamber device via the aspheric lenses; a first optical filter positioned between the microchamber device and the imaging apparatus, the first optical filter cutting off light emitted from the light source and allowing at least a portion of light having a longer wavelength than the wavelength of the light emitted from the light source to pass therethrough; and a light-shielding unit configured to suppress the detection, by the imaging apparatus to be held, of light other than light generated from the microchamber device and detected by the imaging apparatus to be held.
assignee: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company, Inc.; The University Of Tokyo

title: Backlight module and electronic device having the same
abstract: A backlight module includes a substrate, a light guide plate and a plurality of light sources. The light guide plate includes a bottom surface, a top surface, and a plurality of receiving recesses. The bottom surface and the top surface are facing away from each other, and the bottom surface is closer to the substrate than to the top surface. The receiving recesses are recessed inward from the bottom surface. Each receiving recess includes a groove bottom surface and at least one light incident surface connected to the groove bottom surface, a normal direction of each of the light incident surface is not parallel to a normal direction of the bottom surface. The light sources are electrically connected to the substrate and arranged in the receiving recesses. Each light source is configured to emit light toward the light incident surface of one of the receiving recesses.
assignee: Advanced Optoelectronic Technology, Inc.; Asphetek Solution Inc.; Exbri Technology Inc.

title: Magnetic memory device
abstract: According to one embodiment, a magnetic memory device includes a plurality of magnetoresistance effect elements arranged along first and second directions, and an insulating layer including hole portions provided for magnetoresistance effect elements. The magnetoresistance effect element includes first and second magnetic layers and first non-magnetic layer between the first and second magnetic layers, each of the second magnetic layer and the first non-magnetic layer includes a portion provided along bottom and side surfaces of a corresponding hole portion, and the portion of the second magnetic layer along the bottom and side surfaces has magnetism, and at least a portion of the second magnetic layer along the bottom surface has a variable magnetization direction.

title: Semiconductor memory device and method for manufacturing the same
abstract: A semiconductor memory device includes a first dielectric wall, a second dielectric wall, first channel portions, second channel portions, an isolation wall, and a dielectric feature. The second dielectric wall is spaced apart from the first dielectric wall in a first direction. The first channel portions are disposed on a side of the first dielectric wall and are spaced apart from each other in a second direction transverse to the first direction. The second channel portions are disposed on a side of the second dielectric wall and are spaced apart from each other in the second direction. The isolation wall is located between the first dielectric wall and the second dielectric wall. The dielectric feature is disposed to separate the first dielectric wall and the isolation wall, and is disposed on the other side of the first dielectric wall opposite to the first channel portions in the first direction.

title: Display device and electronic device including the same
abstract: A display device includes a first pixel group including a first pixel, a second pixel, a third pixel and a fourth pixel in which a plurality of emission areas are defined. A second pixel group includes a fifth pixel and a sixth pixel in which a plurality of emission areas are defined. An optical lens unit includes a first lens and a second lens. The second pixel group and the optical lens unit are disposed on the first pixel group. The fifth pixel overlaps the first pixel in a thickness direction of the optical lens unit. The first lens overlaps the second pixel in the thickness direction.

title: Systems, methods, and media for processing sub-indirection-unit data in solid-state drives
abstract: Mechanisms, including systems, methods, and media, for processing sub-indirection unit sized data in a solid-state drive (SSD) are provided, the methods including: identifying, in a first portion of storage of the SSD, a plurality of indirection units each containing sub-indirection-unit-sized data and padding; combining the plurality of indirection units into a page-size data structure using a hardware processor; copying contents of the page-sized data structure to a second portion of storage of the SSD; and updating a data structure relating logical address of data to physical locations of data so that an entry corresponding to the sub-indirection-unit-sized data of one of the plurality of indirection units changes from having a physical address in the first portion of storage to having a physical address in the second portion of storage.
assignee: Sk Hynix Nand Product Solutions Corp.

title: Quantum dot composite material, method of forming the same and light-emitting device
abstract: A quantum dot composite material is provided. The quantum dot composite material includes a carrier core; a plurality of quantum dot particles attached to the carrier core; and a composite protective layer covering the carrier core and the plurality of quantum dot particles, and including a cladding layer and a porous light-diffusion layer which include light-transmissive materials. The cladding layer is conformably formed on the carrier core and the plurality of quantum dot particles. The porous light-diffusion layer is formed on the cladding layer and includes an irregular surface.

title: Terminal, system, control method of terminal, and storage medium
abstract: A terminal includes an identity verification means and a storage means. The identity verification means performs identity verification of an opener of a digital wallet using biometric information acquired from an identity verification document and biometric information of the opener of the digital wallet. The storage means, in a case of successful identity verification, stores the biometric information acquired from the identity verification document or the biometric information of the opener of the digital wallet as biometric information of the holder of the digital wallet.

title: Transmission method and device using multiple carrier waves
abstract: A method by which a first device ( 100 ) operates in a wireless communication system is presented. The method may comprise the steps of: acquiring information about aggregated carrier waves; and performing inter-device transmission for a second device by using the aggregated carrier waves, wherein the aggregated carrier waves include a first carrier wave and a second carrier wave, and it could be expected that first information about a symbol that can be used for inter-device communication included in the first carrier wave is configured to be the same as second information about a symbol that can be used for inter-device communication included in the second carrier wave.

title: Lighting control system configurable by mobile device
abstract: A commissioning and configuration for a lighting control system of a building environment comprises a mobile device and a directional device. The directional device directs a directional link to a select sensor device. The select sensor device is either a first sensor device or a second sensor device located in a particular area of the building environment. The mobile device connects to the first sensor device via a wireless communication link, receives a response message from the select sensor device via the wireless communication link in response to the directional device directing the directional link to the select sensor device. The mobile device associates the select sensor device with a device group corresponding to the particular area based on the response message. The mobile device configures a communication and operational parameter for a sensor network including the sensor devices as a group.

title: Contagion-based flood propagation models using multilayer networks
abstract: Examples include generating a flood contagion model using transportation system data corresponding to a transportation system of a defined area and stormwater system data corresponding to a stormwater system of the defined area, the flood contagion model including a multilayer network including: a transportation system layer comprising a plurality of first nodes; and a stormwater system comprising a plurality of second nodes, wherein the transportation system layer and the stormwater system layer are interconnected based on connections made between the plurality of first nodes and the plurality of second nodes; generating time series water depth data by applying a hydrologic model to the defined area; calibrating the flood contagion model using the time series water depth data; simulating a flooding scenario using the calibrated flood contagion model to determine locations of flooding in the multilayer network; and displaying results of the simulation on a user device.
assignee: The Board Of Regents Of The University Of Oklahoma

title: Dryer module for articles of clothing
abstract: The invention relates to a dryer module comprising a structure substantially delimiting a control volume forming an air circulation or exchange chamber, which has side faces that are connected to an upper face and a lower face; the structure has a front face and a rear face; the exchange chamber includes laundry hanging elements that allow for the hanging of objects such as clothes; the rear face includes at least one door. The side faces and the front face selectively include air circulation areas, according to the selected operating modes of the dryer module, and the dryer module includes different geometrical proportions between the total height, total width and total depth. The dryer module includes several means of anchoring to a facade wall.

title: Augmented Neuromodulation and Biofeedback for Symptom Intervention
abstract: A symptom intervention system monitors data representative of a user's movement, identifies an onset of a symptom of a physical condition, and applies an actuation to intervene with the identified onset. A machine-learned model is trained to identify an onset of a symptom based on the monitored data. The system may use the machine-learned model to determine whether to modify an upcoming administration of a chemical stimulus that is administered to the user to treat their physical condition. The system may determine a modification to a dose or a time associated with the upcoming administration of the stimulus and apply the stimulus to the user based on the determined modification. The system may use the machine-learned model to determine that the user is exhibiting a particular symptom of their physical condition. Depending on the symptom, the system may depolarize or hyperpolarize neurons of the user.

title: Satellite Communication Method and Apparatus
abstract: A satellite communication method and an apparatus are provided. The method can be applied to the field of satellite communication. The method includes: receiving extension configuration information; receiving first duration indication information; and extending a first validity duration and/or extending a second validity duration based on the extension configuration information and the first duration indication information. According to the method, a validity duration of position information used for uplink synchronization or mobility management can be separately determined, to improve communication efficiency.

title: Lithium storage body, anode for lithium secondary battery including the same and method for manufacturing the lithium storage body
abstract: The present disclosure provides a lithium storage body including a composite of a sulfide-based solid electrolyte and a conductive material, and an anode for a lithium secondary battery including the same. The lithium storage body includes the composite of the sulfide-based solid electrolyte and the conductive material, thereby improving mechanical properties and electrical characteristics thereof.
assignee: Sk On Co., Ltd.; University-Industry Cooperation Group Of Kyung Hee University

title: Method for continuing video recording and recording device
abstract: A method for continuing video recording applied to a recording device including an interactive device includes obtaining a video to be processed. The video to be processed includes a recorded video or a paused video that the recording device has currently paused recording during a recording process. The method further includes in response to a user operation of the interactive device, controlling the recording device to record a continuation video; in response to determining that the video to be processed is the recorded video, generating a target video according to the recorded video and the continuation video; and in response to determining that the video to be processed is the paused video that the recording device has currently paused recording, generating a target video according to the paused video and the continuation video.

title: Wearable throat muscle training apparatus
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wearable throat muscle training apparatus designed as a mechanically actuated device that provides controlled, repeatable resistance to cervical and throat muscles. The apparatus includes a collar body frame positioned around the anterior and lateral neck regions, supporting two symmetrically arranged resistance modules and a pivot-mounted mouthpiece arm assembly. Each resistance module contains a compression spring within a spring chamber, guided by a central rod and adjustable via a preload screw to set initial resistance. The mouthpiece arm is connected through a pivot joint and incorporates a force transmission rod that moves axially. This rod engages both resistance modules simultaneously through a bifurcated structure. When force is applied via the mouthpiece, rotational motion is converted into linear displacement, compressing the springs evenly. Upon release, the springs expand, restoring the system to its original position, enabling consistent, balanced throat muscle training.

title: Automated cart operation
abstract: A system is provided. The system includes a cart including a hopper and an unload auger, the hopper having a flow door configured to release material stored in the hopper into the unload auger when in an open condition. The system includes one or more sensors, at least a first sensor of the one or more sensors being configured to measure a rotation rate of the unload auger. The system includes a controller. The system includes processing circuitry configured to: (1) prevent the flow door from opening if the rotation rate of the unload auger is below a threshold and/or the unload auger is in a folded position; and/or (2) close the flow door if the rotation rate of the unload auger is below the threshold.

title: Upcycling polyurethane foam by incorporation of dynamic covalent adaptable networks
abstract: A thermoplastic polyurethane foam has chemical dynamic covalent adaptable networks. The foam comprises a reaction product of a polyol mixture and an isocyanate mixture. The polyol mixture comprises a polyol and a dynamic cross-linking agent with a content between 0.05 to 70 wt. %. The dynamic cross-linking agent forms dynamic cross-linking bonds.

title: Techniques for determining fetal situs during an imaging procedure
abstract: Techniques for determining fetal situs during an ultrasound imaging procedure are disclosed. The techniques can include obtaining an ultrasound image of a fetus in utero. The fetus will include a torso and a spine and the ultrasound image can comprise a circumferential view of the torso of the fetus. The circumferential view can include at least: (i) an outer border of the torso, and (ii) the spine that includes three landmarks arranged in a triangular orientation. The techniques can further include superimposing a fetal overlay based on an alignment instruction corresponding to an alignment between the outer border of the torso and the three landmarks to obtain an augmented reality image of the fetus. The fetal overlay can include a graphical element indicating a left side and a right side of the fetus. The augmented reality image of the fetus can be output on a display of the ultrasound machine.

title: Vegetation-based remediation systems, remediation straw and cartridge apparatuses for groundwater treatment, and methods for installation of vegetation-based remediation systems
abstract: Vegetation-based remediation systems, remediation straws, and in-line cartridges for groundwater treatment, and methods for installing vegetation-based remediation systems are disclosed herein. A vegetation-based remediation system can include a liner sleeve for positioning within an excavated hole and a bottom impermeable barrier positioned at a bottom of the excavated hole on which the liner sleeve resides. The vegetation-based remediation system can also include a straw for insertion in a hole through backfill soil mixture, the liner sleeve, and the bottom impermeable barrier and into the soil below the bottom impermeable barrier. The straw has an inlet well screen and an outlet well screen. A removable treatment cartridge can be inserted into the straw. The treatment cartridge can have a filter section with treatment media therein. The filter section can be positioned within the straw between the outlet well screen and the inlet well screen of the straw upon installation.

title: Lens unit, camera module, imaging system, and mobile body
abstract:
Provided are a lens unit, a camera module, an imaging system, and a mobile body in which vibration is easily transmitted from a vibrating body to a first lens. 
     A lens group in which a plurality of lenses is arranged along an optical axis of the lenses and a lens barrel that houses and holds the lens group are provided, a vibration mechanism including a vibrating body that vibrates a first lens located closest to an object side among the plurality of lenses is provided, a black adhesive layer is provided on a flat surface of the first lens facing an image side, and the vibrating body is bonded to the flat surface via the black adhesive layer.
assignee: Maxell, Ltd.; Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

title: Substrate processing apparatus and substrate processing method using the same
abstract: A substrate processing method includes classifying a kind of substrate treatment process in which a focus ring is used, classifying a plurality of focus rings, selecting from the classified plurality of focus rings a specific focus ring suitable for a certain substrate treatment process corresponding to the classified kind of substrate treatment process, and performing the certain substrate treatment process using the selected specific focus ring. The operation of classifying the plurality of focus rings includes classifying the plurality of focus rings into two or more grades.

title: Method for manufacturing a color-fast and weather-resistant board
abstract: The invention relates to a method for manufacturing a color-fast and weather-resistant board. In order to provide a color-fast and weather-resistant board with a simple coating, it is provided that a waterproof carrier board is provided to which a first layer of a coating selected from the group comprising decorative paper, finish foil, veneer, lacquer, continuous pressure laminate (CPL) or high pressure laminate (HPL) is applied and to which a second layer of a coating is applied which is a lacquer layer, a layer of oil, wax or glaze. The invention further includes a color-fast and weather-resistant board.

title: System and Method for Self-Aligned Multiple Patterning with Process Steps Within a Single Plasma Process Chamber
abstract: Disclosed herein is a system and method for executing self-aligned double patterning (SADP) and self-aligned quadruple patterning (SAQP) in situ within a single plasma process chamber. The system integrates atomic layer deposition (ALD), atomic layer etching (ALE), radical-based highly selective etching (HSE), and dry cleaning, eliminating vacuum breaks to reduce cycle time and prevent undesired surface modifications.

title: X-ray apparatus with non-linear anode and non-linear cooling channels
abstract: Some embodiments include an x-ray apparatus, comprising: a non-linear anode; a non-linear cooling channel disposed within the non-linear anode; a target disposed on the non-linear anode; wherein: the target is configured to generate x-rays in response to incident electrons; and in a plane perpendicular to a path for coolant in the non-linear cooling channel, a material of the non-linear anode is continuous around the non-linear cooling channel.

title: Delivery systems for prosthetic heart valves
abstract: A delivery apparatus can include a handle, a first shaft extending distally from the handle, a second shaft extending distally from the handle coaxially through the first shaft,  a shoulder assembly disposed at a distal end portion of the delivery apparatus, and a balloon coupled to a distal end of the second shaft. The balloon can extend over the shoulder assembly and can be shape set to form a distal balloon bump over the shoulder assembly, a central portion, and a proximal balloon bump disposed proximally of the central portion.

title: Computer implemented method and system for launching content
abstract: A computer implemented method comprising: displaying a portion of a virtual space; responsive to a panning input, panning the displayed portion of the virtual space to a part of the virtual space containing one or more interactive symbols, each of the one or more interactive symbols being associated with content; responsive to a selection input: selecting one of the one or more interactive symbols; and launching the content associated with the selected interactive symbol. A system comprising a display device, an input device, and a processor is also described.

title: Endoscope and operation section for endoscope
abstract: An endoscope includes: an insertion section including a distal end and a proximal end, the insertion section configured for insertion into a subject; an operation section main body connected to the proximal end of the insertion section and, the operation section main body configured to be grasped by a user. The operation section main body includes an operation knob and a switch button. The operation knob is rotatable about a center axis to move the distal end of the insertion section. The switch button is translatable in a translating direction. In a view in a longitudinal direction of the operation section main body, the center axis of the operation knob is configured to be tilted with respect to a direction that is perpendicular to each of the longitudinal direction of the operation section main body and the translating direction of the switch button.

title: Dental mirror suction adapter
abstract: A dental mirror suction adapter includes a main body having a lower body section, a middle body section and an upper body section. The lower body section includes a circular shaped element that houses a mirror. The middle body section connects the lower body section to the upper body section at an oblique angle. The upper body section includes a first opening positioned adjacent to the mirror, a hollow middle section, and a second opening located opposite to the first opening. The second opening connects to a disposable tip for a High Suction Evacuation system. A protrusion within the upper body section engages a hole in the tip to secure the HSE tip to the device. The device mirror is positionable within the mouth of a patient and any saliva, fluids and debris are sucked into the first opening, through the device and into the High Suction Evacuation system.

title: Semiconductor device, semiconductor module, power conversion unit, and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a semiconductor element, a plurality of connecting parts each being conductive, a sealing part that covers the semiconductor element and a portion of each of the connecting parts, a plurality of signal terminals each inserted into one of the connecting parts, and a holding part. The signal terminals protrude from the sealing part toward a first side in a thickness direction of the sealing part. The holding part covers a portion of each signal terminal. In one example, the signal terminals are collectively held and inserted into the connecting parts.

title: Coaxial drive module capable of motion and force control
abstract: The coaxial drive module capable of motion and force control includes a first drive configured to provide a first driving force about a drive shaft; a second drive coaxially connected to the drive shaft and configured to be interlocked with the first driving force or to provide a second driving force different from the first driving force; and an output unit configured to receive and output the first and second driving forces, wherein the first driving force includes a linear driving force with respect to the output unit to adjust a position of an object output by the output unit, and the second driving force includes an elastic driving force with respect to the output unit to adjust a magnitude of force output by the output unit.
assignee: Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute Of Science And Technology

title: Device for monitoring a power supply
abstract: A device for monitoring a power supply for Safety Extra Low Voltage includes: a first monitoring element for monitoring a first current, I 1,  and a first voltage, U 1,  which are output on a secondary side of a voltage converter; a primary side control element signal conducting connected to the first monitoring element for controlling the voltage converter on a primary side based on the first current, I 1,  and the first voltage, U 1,  when a first threshold value is exceeded; and a second monitoring element for monitoring a second current, I 2,  and a second voltage, U  2,  the second current, I 2,  and the second voltage, U 2,  being based on the first current, I 1,  and the first voltage, U 1,  with the second monitoring element supplied by the first monitoring element with the first current, I 1,  and the first voltage, U 1.  The primary side control element is signal conducting.

title: Method for manufacturing light-emitting module, method for manufacturing image display device, and light-emitting module
abstract: A method for manufacturing a light-emitting module according to an embodiment includes: preparing a first intermediate member including a support member having a first surface and a second surface, a wiring layer provided on the first surface, a plurality of light-emitting elements electrically connected to the wiring layer on the first surface, and a photoresist member covering the light-emitting elements; and forming a second intermediate member by lighting the plurality of light-emitting elements to expose a plurality of first portions of the photoresist member to light. The photoresist member is sensitive to irradiation with light including a wavelength of light of the plurality of light-emitting elements.

title: Secure intercalate modular message solution (simms)
abstract: The present disclosure is directed to systems, methods, and non-transitory computer-readable media for generating, by a first node, an encrypted protected message. Generating the encrypted protected message includes generating an obfuscated message by intercalating a second message into the first message, generating a protected message by applying a plurality of data protection mechanisms to the obfuscated message, and generating the encrypted protected message by applying a plurality of confidentiality techniques to the protected message. The first node transmits to a second node the encrypted protected message using a plurality of communication channels.

title: Booklet producing apparatus
abstract: Disclosed is a booklet producing apparatus including an application unit configured to apply adhesive onto a sheet, a stacking portion on which a plurality of sheets onto which the adhesive has been applied by the application unit are stacked, a bonding unit configured to nip and bond the plurality of sheets stacked on the stacking portion with the adhesive, and a control unit configured to execute an operation of producing a booklet, the control unit being configured to control the application unit such that an amount of the adhesive per unit area of a layer of the adhesive formed between each pair of adjacent sheets in the booklet varies depending on a position of the layer of the adhesive in a thickness direction of the booklet.

title: Time Tracking Apparatus
abstract: The present invention relates to a time tracking apparatus and a time tracking system for determining a track time of a moving object on a travelling path, the time tracking system comprising at least two time tracking apparatuses. The invention further relates to a method of determining a track time of the moving object.

title: Printer error resolution mechanism
abstract: A system is described. The system comprises at least one physical memory device to store printer error resolution logic and one or more processors coupled with the at least one physical memory device to execute the printer error resolution logic to receive a subject error descriptor, generate processed data by data processing machine log data and reference service data, wherein the machine log data comprises machine log data associated with the subject error descriptor, perform a filtering operation to generate reference machine log data without subject error descriptors, compare the reference machine log data without error descriptors to the machine log data associated with the subject error descriptor to generate an error resolution request and transmit the processed data and the error resolution request to an advisor system for generation of one or more service recommendations for the subject error descriptor.

title: User mediation for hotword/keyword detection
abstract: Techniques are described herein for improving performance of machine learning model(s) and thresholds utilized in determining whether automated assistant function(s) are to be initiated. A method includes: receiving, via one or more microphones of a client device, audio data that captures a spoken utterance of a user; processing the audio data using a machine learning model to generate a predicted output that indicates a probability of one or more hotwords being present in the audio data; determining that the predicted output satisfies a secondary threshold that is less indicative of the one or more hotwords being present in the audio data than is a primary threshold; in response to determining that the predicted output satisfies the secondary threshold, prompting the user to indicate whether or not the spoken utterance includes a hotword; receiving, from the user, a response to the prompting; and adjusting the primary threshold based on the response.

title: Heteroepitaxial growth method of compound semiconductor materials on multi-oriented semiconductor substrates and devices
abstract: A method for growing a semiconductor material over a Si-based substrate includes providing the Si-based substrate; growing a monocrystalline refractory-metal ceramic film directly over the Si-based substrate; and depositing a semiconductor film directly over the monocrystalline refractory-metal ceramic film. The monocrystalline refractory-metal ceramic film has a thickness less than 300 nm.
assignee: King Abdullah University Of Science And Technology

title: Electronic device
abstract: The present disclosure provides an electronic device including an interposer including a connection substrate including a substrate layer and through vias penetrating thereof, and a first and second circuit structures respectively on first and second surfaces of the substrate layer, and each including first wirings electrically connected to each other through first through vias among the through vias and second wirings thermally coupled to each other through second through vias among the through vias, an electronic unit disposed on and electrically connected to the interposer, and a heat dissipation element unit disposed on the interposer at opposite sides of the interposer, and is in contact and thermally coupled to the second wirings and the second through vias.
assignee: Innolux Corporation; nD-HI Technologies Lab, Inc.

title: Method and apparatus for video compression using skip modes
abstract: A video compression device is described having one or more processors configured to execute video compression by, for each of a plurality of regions in a state of a video stream, estimating motion between that region in that state and corresponding regions in other states of the video stream. Selecting one or more parts in the state of the video stream as a part to be skipped in dependence on the respective estimated motion for an associated region in the state of the video stream. Encoding the video data of the video stream to form a residual representing the state of the video stream in one or more channels by, in response to a part having been selected to be skipped, omitting data representing that part in at least one of the channels from the residual.

title: X-ray system with modular two-layer detector
abstract: The present invention relates to a detection system for an X-ray imaging system. The detection system comprises a first detector a second detector, each detector comprising a detector area and being configured for detecting X-ray radiation emitted by an X-ray source of the X-ray imaging system impinging onto the respective detection area. The detection system is configured to adjust a position of at least one of the first detector and the second detector with respect to the other of the first detector and the second detector. The first detection area of the first detector and the second detection area of the second detector can be positioned at least partially one behind the other with respect to a direction of X-ray radiation emitted from the X-ray source of the X-ray imaging system.

title: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for continuous monitoring and effective management of hydration
abstract: A real time automated hydration management solution is described herein that uses predictive and counterfactual generation models to recommend optimal behavior for normalizing hydration levels based on data collected in real time.
assignee: Arizona Board Of Regents On Behalf Of Arizona State University

title: Fluid delivery cassette
abstract: A fluid delivery cassette includes a cartridge assembly and a needle assembly. The cartridge assembly includes a cartridge configured to contain a fluid, a septum positioned at a distal opening of the cartridge, a piston sealing a proximal opening of the cartridge and movable in an axial direction, and a drive assembly configured to move the piston. The drive assembly includes an axially extendible portion having a distal end that is controllably extendible from a retracted position to an extended position, and a rotatable force-transfer portion configured to receive an applied force and to cause the distal end of the axially extendible portion to move in the axial direction in response to the applied force. The axially extendible portion can be manufactured as a tapered helix having a diameter that varies so that the axially extendible portion is collapsible into the retracted position.

title: Station apparatus for charging robot and method of controlling station apparatus
abstract: A station apparatus for charging a robot includes a frame for forming an exterior of the station apparatus, a protruding member protruding from the frame, and a charging circuit including a first charging terminal for charging the robot, and based on the robot contacting the protruding member, the protruding member protruding from the frame is retracted into the frame and reduces a traveling speed of the robot, as the protruding member is retracted into the frame, the first charging terminal protrudes from an inside of the frame to an outside of the frame, and as the first charging terminal protrudes to the outside of the frame, a contact area between the first charging terminal and a second charging terminal of the robot gradually increases.

title: Aerosol delivery device, an article for use therewith, and a method of identifying an article
abstract: An article including an aerosolizable material; and a signal altering component, wherein the signal altering component is configured to alter a first signal transmitted at least partially through the article into a second signal indicative of article data.

title: Diphosphine-diborane complex and method for producing same
abstract: The present invention pertains to: a stable equivalent of 2,2″-bis(1-phosphinoethyl)-1,1″-biferrocene or the like that is useful as a ligand in various catalytic reactions but is difficult to synthesize or isolate and purify; and a method for efficiently producing the stable equivalent. The present invention provides: a diphosphine-diborane complex represented by general formula (1·(BH 3 ) 2 ); and a method that is for producing the diphosphine-diborane complex, and that comprises sequentially reacting a magnesium source and an oxidizing agent with a phosphine-borane complex.

title: Compounds and compositions for use in stem cell transplantation
abstract: The invention relates to a Matriptase-2 (MT2) inhibitor, TMPRSS6 inhibitor, Ferroportin blocker, or hepcidin enhancer. In particular, the invention relates to the use of compounds capable of reducing at least one of systemic iron level, Transferrin saturation (Tsat), non-transferrin-bound iron (NTBI), and labile plasma iron (LPI). This may take place by inhibiting the expression of a target gene, wherein the target gene may be Transmembrane protease, serine 6 (TMPRSS6). Further, the invention relates to compositions comprising said compound and to methods for using such compounds and/or compositions. The uses may comprise therapeutic uses such as for reduction or iron overload and the prevention of iron related toxicity before, during or after chemotherapeutic conditioning, stem cell transplantation and engraftment.
assignee: Silence Therapeutics Gmbh; New York Blood Center, Inc.

title: Targets and methods of diagnosing, monitoring and treating frontotemporal dementia
abstract: Disclosed herein are antibodies, antibody fragments, binding agents, and compositions that specifically recognize protein variant biomarkers associated with frontotemporal dementia, kits and methods of use, including diagnosing, monitoring and treating frontotemporal dementia.
assignee: Arizona Board Of Regents On Behalf Of Arizona State University

title: Method and system for detecting small ship targets in thermal infrared images based on hierarchical feature attention network
abstract: A method and system for detecting small ship targets in thermal infrared images based on hierarchical feature attention network belongs to the field of satellite remote sensing image processing and application technology. The present disclosure constructs the first pixel level annotated three-channel infrared ship target detection image dataset based on SDGSAT-1. This dataset covers various scenarios and contains rich thermal information, and is more suitable for detecting small ships in thermal infrared images. Meanwhile, a network model based on hierarchical feature attention mechanism is constructed, which generates feature maps of different scales through multi-level detail enhancement processing. Multi-level long-distance information was extracted through a multi-level large kernel attention mechanism. By the multi-level fusion of feature maps at different scales, a predicted target probability map is generated to achieve fusion and interaction of different scales, enabling accurate location of ships.
assignee: Shanghai Institute of Technical Physics Chinese Academy of Sciences

title: Measurement method in non-terrestrial network, communication device, and storage medium
abstract: The present application provides a measurement method and apparatus. The method is executed by a terminal device, and the method comprises: receiving serving satellite information via a system information block from a network device, in which the serving satellite information includes a distance threshold, the distance threshold is a distance from a reference location of a serving cell and is used in location-based measurements initiation; in response to the distance between the UE and the reference location of the serving cell being shorter than the distance threshold, not performing intra-frequency measurements or inter-frequency measurements, wherein the UE is in an RRC (Radio Resource Control) idle state; in response to the distance between the UE and the reference location of the serving cell being above the distance threshold, performing intra-frequency measurements or inter-frequency measurements, wherein the UE is in an RRC connected state. In the present application, the throughput loss and energy consumption of a terminal device is reduced.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Cover, lock and alignment mark
