abstract: Examples include a consumer product comprising a detergent product and a container, the container comprising a box, a cover for the box, and a lock to reversibly maintain the cover in a closed position. The box comprises the detergent product, the box comprising a base, sidewalls and an opening, the cover comprising a top and flanks, the cover covering the opening and the cover covering at least a specific portion of a specific sidewall of the box when the cover is in the closed position. At least one of the flanks and sidewalls comprises a graphical alignment mark coinciding with the cover being in the closed position.

title: Rodent trapping apparatus
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention disclose a rodent trapping apparatus. The rodent trapping apparatus includes a lid including a top surface, wherein the lid comprises a longitudinal slot having two opposing longitudinal edges. Further, the rodent trapping apparatus includes two sidewalls provided on the top surface, with one sidewall along each longitudinal edge of the longitudinal slot. The rodent trapping apparatus further includes a transverse connecting member connecting the two sidewalls thereby forming a tunnel over the longitudinal slot, a proximal end of the tunnel being located at the edge of the lid. The rodent trapping apparatus further includes a bait compartment located at a distal end of the tunnel. The rodent trapping apparatus includes a swivel platform located within the longitudinal slot. The swivel platform is configured to swivel about a pivot axis, the pivot axis being located between the distal end and the proximal end of the tunnel.

title: Surface-modified nanosheets and coatings
abstract: A novel flake including a nanosheet, which is capable of forming a smooth and thin coating; a coating including the flake; and a method for producing the coating. Provided is a flake containing a composite that contains a clay mineral and an amine, and having a thickness of 10 nm or less.

title: Deploying autonomous software agents via third-party messaging applications
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems, methods, and non-transitory computer-readable media that connects with a messaging application for digital conversations between a plurality of users and deploys an autonomous software agent via a prompt received from the messaging application. In particular, the disclosed systems connect a messaging application with an autonomous software agent system. Moreover, the disclosed systems receive a prompt to activate an autonomous software agent from the messaging application. Additionally, the disclosed systems deploy the autonomous software agent that operates within an independent virtual machine computing environment to generate artificial intelligence outputs responsive to the prompt and proves the artificial intelligence outputs to the messaging application.

title: Housings for tracking devices
abstract: Housings for tracking devices comprise a body and an electrical network. The body defines a device-receiving region and a housing battery region. The device-receiving region is configured to receive the tracking device without a battery cover of the tracking device present. The housing battery region is configured to receive one or more housing batteries. The electrical network is configured to electrically couple the one or more housing batteries with the tracking device when the tracking device is operatively received in the device-receiving region and when the one or more housing batteries are operatively received in the housing battery region.

title: Shadow generation
abstract: Light source information of a virtual light source and one or more observation parameters of a virtual camera are obtained. Based on the light source information and the one or more observation parameters, a multi-angle contour map of the three-dimensional model is generated. The multi-angle contour map is a combination of a plurality of binary contour images of the three-dimensional model from different angles. Based on the light source information and the one or more observation parameters, the multi-angle contour map is projected onto a reference plane, to obtain a hard shadow image. A shadow feature of the three-dimensional model is obtained based on the light source information and a material attribute of the three-dimensional model. The hard shadow image and the shadow feature are input into a convolutional neural network-based shadow prediction model to generate a soft shadow image of the three-dimensional model.

title: Inhibitors of nlrp3 inflammasome
abstract: The present disclosure relates to compounds that act as inhibitors of NLRP3 inflammasomes; pharmaceutical compositions comprising the compounds; and methods of treating disorders associated with inflammation and inflammaging, including hearing loss and other diseases associated with aging.

title: Hardware-attested wrapper for institutional prediction markets
abstract: A hardware-attested wrapper platform transforms a native prediction market contract into a wrapped derivative instrument within a hardware trusted execution environment having a hardware measurement register and a hardware-rooted attestation key. A compliance processing engine executes within the environment under a four-element interlock binding the measurement register to a measured compliance code base, sealing committed rule sets to the hardware identity, binding wrapped outputs to committed rule-set versions, and binding a compliance attestation record to the foregoing. The engine applies screening, jurisdictional mapping, Basel-aligned capital treatment, and regulatory reporting transformation. A compliance attestation record is admitted to an export interface only when the measurement register matches an authorized-measurement set and the record is signed by the hardware-rooted key within the environment. The record is independently verifiable against a hardware-vendor attestation service without operator participation.

title: Recess gate and interconnector structure and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present application provides a semiconductor device and a method for preparing the same. The semiconductor device includes a substrate having an active region; a recess gate structure disposed in the substrate and intersecting the active region; a bit line contact including a polysilicon stack and disposed on the substrate; a conductive pillar disposed over the substrate and electrically connected to the active region; a landing pad disposed on the conductive pillar and electrically connected to the conductive pillar; and a stack of dielectric layers disposed over the substrate and laterally surrounding the bit line contact. The polysilicon stack includes a first polysilicon layer and a second polysilicon layer disposed over the first polysilicon layer. The second polysilicon layer is in direct contact with the stack of dielectric layers.

title: Cutting insert, cutting tool, and method for manufacturing machined product
abstract: A cutting insert includes first and second lateral surfaces and a first corner lateral surface. The first lateral surface includes a first recessed portion. The second lateral surface includes a second recessed portion. In a direction parallel to an upper surface, a distance from the first recessed portion to the first corner lateral surface is a first distance, a distance from the second recessed portion to the first corner lateral surface is a second distance, a width of the first recessed portion is a first width, and a width of the second recessed portion is a second width, the first width and the second width are smaller than the first distance and the second distance. In a front view of the first corner lateral surface, the first recessed portion and the second recessed portion are rotationally symmetrically with respect to a center of the first corner lateral surface.

title: System and method of controlling automatic ventilation for vehicle
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an automatic ventilation control system and control method for a vehicle. The system may include a mode button, a rain sensor and/or a wiper detection module, a vehicle speed sensor, an air conditioning control system, and an automatic ventilation controller. The automatic ventilation controller may be configured to determine whether the automatic ventilation mode is on, determine whether the rain sensor or the wiper detection module detects rain, determine whether the vehicle speed is within a predetermined range, determine whether the vehicle interior temperature approaches the set temperature based on the vehicle interior temperature and the set temperature, and control the vehicle to perform ventilation when the automatic ventilation mode is on, the rain sensor or the wiper detection module detects no rain, the vehicle speed is within the predetermined range, and the vehicle interior temperature approaches the set temperature.

title: Article of manufacture for treating crohns disease
abstract: Antibody formulations are described comprising a mixture of an anti-α4β7 antibody, an antioxidant or chelator, and at least one free amino acid. The disclosed formulations may have improved stability, reduced aggregate formation, or both. The present invention further provides a safe dosing regimen of these antibody formulations that is easy to follow, and which results in a therapeutically effective amount of the anti-α4β7 antibody in vivo.

title: Vehicle storage device
abstract: A vehicle storage device includes a first floor coupling panel, a second floor coupling panel, and a third floor coupling panel that are respectively rotatably coupled to edge portions of an opening section of an underfloor storage chamber, and a first seat coupling panel, a second seat coupling panel, and a third seat coupling panel that are rotatably coupled to a back face of a seatback of the rear seat. In the storage device, the opening section of the underfloor storage chamber is configured to be openable/closeable by the first floor coupling panel and the second floor coupling panel. These coupling panels are able to form a storage box having an interior in communication with the inside of the underfloor storage chamber at a vehicle upper side of the underfloor storage chamber.
assignee: Nhk Spring Co., Ltd.; Subaru Corporation

title: Confocal microscope and method for confocal microscopy, with automatic focusing
abstract:
The invention relates to a confocal microscope ( 1 ) comprising:
         an excitation light source ( 5 ) for an excitation light beam ( 6 ),   an excitation light beam splitter ( 7 ),   a point detector ( 14 ) with detector lens ( 13 ) for sample light ( 10 ) returning from a sample ( 2 ),   a microscope objective ( 4 ),   a movement device ( 3 ) for adjusting a relative distance (AB) between the microscope objective ( 4 ) and the sample ( 2 ),   an analysis device ( 16 ) comprising an analysis beam splitter ( 8 ) for coupling out a portion ( 11   a ) of the sample light ( 10 ) returning from the sample ( 2 ), an analysis lens system ( 12 ) for focusing the coupled-out portion ( 11   a ) toward an analysis detector ( 17 ), the analysis detector ( 17 ) for detecting the coupled-out portion ( 11   a ), and a modulation device ( 22 ) with which the refractive power of the analysis lens system ( 12 ) and/or a relative distance (RA) between the analysis detector ( 17 ) and the analysis lens system ( 12 ) can be cyclically varied over time according to a modulation signal ( 140 ), wherein, based on a detector signal ( 150 ) of the analysis detector ( 17 ) a focus time (t x ) is determined at which the coupled-out portion ( 11   a ) is focused on the analysis detector ( 17 ) and with which a distance control signal for the movement device ( 3 ) is generated. The confocal microscope makes possible a simple and reliable automatic tracking of the distance between the sample and the microscope objective.

title: Makeup mirror lamp capable of air blowing and fill-light illumination
abstract: A makeup mirror lamp capable of air blowing and fill-light illumination includes a base, a lamp body, a ventilation mechanism, and an illumination mechanism. The base supports the lamp body and is provided with a switch and a power interface. An air duct and a fan are disposed in the lamp body, and rear air inlets communicate with an annular air outlet through the air duct. The illumination mechanism is disposed at a front portion of the lamp body and includes a reflector, a light strip arranged around the reflector, and an outer-ring sandblasted glass lens covering LED chips, where luminous centers of the LED chips face a reflective surface. The present disclosure reduces heat in a makeup environment through annular airflow, and achieves soft and uniform light filling by means of secondary reflection.
assignee: Dongguan Mizhi Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Controlled exposure of row-level sparsity patterns for efficient partially homomorphic evaluation of machine learning weight matrices
abstract: A server receives public row metadata from a client device, detailing sets of non-zero column indices for rows in a weight matrix tied to a linear operation. The server groups these rows into multiple pattern groups, with each group containing rows that share an identical pattern of non-zero column indices. For every pattern group, the server creates a pattern descriptor that specifies the shared pattern. The server then receives an encrypted input vector from the client. Using homomorphic encryption, the server sums the encrypted input vector elements according to each pattern descriptor, producing encrypted partial sums for each group. For every row within a group, the server derives an encrypted row result based on the group's partial sum. Finally, the server sends the encrypted row results, encrypted partial sums, and mapping information that links rows to their corresponding pattern groups back to the client device.
assignee: Constructor Technology Ag; Constructor Education and Research Genossenschaft

title: Vehicle sound control system
abstract: A vehicle sound control system for a vehicle having at least one seat provided with a headrest, the vehicle sound control system including: at least one reproduction speaker installed in the headrest and configured to reproduce at least one sound source; at least one sound field control speaker installed in the headrest separately from the reproduction speaker; and a controller configured to control the reproduction speaker and the sound field control speaker, and the controller is configured to execute sound field control that forms a plurality of areas having different sound pressure levels by the reproduction speaker and the sound field control speaker.

title: Power converter and modulation method for three-phase four-bridge-arm inverter circuit
abstract: A power converter and a modulation method for a three-phase four-bridge-arm inverter circuit are disclosed. An inverter includes the three-phase four-bridge-arm inverter circuit and a controller. The controller is configured to: when an absolute value of an instantaneous value of a modulation signal of a bridge arm N is greater than a first effective modulus value, inject a common mode signal into the bridge arm N in a unipolar manner; or when an absolute value of an instantaneous value of a modulation signal of a bridge arm N is less than a second effective modulus value, inject a common mode signal is into the bridge arm N in a bipolar manner. This can prevent a loss of a modulation signal of the bridge arm N, reduce a switching loss of a main bridge arm, and improve quality of electric energy output by the power converter.
assignee: Huawei Digital Power Technologies Co., Ltd.

title: Anode active material, anode including same, secondary battery including same anode, and method for manufacturing anode active material
abstract: The present invention relates to a negative electrode active material, a negative electrode including the same, a secondary battery including the negative electrode, and a method for manufacturing a negative electrode active material.

title: Reading apparatus, checkout system, and reading method
abstract: This reading device ( 10 ) comprises a commodity reading unit ( 101 ), an imaging unit ( 150 ), an identification unit ( 250 ), and a control unit ( 230 ). The commodity reading unit ( 101 ) is provided in a passage through which a person who intends to purchase a commodity passes, and reads commodity information from a wireless communication tag attached to the commodity. The imaging unit ( 150 ) captures an image including at least one among a reading region of the commodity reading unit ( 101 ) and the periphery of the reading region. The identification unit ( 250 ) uses the reading result of the commodity reading unit ( 101 ) and identifies the commodity carried by the person who has passed through the passage. The control unit ( 230 ) controls at least one among the reading condition of the commodity reading unit ( 101 ) and the identification unit ( 250 ) on the basis of the result obtained by processing the image.

title: Bicomponent yarn with improved bulk and hand-feel and elastic fabrics including the bicomponent yarn
abstract: The invention includes fabrics and yarns including polyester bicomponent multifilament yarns. The bicomponent polyester yarn is made from polyethylene terephthalate and polytrimethylene terephthalate in a side by side or eccentric sheath core configuration. The yarns have an improved bulk and provide a more desirable hand-feel in fabrics compared to traditional polyester bicomponent yarns.

title: Virtualized parallel access architecture for flash memory
abstract: A memory controller for controlling a flash memory includes a parallel accessing control circuit. The parallel accessing control circuit is coupled to a command and address (CA) bus, a first data bus, and a second data bus that are respectively coupled to a plurality of first memory units and a plurality of second memory units of the flash memory. The parallel accessing control circuit includes a CA sequencer configured to manage control signals and memory addresses that are transmitted over the CA bus; a first data input/output (DQ) sequencer configured to, through the first data bus, transmit/receive a first portion of encoded write/read data to/from one of first memory units; and a second DQ sequencer, configured to, through the second data bus, transmit/receive a second portion of the encoded write/read data to/from one of second memory units.

title: Storage box manipulator for swimming pools, indoor pools, outdoor pools, fitness studios, and changing areas of industrial companies
abstract: A storage box manipulator includes an effector detachably connectable to an interface of a storage box. The effector comprises at least two switchable magnetic holding elements having holding regions that together span a holding surface. The interface of the storage box provides a ferromagnetic counter surface shaped complementarily to the holding surface. The holding surface of the effector and the counter surface of the storage box are flat, enabling stable magnetic attachment and detachment of the storage box for handling and manipulation.

title: Unit cooler
abstract: A unit cooler includes a housing and an air conditioner. The housing has a base plate having a through hole and an under cover fastened to the base plate with fastening members. A drain passage is recessed in the under cover and located under the through hole. The air conditioner has an electric compressor, a condenser, a decompression device, an evaporator, a first fan, a second fan, and a control device. The fastening members include pairs of first fastening members, second fastening members, and third fastening members. The through hole is open at a position overlapping an intersection point of diagonal lines connecting the second fastening members and the third fastening members.

title: Methods and arrangements for inline, online, at-line, and offline process analytical technology testing (pat) boxes, fraction collectors, skids and automated sampling modules
abstract: The invention provides a modular apparatus comprising at least one process analytical instrument and a controller adapted for fluid communication with a unit operation of a pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing system, systems comprising the modular apparatus, and related compositions and methods. The modular apparatuses described here and associated digital architecture provide a universal solution to fully integrate any pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing process using a wide range of process analytic tools.

title: Golf Shoe with Sensory Feedback System
abstract: A golf shoe includes a sensory feedback system which applies pressure to the bottom of a golfer's foot. The feedback system can comprise a generally planar bendable member which is supported beneath the golfer's foot and includes a first end and a second end. When one or both of the bendable member first and second ends are moved towards the other, the bendable member bends and lifts upwardly for thereby applying pressure to the bottom of the golfer's foot. The feedback system can also comprise first and second lifting components having first and second sloped surfaces. The lifting components are positioned with the first and second sloped surfaces slidingly engaging each other. When the first and/or second lifting component is moved relative to the other in a first direction, a thickness of the system increases in a second direction towards the bottom of the golfer's foot for applying pressure thereto.

title: Power Conversion Apparatus
abstract: A power conversion apparatus includes a plurality of circuit components, a metal base substrate, a first heat transport member, and a cooler. The metal base substrate includes: a main surface on which the plurality of circuit components are mounted; and an end surface connected to the main surface. The first heat transport member includes a main surface and an end surface facing the cooler. The end surface and the end surface are thermally connected to the cooler. The main surface is thermally connected to the metal base substrate.

title: Receiving device and optical wireless communication system
abstract: A receiving device includes: an event camera configured to detect a rising edge and a falling edge of luminance as events; and a controller configured to receive, through the event camera, an optical wireless communication signal transmitted from a transmitting device. A protocol defines how data is represented in the optical wireless communication signal. hen start of reception of the optical wireless communication signal is detected, the controller executes a protocol identification process that identifies an applied protocol applied to the received optical wireless communication signal. After the protocol identification process, the controller recognizes data represented by the optical wireless communication signal based on the applied protocol.

title: Steam cracking of non-hydroprocessed liquid hydrocarbons
abstract: The present disclosure is concerned with a method of supplying a stream of a liquid hydrocarbon to an inlet of a steam cracking furnace and injecting hydrogen gas into the stream of the liquid hydrocarbon at or before the inlet of the steam cracking furnace to produce a mixture of the liquid hydrocarbon and the hydrogen gas. The liquid hydrocarbon in the mixture undergoes steam cracking to produce a reaction product that includes hydrocarbons having smaller carbon chain lengths than before entering the steam cracking furnace. The method does not comprise hydroprocessing the liquid hydrocarbon before steam cracking.

title: Kernel-enforced authentication for ledger-registered ai agents
abstract: The systems and methods disclosed herein load a monitoring program into a kernel or other monitoring component of an operating system external to a user space. The monitoring program attaches to at least one hook point associated with execution of an artificial intelligence agent and captures a plurality of event records (a process identifier, an operation identifier, a resource identifier, a timestamp) associated with the agent. The system generates a cryptographic value by applying one or more functions to a representation of at least a subset of the event records and maintains the cryptographic value on a distributed database within a record associated with the agent. The distributed database maintains a sequence of records that links each record to one or more previous records. The system can detect anomalous agent operations and execute enforcement actions within the monitoring component that restrict agent execution.

title: Image encoding method/device, image decoding method/device, and recording medium in which bitstream is stored
abstract: The present invention provides an image encoding method and an image decoding method. The image encoding method of the present invention comprises: a first dividing step of dividing a current image into a plurality of blocks; and a second dividing step of dividing, into a plurality of sub blocks, a block, which is to be divided and includes a boundary of the current image, among the plurality of blocks, wherein the second dividing step is recursively performed by setting a sub block including the boundary of the current images as the block to be divided, until the sub block including the boundary of the current image does not exist among the sub blocks.
assignee: Industry Academy Cooperation Foundation Of Sejong University

title: Truncated leaflet for prosthetic heart valves
abstract: A prosthetic heart valve includes a radially collapsible and expandable frame having an inflow end, an outflow end, and a central longitudinal axis, and a plurality of leaflets coupled to the frame. Each leaflet includes a free edge portion configured to abut adjacent leaflet free edge portions to prevent fluid flow in a closed position. Opposing upper edge portions of each leaflet are secured to respective commissure support portions of the frame. The leaflet includes a truncated base and first and second side edge portions extending diagonally from opposing ends of the base to the respective upper edge portions. Each side edge portion is coupled along an entire length of a corresponding frame portion extending from adjacent the inflow end to a commissure support portion. The side edge portions diverge from one another in a direction from the leaflet base toward the free edge portion.

title: Light-emitting element, light-emitting module and display backlight unit
abstract: A light-emitting device includes a semiconductor stack, an insulating material stack, an opening formed in the insulating material stack, and an electrode located on the insulating material stack and filled in the opening to electrically connect to the semiconductor stack. The semiconductor stack includes a main surface, and a side surface inclined to the main surface. The material stack includes a first stack and a second stack. The first stack includes a plurality of first insulating pairs, and covers the main surface without covering the side surface. The second stack includes a plurality of second insulating pairs, and covers the side surface. One of the first insulating pairs has a first average thickness on the main surface, and one of the second insulating pairs has a second average thickness on the side surface, and the second average thickness is different from the first average thickness.

title: Battery swapping station
abstract: A battery swapping station that identifies in advance the type of battery pack supplied to a battery slot, takes out a charging connector suitable for the type of battery pack, and connects it to the battery pack. The battery swapping station includes a battery slot configured to accommodate one of n different types of battery packs (n is a natural number of 2 or more), n different charging connectors corresponding to each of the n different types pf battery packs, a sensing unit that configured to identify a type of battery pack of the n different types of battery packs being accommodated in the battery slot, and a connector coupling portion configured to select a charging connector of the n different charging connectors suitable for the identified battery pack and connect the selected charging connector to the identified battery pack accommodated in the battery slot.

title: Liquid cooling system
abstract: A liquid cooling system includes first liquid cooling plates and liquid cooling modules. The first liquid cooling plates are configured to respectively thermally contact first heating elements. The first liquid cooling plates are connected in series and in fluid communication with each other. The liquid cooling modules connected in series and in fluid communication with each other. Each liquid cooling module includes two divergence parts and second liquid cooling plates. The divergence parts are in fluid communication with the first liquid cooling plates. Each divergence part has divergence holes. The second liquid cooling plates are configured to thermally contact second heating elements. The second liquid cooling plates are disposed between the divergence parts and are in fluid communication with the divergence parts via the divergence holes, respectively. The first liquid cooling plates and the liquid cooling modules are connected in series and in fluid communication with each other.

title: Bupropion as a modulator of drug activity
abstract: Dosage forms, drug delivery systems, and methods related to sustained release of dextromethorphan or improved therapeutic effects are disclosed. Typically, bupropion or a related compound is orally administered to a human being to be treated with, or being treated with, dextromethorphan.

title: System and method for establishing a user controlled and managed service inside a hosting network
abstract: Embodiments of the present application relate to a system and a method for establishment of a user controlled and management (UCM) service inside a network using a digital representative of a user (D-User). An example method includes receiving a request for establishing a UCM service, the request including a UCM service type. The method also includes establishing the UCM service according to the UCM service type, and informing a User Equipment (UE) of the user that the UCM service is established and that communication sessions related to the UCM service can be initiated.

title: System and method for collabrative photography
abstract: Disclosed is a system for cooperative photography. The system comprises a first user device relating to a first user and a second user device relating to a second user. Furthermore, the system includes at least one server arrangement that is communicably coupled to the first user device and the second user device. The server arrangement is configured to receive a first request from the first user device to have cooperative photography. Moreover, the server arrangement propagates the first request to the second user device. Additionally, the server arrangement is further configured to receive at least one response from the second user device corresponding to the first request. The response from the second user device includes an acceptance of the second user via the second user device to participate in the cooperative photography.

title: Beds and other body support devices with individually controllable cells comprising one or more air bladders
abstract: Devices, systems, and methods for supporting the body of user are described. Devices, systems, and methods can employ a plurality of cells where each of the cells within the plurality of cells can comprise a bladder containing air or another compressible fluid supported by a base that forms a fluid-tight seal with the bladder The base and bladder can be constructed and arranged so that the bladder forms a rolling diaphragm portion with the base. The height and/or applied pressure in response to an applied load of such bladder may be adjustable substantially independent of the cross-sectional shape and dimensions of the bladder. Each of the cells within the plurality of cells which may be a subset or all of the cells of a given support, can also comprise, or otherwise be operatively associated with its own: pressure sensor, height sensor, or both, and/or controllable inlet/outlet valve(s). The pressure sensor and height sensor can be used to measure the pressure of a fluid within the bladder and the height of the bladder of a particular cell to facilitate control of each cell or any chosen group or subsets of cells.

title: Integrated bidirectional charger and inverter for electric vehicles
abstract: A method includes receiving an indication of a charging current received at an on-board charging circuit of a vehicle from a source having a charging voltage. The on-board charging circuit includes a multi-phase traction motor, an inverter electrically coupled to the multi-phase traction motor and including an upper set of switching elements and a lower set of switching elements, and an energy storage device (ESD) electrically coupled to the inverter and having a storage voltage. The method includes determining whether the charging voltage is greater than or equal to the storage voltage. When the charging voltage is greater than or equal to the storage voltage, the method includes instructing at least one switching element in the upper set to operate in an on state and all of the switching elements in the lower set in an off state to cause fast charging of the ESD using the charging current.

title: Electrostatic input device and electrostatic detection device
abstract: An electrostatic input device includes: a sensor electrode provided on a back side of an operation surface of a cover; a measurement circuit connected to the sensor electrode; a determination unit configured to perform, based on a capacitance of the sensor electrode obtained from an output of the measurement circuit, a failure determination for determining a failure of the sensor electrode and an operation determination for determining contact or proximity of an object to the operation surface; and a sensitivity setting unit configured to set a first output sensitivity of the measurement circuit in the failure determination performed by the determination unit to be lower than a second output sensitivity of the measurement circuit in the operation determination performed by the determination unit.

title: Optically pumped magnetometer cell
abstract: The invention relates to a cell for an optically pumped magnetometer, including: —an enclosure containing a gas; and —a circuit for exciting a plasma in the enclosure, which comprises one or more elements ( 11 ) made of an electrically conductive material arranged so as to apply an electrical discharge to the gas enclosed in the enclosure. A conductance of the excitation circuit is less than 8000 Siemens. This conductance is defined as the sum of the conductance of each of the element or elements made of electrically conductive material wherein the conductance of an element made of electrically conductive material corresponds to the conductivity of the electrically conductive material weighted by the ratio between the volume of electrically conductive material of the element and the square of the distance between the element and the centre of the cell.

title: Muscle relaxation monitoring device and medical device system
abstract: A muscle relaxation monitoring device includes: a stimulator configured to apply a stimulation having a predetermined current value and a predetermined pulse width value to a nerve of a living body; and a physiological response detector configured to detect a physiological response. The stimulator applies a first stimulation having a first current value and a first pulse width value, and applies a second stimulation having a second current value and a second pulse width value after applying the first stimulation. The stimulator compares the physiological response detected when the first stimulation is applied with the physiological response detected when the second stimulation is applied, and adjusts the predetermined current value and/or the predetermined pulse width value to be applied to the living body.

title: Heart valve treatment device and method
abstract: A heart valve therapeutic device ( 1 ) has an elongate anchor ( 7 ) wherein the anchor has a stiffness to hold its shape and location to support the valve element. The anchor may have a stylet or a shaped or stiff collar ( 70 ) arranged to provide a desired shape to the anchor ( 7 ) and it may be lockable. A prosthetic valve element ( 15 ) has leaflets ( 17 ) and is supported on the anchor by coupler ( 16 ,  50 ) at a desired location. There is an actuator for changing relative axial position of the proximal and distal couplers ( 16 ,  50 ) on the anchor. The anchor stiffness may be sufficient to provide sufficient support to resist axial forces from the ventricle in use without necessarily having a fixing element engaging heart tissue. The prosthetic leaflets ( 240 ) may extend proximally and radially outwardly, so that there is excellent co-apting of the native leaflets (NL) against the prosthetic leaflets ( 240 ).
assignee: The Provost, Fellows, Foundation Scholars and the other members of Board, of the College of the Holy

title: Field-grown cotton growth status assessment and prediction system based on unmanned aerial vehicle red-green-blue imagery
abstract: A field-grown cotton growth status assessment and prediction system based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) red-green-blue (RGB) imagery includes interconnected modules: a data acquisition module, configured to collect initial image data; a data processing module, configured to perform denoising, distortion correction, orthophoto mosaic, and illumination correction to obtain standardized image data; an image mining module, configured to perform image segmentation and object detection, and extract cotton canopy features and growth indicators; a comprehensive assessment module, configured to construct a growth status assessment model to obtain a comprehensive growth condition score and evaluation metrics; a growth prediction module, configured to incorporate yield-related factors to perform yield prediction and growth anomaly warnings; and a real-time monitoring and decision support module, configured to visually display assessment and prediction results and automatically generate decision support. The system can comprehensively analyze field-grown cotton growth status, enhancing comprehensiveness, accuracy, and efficiency of assessment and prediction.
assignee: Institute Of Cotton Research, Chinese Academy Of Agricultural Sciences

title: Low wear and friction composites comprising polyether ketone ketone and a perfluoropolymer and methods of making and use thereof
abstract: Disclosed herein are compositions, such as low wear and friction composites comprising polyether ketone ketone (PEKK) and a perfluoropolymer, and methods of making and use thereof. For example, disclosed herein are composites comprising PEKK and a perfluoropolymer, wherein the composites exhibit a wear rate and/or a friction coefficient in an environment with less than 0.5 ppm of water and oxygen that is lower than the wear rate and/or friction coefficient of the composite in an environment with 0.5 ppm or more of water and oxygen. Also disclosed herein are composites comprising from 20 to 80 wt. % PEKK, and from 80 to 20 wt. % polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), based on the total amount of PEKK and PTFE in the composite. Also disclosed herein are methods of making and use any of the composites disclosed herein. Also described herein are articles of manufacture comprising any of the composites described herein.
assignee: The Florida State University Research Foundation, Inc.

title: Memory and Storage Control Coordination
abstract: Moving large amounts of data from persistent storage to volatile memory involves significant data routing overhead that increases latency and consumes battery power. If an electronic device transitions to a deep sleep state to save power, restoring the system state data upon awakening is a slow process that negatively impacts device responsiveness. This document describes hardware and techniques that enable memory and storage control coordination. To accelerate data transfers, a local interconnect couples a storage controller to a memory controller. This arrangement allows the storage controller to bypass a coherent interconnect when sending data to the memory controller. By bypassing the coherent interconnect, the electronic device can avoid packetizing data into flits. Consequently, data transfer latency is reduced, enabling the electronic device to transition into aggressive power-saving states to extend battery life in a wider variety of scenarios.

title: Nonvolatile memory device and control method thereof
abstract: According to one embodiment, a control circuit executes a read operation of simultaneously selecting two adjacent word lines adjacent to a read target word line using a first voltage for determining whether or not threshold voltages of two adjacent memory cells connected respectively to the two adjacent word lines are threshold voltages of a first state or lower. Based on the result of the read operation, the control circuit selects one date among data which is read from a memory cell of the read target word line using first read voltages and data which is read from the memory cell of the read target word line using second read voltages that are respectively lower than the first read voltages.

title: Discharge control device
abstract: According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a discharge control device comprises a housing internally having a pressure space that communicates with a discharge flow path at one side in the axial direction, a valve body disposed inside the housing, and an anchor member disposed around the valve body and having a valve seat surface. The housing has a recessed section formed in one side inner end surface inside the housing, the recessed section defining the pressure space with one side end surface of the valve body. One side end surface of the anchor member includes a first seal section that abuts the one side inner end surface of the housing and forms a seal surface, and a first recess section that is made up of an annular recess that is formed facing the first recess section on the outer circumferential side of the second seal section.
assignee: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Engine & Turbocharger, Ltd.

title: Assistance Information for Handling of QoE Reporting
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for handling quality-of-experience, QoE, measurement reporting in a communications network An example method comprises a first network node assembling ( 310 ) a QoE measurement configuration, the QoE measurement configuration comprising one or more attributes indicative of at least one absolute priority or relative priority for one or more QoE measurements, and the first network node sending ( 320 ) the QoE measurement configuration towards a second network node. The method further comprises the second network node configuring ( 330 ) one or more user equipments, UEs, to perform QoE measurements based on the QoE measurement configuration and the second network node, responsive to at least a first load condition in or associated with the second network node, signaling ( 340 ) one or more of the UEs to pause reporting of one or more of the QoE measurements based on the one or more attributes.

title: Memory device and electronic device
abstract: A memory device with few transistor manufacturing steps is provided. Each of a first selection transistor, a cell transistor, and a second selection transistor included in a memory string includes a cylindrical structure body. The structure body includes an oxide semiconductor, an insulator, and a conductor concentrically in an inward direction from a side surface. In the memory string, the transistors can be arranged in the lateral direction, and the first selection transistor and the second selection transistor can be formed in the same step. Accordingly, the number of transistor manufacturing steps can be reduced.

title: Photodetection device and electronic apparatus
abstract: To further improve reliability of a photodetection device and an electronic apparatus. A photodetection device includes: a semiconductor layer that has a first surface and a second surface located opposite to each other in a thickness direction; a multilayer wiring layer that is provided on the first surface side of the semiconductor layer; a warpage suppression film that is provided on a side opposite to the semiconductor layer side of the multilayer wiring layer; and a recess that overlaps with the warpage suppression film in plan view and extends from the second surface side of the semiconductor layer to the multilayer wiring layer. Then, the warpage suppression film has an opening in an overlapping region overlapping with the recess in plan view.

title: Mild lamellar wash composition having reduced isethionate and palm kernel oil derived structurant
abstract: The present invention is directed to a lamellar wash composition having a surfactant system with total anionic that has less than 40% by weight isethionate, and an amphoteric, zwitterionic or both. The composition is stable and has no or reduced amounts of structurant derived from palm kernel oil. The composition surprisingly provides excellent sensory and lathering characteristics and remains stable in lamellar phase.

title: Systems and methods for an adaptive voice interface with emotional state detection, multi-model routing, and domain-specific retrieval augmented generation
abstract: A voice assistant system and method incorporates emotional state detection, multi-model large language model routing, and domain-specific retrieval augmented generation. The system receives user inputs through voice and multi-modal input devices, performs voice analysis including prosody analysis to detect emotional cues and determine the user's emotional state, and adjusts task prioritization, workflow, response content, and user interface presentation based on the detected emotional state. A router selects from a plurality of large language models based on cost, performance, latency, user satisfaction, and input content, with an abstraction layer transforming inputs and outputs for cross-model compatibility. A fallback mechanism switches models when outputs are unacceptable. Domain-specific information is retrieved from vector databases and provided to the selected model through advanced context layers. The system incorporates adaptive communication style adjustment, controlled imperfections for humanlike output, consistent personality maintenance, conversation steering rules, and continuous learning from user interactions.

title: System and method for offloading devices in a cellular network
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to a system and method for offloading user equipments and as such, unicast and/or broadcast/multicast content of the user equipments from one broadcast/multicast system to another broadcast/multicast system and vice versa based on multiple criteria. The system collects one or more data parameters from the user equipments in a first network system, identifies a number of the user equipments to be offloaded based on the one or more data parameters, determines whether the identified number of the user equipments meet one or more offloading criteria, and triggers offloading of the identified number of the user equipments from the first network system to a second network system. The system facilitates switching the network system seamlessly without any manual intervention of users and provides continued broadcast/multicast services.

title: Geometric Robot Control and Motion Planning Using Federated Manifold Cognitive Architecture
abstract: A system and method for controlling a physical system through a federated architecture of epistemically conditioned geometric substrates. A central cognitive manifold encodes intention, planning, and action-selection states and governs deliberative reasoning. A plurality of peripheral manifolds each encode the states and constraints of a respective sensorimotor or environmental domain, including at least a configuration manifold and one or more sensory manifolds. Persistent typed projection operators couple the central manifold to each peripheral manifold and enforce cross-manifold admissibility conditions on projected states. Before any candidate action is executed, the system evaluates federated admissibility by projecting the action into affected peripheral manifold and denying execution if admissibility fails in any one of them. Inadmissible configurations are encoded as irreversible reservoirs that persistently shape future admissibility evaluations without being modifiable by active execution. Cross-manifold coherence monitoring detects plan-execution mismatch across the cycle and triggers corrective intervention when a coherence failure is detected.

title: Content distribution and optimization system and method for deriving new metrics and multiple use cases of data consumers using base event metrics
abstract: Provided is a content distribution and optimization system that ingests raw event data from a client computing device at an entry point of a data pipeline service in accordance with a defined schema. Each payload of the raw event data comprises a first set of dimensional properties provided by the client computing device and/or a second set of dimensional properties added by the processor at the entry point. The raw event data is transmitted to a message bus pipeline for enrichment. A distinct use case is derived for each data consumer at a same time instant based on the enriched raw event data comprising same base event metrics associated with the base event. One or more payloads of the raw event data are transmitted to a stream-based messaging bus as raw video events. New metrics are derived based on raw video events for network selection and centralized alarming and reporting.

title: Wireless communication method, terminal device, and network device
abstract: A wireless communication method, a terminal device, and a network device are provided. The method includes indicating, by a terminal device, a first type of the terminal device or a first capability set of the terminal device through a first message, and indicating, by the terminal device, a second type of the terminal device or a second capability set of the terminal device through a second message. The first message includes a channel and/or a signal, and the second message includes a channel and/or a signal.
assignee: Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp. Ltd.

title: Method of processing a substrate
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure generally relate to a method of processing a substrate. The method includes exposing the substrate positioned in a processing volume of a processing chamber to a hydrocarbon-containing gas mixture, exposing the substrate to a boron-containing gas mixture, and generating a radio frequency (RF) plasma in the processing volume to deposit a boron-carbon film on the substrate. The hydrocarbon-containing gas mixture and the boron-containing gas mixture are flowed into the processing volume at a precursor ratio of (boron-containing gas mixture/((boron-containing gas mixture)+hydrocarbon-containing gas mixture) of about 0.38 to about 0.85. The boron-carbon hardmask film provides high modulus, etch selectivity, and stress for high aspect-ratio features (e.g., 10:1 or above) and smaller dimension devices (e.g., 7 nm node or below).

title: Systems and methods for suppressing sound leakage
abstract: A speaker comprises a housing, a transducer residing inside the housing, and at least one sound guiding hole located on the housing. The transducer generates vibrations. The vibrations produce a sound wave inside the housing and cause a leaked sound wave spreading outside the housing from a portion of the housing. The at least one sound guiding hole guides the sound wave inside the housing through the at least one sound guiding hole to an outside of the housing. The guided sound wave interferes with the leaked sound wave in a target region. The interference at a specific frequency relates to a distance between the at least one sound guiding hole and the portion of the housing.

title: Liquid discharge apparatus, image forming apparatus, and liquid discharge controlling method
abstract: A liquid discharge apparatus is provided that includes a liquid discharge head including a plurality of nozzle rows and a circuitry. The circuitry is configured to control the liquid discharge head to discharge a droplet having a first volume from the plurality of nozzle rows to form an image on a recording medium and, when a linear defect is observed in the image, control the liquid discharge head to discharge a droplet having a second volume larger than the first volume at different time intervals from a nozzle of a first nozzle row that has caused the linear defect or a nozzle of a second nozzle row adjacent to the first nozzle row.

title: Synthesis of Air Quality Data from Diverse Sources Using Machine Learning
abstract: Composite health impact scoring of air quality for multiple pollutants is described. In one or more implementations, input data is received indicating concentrations of multiple pollutants at a geographic location. A composite health impact score is generated based on the input data. As part of this, response factors are applied to the multiple pollutants, where the response factors quantify health impacts from exposure to respective pollutants of the multiple pollutants. Moreover, independence factors are applied to the multiple pollutants, where the independence factors adjust the health impacts attributable to the respective pollutants based on combined exposure to the multiple pollutants. The composite health impact score is communicated to a client device for output in a user interface.

title: Battery management system and method for operating same
abstract: The present disclosure provides a battery management system and a method for operating the same. A battery management system may include a plurality of battery modules. Each battery module may include a plurality of battery cells. The system may include a cell monitoring unit to monitor a corresponding battery module and generate battery module information including state of charge (SOC) information. The system may include at least one wireless communication unit provided in a corresponding monitoring unit and configured to support wireless communication by consuming power of the corresponding battery module. The system also may include a control unit configured to control at least one cell monitoring unis and a corresponding wireless communication unit based on the battery module information. The control unit is configured to control the wireless communication unit to consume power of the battery module to perform cell balancing for the battery module.

title: Recombinant neuraminidase and uses thereof
abstract: In one aspect, provided herein are recombinant neuraminidases comprising an ectodomain of influenza virus neuraminidase with amino acid substitutions or insertions of cysteines in the stalk domain to generate a more stable, tetrameric influenza virus neuraminidase. In specific embodiments, the influenza virus neuraminidase further comprises influenza virus neuraminidase transmembrane and cytoplasmic domains. In another aspect, provided herein are recombinant neuraminidase comprising a globular head domain of influenza virus neuraminidase and a tetramerization domain, wherein the recombinant neuraminidase lacks influenza virus neuraminidase stalk, transmembrane and cytoplasmic domains. In another aspect, provided herein are methods of immunizing against influenza virus using such recombinant neuraminidases or compositions thereof.
assignee: Icahn School Of Medicine At Mount Sinai

title: Prevention and/or treatment of contrast-induced acute kidney injury
abstract: Methods are provided for preventing, reducing, and/or treating contrast-induced acute kidney injury which include administering an inhibitor of fatty acid oxidation to a patient in need thereof. Also provided are methods involving use of trimetazidine or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof for the prevention and/or treatment of contrast-induced acute kidney injury. Methods are also provided for preventing and/or treating contrast-induced acute kidney injury which include administration of one or more of trimetazidine, etomoxir, oxfenicine, perhexiline, mildronate, or ranolazine, or pharmaceutically acceptable salts of any of the preceding.

title: Device and method for obtaining an augmented patient-specific bone/cartilage model of a target anatomical structure of a patient
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and method for obtaining an augmented patient-specific bone/cartilage model of a target anatomical structure of a patient.

title: Declaration-based data routing for analysis modules
abstract: An embodiment receives, at an analytics service of a telemetry manager platform of an information handling system, from an analytics requestor, an analytics request comprising a datatype identifier. An embodiment requests, from a data service selected using the datatype identifier, data fulfilling the analytics request. An embodiment computes, using an analytics plug-in and the data received from the data service, an analysis result. An embodiment forwards, to the analytics requestor, the analysis result.

title: Prime editing system based on perv reverse transcriptase
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of genetic engineering. Specifically, the present invention relates to a prime editing system based on PERV reverse transcriptase, and a method for gene editing by said system. More specifically, the present invention provides: 1. a prime editing system using a PERV-RT with PERV-NC fusion, RNase H domain deletion and multiple mutations; 2. a pegRNA fused with a truncated Csy4 (tCsy4-pegRNA); 3. one or more small molecule compounds and combinations thereof for treating cells; to improve the efficiency of prime editing in mammals.
assignee: Jiangxi Agricultural University; lnstitute of Genetics and Developmental Biology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

title: Ferroelectric memory device and method of forming the same
abstract: Provided is an integrated chip structure. The integrated chip structure includes a plurality of dielectric layers vertically interleaved between a plurality of conductive lines over a substrate. A channel layer is arranged along sides of the plurality of conductive lines and the plurality of dielectric layers. The integrated chip structure further includes a plurality of data storage structures. The channel layer is laterally separated from the plurality of conductive lines by the plurality of data storage structures. The plurality of data storage structures are entirely embedded within recesses in a side of the channel layer that faces the plurality of conductive lines.

title: Pressure monitoring system for tourniquet and method of use thereof
abstract: A pressure monitoring system for recording pressure applied to a limb by a tourniquet; it has a pressure sensor for measuring pressure applied by tourniquet to the limb; a power source; a processor; an input/output interface; memory including program code that, when executed by the processor, causes the processor to: receive pressure readings from the pressure sensor; upon receiving a trigger event, generate time readings indicative of a passing of time following the trigger event; and cause a transmission of the received pressure readings and the time readings for one or more of: storage of the received pressure readings and the time readings; and display, on a display, information on pressure applied to the limb by the tourniquet over time related to historical pressure-time data corresponding to a relation between the time readings and the pressure readings over a period of time; a method of use thereof.

title: Particulate electrode active material-solid electrolyte composite and method for producing same, electrode mixture, and battery
abstract: The present disclosure provides particulate electrode active material-solid electrolyte composite capable of suppressing reaction resistance of a battery, a method for producing the same, an electrode mixture including such particulate composite, and a battery including such an electrode mixture. The particulate electrode active material-solid electrolyte composite of the present disclosure includes a core portion having one or more solid electrolyte particles and a shell portion having a plurality of electrode active material particles. The method of the present disclosure for producing particulate electrode active material-solid electrolyte composite includes mixing the plurality of the electrode active material particles formed into a composite with one or more solid electrolyte particles, and in the method of the present disclosure, the solid content ratio of the slurry is 25 mass % or less.

title: Dope additive and fiber
abstract: To provide an additive and the like. An additive is configured by a polyurethane (A) having a value of V2/V1 of 1 or more when: a viscosity of when dissolved in dimethylacetamide (DMAc) at 20% by mass at 40° C. is set to be V1; and a viscosity after 24 hours have additionally elapsed at 40° C. after dissolution is set to be V2.

title: Methods and apparatus for tracking with occlusions
abstract: Methods and apparatus for tracking with occlusions are disclosed. A disclosed example apparatus includes interface circuitry communicatively coupled to an aiming device and an image sensor carried by an aircraft, machine-readable instructions, and at least one processor circuit to be programmed by the machine-readable instructions to determine that a target has been occluded as the image sensor is directed toward the target via the aiming device to track the target, determine, in response to the target being occluded, orientations of the image sensor during tracking of the target, and determine an estimated position of the target based on navigation information of the aircraft and the orientations for directing the aiming device during the occlusion of the target.
assignee: InSitu, Inc., a subsidiary of the Boeing Company

title: Page generation method and apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: A page generation method includes obtaining node tree corresponding to target page and including nodes configured for representing content of the target page. The method further includes, for any node: if parent node of the node uses flexible layout, obtaining style attribute of the node, and determining main axis size of the node based on the style attribute; if the node includes child node(s), obtaining parameter mapping table including mapping relationship between the style attribute and size value, and obtaining cross axis size of the node based on the main axis size and the parameter mapping table; and determining main and cross axis coordinates of the node based on the main and cross axis sizes of the node. The method also includes generating the target page according to the main and cross axis sizes, and the main and cross axis coordinates of each node.

title: Vehicular load sensing system and method using tilt sensors
abstract: A system and method calculates a vehicle load on a suspension system of a vehicle using a plurality of tilt angle sensors. The angle sensors are attached to the suspension system and configured to measure an angle with respect to gravity. A first angle sensor is configured to measure a first angle. A second sensor configured to measure a second angle. The measured first and second angles are combined to obtain a combined value representative of a vehicle load adjusted for tilt.

title: Methods and systems for providing dynamic summaries of missed content from a group watching experience
abstract:
Systems and methods are presented for providing dynamic summaries of missed content of content streaming on multiple device. A plurality of groups for a concurrent presentation of a content is identified, and a selection is received by a user via a second device to join a first group of the plurality of groups for the concurrent presentation of the content. Based on a user via the second device joining a group, a determination is made as to whether a user via the second device missed any content from the concurrent presentation of the content for the first group. 
     Based on the detection of missed content, the system generates for the second device one or more summaries of the missed content segments and the missed reactions to the segments based on preferences associated with the user profile. In response to generating the summaries, the summaries are presented via the second device to the user.

title: Bioactive Conjugate, Preparation Method Therefor and Use Thereof
abstract:
The present disclosure provides antibody drug conjugate platforms comprising a conjugator assembly component, and antibody drug conjugates comprising platform-derived linker-payloads and antibodies or antigen-binding fragments thereof. title: Double Stack Locking Cleat
abstract: A ball locking cleat including a housing, a strap configured to be positioned within the lower aperture, the upper aperture, or both, and a locking ball configured to be positioned within the ball locking portion and couple to the strap. The housing may include a top, a bottom, a front, a back, a first side, a second side, and a divider. The housing is configured to define an interior space that may include a lower aperture positioned between the bottom and the divider, an upper aperture positioned between the divider and the top, and a ball lock portion extending from the upper aperture.

title: System and method with artificial intelligence patch clamp for automated recording and kinetics analysis
abstract: An automated patch clamp system includes a computing platform, a cell dish, a pipette, a micromanipulator, a pressure regulator, recording electrodes, and a digitizer. The cell dish holds at least one cell in a physiological solution for electrophysiological measurement. The pipette interfaces with the cell membrane to establish a gigaseal, positioned by the micromanipulator based on computing platform control. The pressure regulator applies suction for gigaseal formation. One recording electrode is in the pipette, the other in the bath solution, detecting ionic currents. The digitizer converts detected signals into digital form. The computing platform processes these signals using an AI framework or machine learning model for ion channel kinetics analysis and anomaly detection, classifying ion channel types based on extracted electrophysiological features.

title: Method for dry-forming cellulose products from cellulose fibres in a product forming unit and a product forming unit
abstract: A method for dry-forming a three-dimensional cellulose product from cellulose fibres in a product forming unit that includes a fibre transporting unit, a shaping unit including one or more shaping elements having a three-dimensional surface, and a forming mould M. The one or more shaping elements are arranged on a movable support structure. The method includes the steps: providing loose and separated cellulose fibres and feeding the loose and separated cellulose fibres to the one or more shaping elements by means of flow of air, and arranging the loose and separated cellulose fibres onto the one or more shaping elements, wherein the three-dimensional surfaces of the one or more shaping elements have a shape corresponding to or similar to a final shape of the cellulose product formed in the forming mould; dry-forming the cellulose product into a three-dimensional compressed fibre structure in a pressing operation by pressing and heating.

title: Downlink Control Monitoring Adaptation for Carrier Aggregation
abstract: A wireless device receives one or more messages comprising a first index of a first search space (SS), of the first cell, and a second index of a second SS of the second cell. The first SS is for scheduling the first cell. The second SS is linked to the first SS for the cross-carrier scheduling based on the first index being same as the second index. The wireless device receives, via the first cell, a downlink control information (DCI) comprising a carrier indicator field (CIF) indicating scheduling the first cell or cross-carrier scheduling the second cell and a PDCCH monitoring skipping indication. The wireless device, in response to the PDCCH monitoring skipping indication, skips PDCCH monitoring, according to the SSs of the first cell.

title: Image sensor including conductive pattern
abstract: An image sensor according to example embodiments of the present disclosure includes: a substrate including pixel regions including each photodiode; a floating diffusion region disposed in each of the pixel regions, on one surface of the substrate; circuit elements transmitting a photoelectric signal according to the charges of the floating diffusion region; and an upper isolation pattern defining the floating diffusion region and the circuit elements on the one surface of the substrate, and at least one of the circuit elements includes: a gate pattern disposed on the one surface of the substrate; and a source/drain region disposed on both side surfaces of the gate pattern, and at least one of the source/drain regions includes a conductive layer disposed on the upper isolation pattern, contacting the substrate below the gate pattern, and including a material different from a material of the substrate.

title: Image encoding/decoding method and apparatus using model-based prediction method, and bitstream storage medium
abstract: In an image encoding/decoding method and apparatus and a recording medium, the image encoding/decoding method comprises the steps of: performing prediction of a target block on the basis of a mapping model so as to obtain a prediction block of the target block; and reconstructing the target block on the basis of the prediction block, wherein the mapping model may be determined on the basis of any one of a plurality of mapping model candidates.

title: Interaction control method, device, electronic apparatus and medium
abstract: The present disclosure discloses an interaction control method, device, electronic apparatus and medium, the method comprises: receiving a touch operation of a user; if there is a collision point between a virtual identifier and a first application in an application list, creating a first virtual screen and a first window in response to the touch operation, running the first application on the first virtual screen, and rendering screen data of the first virtual screen to the first window; acquiring degrees-of-freedom information of a head-mounted display apparatus; and adjusting the first window according to the degrees-of-freedom information, encoding the screen data in the adjusted first window, and sending the encoded screen data to the head-mounted display apparatus for decoding and displaying.

title: Display device and electronic device
abstract: A display device includes: a first data driving circuit on one side of a display area; a first distribution circuit between the first data driving circuit and the display area; and a gamma circuit generating a plurality of grayscale voltages, the first data driving circuit including a first data processing circuit, and a first data output circuit converting first digital image data into a first analog image signal and providing the converted first analog image signal to the first distribution circuit, the first data output circuit is between the first data processing circuit and the first distribution circuit, the gamma circuit including a master gamma circuit generating a gamma reference voltage based, and a first slave gamma circuit generating a plurality of grayscale voltages by dividing the gamma reference voltage, and the first slave gamma circuit is between the first data processing circuit and the first data output circuit.

title: Aircraft door assembly with decompression panels
abstract: An aircraft door includes a body defining a first body aperture therein and a primary panel pivotably attached to the body and configured to pivot between first and second positions, wherein when the primary panel is in the first position, the primary panel partially encloses the first body aperture, and wherein the primary panel has a first panel aperture defined therein. The aircraft door also includes a secondary panel pivotably attached to the primary panel and configured to pivot between first and second positions, wherein when the secondary panel is in the first position, the secondary panel encloses the first panel aperture.

title: Service subscription optimization
abstract: A computer-implemented method for grouping one or more features of a first set of data associated with a customer into one or more sets of opportunity groups based on a feature evaluation using a first machine learning model; identifying a subset of the one or more sets of opportunity groups that meets at least one objective associated with the customer; and identifying one or more candidate services within the subset that exceed a correlation threshold for the one or more sets of opportunity groups based on the one or more features.

title: Computer software, computer system, and computer-implemented method for preparing an electronic data package and an eletronic data package prepared by same
abstract: Computer software and computer-implemented method for preparing an electronic data package in connection with a damaged vehicle for submission to the vehicle owner’s insurance company for settlement of a claim or for use by an Original Equipment Manufacturer to determine compliance with established repair requirements. A computer-readable medium for storing executable software for preparing the package for a damaged vehicle, a computer system including the executable computer software stored in the computer-readable medium for preparing the package for a damaged vehicle damage are also disclosed. An electronic date package for vehicle damage repair is prepared by the computer-implemented method by executing the computer software stored in the computer-readable medium of a computer system.

title: Spatially resolved membrane molecule analysis
abstract: The present invention suggests a method and a system for characterizing a membrane bound molecule. The method comprises determining a plurality of spatially resolved membrane properties of a biological membrane, determining, for a plurality of locations, a spatially resolved membrane molecule signal related to the membrane bound molecule at the plurality of locations on the membrane and grouping the spatially resolved membrane molecule signals to classes of at least one of the membrane properties or state classes of the membrane bound molecules. The method further comprises identifying the distribution of conformational states of the membrane bound molecule based on the distribution of the classes.
assignee: Dimitrios Stamou; Gabriele KOCKELKOREN; Line LAURITSEN; Christopher SHUTTLE; Artu BREUER; Eieftheria KAZEPIDOU

title: Linear light-emitting device, lamp assembly, and vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a linear light-emitting device, comprising a plurality of linear light-emitting elements, all of which are laterally light-emitting elements for jointly forming a lateral light exit region of the linear light-emitting device, wherein for at least a portion of the linear light-emitting device, each linear light-emitting element comprises: a core layer, which is rod-shaped and at least one end side of which is configured to receive and input light from a light source; a cladding layer covering the outer side of the core layer, wherein the refractive index of the cladding layer is lower than that of the core layer, and light from the core layer enters the cladding layer through refraction; and a reflective layer, formed on the outer side of the cladding layer and configured to reflect light from the cladding layer towards the lateral light exit region.

title: Interactive digital twin with data integration
abstract: A system is configurable to: (i) present a visual representation of a physical system that comprises a plurality of physical components, wherein the visual representation comprises a plurality of 2D or 3D components that each correspond to a respective physical component of the plurality of physical components of the physical system; (ii) present a model-based systems engineering (MBSE) hierarchy representation that comprises a plurality of labels and a relational structure indicating one or more relationships among the labels defined by MBSE artifacts of an MBSE model of the physical system, wherein each label corresponds to a respective 2D or 3D component of the visual representation of the physical system; (iii) receive user input directed to a particular label that corresponds to a particular 2D or 3D component; and (iv) navigate to and visually emphasize the particular 2D or 3D component within the presentation of the visual representation.

title: Large scale spherical roller bearing having radially offset cage bars
abstract: A spherical roller bearing includes an outer ring, an inner ring, two set of spherical rollers rollable along raceways of the rings and a cage for retaining the rollers. The cage includes an axial inner cage ring, a first axial outer cage ring spaced on a first side from the inner cage ring connected by a plurality of cage bars to form closed pockets for receiving the first set of rollers, and a second axial outer cage ring spaced on a second side from the inner cage ring on a second axial side opposite of the first axial side and connected by a plurality of cage bars to form closed pockets for receiving a second set of rollers. The cage bars are arranged at a radial position offset from a pitch diameter and a retention element or elements securely hold the spherical rollers in the pockets of the cage.

title: Demodulation reference signal port combinations in accordance with a capability of a user equipment associated with 8-layer downlink multiple input multiple output communications
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. Various aspects relate generally to multiple input multiple output (MIMO) communications. Some aspects more specifically relate to signalling of demodulation reference signal (DMRS) port combinations in accordance with a capability of a UE associated with 8-layer downlink MIMO communications.
