A processor of a substrate treatment apparatus sets a monitoring region three-dimensionally based on three-dimensional design information pertaining to the substrate treatment apparatus, generates a normal image for each of timings during a normal operation carried out based on a recipe by two-dimensionalizing the monitoring region in a view from a placement position, and stores the normal image in a normal image memory before performing an actual treatment on the substrate. Further, during working in which the substrate is actually treated based on the recipe, the processor detects an anomaly on the basis of a difference between the normal image and the real image captured by the camera, which are synchronized with the operation based on the recipe.

title: Driving apparatus and vehicle
abstract: A driving apparatus and a vehicle provided with same. The driving apparatus includes a driver, a gearbox, and a speed reducer. The gearbox and the driver are spaced apart in the width direction of the vehicle. At least a portion of the speed reducer is located between the driver and the gearbox. At least one of the driver or the gearbox is higher than the bottom of the speed reducer in the height direction of the vehicle.

title: Absorbable composition for regeneration of skin lesions
abstract: An absorbable composition for the regeneration of skin lesions, comprising: chitosan; an organic solvent; metal nanoparticles; resveratrol; taurine; and at least one pharmaceutically acceptable excipient.

title: Method and device for transmitting/receiving uplink control information in wireless communication system
abstract: A method and a device for transmitting/receiving uplink control information in a wireless communication system are disclosed. The method according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: receiving configuration information related to a UCI report from a base station; and transmitting the UCI report to the base station on the basis of the configuration information.

title: Method and apparatus for training model
abstract: A method and an apparatus for training a model of a semiconductor device are provided. In the method, a training environment including a dataset is established, where the dataset correlates a plurality of parameters of the semiconductor device with at least one electrical parameter. A state represented by a set of values of the parameters is defined in the training environment. An action is executed through a prediction model to modify at least one value in the set of values. A reward value is calculated based on a reward function, where the reward function is configured to guide the prediction model to maximize the electrical parameter, subject to a parameter constraint. A violation of the parameter constraint is penalized by a penalty that increases non-linearly with a degree of the violation. The prediction model is updated based on the reward value. Therefore, design efficiency and accuracy could be significantly enhanced.
assignee: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.

title: Photodetector and electronic apparatus
abstract: A photodetector according to an embodiment of the disclosure includes a first photoelectric conversion element, a first readout circuit, a second photoelectric conversion element, a second readout circuit, and an electric conductor. The first photoelectric conversion element photoelectrically converts light. The first readout circuit includes a first transistor provided on a side of a first surface of a first semiconductor layer, and is configured to output a first signal based on electric charge obtained by conversion by the first photoelectric conversion element. The second photoelectric conversion element photoelectrically converts light. The second readout circuit includes a second transistor provided next to the first transistor on the side of the first surface of the first semiconductor layer, and is configured to output a second signal based on electric charge obtained by conversion by the second photoelectric conversion element. The electric conductor is provided between the first transistor and the second transistor.

title: Heater assembly for a haircare appliance
abstract: A heater assembly for a haircare appliance is described. The heater assembly comprises first and second frames arranged along a curved path to define an airflow path, a first resistive track supported by the first frame such that the first resistive track is held within the airflow path, and a second resistive track supported by the second frame such that the second resistive track is held within the airflow path.

title: Method and system for determining the specific temperature corresponding to a viscometric fixed point for a free fluid stream
abstract: A computer implemented method for determining the specific temperature, Tlog, corresponding to a viscometric fixed point of a fluid. The method takes as input one value of the dynamic viscosity and one value of the temperature of the fluid. The method provides as output a value of the characteristic temperature Tlog3. The characteristic temperature Tlog3 is computed by a VFT-like model, wherein the adjustable parameters of the VFT-like model comprise a chemical composition-dependent adjustable parameter, T 0 , which depends on the chemical composition of the fluid, and wherein the adjustable parameters of the VFT-like model are statistically adjusted over a dataset of experimental and/or simulated temperature-dynamic viscosity values for the fluid within a chemical composition range.

title: Battery module
abstract: A battery module includes battery cells and bus bars electrically connecting the battery cells. Each of the bus bars include a first conductor and a second conductor connected to two adjacent battery cells, and a connecting portion electrically connecting the first conductor to the second conductor. An end of the first conductor and an end of the second conductor each include a first magnet, opposite ends of the connecting portion are attached by the first magnet, and a metal layer is on a surface of the first magnet.

title: Method, apparatus, device, and storage medium of interface interaction
abstract: A method, an apparauts, a device, and a storage medium of interface interaction are provided. The method provided herein includes: presenting a detail interface of first music content; presenting, in response to a current user not having a predetermined permission with regard to the first music content, a first editing entry in the detail interface; and presenting, in response to a trigger for the first editing entry, a first editing interface associated with second music content. The second music content is determined based on the first music content. The current user has the predetermined permission with regard to the second music content.

title: Imidazoquinoline compound having anti-inflammatory, antifugal, antiparasitic, and anticancer activity
abstract: An imidazoquinoline compound having activity against inflammation, fungi, unicellular parasitic microorganisms, and cancer is described.

title: Integrated Assemblies and Methods of Forming Integrated Assemblies
abstract: Some embodiments include an integrated assembly having a memory region and another region adjacent the memory region. Channel-material-pillars are arranged within the memory region, and conductive posts are arranged within said other region. A source structure is coupled to lower regions of the channel-material-pillars. A panel extends across the memory region and the other region. Doped-semiconductor-material is directly adjacent to the panel within the memory region and the other region. The doped-semiconductor-material is at least part of the source structure within the memory region. Liners are directly adjacent to the conductive posts and laterally surround the conductive posts. The liners are between the conductive posts and the doped-semiconductor-material. Some embodiments include methods of forming integrated assemblies.

title: Polishing composition
abstract: Provided is a polishing composition that can improve a polishing removal rate. The polishing composition contains resin particles and an oxidant in which the oxidant contains a composite metal oxide and the concentration of organic particles is 0.01% by weight or more.

title: Treatment of syngap1 encephalopathy
abstract: The present technology relates to methods of treating SYNGAP1 encephalopathy by transdermally administering an effective amount of cannabidiol (CBD) to the subject, wherein a SYNGAP1 symptom is treated in the subject.

title: Hardware circuit for statistical reduction during data transport
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques for performing statistical calculations during data transport in graphics processing units are disclosed herein. The system may include a statistical reduction circuit coupled to a data transport circuit. The statistical reduction circuit performs statistical reduction operations on data elements during transfer from tensor memory or directly from matrix multiply-accumulate arrays to register files. The statistical reduction circuit may compute running statistical values as each data element is transferred, eliminating separate computational passes. The system may include not-a-number handling circuitry that implements filtering modes for wide reduction operations. The system may support statistical operations such as determination of a maximum value, a minimum value, and absolute value variants, while processing multiple numeric formats. The integrated statistical computation capability can reduce latencies and eliminate register file bandwidth conflicts during statistical processing through concurrent data movement and statistical computation.

title: Modular user health status monitoring device, method, and system
abstract: Provided are a modular user health status monitoring device, method, and system, relating to the technical field of health status monitoring. The device includes: a plurality of functional components, where the plurality of functional components are detachably connected end to end to form a wristband or a ring; a sensing detection module, located in any one of the functional components; and a main control module, located in any one of the functional components and connected to the sensing detection module. The modules in this application can be easily detached and arbitrarily combined, enabling convenient implementation of different measurement functions.

title: Propane Manifold Assembly
abstract: A propane manifold assembly for quickly and easily attaching a plurality of appliances to a propane source includes a propane source storing a propane gas and a manifold with an inlet and a plurality outlets. A plurality of appliances are operationally coupled to the manifold. A plurality of manifold valves are coupled to the manifold wherein each manifold valve of the plurality of manifold valves is coupled to an associated manifold outlet of the plurality of manifold outlets. Each manifold valve of the plurality of manifold valves is actuatable to selectively inhibit transfer of the propane gas from the associated manifold outlet of the plurality of manifold outlets to an associated appliance of the plurality of appliances. A plurality of appliance connector fittings are couplable couples the plurality of manifold valves to the plurality of appliances. A hose fluidly couples the propane source to the inlet of the manifold.

title: Bonding apparatus, bonding system, and bonding method
abstract: A bonding apparatus configured to bond first substrate and second substrate includes first holder configured to hold first substrate; second holder disposed to face first holder, and configured to hold second substrate; two imaging units each including first imaging device configured to image a first alignment mark formed on a bonding surface of the first substrate and a second imaging device configured to image a second alignment mark formed on a bonding surface of the second substrate; a first moving mechanism configured to move the two imaging units along a first direction in a planar region between the first holder and the second holder; a second moving mechanism configured to move the first imaging unit of the two imaging units along a second direction orthogonal to the first direction; and a third moving mechanism configured to move the second imaging unit of the two imaging units along the second direction.

title: Propagation delay compensation for time sensitive networking
abstract: A system, method and apparatus for mobile communications including time sensitive communications is provided. A user equipment (UE) receives a medium access control (MAC) control element comprising a value for calculating a propagation delay (PD) compensation. The UE determines a first timing advance (TA) based on matching a value associated with the first TA with one or more first defined values. The UE determines a PD compensation based on the value. The UE performs a timing synchronization based on the PD compensation and determines an uplink timing based on the first TA. The UE then transmits at least one of an uplink signal or an uplink channel based on the determined timing synchronization and the determined uplink timing.

title: Metrology structures with a diffraction grating
abstract: Metrology structures and methods of forming metrology structures. The metrology structure comprises a target layer, a waveguide core including a diffraction grating, and a reflector. The target layer may include a portion that is arranged between the diffraction grating and the reflector or, alternatively, the reflector may be arranged between the diffraction grating and the portion of the target layer.

title: Autonomous vehicle charge management in a dynamic environment
abstract: An example operation includes at least one of predicting an availability of a first charging station at a first point in time, predicting an availability of a second charging station at a second point in time, estimating a first state of charge (SOC) of a vehicle at the first point in time and a second SOC of the vehicle at the second point in time based on state of charge data measured from a battery of the vehicle, selecting the first charging station or the second charging station based on the availability of the first charging station, the availability of the second charging station, the first estimated SOC, and the second estimated SOC, and maneuvering the vehicle autonomously to the selected charging station.
assignee: Toyota Motor North America, Inc.; Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha

title: Method for arranging a plate on a u-shaped rail
abstract: A method is provided for arranging a plate on a U-shaped, dimensionally stable rail. having a U-shaped rail, a plate, a plurality of spacers, a two-component system with a binder and a hardener component and a nozzle for applying the two-component system. The method includes pair-wise arrangement of the spacers on the plate, arranging the plate together with the spacers-in an opening of the U-shaped rail, aligning the plate with respect to the rail by fixing elements to the extent necessary, and filling a two-component system via the nozzle into at least one recess present in the longitudinal direction of the rail between two associated spacers. Furthermore, a part set for carrying out a method is disclosed.

title: Metal Ion Battery Safety Arrangement
abstract: The present invention concerns a fire safety arrangement for a battery. More particularly, but not exclusively, this invention concerns a fire safety arrangement for a metal ion battery, for example a lithium ion battery cell. The metal ion battery cell comprises a plurality of electrodes and an electrolyte encased within a housing. The housing comprises a safety valve or vent to allow gas build up within the housing to vent outside the housing, and a fabric envelope surrounding the housing. Any sparks generated by the battery are contained within the fabric envelope, thereby reducing or eliminating the chances of fire or explosion.

title: Resource utilization monitoring for optical transport networks
abstract: Methods and systems for tracking utilization of a resource of an optical transport network by established end-to-end connections include configuring a network element to obtain one or more utilization metrics for utilization of the resource by one or more input data streams, and transmitting the utilization metrics to at least one of a network management system (NMS) of the optical network or another network element. In some implementations, the methods and systems may include performing resource usage measurements. In some implementations, the utilization metrics may be transmitted to another network element in overheads of digital containers encapsulating the one or more input data streams.

title: Signaled Transform Set
abstract: This disclosure relates generally to video coding/decoding and particularly for improvement of signaled transform set. One method includes receiving a coded video bitstream; extracting, based on the coded video bitstream, a set of transform coefficients for the current block; determining, based on a syntax element explicitly signaled in the coded video bitstream, a transform set index for the current block in an intra prediction mode, the transform set index indicating a transform set among a plurality of transform sets; identifying the transform set according to the transform set index; performing an inverse transform using the set of transform coefficients and the identified transform set to obtain a residual block for the current block; and reconstructing, by the device, the current block based on the residual block.

title: High-speed ct scanner system with x-ray tube producing linear x-ray sources
abstract: This application provides the structure of an x-ray tube that produces a sequence of linear x-ray sources. An x-ray tube includes a rotatable member having a rotation axis and a helical fin rigidly attached to the rotatable member. The helical fin is configured to rotate together with the rotatable member around the rotation axis. The x-ray tube further includes an electron beam generator configured to generate at least one electron beam. The at least one electron beam is directed to bombard the helical fin as the helical fin rotates, producing x-rays whose focal spot moves in space along a line defined by the at least one electron beam.

title: Electrical heating element, and softening device therefor and control method
abstract: A method of securing an elongate electrical heating element to a carrier of a cushion, the method includes: providing a softening device having a body including a feeding passage, a gas passage, and an open cavity; conveying the electrical heating element through the feeding passage; driving heated air from a heat source through the gas passage and into the open cavity; heating the electrical heating element within the open cavity to a heat softening temperature; conveying the heated electrical heating element to a sewing head of a sewing apparatus; and securing the heated electrical heating element to the carrier with the sewing head to form a bending in the electrical heating element, the bending is configured to be secured on the cushion and is not able to be bent into a straight line or reshaped at room temperature without damaging the outer insulating layer or the electrical heating wire.

title: Display control device
abstract: A display control device is mounted on a vehicle and controls a touch panel that receives a touch operation from a user of the vehicle. The display control device includes an operation amount adjustment unit that adjusts a movement amount of an image within a screen by the touch operation based on a converted operation amount obtained by converting an operation amount of the touch operation according to a predetermined reference screen size and a screen size of the touch panel, and a display control unit that causes the touch panel to display the image such that the image moves within the screen of the touch panel according to the movement amount that is adjusted.

title: Image forming apparatus that prints image by electrophotography
abstract: A controller causes laser diodes adjacent to each other to form detection patches on a sheet, each including a plurality dot patterns of a same shape, arranged in a main scanning direction and a sub scanning direction at predetermined intervals, with respect to each of the dot patterns, acquires the density of the detection patches, among which the dot pattern is different, from a density detection device, calculates a beam pitch shift amount using the density of each of the detection patches, and adjusts light emission timing of the light beam emitted from a laser diode, using the beam pitch shift amount calculated. A light amount of the light beam emitted from the laser diode to form the dot pattern is set to a predetermined light amount for adjustment, smaller than a normal light amount to form a normal electrostatic latent image.

title: Layout structure for sensor, head, and neck
abstract: A layout structure for a sensor, a head, and a neck of a robot, includes a head, a neck, and a sensor. The neck is connected between the head and a torso. A lower portion of the neck is inclined forward such that a forward-open layout space is formed between a front side of the neck and a chin of the head. The sensor is arranged in the forward-open layout space. In a horizontal plane, the neck blocks less than 90° of a circumferential field of view of the sensor, which reduces the obstruction of the neck structure to the sensor and thus significantly enhances the environmental perception capability of a robot.

title: Backlight module and display device
abstract: A backlight module comprises a bottom chassis, a light source unit, a middle frame, and a front chassis. The bottom chassis includes a plurality of sidewalls that collectively define a receiving space, with a gap formed between two adjacent sidewalls. The light source unit is disposed in the receiving space. The middle frame includes at least one positioning boss extending into the gap to restrict the position of the middle frame with respect to the bottom chassis. The front chassis covers the sidewalls and the at least one positioning boss. Through this configuration, the gap of the bottom chassis functions as an installation and positioning structure for the middle frame while suppressing light leakage from the backlight module.

title: Display device, method of manufacturing the same and electronic device including the same
abstract: A display device includes a display panel having a folding area and a non-folding area, an upper structure disposed on the display panel in a thickness direction of the display device and including an upper cover, a lower structure disposed under the display panel and including a lower support plate that includes lattice bars in an area overlapping the folding area, and a first sealing material disposed on a portion of a side surface of the display panel corresponding to the folding area. The first sealing material includes a first sub-sealing material disposed on the portion of the side surface of the display panel corresponding to the folding area, and a second sub-sealing material disposed on an upper surface of the first sub-sealing material to partially overlap the first sub-sealing material in a direction perpendicular to the thickness direction.

title: Front vehicle body structure
abstract: A front vehicle body structure may include a front side member arranged along a front-rear direction of the vehicle body on both sides according to a vehicle width direction; a fender apron member connected to each of the front side members; and an integrated casting member joined to the front side member and the fender apron member, wherein the dash panel and the front cowl are formed in one body.

title: Patient-specific surgical devices, system, and methods
abstract: A surgical device includes a body having a first side with a first surface that is complementary to a surface of a foreign object disposed within a patient based on preoperative imaging of the patient. The body defines at least one hole positioned relative to the body to facilitate insertion of an elongate device at a predetermined location relative to the foreign object.

title: Reaction apparatus and reactor
abstract: A reaction apparatus includes: a cylindrical reaction vessel including an intermediate part between one end side and another end side; a temperature control unit configured to control a temperature of the intermediate part; a supply unit configured to supply a substance to be treated to one end side in the reaction vessel; a conveyance mechanism configured to convey the substance to be treated from one end side of the reaction vessel to another end side of the reaction vessel passing through the intermediate part; a first support part configured to support the one end side of the reaction vessel in a state in which it is fixed; and a second support part configured to support another end side of the reaction vessel in such a way that the other end side of the reaction vessel is movable in an axial direction of the reaction vessel.

title: Hot water mixing valve
abstract: A hot water mixing valve assembly includes a valve body defining hot and cold water inlets, a mixed water outlet, and a mixing chamber. A shuttle is movable in the mixing chamber between first and second valve seats to vary respective amounts of hot and cold water delivered to the mixing chamber. An actuator is operatively coupled to the shuttle, and a controller commands movement of the actuator based at least in part on temperature data from a temperature sensor positioned to sense mixed water discharged toward the outlet. The controller may slow a speed of the actuator as the shuttle approaches the valve seats. The valve may include sleeve inserts, end caps, and a removable shuttle assembly for servicing. The shuttle may include opposed plugs having distal-facing grooves that receive lips of corresponding valve seats and proximal-facing grooves that capture a seal between the plugs.

title: Method for Exploiting Dissipation in Computing Systems to Improve Algorithmic Performance
abstract: We present Noise Directed Adaptive Remapping (NDAR), a heuristic method to approximately solve optimization problems using a system featuring the presence of biased noise. We assume that the system dynamics has a global attractor state—a canonical example of system with noise fulfilling this assumption is a quantum processor subject to the amplitude damping channel, a type of noise prevalent in superconducting quantum devices. NDAR bootstraps the attractor by iteratively gauge-transforming cost-function Hamiltonian and proceeding in a greedy fashion or via a more sophisticated search. In each iteration step, the gauge transformation effectively changes the attractor state into a lower energy state of the cost Hamiltonian based on the results of runs in the previous step. Intuitively, thanks to the gauge transformations, noise aids state preparation for the variational optimization, as opposed to hindering it. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our protocol in experiments with subsystems of Rigetti's superconducting quantum device. Using the basic version of the method, we obtain approximation ratios (of best-found outcomes) above ≈ 0.9  for multiple instances of random, fully connected graphs on n=82 qubits, using only p=1 (noisy) QAOA in conjunction with QDR, compared to ≈ 0.3  for standard QAOA with the same amount of function calls. More advanced version of the methods have been tested, further improving the quality to solution to optimality and decrease the runtime by at least 3 times the basic version.

title: Waterproofing gasket for shower clamps of frameless shower assemblies
abstract: A frameless shower can be installed by placing a gasket that forms a watertight seal between a shower clamp and a wall surface and securing the shower clamp to the wall surface via screws passing through the shower clamp and the wall surface. The gasket can be a waffle gasket, where the tightening of the screw enhances the strength of the seal. The shower clamp can be a pivot hinge for a door of a frameless shower. In embodiments, the shower clamp can secure a pane of glass, which does not pivot to a wall. In embodiment, the gasket can be sold as part of a kit, which includes screws and anchors. The kit may also include shower clamps. Further, the kit can be part of a full shower installation kit that includes doors, panels, clamps, gaskets, doors, screws, and anchors.

title: Method and apparatus for performing multiple-input multiple-output antenna-based uplink transmission and reception in wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G communication system or a 6G communication system for supporting higher data rates beyond a 4G communication system such as long term evolution (LTE). According to an embodiment of the disclosure, a method performed by a base station in a wireless communication system is provided, the method including transmitting, to a terminal, codebook configuration information associated with a second codebook, the second codebook is applicable to a first codebook, and sounding reference signal (SRS) configuration information for configuring an SRS transmission resource; receiving, from the terminal, an SRS on the SRS transmission resource configured based on the SRS configuration information; based on the received SRS, determining a transmitted precoding matrix indicator (TPMI) based on the first codebook and a precoding matrix control parameter based on the second codebook; and transmitting, to the terminal, information associated with the precoding matrix control parameter and the TPMI.

title: Electronically verified command transmission between programs
abstract: Systems and methods for using on-chain programs for message transfer are disclosed herein. A system may receive a request to obtain control of second on-chain data structures of a second type. The request may comprise identifiers for first on-chain data structures of a first type. The system may determine that the first type is stored on a first blockchain and the second type is stored on a second blockchain and execute an operation that transfers control of first on-chain data structures of the first type to be controlled by a second cryptography-based storage application associated with an agent on the first blockchain. In response to a confirmation that the operation was successful, the system may cause a message to be transmitted to a second on-chain program instructing it to transfer the second on-chain data structures to be controlled by the user.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and non-transitory computer readable medium
abstract: An information processing apparatus includes a pulse wave estimation unit configured to estimate a pulse wave of a living body as an electrocardiogram estimation target based on a video obtained by capturing the living body as the electrocardiogram estimation target, using a machine learning model trained using, as training data, a combination of a video obtained by capturing a living body and measurement data of a pulse wave of the living body. The information processing apparatus includes an electrocardiogram estimation unit configured to estimate an electrocardiogram of the living body as the electrocardiogram estimation target based on the estimated pulse wave. The information processing apparatus can assist in decision-making based on the electrocardiogram estimation result.

title: Systems and methods for discovering and monitoring devices using search patterns for object identifiers and values
abstract: The present disclosure is directed to systems and methods of managing remote devices. The system can include a server with memory, a detection module, and a collection module. The memory can store a management information base (MIB) having a hierarchical tree of object identifiers and corresponding object values. The detection module can query devices and receive a first object identifier and its first object value, which can vary from those in the MIB; and use patterns to match the first object identifier and object value; and generate an identification of the device from the matches. The collection module can use the identification to select a collection template, which can indicate a subtree of the MIB and a collection pattern; traverse the subtree and identify a second object identifier that matches the collection pattern, and its second object value; and associate the second object value with the first object value.

title: Snack bar
abstract: Provided herein is a snack bar containing essentially identifiable uncooked and ready-to-eat foodstuff while being substantially devoid of an added binder, such as carbohydrate-based binder. Also provided is a process of preparing the binder-free snack bar, using compression and ultrasonic energy without cooking the foodstuff, while achieving a chemically and mechanically stable ready-to-eat product.

title: Single-cell manipulation device and methods operating the same
abstract: Disclosed is a single-cell manipulation device, including a stage, a probe, a probe control assembly, a microscopic imaging assembly, and a pneumatic pressure source assembly. The pneumatic pressure source assembly is configured to provide positive and/or negative pneumatic pressure to the at least one probe in the form of pulses. A method for extracting single cells, a method for injecting a reagent into a single cell and/or extracting contents from a single cell, and a method for performing sample spotting using the single-cell manipulation device are further disclosed. By providing pulsed positive and negative pneumatic pressure to the probe, the present disclosure not only enables precise in-situ extraction of target cells, but also allows the extracted cells to enter the interior of the probe. Thus, the probe serves as a temporary storage site for cells, enabling continuous extraction of multiple cells and improving operational efficiency.

title: Garden bean variety ‘firebird’
abstract: A new variety of garden bean ( Phaseolus vulgaris  L.) designated ‘Firebird’ is provided. Garden bean variety ‘Firebird’ is characterized by its intense dark green pods in mainly the 4 sieve class, heat tolerance, strong, compact and erect plant habit, and resistance to  Colletotrichum lindemuthiunum  (Anthracnose) and resistance to many races of  Uromyces appendiculatus  (Rust).

title: Device-based citizen band radio spectrum (cbrs) radio select and unselect
abstract: Aspects of the subject disclosure may include,: determining whether a Subscriber Identity Module (SIM) profile that supports communication via Citizen Band Radio Spectrum (CBRS) is present on a device, resulting in a determination; responsive to the determination being that the SIM profile that supports the communication via the CBRS is present on the device, providing to a user via an interface an element that permits the user to select enabling of communication via the CBRS, or disabling of communication via the CBRS; receiving from the interface a selection by the user, wherein the selection indicates either an instruction by the user to enable the communication via the CBRS, or an instruction by the user to disable the communication via the CBRS; and responsive to the selection: enabling the communication via the CBRS or disabling the communication via the CBRS.
assignee: At&T Intellectual Property I, L.P.; At&T Mobility Ii Llc

title: Method and apparatus for generating plate-like three-dimensional model, and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method and apparatus for generating a plate-like three-dimensional model, and a storage medium. The method includes: displaying a base plate image and an element bar, the base plate image being a two-dimensional image, and the element bar including a thickness icon and at least one content icon; when one or more content icons in the element bar are selected, acquiring content images corresponding to the selected content icons, and adding the content images corresponding to the selected content icons to the area of the base plate image, to obtain a board surface image; and when the thickness icon in the element bar is selected, acquiring the thickness corresponding to the board surface image, and generating a plate-like three-dimensional model on the basis of the thickness corresponding to the board surface image and the board surface image.

title: Method by which network transmits message in wireless communication system, and apparatus therefor
abstract: A device receives, from a user equipment, a negotiation request message related to prediction of mobility information of the user equipment; transmits, to the user equipment, a message including condition information for the prediction of the mobility information of the user equipment by the device; and on the basis of reception or transmission of a notification message notifying that at least one condition included in the condition information is satisfied, transmits a message including the mobility information predicted with respect to the user equipment.

title: Multi-connection optical fiber assembly
abstract: An optical fiber assembly comprises a plurality of first connectors each having a first plurality of optical channels and a plurality of second connectors for connection with a Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) switch, each having a second plurality of optical channels. The first connectors are connected with the second connectors via a plurality of optical fibers, such that each first connector is connected with all of the second connectors. The optical fiber assembly includes twice as many first connectors as second connectors, and consequently each second connector includes twice as many optical fiber connections as each first connector.

title: Climate controlled battery module and method
abstract: A battery module, and associated methods are disclosed. In one aspect, a thermal management system is included with a stack of battery cells that provides both heating and cooling as needed. Aspects are shown that include heat exchangers with circulating media. Aspects are shown that include resistive elements.

title: Organic electroluminescent element and electronic device
abstract: Provided is an organic electroluminescent element having a cathode, an anode, and one or more organic layers disposed between the cathode and the anode, wherein: at least one layer among the one or more organic layers includes a first component and a second component; the first component is the compound represented by formula (1); and the second component is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals, alkali metal compounds, alkaline earth metals, alkaline earth metal compounds, rare earth metals, rare earth metal compounds, organometallic complexes including an alkali metal, organometallic complexes including an alkaline earth metal, and organometallic complexes including a rare earth metal.

title: Method of storing photoresist coated substrates and semiconductor substrate container arrangement
abstract: A method for manufacturing a semiconductor device includes forming a forming a photoresist layer over a semiconductor substrate and selectively exposing the photoresist layer to actinic radiation. After selectively exposing the photoresist layer to actinic radiation, storing the semiconductor substrate in a semiconductor substrate container under an ambient of extreme dry clean air or inert gas. The method also includes after the storing the semiconductor substrate, performing a first heating of the photoresist layer.

title: Optical imaging sensor and biological reaction system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an optical imaging sensor and a biological reaction system. The optical imaging sensor comprises: an illumination assembly, configured to generate an illumination beam in a first direction; a detection assembly, configured to receive and detect an imaging beam formed from the illumination beam and in a second direction, wherein the first direction and the second direction intersect with each other; and a housing, configured to accommodate the illumination assembly and the detection assembly, wherein the housing includes a window portion located on an emergent light path of the illumination assembly and on an incident light path of the detection assembly, so that the illumination beam and the imaging beam can transmit through the window portion.

title: Signal processing device, signal processing method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing a program
abstract: According to one embodiment, a signal processing device according to the present invention includes a signal acquisition unit, a detection unit, and a first AQA processing unit. The signal acquisition unit acquires a time-series signal, the detection unit detects a signal of an interval including an event indicated by an event label from the time-series signal as an event signal, and the first AQA processing unit generates an answer sentence to a question sentence on the basis of the time-series signal, interval information indicating a relationship between the time-series signal and the event signal, the event label, and the question sentence related to the event label.

title: Anode, Anode Dam Coating Composition, and Lithium Secondary Battery
abstract:
A composition for coating a negative electrode dam according to one embodiment of the present disclosure includes a cellulose-based compound. 
     In the composition for coating a negative electrode dam according to one embodiment of the present disclosure, the surface tension is high to the level of a negative electrode slurry, thereby suppressing the occurrence of fat-edge of the negative electrode. Furthermore, the dam coating layer formed from the composition for coating a negative electrode dam shortens the sliding length of the negative electrode active material layer, thereby reducing the risk of NP-ratio inversion of the lithium secondary battery.

title: Surface smoothing agent for polyurethane coating film, composition, curing agent, polyurethane resin-forming composition, coating composition, and coating film
abstract:

title: Method for the bonding, transport, reaction activation, conversion, storage and release of water-soluble gases
abstract: The present invention relates to methods for selective binding, selective membrane transport and storage of carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) in aqueous media. The method of the present invention comprises providing an aqueous acceptor solution containing at least one acceptor compound having a free guanidino and/or amidino group, which is contacted with a gas containing carbon dioxide to bind the carbon dioxide in the acceptor solution. The acceptor solutions containing bound carbon dioxide obtained thereby are useful for storing carbon dioxide in aqueous media, for again releasing the carbon dioxide, and for use in electrochemical processes, such as electrodialysis, to selectively transport bound carbon dioxide through separation membranes into aqueous media. The present invention further relates to the preparation of carbonates starting from acceptor solutions containing bound carbon dioxide.

title: Lipid emulsion for parenteral administration
abstract: The present disclosure relates to lipid emulsions for parenteral administration, comprising 10 to 30% of a lipid phase comprising soybean oil, medium-chain triglycerides (MCT), olive oil and fish oil and less than 25 mg, preferably less than 20 mg, campesterol, less than 30 mg, preferably less than 25 mg, stigmasterol and less than 120 mg, preferably less than 100 mg, beta-sitosterol per 100 g of the lipid phase. The present disclosure also relates to the lipid emulsions according to the present disclosure for providing parenteral nutrition, in particular to neonates, as well as to methods for manufacturing the lipid emulsions according to the present disclosure.

title: Gaming chip and management system
abstract: A management system includes a recording device recording an image of a gaming chip and an inspection device determining a type and authenticity of the gaming chip. The gaming chip has a multilayer structure in which both sides of a colored layer are sandwiched between light color layers, surface printing representing a type of the gaming chip is performed on outer sides of the light color layers, and an authenticity recognition mark is printed on the colored layer of an inside of the light color layers by an infrared absorbing material. A visible light camera photographs a visible light image of the surface printing, and an infrared light camera photographs an infrared image of the internal printing. The inspection device determines the type and authenticity of the gaming chip using the visible light image and the infrared image.

title: Circuit mapping
abstract: A method for provisioning IoT fixtures. The method may include inputting to a microprocessor a circuit identifier associated with a circuit that includes a first fixture that is within a reception range of a radio frequency fixture interface. A second fixture may be deployed within the range. The method may include initiating a fixture discovery process, over a wired path, from a wall station that is in wired communication with the first fixture and not in wired communication with the second fixture. The method may include receiving, at a wireless communication device, a wireless discovery message from the first fixture and not from the second fixture. The method may also include, in response to receipt of the wireless discovery message, confirming an association between the first fixture with the circuit identifier.

title: Camelid-Derived Bioactive Compounds: Compositions, Methods, and Therapeutic Analgesic Applications
abstract: A novel method for preparing and utilizing camel fat as a source of endocannabinoid compounds is described. This method involves isolating, quantifying, and formulating bioactive lipids, including palmitoylethanolamide (PEA), N-arachidonoylethanolamine (AEA), 2-arachidonoylglycerol (2-AG), and oleoylethanolamide (OEA), into a topical analgesic. A further method includes using the camelid-derived bioactive lipids for non-opioid pain management. The application of camelid-derived endocannabinoids contributes to the development of bioactive lipid therapeutics, providing a natural alternative to synthetic and plant-based analgesics.

title: Track system for use with an operating element in an architectural-structure covering
abstract: An architectural-structure covering including a covering moveable between extended and retracted positions, a rotatable member coupled to the covering, an operating system coupled to the rotatable member, an operating element manipulatable by a user for rotating the rotatable member, and a track coupled to the operating element to restrain the operating element from being moved away from the track. In some embodiments, the operating element is a bead chain including a plurality of beads and a plurality of dog-bone shaped beads including first and second beads wherein the first bead is positioned within, and forms part of, the bead chain and the second bead is positioned within a channel formed in the track.

title: Integral resistance heaters including niobium and processes for making same
abstract: Disclosed is a process of forming a pedestal with an integral resistance heater. The process may comprise applying a metal layer in a pattern on a beryllium oxide ceramic body, wherein the pattern of the metal layer is connected to a conductor, contacting a first surface of a substrate with the metal layer to position the substrate in line with the ceramic body to form a pre-assembly body, wherein the substrate comprises a ceramic, and heating the pre-assembly body to a joining temperature from 800° C. to 1900° C. to form a heating element that joins the substrate to the ceramic body, wherein the pattern retains integrity when forming the heating element. The metal layer may comprises from 10% to 100% by weight of niobium.

title: Fan with seal and vacuum operated pneumatic linear drive connected thereto
abstract: A fan having an inlet, an outlet, an impeller arranged therebetween configured to generate a fluid flow from the inlet to the outlet. A mechanical seal has a closed position fluidically sealing the inlet and an opened position fluidically releasing the inlet, and a pneumatic linear drive is connected to the mechanical seal and configured to move the seal from the opened position to the closed position and from the closed position to the opened position. The pneumatic linear drive is configured to automatically return the seal to the closed position and is fluidically connected to a pressure relief port arranged between the inlet and the impeller, through which a vacuum holding the seal in the opened position and/or moving it to the opened position is generatable in the pneumatic linear drive.
assignee: ebm-papst Mulfingen GmbH & Co., KGaA & Co. KG

title: Reconfigurable air diffusers and systems and methods thereof
abstract: The disclosure presents a system for constructing diverse air diffusers including an air inlet, a diffuser module having a hollow housing, and a variable direction regulator designed to fit within the diffuser module, where one variable direction regulator can be exchanged with another variable direction regulator within the same housing. The regulator includes a base shape with perforations and a rotatable regulation shape with other perforations that rotates about a fixed assembly pin. The regulator operates in two distinct modes. In the first mode, a predetermined portion of the regulation shape's perforations is obstructed by the base shape, while the remaining perforations align with those of the base shape to direct airflow. In the second mode, achieved by rotating the regulation shape through a predetermined angle, the previously obstructed perforations align with the base shape's perforations, thereby redirecting the airflow in an alternative direction.

title: Process that uses an NLE (non-linear editor) workflow and combines it with generative video and audio processes into a streamlined NLE using node-based visual sequencing to integrate generative features directly in the editor.
abstract: An integrated node-based non-linear editing system is disclosed that streamlines video production by incorporating generative video and audio processing directly within the editing interface. The system enables users to upload or create source files such as text-based scripts or visual documents which are analyzed using artificial intelligence models to identify segments that are automatically mapped to clip nodes. Each node represents a media clip, a generative transformation, or an effect modifier, thereby facilitating features such as visual style transfer, character replacement, object replacement, face-swapping, lip synchronization, and environmental adjustments. The system further supports automated clip matching from a large-scale database and provides advanced post-processing functions including AI-driven upscaling and color correction. This unified platform eliminates the need for external plug-ins, enabling efficient, AI-first video production for applications in film, television, advertising, and live event production.

title: Medical Vaporizer with Precision Controlled Vapor Composition
abstract: A medical vaporizer is provided, comprising a temperature-controlled heating module that provides a high level of control over vapor composition. The vaporizer also comprises a mouthpiece that produces a helical vortex of vapor at the outlet.

title: Fuel cell stack
abstract: A fuel cell stack includes: a cell stack body; end units disposed at both ends of the cell stack body; and a tube body disposed in a cooling medium discharge flow path to capture and discharge bubbles in cooling medium. One end unit includes an end portion receiving part for receiving an end portion of the tube body. The end portion receiving part includes: a first recessed part that is recessed in a direction away from the cell stack body and is open toward the cell stack body, the first recessed part being provided with a first wall surface that an end surface of the tube body can contact; and a second recessed part that is recessed from a part of the first wall surface in a same direction as the first recessed part, opens in the first wall surface, and communicates with an internal passage of the tube body.

title: Ophthalmic imaging instrument and ophthalmic imaging method
abstract: An ophthalmic apparatus comprises a visible light illumination channel, which illuminates a retina of an eye of a patient under examination by visible light. A near-infrared illumination channel illuminates the retina of the eye of the patient under examination by near-infrared light. An imaging channel receives light from the retina of the eye illuminated by the visible light and/or the near-infrared light. A target channel outputs fixation image content to a patient whose eye is under the examination for fixation of a gaze direction of the patient. An alignment arrangement illuminates the anterior part of the eye and reflections therefrom are received by two of a fundus camera sensor and a first and second pupil camera sensors. A data processing unit determines an optimal positional alignment of the eye for imaging a fundus of the eye by a fundus camera sensor based on still image and/or video capture of the anterior part of the eye.

title: Ultrabroadband Cascade Capacitor
abstract: Multilayer capacitors are provided. For example, a multilayer capacitor may include first and second terminals adjacent first and second opposing end surfaces, respectively, and a plurality of active electrode layers, each active electrode layer including a first active electrode electrically connected with the first terminal and a second active electrode electrically connected with the second terminal. The first active electrode may be spaced apart from the second active electrode in a lengthwise direction to form an active electrode end gap. The multilayer capacitor also may include a plurality of floating electrode layers, including topmost and bottommost floating electrode layers. The plurality of active electrode layers may be an odd number such that a topmost active electrode layer is disposed between the topmost floating electrode layer and a top surface and a bottommost active electrode layer is disposed between the bottommost floating electrode layer and a bottom surface.

title: Battery monitoring device and battery monitoring circuit
abstract: A battery monitoring device connects to multiple battery cells via a circuit board and includes a battery monitoring circuit. The monitoring circuit has first and second conversion circuits, each connected to the positive and negative terminals of a respective cell. The first conversion circuits convert analog signals to digital signals to output measurements used to determine each cell's complex impedance. The second conversion circuits also convert analog signals to digital signals, but output signals used to detect each cell's state. The first and second conversion circuits are organized into pairs, with each pair (one first and one second circuit) dedicated to one battery cell. The circuit board provides corresponding terminal pairs that connect each first conversion circuit to its target cell.

title: Memory access scheduling for parallel computations using a processing-in-memory architecture
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computational instructions/programs encoded on non-transitory computer-readable media, are disclosed for command and memory access scheduling at an integrated circuit. A system determines a performance target for executing an ML workload and based on a first priority, schedules commands for compute operations for executing the workload at a processor-in-memory (“PiM”) block of a memory device. For concurrent memory transactions of both PiM commands for the compute and memory access requests, the system determines a prospective violation of the performance target for the workload and addresses the prospective violation by adjusting the first priority to exceed a second priority assigned to the memory requests. The system satisfies both the performance targets for executing the ML workload at the PiM block and processing memory requests by adjusting the first priority to exceed the second priority and adjusting an operating frequency of the memory device and PiM block.

title: Rare earth bonded magnet
abstract: A rare earth bonded magnet includes a rare earth bonded magnet containing rare earth magnet powder and a resin cured product of a thermosetting resin. The rare earth magnet powder is isotropic Nd—Fe—B based magnet powder, the thermosetting resin is an epoxy resin, the resin cured product is contained in an amount of more than 5 wt % and 6.5 wt % or less in 100 wt % of the rare earth bonded magnet, and the rare earth bonded magnet has a porosity of less than 5%, a radial crushing strength of 60 MPa or more, and an electrical resistivity of 100 μΩ·m or more.

title: Devices and Methods for Generating Post-Operational Data of an Imaging Device
abstract: A first aspect of the present disclosure is related to a device for generating post-operational data of an imaging device, configured to: obtain operational data of an imaging device; determine instruction data based on: the operational data; and determine a post-operational data set based on: the instruction data; and the operational data.

title: Bus bar, bus bar module, and manufacturing method of bus bar
abstract: A bus bar includes: two single-layer bus bars  each constituted by a metal plate-like member; and a laminated bus bar having a plurality of metal plate-like members provided in an overlapping manner, the laminated bus bar provided across the two single-layer bus bars and electrically connecting the two single-layer bus bars, in which the laminated bus bar has overlapping regions arranged in an overlapping manner with the respective single-layer bus bars, the overlapping regions each provided with adhesive bonding portions in each of which one plate-like member of the laminated bus bar adheres to and is bonded to the plate-like member of the single-layer bus bar by pressing the laminated bus bar and the single-layer bus bars.

title: Accommodating intraocular lens with fluid channels
abstract: A biomimetic accommodating intraocular lens (AIOL), configured to provide an amount of accommodation to allow a continuous range of vision, includes exterior channel features to control fluid flow around the periphery of the lens. The channel geometry may vary to improve fluid flow and may have a longitudinal profile of constant or varying depth. The number of channels may range from a single channel to numerous channels disposed around the circumference of the lens. The channel(s) may extend radially outward from the edges of the lens optic zones and transit the equator region of the lens body therebetween. The channel(s) allow the eye's aqueous humor to bathe the lens capsular bag, thereby decreasing the incidence of anterior and posterior capsule opacification. The channels allow for a smaller volume IOL to be compressed through a smaller limbal incision and for egress of OVD during the irrigation/aspiration step of cataract surgery.

title: Biocatalytic synthesis of unnatural mycosporine-like amino acids
abstract: The present invention relates to methods of producing compounds of interest in a recombinant microorganism. In particular, the present invention relates to using a recombinant microorganism comprising a heterologous nucleic acid encoding one or more mycosporine-like amino acid (MAA) biosynthetic enzymes (e.g., MysD) to produce compounds of interest using unnatural amino acids or amine containing substrates. Compositions comprising compounds produced using such methods are also provided herein. The present disclosure also provides methods of preventing sunburn, cancer, and chronic inflammatory diseases by administering such compositions to subjects in need thereof.
assignee: University Of Florida Research Foundation, Incorporated

title: Resource efficient vector database searching in prompting of large language models
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer-readable storage media for receiving a query, processing the query through a named entity recognition (NER) machine learning (ML) model to generate a set of entities, identifying, from a set of tuples of a vector database, a sub-set of tuples responsive to the set of entities, determining, from the sub-set of tuples, a sub-set of chunks responsive to the query, generating a prompt including the sub-set of tuples and at least a portion of the query, prompting a first LLM using the prompt to providing a LLM response, and returning a response to the query, the response including at least a portion of the LLM response.

title: Network connection method, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: This application provides a network connection method, an electronic device, and a computer-readable storage medium. When an access point device uses a WPA2/WPA3 hybrid encryption mode, if a station device does not have a WPA3 encryption capability and advertises support for WPA3 encryption, the access point device may guide the station device to perform access authentication by using WPA2 encryption. In this way, the station device can successfully be connected to a network in which the access point device is located, thereby improving compatibility of the access point device when using the WPA2/WPA3 hybrid encryption mode.

title: Optoelectronic microdevice
abstract: The present disclosure relates to development of microdevices on a substrate that can be released and transferred to a system substrate. The disclosure further relates to methods to integrate anchors to hold a microdevice to a substrate. The microdevices are in different configurations with respect to anchors, release layers, buffers layers and substrate.

title: Semi-Persistent Scheduling Activation for Multicast Services
abstract: A wireless receives, from a base station, a multicast TB based on receiving a group common DCI indicating an activation of a SPS for MBS, wherein configuration parameters of the SPS comprises a HARQ-ACK codebook index. The wireless device transmits feedback for the multicast TB in a HARQ-ACK codebook, of HARQ-ACK codebooks, indicated by the HARQ-ACK codebook index.

title: Display apparatus
abstract: Some of a plurality of image signal lines of a display apparatus according to one embodiment includes: a plurality of bypass wiring portions (bypass wirings) arranged in a frame region so as to have both ends being connected to a plurality of extension wiring portions (extension wirings). The plurality of bypass wiring portions of the plurality of image signal lines include: a plurality of second-layer bypass wirings arranged in a second conductive layer; and a plurality of third-layer bypass wirings arranged in a third conductive layer that is different from a first conductive layer and the second conductive layer. Each of an arrangement pitch between the plurality of second-layer bypass wirings and an arrangement pitch between the plurality of third-layer bypass wirings is smaller than an arrangement pitch between the plurality of image signal lines in a display region.

title: Horology movement fitted with a bidirectional drive mechanism for a jumping indicator
abstract: A horology movement is fitted with an indicator ( 4 ) and includes a mechanism ( 6 ) for driving this indicator in jumps in a first direction, the mechanism including a wheel plate ( 8 ) defining an axis of rotation, a rigid part ( 10 ) arranged above the wheel plate and forming a drive finger ( 12 ), and a spring having one end rotationally attached to the wheel plate and the other end rotationally attached to the rigid part, which is rotationally mobile relative to the wheel plate and runs through an opening ( 26 ) that enables the drive finger to be retracted towards the axis of rotation. The mechanism can drive the indicator in both directions and is arranged such that the spring contracts as it is being loaded in order to cause the indicator to jump in said first direction.

title: Method and apparatus for performing read operation on a memory block of a storage device
abstract: A method and an apparatus for performing a read operation on a memory block of a storage device. The method includes determining an optimal read level voltage for a current memory block, based on a failure of a read operation performed on the current memory block; performing, based on the optimal read level voltage determined for the current memory block, one of: determining a recalibrated read level voltage for an existing read level cluster among one or more existing read level clusters created previously for one or more memory blocks of the storage device; and creating a new read level cluster with respect to the optimal read level voltage; and performing, based on a subsequent read operation request for the current memory block, the read operation on the current memory block based on the recalibrated read level voltage or the new read level voltage.

title: Method for manipulating 3d objects by flattened mesh
abstract: A computer-implemented method for generating a corresponding 3D mesh representing a 3D object includes transforming an initial three-dimensional mesh into a planar mesh, wherein each vertex or edge of the planar mesh is a transformation of a vertex or edge from the initial three-dimensional mesh; and sampling the planar mesh to generate a plurality of samples such that each sample comprises a three-dimensional coordinate representing a point in a three-dimensional space derived and/or taken directly from the initial three-dimensional mesh, and a coordinate representing a position of the sample relative to other samples; and generating the sampled matrix based on the plurality of samples; and representing the sampled matrix as a corresponding 3D mesh.

title: Implantable pressure sensor and monitoring system
abstract: The present invention provides an implantable pressure sensor and a monitoring sensor. The detection sensor includes an inflatable bag to be implanted into a site to be measured; a first gas pressure sensor disposed in an environment in gas communication with interior of the inflatable bag, for measuring an gas pressure value inside the inflatable bag. Combination of the inflatable bag and the first gas pressure sensor enables implantable pressure monitoring, and reducing volume and size of the detection sensor. Direct measurement of intracranial pressure via the inflatable bag results in accurate intracranial pressure values and prevents brain tissue from being exposed to injury risks. The detection sensor further includes a first wireless power supply and communication module, which wirelessly powers internal components of the detection sensor and directly transmits measured parameters to an external receiver.

title: Systems and methods for dynamic hyperlinking
abstract: A method is provided for generating a hyperlink in real-time. In one example, the method includes monitoring a user's interaction with a document and displaying a first hyperlink in the document at a user interface of a display device based on the user's interaction. An anchor and a destination of the first hyperlink may be mapped and to generate a dataset used to place a second hyperlink in the document during a subsequent hyperlink generation event.

title: System and method for monitoring and communicating with confined animals
abstract: Systems and methods for an animal monitoring and communication. The animal monitoring and communication system includes a first sensor configured to be positioned proximal to an environment of an animal, an environment device configured to modify the environment of the animal, and a processor communicatively coupled to the first sensor and to the environment device. The processor is configured to receive a first condition from the first sensor, compare the first condition to a first threshold condition, and initiate an action within the environment of the animal in response to the first condition reaching the first threshold condition.

title: Multispecific binding agents against pd-l1 and cd137 for treating cancer
abstract: The present invention relates to therapy using a binding agent that binds to human PD-L1 and to human CD137 to reduce or prevent progression of a tumor or treating cancer.

title: Memory Circuit with Replica Column Multiplexer
abstract: A system includes a memory circuit, which includes a bit cell array, a column multiplexer, and a current mirror circuit. The current mirror circuit includes compensating circuits to increase or reduce a bit cell programming current to achieve a desired value for the bit cell programming current, despite leakage current and bit cell process variation. The compensating circuits may include a replica column multiplexer and a splitting circuit.

title: User modeling and personalized product recommendation system and method
abstract: The invention relates to a recommendation system ( 100 ) and method ( 200 ) where personalized recommendation clusters are computed by querying streaming data for flow-based recommendation systems used in the machinery and power systems sector, and these recommendations are presented to the user.
assignee: Borusan Makina Ve Guc Sistemleri Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi

title: Radar transmissive systems, methods of manufacture thereof, assemblies thereof, and methods of use thereof
abstract: Radar transmissive systems, methods of manufacture thereof, assemblies thereof, and methods of use thereof are provided. The radar transmissive system comprises a substrate, a first layer, and a second layer. The substrate comprises a first surface and a second surface positioned opposite the first surface. The second surface is configured to be directed towards a radar system. The first layer is applied over at least a portion of the first surface of the substrate. The second layer is applied over at least a portion of the second surface of the substrate. A dry film thickness of the second layer is configured to reduce radar transmission loss through the radar transmissive system based on a permittivity and a thickness of the first layer and the substrate layer in the radar transmissive system. The radar transmissive system transmits 50% or greater of electromagnetic radiation.

title: Model rendering method and related apparatus
abstract: This application discloses a model rendering method performed by a computer device, the method including: reducing a model mesh quantity of an initial three-dimensional model based on a topology structure feature of the initial three-dimensional model to obtain a simplified three-dimensional model, the simplified three-dimensional model and the initial three-dimensional model satisfying a preset similarity requirement; determining illumination intensities corresponding to vertexes of the simplified three-dimensional model in a preset virtual environment; and rendering the simplified three-dimensional model based on the simplified three-dimensional model and the illumination intensities corresponding to the vertex in the simplified three-dimensional model, to obtain a model image configured for representing the simplified three-dimensional model. In the method, a three-dimensional model can be automatically reconstructed and rendered, thereby improving reconstruction efficiency of the three-dimensional model, and reducing labor costs.

title: Injectable gel composition
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an injectable gel composition for controlled, short-term delivery of fertility hormones. The injectable gel composition includes 0.5–20% w/w non-crosslinked high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid ( 1000 – 1400  kDa) and 0.5–20% w/w methylcellulose. The high molecular weight hyaluronic acid has a molecular weight of  1000 – 1400  kDa. The methylcellulose has a viscosity of 100–8000 Cp. The hyaluronic acid is non-crosslinked. The hyaluronic acid and methylcellulose form a physically assembled hydrated polymer matrix through reversible physical interactions. The physically assembled hydrated polymer matrix is injectable and formed in an absence of added chemical crosslinking agents. The injectable gel composition exhibits shear-responsive flow sufficient to permit injection through a needle or microneedle lumen and recovers mechanical cohesion upon cessation of shear. The hydrated polymer matrix loses structural cohesion and disperses, dilutes, or degrades within  1 –14 days following administration without forming a chemically crosslinked polymer depot.

title: Memory devices
abstract: A method of forming a microelectronic device comprises forming a microelectronic device structure assembly comprising memory cells, digit lines coupled to the memory cells, word lines coupled to the memory cells, and isolation material overlying the memory cells, the digit lines, and the word lines. An additional microelectronic device structure assembly comprising control logic devices and additional isolation material overlying the control logic devices is formed. The additional isolation material of the additional microelectronic device structure assembly is bonded to the isolation material of the microelectronic device structure assembly to attach the additional microelectronic device structure assembly to the microelectronic device structure assembly. The memory cells are electrically connected to at least some of the control logic devices after bonding the additional isolation material to the isolation material. Microelectronic devices, electronic systems, and additional methods are also described.

title: Ion pump with monitoring system
abstract: An ion pump, preferably a vacuum pump operating at ultra-high vacuum, comprises an electron trap, preferably a Penning cell, configured to generate an electron plasma. The ion pump further comprises a monitoring system configured to measure a parameter of or relating to the electron plasma. Based on the measurement of the parameter, the monitoring system determines whether the ion pump is in an ON state or an OFF state. In the ON state the electron plasma is generated. In the OFF state no electron plasma is generated.

title: Method, apparatus, and computer-readable medium for intent classification of natural language queries in a generative artificial intelligence platform
abstract: A method, apparatus, and computer-readable medium for intent classification of natural language queries in a generative artificial intelligence platform, the method including receiving a natural language query from a user in a user interface of a generative artificial intelligence platform coupled to an enterprise data catalog, determining a metadata context corresponding to assets in the enterprise data catalog associated with the natural language query, retrieving previous conversations of the user on the generative artificial intelligence platform, generating a structured prompt based at least in part on the natural language query, the assets, the metadata context corresponding to the assets, and the previous conversations, and determining an intent associated with the natural language query by inputting the structured prompt into a large language model, the large language model being trained based at least in part on training queries on the enterprise data catalog, training conversations, and training metadata contexts.

title: Cannabinoid Dosing Regime for Acne
abstract: A method for treat acne comprising administering between 50 mg and 3000 mg of a topical liquid or gel composition comprising between 1% w/w and 15% w/w cannabinoid, wherein the cannabinoid is dissolved in the liquid or gel composition is described.

title: Foundation work equipment for hybrid construction methods
abstract: The present invention relates to foundation work equipment for hybrid construction methods that is capable of switching between a steel pipe press-fitting construction method and a drilling construction method, the foundation work equipment including: a base machine; a leader pivotably installed at one side of the base machine; and a drive installed to be movable in a longitudinal direction of the leader, wherein a kelly bar for the drilling construction method or an auger tool for the steel pipe press-fitting construction method is selectively installed on the drive. According to the present invention, foundation work equipment for hybrid construction methods that is capable of promptly and easily switching between a large diameter drilling construction method and a steel pipe press-fitting construction method can be provided.

title: Process for treatment of mine contact water
abstract: A process for treating high alkalinity Mine Contact Water (MCW) includes providing the MCW to a feed stream, adding acid to the feed stream to provide a reduced pH and alkalinity feed stream, subjecting the reduced pH and alkalinity feed stream to filtration and a membrane treatment to separate the reduced pH and alkalinity feed stream into permeate and brine, subjecting the brine to a high density sludge (HDS) process to produce a processed brine and residues; recycling a majority of the processed brine to the feed stream, separating a minor fraction of the processed brine to provide a bleed off of the processed brine prior to the recycling, and subjecting the bleed off of the processed brine to a subsequent treatment to remove at least some contaminants.

title: Power converter, method and apparatus for insulation detection thereof
abstract: Disclosed are a power converter, a method and apparatus for insulation detection thereof. The power converter is provided with a switch between a node at which two alternating-current switches in any phase of an alternating-current side of the power converter are connected in series to each other and a virtual neutral point of the alternating-current side. The switch may be turned on while a second alternating-current switch connected thereto being turned on, to provide an alternating-current side detection loop for detecting the insulation impedance between an alternating-current side neutral point of the power converter and ground. The switch may also be turned on while a first alternating-current switch connected thereto being turned on and at least one switching transistor in the power converter being turned on, to provide a direct-current side detection loop for detecting the insulation impedance of the direct-current side of the power converter.

title: Location area update method and apparatus, method and apparatus for triggering location area update, method and apparatus for paging, and device and storage medium
