abstract: Techniques are described for using computing devices to perform automated operations for modifying a source image acquired at a building to add a target object of a defined size without using a 3D object model of the target object, and using the modified source image in an automated manner. The techniques may include determining a group of pixels within the source image with a size and shape corresponding to the target object's actual 3D size using image-specific dimensions of parts of the building visible in the source image (e.g., using a floor plan of the building and dimensions for a visible room), determining positioning within the source image for the group of pixels, generating and supplying conditioning information to a trained machine learning diffusion model including a pixel mask at contiguous pixel locations for the positioned pixel group within the source image, and displaying the modified source image.

title: Targeting Microbubbles
abstract: This invention related to manufactured microbubbles, as well as methods of using manufactured microbubbles, for example, in medicinal applications. The invention pertains to the physical structure and materials of the microbubbles, as well as to methods for manufacturing microbubbles, methods for targeting microbubbles for specific medicinal applications, and methods for delivering microbubbles in medical treatment.
assignee: California Institute Of Technology; The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Multi-modal, multi-agentic system associated with a manufacturing system
abstract: Methods and systems for performing tasks associated with a manufacturing system using a multi-modal, multi-agentic framework. A user query to perform a task pertaining to a manufacturing system including a set of specialized subsystems that are each associated with an aspect of a manufacturing process of the manufacturing system is detected from a client device. A set of operations associated with the task is determined. Each operation is associated with a distinct artificial intelligence (AI) model. For each operation in the set, an instruction to perform the operation is transmitted to a computing device associated with the respective distinct AI model corresponding to the instructed operation. Data corresponding to an output of the respective distinct AI model is received from each computing device, which is used to generate a response to the user query. The generated response is provided to the client device.

title: Blood Plasma Fractions as a Treatment for Aging-Associated Cognitive Disorders
abstract: Methods and compositions for treating and/or preventing aging-related conditions are described. The compositions used in the methods include fractions derived from blood plasma with efficacy in treating and/or preventing aging-related conditions such as neurocognitive disorders.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor configured to collect, in real time, environmental data within a data center from a plurality of sensors including temperature sensors, humidity sensors, power meters, and sensors monitoring operation of a cooling apparatus. The processor transmits the collected data to a cloud database for storage and analyzes accumulated data to learn an operation pattern of the data center. The processor acquires external climate data and energy market information from external data sources and integrates the external data with the accumulated data. Based on analysis of the accumulated data and the external climate and energy market information, the processor proposes an optimal operation method for the data center and notifies a data center administrator of the optimal operation method via a notification interface.

title: Synchronizing audiovisual streams delivered through separate delivery networks
abstract: A subscriber device connected to a delivery system for live interactive programming, is at a point of delivery of both live interactive content and broadcasted live video programming. The subscriber device receives the live interactive programming from the live interactive delivery system, and presents such programming on presentation devices. Other presentation devices at the point of delivery present the broadcasted video programming. The subscriber device captures audible sound from the environment at the point of delivery. An application compares the captured sound to the audio from the live interactive programming to determine any delay between the live interactive programming and the broadcast video programming. Given the determined delay, the determined delay can be used to synchronize presentation of live interactive programming by the subscriber device with the broadcasted video programming.

title: Treatment method for waste solid-state battery
abstract: There can be provided a treatment method of separating a positive electrode and a negative electrode in a short time. Provided is a treatment method for a waste solid-state battery  100  that includes a solid electrolyte  10  and a negative electrode material  12 , and at least one selected from them is water-soluble. The method includes a step of immersing an electrode assembly of the waste solid-state battery  100  in water, and a step of reducing a pressure of a surrounding environment of the water.

title: Joint structure, robotic arm, and robotic leg
abstract: A joint structure is configured to connect a proximal limb and a distal limb. The joint structure includes a first motor, an adapter bracket, and a second motor. The first motor is configured to be arranged inside the proximal limb. The adapter bracket includes a connection portion and a support portion. An upper end of the connection portion is connected to an output shaft of the first motor. A lower end of the connection portion is connected to the support portion. The support portion is located below the proximal limb. The second motor is arranged inside the support portion and an output shaft of the second motor extends out of the support portion and is connected to the distal limb. An axis of the first motor is perpendicular to an axis of the second motor, such that proximal housings of the proximal limb remain continuous and intact.

title: Image sensor assembly with data signal line for intensity readout
abstract: An image sensor assembly includes pixel circuits, wherein each pixel circuit includes an amplifier transistor electrically coupled to a data signal line. A buffer transistor is electrically connected to the data signal line. The buffer transistor discharges the data signal line in an AD conversion period. The image sensor assembly further includes a detector circuit that includes a sensing path. The amplifier transistor, the buffer transistor, and the sensing path are electrically connected in series. The detector circuit outputs an active comparator output signal when a current through the sensing path exceeds a predefined threshold value.

title: Generating segmentation masks for objects in digital videos using pose tracking data
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems, methods, and non-transitory computer-readable media that generate joint-based segmentation masks for digital objects portrayed in digital videos. In particular, in one or more embodiments, the disclosed systems utilize a video masking model having a pose tracking neural network and a segmentation neural network to generate the joint-based segmentation masks. To illustrate, in some embodiments, the disclosed systems utilize the pose tracking neural network to identify a set of joints of the digital object across the frames of the digital video. The disclosed systems further utilize the segmentation neural network to generate joint-based segmentation masks for the video frames that portray the object using the identified joints. In some cases, the segmentation neural network includes a multi-layer perceptron mixer layer for mixing visual features propagated via convolutional layers.

title: Level Lock Mode on Camera
abstract: A method includes inferring a user intent to capture a level image based on user positioning of a camera. Based on the inferred user intent, the method includes causing a viewfinder to enter a level-lock mode, wherein the level-lock mode comprises displaying a preview level image in the viewfinder, wherein the preview level image is rotated based on an orientation of the camera relative to a level orientation. The method further includes receiving a signal indicating to capture an image. Based on the viewfinder being in the level-lock mode, the method includes providing a captured level image, wherein the captured level image is rotated based on the orientation of the camera relative to the level orientation.

title: Extending location fix validity for non-terrestrial network communication
abstract: Aspects relate to wireless communication using a non-terrestrial network. A user equipment (UE) acquires initial location information of the UE from a location fix at a first time instance and obtains, based on the initial location information of the UE and a velocity information of the UE at the first time instance, updated location information of the UE at a second time instance, without a location fix update. The UE applies, based on the updated location information, one or more link compensations to an uplink transmission of the UE directed to a non-terrestrial network (NTN) node. The NTN receives, during an established connection with the UE, at least one uplink transmission from the UE based on velocity-based link compensation and updated location information of the UE obtained without the location fix update.

title: Frequency bundled transmission (fbt) approaches for ultra-reliable low latency communication (urllc) systems
abstract: Methods, devices, and systems for mitigating the impact of high-power narrow band interference on hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ) performance in URLLC systems. In a first aspect, the present application is directed to implementations of frequency bundled transmissions (FBTs), which may enable a device to simultaneously or near-simultaneously transmit different individual redundancy versions (RVs) of the same uplink data of multiple pre-configured frequency resources. In a second aspect, the present application is directed to implementations of FBTs with frequency domain repetitions, which may enable a device to simultaneously or near-simultaneously transmit redundancy version bundles of the same uplink data over multiple pre-configured frequency resources.

title: Textile fibers blending system and method
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system to produce a blended textile material. The system comprises a fiber preparation unit processing a mixture comprising at least one natural fiber selected from Alpaca wool, Vicuna wool, Llama wool, goat wool, sheep wool, lamb wool, and cotton, and at least one synthetic fiber selected from virgin polyethylene terephthalate and recycled polyethylene terephthalate. A blending unit pelletizes the mixture and forms fiber blends for extrusion. An extrusion unit receives the fiber blends from the blending unit and co-extrudes the fiber blends to form a hollow fiber structure comprising a combination of the natural fiber and the synthetic fiber. A 3D bio-printing unit deposits a material comprising polyester and cellulose onto a surface of the hollow fiber structure to modify surface properties.

title: Apparatuses and methods for negative pressure wound therapy
abstract: Disclosed herein are several embodiments of a negative pressure system and methods of using the same in the treatment of wounds. Some embodiments are directed to a system that utilizes a wound dressing with at least three layers. These embodiments are directed toward improved distribution of negative pressure to a wound and periwound site surrounding the wound. Some embodiments are directed to a fixation strip for sealing a wound dressing to a wound and periwound site. The fixation strip can comprise multiple layers including an adhering layer, a wound sealing layer and at least one protective liner.

title: Window assembly fittings and method
abstract: There is a window frame assembly for mounting a window relative to an opening in a supporting structure. It has an outer half-frame, an inner half-frame, and a glazing sheet that co-operate as an assembled full frame and window, such as may be a garage door window. The full frame has an accommodation for the glazing sheet. The glazing sheet has a span that is larger than a corresponding span of the opening in the supporting structure. The glazing sheet has a height and a width, and one or both of (a) the width; and (b) the height are greater than the height of the opening. The glazing footprint may overlap the opening in the supporting structure on all sides. The glazing sheet has accommodations formed in it to permit fasteners to pass through the glazing sheet. The glazing may be a polycarbonate sheet.
assignee: Elton Manufacturing, A Division Of Ontario Door Sales Ltd.

title: Polymer optical fiber
abstract: Polymer optical fibers (POFs) including a polyamide core are described herein. The polyamide cores generally include one or more nylon polymers and are microcrystalline. The described POFs can have an operating temperature exceeding 150° C. and a calculated numerical aperture of 0.6 or greater.

title: System for capturing waste heat from a thermal incinerator
abstract: A system for capturing waste heat to generate electrical power includes a thermal incinerator including a gas vessel tower having an open interior and an exterior shell, in which the thermal incinerator may substantially incinerate harmful air pollutants. A plurality of thermal electrical generators are wrapped about the exterior shell of the thermal incinerator, wherein the thermal electrical generators generate electrical power supplied to a power storage for storing the electrical power from the thermal electrical generators.

title: Filamentous fungal biomats, methods of their production and methods of their use
abstract: A novel method of growing fungi is disclosed which uses an engineered artificial media and produces high density filamentous fungi biomats that can be harvested with a minimum of processing and from which fungal products such as antibiotics, proteins, and lipids can be isolated, the method resulting in lowered fungus cultivation costs for energy usage, oxygenation, water usage and waste stream production.

title: Environmental-based power adjustment in an implantable device
abstract: Presented herein are techniques for adjusting power supplied to elements of an implantable device, such as an implantable acoustic hearing device, based on environmental conditions associated with an ambient environmental.

title: Grain-oriented electrical steel sheet and method for forming insulating coating
abstract: The grain-oriented electrical steel sheet includes: a base steel sheet; and an insulating coating formed on a surface of the base steel sheet, in which the insulating coating includes: an intermediate layer that is formed on a side of the base steel sheet and contains a crystalline metal phosphate; and a tension coating layer formed on a surface side of the insulating coating, and the intermediate layer has a porosity of less than 40%.

title: Controlling intersample analyte variability in complex biological matrices
abstract: Described herein are compositions and methods for normalizing the variability of inter-sample analyte measurements from a biological matrix. In some embodiments, the present disclosure relates to methods for normalizing the levels of one or more proteins from urine as measured by an aptamer based assay.

title: Updating application binary during video game execution
abstract: Techniques for updating application binary during video game execution are provided. In an example, a computer system executes a video game application based on a binary including a first compiled program code and a second compiled program code. The computer system receives, while the video game application executes, a program code patch that includes a third compiled program code to replace the first or second compiled program code or to be added to the binary. The computer system updates the binary to include the program code patch while the video game application continues to execute.

title: Object sequencer for container loading
abstract: The present application discloses a method, system, and computer system for sequencing a set of objects to be loaded into a transport container. The method includes (i) receiving an indication of the set of objects to be loaded into the transport container for transport from a source location to a destination location, (ii) determining, based at least in part on object information corresponding to the set of objects and resources available to load the set of objects, a sequence according to which the set of objects are to be loaded into the transport container, and (iii) providing the sequence to a robotic system to implement in connection with loading the set of objects to the transport container.

title: Drywall grid soffit framing system
abstract: A framing system including a clip configured to couple with an identical opposing clip attached to a second tee. The clip and the identical opposing clip each having a body portion attached to an end of a respective tee. The body portion having an opening formed therein, and a nose portion extending from the body portion. The nose portion comprising a catch formed on one side thereof. When the clip is connected to the identical opposing clip, the nose portion of the clip extends through a pocket formed between the body portion of the identical opposing clip and the second tee into the opening formed in the body portion of the identical opposing clip and the catch of the clip engages a mating edge of the opening formed in the body portion of the identical opposing clip.

title: Source driver integrated circuit and display system including the same
abstract: A source driver integrated circuit according to one aspect of the present invention, which may reduce the delay or distortion of a driving signal by reducing the resistance variation between a plurality of routing metals, includes: a first routing metal connecting a first channel driving circuit and a first pad; a second routing metal connecting a second channel driving circuit and a second pad and having a length different from that of the first routing metal; a first resistance variation compensation circuit connected to the first routing metal and having a first compensation resistance value; and a second resistance variation compensation circuit connected to the second routing metal and having a second compensation resistance value different from the first compensation resistance value.

title: Method, apparatus, and computer program product for anonymizing destinations
abstract: Embodiments described herein relate to contextually recommend parking locations to improve the privacy of visited destinations. Methods may include: receiving a routing request from a user for a route to a destination POI (point-of-interest); determining a sensitivity of the destination POI; analyzing parking locations proximate the destination POI to determine a level of privacy associated with the parking locations POI; selecting at least one parking location based on the level of privacy associated with the at least one parking location; generating at least one candidate route to the at least one parking location; and calculating a privacy rating associated with the at least one candidate route and the at least one parking location based on a likelihood of associating the at least one candidate route and the at least one parking location with the destination POI.

title: User equipment and method of resource allocation in sidelink communication
abstract: A method of resource allocation in sidelink (SL) communication by a user equipment (UE) includes performing resource allocation across multiple SL resource pools (RPs)/carriers. The multiple SL RPs/carriers include a first SL RP/carrier having the first sub-carrier spacing (SCS) and the second SL RP/carrier having a second SCS, and resources are selected based on at least one of following conditions: selecting resources consecutive in the time domain in the second SL RP/carrier and overlapping with at least one resource or slot in the first SL RP/carrier, selecting resources in the second SL RP/carrier and overlapping with a first portion of the at least one resource or slot in the first SL RP/carrier, and avoiding selecting a slot of resources in the second SL RP/carrier where a feedback occasion overlaps in the time domain with a reserved resource in the first SL RP/carrier.
assignee: Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd.

title: Antenna device and electronic device using the same
abstract: The antenna device includes a substrate, a first helical antenna, a second helical antenna and a first support member. A first end of the first helical antenna is coupled to the substrate and electrically connected to a ground terminal. A first end of the second helical antenna is coupled to the substrate and electrically connected to a signal feeding terminal. The first support member is coupled to the substrate. A second support member is disposed in the first support member. The first helical antenna is disposed around an outer surface of the first support member. The second helical antenna is disposed between the inner surface of the first support member and the second support member.

title: Lens unit, camera module, imaging system, and mobile body
abstract: A lens unit that includes a lens group in which a plurality of lenses is arranged along an optical axis of the lenses, and a lens barrel that houses and holds the lens group, a black-based metal sheet being bonded to a flat surface facing an image side of a first lens located closest to an object side among the plurality of lenses with an adhesive so that an air layer is not interposed between the flat surface and the metal sheet.
assignee: Maxell, Ltd.; Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

title: Method for producing a base paper
abstract: Method for producing base paper, wherein cellulose pulp containing both softwood and hardwood components, and additives, is subjected to grinding, and at least one compacting step, a bleached cellulose pulp, of 55 to 80 parts by weight, of hardwood primary cellulose and 25 to 45 parts by weight, of softwood primary cellulose, and up to 3 parts by weight of filler; cellulose pulp obtained by mixing hardwood and softwood pulp; to form the cellulose pulp which is ground to a refinement of 39 to 45° SR according to ISO 5267-1:1999 for the hardwood pulp and 35 to 41° SR according to ISO 5267-1:1999 for the softened pulp the mixture of pulps is ground to a degree of refinement of 39 to 42° SR; and subjected to dewatering, the formed sheet is calendered on at least one side. The invention also relates to a base paper produced according to the method.

title: Abnormal load detection device, abnormal load detection method, and abnormal load detection program
abstract: Provided is an abnormal load detection device that detects an abnormal load condition of a shaft in a machine tool. A movement instructions generation unit generates movement instructions for the shaft on the basis of a machining program, and a predicted load calculation unit calculates a predicted load which is to be applied the shaft. A movement control unit controls the movement of the shaft on the basis of the movement instructions, and an actual load calculation unit calculates the actual load which is actually applied to the shaft. A difference apparatus calculates a load prediction error, which is the difference between the predicted load and the actual load, and an abnormal load detector detects an abnormal load condition of the shaft on the basis of the load prediction error.

title: Backlight module and display device
abstract: The present disclosure provides a backlight module and a display device. The backlight module includes a light guide plate, a light source assembly, and a driving circuit. The light guide plate includes a light-emitting surface, a bottom surface opposite to the light-emitting surface, and a lateral surface connecting the light-emitting surface and the bottom surface. A mounting groove is provided on the lateral surface. The light source assembly is arranged in the mounting groove. The driving circuit is electrically connected to the light source assembly. The driving circuit is arranged on at least one of the light-emitting surface and the bottom surface, and the driving circuit is located adjacent to the light source assembly.
assignee: Guangzhou China Star Optoelectronics Semiconductor Display Technology Co., Ltd.

title: System and method for authorizing presence of entities in monitored zones
abstract: A system for authorizing presence of an entity in a zone is described. The system includes a monitoring system configured to transmit a credential authentication request upon detection of a triggering event associated with the entity. In absence of a response to the credential authentication request from a first electronic device associated with the entity within a predetermined time interval or a failure to authenticate the first electronic device based on a response to the credential authentication request or detection of a tampering event at the first electronic device, the monitoring system is configured to transmit a biometric authentication request to a second electronic device associated with the entity. The monitoring system is configured to authenticate the entity based on biometric data received in response to the biometric authentication request, authorize the presence of the entity upon the authentication, and deactivate a response device based on the authorization.

title: Information search method
abstract: In an information search method, first search suggestion information is displayed in an information search interface on a display of a processing device when received target search information is related to one or more historical search operations. In the method, a current search result is generated based on the target search information and contextual corpus information that includes historical search information of the one or more historical search operations, browsed content from each historical search result of the one or more historical search operations, or records of feedback behaviors performed in association with the browsed content. In the method, the current search result is displayed in a search result interface on the display.

title: Injection device
abstract: An injection device for delivering a dose of a medicament includes a housing having an exterior surface and defining a container-receiving space configured to accommodate a medicament container. A thermal conductor is attached to the housing or formed integrally with the housing. The thermal conductor has an interior contact surface that adjoins the container-receiving space or extends into the container-receiving space to make direct mechanical contact with the medicament container when the container is positioned within the space, providing a thermal pathway between the container and the housing.

title: Content activation via interaction-based authentication, systems and method
abstract: Systems, methods, and use-cases of multi-modal authentications and content distribution are presented. A content consumer can capture a multi-modal digital representation of multiple objects where a juxtaposition of features derived from the digital representation can be used to recognize that at least some of the objects are a valid authentication object. Upon authentication, an authentication agent determines a content access level for content associated with the corresponding to the juxtaposition. The content can then be presented on an electronic device, possibly within a secure virtual machine, according to the content access level.

title: Compositions and methods for treatment of monogenic neurodevelopmental disorder
abstract: Described herein are antisense oligonucleotides, vectors, and related compositions and methods for increasing endoge-nous expression of SHANK3 protein and uses thereof for conditions associated with SHANK3 haploinsufficiency such as Phelan-McDermid syndrome.

title: Substrate assembly with surface structure
abstract: A substrate arrangement and a method for producing an electronic assembly. The substrate arrangement has (a) a bonding substrate which comprises an upper side and an underside, and (b) a contacting layer which comprises a contacting means, wherein the contacting layer is connected to the underside of the bonding substrate in a planar manner at least in regions, wherein the underside of the bonding substrate (i) has an arithmetic mean roughness value R(1) a  along at least one section S1, and (ii) an arithmetic mean roughness value R(2) a  along at least one section S2, wherein the at least one section S2 runs perpendicularly to the at least one section S1, wherein the ratio Q of arithmetic mean roughness value R(1) a  to arithmetic mean roughness value R(2) a  is in the range of 1.70-10.00.

title: Reporting data volume associated with small data transmission threshold
abstract: A method, network node and wireless device (WD) for reporting data volume close to small data transmission (SDT) threshold are disclosed. A method in a network node configured to communicate with a user equipment (UE) is described. The method includes receiving small data transmission (SDT) feedback information from the UE, where the SDT feedback information is based at least in part on a volume of data (V) pending for uplink (UL) transmission and an SDT data volume threshold, and performing one or more actions based at least in part on the SDT feedback information.

title: Recess gate and interconnector structure and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present application provides a semiconductor device and a method for preparing the same. The semiconductor device includes a substrate having an active region; a recess gate structure disposed in the substrate and intersecting the active region; a bit line contact including a polysilicon stack and disposed on the substrate; a conductive pillar disposed over the substrate and electrically connected to the active region; a landing pad disposed on the conductive pillar and electrically connected to the conductive pillar; and a stack of dielectric layers disposed over the substrate and laterally surrounding the bit line contact. The polysilicon stack includes a first polysilicon layer and a second polysilicon layer disposed over the first polysilicon layer. The second polysilicon layer is in direct contact with the stack of dielectric layers.

title: Compound and organic light-emitting element comprising samee
abstract:
A compound represented by Chemical Formula 1: 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     where X is NR or S; Y is NR′, O, or S; and the other substituents are as defined in the specification, and where at least one of three benzene rings directly or indirectly linked to boron is substituted with at least one carbazole group and at least one of an aryl group, a silyl group, or a heterocyclic group; and an organic light emitting device including the compound.

title: Transient overvoltage detection system and method
abstract: A detection system for detecting a transient overvoltage event in an electrical system that operates at a system frequency includes an analog circuit connected to the electrical system and having a high pass filter operable to allow for the passage of a transient voltage signal having a signal frequency greater than the system frequency. A digital circuit includes an analog to digital convertor that operates to convert the transient voltage signal to a digital transient voltage signal and a microprocessor operable to receive the digital transient voltage signal, to direct the digital transient voltage signal to a data storage device for storage in an overvoltage database, and to reset the analog circuit. A computer system is operable to output the data stored in the overvoltage database.
assignee: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG

title: Electronic device and fixture for assembly and repair
abstract: An electronic device, namely a tiled electronic device, and methods for its manufacture and repair are provided. The tiled electronic device includes a frame with a plurality of guide holes and a plurality of electronic modules mounted on the frame, each electronic module having a plurality of positioning holes corresponding to the guide holes. The method for repairing the tiled electronic device involves using a fixture with a plurality of guide posts to remove a defective electronic module and install a replacement. This process includes inserting the guide posts through the frame's guide holes and into the replacement module's positioning holes, guiding the replacement module towards the frame, and securely fixing it in place.

title: Sidewall-reinforced bicycle rim and method for manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure provides a sidewall-reinforced bicycle rim and a method for manufacturing the same. A sidewall-reinforced bicycle rim includes a rim body with a cavity, where a sidewall reinforcement member is separately embedded in each of inner walls on two sides, corresponding to the cavity, of the rim body, the sidewall reinforcement member includes a foaming body and reinforced carbon fiber layers that are attached to two sides of the foaming body, the foaming body is of a convex-ribbed mesh structure, a plurality of hollow holes are provided in the foaming body, and the reinforced carbon fiber layers on the two sides are closely attached at the hollow holes. Therefore, continuous delamination does not occur between the reinforced carbon fiber layer and the foaming body. This prevents delamination between the foaming body and the rim body, so that the reinforcing effect is better and reliability and stability are high.
assignee: Xiamen Carbonking Composites Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Display panel and display apparatus
abstract: A display panel includes a drive backplane, a pixel definition layer disposed on a side of the drive backplane, and a plurality of light-emitting devices separated by the pixel definition layer. Each of the light-emitting devices includes a first electrode, at least one first common layer, at least one second common layer, and a common electrode layer sequentially stacked in a direction away from the drive backplane; first common layers of the plurality of light-emitting devices are integrated as a whole; and second common layers of the plurality of light-emitting devices are integrated as a whole. An orthogonal projection of the first common layer on the drive backplane is within an orthogonal projection of the second common layer on the drive backplane.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Reporting Consistent Uplink Listen-Before-Talk Failures in Shared Channels
abstract: Embodiments include methods for a user equipment (UE). Such methods include initiating an uplink (UL) transmission in an active first bandwidth (BWP) of a plurality of configured BWPs in unlicensed spectrum. The UL transmission is unrelated to a random access (RA) procedure. Such methods include detecting consistent listen-before-talk (LBT) failure in the first BWP and logging information associated with the first BWP in which the consistent LBT failure was detected. Such methods include repeating the following operations until an RA procedure in an active BWP succeeds or RA procedures fail in all configured BWPs having RA resources: deactivating the active BWP, activating another of the configured BWPs having RA resources, and performing an RA procedure in the active BWP. Such methods include sending to a radio access network (RAN) a report including at least the logged information associated with the first BWP. Other embodiments include complementary methods for RAN nodes. FIG.  7  is selected for publication.

title: Generating audio and haptics output from a common actuator
abstract: A haptic driver for driving a haptic actuator, the haptic driver configured to: provide a haptic drive signal and an audio drive signal, the haptic drive signal for causing the haptic actuator to generate a haptic vibration output and the audio drive signal for causing the haptic actuator to generate an audio output; and drive the haptic actuator with the haptic drive signal and the audio drive signal so that the haptic actuator generates the haptic vibration output and the audio output.

title: Laminated antifouling coating film
abstract: The present invention provides, e.g., a laminated antifouling coating film which produces no problems such as peel-off when an antifouling coating film using a hydrolyzable copolymer is repaired and which provides easy repairment for regaining smoothness of the coating film, and provides a method for producing the laminated antifouling coating film. The laminated antifouling coating film of the present invention has an antifouling coating film (af) and a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer (pa). The antifouling coating film (af) contains a hydrolyzable copolymer (A) having a constitutional unit derived from a hydrolyzable group-containing monomer (a1).

title: Modular treatment, examination, and waiting station
abstract: A modular treatment, examination, and waiting station can include a back module with a bench and opposing towers, and first and second side modules extending in the same direction from the back module. Each side module may include a recessed storage space. Modular treatment, examination, and waiting station modules may define a floor space of less than 50 square feet. The modular treatment, examination, and waiting station may also include a ceiling module supported by the towers of a back module. One or more modular treatment, examination, and waiting stations may act as a system and may be configured in multi-station arrangements, with shared side modules providing access to equipment from adjacent stations.
assignee: Dirtt Environmental Solutions, Inc.; HKS, Inc.

title: Acoustic wave device with reduced acoustic coupling
abstract: An acoustic wave device is disclosed. The acoustic wave device can include a support substrate that includes a first substrate portion, a second substrate portion, and a third substrate portion between the first substrate portion and the second substrate portion. The acoustic wave device can also include a piezoelectric layer that includes a first portion over the first substrate portion and a second portion over the second substrate portion. The piezoelectric layer can be arranged such that a region over the third substrate portion is free from the piezoelectric layer. The acoustic wave device can also include a first interdigital transducer electrode on the first portion of the piezoelectric layer. The acoustic wave device can further include a second interdigital transducer electrode on the second portion of the piezoelectric layer.

title: Reassigning exit internet protocol addresses in a virtual private network server
abstract: A method including configuring a VPN server to activate a first exit IP address for communicating data associated with a user device having an established VPN connection with the VPN server; configuring the VPN server to deactivate the first exit IP address from communicating the data associated with the user device based at least in part on determining that an amount of data communicated utilizing the first exit IP address satisfies a data threshold; and configuring the VPN server to reactivate, the first exit IP address for communicating the data associated with the user device based at least in part on determining that the amount of data communicated utilizing the first exit IP address fails to satisfy the data threshold is disclosed. Various other aspects are contemplated.

title: Systems and methods for mass spectrometry
abstract: Described herein are mass spectrometers, ion manifolds, and analytical methods for high-duty cycle, tandem mass spectrometry.

title: Control apparatus for vehicle
abstract: A vehicle control apparatus including (a) a drive controller configured to control a power source, (b) a clutch controller configured to place the friction clutch in a slip state, when a vehicle starts running or runs within a small speed range; and (c) a state determiner configured to determine whether a running road is an uphill road or a flat road. The drive controller sets a slip-state target rotational speed that is a target value of a rotational speed of the power source during the slip state of the friction clutch, such that the slip-state target rotational speed is set to a first speed value when the running road is determined to be a flat road, and such that the slip-state target rotational speed is set to a second speed value that is smaller than the first speed value when the running road is determined to be an uphill road.

title: Dynamic Uplink Modification Using Transmission Time Interval Bundling and Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: A system can execute a deep reinforcement learning agent that comprises a reward function based on changes to uplink throughputs, changes to packet error rates, changes to respective call drop rates, and changes to latencies. The system can input currently applicable measurements of the broadband cellular communications with the user equipment that satisfy a real-time criterion into the deep reinforcement learning agent, wherein the deep reinforcement learning agent produces an output that indicates a modification to the broadband cellular communications, and wherein the modification comprises a transmission time interval configuration of the first group of transmission time interval configurations or a layer 1 retransmission strategy of the second group of layer 1 retransmission strategies. The system can apply the modification to the broadband cellular communications, to result in modified broadband cellular communications with the user equipment.

title: Semi-permanent tattoo with film release liner
abstract: In a first aspect, the present disclosure relates to an applicator for applying a pattern comprising a semi-permanent colorant, wherein the applicator comprises a carrier liner and an adhesive layer. The applicator further comprises a pattern provided on and/or in the adhesive layer, wherein the pattern comprises a semi-permanent colorant. Furthermore, the applicator comprises a release liner having a surface contacting the adhesive layer and the pattern, wherein the surface is formed by a film.

title: System, method, and apparatus for providing optimized network resources
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing optimization of network resources. The system is operable to monitor the electromagnetic environment, analyze the electromagnetic environment, and extract environmental awareness of the electromagnetic environment. The system extracts the environmental awareness of the electromagnetic environment by including customer goals. The system is operable to use the environmental awareness with the customer goals and/or user defined policies and rules to extract actionable information to help the customer optimize the network resources.

title: Battery diagnosis apparatus and battery diagnosis method
abstract: Disclosed is a battery diagnosis apparatus and a battery diagnosis method. The battery diagnosis apparatus includes a processor configured to control a stimulation application device to intermittently apply a second electric stimulation that is greater than a first electric stimulation to a target cell during a state change period until an electric state of the target cell changes to a target state from an initial state, and a communication unit configured to obtain current time series data during the state change period and voltage time series data representing a change history of a full-cell voltage of the target cell during periods of rest between the intermittently applied second electric stimulation given in the state change period. The processor generates a measurement full-cell profile of the target cell based on the current time series data and the voltage time series data, and analyzes the measurement full-cell profile to estimate a positive electrode loading amount representing an amount of positive electrode active material per unit area of a positive electrode of the target cell.

title: Soil tillage device
abstract: The invention relates to a soil tillage device for tillage of an agricultural area (N), which is movable relative to the agricultural area (N), with a plurality of working tools ( 3 ) arranged on a tool frame ( 2 ) and engaging with the agricultural area (N), and at least one clogging sensor ( 4 ) for detecting material accumulations (M) that are dragged along by the working tools ( 3 ) and impair the soil tillage, wherein the clogging sensor ( 4 ) is coupled to a touch element ( 4.1 ) arranged movable relative to the tool frame ( 2 ) for tactile detection of the material accumulations (M).
assignee: Amazonen-Werke H. Dreyer SE & Co. KG

title: Location-based network anomaly diagnostic
abstract: Example embodiments of the present disclosure relate to location-based network anomaly diagnostic. According to example embodiments, a device may include an Anomaly Detection Component that may be configured to: receive data associated with cell coverage of a plurality of sections of a location and connectivity sessions at the location; determine, based on the received data, a plurality of anomaly detection results, wherein each of the anomaly detection results indicates whether a network anomaly has occurred in a respective one of the plurality of sections; and provide, to a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Component, data associated with at least one of the anomaly detection results that indicates that a network anomaly has occurred.

title: Coumarin synthesis and uses thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to genes, materials and methods for coumarin synthesis and the application thereof for improving plant health, preferably against infection by phythopathogenic microorganisms, and/or for improving plant health against coumarin-induced adverse effects on plant health. Furthermore, the invention pertains to methods and uses of such genes and materials for creating correspondingly beneficial plant cells, plant parts and whole plants, and relates to products obtained from such plants or plant parts.

title: Electric field resonant antenna, and wireless power transmission system
abstract: An electric field resonant antenna includes: a resonance unit including a first electrode, a second electrode, and a coil connected to the first electrode and the second electrode; and a waterproof case covering the resonance unit.

title: Power management circuit having thin-film inductors
abstract: In an aspect, an electronic device includes a die substrate; a substrate overlying the die substrate, the substrate having one or more non-magnetic dielectric layers, and a central region and a side region adjacent the central region; a set of metallizations extending through the one or more non-magnetic dielectric layers of the central region of the substrate, wherein the set of metallizations are connected to control lines of the die substrate; and a solenoid thin-film inductor (TFI) disposed in the one or more non-magnetic dielectric layers of the side region, the solenoid TFI comprising a central magnetic block, one or more magnetic blocks disposed adjacent to opposite ends of the central magnetic block, and conductive windings disposed about the central magnetic block.

title: Wafer level optical sensor packaging
abstract: A package includes a silicon integrated circuit substrate die including a die area for an optical function such as light sensing or light emitting. A micro-dam structure surrounds the die area. The micro-dam structure delimits a reservoir that is filled with a transparent material. An opaque material laterally encapsulates the micro-dam structure filled by the transparent material.

title: Vehicle body structure
abstract: A vehicle body structure includes: a side sill inner member, extending in a vehicle length direction, and provided with a fixing hole for mounting a belt or a hook to be fixed to a loaded object during loading and transportation; a side panel outer member, joined to the side sill inner member from an outer side in a vehicle width direction to form a side sill cross-section portion; and a support member, provided at an end portion of the side sill inner member corresponding to the side sill inner member, and having a support hole at a position corresponding to the fixing hole, in which the support member has a connecting surface portion extending from the end portion of the side sill inner member in the vehicle length direction and bent in a vehicle height direction, and the connecting surface portion is connected to the side panel outer member.

title: Ear-clip earphones
abstract: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure relates to an ear-clip earphone. The ear-clip earphone includes a sound-generating portion, a abutment portion, and an ear hook. The ear hook is configured to bypass an antihelix and a helix of a user, and connect the sound-generating portion and the abutment portion. The ear hook has a first symmetry plane. A housing forms a first projection on the first symmetry plane. The abutment portion forms a second projection on the first symmetry plane. The ear hook forms a third projection on the first symmetry plane. A first tangent point exists between the first projection and the second projection. The first tangent point serves as a first feature point. A point on an inner contour curve of the third projection that is farthest away from the first feature point is defined as a second feature point.

title: Highly refined fibre forming process
abstract: The present invention relates to a forming process. In particular it relates to a double-layer forming process improved with the purpose of obtaining in the final product an oil-proof barrier without using chemical additives.

title: Systems and methods for analyzing advertising messaging
abstract: Systems and methods for predicting which of two alternate messages is likely to be more successful in motivating members of a target audience to take a particular type of action utilize a neural network to make such a prediction. The neural network can take into account information about the target audience in making the prediction. Such systems may also provide marketing personnel with an editing capability that allows a user to selectively edit marketing messages and to then receive immediate feedback about how the edits impact the likelihood that a message will motivate a member of a target audience to take a particular type of action.

title: System for providing personalized application programming interface experience
abstract: A system that builds an individual natural language processing model and provides a personalized experience for a customer using an application programming interface connection. A pre-trained base model is prepared on a server, and text data is collected from the customer's messaging apps, emails, and social networking services on a terminal. The collected data is used to learn the language usage patterns and preferences of each customer on the server and generate an individual model.

title: Bumper Element for a Tool, a Venting Structure, and a Tool
abstract: A bumper element for a tool is disclosed. The bumper element has a bearing end face located at one end in the axial direction and a supporting end face located at the other end in the axial direction. At least one groove is provided on a circumferential surface between the supporting end face and the bearing end face to increase the surface area of the circumferential surface.
assignee: Bosch Power Tools (China) Co., Ltd.; Robert Bosch Gmbh

title: Semiconductor device with alternating bitlines and string select lines
abstract: A semiconductor device includes word lines disposed on a substrate and spaced apart in a first direction perpendicular to an upper surface of the substrate, a string select line disposed on the word lines, memory strings extending in the first direction on the substrate, each memory string including a first channel extending in the first direction through the word lines, and memory cells constituted by the word lines around the first channel, bit lines electrically connected to the memory strings, and a strapping line connected to the string select.

title: Network traffic rerouting for power reduction
abstract: In one embodiment, a system for managing power consumption in a node interconnect network includes a plurality of nodes interconnected via a network, and an orchestrator to analyze link requirements, configure dynamic routing profiles for the plurality of nodes based on the link requirements, and instruct the plurality of nodes to implement the dynamic routing profiles, wherein each one node of the plurality of nodes is to selectively route traffic to a subset of available ports of the one node based on a dynamic routing profile of the one node, thereby allowing unused ports to enter a low-power state.

title: Mounting arrangement for ceiling suspended skylight luminaires
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a skylight luminaire ( 1 ) comprising a circumferential plate ( 10 ) and a recessed skylight unit ( 20 ) arranged in the circumferential plate ( 10 ). The skylight luminaire ( 1 ) further comprises fastening elements ( 11   a   , 11   b ) arranged on the circumferential plate ( 10 ). A protrusion ( 21 ) of the recessed skylight unit ( 20 ) forms a rectangular base ( 21′ ) on the upper surface ( 18 ) of the circumferential plate ( 10 ) wherein the rectangular base ( 21′ ) extends between a first pair of parallel sides separated in a first direction (L 1 ) and a second pair of parallel sides separated in a second direction (L 2 ) perpendicular to the first direction (L 1 ). The fastening elements ( 11   a   , 11   b ) are arranged at outside of the rectangular base ( 21′ ).

title: Soybean variety '10021330747'
abstract: New soybean variety designated ‘10021330747’ is described. ‘10021330747’ is a soybean variety exhibiting stability and uniformity.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device includes a substrate, an electronic element, and a first bonding element. The substrate has an active area and a peripheral area adjacent to the active area. The electronic element is disposed on the substrate and located in the active area. The first bonding element is disposed on the substrate and located in the peripheral area, wherein the first bonding element includes a first bonding layer and a second bonding layer, the second bonding layer is disposed on the first bonding layer, and the second bonding layer covers a side surface and a top surface of the first bonding layer.

title: Autofill skimmer lid assembly, systems, and methods
abstract: A lid for a skimmer for an aquatic environment is disclosed. The lid includes a top member having a top side and a bottom side. The lid also includes a main body extending downwardly from the bottom side of the top member and a vision system disposed on the bottom side of the top member. The vision system is designed to detect objects in a filter of the skimmer. The lid includes a controller designed to output a signal to alert that the filter needs to be emptied.
assignee: Pentair Water Pool And Spa, Inc.

title: Inlay, Component Carrier, and Method of Manufacturing the Inlay
abstract: An inlay includes a first electrically insulating material layer having at least one first via; a second electrically insulating material layer having at least one second via; and a central layer arranged between the first electrically insulating material layer and the second electrically insulating material layer, wherein the first via and/or the second via extend at least partially into the central layer.

title: Gate Driver and Touch Sensing Display Device Including the Same
abstract: A gate driving circuit includes a plurality of first odd main stages configured to drive first odd gate lines of a first display block in a first display period, a plurality of second odd main stages configured to drive second odd gate lines of a second display block adjacent to the first display block in a second display period, an odd reset dummy stage configured to reset a Q node included in a first lower-priority operation stage that is relatively late in operation order among the plurality of first odd main stages in the first display period; and an odd set dummy stage configured to set a Q node included in a first higher-priority operation stage that is relatively advanced in operation order among the plurality of second odd main stages in the second display period.

title: Aircraft with high transport efficiency and a method of operation
abstract: an aircraft with high transport efficiency, wherein the aircraft include a blended wing body with a downward depressed upper aft surface, configured to operate at a high cruising level within a high cruise altitude range, wherein the blended wing body include a main body configured to accommodate a payload, and at least a wing, wherein the blended wing body include no striking demarcation between the main body and the at least a wing and at least a propulsor attached to the blended wing body and configured to propel the aircraft.

title: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing the semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device that can be miniaturized or highly integrated is provided. The semiconductor device includes a transistor and an insulator; the insulator is provided over one of a source and a drain of the transistor; the other of the source and the drain of the transistor is provided over the insulator; an opening portion reaching one of the source and the drain is provided in the insulator and the other of the source and the drain; an oxide semiconductor included in the transistor is in contact with a top surface of one of the source and the drain, a side surface of the insulator, and a side surface of the other of the source and the drain that are in the opening portion; a gate insulator of the transistor is provided over the oxide semiconductor; a gate of the transistor is provided over the gate insulator; the oxide semiconductor includes a first region in contact with one of the source and the drain, a second region in contact with the insulator, and a third region in contact with the other of the source and the drain; the first and third regions have lower resistance than the second region; and the second region has a lower potential than the first and third regions.

title: Bridged tricyclic carbamoylpyridone compounds and uses thereof
abstract:
The present disclosure relates generally to compounds, of Formula I: 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     Also disclosed are pharmaceutical compositions comprising said compounds and methods of making said compounds. The compounds of the disclosure are useful in treating or preventing human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection.

title: Laser radar target detection method, system, terminal, and storage medium
abstract: The method comprises: acquiring target point cloud data and determining whether the total number of points in the target point cloud data exceeds a maximum point limit; when the total number of points in the target point cloud data exceeds the maximum point limit, performing weighted sampling on the target point cloud data using a point cloud sampling method based on the dynamic fusion of density and depth weights to obtain sampled point cloud data; performing voxelization on the sampled point cloud data to obtain voxelized point cloud data, processing the voxelized point cloud data using an improved feature encoding module, and outputting a target tensor; generating a pseudo-image based on the target tensor, extracting features from the pseudo-image using a two-dimensional convolutional neural network, and performing detection and regression on the extracted features using a detection head to obtain detection results.

title: Tape library with variable speed air conditioner
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention include a method for managing temperature and humidity levels within a tape library utilizing a variable speed air conditioning unit. The method includes receiving environmental values for an internal environment of an enclosure of a tape library. The method further includes determining the environmental values are approaching a target temperature for the enclosure of the tape library. The method further includes reducing or increasing an original output of a compressor and a fan speed of a variable speed air conditioning unit of the tape library to a new output.

title: Heterocycloalkyl beta-hydroxy alkyl amines for use in the treatment of hyperglycaemia and disorders characterised by hyperglycaemia
abstract: There are herein provided compounds of formula (I) wherein Q 1  to Q 5 , ring A, Z, n, m and r have meanings as provided in the description. Medical uses thereof are also provided herein.

title: Radial heat-spreading aluminum chamber interfaces with hydrocarbon-mediated thermal flux modulation
abstract: An aluminum hydrocarbon-coated cylindrical sleeve system is provided that includes an aluminum structural body defining a cylindrical main body and a substantially circular internal cavity configured to receive a payload positioned centrally within the cylindrical main body. The aluminum structural body includes a hydrocarbon coating disposed on at least an interior surface of the aluminum structural body, wherein the hydrocarbon coating is applied by a polymerization process and is configured to establish a continuous thermal interface with the payload. The aluminum hydrocarbon-coated cylindrical sleeve system further includes an exterior cooling block interface region disposed along a longitudinal exterior surface of the aluminum structural body and configured for thermal coupling to an external cooling interface assembly. The hydrocarbon-coated aluminum structural body is configured to transmit cooling energy from the exterior cooling block interface region into the circular internal cavity and to absorb thermal energy from the payload for outward conduction through the aluminum structural body.

title: Apparatus and method for reasoning music based on brain computer interface
abstract: A BCI-based music inferring method according to an embodiment of the present disclosure is a BCI-based music inferring method in which at least part of each operation is performed by a processor, and includes receiving brain signal data of a subject imagining a melody, determining partial brain signal data having musical significance from the brain signal data, and estimating a melodic contour of the melody on the basis of the partial brain signal data.

title: Method for leaching rock metal component, method for storing carbon dioxide underground, and method for fixing carbon dioxide
abstract: A method for leaching rock metal components, capable of enhancing dissolution of mafic rocks such as basalt and ultramafic rocks such as olivine at lower than 200° C. underground and improving permeability of the rocks, a method for storing carbon dioxide underground using the above method, and a method for fixing carbon dioxide. The method includes a leaching fluid composed of a chelating agent-containing liquid is injected into mafic rocks or ultramafic rocks at lower than 200° C. underground to extract, into the leaching fluid, metal components included in the mafic rocks or ultramafic rocks. Furthermore, carbon dioxide or a storage liquid with carbon dioxide dissolved therein is injected into the mafic rocks or ultramafic rocks from which the metal components have been extracted into the leaching fluid.

title: Processing information forming system and processing information forming program
abstract: An information acquisition unit of a processing information generation system acquires wooden structural member information, metal fitting information connected to the wooden structural member, and fixed position information of the metal fittings to the wooden structural member. A processing information generation unit of the processing information generation system groups ones of the metal fittings having overlapping hole positions in a height direction when the metal fittings are arranged on the wooden structural member. The grouping is based on the metal fitting information and the fixed position information. The processing information generation unit sets bolt hole candidates for fixing the metal fittings that belong to the group based on the metal fitting information for each of the metal fittings that belong to the group. The processing information generation unit selects a bolt hole that satisfies a fixing condition for the metal fittings from the bolt hole candidates.

title: Compositions and methods for isolating cell-free dna
abstract: Disclosed herein are compositions and methods for isolating DNA, such as cell-free DNA (cfDNA). In some embodiments, the cell-free DNA is from a subject having or suspected of having cancer and/or the cell-free DNA comprises DNA produced by a tumor. In some embodiments, the DNA isolated by the method is captured using a sequence-variable target region set and an epigenetic target region set, wherein the sequence-variable target region set is captured with a greater capture yield than the epigenetic target region set. In some embodiments, captured cfDNA of the sequence-variable target region set is sequenced to a greater depth of sequencing than captured cfDNA of the epigenetic target region set.

title: Silicone - polyether copolymer and method for synthesis thereof
abstract: A silicone-polyether copolymer and methods for its preparation and use are disclosed. The silicone-polyether copolymer is useful in various applications including hair care compositions due to having a refractive index >1.46.

title: Adapting operational parameters based on measurements confidence level
abstract: A method for adapting operation of a LIDAR system based on detected objects, comprising receiving a plurality of measurements associated with detection results of a LIDAR system scanning a scene, each of the plurality of measurements is associated with at least one confidence level, accessing one or more memories storing classification information for classifying a plurality of objects, classifying a particular object based on the classification information, and the plurality of measurements and their associated confidence levels, and adapting one or more operational parameters of the LIDAR system according to one or more confidence levels of one or more of the plurality of measurements.

title: Self-powered nitrogen dioxide sensing system with excellent performance
abstract: A self-powered nitrogen dioxide sensing system with excellent performance is composed of an EMC-TENG and a MoS 2 /MoO 3 -based NO 2  gas sensor connected through a rectification and voltage regulation module, where the rectification and voltage regulation module consists of a bridge rectifier circuit, an RC filter circuit, and a 24 V Zener diode, the input terminal of the rectification and voltage regulation module is connected to the EMC-TENG to receive an alternating current signal, and the output terminal of the rectification and voltage regulation module is connected to the MoS 2 /MoO 3 -based NO 2  gas sensor to supply power to the gas sensor.

title: Feature channel removal mechanism for feature compression bitstream
abstract: Systems, methods, and instrumentalities are disclosed for a device configured to receive, in a bitstream, a channel removal indication indicating whether a plurality of indices of coded channels is sorted. The device may, based on the channel removal indication indicating that the plurality of indices of coded channels is sorted, receive a coded channel count indicating a first subset of a sorted plurality of indices of coded channels to be decoded from the bitstream. The device may decode a feature tensor based on at least one coded channel indicated by the coded channel count.

title: Gravitational Information Extraction Device for Recognition-Weighted Multiscale Analysis of Gravitational Wave Signals
abstract: A gravitational information extraction device detects, analyzes, and extracts informational content from gravitational wave signals. A sensor subsystem generates measurement data responsive to gravitational-wave-induced effects, and processing circuitry derives a recognition signal parameter from amplitude, frequency, and time quantities associated with the measurement data. The processing circuitry computes a bounded recognition coverage quantity, applies scale-dependent recognition weighting to generate multiscale recognition transforms, identifies structured informational features from the transforms, and computes one or more informational content quantities. The device generates outputs including event indicators, classifications, reports, or correlation results. In some embodiments, the device includes a quantum enhancement subsystem configured to improve measurement sensitivity. In some embodiments, recognition-transform results from multiple detectors are time-synchronized and phase-synchronized for cross-correlation. The disclosed system supports extraction of structured information from gravitational wave measurements using recognition-weighted multiscale analysis.

title: Half-duplex data communication system
abstract: A half-duplex data communication system includes a first communication device and a second communication device. The first communication device is connected to the second communication device via a communication link. The first communication device sends a first signal to the second communication device. The second communication device sends a second signal to the first communication device. The first signal includes a synchronization frame. The second communication device recovers a data frame synchronization signal according to the received synchronization frame, and communicates with an external device based on the data frame synchronization signal. A local clock generation module in the second communication device generates a local clock of the second communication device, the clock for the second communication device to send the second signal is the local clock of the second communication device, and the first signal and the second signal are transmitted on the communication link in a time-division manner.

title: Enhanced real-time processing of live x-ray image streams using machine learning and artipicial intelligence for optimization of patient outcomes in embolization procedures
abstract: Hardware and software improvements support Real-time image processing system (RTIPS) algorithm effective for detection of intrusion into protectable zones during, for example the special example of the onset of dangerous embolization agent flow/movement during Middle Meningeal Artery Embolization; along with analogous data set harvesting during Embolization of arterio-venous malformations of the brain; Embolization of arterio-venous fistulae of the brain and its coverings (dura); Cerebral Aneurysm embolization; Neuro-interventional embolization procedures of the head, neck and central nervous system; Injection of cement into bony structures (during kyphoplasty or vertebroplasty); Hardware (screw) placement during spinal instrumentation procedures; Arterial embolization procedures of organs or lesions in the human body; and, Venous embolization procedures of organs or lesion in the human body.

title: Non-coding rna peptide antigens for cancer vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostics
abstract: Provided herein are methods of identifying ncRNA neoantigens for diagnosing, treating, and preventing cancer. Also disclosed are methods and compositions for administering identified ncRNA neoantigens for the treatment and prevention of cancer.

title: Animal trays, multi-imaging-animal fixation devices, and systems and methods for animal imaging
abstract: Provided are an animal tray, a multi-imaging-animal fixation device, a system and a method for animal imaging. The method includes: scanning an imaging animal using an imaging device to acquire scan data of the imaging animal; and reconstructing a target medical image of the imaging animal based on the scan data. During the scan, the imaging animal is placed on a tray in a preset positioning posture and is placed into the imaging device via the tray. The tray includes body part fixation portions disposed at fixed positions on the tray and configured to maintain the preset positioning posture of the imaging animal.
assignee: Wuhan United Imaging Life Science Instrument Co., Ltd.

title: Lighting device for vehicles
abstract: The invention relates to a vehicle lighting device including a first lighting unit for generating a first light function and a second lighting unit for generating a second light function. The first lighting unit includes a flat light guide having opposing flat sides between which coupled light is totally internally reflected in a light-guiding direction, and a narrow side connecting the flat sides through which light from at least one light source is coupled into the light guide. The second lighting unit is arranged downstream of the first lighting unit in a main emission direction. Light emitted by the second lighting unit passes through the flat sides of the light guide and is emitted in the main emission direction. The second lighting unit is positioned, in projection onto a normal of the light guide, in an edge region of the light guide and/or outside the edge region, and includes optical elements such that the emitted light passes through a light transmission surface greater than 50% of a total surface area of the flat light guide.

title: Digital low-dropout voltage regulator
abstract: In some embodiments, an integrated circuit device includes multiple rows of functional cells, with each row having a cell height. At least one of rows of functional cells includes at least one digital low-dropout voltage regulator (DLVR) cell with the cell height for the row. The DLVR cell includes: an input terminal, an output terminal, a voltage supply terminal, a reference voltage terminal, and one or more pairs of transistors. Each pair of transistors are arranged in cascode configuration connected between the voltage supply terminal and output terminal. The gate of one of the transistors the cascode configuration is connected to the input terminal, and the gate of the other transistor in the cascode configuration is connected to the reference voltage terminal. The four terminals each comprises a metal track in the bottom metal layer and disposed within the cell height.

title: Air tolerant photocathode electron gun
abstract: optics that includes a photocathode and light optics configured to direct a light beam towards the photocathode, the light beam forms a sub-micron spot on the photocathode. The photocathode is air tolerant, is made of a material selected of Na 2 O, K 2 O and Rb 2 O, and is configured to convert the light beam to an electron beam.

title: Glucagon Analogs Comprising Beta-Amino Acids, Their Pharmaceutically Acceptable Salts, and Therapeutic Applications
abstract: The present invention discloses a glucagon analogue comprising β-amino acid substitutions or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, along with its therapeutic applications. By incorporating β-amino acids at designated positions within the glucagon sequence, the disclosed analogues exhibit glucagon receptor (GCGR) agonist activity comparable or superior to native glucagon in in vitro and in vivo assays. Furthermore, these structural modifications confer enhanced plasma stability and resistance to hepatic microsomal degradation, resulting in improved pharmacokinetic profiles and drug-like properties. Collectively, these attributes position the analogues as viable candidates for further development into therapeutic interventions in metabolic disorders such as diabetes, obesity, and hyperglycemia.

title: Belt for pulp or paper machine with sensors for detecting pressure during operation and press using same
abstract: A pressure-sensing belt for a shoe press or the like includes: a substantially cylindrical polymeric belt having a longitudinal axis, a radially inner surface, and a radially outer surface; a plurality of reinforcing cross-machine (CD) fibers extending parallel to the longitudinal axis for the length of the belt between the inner and outer surfaces; a plurality of reinforcing machine direction (MD) fibers extending circumferentially relative to the longitudinal axis between the inner and outer surfaces; and a plurality of piezoelectric fibers extending within the belt, the piezoelectric fibers each having a sensing portion and a signal-carrying portion.

title: Auto Dimensioning Tool for Construction Mobile Applications
abstract: A method and apparatus for automatically presenting a dimension of a depiction of an object is disclosed. One embodiment is evidenced by a method which comprises accepting a hit point on the depiction of the object and automatically presenting the dimension according to the plurality of surface boundary edges. The surface of the depicted object may be determined by collecting a plurality of connected triangles and edges that form the surface, then for each connected triangle, determining the triangle edges that form the border of the surface, and the triangle border vertices, and finally collating the triangle edges to produce the plurality of surface boundary edges from the triangle border edges.

title: Pump for a bioprocessing system
abstract: The present disclosure related to a pump ( 100, 1100, 2100 ) for providing substantially continuous liquid flow in a bioprocessing system ( 200 ), the pump ( 100, 1100, 2100 ) comprising: a pressurizable outlet chamber ( 122, 1122 ) in fluidic communication with an outlet ( 126, 1126, 2126 ) of the pump ( 100, 1100, 2100 ); and a pressurizable feed chamber ( 120, 1120 ) connected in series with the outlet chamber ( 122, 1122 ), wherein the feed chamber ( 120, 1120 ) is configured to fill the outlet chamber ( 122, 1122 ) during discharge of liquid from the outlet chamber ( 122, 1122 ).

title: Systems and methods for federated task performance controlled by agents
abstract: Systems and methods for providing federated task performance controlled by agents are disclosed.
