In a write operation of setting the memory cells to a first state, the control circuit repeatedly executes a loop operation of sequentially executing a verification operation and a program operation, executes first and second sensing operations in the verification operation of a first loop operation, the first sensing operation being an operation of determining whether a threshold voltage of each of the memory cells is equal to or higher than a first voltage, the second sensing operation being an operation of determining whether a threshold voltage of each of the memory cells is equal to or higher than a second voltage, and does not execute the first sensing operation in the verification operation of a second loop operation that is after the first loop operation.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING ß-LACTAM COMPOUND
abstract:
There is provided a method for producing a β-lactam compound, the method including: introducing, into different flow channels, each of
         a reaction solution (i) obtained by dissolving a metal salt (y) represented by Formula (2) generated by introducing, in a solution of a metal salt (x) represented by Formula (1), a protective group into an amino group of the metal salt (x),   a solution (ii) of an acid halide, and   a solution (iii) of a β-lactam compound (a) having an amino group, and causing each solution to flow in each flow channel;   merging the reaction solution (i) and the solution (ii) to generate a mixed acid anhydride; and   merging the merged solution (M 1 ) and the solution (iii) to generate a β-lactam compound (b) having an amide bond,       

     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
         
         
           
             in the formulae, R represents a cyclic hydrocarbon group, M represents an alkali metal, and X represents a protective group.

title: Stream-level video analytics tailored for different users of a video surveilance camera
abstract: Methods, video cameras, systems, and stored instruction sets for video cameras and systems. A video camera captures a raw video stream. The camera or a separate device processes the raw video stream to produce a first processed video stream, including applying a first video analytics algorithm resulting in the first processed video stream having first video analytics algorithm results. The camera or the separate device also processes the raw video stream to produce a second processed video stream, including applying a second video analytics algorithm resulting in the second processed video stream having second video analytics algorithm results, wherein the second video analytics algorithm is different from the first video analytics algorithm. The first stream and first results are provided to a first user and not a second user, while the second stream and second results are provided to a second user and not the first user.

title: Braiding fibers with programmably driven carriers
abstract: A braiding machine includes multiple carriers driven along paths that are programmatically defined. The braiding machine has a powered platform that contains an array of electromagnets that are selectively energized by an electronic controller. The carriers ride on respective movers, which are placed on or above the platform. The movers contain respective arrays of permanent magnets. The electromagnets magnetically interact with the permanent magnets to form planar motors, which can drive the movers in arbitrary directions along the platform and can rotate the movers. The electronic controller controls the movers individually, with each mover following its own path and with all movers operating simultaneously.

title: Negative electrode active material for chloride ion battery, method for producing same, and chloride ion battery
abstract: The present disclosure provides a negative electrode active material for a chloride ion battery that is capable of improving the initial charge-discharge efficiency of a chloride ion battery, a method for producing the same, and a chloride ion battery containing such a negative electrode active material for a chloride ion battery. The negative electrode active material for a chloride ion battery of the present disclosure contains a chloroaluminate of an alkali metal. The method of the present disclosure for producing a negative electrode active material for a chloride ion battery includes treating an alkali metal chloride and aluminum chloride by a mechanical milling method. a chloride ion battery  1  of the present disclosure includes a negative electrode active material layer  20 , and the negative electrode active material layer contains the negative electrode active material for a chloride ion battery of the present disclosure.

title: Efficient pwm modulator utilizing interpolation
abstract: The present invention is in the field of basic electronic circuitry, in particular of a digital signal processor for streaming audio applications, more in particular a pulse-width modulator, an integrated circuit comprising said electronic circuit, and a device comprising said electronic circuitry or said integrated circuit, such as an audio device.

title: Pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyridine derivatives
abstract: The current invention relates to compounds of the formula (I) wherein the substituents are as defined in claim  1 , to processes and methods for preparing compounds of formula (I), to agrochemical compositions comprising compounds of formula (I) as defined in claim  1 , to preparation of these compositions and to the use of the compounds or compositions in agriculture or horticulture for combating, preventing or controlling infestation of plants, harvested food crops, seeds or non-living materials by phytopathogenic microorganisms, in particular fungi.

title: Biopolymer scaffolds and methods for production or use thereof
abstract: Methods for the manufacture of porous biopolymer scaffolds containing a first biopolymer in combination with chondroitin sulfate and/or hyaluronic acid, compositions made by such methods, and use of the biopolymer scaffolds in dermal regeneration. Non-limiting examples of first biopolymers include alginate, chitosan, collagen, cellulose, gelatin, starch, and various combinations thereof.

title: Command Disambiguation based on Environmental Context
abstract: In one implementation, a method of changing a state of an object is performed at a device including an image sensor, one or more processors, and non-transitory memory. The method includes receiving a vocal command. The method includes obtaining, using the image sensor, an image of a physical environment. The method includes detecting, in the image of the physical environment, an object based on a visual model of the object stored in the non-transitory memory in association with an object identifier of the object. The method includes generating, based on the vocal command and detection of the object, an instruction including the object identifier of the object. The method includes effectuating the instruction to change a state of the object.

title: Method and Device for Producing a Component
abstract: A method and device for producing a component using additive production, the method comprising the steps of a) creating a main body in an additive manufacturing method, as a result of which the main body has a plurality of material layers that lie one above the other in a first build direction, and b) applying at least one material web onto the outer contour of the main body by applying a plasticized material strand such that the at least one material web connects several of the material layers to one another.

title: Organic electroluminescent device comprising a compound of formula (i) and an organic electronic device comprising the organic electroluminescent device
abstract:
The present invention relates to an organic electroluminescent device comprising a compound of Formula (I): 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     and an organic electronic device comprising the organic electroluminescent device.

title: Methods of forming microelectronic devices including staircase structures, and related microelectronic devices
abstract: A method of forming a microelectronic device includes forming a staircase structure within an upper portion of a preliminary stack structure that comprises preliminary tiers respectively including insulative material and sacrificial vertically neighboring the insulative material. An oxide liner material is formed on steps of the staircase structure, and then additional staircase structure is formed within a lower portion of the preliminary stack structure. Implanted regions are formed within portions of the sacrificial material of the preliminary tiers of the lower group of the preliminary tiers proximate the additional steps of the additional staircase structure. The sacrificial material of the preliminary tiers is replaced with conductive material to form a stack structure. Conductive contacts are formed within the contact openings and vertically extending through an entire height of the stack structure. Additional conductive contacts are formed within horizontal areas of and vertically extending to the steps of the staircase structure.

title: Mixture of physical ai agents
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques for generating a response in response to a user query using physical AI agents. In at least one embodiment, one or more processors comprise circuitry to generate a task plan from a user query, the task plan comprising workflow to generate response to the query; execute the task plan by using a neural network to select different agents to generate information to perform different operations in the task plan; and generate a response based on execution of the task plan.

title: Private key security management method of a cold wallet and a cold wallet server thereof
abstract: A private key security management method of a cold wallet and a cold wallet server thereof, the user provides a mnemonic to generate a private key and a wallet address, and then the system stores the private key fragments in volatile storage devices at different storage addresses, such as RAM. Even if the cold wallet server is hacked and causes data leakage of the RAM, but will not cause the entire private key information leakage, that is, the hacker can only obtain part of the private key fragments, and cannot piece together the complete private key to control the cold wallet assets, which greatly reduces the overall private key leakage risk caused by local security issues. Furthermore, if the cold wallet server detects an illegal intrusion, it will initiate a system restart or power-off protection measure. Once the system restarts or cut off power, the private key fragments stored in the RM will also disappear, further improving the security and reliability of key protection.

title: Winding method of wire rod
abstract: A winding method of a wire rod includes a step of winding the wire rod delivered from a tip end of a nozzle around magnetic poles by revolving the tip end of the nozzle around a magnetic pole of the magnetic poles by combining swinging of the magnetic pole about a center axis of a stator core and a relative movement of the nozzle in an axial direction of the stator core with respect to a slot between the magnetic poles, wherein by moving the nozzle in a radial direction of the stator core while the magnetic pole is being swung, the tip end of the nozzle from which the wire rod is delivered is moved linearly relative to a width direction of the magnetic pole.

title: Dielectric rod antenna and dielectric rod
abstract:
[Problem] The purpose of the present invention is to realize a dielectric rod antenna and a dielectric rod that are capable of relatively reducing transmission line loss, increasing gain, and handling beam scanning in an array antenna of a millimeter wave band or above. 
     [Solution] This dielectric rod is mounted to an external antenna and comprises a plurality of dielectric elements. The dielectric elements are arranged so that one or more dielectric elements correspond to each antenna element included in the external antenna. The dielectric elements each have a base part, a distal-end part, and a body part connecting the base part and the distal-end part. The base parts are arranged in a lattice shape. The body parts each have a shape extending substantially linearly from the base parts toward the distal-end parts. Each of the body parts is arranged so as to mutually separate from the base part toward the distal-end part.

title: Digital worker using hybrid nlp technique for incident resolution
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods and systems for natural language processing (NLP). An example method includes joining, by a chatbot, a group conversation in a messaging system in response to receiving an invitation to the group conversation. The method further includes receiving, by the chatbot, a natural language request from a first user in the group conversation, where the natural language request is associated with a current incident. The method further includes identifying, by the chatbot, authorization information associated with each user in the group conversation. The method further includes determining, by the chatbot, one or more authorization requirements associated with the natural language request. The method further includes in response to determining that the identified authorization information associated with each user in the group conversation satisfies the determined one or more authorization requirements associated with the natural language request, determining a category of the natural language request.

title: Semiconductor device, electronic apparatus, and vehicle
abstract: For example, a semiconductor device, comprises: a first drive circuit that drives a first drive signal for a first transistor between a positive supply voltage and a first intermediate voltage that is lower than the positive supply voltage but is higher than a negative supply voltage; and a second drive circuit that generates a second drive signal for a second transistor between a second intermediate voltage that is lower than the positive supply voltage but is higher than the negative supply voltage and the negative supply voltage.

title: Resist underlayer film-forming composition
abstract: A resist underlayer film-forming composition, containing: a compound (A) including a side chain or a terminal having a chain α,β-unsaturated carbonyl group; and a solvent (B).

title: Child safety seat and detachable side impact protection block
abstract: A detachable side impact protection block and a child safety seat provided with same. The detachable side impact protection block comprises a protection block and at least one locking member. The protection block is detachably connected to the child safety seat, and when in a connected state, protrudes from the surface of the connection position; each locking member is arranged between the protection block and the child safety seat, and is used for locking the protection block to the child safety seat, while also allowing for unlocking. The present detachable side impact protection block allows users to selectively install same on the child safety seat according to use requirements, such that child safety seat is adequately safe during use. When not in use, said detachable side impact protection block can be dismounted, such that the child safety seat occupies less lateral space.

title: Method of operating a laundry appliance to perform a cleaning operation of the laundry appliance
abstract: A method of operating a laundry appliance includes performing a cleaning operation. Performing the cleaning operation includes dispensing a quantity of cleaning fluid into a fresh water flow path for mixing with a quantity of water. Additionally, performing the cleaning operation includes operating a valve of the laundry appliance, whereby the quantity of water is supplied into the fresh water flow path and mixed with the dispensed quantity of cleaning fluid within the fresh water flow path to create a mixed fluid, the mixed fluid flowing from the fresh water flow path to the condensate collection tank of the laundry appliance. Furthermore, performing the cleaning operation includes operating a tank pump to pump the mixed fluid from the condensate collection tank.

title: Method and apparatus for determining vehicle traveling trajectory, electronic device and storage medium
abstract: The application relates to a method and apparatus for determining a vehicle traveling trajectory, an electronic device and a storage medium. The method comprises: based on historical traveling trajectory information of at least one vehicle on a target road segment, determining a plurality of historical driving-in trajectory points of a driving-in section of the target road segment, and determining a plurality of historical driving-out trajectory points of a driving-out section of the target road segment (S 1 ); determining a driving-in section intersection point of the target road segment based on the plurality of historical driving-in trajectory points, and determining a driving-out section intersection point of the target road segment based on the plurality of historical driving-out trajectory points (S 2 ); and determining a recommended traveling trajectory of the target road segment based on the driving-in section intersection point and the driving-out section intersection point (S 3 ). In this way, a recommended traveling trajectory can be rationally planned for a target road segment, such that it can both reduce the chances of vehicles being unable to drive into the planned path and ensure the operation stability and speed of vehicle.
assignee: Beijing Horizon Information Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Chamber cleaning for substrate processing systems
abstract: A substrate processing system includes a process chamber, processing stations, and a hub. The processing stations are disposed in the process chamber. Each of the processing stations includes a respective substrate support. The hub is disposed between the processing stations. The hub rotates between a first position and a second position, directs a gas to clean a first area of the process chamber when in the first position, and directs the gas to clean a second area of the process chamber when in the second position.

title: Methods, systems, and computer-readable meidum for contour refinement in adaptive radiotherapy
abstract: A computer-implemented method for refinement of contours in medical images for use in radiotherapy treatment planning, comprises: receiving current contours comprising a current contoured medical image delineating anatomical structures in a subject at a current fraction; receiving previous contours comprising a previous contoured medical image delineating the same anatomical structures in the same subject at a previous fraction; receiving corrected previous contours comprising a corrected version of the previous contours; generating corrected current contours using (i) the current contours, (ii) the previous contours and (iii) the corrected previous contours, the corrected current contours comprising a corrected version of the current contours and modifying a treatment plan using the corrected current contours.

title: Power amplifier stability enhancement at extreme conditions
abstract: A power amplifier comprises a first transistor, a first transformer, a first variable resistor, a first bias circuit and coupling circuitry configured to couple the first transformer, a first end of the first variable resistor, and a collector of the first transistor at a first node, the first transformer and a second end of the first variable resistor at a second node, and the bias circuit and a base of the first transistor at a third node.

title: Assistance system for a vehicle, in particular a commercial vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to an assistance system ( 16 ) configured to be installed in an ego vehicle ( 10 ) and support a driver of the ego vehicle ( 10 ) in avoiding a collision of the ego vehicle ( 10 ) with another vehicle ( 18 ), the assistance system ( 16 ) being configured to monitor an environment ( 40 ) of the ego vehicle ( 10 ) and detect the other vehicle ( 18 ) approaching the ego vehicle ( 10 ). The assistance system ( 16 ) is configured to determine that the driver of the ego vehicle ( 10 ) is about to perform a turning maneuver ( 32 ) of the ego vehicle ( 10 ) towards a driver’s side ( 26 ) of the ego vehicle ( 10 ). The assistance system ( 16 ) is configured to determine the risk of a collision resulting from the turning maneuver ( 32 ), between the ego vehicle ( 10 ) and the other vehicle ( 18 ).

title: Automated Roof Plan Extraction and Dimensioning Using Artificial Intelligence
abstract: A method and system are provided for automated extraction of roof plans, determination of roof dimensions, and generation of solar panel layouts. One implementation processes roof images by detecting line segments using techniques such as LSD or the Hough Transform, and constructing a graph with vertices formed by these segments connected by distance-weighted edges. Refinement steps include filtering out non-structural lines, merging segments, thresholding, and removing redundancies to produce an accurate roof plan. A pre-trained AI segmentation model—with a potential multi-task architecture for predicting lines, points, and segmentation fields—is used to recognize roof contours and obstacles, including oriented objects, with an iterative process ensuring candidate lines correspond to roof vertices.

title: Method for establishing a communication connection between a new vehicle key and a vehicle and system for carrying out the method
abstract: A communication connection between a new vehicle key and a vehicle is established using a key connection process. A training application checks whether 1) a user is in the vehicle and a digital permission to connect the new vehicle key to the vehicle has been provided to the user in a backend application of the learning application, 2) the new vehicle key is in the vehicle, and 3) a vehicle key is in the vehicle. After successful verification of the criteria 1) to 3), the new vehicle key is communicatively connected to the vehicle in a coupling step.

title: Haptic signal interpolation
abstract: Some aspects of the disclosure provide a method of haptic signal interpolation. In some examples, a bit stream including coded information of a haptic signal is received. The haptic signal includes a plurality of haptic events. An interpolation type of a first haptic event component in a first haptic event is determined according to at least an identifier in the coded information of the haptic signal. A signal value interpolation between a first signal value of the first haptic event component and a second signal value of a second haptic event component is performed based on the interpolation type of the first haptic event component, the second haptic event component precedes or follows the first haptic event component. The haptic signal is reconstructed based on at least the signal value interpolation. Apparatus and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium counterpart embodiments are also contemplated.

title: Application programming interface to indicate a technique to perform a wireless cell
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to perform one or more APIs. In at least one embodiment, a processor is to perform an API to indicate a number of 5G-NR cells that are able to be performed concurrently by one or more processors; a processor is to perform an API to indicate whether one or more processors are able to perform a first number of 5G-NR cells concurrently; a processor comprising one or more circuits is to perform an API to indicate whether one or more resources of one or more processors are allocated to perform 5G-NR cells; and/or a processor comprises one or more circuits to perform an API to indicate one or more techniques to be used by one or more processors in performing one or more 5G-NR cells.

title: Lottery ticket vending machine
abstract: A lottery ticket vending machine configured to consistently repeated precisely align its ticket bursters with its ticket collection receptacle of its front door to ensure proper delivery of the lottery tickets from the ticket bursters to the ticket collection receptacle.

title: Driver and electro-optical apparatus
abstract: A driver includes first to n-th capacitors provided between an output terminal and first to n-th capacitor driving nodes, a capacitor driving circuit configured to output first to n-th capacitor driving voltages corresponding to capacitive driving data to the first to n-th capacitor driving nodes, and a control circuit configured to output the capacitive driving data based on gradation data. The control circuit sets the capacitive driving data in a way that an amount of electric charge at a node of the output terminal is changed by an amount of change in electric charge greater than an amount of change in electric charge corresponding to an amount of change in the gradation data in a predetermined period where the gradation data changes.

title: Auxiliary hydraulic port expansion system for excavators
abstract: A diverter valve assembly for a hydraulic system is disclosed that includes a diverter valve that couples a first fluid port to either a second fluid port or a third fluid port depending on a position of the diverter valve. The diverter valve assembly further includes an attachment system for attaching the diverter valve to a machine. The attachment system includes an adapter plate configured to attach to pre-existing mounting holes on a structural member of the machine including a stick without drilling or welding. The diverter valve is mechanically secured to the adapter plate.

title: Extraction of a nicotinic component from a substrate using a base
abstract: The disclosure provides a method of extracting nicotinic components from substrates. The method includes contacting the substrate with a strong base in a solvent to form a mixture; heating the mixture at an elevated temperature to form a vapor containing the nicotinic component; and releasing the vapor containing the nicotinic component, forming a decontaminated substrate.

title: Dishwasher and method for controlling the same
abstract: A dishwasher is capable of improving drying performance of a drying-only course. When performing the drying-only course, the dishwasher partially opens a door, and drives at least one of a regeneration heater or a fan motor to perform at least one of a regeneration cycle or a drying cycle based on whether the drying-only course has been performed in a previous cycle, thereby improving drying performance of the drying-only course.

title: Tube swage process and system with rotatable tube joint
abstract: A connector creates a connection between one or more tubes swaged with a swaging tool and the connector, allowing in-place modifications to allow connection between the tubes and the connector. The swaging tool creates one or more annular bosses in the tubes which engage corresponding annular square cut grooves of the connector with 90 degree square corners to permanently connect one or more tubes. Voids are formed between parts of a surface of the first annular boss and parts of a surface of the first annular square cut groove. The tubes are rotatable about the connector, and the connector can be rotatable about the tubes. Optional through-holes in the connector allow wiring, fluids, or other materials to pass through and be protected by the swage tube assembly. Multiple clamping, threaded and pivoting connection variants are possible.

title: Method and device for correcting multi-resource leak to ensure control flow of software
abstract: Disclosed is a method for correcting a multi-resource leak. The method for correcting a multi-resource leak includes: an information extraction step of extracting a source code and a resource leak from a dataset and extracting a method including the resource leak; a control flow identification step of identifying a control flow of an original code by classifying resource blocks related to resources in the method; a hierarchical structure identification step of identifying a hierarchical structure of the resources included in the resource blocks; and a resource leak correction step of correcting the resource leak through an artificial intelligence algorithm by using the source code and the hierarchical structure of the resources as input data.

title: Systems and methods for displaying intraoperative image data
abstract: An exemplary method of displaying an intraoperative image of a surgical site includes: receiving a plurality of images captured by a plurality of cameras, wherein the plurality of images capture the surgical site from a plurality of different perspectives; inputting an image of the plurality of images into a trained machine-learning model to determine if the image includes an obstruction to the surgical site; in accordance with a determination that the image includes the obstruction, generating, based on the plurality of images, a synthetic image that captures the surgical site from a synthetic perspective different from the plurality of different perspectives, wherein the synthetic image excludes the obstruction; and displaying the synthetic image as the intraoperative image of the surgical site.

title: Laser emitter assembly and method for providing an output laser beam at an output of a laser emitter assembly
abstract: A laser emitter assembly for providing an output laser beam at an output of the laser emitter assembly is provided. The laser emitter assembly includes a plurality of laser emitter devices, and an optical device positioned between the output and the plurality of laser emitter devices. Each laser emitter device is configured to generate a respective laser beam that propagates in a respective propagation direction. The laser beams pass through the optical device for changing the propagation directions, The output laser beam is formed from the laser beams of the plurality of laser emitter devices.

title: Lidar with adaptive laser point density
abstract: A LIDAR may be configured to scan a field of view (FOV) with non-uniform density, based on previous scans of the FOV. However reconfiguring a LIDAR during an ongoing scan of a FOV to perform a dense scan of an object, poses additional challenges (e.g. completing the scan of the whole FOV within the original timeframe). Within embodiments, a LIDAR that is originally configured to scan a FOV can be reconfigured during the scan, in response to detecting an object, to thereby investigate the object with a higher than initially planned density of laser pulses. In order to complete the scan of the FOV in a target time the LIDAR may be reconfigured a second time to scan a remaining portion of the FOV with a lower than initially planned density.

title: Time-Based Message Actions
abstract: One or more computing devices and/or methods for time-based message actions are provided. Time-based message action rules are defined for a message account. A time-based action rule specifics that an action is to be performed upon messages, having a message type, after expiration of a timespan. Message content of a message is analyzed to determine a detected message type of the message. In response to the detected message type of the message matching the message type of the message action rule, a determination is made as to whether the timespan as expired for the message. If the timespan has expired, then the action is performed for the message.

title: Device for imaging and electrochemical sensing
abstract: The disclosure is directed to a device comprising: a piezoelectric resonator; and a micro or nano-sized reservoir coupled to at least a portion of the piezoelectric resonator and having a predetermined length and comprising a body having a predetermined volume and extending into a tip, wherein the tip defines a distal portion of the reservoir and has a predetermined aperture diameter, wherein the predetermined length is measured from a coupling point to the piezoelectric resonator, wherein the body of the micro or nano-sized reservoir comprises: (a) a first electrode; and (b) an electrolyte solution configured to at least partially disperse as a droplet from the tip on a surface of a substrate; wherein the predetermined length is selected to provide a Q-factor of the piezoelectric resonator of 500 Hz to 10 KHz.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The University Of Alabama

title: System and method for monetizing protected digital content
abstract: A computer-implemented platform, system, and method for monetizing protected digital content and tokenized data includes a database that associates a plurality of digital fingerprints with a plurality of protected content items and corresponding tokens, each of the tokens associated with a smart contract stored on a distributed ledger. A media input is received and automatically analyzed using one or more machine learning models trained to recognize the digital fingerprints to detect a protected content item. The smart contract corresponding to the detected protected content item is identified, utilization is verified based on license utilization events recorded in the distributed ledger, a new license utilization event is recorded, a license fee is collected, and compensation is electronically distributed to a user according to terms of the smart contract. The platform may also mint authenticated nonfungible tokens using embedded inaudible tones and may tokenize user investment information for targeted advertising.

title: Pressure Injury Relief System
abstract: The present invention relates to a system to reduce pressure-induced skin and soft tissue injury to patients, and more particularly to a system of lightweight, packable support pad or pads to alleviate contact pressure, friction, temperature, and moisture.
assignee: Ashish Purekar; Pablo Sztein; Gregory Hiemenz; Amit N. Shah

title: Multi-modal neural networks with decoder-only language models
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for training a multi-modal neural network using contrastive and image captioning losses.

title: Box fan surface-mount device
abstract: A box fan surface-mount device is provided. The device is comprised of a frame assembly that securely holds a box fan on various surfaces, including walls, ceilings, and corners. The frame assembly comprises at least two frame members connected by a horizontal frame arm, allowing adjustable width in a telescopic embodiment. Each frame member comprises vertical and horizontal members and further includes a cradle assembly with telescopic angled members that adjust to different fan depths and feature fasteners such as clips or magnets for retention. The cradle assemblies attach to the frame members via pivot points, enabling fan orientation adjustment, and may include locking mechanisms for stability. The device is also comprised of a mounting structure for secure attachment to surfaces using fasteners.

title: Charger, charging method, and program
abstract: A charger is used in an electric tool. The charger charges an assembled battery, including an all-solid-state battery, with electricity. The charger includes a charging unit. The charging unit charges the assembled battery by constant current charging until a voltage value of the assembled battery during charging reaches a predetermined voltage value which is larger than a voltage value of the assembled battery in a fully charged state.

title: Operation robot
abstract: An operation robot includes a work implement and a mobile robot. The mobile robot includes a vehicle body, a support, and a drive assembly. The support is pivotally mounted to the vehicle body to allow pitching rotation, and the work implement is detachably mounted to the support. The drive assembly is mounted within the vehicle body and operatively coupled to the support through a linkage assembly. The drive assembly is configured to drive rotation of the support to cause the work implement to perform a pitching motion relative to the mobile robot.

title: Systems and methods for creating and presenting relationships within information technology data
abstract: In one aspect, a computing system including a processor in communication with at least one memory may be provided. The processor may be configured to: (i) connect to a plurality of data sources in a nodal network including a plurality of nodes; (ii) determine, for each node of the plurality of nodes, a relationship to at least one other node of the plurality of nodes; (iii) generate, based upon the determined relationships between nodes, a mapping including each node of the plurality of nodes and each relationship of the determined relationships; (iv) analyze each relationship of the determined relationships to determine at least one threat; (v) determine at least one solution for the at least one threat; and/or (vi) cause display of the at least one threat and the at least one solution.
assignee: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company

title: Polishing additive and polishing composition containing same
abstract:
The polishing additive includes at least one compound selected from polyether-based amine compounds represented by Formula (1) and Formula (2). 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     (In Formula (1), AO represents an oxyalkylene group having 2 to 4 carbon atoms, m represents an average number of moles of the oxyalkylene group added and is a number from 1 to 60, n is a number from 1 to 4, and Rs each independently represent a hydrogen atom or a hydrocarbon group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms.) 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     (In Formula (2), AO represents an oxyalkylene group having 2 to 4 carbon atoms, m represents an average number of moles of the oxyalkylene group added and is a number from 1 to 60, and Rs each independently represent a hydrogen atom or a hydrocarbon group having 1 to 4 carbon atoms.)

title: Electrophotographic member, transfer device, charging device, and image forming apparatus
abstract: An electrophotographic member includes a surface layer that contains a binding material and polysiloxane compound particles, in which a content of the polysiloxane compound particles in the surface layer is 100 parts by mass or more and 250 parts by mass or less with respect to 100 parts by mass of the binding material, and an exposure rate of the polysiloxane compound particles in the surface layer is 30% or more and 75% or less.

title: Using embeddings to obfuscate private data in resource assignments
abstract: Systems and methods for generating user recommendations based on restricted and accessible parameter sets are described herein. The system may transmit a request for a first parameter set. The system may cause a first plurality of embeddings to be generated using an embedding model based on the first parameter set. The system may retrieve a second parameter set. The system may provide the second parameter set to a duplicate embedding model for generating a second plurality of embeddings. The system may generate one or more parameter sets. The system may generate one or more indications corresponding to one or more resources associated with the one or more parameter sets.

title: Fluorescence microscope
abstract: To suppress an increase in size of a housing even when the number of filter cubes is increased. A fluorescence microscope includes: an optical module that is disposed on an optical path of excitation light emitted from an illumination module, collects the excitation light emitted from the illumination module, guides the excitation light to an observation target, and collects fluorescence generated in the observation target; a Z-plate that is connected to the optical module and includes a protrusion extending rearward of the optical module; and a Z-drive module that is connected to the protrusion of the Z-plate and moves the optical module in a Z direction.

title: Selective playback of audio at normal speed during trick play operations
abstract: Systems and methods are described herein for selective playback of portions of audio at normal speed during a fast-forward operation. Upon receiving a command to perform a fast-forward operation, a current playback position is identified, as well as a plurality of portions of audio of the content item that will be subject to the fast-forward operation. A subset of the audio portions that will be subject to the fast-forward operation are selected. The fast-forward operation is initiated, and video of the content item is played back at the increased speed while the selected portions of audio of the content item are played back at normal speed.

title: Network packet processing apparatus with multi-core parallel processing capability and packet order preservation capability and related network packet processing method
abstract: A network packet processing apparatus includes a receive (RX) ring buffer, a transmit (TX) ring buffer, a plurality of queues, a plurality of first processor cores, and a second processor core. The first processor cores read a plurality of groups of RX packet descriptors in turn according to a polling order, and perform parallel processing upon a plurality of groups of packets. Each first processor core generates at least one TX packet descriptor and at least one queue element for a group of packets, and pushes the at least one queue element into a corresponding queue, where the at least one queue element has an end flag asserted therein. The second processor core reads the queues in turn according to the polling order. When reading the end flag, the second processor core switches to read a next queue according to the polling order.

title: Seat belt device
abstract: A seat belt device includes a seat belt, a tongue, a buckle, and an adapter. The tongue is attached to the seat belt such that the tongue is slidable in a longitudinal direction. The tongue is configured to be attached to and detached from the buckle. The adapter is attached to the tongue and is made of a flexible material having a larger friction coefficient than a material of the seat belt. The adapter is disposed to extend from the tongue along an inner surface of the seat belt. The adapter is configured such that, in a state in which the tongue is attached to the buckle, the adapter is disposed between the seat belt and an ilium of an occupant.

title: A Non-Adherent Absorbent Article
abstract: The present invention relates to a non-adherent, absorbent article with an optimum moisture vapor transmission rate (MVTR) that may be used as wound dressing or as an anti-adhesive membrane in surgical devices. The present invention further relates to an article comprising of a polymer deposited/coated on to a woven and/or non-woven mesh and to the process of fabrication thereof.

title: Neural Network-Based Generation and Placement of Tooth Restoration Dental Appliances
abstract: Techniques are described for automating the design of dental restoration appliances using neural networks. An example computing device receives transform information associated with a current dental anatomy of a dental restoration patient, provides the transform information associated with the current dental anatomy of the dental restoration patient as input to a neural network trained with transform information indicating placement of a dental appliance component with respect to one or more teeth of corresponding dental anatomies, the dental appliance being used for dental restoration treatment for the one or more teeth, and executes the neural network using the input to produce placement information for the dental appliance component with respect to the current dental anatomy of the dental restoration patient.

title: Independent configuration adjustment for network infrastructure management
abstract: A method for managing real network infrastructure. The method includes adjusting a configuration parameter for the application to a new value using a machine learning model based on the application-related values obtained during that period. It also involves predicting a new value and determining whether the resource-related metric for the second period meets a set of criteria based on the new value.

title: Electronic game gift purchase, delivery, and return systems and methods for gaming environments
abstract: Electronic game gift purchase, delivery, and return systems and methods for gaming environments. In various embodiments, the systems and methods enable a gift buyer to buy an electronic game gift, cause the electronic game gift to be sent to a gift receiver, enable the gift receiver to receive and use electronic game gift, and if the gift receiver is unable to receive or use the electronic game gift, return the electronic game gift or the purchase price thereof to the gift buyer.

title: Robot system, method for controlling robot system, method for manufacturing product using robot system, control program, and recording medium
abstract: A robot system includes a robot body, at least two first control devices provided in the robot body, a second control device that communicates with the first control devices, and first and second communication media each enabling the first control devices to communicate with the second control device. The second control device selectively operates in one of a first mode and a second mode. In the first mode, the second control device transmits information to a subset of the first control devices not using the second communication medium and using the first communication medium, and the second control device transmits information to the other first control devices not using the first communication medium and using the second communication medium, and in the second mode, the second control device transmits information to all the first control devices using both the first communication medium and second communication medium.

title: Machine direction oriented polyethylene films for labels and related methods
abstract: Machine direction oriented polyethylene films may be useful as the face stock material of labels. A nonlimiting oriented film may include: a first layer comprising a long chain branched metallocene linear low density polyethylene (LCB-mLLDPE); a second layer comprising a high density polyethylene; a third layer comprising 0 wt % to about 90 wt % of a metallocene linear low densitypoly-ethylene (mLLDPE) and about 10 wt % to 100 wt % of an ethylene-based elastomer and/or a propylene-based elastomer, wherein the third layer does not form a surface of the oriented film; wherein the oriented film has a polyethylene content of about 90 wt % or greater; and wherein the oriented film has a uniaxial, machine orientation.

title: Sleeve for an endoluminal device having an aperture for portal access of an implantable device
abstract: An endoluminal device includes an implantable device transitionable between a collapsed, delivery configuration, an expanded, deployed configuration, and a partially deployed configuration, and a constraining sleeve removably disposed around the implantable device in the collapsed, delivery configuration. The implantable device has an intermediate portion with at least one opening in the sidewall providing access to an inner lumen of the implantable device. The constraining sleeve has an aperture aligning with the at least one opening such that the aperture provides access from an exterior to the inner lumen in the partially deployed configuration.

title: Code generation based on variable attributes
abstract: In various examples, a compiled code for execution of instructions on a host device including a graphics processing unit (GPU) and/or a central processing unit (GPU) is generated from a higher-level or intermediate representation. The code generation system can iteratively process functions of the input instructions by selecting an appropriate code generation function and selecting an appropriate variant of the code generation function. The variant of the code generation function can be selected based on a value of an attribute for a variable input to the function. A visitor configuration is used to cause the appropriate variant to be selected. By propagating values for a binding attribute of variables, statically defined code can be eliminated from the compiled output. In addition, memory allocation and layout can be optimized by propagating values for minimum, maximum, and/or divisibility attributes.

title: Information processing apparatus and control method
abstract: The present application is to maintain performance related to the execution of a specific application as needed. A host system operates using any one-stage power mode among multi-stage power modes different in power consumption in such a manner that, when executing processing of a specific application as a predetermined specific application program, the host system measures a processing speed of the specific application, and when the processing speed is lower than a predetermined reference speed, the host system upgrades an operating mode as a power mode used for the operation to a power mode higher in power consumption.

title: Image forming apparatus and image forming method
abstract: An image forming apparatus includes a first image forming unit that forms a first toner image by using a toner having a first fluorescent color, a second image forming unit that forms a second toner image by using a toner having a second fluorescent color, and a transfer unit that transfers the first toner image to a recording medium by superimposing the first toner image on the second toner image such that the first toner image is located above the second toner image on the recording medium, in which a photoluminescent intensity in a case where the toner image formed by using only the toner having the second fluorescent color is irradiated with ultraviolet rays having a wavelength of 365 nm is higher than a photoluminescent intensity in a case where the toner image formed by using only the toner having the first fluorescent color is irradiated with ultraviolet rays having a wavelength of 365 nm.

title: Self-retracting lifeline device with integrated ratchet mechanism powered by a current generator
abstract: A self-retracting lifeline (SRL) device is provided. For example, an SRL device comprises a housing, a rotatable axle, a lifeline wound around the axle such that extending the lifeline rotates the axle in a first rotational direction, a coil spring wound around the axle to provide a rotational biasing force to the axle in a second rotational direction opposite the first rotational direction such that the axle provides a retraction force to the lifeline, an electrical generator attached to the axle to generate electricity when the axle rotates, a ratchet wheel attached to the axle such that the ratchet wheel rotates when the axle rotates, a pawl having a pivoting proximal end, and an electrically activated actuator connected to a distal end of the pawl to pivot the pawl from a disengaged position to an engaged position when the generated electricity is above a threshold.

title: Immersion nozzle
abstract: An immersion nozzle that is applicable to an immersion nozzle replacement apparatus satisfies both the suppression of occurrence of cracks in a neck portion thereof and the suppression of occurrence of sinking thereof. The immersion nozzle includes a bridging member bridging an inner peripheral surface of a metal case surrounding a flange portion and an outer peripheral surface of a nozzle body. The bridging member has one end fixed to the metal case and the other end engaged with a recess provided in the outer peripheral surface of the nozzle body. Further, in an area above an action point of an upward support force by a support device of the immersion nozzle replacement apparatus, the outer peripheral surface of the nozzle body is formed to have a shape extending in a vertical direction without dimensional change with respect to a central axis of an inner bore, except for the recess.

title: Collective communication processing method and apparatus, computer device, and storage medium
abstract: A collective communication processing method includes obtaining a node orchestration request for a target collective operation in collective communication, the node orchestration request carrying an original node list, and the original node list comprising server nodes selected to perform the target collective operation; obtaining topology information of the server nodes, the topology information describing switching nodes connected to the server nodes at various levels in a node communication network, and the server nodes communicating with each other based on the switching nodes connected at the levels in the node communication network; performing an orchestration update on a sequence of the server nodes based on the topology information and levels in the node communication network, to obtain an orchestration node list; and performing collective communication for the target collective operation using the server nodes based on the sequence of the server nodes in the orchestration node list.

title: Video data transmission method and device, storage medium, and system
abstract: A video data transmission method and device, a storage medium, and a system are provided. The method comprises: in response to establishing a communication connection with a server end, a client sends to the server end an obtaining request for obtaining a key frame, to enable the server end to encodes a current to-be-transmitted video image into a first key frame; the client receives the first key frame fed back by the server, and decodes the first key frame according to first decoding information included in the first key frame to display a decoded video image.
assignee: Cloud Intelligence Assets Holding (Singapore) Private Limited

title: Multilayer electronic component and board having the same mounted thereon
abstract: A multilayer electronic component includes a body, an external electrode, and a connection terminal. The body includes a dielectric layer and internal electrodes alternately disposed with the dielectric layer interposed therebetween in a thickness direction. The external electrode is disposed in a length direction of the body. The connection terminal is disposed on one surface of the external electrode and includes a recess portion in a region recessed on the outside thereof in the length direction. A maximum length of the recess portion in the length direction is 100 μm or more.

title: Bis-pyridinium compounds, materials including such, and uses thereof such as in corrosion resistance
abstract: Provided are bis-pyridinium compounds, in which the two pyridinium groups are connected by a spacer through functionalized groups containing oxygen, nitrogen, and/or sulfur. Also provided are materials and formulations including such bis-pyridinium compounds. Also provided are corrosion-resistant substrates and films including such bis-pyridinium compounds. Also provided are processes for inhibiting corrosion of a metallic surface using the formulations and processes of acidizing a subsurface formation using the bis-pyridinium compounds.

title: Machine learning system, server device, client device, machine learning method, and computer readable medium
abstract: A machine learning system ( 500 ) includes a client device ( 200 ) that has its own unique learning data and a server device ( 100 ) that has training data. Each of the client device ( 200 ) and the server device ( 100 ) has an AI model. Further, the machine learning system ( 500 ) proceeds with learning while keeping the learning data of the client device ( 200 ) and the training data of the server device ( 100 ) private to each other. The server device ( 100 ) includes a fraudulent client detection unit ( 2530 ) to estimate a fraudulent client device that performs an attack to disrupts the learning of the AI model in the server device ( 100 ).

title: Automated error analysis within isolated network
abstract: The present disclosure involves methods, apparatus, and systems for automated failure analysis of software in an isolated environment. This can include identifying, from an error log, a set of errors generated during code execution in an isolated computing environment; parsing the set of errors to categorize each particular error into a first category of errors or a second category of errors; and for each error in the second category of errors: generating a summary of the error; identifying a portion of code causing the error; removing sensitive information from the portion of code to create masked portion of error code; and sending a message to an external system outside the isolated computing environment, the message comprising the summary and the masked portion of error code.

title: Enhancement for block adaptive weighted prediction
abstract: This disclosure relates generally to video coding/decoding and particularly for enhancing block adaptive weighted prediction. One method includes receiving a coded video bitstream comprising a current block of a current frame and a first syntax element indicating a prediction mode for the current block, a plurality of scaling factor look-up tables being stored and comprising different ranges of scaling factors, wherein step sizes of the scaling factors or precisions of the scaling factors for each look-up table in the plurality of scaling factor look-up tables are same; determining the prediction mode based on a value of the first syntax element, wherein the prediction mode is used for predicting the current block based on a reference block of a reference frame; determining a scaling factor from one of the plurality of scaling factor look-up tables; and reconstructing the current block based on the reference block and the determined scaling factor.

title: Image sensor system
abstract: An image sensor system is disclosed. The image sensor system includes a housing assembly defining a cavity between a first edge and a second edge of the housing assembly. A printed circuit board is received within the cavity. The printed circuit board assembly has a first peripheral edge and a second peripheral edge. An adhesive material is disposed, i.e., dispensed, between the first peripheral edge and the first edge of the housing assembly and between the second peripheral edge and the second edge of the housing assembly.

title: Microscopic imaging method and application
abstract: The present application relates to the field of sequencing, and specifically relates to a method for adjusting a first optical parameter during sequencing and an application thereof. The present application discloses an adaptive optical adjustment method, which involves imaging a small region on a chip, estimating the sequencing brightness, and adjusting the laser power or exposure time to ensure that the base brightness falls within the range meeting the base calling requirements. This helps the sequencer stabilize sequencing signals despite performance fluctuations in the chip, a laser, a reagent, or an optical system.

title: Track bar bushing system for vehicle wobble mitigation
abstract: The invention encompasses a track bar bushing system for vehicles, specifically designed to mitigate undesired movement or misalignment in both new and older vehicle models. The core component is a bushing material boasting a hardness range of 80-90 D Shore durometer. This bushing system includes an encapsulated multi-piece design comprising a casing of stainless steel halves, providing both corrosion resistance and robust support to all bushing surfaces.

title: Massager
abstract: A massager includes a housing, an extensible member disposed within the housing, a driving mechanism operatively connected to the extensible member, and at least two swinging members connected to the extensible member. The driving mechanism is disposed within the housing and is configured to drive the extensible member to reciprocate along a lengthwise direction thereof. The swinging members extend outwardly from the housing. When the extensible member reciprocates along the lengthwise direction, the extensible member drives the swinging members to swing reciprocally.
assignee: Dongguan Qunan Technology Co., Ltd.; Shenzhen Zhonghongtian Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Multicontext unique identifier regeneration
abstract: Regenerable items serve as identifiers or keys or both. A regenerable items tuple is generated by combining context-specific identifiers into a string, hashing the string, and designating individual hash portions as respective regenerable items. Regenerable items maintain artifact tracking continuity after a reinstall, a reboot, or another intervening event without retrieval of a previously generated value from a registry or state file. Some regenerable items conform to a universally unique identifier specification. Some regenerable items are free of reliance on nondeterministic content, and some are free of reliance on time-dependent content.

title: Carbon dioxide extraction using diffusion
abstract: An apparatus for extracting carbon dioxide including a panel structure having a thermal gradient between a first side and a second side, and a porous wicking material soaked in an aqueous amine solution disposed within the panel structure between the first side and the second side is provided. The porous wicking material is configured to absorb a low concentration of carbon dioxide gas at the first side and desorb a high concentration of carbon dioxide gas at the second side. An associated method is also provided.

title: Audience monitoring systems and related methods
abstract: Audience monitoring systems and related methods are described herein. An example audience monitoring system includes a beacon to be disposed proximate a media presentation device. The beacon is to transmit a ping signal. The system also includes a portable metering device to be carried by a person. The portable metering device includes a microphone to receive an audio signal and a processor to determine a distance value indicative of a distance between the portable metering device and the beacon based on the ping signal.

title: Cleaning devices and operations for downhole separation in a well
abstract: A separation system to be positioned in a subsurface formation that includes a multi-bore well, to separate formation fluid into production and nonproduction fluid. The system comprises at least one filtering device to be positioned in an opening of a downhole tubular; a controller to initiate an operation to clean the filtering device; and fluid pumps to pump the production fluid and nonproduction fluid toward the surface, and disposal, respectively. A method comprises separating the formation fluid; filtering at least a portion of solids included in the formation fluid, production fluid, or nonproduction fluid; cleaning the filtering device in response to measuring a parameter value that indicates the filtering device needs cleaning; and pumping the production fluid for delivery to a surface of the multi-bore well, and the nonproduction fluid into a second bore of the multi-bore well for disposal.

title: Supplemental enhancement message (sei) processing for video coding
abstract: An example device for decoding video data includes a memory to store video data and a processing system implemented in circuitry and to determine a value for a first syntax element of a supplemental enhancement information (SEI) processing order (SPO) SEI message of a video bitstream, the first syntax element indicating whether an SEI message of the video bitstream is included in a processing order nesting (PON) SEI message of the video bitstream; and when the value for the first syntax elements indicates that the SEI message is not included in the PON SEI message, determine that the SPO SEI message includes a value for a second syntax element, the second syntax element indicating whether a third syntax element is included for the SEI message in the SPO SEI message, the third syntax element indicating a number of prefix bits included for the SEI message in the SPO SEI message.

title: Interpreting Mold Test Results for HVAC Filters
abstract: Interpreting mold test results for HVAC filters is described. In one or more implementations, results of one or more laboratory mold tests are received as conducted on a heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) filter previously installed in an HVAC system of a structure. Changes in ambient pressure are detected by a pressure sensor within an indoor environment of the structure during an installation period of the HVAC filter. The changes are indicative of activation of the HVAC system. Air volume processed by the HVAC filter during the installation period is estimated based on durations of the changes in the ambient pressure. A machine learning model is prompted to generate a mold risk assessment by interpreting the results based on the air volume, and at least a portion of the mold risk assessment is communicated to a client device for output in a user interface.

title: Biometric authentication using a smart ring
abstract: A method can include collecting, by one or more sensors, biometric data of a user. The method also can include performing, by one or more processors, an authentication operation which can include determining whether the biometric data of the user matches a biometric signature for a known user. The authentication operation further can include authenticating the user by updating a record to indicate that the user has been identified and authenticated as the known user. The method also can include performing operations by the one or more processors. The operations can include generating a private key from a seed valued stored in a profile of the known user. The operations further can include digitally signing transaction data using the private key. The operations also can include providing the known user with access to a source of information while the known user is wearing the housing. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title: Fluid routing plug
abstract: A fluid routing plug for use with a fluid end section. The fluid end section being one of a plurality of fluid end sections making up a fluid end side of a high pressure pump. The fluid routing plug is installed within a horizontal bore formed in a fluid end section and is configured to route fluid between an intake and discharge bore. The fluid routing plug comprises a plurality of first and second fluid passages. The first and second passages do not intersect and are offset from one another. The first fluid passages are configured to direct fluid delivered to the horizontal bore from intake bores towards a reciprocating plunger. The second fluid passages are configured to direct fluid pressurized by the plunger towards a discharge bore.

title: Bus duct for direct current power branching and direct current power bus duct system comprising same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a bus duct for direct current power branching and a bus duct system comprising the same, which can minimize arcs and safety hazard that may occur in a process of installation and removal of a branch box in the bus duct for direct current power branching.

title: Cooling fluid control system and methods of operating a cooling fluid system for a turbine engine
abstract: A cooling fluid control system for a turbine engine having one or more fuel nozzles. The cooling fluid control system includes a cooling fluid system and a controller. The cooling fluid system is in fluid communication with the one or more fuel nozzles for supplying a cooling fluid to the one or more fuel nozzles. The controller controls the cooling fluid system to supply the cooling fluid through the one or more fuel nozzles when the turbine engine is shut down. In one aspect, the controller controls the cooling fluid system to supply the cooling fluid through the one or more fuel nozzles when a fuel nozzle temperature of the one or more fuel nozzles is greater than a fuel nozzle temperature threshold during at least one of a mid-level power operation or a low power operation of the turbine engine.

title: Generating Models Of Data Center Fabrics
abstract: A system instantiates a fabric model entity that includes a data structure representing a model of a fabric. The fabric model entity includes a first group entity representing a first set of device model entities corresponding to a first portion of the model and a second group entity representing a second set of device model entities corresponding to a second portion of the model. The system selects a linking rule that defines one or more criteria for linking the first set of device model entities of the first group entity to the second set of device model entities of the second group entity. Based on the linking rule, the system instantiates, in the model, a linking entity that defines a set of links between the first set of device model entities of the first group entity and the second set of device model entities of the second group entity.

title: Method and system for estimating an angular rate sensor bias
abstract: A gyroscope calibration system and method for estimating an angular rate sensor bias of a gyroscope sensor. The system includes: a filter unit which filters received gyroscope raw data to ascertain an estimated angular rate signal; a motion detection unit designed to calculate a moving average of a time derivative of the angular rate signal obtained from the filter unit and to identify a type of motion on the basis of the calculated moving average; an assignment unit designed to provide calibration parameters depending on the type of motion identified by the motion detection unit; and a calibration unit designed to estimate the angular rate sensor bias of the gyroscope sensor based on the calibration parameters assigned by the assignment unit to the calibration unit.

title: Immunogenic trimers
abstract: The invention relates to PGT121-germline-targeting designs, trimer stabilization designs, combinations of those two, trimers designed with modified surfaces helpful for immunization regimens, other trimer modifications and on development of trimer nanoparticles and methods of making and using the same.
assignee: International Aids Vaccine Initiative, Inc.; The Scripps Research Institute

title: Improving microbial activity
abstract: The invention is concerned with microorganisms, materials and methods for improving microbial activity. In particular, the invention provides methods for preparing microorganisms to improve metabolic activity and/or alignment, metabolically activated and/or aligned microorganisms, and methods of using them, in particular in industrial fermentation processes.

title: Disordered Bi-Element Substitution for Cathode Materials
abstract:
A cathode material for an electrochemical cell has a cation disordered composition comprising a spinel crystal structure and a formula:
