title: Motor
abstract: A motor includes a shaft, a yoke including a tube, a stator surrounded by the yoke, a bearing supporting the shaft, and a base holding the bearing. The base is accommodated in the tube of the yoke.

title: Skin archaea preparation
abstract: A preparation comprising skin-specific ammonia-oxidizing archaea (sAOA) of the phylum Thermoproteota and genus  Nitrosocosmicus , which comprise at least one of the ssp strains R2S, T1S, X2B, or Z3A, which are each characterized by a unique amoA sequence.

title: A Clamping Device, Detensioning System And a Method Thereof For Clamping An Object Such As Structural Elements Or Tensioning Elements
abstract: Present invention relates to a clamping device, a detensioning system and their methods thereof for clamping an object, wherein the clamping device ( 100 ) comprises a body ( 20 ) and a stressing means ( 40 ); wherein the body ( 20 ) of the clamping device ( 100 ) comprises at least two wedge-like elements ( 22 ), and structural support elements such as backing elements ( 21 ) and/or closing plates ( 23 ) for supporting the at least two wedge-like elements ( 22 ), wherein the wedge-like elements ( 22 ) are housed at least partially within the body ( 20 ), arranged next to each other for forming a cavity with an opening for receiving an object ( 50 ) to be clamped, wherein the wedge-like elements ( 22 ) are movable by the stressing means ( 40 ) in at least one degree of freedom relative to each other; wherein the stressing means ( 40 ) is either mounted directly on the clamping device ( 100 ), or on a stressing chair which in turn is bearing against the body ( 20 ) in order to exert a force to the clamping device ( 100 ) such that the resulting movement of the wedge-like elements ( 22 ) against the surface of the object ( 50 ) to be clamped induces a clamping force.

title: Brewing and cooling a beverage
abstract: Some machines for brewing and then cooling a single serving of a beverage include a housing and a receptacle configured to receive a pod containing ingredients for producing the single serving of beverage. The machines include an economizer having a plurality of flow channels configured to transfer heat from the beverage to water as the beverage and the water flow through respective channels in opposite directions to assist in heating the water and cooling the beverage. The machines include an evaporator having a plurality of flow channels configured to transfer heat from (i) the beverage after being at least partially cooled by the economizer (ii) to a refrigerant as the beverage and the refrigerant flow through respective channels in the same direction or opposite directions to further cool the beverage. The machines include a dispenser configured to dispense the cooled beverage from the machine after the beverage has been cooled by the economizer and the evaporator.

title: Flow Restriction Devices, Methods, and Systems
abstract: A flow restrictor includes a flexible tube held in a housing and a linear actuator connected through an intermediate link to a distal link via a first revolute joint proximate the linear actuator and a second revolute joint connecting the intermediate and distal links. The distal link has a distal end adjacent the flexible tube and the intermediate and distal links are constrained to move such that when the linear actuator moves the first revolute joint toward the linear actuator, the distal end of the distal link is driven into the side of the tube thereby progressively occluding the flexible tube.

title: Memory system, decoding circuit and method
abstract: According to an embodiment, a memory controller performs, for each of a plurality of first sections obtained by dividing a first symbol string in units of a first length, a first conversion operation of converting an arrangement order of symbols in one first section with a conversion pattern corresponding to a position of one first section in the first symbol string. The memory controller performs, for each of the plurality of first sections after the first conversion operation, a second conversion operation of converting an arrangement order of symbols in one first section with a conversion pattern common to the plurality of first sections. The memory controller performs decoding using parity on the plurality of first sections after the second conversion operation.

title: Fusion proteins comprising truncated forms of iga protease and uses thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a truncated form of IgA protease, a fusion protein comprising a truncated form of IgA protease (e.g., a fusion protein comprising a truncated form of IgA protease and Fc) and uses thereof in treating diseases associated with IgA deposition (e.g., IgA nephropathy).
assignee: Peking University First Hospital; Shanghai Alezyme Pharmaceuticals Ltd.

title: Methods of forming cover lens structures for display devices, and related apparatus and devices
abstract: Implementations of the present disclosure relate to methods, and related apparatus and devices, of forming flexible cover lens structures for flexible or foldable display devices. In one or more implementations, one or more adhesion promotion layers are deposited above at least one wet hardcoat layer of a substrate structure. A dry hardcoat layer is deposited above the one or more adhesion promotion layers using a dry deposition process that includes plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD). An anti-smudge layer is deposited above the dry hardcoat layer. Each of the one or more adhesion promotion layers, the dry hardcoat layer, and the anti-smudge layer is deposited at a process temperature that is less than 80 degrees Celsius.

title: Unloading assembly
abstract: According to one aspect of the present invention, there is provided an unloading assembly for unloading a tray, comprising: a main body unit having a left side and a right side on each of which a first guide groove is formed, and a bottom side removably attached to a predetermined position; a support unit having a support member formed in an inward direction of the main body unit to support a tray, and configured to perform a primary linear motion along the first guide groove in a frontward direction of the main body unit, wherein a second guide groove is formed along at least a part of the support member; and a push unit configured to perform a secondary linear motion along the second guide groove in the frontward direction of the main body unit to cause the tray to be unloaded onto a target structure.

title: Communication method, apparatus, and readable storage medium
abstract: A communication method is performed by a terminal, and includes: sending first information, wherein the first information is configured to indicate whether the terminal supports a first capability, and the first capability is a capability of performing a positioning measurement on a plurality of carriers while performing communication with a network device on a plurality of carriers.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Recognition-Based Database Search Algorithm (RDSA): Accelerated Query Optimization and Data Retrieval Using Recognition Coverage Functions
abstract: A recognition-based database search algorithm accelerates database queries and optimizes data retrieval by applying a bounded recognition coverage function with a fixed constant across query analysis, data-structure sizing, plan selection, and resource allocation. A query is received and parsed to derive nonnegative query feature magnitudes, and a complexity score is computed by applying the coverage function to the magnitudes. One or more database access structures are configured using recognition-based parameters, including a tree index node capacity, a hash-table bucket count and key mapping, and a probabilistic membership filter size and hash count. Candidate execution plans are scored using a coverage-weighted combination of inverse cost and resource feasibility, and a selected plan is executed using recognition-weighted resource allocations among concurrent tasks. Runtime telemetry can trigger adaptation of sizing, partitioning, and scheduling without changing the fixed constant. The techniques are applicable to relational, NoSQL, in-memory, time-series, and distributed database systems.

title: Method for forming semiconductor structure
abstract: Semiconductor structures and methods for manufacturing the same are provided. The method includes forming a first stack structure over a substrate. The method includes forming an isolation structure surrounding the first stack structure, and forming a dummy gate structure over the first stack structure. The method includes removing a portion of the first stack structure to form an S/D recess, and forming an S/D structure in the S/D recess. The method includes removing the first semiconductor material layers to form nanostructures, and replacing the dummy gate structure with a gate structure. The method includes removing the substrate to expose a bottommost gate dielectric layer, and removing a portion of the bottommost gate dielectric layer to form a recess, wherein a sidewall surface of the gate electrode is exposed. The method includes forming a first layer in the recess, wherein the first layer covers the gate electrode.

title: Mixture, polymer, dental polymer for 3d printing and medical product thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a mixture, for 3D printing, particularly a resin for 3D printing comprising—a monomer, oligomer or polymer, or a mixture thereof, comprising at least one acrylate or methacrylate subunit, and—a lactam, characterized in that the lactam concentration is 0.001 to 0.3 wt %, particularly the lactam concentration is 0.001 to 0.15 wt %, more particularly the lactam concentration is 0.01 to 0.1 wt %. Furthermore, the present invention relates to a polymer, in particular a dental polymer or an otoplastic polymer comprising polymerised monomers and/or oligomers or polymers and a lactam, as well as a medical product comprising said polymer.

title: Encoder, decoder, encoding method, and decoding method
abstract: An encoder includes circuitry and memory coupled to the circuitry. Given id indicating a lower temporal sublayer other than a highest temporal sublayer in temporal sublayers, the circuitry calculates a DPB output time [id] for a picture in the lower temporal sublayer. In doing so, the circuitry of the encoder subtracts a DPB output delta [id] provided for each of the temporal sublayers from a DPB output delay shared between the temporal sublayers, and given maxid indicating the highest temporal sublayer, calculates the DPB output delta [id] by subtracting a CPB removal delay [maxid] and an offset [id] from a CPB removal delay [id]. Next, the circuitry stores the offset [id] in a bitstream.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Corporation Of America

title: Coffee machine with milk frothing system
abstract: A coffee machine comprises a user interface configured so that the user can enter a final temperature and a frothing degree of the milk, and a control unit comprising an interpolator configured to interpolate the temperatures detected by a temperature probe so as to obtain a temperature curve over time and calculate an inclination of the temperature curve, and an algorithm that receives the final temperature, frothing degree, and inclination of the temperature curve and accordingly calculate an injection time to close the steam and air valves and a quantity of air to adjust a shutter of the air valve ( 8 ).

title: Solar panel system
abstract: A solar panel system includes a solar module. The solar module includes a housing, a solar panel, and a reflector. The solar panel is supported by the housing. The solar panel is configured to receive incident light and convert a first portion of the incident light to electricity. The reflector is positioned io reflect a second portion of the incident light that was not convened to electricity by the solar panel back at the solar panel.

title: Module card as well as combination of module card and slot
abstract: The present disclosure provides a module card and its combination with a slot. The module card of the present disclosure includes a substrate, a first die, a second die, adhesive, a plurality of metal contacts, a heat-conducting layer and a thermally conductive material. The substrate has opposing first surface and second surface. A plurality of through holes is formed in the substrate. The through holes penetrate the substrate from the first surface to the second surface. The first die and the second die are disposed on the first surface of the substrate. The adhesive is used to attach the second die to the first surface of the substrate. The metal contacts are disposed on the second surface of the substrate. The heat-conducting layer is disposed on the second surface of the substrate. The thermally conductive material is filled in the through holes and is in contact with the adhesive and the heat-conducting layer.

title: Probe card and method for manufacturing probe card
abstract: A probe card includes a main board, a wiring board having a plurality of probes, a plurality of pogo pins electrically connecting the main board and the wiring board, and a pin holder disposed between the main board and the wiring board and having a plurality of guide holes which guide the plurality of pogo pins, in which the pin holder is formed from a ceramic holder having therein a plurality of conductor layers which are not electrically connected to each other.

title: Device, System, and Method for Tracking Multiple Projectiles
abstract: A system for tracking multiple projectiles includes a first radar device aimed so that a field of view of the first radar device covers at least a portion of a target area into which projectiles are to be launched from a plurality of launch locations and a processor receiving data from the radar and identifying from the data tracks of a plurality of projectiles. The processor determines for each projectile track identified a specific one of the launch locations from which the projectile was launched and provides to the launch location associated with each projectile data corresponding to a trajectory of the projectile.

title: Storage gel
abstract: The present invention relates to a gel composition comprising: (a) a supramolecular gel formed from or comprising a network of one or more low molecular weight gelators (LMWGs) in an aqueous solution; wherein the supramolecular gel: (i) has a storage modulus (G′) of from 100 to 1,000,000 Pa; (ii) has a loss modulus (G″) such that G″/G′ is from 0.01 to 0.5; and (iii) has a breakage strain of from 0.1 to 300%. Additionally, the invention relates to processes for preparing such gel compositions. The present invention also relates to a gel composition comprising an encapsulated component, processes for preparing such gel compositions and processes relating to storing, transporting and extracting such encapsulated components.
assignee: University Of Warwick; The University Court Of The University Of Glasgow

title: Telescopic Tube, Telescopic Rod Incorporating the Same and Application thereof
abstract: Disclosed is a telescopic tube, comprising an inner tube, an outer tube and a locking mechanism located therebetween. The locking mechanism comprises a fixed base secured to an end of the inner tube, a sliding frame arranged inside the outer tube and slidable axially, and an expansion block arranged near the outer tube. The sliding frame is in helical fit‌ with the fixed base along a centerline. When the inner and outer tubes are extended, the expansion block is driven to approach the fixed base, generating an interference force that causes the expansion block to expand outward and press tightly against the outer tube for locking; when rotated, the inner tube drives the sliding frame to move axially, allowing the expansion block to move away from the fixed base and recess inward to disengage from the outer tube for unlocking, with a rotation angle not exceeding 270°.

title: Method for assisting remote operators in orienting themselves to their immediate environment and capturing critical information in real-time
abstract: The teleoperations system assigns move assignments to specific vehicles instead of directly to different teleoperators. Instead of operating a specific vehicle for an entire day, the teleoperator instead selects (or is assigned) move assignments and is connected to the vehicle associated with the move assignment. The teleoperator then performs the move assignment for that particular vehicle and then selects (or is assigned) the next move assignment. The next assignment may be associated with the same vehicle or an entirely different vehicle. A drive fulfillment system provides teleoperators with real-time feedback on their current location, detailed information on materials available nearby, access to camera feeds for identifying materials in transit, and the ability to determine their location based on the vehicle's position.

title: Flow path device and detection device
abstract: A flow path device includes a first member having a pair of first main surfaces and a groove with an opening located in one of the first main surfaces, and a second member having a pair of second main surfaces, one surface of the pair of second main surfaces is joined to the one surface of the pair of first main surfaces of the first member, and closes the opening, wherein the first member or the second member includes a through hole connected to the groove, and in plan view, a corner portion is formed at the edge of the groove, and no corner portion is formed at the edge of the groove opposite to the corner portion.

title: Improved filtering pulley
abstract: Filtering pulley has a hub adapted to be fixed to a shaft rotating around an axis (A), a crown mounted coaxially and rotationally free on the hub, at least one elastic group arranged circumferentially with respect to the hub and the crown and interposed, each, between a pair of first elements fixedly carried by hub and between a pair of second elements fixedly carried by crown. The filtering pulley includes a centring member configured to cooperate with the hub and the first elements in order to fix the first elements in a predefined angular position with respect to the hub.

title: Vehicle seat
abstract: A vehicle seat, includes: a seat cushion that is configured to support the buttocks of a seated occupant; a seatback that is supported tiltably downward toward a seat front side relative to the seat cushion; and a headrest configured to adopt a first state, in which the headrest is disposed at a seat upper side of the seatback and is configured to support the head of the seated occupant in a state in which the seatback is upright relative to the seat cushion, and a second state, in which the headrest is disposed at a portion at a seat front side of a support surface at the seat upper side of the seatback and the headrest is configured to support the head of the occupant lying on the support surface in a state in which the seatback is tilted downward toward the seat front side.
assignee: Nhk Spring Co., Ltd.; Subaru Corporation

title: Method for acquiring a signal with overlapping receive coils for mr imaging
abstract: According to the invention, a method for selecting a set of coil elements of a radio frequency coil system ( 2 ) with a plurality of coil elements ( 4 ) for receiving magnetic resonance signals of a region of interest, the method comprising the following method steps: determining a signal to noise ranking of the plurality of coil elements ( 4 ) for the region of interest; assigning the coil elements ( 4 ) to a first type A and a second type B based on the determined signal to noise ranking, wherein coil elements with a signal-to-noise ratio higher than a predetermined threshold are assigned to type A and coil elements with a signal-to-noise ratio lower than the predetermined threshold are assigned to type B; determining a coupling effect of each coil element ( 4 ) of the radio frequency coil system ( 2 ) for the region of interest; grouping the coil elements ( 4 ) assigned to the first type A or to the second type B into a primary coil group ( 8 ) and a secondary coil group ( 9 ) based on the determined coupling effect and the signal-to-noise ratio, wherein coil elements of the same type A or B ( 4 ) with mutual coupling effect with each other are at least partially allocated into different coil groups ( 8 ,  9 ); and selecting the coil elements either of the primary coil group ( 8 ) or of the secondary coil group ( 9 ) for receiving the magnetic resonance signals of the region of interest. In this way, the quality of MR imaging can be improved while avoiding a simple exclusion of coil elements ( 4 ) that do not deliver enough information content but by selecting and combining coil elements ( 4 ) so that the maximum possible number of coil elements ( 4 ) are used for receiving the electromagnetic induction signal while increasing the SNR.

title: Liquid discharge apparatus and supply control method
abstract: A liquid discharge apparatus includes a liquid discharger, a liquid storage, a liquid supplier, and circuitry. The liquid discharger discharges a liquid. The liquid storage stores the liquid to be fed to the liquid discharger. The liquid supplier supplies two or more types of liquids to the liquid storage. The circuitry controls the liquid supplier to supply the two or more types of liquids to the liquid storage in multiple batches within a supply period to store the liquid including the two or more types of liquids at a predetermined mixing ratio in the liquid storage, and changes a number of the multiple batches according to a miscibility of the two or more types of liquids.

title: Sensor device and method for operating a sensor device
abstract: A sensor device comprises a pixel array comprising a plurality of pixels each being configured to receive light and to perform photoelectric conversion to generate an electrical signal, a storage unit that is configured to store fixed pattern noise, FPN, data indicating FPN of the pixel array, and an output unit that is configured to output the electrical signals generated by the pixels and the FPN data.

title: Amplifier circuit and switched capacitor circuit
abstract: An amplifier circuit includes a first series connection of a first MOSFET, capacitor, and second MOSFET between a power supply and ground. The circuit has a differential input pair with a common-voltage terminal, high-potential terminal, and low-potential terminal. Second and third series connections of a third and fourth MOSFET, and a fifth and sixth MOSFET, are arranged in parallel between the high- and low-potential terminals. Positive-side and negative-side switches connect the common-voltage terminal to nodes between the third and fourth MOSFETs, and between the fifth and sixth MOSFETs. Fourth and fifth series connections of a seventh and eighth MOSFET, and a ninth and tenth MOSFET, are coupled between the high-potential or low-potential terminals and nodes of the first series connection. The second MOSFET and the switches are driven by a first clock signal. Other MOSFETs are driven by clock signals with specified phases and inversion.
assignee: Denso Corporation; Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha; MIRISE Technologies Corporation; The University Of Tokyo

title: Systems and methods for satellite service entitlement verification
abstract: System and methods for modifying terrestrial coverage devices to provide mobile network coverage using an entitlement server is described herein. An entitlement server is used to determine if the hardware/software configuration of a user equipment attempting to register with a satellite is approved. Before attempting to access a network through a satellite, in some examples, the user equipment can check to see if an entitlement certificate is stored thereon the user equipment. The entitlement certificate indicates that the network has already authorized access by the user equipment to satellite coverage. In some examples, the entitlement determination may be done while the user equipment is attempting to access the satellite. In these examples, when the user equipment transmits a registration request message to attempt to use the satellite of a mobile network, the mobile network determines if the user equipment is entitled to use the satellite.

title: Systems and methods for ranking call intent probability
abstract: Systems, apparatuses, methods, and computer program products are disclosed for deriving call intent probability. An example method includes receiving a set of call menu tokens and creating an n-gram from the set of call menu tokens. The example method further includes receiving an intent call log for a candidate call intent, which includes a frequency of the n-gram and a total frequency, and determining, by scoring circuitry, an n-gram intent score based on the frequency of the n-gram and the total frequency of the intent call log. The example method further includes determining a total score for the candidate call intent based on the n-gram intent score, where the total score provides a measure of a probability of the candidate call intent and outputting a ranked list of call intents comprising the total score and the candidate call intent.

title: Boosting performance of ai/ml hpc workloads
abstract: One aspect of the instant disclosure provides a system and method for managing high-performance computing (HPC) workloads. During operation, a workload management node in an HPC cluster may receive a request for executing a job for performing a machine learning task, distribute the job to a plurality of compute nodes based on the request, and configure a respective compute node of the plurality of compute nodes to store machine code associated with a function at a shared storage location. The function is part of the job, and the shared storage location is accessible to the plurality of compute nodes to allow a different compute node to execute the function without compiling source code of the function.

title: Method, device, and medium for video processing
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a solution for video processing. A method for video processing is proposed. The method comprises: constructing a list of merge candidates for a target block of a video in a coding mode based on motion vector difference (MVD); reordering the list of merge candidates for the target block; and performing a conversion between the target block and a bitstream of the video based on the reordered list of merge candidates. Compared with the conventional solution, the proposed method can advantageously improve the coding efficiency.
assignee: Beijing Bytedance Network Technology Co., Ltd.; Bytedance Inc.

title: Security case
abstract: A security case to protect theft prone products in a retail establishment is provided. The security case can include at least one of an adjustable depth system of telescoping panels to accommodate different depth shelves, a moveable reinforced transparent closure and/or a toe kick levelling system securable to a base of a sales rack or gondola to enable the security case and its components to level to a horizontal plane. These systems and others can be singular or combined with one another in any manner and number.

title: Vehicle loudspeaker and sound system
abstract: Disclosed are a vehicle loudspeaker and sound system. The vehicle loudspeaker includes a frame, a diaphragm having an outer edge connected to the frame, a voice coil with an upper end portion connected to a middle portion of the diaphragm, and a magnetic drive unit having a magnetic gap, the magnetic drive unit being arranged on the frame, wherein a lower end portion of the voice coil is inserted into the magnetic gap. The vehicle loudspeaker further includes two independent dampers spaced apart from each other, the two dampers are respectively located on two opposite sides of the voice coil, a part of an edge of each damper is connected to the frame, the diaphragm has two first connecting portions recessed downwards, and the first connecting portions are connected to the dampers respectively.

title: Methods of evading immune rejection
abstract: The present disclosure is directed to methods, compositions and devices capable of avoiding foreign body responses to implanted material. This technology utilizes polymer encapsulated engineered cells that produce natural, cell-generated cytokines to elicit a tailored immune response to implanted materials for applications in diabetes, immune tolerance, and organ transplantation.

title: Aperture-Metasurface and Hybrid Refractive-Metasurface Imaging Systems
abstract: Hybrid imaging systems incorporating conventional optical elements and metasurface elements with light sources and/or detectors, and methods of the manufacture and operation of such optical arrangements are provided. Systems and methods describe the integration of apertures with metasurface elements and refractive optics with metasurface elements in illumination sources and sensors.

title: Memory package and memory module including the memory package
abstract: A single memory package includes: a substrate; and a memory chip and a buffer chip that are integrated over the substrate, wherein the memory chip includes an interface modulator embedded therein, and the interface modulator is a serializing modulator including a multi-level amplitude modulator.

title: High-strength and low-iron-loss non-oriented electrical steel plate and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: Disclosed in the present invention is a non-oriented electrical steel plate. In addition to Fe and inevitable impurities, the non-oriented electrical steel plate further contains the following chemical elements in wt %: 0<C≤0.0035%, Si: 2.00-3.80%, Mn: 0.05-1.00%, Al: 0.10-1.20%, and Cu: 0.05-2.00%. Correspondingly, further disclosed in the present invention is a method for manufacturing the non-oriented electrical steel plate, wherein in a heating step, the heating rate of a casting slab in a temperature range of 940-1030° C. is 4.5-8.4° C./min; and in a leveling step, the leveling reduction rate is controlled to be 0.5-8.0%. By using this technical solution, the present invention achieves both low iron-loss performance and high strength.

title: Audio processor with a steered audio bandwidth extension
abstract: An audio processor or coder for processing or coding a signal, the processor or coder comprising: a band-limited entity or coder configured to provide or code a band-limited signal of the signal; and a bandwidth extension entity or coder configured to provide or code an extended-band signal of the signal, the provided or decoded extended-band signal comprising a mixture of a first extended-band excitation and a second extended-band excitation; wherein the bandwidth extension entity or coder is configured to generate the first extended-band excitation and a noise generator configured to generate random noise as the second extended-band excitation; wherein the mixture is controlled via a steering factor derived from a characteristic output or parameter of the band-limited entity or coder.
assignee: Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der angewandten Forschung e.V.

title: Powder for thermal spraying
abstract:
It is an object of the present invention to provide a novel powder for thermal spraying capable of improving performance of an yttrium-aluminum composite oxide coating film. A powder for thermal spraying, including a composite oxide formed with yttrium oxide and aluminum oxide, wherein the powder for thermal spraying is subjected to component analysis at any plurality (n) of positions of a scanning electron microscope image (SEM image) by an energy dispersive X-ray spectrometer (EDX) in which characteristic X-ray peak areas are measured, and a content of the element yttrium (C Y (at %)) and a content of the element aluminum (C Al (at %)) are calculated from a ratio of the peak areas and determined so as to satisfy the relationship of the following expression (1):

title: Fully genetically encoded nad+protein probe based on resonance energy transfer,and preparation method therefor and use thereof
abstract: A fully genetically encoded NAD+protein probe based on resonance energy transfer, and a preparation method therefor and the use thereof. Specifically provided is a fully genetically encoded NAD+protein probe, which is formed by means of linking a resonance energy transfer donor, an NAD+responsive protein and a resonance energy transfer receptor in series, wherein the NAD+ responsive protein is a mutant of a DNA ligase; the sequence of the mutant of the DNA ligase is as shown in SEQ ID NO. 3 or SEQ ID NO. 6; the resonance energy transfer donor is selected from luciferase or a fluorescent protein; the resonance energy transfer receptor is selected from a fluorescent protein; and the fluorescent protein as the resonance energy transfer receptor is different from that of the resonance energy transfer donor. The protein probe can be synthesized in living cells and used for detecting the concentration of NAD+ in living cells.

title: Security assessment systems and methods based on architectural models of systems
abstract: An architectural model and a security verification library can be used to assess security of a system having multiple components. The architectural model can include communication interfaces, connections between the components, and one or more specifications. At least one aspect of the one or more specifications can be a behavior specification for security of the system. The security verification library can include a plurality of data structures that define actor profiles, techniques, and executable logic nodes for computing state transitions. The model can be annotated with one or more selections from the security verification library and subsequently evaluated. The evaluating can include verifying the annotated model with respect to the specification(s) by executing a formal proof over a symbolic state space of the annotated model. For example, the architectural model can be configured using Architectural Analysis and Design Language, and the system can be a cyber-physical system.
assignee: George Mason University; Board Of Regents, The University Of Texas System

title: Method and internet of things system for liquid accumulation supervision in smart gas pipelines
abstract: Provided is a method and an Internet of Things system for liquid accumulation supervision in smart gas pipelines. The system comprises: a gas company management platform, a gas company sensor network platform, and a gas device object platform; the gas company management platform is configured to: obtain gas sampling information; determine a cumulative transmission time; determine a liquid accumulation volume in an interior of the gas pipeline; determine a valve opening adjustment amount and control movement of a pressure regulating valve of a gas gate station based on the valve opening adjustment amount, or issue an instruction to the gas gate station to replace a filter element of a gas filtration device; and remotely control a liquid accumulation supervision device to open an automatic blowdown valve.
assignee: Chengdu Qinchuan Iot Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Invisible wall element
abstract: The present invention relates to a wall element ( 16 ) which is configured to be arranged around an opening ( 14 ) formed in a wall ( 12 ), the wall element ( 16 ) comprising at least one frame ( 20 ) and at least one sliding element ( 221, 222, 223 ) which is able to slide in the frame ( 20 ) in a transverse direction (T), the frame ( 20 ) comprising at least two doorframes ( 26   a   , 26   b ) opposite one another, each frame ( 26   a   , 26   b ) being configured to receive an edge ( 24   a   1, 24   b   1, 24   a   2, 24   b   2, 24   a   3, 24   b   3 ) of the at least one sliding element ( 221, 222, 223 ), the doorframes ( 26   a   , 26   b ) being configured such that the at least one sliding element ( 221, 222, 223 ) is translatably movable between a position wherein it covers the opening ( 14 ) and a position wherein it uncovers the opening ( 14 ), the at least one sliding element ( 221, 222, 223 ) being configured to be entirely outside a perimeter of the opening ( 14 ) in the uncovering position thereof, the doorframes ( 26   a   , 26   b ) each comprising an attachment support ( 30 ) which is configured to be rigidly connected to the wall ( 12 ), the attachment supports ( 30 ) being configured such that the frame ( 20 ) extends entirely outside the perimeter of the opening ( 14 ) of the wall ( 12 ), and the at least one sliding element ( 221 ) comprising a glazed panel ( 251 ) and a first edge ( 241 ) and being configured so that the first edge ( 241 ) is entirely outside the perimeter of the opening ( 14 ) in the covering position of the first sliding element ( 221 ).

title: Accessing memory using memory accelerators
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to compile computer program code to cause one or more memory accelerators to be used to access a plurality of memory locations. In at least one embodiment, computer program code is compiled to cause one or more memory accelerators to be used to access a plurality of memory locations based on, for example, an indication of a layout of the plurality of memory locations in the computer program code.

title: Method of producing fluorine-containing elastomer, composition, solid composition, and crosslinked rubber article
abstract: There is provided a method of producing a fluorine-containing elastomer, the method comprising a step of polymerizing a monomer A containing a compound represented by CX 1 X 2 ═CX 3 -L-Z, a cyano group-containing monomer, and at least one selected from the group consisting of tetrafluoroethylene, a fluorine-containing vinyl ether, and a fluorine-containing allyl ether under a condition in which an emulsifier having a fluorine atom is substantially absent in an aqueous medium.

title: System and method for drone routes generation for seismic nodes deployment
abstract: A method for generating a route for a drone for seismic node deployment includes receiving drone data, receiving field data with regard to one or more drone features, receiving a receiver processing support (RPS) file that conforms with a shell processing support format for 3D surveys as defined by society of exploration geophysicists (SEG), generating a comma-values separated (CVS) file including waypoints making up the route of the drone, based on the RPS file, the drone data, and the field data, and transmitting the CVS file to the drone for the seismic node deployment.

title: Energy harvesting switch integrated with multiple gateways to cabin network
abstract: A system and method using push-button energy harvesting (EH) switch devices for controlling devices in an aircraft vehicle, and for dynamically receiving and responding to switch events. The EH switch devices transmit EH switch wireless datagram messages responsive to corresponding EH switch actuations. A gateway transceiver at the aircraft receives and performs a real-time analysis of all EH datagram messages including screening detected EH messages based on a database of commissioned devices. The datagram payload data includes a sequence counter to combat any record-and-replay spoofing attacks. A control processor uses a memory to track reception sequencing for all preconfigured EH switch devices. The sequence counter is transmitted by the EH switch for every commissioned unit and is tracked by the control processor using the memory. If a sequence value received is less than or equal to the last detected sequence value for a particular device, an error message is flagged.

title: Methods of reducing the enzymatic hydrolysis activity rate in a composition obtained from a purification platform
abstract: The present disclosure provides purification platforms comprising a depth filter step and/or a hydrophobic interaction chromatography (HIC) step. Also disclosed herein are methods of using the purification platforms described herein and compositions obtained therefrom, such as pharmaceutical compositions.

title: Webpage Creation Leveraging Generative AI
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are leveraged in order to dynamically generate webpages and to modify pre-existing webpages. The LLMs determine the intent of queries and modification requests and obtain relevant content using differently defined page generation strategies. Related apparatus, systems, techniques and articles are also described.

title: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for content presentation
abstract: A method, an apparatus, a device and a storage medium for content presentation are provided. The method includes presenting a first set of media content items in a first view on a content presentation interface, the first set of media content items including at least one media content item; and in response to detecting first switching on the content presentation interface, presenting the first set of media content items in a second view on the content presentation interface.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Phone case with hidden stand
abstract: A phone case with a hidden stand is provided, and relates to the technical field of phone cases. The phone case includes a main body. The main body includes a bottom plate and a rim. The rim is fixedly arranged around a front surface of the bottom plate. A magnetic attraction ring is embedded into a back surface of the bottom plate. A stand assembly is arranged on the back surface of the bottom plate. The stand assembly covers the magnetic attraction ring. A magnetic attraction slot is formed in the stand assembly. The stand assembly includes a connecting portion and stand wings. The connecting portion is fixedly arranged on the back surface of the bottom plate. The stand wings capable of rotating around a connection position are arranged on two sides of the connecting portion.

title: Grain-oriented electrical steel sheet and method for forming insulating coating
abstract: This grain-oriented electrical steel sheet is a grain-oriented electrical steel sheet including a base steel sheet and an insulating coating formed on a surface of the base steel sheet, in which the base steel sheet includes a flat surface part and a groove part extending in a direction of 45 to 135° with respect to a rolling direction, the groove part has a depth of 10 to 30 μm and a width of 10 to 200 μm, the insulating coating includes an intermediate layer formed on a side of the base steel sheet, containing a crystalline metal phosphate, and having a thickness of 0.1 to 15.0 μm, and a tension coating layer formed on a surface side of the insulating coating, and the base steel sheet is covered with the insulating coating including the intermediate layer and the tension coating layer in 60% or more of the groove part in terms of area ratio.

title: Adaptive bit rate control with look-ahead analysis and subsequent rate control refinement
abstract: Adaptive rate control for video encoding can be performed using look-ahead analysis and actual encoding feedback. A look-ahead encoding pass can be performed using an adaptive look-ahead quantization parameter (QP) selected based on video resolution and target compression ratio, so that look-ahead statistics better correlate with statistics expected during actual encoding. The look-ahead statistics can be used to classify a group-of-pictures (GOP) according to temporal correlation. The classification can be used to select bit-allocation adjustment ratios and relative QP values for distributing bits and QPs among an anchor frame and subsequent frames of the GOP. An estimated minimum and maximum QP range can be generated and applied to constrain actual encoding QP decisions and prevent excessive QP adjustment. After actual encoding begins, feedback, including actual statistics and/or actual QP, can be used to refine one or more subsequent encoding decisions.
assignee: Ximin Zhang; Yunbiao Wang; Yi-Jen Chiu

title: Network rejection or no response and handling of equivalent plmn or snpn
abstract: In an aspect of the disclosure, a method, a computer-readable medium, and an apparatus are provided. The method may be performed by a UE. In certain configurations, the UE maintains a single list of equivalent networks for a first network. The UE performs a registration procedure or a de-registration procedure over a first access to the first network, where the UE is registering or has registered over a second access to the first network. In the registration procedure or the de-registration procedure, in response to an event in the registration procedure or the de-registration procedure, the UE keeps the single list of equivalent networks. The event may include: receiving a cause #13 indicating that roaming is not allowed in a tracking area in a downlink non-access stratum (NAS) message over the first access, or encountering a registration attempt counter equal to 5.

title: Harness holder
abstract: A harness holder includes a holder body, a grommet, and a protector. The holder body is attached to a through-hole that penetrates through a housing. The holder body has an insertion hole for a harness to pass through. The grommet is attached to the insertion hole in a state in which the grommet has the harness inserted therethrough. The protector is attached to the holder body so as to protrude outside of the housing. The protector has a guide passage that guides the harness. The guide passage has a shape that extends in a penetration direction of the through-hole from a communication portion with the insertion hole to a predetermined direction-change portion, and then extends in a guide direction that is different from the penetration direction. The harness is bent along the guide passage at the direction-change portion, and thereby bending of the harness is maintained.

title: Universal vaccine for african swine fever virus (asfv) infections
abstract: The present invention relates to vaccine compositions for administration to domestic pigs ( Sus scrofa domesticus ), wild boars, warthogs, bush pigs, and giant forest hogs. In one embodiment, the present vaccine is designed to provide broad-spectrum immunity against all known genotypes (I-XXIV) and serotypes (1-8) of African Swine Fever Virus (ASFV) by incorporating highly conserved antigenic regions across multiple viral proteins. This multi-epitope vaccine construct is formulated to elicit both cellular (CD8 +  and CD4 +  T-cell) and humoral (antibody-mediated) immunity, ensuring cross-protection against diverse ASFV strains. By targeting conserved epitopes in structural (p72, p54, p30, CD2 v ) and non-structural proteins (MGF family, DNA replication enzymes, immune evasion factors), this vaccine aims to mitigate ASFV outbreaks globally, including regions affected by highly virulent Genotype II (Eastern Europe, Asia) and endemic strains in Africa. This universal antigen is optionally fused to a serum protein or a small synthetic peptide capable of binding to a serum protein in vivo to extend its half-life. In another embodiment, the invention, the antigen is produced by recombinant technology, or RNA technology to deliver the antigen in vivo or to produce it by a cell-free synthesis.

title: Collapsible Ramp
abstract:
A collapsible ramp is disclosed that may contain a bridge, a first ramp, a second ramp, and a plurality of side walls. The first and second ramps are operatively connected to the bridge. The plurality of side walls are operatively connected to the bridge, the first ramp and the second ramp. The first and second ramps can be moved from a first, collapsed position to a second, extended position. 
     The plurality of side walls can similarly be moved from a first, collapsed position to a second, extended position. The bridge may contain a first leg and a second leg. The first and second leg may also be moved from a first, collapsed position to a second, extended position. The collapsible ramp may further contain a gripping material coupled to the bridge, the first ramp, and the second ramp.

title: Films, methods of making films, and devices incorporating the film
abstract: The present disclosure is directed to membranes, films, method of making films and films, and devices including the films. In particular, the present disclosure is directed to methods of processing highly uniform soft thin films on liquid surfaces for flexible electronics, highly uniform soft thin films, and related systems thereof.

title: Independently randomly generated different features associated with different activators in free activation setting
abstract: Gaming systems and methods that provide free plays of a game including multiple pots, multiple different features associated with the pots, multiple activators that can cause activation of the pots and features associated with the pots, a reduced quantity of symbols for the free plays of the game, and symbol upgrades for the free plays of the game that cause the upgrade of the reduced quantity of symbols, wherein the combination of such functions provide an enhanced display of the free plays of the game.

title: Aquacultured crustacean and method of producing same
abstract: Provided is an aquacultured crustacean having improved umami, uses thereof, and a method for producing the same. The crustacean does not burrow in sand, contain glycine and alanine, and has 2400 mg or more of free amino acids per 100 g of abdominal muscle. The content of glycine is 550 mg or more per 100 g of abdominal muscle, and the content of alanine is 140 mg or more per 100 g of abdominal muscle.

title: Door assembly for a laundry appliance
abstract: A door assembly for a laundry appliance includes an outer door frame, a first locator pin and a second locator pin extending from the outer door frame, wherein each of the first locator pin and the second locator pin define a first portion having a first width and a second portion having a second width smaller than the first width, the second portion being positioned on top of the first portion opposite the outer door frame, a bracket mounted to the outer door frame, and a first aperture and a second aperture defined on the bracket opposite from the first locator pin and the second locator pin, wherein the first aperture is configured to receive the first locator pin and the second aperture is elongated along the vertical direction and configured to receive the second locator pin.

title: Tire with improved rubber compound
abstract: According to aspects of the invention, a tire for a vehicle comprising a tread is provided. The tread comprises a set of consecutive blocks arranged along a circumference of the tire, a plurality of first grooves arranged over the circumference of the tire, wherein each of the plurality of first grooves is arranged between two blocks of the set of consecutive blocks, and a plurality of sipes defining an edge ingredient, E1, corresponding to the ratio between a sum of projected lengths of the plurality of sipes in an axial direction, SAP, and the circumference of the tread, C, such that (I). The E1 is at least 2 and at most 20. The tread is made of a rubber composition having an E′ @−20° C. of at least 20 MPa and at most 80 MPa, when measured according to ISO 4664.

title: Multi-Agent Real-Time Research System and Method
abstract: System and method for providing real-time research in response to a user query. A multi-agent service platform communicates with user devices over a network. A multi-agent layer has agents responsible for issue identification, planning, real-time search, ranking, legal analysis, and rule application. An orchestration layer manages communication between these agents, and a storage layer that manages data retrieval and storage. In one embodiment, the real-time research relates to labor and employment law.
assignee: Vorys, Sater, Seymour and Pease, LLP

title: Optical add drop multiplexers with asymmetrical filtering
abstract: This disclosure describes techniques for Optical Add Drop Multiplexers (OADMs) that apply asymmetrical filtering to allow for individual channels within a channel group to be independently added/dropped or passed through. In one example, an optical add-drop multiplexer includes a first input port configured to receive an input signal having a first wavelength channel, a second wavelength channel, and a third wavelength channel; a demultiplexer having a first filter configured to: pass the first wavelength channel and the second wavelength channel, and filter the third wavelength channel; a multiplexer having a second filter configured to: pass the second wavelength channel and the third wavelength channel, and filter the first wavelength channel; and a first output port configured to output an output signal comprising the second wavelength channel of the input signal.

title: Production method of semiconductor device
abstract: A production method of a semiconductor device is provided and includes providing a silicon substrate including a first main surface; forming a silicon oxide film over the first main surface of the silicon substrate; forming an amorphous silicon film over the silicon oxide film; forming a metal layer over the amorphous silicon film; changing the amorphous silicon film into a crystal silicon film by annealing the silicon substrate over which the metal layer is formed; forming a transistor using a portion of the crystal silicon film as a channel; and forming a capacitor next to the transistor as viewed in a direction perpendicular to the first main surface, the capacitor being electrically connected to the transistor.

title: Driving power switches with variable currents
abstract: A current-source gate driver includes circuitry that is configured to determine a rate of change of a current flowing through a power switch and generate a signal indicative of the rate of change of the current flowing through a power switch and a variable current source configured to output a drive current to a control terminal of a power switch, wherein the variable current source is configured to decrease magnitude of the drive current in response to the signal indicating that a rate of change in the current flowing through the power switch is positive.

title: Antiferroelectric containing dysprosium and a manufacturing method thereof
abstract: An antiferroelectric and a method for manufacturing an antiferroelectric are disclosed herein. The antiferroelectric may have high permittivity and breakdown voltage by having a Pb x La 1−x ([Zr 1−Y Sn Y ] Z Ti 1−Z ) composition. The manufacturing of the antiferroelectric may be performed through appropriate mixing and dysprosium addition.
assignee: Hyundai Motor Company; Kia Corporation; Korea Institute Of Ceramic Engineering And Technology

title: Systems and methods for online doppler lidar calibration for road vehicles
abstract: A system for sensor calibration is provided. The system includes a processor in communication with a memory device and a plurality of LiDAR sensors of an autonomous vehicle. The processor is configured to detect, based on data received from a first LiDAR sensor of the plurality of LiDAR sensors, a relative velocity of the autonomous vehicle to a static object while the autonomous vehicle is traveling along a straight trajectory, compute, based on the relative velocity, a vector representing a velocity estimate of the autonomous vehicle, identify the first LiDAR sensor as misaligned when a lateral component of the computed vector is greater than a threshold lateral component, and store, in the memory device, a status of the first LiDAR sensor as misaligned, wherein the autonomous vehicle is controlled based in part on the status of the first LiDAR sensor.

title: Load center, neutral rail for load center, and method of making neutral rail
abstract: A load center for electrical distribution with a dielectric base has left and right neutral bus bars are at laterally spaced locations and left and right neutral rails connected to the bus bars. Each of the left and right neutral rails has a main rail section extending longitudinally along the dielectric base from a proximal end portion to a distal end portion and a connector section integrally formed with the respective main rail section and extending laterally from the proximal end portion of the main rail section. The left and right neutral rails are mounted on the dielectric base such that the main rail sections are spaced apart laterally and lie in a common neutral rail plane. The connector sections of the left neutral rail and the right neutral rail are offset from one another along the depth axis.

title: Display device comprising a variable-wavelength led and methods of calibrating and driving a display device comprising a variable-wavelength
abstract: A display device comprises a variable-wavelength LED, the variable-wavelength LED being a pixel of the device, or one of a plurality of subpixels of a device pixel, and an absorptive colour filter. The absorptive colour filter is positioned between the variable-wavelength LED and an outlet of the display device, such that light emitted by the variable-wavelength LED passes through the absorptive colour filter before passing out of the outlet of the display device. The variable-wavelength LED, or a second LED subpixel, is driveable to emit light at a first emission wavelength in response to a first electrical driving condition, and the variable-wavelength LED is driveable to emit light at a second emission wavelength in response to a second electrical driving condition. The absorptive colour filter is configured to attenuate the luminance of light emitted at the second emission wavelength, which is shorter than the first emission wavelength. Methods of calibrating and driving the display device are also provided.

title: Ramp pad spacer for a hard disk drive
abstract: A ramp pad spacer for a hard disk drive includes a body, a pad attachment hole, and a ramp attachment hole. The body has a first surface and a second surface, opposite of the first surface, and spaced apart by a predetermined thickness of the body. The pad attachment hole and the ramp attachment hole are spaced apart from each other, and both extend through the predetermined thickness. The predetermined thickness defines a height offset between an attached component of the hard disk drive and a mounting surface of the hard disk drive in response to the ramp pad spacer being positioned between the attached component and the mounting surface.

title: Vehicle support for a test stand, and method for setting up a test stand with such a vehicle support
abstract:
Test stands are known in which vehicles have to be brought in on lifting platforms or independently and prepared for connection to the load devices. 
     In order to shorten the present set-up time and dismantling time on the test stand, a vehicle support ( 10 ) is proposed for a test stand ( 82 ) which has two longitudinal beams ( 12 ,  14 ), a front crossmember ( 22 ) and a rear crossmember ( 20 ) by means of which the two longitudinal beams ( 12 ,  14 ) are connected to each other, two bearing portions ( 26 ) which extend on the sides of the longitudinal beams ( 12 ,  14 ) facing away from the rear crossmember ( 20 ), two bearing portions ( 26 ) which extend on the sides of the longitudinal beams ( 12 ,  14 ) facing away from the front crossmember ( 20 ) and four supporting elements ( 36 ) which are attached to the four bearing portions ( 26 ). Rollers ( 38 ) are arranged at least on the two supporting elements ( 36 ) which are arranged on the sides of the longitudinal beams ( 12 ,  14 ) facing away from the front crossmember ( 22 ), and adapter devices ( 44 ) to which wheel hubs ( 46 ) of a vehicle ( 48 ) can be attached are attached to the supporting elements ( 36 ). Furthermore, a corresponding method for setting up a test stand with such a vehicle support is proposed.

title: Macrocyclic broad spectrum antibiotics
abstract: Provided herein are antibacterial compounds, wherein the compounds in some embodiments have broad spectrum bioactivity. In various embodiments, the compounds act by inhibition of bacterial type 1 signal peptidase (SpsB), an essential protein in bacteria. Pharmaceutical compositions and methods for treatment using the compounds described herein are also provided.

title: Sim-based registration management system
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for managing network acquisition. A wireless device receives an authentication request for a private network and determines a location (TAC/LAC) of the wireless device. It is determined whether the location of the wireless device is on a list of allowed or disallowed locations from a subscriber identification module (SIM) of the wireless device. In response to determining that the location of the wireless device is not listed as an allowed location or is a disallowed location, ignoring the authentication request from the private network.

title: Densified multi-dimensional massive mimo unit
abstract: An apparatus includes transmit receive point (TRP) antenna boards layered such that a front of each respective TRP antenna board faces the same direction. The apparatus includes at least one printed circuit board (PCB) including multiple antenna-facing sides on which the TRP antenna boards are attached, respectively. The apparatus includes front-end circuits that are attached to the at least one PCB and that are electrically coupled to the TRP antenna boards, respectively. Each of the TRP antenna boards includes a rear that is opposite to the front, a signal-propagation side, and a second side. The signal-propagation side includes a two-dimensional (2D) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna array and extends from the front to the rear. The second side faces toward the at least one PCB, is opposite to the signal-propagation side, and extends from the front to the rear.

title: Space Lighting System Based on Lighting Target
abstract: A spatial illumination or lighting system based on a light color target has a control device and an actuating device, wherein the control device is configured to interact with a user and communicates with the actuating device, the control device receives identity identification information about the illuminated object input by the user, detects real-time light color data of the object and feeds the detection result back to the user, and sends the identity identification information about the object, the detection result and the light color target to the actuating device. The actuating device is arranged in the space or place, configured to communicate with the control device and implement lighting for the illuminated object: it receives the identification information, the detection result and the light color target of the object, calculates a comprehensive adjustment parameter corresponding to the object, and illuminates the object to achieve the desired light color target.
assignee: Self Electronics Co., Ltd.; Wanjiong Lin; Self Electronics Usa Corporation

title: Layering garment
abstract: A modular layering garment system includes a base undergarment and a separable interchangeable member. The base undergarment has a modular attachment system with an inner flap and a hingedly attached outer flap that define an insert-receiving channel. The outer flap moves between an open configuration exposing the channel, and a closed configuration enclosing the channel. The base undergarment includes at least one latching element. The interchangeable member includes a visible body portion extending from an insert portion. The insert portion is removably received within the channel and includes an engagement feature—either a corresponding latching element for direct mating, or an entry point permitting releasable engagement through the insert portion. In an assembled condition, the interchangeable member is releasably retained relative to the base undergarment by structural capture of the insert portion between the flaps alongside latching engagement, with the closed outer flap restricting channel access.

title: Sidelink Transport Block Size Considering Sidelink Reference Signals
abstract: A first wireless device receives, a radio resource control (RRC) message comprising a parameter indicating a number of first symbols of at least one sidelink (SL) reference signal (RS). The first wireless device determines, for a physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH) in second consecutive symbols of a slot, a number of REs allocated for the PSSCH within a physical resource block (PRB) based on a product of the number of first symbols and a number of subcarriers within a resource block. The first wireless device transmits, to a second wireless device during the first symbols of the slot, the at least one SL RS. The first wireless device transmits, via the PSSCH and to the second wireless device during the second consecutive symbols of the slot, a transport block (TB) with a TB size based on the number of REs allocated for the PSSCH within the PRB.

title: Sensitive data reclassification engine in a security management system
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer storage media for providing data security posture management using a sensitive data reclassification engine in a security management system. Data security posture management provides security operations—including identifying and remediating risk exposure—to securely manage data, resources, and workloads. In operation, sensitive data scan results are accessed. A scanned data item having a first data sensitivity confidence score—and a first data classification that indicates that the scanned data item is a potentially sensitive data item—is identified in the sensitive data scan results. Based on the scanned data item having the first data classification, scanned metadata comprising a sensitive data attribute is accessed. Based on a second data sensitivity confidence score associated with the sensitive data attribute and the scanned data item, the first data classification is replaced with a second data classification that indicates that the scanned data item is a sensitive data item.

title: Computational medical guidelines and connected knowledge graph for query, traversal and inference
abstract: A computational platform includes a clinical knowledge graph having medical condition nodes to which are linked factor nodes and investigation nodes. Medical guideline nodes linked to a medical condition represent a computational guideline. Observation nodes and laboratory test nodes within the guideline link to factor nodes or investigation nodes. Therapy ingredient nodes represent drugs with a guideline. A patient is diagnosed or treated by traversing the guideline nodes associated with a particular condition. Probabilities annotated upon edges facilitate predicting a future patient state. Use cases include queries from a clinician, an insurance claims database, or an LLM, generation of FHIR value sets, and generation of executable CQL for a medical guideline. The knowledge graph receives a medical query, executes it and outputs a result. A medical condition ontology with factors and investigations connects to an ontology representing a computational medical guideline. Elemental therapeutic intervention nodes represent drug or nondrug therapies.

title: Touch screen interface membrane
abstract: A system includes a processor and a memory that includes instructions executable by the processor to receive a request for a touch screen user interface of a clinical medical application. Additionally, a reset signal is sent to a touch screen interface membrane. Further, a predetermined configuration for the touch screen interface membrane is selected. Additionally, the configuration is associated with the clinical medical software application and the touch screen user interface. Further, the configuration maps a touch screen control and a corresponding tactile effect. Additionally, a configuration signal is sent to the touch screen interface membrane that causes the tactile effect to be generated on a surface of the touch screen interface membrane in an area of the touch screen interface membrane that corresponds to a location of the touch screen control that is displayed on a display device having the touch screen interface membrane overlaid.

title: Detecting potential breaks or leaks due to disruptive events
abstract: In various embodiments, techniques for detecting potential breaks or leaks due to disruptive events include detecting, by a computing device, an event occurring at a location proximate a metering device, the event corresponding to an earthquake or a severe weather event; receiving, by the computing device, first consumption data for a commodity, the first consumption data being collected by the metering device after the event; comparing the first consumption data with second consumption data for the commodity, the second consumption data being collected by the metering device before the event; and in response to the comparing, performing, by the computing device, a remedial action.

title: Composite iron oxide particle powder and method for manufacturing same
abstract: A composite iron oxide particle powder including at least one of NaHCO3 and Na2CO3, in an amount greater than 25% by weight and up to 60% by weight, and having an Na/Fe molar ratio of 0.4 to 1.2.

title: Electrolyte comprising imidazolium ionic liquid and solvent with high boiling point and batteries comprising same
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte composition comprising a lithium salt, an imidazolium ionic liquid, and an organic solvent with a high boiling point. In one embodiment, the high boiling point is 100° C. or above. The electrolyte and an electrochemical device comprising the same exhibit an improved thermal stability and safety.

title: Systems With Supplemental Illumination
abstract: A head-mounted device may have a head-mounted support structure. Displays may present images to eye boxes at the rear of the head-mounted support structure. Cameras and other sensors may be supported by the head-mounted support structure. Tracking cameras may be used to track the movement of a user’s hands or other external objects. In dim ambient lighting conditions, a supplemental illumination system may be activated to provide supplemental illumination for the tracking cameras. A single beam of supplemental illumination may be emitted over a given coverage area or a smaller beam of supplemental illumination may be steered across the given coverage area. Light-emitting devices such as infrared light-emitting diodes and infrared lasers may be used to form infrared light sources for the supplemental illumination system.

title: Channel multiplexing method and multiplexed channel transmission method for wireless communication system and device using same
abstract: A base station of a wireless communication system is disclosed. The base station of the wireless communication includes: a communication module; and a processor configured to control the communication module. When a second physical uplink data channel transmission of the UE is scheduled to a time-frequency resource in which uplink control information (UCI) transmission of a first physical uplink data channel of the UE is scheduled, the processor is configured to transmit the UCI to a base station of the wireless communication system in a time-frequency resource except for a time-frequency resource in which a second physical uplink data channel transmission of the UE is scheduled.
assignee: Wilus Institute Of Standards And Technology Inc.

title: Soybean varieties '21782047', '21849629', and '21800737'
abstract: New soybean varieties designated ‘21782047’, ‘21849629’, and ‘21800737’ are described. ‘21782047’, ‘21849629’, and ‘21800737’ are soybean varieties exhibiting stability and uniformity.

title: Mounting crystal resonator over inductor in an integrated circuit package
abstract: Some examples of the teachings herein include a system comprising: a silicon die including an inductor element; a crystal connected to the silicon die by bonding wires; and a non-conductive spacer between the silicon die and the crystal; wherein the non-conductive spacer has a thickness defining a distance between the silicon die and the crystal, the distance selected to reduce an effect of the crystal on a magnetic flux of the inductor.

title: Bupropion as a modulator of drug activity
abstract: Dosage forms, drug delivery systems, and methods related to sustained release of dextromethorphan or improved therapeutic effects are disclosed. Typically, bupropion or a related compound is orally administered to a human being to be treated with, or being treated with, dextromethorphan.

title: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for interface interaction
abstract: Embodiments of the invention relates to a method, apparatus, device and storage medium for interface interaction. The method provided includes: displaying a target interaction area in a playback interface of a first work, the target interaction area displaying a first content and at least one candidate item associated with the first content, where the first content or the at least one candidate item represents a work topic associated with the first work; and receiving a selection by a user for a target candidate item in the at least one candidate item, the selection configured to express feedback from the user with respect to the first work. In this way, the embodiments of the present disclosure can adjust the recommended content for the user by obtaining the confirmation of the user about prompts.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Organic electroluminescent materials and devices
abstract:
A compound having a ligand L A  comprising a structure of Formula I, 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     is provided. In Formula I, moiety A is a monocyclic ring or a polycyclic fused ring system; each of X 1  to X 3 , Z 1 , and Z 2  is C or N; X is a linking group; each R X , R X′ , R 1 , R A , and R B  is a hydrogen or a General Substituent defined herein; and metal M is Ir, Rh, Re, Ru, Os, Pt, Pd, Ag, Au, or Cu. Compositions, OLEDs, and consumer products containing the compound are also provided.

title: Autonomous Vehicle Control Device and Method
abstract: An apparatus of a vehicle may comprise a processor and a memory storing at least one instruction that, when executed by the processor communicating with the memory, causes the apparatus to obtain, via a transceiver of the vehicle, a plurality of first coordinates indicating a driving path in a first region where driving starts in an arbitrary driving section, obtain a plurality of second coordinates indicating a driving path in a second region where driving ends in the arbitrary driving section, determine a first direction at an entry point, determine a second direction at an end point, output a signal indicating a driving plan path based on the directions, and control, based on the signal, autonomous driving of the vehicle.

title: Tooling for use in heat-sealing of flexible materials used in packaging
abstract: In a system for heat-sealing of flexible materials used in packaging of goods, an improved design for a set of heat-seal jaws is described herein.

title: Utility meter with digital inputs and synchronization circuit
abstract: A utility meter includes a housing and at least one sensor connected to the housing and configured to be connected to a utility system. The utility meter includes a processing system having one or more processors. The utility meter can utilize a current regulating circuit to provide proper voltage output to the various components. The utility meter can also utilize a zero-crossing detector circuit configured to produce a zero-crossing signal for a three-phase power supply.
assignee: EI Electronics LLC, d/b/a Electro Industries/Gauge Tech

title: Direct air capture of carbon dioxide
abstract: A cyclic process for the capture of carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) directly from air utilizing a three-compartment electrolytic cell coupled with a hydroxide-based CO2 capture system as well as a carbonate-based CO2 capture system. Air is passed over a hydroxide compound in the hydroxide-based CO2 capture system to extract carbon dioxide from the air and produce a carbonate compound which is transferred to the carbonate-based CO2 capture system, where air is passed over the carbonate compound to extract carbon dioxide from the air and produce a bicarbonate compound. The bicarbonate is then passed into the three-compartment electrolytic cell where CO2, hydrogen and oxygen gases are separately released and the bicarbonate solution is transformed into a hydroxide solution that is reused in the hydroxide-based CO2 capture system. The flow of input compounds from one system to the other enables efficient operation of the direct air capture of carbon dioxide system.

title: Systems and methods for multipartite relay protocols
abstract: A method for multipartite relay may include receiving, from a multipartite relay system, a multipartite relay request. The multipartite relay request may include relay data. The relay data may include a single relay amount and an allocation policy. The method may further include requesting a relay of the single relay amount. The method may further include receiving the relay of the single relay amount. The method may further include, in response to receiving the relay of the single relay amount, splitting the single relay amount into a first apportioned amount and a second apportioned amount according to the allocation policy of the multipartite relay request. The method may further include transmitting the first apportioned amount into a first recipient system of a first recipient and the second apportioned amount into a second recipient system of a second recipient.

title: Display panel and manufacturing method therefor, and display device
abstract: A display panel, comprising a substrate, a display structure layer located in a display area, a plurality of data leads located in a signal access area, a plurality of contact pads, and an inorganic composite insulating layer. At least one contact pad comprises a plurality of contact pad metal layers electrically connected to each other, and the plurality of contact pad metal layers are electrically connected to one of the plurality of data leads. The inorganic composite insulating layer is located on the side of at least one of the plurality of contact pad metal layers close to the substrate. The orthographic projection of the inorganic composite insulating layer on the substrate does not overlap the orthographic projections of the plurality of contact pads on the substrate.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Agentic Information Retrieval And Synthesis
