abstract: A new variety of garden bean ( Phaseolus vulgaris  L.) designated ‘FireJax’ is provided. Garden bean variety ‘FireJax’ is characterized by its dark green pods in mainly the 4 sieve class, heat tolerance, strong, compact and erect plant habit, and resistance to  Colletotrichum lindemuthiunum  (Anthracnose) and resistance to many races of  Uromyces appendiculatus  (Rust).

title: Human body dummy for comfort assessment
abstract: A human body dummy for comfort assessment includes: a skeletal portion which is molded from a resin material; a fleshy portion which is formed from a material different from the resin material and which surrounds an outer periphery of the skeletal portion; and a skin portion which is disposed on an outer surface side of the fleshy portion. The skeletal portion is molded from resin materials that differ according to bone site, and has a bone weight of between 10% and 60% inclusive, of bone weight of a skeletal portion of a human body dummy for crash safety performance testing internationally standardized on the basis of human body data.

title: Systems and methods for aerial image-based repair progress monitoring and exterior damage identification of insured assets
abstract: Various techniques are described utilizing one or more unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs, or “drones”) for various disaster and/or catastrophe-related purposes. UAVs may collect data in an attempt to predict the occurrence and/or extent of a catastrophe and/or to mitigate the impact of a catastrophe before and, if not at that time, once it has occurred. The UAVs may perform various tasks such that the damage to property caused by a catastrophe (or potential catastrophe) may be eliminated or mitigated. A UAV may receive a flight path based on an energy consumption related condition and operate based on the flight path. Operating based on the flight path includes docking the UAV with a power supply device for charging a power source of the UAV.

title: End-to-end evaluation of perception outputs for autonomous and semi-autonomous systems and applications
abstract: In various examples, an end-to-end perception evaluation system for autonomous and semi-autonomous machine applications may be implemented to evaluate how the accuracy or precision of outputs of machine learning models—such as deep neural networks (DNNs)—impact downstream performance of the machine when relied upon. For example, decisions computed by the system using ground truth output types may be compared to decisions computed by the system using the perception outputs. As a result, discrepancies in downstream decision making of the system between the ground truth information and the perception information may be evaluated to either aid in updating or retraining of the machine learning model or aid in generating more accurate or precise ground truth information.

title: Light source module and projector
abstract: A light source module includes a light source including a light emitting element that emits a light and a substrate on which the light emitting element is mounted, a light guide element having an incident end and an emission end, and uniformizing in-plane illuminance of the light, and a holding member holding the light guide element, wherein the holding member is fixed to the substrate, the holding member has a wall portion forming a side surface surrounding the light guide element, an incident end portion facing the light source in the wall portion, and an emission end portion located at a side opposite to the incident end portion, the incident end portion and the emission end portion penetrate along an optical axis direction of the light, and the wall portion has an opening overlapping the light guide element when viewed from a direction intersecting the optical axis.

title: Bioprinted Three-Dimensional Tumor Model
abstract: The present invention relates a bioprinted three-dimensional tumor model which is able to reproduce the cellular heterogeneity, the spatial architecture, and the tissue-specific ECM of the tumor microenvironment. In addition, the invention refers to a process for preparing such three-dimensional tumor model, to methods for testing anticancer drugs as well as to the use of the tumor model in developing personalized medicine and developing new therapies based on the understanding of the in vitro tumor progression.
assignee: Asociación Centro De Investigación En Biomateriales - Cic Biomagune; Administración General Comunidad Autónoma De Euskadi

title: Vehicle-to-vehicle communication system and method
abstract: A vehicle has a Global Satellite Navigation System receiver to determine a current location, a microphone to capture a voice command of a user and a processor executing a speech recognition module to process the voice command to determine that the user is requesting that a call be initiated a nearby vehicle and to determine from the voice command of the user a visual identification of the nearby vehicle to call. The vehicle includes a radiofrequency cellular transceiver cooperating with the processor to transmit the visual identification of the nearby vehicle and the current location to the remote server and to receive from the remote server a communication-availability of the nearby vehicle. The processor cooperates with the radiofrequency cellular transceiver or with a short-range vehicle-to-vehicle transceiver of the vehicle to initiate a voice communication with the one of the nearby vehicles with which the user wishes to initiate the call.

title: Anti trbc1 antigen binding domains
abstract: The present disclosure relates to anti-TRBC1 antigen binding domains characterized by the sequences of the variable chains. The CDRs sequences of the variable chains are: (VH CDR1) GYTFT, (VH CDR2) NPYNDDIQS, (VH CDR3) GAGY-NFDGAYRFFDF; and (VL CDR1) RSSQRLVHSNGNTYL, (VL CDR2) RVSNRFP, (VL CDR3) SQSTHVPYT. The claimed humanized antibodies derive from the murine JOVI antibody. Uses in cancer therapy.

title: Ranging with simultaneous frames
abstract: Embodiments of a device for wireless communication are disclosed. In some embodiments, the device includes: a transceiver configured to receive a message from a second device and at least one processor. The processor is communicatively coupled to the transceiver and is configured to: generate a response message includes a SYNC portion, a start frame delimiter (SFD) portion, and a cipher portion. The SYNC portion includes a sequence of symbols forming a preamble. The cipher portion includes a ciphered sequence of pseudo-randomized pulses. The transceiver is further configured to transmit the response message.

title: WIDEBAND HYBRID FIBER AMPLIFIERS AND LASERS OPERATING IN THE 2000 nm WAVELENGTH REGION
abstract: A hybrid optical fiber amplifying device is proposed that is based upon a concatenated combination of a section of Tm-doped fiber (TDF) followed by a section of Ho-doped fiber (HDF). The doped fiber sections are configured to be no more than a few meters in length. Using the sections of doped fiber in this order (i.e., TDF followed by HDF) has been found to provide amplification of input signals over a relatively wide wavelength band from about 1725 nm to about 2105 nm (thus exhibiting a useful wideband range of about 380 nm). The use of pump beams operating at several Watts of power have been found to yield multi-Watt output signals. The wideband hybrid device itself may take the form of an amplifier, laser (including a ring laser configuration), or a source of amplified stimulated emission (ASE).

title: Method for providing die-to-die testability
abstract: The technology described herein provides a device including a wafer including a plurality of Tx macros, each of the Tx macro including a plurality of transmit lanes; a pseudorandom bit sequence (PRBS) generator configured on one of the Tx macros, the PRBS generator configured to generate a PRBS serial signal; a transmit data path to transmit the PRBS signal to one or more of a plurality of transmit lanes of a transmitter (Tx) macro; and a logic device to compare the output from the one or more of the plurality of transmit lanes to generate an error flag, wherein a positive value of the error flag indicates a manufacturing defect on the wafer.

title: Surgical instrument counting system and working platform thereof
abstract: A working platform for a surgical instrument counting system, comprising: a body portion; a first placement portion connected to the body portion; a second placement portion connected to the body portion; a connecting device for connecting to a plurality of first surgical instruments, each of the plurality of first surgical instruments having an annular portion; and a surgical instrument carrier loaded with a plurality of second surgical instruments, none of which has an annular portion; wherein the connecting device is removably connected to the first placement portion, and/or the surgical instrument carrier is removably connected to the second placement portion.

title: Dynamic multi-flowline control system for downhole tools
abstract: Embodiments presented provide for a multi-flowline control system and methods for dynamically switching fluid flow in downhole tools. The method may include operating the downhole tool in a first valve configuration, the downhole tool configured to sample fluid from a geological stratum, sending an actuation signal to the first valve configuration, receiving the actuation signal at the first valve configuration, altering the first valve configuration to a second valve configuration, where the first valve configuration allows for sampling of fluids from the geological stratum outside the downhole tool to the second valve configuration and where the downhole tool is configured to operate in a closed-loop configuration wherein sampling of fluids from the geological stratum is not possible, and circulating fluids within the closed loop configuration.

title: Static force amplifier
abstract: An actuation system includes one or more two-stage actuator units and a hydraulic booster unit fluidly coupled to the one or more two-stage actuator units. The one or more two-stage actuator units includes an electrical motor, a ball screw coupled to the electrical motor, and a clamping body coupled to the ball screw. The hydraulic booster unit includes an accumulator configured to contain a fluid, an amplifier body having a first volume and a second volume fluidly coupled to the accumulator, and a screw actuator disposed within the first volume and the second volume.

title: Illumination systems employing multi-layer laminated sheet-form optical structures with embedded tir channels
abstract: An illumination system includes a lighting module having a plurality of light emitting diodes and a flexible optically transmissive sheet disposed to receive light from the lighting module. The sheet has a multi-layer laminated structure including optically transmissive layers and an optically transmissive adhesive layer, and has a generally rectangular shape and a thickness between 200 micrometers and 1 millimeter. At least one layer includes a regular array of linear channels extending between edges of the sheet, with side walls of the channels reflecting light by total internal reflection. In some configurations, another layer includes a second regular array of linear channels oriented at an angle relative to the first array. A textured optically transmissive layer defines a textured outer surface and is bonded to channel-separating surface portions by the adhesive layer. A broad-area reflective surface reflectively scatters light received directly or indirectly from the sheet.

title: Space-efficient data structure
abstract: A data structure includes an array having at least a first element, a second element and a third element. The first element represents a first bit of a first entry and a first bit of a second entry, wherein the first bit of the first entry is at the same position as, but has a different value from, the first bit of the entry. The first element stores a reference to only the second element. The second element represents a second bit of the first entry, the second bit of the first entry having a position next to the first bit of the first entry. The third element represents a second bit of the second entry, the second bit of the second entry having a position next to the first bit of the second entry. The third element is stored adjacent to the first element in the array.

title: Low noise wind turbine blade
abstract: A wind turbine blade and a wind turbine having such wind turbine blade is disclosed. The wind turbine blade having a profiled contour including a pressure side and a suction side, and a leading edge and a trailing edge with a chord extending therebetween defining a chordwise direction. The wind turbine blade extends in a longitudinal direction between a root end and a tip end and having a blade length along the longitudinal direction. The wind turbine blade has a first airfoil blade section along the longitudinal direction being located between 40% and 100% of the blade length measured from the root end. Within the first airfoil blade section, the pressure side is substantially straight near the trailing edge.

title: Substrate processing apparatus and substrate processing method
abstract: A substrate processing apparatus includes a cleaner for cleaning a substrate processed in a processor with a cleaning liquid, and a transferrer for transferring the substrate between the processor and the cleaner. The cleaner includes a cleaning tank for storing the cleaning liquid and having a bottomed cylindrical shape with an open top, a switcher including a valve for switching an outflow destination of the cleaning liquid discharged from the cleaning tank between a first pipe connected to a regeneration processor and a second pipe for a waste liquid, a liquid receiver provided to cover at least a peripheral edge portion of an opening of the cleaning tank and to receive droplets of the processing liquid falling from the substrate when the substrate processed in the processor is moved from the processor to the cleaning tank, and a drainage part for discarding the liquid collected by the liquid receiver.

title: Method and tool for cementing wellbore
abstract: A wellbore can be cemented by injecting into the wellbore a cement slurry comprising an accelerator composite having a shell encapsulating a core comprising an accelerator; a cementitious material; and an aqueous carrier; passing the cement slurry through a tool that includes an ultrasonic emitter, emitting ultrasonic waves from the ultrasonic emitter as the cement slurry passes the ultrasonic emitter to break the shell releasing the accelerator from the accelerator composite and activating the cement slurry. This process can be implemented using a tool with includes a tube through which cement slurry can be injected into the wellbore and an ultrasonic emitter positioned to direct ultrasonic waves onto the cement slurry as is moves through the tube.

title: Continuous-jet rain erosion testing device for materials
abstract: A continuous-jet rain erosion testing device for materials is provided, including a frame, an impact assembly and a jet assembly. The impact assembly includes a ram acceleration component and a drive component, the ram acceleration component and the drive component are respectively arranged on the frame, one end of the ram acceleration component is connected to the drive component; where when the drive component is in a first motion state, the ram acceleration component is driven to rotate counterclockwise around a connection point with the frame; and when the drive component is in a second motion state, the ram acceleration component resets clockwise. The jet assembly includes a jet generation component and a support table, the jet generation component is installed on a top of the support table.

title: Cooking appliance
abstract: The present invention provides a cooking appliance, comprising a heat insulation cavity assembly, the heat insulation cavity assembly comprising a cooking cavity and a heat insulation frame, a heat insulation member being disposed between the cooking cavity and the heat insulation frame, and a heat dissipation structure being disposed outside the heat insulation cavity assembly. The present invention can effectively prevent heat in the oven cavity from being transferred to the outside, preventing excessive heat dissipation load in the electrical cavity; meanwhile, the heat dissipation structure can ensure operational reliability of key components, which is critical for cooking appliances having dual magnetrons.
assignee: Guangdong Galanz Enterprises Co., Ltd.; Guangdong Galanz Appliances Manufacturing Co., Ltd.; Guangdong Galanz Microwave Oven And Electrical Appliances Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

title: Coaxial connector and coaxial connector unit
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to enable smooth connection of outer conductor terminals. This coaxial connector is a coaxial connector that includes a coaxial terminal to which a mating coaxial terminal is connected, the coaxial connector comprising a coaxial terminal that includes an inner conductor terminal and a cylindrical outer conductor terminal surrounding the inner conductor terminal, and a resin housing that includes a terminal holding part holding the coaxial terminal, wherein the coaxial terminal includes a holding subject held by the terminal holding part, and a connecting end part that protrudes from the terminal holding part and is connected to the mating coaxial terminal, and the resin housing includes a regulating cylinder part that extends from the terminal holding part to surround the connecting end part and regulates the posture of the connecting end part.
assignee: Autonetworks Technologies, Ltd.; Sumitomo Wiring Systems, Ltd.; Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd.

title: Relay control apparatus, electrical system, relay control method, apparatus, and medium
abstract: A relay control apparatus ( 100 ), an electrical system ( 1000 ), a relay control method, a relay control apparatus ( 20 ), and a storage medium ( 200 ). The relay control apparatus ( 100 ) includes a relay control board ( 10 ) configured to forward a control signal to an electrical appliance ( 300 ) to control an operating condition of the electrical appliance ( 300 ). The relay control board ( 10 ) selectively forwards the control signal according to a refrigerant leakage signal received when a refrigerant leaks to control the operating condition of the electrical appliance ( 300 ) associated with the refrigerant.
assignee: Gd Midea Heating & Ventilating Equipment Co., Ltd.; Midea Group Co., Ltd.

title: Aspiration catheter systems
abstract: Methods and apparatuses for blood clot aspiration. Described are fluid management components and assemblies for blood clot extraction from a patient’s body and for filtering blood and recirculating blood back into the patient’s body.

title: Intrusion response system with rule base
abstract: The disclosed technology relates to a computer-implemented method of determining rules for an intrusion response system (IRS). The method comprises receiving a predictive model configured to analyse potential threat data and recommending mitigating actions to potential threats. The method applies a rule extraction algorithm to the predictive model to extract one or more rules from the predictive model and updates an IRS rule base of the IRS to include the one or more rules. Some examples of the method detect a potential threat that matches at least one of the one or more rules and perform a mitigating action defined by the at least one of the one or more rules, subsequent to updating the IRS rule base.

title: Laser printing apparatus
abstract: A laser printing apparatus includes: an excitation light generation section; a laser light generation section that generates UV laser light; a laser light scanning section; a distance measurement light emitting section; a merging mechanism that merges the distance measurement light with a laser optical path; a distance measurement light receiving section that receives distance measurement light separated from the laser optical path; a distance measurement section that measures a distance to a surface of a workpiece; and a sealing section that hermetically seals the merging mechanism and in which a first transmission window and a second transmission window are disposed, the first transmission window transmitting the distance measurement light until the distance measurement light is merged into the laser optical path, and the distance measurement light separated from the laser optical path, and the second transmission window transmitting UV laser light and distance measurement light.

title: Fastening Device for Fastening a Component to a Vehicle Component in or on a Vehicle
abstract: A fastening apparatus secures a component such as a cable, cable harness, or power bus to a vehicle structure. The apparatus includes a holding device that attaches to the component and a connector device that links the holding device to the vehicle structure. The connector device forms a bearing connection with the holding device that allows limited movement. The movable connection accommodates thermal expansion and other dimensional changes between the component and the vehicle structure. By allowing controlled relative movement, the apparatus reduces mechanical stress and prevents tension caused by temperature variations while maintaining reliable attachment of the component.

title: Electoacoustic transducer
abstract: An electroacoustic transducer ( 1 ), in particular a bending wave transducer, has at least a bending-resistant acoustic diaphragm ( 2 ) and a structure-borne sound transducer ( 3 ) that excites the acoustic diaphragm ( 2 ) to vibrate. The acoustic diaphragm ( 2 ) comprises a synthetic resin-coated support material ( 4 ), the sound emission surface ( 5 ) of which is formed of at least two, or in particular at least three, layers of synthetic resin ( 6 ) that are bonded materially to one another without any bonding means.

title: Modular geothermal power generation system
abstract: A modular geothermal power generation system comprises a plurality of groups of thermoelectric power generation modules, a hot water supply system and a cold water supply system. The thermoelectric power generation module comprises at least two heat exchangers arranged adjacent to each other at an interval, the adjacent two heat exchangers are respectively a hot heat exchanger and a cold heat exchanger, a plurality of thermoelectric modules for thermoelectric power generation are arranged between the two heat exchangers, the hot water supply system is connected with the hot heat exchanger, and the cold water supply system is connected with the cold heat exchanger. A hot end and a cold end are formed by oppositely arranging the hot heat exchanger and the cold heat exchanger, and the thermoelectric module is arranged between the hot end and the cold end, so that a whole structure is modularized.

title: System and/or method for electronically processing of hierarchically sorted content stored in memory
abstract: Disclosed are a system, method and apparatus for electronically processing hierarchically sorted electronic content stored in a memory. A menu of a plurality of analytical tools on the display device may be presented on a display device responsive to selection of a node via a graphical user interface (GUI). Responsive to selection of an analytical tool of the presented plurality of analytical tools, the selected analytical tool may be applied to data objects in the memory linked to the selected node.

title: Photoelectric conversion device, photodetection system, movable object, and equipment
abstract: A photoelectric conversion device includes a photon detection circuit configured to output a pulse signal in response to incidence of a photon, and a signal processing circuit connected to the photon detection circuit and including a plurality of counters configured to count the pulse signal. The signal processing circuit is configured to output a threshold value reaching signal when a count value of each of the plurality of counters reaches a predetermined threshold value, and the photon detection circuit is configured to stop outputting the pulse signal when receiving the threshold value reaching signal from each of the plurality of counters.

title: Phase-synchronized computer game systems and methods based on segmented audio tracks
abstract: Computer-implemented game systems and methods are disclosed in which gameplay is partitioned into multiple discrete phases synchronized to segments of a fixed-length, non-looping audio track. A song map may define phase boundaries, gameplay configurations, and transition parameters corresponding to musically meaningful sections of the audio. At runtime, one or more processors may monitor audio playback position and automatically transition between gameplay phases at predefined boundaries without requiring player input to initiate such transitions. Gameplay mechanics, environments, objectives, difficulty parameters, or grouping configurations may vary between phases. Performance metrics from a completed phase may influence subsequent phase configuration, including regrouping of competitors, conditional phase selection, or score normalization. Phase outcomes may be aggregated using weighted or normalized scoring policies to determine a final result at completion of the audio track. Automated or semi-automated systems may generate segmentation data and phase mappings using signal processing and rule-based or machine learning techniques.

title: Method and system for optical coherence tomography exploiting truncated singular value decomposition
abstract: An Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) system ( 100 ) is provided. The OCT system comprises: a light source ( 105 ) configured to generate a coherent light signal having a wavelength that varies over time across a time interval; an optical interferometer ( 110 ) configured to divide the coherent light signal into a reference forward signal directed to a reference arm of the optical interferometer leading to a reference reflector (R), and into an operative forward signal directed to an operative arm of the optical interferometer leading to a target object (O); an optical detector ( 115 ) configured to detect an interference light signal generated by a combination of a reference return signal returning from the reference arm after reflection by the reference reflector (R) and an operative return signal returning from the operative arm after reflection by the object (O), and configured to generate a corresponding detected interference electrical signal indicative of the interference light signal; a processing unit ( 125 ) configured to: —receive from the optical detector ( 115 ) a sequence of electrical signal samples of the detected interference electrical signal collected in corresponding sample times within the time interval; —process the received electrical signal samples to calculate for each predetermined depth among a set of predetermined depths inside the target object a corresponding reflectivity value indicative of the reflectivity of the target object at said predetermined depth, so as to obtain a corresponding set of reflectivity values. The processing unit ( 125 ) is configured to calculate the reflectivity values of the set by calculating each reflectivity value as a corresponding summation of electrical signal samples each one weighted by a respective weight, wherein said weights corresponds to singular values obtainable by the decomposition of a coefficient matrix of a system of equations, each equation of the system expressing a relationship between one of the received electrical signal samples and at least one of the reflectivity values of the set, and wherein said summation involves a subset of the received electrical signal samples.

title: Dynamic Data Block Grouping Based On Garbage Collection Performance Parameters
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for improving garbage collection efficiency through adaptive grouping of data blocks. A storage system controller determines a group size for batching data blocks based on one or more garbage collection performance parameters, such as data block occupancy and historical eviction patterns. The storage system controller groups data blocks according to corresponding lifespans, which may be derived from data block age, and assigns the data blocks to groups having defined lifespan ranges. Groups of data blocks are then selectively chosen for garbage collection. The group size may be dynamically adjusted based on observed garbage collection behavior to optimize system performance.

title: Compositions for antigen-specific immune cell activation
abstract: Disclosed are engineered polynucleotides for expressing chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) that bind a hapten and antibodies conjugated to hapten molecules. Also disclosed are methods for co-administering cells expressing the anti-hapten CARs and the hapten-modified antibody molecule for treating a cancer.

title: New padding schemes in wireless communications
abstract: Techniques pertaining to new padding schemes in wireless communications are described. An apparatus (e.g., a station (STA)) performs a wireless communication by: (a) generating and transmitting a physical-layer protocol data unit (PPDU); or (b) receiving and processing the PPDU. The PPDU comprises post-frame check sequence (post-FCS) padding after a frame check sequence (FCS) field of the PPDU.

title: Apparatus and method for testing automatic door motor
abstract: An apparatus configured to test a motor configured to close a door, the apparatus including: a piston within a cylinder; a spring mounted within the cylinder in cooperation with the piston, the spring movable between a compressed configuration and an expanded configuration to move the piston; and a trigger assembly mounted to the cylinder. When unlocked, the trigger assembly releases the spring to move from the compressed configuration to the expanded configuration and push the piston outward from the retracted position to the extended position. The spring is configured to push the piston with a predetermined amount of force expected to activate the motor to pivot the door and bring a door latch into contact with a door striker.

title: Transparent protective coverage using continuous laminar flow for solar panels in remote platforms
abstract: A method for maintaining efficiency and cleanliness of remote solar panels is provided. In some implementations, the method comprises sourcing water from a water source. In one or more implementations, the method includes pumping the sourced water onto one or more solar panels, each having a surface. In particular arrangements, the pumping is performed by a water pump controlled by a water pump control module. In various arrangements, the method also includes distributing the water across the one or more panel surfaces. In one or more variants, the distributing is performed by one or more water outlets connected to the water pump. In one or more variations, the one or more water outlets are controlled by the water pump control module to maintain a substantially transparent laminar flow sheet across the panel surface. A system for maintaining efficiency and cleanliness of remote solar panels is also disclosed.

title: Battery and electric device
abstract: A battery includes a battery cell and a support member. The battery cell includes a housing and a pressure relief component, where the housing includes a first wall portion, and the pressure relief component is disposed on the first wall portion. The pressure relief component includes a first groove, and the pressure relief component is configured as capable of rupturing along the first groove during pressure relief of the battery cell. The support member supports the first wall portion, the support member has a support surface facing the first wall portion, and the support surface is provided with a clearance portion. Along a thickness direction of the first wall portion, a projection of the first groove is located within the clearance portion.

title: Reciprocating pump
abstract: A pump suitable for use in a wearable medical device, such as a patch pump, comprises an axially translatable chamber with an inlet and an outlet, a piston or a diaphragm rotatably received in the chamber, a first valve between the inlet and the chamber, a second valve between the outlet and the chamber, a cam affixed to the chamber, a follower affixed to the piston and in contact with the cam for axially translating the chamber, and a biasing means acting on the chamber for applying a force on the chamber in an axial direction of the chamber to maintain such contact.

title: Selenoglycoside decoys of glycosylation for anti-inflammatory and antiviral pharmaceuticals
abstract: In one aspect, the disclosure relates to In accordance with the purpose(s) of the present disclosure, as embodied and broadly described herein, the disclosure, in one aspect, relates to acetylated glycosides comprising at least one O, S, or Se atom external to the glycoside ring, wherein the O, S, or Se is bonded to a moiety selected from C1-C20 linear or branched alkyl, alkenyl, aryl, alkylaryl, or arylalkyl. Also disclosed are methods of making the compounds, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the compounds, and methods of treating or preventing viral diseases and their symptoms in a subject using the same. In one aspect, the glycosides target host cell glycan decoration of viral proteins and do not cause the viruses to mutate. In another aspect, the glycosides and pharmaceutical compositions comprising the same can be applied topically and thereby do not cause systemic side effects in the subject.
assignee: Board Of Supervisors Of Louisiana State University And Agricultural And Mechanical College

title: An extraoral scanner system
abstract: An extraoral scanner system for determining a 3D geometry of a dental object: at least one camera; a pattern generator configured to generate a probe light with a plurality of configurations in the form of an illumination pattern; an optical system configured to transmit the probe light towards the dental object, and to transmit at least a part of the light returned from the dental object to the camera to form a plurality of 2D dental data, an intraoral mirror device configured to reflect the probe light towards the dental object, and to transmit at least a part of the light returned from the dental object to the camera to form a plurality of 2D mirror dental data, and one or more processors.

title: Power connector
abstract: A power connector is disclosed in this application. The power connector includes an insulation case, at least one power terminal, at least one conductive plate and at least one signal cable-fixing member. The power terminal has at least one power contact portion and at least one signal trigger portion. When an insert is inserted into a slot of the insulation case, the power contact portion first makes electrical contact with the insert, and the signal trigger portion is forced to move away from the slot and establish electrical contact with the conductive plate for timely triggering a power supply signal.

title: Method for preparing make-up powder block having spot-dyeing effect and make-up powder block
abstract: The present application provides a method for preparing a make-up powder block having a spot-dyeing effect and a make-up powder block. The method comprises the following steps: preparing a powder base material; preparing a spot-dyeing base material, and mixing the spot-dyeing base material with a water-insoluble coloring material to obtain a spot-dyeing material; applying the at least one spot-dyeing material in dots onto at least one preset position on the bottom of the cavity; filling the mold after dot application with a predetermined amount of the powder base material; freezing and demolding the mixed material within the mold; freeze-drying the demolded powder masterbatch to obtain a make-up powder block having a spot-dyeing effect; wherein the powder base material and the spot-dyeing material exhibit fluidity at normal temperature and pressure.
assignee: A & H International Cosmetics Co., LTD.

title: Inhibitors of ets2-activating molecules for the treatment of inflammatory diseases
abstract: The present invention provides inhibitors of proteins that activate Erythroblast Transformation Specific proto-oncogene (2) (ETS2), and their use in treating or preventing inflammatory and/or autoimmune diseases. The inhibitors are generally MEK inhibitors, HSP90 inhibitors, RAF inhibitors, SRC inhibitors, and/or ERK inhibitors. The invention also encompasses methods of diagnosis and methods of screening for agents that reduce macrophage activation.

title: Liquid crystal composition and use thereof
abstract: A liquid crystal composition includes one or more compounds represented by Formula I and one or more compounds represented by Formula II and/or Formula III. The liquid crystal composition has excellent flicker level and a relatively large elastic constant K 11  and a relatively small rotational viscosity γ 1  while maintaining a suitable optical anisotropy and a suitable clear point, that is, the liquid crystal composition has a relatively small γ 1 /K 11  ratio, so that the liquid crystal display element and the liquid crystal display have a relatively fast response speed.
assignee: Shijiazhuang Chengzhi Yonghua Display Material Co.,Ltd.

title: Method of Providing a Multi-layer Adhesion Layer on a Workpiece
abstract: A semiconductor substrate has a layer of polysilicon located thereon. A first layer of titanium having a thickness in the range of 5 nanometres to 10 nanometres is deposited on the layer of polysilicon. A layer of titanium nitride having a thickness in the range of 10 nanometres to 25 nanometres is deposited on the first layer of titanium. A second layer of titanium having a thickness in the range of 20 nanometres to 30 nanometres is deposited on the layer of titanium nitride.

title: Deep semantic cartography for real-time multi-domain mapping and knowledge persistence
abstract: A system for dynamic mapping that integrates real-time data from multiple sources into context-aware visualizations. The system creates semantic map overlays that adapt based on user roles and operational needs, while fusing diverse data inputs through confidence-weighted scoring. It processes spatial information through optimized tokenization and implements a multi-tiered memory architecture that distinguishes between temporary and permanent features. The system intelligently promotes or demotes spatial data across memory tiers based on confidence thresholds and operates across different spatial scales with independent update cycles. Data is organized in a multi-tenant knowledge graph with domain-specific rules and temporal awareness. A hybrid edge-cloud architecture enables both local processing and global consistency, while contextual guardrails ensure appropriate data access based on user identity and operational context. This integrated approach enables responsive, intelligent mapping across diverse applications.

title: Highly reliable transmission for mlo ba procedure
abstract: A method for data transmission for block acknowledgment. The method comprises determining that a number of frames retransmitted on an uplink from a station to a first access point (AP) meets a predetermined condition. The method further comprises selecting a second AP to assist the station in transmitting frames to the first AP. The method further comprises receiving a second frame from the second AP, where the second frame is a duplicated frame of a first frame, and the first frame is transmitted by the station to the first AP through a block. The method further comprises updating acknowledgment information corresponding to the first frame, where the acknowledgment information indicates received frames and missing frames in the block. In addition, the method further comprises transmitting the acknowledgment information to the station through the first AP.

title: A thin-film deposition apparatus cluster
abstract: A substrate processing system ( 1900 ) comprising, a reception module ( 1910 ) configured to load and unload substrates ( 130 ) to and from the substrate processing system ( 1900 ), and a heating module ( 1930 ) configured to heat substrates ( 130 ), and at least one processing module ( 1950 ) configured to process the substrates ( 130 ) with sequential self-limiting surface reactions, the at least one processing module ( 1910 ) comprising a laminar flow reaction chamber ( 120 ) and a substrate lifting system ( 500 ) configured to transfer substrates ( 130 ), in a direction perpendicular to surfaces thereof, between a loading position and a processing position, and a transfer unit ( 1910 ) comprising a robotic system configured to transfer the substrates ( 130 ) between said reception module, said heating module, and said at least one processing module.

title: Semiconductor Device and Method of Making Using Microwave Based Debonding
abstract: A semiconductor device manufacturing process is performed by providing a carrier and disposing an adhesive coating over the carrier. The adhesive coating includes polypropylene carbonate, graphite powder, and a photo acid generator or thermal acid generator. A semiconductor wafer is attached to the carrier using the adhesive coating. Backside processing is performed on the semiconductor wafer while the semiconductor wafer is attached to the carrier. The semiconductor wafer is debonded from the carrier by applying microwave energy to the adhesive coating.

title: Aerosol Generation Device Battery Monitoring
abstract: There is provided an aerosol generation device comprising a battery module, and a battery temperature sensor, and a controller. The controller is configured to monitor a temperature of the battery during charging of the battery to detect an indication of an end-of-charge temperature rise and determine whether the indication of the end-of-charge temperature rise has been detected in the monitored battery temperature. The controller controls the aerosol generation device to perform an action when the indication of the end-of-charge temperature rise is detected, and maintain the aerosol generation device in an operable state and not control the aerosol generation device to perform the action when the indication of the end-of-charge temperature rise is not detected.

title: Systems, methods, and apparatus to identify media devices
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatus to identify media devices are disclosed. An example network communications monitor includes network interface circuitry, computer readable instructions, and processor circuitry. The processor circuitry is to execute the computer readable instructions to detect, via the network interface circuitry, multiple network communications transmitted on a home network within the household, access panelist data that associates a panelist of the household with a panelist device of the panelist, determine, based on the panelist data, that one or more of the multiple network communications are associated with the panelist device, and cause storage of data identifying the one or more network communications in association with the panelist.

title: Fuel cell based uninterruptible power supply systems
abstract: A system includes a DC bus and an auxiliary power source coupled to the DC bus. The system further includes an energy storage device and a modular uninterruptible power supply (UPS) including a first uninterruptible power module (UPM) coupled to the DC bus and configured to provide power to an AC load from the auxiliary power source and a second UPM coupled to the DC bus and the energy storage device and configured to transfer energy between the DC bus and the energy storage device to regulate a voltage on the DC bus.

title: Thermal printer and portable terminal
abstract: A thermal printer, includes a thermal head configured to perform printing on recording paper; a platen roller, which is arranged at a position opposed to the thermal head, and is configured to convey the recording paper by nipping the recording paper between the platen roller and the thermal head; a head support member having conductivity, which is configured to support the thermal head; a head shaft having conductivity, which is configured to rotatably support the head support member; a motor housing having conductivity, which is provided on an outer periphery of a motor main body configured to rotate the platen roller; and a conductive member configured to be held in contact with the head support member, the head shaft, and the motor housing to provide electrical connection therebetween.

title: Hemodialysis access method for a patient and associated dialysis stent for use with an arteriovenous fistula or graft
abstract: A hemodialysis access method is provided for a patient. The method includes deploying a dialysis stent within an arterial venous (AV) fistula or graft, the dialysis stent including a shunt tube having (i) an elastic central restrictor segment that is integral with a wall of the shunt tube, (ii) an inlet end, (iii) an outlet end, and (iv) a central opening extending from the inlet end to the outlet end such that the central opening has a first diameter. The method further includes elastically adjusting the elastic central restrictor segment from the second diameter to the third diameter responsive to a balloon inflating to expand the elastic central restrictor segment, and from the third diameter back to the second diameter responsive to the balloon subsequently deflating.

title: Electrical interface
abstract: An electrical interface includes a first housing having a chamber extending at least between a first opening arranged at a mating end of the first housing, and a second opening arranged at a bottom end of the first housing. The mating end is configured to receive a corresponding electrical plug connector. The electrical interface includes at least one electrical contact extending within the chamber at least between the mating end and the bottom end and is configured to electrically connect to corresponding plug contacts of the plug assembly. The electrical interface includes a shielding assembly having a first end configured to be mounted to a printed circuit board, and a second end configured to slidably engage within the bottom end of the first housing.

title: Assisted traffic management
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for implementing traffic management techniques in connected, but not necessarily autonomous vehicles. In accordance with one embodiment, a method comprises determining a first vehicle instruction based on vehicle-related data; transmitting the first vehicle instruction to a first vehicle; when the first vehicle performs an action, inferring whether the action is in response to the first vehicle instruction; and based on the inference, transmitting a second vehicle instruction with a compensation action to a second vehicle.
assignee: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing North America, Inc.

title: Molded body, downhole tool member, and downhole tool
abstract: Provided is a molded body that has an improved thickness reduction rate after a thickness reduction of 5 mm or greater from its initial thickness, while maintaining tensile strength. The molded body of the present invention includes a glycolic acid polymer, a cyclic ester, a basic metal oxide and a carboxylic anhydride. A content of the cyclic ester is 21 parts by mass or less when a total mass of the glycolic acid polymer, the cyclic ester, the basic metal oxide, and the carboxylic anhydride is 100 parts by mass. The shortest interparticle distance of the basic metal oxide is 9.1 μm or less.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes an insulation layer and a first electrode pattern. The first electrode pattern includes a first body portion and a first step portion. The first body portion has a first surface facing the insulation layer, a second surface located opposite to the first surface, and a first side surface. The first step portion has a third surface facing the insulation layer, and a first step surface located opposite to the third surface. A boundary between the second surface and the first side surface is defined as a first boundary. A boundary between the first side surface and the first step surface is defined as a second boundary. In a cross section perpendicular to the second surface, a length of the first side surface is longer than a length of a line segment connecting the first boundary and the second boundary.

title: System and method for presence and pulse detection from wireless signals
abstract: Systems and methods for detecting and monitoring human breathing, respiration, and heart rate using statistics about the wireless channel between two or more connected devices. A user is monitored for identifying patterns in the user's behavior allowing the system to alert a caregiver to deviations in the user behavior that may be indicative of a potential issue, such as depression. User presence may be detected in a sensing area through the detection of spectral components in the breathing frequency range of comprises user includes transforming phase difference between spatial streams and amplitude of the samples representing frequency response of the channel for any frequency value into frequency domain to perform frequency analysis. Statistical analysis may be performed on the frequency space provided by the transformation. Micro motions may also be detected by detecting presence in a sensing area through the detection of spectral components in the micro motion frequency range.

title: Display device and electronic device including the same
abstract: A display device includes a pixel circuit, a gate driver, a data driver which applies a data voltage to the display panel and a voltage generator which applies a driving voltage to the display panel. The pixel circuit includes a driving transistor which generates a driving current based on the data voltage and a light emitting element which emits light based on the driving current. The driving voltage includes an initialization voltage applied to a control electrode of the driving transistor. The initialization voltage is changed based on a setting luminance of the display panel. When the initialization voltage is changed, the data voltage has a voltage level which is a sum of a setting data voltage level and an offset voltage level.

title: Asparaginase-based cancer therapy
abstract: The present invention relates to an improved preparation and delivery of asparaginase for use in medicine, e.g. in human and veterinary medicine. Aspects of the present invention may relate to an aqueous asparaginase preparation comprising monomeric asparaginase in urea, wherein the urea is in a concentration of 4 mol/L to 6 mol/L. The asparaginase may be an asparaginase produced in a bacterial cell (e.g.,  Escherichia coli  or  Dickeya dadantii ). The urea is in a concentration of 5 mol/L. The asparaginase may be a recombinant asparaginase. Aspects of the present invention may relate to a method for the treatment of cancer comprising administering a therapeutically effective amount of monomeric asparaginase in a chaotropic agent to a subject in need thereof.

title: Semiconductor device package assemblies having a pre-applied thermally conductive adhesive
abstract: In a general aspect, a semiconductor device package can include a die attach paddle having a first surface and a second surface that is opposite the first surface; a semiconductor die coupled with the first surface of the die attach paddle, and a direct-bonded-metal (DBM) substrate The DBM substrate can include a ceramic layer having a first surface and a second surface that is opposite the first surface, a first metal layer disposed on the first surface of the ceramic layer and coupled with the second surface of the die attach paddle, a second metal layer disposed on the second surface of the ceramic layer, and a thermally conductive adhesive disposed on the second metal layer, At least a surface of the thermally conductive adhesive can be exposed external to the device package. The thermally conductive adhesive can be configured for coupling the device package with a thermal dissipation appliance.

title: Secondary battery and electric apparatus
abstract: A secondary battery includes an electrode assembly which includes a positive electrode sheet, a negative electrode sheet, and a separator. The positive electrode sheet includes a positive electrode current collector and a positive electrode active material layer. The positive electrode active material layer includes a positive electrode active material. The negative electrode sheet includes a negative electrode current collector and a negative electrode active material layer. The negative electrode active material layer includes a negative electrode active material. The positive electrode current collector as a whole extends to form a plurality of positive electrode tabs, and the negative electrode current collector as a whole extends to form a plurality of negative electrode tabs. A coating weight of the positive electrode active material layer is W z , a coating weight of the negative electrode active material layer is W f , and W z  and W f  satisfy: 1.6W f ≤W z ≤2.2W f , and 3.25 mg/cm 2 ≤W f ≤5.84 mg/cm 2 .

title: Ultrasound diagnostic apparatus and control method of ultrasound diagnostic apparatus
abstract: An ultrasound diagnostic apparatus and a control method of an ultrasound diagnostic apparatus that enable a user to easily use information stored in a tag of an ultrasound image are provided. An ultrasound diagnostic apparatus ( 1 ) displays an ultrasound image on which a breast schema image showing a position of an ultrasound probe ( 2 ) in imaging is superimposed, and includes a text information conversion unit ( 17 ) that converts the position of the ultrasound probe ( 2 ) plotted on the breast schema image into text information, and a text information storage unit ( 18 ) that stores the text information converted by the text information conversion unit ( 17 ) in a tag attached to the ultrasound image.

title: Systems and methods for adaptive probe response
abstract: Systems and methods for providing adaptive probe responses may be provided. An Access Point (AP) may receive a new probe response configuration, and compare the new probe response configuration to an old probe response configuration. The AP may determine that AP is operating in an ignore, a duplicate, or a hybrid mode based on the comparison of the new probe response configuration to the old probe response configuration. The AP may determine one or more probe response structures using the new probe response configuration and/or the old probe response configuration based on the mode the AP is operating in. When the AP receives a probe request from a Station (STA), the AP may send one or more probe responses in the probe response structures based the mode the AP is operating in.

title: Deposition apparatus and electronic device including display panel manufactured by shadow mask of the deposition apparatus
abstract: A deposition apparatus includes a mounting stage, a first fixing chuck disposed on the mounting stage, a mask support attached on the first fixing chuck and defining at least one opening hole therein, a shadow mask disposed on the mask support and defining at least one mask hole therein, a support unit disposed on the mounting stage and supporting a lower portion of the mask support, and a second fixing chuck disposed on the support unit and to which a lower portion of the mask is attached, and the support unit may be  adjusting a flatness of the mask support.

title: Display device and driving method therefor, and display apparatus
abstract: A display device includes: a light absorption layer and a liquid crystal element layer, the liquid crystal element layer including at least two stacked liquid crystal elements. Each liquid crystal element includes: a first substrate, a reflective liquid crystal layer and a second substrate. When the reflective liquid crystal layer of one liquid crystal element of the adjacent liquid crystal elements is in a reflective state, light reflected by the liquid crystal elements at least includes left-handed polarized light; and when the reflective liquid crystal layer of the other liquid crystal element of the adjacent liquid crystal elements is in the reflective state, light reflected by the liquid crystal elements at least comprises right-handed polarized light.
assignee: Chongqing Boe Smart Electronics System Co.,Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.; Beijing Boe Technology Development Co., Ltd.

title: Formulations and Applications of Feruloyl Glycerides
abstract: Formulations with feruloyl glycerides yield novel enhancements to improve SPF of sunscreens, offer enhanced protection of active ingredients and therapeutic agents from UV light and serve as an antioxidant. These agents have the advantage of being synthesized from natural materials, while providing a value-added use for vegetable oils. They are readily applied to sunscreen, lotion, haircare, suncare, personal care, pharmaceutical and industrial formulations.

title: Systems and methods of generating a route
abstract: In some embodiments, an electronic device receives a gesture starting from a first location of a map area to a second location of the map area and in response, the electronic device generates a route from a first respective location to a second respective location. In some embodiments, generating the route is based on one or more attributes of a movement portion of the gesture from the first location to the second location and map data.

title: Clearcoat coating materials for plastic parts
abstract: Disclosed herein is an protic solvent-based two-pack clearcoat coating material, including: a master batch component including one or more poly(meth)acrylate polyols A, the poly(meth)acrylate polyols A having a hydroxyl value in the range from 160 to 240 mg KOH/g and a weight-average molecular weight in the range from 1000 to 7000 g/mol; and one or more catalysts C for crosslinking hydroxyl groups with free isocyanate groups; and including a hardener component including one or more curing agents B selected from the group consisting of diisocyanates and polyisocyanates; and one or more organic solvents, which can be contained in the master batch component, the hardener component, or in the master batch component and in the hardener component. Also described herein are a method of coating substrates with the coating material and a method of using the coating material in coating substrates.

title: Optical communication assembly, optical communication device, and optical communication system
abstract: Embodiments of this application disclose an optical communication assembly, which is used in the field of optical communication and the field of optical fiber communication. The optical communication assembly includes an optical transmitter and a first pigtail. The optical transmitter is connected to the first pigtail. The first pigtail is connected to a first optical fiber via a first optical connector. The first pigtail is a plastic optical fiber. The first optical fiber is a glass optical fiber. The optical transmitter is configured to: generate a first optical signal, and transmit the first optical signal to another optical communication assembly through the first pigtail and the first optical fiber.

title: Conditional layer 1 (l1) measurements
abstract: Some embodiments include a system, apparatus, article of manufacture, method, and/or computer program product and/or combinations and sub-combinations thereof, for conditional layer 1 (L1) measurements. Some embodiments include a user equipment (UE) that can receive a configuration signal including an activation/deactivation condition for conditional layer 1 (L1) measurements, and determine that the activation/deactivation condition is satisfied for a target cell. The UE can activate/deactivate a conditional L1 measurement corresponding to the target cell. In some embodiments, responsive to an activated conditional L1 measurement satisfying a threshold value, the UE can initiate a cell switch to the target cell. In some embodiments, the activation/deactivation is based on a layer 3 (L3) measurement corresponding to the target cell, a location of the UE, or a determined time corresponding to the UE.

title: Nitride Semiconductor Photoelectrode and Method for Manufacturing the Same
abstract: A nitride semiconductor photoelectrode including: a conductive membrane formed on a substrate; and a polycrystalline nitride semiconductor membrane formed on the conductive membrane and having lattice distortion of 0.35% or less. The polycrystalline nitride semiconductor membrane has a surface irradiated in an aqueous solution with light opposed to the surface to cause a redox reaction.

title: Depolymerization of cross-linked polyethylene
abstract: A method for producing a cracker feedstock by depolymerizing plastic waste material made from or containing cross-linked polyethylene. A method for producing a cracker feedstock by depolymerizing a polymeric waste material comprising crosslinked polyethylene (PEX), comprising the steps of: (i) introducing the waste material into a pyrolysis reactor; (ii) mixing the waste material with a depolymerization catalyst comprising an acidic compound; (iii) depolymerizing the waste material in an oxygen-free atmosphere at a temperature ranging from 400 to 590° C., thereby obtaining a gaseous depolymerization product; and (iv) collecting and condensing at least part of the gaseous depolymerization product, thereby obtaining the cracker feedstock.

title: Charged particle beam device and deposition method
abstract: A charged particle beam device includes a chamber configured to accommodate a target; a first beam generator configured to irradiate the target with a charged particle beam in a first direction; a first nozzle configured to introduce a first gas to the chamber for depositing a material on the target, the first nozzle extending toward a first position on the target being irradiated with the charged particle beam; and a second nozzle configured to introduce a rare gas to the chamber, the second nozzle extending toward a second position above the first position.

title: Nr pdcch search space configuration
abstract: Various embodiments disclosed herein provide for a method and apparatus to configure different User Specific Search spaces (USSs) for Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) candidates for different User Equipment devices (UEs). By selecting different USS configurations for different UEs, the search spaces can cover fewer symbols that there can be more PDCCH candidates in each symbol. By configuring each UE with a selected USS, the PDCCH capacity can be improved by optimizing Control Channel Element (CCE) utilization and improving downlink capacity by increasing the number of symbols used for Physical Downlink Shared Channel (PDSCH) use.

title: Virtual assistant and voice integration for power machines
abstract: A virtual assistant and voice-commands may be implemented to control power machines. Additionally, on-site training or assessment functionality may be implemented with respect to power machines such that an operator’s capabilities in operating power machines may be determined.

title: Scheduling apparatus, control method, and control program
abstract: A scheduling apparatus includes: a scheduling apparatus that schedules functions executed by a plurality of vehicle-mounted control apparatuses that communicate with each other via a communication bus, an acquisition unit that acquires first information, which determines first execution start timing, and a first execution period, which is a period at which the first function is executed, and second information, which determines a second execution start timing; and a determination unit that determines, based on the first information and the second information, the first execution start timing, the first execution period, the second execution start timing, and the second execution period, which minimize total power consumption of the first vehicle-mounted control apparatus, the second vehicle-mounted control apparatus, and the third vehicle-mounted control apparatus.
assignee: Autonetworks Technologies, Ltd.; Sumitomo Wiring Systems, Ltd.; Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd.

title: Printable gamma prime superalloys
abstract: A nickel-based alloy composition for additive manufacturing and an additive manufacturing component made from the nickel-based alloy, which includes: 36-89 wt. % nickel; 4-9 wt. % aluminum; 6-14 wt. % cobalt; 4-26 wt. % chromium; 2-5 wt. % tantalum; and 3-13 wt. % tungsten. The nickel-based alloy composition provides an additive manufacturing component having a cracking density of less than 4.0 cracks/mm 2 .

title: Dual-helix quantum architecture for accelerated quantum workload execution
abstract: A computer-implemented method for executing an artificial intelligence task on a quantum computing architecture may include obtaining computational elements associated with the artificial intelligence task. The method may also include determining similarity relationships among the computational elements based on at least one of statistical similarity, interaction frequency, connectivity strength, spatial adjacency within a data representation, or graph-based correlation metrics. The method may further include providing a quantum computing architecture comprising quantum nodes arranged along two intertwined helices, each quantum node being associated with an angular position along a helical path and assigning the computational elements to the quantum nodes based on the similarity relationships such that computational elements having higher similarity are assigned to quantum nodes having smaller angular separation along at least one of the intertwined helices. The method may further include executing quantum gate operations associated with the artificial intelligence task between quantum nodes.

title: Systems and Methods for Auto-Generation of Ion List
abstract: A method for determining a composition of a sample utilizing mass spectrometry includes introducing a plurality of sample ions, obtaining a plurality of mass spectra including a sample introduction mass spectrum associated with the sample introduction event, identifying a set of background signals, identifying a set of sample ion signals by removing background ions, and deriving, from the set of sample ion signals, an ion list corresponding to the composition of the sample.

title: Methods of making bempedoic acid and compositions of the same
abstract: The invention provides methods of preparing 8-hydroxy-2,2,14,14-tetramethylpentadecanedioic acid and methods of making a pharmaceutical material comprising a purified amount of 8-hydroxy-2,2,14,14-tetramethylpentadecanedioic acid. Also provided are compositions and pharmaceutical materials including a purified amount of 8-hydroxy-2,2,14,14-tetramethylpentadecanedioic acid as well as methods of treating various diseases and conditions using the compositions and pharmaceutical materials.

title: Boronic acid derivatives and therapeutic uses thereof
abstract: Disclosed herein are antimicrobial compounds compositions, pharmaceutical compositions, the method of use and preparation thereof. Some embodiments relate to boronic acid derivatives and their use as therapeutic agents, for example, β-lactamase inhibitors (BLIs).

title: Pivoting drinkware closure with magnetic device mount
abstract: A drinkware closure assembly includes a housing with a socket portion and a coupling base portion that engages a beverage container. A ball seated within the socket portion forms a multi-axis articulation joint. A mounting platform has a tapered neck coupled to the ball, the neck narrowing toward the ball, a mounting surface for receiving a mobile device or accessory, and a magnetic module. The ball-and-socket joint allows the mounting platform to be repositioned in multiple axes while the beverage container remains stationary. A central structural core extends through at least a portion of the mounting platform, tapered neck, and ball, transferring tensile loads toward the coupling base portion. A fluid control seal separates a mechanical zone of the articulation assembly from a fluid zone of the coupling base portion. The coupling base portion may include an offset straw port or a clean-core hydration configuration.

title: Ejaculation-promoting device
abstract: The disclosure relates to an ejaculatory stimulation device for medical semen collection and personal-use hygiene applications. Conventional devices may be prone to accidental detachment during operation and may be inconvenient to disassemble for cleaning or replacement. The device includes a drive assembly with an exterior contact surface and a detachable movable assembly having a massage member with a massage channel, where the movable assembly reciprocates along a first direction aligned with an inserted phallic structure to provide frictional stimulation, and is released from the drive assembly by movement in a different second direction, such as rotation, while remaining outside the housing. This arrangement can improve operational stability, facilitate removal and maintenance, and help reduce liquid ingress into the drive assembly.

title: Silicon nitride etching composition and method
abstract: Compositions useful for the selective removal of silicon nitride materials relative to polysilicon, silicon oxide materials and/or silicide materials from a microelectronic device having same thereon are provided. The compositions of the invention are particularly useful in the etching of 3D NAND structures.

title: Nickel-Based Alloy Powder for Lamination Molding and Lamination Molded Body
abstract: A powder for metal additive manufacturing having excellent high-temperature strength and cracking resistance and an additively manufactured article having excellent high-temperature strength produced using the powder for additive manufacturing. The mixed powder for additive manufacturing includes: a Ni-based alloy powder containing, as a chemical component, at least one or two of and Ti in a range of 0.5 mass %≤(Al+½Ti)≤2.8 mass %; and oxide nanoparticles attached to a surface of the Ni-based alloy powder.

title: Semiconductor structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A semiconductor structure including a carrier wafer structure and transistor wafer structures is provided. The transistor wafer structures are stacked on the carrier wafer structure. Each of the transistor wafer structures includes a transistor wafer, a first bonding layer, and a second bonding layer. The transistor wafer has a first side and a second side opposite to each other. The first bonding layer is located on the first side of the transistor wafer. The second bonding layer is located on the second side of the transistor wafer. The first bonding layer of one of two adjacent transistor wafer structures is bonded to the second bonding layer of the other of the two adjacent transistor wafer structures.

title: Optical system, optical device, and method for manufacturing optical system
abstract: An optical system includes a first optical system including, in order from the object side, a front lens group, an optical path splitter having a splitting plane, and a first rear lens group on which light that enters the front lens group and the optical path splitter and that is reflected by the splitting plane is incident. The optical system further includes a second optical system including, in order from the object side, the front lens group, the optical path splitter, and a second rear lens group on which light that enters the front lens group and the optical path splitter and that is transmitted through the splitting plane is incident. The second optical system is configured to have a total focal length different from a total focal length of the first optical system.

title: Intelligent notification delivery
abstract: Disclosed herein are techniques related to intelligent notification delivery. In some embodiments, the techniques may involve receiving context data associated with a change in a condition of a subject. Furthermore, the techniques may involve selecting, from a plurality of candidate recipients, a recipient to be notified of the change. The recipient may be selected based on applying an artificial intelligence model to the change. The techniques may also involve generating first tailored data based on tailoring the context data to qualifications of the selected recipient for responding to the change. Additionally, the techniques may involve generating a notification to be communicated to the selected recipient. The notification may include the first tailored data. The techniques may further involve communicating the first notification toward the selected recipient.

title: Systems, Methods, And Storage Media For Conducting Security Penetration Testing
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer-readable media are disclosed herein that conduct security penetration testing. In accordance with embodiments, a security extension is run in a web browser in order to record a user interface workflow and to generate a test script of the user interface workflow. The test script is executed in an application in order to perform penetration testing of the user interface workflow, in some embodiments. Based on the outcomes of the penetration testing, a security report may be generated in order to identify one or more security vulnerabilities in the user interface workflow.

title: Powered fastener driver
abstract: A powered fastener driver including: a housing; a nosepiece extending from the housing; a driver blade movable within the nosepiece; a piston coupled to the driver blade for movement therewith; a driver cylinder within which the piston is movable from a top dead center position (TDC) and a bottom dead center (BDC) position; a magazine coupled to the nosepiece in which collated fasteners are receivable; a fastener delivery mechanism coupled to the nosepiece for individually transferring collated fasteners in the magazine to a fastener driving channel in the nosepiece, the fastener delivery mechanism movable between a fastener retrieval position and a fastener delivered position in which a fastener of the collated fasteners is properly loaded into the fastener driving channel; and a sensor for determining when a position of the fastener delivery mechanism is in the fastener delivered position.

title: Packaging structure, packaging method, chip stacking structure and electronic device
abstract: A packaging structure includes a first chip and a second chip stacked with the first chip, and the first chip has a first element. An active surface of the second chip is arranged opposite to an active surface of the first chip. The second chip includes a shielding element arranged on one side of the second chip close to the first chip, and the shielding element is configured for reducing signal interference from the second chip to the first element.

title: Methods of estimating blood glucose and related systems
abstract: A method includes estimating a value of a parameter indicative of an age or lifespan of a population of red blood cells of a subject, estimating a value of average glucose (AG) of the subject based on (i) the value of the parameter and (ii) a value indicative of an amount of glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) of the subject, and providing information for treatment or diagnosis of a hyperglycemia condition of the subject based on the estimated value of AG.

title: Image coding method and image coding apparatus based on intra coding
abstract: An image decoding method according to an embodiment of the disclosure includes deriving a reference stack motion vector (MV) for a current block, based on neighboring blocks of the current block, deriving an MV for the current block, based on the reference stack MV, and generating prediction samples of the current block, based on the MV for the current block and a reference frame, wherein the reference frame is a current frame including the current block.

title: Methods and compositions for cleaning
abstract: The present disclosure is directed towards compositions and methods for cleaning. More specifically, the present disclosure relates to compositions and methods for mitigating malodors associated with items, such as but not limited to, a textile or machine, wherein the machine is a laundry machine or a dishwasher.
assignee: Danisco Us Inc.; International Flavors & Fragrances

title: Refrigerator
abstract: A refrigerator in which an internal storage structure is changeable. The refrigerator comprises a main body; a storage chamber; and a plurality of seating portions on a side wall of the storage chamber along a height direction, and to which a first cover or a second cover is selectively coupleable. The first cover comprises a rail formed in the depth direction of the storage compartment to guide a storage box to be introduced into and withdrawn from the storage chamber, a fastening members coupleable to a groove among a plurality of fastening grooves formed in the seating portions, a stopper which at least partially protrudes in the height direction from the passage of the rail; and a latch which is arranged in an opening formed in the stopper and configured so that a hooking portion is fixable to and releasable from a hooking ledge provided on the seating portion.

title: Hot work tool steel powder for additive manufacturing and additively manufactured hot work tool steel object
abstract: Provided is hot work tool steel powder for additive manufacturing with which an additively manufactured hot work tool steel object having excellent crack resistance during manufacturing can be manufactured. The hot work tool steel powder for additive manufacturing and the additively manufactured hot work tool steel object comprise: 0.10% to 0.25% both inclusive of C, 0.01% to 0.5% both inclusive of Si, 1.5% or less of Mn, 3.0% to 6.0% both inclusive of Cr, 2.0% to 3.5% both inclusive of one or two of Mo and W according to a relational expression (Mo+½W), 0.3% to 0.7% both inclusive of V, 0% to 0.5% both inclusive of Ni, 0% to 0.25% both inclusive of Cu by mass, and the balance being Fe and unavoidable impurities; and satisfy an equation (1): C+Si/30+(Mn+Cr+Cu)/20+Ni/60+(Mo+½W)/15+V/10≤0.75.

title: Muscle mass measurement system and muscle mass measurement method using same
abstract:
The present invention relates to a system for measuring a muscle mass of a specific muscle. The system receives a plurality of MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) tomographic images acquired by scanning along a single axis of a muscle to be measured, calculates a location, contour, and fat fraction of the muscle to be measured based on the images, and ultimately calculates a volume excluding fat of the muscle to be measured.
