     Accordingly, the time required for measuring muscle mass can be reduced, and a measurement result close to an actual value can be obtained.

title: 3d chip package based on through-silicon-via interconnection elevator
abstract: A chip package includes a first interconnection scheme; a plurality of first metal contacts under and on the first interconnection scheme and at a bottom surface of the chip package; a first semiconductor IC chip over the first interconnection scheme; a first connector over the first interconnection scheme and at a same horizontal level as the first semiconductor IC chip, wherein the first connector comprises a first substrate and a plurality of first through vias vertically extending through the first substrate of the first connector; a first polymer layer over the first interconnection scheme, wherein the first polymer layer has a top surface coplanar with a top surface of the first semiconductor IC chip, a top surface of the first substrate of the first connector and a top surface of each of the plurality of first through vias; and a second interconnection scheme on the top surface of the first polymer layer, the top surface of the first semiconductor IC chip, the top surface of the first connector and the top surface of each of the plurality of first through vias, wherein the second interconnection scheme comprises a plurality of second metal contacts at a top surface of the chip package.

title: Apportioning data center compute power
abstract: The present invention provides a method and apparatus for a thinking system using an ASI distributed Application State Machine that connects to real, accurate, dedicated absolute data, providing privacy, security, and eliminating hallucinated AI. Specifically, one embodiment of the present invention discloses an ASI Command, Control, Communications and Computer Intelligence (C4I) system for independent, intelligent AI Prompting and ASI Browsing. The ASI Application State Machine comprises: ASI Application data structure network; ASI Enterprise Interface State Machine, said data structures interfacing with a back-end channel, a Finite State Machine embedded in each data structure; and Application Service Information Base providing a uniform interface for ASI Application data structure identities. Additional embodiments disclose ASI Browser displaying ASI Applications; ASI Agents; ASI Application Network Nodes; ASI Operating System; ASI Switch; ASI Database of real, accurate, dedicated absolute data, for Machine Learning to train AI Models, for performing real-time, bi-directional transactions, connecting to billing.

title: Method for generating blood pressure measurement scheme, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract: A wearable device ( 100 ) obtains one or more of user information, physiological data, and a device status. The wearable device generates a blood pressure measurement scheme based on one or more of the user information, the physiological data, and the device status, where the blood pressure measurement scheme includes one or more of the following: a start moment of blood pressure measurement, an end moment of blood pressure measurement, a duration of blood pressure measurement, a quantity of times of blood pressure measurement within the duration of blood pressure measurement, a time interval between two adjacent times of blood pressure measurement within the duration of blood pressure measurement, and a total quantity of times of blood pressure measurement.

title: Methods and apparatus for multiplexing and demultiplexing optical signals of protected optics
abstract: An optical apparatus may include a set of primary optical transceivers configured to generate a set of primary wavelengths and one or more redundant optical transceivers configured to generate a set of replacement wavelengths. The optical apparatus may include a multiplexer coupled to the primary and redundant optical transceivers via first protection optics. The first protection optics may be configured to replace a primary wavelength from a primary optical transceiver with a replacement wavelength from the one or more redundant optical transceivers when the primary optical transceiver fails. The optical apparatus may include a demultiplexer coupled to the primary and redundant optical transceivers via second protection optics. The second protection optics may be configured to forward a wavelength from the wavelength demultiplexer to one of the one or more redundant optical transceivers instead of one of the primary optical transceivers when the one of the primary optical transceivers fails.

title: Memory system
abstract: According to one embodiment, a memory system includes a semiconductor memory device and a control device. The control device instructs write operations and erase operations. In a write operation, write loops involving supplying a program voltage to a conductive layer are performed. The program voltage is increased for each subsequent write loop in the write operation. In an erase operation, a plurality of erase loops are performed, each including supplying an erase voltage then an erase verification operation. The semiconductor memory device outputs data corresponding to an erase verification operation result to the control device. Whenever executing a write operation, the control device transmits data indicating an initial program voltage to be used in the write operation based on the erase verification operation result.

title: Micro puree machine
abstract: The present application relates to the technical field of food processors, and in particular, to a micro puree machine. A bowl piece is mounted on a fixed platform, the bowl piece is provided with an accommodating cavity for food, and the bowl piece is provided with an extrusion port communicated with the accommodating cavity. An extrusion element is movably arranged in the accommodating cavity, so as to force the food in the accommodating cavity to be extruded from the extrusion port. The bowl piece is provided with an air channel in communication with the accommodating cavity. Airflow enters the accommodating cavity through the air channel to push the extrusion element to move from a first position to a second position, so as to force the food in the accommodating cavity to be extruded from the extrusion port. A moving platform is movably arranged relative to the fixed platform.
assignee: Guangdong Link Plus Technology Group Co., Ltd

title: Fused bicyclic compounds as vrk1 inhibitors
abstract:
Disclosed are compounds of Formula (I): 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, and methods of using the compounds for treatment of cancer and inhibiting VRK1, as well as pharmaceutical compositions comprising such compounds.

title: Communication method and apparatus
abstract: Embodiments of this disclosure provide a communication method and apparatus, and relate to the field of communication technologies. The method includes: A first communication apparatus receives first traffic-associated information transmitted through a first path, and adjusts (or determines), based on the first traffic-associated information, a first service processing policy corresponding to a first service. Because the first path is a path for transmitting a service flow, the first communication apparatus can obtain the first traffic-associated information earlier, so that the first communication apparatus can adjust the first service processing policy in a more timely manner.

title: Light emitting display apparatus
abstract: A light emitting display apparatus including a light emitting device layer configured on a substrate and including a first electrode, an emission part, and a second electrode; a scattering layer configured on the second electrode; and a protective layer configured on the scattering layer is provided. The scattering layer scatters emitted light, improving luminance viewing angle characteristics and light extraction. Improved light extraction allows for lower power consumption to achieve a desired luminance.

title: System for blending a fragrance
abstract: The system includes a generative AI unit, a scent blending unit, a user interface unit, and a database unit, and receives an image of a scent from a user as input. The generative AI unit analyzes the input using natural language processing technology and extracts keywords related to the scent. The database unit stores fragrance materials corresponding to these keywords and is referred to when the AI determines the scent components.

title: Curved roller process for pre-stretched film
abstract: The present disclosure seeks to address technical problems associated with the application of film to curved surfaces by providing for systems and methods for pre-stretching film. A system for pre-stretching film includes an intermediate roller to receive film from a starting cylindrical roll of film, stretch the film as the film passes over the intermediate roller, and provide the film to a final non-cylindrical roll that stores the film in a pre-stretched condition. The pre-stretched film is stored on the final non-cylindrical roll, which is detachable from the system, until the application of the pre-stretched film to a curved surface. The pre-stretched film is pre-stretched to fit on the curved surface.

title: Compounds and compositions for treating conditions associated with calcitonin receptor and/or amylin receptor activity
abstract: The present disclosure provides compounds for modulating calcitonin receptor and/or amylin receptor activity, as well as pharmaceutical compositions comprising the compounds disclosed herein. Also provided are methods for treating a calcitonin receptor and/or amylin receptor associated disease or disorder.

title: Method for determining intestinal permeability
abstract: The present invention relates to an in vitro method for evaluating the state of intestinal permeability of a subject and, consequently, for the diagnosis of diseases or dysfunctions associated with intestinal hyper-permeability. More specifically, the procedure allows measuring using a common food component the amount of dietary antigen that can traverse a dysfunctional intestine. The procedure allows for the development of analytical products and processes within the framework of the medical devices industry.

title: Smart in-frame bicycle backbone
abstract: A smart in-frame bicycle backbone includes a control circuit disposed within a top tube of a bicycle frame, the control circuit including at least one processor, a memory storing instructions, and at least one antenna, a wiring bus routed within the bicycle frame and operatively coupled to the control circuit to distribute electrical power and data to electronic components of the bicycle, and an energy harvester mounted to the top tube and electrically coupled to the control circuit, wherein the control circuit is configured to (i) communicate with a smart device, (ii) provide power and data communication over the wiring bus to the electronic components, and (iii) execute one or more instructions to provide at least one of security monitoring, event detection, ride monitoring, maintenance prediction, or firmware management for the bicycle.

title: Access control management
abstract: Techniques are described for managing access permissions and entitlements associated with entities in a computing environment. A lifecycle or operational criterion associated with an entity is determined to have occurred. Based at least in part on information associated with the entity, a template identifying one or more actions associated with modifying access to one or more computing resources is generated.

title: Porous transport layer
abstract: A porous transport layer for an electrolyser or for a fuel cell, comprising —a first nonwoven layer of metal fibers provided for contacting a proton exchange membrane, wherein the first nonwoven layer of metal fibers comprises metal fibers of a first equivalent diameter, wherein the first nonwoven layer of metal fibers has a first surface roughness and a first porosity, —a second nonwoven layer of metal fibers, wherein the second nonwoven layer of metal fibers comprises metal fibers of a second equivalent diameter, wherein the second nonwoven layer of metal fibers has a second surface roughness and a second porosity, wherein the first surface has a material ratio of less than 5% of material at a height of 5 μm, and more than 70% of material at a depth of −5 μm, the first equivalent diameter is smaller than the second equivalent diameter.

title: Display device, electronic device, and method for manufacturing display device
abstract: Provided are a display device, an electronic device, and a method for manufacturing display device. A display device may include a substrate including a through hole and a display area surrounding the through hole; a display layer including a thin film transistor layer on the substrate, a light emitting element layer on the thin film transistor layer, an encapsulation layer on the light emitting element layer, and a sensor electrode layer on the encapsulation layer; a planarization film on the display layer; and a barrier dam between the display layer and the through hole. The planarization film may be on an upper portion of the display layer and inside a valley disposed between a side portion of the display layer and the barrier dam.

title: Video coding and decoding methods and apparatuses, computer-readable medium, and electronic device
abstract: The present application provides a video decoding method performed by an electronic device. The method includes: obtaining a coded video bitstream; decoding the video bitstream to obtain a residual signal of a current block; determining a predicted signal of the current block based on the video bitstream; determining a reconstructed signal of the current block based on the residual signal and the predicted signal; determining statistical information of the residual signal of the current block; comparing the statistical information with a first threshold to obtain a comparison result; and determining whether to perform loop filtering processing on the reconstructed signal based on the comparison result. For each block in each image frame, loop filtering processing is adaptively enabled based on a comparison result between statistical information of a residual signal of the block and a first threshold, thereby effectively reducing decoding complexity, and further improving coding/decoding efficiency.

title: System and method for data collection for a personal ai assistant
abstract: A computer-implemented method for managing household information comprises receiving documents and data from multiple sources including user uploads, API connections, and advisor pre-population, then processing documents through a knowledge processing pipeline comprising classification, extraction, refinement, and synthesis stages executed by specialized LLM-based agents. The method populates domain-specific analytics tables organized by household identifier using a three-phase process: direct field mapping, retrieval-augmented generation enrichment, and cross-document synthesis, wherein each phase executes as separate database transaction providing failure isolation and progressive enrichment. The method supports flexible deployment configurations including business-to-consumer wherein consumers directly populate household data, business-to-business-to-consumer wherein advisors pre-populate client household data before client access, and hybrid configurations enabling transitions between deployment models. The method enables conversational querying via retrieval-augmented generation combining document embeddings and structured analytics, generates comprehensive holistic planning reports with LLM-generated observations and provenance tracking, and supports management of multiple distinct households with independent encryption keys.

title: Intelligent blending system
abstract: A blending system is provided for contextual blending. The blending system may include an ingredient component and a recipe component. The ingredient component may identify ingredients and determine a quantity of each type of ingredient. The recipe component may create a recipe based on the identified ingredients and the determined quantities of the ingredients. The recipe may include instructions for controlling a blender device.

title: Garment that provides assistance during a leg motion
abstract: A garment configured to provide assistance during a leg motion includes a body portion configured to be worn over a pelvic area of a wearer and at least one portion configured to extend over a wearer's leg. The garment supports a framework including a structured waistband and one or more elastic assistance structures arranged along different paths corresponding to different lower-body anatomical areas of the wearer. The one or more elastic assistance structures may include elastic bands, integrated elastic band sets, removable elastic band sets, or combinations thereof. One or more of the elastic assistance structures may be configured to stretch during a first movement of a leg and to release stored potential energy during a second movement of the leg to assist at least one of movement and stabilization of a hip joint, a knee joint, or both.

title: Semiconductor device and method of forming the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a first conductive layer, a memory layer, a second conductive layer and a selector layer. The memory layer surrounds the first conductive layer. The second conductive layer faces the memory layer. The selector layer is disposed on the second conductive layer and faces the memory layer. A first side of the second conductive layer is covered by the selector layer.

title: Method for writing to magnetic random access memory
abstract: A method of manufacturing an array of magnetic random access memory cells includes writing to a magnetic random access memory cell. The writing to a memory cell includes determining an optimum write current for the array of memory cells, and applying the optimum write current to a first memory cell in the array. A first read current is applied to the first memory cell to determine whether a magnetic orientation of the first memory cell has changed in response to applying the optimum write current. A second write current is applied to the first memory cell when the magnetic orientation of the first memory cell has not changed. The second write current is different from the optimum write current. A second read current is applied to the first memory cell to determine whether the magnetic orientation of the first memory cell changed in response to applying the second write current.

title: Trash intercepting and sediment barrier device
abstract: Provided is a trash intercepting and sediment barrier device. The trash intercepting and sediment barrier device includes a frame, a sediment collecting device, an intercepting device and a hoisting device. The intercepting device includes a float, an intercepting net and a sediment barrier plate. The float is fixed on the frame. An upper end of the intercepting net is connected to the float. A lower end of the intercepting net is connected with a counterweight. An upper end of the sediment barrier plate is connected to the lower end of the intercepting net. The sediment barrier plate includes a plurality of sediment barrier plate units that are sequentially hinged along a height direction. The sediment collecting device includes a collecting tank. The collecting tank is arranged at a downstream side of the intercepting device. A side of the collecting tank facing an incoming flow is provided with an inlet.

title: Video coding
abstract: An example apparatus comprising: at least one processor; and at least one memory storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, cause the apparatus at least to perform: generating or defining an exact match syntax flag for indicating whether an exact match of a decoded picture sample value in an object mask coded picture and an object mask picture sample value associated with an object mask identifier is required to associate a sample position with the object mask identifier, wherein the object mask picture sample value is described in an information message; and including the exact match syntax flag in the information message.

title: Automated electronic security system
abstract: An automated electronic security system that includes a digital security seal. The security seal may be coupled to a trailer, shipping container, or individual item. The security seal optionally communicates with a master control circuit in a trailer to notify a remote monitoring service when a seal is tampered with. The seal may communicate with a master control circuit via a trailer wiring system using an optional adapter to provide timely status updates. The real-time status of the seal may be monitored by the master control circuit. When the seal is damaged or broken, an alert may be sent to the monitoring service, which is optionally configured to send a notification to a remote monitoring service. The remote monitoring service optionally applies geographical boundary data and/or triggering rules to determine when an alert should be sent based on geographical locations.

title: Systems and methods for battery-assisted cooking in an oven range appliance
abstract: A cooking appliance including one or more electric heaters, a main power connection to a main supply of electrical power at a first voltage, an auxiliary power connection to a battery supply of electrical power at a second voltage, and a voltage controller for regulating the electrical power from the battery supply to at least one of the one or more electric heaters. A controller is configured to receive a call for heat from the one or more electric heaters, determine that a total requested battery power draw associated with the call for heat is greater than a battery power maximum threshold, calculate a reduced battery power draw that is less or equal to the battery power maximum threshold, and operate the voltage controller to supply the reduced battery power draw to the one or more electric heaters.

title: Cancer biomarkers and methods of use thereof
abstract: Embodiments are provided for characterizing a biological sample. In some embodiments, one can estimate the risk that a subject with ductal carcinoma in situ will have a subsequent DCIS event and/or invasive cancers.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California; Prelude Corporation; Yale University

title: Air heating apparatus
abstract: Disclosed is an air heating apparatus including an expansion tank which preserves water, a water heater which receives heat from a combustion gas generated through a combustion reaction and heats the water, a heating heat exchanger which receives the water heated by the water heater and exchanges heat with air that is to be discharged for heating, a fan which sends the air to the heating heat exchanger, and a case, in which the water heater, the expansion tank, the heating heat exchanger, and the fan are disposed in an interior thereof.

title: An Aerosol Generation Device
abstract: There is provided an aerosol generation device for releasably retaining a battery cell. The device may include an identification module and a controller. The identification module may be configured to obtain identification information of said battery cell when releasably retained in the device. The controller may be configured to control a function of the aerosol generation device based on the received identification information. The identification module may use a wireless communication protocol.

title: Training Speech Recognizers Based On Biased Transcriptions
abstract: A method includes receiving a biased transcription for a voice command spoken by a user and captured by a user device, the biased transcription biased to include a biasing phrase from a set of biasing phrases specific to the user. The method also includes instructing an application executing on the user device to perform an action specified by the biased transcription for the voice command, and receiving one or more user behavior signals responsive to the application performing the action specified by the biased transcription. The method further includes generating, as output from a confidence model, a confidence score of the biased transcription based on the one or more user behavior signals input to the confidence model and, based on the confidence score output from the confidence model, training a speech recognizer on the biased transcription.

title: Energy state based scheduling
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a wireless communication device may perform a first communication with a first tag, based at least in part on a first energy state or a first priority of the first tag, using a first communication configuration, wherein the first communication configuration indicates a first communication occasion for the first communication. The wireless communication device may perform a second communication with a second tag, based at least in part on a second energy state or a second priority of the second tag, using a second communication configuration, wherein the second communication configuration indicates a second communication occasion for the second communication. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Handle for rowing machine
abstract: The present invention relates to a handle ( 100 ) for a rowing machine. The handle ( 100 ) comprises one or more sensors for providing feedback of a performance of a rowing stroke by a user by measuring force applied to, and/or movement of the handle ( 100 ) during the rowing stroke. In some arrangements the handle ( 100 ) comprise a haptic module, that includes a vibration motor, for providing feedback to the user of the performance. The haptic module comprises one or more haptic elements that are arranged within the handle ( 100 ) to provide directional feedback to the user for applying a corrective movement of the handle ( 100 ).

title: Vehicle air conditioning system
abstract: A vehicle air conditioning system includes: a refrigerant flow path that circulates a refrigerant across a condenser and an evaporator; a coolant flow path through which a coolant that exchanges heat with the refrigerant in the condenser and the evaporator flows; and a heat exchanger that performs heat exchange between air and the coolant in order to cool and heat a vehicle interior.

title: Space vehicle imaging studio
abstract: Systems and methods for high performance, professional-grade photography and filmmaking in a spacecraft during space flights are provided. The systems may include an imaging studio, which is a partially enclosed volume within a spacecraft. The imaging studio may enable photography during microgravity coast phases of space flight while allowing astronauts to tend to non-photographic activities. The imaging studio may allow for commercially-valuable imagery that includes a background of an illuminated, curved Earth horizon. Imagery may also involve, among other things, a unique microgravity environment. Such imagery, without use of an imaging studio as described herein, may otherwise require artificial visual effects that may appear less realistic. Additionally, the novelty of capturing images during an actual space flight may itself be valuable.

title: Felting-based anchoring systems and methods of use thereof
abstract: Apparatus for use with tissue of a heart of a subject, the apparatus comprising a textile, a tether, and a tool. The tether extends through the textile. The tool is transluminally advanceable into the heart of the subject, and comprises, at a distal end thereof, multiple barbs. While the textile contacts the tissue, the multiple barbs are adapted to fix the textile to the tissue by repeatedly (i) moving distally through the textile and into the tissue to draw fibers of the textile into the tissue; and (ii) moving proximally out of the tissue and the textile, while leaving the fibers remaining within the tissue. Other embodiments are also described.

title: Semiconductor device manufacturing method, and semiconductor device
abstract: In a semiconductor device manufacturing method according to one embodiment, in a first process, a device layer formed on a semiconductor substrate is irradiated with a laser beam having abrasion effect along a dicing line, and a plurality of grooves having a depth that does not reach the semiconductor substrate is formed in the device layer. In a second process, the dicing line is cut using a cutting blade. An interval between grooves closest to each other from among the plurality of grooves formed in the first process is smaller than a width of the cutting blade, and an interval between grooves located at both ends from among the plurality of grooves is greater than the width of the cutting blade.

title: Method and apparatus for wireless communication
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods and apparatuses for wireless communication. According to some embodiments of the disclosure, a method may include transmitting, at a first user equipment (UE), a radio resource control (RRC) reconfiguration sidelink via relay message on a sidelink between the first UE and a second UE; and starting a timer associated with the RRC reconfiguration sidelink via relay message. The second UE may act as a relay node and may transfer the received message to a destination UE or base station. The destination UE or base station may respond to the first UE before a timer expires.

title: Immersive Supply Chain Analytics using Mixed Reality
abstract: A system and method are disclosed for a mixed-reality visualization system having a computer configured to render a mixed-reality three-dimensional surface, identify one or more current demand regions, identify one or more potential demand regions;, map the one or more current demand regions and the one or more potential demand regions on the rendered three-dimensional surface, model a free body coupled with demand centers of each of the one or more demand regions and each of the one or more potential demand regions using a spring model, calculate a location on the rendered three-dimensional surface representing an equilibrium position between the demand centers of the one or more demand regions and the one or more potential demand regions using the spring model, and render, for display on a rendering device, a visual indicator within the area corresponding to the location of the calculated equilibrium position.

title: Tie systems for sternal closure
abstract: An example tie assembly includes a needle, a tie, a plug, and a tether. The needle has a proximal end and a distal end. The tie extends from the proximal end of the needle. The plug has an axial bore therethrough. The tie is disposed within the axial bore. The tether tethering the plug to the proximal end of the needle. An additional plug threadable onto the tie of the tie assembly, wherein (a) a head of the additional plug includes at least one tether-receiving groove therein or (b) the additional plug comprises a surgical clip.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of Michigan

title: Data pipeline for cameras with multiple color channels
abstract: Provided are methods for processing raw data for sensors with multiple color channels, which can include receiving raw image data associated with an image sensor, wherein the raw image data includes a plurality of groups of pixels including a first group of pixels associated with a first filter and a second group of pixels associated with a second filter. The methods may also include generating, from the raw image data, a plurality of wavelength-based data groups including a first wavelength-based data group and a second wavelength-based data group. The first wavelength-based data group may include first pixels corresponding to the first group of pixels and the second wavelength-based data group may include second pixels corresponding to the second group of pixels. The methods may also include encoding the first wavelength-based data group and the second wavelength-based data group. Systems and computer program products are also provided.

title: Terminal handler for providing remote access to service devices to facilitate secure transactions
abstract: A terminal handler of a computing environment can provide remote access to Internet of Things (IoT) service devices positioned in a location associated with a service provider to facilitate secure transactions. For example, the terminal handler can receive, from a mobile device, a request to perform a function of an IoT service device. The particular IoT service device may include a near-field communication (NFC) token and receiving the request may include detecting a tap gesture between the mobile device and the NFC token. The terminal handler may further authenticate the mobile device and identify a user account. Then, in response to identifying the user account and authenticating the mobile device, the terminal handler can transmit an application programming interface (API) call to the IoT service device to cause the IoT service device to perform the function.

title: System and methods for smart crochet hook
abstract: A smart crochet hook includes having a first end and a second end, and a hook portion formed at the first end of the shaft. A sensor module is integrated within the shaft and configured to detect stitch formation. A processor is coupled to the sensor module and configured to count stitches based on detected stitch formation. A wireless communication module is configured to transmit stitch count data to an external device. The smart crochet hook may include a display unit integrated into the shaft for displaying the stitch count. The sensor module may comprise an accelerometer for detecting movement associated with stitch formation. The wireless communication module may transmit data to a mobile device running a crochet pattern application. A data logging module may store stitch count data over time and track information about multiple crochet projects.

title: Mems with curved mirrors and methods of manufacture
abstract: This disclosure describes a small MEMS mirror whose surface shape can be adjusted as needed. The mirror sits on a thin flexible membrane, which is held by flexures in a frame and supported from below by a post so that it can bend in a controlled way. Electrodes placed under and around the membrane apply voltages that pull on the membrane and change the mirror from its built-in curved shape toward flatter or oppositely curved shapes. Separate electrical paths run through different flexures so the voltages to the movable mirror side and the fixed electrode side stay isolated, allowing independent, stable, and precise control of the mirror curvature.

title: Electronic device with improved display operation during startup and mode transitions
abstract: An electronic device includes a control unit and a display component. The control unit provides an initial clock signal and a first frame start pulse signal. The display component is electrically connected to and controlled by the control unit during a plurality of frame periods, including a first frame period and a subsequent second frame period. The control unit causes the initial clock signal to enter a first operable state during the first frame period, and the first frame start pulse signal to enter a second operable state during the second frame period.

title: Memory device
abstract: A memory device of embodiments includes a memory cell including a first conductive layer, a memory layer, and a second conductive layer. The memory layer contains an oxide, a nitride, or an oxynitride of a first element selected from Al, Si, Ge, Zr, Y, Ta, La, Ce, Ti, Hf, and Mg, a second element selected from Al, Zn, Sn, Ga, Bi, and In, and a third element selected from Te, S, Se, and Sb. The memory layer includes a first region, a second region, and a third region. The sum of concentrations of second and third elements is greater in the first region than in the second region. In the third region, a concentration of the third element is higher than a concentration of the second element. The ratio of the concentration of the third element to the concentration of the second element is greater in the third region than in the second region.

title: Oral products and methods of forming the same
abstract: Methods for forming an oral product include depositing a solution onto or near one or more surfaces of a substrate by a gravure printing process to form one or more layers that define at least a portion of the oral product. The solution includes an active ingredient, a flavorant, or a combination of the active ingredient and the flavorant.

title: Water discharge device
abstract: A water discharge device includes a foamer. The foamer includes: a foamer body having an opening at one end; a flow inlet through which a fluid flows into the foamer body; an agitation part that is housed in the foamer body and that generates foam by agitating the fluid; a flow outlet through which foam generated in the agitation part flows out of the foamer body; and a lid detachably provided on the opening of the foamer body. When the lid is detached from the opening of the foamer body, the agitation part can be removed from the foamer body through the opening.

title: Film Through Scope Camera Mount System
abstract: Systems and methods are described which provide a film through scope camera mount including a housing that includes a beam splitter, first and second mirrors, and a sensor. The camera mount system may receive an input optical signal from a first direction; split the input optical signal using the beam splitter such that a first portion of the input optical signal may be communicated out of the camera mount system in a second direction and a second portion of the input optical signal may be reflected lateral to the first direction; reflect the reflected signal vertically using the first mirror; reflect the vertically reflected signal in a second lateral direction using the second mirror; and receive the signal reflected by the second mirror in the sensor, which may comprise a visible light sensor and/or an infrared sensor.

title: Method for fabricating interposer, method for fabricating chip, interposer, chip and chip package
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for fabricating an interposer, a method for fabricating a chip, an interposer, a chip, and a chip package. The method includes the following steps: S 1 , providing a first carrier, where the first carrier includes a first portion and a second portion, the first portion being an outer edge of one side of the first carrier, and the second portion being a plane of the side defined by the outer edge; S 2 , adding a first release adhesive to the first portion, adding a first metal film to the second portion, and curing the first release adhesive; S 3 , adding a first dielectric layer to a surface of the first metal film; S 4 , preparing a first redistribution layer on the first dielectric layer; S 5 , removing the current first portion, where the current first portion at least includes the first release adhesive attached thereon; and S 6 , peeling off the current second portion, and cutting to form the interposer. The method can allow for rapid peeling of the first carrier without high temperature or laser to obtain an organic interposer with a thickness less than 30 microns.
assignee: Beijing Huafeng Integrated Electronics Co., Ltd.

title: Apparatus, memory controller, memory device, memory system, and method for clock switching and low power consumption
abstract: In an apparatus, a memory controller, a memory device, and a method for switching frequencies of clock signals to reduce power consumption, when the memory device performs an internal operation according to a command of the memory controller, a frequency of a clock signal of the memory controller is changed. The memory controller switches the frequency of the clock signal to a low frequency according to assertion of a status signal that indicates a busy operation status of the memory device according to the command, and switches the frequency of the clock signal to a high frequency according to de-assertion of the status signal that indicates a ready operation status of the memory device.

title: Systems and methods for playing media assets stored on a digital video recorder
abstract: Improved technical functionality is provided to dynamically select and seamlessly play advertisements immediately before playing of a recorded program upon selection of the recorded program for playing, or upon other detected events and conditions associated with the set-top-box (STB) or user. In some embodiments, this is performed by using metadata which may be delivered to and stored on a digital video recorder (DVR) prior to recording the program, providing a technical solution to enable opportunities for additional advertisement impressions. Playing of the advertisement may also or instead occur upon the recorded program finishing playing. Thus, the technical solution provides the additional opportunity for the content creator and/or the satellite television or cable service provider to sell advertising spots in addition to those already sold for breaks within the recorded program.

title: Mesh wireless local area network discovery with multi-link operation
abstract: A method of configuring a mesh multi-link device (MLD) operating in a mesh network using multi-link operation (MLO), wherein the mesh network including a plurality of mesh stations (STAs) and mesh MLDs, wherein the MLD communicates over multiple wireless local area network (WLAN) radio links between one or more access point (AP) MLDs and one or more non-AP MLDs, wherein each MLD has one or more affiliated STAs, and wherein each affiliated STA operates on a different link designated for mesh operation. The method comprising receiving multi-link operation mesh basic service set (MLO MBSS) information indicating MLO MBSS capability and/or operational parameters, and advertising the mesh capability of the MLD using a mesh multi-link element (MLE) included in the MLO MBSS information.

title: Apparatus and method for rapid hands-free application of gloves
abstract: A glove-donning apparatus includes a support structure and a pair of rings attached to the support structure. Each ring defines an opening configured to receive a hand of a user and to support an opening of an elastic glove stretched thereover. In certain embodiments, the rings are non-continuous and define a gap to enable a user's hand or arm to pass through the rings. The rings may be positioned to receive both hands of the user simultaneously, and the gloves may be positioned such that thumbs of the gloves are directed toward one another. When a user inserts his or her hands into the gloves and moves the hands through the rings, the gloves disengage from the rings and contract around the user's hands. The apparatus may enable the user to don gloves without handling the gloves during the donning process.

title: Systems and methods for automatically identifying analog materials based on estimated petrophysical properties of a selected sample material
abstract: A method for automatically identifying analog materials of a subject porous media sample includes receiving a set of digitally estimated petrophysical properties of a plurality of reference porous media samples from a material library, determining a similarity score between a subject porous media sample and each of the plurality of reference porous media samples by comparing a plurality of digitally estimated petrophysical properties of the subject porous media sample with the digitally estimated petrophysical properties of each of the plurality of reference porous media samples, and identifying one or more of the plurality of reference porous media samples as an analog material of the subject porous media sample in response to the similarity scores of the one or more reference porous media samples meeting a predefined similarity score threshold.

title: Light-emitting unit and optical sensor
abstract: A light emitting unit for an optical sensor is disclosed. The sensor detects a target by receiving reflected light in response to irradiation light directed toward a sensing area. The light emitting unit includes a resonant circuit with an inductor and a capacitor, a light emission branch path with a light emitting diode, and a discharge switch for controlling capacitor discharge. A control branch path and a second charge switch are provided for managing charging to the capacitor. A drive circuit independently controls the discharge switch, first charge switch, and second charge switch, and switches between two control modes. In the first mode, the on-period of the first charge switch is controlled during the on-period of the second charge switch. In the second mode, the on-period of the second charge switch is controlled during the off-period of the first charge switch.

title: Stacked amplifier with linearization scheme
abstract: This disclosure is generally directed to linearization circuitry of a multi-stage amplifier of wireless transmission circuitry. The amplifier may include multiple amplifier stages. The amplifier stages are cascaded such that an output signal of an amplifier stage may be input by a subsequent amplifier stage. Moreover, the amplifier stages are stacked such that the amplifier stages share (e.g., serially receive) a bias signal (e.g., a single bias signal). The linearization circuitry may include at least one operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) and at least one gain correction circuit to reduce a voltage and/or current of undesired signals that may be present based on non-linear behaviors of one or more of the amplifier stages.

title: Tool blade, tool fitting, system and power tool
abstract: A tool blade ( 14 ) which has a structure ( 24 ) that includes at least two elements ( 22 ) on at least one side face ( 26 ) of the tool blade ( 14 ), wherein, about a central blade rotation axis (R) of the tool blade ( 14 ), the structure ( 24 ) with its elements is rotationally symmetrical with respect to an angle of rotation of less than 360°, in particular of at most 180°, but is not mirror-symmetrical with respect to any diameter of the tool blade ( 14 ) passing through the blade rotation axis (R). A tool fitting ( 12 ), a tool blade system ( 15 ) and a power tool ( 10 ). It allows particularly safe working.

title: Packaging material for power storage device, method of producing same, and power storage device
abstract: This packaging material for a power storage device is constituted by a laminate comprising, in the stated order, at least a substrate layer, a barrier layer, and an inside layer. The inside layer is provided with an adhesive layer and a heat-sealing resin layer from the barrier layer side; and if dynamic viscoelasticity is measured by tension with respect to the inside layer, the growth rate at 80° C. is 8.0% or lower.

title: Unified Data Side Panel
abstract: Systems and techniques are described for a unified data pipeline interface. The pipeline interface provides an interface illustrating key metrics, activities, insight, and/or other categories. The pipeline interface provides such data as to a specific opportunity. The systems and techniques described herein allow for the determination, presentation, and standardization of such data through a specifically configured graphical user interface.

title: Organic compound and organic light-emitting device comprising same
abstract:
A compound represented by Chemical Formula 1-1 or Chemical Formula 1-2: 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
         
         
           
             where the substituents are as defined in the specification, and an organic light-emitting device including the same, wherein the compound represented by Chemical Formula 1-1 or Chemical Formula 1-2 is a compound in which anthracene, serving which serves as a key core when functioning as a blue fluorescent host compound, is substituted with deuterium. The compound represented by Chemical Formula 1-1 or Chemical Formula 1-2 can be used in an organic light-emitting device to improve device characteristics, e.g., lowering driving voltages, improving efficiency, or improving lifespan characteristics.

title: Painting system
abstract: A painting system includes a painting head unit including a painting head; a robot arm that moves the painting head unit to a desired position; an image acquisition means that acquires painting data of a painting portion; and a control unit that controls activation of a three-dimensional scanner and controls activation of the painting head and the robot arm. The control unit activates the image acquisition means to scan an image for measurement with the image acquisition means prior to execution of painting, acquires measurement image data that reflects a vibration state of the image acquisition means, generates painting data for correction for the purpose of eliminating deviation in landing positions of droplets based on the measurement image data acquired by the image acquisition means, and performs driving control of the robot arm and the painting head based on the painting data for correction.

title: System and method for autonomous threat mitigation in agentic artificial intelligence systems using runtime enforcement mechanisms for large language models
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for autonomous threat mitigation in agentic artificial intelligence systems using runtime enforcement mechanisms for large language models. The disclosed system comprises a runtime observation processor configured to capture intermediate reasoning states, contextual execution activities, memory access operations, tool invocation requests, and external communication instructions generated by one or more large language model agents during runtime execution. A semantic interpretation processor transforms the captured runtime activities into contextual semantic representations comprising intent vectors, behavioral embeddings, execution dependency structures, and contextual trust indicators. A contextual policy validation processor evaluates the semantic representations against adaptive governance policies, semantic trust boundaries, execution authorization conditions, and operational safety constraints. A threat correlation processor identifies adversarial reasoning patterns, recursive exploitation sequences, prompt injection attacks, memory poisoning activities, unauthorized privilege escalation operations, and anomalous behavioral transitions associated with autonomous execution activities.
assignee: Aakash Abhay YADAV; Tushar BADLANI; Sumit Gupta

title: Hot rolling equipment and hot rolling method
abstract: Hot rolling equipment for hot rolling a steel material containing Cu, the hot rolling equipment including: a heating furnace; a rough rolling apparatus including a plurality of rolling mills that rough roll on the steel material; a finish rolling apparatus that finish rolls on the steel material; and a removal apparatus that removes a target region including cracks caused by a Cu-rich layer that is present at a surface side of the steel material that is being rough rolled or has been rough rolled and in which a concentration of Cu components is higher than a concentration of Cu components in a base material of the steel material, wherein the removal apparatus is provided downstream of a rolling mill located furthest upstream among the plurality of rolling mills in the rough rolling apparatus in a transport direction of the steel material and upstream of the finish rolling apparatus.

title: Stair lift systems and methods for assembling, installing, and using such systems
abstract: A modular rail includes a modular rail assembly having a first end and an opposing second end. The modular rail includes a cable tensioning assembly having a tension cable disposed through the modular rail assembly. The tension cable is affixed at opposing ends of the cable tensioning assembly to each of the first end and opposing second end of the modular rail assembly. The cable tensioning assembly is configured to transfer tension forces applied to the tension cable into compressive force acting on opposing ends of the modular rail assembly, sufficient to provide structural support to the modular rail assembly.

title: Plastron trapping trenches and uses thereof
abstract: The invention, according to one embodiment, discloses the geometric (i.e., shape) and dimensional (i.e., size) details and other properties of trenches that can retain trapped gas under a fluid such as water (called “plastron”) while subjected to the flow conditions common for traveling watercraft. A solid surface of numerous trenches filled with air allows the surface to experience a smaller friction drag in flowing water. Retainment of the plastron under high-speed conditions of regular watercraft has proved elusive. Here, the geometric and dimensional details of the trenches are disclosed that can retain the plastron under the flow conditions common for watercraft—under the shear rate of water flow that a boat traveling even over 10 knots would experience. The trenches may also be applied to other objects or surface that come into contact with flowing fluid.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Bio-inspired nanocoating and the use thereof
abstract: Embodiments can relate to an adsorbent including a substrate and a coating formed on a surface of the substrate. The coating can include a bifunctional hairy cellulose nanocrystal (BHCNC) having a dialdehyde group and a dicarboxylate group. Additional embodiments can relate to methods of making and using the same.

title: Accurate scanning of reflective objects
abstract: A method includes receiving intraoral scan data generated by an intraoral scanner, the intraoral scan data comprising one or more images of a reflective intraoral object generated during projection of light onto the reflective intraoral object by a light projector of the intraoral scanner. The method further includes identifying a virtual image of the light projector in the one or more images caused by reflection of the light off of the reflective intraoral object. The method further includes determining at least one of a position or an angle of a surface of the reflective intraoral object based at least in part on the virtual image of the light projector identified in the one or more images.

title: Variable Cooling System for Strips and Rolls
abstract: A nozzle beam with a plurality of lateral outlet openings, through which a fluid can be applied to a roll or to a rolled material. The nozzle beam has a longitudinal bore extending within it in an axial direction. The longitudinal bore is connected to lateral outlet openings of the nozzle beam via transverse channels. A control tube with lateral openings in a tubular shell is provided in the longitudinal bore. By rotating or axially displacing the control tube, the lateral openings of the control tube at least partially open the openings to the transverse channels and thus the mass flow of the fluid to the lateral outlet openings can be adjusted. A method for adjusting the mass flow of a fluid to the individual lateral outlet openings of a nozzle beam is also included.

title: Three dimensional stacked processing unit
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide a stacked configuration for processing unit cores. According to certain aspects, an apparatus includes a stack of a first die and one or more additional dies; and at least one processing unit, comprising one or more processing cores and cache memory, distributed across at least two of the first die and the one or more additional dies.

title: Garment for enhancing privacy while dipping
abstract: A garment is provided that includes a front face, a back face, a right side, a left side, a top side, a bottom side, and a back face. The back face includes an elongated pocket. Moreover, the garment includes a button hole extending between the front and back faces and a disc having a first surface and a second surface. The disc is movable within the pocket and is configured to cooperate with the button hole to releasably secure the garment about a person to enhance privacy before, during and after water dipping.

title: Conductive module
abstract: A conductive module includes a wiring component, a temperature sensor unit, a pressing member, and a housing member, in which the temperature sensor unit includes a temperature detection branch body of the wiring component, a temperature sensor physically and electrically connected to a temperature detection conductor portion of the temperature detection branch body, and a frame-shaped frame member arranging the temperature sensor on the inner side thereof such that the temperature sensor is surrounded by the frame member, the pressing member includes a pair of locked portions disposed to face each other with a space therebetween, and a pressing portion provided on a virtual line connecting the pair of locked portions and configured to press the temperature sensor unit against a battery cell.
assignee: Yazaki Corporation; Prime Planet Energy & Solutions, Inc.

title: Split torque gearbox with variable backlash controller
abstract: A split torque gearbox is provided with a phase controller present between two legs of the gearbox which is controllable to lock together the two legs for a high precision operation or unlocked between the two legs to allow them to operate in an open condition for hi torque and speed. The system provides a gearbox capable of delivering both high torque high-power and high-speed motion at an output and high precision by operation of a backlash controller.
assignee: Pratt & Miller Engineering And Fabrication, Llc

title: POLYMORPHS OF AN INTEGRIN Alpha5Beta1
abstract: Provided herein are (S)-2-(methyl((1S,3S)-3-(4-(5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1,8-naphthyridin-2-yl)butoxy)cyclopentyl)amino)-2-((S)-1-methylisochroman-8-yl)acetic acid polymorphs, salts, compositions, methods of preparation, and use thereof.

title: Air suspension system
abstract: The present application discloses an air suspension system, including a frame for mounting a vehicle body, a bridge housing for mounting wheels, and air springs, shock absorbers, a connecting rod frame and a thrust module connected between the frame and the bridge housing. Since the thrust module is standardized, a suitable thrust module can be matched according to different working conditions, thereby making the complex suspension adjustment work lightweight.
assignee: Jilin Weichuang Electromechanical Engineering Co., Ltd.

title: Secure packet record in multi-source vr environment
abstract: A system for secure packet recordation in multisource virtual environments includes: a computing system having one or more processor and a network connection for operatively connecting the computing system to a modeling server providing a geometric model. The computing system, upon user navigation action directed to the first modeling server, accesses the first geometric model and causes display a three dimensional virtual environment based. An asset indicium representing a virtual asset of the user and a graphical representation of a secure packet are displayed. Upon a deposit request by the user, the first virtual asset is received into the secure packet. Upon user navigation directed away from the first modeling server, display of the three dimensional virtual environment is terminated, for example as a user explores another environment. In the absence of user attention, a content record is maintained including tabulation of at least the first virtual asset.

title: Systems and methods for automated ai-assisted backporting of software patches
abstract: A system detects, on a source code management system, a pull request from an upstream version of a software to one or more target versions of the software. When the pull request is detected, the system executes backporting by: collecting input parameters associated with the pull request from the source code management system, wherein the collected input parameters comprise a patch; and for each target version of the software: the system analyzes the input parameters using a first machine learning model (MLM) to determine whether the target version is affected by the patch, generates, by a second MLM, an adapted patch that adapts the patch to a source code of the target version, wherein the first MLM indicates that the target version is affected by the patch; and applies the adapted patch on the target version via the source code management system.

title: Memory system, memory controller, and control method of data arrangement
abstract: The memory system includes a nonvolatile memory and a memory controller. The memory controller executes first writing and second writing, and has a first queue. In writing data, the memory controller writes the data into nonvolatile memory with the first writing and stores, in the first queue, block numbers of blocks on which the first writing is executed in an order of execution. When generating an empty capacity in the nonvolatile memory by rewriting the data having undergone the first writing with the second writing, the memory controller acquires the block numbers from the first queue in the order they were stored, and selects, as movement source blocks of the garbage collection process, the blocks corresponding to the acquired block numbers.

title: Modular Barrier System
abstract: A coupler for mechanically coupling an elongate rail to an upright post includes a polymer housing, a base configured to be attached to the upright post, an internal support extending through the polymer housing from the base and configured to extend into the elongate rail, and a cavity defined by the internal support and the polymer housing, the cavity configured to receive an end of the elongate rail. The coupler further includes a first set of openings in the internal support configured to receive one or more fasteners for attaching the elongate rail to the coupler, and a second set of openings in the base configured to receive the one or more fasteners for attaching the coupler to the upright post. Each of the one or more fasteners is received in an opening in the first set of openings in the internal support and a corresponding opening in the second set of openings to attach the coupler to the upright post, such that the one or more fasteners are concealed by the elongate rail, the internal support, and the coupler housing.

title: Cold spray reinforced impeller shroud
abstract: A shrouded impeller for centrifugal compressors, and methods for manufacturing shrouded impellers for centrifugal compressors are provided. In one embodiment, the method includes manufacturing an impeller base, then depositing by cold spraying at least one layer of metallic material on the surface of the frontal part of the impeller corresponding to the shroud of the impeller and machining the impeller to complete and finish the structure thereof. The at least one layer deposited by cold spraying may include grooves adapted to optimize the dynamic behavior of the impeller by modifying and tuning the local natural frequencies.

title: Switching power supply module
abstract: A switching power supply module includes a circuit board on which a switching element is mounted, a circuit board on which at least one of an input capacitor element and an output capacitor element is mounted, and a power inductor element that electrically connects the switching element and the output capacitor. The power inductor element is between the circuit board and the circuit board. The power inductor element includes a metal conductor and a core magnetic material, the magnetic core encloses the metal conductor, and in an enclosed portion the metal conductor and the magnetic core are in close contact with each other to form a closely contacting structure. The metal conductor includes a main body portion enclosed in the magnetic core.

title: Method and apparatus for transmitting/receiving wireless signal in wireless communication system
abstract: In the present disclosure, a the method comprises configuring a split bearer comprising a first radio path directly connected to a network and a second radio path indirectly connected to the a network through a relay UE; and transmitting a RRC (Radio Resource Control) message to the network through a primary path for the split bearer, upon configuring the split bearer, the primary path for the split bearer is determined as the first radio path based on a type of the split bearer being a specific type of SRB (Signaling Radio Bearer) carrying the RRC message.

title: Vehicle control apparatus, vehicle control method, and non-transitory storage medium storing program thereof
abstract: An ECU of a vehicle control apparatus determines whether a prerequisite condition is satisfied. The prerequisite condition is satisfied when an operation amount of an accelerator pedal becomes equal to or greater than a high operation amount threshold within a period from a first time point at which a rate of increase of the accelerator pedal operation amount becomes equal to or greater than an operation speed threshold to a second time point at which an elapsed time from the first time point reaches a rapid acceleration determination time threshold. The ECU determines whether a non-stopping condition to be satisfied when the vehicle does not stop within a predetermined vehicle non-stopping monitoring period is satisfied, and determines that an erroneous operation of the accelerator pedal has occurred when an erroneous operation determination condition that includes the prerequisite condition and the non-stopping condition becomes satisfied.
assignee: Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha; Denso Corporation

title: Image coding method and apparatus therefor based on multiple reference lines
abstract: An image decoding method according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes obtaining reference line selection information and intra prediction mode information through a bitstream, determining a reference line for a current block based on the reference line selection information, deriving an intra prediction mode for the current block based on the intra prediction mode information, and generating prediction samples for the current block based on the determined reference line and the intra prediction mode, wherein the reference line selection information indicates one or more reference line candidates among a plurality of reference line candidates.

title: Wearable Electronic Device with Built-in Intelligent Monitoring Implemented using Deep Learning Accelerator and Random Access Memory
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods related to a deep learning accelerator and memory are described. For example, a wearable electronic device may be configured to execute instructions with matrix operands and configured with: a housing to be worn on a person; a sensor having one or more sensor elements generate measurements associated with the person; random access memory to store instructions executable by the deep learning accelerator and store matrices of an artificial neural network; a transceiver; and a controller to monitor an output of the artificial neural network, generated using the measurements as an input to the artificial neural network. Based on the output, the controller may control selective storage of measurement data from the sensor, and/or selective communication of data from the wearable electronic device to a separate computer system.

title: System
abstract: A system includes circuitry configured to receive, via a communication interface coupled to a packet-switched network, attribute data records associated with a plurality of user profiles, each record including user-specific parameters. The circuitry computes, based on the attribute data records and reference data stored in memory, per-user requirement values for the user profiles. The circuitry generates a composite output plan by inputting the per-user requirement values into a data generation model, the composite output plan satisfying constraint conditions derived from the per-user requirement values. Based on the composite output plan, the circuitry generates instruction data including a sequence of operational parameters and transmits the instruction data to a controlled apparatus over the packet-switched network to cause execution of operations in accordance with the operational parameters.

title: Wireless Apparatus And Communication Method
abstract: A wireless apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: first and second  processing units  configured to transmit and receive wireless signals using different channels; and a link management unit configured to manage a first link  between the first  processing unit and a  terminal and a second link  between the second  processing unit and the terminal, in which the link management unit receives a  request signal requesting data exchange relating to a first traffic identifier from the terminal, associates the first traffic identifier with the second link based on the request signal, and when a second traffic identifier different from the first traffic identifier is associated with the second link, changes the association of the second traffic identifier from the second link to the first link based on the request signal.

title: Method and apparatus for seamless dynamic configuration for split inferencing in a mobile communication system
abstract: The disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data transmission rate. The present disclosure provides method and apparatus for seamless dynamic configuration of for split inferencing in a mobile communication system.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A semiconductor device includes first and second structures. Semiconductor elements are formed in the first structure. The second structure is stacked on the first structure. The second structure includes second semiconductor elements on a first surface of a substrate, and isolations between adjacent ones of the second semiconductor elements and penetrating through the substrate between the first surface and a second surface of the substrate on the opposite side to the first surface. A first conductor is located between the first structure and the second structure and is electrically separated from the substrate. The isolations respectively include a first isolation extending from the first surface toward the second surface and where a width thereof decreases from the first surface toward the second surface, and a second isolation extending from the second surface toward the first surface and where a width thereof decreases from the second surface toward the first surface.

title: Small wire-based image-capturing system
abstract: A small wire-based image-capturing system is provided. The small wire-based image-capturing system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a plurality of wires, each having one end installed on an indoor wall surface by means of a fixing anchor; a flying unit connected to the other end of each of the plurality of wires to control the winding or unwinding operation of each of the plurality of wires and thereby move to an arbitrary position in an indoor space; and an image-capturing unit provided below the flying unit to capture images of an object to be image-captured.

title: Structured powders for carbon dioxide capture
abstract: A structured powder for capturing CO 2  from a gas stream includes an agglomerated powder, wherein magnesium hydroxide is 5 wt % to 90 wt % of the powder, and particles of the powder have a mean diameter of 1 micron to 40 microns. The structured powder has a mean largest dimension of 1 mm to 250 mm and an internal porosity of 10 vol % to 50 vol %.

title: Systems and methods for digitally signing a supplemental enhancement information message in video coding
abstract: A device may be configured to decode video data based on information included in supplemental enhancement information message. In one example, the supplemental enhancement information message includes a digital signature. In one example, the supplemental enhancement information message includes syntax elements specifying verification of the digital signature. In one example, the supplemental enhancement information message includes a syntax element identifying a certificate.

title: Scale up process textile to textile processing of polyester
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system for textile-to-textile processing of polyester. The system comprises a dissolution unit which receives a waste textile material and a dissolution solvent for selective dissolution of a polyester fraction. The system further comprises a downstream processing unit which receives the dissolution solvent from the dissolution unit. The downstream processing unit comprises a precipitation chamber which receives a precipitation solvent to precipitate the dissolved polyester. Additionally, the downstream processing unit comprises a drying unit which dries the precipitated polyester.

title: Systems and Methods for Modulating Electrical Activity in Excitable Biological Tissue Using Induced Electric Fields Generated by Time-Varying Magnetic Fields
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for modulating electrical activity in excitable biological tissue using electric fields induced by time-varying magnetic fields. A first time-varying magnetic field induces a subthreshold electric field that alters tissue excitability without evoking an action potential, and a second time-varying magnetic field induces a depolarizing electric field sufficient to evoke activation. Interaction of the induced electric fields enables controlled modulation, including selective activation and reduced stimulation thresholds. Operation may be open-loop, closed-loop, or hybrid, wherein closed-loop control utilizes sensed physiological responses, including evoked responses, and/or signals representative of the magnetic field detected by one or more sensing elements. Systems include one or more coils configured to generate spatially and temporally varying magnetic fields. The disclosed techniques are applicable to neural, cardiac, and other excitable tissues, and enable stimulation without direct electrode-tissue contact.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to capture, in real time, uttered speech of a user by controlling a high-sensitivity microphone unit, perform digital signal processing on audio data captured by the high-sensitivity microphone unit by controlling a digital signal processing unit, analyze digitally processed audio data and convert the digitally processed audio data into a normal pronunciation by controlling an AI speech recognition unit, synthesize converted audio data into natural and fluent speech by controlling a speech synthesis unit, output synthesized speech by controlling a speaker unit, and communicate with an external device by controlling a wireless communication unit.

title: Clip-type connector and device
abstract: A clip-type connector includes: a base portion having a main surface; a wall portion extending upright from the base portion; a first elastic portion and a second elastic portion, the first elastic portion and the second elastic portion being located on a side of the wall portion opposite to the base portion and separated from each other in a direction along the main surface; a coupling portion that couples the first elastic portion and the second elastic portion, the coupling portion facing the main surface and being located on a side of the first elastic portion and the second elastic portion opposite to the wall portion; and a first extension portion between the first elastic portion and the second elastic portion, the first extension portion extending from the coupling portion toward the wall portion.

title: Quantitative monitoring of drug release by enzyme-responsive polymeric nanoparticle
abstract: Disclosed herein is a nanocomposite particle comprising a polymer, a cleavable entity conjugated to the polymer, a magnetic nanoparticle, and a therapeutically effective amount of an active agent, and pharmaceutical compositions comprising the nanocomposite particle. MPI with the disclosed nanocomposite particles also allows for real-time quantitative monitoring of the rate of release of the active agent loaded onto the nanocomposite particle anywhere in the body and at any depth. The nanocomposite particle is also useful for the treatment of cancer.
assignee: Board Of Trustees Of Michigan State University

title: Real-time dashboard reflecting student progress in artificial intelligence-driven classroom workflow using large language models
abstract: An application executes a workflow for a class of students, the workflow comprising a set of prompts to which the students are to respond with answers. The application generates a classification for each answer at least in part by prompting an LLM to classify the answer and storing the answer and the classification of the answer. The application displays a user interface that tracks progress of each student of the class of student users through the workflow by retrieving progress information for the student, the progress information reflecting a portion of the workflow through which each student user has completed and a corresponding classification for each completed prompt within the portion, outputting a progress bar for each student showing a cell for each completed prompt within the portion, and outputting an indicator within each cell showing a corresponding classification of the answer corresponding to each cell.

title: Semiconductor memory device and method of fabricating the same
abstract: A semiconductor memory device includes a substrate including an active area defined by an element separation layer, the active area including a first portion and second portions defined on both sides of the first portion a bit line crossing the active area and extending in a first direction on the substrate, and a bit line contact disposed between the substrate and the bit line and directly connected to the first portion of the active area. The bit line contact includes an indent area recessed into the substrate and an upper area on the indent area, a width of the indent area decreases as a distance from the bit line increases, the indent area includes a slope forming a boundary with the substrate and having a straight line shape, and a starting point of the slope of the indent area is lower than an upper surface of the element separation layer.

title: Modular shelving and method
