abstract: Implementations described herein relate to a computer-implemented method that includes capturing image data using one or more cameras, wherein the image data includes a primary image and associated depth values. The method further includes encoding the image data in an image format. The encoded image data includes the primary image encoded in the image format and image metadata that includes a device element that includes a profile element indicative of an image type and a first camera element, wherein the first camera element includes an image element and a depth map based on the depth values. The method further includes, after the encoding, storing the image data in a file container based on the image format. The method further includes causing the primary image to be displayed.

title: Method for making flat box blanks and method for packaging products
abstract: A method for producing flat box blanks, wherein an array of unbound loose fibers shapes is formed, the unbound loose fibers shapes are wetted, and the unbound loose fibers shapes are compressed to form an array of flat box blanks

title: Arc detection device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an arc detection device comprising: a high frequency signal detection unit for detecting a high frequency signal from a current flowing through a power line; a signal strength detection unit for detecting the strength of the detected high frequency signal; a voltage detection unit for detecting a change in the voltage of the power line; and a control unit for detecting zero crossing points, which are time points having a reference voltage according to phase alternation of the voltage from the change in voltage, detecting a preset number of peaks from changes in the strength of the high frequency signal detected at intervals between the detected zero crossing points, and determining whether arcs occur in the intervals by comparing signal strength values of the detected preset number of peaks to a preset reference value.

title: Electrode plate stacking apparatus
abstract: An electrode plate stacking apparatus includes a first supplier configured to supply a first electrode plate, a second supplier spaced apart from the first supplier and configured to supply a second electrode plate, a stage configured to sequentially pass through the first supplier and the second supplier such that the first electrode plate and the second electrode plate are alternately stacked, and a transferer connected to the stage and configured to transfer the stage.

title: Structural Fastener
abstract: A nut operable for blind attachment between two rims on opposite sides of a strut. In one embodiment, the nut is a spin nut operable to rotate and lock onto the two rims on the strut. The spin nut includes a nut having a base, and a pair of wings formed on opposite sides of the nut, the wings being operable to engage the two rims. At least one locking surface is formed around the threaded hole in the nut to provide a prevailing torque. The locking feature may be embossed. A spring extends from the nut away from the strut and toward the two rims. A threaded hole may be formed in the nut extending into the base, such as a threaded nut, according to one embodiment. A bolt may be inserted into the threaded hole to attach to a bracket.

title: Methods and Systems to Determine a Strategy for a Drop Process Associated with a Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) Device
abstract: Example implementations may relate to determining a strategy for a drop process associated with a light detection and ranging (LIDAR) device. In particular, the LIDAR device could emit light pulses and detect return light pulses, and could generate a set of data points representative of the detected return light pulses. The drop process could involve a computing system discarding data point(s) of the set and/or preventing emission of light pulse(s) by the LIDAR device. Accordingly, the computing system could detect a trigger to engage in the drop process, and may responsively (i) use information associated with the environment around the vehicle, operation of the vehicle, and/or operation of the LIDAR device as a basis to determine the strategy for the drop process, and (ii) engage in the drop process in accordance with the determined strategy.

title: Chip structure and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a chip structure and a preparation method thereof. The chip structure includes an epitaxial structure including a first doping type semiconductor layer, a second doping type semiconductor layer, and an active layer, and further includes a confinement layer. A material of the confinement layer is a semiconductor material composed of any one of Group III elements Ga, In, and Al, and any one of Group V elements N, As, and P. A space charge region is formed between the confinement layer and the second doping type semiconductor layer. In a case that the confinement layer has a second doping type, a doping concentration of the confinement layer is less than a doping concentration of the second doping type semiconductor layer in contact with the confinement layer, and in a case that the confinement layer contains Al, the Al content is less than 0.5%.

title: Method for assessing impact of transgenic plants on agricultural biodiversity using environmental dna metabarcoding sequencing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for assessing an impact of a transgenic plant on agricultural biodiversity using environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding sequencing. The method includes the following steps: collecting rhizosphere soil samples and phyllosphere surface attachment samples of a transgenic crop during the same period, and extracting deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) from the samples; using the extracted DNA as a template, performing polymerase chain reaction (PCR) amplification with amplification primers; and purifying PCR amplification products, subjecting the purified PCR amplification products to high-throughput sequencing (HTS) to obtain sequences, comparing the obtained operational taxonomic unit (OTU) sequences with the nucleotide (nt) public database on the website of the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) to identify arthropod species in the samples and calculate biodiversity-related indices, thereby assessing the impact of the transgenic crop on agricultural biodiversity.
assignee: Nanjing Institute Of Environmental Sciences, Ministry Of Ecology And Environment

title: Method for decoding immersive video and method for encoding immersive video
abstract: An image encoding method according to the present disclosure may include classifying a plurality of view images into a basic image and an additional image; performing pruning for at least one of the plurality of view images based on a result of the classification; generating an atlas based on a result of performing the pruning; and encoding the atlas and metadata for the atlas. In this case, the metadata may include spherical harmonic function information on a point in a three-dimensional space.

title: Pipette tip family comprising pipette tips for use with pipettes of a pipette family and pipette family comprising pipettes for use with pipette tips of a pipette tip family
abstract: A pipette family includes pipettes of different types and each including a pipette housing, a drive apparatus, an operating element that protrudes from the pipette housing and is displaceable relative to the pipette housing, an elongated first sensing element and a control unit coupled to the elongated first sensing element. The elongated first sensing element is configured for sensing the top end of a tip plunger inserted into the axial bore of the pipette tip and pushed onto a spigot at a mounting opening. The control unit places the pipette into a state enabling pipetting upon sensing a plunger rod of a pipette tip of a subfamily of the pipette tip family that is matched to a pipette type of the pipette and places the pipette into a state that inhibits pipetting upon sensing a plunger rod of a pipette tip of a subfamily not matched to the pipette type.

title: System And Method For Automated Quantitative Seismic Interpretation
abstract: A method is described for automated quantitative seismic interpretation. The method uses automated well-tie methods to calculate time to depth relationships, deep neural network (DNN) wavelet estimation, and deep neural network (DNN) seismic AVA inversion. The proposed integrated QI workflow ultimately reduces human bias and labor while providing streamlined, accurate reservoir property estimations. The method is executed by a computer system.

title: Semiconductor device and methods of formation
abstract: An electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection circuit includes a high voltage high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) and a plurality of capacitors interconnected with each other in a stacked arrangement. The stacked arrangement of capacitors is connected between a positive supply voltage (VDD) and the gate of the HEMT. A resistor is connected between a negative supply voltage (VSS) and the gate of the HEMT and is connected in series with the stacked capacitor arrangement. During normal operation, the capacitors in the stack are open, and the gate is connected to VSS. When there is an ESD event, the capacitors in the stack are shorted, and the gate is connected to VDD so that the gate of the HEMT receives a voltage corresponding to an ESD event as an input voltage. As a result, the high voltage HEMT may be turned on to conduct and dissipate ESD current.

title: System and method for class-agnostic counting of one or more items in a container
abstract: The present application pertains to systems and methods of tracking, control, management and counting of objects, items or materials within a monitored area. More particularly, embodiments relate to systems and processes for class-agnostic counting of one or more items in a container in the monitored area.
assignee: NTT Ltd Group Services America, Inc.

title: Switching circuit and power supply circuit
abstract: A switching circuit includes two series transistors: a high-withstand-voltage transistor and a low-withstand-voltage transistor. A high-voltage terminal of the low-withstand-voltage transistor is connected to a reference terminal of the high-withstand-voltage transistor. A control terminal of the high-withstand-voltage transistor includes a transistor-control path connected to a reference terminal of the low-withstand-voltage transistor. The transistor-control path includes parallel elements: a gate resistor and a gate diode. An inter-terminal capacitance of the gate diode is equal to or less than 20% of an input capacitance of the high-withstand-voltage transistor.

title: Devices for Maintaining Tension in Chain Saws
abstract: Tensioning devices for maintaining tension in a chain of a chain saw are disclosed. The devices may include a housing adapted to be coupled to a drive cog of a chain saw, a saw bar mount adapted to be coupled to a saw bar of a chain saw, and at least one spring adapted to bias the saw bar mount in a distal direction from the housing, thereby tensioning the spring. The tensioning device may also include a ratchet and pawl assembly that allows the saw bar mount to be moved in the distal direction and stops movement of the saw bar mount in a proximal direction. The tensioning device may also include a lock adapted to hold the saw bar mount in a proximal position against a biasing force of the spring. Methods of assembling and operating tensioning devices are also disclosed.

title: Wire harness
abstract: A wire harness that includes: a tubular shield shell that is configured to cover an outer circumferential surface of a connector housing; a tubular braided wire that is configured to cover an outer circumferential surface of an electric wire extending from the connector housing; a fixing ring that fixes the braided wire to an outer circumferential surface of the shield shell; a tubular grommet that covers the shield shell, the braided wire, and the fixing ring; and a protective tube that is formed of a flexible material and that covers an outer circumferential surface of the fixing ring inside the grommet.

title: Compositions and methods of use for modified release minoxidil
abstract: The compositions and methods provided herein include a pharmaceutical formulation for oral administration comprising a daily dose of a modified release formulation of minoxidil or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. Also provided herein are pharmaceutical formulations for oral administration comprising a daily dose of a modified release formulation of minoxidil or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and one or more additional active agents. Also provided herein are methods of treating hair loss by administering to a subject in need thereof a daily dose of a modified release formulation of minoxidil or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof. Further provided herein is a kit including a slow modified release vehicle comprising oral minoxidil or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

title: A method to provide comprehensive key vocabulary for search
abstract: The present invention relates to a method to provide comprehensive key vocabulary for search involving the steps of receiving ( 101 ) a user-specified term or phrases with text cleaning ( 101 A), identifying ( 102 ) domain specific vocabulary, extracting ( 103 ) relationship between plurality of key phrases in a text document, deriving ( 104 ) a knowledge graph that involves in establishing relationship between two phrases and a connection to form edge relationship thereby deriving a lemma, improving ( 105 ) the quality of the key phrases, storing ( 106 ) phrases, document ids and statistical details about phrases, ordering ( 107 ) the phrases identified using the ranking criteria based on the phrases statistics, selecting ( 108 ) and returning the best key phrases as search results and showing ( 109 ) the search results as word cloud for the users to quickly identify the key vocabulary.

title: Dewatering apparatus and process
abstract: A capillary dewatering apparatus and/or process, may include a framework with a plurality of apertures, and a flexible member disposed around an exterior surface of the framework, in which an inner surface of the flexible member may be in contact with at least a portion of the exterior surface of the framework and in which the flexible member and the framework may not be bonded.

title: Systems, methods, and computer program products for hybrid quantum-classical control of an artificially intelligent entity
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer program products that achieve hybrid quantum-classical control of an artificially intelligent entity are described. A classical control system runs a classical prediction algorithm that predicts: a) an action to be performed by the artificially intelligent entity, and b) the perception data that is expected when the action is performed. The artificially intelligent entity performs the predicted action. When the actual perception data differs from the predicted perception data beyond an acceptable threshold, the control system makes a call to a quantum processing system to request a new predicted action determined by a quantum prediction algorithm. The quantum-predicted action may be advantageous over the classical predicted action, and may be used to both: i) improve control of the artificially intelligent entity, and ii) update/train the classical prediction algorithm to improve the classical prediction algorithm as well.

title: Nanoscale coatings for encapsulation of biological entities
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices are disclosed for encapsulating biological entities with preservation of their biological activity. In one aspect, a method of encapsulating a biological entity includes templating a biocompatible material onto a biological structure to form a coating structure enclosing the biological structure, the coating structure having a size  5  in the nanometer range, in which the coated biological structure preserves its biological activity within the coating structure. In some implementations of the method, the biological structure includes a virus and the biocompatible material includes silica.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Universal holder
abstract: An apparatus for holding an object is provided. The apparatus includes a tightening mechanism, a fastening rod operatively connected to the tightening mechanism, and first and second articulating rods. The first articulating rod comprises a first engagement mechanism operatively connected to the fastening rod and a first engagement rod having a proximate end operatively connected to the first engagement mechanism and a distal end configured to engage with a first ball and socket comprising a protruded portion configured to engage with an attachment. The second articulating rod comprises a second engagement mechanism operatively connected to the fastening rod and a second engagement rod having a proximate end operatively connected to the second engagement mechanism and a distal end configured to engage with a second ball and socket comprising a second protruded portion configured to engage with a clamp.

title: Low power intruder event
abstract: One embodiment provides a method, the method including: detecting, at a microcontroller unit of a device in a mechanical-off state, an intruder event; logging, at the microcontroller unit of the device, the intruder event, wherein the logging comprises storing at least a timestamp associated with the intruder event; and providing, upon powering the device, data corresponding to the intruder event from the microcontroller unit to an embedded controller of the device. Other aspects are claimed and described.

title: Cooling device and housing for a switching arrangement, and switching arrangement
abstract: A cooling apparatus for a switching arrangement, in particular for an electronic module of a switch of the switching arrangement, includes a variable cooling module which includes a number of cooling units for mounting in a housing of the switching arrangement. The cooling module Includes a carrier unit designed to receive and hold a variable number of the cooling units, with the cooling units being designed differently and/or homogeneously in terms of cooling capacity, shape, type and/or size.

title: Image encoding method/device, image decoding method/device, and recording medium in which bitstream is stored
abstract: The present invention provides an image encoding method and an image decoding method. The image encoding method of the present invention comprises: a first dividing step of dividing a current image into a plurality of blocks; and a second dividing step of dividing, into a plurality of sub blocks, a block, which is to be divided and includes a boundary of the current image, among the plurality of blocks, wherein the second dividing step is recursively performed by setting a sub block including the boundary of the current images as the block to be divided, until the sub block including the boundary of the current image does not exist among the sub blocks.
assignee: Industry Academy Cooperation Foundation Of Sejong University

title: Artificial intelligence-based network performance prediction training
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for training an artificial intelligence-based wireless communication network simulator. An example method includes obtaining first training data associated with a first network simulator, wherein the first training data includes first parameters associated with simulation of a wireless network operating, in a scenario, according to first configurations, wherein the wireless network includes a network node in communication with a user equipment (UE); obtaining second training data associated with a second network simulator, wherein the second training data includes second parameters associated with simulation of the wireless network operating, in the scenario, according to second configurations; generating third training data based at least in part on the first training data and the second training data; and training a machine learning model, associated with prediction of performance metrics of the wireless network, based at least in part on the third training data.

title: Apparatus and method for estimating oxygen saturation
abstract: A method for measuring a person's oxygen saturation is provided. The method includes: acquiring, by a radar sensor, a radar complex signal reflected from the person; deriving, by a processor, fine chest displacement information of the person based on the radar complex signal; deriving, by the processor, intra-pulmonary pressure information of the person based on the fine chest displacement information; deriving, by the processor, tidal volume information of the person based on the intra-pulmonary pressure information; deriving, by the processor, minute ventilation information of the person based on the tidal volume information; deriving, by the processor, carbon dioxide partial pressure information of the person based on the minute ventilation information; deriving, by the processor, oxygen partial pressure information of the person based on the carbon dioxide partial pressure information; and deriving, by the processor, oxygen saturation information of the person based on the oxygen partial pressure information.

title: A method of controlling a maintenance operation apparatus of a recovery boiler and a maintenance operation apparatus
abstract: A method of controlling a maintenance operation apparatus ( 10 ) of a recovery boiler ( 11 ) including: defining a position of a fixed world coordinate system ( 20 ) at a recovery boiler ( 11 ); defining a position of an initial base coordinate system ( 21 ) of a maintenance object ( 12 ) that is at a chosen point of a maintenance object (S 1 -S 14 ) determined in the fixed world coordinate system ( 20 ) in an initial temperature of the recovery boiler ( 11 ); defining a position of a corrected base coordinate system ( 22 ) of the maintenance object in the fixed world coordinate system at the position of the chosen point in the fixed world coordinate system in a transited temperature of the recovery boiler, ( 11 ); controlling a tool moving device (R 1 -R 5 ) to perform the maintenance operation of the maintenance object in the corrected base coordinate system.

title: Barbed Wire Spool Assembly
abstract: A barbed wire spool incorporating an axle having an upper end, a lower end, and a rotation axis; the barbed wire spool further incorporating a base plate mounted at the lower end of the axle, the base plate being adapted for rotation about the rotation axis; the barbed wire spool further incorporating a fork having a crown rotatably mounted at the upper end of the axle, the fork further having a plurality of legs fixedly attached to and extending downwardly from the crown, wherein the lower ends of the fork's legs are releasably retained within apertures which open at the base.

title: Coaxial connector with grounding and retention
abstract: A cable connector including: a body; a nose having a forward nose portion, a rearward nose portion that is configured to be coupled with the body, and a recessed nose portion; a coupler configured to be coupled with the forward nose portion; a conductor configured to be supported in the body and the nose portion; and a biasing portion configured to be received in the recessed nose portion. The coupler is configured to be rotatably coupled to the nose; and the biasing portion is configured to biasingly provide an electrical ground path between the nose and the coupler so as to improve an electrically conductive connection between an outer conductor of a coaxial cable and the coupler when the coupler is not connected to an interface port, when the coupler is loosely coupled to the interface port, and when the coupler is fully tightened to the interface port.

title: Information processing method, apparatus, electronic device and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method and apparatus for information processing, an electronic device and a storage medium. The method comprises: obtaining a page loading instruction comprising identification information of a page to be loaded, wherein the page to be loaded comprises a target configurable area and a target non-configurable area; rendering the page to be loaded using first target resource information and second target resource information; wherein the first target resource information corresponds to the target configurable area; the first target resource information is variable resource information and determined according to current promotion activity contents; and the second target resource information corresponds to the target non-configurable area; and the second target resource information is fixed resource information, which does not vary with changes of promotion activity contents.
assignee: Beijing Youzhuju Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Handheld Electromechanical Surgical System With Low Tissue Compression Indiction
abstract: A surgical device includes a reload assembly having a plurality of staples and a storage device storing data including a minimum clamp force limit. The surgical device also includes an anvil assembly movable relative to the reload assembly, a power source, and a motor coupled to the power source. The surgical device further includes a transmission assembly movable by the motor and configured to move the anvil assembly relative to the reload assembly. The surgical device also includes a force sensor configured to measure a force imparted on the anvil assembly by the transmission assembly. The surgical device also includes a controller configured to activate the motor to move the anvil assembly relative to the reload assembly, compare the measured force to the minimum clamp force limit, and output an alert in response to the measured force being lower than the minimum clamp force limit.

title: Apparatus and method correlated therewith for producing water by means of a vapor convection type solar receiver
abstract: A solar receiver for producing water from ambient humidity includes a thermal absorber in the region of a focusing axis and a casing which is transparent and concentric with respect to the thermal absorber. The absorber contains drying material which allows adsorption of humidity contained in the air and the desorption of the water vapor. The solar receiver also includes intake and emission valves connecting the thermal absorber to the external environment and a circuit which fluid-dynamically connects the thermal absorber to the casing. Humid air is directed, by a fan, inside the thermal absorber and, once the drying material is saturated, the valves are closed and the air inside the casing and the thermal absorber is heated. Once the optimum temperature is reached, the fan is activated in order to enable desorption of the water from the drying material and to collect the condensate and water in a condenser.

title: Articles comprising thermally stable, grain-refined zinc alloys
abstract: Articles including electrodeposited layers of fine-grained alloys of Ni, Cu, Co, Fe and Zn with minor additions of B, O, P and S that provide high strength, ductility and thermal stability, are disclosed. The disclosure further relates to a process for fabricating the articles. Non-metallic additions of ≤2% are required to significantly increase the maximum temperature at which softening and grain-growth occurs. The grain-refined metallic layers or coatings are particularly suited for use in strong and lightweight parts required in aerospace, automotive and industrial applications subject to at least, at times, higher than ambient operating temperatures.

title: Refrigerant module
abstract: A characteristic configuration of a refrigerant module according to the present disclosure is as follows: a refrigerant module includes: a manifold in which a refrigerant flow path through which refrigerant flows is formed, and a bracket that holds at least one device through which refrigerant flows, the bracket having a casting porosity volume ratio higher than a casting porosity volume ratio of the manifold, and the manifold and the bracket are integrated by being coupled.

title: Stacked integrated passive device
abstract: A method of forming a device includes fabricating at least one passive component on a first silicon carbide (SiC) substrate to form a first integrated passive device (IPD) die having a first surface and a second surface on the first SiC substrate, a first contact on the first surface, and at least one first metal portion on the second surface. The method includes fabricating at least one passive component on a second SiC substrate to form a second IPD die having a third surface and a fourth surface on the second SiC substrate, a second contact on the third surface, and at least one second metal portion on the fourth surface. The method includes forming at least one electrical interconnection structure between one of the first and second surfaces of the first IPD die and one of the third and fourth surfaces of the second IPD die.

title: Gas Separation Membrane And Gas Separation Apparatus
abstract: A gas separation membrane for permeating and separating a predetermined component from a mixed gas includes: a porous layer which is porous; a separation layer which is provided on one surface of the porous layer and is formed of a polymer material; and a to-be-held layer which is provided outside the separation layer on one surface of the porous layer, is thicker than the separation layer, and has a lower gas permeability of the predetermined component than the separation layer.

title: Memory device having improved p-n junction and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a memory device having improved P-N junction and a manufacturing method thereof. The memory device includes a semiconductor substrate having a first surface and defined with an active area under the first surface, a gate structure adjacent to the active area and indented into the semiconductor substrate from the first surface, a doped member extending into the semiconductor substrate and surrounded by the active area, a conductive layer including a first portion extending into the semiconductor substrate from the first surface and a second portion disposed over the doped member and coupled to the first portion, a first insulating layer disposed adjacent to the first portion of the conductive layer and between the doped member and the active area of the semiconductor substrate, a first contact disposed over the conductive layer, and a conductive pillar disposed over the first contact.

title: Information providing method, non-transitory computer-readable storage medium, and information processing device
abstract: There is provided an information providing method of providing information to an occupant of an electric bicycle ( 10 ), and the information providing method includes a step of acquiring a vehicle-related state having at least one of a state of the electric bicycle ( 10 ), a state of the occupant, a state of a component mounted on the electric bicycle ( 10 ), and a state of a device mounted on the electric bicycle ( 10 ), a step of acquiring a current position of the electric bicycle ( 10 ), a step of generating display information to be displayed on a portable terminal ( 8 ) disposed at a position visually recognizable by the occupant, the display information having a state display area ( 823 ) for displaying the vehicle-related state and a map area ( 821 ) for displaying map information including the current position, and a step of displaying the display information on the portable terminal ( 8 ).

title: Packaging apparatus
abstract: Color development occurring in a packaging material having a heat-sensitive color-developing layer during heat sealing of the packaging material is suppressed. The packaging material has a base material and a heat-sensitive color-developing layer stacked on the base material. An accommodation portion forming unit has a heating member and a receiving member disposed to face the heating member. In the packaging material that is being conveyed through the accommodation portion forming unit, the heat-sensitive color-developing layer is positioned farther away from the heating member than the base material.

title: Adaptive fiber control
abstract: A medical apparatus includes a fiber channel having a proximal end and a distal end, a flexible bellows extending around at least the proximal end of the fiber channel, a motor, a circuitry, and a housing, the housing including a slidable component, wherein the housing surrounds at least a portion of the fiber channel, the flexible bellows, motor, and circuitry, and wherein the slidable component is located proximal of the fiber channel.

title: Semiconductor transistor mesa isolation structure and method of forming the same
abstract: A semiconductor transistor mesa isolation structure and method of forming the same including a mesa isolation structure located between a first gate and a second gate, the mesa isolation structure including sidewalls latitudinally offset from each of the first gate and the second gate, and the mesa isolation structure extending through an interior of a barrier layer of the semiconductor transistor, and the mesa isolation structure formed with a dielectric material.

title: Gripping System
abstract: The technology is generally directed to a gripping system for receiving hard drives of varying thicknesses and located in any position or orientation. The gripping system may include two arms to grip a hard drive and at least one belt positioned along a length of each arm to move the hard drive towards or away from the system. The arms may be pivotally attached so that hard drives of varying widths can be received between the arms. The belts may provide improved control of the hard drive once received between the arms because a force exerted by the belts may secure the hard drive in place to prevent the hard drive from drooping or moving out of place.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device according to example embodiments of the present disclosure may include a display area including a plurality of light emitting devices, a plurality of row lines arranged in the display area, a plurality of column lines arranged in the display area, and a plurality of drivers configured to drive the plurality of row lines and the plurality of column lines. Each of the plurality of column lines may be electrically connected in common with a first electrode of each of two or more light emitting devices arranged in the same column among the plurality of light emitting devices. Each of the plurality of row lines may be electrically connected in common with a second electrode of each of two or more light emitting devices arranged in the same row among the plurality of light emitting devices. The plurality of row lines may include a first row line and a second row line arranged in the same row and electrically short-circuited with each other. A display-on driving period of the first row line and a display-on driving period of the second row line may be performed at the same timing.

title: Systems and methods for dynamically stabilizing videos
abstract: A video may be captured by an image capture device. A stabilized view of the video may be generated by using a punchout of the video. The shape and/or size of the punchout may be dynamically changed based on stabilization performance of the video. The shape and/or size of the punchout may be changed when the punchout is moving within the video. The shape and/or size of the punchout may not be changed when the punchout is not moving within the video.

title: Antenna
abstract: An antenna comprising: a first element including a plurality of parallel resonators configured to resonate in a first frequency band, and at least one first connecting portion configured to connect the parallel resonators immediately adjacent to each other in the plurality of the parallel resonators; and a second element configured to be connected to the first element, wherein the first element and the second element operate with radio waves in a second frequency band different from the first frequency band.

title: A method for manufacturing a decorative slab
abstract: A method for manufacturing decorative ceramic slabs may involve compacting a mass of powder to form a green base body. A main décor may be provided on an upper surface of the green base body. The green base body with the main décor may be fired to obtain a ceramic slab. A visual inspection may be performed of the upper surface of the fired ceramic slab and the ceramic slab may be classified on the basis of the visual inspection. A secondary décor may be printed on at least one side edge of the ceramic slab. The secondary décor may be chosen on the basis of the classification.

title: Atomoxetine oral solution
abstract: The present invention provides for an oral solution that includes atomoxetine, or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, methods of manufacturing the oral solution, and methods of treating attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in a human subject that include orally administering the oral solution to a human subject in need thereof.

title: Electronic device and method for receiving voice of user
abstract: An electronic device for sensing the voice of a user is provided by an aspect of the present disclosure. The electronic device includes a bone-conduction microphone (BCM) chip configured for sensing a vibration caused by the voice in a first direction and converting the vibration into an audio signal. The electronic device also includes a vibration plate. The BCM chip is fixed on a first surface of the vibration plate. The first surface is perpendicular to the first direction. The electronic device also includes a bracket. The vibration plate is flexibly disposed on one end of the bracket.

title: Epsilon-vopo4 cathode production, and applications thereof
abstract: A lithium battery with a cathode fabricated using an improved method for slurry formulation and electrode production. The cathode comprises the epsilon polymorph of vanadyl phosphate, ε-VOPO 4 , made from solvothermally synthesized H 2 VOPO 4 , and optimized to reversibly intercalate two Li-ions to reach full theoretical capacity with a coulombic efficiency of 98%. This material adopts a stable 3D tunnel structure and can extract two Li-ions per vanadium ion, giving a theoretical capacity of 305 mAh/g, with an upper charge/discharge plateau at around 4.0 V, and one lower at around 2.5 V. The ε-VOPO4 particles may be modified with niobium (Nb) to improve the cycling stability.
assignee: The Research Foundation For The State University Of New York

title: Memory device and method of operating the same
abstract: A memory device includes a memory block including strings, each including first memory cells coupled between a first dummy cell and a second dummy cell and second memory cells coupled between third dummy cell and fourth dummy cell, and a peripheral circuit performing a normal program operation on first and second memory cells, or a soft program operation on first to fourth dummy cells, wherein the peripheral circuit is configured to, perform a soft program operation on the fourth dummy cell which is farthest from an area to which the precharge voltage is applied and perform a normal program operation on second memory cells, wherein the precharge voltage is applied to the area during the normal program operation, and wherein the area is adjacent to the first dummy cells.

title: Annotation cross-labeling for autonomous control systems
abstract: An annotation system uses annotations for a first set of sensor measurements from a first sensor to identify annotations for a second set of sensor measurements from a second sensor. The annotation system identifies reference annotations in the first set of sensor measurements that indicates a location of a characteristic object in the two-dimensional space. The annotation system determines a spatial region in the three-dimensional space of the second set of sensor measurements that corresponds to a portion of the scene represented in the annotation of the first set of sensor measurements. The annotation system determines annotations within the spatial region of the second set of sensor measurements that indicates a location of the characteristic object in the three-dimensional space.

title: Rf blocker for uniformity control
abstract: A semiconductor processing system with improved plasma density is disclosed. The system includes a plasma chamber having a base, chamber walls and a top wall. An antenna is used to generate RF energy that is inductively coupled into the plasma chamber. The antenna comprises a plurality of coils that are proximate a dielectric window. One or more RF blockers are disposed adjacent to the dielectric window to block some of the RF energy from entering the plasma chamber. If the RF blocker is placed near a region of high plasma density, the density in that region may be reduced, improving the uniformity of the plasma density within the plasma chamber. Further, the RF blockers may have openings and may also be overlapped to create varying degrees of blocking.

title: Method and apparatus for handling refrigerant
abstract: An apparatus for processing refrigerant includes a storage tank configured to store a recovered refrigerant mixture from an air conditioning system, a mixing container configured to blend refrigerants, material refrigerant tanks configured to supply single-component refrigerants to the mixing container, and a processor. The processor controls the storage tank to store the recovered refrigerant mixture from the air conditioning system, determines material refrigerants of an initial refrigerant mixture corresponding to the recovered refrigerant mixture in the storage tank before deterioration, and a mixing ratio of the material refrigerants of the initial refrigerant mixture, controls the material refrigerant tanks to supply the single-component refrigerants from the material refrigerant tanks to the mixing container according to the material refrigerants and the mixing ratio of the initial refrigerant mixture to form a blended refrigerant mixture, and controls the refrigerant pump to inject the blended refrigerant mixture into the air conditioning system .
assignee: Sk Innovation Co., Ltd.; Sk On Co., Ltd.

title: Autonomous snow-melting device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an autonomous snow-melting device and methods of using the same to remove snow or ice from surfaces. Specifically, an autonomous snow-melting device is disclosed that can be powered by solar energy and that is equipped with an intelligent control module, sensor-based navigation, and heating elements for melting snow and ice.

title: Antisense oligomers for treatment of conditions and diseases
abstract: Alternative splicing events in SCN1A gene can lead to non-productive mRNA transcripts which in turn can lead to aberrant protein expression, and therapeutic agents which can target the alternative splicing events in SCN1A gene can modulate the expression level of functional proteins in Dravet Syndrome patients and/or inhibit aberrant protein expression. Such therapeutic agents can be used to treat a condition caused by SCN1A, SCN8A or SCN5A protein deficiency.

title: Trench support method and apparatus
abstract: An apparatus for supporting a trench, including at least four beams; at least first and second struts; a first plate; first and second L-shaped brackets attached to the first plate; a second plate; and third and fourth L-shaped brackets attached to the second plate. Each of the beams may include an outer; a divider, and an inner member, which are spaced apart from each other and substantially parallel to each other, and connected together by a central member which is substantially perpendicular to the outer, divider, and inner members; where each outer member of each beam has fixed thereto first and second extensions, which are substantially perpendicular to the respective outer member; wherein the first and second extensions, together with at least part of the respective outer member, a least part of the divider member, and at least part of the central member, form first and second L-shaped channels.

title: Method and apparatus for applying trp switching
abstract: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for applying TRP switching. A method of a UE comprises the steps of: performing first TRP communication with a base station; receiving a first indication of a TRP switching operation from the base station; determining an application time of the TRP switching operation on the basis of the first indication; performing the TRP switching operation from the first TRP communication to second TRP communication at the application time; and performing the second TRP communication with the base station.

title: Controller system and control method
abstract: This application relates to the field of intelligent vehicle technologies in the field of artificial intelligence technologies, and in particular, to a controller system. The controller system includes: an intelligent driving domain control unit; a human-machine interaction domain control unit; and a sensor interface unit that is connected to the intelligent driving domain control unit and the human-machine interaction domain control unit. The sensor interface unit is connected to a sensor, and transmit data of the sensor to the intelligent driving domain control unit and the human-machine interaction domain control unit. In this application, external cable connections can be simplified, occupation of data stream transfer resources can be reduced, and power consumption of a vehicle can be reduced.

title: A modified cell and uses thereof
abstract: The present invention belongs to the field of biomedicine, and provides a modified cell and uses thereof, and in particular relates to a method for culturing cells that comprises reducing the expression and/or attenuating the activity of target genes in the cells. The present invention also relates to methods for using the cultured cells to prevent and/or treat tumors.
assignee: Suzhou Grit Biotechnology Co., Ltd.; Shanghai GRIT Biotechnology Co., Ltd.; Beijing Grit Biotherapeutics Co., Ltd.

title: Systems and methods for image vignetting replacement
abstract: A method, apparatus, non-transitory computer readable medium, and system includes obtaining a digital image including a content area and a vignette border area including a first corner area at a first corner of the digital image and a second corner area at a second corner of the digital image, generating a preliminary border mask indicating a location of the vignette border area, where the preliminary border mask includes the first corner area and the second corner area, modifying the preliminary border mask by mirroring the first corner area, comparing the mirrored first corner area to the second corner area, and updating the preliminary border mask based on the comparison to obtain a modified border mask, and generating a generated image based on the digital image and the modified border mask, where the generated image includes the content area and a generated area corresponding to the vignette border area.

title: Integrated substrate, manufacturing method thereof and electronic device
abstract: An integrated substrate includes: a dielectric substrate having a first surface and a second surface opposite to each other in a thickness direction of the dielectric substrate, where the dielectric substrate includes a first connection via running through the dielectric substrate in the thickness direction of the dielectric substrate; a first buffer layer on the first surface side and provided with a first hollowed-out pattern; a second buffer layer on the second surface side and provided with a second hollowed-out pattern; a first conductive structure in the first hollowed-out pattern; a second conductive structure in the second hollowed-out pattern; and a first connection electrode in the first connection via, where the first conductive structure and the second conductive structure are connected through, and form an integral structure with, the first connection electrode.
assignee: Beijing Boe Sensor Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.; Beijing Boe Technology Development Co., Ltd.

title: Semiconductor device having two step source or drain contact
abstract: The present disclosure describes a semiconductor device having a two-step source or drain contact structure. The two-step source or drain contact structure includes a first part on a source or drain structure of a transistor, and a second part on the first part and extending laterally beyond the first part toward a source or drain structure of another transistor.

title: Ph20 polypeptide variants, formulations and uses thereof
abstract: PH20 hyaluronidase polypeptides, including modified polypeptides that exhibit increased stability and/or increased activity, are provided. Also provided are compositions and formulations and uses thereof.

title: Agentic artificial intelligence systems
abstract: System, apparatus, article of manufacture, method and/or computer program embodiments are provided for using an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) system to automate jobs. An example method can include determining a domain of a task; assigning, by a coordinator agent including an AI model(s), the task to a domain-specific agent selected from a set of domain-specific agents based on the domain of the task and respective domains of the set of domain-specific agents, wherein each of the set of domain-specific agents comprises a different AI model trained or customized for a specific domain from the respective domains; triggering the domain-specific agent to perform the task and generate an output; and determining, by a verifier agent, an accuracy of the output generated by the domain-specific agent, wherein the verifier agent comprises another AI model(s) trained or customized to determine respective accuracies of outputs generated by the set of domain-specific agents.

title: Cluster Water Source Heat Pump
abstract: The present invention is a “Cluster WSHP” system for rapid upgrade or installation of large built-up air handling units (AHUs) as heat pumps using multiple common and in distribution (i.e., “commodity”), smaller unitary or split water source heat pumps (WSHPs), typically with a Cluster Controller to simplify the controls by making the Cluster WSHP appear as one unit to a BMS. This Cluster WSHP enables low cost yet high efficiency change-outs or new installations with far more coil per volume of airflow than large commercial AHUs have today. The small commodity WSHP units used are those commonly used for decarbonizing buildings due to their high efficiency. This innovation will enable easier and very cost effective decarbonization of buildings. It will also transform large HVAC unit servicing into a task no more complex than servicing a typical residential heat pump.
assignee: Richard A Clemenzi; Judith A Clemenzi

title: Cleaning device and electrical power tool
abstract: The application relates to the field of electrical power tools and discloses a cleaning device. The cleaning device includes: a first body having a drive device for outputting torque arranged therein; a second body rotatably connected to the first body, the second body including a rotating part that rotates around a first axis direction; a power transmission device having an input shaft connected to an output end of the drive device and an output shaft connected to the rotating part; and a cleaning component disposed on the rotating part. The relative angle between the second body and the first body is adjustable, allowing the angle of the cleaning component to be adjusted according to actual needs, thereby avoiding a series of defects caused by traditional fixed connection methods.

title: Housing and antenna architecture for mobile device
abstract: A device includes a display and a housing. The housing at least partially surrounds the display. The housing includes a first housing segment defining at least a first portion of an exterior surface of the device and a first interlock feature having an interlock surface that is offset with respect to an end surface of the first housing segment. The first interlock feature has a first opening formed in the interlock surface. The housing further includes a second housing segment defining at least a second portion of the exterior surface of the device and a second interlock feature having a second opening aligned with the first opening, and a non-conductive housing component defining a third portion of the exterior surface of the device and extending into the first opening and the second opening.

title: Reconfiguration of block item hierarchy in response to modification requests
abstract: Systems and methods for modifying block items in a hierarchical structure are disclosed herein. The system can receive a request to modify a first block item. The system can query the system for information of displayed block items. The system can receive a set of identifiers of the displayed block items, relational information, and privacy information. The system can determine an indication of displayed subordinate block items associated with the first block item. The system can use the indication of the displayed subordinate block items to query a block database to obtain non-displayed subordinate block items. The system can modify the block database in accordance with the instruction, the displayed subordinate block items, and the non-displayed subordinate block items. The system can determine updated displayed block items using the modified block database. The system can communicate an indication of the updated displayed block items to the client device.

title: Computing system for calculating carbon emissions of semiconductor products and method
abstract: A method for calculating carbon emissions of semiconductor products and a computing device using the same are disclosed, and more particularly, a method for indicating the environmental impact of a semiconductor product (DRAM, NAND, SSD, HBM, etc.) as a quantitative number using a unique product code thereof, and converting it into carbon emissions equivalents, thereby evaluating the carbon emissions.

title: Display structure
abstract: According to an example embodiment, display structure comprises a waveguide, an in-coupling structure, a first one-dimensional diffractive grating structure, and a second one-dimensional diffractive grating structure. The first one-dimensional diffractive grating structure is configured to receive the first set of in-coupled beams, and to diffract the first set of in-coupled beams producing a first diffracted set of beams. The second one-dimensional diffractive grating structure configured to receive the second set of in-coupled beams, and to diffract the second set of in-coupled beams producing a second diffracted set of beams. The first one-dimensional diffractive grating structure is further configured to receive, from the second diffracting structure, the second diffracted set of beams, and to out-couple the second diffracted set of beams from the waveguide.

title: Declaration-based data routing for analysis modules
abstract: An embodiment receives, at an analytics service of a telemetry manager platform of an information handling system, from an analytics requestor, an analytics request comprising a datatype identifier. An embodiment generates a nonce corresponding to the analytics request. An embodiment requests, from a data service selected using the datatype identifier, data fulfilling the analytics request, wherein the data request includes the nonce. An embodiment computes, using an analytics plug-in and the data received from the data service, an analysis result. An embodiment forwards, to the analytics requestor, the analysis result.

title: Information processing method, information processing apparatus, and program
abstract: The information processing method of the present disclosure includes a calculation process of a route, a detection process of an obstacle, and an evaluation process of the route. The calculation process calculates a route of the mobile body to the target point. The detection process of the obstacle detects an obstacle based on the distribution of the cluster group indicating the surrounding objects. The evaluation process of the route evaluates the safety of the route based on the positional relationship between the obstacle and the route.

title: Branched carboxylic acid-modified silicone and release agent composition for die casting containing same
abstract: Provided is a branched carboxylic acid-modified silicone which has excellent heat resistance when used at high temperatures, has excellent adhesion to a mold, vertical holding properties, and spreadability, even when used in a small amount, and can provide excellent mold releasability, and to provide a mold release agent for die casting containing the same. A branched carboxylic acid-modified silicone, containing in a molecule: 0.1 to 5.0 mass % of structural units expressed by RSiO 3/2 , R representing a monovalent hydrocarbon group; and 0.5 to 40.0 mass % of structural units expressed by RR′SiO 2/2 , R representing a monovalent hydrocarbon group and R′ being a carboxylic acid-containing organic group, and a mold release agent composition for die casting containing the branched carboxylic acid-modified silicone (including in the form an oil agent dispersion or an oil-in-water emulsion).

title: Integrated circuit structures having uniform grid metal gate and trench contact plug
abstract: Integrated circuit structures having uniform grid metal gate and trench contact cut, and methods of fabricating integrated circuit structures having uniform grid metal gate and trench contact cut, are described. For example, an integrated circuit structure includes a vertical stack of horizontal nanowires. A gate electrode is over the vertical stack of horizontal nanowires. A conductive trench contact is adjacent to the gate electrode. A dielectric sidewall spacer is between the gate electrode and the conductive trench contact. A first dielectric cut plug structure extends through the gate electrode, through the dielectric sidewall spacer, and through the conductive trench contact. A second dielectric cut plug structure extends through the gate electrode, through the dielectric sidewall spacer, and through the conductive trench contact, the second dielectric cut plug structure laterally spaced apart from and parallel with the first dielectric cut plug structure.

title: Information processing apparatus and control method
abstract: An information processing apparatus includes: a processor that executes BIOS processing; and a memory that temporarily stores pieces of data to be accessed by the BIOS processing. The processor is configured to store data location information indicating a location within the memory of some of the pieces of data in an area separate from an area in the memory where the pieces of data is stored; and when accessing one of the pieces of data stored in the memory through the BIOS processing, if the data location information on the data to be accessed is not stored in the memory, access the data by searching the pieces of data stored in the memory in a predetermined order, and if the data location information on the data to be accessed is stored in the memory, access the data in accordance with the data location information.

title: Method and apparatus for network parameter adaptation
abstract: Network parameter adaptation in a wireless communication system. A method for a user equipment (UE) includes receiving first information related to operation states on a cell and second information related to a search space set to receive physical downlink control channels (PDCCHs). A first operation state from the operation states includes first parameters associated with transmissions of channels or signals on the cell in one or more of a power, spatial, time, or frequency domain. A PDCCH from the PDCCHs provides a downlink control information (DCI) format that indicates one or more of the operation states. The method further includes receiving the PDCCH; determining the parameters in the one or more of the power, spatial, time, or frequency domain based on the one or more operation states indicated by the DCI format; and receiving the channels or signals on the cell based on the parameters.

title: Device and method for estimating a refractive error from measured visual acuity
abstract: A refractive error of an eye of a user is estimated by receiving measurements of the visual acuity of the user's eye, called reference visual acuity measurements, and data related to distinct respectively associated levels of blur, called reference blur data, the reference visual acuity measurements being performed within a reference measurement period by imposing the respective levels of blur on the user's eye. A generic model involving a theoretical visual acuity, theoretical blur data and a theoretical refractive error is particularized into a specific model for the user's eye, from the reference visual acuity measurements and the reference blur data, and information relevant to the refractive error of the user's eye is produced from the specific model and provided.

title: Surface acoustic wave facilitated fluidic assay systems and methods
abstract: Surface acoustic wave facilitated fluidic assay systems and methods are disclosed. An example system includes a piezoelectric substrate; a transducer assembly including a plurality of transducers that are deposited on the piezoelectric substrate, the transducer assembly configured to apply alternating electric fields to the piezoelectric substrate to induce surface acoustic waves; and a well plate configured to be positioned to receive the surface acoustic waves from the piezoelectric substrate, the well plate including a plurality of wells configured to contain fluid samples, in which the plurality of transducers are arranged to align with the plurality of wells to allow the surface acoustic waves to propagate into the fluid samples in the wells, thereby facilitating performance of an assay protocol performed in the fluid samples.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Negative type photosensitive composition
abstract: [Problem] To provide a negative type photosensitive composition capable of being cured at a low temperature. [Means for Solution] A negative type photosensitive composition comprising (I) a polysiloxane A having a certain structure, (II) a polymerization initiator, (III) a compound containing two or more (meth)acryloyloxy groups, (IV) a thiol compound containing two or more sulfanyl groups, and (V) a solvent.

title: Universal technology socket
abstract: The present invention is directed to a smart universal technology socket. The technology socket provides for easy installation and connection to an electrical power source. The technology socket is operable to receive hot swappable, modifiable, and upgradable pluggable devices. The technology socket supports pluggable devices with a variety of electrical requirements. The present invention provides a self-retaining technology socket for home, medical, school, and industrial uses.

title: Additively manufactured orthodontic appliances
abstract: The techniques described herein relate to additively manufactured orthodontic appliances. An example custom metal orthodontic bracket includes a body, a plurality of tie-wings, and a base. The base includes a base surface that is contoured to a shape of a tooth of a patient to which the custom metal orthodontic bracket is to be bonded, and a plurality of retentive structures, wherein at least one of a portion of the base is not polished or only partially polished, or a portion of at least one of the plurality of retentive structures is not polished or only partially polished. An example method for manufacturing a custom orthodontic bracket includes measuring dentition data of a patient, constructing a three-dimensional (3D) model of at least one tooth of the patient, designing a 3D model of the bracket, preparing feedstock, building the bracket, removing the feedstock, hardening the bracket, and polishing the bracket.

title: System and Method for Creation of Parametric 3D CAD Models
abstract: A method for generating a three-dimensional (3D) model of a monolithic part includes performing a plurality of generative actions using a plurality of thought tokens to generate a primary model based on a prompt received at the geometric modelling agent. The primary model is converted to executable code to generate a 3D computer-aided design (CAD) model associated with the primary model. Parametric equations are generated to represent the 3D CAD model based on the executable code. An evaluation metric associated with the 3D CAD model rendered based on the parametric equations is calculated, and the 3D parametric model is generated based on determining that the evaluation metric of the 3D CAD model exceeds a predetermined threshold.

title: Bearing device
abstract: A bearing device includes bearing pads each having a sliding surface that rotatably supports a rotary shaft, and an annular housing that holds the pads arranged in a circumferential direction. The bearing pad has a pad main body having a hollow part formed inside, a lubricating oil supply path communicating with the hollow part, and a discharge opening communicating with the hollow part. The hollow part has a first wall surface on the sliding surface side and a second wall surface which is on the opposite side of the sliding surface and on which a supply opening communicating with the lubricating oil supply path is formed. The hollow part also includes a support structure that connects the wall surfaces in a non-formation region of the supply opening. The hollow part has a space part in which the support structure is not formed and which serves as a linear space.

title: Enhanced neurosymbolic architecture for computer numerical control operations
abstract: A system and method for controlling computer numerical control (CNC) operations using an enhanced neurosymbolic architecture. The system combines symbolic planning and reasoning with neural perception and state estimation, implementing extended Action Notation Modeling Language (ANML) constructs for probabilistic state estimation, perception integration, and human-robot collaboration. The architecture includes a symbolic planner, neurosymbolic bridge component, execution engine, and physical layer interface, enabling advanced capabilities such as real-time adaptation, multimodal sensing integration, and intelligent human-robot collaboration. The system incorporates simulation capabilities through a digital twin interface and hybrid simulation models, supporting continuous improvement through learning from demonstration and online parameter adaptation.

title: Apparatus, a method and a computer program for cross-component parameter calculation
abstract: A method comprising: calculating at least two parameters that define a mapping from a first color component to a second color component, the at least two parameters including at least a slope parameter and an offset parameter; determining an update term to the slope parameter; applying the update term to the slope parameter by adding the update term to the value of the slope parameter to generate an updated slope parameter; determining a reference value of first color component; and calculating an updated offset parameter based on the reference value of the first color component and the updated slope parameter.

title: Detection device
abstract: According to an aspect, a detection device includes: a light source; a planar optical sensor; an object placement part allowing a culture medium accommodated in a dish to be placed such that the culture medium is interposed between the light source and the planar optical sensor; and a processor. The processor is configured to determine a boundary between a proliferation area and a non-proliferation area of culture targets based on a degree of light transmission of the culture medium. The boundary is in a position closest to a position where a rate of change in the degree of the light transmission is relatively highest among positions where the rate of change in the degree of the light transmission is equal to or less than a predetermined value within an area where the degree of the light transmission changes from a relatively higher side toward a relatively lower side.

title: Face encoder including token fusion model
abstract: A computing system including one or more processing devices configured to execute a face encoder including a text encoder, a face extraction model, and a token fusion model. At the face encoder, the one or more processing devices receive a text prompt and receive an input image depicting a face. At the text encoder, the one or more processing devices compute a text token sequence based at least on the text prompt. At the face extraction model, the one or more processing devices compute a face patch token sequence that encodes the face. At the token fusion model, the one or more processing devices compute a multimodal token sequence based at least on the text token sequence and the face patch token sequence. At a pretrained diffusion model, the one or more processing devices compute and output an output image conditioned on the multimodal token sequence.

title: Semiconductor device and method for fabricating thereof
abstract: A method of fabricating a semiconductor device that includes forming an opening in a substrate layer; forming a semiconductor layer lining the opening of the substrate layer; forming a first dielectric layer lining the semiconductor layer, in which the first dielectric layer is formed with a first temperature and a first hydrogen (H 2 ) concentration; and forming a second dielectric layer on the first dielectric layer and filling the opening, in which the second dielectric layer is formed with a second temperature different from the first temperature and a second hydrogen (H 2 ) concentration different from the first hydrogen (H 2 ) concentration.

title: Real-Time Generation of Natural-Sounding Audio Content From Context Data Using a Multi-Model Architecture
abstract: Provided are computer systems and methods for automatic generation of natural-sounding audio content from a variety of input data. The proposed systems and methods address several technical challenges observed in previous attempts to apply machine learning to this task. In particular, when applied to the task of automatic audio content generation, traditional large models such as large language models (LLMs) or similar often produced audio content that sounded unnatural due to issues such as preachy tones, excessive flattery, awkward transitions, monotone delivery, and/or limited conversation length. These drawbacks made the generated dialogues feel less engaging and realistic. Additionally, the proposed systems and methods provide for scalable personalized audio content by splitting the process of transcript generation and personalized transcript re-writing between multiple models.

title: Summarizing chat sessions to manage information loss
abstract: A chat history between a user and a machine learning model is preserved despite the context window size constraint of the machine learning model to ensure an enduring understanding of the chat or conversation history. When the token constraint of the context window size is reached, a summary of the chat history is generated to replace the chat history. The original content of the summarized chat history is stored in a lookup table and indexed by keywords. Instructions are provided to the model that allow the model to ask for the original content of the chat history summary which is obtained from the lookup table and provided to the model.

title: Defibrillator
abstract: The application relates to a defibrillator for implantation into a body of a living being and for controlling a cardiac activity of the heart of the living being, including: an electrode section, which is arranged as intended during implantation of the defibrillator such that a current surge/shock (ST) delivered via the electrode section controls the cardiac activity; switching electronics connected to the electrode section, which are configured to control the defibrillator and to trigger delivery of the current pulse (ST); at least one electrical energy storage device which supplies a voltage for long-term power supply, wherein the switching electronics are configured to generate, from the supplied voltage, a surge/shock voltage by means of which the electric current surge/shock for controlling the cardiac activity is delivered, by multiplying and/or reducing the supplied voltage for generating the surge/shock voltage; and an energy receiving section connected to the switching electronics, which is configured to receive energy in a contactless manner and to deliver the energy to the energy storage device for recharging the energy storage device, wherein the energy receiving section includes at least one coil which is configured to receive the energy and to deliver it to the energy storage device via a rectifier when permeated by a magnetic alternating field generated by an external charger.
assignee: Walter Mehnert; Thomas Theil; Rainer Reimann

title: Hardware apparatus for isolated virtual environments
abstract: A hardware apparatus for isolated virtual environments includes graphics processing unit comprising a first dedicated memory and a first plurality of processing cores, a central processing unit comprising a second dedicated memory and a second plurality of processing cores, a field programmable gate array comprising a third dedicated memory, a control and data bus assembly connecting the field programmable gate array, the central processing unit, and the graphics processing unit, and a hypervisor located on a non-volatile memory of the hardware apparatus, the hypervisor configured to create one or more virtual machines by isolating the graphics processing unit, the central processing unit and the field programmable gate array.

title: Organic Compound of Formula (I) for Use in Organic Electronic Devices, a Composition Comprising a Compound of Formula (IV) and at Least One Compound of Formula (IVa) to (IVd), an Organic Semiconductor Layer Comprising the Compound or Composition, an Organic Electronic Device Comprising the Organic Semiconductor Layer, and a Display Device Comprising the Organic Electronic Device
abstract: The present invention relates to a compound of formula (I) and an organic electroluminescent device a compound of formula (I).

title: Cooled flare tip barrel
abstract: A flare tip assembly includes a barrel having a barrel wall with an inner surface and an outer surface, an interior cavity defined within the inner surface and extending axially through the barrel, and internal channels formed through the barrel wall. The internal channels have a first opening at a lower axial end of the barrel wall and a second opening at an opposite, upper axial end of the barrel wall, and the internal channels are enclosed between the inner surface and the outer surface of the barrel wall. The flare tip assembly further includes a pilot positioned proximate to the upper axial end of the barrel.

title: Driving control apparatus
abstract: A driving control apparatus includes a microprocessor and a memory connected to the microprocessor. The microprocessor is configured to perform: comparing a target operation value of a predetermined operation of a moving body with an actual operation value, calculating a command value used for controlling the operation so as to bring the actual operation value closer to the target operation value, and controlling the operation based on the command value. The microprocessor is configured to further perform: calculating a corrected target operation value by correcting the target operation value using an assist component of an assist function in which manual operation for the operation by an occupant is assisted, and comparing the corrected target operation value with the actual operation value to calculate the command value.

title: User equipment (ue)
abstract: Although a UE is not storing allowed NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN, configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN, and/or default configured NSSAI, in a case that the UE is storing the partially allowed NSSAI and is in a TA in which S-NSSAI included in the partially allowed NSSAI is supported, the UE includes the S-NSSAI in requested NSSAI in a registration request message.

title: Color conversion substrate, method of manufacturing color conversion substrate, and electronic device
abstract: A color conversion substrate may include a base layer including first to third emission areas and a non-emission area, a bank provided on the base layer and defining first to third color conversion openings respectively corresponding to the first to third emission areas and a spacer opening provided in the non-emission area, a color conversion layer provided in the first to third color conversion openings, and a spacer provided in the spacer opening and including substantially the same material as the color conversion layer. Each of the bank and the spacer may include a first surface opposite to (e.g., facing) the base layer and a second surface opposite to the first surface. The second surface of the spacer may be convex in a direction opposite to a direction toward the base layer from the second surface of the bank.

title: Method and apparatus for refreshing interface, device and product
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method and an apparatus for refreshing an interface, a device, and a product. The method includes determining, in response to detecting a user’s interactive operation for a first interface, first data, the first interface being used for editing an audio-and-video, and the first data indicating data for refreshing the first interface and corresponding to the interactive operation. The method includes generating second data based on the first data and model data of the audio-and-video. The method includes refreshing the first interface based on the second data , the refreshed first interface being a second interface. In addition, the method further includes displaying the edited audio-and-video on the second interface.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Pharmaceutical composition containing specific self-assembling peptide rada16 for treating or preventing lower gastrointestinal diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a pharmaceutical composition for treating or preventing lower gastrointestinal diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease.
