User credentials for accessing password-protected sources are securely stored and managed. Artificial intelligence (AI) is utilized to adaptively navigate and extract bills from at least one of open websites, open portals, or password-protected portals, or configure email forwarding to receive bills in a designated customer billing inbox. Automated synchronization for recurring data retrieval tasks is performed. Billing data from various sources is normalized into a unified format. The consolidated billing data is presented to a user through a user interface. As such, the intelligent invoice system leverages AI-driven navigation to adapt to changing website layouts and API structures, streamlining bill retrieval and consolidation for improved efficiency and user experience.

title: Image Tagging With Prompts
abstract: A text prompt describing a target image classification is received via a graphical user interface. A text prompt embedding is generated for the text prompt using a text encoder. From a data repository storing images, a positive label subset is identified based on a first set of similarity scores. A negative label subset is identified from the data repository based on a second set of similarity scores. An image classification engine is trained using the positive label subset and the negative label subset to classify an input image as matching or not matching the text prompt based on an embedding of the input image. The embedding of the input image is obtained using the image encoder. An output associated with the trained classification engine is provided via the graphical user interface.

title: Intra prediction fusion with inherited cross-component models
abstract: A video coder specifies a cross-component prediction mode for a current block of a current picture of a video. The video coder derives a current cross-component model according to the specified cross-component mode for the current block. The video coder identifies a list of cross-component model candidates for the current block. The video coder selects a cross-component model candidate from the list of candidate cross-component models. The video coder generates a combined prediction based on the derived cross-component model and the selected cross-component model. The video coder encodes or decodes the current block by using the generated combined prediction. The video coder may signal a first syntax element indicating the specified cross-component prediction mode and a second syntax element indicating whether to use the combined prediction to encode the current block, with the first syntax element signaled before the second syntax element.

title: Pyrvinium and its derivatives for the treatment of pre-cancers
abstract: Described herein are pyrvinium and its derivatives for reprogramming a pre-cancerous mucosa to a non-cancerous state. Further described herein are pyrvinium and its derivatives for reducing the risk of cancer development in a living organism containing a metaplastic cell or a dysplastic cell.
assignee: Vanderbilt University; The United States Government As Represented By The Department Of Veterans Affairs

title: Image encoding/decoding method and device, and recording medium with bitstream stored thereon
abstract: An image decoding method and device according to the present disclosure may receive a bitstream including an encoded video picture and reconstruct the encoded video picture included in the bitstream. Here, the bitstream may include artificial intelligence (AI) usage constraint information indicating constraints on AI usage.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and recording medium
abstract: In order to visualize a process in which a result is generated by generative AI and a basis for the result to improve the transparency and reliability of operation of the generative AI, in an information processing device, a processor acquires input information from a user. The processor performs processing based on the input information to generate a result. The processor records process information used in a process of generating the result. The processor displays the result and basis information indicating a basis for the result based on the process information, simultaneously. The processor receives editing on the basis information from the user. This arrangement enables reliable AI-driven decision making by allowing users to visualize, edit, and verify the reasoning process behind generated results.

title: Biometric System Disruption Personal Gear, Modules And Methods
abstract: Personal gear and attachable modules configured to disrupt biometric systems, including facial recognition systems, are provided. Devices incorporate infrared emitters, control circuitry, power systems, and thermal-management features to corrupt capture of facial features across a range of lighting conditions, preventing reliable extraction or reconstruction by biometric systems. Embodiments include eyewear, headgear, jewelry, handhelds, and mobile-device attachments. Emission patterns are modulated, randomized, or sensor-responsive, with optional camera-detection activation. Materials and ergonomics support discreet, prolonged wear. Methods of use are also provided.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to acquire messages from a plurality of different communication applications, to analyze acquired messages using natural language processing to evaluate an urgency and an importance of each message based on content of the message, to generate a notification directed to a user for a message that is evaluated as having high urgency and high importance, and to generate a summary for a message that is evaluated as having low urgency and low importance and to provide the summary for later review by the user.

title: Access filter via select commands
abstract: In some aspects, a radio frequency identification (RFID) reader may select one or more filters to reduce a tag population to a tag sub-population. The RFID reader may transmit, to one or more tags in the tag population and as part of a set operation, one or more select commands associated with the one or more filters. The one or more filters may include one or more of a selection filter, a first access filter, or a second access filter. The set operation may command the one or more tags in the tag population to set or update a selected flag value or an inventoried flag value in accordance with one or more of the selection filter, the first access filter, or the second access filter. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Control of hysteretic current mode multilevel buck converter
abstract: A method of controlling a multilevel power converter may include measuring an input voltage at a converter input, determining a half input voltage based on the input voltage; measuring a flying capacitor voltage across the flying capacitor; determining an error voltage based on a difference between the flying capacitor voltage and the half input voltage; generating an inductor current window having an inductor peak current and a valley inductor current; modulating the inductor peak current into an upper inductor peak current and a lower inductor peak current based on the error voltage; and operating the multilevel power converter to produce an output current through an inductor to a converter output, the output current being within the inductor current window and based on a sequence of pulse width modulation states.

title: Servo Write Head For Writing Servo Patterns Having Opposite-Polarity Bars
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to a servo write bar comprising one or more servo write heads for writing servo patterns on a tape. Each servo write head comprises a first end pole, a second end pole, and a center pole disposed between the first and second end poles. The center pole is spaced from the first end pole by a first gap, and spaced from the second end pole by a second gap. A coil coupled to a current source is disposed around the center pole. A top surface is disposed over the center pole, and the first and second end poles. A servo pattern is disposed on the top surface over the coil. A first servo line of the servo pattern is disposed over the first gap, and a second servo line of the servo pattern is disposed over the second gap.

title: Display apparatus and method of driving the same
abstract: A display apparatus includes a display panel, a gate driver, a data driver, a first touch layer, a second touch layer and a touch driver. The gate driver is configured to output gate signals to the display panel. The data driver is configured to output data voltages to the display panel. The first touch layer is disposed adjacent to the display panel and includes a plurality of first touch electrodes. The second touch layer is disposed adjacent to the display panel and includes a plurality of second touch electrodes. The touch driver is configured to output touch driving signals to the plurality of first touch electrodes. When first gate pulses are applied to a first gate line group of the display panel, a first touch driving signal applied to a 1-1 touch electrode overlapping the first gate line group among the plurality of first touch electrodes has a discharging period.

title: Prefabricated 3d truss construction modules
abstract: The disclosure provides prefabricated 3D truss construction modules for home construction. One implementation provides an apparatus which includes a pair of sloped top chord panels having first ends meeting at a ridge line, one or more horizontal bottom chord panels supporting opposing second ends of the sloped top chord panels, and a web panel including a horizontal member and a pair of vertical members joined and meeting on either end of the horizontal member at right angles, the web panel supporting each top chord panel on an underside portion of the top chord panels where the horizontal and vertical members of the web panels meet, the web panel supported by the one or more bottom chord panels. The disclosure also provides a modular architectural roof feature system as well as modular homes or buildings manufactured using the truss or roof feature modules.

title: Method of manufacturing semiconductor device including buried connector
abstract: A method of manufacturing a semiconductor device includes forming a source/drain pattern and a channel pattern on an upper surface of a substrate, forming a through pattern extending through the source/drain pattern, forming an active contact on the through pattern, and forming a buried connector on a bottom surface of the substrate, where the upper surface and the bottom surface of the substrate are opposite each other and the buried connector is formed to be connected to the through pattern.

title: Reliability enhancement in distributed system
abstract: In an aspect of the disclosure, a method, a computer-readable medium, and a wireless system including a wireless device and a UE are provided. The UE transmits, on first RF time-frequency resources, first RF signals carrying user data to be sent to a base station. The wireless device receives the first RF signals on the first RF time-frequency resources. The wireless device transmits, to the base station, second RF signals on second RF time-frequency resources. The second RF signals carries the user data.

title: Pouch Transfer Device
abstract: A pouch transfer device including a first transport part, on which a lower surface of a pouch is seated and provided to transfer the pouch along a first path, a folding part provided to be capable of entering inside of the first transport part to support the lower surface of the pouch seated on the first transport part, and a nozzle part disposed on the first path and provided to spray air to an upper portion of an upper surface of the pouch during transfer by the first transport part is provided.

title: System for transporting objects employing at least one reusable smart mobile container and a chatbot
abstract: The invention relates to an object-transporting system allowing a conversational exchange. According to the invention, such a system comprises at least one intelligent movable object-transporting container configured to capture a first datum coming from an interlocutor, an identifier of the object present in the container, and an intelligent conversational agent configured to: receive the first datum with the object identifier; perform a contextualized semantic analysis of the first datum in the light of the object identifier: produce, optionally, a second contextualized datum resulting from the semantic analysis; transmit, optionally, the second datum to said at least one container; said container being moreover configured so as to process the second received datum.

title: Jackpack systems
abstract: A backpack with a jacket integrated into the back is called a Jackpack. It can be used by schoolchildren, who can unfold the waterproof jacket by unzipping the back of the backpack when it rains on their way to or from school. It complements the standard backpack. In a similar way when an adult is hiking or fishing and it starts to rain, they can remove the jacket from their rucksack and then zip it up. It is beneficial in any bad weather conditions.

title: Method for identifying and quantitating large number of targets in reduced number of reactions using molecular gates
abstract: Embodiment herein provides a method for identifying a large number of targets in a reduced number of reactions using molecular gates by (a) performing assays at a testing device on a sample by implementing a plurality of molecular OR gates or molecular SUM gates, one molecular gate per column of a group testing Matrix B, wherein an output of each molecular gate records the presence of any one of T nucleic acid targets in the corresponding column of the group testing Matrix B, (b) determining a Boolean vector Y of dimension M by determining a noisy version of outputs of the molecular OR gates, (c) identifying or quantitating a large number of T nucleic acid targets in reduced number of reactions by reconstructing a T-dimensional vector X using a group testing method or a compressed sensing method, optionally utilizing a regularity condition on X.

title: Methods and apparatus for indoor farming
abstract: Embodiments described herein generally relate to systems and methods for indoor farming. Containers having a lid and a basin can be used to grow plants in stagnant liquid growing medium (e.g., water and nutrients). The lid can contain solid growing medium (e.g., dirt) and seeds and/or plants. The lid can define slots that allow roots of plants to access the liquid growing medium. The containers can be stored in bays of a dense vertical rack system. Each bay can include a gravity feed system. A gantry can be operable to deposit containers into and retrieve containers from bays. Containers can be left in bays for plants to grow with no recirculation or agitation of liquid within the basins and little or no handling.

title: Belt suspended fully detachable cloth diaper with compatible belted garments
abstract: A garment system for managing incontinence comprises an absorbent article and one or more carrier garments. The absorbent article includes a liquid-impervious outer material, an inner-facing material, and at least one absorbent unit. The absorbent article contains no belt, waistband wings, waist-encircling structure, or crotch panel, rendering it incapable of independent wear. One or more carrier garments, selected from a waist belt, crotchless pants, crotchless shorts, a crotchless bodysuit, a skirt, a dress, or a shirt, each include a hip-surrounding portion and outward-facing fasteners. When connected, the carrier is sandwiched between the wearer's lower torso and the absorbent article. Discrete front and rear fastener sets allow independent detachment from either end, enabling absorbent article replacement without removing the carrier. The absorbent article is interchangeable among multiple carrier types while each carrier remains continuously worn.

title: Apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium, an article of aerosolizable medium and a method of operating an aerosol generating apparatus
abstract: A method of operating an aerosol generating apparatus is disclosed. The method comprises: sensing, at a first sensor of a sensor arrangement, a first indicia of an article comprising aerosolisable medium; sensing, at a second sensor of the sensor arrangement spaced a predetermined distance from the first sensor, a second indicia of the article; determining a distance between the first indicia and the second indicia; and operating the aerosol generating apparatus based at least on the distance between the first indicia and the second indicia.

title: Abeta-targeting proteins and methods of use
abstract: Described are Abeta-targeting proteins comprising an Abeta-binding region, a transferrin receptor (TfR)-binding region that specifically binds a TfR with an affinity of about 900 nM to about 10,000 nM, an FcγR-binding region. Also described are method of making the Abeta-targeting proteins and methods of using the Ab eta-targeting proteins to treat neurodegenerative disorders.

title: Systems and methods for determining instrument position in the presence of backlash
abstract: A robotically-assisted manipulator system includes an instrument, an instrument manipulator, and a controller. The instrument includes first and second instrument drivers coupled such that movement of the first instrument driver causes movement of the second instrument driver. The instrument manipulator includes first and second carriage drivers and a sensor. The first and second carriage drivers couple to the first and second instrument drivers. The controller is configured to: apply a first torque to the first carriage driver configured to impart motion to the first instrument driver to move the instrument in a degree-of-freedom; apply a second torque to the second carriage driver; adjust a magnitude of the first torque to cause a desired degree of movement of the instrument; receive a sensor signal indicating a position of the second carriage driver; and determine, based on the position of the second carriage driver, a current instrument position.

title: Anti-ccr8 antibodies and uses thereof
abstract: Provided herein are various embodiments relating to anti-CCR8 binding agents, that bind to CCR8, and uses thereof. Some of the embodiments include antibodies, fragments thereof, variants thereof, derivatives thereof, and binding polypeptides targeting the same that bind CCR8. Such anti-CCR8 binding agents can be used in methods to treat, for example, cancer.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor configured to receive sensor data from an Internet of Things (IoT) unit including a plurality of sensors installed in farmland, the sensor data being indicative of soil moisture, pH, temperature, crop growth status, and surrounding weather conditions. The processor evaluates a health state of crops and a progress of crop growth by applying a machine learning algorithm to the sensor data using an artificial intelligence (AI) unit. The processor further acquires weather forecast data and market demand data and performs a comprehensive analysis to generate an optimal farm work plan. Based on an analysis result produced by the AI unit, the processor controls agricultural machines including at least an irrigation system, a pesticide spraying drone, and a harvesting robot to automate farm work.

title: Gearbox arrangement for close to constant speed accessories
abstract: A gas turbine engine includes a high speed turbine and a high speed compressor connected by a high speed shaft to define a high speed spool. A low speed turbine and a low speed compressor are connected by a low speed shaft to define a low speed spool. A high speed tower shaft is driven by the high speed spool and a low speed tower shaft is driven by the low speed spool. The low speed tower shaft drives a low speed input gear in an accessory drive differential. The high speed tower shaft drives a high speed input gear in the accessory drive differential. One of the high speed input gear and the low speed input gear increases an output speed of an output gear, and the other decreases an output speed of the output gear. The output gear drives at least one accessory for the gas turbine engine.

title: Method and apparatus for updating srs configuration information, and communication device and storage medium
abstract: A method for updating sounding reference signal (SRS) configuration information, includes: updating first configuration information in SRS configuration information; where the SRS configuration information comprises the first configuration information and second configuration information, and the terminal transmits an SRS in at least two cells based on the second configuration information.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Apparatus and method for deterministic networking packet processing in communication system
abstract: Provided is an apparatus for deterministic networking packing processing in a communication system. The apparatus includes a network interface block, a system interface block, a time synchronization interface block, a processor interface block, a packet processing block group, and a packet buffering block. The packing processing block group includes a flow lookup block for identifying flow of a best-effort packet, an in-time packet, or an on-time packet and generating metadata, a flow sequence check block for verifying a sequence number of a packet, a filtering and policing block for filtering and policing the packet, a packet header processing block for processing a packet header, and an output scheduling block for scheduling the packet for each traffic class.

title: Display device, method of manufacturing the same and electronic device including the display device
abstract: A display device includes a transistor, a capacitor electrically connected to the transistor and including a first capacitor electrode including a first conductive layer and a plasma-treated layer disposed on the first conductive layer and a second capacitor electrode disposed on the first capacitor electrode and including a second conductive layer, and an insulating layer disposed between the first capacitor electrode and the second capacitor electrode.

title: Guide wire and catheter
abstract: A main body portion includes a plurality of segments and a linear member. The segments are continuously provided in a longitudinal direction of the main body portion, and are configured to be separated from or closer to each other in the longitudinal direction. The linear member is inserted into at least a portion of the plurality of segments. The linear member is connected to an operation portion in one end. The linear member is connected to a connection segment which is one of the segments in the other end opposite to the one end. The tension of the linear member extending between the connection segment and the operation portion is increased. The distance between the two segments disposed adjacent to each other on the proximal end side with respect to the connection segment is decreased, or the pressure contact force applied to the two segments from each other is increased.
assignee: SB-Kawasumi Laboratories, Inc.; Sumitomo Bakelite Co., Ltd.

title: Protective drain cap for a drain port of a swimming pool filter unit and method therefor
abstract: A protective drain cap for a drain port of a swimming pool filter unit includes a body, a female threading, and at least one aperture. The body is cylindrical and includes a front wall and a perimeter wall extending perpendicularly from the front wall. The front wall and the perimeter wall enclose a receptacle in the body. The body includes pest-resistant material to prevent damage to the drain port of the swimming pool filter unit from chewing by a pest. The female threading is positioned on an inner surface of the receptacle and designed to matingly engage with a male threading of the drain port. The aperture is formed in the front wall. The aperture is connected to the receptacle for drainage of water from the drain port of the swimming pool filter unit through the front wall when the swimming pool filter unit is not in use.

title: Vehicle-mounted camera mounting structure
abstract: The bracket has a base portion, a cover portion, and a hinge portion. An insertion hole for the camera is formed in the base portion. The camera is accommodated in the base portion through the insertion hole. The cover portion closes the insertion hole. The cover portion engages with the base portion. The hinge portion connects the base portion and the cover portion.

title: B-integral compensation in chirped pulse amplification
abstract: A method for chirped pulse amplification stretches laser pulses from an ultrashort duration to a longer duration, sets a repetition rate of the laser pulses delivered to one or more nonlinear laser amplifiers, amplifies the laser pulses in the nonlinear amplifier(s), and then recompresses the stretched, amplified laser pulses. The magnitude of a B-integral imposed by each nonlinear amplifier increases with pump power and decreases with pulse repetition rate. The final duration and/or spectral characteristic(s) of the recompressed laser pulses are sensitive to a total B-integral imposed by the nonlinear amplifier(s). The method also changes the repetition rate from a first to a second repetition rate, and, in conjunction herewith, adjusts the pump power for at least one nonlinear amplifier to achieve approximately the same final duration and/or spectral characteristic(s) at the first and second repetition rates without changing the chromatic dispersion imposed by the compressor.

title: Grease gun including an air vent with a membrane for priming
abstract: A grease gun includes a housing, a motor supported in the housing, a pump assembly coupled to and driven by the motor, a pump housing supported in the housing, and at least partially supporting the pump assembly, the pump housing at least partially defining a flow path, an air vent supported in the pump housing in fluid communication with the pump assembly and the flow path, the air vent configured to allow air to pass through the air vent to an exterior of the pump housing while retaining other fluids within the pump housing.

title: Eis measurement for batteries under load with measurement distribution characteristic
abstract: Various examples are directed to systems and methods for operating a battery. An Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) circuit may apply an alternating current (AC) excitation signal to a battery at a first frequency. The EIS circuit may store a first impedance of the battery measured at a first time during application of the AC excitation signal at the first frequency and a second impedance of the battery measured at a second time during application of the AC excitation signal at the first frequency. The EIS circuit may determine a first distribution characteristic of battery impedance based on the first impedance of the battery and the second impedance of the battery. The EIS circuit may measure a third impedance of the battery at a third time and determine, using the first distribution characteristic, that the third impedance is an outlier.

title: Sub-component shear sensor
abstract: A practical component configured to be connected to a substrate and subjected to a washing process for determining a shear force and/or a shear direction under the practical component. The practical component comprising a body, a movable section, and a sensor. The body includes a bridge and a number of supports extending from the bridge such that the body forms a space thereunder. The supports are configured to be secured to the substrate for retaining the practical component in a fixed position relative to the substrate. The movable section is at least partially positioned in the space and configured to shift relative to the body from liquid passing through the space. The sensor is configured to detect movement of the movable section relative to the body and hence a shear force of the liquid against the movable section.

title: Novel plk1 degradation inducing compound
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a novel PLK1 degradation inducing compound, a method for preparing the same, and the use thereof. The compounds of the present disclosure exhibit an effect of inducing PLK1 degradation. Therefore, the compounds of the present disclosure may be effectively utilized for preventing or treating PLK1-related diseases.

title: Processing methods for positioning reference signal configuration, and apparatus, communication device and storage medium
abstract: A method for processing an uplink positioning reference signal configuration is performed by a user equipment (UE). The method includes: releasing or saving an uplink positioning reference signal configuration according to a preset rule, wherein the uplink positioning reference signal configuration is used for uplink positioning when the UE is in a radio resource control (RRC) non-connected state.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Display device including a noise shielding layer and electronic device using the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a display device and an electronic device using the same. According to an embodiment of the disclosure, a display device comprising a display panel displaying an image; and a display driving circuit controlling an image display operation of pixels formed in the display panel, wherein the display panel includes a display module including a thin film transistor layer, a light emitting element layer, and an encapsulation layer on a substrate, a noise shielding layer formed on a front surface of the display module in a planar mesh type, and a touch sensing unit arranged in front of the noise shielding layer.

title: Tank cleaning system
abstract: The present invention relates to, in a first aspect, a tank comprising one or more chambers separated from one another by a weir, an inlet that opens into a first thereof, and an outlet that opens into a last thereof, a drain associated with each of the chambers, the inlet and each of the drains having a valve, each being able to be separately actuated between an open and closed position, a plurality of spray nozzles arranged to spray fluid onto an inner surface of each of the chambers, a fluid pipe arranged to provide fluid to each spray nozzle, a flow control means, and a control module connected to the fluid pipe flow control means and each valve. Also provided are a bank of tanks, each comprising multiple chambers, as well as a kit for conversion of an existing tank.

title: Nanocellulose-based hybrid materials
abstract: The invention provides a sustainable alternative nanocellulose-based hybrid material having improved strength and flexibility compared to known biopolymers and leather alternatives. The invention further provides methods of producing the nanocellulose-based hybrid material.

title: Full power uplink transmission mode 1 for 8tx ue
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate to methods, apparatuses, and systems that support full power uplink transmission. Some implementations of the method and apparatuses described herein may further include a user equipment (UE) for wireless communication, comprising: at least one memory; and at least one processor coupled with the at least one memory and configured to cause the UE to: receive a DCI format 0_1 or 0_2 including a TPMI field, where the TPMI field contains PUSCH transmission scheme information, wherein, the PUSCH transmission scheme information contains data layer split and duplicate information, and precoders used for antenna groups.

title: Optical patch panel
abstract: A server rack includes an optical patch panel and a plurality of processing units. The optical patch panel includes a plurality of L1 connections, a plurality of L2 connections, and a removable connectivity cartridge optically connecting the plurality of L1 connections and the plurality of L2 connections. The plurality of processing units is connected to an L2 domain of a datacenter through the removable connectivity cartridge of the optical patch panel.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to obtain audio data via an audio input unit, analyze the audio data via a speech recognition unit and convert the audio data into text data, analyze prosodic features of the audio data via an emotion identification unit and identify emotion information based on the prosodic features, generate a sign language expression based on the text data and the emotion information via a sign language translation unit, and generate character animation for visually displaying the sign language expression via an animation display unit.

title: Anti-ctla4 and anti-pd-1 bifunctional antibody, pharmaceutical composition thereof and use thereof
abstract: An anti-CTLA4 (cytotoxic T lymphocyte associated antigen4) and anti-PD-1 (programmed cell death 1) bifunctional antibody. a pharmaceutical composition thereof and use thereof. Particularly, the anti-CLTA4 and anti-PD-1 bifunctional antibody comprises a first protein functional domain that targets PD-1 and a second protein functional domain that targets CTLA-4. The bifunctional antibody can bind to CTLA-4 and PD-1 specifically, relieve immunosuppression of CTLA4 and PD-1 on an organism specifically, activate T lymphocytes, and thus has good application prospects.

title: Safe Vertical Take-Off and Landing Aircraft Payload Distribution and Adjustment
abstract: Vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) aircraft can provide opportunities to incorporate aerial transportation into transportation networks for cities and metropolitan areas. However, VTOL aircraft can be sensitive to uneven weight distributions, e.g., the payload of an aircraft is primarily loaded in the front, back, left, or right. When the aircraft is loaded unevenly, the center of mass of the aircraft may shift substantially enough to negatively impact performance of the aircraft. Thus, in turn, there is an opportunity that the VTOL may be loaded unevenly if seating, luggage placement, and/or positions of internal components are not coordinated. Among other advantages, dynamically assigning the payloads and adjusting components of the VTOL aircraft can increase VTOL safety by ensuring the VTOL aircraft is loaded evenly and meets all weight requirements; can increase transportation efficiency by increasing rider throughput; and can increase the availability of the VTOL services to all potential riders.

title: Method for catalytic reforming with upgrading of non-aromatic effluents
abstract: According to a first aspect, the present invention relates to a process and apparatus for producing aromatic compounds. in which the raffinate ( 16 ) from an aromatics extraction unit ( 14 ) is sent to a dedicated catalytic reforming unit ( 17 ) to produce a reformate exit stream ( 18 ) that is successively treated by: a recontacting section ( 4 ) to separate hydrogen ( 5 ); a stabilization section ( 7 ) to separate C1-C2 hydrocarbon compounds ( 8 ) and C3-C4 or C3-C5 hydrocarbon compounds ( 9 ); and a reformate separation column ( 11 ) to separate a C6-C8 fraction ( 12 ) and a C8+ fraction ( 13 ), the C6-C8 fraction ( 12 ) being sent to the aromatics extraction unit ( 14 ). The present invention also relates to a process for modifying an existing apparatus for producing aromatic compounds, comprising installing the process according to the first aspect in the existing apparatus.

title: Formation of co-crystals
abstract: The invention relates to a method of forming a co-crystal, the method comprising forming a droplet comprising a first liquid and a second liquid; wherein the first liquid comprises a chemical molecule, or a salt thereof, and a co-former, or a salt thereof, and the second liquid is an oil. The invention also relates to a method of screening for co-crystals of a chemical molecule, or salt thereof, the method comprising said method of forming a co-crystal.

title: Self-lubricating guide rail arrangment for linear actuators
abstract: Described are linear actuators the include plain bearing linear rails whose sliding interfaces are made up of a self-lubricating polymer surface on one side and a stainless steel surface on the other. Such a configuration lowers wear and friction without the use of grease or other such organic lubricants that may produce contaminants inside controlled environments such as sealed enclosure hard disk drives. The self-lubricating polymer of the described linear rails may be provided as a sandwiched layer or top coating layer bound by a metal architecture, preferably stainless steel. The self-lubricating polymer may be polyoxymethylene (POM), polyamide (Nylon), polyether ether ketone (PEEK) or combinations thereof.

title: Event detection pixel sensor circuit assembly
abstract: An event detection pixel sensor circuit assembly for employment in image sensors utilized in automotive, aerospace, medical, robotics, industrial, civilian, and military applications, among many other possibilities. The event detection pixel sensor circuit assembly, per an implementation, includes a multitude of transistors, a cross-coupled inverter, and an exclusive OR (XOR) logic gate circuit assembly. One of the multitude of transistors is a hybrid phase transition field-effect transistor (HyperFET) with a phase transition material (PTM). Amid operation of the event detection pixel sensor circuit assembly, the phase transition material switches states in response to incident light levels (e.g., high, low) at a photodiode of the event detection pixel sensor circuit assembly.

title: Tracking target position detection device, radiotherapy system, and tracking target position detection method
abstract: A moving object tracking calculation device evaluates priority of visibility of a tracking target between a high-visibility digital radiography image and a low-visibility digital radiography image of the tracking target, calculates a weight distribution representing relative presence accuracy of the tracking target in the low-visibility digital radiography image using epipolar geometry and a difference in visibility between the high-visibility digital radiography image and the low-visibility digital radiography image, and determines a detection position of the tracking target in the low-visibility digital radiography image using the weight distribution and a similarity distribution of the low-visibility digital radiography image.

title: Mesh-shaped porous co2-capturing solution and separation method for co2 gas
abstract: There are a mesh-shaped porous CO 2 -capturing solution and a separation method for CO 2  gas. The composition of the capturing solution has 1%-50% of a specific chemical agent and 50%-99% of water. The specific chemical agent is one or a combination of two or more of an imidazole substance, an imidazole ionic liquid, a piperazine substance, and an amino alcohol substance. The mesh-shaped porous CO 2 -capturing solution remains stable and adsorbs CO 2  at low temperatures. The porous structure disintegrates and releases CO 2  at high temperatures. The mesh-shaped porous CO 2 -capturing solution has advantages, including fast absorption rate, a large absorption capacity, and a low regeneration temperature.
assignee: China University Of Petroleum-Beijing; Basemof Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Fenestration unit with sash supported for gliding movement and lateral movement within a frame
abstract: A fenestration unit includes a frame and a sash. The sash includes a glide support member and a projection. The frame includes a frame member that is elongate. The frame member at least partly defines a panel seat that opposes the panel peripheral area when the sash closed, a support track configured to engage and support the glide support member for gliding movement of the sash, and a guide channel that receives the projection to guide gliding movement of the sash. The frame member includes a diverter channel extending between the panel seat and the guide channel and is configured to receive the projection to guide movement of the sash. The frame member includes a recess providing clearance between the frame member and the glide support member as the sash moves.

title: Novel tag for liquid-phase peptide synthesis
abstract: The present invention relates compound according to formula (I), wherein, X is selected from the group consisting of —O—(CH 2 ) n —, wherein n is 0 to 4, R 1  and R 2  are independently selected from the group consisting of C 11 -C 25  alkyl, SP is a spacer, particularly selected from the group consisting of saturated C 4 -C 8  alkyl, unsaturated C 4 -C 8  alkyl and substituted or unsubstituted C 6 -aromatic compound, in particular the substituted C 6 -aromatic compound is an alkyl substituted C 6 -aromatic compound, Y is a heteroatom, particularly selected from the group consisting of —O— and —NH—, L is a linker for peptide synthesis and m is 0 or 1, particularly m is 1.

title: Time-dependent synthetic biological barrier material
abstract: Thermally stable absorbable fiber populations, i.e. fiber populations that do not undergo thermally induced crystallization, can be intermixed to yield a stabilizing effect without altering morphological properties of a first fiber system. By addition of a stabilizing fiber population one may minimize thermally induced shrinkage and maintain physical properties of electrospun materials in the as-formed state. In one particular abstract, medical barrier materials may be formed from the electrospun materials to provide improved medical barriers for treatments.

title: Solar cell
abstract: A solar cell, including: a silicon substrate containing antimony, wherein silicon substrate has a first surface; an antimony-containing tunneling oxide layer covering first surface; and a doped conductive layer covering, along a thickness direction of the solar cell, a surface of antimony-containing tunneling oxide layer away from silicon substrate, where doped conductive layer contains antimony. An antimony concentration of antimony-containing tunneling oxide layer is greater than an antimony concentration of silicon substrate, and the antimony concentration of silicon substrate is greater than an antimony concentration of doped conductive layer. Along the thickness direction of the solar cell, a first antimony-containing region is formed at a side of doped conductive layer adjacent to antimony-containing tunneling oxide layer, and an antimony concentration of first antimony-containing region is greater than an antimony concentration of rest region of the doped conductive layer.

title: Semiconductor device and semiconductor memory device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes: a first electrode; a second electrode; an oxide semiconductor layer provided between the first electrode and the second electrode and including a first region, a second region, and a third region between the first region and the second region; a gate electrode facing the third region; a first insulating layer facing the first region; a second insulating layer facing the second region; and a gate insulating layer provided between the gate electrode and the oxide semiconductor layer, the gate insulating layer containing oxygen (O) and at least one metal element selected from a group consisting of Al, Hf, Zr, La, Y, Zn, In, Sn, and Ga, and the gate insulating layer having a chemical composition different from that of the oxide semiconductor layer.

title: Method and apparatus for parallel pointer operations
abstract: A method and apparatus for parallel pointer operations are disclosed. According to one aspect of the present disclosure, there is provided a method performed by one or more computers for performing a loop operation including pointer operations on a plurality of pointers, the method comprising: a pointer vectorization process of vectorizing the plurality of pointers by storing an address value pointed to by each of the plurality of pointers as an individual element of a vector register of a processor to generate a vector variable, wherein each element of the vector variable represents a memory address of an individual pointer; and a pointer vector operation process of updating addresses of the plurality of pointers stored in the vector register in parallel through a vector operation using a preset vector offset variable during execution of a loop body.

title: Electronic device comprising display protection structure
abstract: An electronic device may comprise: a housing including a support structure; a display including a display panel and an extension part bent from one side of the display panel toward the inside of the housing; a molding surrounding one side of the display panel and the extension part; and an adhesive member disposed between the molding and the support structure, wherein the molding includes a part including a recess area recessed from a surface facing the support structure toward the display, and the adhesive member is disposed between the support structure and a part of the molding, which is disposed between the recess part and a side wall. Other embodiments are possible.

title: Device
abstract:
The purpose of the present disclosure is to provide a device capable of efficiently performing cooling of an antenna. 
     The device of the present disclosure is characterized by comprising a housing, a first container provided inside the housing and capable of maintaining a depressurized state, a second container provided inside the first container to house an item to be processed, an antenna space portion provided inside the second container and composed of a member a part of which transmits a microwave, an antenna provided inside the antenna space portion to emit a microwave, and an opening portion provided in the antenna space portion, wherein the antenna is connected to a high-frequency oscillation circuit via a transmission line, and the opening portion is a hole penetrating through the first container and the second container to provide communication between the housing and the antenna space portion.

title: Systems and methods for deferred tool execution
abstract: A first connection is established between a client device and server. The client sends a user query (a first message) to the server and the server sends a first prompt based thereon to a LLM. In response, the LLM invokes a tool call for execution by the client device. The server transmits the tool call to the client device and the first connection is closed. The client executes the tool call. A second connection is established between the client device and server. The client device sends a second message to the server. The server determines that the second message includes a tool response in reply to the tool call and transmits a message including the tool response and at least a portion of stored conversation history to the LLM. The LLM sends an assistant message in reply and the server transmits a first assistant message to the client device.

title: Smart routing rule caching for orthogonal rule entries
abstract: Techniques for providing a smart routing rule caching mechanism for orthogonal routing rule entries. The techniques can be implemented in a storage system that includes a routing rule table for controlling access to multiple routing tables, and a routing rule cache table that can store one, two, or more recently used routing rules, each of which is orthogonal to a high number of routing rules stored in the routing rule table. The techniques include determining that attributes of a packet transmission match corresponding attributes of an orthogonal routing rule in the routing rule cache table. The techniques include moving the matched orthogonal routing rule to the top position of the routing rule cache table if not already in the top position. The techniques include, based on the matched orthogonal routing rule, accessing a routing table from among the multiple routing tables to lookup routing information for forwarding the packet transmission.

title: Substrate for liquid filter and liquid filter
abstract: Provided is a substrate for a liquid filter including a polyolefin microporous membrane having a pore diameter of 1 nm to 35 nm and containing 1 to 2 particulates having a major axis of 1 mm or more per 1 m 2 .

title: Feature detection
abstract: In various examples, a path perception ensemble is used to produce a more accurate and reliable understanding of a driving surface and/or a path there through. For example, an analysis of a plurality of path perception inputs provides testability and reliability for accurate and redundant lane mapping and/or path planning in real-time or near real-time. By incorporating a plurality of separate path perception computations, a means of metricizing path perception correctness, quality, and reliability is provided by analyzing whether and how much the individual path perception signals agree or disagree. By implementing this approach—where individual path perception inputs fail in almost independent ways—a system failure is less statistically likely. In addition, with diversity and redundancy in path perception, comfortable lane keeping on high curvature roads, under severe road conditions, and/or at complex intersections, as well as autonomous negotiation of turns at intersections, may be enabled.

title: Method and apparatus for configuring shared cell in communication system
abstract: A method performed by a middle node in a communication system includes: receiving a request message for capability information from a controller; transmitting capability information of the middle node as a response to the request message; and receiving timing information corresponding to multiple subcarrier spacings (SCSs) from the controller based on the capability information of the middle node.

title: Alignment ring for scope
abstract: Disclosed herein are alignment features for scopes, such as alignment rings for telescopic sights. For example, a scope can includes a proximal end having an interior surface. The proximal end is that which a user aligns his or her eye in order to visualize a target. The scope may also include an alignment ring on the interior surface of the proximal end. The alignment ring assists a user in determining whether his or her eye is properly aligned with a longitudinal axis of the scope. With correct eye alignment, the alignment ring is not visible. With incorrect eye alignment, at least a portion of the alignment ring is visible, thus ensuring accurate sighting.

title: Array substrate, display panel, and display apparatus
abstract: An array substrate includes: a substrate; a plurality of pixel circuits disposed on the substrate; a first conductive layer including a plurality of conductive patterns; and a second conductive layer disposed on a side of the first conductive layer away from the substrate and including a plurality of first signal lines. The plurality of pixel circuits being arranged in rows and columns. The plurality of conductive patterns are spaced apart from the plurality of pixel circuits, and a conductive pattern includes at least two contact portions arranged at intervals. The plurality of first signal lines are arranged at intervals in a first direction and all extend in a second direction; a first signal line is electrically connected to at least one conductive pattern, and the first signal line is connected to the at least two contact portions of the conductive pattern.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Drill bit and method to perform an osteotomy using this drill bit
abstract: The present disclosure provides a drill bit comprising an apical end, a coronal end, and a longitudinal axis extending between the apical end and the coronal end. The drill bit further includes a drill bit core extending along the longitudinal axis, at least two flutes, each flute being defined by a concave surface forming a recess along the drill bit core, and an apical end face at the apical end. Apical edges of the concave surfaces and an apical edge of the drill bit core define the shape of the apical end face so that the apical end face defines a profile of retention arms at the apical end, each retention arm being formed between the concave surfaces of adjacent flutes. The present disclosure also provides a method to create an osteotomy using a drill bit.

title: A gene signature for diagnosing stimulator of interferon genes (sting)-associated vasculopathy with onset in infancy (savi)
abstract: Gain-of-function mutations in STING1, that codes for the Stimulator of Interferon Gene (STING), result in a severe autoinflammatory disease termed STING-associated vasculopathy with onset in infancy (SAVI). Although elevated type I interferon (IFN) production is thought to be the leading cause of the symptoms observed in patients, STING can induce a set of pathways, and their role in the onset and severity of SAVI remains to be elucidated. To address this point, the inventors compared a single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) dataset of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from SAVI patients to a dataset of healthy PBMCs treated with recombinant IFN-β. In particular, scRNA-seq clustering identified a patient-specific subset of monocytes, highly inflammatory and expressing a strong integrated stress response (ISR). Even more particularly, the inventors have identified at the transcriptomic level a STING-associated signature of 21 genes that is driven by STING activation, independently of type I IFN. This signature is therefore suitable to better distinguish SAVI from other type I interferonopathy.
assignee: Institut National de la Santé et de la Recherche Médicale; Université Paris Cité; Assistance Publique-Hôpitaux De Paris (Aphp); Fondation Imagine; Sanofi

title: Camera module and electronic device comprising same
abstract: A camera module according to an embodiment, may include a housing, a lens assembly disposed at least in part inside the housing, and including at least one lens, an image sensor for converting light received through the at least one lens into an electrical signal, a printed circuit board including a first side on which the lens assembly is disposed, a base on which the printed circuit board is disposed, and an electrical element connected to the printed circuit board. The printed circuit board may include a first region having a first thickness, and a second region having a second thickness which is greater than the first thickness. The first region may include a second side facing in a direction opposite to the first side. The electrical element may be disposed to the second side of the first region. Besides, various embodiments obtained from the specification are possible.

title: Water-filled capsule and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a technology for a water-enclosed seamless capsule that may seal and retain the moisture of a content liquid in a capsule over a long period of time. In a water-enclosed capsule including a water-containing core containing water and an enclosing layer disposed on the outside of the water-containing core, it has become possible to seal and retain the moisture of the water-containing core in a capsule over a long period of time when the enclosing layer consists of a lipophilic composition having a specific gravity adjusted within a specific range, or when the shell thickness of the enclosing layer is at a predetermined shell thickness or more, which is a range to be retained.

title: Substrate processing method and substrate processing apparatus
abstract: A substrate processing method includes preparing a substrate having a first main surface and a second main surface, each of the first and the second main surfaces having waviness, performing a laser processing of the first main surface, performing a grinding or polishing processing of the second main surface, and preforming a grinding or polishing processing of the first main surface in this order. The substrate processing method includes acquiring map data of the waviness of the first main surface before the laser processing; and setting a processing condition for a current laser processing based on, in addition to the map data of the waviness of the first main surface, required data of the substrate previously subjected to the laser processing of the first main surface, the grinding or polishing processing of the second main surface, and the grinding or polishing processing of the first main surface in this order.

title: Electroplating apparatus
abstract: The present invention provides an electroplating apparatus. A solid anode, a meshed anode or a perforated anode is arranged in the anode region to serve as an inert anode. And the constant distance is maintained between the inert anode and a substrate, so as to form a stable electric field on the surface of the substrate, thereby improving the uniformity of electroplating. An active anode is arranged below the inert anode in the anode region, so as to continuously replenish metal ions during the electroplating process, so that the metal ions can be more sufficiently conveyed to the substrate, thereby playing a role in improving the uniformity of electroplating. Components such as a rectifying plate, a fluid dispersion pipe or a stirring member are arranged in the anode region, so as to uniformly disperse the anode liquid, thereby further improving the uniformity of electroplating.

title: Automated bagging machine for forming side seals
abstract: An automated bagging machine includes a frame, a roller coupled to the frame and including a first end, a second end opposite the first end, and a longitudinal axis extending through the first and second ends. The roller is configured to rotate about the longitudinal axis. The bagging machine further includes a seal bar coupled to the frame and having a first drive mechanism configured to axially drive the seal bar toward the roller, a heat member configured to heat the seal bar, and a blade, and a second drive mechanism configured to drive rotation of the roller. When the first drive mechanism drives the seal bar toward the roller, the roller and the seal bar are configured to engage with film moved through the machine and form a side seal along an edge of the film.

title: Round and small diameter optical cables with a ribbon-like optical fiber structure
abstract: Ann optical fiber cable including an optical fiber ribbon in a pipe, wherein the ribbon includes at least two optical fibers arranged side by side, and wherein at least two of the optical fibers are bonded intermittently along a length of the fibers.

title: Device and methods for facilitating information flow using meta-context transfer
abstract: A method of controlling an electronic device for enabling a context transfer from a virtual session to an environment external to the virtual session, includes detecting at least one user in an a virtual session; based on detecting the at least one user, obtaining a context of at least one virtual device content present in the virtual session, based on detecting the at least one user; obtaining at least one user interest related with the at least one virtual device content using at least one user input in the virtual session; obtaining correlation information between the at least one user interest and at least one content capability of a plurality of real world user devices of the at least one user; and providing at least one real world user device, among the plurality of user devices, to the at least one user for transferring the context of the at least one virtual device content based on the correlation information.

title: Data transmission
abstract: In a data transmission method, whether a plurality of quality of service (QoS) flows meets a synchronous transmission criterion is determined. In the method, when the plurality of QoS flows is determined to meet the synchronous transmission criterion, transmission resources are allocated to the plurality of QoS flows based on a synchronization requirement, whether transmission processes of the plurality of QoS flows meet the synchronization requirement is monitored, and the transmission resources allocated to the plurality of QoS flows are adjusted when the transmission processes of the plurality of QoS flows are determined not to meet the synchronization requirement. Apparatus and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium counterparts are also contemplated.

title: Optical module and wearable device
abstract: An optical module and a wearable device are disclosed. The optical module includes an imaging lens group, a first bracket, a lens barrel, an arc-shaped rack, a lead screw gear, and a driving member. The imaging lens group includes a first lens, having a beveled lens; the first lens is provided in the first bracket, and an outer wall of the lens barrel is provided with an arc-shaped groove; a lead screw gear includes a lead screw and a gear provided at one end of the lead screw, the lead screw is in transmission connection with the first bracket, and the gear forms meshing transmission with the arc-shaped rack; and the driving member forms meshing transmission with the arc-shaped rack.

title: Data tracing method and apparatus, and related device
abstract: A data tracing method includes: A data tracing system obtains a tracing request, where the tracing request is used to find a cause of an anomaly of a to-be-traced record in a result table, the tracing request includes a tracing parameter, the result table includes a tracing field, a field value of the tracing field includes one or more table identifiers and a filter condition corresponding to each table identifier, the result table is obtained based on source data tables corresponding to the one or more table identifiers, and the tracing parameter includes a field value of a tracing field corresponding to the to-be-traced record. The data tracing request determines a tracing statement based on the tracing request, and executes the tracing statement, to determine the cause of the anomaly corresponding to the to-be-traced record.

title: Method for providing a workpiece support unit for supporting a workpiece
abstract: The present disclosure describes a method of providing a workpiece support unit for supporting a workpiece. The method comprises the steps of providing a carrier having a first side and a second side opposite to the first side, providing a protective sheeting, and providing an intermediate layer. The method also comprises the step of arranging the protective sheeting and the intermediate layer on the first side of the carrier by at least partially interposing the intermediate layer between the protective sheeting and the carrier so that an attachment force between said protective sheeting and said carrier is greater in a peripheral region of the first side of the carrier than in a center region of the first side of the carrier. The disclosure also proposes a workpiece support unit.

title: Conflict resolution for malformed blocked airspace designations
abstract: In some aspects, the techniques described herein relate to a method including: receiving, by a processor, blocked airspace description data; converting, by a processor, a flight path into a plurality of latitude-longitude pairs; expanding, by the processor, the blocked airspace description data into a plurality of potential blocked airspace sub-regions, each of the potential blocked airspace sub-regions including a geographical area; identifying, by the processor, a subset of the potential blocked airspace sub-regions based on comparing flight steps between respective latitude-longitude pairs and geographic areas of the potential blocked airspace sub-regions; and using, by the processor, the subset of the potential block airspace sub-regions to adjust the flight path.

title: Magnetic assembly and vacuum pump
abstract: Magnetic assembly for a rotor preferably of a molecular drag vacuum pump, comprising a first rotated magnet to be connected to the rotor and rotated together with the rotor, a static damper element arranged axially next to the first rotated magnet to induce eddy currents into the static damper element, a rotated yoke arranged axially next to the first rotated magnet extending radially, a static coil configured to generate a magnetic field, and a static yoke connected to the static coil and arranged directly next to the rotated yoke to induce an axial magnetic force into the rotated yoke.

title: Securing A Storage System From An Unapproved Reset
abstract: Securing a storage system from an unapproved reset, including: verifying that one or more prerequisites for resetting a storage system are satisfied; providing, based on the one or more prerequisites being satisfied, a token to reset the storage system; and initiating a reset of the storage system in response to a command to reset the storage system comprising the token.

title: Haptics and sensing systems for an input device
abstract: In some embodiments, a computer mouse includes a housing, a depressible keyplate, and a haptic element coupled to a bottom surface of the depressible keyplate. The haptic element can be configured to operate in a plurality of modes of operation including a first mode and a second mode. In the first mode of operation, the haptic element can generate a haptic output that statically and unidirectionally deflects and holds the haptic element and coupled keyplate at a deflection distance. In the second mode of operation, the haptic element can generate a second haptic output that bidirectionally deflects the haptic element relative to the deflection distance thereby generating a vibrational feedback that is superimposed on the unidirectional deflection at the deflection distance. In some aspects, the haptic element is a piezoelectric device and the control signal is a voltage applied to the haptic element.

title: Memory device and method of fabrication
abstract: A memory device includes a stack including a plurality of electrode layers and a plurality of interlayer insulating layers that are vertically alternately stacked; a cell plug vertically penetrating the stack; a source plate disposed on the stack and connected to the cell plug; a contact vertically penetrating the stack and connected to one of the plurality of electrode layers; and a pass transistor disposed on the stack, and including a semiconductor pillar that is connected to the contact, a gate insulating layer that surrounds an outer wall of the semiconductor pillar and a gate electrode that surrounds an outer wall of the gate insulating layer.

title: A device for secure storage of data
abstract: A device includes a circuit board and a first processing component. The first processing component includes a first chip. The first processing component is mounted on a first side of the circuit board with an active surface of the first chip facing towards the circuit board. The device includes a second processing component comprising a second chip, the second processing component mounted on a second side of the circuit board with an active surface of the second chip facing towards the circuit board, wherein the second side of the circuit board is opposite to the first side of the circuit board. The second processing component is mounted at least partially overlapping with the first processing component. A first tamper detection link is provided through the circuit board and in the area of overlap between the first processing component and the second processing component.

title: Systems and methods for power distribution in electric aircraft
abstract: An aircraft includes a flight controller; a plurality of battery packs, at least some of which are located in one or more wings of the aircraft; a plurality of power distribution buses that are electrically isolated from each other; and six electric propulsion units electrically coupled to the battery packs via the power distribution buses and a plurality of contactors or fuses. Each of the battery packs is configured to provide power to three of the electric propulsion units. At least one of the electric propulsion units is configured to, after loss of one of the other electric propulsion units, increase an operating power to at least partially compensate for the loss.

title: Cavity-free frame and photovoltaic module
abstract: A cavity-free frame includes a frame body, an abutting member, and a limiting member. The frame body includes a load-bearing portion, a support portion, a mounting portion, and a reinforcement portion. The load-bearing portion and the mounting portion are spaced apart, and the support portion is disposed between the load-bearing portion and the mounting portion and connected to the load-bearing portion and the mounting portion. The abutting member is connected to a first end of the load-bearing portion. The limiting member is connected to an end of the abutting member away from the load-bearing portion. The limiting member, the abutting member, and the bearing surface together enclose a mounting groove for installing a laminate member. An opening of the mounting groove faces a second end of the load-bearing portion. The present disclosure can reduce material costs.

title: Frequency adjustment device and frequency adjustment method
abstract: A frequency adjustment device operating based on a power supply and an operation frequency is provided, comprising: a clock supply circuit, configured to output one of multiple clock signals as a supply clock signal; a clock gating component, configured to gate the supply clock signal to generate an output clock signal; and a control circuit, configured to: when a voltage variation slope of the power supply is less than a critical slope, reduce a frequency of the output clock signal; when the voltage variation slope is greater than zero, increase the frequency of the output clock signal; and when the voltage variation slope is maintained in a stable slope range for a specified period, control the clock supply circuit to select one clock signal with the operation frequency as the supply clock signal, and adjust the frequency of the output clock signal to which of the selected clock signal.

title: Method and system for dynamically customizing food formulations
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system, a method and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium for dynamically customizing one or more pre-existing food formulations. The method includes receiving one or more input parameters from a user device. The method includes extracting one or more pre-existing food formulations and a set of food processing conditions for the one or more pre-existing food formulations. The method includes generating, using the machine learning model, the nutrient degradation profile for each nutrient corresponding to one or more ingredients associated with the one or more pre-existing food formulations. The method includes determining a set of degradation coefficients for each nutrient corresponding to the one or more ingredients. The method includes predicting nutrient retention rates associated with the one or more pre-existing food formulations. The method includes customizing the one or more pre-existing food formulations.

title: Hot stamping system and method
abstract: A method for hot stamping a plurality of blanks includes providing a plurality of blanks. The method also includes heating the plurality of blanks concurrently in a batch heating furnace at an intermediate temperature for a first time duration. The method also includes heating at least one of the plurality of blanks in a roller hearth furnace at a stamping temperature for a second predetermined period of time after heating the at least one of the plurality of blanks in the batch heating furnace. The method also includes stamping the at least one of the plurality of blanks in a die after heating the at least one of the plurality of blanks in the roller hearth furnace.
assignee: Jason BOETTGER; Cyrus YAU; Eduardo Rodriguez HERRERA; Alexander Schmidt

title: Voltage Supply Device for a Motor Vehicle; Motor Vehicle and Manufacturing Method for a Voltage Supply Device
abstract: A voltage supply device for a motor vehicle includes at least one carrier plate on which a half-bridge circuit is arranged, which comprises a high-side switch and a low-side switch, each of which comprises at least one switchable semiconductor chip. On the carrier plate, a plurality of chip positions are arranged for the high-side switch  6 ) and the low-side switch, each of which can be occupied by exactly one semiconductor chip, wherein a number of occupied chip positions depends on a predetermined current strength for an output current of the voltage supply device. The disclosure also relates to a motor vehicle with the voltage supply device, and to a method of manufacturing the voltage supply device.

title: Triggered data arrangement method and memory device
abstract: The present disclosure provides a triggered data arrangement method and a memory device. The memory device includes a memory controller and a memory module. The memory module includes multiple blocks. The triggered data arrangement method includes: in response to an electronic device detecting a first trigger event, triggering, by the electronic device, the memory controller to execute an aggressive garbage collection operation, in which the aggressive garbage collection operation is used to maximize a number of spare blocks of multiple first blocks of a first type among the blocks; and in response to a second trigger event, stopping, by the memory controller, the aggressive garbage collection operation, in which the aggressive garbage collection operation includes executing an uninterrupted garbage collection operation before the second trigger event occurs.

title: Storing cross-component models for non-intra coded blocks
abstract: A video coder receives data to be encoded or decoded as a current block of pixels of a current picture. The current block includes a first-color block and a second-color block. The video coder performs non-intra prediction to generate a reconstruction of the first-color block based on motion information of the current block. The video coder retrieves a cross-component model from an indexed table having table entries storing one or more cross-component models corresponding to different index values. A position in a picture may be used to lookup an index value in an index buffer having buffer entries storing index values corresponding to different positions of the picture. The video coder applies the cross-component model to the reconstruction of the first-color block to generate a prediction of the second-color block. The video coder encodes or decodes the current block by using the prediction of the second-color block.

title: Matrix capture approach for eddy current (ec) inspection
abstract: A machine-implemented technique as described herein can include construction of eddy current sensor measurements using a matrix capture acquisition approach applied to data obtained using an eddy current array (ECA) probe. Such measurements can be established or selected to provide EC inspection results for coverage of different flaw orientations, such as providing firmware or software configurability of detection orientation. Use of a matrix capture approach can also be used to perform lift-off sensing and associated compensation without requiring use of a separate lift-off sensing element. A matrix capture approach allows for inspection and lift-off sensing modalities that differ from the physical arrangement of sensors used for performing the acquisition, such as providing inspection results corresponding to novel sensor constructions.

title: Anti-mullerian hormone receptor binding peptides
abstract: Disclosed are compositions and methods including Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH) receptor binding peptides. The AMH receptor binding peptides can be used, for example, to modify the activity of the AMH receptor. For example, the AMH receptor binding peptides can activate the AMH receptor, such as the AMH receptor 2, thereby mimicking the function of AMH. In other examples, the AMH receptor binding peptides function as AMH receptor antagonists, thereby interfering with the function of endogenous AMH. By modifying the activity of the AMH receptor, the peptides have multiple applications, including for example modification of treatment of precocious puberty in females, delay of natural menopause, preservation of ovarian follicular reserve, contraception, fertility preservation after ovarian cortex transplant, treatment of endometriosis, treatment of cancer and/or cancer prevention, and treatment of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

title: Coordinated control method for mutiple high-voltage direct current (hvdc) links after fault based on extended equal area criterion
abstract: A coordinated control method for multiple high-voltage direct current (HVDC) links after a fault based on an Extended Equal Area Criterion includes the following steps: S1: dividing a critical generator group G S  and a remaining generator group G A ; S2: calculating a support effect evaluation index of each DC converter station for all generators in the critical generator group G S  to determine an optimal DC converter station; S3: if a three-phase short-circuit fault occurs, reducing the power of the optimal DC converter station by f percentage points; if a DC fault occurs, increasing the power by f percentage points; S4: if the sign of the difference between the two equivalent angular velocities switches, re-determining the optimal DC converter station; S5: repeating S1-S4 until a duration of a DC power support reaches a short-term overload time limit t s  of a converter station.

title: Article of footwear having an outer stabilizing element
abstract: An article of footwear comprising: an upper configured to receive a foot of a wearer of the article of footwear, the upper include a lateral side and a medial side opposite the lateral side; and a sole structure connected to the upper, the sole structure comprising: a midsole coupled to the upper; and an outsole plate coupled to the midsole, the outsole plate including a ground engaging surface configured to contact a ground surface when worn by the wearer, wherein the outsole plate is disposed below the midsole; an outer stabilizing element connected to an outside surface of the lateral side of the upper.

title: Conveying device
abstract: A conveying device ( 100 ), comprising a diverting assembly ( 10 ), a feeding belt ( 20 ), a loading belt ( 30 ), and an unloading belt ( 40 ). The diverting assembly ( 10 ) comprises a first conveyor belt ( 11 ), a second conveyor belt ( 12 ), a first diverting belt ( 13 ), a second diverting belt ( 14 ) and transfer vehicles ( 15 ) which are arranged to form a closed loop; the transfer vehicle ( 15 ) is configured for changing a conveying direction of a tray ( 90 ).
