This enables a single user action to wake the device up and set it up with networking credentials. The same process may be used to wake the device outside of a normal sleep-wake cycle.

title: Phase-rotated pi/2 bpsk for mu-mimo operation
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for wireless communications by a device. A method generally includes receiving, from a network entity (NE), an indication of a pi/2-binary phase shift keying (BPSK) modulation configuration comprising a phase rotation factor, and communicating in accordance with the pi/2 BPSK modulation configuration.

title: Smart Lock Assembly with Solar Cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a smart lock assembly. A solar cell layer is presented which generates power for the smart lock. The smart lock assembly has a transparent cover over the solar cell. The smart lock assembly has a circuit board connected to the solar cell. The smart lock assembly includes a time-of-flight sensor that is mounted to the circuit board and emits and detects signals for user detection. A cutout in a conductive layer of the solar cell allows a signal from the time-of-flight sensor to penetrate the solar cell without significantly degrading the signal while being emitted or returned. The solar cell absorbs light while permitting the time-of-flight sensor's signal to pass through.

title: Flexible object expansion device control system and flexible object expansion device
abstract: Provided is a flexible object expansion device control system which controls a flexible object expansion device that widens a flexible object, including the flexible object expansion device including an opening into which the flexible object is inserted and a plurality of suction parts on an inner surface of the opening, a suction control part configured to control a suction force of the suction parts, and a relative movement part configured to move the flexible object expansion device and the flexible object relative to each other.

title: Method and device for signal collection
abstract: Methods for performing signal collection on fluorescence emitted by an object to be subjected to detection in a sample comprise: performing photoelectric detection on fluorescence emitted by the object to generate an electrical signal; integrating the electrical signal; collecting the integrated electrical signal; and in response to a trigger indication, releasing, within a time period, more than 90% of charges accumulated in a charge integrator that integrates the electrical signal, wherein the time period is less than 15% of a full width at half maximum of a time-domain waveform corresponding to fluorescence intensity. By releasing most of the accumulated charges in a timely manner within a short time during the process of integrating an electrical signal generated during fluorescence detection, the problem of the dynamic range of a fluorescence detector being insufficient is effectively solved, such that the dynamic range can be expanded.
assignee: Thermo Fisher Scientific (Shanghai) Instruments Co., Ltd.

title: Woven papermaking fabrics
abstract: Some of the aspects of the present disclosure relate to woven papermaking fabrics having a three dimensional surface topography comprising a plurality of protuberances. Some aspects relate to woven papermaking fabrics having a three dimensional surface topography comprising a plurality of protuberances oriented in a machine direction (MD) and plurality of protuberances oriented in a cross-machine direction (CD). Some aspects relate to woven papermaking fabrics having a three dimensional surface topography comprising a plurality of recesses formed by MDoriented and CD-oriented protuberances.

title: Three-dimensional position tracking to provide audio based gaming experiences
abstract: Provided is a gaming device including a first speaker that provides a first portion of an audio output signal based on a first audio data signal received from an EGM, a second speaker that provides a second portion of the audio output signal based on a second audio data signal from the EGM, a first transceiver that is communicatively coupled to the EGM to determine a first distance between the first speaker and the EGM and to transmit the first audio data signal, and a second transceiver that is communicatively coupled to the EGM to determine a second distance between the second speaker and the EGM and to transmit the second audio data signal. The gaming device includes a processor circuit and a memory comprising machine-readable instructions that, when executed by the processor circuit, cause the processor circuit to modify the first portion of the audio output signal.

title: In vivo daric
abstract: The present disclosure provides compositions and methods effective for transducing cells in vivo with a recombinant retrovirus comprising a polynucleotide encoding a dimerizing agent regulated immunoreceptor complex (DARIC).

title: Food compositions for weight management
abstract: A food composition contains dietary fibers, beta-carotene, folate, magnesium, zinc, Vitamin C, and thiamin. The food composition is suitable for use in assisting in post-partum weight management.

title: Calibration device for an extruded plastic profile strand and method for calibrating an extruded plastic profile strand and calibrated plastic profile
abstract: A calibration device and a method for calibrating at least one extruded plastic profile strand enable a plastic profile to be calibrated such that at least two complementary elements of the at least one extruded plastic profile strand ( 50 ) to be calibrated, which are initially separated or spaced apart perpendicular to a direction of movement (F) through a calibrator body ( 31 ) and are not yet in a form fit connected state, are brought into the form fit connected state in a cross section perpendicular to the direction of movement upon reaching the output side ( 33 ) of the calibrator body.

title: System and method for optimizing virtual world computations through an n-tier architecture
abstract: Systems and methods for optimizing virtual world computations through an n-tier architecture including at least three tiers are provided. In a sample three-tier architecture, a first tier comprises a client software engine configured to receive input data, send the data to the second tier, and perform end-user processing. A second tier connects to the first tier and to a third tier through a network and comprises a client-dedicated module that is dynamically instantiated and which is configured to either prepare the received data for subsequent processing from the client software engine or send the received data to the third tier. The third tier comprises a virtual world processing module configured to receive and process data from the second tier, generating world state updates, and to dynamically instantiate the client-dedicated module to spawn client-dedicated instances. The world state updates are sent to corresponding client-dedicated module instances for further processing.

title: Residual coefficient sign prediction with adaptive cost function for intra prediction modes
abstract: Systems, methods, and instrumentalities are disclosed for performing video coding using residual coefficient sign prediction with an adaptive cost function for intra prediction modes. An adaptive cost function for intra prediction modes (IPMs) may include multiple (e.g., selectable) cost functions, such as a default or standard cost function, a horizontal cost function, a vertical cost function, a diagonal up-right cost function, a diagonal down-right cost function, and/or a diagonal down-left cost function. A cost function may be selected based on one or more rules, which may be based on an IPM and a corresponding IPM index. An adaptive cost function for IPMs may include a cost function for multiple (e.g., all) directions. A cost function for multiple directions may include weighting factors related to an IPM and corresponding IPM index. A weighting parameter between the top and the left border continuity cost may be deduced from the IPM index.

title: Advanced enviromentaly sound in room cooling and heating system
abstract: The option for heating or cooling by a custom air mover (fans) to allow the user to customize the air mover portion to their situation and needs meeting all room temperature comfort zones with a quiet energy efficient system.

title: Exercise device and methods for use
abstract: An exercise device for performing abdominal exercise in a supine or seated position includes a middle portion and two end portions, the middle portion being contoured for a comfortable fit around the back of the user's neck, and the end portions serving as hand grips for the user such that the hands are disposed at shoulder width and slightly forward of and above the shoulders when in use. The device has a telescoping construction comprised of three sequential tubular segments of substantially equal length joined together in a telescoping manner and locked in place relative to one another by retractable locking pins. The hand grips can be selectively connected to the middle portion in two different ways, one in which the hand grips are configured to be generally parallel to the longitudinal axis of the device and a second in which the hand grips are configured to be generally perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the exercise device. The device can be used to perform sit-ups and a variety of other exercises from a supine or seated position.

title: Quick cutsheet for termination and organization of cables in network infrastructure rooms
abstract: The present invention relates to a quick cutsheet for the termination and organization of cables in network infrastructure rooms. The quick cutsheet may streamline the termination and organization of cables in network infrastructure rooms, such as IDF rooms, MDF rooms, data closets, AV racks, and IT rooms. The quick cutsheet may provide a comprehensive overview of the cabling layout, including patch panel numbers, patch panel ports, left and right-side termination designations, and a detailed “key” that specifies the status of each cable (missing, found, tested, doubled/duplicated).

title: Fan module
abstract: A fan module includes: a fan housing, arranged with an air inlet structure and an air outlet corresponding to the air inlet structure; a fan assembly, arranged inside the fan housing and configured to push an airflow to flow from the air inlet structure toward the air outlet; and an airflow increasing ring, connected to the fan housing, wherein the airflow increasing ring surrounds and covers the air outlet.

title: Steering assemblies and associated methods
abstract: A sonar system is provided including a sonar assembly configured to attach to a motor assembly of a watercraft or a watercraft. The sonar assembly includes sonar transducer element(s) that transmit sonar beam(s). The sonar system includes a display, processor(s), and a steering assembly configured to cause rotation of the sonar assembly or the motor assembly. The sonar system includes a memory including computer program code that causes the processor(s) to cause the sonar transducer element(s) to emit sonar beam(s), receive sonar return data from a coverage volume of the sonar transducer element(s), generate a sonar image of the coverage volume based on the sonar return data, receive an input from a user, determine a target in the underwater environment based on the input, and cause the steering assembly to adjust the coverage volume to maintain the target within the coverage volume as the watercraft moves relative to the target.

title: Semiconductor package
abstract: A semiconductor package includes: an encapsulation layer sealing at least one semiconductor chip; a redistribution level layer arranged on the encapsulation layer; a laser mark metal layer arranged on the redistribution level layer; and a laser mark arranged inside the laser mark metal layer. The laser mark includes letters, numbers, figures, symbols, and recognition codes indicating various pieces of information of the semiconductor package.

title: Flexible paper attribute selection for printing operations
abstract: A printing system includes a printing device having one or more paper trays. A print job is received for the printing device having at least one attribute. A digital front end (DFE) of the printing device parses a print ticket for the print job to determine the attribute. One or more media definitions for papers within the printing system are determined based on the attribute. The media definitions are compared to a paper catalog for the printing device. A list of papers is generated from the paper catalog that supports the media definitions. The DFE determines whether a paper of the list of papers is assigned to a paper tray. The print job is matched to the paper tray and the paper related to the media definitions. The print job is processed using the paper in the paper tray.

title: Systems and methods for discovery of media items through descriptors
abstract: A computer system associated with a media-providing service obtains a set of text descriptors from a plurality of media items in a pool of media items personalized for a first user. The system selects, from the set of text descriptors, a first text descriptor using first criteria and a second text descriptor using second criteria. The system causes an application associated with the media-providing service, executing on a client device of the first user, to concurrently display a first option for playing back a first playlist of media items associated with the first text descriptor and a second option for playing back a second playlist of media items associated with the second text descriptor. In response to receiving selection by the first user of the first option, the system provides, to the application, media items from the first playlist of media items associated with the first text descriptor.

title: Household appliance wire harness
abstract: A household appliance includes a cabinet. The cabinet includes a first side panel, a rear panel, and a second side panel, and a harness assembly is coupled to the rear panel of the cabinet. The harness assembly includes a housing extending between a top end and a bottom end in a vertical direction, a front side and a back side in a transverse direction, and a first side and a second side in a lateral direction. The harness assembly also includes a fastener extending in the transverse direction from the back side of the housing, a clip extending in the transverse direction from the front side of the housing, and a locating protrusion extending in the transverse direction from the back side of the housing.

title: Dialogue model training
abstract: In a method for training a dialogue model, a first audio sample and a second text sample of a second audio sample are obtained. The second audio sample is before the first audio sample. A first text sample is generated based on speech recognition that is performed on the first audio sample. Through a first dialogue model, a first predicted reply text for the first audio sample is generated based on a first text feature of the first text sample, a first audio feature of the first audio sample, and a second text feature of the second text sample. The first dialogue model is trained based on the first predicted reply text.

title: Part Retention
abstract: The description relates to devices that have removable parts, such as feet or pads. One example can include a housing containing electronic components and a receptacle positioned in the housing. A foot assembly can be positioned in the receptacle. The foot assembly can include a locking mechanism that mechanically blocks removal of the foot assembly from the receptacle unless acted upon by a magnetic field that rearranges the locking mechanism and unblocks removal of the foot assembly from the receptacle.

title: Condensed cyclic compound, light-emitting device including the condensed cyclic compound, and electronic apparatus including the light-emitting device
abstract:
A condensed cyclic compound represented by Formula 1, a light-emitting device including the condensed cyclic compound, and an electronic apparatus including the light-emitting device are provided: 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     wherein the detailed description of Formula 1 is the same as described in the present specification.

title: Oral utensil disinfection box
abstract: An oral utensil disinfection box includes a main body, a box cover, a control module, and a sensing unit for sensing or recognition. The main body is provided with a disinfection cavity with a first opening on one side. The main body is equipped with a driving unit and a sterilization and disinfection unit. The sterilization and disinfection unit is used for sterilizing and disinfecting an oral utensil. The box cover is connected to the driving unit. The sensing unit, the sterilization and disinfection unit, and the driving unit are all electrically connected to the control module. The box cover covers the first opening when in a closed state. The control module is configured for driving the driving unit to work based on an electrical signal fed back by the sensing unit, so that the driving unit drives the box cover to move to open or close the first opening.
assignee: Thumbs Up Innovations Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Adjustment method on inter prediction with linear prediction model
abstract: A method includes receiving a bitstream indicating an adjustment factor to a linear formula used in a formula-based inter prediction of a current block in a current picture based on a reference block in a reference picture. The formula-based inter prediction generates a prediction sample of the current block based on the linear formula applied to one or more reconstructed samples in the reference block. The adjustment factor is applied on an initial slope parameter to determine an adjusted slope parameter. An adjusted offset parameter is calculated according to the adjusted slope parameter and a first weighted average of a plurality of first samples in a reference template of the reference block. An adjusted linear formula is generated based at least on the adjusted slope parameter and the adjusted offset parameter. At least a reconstructed sample of the current block is determined according to the adjusted linear formula.

title: Versatile layer-3 blockchain service interface for automating and decentralizing pecuniary micro transactions among iot and m2m devices
abstract: A device-facing Layer-3 blockchain service interface, installable within a broader electronic digital network, is engineered to adjust, hybridize, and couple Layer-1 and Layer-2 blockchain technologies that concurrently operate within, thereby offering e enabling advanced, automated, and cost-effective pecuniary transactions among enrolled, subscribed, and/or otherwise participating IoT and M2M devices. The Layer-3 blockchain service interface unlocks broad opportunities for automated micropayments, enabling practical, stable, scalable, and cost-effective solutions for smart devices in IoT and M2M networks. The service interface in particular utilizes a real-time market-based service registry for dynamic price and fee determination while facilitating decentralized authentication. Versatility, enhanced security, and the enablement of new revenue streams in IoT and M2M industries requiring real-time, trustless financial interactions are among the advantages of the service interface.

title: Video metadata generation using video chunking and data fusion
abstract: In various examples, techniques for video metadata generation using video segmentation and data fusion are described herein. For instance, systems and methods described herein may segment a video may into video segments using one or more factors that are configured to enhance the processing of the individual video segments. For example, the video segments may be processed—such as by using one or more processing components and/or parallel processing—to generate instances of metadata associated with the video segments. As described herein, an instance of metadata may represent at least identifiers, spatio-temporal information, and/or visual information associated with objects as represented by a video segment. The systems and methods described herein may then analyze the instances of metadata to track objects between the video segments (e.g., perform object reassociation) and generate fused metadata associated with the video.

title: Roof tarp system
abstract: A roof tarp system includes a large waterproof tarp having a plurality of side edges and a plurality of channels located adjacent to each edge. A plurality of edge rails that are constructed from an elongated piece of rigid material are positionable along the outer edges of the tarp, or within the channels of the tarp body. The system includes a plurality of water weight bags each having at least one hole for receiving a connector that is passed through the hole to engage an edge rail along the tarp body. Each of the bags includes an inner watertight chamber for receiving several gallons of water through a capped opening on the bag body. When filled, the water provides a weight to each bag sufficient to secure the tarp and frame rail assembly onto the roof of the building.

title: Solar movement and timepiece
abstract: There is provided a solar movement capable of improving productivity. The solar movement includes: a movement body including a battery housing portion configured to house a primary battery; a dial-side unit disposed on a dial side of the movement body and including at least a solar panel; a case-back-side unit disposed on a case back side of the movement body and having at least a part thereof housed in the battery housing portion; a secondary battery housed in the battery housing portion; and a motor driving unit driven by supply of power from the secondary battery. At least one of the dial-side unit and the case-back-side unit is provided with a printed wired board forming a circuit block including a charging circuit unit configured to control charging of the secondary battery with power supplied from the solar panel, and a driving circuit unit configured to control driving of the motor driving unit with power supplied from the secondary battery.
assignee: Seiko Watch Kabushiki Kaisha (trading as Seiko Watch Corporation)

title: System and method for remote data collection and outcome prediction
abstract: Provided are computer-implemented systems and methods for generating a health outcome prediction, including: receiving user data, the user data comprising passively collected data by a passive data collection monitoring device associated with the user; self-reported health metrics associated with the user; receiving clinical health outcome data, the clinical health outcome data comprising at least one health outcome based on clinical data; extracting a plurality of variables from the user data; providing the plurality of variables and the clinical health outcome data as inputs to at least one machine learning model to identify at least one selected variable from the plurality of variables, having an associated predictive value to the clinical health outcome data; generating based on the at least one selected variable, an individualized prediction algorithm for generating the health outcome prediction; applying the individualized prediction algorithm to the user data to generate the health outcome prediction.

title: Aircraft assembly and aircraft
abstract: An aircraft assembly comprising two or more aircraft components which are connected with each other by one or various tethers. The tethers are configured to delimit a drifting apart of the aircraft components in case of a breakage of the aircraft assembly during a potential crash scenario. The aircraft components may include a fuel tank.

title: Shifting quantization center by gradient of a rate
abstract: Systems, methods, and instrumentalities are configured for shifting a quantization center by a gradient of a rate. A video coding device (e.g., a video encoding and/or video decoding device) may obtain a quantization index. The device may shift the quantization index based on an amount that is inverse of the quantization index. The device may apply the shifted quantization index to a transform coefficient to generate an adjusted transform coefficient.

title: Intra-prediction-based image encoding/decoding method, device, and recording medium storing bitstreams
abstract: Provided are an image encoding/decoding method and device. The image decoding method according to the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: acquiring conversion implementation information indicating whether to implement a conversion; implementing the conversion on a first prescribed adjacent area adjacent to a reference block of the current block on the basis of the conversion implementation information; generating a first prediction block of the current block on the basis of the first adjacent area on which the conversion has been implemented and a second prescribed adjacent area adjacent to the current block; and generating a final prediction block of the current block by implementing the conversion on the first prediction block, wherein the first adjacent area is at a position corresponding to the second adjacent area, and the conversion includes at least one of inverse conversion or rotation conversion.

title: Systems for predicting cardiac disease status and echocardiographic measurements from veterinary radiographs
abstract: Herein disclosed is a computer-implemented method for cardiac assessment in veterinary patients. The computer-implemented method includes receiving a radiograph image corresponding to an animal, preprocessing the radiograph image to generate a preprocessed radiograph image, generating a left atrial enlargement prediction, and providing access to the left atrial enlargement prediction. The left atrial enlargement prediction is generated based on the preprocessed radiograph image using a left atrial enlargement prediction machine learning model. In certain embodiments, the left atrial enlargement prediction includes one or more of a predicted left atrial-to-aortic ratio (LA:Ao) value, a binary B2 classification indicating whether the animal meets criteria for ACVIM Stage B2 classification, or an ACVIM stage classification indicating one or more of Stage B1, Stage B2, Stage C, or Stage D.
assignee: Tomas Alejandro Reyes; Tabitha Jean Baibos-Reyes

title: Hybrid automatic repeat request process determination
abstract: Techniques for flexible hybrid automatic repeat request selection by a user equipment are provided. An example method includes a user equipment (UE) detecting a set of physical uplink shared channel (PUSCH) opportunities within a configured grant cycle. The UE can associate a first hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ) process identifier (PID) setting with a first PUSCH opportunity of a first subset of the set of PUSCH opportunities, the first HARQ PID setting configured by a base station. The UE can select a second HARQ PID setting for a second PUSCH opportunity of a second subset of the set of PUSCH opportunities.

title: Flow rail system and pallet stop apparatus
abstract: A roller for a conveyor system is provided. The roller may include a body, an axle, a first end connector, and a spring. The body may include a first end and a second end opposite the first end. The axle may be disposed in the body extending from the first end to the second end. The first end connector may be configured to interface with the body on the first end. The first end connector may protrude at least partially past the first end. The spring may be configured to interface with the body and the first end connector. The spring may be configured to provide a restoring force to the first end connector when depressed.

title: System and method for serving multiple customers by a live agent
abstract: A system and method for allowing a single live customer service agent to simultaneously serve multiple customers. According to various embodiments, a virtual agent operates at the front end to receive and attempt to handle customer issues. The virtual agent employs speech recognition and intent mapping in order to generate a proposed response that attempts to identify and resolve customer issues. In some scenarios, the proposed response includes both a response message and a response action to be taken. A chat history and the proposed response is then provided to the live agent. The live agent reviews the information provided, and determines whether the proposed response is appropriate. The live agent then approves the response or revises or replaces the response. The final response is sent back to the virtual agent for processing and providing to the customer.

title: Handle Grip
abstract: This disclosure relates to a handle grip for preventing roll-over. The handle grip includes two sections. The first section has a pseudo-triangular cross-sectional shape while the second section extends from the first section and transitions from the pseudo-triangular shape to a pseudo-trapezoidal cross-sectional shape. The handle grip elevates one or more proximal interphalangeal joints of the user's hands away from the handle of a handled to improve grip mechanics and prevent roll-over.

title: Power Washer Assemblies and Methods
abstract: A pressure washer assembly that is operable in multiple modalities includes a pump assembly that communicates a pressurized flow to a valve assembly. The valve assembly includes a pressure relief valve and an unloader valve assembly that are oriented in parallel relative to one another. The pressure relief valve assembly is configured to generate a first pressurized fluid flow and the unloader valve assembly is configured to generate a second fluid flow having a considerably higher pressure than a pressure associated with the first pressurized flow. A valve is disposed between an output of the pump and each of the respective pressure relief valve and unloader valve and is operable to select the cleaning mode associated with operation of the pressure washer.

title: Controlling the damping of sidewards tower oscillations based on a power oscillation disturbance level
abstract: The present invention relates to control of wind turbines of a wind park in relation to damping sidewards tower oscillations in view of a power oscillation disturbance level at the point of measurement of an electrical grid. The invention comprising determining a power oscillation disturbance level of at the point of measurement of the electrical grid; determining a grid condition level at the point of measurement; and determining a disturbance severity based on the power oscillation disturbance level and the grid condition level. Upon receiving a request to reduce the power oscillation disturbance level at the point of measurement from a system operator, the group of wind turbines is operated to reduce the power oscillation disturbance level based on the disturbance severity.

title: Refractive image reveal composite
abstract: A multi-layer composite imaging system for selective image reveal and method of manufacturing same, said system having a base substrate with a primary graphic layer printed on at least one surface, a transparent carrier film laminated over said primary graphic layer via an intervening adhesive layer, a microporous coating disposed on the upper surface of said transparent carrier film, said coating comprising a matrix of inorganic particles and a binder defining a plurality of interstitial voids, wherein said coating is substantially opaque in a dry state and a secondary graphic layer printed upon said microporous coating, wherein said secondary graphic layer comprises line art registered to the contours of said primary graphic layer.

title: Method of treating olfactory disorder
abstract: A method of treating an olfactory disorder can be performed on a patient after the patient receives only local facial anesthesia, and the method essentially includes injecting a plasma composition into the patient's nasal cavity so that the patient's olfactory functions can be effectively improved or enhanced after the injection, thereby achieving the effect of treating the patient's olfactory disorder.

title: Systems and methods for personalized spatial video/light field content delivery
abstract: Systems and methods are provided herein for streaming immersive content to a device. This may be accomplished by a system displaying a piece of media on a display in a first format and determining that the piece of media is approaching a segment of the piece of media that is available in a second format (e.g., light field content). In response to determining that the upcoming segment is available in the second format, the system can use one or more sensors to determine a position of a user in relation to the display. The system can then send a request for the piece of media in the second format, wherein the request comprises the position of the user. The system can then receive and display the segment of the piece of media in the second format, wherein the segment is customized according to the position of the user.

title: A method and system of adaptive spatiotemporal synchronization for multi-source data in intelligent vehicle-infrastructure collaborative perception
abstract: Provided in the present invention are a multi-source data spatial-temporal adaptive registration method and system oriented to road-vehicle intelligent fusion perception. The registration method comprises: a connected vehicle carrying a vehicle-mounted positioning sensor and a vehicle-mounted perception sensor driving in the sensing range of each road-region sensor to collect calibration data; on the basis of the sensed data of the vehicle, by means of discrete trajectory data continuity, weighted feature map creation and map matching similarity matrix calculation, determining a vehicle-road trajectory data matching relationship; and, on the basis of the position data of the vehicle, successively solving calibration parameters of a single sensor and a plurality of sensors to implement multi-source data adaptive registration. On this basis, the multi-source data spatial-temporal adaptive registration system oriented to road-vehicle intelligent fusion perception provided by the present invention comprises three modules, i.e. a vehicle end apparatus module, a road-region apparatus module and a multi-source data spatial-temporal adaptive registration platform. Compared with the prior art, the present invention may implement rapid and automatic spatial-temporal adaptive registration of the road-vehicle intelligent fusion perception multi-source data, and implement efficient spatial-temporal synchronization of the road-vehicle intelligent fusion perception multi-source data.

title: Fluorine-containing cyclic olefin (co)polymer and method for producing same
abstract: A fluorine-containing cyclic olefin (co)polymer containing a structural unit represented by general formula (1) shown below and a structural unit derived from an α-olefin having 2 to 10 carbon atoms, wherein the amount of the structural unit represented by general formula (1) exceeds 40 mol %, and the amount of the structural unit derived from an α-olefin having 2 to 10 carbon atoms is at least 0 mol % but less than 60 mol %. [In general formula (1), R 1  to R 8  each represent a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, or a hydrocarbon group, R 9  to R 12  each represent a hydrogen atom, a fluorine atom, a substituted or unsubstituted alkyl group, or an alkyl group having a fluorine atom, or the like, and at least one fluorine atom is included in R 9  to R 12 . Further, m represents 0 or a positive integer.]

title: Blood pressure measurement device, biological information processing system, information processing terminal, and storage medium
abstract: A blood pressure measurement device measures blood pressure and includes a pulse wave acquisition unit, a display unit, and a control unit. During pulse wave acquisition, if one or more indices meet an arrhythmia detection condition, the control unit determines if arrhythmia is present. If the condition is met and arrhythmia is detected, the display shows that arrhythmia was present during the acquisition. If the condition is not met, the display indicates that arrhythmia determination was not performed. This assesses the feasibility of arrhythmia detection based on the indices and displays the result, promoting more reliable blood pressure readings.

title: Low viscosity cm-mfc
abstract:
The present invention relates to a low viscosity CM-MFC comprising a substitution degree of 0.2-0.29, preferably with a viscosity between 6700-9900 cP with a spindle R4 at 100 rpm at 1% w/w and a viscosity between 65-85 cP with a spindle R4 at 10 rpm at 0.8% w/w and a method for producing a low viscosity CM-MFC, comprising:
         defibrating the resulting CMC with a rotating disc and a stationary rotor with a water dispersion of 4-10% w/w to obtain a CM-MFC at an extent that the CM-MFC fiber average diameter is between 0.8 μm to 8 μm.

title: Energy storage system and power source apparatus
abstract: An energy storage system and a power source apparatus. The energy storage system includes: a general positive line, a general negative line and a battery module connected between the general positive line and the general negative line, and the battery module includes M battery assemblies connected in series. The energy storage system further includes: N supporting members, wherein the M battery assemblies are supported by means of the N supporting members, and the M battery assemblies are insulated from the N supporting members. The energy storage system further includes: a conductive path, wherein K supporting members among the N supporting members are connected to the conductive path by means of K branches, respectively, M, N and K are all positive integers, and M≥N≥K> 1 . A protective assembly is arranged on the conductive path and/or the branch in series.

title: High-electron-mobility transistors with a patterned barrier layer
abstract: Structures for a high-electron-mobility transistor and methods of forming such structures. The structure comprises a layer stack including a first layer and a second layer on the first layer. The first layer comprises a first III-V compound semiconductor material, the second layer comprises a second III-V compound semiconductor material, and the second layer includes a first section and a second section spaced from the first section by a gap. The structure further comprises a high-electron-mobility transistor including a gate overlying the gap, the gate laterally positioned between the first section of the second layer and the second section of the second layer.

title: Display device
abstract: There is provided a display device comprises a substrate comprising a display area in which emission areas; a circuit layer; and an element layer comprising light emitting elements disposed in the emission areas. The circuit layer comprises light emitting pixel drivers electrically connected to the light emitting elements and arranged in a plurality of pixel columns and a plurality of pixel rows; and a first power line transmitting a first power to the light emitting pixel drivers. The first power line comprises power auxiliary lines extending in one direction; and mesh auxiliary electrodes electrically connected to the power auxiliary lines. Among the power auxiliary lines, two power auxiliary lines neighboring each other are electrically connected to each other through mesh auxiliary electrodes disposed between the two power auxiliary lines and parallel to each other in the one direction, among the mesh auxiliary electrodes.

title: Geared rotary table
abstract: A geared rotary table includes a base, a spindle mechanism, a work plate, a clutch gear mechanism, and a drive mechanism. The spindle mechanism is disposed in the base and located above a support portion of the base, and is driven by the drive mechanism to rotate. The work plate is coupled to the spindle mechanism. The clutch gear mechanism is fitted on the spindle mechanism. When an upper clutch gear of the clutch gear mechanism is moved upward, the work plate is driven to rotate simultaneously during machining. When the upper clutch gear is moved downward to engage with a first lower clutch gear and a second lower clutch gear of the clutch gear mechanism, the work plate is immovable during machining.

title: Cable duct clamp and enclosure
abstract: A cable duct clamp includes a body forming an insert passage extending along an axial direction from a first opening to a second opening. The body includes an internal thread positioned proximate to the first opening, and a cross sectional area at the insert passage converging along the axial direction toward the second opening. An insert forming a cable passage extends along the axial direction from a first end to a second end. The insert includes a pair of more of slots extending along the axial direction from the second end toward the first end. The insert includes an external thread configured to thread with the internal thread of the body. The insert at the cable passage includes a gripping interface configured to attach to a fiber optic cable.

title: Pdu device with heterogeneous feedthrough
abstract: A power distribution unit, including a housing and a set of components disposed within the housing, wherein the housing includes a chamber wall, a feedthrough portion attached to the chamber wall, and a bushing, disposed within the feedthrough portion and defining a high voltage passage extending through the chamber wall.

title: A unit design and process for direct capture of carbon dioxide from air
abstract: Implementations of the disclosed subject matter provide a process for capture of carbon dioxide from a gaseous feed stream. The process may include a direct air capture (DAC) unit comprising: a first and second inlet faces located on opposite sides of the DAC unit. A sorbent material may be located inside the DAC unit and at or behind each of the inlet faces. An outlet may be located at the top of the DAC unit and may provide an exit gaseous outlet stream. The exit gaseous outlet stream may have a flow that is produced by at least one fan. The process may include receiving a gaseous feed stream at the inlet faces. The gaseous feed stream may have an average CO2 concentration greater than 95% of the CO2 concentration of ambient air, by minimizing reingestion of the exit gaseous outlet stream, for any wind direction and any wind speed.

title: Rna vectors with hairpin-like inserts
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a viral vector having an exogenous RNA segment with a hairpin-like structure, for example having two or more base-paired regions separated by one or more non-base-paired regions. The exogenous RNA segment may have a secondary structure, minimum free energy, average positional entropy or other attributes within specified ranges, or with values similar to one or more hairpin-like structures of a reference wild type virus. In some examples, the viral vector is a live attenuated vaccine. In some examples, the viral vectors downregulates a susceptibility gene in a host plant.
assignee: University Of Maryland, College Park; Silvec Biologics Inc.

title: Damper, method for damping, and apparatus including a damper
abstract: The present disclosure provides a damper for an object table, the damper comprising: a pair of plates ( 22,24 ) arranged defining a volume ( 30 ) between them; a plurality of posts ( 26 ) arranged in the volume and extending between the pair of plates; and an elastomeric section ( 32 ) enclosing the posts and extending between the plates. The posts may be uniformly distributed over the volume. The damper can be configured to serve as an interface between a magnet assembly and a frame of an actuator.

title: VOICE OVER INTERNET PROTOCOL (VoIP) TRANSMIT REDUNDANCY
abstract: A method for of wireless communication includes establishing a primary real-time transport protocol (RTP) link to a peer device via an Internet protocol-based multimedia subsystem (IMS) network. The method also includes establishing a duplicate real-time transport protocol (RTP) link to the peer device via a firewall and a network address translation (NAT) server. The duplicate RTP link is initially established with a session traversal utilities for NAT (STUN) server. The method further includes transmitting RTP packets to the peer device via the primary RTP link and the duplicate RTP link. The method still further includes determining whether to continue with the duplicate RTP link established with the STUN server or to reestablish the duplicate RTP link with a traversal using relays around NAT (TURN) server.

title: Image decoding device, image decoding method, and program
abstract: An image decoding device includes a first intra-frame predicting part configured to generate first predicted pixels based on decoded pixels and control information, a second intra-frame predicting part configured to generate, from one or more block vectors for a block to be decoded, second predicted pixels based on the decoded pixels and the control information, a storing part configured to store the decoded pixels, an inter-frame predicting part configured to generate third predicted pixels based on the stored decoded pixels and the control information and an adder configured to add the prediction residual and the first predicted pixels to the third predicted pixels to derive the decoded pixels.

title: Sql rewrite layer detection for differential privacy
abstract: The present disclosure involves methods, apparatus, and systems for selection operations to perform a differential privacy (DP) rewrite. This can include: identifying a SQL query; identifying one or more source tables against which the SQL query will be processed and a classification of each source table; generating a parse tree based on the SQL query, the parse tree comprising the one or more source tables, an output table, and at least one operation; searching the parse tree for operations to re-write by: selecting a current branch to search; performing, as an analyzed operation, an analysis of each operation in the current branch starting at the output table and for each operation: determining whether the analyzed operation is an aggregation process that transforms a user-level detailed table (ULDT) into an aggregate table.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Condenser mounting pad
abstract: An air conditioner condenser mounting pad includes a clipped corner section to provide ease of condenser installation. The pad further includes security features to deter theft, such features including anchoring mechanisms for attaching the pad to an underlying support surface and/or ballasting substances for weighing down the pad. Such features deter a thief from removing the coupled AC unit.

title: Uplink transmission execution method and device, uplink transmission receiving method and device, communication device, and storage medium
abstract: A method for performing uplink transmission, performed by a terminal, includes: determining, in a case where uplink transmissions are to be performed in a plurality of slots and according to a relation between a frequency domain resource for an uplink transmission in a first slot among the plurality of slots and an uplink subband in the first slot, whether to perform the uplink transmission in the first slot.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: 5-membered heteroaryl carboxamide compounds for treatment of hbv
abstract: The present disclosure provides, in part, 5-membered heteroaryl carboxamide compounds, and pharmaceutical compositions thereof, useful for disruption of HBV core protein assembly, and methods of treating Hepatitis B (HBV) infection.

title: Vehicle seat and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: The vehicle seat includes a seat cushion and a seat back extending upward from a rear part of the seat cushion. The seat back includes a frame forming a skeletal structure, a pad supported by the frame, a skin material covering the pad, and a plurality of air cells and a plurality of vibrators provided on the pad. The vibrators and the air cells are placed so as not to overlap with one another.

title: Aircraft propulsion system with power turbine electric machine
abstract: An aircraft system is provided that includes an open propulsor rotor, a turbine engine and a power turbine electric machine. The turbine engine includes a core compressor section, a core combustor section, a core turbine section, a power turbine section, a flowpath, a first core rotating structure and a power turbine rotating structure. The first core rotating structure includes a first core compressor rotor and a first core turbine rotor. The first core compressor rotor is disposed in the core compressor section. The first core turbine rotor is disposed in the core turbine section. The power turbine rotating structure is configured to drive rotation of the open propulsor rotor. The power turbine rotating structure includes a power turbine rotor disposed in the power turbine section. The power turbine electric machine is operatively coupled to the power turbine rotating structure.

title: Systems and Methods for Generating Behavioral Predictions in Reaction to Autonomous Vehicle Movement
abstract: Systems and methods are directed to generating behavioral predictions in reaction to autonomous vehicle movement. In one example, a computer-implemented method includes obtaining, by a computing system, local scene data associated with an environment external to an autonomous vehicle, the local scene data including actor data for an actor in the environment external to the autonomous vehicle. The method includes extracting, by the computing system and from the local scene data, one or more actor prediction parameters for the actor using a machine-learned parameter extraction model. The method includes determining, by the computing system, a candidate motion plan for the autonomous vehicle. The method includes generating, by the computing system and using a machine-learned prediction model, a reactive prediction for the actor based at least in part on the one or more actor prediction parameters and the candidate motion plan.

title: Systems and methods for dynamically creating and adjusting scene models
abstract: In one aspect, a dynamic model creation (“DMC”) computing device including a processor in communication with a memory device may be provided. The processor may be configured to: (i) analyze a statement to generate speech data, (ii) retrieve map data, (iii) determine, for a plurality of moments in time during the collision, a position and an orientation of the vehicle, (iv) generate or adjust a first model including a representation of the vehicle involved in the collision based upon the map data and the determined position and orientation of the vehicle for the plurality of moments in time, (v) cause display of the first model on a graphical user interface (GUI) of a user computing device, (vi) receive at least one input signal generated by the user computing device, and/or (vii) generate an updated model based upon the first model and the at least one input signal.
assignee: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company

title: Context-aware error concealment to improve inference accuracy
abstract: In various examples, systems and methods are disclosed relating to context-aware error concealment to improve inference accuracy are disclosed. A system can identify a frame of a video stream and determine that the frame comprises corrupted or lost data. The system can generate a corrected frame by applying an error concealment function selected based at least on a location of the corrupted or lost data in the frame and a region of interest in the frame.

title: Precoder design for mimo transmission using orbital angular momentum modes
abstract: Methods and apparatuses for OAM precoder are disclosed. In one embodiment, an OAM transmitter comprises TX antennas; and a processor, wherein, the processor is configured to: transmit, via the TX antennas, at least two OAM modes including OAM mode (l, p) and OAM mode (−l, p), where l is a positive integer and p is a non-negative integer, each OAM mode transmits one layer of signal in each utilized polarization; and apply a precoding matrix to the transmission of at least (l, p) and (−l, p) to mitigate the cross interference between (l, p) and (−l, p).

title: Process for treating waste materials having a low softening temperature with kinetic pulverization
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the treatment of waste streams having a portion of material with a low softening temperature, such as thermoplastics. Waste streams can include manufacturing waste, such as composite flooring reject material, or consumer waste. The process can include a kinetic pulverization stage with a kinetic pulverizer that produces an airflow having multiple overlapping vortices that simultaneously size-reduces the manufacturing waste and reduces or maintains an internal temperature of the kinetic pulverizer when compared with conventional size-reduction machinery so as to efficiently size reduce the thermoplastic. The kinetic pulverizer can be selectively operated at specific speeds that serve to size reduce a majority (for example, between 70% and 100%) of the waste in a single pass (one pass kinetic pulverization) or selectively liberate a portion of the manufacturing waste product. Optionally, the process can include a separation stage, such as mechanical and/or magnetic screening.

title: Method, device, and system for tracking an object in a sequence of video frames
abstract: A method, device, and system track an object in a sequence of video frames by using a tracking filter. In the method, costs are assigned for associating each object detection in a received set of object detections to the tracked object. The cost assigned to an object detection is a measure of deviation between a motion associated with the object detection and both of a first motion of the object estimated by the tracking filter and a second motion of the object indicated by motion vectors from a video encoder which encodes the sequence of video frames.

title: Cell housing device
abstract: A cell housing device that enables manipulation of the posture of a target cell accommodated in a well is provided. A cell housing device includes a well and a posture manipulation device. The well has inner wall surfaces that accommodate a target cell immersed in a liquid. The target cell is a cell or a cell aggregate. The posture manipulation device has a retention channel. The retention channel drains a fluid from the well via the inner wall surface of the well, to bring the target cell into a retained state in which the target cell is rotatably retained at a tip end of the retention channel. The posture manipulation device manipulates the posture of the target cell by rotating the target cell in the retained state.

title: Tote tank accessory kit
abstract: A storage case system designed for attachment to portable blackwater tanks, facilitating the transportation and storage of blackwater accessories. The system comprises a base with a textured floor bordered by an interior and exterior wall, featuring an access gap for accessible utility. The inclusion of a mounting channel and screw mount allows for secure attachment via an elongated mounting member, which connects to the tank and the case. A matching lid with corresponding walls and access gap ensures that items are securely stored while allowing for access. Additional features include a handle for improved portability, a rubber strap and strap cover for secure closure, and the option for dual elongated mounting members for enhanced stability of the case.

title: An optical wireless communication device
abstract: An optical wireless communication device comprising an optical system for use in identifying the location of a communication partner for an optical wireless communication device. The optical system is configured to generate a line beam, which is a beam of light having a width five or more times larger than its height. The line beam is rotated and the intensity of any reflections/responses to the line beam are recorded. The angle at which the intensity is the greatest is identified, and used to determine the location of the communication partner.

title: Operating device of human-powered vehicle
abstract: An operating device of a human-powered vehicle includes an operating structure, a coupling member, a fastener, and a restriction member. The operating structure includes a first operating member and a first electric switch. The first electric switch is configured to be activated in response to a movement of the first operating member. The coupling member is configured to couple the operating structure and a handlebar. At least one of coupling member and the operating structure defines a holder space in which an electric power source is to be provided. The fastener is configured to fasten the operating structure to the coupling member. The restriction member is attached to the fastener to restrict the fastener from falling off the coupling member.

title: Uses of JAK Inhibitors in the Management of Sepsis and Comorbidities
abstract: Disclosed are methods of treating, preventing, or reversing sepsis and comorbidities comprising administering an effective amount of a Janus kinases (JAK) inhibitor such as baricitinib to a patient in need thereof. In certain embodiments, the subject is at risk of, exhibiting symptoms of or diagnosed with sepsis-associated organ failure, sepsis associated encephalopathy, sepsis associated acute kidney injury, sepsis induced cardiac dysfunction, sepsis induced acute respiratory distress, and/or hepato-splanchnic dysfunction.

title: Application programming interface (api) endpoint protection using behavior-based monitoring
abstract: User interactions are detected for a remote client accessing a specific web application hosted by a web application server on an enterprise network. A Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) corresponding to the specific web application is identified. A real-time API and/or visited URL sequence of the client interactions with the specific web application is tracked to identify anomalous user interactions.

title: Vehicle Seat Assembly
abstract: The subject disclosure provides a vehicle seat assembly comprising a seat component having a support surface, a foam layer, and a formed cloth. The foam layer has an A-surface and a B-surface. The formed cloth has an inner surface and an outer surface with the inner surface attached to the B-surface of the foam layer. The formed cloth comprises a plurality of fibers shaped to define a plurality of suspension springs each having a pre-defined 3-dimensional configuration defining a cavity. Each cavity is filled with a portion of the foam layer and the foam layer at least partially penetrates the formed cloth between the inner and outer surfaces to further define the suspension springs and to maintain the pre-defined 3-dimensional configurations of the suspension springs. A portion of the outer surface of the formed cloth on the suspension springs engages the support surface of the seat component. The suspension springs respond to dynamic input by partially deflecting to a deflected state and recovering to an initial state relative to the support surface of the seat component for isolating vibrations of an occupant during use of the vehicle seat assembly.

title: Medical monitoring analysis and replay including indicia responsive to light attenuated by body tissue
abstract: The present disclosure includes a medical monitoring hub as the center of monitoring for a monitored patient. The hub is configured to receive and process a plurality of physiological parameters associated with the patient. The hub includes advanced analytical presentation views configured to provide timely, clinically-relevant, actionable information to care providers. In certain embodiments, the monitoring hub stores and is able to replay previously presented data reflective of the patient's condition.

title: Head-mounted display and image display method
abstract: An image processing section of a head-mounted display sets a control plane  350  corresponding to distribution of distances from a user  280  to real objects  354   a  and  354   b  in a virtual three-dimensional space. The control plane  350  is updated according to movement of the user  280 . The image processing section decides a virtual distance ds of a superimposed image in the virtual three-dimensional space on the basis of a distance dc from the user  280  to a control plane in a line-of-sight direction, places the superimposed image in the virtual three-dimensional space, and then renders a view as seen from a virtual camera on a see-through image.

title: Method, device and communication device for determining beam information
abstract: A method, a device and a communication device for determining beam information are provided in the present disclosure, which solves the problem that the beam indication method in the related technologies is difficult to apply to an RIS system or a relay system. The method includes: obtaining, by a terminal, multiple QCL parameter configurations of a reference signal; and determining, by the terminal, at least one target QCL parameter from the multiple QCL parameters of the reference signal based on a predefined rule or an indication from a network side device; the predefined rule or the indication from the network side device is determined based on an association relationship between QCL parameters of the reference signal and pieces of transmission information, and the transmission information includes at least one of a transmission time unit, a scheduled transmission, a transmission channel or a transmission signal.
assignee: Datang Mobile Communications Equipment Co., Ltd.

title: Device, method and system for drawing a liner into a tube by means of an inversion method
abstract: The invention relates to a device ( 300 ) for drawing a liner ( 20 ) into a tube ( 10 ) by means of an inversion method, comprising a pressure container ( 310 ) which can be applied with a pressure for inverting the liner ( 20 ); a shaft ( 320 ) that is rotatably mounted in an interior ( 312 ) of the pressure container ( 310 ) and has a rotatably mounted end ( 322 ) and a free end ( 324 ), wherein the shaft ( 320 ) is designed to unwind the liner ( 20 ) for inversion; and a first limiting element ( 330 ) arranged at the free end ( 324 ) of the shaft ( 320 ) and decoupled from a rotational movement of the shaft ( 320 ), wherein the first limiting element ( 330 ) is designed to limit a movement of the liner ( 20 ) in a direction parallel to an axis of rotation (DA) of the shaft ( 320 ), wherein the pressure container ( 310 ) comprises a supply access ( 340 ) for at least one curing device ( 100 ) that can be connected to a first end ( 22 ) of the liner ( 20 ).

title: Power-on detection circuit
abstract: A power-on detection circuit includes a pull-up circuit, a pull-down circuit, a Schmitt trigger, a level shifting circuit, a combinational logic circuit, and a glitch filter. The pull-up circuit and the pull-down circuit are connected to a first node. The pull-down circuit receives a first supply voltage. The Schmitt trigger is connected to the first node. The Schmitt trigger generates a Schmitt output signal. An enable terminal of the level shifting circuit receives the Schmitt output signal. A first input signal is converted into a first level-shifted signal by the level shifting circuit. The combinational logic circuit receives the first level-shifted signal and the Schmitt output signal and generates a first power detecting signal. The glitch filter receives the first power detecting signal and generates a second power detecting signal.

title: Aerosol generating device and aerosol generating system including the same
abstract: An aerosol generation system includes an aerosol generating article and an aerosol generating device configured to heat the aerosol generating article inserted into an accommodation space of the aerosol generating device, wherein the aerosol generating article includes a first susceptor arranged in a first portion and a second susceptor arranged in a second portion different from the first portion, and the aerosol generating device includes a first coil arranged in a first region of the accommodation space, a second coil arranged in a second region of the accommodation space that is different from the first region, and a controller configured to control power supplied to the first coil and the second coil.

title: Intravascular blood extraction systems, devices, and methods
abstract: An intravascular blood extraction system for phlebotomy through a previously placed peripheral intravascular catheter having a cannula within a protective housing and/or structures and/or structure, a cannula forming a laminar fluid path extending from the distal fluid entry to a lateral or proximal fluid exit orifices directly coupled to the protective housing and/or structures and/or structure, a slider o plunger actuator coupled to the fluid exit orifice of the cannula so that distal advancement of the slider advances the cannula inside a fluid vessel.

title: Adsorber modules and reactors for capture of carbon dioxide
abstract: In one aspect, modules comprising adsorbers are described herein for the removal of CO2 from the ambient atmosphere, flue gas streams, or process gas streams. Such modules, in some embodiments, provide unique structure, fluid flow paths and associated flow management characteristics for the efficient capture and processing of CO2 from fluid streams. In some embodiments, a module for the capture of CO2 from a fluid stream comprises a fluid stream inlet including an inlet duct and an inlet valve for reversibly sealing the inlet duct, and a bed for adsorption of the CO2 from the fluid stream. The module also includes a fluid stream outlet comprising an outlet duct and an outlet valve for reversibly sealing the outlet duct, wherein the fluid stream inlet duct is in fluid communication with piping for collection of an enriched CO2 fluid stream, and the outlet duct is in fluid communication with a source of desorption fluid operable to effectuate desorption of CO2 captured by the bed and/or cooling fluid operable to reduce temperature of the bed.

title: Sodium secondary battery and electric device
abstract: A sodium secondary battery and an electric device are provided. The sodium secondary battery includes a negative electrode plate and an electrolytic solution. The negative electrode plate includes a negative electrode active material having an actual discharge-specific capacity measured by a three-stage stepwise discharge method relative to a theoretical discharge-specific capacity defining a ratio a. The electrolytic solution includes a fluorinated carbonate compound having a mass proportion b based on a total mass of the electrolytic solution. The ratio a/b satisfies 1≤a/b≤270. The sodium secondary battery exhibits reduced volume expansion after high-temperature storage and improved low-temperature charging performance and cycling stability.

title: Conductive module and battery pack
abstract: There are included a connection conductor that is directly electrically connected to an electrode terminal of a battery cell constituting a battery module, a fuse unit that indirectly electrically connects the connection conductor to a battery monitoring unit, and a housing component that is assembled to the battery module and in which the connection conductor and the fuse unit are housed, are provided, in which the housing component includes a housing member that is provided with a conductor housing chamber and a unit housing chamber, and a cover member that is assembled to the housing member and covers the conductor housing chamber and the unit housing chamber at an assembly completion position to the housing member, and the housing member also serves as a transport tray for transporting, to a next factory floor, at least either the connection conductor or the fuse unit in a housed state.

title: Composition and method for manufacturing light-emitting element using same
abstract: There is provided a photoresist capable of forming a photoresist layer having both developability and polar solvent resistance while having high peeling and removing properties as a positive-working photoresist layer. A composition constituting the photoresist includes a water-soluble resin, a positive-working photosensitizer, and a solvent, and the water-soluble resin includes a copolymer containing a vinyl alcohol monomer unit.

title: Dysregulation of planktonic bacterial metabolism
abstract: A composition comprising a 2-hydroxycarboxylic acid for dysregulating the metabolism of planktonic bacteria, and uses of the same.

title: Reactive sintering of ceramic lithium-ion solid electrolytes
abstract: Solid lithium-ion ceramic electrolyte membranes have an average thickness of less than 200 micrometers. A constituent electrolyte material has an average grain size of less than 10 micrometers. The solid lithium-ion ceramic electrolyte is free-standing. Alternatively, solid lithium-ion electrolyte membranes have a composition represented by Li 1+x-y M x M′ 2-x-y M″ y (PO 4 ) 3 , where M is a 3 +  ion, M′ is a 4 +  ion, M″ is a 5 +  ion, 0≤x≤2 and 0≤y≤2.

title: Smart item drop-off
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a smart item drop-off system. A location of a user device may be determined to be within a predetermined proximity of a storage system, and a selection of an item may be received from the user device. A storage unit, of the storage system, that will store the item may be identified. An identification of the storage unit and a command to cause access to the storage unit to be enabled may be transmitted to the storage system.

title: Power transistor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The present invention involves a power device and a manufacturing method thereof. The method comprising steps of providing a semiconductor substrate, growing an epitaxial layer on the semiconductor substrate, forming an insulating layer on the epitaxial layer, forming a metal mask layer on the insulating layer, and performing an ion implantation process from above the metal mask layer on the epitaxial layer. The metal mask layer includes an ion implantation blocking region and an ion implantation penetration region.

title: Step drill bit
abstract: A drill bit including a shank extending along a bit axis. The bit includes a body having a proximal end, a distal end, and a body including a bit tip. The body defines a plurality of steps including a first step and a terminal step. The steps include at least 13 steps and have stop-on steps and intermediate steps. The steps include more intermediate steps than stop-on steps. Each stop-on step includes a first length measured in a direction parallel to the bit axis and being in a range between 0.1 inches and 0.25 inches. Each intermediate step includes a second length measured in a direction parallel to the bit axis and being in a range between 0.075 inches and 0.12 inches. The first length is greater than the second length. The bit includes a flute formed in the body and a cutting edge extending along the flute.

title: One or more non-transitory computer-readable storage media, information processing system, and computer-implemented method
abstract: One or more non-transitory computer-readable storage media have stored therein instructions that, when executed, cause one or more processors to perform operations comprising: displaying an animated frame that surrounds a display area where a content image is displayed; and switching a display mode of the frame from a first display mode to a second display mode that stands out less than the first display mode in a case where the display area indicated by the frame is an area whose content image changes.

title: Diagnostic device and method
abstract: A lab-on-a-chip (LoC) ( 1 ) comprising a plurality of sampling wells ( 51, 41 ) and a nano-porous filter ( 45 ). A first sampling well ( 51 ) in fluid communication with a second sampling well ( 41 ) via a flow path. The nano-porous filter ( 45 ) being provided in the first sampling well ( 51 ).

title: Sensing apparatus
abstract: Disclosed is a sensing apparatus comprising: a first sub-substrate including a first input unit configured to receive signals from a first plurality of sensors, a low-pass filter configured to remove noise in the signals from the first input unit, and a conversion circuit configured to convert analog signals from the low-pass filter into digital signals; a second sub-substrate including a second input unit configured to receive signals from a second plurality of sensors, a low-pass filter configured to remove noise in the signals from the second input unit, and a conversion circuit configured to convert analog signals from the low-pass filter into digital signals; a main substrate configured to supply power to the first sub-substrate and the second sub-substrate; and a control unit configured to output data based on the digital signals.

title: Diode structures of stacked transistors and methods of manufacturing the same
abstract: A three-dimensional (3D) transistor structure includes a first stacked transistor structure including a first lower source/drain (S/D) region and a first upper S/D region stacked thereon with an insulating layer therebetween. The first lower S/D region has a first conductivity type, and the first upper S/D region has a second conductivity type that is opposite to the first conductivity type. A first contact is connected to the first upper S/D region, and a second contact is connected to the first lower S/D region. A shared contact connects the first upper S/D region to the first lower S/D region. Related devices and fabrication methods are also discussed.

title: Motor unit
abstract: A motor unit includes: an electric motor including: a rotor; a stator; and a housing that internally houses the rotor and the stator, the housing having: an upper portion where an oil path where a cooling oil flows and outlet paths where the cooling oil is discharged from the oil path toward the stator are formed; and a lower portion having a cooling oil storage unit; a reducer including: a reducer mechanism; and a gear case that internally houses the reducer mechanism, and has a lower portion having a cooling oil storage unit communicating with the storage unit in the housing, the reducer having a second end surface on which a first end surface of the electric motor is mounted; an oil pump that is mounted on a first end surface of the reducer; and an oil cooler that is mounted on the first end surface of the reducer.

title: Audio Device
abstract: A game headset receives a game audio during play of a particular game, monitors the game audio and detects an occurrence of one or more particular sounds in the game audio during the monitoring of the one or more of the plurality of audio channels. In response to the detecting, the game headset triggers playback of one or more of a plurality of voice commands that corresponds to the one or more particular sounds. The voice commands may be predefined and associated with the one or more particular sounds in a data structure. The voice commands may instruct the listener of the game headset to perform an action in the particular game. The characteristics of the one or more sounds may include direction, intensity, and/or frequency of the particular one or more sounds.

title: Extended joint structure
abstract: Provided is an extended joint structure, which includes a sleeve body and a catalytic structure. The sleeve body is provided with an air inlet, an air outlet, and a catalytic chamber, one end of sleeve body is connected to an air exhaust pipe, and the other end of the sleeve body is connected to an oxygen sensor, so that the gas in the air exhaust pipe flows into the catalytic chamber through the air inlet and then flows out from the air outlet to the oxygen sensor; the catalytic structure is provided inside the catalytic chamber to catalyze the gas flowing through the catalytic chamber to improve the quality of the gas flowing out from the air outlet. This application has the effect of improving the detection environment of oxygen sensors by catalytic treatment of flowing gas, thereby enhancing the stability of detection signals.

title: Catheters and system for isolating an interior of a mammal hollow organ
abstract: Catheters for isolating an interior of a mammal hollow organ, each comprising: (i) an elongate catheter body designed to be inserted into a lumen of the mammal hollow organ; (ii) two balloons, individually and separately disposed along the elongate catheter body and designed to be inflated to isolate the interior of the mammal hollow organ therebetween; and (iii) a functional channel extending in the elongate catheter body and comprising a functional opening provided in the elongate catheter body between the balloons, wherein the functional channel is designed to allow a negative pressure to be produced in the isolated interior to take a gaseous medium, a liquid medium or a fluid medium therefrom via the functional opening.

title: Cross-Project Connection Sharing
abstract: Techniques for managing connections and connection configurations to be used by resource consumers are disclosed. A system receives a request for a connection configuration to be used by a resource consumer to access a connection to an application resource. The system identifies a set of connection configurations that can be used to connect to the application resource. These connection configurations are stored remotely from the resource consumer. The system presents the identified set of connection configurations for accessing the application resource. The system receives a selection of one of the presented connection configurations. The system configures the resource consumer to use the selected connection configuration to access the connection to the application resource by storing a reference to the connection configuration with the reference being associated with the resource consumer.

title: Charged particle beam device and method
