abstract: A charged particle beam device having an optical axis and comprising: a charged particle source for providing a primary charged particle beam; a deflector arrangement configured to provide a tilted primary charged particle beam and to guide signal charged particles comprising: a first deflector, a second deflector positioned downstream of the first deflector, a third deflector positioned downstream of the second deflector, a fourth deflector positioned downstream of the third deflector; a first detector comprising a first detection area for detecting signal charged particles and positioned upstream of the second deflector; an objective lens for focusing the primary charged particle beam onto a sample to generate the signal charged particles.
assignee: ICT Integrated Circuit Testing Gesellschaft für Halbleiterprüftechnik mbH

title: Spdx license expression construction using llm
abstract: Here is prompt engineering for a large language model (LLM) that inferentially generates a formal license expression from many license files in a software repository. A computer loads multiple software licenses from many license text files that each can contain a software license that can contain a license identifier. Many original license chunks are generated by splitting each software license into license chunk(s) that do not exceed a predefined chunk size. From the original license chunks are selected multiple chunks that contain at least one expected string. A linguistic prompt is generated that contains the selected license chunks. From the linguistic prompt, the LLM inferentially generates a license expression and a natural language explanation of the expression.

title: Speaker and Recorder Device for Word Recall
abstract: An audio recording device that mounts to a target object to help with word retrieval and recall. The device comprises an electronic system and a system housing, wherein the electronic system is integrated within the system housing. The system housing comprises a playback button on a front panel and a record button on the rear panel. A text label is placed over the playback button displaying the name of the target object. After recording the target word associated with the target object, the user attaches the device to the target object to practice recalling the name of the target object. In an alternative embodiment, the device can also be used to set task reminders. In this embodiment, the user records a daily task and then attaches the device to a convenient location. When the playback button is pressed, the user is reminded of the task to complete.

title: Contextual response retrieval using modular endpoints
abstract: Systems and methods for retrieving information using a modular endpoint system are disclosed herein. The system accesses a suite of model-based agents that interface with a plurality of retrieval augmented generation (RAG) endpoints and receives, from a user via an application programming interface (API), (a) a query and (b) session parameters. The system may input the query and the session parameters into a model configured to identify at least one RAG endpoint and, responsive to identifying the at least one RAG endpoint, retrieve a schema specific to the at least one RAG endpoint. Using the function calling capabilities of the model, the system may generate a request for data conforming to the schema and retrieve the data.

title: Spherical alumina and supported catalyst, and preparation methods and use thereof
abstract: Provided are a spherical alumina and a supported catalyst, and preparation methods and use thereof. A method for preparing the spherical alumina includes: kneading an alumina powder, an adhesive, and water, and subjecting a resulting mixture to extrusion to obtain a strip-shaped sample; and subjecting the strip-shaped sample to spheronization to obtain spherical particles, and subjecting the spherical particles to a first calcination to obtain the spherical alumina. The spherical alumina with a higher sphericity is prepared from the alumina powder using a process that integrates kneading, extrusion, and spheronization, and a diameter of the spherical alumina could be adjusted and controlled by adjusting a diameter of the strip-shaped sample obtained after the extrusion.
assignee: Tianjin University; Dalian University Of Technology

title: Column-beam joint structure using hybrid mounting bracket
abstract: The present invention relates to a column-beam joint structure using a hybrid mounting bracket, whereby concrete can be cast in a state in which an end part of a beam, the opposite ends of which bearing supporting devices protruding downward are coupled to, is held in a hybrid mounting bracket which has a U-shaped cross-section and is provided at one side of a column, so that a factory-manufactured beam can be easily joined to the column, a construction period can be shortened, and excellent structural performance of a joint part can be achieved.

title: Relay device, communication device, and communication method
abstract: An electronic device including circuitry configured to transmit and/or receive, at least first information corresponding to a quality of a communication with a transmission communication device and/or second information corresponding to a quality of a communication with a reception communication device, wherein the first information includes at least a first message for channel state information (CSI) measurement or feedback of CSI information, and wherein the second information includes at least a second message for the CSI measurement or the feedback of CSI information.

title: Medical imaging method and medical imaging device
abstract: A medical imaging method including performing acquisition on a section of the heart in chronological order to obtain multiple images in two-dimensional mode; identifying at least one anatomical structure of interest in the multiple images in two-dimensional mode and determining a coordinate point of the at least one anatomical structure of interest; generating at least one virtual sampling line in the multiple images in two-dimensional mode, the at least one virtual sampling line passing through the at least one anatomical structure of interest; generating a displacement time map of the at least one anatomical structure of interest by using the at least one virtual sampling line on the basis of the multiple images in two-dimensional mode; and detecting multiple corresponding sets of end-systolic coordinates and end-diastolic coordinates on the basis of the displacement time map to determine multiple cardiac cycles.

title: Adaptable automated artificial intelligence security operations center investigation agent
abstract: A computing system for an adaptable automated artificial intelligence security operations center alert investigation implements an automated artificial intelligence (AI) security operations center (SOC) investigation program via an automated SOC analyst (SA) investigation agent. The SA investigation agent initiates an investigation for a security alert and retrieves alert data including an entity. An adaptability agent processes the alert data according to adaptability criteria to reach an adaptability verdict. If the adaptability verdict indicates the security alert is malicious or benign, then the SA investigation agent refrains from implementing an investigation workflow and outputs a final verdict. If the adaptability verdict is indeterminate, then the SA investigation agent implements the investigation workflow to determine entity investigation agents to investigate the entity. The SA investigation agent receives intermediate verdicts from the entity investigation agents indicating whether the entity is malicious or benign, and determines a final verdict for the security alert.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A semiconductor device of the embodiment includes two structures and two conductors. A plurality of first semiconductor elements are formed in the first structure. The second structure includes a substrate including a plurality of impurity diffused layers, and a plurality of second semiconductor elements located in the impurity diffused layers on the side of a first surface of the substrate, and is stacked on the first structure on the side of a second surface of the substrate on the opposite side to the first surface. The first conductor is located between the first structure and the second structure, is electrically separated from the substrate, and is electrically connected to at least one of the first semiconductor elements. The second conductor is located between the first conductor and the impurity diffused layers, and shields at least a portion of the impurity diffused layers from an electric field of the first conductor.

title: Dynamic mapping of outdoor yards
abstract: Systems, methods, software, and devices are disclosed herein that provide for maintaining a digital twin of a state of operation of an outdoor yard of a distribution center indicative of changes in states of vehicles in the outdoor yard. In an embodiment, a yard management system is provided that includes a memory configured to store a dynamic map of the yard, and a processor coupled with executable instructions forming modules of the yard management system and configured to execute the modules to update the dynamic map of the outdoor yard. The modules may include an input interface, an output interface, a gate check-in module, a roadside-unit (RSU) module, and a gate check-out module. The input interface is configured to accept images of the outdoor yard, and the output interface is configured to output the dynamic map as updated by the gate check-in, RSU, and gate check-out modules.

title: Clad steel plate and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: The present invention provides a clad steel plate, comprising a base layer and a cladding layer on the base layer, wherein the clad steel plate has a thickness of 60-120 mm, the cladding layer is made of stainless steel, the base layer is made of carbon steel, and a bonding strength between the base layer and the cladding layer is 500 MPa or more. The clad steel plate of the present invention exhibits excellent tensile performance, low-temperature impact performance, and interlayer bonding performance. The present invention also provides a method for manufacturing the clad steel plate.

title: Control devices with locking handle
abstract: A medical device system may include a handle having first and second portions, with the first portion being axially displaceable relative to the second portion. One or more snap members may extend from the body member, each having a radially inwardly extending protrusion. The second portion may include a plurality of recesses configured to selectively receive the radially inwardly extending protrusions of the snap members, enabling selective locking engagement between the first and second portions.

title: Acidic gas reduction electrode catalyst and acidic gas reduction device using same
abstract: An electrode catalyst includes: a catalyst particle having an electrically conductive fine particle and an active metal adhered on a surface of the electrically conductive fine particle; a porous membrane which adsorbs an acidic gas; a cation exchange membrane through which protons are transmitted; and a porous current collector having a surface to which the catalyst particle has been immobilized, the porous membrane and the cation exchange membrane coexisting on the catalyst particle. The catalyst particle is coated with the porous membrane, is covered with the cation exchange membrane, and is immobilized to the surface of the current collector.

title: Treatment of cancer with a parg inhibitor
abstract: Provided herein are compositions and methods for the treatment of a cancer. Said compositions comprise a PARG inhibitor. Some embodiments comprise combination therapy featuring the PARG inhibitor with at least one additional oncology therapeutic agent.

title: Systems and Methods for Sequencing of Cell-Free RNA
abstract: Systems and methods for sequencing of cell-free RNAs are provided. Targeted sequencing can be performed using a panel of transcripts that are genes of rare abundance within a population of control samples of cell-free nucleic acids.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University

title: Charging cases for earphones
abstract: The present disclosure provides a charging case for at least one earphone. Each of the at least one earphone may include a core module and a hook structure connected to the core module. The charging case may include at least one profiling groove configured to accommodate one of the at least one earphone. Each of the at least one profiling groove may include a first profiling groove region corresponding to the core module and a second profiling groove region corresponding to the hook structure. A projection of the first profiling groove region and a projection of the second profiling groove region in the first reference direction overlap, and a projection of the first profiling groove region and a projection of the second profiling groove region in the second reference direction overlap. The first reference direction may be perpendicular to the second reference direction. With such arrangement, the charging case in the present disclosure can have a relatively small volume.

title: Delay information collection apparatus, delay control system, delay information collection method and program
abstract: A delay information collection device includes a path information acquisition unit that acquires path information regarding a communication path between a control target device and a control device, a delay information acquisition unit that acquires delay information indicating a delay time of communication generated in the communication path from one or a plurality of communication devices existing in the communication path, and a delay information transmission unit that transmits total delay information indicating a total of the delay times based on the delay information acquired by the delay information acquisition unit to the control device that controls the control target device on a basis of the total delay information.

title: Systems and methods for determining embedding vector for heterogeneous and asynchronous it operations event data
abstract: A computer-implemented method for determining a signature embedding vector for information technology events. The method including: receiving a current data object representing an occurrence of an information technology event associated with a configurable item; obtaining a graph database of logical associations of the configurable item; applying a clustering algorithm to the graph database to determine a subset of graphs; extracting associated data of the subset of graphs; applying an embedding model to the extracted associated data to determine an embedding vector for each subset of graphs; aggregating the embedding vector for each subset of graphs to determine a signature embedding vector; and utilizing the signature embedding vector to perform further analysis of the current data object.

title: Information processing system, identification system, and storage medium
abstract: An information processing system includes: an acquisition unit configured to acquire molecular information relating to biomolecules of an organism for a plurality of biomolecules; and an identification unit configured to identify a state of the organism according to a target associated with a biomolecule among the plurality of biomolecules, the target satisfying a condition defined for changes in biomolecules identified from the molecular information.
assignee: Aiwell Inc.; Institute Of Science Tokyo

title: Two-dimensional photosensor and manufacturing method of two-dimensional photosensor
abstract: The present invention provides a two-dimensional photosensor which can be manufactured at a low cost in a thin film transistor factory and extends over a relatively wide two-dimensional plane. This two-dimensional photosensor comprises a plurality of arrayed photodiodes. The photodiodes each have a laminate of a first metal electrode, a first semiconductor layer, a first ohmic contact layer, and a first transparent electrode. The first semiconductor layer and the first ohmic contact layer are arranged between the first metal electrode and the first transparent electrode. This two-dimensional photosensor has a Schottky barrier at the interface between the first semiconductor layer and the first metal electrode, or at the interface between the first semiconductor layer and the first transparent electrode, and senses light incident thereon from the first transparent electrode side toward the first semiconductor layer.

title: Conductive material dispersion, positive electrode manufactured using the same, and rechargeable lithium battery including the positive electrode
abstract: A conductive material dispersion for a rechargeable lithium battery, a positive electrode for a rechargeable lithium battery, and a rechargeable lithium battery are disclosed. A conductive material dispersion for a rechargeable lithium battery includes a conductive material and a dispersant, and the conductive material includes carbon nanotubes having an average diameter of 4 nm or more and 15 nm or less and an average specific surface area of 200 m 2 /g or more and 800 m 2 /g or less, the dispersant includes hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber having a weight average molecular weight of 200,000 to 500,000 g/mol, and the dispersion satisfies Equation 1 herein.

title: Redundant control system for an air to air refuelling system
abstract: Methods and systems for controlling the hose tension during contact operation in a hose and drogue refuelling system in an air to air refuelling for aircraft. A redundant control system is provided to keeping hose in tension during via two motors and two control units and each control unit having two control devices. In the event of a failure in the system, another component can function to keep hose tension.

title: Climate control systems for use with high glide working fluids and methods for detecting a concentration of refrigerant in the working fluid
abstract: A method of determining a composition of a blended working fluid in a climate control system includes detecting a characteristic of a working fluid flowing through a fluid conduit at a location of the fluid conduit using a sensor; calculating a first concentration of a first refrigerant of the blended working fluid at the location; and calculating a second concentration of the second refrigerant of the blended working fluid at the location. The calculating the first concentration of the first refrigerant is based on the characteristic and stored information. The stored information includes a first stored value of the first refrigerant and a second stored value of a second refrigerant. The calculating the second concentration of the second refrigerant is based on the characteristic and the stored information. The calculating is based only upon the characteristic and the stored information.

title: Copper-anf composite conductor fabrication
abstract: A method of fabricating a conductor includes preparing an aramid nanofiber solution in which a matrix of aramid nanofibers is dispersed, preparing a dispersion of copper nanoparticles, each copper nanoparticle of the dispersion of cooper nanoparticles having an organic capping ligand attached to the copper nanoparticle, and incorporating copper nanoparticles of the dispersion of copper nanoparticles into the matrix of aramid nanofibers such that each incorporated copper nanoparticle is bonded to a respective aramid nanofiber of the matrix of aramid nanofibers via the organic capping ligand to which the copper nanoparticle is attached. The organic capping ligand may include a mercaptocarboxylic acid.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of Michigan

title: Method of marking lesions
abstract: A method of marking lesions is disclosed herein. The disclosed method may assist surgeons localize small nodules or other lesions by marking the nodules or other lesions with a fiducial marker impregnated with a luminescent material, such as a fiducial coil impregnated with a fluorescent dye. In some preferred implementations, a fiducial coil is placed at the time of biopsy using a robotic surgery system. In alternate implementations, non-robotic peripheral navigation platforms may also be used effectively as an adjunct to surgical resection. The dye marks the location of a nodule or other lesion, making it visible and palpable at the time of surgery. A surgeon may then target tissue for removal with greater precision. The disclosed method allows a fiducial marker to be placed several days prior to surgery.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and storage medium
abstract: An information processing device includes: a first sensor configured to output an address event signal indicating a position and a time of a pixel in which a change in luminance occurs; and a second sensor configured to read an image signal at a predetermined frame cycle. A first detection result is acquired by detecting a feature point of a subject based on the output of the first sensor, a feature point image is generated using the first detection result when the first detection result satisfies a predetermined standard, and the feature point image is generated preferentially using a second detection result that is a detection result of the feature point based on an output of the second sensor rather than the first detection result when the first detection result does not satisfy the predetermined standard.

title: Hinge device
abstract: A hinge device includes a base seat, a rotating unit, a translating slider, and a rotating foot cushion member. The rotating unit includes a rotating member rotatable relative to the base seat between first and second positions and a first connecting protrusion. The translating slider is slidably movable relative to the base seat between first and second translation positions. The rotating foot cushion member is rotatable relative to the base seat between folded and supporting positions. When the rotating member is in the first position, the translating slider is in the first translation position, and the rotating foot cushion member is in the folded position. When the rotating member rotates to the second position, the translating slider is driven to slide to the second translation position by the first connecting protrusion, thereby driving the rotating foot cushion member to rotate to the supporting position.

abstract:

title: Voltage regulation circuit, method, and apparatus, and server power supply
abstract: A voltage regulation circuit, method, and apparatus, and a server power supply. The voltage regulation circuit includes an input-output branch and a regulation branch. The regulation branch includes a signal processor, a rectification circuit, and a voltage regulator. The input-output branch outputs a direct-current voltage by controlling a switching frequency, and the regulation branch controls the direct-current voltage to be constant by regulating a target input voltage of the input-output branch. The rectification circuit is connected to the voltage regulator. An output voltage of the voltage regulator is a regulated voltage outputted by the regulation branch. The regulated voltage and a previous-stage input voltage of the voltage regulation circuit are used as the target input voltage. The signal processor is connected to the rectification circuit, and the signal processor is configured to output a first switching signal to the rectification circuit to control the regulated voltage.
assignee: Suzhou Metabrain Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Cooperation between storage system controllers
abstract: A first indication of an input/output (I/O) operation to be performed by a first storage system controller is stored in memory of a particular storage device storing data associated with the I/O operation by a second storage system controller. The first indication causes the particular storage device to store the data in a buffer of the first storage system controller. A second indication from the first storage system controller that the I/O operation has been completed is received via the particular storage device.

title: Al-sc-ga sputtering target, and method for producing same
abstract: An Al—Sc—Ga sputtering target includes a main body portion that contains Al, Sc, and Ga and that does not contain a Ga phase. In the main body portion, the atomic ratio of Sc to Ga (Sc/Ga) may be 0.5 or more. In the main body portion, the atomic ratio of Sc to Ga (Sc/Ga) may be 20 or less. The Al—Sc—Ga sputtering target may further include a backing plate bonded to the main body portion with a bonding material interposed therebetween.

title: Hair dryer
abstract: A hair dryer is provided, including: a hair dryer body, where an air duct disposed in an axial direction of the hair dryer body is provided inside the hair dryer body; an air inlet structure including an air inlet region arranged at a rear end of the hair dryer body, where a lateral air intake through hole communicated with the air duct is provided on the air inlet region; and an air guide hood fixedly or detachably connected to a rear end of the hair dryer body to guide and convert a radial air flow and/or a near-radial air flow entering from the lateral air intake through hole into an axial air flow in the axial direction of the hair dryer body, to change a direction of noise in the air inlet region.
assignee: Hong Kong Tung Hei Yuen Technology Co., Limited

title: Electrochemical-sensing apparatus and method therefor
abstract: An electrochemical-sensing apparatus for analyzing a sample of a user. The apparatus has a housing with a port for receiving an electrochemical-sensor structure having a counter electrode (CE), a reference electrode (RE), and at least one working electrode (WE) for contacting the sample, and an analysis circuitry for coupling to the electrodes for analyzing biomarkers in the sample, and an output for outputting an analytical result. The analysis circuitry has a circuit for generating an excitation signal and applying it to CE and RE, at least one frequency analyzer for receiving a return signal from the at least one WE for analyzing the sample, and a set of switches for short-circuiting CE and RE and for engaging at least one calibration resistor to CE/RE and the at least one frequency analyzer for directing a calibration signal to the at least one frequency analyzer component for calibration.

title: Inflatable patient transfer mattress
abstract: An inflatable patient transfer mattress having: a lower portion with a lower air-permeable region configured to allow for the transfer of air from within the mattress to outside the mattress therethrough; an upper portion with an upper air-permeable region configured to allow for the transfer of air from within the mattress to outside the mattress therethrough; and an air inlet configured to allow for a supply of air to be provided into an inner region of the mattress, between the lower portion and the upper portion, therethrough.

title: User interface(s) related to synthesizing programs in a spreadsheet programming language
abstract: Techniques are described herein for automatically synthesizing programs that include one or more functions in a spreadsheet programming language. A method includes: receiving first user input in a first cell in a spreadsheet; automatically synthesizing a program using the first user input in the first cell as a first example, where the program includes at least one function in a spreadsheet programming language and, when the program is executed, the program generates output that matches the first example; determining at least one additional cell in the spreadsheet that is related to the first cell; determining that a display triggering condition is satisfied; and in response to the determining that the display triggering condition is satisfied, displaying, in each of the at least one additional cell, an output of the program corresponding to the additional cell.

title: Fused ring compound, preparation method therefor and medicinal application thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a fused ring compound, a preparation method therefor and a medicinal application thereof. Specifically, the present disclosure relates to a fused ring compound represented by general formula (IN), a preparation method therefor, a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound, and a use thereof as a therapeutic agent, in particular, the use thereof in the preparation of a drug for inhibiting KRAS G12D. Each group in the general formula (IN) is as defined in the description.
assignee: Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.; Shanghai Hengrui Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

title: Flotation device for thermal runaway management
abstract: As disclosed herein, a flotation device includes a first portion arranged in fluid communication with liquid coolant accommodated by a liquid coolant pipe, the first portion causing selective blocking or opening of an outlet leading inside a battery pack; a second portion arranged inside the battery pack being floatable; and a third portion interconnecting the portions, wherein the third portion is configured to adjust a position of the first portion based on a position of the second portion.

title: Dynamic circuit calibration during voltage change transitions
abstract: In some aspects, an electronic device may detect a start of a voltage ramp transition period associated with changing a voltage at which an integrated circuit operates from a first voltage to a second voltage, wherein changing the voltage from the first voltage to the second voltage causes changes to one or more parameters that impact performance associated with the integrated circuit during the voltage ramp transition period. The electronic device may trigger, responsive to detecting the start of the voltage ramp transition period, a dynamic calibration mode that compensates for the changes to the one or more parameters that impact the performance associated with the integrated circuit during the voltage ramp transition period. The electronic device may exit the dynamic calibration mode responsive to detecting an end of the voltage ramp transition period. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Systems and methods for predicting dry matter intake in animals using machine learning
abstract: A computing system may receive data comprising values of a set of variables corresponding to a plurality of animals, the set of the variables including a water intake and a dry matter intake. A computing system can train a machine learning model on the data to provide values of dry matter intake based on the values of the set of the variables. A computing system can after training, provide the machine learning model with input values of at least a subset of the variables associated with at least one animal to generate a value of dry matter intake for the at least one animal.
assignee: West Virginia University Board of Governors on behalf of West Virginia University

title: Acoustic control device and method of vehicle
abstract: An acoustic control device of a vehicle includes a memory, a processor configured to generate a noise cancelling signal for removing noise generated inside the vehicle, a speaker disposed inside the vehicle and outputting the noise cancelling signal according to control of the processor, a microphone disposed inside the vehicle to detect a sound wave signal, and an acceleration sensor disposed in the vehicle to measure a vibration signal, wherein the processor determines a frequency response based on an acoustic transfer path between the speaker, the microphone, and the acceleration sensor and compares the determined frequency response with a normal frequency response stored in the memory and determines whether the acoustic transfer path is abnormal.

title: Thinned semiconductor device having doped semiconductive zone localized proximate to a memory array
abstract: Implementations described herein relate to various structures, integrated assemblies, and memory devices. In some implementations, a semiconductor device assembly includes a memory array region, an insulative layer, an intrinsic semiconductive region between the memory array region and the insulative layer, and a doped semiconductive region that is contained within a lateral zone that is between the intrinsic semiconductive region and the insulative layer.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to learn user knowledge, language patterns, and past conversation histories by a learning unit, acquire a current situation and context of a user by a context acquisition unit, predict content that the user is likely to want to say next by a prediction unit, present a plurality of predicted conversation candidates to the user by a presentation unit, receive, by a selection unit, a selection made by the user from among the presented conversation candidates, and store, by a feedback unit, a result of the selection as learning data so as to improve prediction accuracy in subsequent predictions.

title: Splicing display device
abstract: A splicing display device includes multiple display modules. Each of the display modules includes a display panel, a frame, a plate body, an elastic element, and a locking element. The frame is disposed on the back of the display panel. The plate body is located on an outside edge of the frame. The elastic element is disposed between the plate body and the frame. The locking element passes through the plate body and the elastic member to be fixed to the frame, where the plate bodies of two adjacent display modules are disposed opposite to each other.

title: Methods, entities and computer readable media for non-3gpp access authentication
abstract: A method at a protocol translation entity. The method includes receiving, from a Non-3GPP access point, an authentication request message of a first protocol type for a UE that includes an identity of the UE. The method also includes translating the authentication request message of the first protocol type to a corresponding authentication request message of a second protocol type and transmitting to an entity for authentication the corresponding authentication request message of a second protocol type that includes the identity of the UE.

title: Magnetic energy controlled power generating system
abstract: A magnetic energy control power generation system includes: a base having a magnet control unit, three energy storage devices, three controllers, and a crankshaft. The crankshaft is connected to a generator and a drive motor. The magnet control unit has three standing pipes fixed to the base, each containing a magnetic core with an electromagnetic coil wound around it. When the electromagnetic coil is energized, the magnetic pole direction changes, allowing the magnetic core to be extended upwards or retracted after being extended upwards. The crankshaft is horizontally pivoted on the base and has three connecting rods connected to it. The three connecting rods are pivotally connected to the three magnetic cores, allowing the crankshaft to rotate via the extension or retraction of the magnetic cores.

title: Print apparatus, method of controlling print apparatus, and storage medium
abstract: A method of controlling a print apparatus configured to convey a sheet to a static elimination apparatus configured to perform static elimination processing on the sheet includes performing control, in a case where a jam of the sheet occurs, to stop print processing, and displaying at least an occurrence position of the jam and information prompting a user to check a static elimination setting.

title: Agentic ai-powered cybersecurity framework for zero-day vulnerability detection and mitigation
abstract: A method includes receiving a security vulnerability report describing a security vulnerability in natural language and generating at least one executable symbolic rule based on the security vulnerability report using predefined executable symbolic rules templates. The at least one executable symbolic rule is generated using at least one LLM-based executable symbolic rules agent trained to generate executable symbolic rules. The method also includes executing the at least one executable symbolic rule on a database of devices that includes specifications of the devices to provide analysis information on which of the devices are affected by the security vulnerability and receiving the analysis information together with the report at an LLM-based recommender agent trained to recommend mitigation strategies. The method further includes recommending a mitigation strategy for the devices affected by the security vulnerability using the LLM-based recommender agent and providing the analysis information and the mitigation strategy to a web portal.

title: Information interaction method and apparatus, electronic device, storage medium, and program product
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide an information interaction method and apparatus, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a program product. The method includes: receiving an addition operation for a two-dimensional object through an interaction device, determining first display information of the two-dimensional object in a local space, and rendering the two-dimensional object into a three-dimensional space according to the first display information; and determining an operation element corresponding to the two-dimensional object, determining rendering configuration information of the operation element, and rendering the operation element into the three-dimensional space according to the first display information and the rendering configuration information to display the operation element on the interaction device; where the operation element is configured to control the two-dimensional object to perform a preset operation.

title: Semiconductor substrate, and method for manufacturing semiconductor substrate
abstract: A semiconductor substrate includes: a main substrate; a seed pattern that is located above the main substrate and includes a first region; and a first semiconductor part extending from the first region, wherein the main substrate is a substrate made of a bulk crystal that is not a nitride semiconductor, and part of a surface of the main substrate is a non-seed region that does not overlap the seed pattern in plan view.

title: Management of akma services to user equipment
abstract: Systems and methods of performing an Authentication and Key Management for Applications (AKMA) service. In one embodiment, a method comprises determining, during primary authentication of user equipment (UE), whether a serving network of the UE belongs to a home public land mobile network. Responsive to determining that the serving network belongs to the home public land mobile network, the method comprises determining that an AKMA service is enabled for a registration of the UE with the serving network, and performing derivation of an AKMA anchor key. Responsive to determining that the serving network does not belong to the home public land mobile network, the method comprises determining that the AKMA service is disabled. After the primary authentication is successful, the method comprises providing an AKMA service indicator from the home public land mobile network to the UE that indicates whether the AKMA service is enabled or disabled.

title: Automatically-aligning magnetic field system
abstract: A wireless power transfer device includes a first transmitting coil oriented along a first axis; a second transmitting coil oriented along a second axis nonparallel to the first axis and being positioned above the first transmitting coil along a thickness direction nonparallel to each of the first and second axes; a nonmagnetic material positioned, along the thickness direction, between the first and second transmitting coils in an area of overlap between the first and second transmitting coils; and a driver configured to differentially drive the first and second transmitting coils respectively with first and second AC currents to generate a magnetic field.
assignee: The Alfred E. Mann Foundation For Scientific Research

title: Display substrate and preparation method therefor, and display apparatus
abstract: A display substrate, a preparation method thereof, and a display apparatus, the display substrate includes a base substrate; a drive circuit layer provided on the base substrate; a light-emitting structure layer provided on a side of the drive circuit layer away from the base substrate, the light-emitting structure layer includes a pixel defining layer and an organic light-emitting layer, the pixel defining layer defines multiple sub-pixel regions and includes a first opening at least partially exposing the drive circuit layer, the organic light-emitting layer is located in the sub-pixel region and is overlapped with the first opening of the pixel defining layer; and a color film structure layer provided on a side of the light-emitting structure layer away from the base substrate, the color film structure layer includes a color film and a black matrix, the black matrix includes a second opening at least partially exposing the first opening.
assignee: Beijing Boe Technology Development Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: A method of manufacturing a semiconductor device includes forming a first contact structure in contact with a source/drain region, and forming a second contact structure on the first contact structure. Forming the second contact structure includes  forming a first layer comprising at least one first grain on the first contact structure, and  forming a second layer including second grains on the first layer. A size of each of the at least one first grain is greater than a size of each of the second grains.

title: Lattice-structured pressure sensor and a system and method for use and calibration thereof
abstract: There is provided a pressure sensor for converting applied pressure to electrical signals, a method for using the pressure sensor, and a method for calibrating the pressure sensor. The pressure sensor including: a non-conductive substrate; conductive material in the non-conductive substrate, the conductive material forming a lattice structure; and a plurality of electrodes connected to the conductive material at respective locations of a boundary of the lattice structure.
assignee: The Governing Council Of The University Of Toronto

title: Contact structure, semiconductor device with the same, and method for fabricating the same
abstract: The present application discloses a cell contact structure, a semiconductor device, and a method for fabricating the semiconductor device. The cell contact structure includes a bottom contact layer positioned on a substrate and enclosed by a plurality of bit line structures and a plurality of partition layers; a liner layer positioned between the bottom contact layer and the substrate, between the bottom contact layer and the plurality of bit line structures, and between the bottom contact layer and the plurality of partition layers; and a top contact layer positioned on the bottom contact layer and the liner layer. A top surface of the bottom contact layer and a top surface of the liner layer are substantially coplanar. The liner layer includes doped polycrystalline silicon, doped polycrystalline germanium, or doped polycrystalline silicon germanium. The bottom contact layer includes tungsten, titanium, or titanium nitride.

title: Grill system with smoke assembly
abstract: Cooking devices, cooking systems, and smoke assemblies for use therewith are provided. In one embodiment, a cooking system is provided and includes a housing and a smoke assembly. The housing can have a lower base portion and an upper lid portion that together define a hollow cooking chamber. The smoke assembly can be coupled to the upper lid portion, and can be in fluid communication with the hollow cooking chamber. The smoke assembly can generate smoke during cooking operations in order to impart smoke flavor onto a food product disposed within the hollow cooking chamber.

title: Transdermal therapeutic system comprising cytisine
abstract: The present invention relates to a transdermal therapeutic system (TTS) for the transdermal administration of cytisine comprising a self-adhesive layer structure containing a therapeutically effective amount of cytisine, such cytisine TTS for use in a method of treatment as well as processes for manufacturing such cytisine TTS.

title: Vertiport with conveyance platforms
abstract:
A system and method for conveying and charging passenger-carrying aerial vehicles (AVs) comprising electric propulsion systems are disclosed. A conveyance platform (CP) is configured to support the full weight of an AV and convey the AV within a vertiport while at least one passenger remains inside the AV. In some embodiments, the AV lands directly on the conveyance platform and takes off directly therefrom. 
     Electrical energy for powered flight may be transferred to the AV through the conveyance platform while the AV is conveyed. In some embodiments, the conveyance platform transfers electrical energy from an external electrical conductor extending along at least a portion of a path of movement of the conveyance platform. The electrical conductor may comprise a rail or a cable connected to an external electrical energy source. 
     In some embodiments, the conveyance platform is associated with a battery configured to transfer electrical energy to the AV, optionally sufficient for one or more AV charging cycles before replenishment. A command system may coordinate movement of a plurality of conveyance platforms during a vertiport ground cycle.

title: Mip-based image encoding/decoding method, method for transmitting bitstream, and recording medium having bitstream stored therein
abstract: An image encoding/decoding method and apparatus are provided. The image decoding method according to the present disclosure comprises the steps of: determining an intra prediction mode of the current block; and generating a prediction block of the current block by performing intra prediction on the basis of the determined intra prediction mode, wherein the intra prediction may be restricted to be performed by using only a reference sample within a predetermined range from among available reference samples of the current block.

title: Voltage droop detection and mitigation circuit sharing delay line, and clock supply circuit including the same
abstract: A clock supply circuit includes: a delay line to which a voltage is supplied from a supply voltage line; a clock signal output circuit configured to output one of a first clock signal or a second clock signal corresponding to an input clock signal to a device based on a flag signal, wherein the first clock signal having a first frequency and the second clock signal having a second frequency; a droop detection circuit configured to output the flag signal to the clock signal output circuit, the flag signal indicating whether a droop is detected for the voltage based on a propagation degree of the first clock signal in the delay line; and a droop mitigation circuit configured to output an output selection signal for the delay line to the clock signal output circuit to control the second frequency of the second clock signal.
assignee: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.; Seoul National University R&Db Foundation

title: Methods and apparatus for video coding using multiple hypothesis cross-component prediction for chroma coding
abstract: A method and apparatus for coding colour pictures or video using coding tools including one or more cross component models related modes are disclosed. According to this method, input data associated with a current block comprising a first-colour block and a second-colour block is received. Two or more candidates are derived, wherein said two or more candidates comprise one or more candidate CCP (Cross-Component Prediction) models. One or more MH (Multiple Hypothesis) candidates are generated by blending two or more hypotheses of prediction associated with said two or more candidates. The second-colour block is encoded or decoded by using prediction data comprising said one or more MH candidates.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device includes: a substrate; a transistor disposed on the substrate; a first electrode disposed on the substrate; a pixel definition layer disposed on the first electrode; a separator pattern layer disposed on the pixel definition layer; a second electrode disposed on the first electrode, the pixel definition layer, and the separator pattern layer; a connection layer connected between the transistor and the second electrode; an emission layer disposed between the first electrode and the second electrode; a conductive pattern layer; and a capping member covering a side end portion of the conductive pattern layer, wherein the conductive pattern layer and the connection layer are disposed on a same layer, and a part of the second electrode disposed on the separator pattern layer and a part of the second electrode disposed around the separator pattern layer are separated from each other.

title: Performing Application and/or Virtual Machine Migrations based on Migration Complexity
abstract: Embodiments plan, schedule, and execute digital element migration between a source system and a target system. For example, a source system can include a number of source assets that operate digital elements, such as applications and/or virtual machines. Implementations can perform digital element migration using digital element sizing and target architecture shaping. For example, the digital elements can be sized to determine resource requirements for the digital elements. The sized digital elements can then support shaping of virtual machine instances for the target system, mapping of the digital elements to the virtual machine instances for the target system, and migration scheduling. Embodiments include a dynamic process manager that provides an extensible framework for migration workflows.

title: Fluorescent body powder, fluorescent body resin composition, fluorescent body, light-emitting element, and light-emitting device
abstract:
Provided are a phosphor powder exhibiting a high absorbance to blue light, together with a phosphor resin composition, a phosphor, a light-emitting element, and a light-emitting device each containing the phosphor powder. 
     This phosphor powder has a ratio (I450/I380-420) of fluorescence intensity (I450) with respect to excitation light having a wavelength of 450 nm and maximum fluorescence intensity (I380-420) with respect to excitation light having a wavelength of 380 nm or more and 420 nm or less of 0.88 or more, in an excitation spectrum showing fluorescence intensity of a maximum fluorescence wavelength λmax, provided that the maximum fluorescence wavelength λmax is a fluorescence wavelength that provides maximum fluorescence intensity with respect to an excitation light having a wavelength of 450 nm.

title: Process for mixing a fluid meltflow stream
abstract: The present disclosure provides a process. In an embodiment, the process includes providing an apparatus. The apparatus includes (A) a passageway having a sidewall with an interior for receiving a first flow stream (FFS 1 ), the passageway having an inflow end and an opposing outflow end. The apparatus includes (B) a gear pump assembly. The gear pump assembly includes (i) a housing, (ii) a gear chamber in the housing, (iii) an inlet placing the passageway in fluid communication with the gear chamber, (iv) a plurality of intermeshing gears mounted for rotation in the gear chamber, the gears having teeth which engage with each other in the chamber, each gear having an axis of rotation, and (v) an outlet in fluid communication with the gear chamber. The apparatus includes (C) one or more injectors upstream of the gear pump assembly for adding a second fluid into the first flowstream (FFS 1 ). Each injector is located on the sidewall. The process includes introducing the second fluid from each respective injector located on the sidewall into the FFS 1  and feeding the FFS 1  and the second fluid into the inlet. The process includes mixing, in the gear chamber, the second fluid with FFS 1  to form a mixed fluid flowstream (mFFS), and discharging the mFFS from the outlet.

title: Computer-implemented method for managing distributed energy storage system
abstract: According to an embodiment, a computer-implemented method for managing a distributed energy storage system comprising a plurality of nodes coupled to a power grid, wherein each node comprises at least one energy storage, comprises: receiving an activation signal for power grid frequency balancing comprising a frequency balancing capacity requirement; selecting nodes out of the plurality of nodes to be activated and/or deactivated for the power grid frequency balancing according to the frequency balancing capacity requirement; activating and/or de-activating the selected nodes for the power grid frequency balancing; monitoring, during the power grid frequency balancing, whether a power quantity of the selected nodes deviates from the frequency balancing capacity requirement; and in response to the power quantity deviating from the frequency balancing capacity requirement, reselecting nodes out of the plurality of nodes to be activated and/or deactivated for the power grid frequency balancing according to the frequency balancing capacity requirement.

title: Composition for improving blood circulation comprising extract of chili pepper by-product as active ingredient
abstract: A method for treating thrombosis includes administering a composition including an extract of chili pepper by-product as active ingredient to a subject in need thereof. Specifically, the extract of chili pepper by-product, for example, the extract of chili pepper leaf or chili pepper stem, exhibits excellent platelet aggregation inhibitory effects. In particular, the ethanol extract shows significantly stronger platelet aggregation inhibition compared to water extract. Therefore, the composition including an extract of chili pepper by-product as active ingredient can be advantageously used as a therapeutic agent for thrombosis, an anti-thrombosis functional health food, or as a material for anti-thrombosis oriental herbal medicine composition.

title: Base Station And Terminal Apparatus
abstract: A base station of an embodiment includes first and second wireless signal processing units and a link management unit. The link management unit establishes a multi-link with a terminal apparatus by using the first and second wireless signal processing units, and sets a primary link used as a main and a secondary link used as an auxiliary during the multi-link. The link management unit transmits a first wireless frame requesting a change of the primary link to the terminal apparatus by using the first wireless signal processing unit set to the primary link, and the link management unit changes the primary link from the first wireless signal processing unit to the second wireless signal processing unit if either the first or second wireless signal processor receives the affirmative response from the terminal apparatus after the first wireless frame is transmitted.

title: Methods and systems for populating data for content item
abstract: Systems and methods are presented for populating content item metadata are described herein. The system receives a content item. The system then receives at the user device selections of identifier tags that are indicative of the source or context of the content item. The system updates at the server the content item along with the metadata and stores it for retrieval. In response to the user device receiving a second content item determined to be the same as the first content item, the system replaces the second content item with a link to the first content item. Once a user interaction with the link is detected, the system may follow the link to generate for display the content item.

title: Model-based prediction
abstract: In a model-based prediction method, an initial prediction result of a first task is generated through a first upper-layer network structure based on a lower-layer output of a lower-layer network structure. In the method, global knowledge information is generated based on an output of the first upper-layer network structure and an output of each of one or more other upper-layer network structures. In the method, an updated prediction result of the first task is generated based on a network layer output of the first upper-layer network structure and the global knowledge information. In the method, a difference prompt is generated based on a difference between the initial prediction result and the updated prediction result. In the method, a refined prediction result of the first task is generated through the first upper-layer network structure based on the difference prompt and the initial prediction result.

title: Non-fractional pixel shifting to improve pixel performance
abstract: Systems and methods for non-fractional pixel shifting are described herein to mitigate pixel performance disparities in display systems. One example display system includes a display for presentation to a user, a pixel panel including a first pixel and a second pixel, and a pixel controller. The first pixel may have a first performance capability with respect to a criterion and the second pixel may have a second performance capability with respect to the criterion. The pixel controller may then cause the display system to present a frame on the display by performing operations including: causing first light emitted by the first pixel to be displayed at a pixel position on the display during presentation of a first subframe of the frame, and causing second light emitted by the second pixel to be displayed at the pixel position on the display during presentation of a second subframe of the frame.

title: Dynamic mechanism on transparent clocks to facilitate exchange of unicast messages
abstract: In a (e.g., ethernet-based PTP) time-distribution system, time receivers unicast (rather than multicast) delay-request messages and time transmitters unicast (rather than multicast) corresponding delay-response messages. An intervening transparent clock maintains a mapping table containing entries that map appropriate (PTP) port IDs to corresponding media access control (MAC) addresses that enable the transparent clock to forward the unicast delay-response messages towards the appropriate time receivers. As such, the volume of messages and the burden on transparent clocks to handle superfluous messages in such systems are reduced.

title: Ground facility
abstract: A satellite constellation forming system forms a satellite constellation which is composed of a satellite group and in which the satellite group cooperatively provides a service. The satellite constellation has a plurality of orbital planes in each of which a plurality of satellites fly at the same nominal orbital altitude. A satellite constellation forming unit continues providing the service while avoiding a collision between satellites by both or one of control of an orbital altitude and control of a passage timing of a satellite group flying in a region where the plurality of orbital planes intersect.

title: Generative content creation for a portal intake flow for an issue tracking system
abstract: A computer-implemented method for defining and creating a request intake flow for an issue tracking system is described. Embodiments described herein include systems and techniques for creating custom portal intake flows for an issue tracking system. The systems may include a user interface that allows portal intake flows to be generated and the user to select the information and workflow for an intake flow during the generation process. Embodiments are also directed to system and methods for creating dynamic summaries for issues managed by an issue tracking system. The dynamic summaries may be generated using a generative output model, as described herein, and provide information to a user about a current status, history or other events associated with an issue. Embodiments are directed to systems and methods for using a generative output engine to provide suggestions for creating a project management interface for an issue tracking system.

title: Rbsic component comprising an sic coating, use of an sic coating, and method for manufacturing a component
abstract: A component comprising a component body made of a reaction bonded silicon carbide (RBSiC) is disclosed, the component body having a body surface at least partially coated with a coating, the coating comprising silicon carbide (SiC) with a layer thickness of at least 25 μm. A use of such an SiC coating and a method for manufacturing a component comprising an SiC coating are disclosed.
assignee: Lars Schnetter; Philipp Gingter; Clara Minas-Payamyar; Dustin KERSBERG; Detlef Brands

title: Film-type patch and method of manufacturing same
abstract: The present invention provides a film-type patch containing a support layer, an adhesive layer laminated on an upper surface of the support layer, and a plurality of patterned protrusions spaced apart from each other and attached to an upper surface of the adhesive layer, wherein the patterned protrusions contain a skin penetrating substance, the space between the protrusions is provided with a number of holes penetrating the support layer and the adhesive layer, and a method of manufacturing the same.

title: Rotated 3d dram cell
abstract: Provided are methods of etching a semiconductor substrate. The semiconductor wafer may be intentionally rotated at an angle in a range of from greater than 10 degrees to 45 degrees relative to the <110> crystal direction of the semiconductor wafer prior. An epitaxial stack is formed on the semiconductor wafer, and a slit is etched through the epitaxial film stack to expose a sidewall of the epitaxial film stack. The sidewall of the epitaxial film stack is oriented along a plane of the epitaxial film stack that is aligned from 25 degrees to 45 degrees to the <100> crystal direction.

title: Methods for verification of a part of a content and related electronic device
abstract: Disclosed is a method, performed by an electronic device, for enabling verification of a second part of a content. The method comprises obtaining an authentication tree comprising a root and authentication tree data associated with the content data, wherein the authentication tree data comprises path hash values associated with a first path of the authentication tree between the second part and the root. The method comprises providing the second part, and verification data associated with the second part, wherein the verification data comprises the path hash values. 2B to be published

title: Battery system
abstract: A battery system includes a battery pack, a plurality of detection lines, and a monitoring device. A plurality of battery cells includes a first battery cell and a second battery cell. When the current flowing through the battery pack is smaller than a predetermined current value that flows during the ignition-off state, the monitoring device detects an abnormality in voltage detection based on an OCV difference, which is a difference between a first OCV of the first battery cell and a second OCV of the second battery cell. When an amount of variation in the current flowing through the battery pack is smaller than a predetermined current value that flows during external charging, the monitoring device detects an abnormality in voltage detection based on a CCV difference, which is a difference between a first CCV of the first battery cell and a second CCV of the second battery cell.

title: Iot systems, methods, and media for sensor-based human-robot collaborative monitoring
abstract: An IoT system, method, and medium for sensor-based human-robot collaborative monitoring are provided. The method includes: obtaining monitoring data of a work area of a collaborative robot; determining a collision risk value based on the monitoring data, a first motion trajectory of an operator, and a second motion trajectory of the collaborative robot; determine an avoidance parameter of the collaborative robot based on the monitoring data, the first motion trajectory, the collision risk value, a collision urgency degree, and a movable space range of the collaborative robot; and generating a motion control instruction based on the avoidance parameter and send the motion control instruction to a motion control system of the collaborative robot, wherein the motion control system is configured to adjust a physical drive signal applied to a joint motor based on the motion control instruction, to drive mechanical links of the collaborative robot to produce a composite motion.
assignee: Chengdu Qinchuan Iot Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Method for the preparation of siloxanes
abstract: Hexamethylcyclotrisiloxane is used in an equilibration reaction with at least one poly(methylhydrogen)siloxane in the presence of at least one equilibration catalyst to form a poly(methylhydrogen)-polydimethylsiloxane copolymer. A content of at least 0.5 wt.-% of hexamethylcyclotrisiloxane can decrease the equilibration reaction time to provide a statistical equal distribution of the SiH functionalities of the poly(methylhydrogen)-polydimethylsiloxane copolymer. The produced poly(methylhydrogen)-polydimethylsiloxane copolymer can be used to produce polyether polydimethylsiloxane that can be used as stabilizers for polymer foams, such as polyurethane foams.

title: Syndesmosis device inserter
abstract: A syndesmosis device inserter system includes a handle; a pusher assembly fit with the handle and including a body, a tube that is cannulated, and a rod fit into the tube; and a suture secured at a first end to a first half of the handle, threaded through a lateral button located in a groove of the handle and a medial button located at an end of the tube, and secured at a second end to a second half of the tube.

title: Light detection element
abstract: A light detection element includes a magnetic element having a first ferromagnetic layer, a second ferromagnetic layer, and a spacer layer sandwiched between the first and second ferromagnetic layers, and a main lens  21  and at least one sub-lens  22  that focus incident light to the magnetic element. The main lens and the sub-lens are metalenses  25  including a plurality of nanostructures  26 . The planar size of the multiple nanostructures in the main lens decreases as the distance from the optical center of the main lens increases in each region determined according to the distance from the optical center of the main lens, and the planar size of the multiple nanostructures in the sub-lens decreases as the distance from the optical center of the sub-lens increases in each region determined according to the distance from the optical center of the sub-lens.

title: Positive electrode active material, battery, and manufacturing method for positive electrode active material
abstract: A positive electrode active material includes a primary particle and a coating material. The primary particle contains an olivine-type phosphate compound. The coating material coats at least part of a surface of the primary particle. The coating material contains carbon and a Group 2 element.

title: Dual-agonist compound for both glp-1 and gip receptors and application thereof
abstract: Provided is a dual-agonist compound for both Glucagon-like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) and Glucose-dependent Insulinotropic Polypeptide (GIP) receptors and application thereof. In particular, provided are a polypeptide analog derived from GLP-1 and a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, which has an agonist effect on human GLP-1 receptor and human GIP receptor and can be used for the treatment of metabolic diseases such as obesity, type II diabetes, and non-alcoholic fatty liver.

title: Implantable medical device
abstract: An implantable medical device comprises a structure having a cylindrical shape and an inner lumen, and a number of radio transponders, at least one radio transponder of the number of radio transponders being configured to transmit a radio signal having a certain frequency to a receiver.

title: RDMA backend for Distributed System
abstract: In one embodiment, a device includes at least one processor to execute a transfer backend plugin acting as an adaptor between a transfer agent and a hardware data transfer device, the transfer backend plugin being to initialize communication with a remote transfer backend plugin, exchange address information with the remote transfer backend plugin, register local memory for data transfers, exchange memory registration information with the remote transfer backend plugin, and interface with the hardware data transfer device to perform data transfers between the local memory and remote memory using at least one data transfer protocol, and a memory to store data used by the transfer backend plugin.​

title: Compositions comprising beauveria bassiana and methods of use thereof
abstract: The disclosure provides a method of increasing soil organic carbon (SOC), comprising: heterologously disposing one or more fungal strains to treat a plant element, wherein the one or more fungal strains comprises a nuclear ribosomal internal transcribed spacer (ITS) sequence that is at least 97% identical to the nucleotide sequence of any one of SEQ ID NOs: 1-8; and the one or more fungal strains are heterologously disposed in an effective amount to increase organic carbon in soil supporting a plant derived from the treated plant element relative to soil supporting a reference plant derived from a reference plant element.

title: Lightweight Autonomous System Evaluation Platform
abstract: An example method includes  (a) generating a request to obtain log data descriptive of operation of an autonomous vehicle control system in a subject scenario, the log data indexed by an indexing parameter; (b) submitting the request to a log repository service, the log repository service configured to receive the request and serve, responsive to the request, log metadata; (c) loading, based on the log metadata and an index value of the indexing parameter, a log data sketch associated with the index value; and (d) loading, based on the log metadata and the index value, and responsive to an inspection indicator, detailed log data associated with the index value.

title: Using pixel-based definition of an integrated circuit design to perform machine-trained routing
abstract: Some embodiments of the invention provide an integrated circuit (IC) that has a novel non-preferred direction (NPD) wiring architecture. In some embodiments, the IC includes a substrate and multiple wiring layers, which include a first set of one or more wiring layers with no preferred wiring directions, and a second set of one or more wiring layers with preferred wiring directions. In some embodiments, the first set of wiring layers includes the third and fourth wiring layers, while the second set of wiring layers includes the fifth and higher metal layers with successive neighboring layers having different (e.g., alternating) preferred wiring directions. The first set of wiring layers in other embodiments includes the third wiring layer but not the fourth wiring layer, which in these embodiments has a preferred wiring direction.

title: Multi-metal catalysts and methods of making and using same
abstract: Catalysts and methods of hydrogenating carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) using the catalysts. The catalyst contains Fe; one or more alkali metals selected from the group consisting of sodium (Na) and potassium (K); and one or more metals selected from the group consisting of copper (Cu), zinc (Zn), and magnesium (Mg). A molar ratio of Fe to the one or more metals can be from about 2:1 to 2:3.
assignee: Tsinghua University; Saudi Arabian Oil Company

title: Solid bio-pesticidal composition comprising of elemental sulphur and azadirachtin
abstract: Methods for treating a plant, crop, locus, or soil against pests or diseases, for managing pesticidal resistance, or for reducing pesticidal residue, the method comprising applying a bio-pesticidal composition comprising elemental sulphur and azadirachtin.

title: Light-emitting substrate and method for manufacturing same, and display device
abstract: A light-emitting substrate includes: a wiring substrate including a base substrate, a wiring layer, and a first insulating protection layer, here the wiring layer including a plurality of first pad groups, the first insulating protection layer including a plurality of first openings, and an orthographic projection of the first pad group on the base substrate is within an orthographic projection of the first opening on the base substrate; a plurality of light-emitting devices at a side of the first pad groups facing away from the base substrate, here each of the light-emitting devices is bound to a corresponding one of the first pad groups; and a plurality of protection structures at a side of the light-emitting device facing away from the base substrate. Each of the protection structures includes a first part and a second part at a side of the first part facing away from the base substrate.
assignee: BOE MLED Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Quantum-Enhanced Gen-AI Approach for Optimizing Model Accuracy and Privacy in Secure Collaborative Analytics
abstract: A system and method for secure collaborative analytics enable multiple parties to perform joint data analysis without exposing sensitive information. The invention integrates quantum computing, advanced cryptographic protocols, and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) to ensure privacy, accuracy, and efficiency. Private datasets undergo quantum optimization to retain significant features, followed by encryption using quantum-resistant protocols. Encrypted data is securely transmitted and analyzed collaboratively using quantum homomorphic encryption, allowing computations directly on encrypted datasets. GenAI optimizes feature selection, computation workflows, and privacy-accuracy trade-offs, enabling iterative refinement of analytical outputs. Results are decrypted securely using quantum key authentication and validated against predefined benchmarks. The system employs differential privacy to protect individual records while preserving data utility and supports a blockchain-like ledger for immutable audit trails. Scalable, adaptable, and compatible with diverse data types, this invention addresses the evolving demands of secure, efficient, and collaborative analytics across various domains.

title: Surgical robot system and control method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a surgical robot system and a control method thereof. The surgical robot system includes: a first slave operation device including a first robotic arm, a second slave operation device including a second robotic arm, and a master operation device communicatively coupled to the first and second slave operation devices. The master operation device includes at least one first operation assembly configured to receive interactive operations from a user to control the first robotic arm or the second robotic arm. A respective first operation assembly is operable in a first operation mode and a second operation mode, in the first operation mode, the respective first operation assembly is configured to control operation of the first robotic arm, and in the second operation mode, the respective first operation assembly is configured to control operation of the second robotic arm.

title: Method and system for estimating a relative phase difference between light beams
abstract: A method and system are disclosed for estimating a relative phase difference between light beams guided through a shared optical path. The light beams have different wavelengths. One or more measurements are performed to measure a value indicative of the physical pathlength variation. The relative phase difference between the light beams at a predetermined location of the optical path is determined based on the value. The optical path delay and/or roundtrip time of the optical path is measured to determine the value. One or more other light beams, each having a different wavelength, is used to determine a value indicative of the physical pathlength variation based on a relative phase difference through the optical path between the other light beams or between one of the light beams and the other light beam.
assignee: Nederlandse Organisatie Voor Toegepast-Natuurwetenschappelijk Onderzoek Tno; Technische Universiteit Delft

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor configured to capture images or video of gestures and objects associated with a user and to analyze the captured data using an image recognition unit to identify at least one object and one user action. The processor accesses a language database to retrieve candidate words or phrases related to the identified object and action and presents the candidate words or phrases to the user. Upon selection of a word or phrase, the processor generates a visual communication medium based on the selected word or phrase. The processor further updates at least one of the language database and an algorithm associated with the image recognition or candidate presentation based on user selection history and feedback to improve system accuracy.

title: Dynamic information virtualization
abstract: A system and method for providing dynamic information virtualization (DIV) is disclosed. According to one embodiment, a device includes a dynamic optimization manager (DOM), a process and memory manager (PMM), a memory, and a host device driver. The device starts virtual functions after booting to allow a virtual machine (VM) running a guest operating system to identify the virtual functions and load virtual drivers of the virtual functions. The PMM allocates a unified cache from the memory to facilitate coherent access to information from storage and network resources by the VM. The host device driver enables a guess process in the VM to access the information stored in the unified cache in a secure and isolated manner.

title: Differential device for vehicle
abstract: A differential device includes a planetary gear mechanism including plural planetary gears and a carrier, and a differential gear mechanism including a pair of side gears and plural pinion gear sets. In each planetary gear, a one-side supported part and an another-side supported part are supported by the carrier. In each pinion gear set, a first pinion gear that engages with one side gear and a second pinion gear that engages with the another side gear are engaged in a holding hole of the carrier.
