The carrier includes a carrier main body in which the holding holes are formed, and a carrier lid body that closes one end in an axial direction of the holding holes. The carrier main body includes plural one-side support parts that support the one-side supported parts of the planetary gears, and plural another-side support parts that support the another-side supported parts.

title: Weak Pull-Up Circuits And Methods Having Leakage Current Compensation
abstract: An integrated circuit includes an output driver circuit coupled to a pad of the integrated circuit. The integrated circuit also includes a weak pull-up circuit coupled to the pad. The weak pull-up circuit includes a resistor and a leakage current sensing circuit coupled to the resistor. The leakage current sensing circuit generates a compensation current in the resistor that compensates for a leakage current through the output driver circuit when the output driver circuit is disabled.

title: Method and apparatus for use in managing handover of a relay user equipment
abstract: A method for use in managing handover of a relay user equipment, UE, from a source base station to a target base station, the relay UE serving one or more remote UEs via one or more sidelink connections, is disclosed. The method at the source base station comprises sending, to the target base station, a handover request for the relay UE and sending, to the target base station, remote UE information associated with all or some of the one or more remote UEs served by the relay UE. The remote UE information may be sent as part of managing handover of the relay UE. In an example, the remote UE information is associated with the remote UEs which would remain connected to the relay UE after handover for the relay UE is completed. Methods at the target base station and relay UE and apparatus are also disclosed.

title: Deploying autonomous software agents and retrieving secrets as part of executing a software task
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems, methods, and non-transitory computer-readable media that deploys an autonomous software agent and determines an activation trigger that indicates an access credential as part of completing a software task. In particular, the disclosed systems receive a prompt to execute a software task and determine (e.g., via an autonomous software agent) an activation trigger that indicates an access credential is required as part of completing the software task. Moreover, the disclosed systems make a call for a token corresponding to the access credential based on the activation trigger. Furthermore, the disclosed systems receive the token in an independent virtual machine computing environment and use the token to complete the software task.

title: Audio signal coding method and apparatus, and audio signal decoding method and apparatus
abstract: An audio signal encoding method and apparatus, and an audio signal decoding method and apparatus. The audio signal encoding method includes: acquiring a high-frequency residual signal and a low-frequency residual signal of a target audio frame; suppressing a frequency component in the low-frequency residual signal within a target frequency range to acquire an encoded suppression signal, where a center frequency of the target frequency range is a fundamental-tone frequency of the low-frequency residual signal; performing spectrum inversion on the encoded suppression signal to acquire a spectrum inversion signal; acquiring a high-frequency energy gain of the target audio signal according to the spectrum inversion signal and the high-frequency residual signal; and generating encoded data of the target audio frame according to the high-frequency energy gain.

title: Methods, system and electronic device for neural data compression, decompression, transmission and reception
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of neural data processing, and in particular to methods, a system and an electronic device for neural data compression, decompression, transmission and reception. The neural data compression method includes: preprocessing neural data to achieve code distribution centered around zero; using an autoregressive model to reshape the code distribution of the neural data; and performing entropy coding on the reshaped neural data to obtain compressed data. Through the compression method provided by the present disclosure, data transmission efficiency is enhanced: the preprocessing and the entropy coding can significantly lower storage space and transmission bandwidth requirements for the data. It is particularly important for a neural interface device that produces a large amount of data, and significant advantages exist in both local storage and transmission to a host through a network.
assignee: Fasikl Incorporated; Hangzhou Fasikl Technology Co.,Ltd

title: Methods and systems for additive manufacturing
abstract: Provided herein are methods, systems, and devices for additive manufacturing. Also provided herein are builds produced by the methods, systems, and devices described herein, including builds that are suitable for use in high-temperature, hydrogen environments. An additive manufacturing system for layer-by-layer manufacturing of a three-dimensional build comprises: a build platform holding a build under construction: a deposition head comprising a primary nozzle for directing a particle stream at the build under construction; a directed energy source for melting the particle stream, thereby forming a melt pool; an auxiliary powder nozzle arranged to direct an additive powder stream at the melt pool; and one or more magnets arranged to apply a magnetic field within the melt pool.

title: Computational medical guidelines and connected knowledge graph for llm query, value set request and code generation
abstract: A computational platform includes a clinical knowledge graph having medical condition nodes to which are linked factor nodes and investigation nodes. Medical guideline nodes linked to a medical condition represent a computational guideline. Observation nodes and laboratory test nodes within the guideline link to factor nodes or investigation nodes. Therapy ingredient nodes represent drugs with a guideline. A patient is diagnosed or treated by traversing the guideline nodes associated with a particular condition. Probabilities annotated upon edges facilitate predicting a future patient state. Use cases include queries from a clinician, an insurance claims database, or an LLM, generation of FHIR value sets, and generation of executable CQL for a medical guideline. The knowledge graph receives a medical query, executes it and outputs a result. A medical condition ontology with factors and investigations connects to an ontology representing a computational medical guideline. Elemental therapeutic intervention nodes represent drug or nondrug therapies.

title: Media and methods for differentiating t cells from hematopoietic stem cells
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure include compositions and methods related to differentiate and engineer hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs or HSCs) to mature T cells (Diff-T cells) for off-the-shelf use for clinical therapy. Embodiments of the media are serum-free, and/or the culture methods are feeder-free. The Diff-T cell products can be conventional aP T cells, yS T cells, and unconventional T cells such as invariant natural killer T (iNKT) cells, non-invariant nature killer T (NKT) cells, mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells, and others. The Diff-T cell products can also be designed to be the CD8-positive or CD4-positive T cell subtypes, and the CD4-positive Diff-T cells can be further designed to be various TH-polarized subtypes.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and non-transitory computer readable medium
abstract: An information processing apparatus includes processing circuitry configured to acquire a plurality of pieces of sample information for a plurality of samples where the sample information of a first sample among the plurality of samples includes first information, second information and third information. The first information is a measurement value of an expression level of a biomarker, the second information indicates a batch of samples measured under same or similar measurement conditions, and the third information indicates a state of a provider of the sample. The sample information of a second sample includes the first information and is missing at least one of the second information and the third information. The processing circuitry estimates the second information and the third information missing for the second sample. The processing circuitry calculates a batch dependent amount by which the expression level of the biomarker depends on the batch.

title: Medical device
abstract: A medical device includes a distal tip, an outer layer coil, and a coating. The outer layer coil is connected to the distal tip. The coating covers an outer peripheral surface of the distal tip and an outer peripheral surface of the outer layer coil in a region from a distal end of the distal tip to a predetermined axial position. The axial position is located on a distal side relative to a proximal end of the outer layer coil.

title: Medical device that includes a refractory metal alloy
abstract: A medical device that is at least partially formed of a refractory metal alloy, and a method for inserting the medical device in a patient.

title: Probabilistic two-tier adaptive edge-to-cloud risk scoring system and method in high-frequency transaction ecosystems
abstract: The present invention relates to a probabilistic two-tier adaptive edge-to-cloud risk scoring system and method for high-frequency transaction ecosystems. The system comprises a transaction acquisition processor configured to receive distributed transaction data streams, a transaction normalization processor configured to generate normalized transaction evaluation frames, and a plurality of edge probabilistic inference processors configured to generate multidimensional transaction feature vectors and localized probabilistic risk values based on behavioral continuity analysis, temporal transaction characteristics, geographic transition patterns, device interaction continuity, and transaction sequence evaluation. A confidence evaluation processor generates confidence-weighted edge risk scores using probabilistic uncertainty measurements associated with transaction ambiguity conditions. A communication synchronization processor generates compressed probabilistic metadata packets for transmission toward a cloud coordination processor.
assignee: Navin Kumar CHHIBBER; Mayank Atreya; Deepak Singh; Nikita CHAWLA

title: Continuous winding assembly
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a continuous winding assembly applied to a stator, the stator including, for each pole of a rotor, a predetermined group of slots adjacent and provided at continuous positions to the poles of the rotor. The continuous winding assembly comprises a first winding portion that includes a plurality of windings extending along a circumferential direction of the stator and arranged in parallel with each other, each of which is wound by being inserted one by one into the slots included in a slot group; and a second winding portion that is electrically connected to the first winding portion, and includes the plurality of windings extending along the circumferential direction of the stator and arranged in parallel with each other, each of which is wound by being inserted one by one into the slots included in the slot group.

title: Miniature retractable undercarriage
abstract: This application relates to the field of model aircraft technology, and in particular to a miniature retractable undercarriage. The miniature retractable undercarriage comprising: a fixed frame body, in the fixed frame body, a drive assembly accommodating cavity and a control assembly accommodating cavity are provided transversely in sequence; a control assembly including a rotating member rotatably disposed within the control assembly accommodating cavity, and a control member sleeved around the outer periphery of the rotating member, wherein the control member is connected to the rotating member via a screw pair; an undercarriage, whose control end being rotatably connected to the control assembly accommodating cavity, wherein the tip of the control end of the undercarriage features a guide slot that cooperates with the control member sliding on the rotating member, thereby driving the undercarriage to rotate about the control end; a drive assembly configured within the drive assembly accommodating cavity and fixedly connected to the rotating member. Under this structure, the fixed frame body of the present application can achieve an ultra-thin design (7.7 mm in thickness), making it suitable for model aircraft weighing less than 400 g.
assignee: Kunshan Helang Aviation Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Process for vaterite production via the carbonation of lime, and hydrated lime and alkaline ca-containing precursors
abstract: The present invention provides tri-phasic methods of preparing a vaterite composition from a calcium source, such as calcium hydroxide, and carbon dioxide. The methods advantageously produce a calcium carbonate with high conversion and selectivity for the vaterite polymorph. The present invention further provides vaterite compositions and systems for producing vaterite.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Roast fork assembly and barbecue apparatus
abstract: A roast fork assembly includes a pivot portion and a roast fork portion. The pivot portion is movably connected to the roast fork portion, and the roast fork portion is capable of swinging and being fixed relative to the pivot portion. The roast fork portion includes two roast forks and a rotation rod, and each roast fork is sleeved at the rotation rod and provided opposite to each other.
assignee: Dongguan Haohong Outdoor Products Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Semiconductor memory device
abstract: According to an embodiment, a semiconductor memory device includes a memory cell array including a memory cell, a word line coupled to the memory cell, a row decoder to which the word line is coupled, a first interconnect coupled to the row decoder, a voltage generator configured to execute charge and discharge of the word line via the first interconnect and the row decoder, a detection circuit included in the voltage generator and configured to output a first signal based on the discharge of the word line, and a determination circuit configured to determine whether the word line is nondefective or defective, based on the first signal.

title: Communication Device, Network Node and Methods for Handling Connectivity
abstract: A communication device ( 200 ,  330 ) and method therein for handling connectivity to a network node ( 311 ) in a wireless communication network ( 300 ) are provided The communication device ( 200 ,  330 ) is configured to communicate with the network node  5  ( 311 ) on a control link and a backhaul link, wherein the control link is established between a first module (NCR-MT) of the communication device ( 200 ,  330 ) and the network node ( 311 ), the backhaul link is established between a second module (NCR-Fwd) of the communication device ( 200 ,  330 ) and the network node ( 311 ). The communication device ( 200 ,  330 ) performs beam monitoring on both the control link and backhaul link; 10 determines whether a beam failure has been detected and a type of the beam failure; and initiates a recovery procedure to the network node ( 311 ) based on the type of the beam failure. Publ.

title: Display device, method of manufacturing the same, and electronic device including the same
abstract: A display device is provided. The display device includes: a transistor array substrate display and non-display areas; a pixel electrode in an emission area on the transistor array substrate, wherein the pixel electrode includes: a first layer connected to a pixel circuit and including a first conductive material; a second layer on the first layer and including a second conductive material; a third layer on the second layer, wherein the third layer includes a third conductive material, wherein the third layer is on an upper surface of an edge portion of the second layer, and wherein an opening that exposes an upper surface of a central portion of the second layer is defined in the third layer; and a fourth layer on the second layer and the third layer and including a fourth conductive material; an emission layer on the pixel electrode; and a common electrode on the emission layer.

title: System and method for controlling an electrical receptacle
abstract: An electrical receptacle including an outlet and a testing circuit. The outlet is configured to connect to an external load. The outlet includes a phase line and a neutral line. The testing circuit is configured to output a direct-current (DC) signal to a phase line of the outlet, receive a response signal from a neutral line of the outlet, and determine when the external load is electrically connected to the outlet based on the response signal.

title: Signaling of inter layer prediction in video bitstream
abstract: An example method of video decoding includes receiving a scalable bitstream including a first layer and determining whether the first layer is a dependent layer of the scalable bitstream based at least in part on a syntax element from the scalable bitstream. When the first layer is the dependent layer, a picture in the dependent layer is decoded based on an inter-layer reference picture (ILRP) list, wherein a size of the ILRP corresponds to a number of direct reference layers indicated in the scalable bitstream. When the first layer is not the dependent layer, the picture in the first layer is decoded without using the ILRP list.

title: Interrupt cognizant rf tuning
abstract: The disclosed technology relates to determining a period in which a non-urgent RRM update should be deferred. The method may comprise applying a first update to an existing configuration of the plurality of wireless access points in the network based on an analysis of telemetry received from the plurality of wireless access points received over a period spanning at least two busy periods. The method may further comprise applying a second update that modifies the first preferred network configuration based on an analysis of telemetry received during the first busy period. The method may further comprise applying a maintenance update to the tweaked network configuration based on telemetry received during the next busy period.

title: Hardware-attested trade integrity system for prediction markets
abstract: Conventional prediction-market surveillance and contract resolution rely on software-only systems that operators can modify and that regulators cannot independently verify. The disclosed platform addresses this through three combined mechanisms: hardware-attested surveillance, deterministic regulator re-execution, and a hardware-attested resolution oracle. Order-flow and account-metadata records are ingested over encrypted channels terminating inside a hardware trusted execution environment. Surveillance classifications are cryptographically bound in hardware-attestation quotes tying together code measurement, input commitment, parameter commitment, and output. A tamper-evident Merkle-accumulator audit ledger anchors its root to a publicly verifiable data registry. A resolution oracle operating in its own TEE produces hardware-attested settlement finality without an optimistic-oracle dispute window. A regulator may instantiate an independent TEE, load the same certified code, verify the input commitments, re-execute the surveillance computation, and obtain bit-identical confirmation; divergence is recorded under attestation.

title: Chat-based querying of multiple data sources using a multi-agent infrastructure
abstract: Systems and methods for implementing chat-based querying of multiple data sources using a multi-agent infrastructure are provided. In an example method, a computing system receives, from a client device, a query. The computing system determines, using an orchestrator agent, one or more relevant contexts based on the query, in which the orchestrator agent includes a large language model (“LLM”). The computing system receives, from a storage system, context information based on the one or more relevant contexts. The computing system provides, to the orchestrator agent, a modified query based on the query and the context information, in which the modified query includes one or more reasoning parts and one or more acting parts. The computing system receives, from the orchestrator agent, a response to the modified query. The computing system outputs the response to the client device.

title: Liquid contaminant absorption device and methods of use
abstract: Devices and methods are provided for absorbing liquid contaminants from aqueous liquids. In certain embodiments, the device comprises a fiber structure including mammalian hair and at least one naturally occurring buoyant fiber. The mammalian hair functions as an absorbent component for attracting and retaining oil, while the buoyant fiber provides flotation that maintains the absorbent structure at or near an oil-water interface. In some embodiments, the device comprises a unitary nonwoven fiber mat including a central absorbent region comprising mammalian hair and a perimeter buoyancy region comprising naturally occurring buoyant fibers such as kapok fiber, milkweed fiber, cork fiber, or combinations thereof. The buoyant fibers may be concentrated in the perimeter region to form a flotation structure that supports the absorbent region at the oil-water interface during use.

title: Systems and methods for urban underground space emergency warning based on internet of things (iot) large models
abstract: A system and a method for urban underground space emergency warning based on an IoT large model are provided. The system includes an emergency supervision management platform configured to: determine a maximum drainage flow rate based on a working parameter of a current drainage device; determine a first water level height and a first water level change of a first drainage structure; obtain a passenger density and passenger flow information of each sub-region in an underground space; based on the first water level change and the maximum drainage flow rate, predict a water accumulation probability of each sub-region; determining a control time interval when the water accumulation probability of at least one sub-region exceeds a probability threshold; adjusting an entrance gate of the underground space to a prohibited entry state at a control time point; and controlling the drainage device to perform drainage at a maximum power.
assignee: Chengdu Qinchuan Iot Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Threshold voltage tracking techniques for memory devices
abstract: A memory apparatus includes memory cells each connected to one of a plurality of word lines and disposed in memory holes and configured to retain a threshold voltage corresponding to data states. A control means is configured to detect a valley point between distributions of the threshold voltage of two of the data states for a group of the memory cells in a threshold voltage tracking operation. The control means is also configured to determine whether the valley point is between a first identified one of the data states and a second identified one of the data states or between the second identified one of the data states and a third identified one of the data states and set an optimal read level for one of the data states based on a count of the memory cells associated with the valley point.

title: Cell phone loss/theft prevention device attached via a cut-resistant dispensable/retractable steel line
abstract:
A universal cell phone tether that protects a cell phone from theft/loss while permitting easy access to the cell phone. The universal cell phone tether works with all cell phones and all cell phone cases, and is particularly useful at crowded events, like concerts. 
     Included is an anchor element configured to be captured between a cell phone case and a cell phone contained in the cell phone case, while a connection tab extends out from the charger opening of the cell phone case. A spring-loaded line dispenser/retractor enclosed within a dispenser/retractor casing dispenses and retracts a cut-resistant line. The cut-resistant line is terminated by a connection element that engages with the connection tab of the anchor element, the casing also having a second connection tab configured to receive a link element for attachment to a belt loop, a belt, or other robust part of a person's clothing or personal effects.

title: Anti-skimming devices
abstract: Embodiments provide a method, apparatus, and system for preventing the attachment of a skimming device to a point-of-sale PIN pad without evident and readily detectable tampering. A system is provided including: a POS (point-of-sale) terminal comprising a PIN (Personal Identification Number) pad; a POS terminal stand, wherein the POS terminal is pivotably attached to the POS terminal stand with a first fastener and a second fastener; a first member, the first member defining a first top extension and a first mid extension, wherein the first member is attached to the POS terminal with the first fastener, and the POS terminal is received between the first top extension and the first mid extension; a second member, the second member defining a second top extension and a second mid extension, wherein the second member is attached to the POS terminal with the second fastener, and the POS terminal is received between the second top extension and the second mid extension.

title: Wi-fi signal-based copresence estimation method and device
abstract: An embodiment may provide a method including: obtaining a first Wi-Fi RSSI corresponding to Wi-Fi networks communicable with the user device; obtaining second Wi-Fi RSSIs corresponding to Wi-Fi networks communicable with other devices; estimating, by applying the first Wi-Fi RSSI and the second Wi-Fi RSSIs as input data to a copresence estimation model, an estimation result indicating whether the other devices are present in a same space as the user device; receiving feedback based on the estimation result; generating, based on the feedback, a feedback dataset including the first and second Wi-Fi RSSIs; obtaining a pre-collected first Wi-Fi RSSI corresponding to the Wi-Fi networks communicable with the user device; obtaining pre-collected second Wi-Fi RSSIs corresponding to the Wi-Fi networks communicable with the other devices; generating, by filtering the pre-collected first and second Wi-Fi RSSIs, a filtered dataset; and updating, based on the feedback and filtered datasets, the copresence estimation model.

title: Silicone-free shampoo composition
abstract: A shampoo composition comprises a surfactant system comprising an anionic surfactant; a conditioning agent comprising a botanical oil; about 0.5 wt. % to about 3 wt. % of an associative thickener; and a liquid carrier. The associative thickener can be a hydrophobically modified polyether. The composition can be substantially silicone-free.

title: Channel transmission method and device, and storage medium
abstract: A channel transmission method is executed by a terminal, and includes: receiving resource set indication information sent by a base station; wherein the resource set indication information indicates a resource set of a physical uplink control channel (PUCCH); determining, in response to determining that the PUCCH needs to be transmitted over a plurality of time units and the plurality of time units correspond to at least two time unit types, at least one first time unit for transmitting the PUCCH among the plurality of time units; determining, based on the resource set and a time unit type of the at least one first time unit, resources occupied when transmitting the PUCCH in each first time unit; and sending the PUCCH to the base station on the resource of each first time unit.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Battery Module
abstract: A battery module is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, the battery module includes: a plurality of battery cell assemblies sequentially arranged in a transverse direction; and a module case including a bottom module case that accommodates the plurality of battery cell assemblies and is positioned below the plurality of battery cell assemblies, wherein each of the plurality of battery cell assemblies includes: a housing defining a hollow portion open in a longitudinal direction; and a battery cell including a cell body accommodated in the housing and electrode leads protruding from the cell body in the longitudinal direction.

title: Spad array lidar, vehicle including the same and method of controlling spad array lidar
abstract: Provided are a SPAD array LiDAR capable of implementing various vertical angular resolutions by a combination of a SPAD array and a vertical scanner, and a vehicle including the same. A SPAD array LiDAR according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes: an optical output unit outputting laser light to recognize a measurement target object; an optical sensor including a Single Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) array sensing reflected light of the laser light reflected from the measurement target object; and a scanner scanning the laser light and the reflected light. The scanner includes a horizontal scanner scanning the laser light and the reflected light in a horizontal scanning direction; and a vertical scanner scanning the laser light and the reflected light in a vertical scanning direction. The SPAD array includes optical pixels arranged in a plurality of pixel rows and a plurality of pixel columns along the horizontal scanning direction and the vertical scanning direction. The optical pixels are grouped into N pixel lines along the vertical scanning direction, where N is an integer of 2 or more. N, which is the number of the pixel lines, is dynamically set according to LiDAR specifications.

title: Method of producing bio-derived ester compound, bio-derived ester compound produced thereby, cosmetic or detergent containing bio-derived ester compound, and method of reducing odor of ester compound
abstract: The present invention provides a method of producing a bio-derived ester compound with reduced odor, a bio-derived ester compound produced by the production method, a cosmetic or a detergent including the ester compound, and a method of reducing an odor of an ester compound.

title: Diagnostic system for determining a clinically relevant severity of a sleep-related breathing disturbance from a patient signal by weighting respiratory events with respiratory events that are close in time
abstract: The present invention relates to a diagnostic system for determining a clinically relevant severity of a sleep-related breathing disturbance from a patient signal of a sleeping patient, comprising: a sensor unit which captures a patient parameter and generates a patient signal; a first detector unit which detects respiratory events in the patient signal and generates a corresponding respiratory event signal therefrom; and a second detector unit which comprises the following: a weighting determination unit which detects, in the respiratory event signal at a particular respiratory event within a time window in which the respiratory event takes place, respiratory events that are close in time and, depending on a number and/or energy of the particular respiratory events that are close in time, generates a weighting signal; a weighting unit which weights the respiratory event signal with a weighting signal; and a severity determining unit which determines the clinically relevant severity from an integral via the weighted respiratory event signal.

title: Interface Processing Method and Electronic Device
abstract: An interface processing method is applied to the electronic device, and a first application and a second application are installed in the electronic device. The method includes: The electronic device runs the first application, and when a user interface of the electronic device displays a first window picture of the first application, receives a first operation of a user for starting the second application; and when a first attribute is set in the first application, in a process of starting and running the second application in response to the first operation, the electronic device successively displays a starting window and a second window picture of the second application in the user interface, where the starting window is an intermediate interface for starting the second application, and the first attribute is used to indicate not to display the starting window.

title: Method and apparatus for producing fluff-free absorbent cores
abstract: A method and apparatus for producing fluff-free absorbent cores for absorbent sanitary articles, wherein loose unbound fibers and superabsorbent granular material dispersed in the loose unbound fibers are deposited on a movable surface and subsequently the fibers are mixed and bound together in such a way as to form an absorbent structure of bound fibers in which superabsorbent granular material is mixed and incorporated.

title: Encoding and decoding method and apparatus, and device thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a decoding method and apparatus, and a device thereof. The decoding method includes: decoding a bit stream corresponding to a current image block to obtain a reconstructed image block, where the reconstructed image block includes a first initial component and a second initial component, where the resolution of the first initial component is greater than or equal to the resolution of the second initial component; generating an adjusted component corresponding to the second initial component based on the first initial component and the second initial component; performing feature enhancement on the adjusted component to obtain a restored target component corresponding to the second initial component. By the technical solution of the present disclosure, decoding performance can be improved, and decoding complexity can be reduced.
assignee: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Anti-fogging device for endoscope
abstract: A method for defogging an endoscope is provided. With the endoscope positioned outside of a body cavity, the distal window of the endoscope is heated with light from at least one light source connected to the endoscope until the distal window reaches a predetermined temperature. Upon the distal window reaching the predetermined temperature, the endoscope is inserted into a surgical cavity and the endoscope and the at least one light source are used to image within the surgical cavity.

title: Accessory for barbecue grill with built-in gripper for fat cleaning
abstract:
The present invention provides an accessory for a barbecue grill, comprising:
         A tray configured to collect grease and fat drippings, designed to be removably incorporated with barbecue grill, the tray defining a longitudinal axis and having at least one waste-discharge opening;   At least one movable gripper disposed within the tray, and configured to travel along the longitudinal axis of the tray;   at least handle mechanically coupled to the gripper and extending outside the tray, wherein manual actuation of the handle causes the gripper to move along the tray and urge accumulated grease toward the waste-discharge opening.

title: Air outlet assembly of air conditioner, main body of air conditioner, and vehicle
abstract: An air outlet assembly includes a mounting member provided with a first connection member configured to be connected to a vehicle, an air outlet panel located below the mounting member and provided with a second connection member connected to the mounting member, an air inlet channel communicating the mounting member with the air outlet panel, and an air outlet channel spaced apart from the air inlet channel in a front-rear direction of the air outlet assembly and communicating the mounting member with the air outlet panel. One end of the air inlet channel has an air inlet formed at the air outlet panel, and one end of the air outlet channel has an air outlet formed at the air outlet panel.
assignee: Wuhu Maty Air-Conditioning Equipment Co., Ltd.; Gd Midea Air-Conditioning Equipment Co., Ltd.

title: An oil composition and a spread comprising the same
abstract: An oil composition comprises liquid oil and from 3 wt. % to 40 wt. % of mono- and di-glycerides, based upon total weight of the oil composition. A spread comprises at least one food ingredient and the oil composition and a method for producing the spread. The use of oil composition for reducing the content of saturated fatty acid moieties in a spread comprising the oil composition.

title: Merged cavities and buried etch stops for three-dimensional memory arrays
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for merged cavities and buried etch stops for three-dimensional memory arrays are described. For example, a row of cavities may be formed using a cavity etching process and material separating cavities of the row may be removed to merge the row of cavities to form a trench. In some cases, a trench may be formed from multiple rows of cavities. Additionally, or alternatively, a trench may be formed from a pattern of cavities that includes different quantities of rows at different locations along the trench. In some examples, etch stopping material portions (e.g., etch stops) may be formed at locations corresponding to cavities prior to the cavity etching process. For example, exposed material surfaces at locations corresponding to cavities or trenches may be oxidized to form etch stops.

title: Battery and electric device
abstract: A battery comprises a box body, insulating members, and at least one battery cell. The box body comprises first side beams and second side beams. The first side beams and the second side beams are connected and define an accommodating space. The at least one battery cell is located in the accommodating space battery cells adjacent to the first side beams are first battery cells, the maximum area surface of each first battery cell is a first surface, and the first surface of the first battery cell faces the corresponding first side beam. The insulating members are located in the accommodating space. Each insulating member is provided between the first battery cells and the corresponding first side beam, so that when the first side beam is impacted, the first surfaces of the first battery cells bear impact, reducing the impact deformation of the first battery cells.

title: Treatment of pancreatic cancer
abstract: The present invention relates to ultrasound mediated delivery of therapeutic agents to the pancreas, and particularly for treatment of pancreatic cancer such as pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). More particularly, the invention provides a cluster composition and a pharmaceutical composition, for use in delivery of therapeutic agents and for treatment of pancreatic cancers, including PDAC.

title: Inflatable pillow with warming/cooling pad pockets
abstract: The inventive subject matter is directed to inflatable pillows that are useful in the context of non-pharmaceutical therapies. Pillows of the inventive subject matter comprise a hexagonal top surface, a hexagonal bottom surface, and one or more pockets that allow users to place warming/cooling pads beneath the top surface of the pillow. In some embodiments, up to three pockets can be included, where each pocket is accessible along an edge of the top surface. When divided into third, each pocket can be accessible along an edge of the hexagonal outer edge of the top surface such that a user's neck can rest along that edge to improve contact with a warming/cooling pad. Embodiments include an air hub to facilitate inflation and deflation, and a stiff pillow base can be included as well.

title: Micromobility transit vehicle lock-to mechanism systems and methods
abstract: In one embodiment, a micromobility transit vehicle includes a frame, a first wheel and a second wheel each rotatably coupled to the frame, a propulsion system configured to drive rotation of at least one of the first wheel or the second wheel, a wireless communications module configured to communicate with a management system, an immobilization lock associated with the first wheel and configured to selectively transition between an unlocked state and a locked state, and a controller. The controller is configured to receive, via the wireless communications module, ride-status information associated with the micromobility transit vehicle, determine, based at least in part on the ride-status information, that a ride associated with the micromobility transit vehicle has ended, and activate the immobilization lock to transition the immobilization lock from the unlocked state to the locked state responsive to determining that the ride has ended.

title: Video streaming
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for compressed-domain compositing of video streams. A server obtains compressed video streams, each compressed video stream including multiple frames, each frame including a video content region that is a portion of the frame, encoded using a segment identifier for pixels included in the video content region, and encoded using a set of static symbol frequencies. The server receives, from a user device, a request for video stream content, and composites a first and a second compressed video stream to obtain a compressed-domain composite video stream including a first video content region of the first compressed video stream and a second video content region of the second compressed video stream, and provides, to the user device, a packet including a set of frames of the compressed-domain composite video stream decodable by a single decoder.

title: Electromagnetic shielding module and photoelectric device
abstract: An electromagnetic shielding module includes a cover and a frame. The cover has a first side wall and a first snap structure. The first snap structure is arranged on the first side wall, and the first snap structure has a first slot and a first elastic arm. The frame has a second side wall and a second snap structure. The second snap structure is arranged on the second side wall. When the cover and the frame are combined, the first elastic arm and the second elastic arm overlap and engage with each other. A photoelectric device is further provided.

title: Vehicle control device, vehicle control method, and storage medium
abstract: A vehicle control device executes a lateral position control to control. In the lateral position control a lateral position of a vehicle in a travel area is controlled to maintain a predetermined target lateral position. An electronic control device of the vehicle control device controls, in the lateral position control, a controlled variable that is able to control the lateral position of the vehicle so as to match a target controlled variable acquired so that the lateral position maintains the target lateral position, controls the target controlled variable to be smaller than when the vehicle is traveling on a motorway, when the vehicle is traveling on a local road other than the motorway, and executes the lateral position control even when the vehicle is traveling on the local road.

title: Conversation information processing method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a conversation information processing method, an electronic device and a storage medium. The method includes: determining whether a target conversation is over; inputting, in response to the target conversation being over, first prompt information and the target conversation into a conversation summarization model to obtain a plurality of candidate summary results, where the first prompt information includes a conversation summary outline; and determining a target summary result based on the plurality of candidate summary results and the target conversation.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.; Bytedance Technology Ltd.

title: Shipping container twist-lock system
abstract: A twist-lock system for locking a shipping container to a truck trailer or to a rail transport vehicle is disclosed. The twist lock system comprises a twist-lock ( 10 ) that is mountable to a truck trailer or rail transport vehicle and includes a rotatable locking element ( 60 ) linked to a driver ( 40 ) that causes the locking element ( 60 ) to rotate for locking and unlocking the twist-lock with a shipping container. The driver ( 40 ) is configured to operate upon receiving an input signal from a location remote from the twist-lock via a remote hand-held device ( 100 ). Also disclosed is a truck trailer including such twist-locks and a remotely actuated twist-lock system. A twist-lock for locking a first shipping container to a second shipping container is also disclosed.
assignee: Spring Loaded And Locked Pty Ltd

title: Two-phase flushing systems and methods
abstract: Two-phase flushing systems and methods. An example method includes moving a valve to a first position to fluidly connect a first reagent reservoir containing a first reagent to a flow cell and flowing the first reagent from the first reagent reservoir to the flow cell to perform a biochemical reaction. The method includes moving the valve to a second position to fluidly connect a gas to the flow cell and flowing gas into the flow cell to expel at least a portion of the first reagent from the biochemical reaction from the flow cell. The method includes moving the valve to a third position to fluidly connect a buffer reagent reservoir containing a buffer reagent to the flow cell and flowing the buffer reagent into the flow cell.

title: System and method for training teacher model based on structure of student model
abstract: A computer-implemented method of training a teacher model and a student model includes dividing the teacher model into a series of teacher blocks each comprising at least one layer; generating a first student branch receiving a first feature output from a first teacher block among the series of teacher blocks; training the teacher model based on outputs of the teacher model and the first student branch; and training the student model comprising a series of student blocks based on the trained teacher model, wherein the first student branch includes at least one student block.

title: Systems and methods for spatial processing of lidar data
abstract: A method for operating a lidar system. The method includes processing raw data from the lidar system using a fixed superpixel size to obtain a range and a signal intensity for each superpixel, and reprocessing the raw data using a variable superpixel size based on at least one of range correlations or intensity correlations with neighboring pixels.

title: Semiconductor device manufacturing method and semiconductor device
abstract: According to one embodiment, a semiconductor device manufacturing method includes forming a stacked film with alternating first-type sacrificial layers and second-type sacrificial layers, then removing the first-type sacrificial layers from the stacked film to leave the second-type sacrificial layers with spaces therebetween. The second-type sacrificial layers are then each replaced with an insulating layer after removing the first-type sacrificial layers. After the second-type sacrificial layers are replaced with the insulating layer, a conductive layer is formed inside the spaces formed by removing the first-type sacrificial layers.

title: Oral Formulations of Kava and Nicotine
abstract: Disclosed herein are oral formulations comprising a nicotine composition and/or a kava composition. The oral formulations comprising a nicotine composition and/or a kava composition disclosed herein may be formulated as a chewable tablet, a lozenge, a chewing gum, a dissolvable oral strip, or a pouch. Also disclosed herein are methods for making a chewable tablet, a lozenge, a chewing gum, a dissolvable oral strip, or a pouch comprising a nicotine composition and/or a kava composition.

title: Batch processing apparatus, systems, and related methods and structures for epitaxial deposition operations
abstract: The present disclosure relates to batch processing apparatus, systems, and related methods and structures for epitaxial deposition operations. In one implementation, an apparatus for substrate processing includes a chamber body. The chamber body includes a processing volume, a plurality of gas inject passages, and an exhaust port. The apparatus includes one or more upper heat sources positioned above the processing volume, one or more lower heat sources positioned below the processing volume, and a pedestal assembly positioned in the processing volume. The apparatus includes one or more side heat sources positioned outwardly of the processing volume and configured to heat the processing volume through a side of the processing volume. The chamber body can be a dual-chamber body that includes a second processing volume, and the one or more side heat sources can be positioned outwardly of one or more of the processing volume or the second processing volume.

title: Low-Friction Wear Surfaces for Sediment Filtration System Hydraulic Damper
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure are directed to hydraulic dampers. A hydraulic damper may include a hydraulic damper rod support having a low-friction wear surface between the hydraulic damper rod and an interior surface of the hydraulic damper housing and having a low-friction wear surface between the hydraulic damper rod and a hydraulic damper rod guide. In some examples, the hydraulic damper may be connected to a sediment filtration system, and the hydraulic damper rod may drive a cleaning armature of the sediment filtration system.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: A semiconductor device includes: a die pad; an adhesive member provided on the die pad and having conductivity; a semiconductor chip provided on the adhesive member; and an encapsulation member provided on the adhesive member and the semiconductor chip. The adhesive member has a central portion in contact with the semiconductor chip and a peripheral portion around the central portion. An upper surface of the peripheral portion has unevenness.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba; Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation

title: Scale-Up Memory Pooling for AI Accelerators, GPUs, and CPUs over CXL with Physical Address Translation
abstract: Enabling memory pooling and disaggregation across hosts, GPUs, and accelerators in scale-up AI fabrics, expanding usable memory capacity beyond the limits of a single server. Implementations incorporating a resource provisioning unit (RPU) coupled to a coherent interconnect of a processor, the coherent interconnect coupled to memory accessible utilizing a physical address space. An MMU maps virtual addresses utilized by an operating system to physical addresses within the physical address space. The RPU comprises a port configured to exchange messages with an entity based on CXL.mem. The RPU is configured to perform physical address translations from physical addresses carried by requests received via the port to physical addresses within the physical address space, whereby the entity is enabled to access the memory via the port. The embodiments may support memory-intensive AI, machine learning, large language model, database, and/or cloud workloads.

title: Method and apparatus for determining state of health of a battery
abstract: A method for determining a state of health (SOH) of a battery includes: updating, using a processing circuit, a full-charge-capacity (FCC) database based on charging data acquired during a charging process, wherein the FCC database is configured to record battery capacity estimation data corresponding to reference values for a plurality of detected quantities detected in the charging process; and if filling of the FCC database is determined to be completed through the updating, calculating the SOH of the battery based at least on the FCC database.

title: Travel-time constrained correction of high-resolution velocity models
abstract: A first velocity model of a subsurface region, having first velocity values, and having a first spatial resolution is used to generate a reference travel-time model of reference travel-time values. A second velocity model of the subsurface region, having second velocity values is received. The second velocity model has a second spatial resolution that is higher than the first spatial resolution. The second velocity model is corrected with a corrected term, and the corrected model is processed to generate a candidate travel-time model of candidate travel-time values. The correction term is updated to minimize a measure of difference between the reference travel-time values and the candidate travel-time values, to obtain an updated correction term. The updated correction term is added to the second velocity model to obtain an updated second velocity model of the subsurface region.

title: Chair assembly
abstract: A chair comprises a frame, a frame connecting member, a removable bar, and a removable seating canvas. The frame comprises a first rear frame member, the first rear frame member comprising a first receiving slot, and a second rear frame member comprising a second receiving slot. The frame further comprises a first seat member and a second seat member. The removable bar extends between the first side and the second side of the frame and is disposed within the first receiving slot and the second receiving slot. The removable seating canvas has at least one rear receiving sleeve configured to receive the removable bar, and a plurality of seat receiving sleeves configured to receive the first seat member and the second seat member. The removable seating canvas is removably attached to the frame.

title: Joint framework for object-centered shadow detection, removal, and synthesis
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems, methods, and non-transitory computer-readable media that detects shadows, removes shadows, and synthesizes shadows in a joint-framework. In particular, the disclosed systems access an object mask of an object and a digital image depicting the object and a shadow of the object. Furthermore, the disclosed systems perform object-centered shadow detection and removal to generate a modified digital image without the shadow by utilizing a shadow analyzer model. Moreover, the disclosed systems receive a user interaction to manipulate an object and generate a modified shadow utilizing a shadow synthesis model where the shadow synthesis model is conditioned on a shadow mask generated by the shadow analyzer model.

title: Method and apparatus of managing active period of cell dtx and cell drx for wireless communication system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method of performing operations for a User Equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system. In particular, the method includes the steps of: activating a cell Discontinuous Transmission (DTX), wherein monitoring a Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) is not required in a non-active period of the Cell DTX; performing a random access (RA) procedure during the non-active period of cell DTX; based on the RA procedure being completed during the non-active period of cell DTX, starting a temporary active period timer; and monitoring the PDCCH during the non-active period of cell DTX based on the temporary active period timer being running.

title: Robot teaching with scans in and out of robot workspace
abstract: A robot teaching system that uses 3D scanning, movable devices, and pose selecting devices, either in or outside the robot workspace, in order to create a robot instruction. The system may include a 3D scanning device, a user input device, and a computation device. The computation device executes instructions to cause the 3D scanning device to capture a 3D scan of a workpiece, record a spatial point, and determine best fit geometries.

title: Methods and apparatus for modulating light
abstract: A light modulating array includes a plurality of light modulating elements, where each light modulating element includes a plurality of electrical interconnects and a heater element coupled to the plurality of electrical interconnects and the heater element is configured to receive electrical energy via the plurality of electrical interconnects. Each light modulating element of the device further includes a phase change material implemented proximal to the heater element and an insulator encapsulating the heater element and the phase change material, where the phase change material is configured to exhibit a change in crystal state based on a thermal contribution from the heater element.

title: Heat pipe apparatuses
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure are directed to an apparatus and/or method involving an evaporator section to receive heat, a condenser section to dissipate heat, and a closed-loop fluid channel having a plurality of alternating wicking and evaporated fluid sections connected in series and passing through the evaporator section and the condenser section, to provide unidirectional fluid flow within the fluid channel. The wicking sections extend between the condenser section and the evaporator section. Each wicking section has a wicking component within the fluid channel to wick condensed fluid within the fluid channel from the condenser section to the evaporator section. The evaporated fluid sections extend between the evaporator section and the condenser section to pass evaporated fluid within the fluid channel from the evaporator section to the condenser section.

title: Systems and Methods for Intermittent Web Form Generation and Display on a User Interface
abstract: A method for progressing a state of case dataset. The method further includes generating the case dataset including the case data and the state in a first stage. The method further includes selecting a rule including a sampling ratio. The method further includes determining the sampling ratio of the rule is fulfilled to trigger a data verification process. The method further includes selecting a form template. The method further includes generating the form based on the form template and at least a portion of the case data. The method further includes receiving input data from the form. The method further includes modifying the state of the case dataset from the first stage to a second stage based on the input data.

title: Applicator for continuous blood glucose measurement device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a continuous blood glucose measurement device and an applicator, wherein the continuous blood glucose measurement device is produced in a state in which a body attachment unit has been assembled inside an applicator, so as to minimize a user's additional work of attaching the body attachment unit to the body, thereby enabling the body attachment unit to be attached to the body only by simply activating the applicator. Particularly, the present invention provides a continuous blood glucose measurement device and an applicator, wherein the continuous blood glucose measurement device: includes a wireless communication chip in a body attachment unit so as to enable communication with an external terminal, thereby enabling simple and convenient use thereof, without additional work for connecting a separate transmitter, and easier maintenance; and is activated by a user's operation after the body attachment unit is attached to the body, so as to enable the operation start time to be adjusted to an appropriate time according to user's needs, and to enable the operation to start in a stabilized state so that blood glucose can be measured more accurately.

title: Interaction control display method and apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract: This application provides an interaction control display method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The method includes: receiving a first operation on any display object in a first interface, where the first interface is an interface corresponding to a first application running in a foreground; performing the first operation, and generating, by using a second application, at least one interaction control corresponding to the display object; and displaying the at least one interaction control on a second interface, where the second interface is an interface that is the same as or different from the first interface. Interaction controls in embodiments of this application are not fixed, and an interaction control that matches a display object operated by a user may be generated based on the display object operated by the user, so that a personalized interaction control can be generated based on the operated display object.

title: Steering Operation Input Device and Steer-By-Wire Type Steering Device
abstract: Steering operation input device includes a first shaft ( 19 ), a second shaft ( 20 ), a coupling member ( 13 ) provided between the first and second shafts ( 19, 20 ), a first torsion spring ( 16 ) provided at the first shaft ( 19 ) and connected to the coupling member ( 13 ), and a second torsion spring ( 17 ) provided at the second shaft ( 20 ). The second torsion spring ( 17 ) has the same spring constant as that of the first torsion spring ( 16 ). A pre-load is applied to the second torsion spring ( 17 ). Until the first shaft ( 19 ) is twisted by 60 degrees in a predetermined rotation direction, an urging force of the first torsion spring ( 16 ) acts on the first shaft ( 19 ). After the first shaft ( 19 ) is twisted by 60 degrees in the predetermined rotation direction, an urging force of the first torsion spring ( 16 ) and the second torsion spring ( 17 ) acts on the first shaft ( 19 ).

title: Door, compartment, method for manufacturing a door, and method for manufacturing slats of a door
abstract: A door configured to be slidably attached to a body to slidably open and close an opening of the body, as well as an associated compartment and methods for manufacture, are disclosed. The door includes a plurality of slats and a flexible connecting layer, the slats being fixedly attached to a first side of the connecting layer which faces an interior of the body. The door includes a flexible outer layer attached to a second side of the connecting layer which faces an exterior of the body. The door includes at least one guide element which is connected to one of the slats and is arranged on a side of the slat(s) which faces the interior of the body. The guide element is configured to cooperate with a counter guide element of the body to guide the door, when the door is slidably opened and/or closed.

title: Memory system
abstract: A memory controller stores first write data in a first memory in response to a first write command from a host. The memory controller transmits a completion response to the first write command to the host in response to storing the first write data in the first memory, if a first size, which is a total size of all sizes of the write data set in a first state stored in the first memory and a size of the first write data, is less than a first threshold value. If the first size is greater than the first threshold value, the memory controller transmits a completion response to the host as the first size is less than the first threshold value.

title: Method of treatment of a neuronal pathology related to hypoxia, hypoglycemia and/or hyperglycemia
abstract: A method of treatment of a neuronal pathology related to hypoxia, hypoglycemia and/or hyperglycemia affecting cells of the central nervous system.

title: Exhaust gas treatment apparatus and exhaust gas treatment method
abstract: The application relates to an exhaust gas treatment apparatus and an exhaust gas treatment method for treating an exhaust gas discharged from a manufacturing apparatus or the like for manufacturing semiconductor devices, liquid crystals, LEDs, or the like, to make the exhaust gas harmless. The exhaust gas treatment apparatus for treating the exhaust gas, includes: a heat generating section including a heat generator-configured to generate heat; and a heat treatment section coupled to the heat generating section and configured to perform heat treatment on the exhaust gas with the heat. The heat treatment section includes: a cylindrical body that forms a flow passage for the exhaust gas; and a water supply structure configured to supply water in the cylindrical body to form a water film on an inner surface of the cylindrical body, and the cylindrical body has a diameter-increasing portion where a diameter of the cylindrical body increases.

title: Aerosol-generating device with sliding contacts for multiple induction coils
abstract: An aerosol-generating device is provided, including: at least two heating arrangements, each heating arrangement including a heating coil, first, second, and third contacts, the first contact being arranged contacting a distal end of the heating coil, the second contact being arranged contacting a proximal end of the heating coil, and the third contact being arranged contacting the heating coil between the first and second contacts, and a sliding arrangement, the heating coils being arranged side by side parallel to a longitudinal axis of the device, the sliding arrangement being arranged adjacent the heating coils and configured to slide parallel to the longitudinal axis and parallel to the heating coils, the third contacts being mounted on the sliding arrangement, and an electrical contact point between each third contact and each respective heating coil being adaptable by sliding the sliding arrangement.

title: Sports footwear with improved recyclability
abstract:
The invention is directed principally to a single-material footwear item consisting of:
         (i) 15 to 65% by weight of thermoplastic polymer selected from polyamides or copolyamides;   (ii) 35 to 85% by weight of PEBA thermoplastic elastomer; and   (iii) 0 to 15% by weight of additives.       

     The invention is also directed to a process for its manufacture and for its recycling, and also to the composition obtainable after recycling and to its use for the manufacture of footwear items.

title: Suspension arm and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: A suspension arm of an aluminum alloy containing 0.25 mass % or more and 0.37 mass % or less of Cu, 0.95 mass % or more and 1.25 mass % or less of Mg, 0.6 mass % or more and 0.75 mass % or less of Si, 0.05 mass % or more and 0.12 mass % or less of Mn, 0.15 mass % or more and 0.35 mass % or less of Fe, 0.25 mass % or less of Zn, 0.050 mass % or more and 0.26 mass % or less of Cr, 0.01 mass % or more and 0.1 mass % or less of Ti, 0.001 mass % or more and 0.03 mass % or less of B, and 0.0010 mass % or more and 0.050 mass % or less of Zr, and the remainder being Al and unavoidable impurities, the suspension arm having a tensile strength ratio of a part with the minimum equivalent strain to a part with the maximum equivalent strain is 0.84 to 1.

title: Cooling Devices and Related Methods
abstract: Cooling device(s), systems and related methods are disclosed. The cooling device(s) and systems may be configured to operate as a unit of a larger cooling system. The cooling device(s) and systems may have one or more inlets and outlets and one or more lumens extending within the cooling device(s). The combination of inlets, outlets, and lumens may form a fluid pathway within the cooling device(s). The cooling device(s) may include one or more additional features for securing or interfacing with a patient before, during, and/or after a surgical procedure. The method(s) may placing or otherwise coupling the cooling device(s) with a patient and circulating cooling fluid from a cooling system into the cooling device(s) to apply thermal therapy to an area of interest of a patient.

title: Electronic module group
abstract: A lamp module group can include at least one housing defining a cavity, the at least one housing defining an opening to the cavity at a first end, the at least one housing defining a first threaded portion at the first end, the cavity at least partially filled with a sealing material; an LED lamp board positioned within the cavity; a lens positioned over the LED; a power supply driving module positioned within the cavity; a first concentric terminal positioned at least partially within the at least one housing; and a second concentric terminal positioned at least partially within the at least one housing.

title: Generation of supplemental audio for masking noise
abstract: An example operation includes one or more of capturing sound data generated by a sound source with at least one sensor associated with a cabin of a vehicle, converting the sound data into frequency data, determining a first subset of frequency bands that include sound and a second subset of frequency bands that do not include sound based on the frequency data, generating supplemental audio that includes supplemental sound during the second subset of frequency bands based on execution of an AI model on the second subset of frequency bands and the sound data, and playing the supplemental audio within the cabin of the vehicle as additional sound data is generated by the sound source.
assignee: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing North America, Inc.; Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha

title: Methods for tiered radio resource management and mobility management in mobile communications
abstract: Various solutions for tiered radio resource management (RRM) and mobility management are described. An apparatus may receive a first reference signal (RS) from a coverage area. The first RS may include identification information of the coverage area. The apparatus may receive a respective second RS from each of a plurality of network nodes within the coverage area. The second RS each may include identification information of a respective one of the plurality of network nodes. Then, the apparatus may perform a first measurement based on the first RS to determine whether to switch a service link from the coverage area to another coverage area, and perform a second measurement based on the second RS to select one or more network nodes from a network node set to form the service link, wherein the network node set includes at least the plurality of network nodes.

title: Neural processing device and load/store method of neural processing device
abstract: A neural processing device is provided. The neural processing device comprises: a processing unit configured to receive an input activation and a weight and perform a two-dimensional matrix calculation with the input activation and the weight to generate an output activation, a first memory, and a load-store unit (LSU) configured to perform memory access operations between the first memory and a second memory. The memory access operations include a main memory access operation for a current processing operation that is performed by the processing unit, and a standby memory access operation for a standby processing operation that is performed by the processing unit after the current processing operation. A level of the first memory is equal to a level of the processing unit, and a level of the second memory is different from the level of the first memory.

title: Battery pack and vehicle including the same
abstract: A battery pack can include a plurality of battery cells, a bus bar assembly having a first side and a second side, the second side of the bus bar assembly provided to a first side of the plurality of battery cells and electrically connected to the plurality of battery cells, a cooling unit disposed at the second side of the bus bar assembly and arranged between the plurality of battery cells along a longitudinal direction of the battery pack, and a bottom rib formed to protrude in a lower direction further than a second side of the plurality of battery cells, and the bottom rib includes an opening provided below a venting portion of the plurality of battery cells.

title: Compile-Time Checking For Exhaustive Switch Statements And Expressions
abstract: Techniques for compiling switch blocks are disclosed. One or more embodiments analyze and rewrite a set of pattern labels in a switch block in a compile-time process for determining whether the switch block is exhaustive. At compile-time, a system populates a set with case labels from a switch block. The system applies a set of rules to iteratively re-write pattern labels in the set and checks whether the re-written set, and hence the original switch block, is exhaustive. If the compiler determines that (a) the set does not appear to be exhaustive, and (b) the set includes patterns labels, then the compiler determines whether the set may be rewritten before further analysis. The compiler iteratively re-writes and re-analyzes the case label set for exhaustivity until the case label set is determined to be exhaustive or cannot be rewritten further.

title: Paper stripping apparatus, paper stripping method, adhesive pasting device, and adhesive pasting method
abstract: The paper stripping apparatus is configured to perform a paper stripping operation. The paper stripping operation includes a paper stripping action of stripping release paper from an adhesive surface and a detection action of detecting whether the release paper after the paper stripping action has been completely stripped or not. The paper stripping apparatus includes a base, a paper stripping mechanism, a first detection camera, and a second detection camera. The first detection camera and the second detection camera are configured to be able to approach or move away from each other so that each of the sheets is within shooting fields of view of the first detection camera and the second detection camera. The first detection camera and the second detection camera are configured to jointly perform the detection action on the multiple sheets.

title: Ai-driven systems and methods for generating, optimizing, and delivering player incentives
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for generating, optimizing, and delivering player incentives using artificial intelligence. Multi-modal player-related data, including historical and real-time behavioral information, is encoded and processed using machine learning models, such as transformer-based neural networks. A media encoding and transcoding router may direct encoded representations to selected machine learning models for prediction, classification, or optimization operations. The system may compute incentive-effectiveness values, predicted engagement responses, or similar metrics, and may generate one or more incentive offers based in part on these predictions. Reinforcement learning or other adaptive machine learning techniques may be applied to refine model parameters using feedback from observed outcomes. Incentive offers may be transmitted to the player using one or more communication channels. Optional operator-control interfaces, compliance functions, and analytics modules may be incorporated. The disclosed embodiments enable automated or semi-automated generation, evaluation, management, and adaptive refinement of player incentives across gaming or non-gaming environments.

title: Sensor device and method for non-invasive monitoring of energy consumption usage
abstract: A sensor device for non-invasive monitoring of energy consumption usage attached to a power cable. The sensor includes a housing having a bottom part and a top part each presenting end sides and side walls, a controller having a software located inside said housing. A pair of clamping elements pivotably connected to the side walls of the bottom part. Each of the clamping elements including a base presenting a base surface and extending to a clamping surface defining an angle of up to 90 degrees between the base surface and the clamping surface to fixedly attached to the power cables of various cross sections.

title: Electronic apparatus and control method for driving state control based on lifting and placement
abstract: An electronic apparatus and a control method thereof are disclosed. The electronic apparatus operates in a first driving state in which the electronic apparatus moves based on a first map of an area in which the electronic apparatus is located. The electronic apparatus identifies whether the electronic apparatus was lifted while operating in the first driving state. Based on identifying that the electronic apparatus was lifted, the electronic apparatus obtains information about a height at which the electronic apparatus is placed after being lifted based on a sensing value obtained from at least one sensor. When the height is within a first range, the electronic apparatus operates in a second driving state in which a speed of the electronic apparatus is limited to less than a first value. Accordingly, the electronic apparatus controls a driving state based on the height at which the electronic apparatus is placed after being lifted.

title: Signaling sounding reference signal bandwidth aggregation in the network during positioning measurement report
abstract: A network node (e.g., a location management function (“LMF”) or a gNB-central unit (“gNB-CU”)) can be in a communications network that includes a communication device and another network node. The network node can transmit a first message to the other network node. The first message can include a request to configure the communication device with a request for bandwidth aggregation information. The network node can further receive a second message from the other network node. The second message can include an indication of a bandwidth aggregation identifier (“ID”) and a set of resources associated with the bandwidth aggregation ID.

title: Direct-From-Vial Medication Infusion System
abstract: A medication infusion system includes a housing with an adapter interface to couple with a medication container (syringe or vial). A pressure source expels gas to deliver fluid to a patient, while a pressure sensor and control unit regulate infusion parameters. A reference chamber with additional sensors enables volume estimation using pressure-volume-temperature relationships. A medication transfer device includes interfaces to couple to the infusion pump and secure the vial, with piercing elements defining inlet and outlet channels. The device may include valves, a gas filter, and a bubble eliminator with a hydrophobic membrane. The system enables direct-from-vial medication delivery without intermediate containers.

title: Agent for oxidative dyeing of keratin fibers, containing isatin and at least one defined polymer
