The device is comprised of a rapidly deployable ballistic bunker device that comprises a structural framework including a lid, a skirt base, and extendable support arms that can be raised to create a protective enclosure. The device incorporates a scissor lift system powered by a hydraulic or manual pump to adjust the lid's height, enabling rapid deployment of the bunker. Ballistic protection is provided by panels that can be inserted into U-shaped tracks and brackets, with options for removable or overlapping configurations. Additional features include a reinforced entrance door that doubles as a shield, an insulated cover for environmental control, a high-voltage power system, and a solar power unit. The bunker may be equipped with a suspension and drive system for mobility, with an auxiliary support box for additional storage and functionality.

title: Inspection method, inspection apparatus, and inspection system
abstract: An inspection method includes (A) forming an assembly by fixing an inspection object and a jig substrate and (B), after (A), inspecting the inspection object by emitting inspection light from an illuminator to an imaging device of the inspection object. The jig substrate includes, in one surface, first connectors and second connectors, which are connected to the first connectors, respectively, and disposed adjacent to the first connectors. In (A), the assembly is formed by a surface of the inspection object having a pad connected to the wiring layer to face the one surface of the jig substrate so that the pad and the first connectors are connected. In (B), the inspection object is inspected that the surface of the inspection object opposite to the wiring layer in the assembly faces the illuminator and probes disposed adjacent to the illuminator are connected with the second connectors, respectively.

title: Multi-Level Approach For Attack Prevention
abstract: A computerized method is disclosed that includes operations of preventing an attack from harming a large language model (LLM). The method includes an evaluator and an analyzer. The evaluator is configured to evaluate a communication from a user using N first classifiers to provide N first classifications. The communication interacts with the LLM. The analyzer is configured to analyze the N first classifications to generate an assessment having a first value. The assessment characterizes an attack level in the communication. The analyzer obtains a response to the communication from the LLM based on the first value and reviews the response using M second classifiers to generating a decision on the response. N is a positive integer and M is a positive integer equal to or different from N.

title: Risk aware model predictive path integral control for stochastic hybrid systems
abstract: A computer-implemented method of path planning for a mobile robot in a dynamic environment is provided, the method includes modeling awareness of an agent for the path planning. An Expansion-Compression (EC) Unscented Transform (UT) Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller comprising an ECUT algorithm and MPPI algorithm is used for the path planning by sampling possible trajectories of the mobile robot around a nominal trajectory and assigning weights to the trajectories based on a cost incurred. A final trajectory of the mobile robot is determined from a weighted summation of all the sampled trajectories.
assignee: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing North America, Inc.; The Regents Of The University Of Michigan; Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha

title: Speech similarity embeddings with sensitivity to recording conditions via two-stage augmentations
abstract: The systems, methods and apparatus described herein are directed towards at least the use of a two-stage augmentation process for vocal audio samples to generate a training dataset for a machine-learning embedding model, the training of machine-learning embedding models on such training data, and the use of such a trained machine-learning embedding models to generate embedding of audio snippets for downstream tasks. The two-stage augmentation process has a first augmentation stage, in which strong augmentations are applied at an audio sample level, and a second augmentation stage, in which weak augmentations are applied at an audio snippet level, where an audio snippet is a section of audio extracted from an audio sample after the first augmentations are applied.

title: Manufacturing method of semiconductor device
abstract: A manufacturing method of forming a semiconductor device includes forming an epitaxial layer on a substrate, forming a well region in the epitaxial layer, forming a source region in the well region, forming a base region in the source region, forming a gate dielectric layer and a gate layer on the epitaxial layer, forming a source contact on the source region and the base region, removing the substrate and a portion of the epitaxial layer, forming a current spreading layer at a bottom of the epitaxial layer; and disposing a replacement epitaxial layer and a replacement substrate under the current spreading layer.

title: Architecture for electromagnetic waveguide
abstract: An electromagnetic waveguide, such as an optical fibre, including a hollow central core surrounded by a microstructured sheath formed by an assembly of elementary cells, the microstructured sheath also including at least two elementary cells, at least one intermediate element connecting the elementary cells, the intermediate element having a cross-section with an area less than or equal to 50% of the cross-sectional area of each of the cells that it connects, the intermediate element having a refractive index less than or equal to the refractive index of each of the elementary cells that it connects, the at least one intermediate element having a tubular structure comprising a wall surrounding a central zone.
assignee: Universite De Limoges; Centre National De La Recherche Scientifique

title: Cloud-Level Physical Security Management for Cloud Infrastructure
abstract: Techniques are disclosed for managing physical access to physical computing devices based on the cloud resources that are executed and/or stored by the physical computing devices. In response to identifying a cloud resource that merits protection, the system identifies a physical computing device that executes and/or stores the cloud resource, and the system maps the physical computing device to physical security devices that can provide some form of physical security to the physical computing device. The physical security devices may include locking mechanisms, alarm mechanisms, surveillance mechanisms, and/or other physical security devices. The system then applies a physical security action to these physical security devices to configure these physical security devices to provide a level of protection to the physical computing device. The system then continues to monitor the cloud resource, the physical computing device, and/or the physical security devices for circumstances that may warrant applying another physical security action.

title: Phase modulation module
abstract: A first holding portion includes a first side wall portion facing a first side surface of a phase modulation element, and a first protruding portion extending from the first side wall portion toward the phase modulation element. A second holding portion includes a second side wall portion facing a second side surface of the phase modulation element. An end surface of the first protruding portion faces the phase modulation element. A potting material connects an end surface of the first protruding portion and the first side surface to each other in a first space formed by the first side surface of the phase modulation element and the first side wall portion and the first protruding portion of the first holding portion. Air is disposed in at least a part of an overlapping portion of the first space overlapping the first protruding portion when view ed from a predetermined direction.

title: Ue-specific channel bandwidth for self-interference mitigation
abstract: Solutions are disclosed that reduce self-interference for frequency division duplexing (FDD) communication in wireless networks (i.e., reducing a radio's transmitter interference with its own reception). For cellular communications, as an example, different UE-specific channel bandwidths (UE-specific CHBWs) in the uplink (UL) channel, with different bandwidths and/or different center frequencies, produce differing levels of self-interference in the downlink (DL) channel. A scheduler selects from among various UE-specific CHBWs for user equipment (UE) based on each UE's ability to withstand interference, and awareness of the interference profiles of the different UE-specific CHBWs. For example, a UE far from a base station antenna receives a relatively weak signal and yet uses high transmit power. For such a UE, the use of a UE-specific CHBW that produces lower levels of interference is more important than it is for UEs closer to the base station that enjoy higher received power while transmitting at lower power

title: Anti-resonant hollow core optical fiber
abstract: An anti-resonant hollow core optical fiber includes an outer cladding having a pipe shape, a plurality of inner cladding elements each having a pipe shape, the plurality of inner cladding elements being in contact with an inner wall surface of the outer cladding, and a coating layer configured to cover the outer cladding. A space surrounded by the plurality of inner cladding elements is a core region. The coating layer includes a primary resin layer and a secondary resin layer covering an outer periphery of the primary resin layer. The secondary resin layer has an average linear expansion coefficient of 10×10 −5  [/° C.] or less at 20° C. to 30° C., and the secondary resin layer has an average linear expansion coefficient of 6×10 −5  [/° C.] or less at −60° C. to −50° C. The secondary resin layer has an in-situ elastic modulus of 1500 MPa or more.

title: Identifying, recording and assessing geospatial assets with data collection, image processing, and selective pruning
abstract: The present invention is intended to provide enhanced asset data collection functions, asset analysis, and/or asset alerts. The system assists in updating existing asset records, adding new assets to asset inventories, identifying maintenance issues, and/or identifying assets which are no longer present. The system is composed of a data collection device(s) which can collect images and location sensor data, server(s), and client interface(s) for interacting with the collected and/or processed data. The system also includes image processing operations and data pruning and selection functions for the smart asset data collection and processing, allowing to obtain the appropriate data for the appropriate asset at the appropriate time.

title: Distal radius implants and instruments
abstract: Devices, systems, instruments, and methods for promoting healing and stability for bone fractures. The bone stabilization system may include a variety trauma plates and one or more bone fasteners configured to secure the plate to bone. The bone plates may be used for the fixation of fractures and fragments in the distal radius. The distal radius plating may be used to create a rigid construct with permanent fixation to promote primary healing and stability.

title: Optical package comprising laser sources
abstract: In an embodiment, an optical package comprising a housing comprising a first end to couple with a cable, and a second end to couple with a node. The housing contains a receiver assembly configured to receive a wavelength division multiplex (WDM) optical signal from a cable coupled there to and comprising a first plurality of optical fibers and a demultiplexer configured to demultiplex the WDM optical signal into a plurality of individual optical signals to be transmitted to the transceiver node via optical fibers. The housing also comprises a transmission assembly comprising a plurality of laser sources, a plurality of optical fibers and a multiplexer. Each laser source is configured to provide an optical carrier signal to the transceiver node to be modulated. The multiplexer is configured to receive the modulated signals from the transceiver node and combine the modulated signals for transmission via the first end.

title: Interface chip, semiconductor memory device, and memory system
abstract: An interface chip includes a first signal line, a second signal line, and a third signal line that receive a signal from a memory controller, a plurality of fourth signal lines that each transmits and receives a signal to and from the memory controller, a plurality of fifth signal lines that each transmits and receives a signal to and from a first memory chip including a plurality of memory cells, a storage, and a controller transmits, in a case where a first signal transmitted from the memory controller via the third signal line is at a first logic level, after a first command for the read operation transmitted from the memory controller is received via the first signal line and the second signal line, a second command for the read operation, the second command corresponding to the first command, to the first memory chip via the fifth signal lines.

title: Article
abstract: An article for an aerosol provision device is provided. The article comprises an aerosol generating layer comprising aerosol generating material, a resistive heating layer comprising a resistive heating element configured to heat at least a portion of the aerosol generating material to generate an aerosol, the aerosol generating layer being on the resistive heating layer, a first type of electrical contact, and a second type of electrical contact. The resistive heating element is at least a portion of an electrically conductive path between the first type of electrical contact and the second type of electrical contact. The article comprises an internal space defining a path along which, in use, aerosol generated from the aerosol generating layer is configured to flow.

title: Pixel driving circuit, driving method for pixel driving circuit and display panel
abstract: A pixel driving circuit, a driving method for the pixel driving circuit and a display panel are provided. The pixel driving circuit includes: a driving transistor, a first reset sub-circuit, a second reset sub-circuit, a luminescent control sub-circuit, a data writing sub-circuit, a gating sub-circuit and an energy storage element. The first reset sub-circuit is configured to write a first initialization voltage signal to a control electrode of the driving transistor in response to a first reset signal; the second reset sub-circuit is configured to write a second initialization voltage signal to a first electrode of at least one light-emitting device in response to a second reset signal; the luminescent control sub-circuit is configured to electrically connect a first power supply line to the first electrode of the driving transistor in response to one of a first luminescent control signal and a second luminescent control signal.

title: Thin film resistor and method of forming the same
abstract: A thin film resistor and a method of forming the same are provided. The method includes forming an insulated oxide film on an upper surface of a substrate; forming a first inner electrode pair on two ends of the insulated oxide film; performing a DC multi-target hybrid sputtering operation to deposit a resistor layer on a portion of the insulated oxide film and a portion of the pair of first inner electrode; performing an RF-DC hybrid sputtering operation to deposit a doping layer over the resistor layer; performing an annealing operation so as to oxidize the doping layer to an oxidized doping film; and forming a passivation layer on the oxidized doping film. Therefore, resistance value and resistivity of the thin film resistor can be controlled.

title: Earphones
abstract: Provided is an earphone. The earphone may include a core module and a hook-like structure connected to the core module. The core module may be located on a front side of an ear in a wearing state, and at least part of the hook-like structure may be located on a rear side of the ear in the wearing state. The hook-like structure may include an adapter housing connected to the core module, and an accommodation cavity may be pre-formed in the adapter housing. The earphone may further include an electronic component that is subsequently mounted in the accommodation cavity.

title: Methods, devices and medium for communication
abstract: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, a terminal device receives, from a network device, information that indicates at least one set of reference signal resources for a time domain channel property (TDCP) reporting. The terminal device performs the TDCP reporting. The TDCP reporting comprises one or more of: at least one amplitude or at least one phase of a correlation between a first reference signal resource and another reference signal resource. If the TDCP reporting comprises a plurality of amplitudes and/or a plurality of phases, the plurality of amplitudes and/or the plurality of phases is based on correlations between the first reference signal resource and a plurality of second reference signal resources. n this way, it can save signaling overheads.

title: Energy storage system and battery module
abstract: An energy storage system, including a battery module including a plurality of battery cells, a battery rack configured to support the battery module, a module fire extinguishing unit configured to detect whether a fire has occurred in the battery module and spray a fire extinguishing agent onto the battery module if fire is detected, a control unit connected to the plurality of battery cells, the control unit being configured to detect a state of one or more of the plurality of battery cells, and a heat blocking unit in the control unit and configured to prevent damage to at least one of the plurality of battery cells due to heat.

title: Feeding mechanism and method for toy projectile launcher
abstract: A toy launcher including a housing, a storage cartridge configured for placement into an opening of the housing, with projectiles within the storage cartridge held in a first orientation, a cocking slide movably attached to the housing between a first position and a second position, a reciprocating frame operatively connected to the cocking slide, a projectile housing pivotably attached to the toy launcher housing adjacent to the storage cartridge, and a reciprocating feed lever operatively connected to the reciprocating frame. Movement of the cocking slide from the first position to the second position in a first priming step and then back to the first position in a second priming step causes the feed lever to push a projectile from the storage cartridge into the projectile housing, pivots the projectile housing so that the projectile is in a second orientation, and places the projectile in the second orientation at a firing position within the toy launcher.

title: Passive structure designs for phased antenna arrays
abstract: Systems and techniques for generating passive structure designs are disclosed. Passive structures constructed according to the generated designs improve performance of phased antenna arrays into which the passive structures are incorporated. A device includes a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium encoded with instructions, and processor(s) coupled to the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium. The processor(s) are configured to execute the instructions to receive a passive structure design, to generate a figure of merit based on the passive structure design and frequency data using a simulation technique, to generate a pool of samples, to select a final sample from the pool of samples using an acquisition function, to provide the final sample to the simulation technique to generate a figure of merit, the final sample being associated with a new passive structure, and to output the new passive structure.

title: Device and method for controlling a comburent-fuel mixture in a premixed gas burner
abstract: A control device for a comburent-fuel mixture for a premixed gas burner comprises: an aspiration duct, which defines a section for the passage of a fluid within the aspiration duct and includes an inlet mouth for receiving the comburent and a delivery mouth for making the mixture available to the burner; an injection duct, configured to feed the fuel; a fan, rotating at a variable rotation speed about a rotation axis and arranged in the aspiration duct to generate therein a flow of comburent or of comburent-fuel mixture; a control unit, configured to generate command signals to be sent to the fan, to control its rotation. The injection duct is open onto the fan, to inject the gas inside the fan.

title: Resource processing method and apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product
abstract: A resource processing method includes obtaining a first service dataset from a preset dataset, the first service dataset comprising service data, and each piece of service data being configured for recording a first historical resource transfer amount of a first resource type and a second historical resource transfer amount of a second resource type based on resources being transferred therebetween, determining, based on the second historical resource transfer amount, target service data in the at least one piece of service data that meets a resource transfer condition, determining a first resource transfer mode of the first resource type based on the first and second historical resource transfer amount in the target service data, the first resource transfer mode comprising resource transfer-in or resource transfer-out, and transferring resources of the first historical resource transfer amount of the first resource type based on the first resource transfer mode.

title: Method for sparse planar array synthesis
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of array antenna synthesis, in particular to a method for sparse planar array synthesis. In order to balance weights of an exploitation process and an exploration process, a nonlinear function reconstruction is used for a math optimizer accelerated in an arithmetic optimization algorithm; the top three optimal individuals are used to replace the current optimal individuals for exploration and exploitation, and an elite variation strategy is introduced to enhance the ability of the algorithm to jump out of local optimum and improve convergence accuracy of the algorithm. An adaptive matrix mapping rule is proposed to judge the current array element distribution. If the current array element distribution does not satisfy a constraint of minimum array element spacing, the current array element distribution is adjusted by an adjustment strategy to ensure the freedom of array elements while avoiding infeasible solutions.

title: Catalytic metamaterial absorber-emitter, devices and methods of fabrication and applications thereof
abstract: Devices and methods are disclosed for near unity absorption or near zero reflection of electromagnetic radiation over a wide range of wavelengths, omnidirectionally and that use the absorbed radiation to enhance the catalysis conversion of reactant chemicals to product chemicals of interest via the patterning of subwavelength metamaterial elements as a surface, or colloidal clusters of subwavelength particles as a suspension. The arrangements, dimensions, materials and geometries of the unit elements of the meta-surface or colloidal clusters may be selected to produce an effective refractive index lower than that of the refractive index of the comprising materials, such that the effective index approaches the index of the surrounding medium. Impedance matching, plasmonic modes between the metamaterial elements or cluster nanoparticles, ohmic material losses, and bandgap absorption may be combined to achieve broadband near-unity absorption and/or modulated thermal emission bands, enhancing the catalysis rates of gas, liquid and multi-phase chemical reactions.
assignee: Joel Yi Yang LOH; Mahdi SAFARI; Nazir Pyarali KHERANI; Edgar ACOSTA

title: Analysis system and analysis method
abstract: An analysis system includes an optical system that guides light from a particle flowing in a flow channel to an image sensor, in which the optical system includes an objective lens facing the flow channel, an additional objective lens that forms an image of light passing through the objective lens, and a mirror that reflects light from the additional objective lens toward the additional objective lens, light from the particle passing through a different position in the flow channel passes through the objective lens and the additional objective lens, and then is focused at a different image forming position, and the mirror has a plurality of reflective surfaces respectively positioned at different image forming positions.

title: Electrolyte, lithium secondary battery, and electric device
abstract: An electrolyte, a lithium secondary battery, and an electric device. The electrolyte includes a first solvent, a silane compound containing a carbon-carbon double bond, and a cyclic lithium borate compound. The first solvent includes a cyclic carbonate compound. Based on a total mass of the electrolyte, a mass content W3 of the cyclic carbonate compound, a mass content W1 of the silane compound containing a carbon-carbon double bond, and a mass content W2 of the cyclic lithium borate compound satisfy: 0.001≤(W1+W2)/W3≤2.67.

title: Optimizing User Interactions and Task Selection for Large Language Models
abstract: Data indicative of a text query is received. A text embedding for the text query is generated using a machine-learned embedding generation model. A plurality of chunk embeddings respectively generated by the embedding generation model for a plurality of document chunks of the plurality of documents are accessed. The plurality of documents are organized into a plurality of document subsets. Data indicative of selected document subset(s) of the plurality of document subsets is obtained. A similarity search is performed for the text embedding with respect to only chunk embeddings that are associated with document chunks that are included in the selected document subset(s). The similarity search identifies chunk embedding(s) as semantically similar to the text query. Document chunk(s) that correspond to the chunk embedding(s) identified by the similarity search are provided for display within a user interface.

title: Pharmacuetical Composition and Method of Treating Hematologic Malignancies
abstract: A method for treating hematologic malignancies comprises administration of a composition inclusive of  64 Zn e (Asp) in a therapeutically effective amount. Such administration may be via intravenous injection and/or infusion and may be once a day or more than once a day. Other identified compounds may be bound to  64 Zn e  replacing L-Aspartate (Asp), provided that the resulting molecular weight does not exceed 700 Da and the resulting compound nanoparticles are less than 50.5 nm in size. The composition is suitable for intravenous injection and/or infusion.

title: Solid-state storage device and method of dynamic quality-of-service management thereof
abstract: A solid-state storage device is provided, which includes a controller, a non-volatile memory, and a volatile memory. The non-volatile memory stores write data provided by a host. The volatile memory includes a submission queue and a wait queue. The controller fetches a plurality of access commands from the host, and record the access commands in the submission queue. The access commands include write commands and read commands. In response to the controller fetching a first write command from the submission queue, the controller determines whether a read count value of the read commands and a standby time from receiving the first write command meet a target condition. If so, the controller executes the first write command. Otherwise, the controller retains the first write command in the wait queue.

title: System and method for order fulfillment
abstract: An order fulfillment system is described herein. The system includes an inventory database identifying inventoried items, an assembly line system configured to deliver items to at least one workstation, at least one camera configured to scan items being transported by the assembly line system in real-time, and a computing system. The computing system is programmed to execute the steps of: receiving an order notification for an order, identifying items in the order, prioritizing the order based on a prescribed rule, receiving a scanned image from the at least one camera, mapping the scanned image to a corresponding inventoried item, ascertaining a location of the corresponding inventoried item, and operating the line assembly line system to: sort the identified items in the order, and send the identified items to a destination, such that movement of those identified items can be controlled and re-routed as necessary.

title: Label affixing device
abstract: A label affixing device includes a peeling member, a conveying path, and a guide path. The peeling member peels an end portion of a label from a release material of a tape, and disposes the end portion at an affixing position to affix the label to an adherend. The conveying path conveys the tape toward the peeling member. The guide path includes a guide surface to contact the adherend, and guides the adherend in a guide direction, from the affixing position toward a peeling completion position. At the peeling completion position, the end portion of the label reaches as the adherend moves and peels the remaining unpeeled section of the label from the release material. An angle of the guide surface of the guide path is equal to or less than 90 degrees with respect to a conveying direction along which the tape is conveyed in the conveying path.

title: Rechargeable battery pack
abstract: A rechargeable battery pack includes: a battery housing having an accommodation space; a plurality of cell modules in the accommodation space an having a plurality of unit battery cells connected to each other, and obliquely arranged; a holder part supporting the cell module inside the battery housing; and a bus bar at an upper side of the holder part and connecting electrode terminals of the unit battery cells, wherein the bus bar is between the cell modules at the upper side of the holder, and a lead part connected to the electrode terminal is obliquely protruded from at least one side of the bus bar.

title: Systems and methods for entropy coding for recursive intra region partitioning
abstract: An example method of video coding includes receiving a video bitstream comprising a plurality of coding blocks and identifying a coding region that comprises two or more coding blocks of the plurality of coding blocks that are encoded in an intra prediction mode, the coding region being a child region of a parent region. When the parent region is not an intra region, the method includes determining a context for the coding region, the context based on a block size corresponding to the coding region, and entropy decoding a region type flag from the video bitstream using the determined context, the region type flag indicating that the coding region is an intra region in which the two or more coding blocks are encoded in the intra prediction mode. The method also includes reconstructing the two or more coding blocks according to a value of the region type flag.

title: Rapidly deployable emergency tourniquet
abstract: A rapidly deployable tourniquet is provided which includes: a strap configured to be placed around a limb; a tension mechanism configured to store energy; and an activation mechanism in operable communication with the tension mechanism, wherein operation of the activation mechanism is configured to release the energy stored in the tension mechanism to tighten the strap around the limb to a degree that is effective to reduce blood flow through the limb to reduce or eliminate hemorrhage therefrom. In one embodiment, the tension mechanism includes a spool and a pre-tensioned spring operably connected to the spool, wherein operation of the activation mechanism is configured to release the pre-tensioned spring to effectuate rotation of the spool to tighten the strap.

title: Geofencing based parental control
abstract: Systems and methods include executing a game environment where a geofencing application executes in the game environment. The method further includes receiving a plurality of criteria for establishing a geofence within the gaming environment from a user gaming device associated with a user, identifying a user location based on location data retrieved from a user device, establishing the geofence based on the user location and the user provided criteria, and receiving a plurality of rules for establishing an interaction within the geofence. The method includes receiving a request for an interaction with the user gaming device from a requesting gaming device, automatically initiating the geofencing application in the game environment, verifying that the requesting gaming device is within the geofence, verifying that the requesting gaming device satisfies the plurality of rules for establishing the interaction, and establishing the interaction between the user gaming device and the requesting gaming device.

title: Aircraft records management platform
abstract:
A method is provided for managing compliance of an aircraft. The method includes receiving aircraft records data for a set of aircraft records of the aircraft, and receiving a request for a report providing compliance information for the aircraft. The method includes determining a set of maintenance task requirements for the aircraft, and identifying aircraft records entries that are to be used as compliance values for respective maintenance task requirements. The aircraft records entries are identified by using search keys to search the aircraft records to identify the aircraft records entries that are relevant to compliance with the respective maintenance task requirements. The method includes determining, using one or more compliance rules, whether the aircraft complies with the respective maintenance task requirements, and generating the report providing the compliance information for the aircraft. The method includes causing the report to be accessible via a user interface of an application. 
     WO

title: Thienyl compounds for the treatment of a central nervous system disease or disorder
abstract: Disclosed herein are thienyl compounds and salts, pharmaceutical compositions, and uses thereof.

title: Adaptive fudicials for mult-modal radiotherapy
abstract: The present disclosure is related to an interstitial marker configured to be imaged when inserted into soft tissue of an organ, tumor or tumor bed within a subject's body, wherein the interstitial marker is optimized for multi-modality compatibility by maintaining necessary dimensions for visibility, trackability and material reduction in a beam path via customized pitch values to minimize proton beam perturbation.

title: Display device and driving method thereof
abstract: A display device includes: a display panel including pixels, a data driving circuit, a scan driving circuit which drives a plurality of first scan lines and a plurality of second scan lines, and a driving controller which controls the data driving circuit and the scan driving circuit to drive a first display area of the display panel at a first operating frequency and drive a second display area of the display panel at a second operating frequency lower than the first operating frequency while an operating mode is a multi-frequency mode. During the multi-frequency mode, first scan signals provided to first scan lines, which correspond to the second display area, of the plurality of first scan lines are maintained at inactive levels in predetermined frames, and second scan signals provided to the plurality of second scan lines transition to active levels at least twice in each of the predetermined frames.

title: Porous transport layer
abstract: A porous transport layer for an electrolyser or for a fuel cell, comprising a first nonwoven layer of metal fibers provided for contacting a proton exchange membrane, wherein the first nonwoven layer of metal fibers comprises metal fibers of a first equivalent diameter, wherein the first nonwoven layer of metal fibers has a first surface roughness and a first porosity, a second nonwoven layer of metal fibers, wherein the second nonwoven layer of metal fibers comprises metal fibers of a second equivalent diameter, wherein the second nonwoven layer of metal fibers has a second surface roughness and a second porosity, wherein the first surface roughness is below 10 μm, the first equivalent diameter is smaller than the second equivalent diameter, the first surface roughness is smaller than the second surface roughness for at least 20%, e.g., in a range of 20% to 120%.

title: Selecting machine learning models for tasks using a regression model
abstract: A computer-implemented method is provided. A processor set receives a benchmark dataset comprising a number of benchmark records for evaluating a number of machine learning models. The processor set creates a number of prompts for the number of machine learning models based on a subset of benchmark records from the number of benchmark records. The processor set retrieves a number of outputs for each machine learning model by inputting the number of prompts to each machine learning model from the number of machine learning models. The processor set determines a performance score for each machine learning model based on correctness for the number of outputs for each machine learning model using a regression model. The processor set selects a subset of machine learning models from the number of machine learning models to perform a task based on performance scores for the number of machine learning models.

title: Display device with wavelength-specific transmittance or reflectivity and electronic device including the same
abstract: An electronic device includes a display device that has a display panel, a first polarizing film located on the display panel, a first phase retardation film located on the first polarizing film, a reflection control film located on the first phase retardation film, a first lens located on the reflection control film, a second lens located on the first lens, a second phase retardation film located on the second lens, a second polarizing film located on the second phase retardation film, and a third lens located on the second polarizing film, wherein a function of a transmittance and a reflectivity of the reflection control film in respect to light of a first wavelength range is different from the function of a transmittance and a reflectivity of the reflection control film in respect to light of a second wavelength range.

title: Pneumatic tyre for a two-wheeled vehicle
abstract:
A two-wheeler pneumatic tire having a tread, a tire carcass, tire sidewalls and two bead regions each having a tire bead with a core, wherein the two bead regions have in each case a bead protection strip which as wear protection is disposed axially outside the carcass; 
     wherein two carcass ply turn-ups are disposed in the zenith of the tire so as to overlap one another, wherein the carcass ply turn-ups extend over the zenith and the tire sidewalls into both bead regions, and in the latter terminate below the bead protection strip in a first carcass ply end.

title: Electrostatic chuck
abstract: An electrostatic chuck  10  includes a dielectric substrate  100  and a base plate  200  including a coolant flow path  250  formed therein through which a coolant passes. In the electrostatic chuck  10 , the dielectric substrate  100  and the base plate  200  are joined to each other, and the coolant flow path  250  is a groove G that is formed on a surface  210  on the dielectric substrate  100  side of the base plate  200 .

title: Electronic device and method for managing database using high-speed storage
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes memory including a first storage and a second storage with faster access speed than the first storage storing instructions, and at least one processor comprising processing circuitry, wherein the instructions, when executed by the at least one processor individually or collectively cause the electronic device to verify, using information related to a database stored in the memory, whether authority to perform read and write operations on the database using the second storage from among the first storage and the second storage is granted, based on verifying that the authority has been granted, execute a function of generating, in the second storage, journal information related to a database stored in the first storage, based on the execution of the function, update, based on the journal information stored in the second storage, the journal information stored in the second storage according to a transaction related to the database, and based on the execution of the function, generate journal information in the first storage based on identifying that the journal information is not generated in the second storage by the execution of the function, generate the journal information in the first storage.

title: Dual-chamber power delivery system
abstract: Aspects provided herein generally include apparatus, plasma processing systems and methods for delivering power to multiple chambers. One example apparatus generally includes: a first generator; a first distribution circuit having an input coupled to an output of the first generator; a first filter coupled between a first output of the first distribution circuit and a first combination node; a second filter coupled between a second output of the first distribution circuit and a second combination node; a second generator; a second distribution circuit having an input coupled to an output of the second generator; a third filter coupled between a first output of the second distribution circuit and the first combination node; and a fourth filter coupled between a second output of the second distribution circuit and the second combination node.

title: Batch folding for parallelized multiuser computations
abstract: A method can provide for obtaining, by a computing system comprising one or more computing devices, first input data respective to a first generation task; obtaining, by the computing system, second input data respective to a second generation task; providing, by the computing system, the first input data and the second input data to an attention mechanism of a batched transformer model to generate a shared context based on the first input data and the second input data; batching, by the computing system, the shared context to produce a first batch associated with the first input data and a second batch associated with the second input data; and performing, by the computing system, a first operation on the first batch while masking a portion of the shared context corresponding to the second batch.

title: Orientation tools for tubing hangers
abstract: An orientation tool and related landing assemblies and methods for adjusting an angular orientation of a tubing hanger in a wellhead system are disclosed. In some embodiments, a landing assembly includes a tubing hanger and an orientation tool coupled to and configured to adjust an angular orientation of the tubing hanger. The orientation tool includes an angular adjustment assembly comprising a piston. Actuation of the piston is configured to rotate the tubing hanger. The orientation tool further includes a control module comprising one or more sensors and a valve assembly. The control module is configured to determine the tubing hanger angular orientation using the one or more sensors and to rotate the tubing hanger via the valve assembly and piston based on the orientation.

title: Fixed Angle Instrument With Rounded Linkages
abstract: A fixed angle instrument includes an elongate guide extending from a proximal end to a distal end, the guide having a proximal portion extending along a longitudinal axis and a distal portion extending transverse to the longitudinal axis. The instrument further includes a shaft disposed within the guide extending through the proximal portion of the guide along the longitudinal axis. The instrument further includes an intermediate element coupled to the shaft, the intermediate element having at least one bulbous link. The instrument further includes a distal element coupled to a distal end of the intermediate element.

title: Method for producing hardened steel components
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing hardened steel components, wherein a sheet steel blank made of a hardenable steel, which is embodied with a metallic anti-corrosion layer, in particular a zinc-based metallic anti-corrosion layer, is first cold formed, the resulting cold preformed component is then fully or partially austenitized by heating and is then inserted into a form hardening tool, wherein the insertion temperature is at least 500° C., in particular greater than 600° C., and through contact with the forming tool, is cooled in the form hardening tool at a speed above the critical hardening speed and is thus quench hardened and formed into the finished component, wherein the metallic anti-corrosion layer has a layer thickness of 7 μm to 20 μm per side, wherein in relation to the total surface area of the finished component, 85-99% of the surface area is made up of regions with cold final forming and 1-15% of the surface area is made up of regions that undergo hot final forming during the form hardening.

title: Bendable radiation detector for measuring posture and position, and operation method for radiation detector
abstract: A radiation detector for detecting radiation of the present disclosure includes a radiation detection panel, which is flexible, extending in a first direction and detecting radiation incident on a first surface, a bending support unit coupled to the radiation detection panel and supporting the radiation detection panel, and controlling bending based on a bending axis parallel to a second direction of the radiation detection panel, and a posture-position sensor coupled to the bending support unit, for determining at least one of a degree of bending of the radiation detection panel or a position of the radiation detection panel with respect to an object.

title: Foodstuff containing r 1,3 butanediol for ketosis, energy, and mental clarity
abstract: A foodstuff can include a free acid β-hydroxybutyrate, and a base. The β-hydroxybutyrate, and base, are present at a less than 1:1 molar equivalence. Ketone Ester may also be incorporated as a component of the foodstuff.

title: Communication device, control method, and non-transitory computer readable storage medium
abstract: This communication device is a Multi-Link Device capable of establishing multiple parallel links with another communication device via respectively different frequency channels. The communication device communicates a prescribed wireless frame with a different first Multi-Link Device. The communication device establishes a link with the first Multi-Link Device. In the communication device, the prescribed wireless frame communicated by the communication device includes a prescribed element that includes an identifier of a logical Multi-Link Device formed by cooperation between at least the first Multi-Link Device and a second Multi-Link Device different from the Multi-Link Device.

title: Display panel and display device comprising shared gate conductive layer for opposing active layer
abstract: A display panel includes a pixel driving circuit including a first type transistor and a second type transistor, the display panel further includes a base substrate, a first active layer located on a side of the base substrate, a second active layer located on the side of the first active layer away from the base substrate, a first conductive layer located between the first active layer and the second active layer; at least partial structure of the first active layer is used to form a channel region of the first type transistor; at least partial structure of the second active layer is used to form the channel region of the second type transistor; partial structure of the first conductive layer is used to form the gate of the first type transistor, partial structure of the first conductive layer is used to form the bottom gate of the second type transistor.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: System and method using multilayer optical lattice qubit arrays for quantum computing
abstract: A quantum computing (QC) system includes a first plurality of logical qubits in a first substantially planar region and a second plurality of logical qubits in a second substantially planar region that is substantially parallel to the first substantially planar region. At least some of the first plurality of logical qubits are configured to interact with one another, and at least some of the second plurality of logical qubits are configured to interact with one another and to interact with the at least some of the first plurality of logical qubits. The QC system can include additional pluralities of logical qubits in additional substantially planar regions that are substantially parallel to the first and second substantially planar regions and at least some of the second plurality of logical qubits can be configured to interact with one or more of the additional pluralities of logical qubits.

title: System and method of providing case picking automation with human and robot orchestration
abstract: A device may include an orchestration system, a robot in communication with the orchestration system and a mobile device in communication with the orchestration system. The device can be configured to: receive an order that requires case picking, dispatch the robot to navigate autonomously to a pick location, transmit an instruction to the mobile device to direct a human to the pick location and to perform a pick task by moving items to the robot at the pick location, log a completed pick report from the mobile device of the human when the pick task at the pick location to the robot is complete; and continuously monitor the robot and the mobile device to make dynamic adjustments for one or more of the robot or the human for pick tasks.

title: Medical devices for shunts, occluders, fenestrations and related systems and methods
abstract: An implantable medical device comprising a first frame portion, a second frame portion arranged within the first frame portion and a plurality of diverging elements connecting the first frame portion to the second frame portion.

title: Computing Node Management System and Method for Managing a Plurality of Computing Nodes
abstract: A computing node management system includes a central offload node and a plurality of computing nodes. A riser card is inserted into each computing node. Each riser card is connected to the central offload node. Each riser card establishes a communication channel between the central offload node and the computing node into which the riser card is inserted. The central offload node is configured to provide resources for the plurality of computing nodes through the communication channels.
assignee: Huawei Cloud Computing Technologies Co., Ltd.

title: Dry etching apparatus
abstract: The dry etching apparatus includes a rotatable sample stage on which a sample is mounted, an etching source for emitting an etching medium to the sample, and a shielding part provided at a position remote from the sample stage to block part of the emitted etching medium from reaching the sample.

title: Rotating electrical machine with high efficiency, high torque density, and reduced usage of rare metals
abstract:
Please replace the abstract in the specification as filed with the below paragraph as follows: 
     A motor is provided with: an inner core and an outer core formed to be relatively rotatable with respect to each other about a common rotating shaft; magnets provided in the inner core; and windings wound around the outer core. The inner core includes a plurality of magnetic material portions made of a plurality of magnetic materials having magnetic characteristics different from each other, respectively, in a cross section perpendicular to the rotating shaft.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: System and method for measuring plant water content and predicting water stress
abstract: An apparatus for measuring plant leaf water content includes a clamp having opposing jaws configured to secure a leaf. A sensing unit on a first jaw measures a temperature of the leaf and an electrical property of the leaf. A heating unit on a second jaw applies controlled heat to the leaf. A control unit regulates power to the heating unit, receives data indicative of a temperature response and the electrical property, and determines a water-content value for the leaf based on the data. In some embodiments, a capacitance sensor is coupled to the leaf and is interrogated to obtain the electrical property independent of the heating unit. The apparatus may be operated as a standalone clip or may be mounted to an end effector of an articulating arm of a mobile robotic platform to obtain measurements from multiple plants, and may include environmental sensing, geotagging, and wireless communication.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Circuit board, and semiconductor package comprising same
abstract: A circuit board according to an embodiment an insulating layer; a first circuit pattern disposed on the insulating layer; and a first protective layer disposed on the insulating layer and including a first open portion vertically overlapping the first circuit pattern, wherein the first protective layer includes a first region including the first open portion and having a first thickness, and a second region having a second thickness greater than the first thickness without including the first open portion, wherein the first thickness of the first region is smaller than a third thickness of the first circuit pattern, and wherein an inner side surface of the first region constituting the first open portion includes a first inner side surface in direct contact with an outer side surface of the first circuit pattern, and a second inner side surface spaced apart from the outer side surface of the first circuit pattern.

title: Refrigerator
abstract: A refrigerator includes a cabinet, a storage compartment provided inside the cabinet, cover rails to be fixed to opposite side walls of the storage compartment, a variable temperature module to be assembled to the cover rails, and a pantry assembled to the cover rails such that while the pantry is assembled to the cover rails, the pantry is positioned at an upper end of the variable temperature module. The cover rails respectively include a stopper configured to secure the variable temperature module along a front-rear direction of the cabinet and a hook configured to secure the pantry to the cover rails, and based on the pantry being secured by the hook, the variable temperature module is secured to the cover rails such that a movement of the variable temperature module along an up-down direction of the cabinet is prevented by the pantry.

title: Secure provisioning of a programmable device
abstract: A device configured to: receive and decrypt an encrypted data package to obtain: a software image for programming onto a programmable device, a first location identifying a location of unprotected sensitive data in the software image, a second location and third location; extract the unprotected sensitive data using the first location; transform the unprotected sensitive data into protected sensitive data; generate a modified software image by inserting the protected sensitive data into the software image and associating the protected sensitive data with the second location; transmit the modified software image to a programming module, the modified software image comprising a program configured, when executed, to transform the protected sensitive data into unprotected sensitive data; and store the unprotected sensitive data at the third location in volatile memory of the programmable device whilst retaining the protected sensitive data at the second location in non-volatile memory of the programmable device.

title: Storage medium, control method, and information processing apparatus for configuring fax cover sheet settings
abstract: A non-transitory computer-readable storage medium stores a computer program that supports a standard driver provided by a provider of an operating system. The computer program is configured to cause a computer to display a settings reception screen that includes a template selection section. The template selection section is configured to receive a selection of a template related to a cover sheet to be attached to image data output from the standard driver.

title: Paint mist removal device
abstract: A paint mist removal device with easily replaced filters includes a filter housing body having a lower housing section and an upper housing section. The lower housing section is configured to removably accommodate a primary filter, and the upper housing section is configured to removably accommodate a secondary filter. The primary filter takes in booth air from a side surface and discharges the booth air from an upper surface. The secondary filter is disposed adjacent to an upper side of the lower housing section and arranged in a triangular configuration. An inlet for introducing booth air into the primary filter in the lower housing section is provided on a side surface of the filter housing body, and an outlet for discharging booth air from the secondary filter in the upper housing section is provided in the filter housing body at a position higher than the inlet.

title: Communication method and communication apparatus
abstract: This application provides a communication method and a communication apparatus, to implement a measurement between APs. The communication method includes: A STA sends a first message to a first AP, where the first message indicates the first AP to measure channel state information between the first AP and a second AP; and the first AP measures the channel state information between the first AP and the second AP based on the first message, and feeds back the channel state information to the STA. The technical solutions in embodiments of this application may be applied to a WLAN communication system like a sensing system, a positioning system, a ranging system, or an ultra-wideband UWB system, and may be further applied to a WLAN communication device that supports 802.11be, 802.11bn, or subsequent evolution.

title: Large-volume 3d image stitching method, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract: A large-volume 3D image stitching method, device, computer equipment, and medium are provided. The method includes following steps: acquiring a to-be-stitched 3D image stack matrix V stack , and extracting to-be-stitched boundaries of to-be-stitched sub-3D images; performing fusion calculation through a sigmoid function on adjacent to-be-stitched boundaries of all adjacent to-be-stitched sub-3D images to obtain smooth boundaries; performing boundary cropping, tensor reshaping and shape transformation on the to-be-stitched 3D image stack matrix V stack  according to the to-be-stitched boundaries to obtain a 3D matrix; and correspondingly applying all smooth boundaries to boundary junctions in the 3D matrix to obtain a seamlessly stitched 3D image.

title: Method for operating a linear transport system and linear transport system
abstract: A computer-implemented method for operating a linear transport system comprises outputting control signals to at least one drive coil of a test motor module of a plurality of motor modules, in order to generate a test magnetic field of the test motor module; outputting control signals to at least one drive coil of at least one interference motor module of the plurality of motor modules, in order to generate an interference variable of the at least one interference motor module; determining an interference of the test magnetic field of the test motor module caused by the interference variable of the interference motor module; and determining an interference motor module immediately adjacent to the test motor module, if the detected interference of the test magnetic field by the interference variable reaches or exceeds a predefined limit value. The application also relates to a linear transport system.

title: System and method for automated vehicle refueling at refueling stations
abstract: A system and method for automated refueling of an autonomous vehicle are described. The autonomous vehicle includes at least one sensor and a processing device communicatively connected to the at least one sensor. The method includes executing instructions stored in a memory with a processing device in communication with the one or more sensors to perform operations. The operation include detecting, using an input from the fuel sensor, when a remaining fuel level for the autonomous vehicle is less than a threshold fuel level, identifying a refueling station for refueling of the autonomous vehicle, controlling the navigation of the autonomous vehicle to locate the autonomous vehicle at the identified refueling station, and further controlling the navigation of the autonomous vehicle to locate the autonomous vehicle in an alignment lane at the identified refueling station.

title: Stacking machine
abstract: The disclosure provides a stacking machine. The stacking machine includes a stacking table, a material-unloading mechanism, a stacking mechanism, a deviation correction table, and a conveying mechanism.
assignee: Wuxi Lead Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.

title: Assembly providing gravity fed or pump fed curvilinear motion for polymer release and mixing, including centrally mounting multi-outlet nozzle, overflow rim discharge system, and method for passive stormwater treatment using controlled rotational flow
abstract: An assembly and method for providing gravity fed or pump fed curvilinear motion for polymer release and mixing is disclosed. The assembly includes a reservoir constructed to promote curvilinear motion of a fluid, a plurality of polymer forms positioned within the reservoir, and an inlet configuration such as a central-mounted multi-outlet nozzle with tangential outlet channels to impart rotational motion. The induced rotation increases friction between the fluid and polymer forms to enhance dissolution and treatment efficiency. The assembly may include an overflow brim at an upper edge of the reservoir and a secondary collection bowl to receive fluid flowing over the brim, establishing consistent residence time and preventing polymer loss. A method is also disclosed comprising pumping stormwater into the reservoir, inducing rotational flow, maintaining polymer-particle interaction for sufficient residence time, and discharging treated stormwater after promoting agglomeration, with optional free floating polymer forms and alternative configurations.

title: System and method of spatial groups in multi-user communication sessions
abstract: Some examples of the disclosure are directed to systems and methods for presenting content in a three-dimensional environment by one or more electronic devices in a multi-user communication session. In some examples, a first electronic device and a second electronic device are communicatively linked in a multi-user communication session, wherein the first electronic device and the second electronic device are configured to display a three-dimensional environment, respectively. In some examples, the first electronic device and the second electronic device are grouped in a first spatial group within the multi-user communication session. In some examples, if the second electronic device determines that the first electronic device changes states (and/or vice versa), the user of the first electronic device and the user of the second electronic device are no longer grouped into the same spatial group within the multi-user communication session.

title: Notification display method and electronic device
abstract: A system and method for providing a notification display method. The method includes displaying a first interface having a status bar on the top, displaying indication information of at least two notifications in the status bar, where the indication information of the at least two notifications comprises indication information of a first notification and indication information of a second notification, and where the indication information of the first notification and the indication information of the second notification are displayed independently of each other, displaying, in response to a first operation, detailed information of the first notification on the first interface in a floating form, and displaying, in response to a second operation, detailed information of the second notification on the first interface in the floating form, and resuming display of the indication information of the first notification in the status bar.

title: Output control method, output control device, and recording medium
abstract: An output control device includes: at least one memory configured to store instructions; and at least one processor configured to execute the instructions to: acquire product identification information for identifying a product in an actual store by an operation of a customer, via a terminal that executes an application program used for product registration in an EC store and the actual store; and output, to the terminal, information browsable in the EC store for the product identified by the product identification information when the product identification information is acquired via the terminal.

title: Enzyme preparation for cheese analog
abstract: The present invention provides an enzyme preparation for cheese analogs, containing (A) a protease, (B) a carbohydrate-modifying enzyme, and (C) a transglutaminase, which improves both the meltability and stretchability when heated and the shreddability when cooled of cheese analogs, as well as a method for producing cheese analogs improved in the above-mentioned properties.

title: Roll stabilization and related apparatuses
abstract: This disclosure relates generally to roll stabilization and related apparatuses.

title: Operating aircraft propulsion system with propulsor coupled electric machine
abstract: An operating method is provided for an aircraft. During this method, a first control signal is provided to drive rotation of a first propulsor rotor of a first propulsion system of the aircraft using a first engine of the first propulsion system. Operation of the first engine is monitored to provide first engine data. A degraded condition of the first engine is identified based on the first engine data. In response to the identifying of the degraded condition, a second control signal is provided to drive the rotation of the first propulsor rotor at a first rate using a first electric machine of the first propulsion system. The first rate is equal to or greater than fifty percent of a second rate at which a second propulsor rotor of a second propulsion system of the aircraft is being rotated.

title: Phospholipid composition comprising surfactant, and use thereof
abstract: The phospholipid composition comprising a surfactant, according to the present invention, comprises lysophospholipid and a sulfosuccinate-based surfactant, thereby allowing lysophospholipid, which is the active ingredient, to be well dispersed even in an aqueous solution, and the active ingredient does not readily decompose even during long-term storage, and the efficacy thereof can be maintained for a long period of time. Therefore, the phospholipid composition of the present invention can be stored for a long period of time by inhibiting decomposition of lysophospholipid, which is the active ingredient, and thus can be used commercially and more easily than a conventional pesticide composition having a short shelf life.

title: Environment generation using one or more neural networks
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques are presented to generate a simulated environment. In at least one embodiment, one or more neural networks are used to generate a simulated environment based, at least in part, on stored information associated with objects within the simulated environment.

title: Etl clustering for reduction of data bloat
abstract: Metadata mapped to units of execution executed by components of a computing infrastructure and data created and/or used by the units of execution may be collected. The metadata may be consolidated and analyzed to identify units of execution mapped to similar or replicative data instances. Instances of potential data bloat mapped to at least a subset of the identified units of execution may be determined. Execution composites may be developed that may include specifications of at least the subset of the identified units of execution. A bloat reduction interface may be generated. The bloat reduction interface may be configured to represent at least the subset of identified units of execution and the instances of potential data bloat mapped to at least the subset of the identified units of execution and to facilitate bloat reduction actions with respect to units of execution of the subset of identified units of execution.

title: Pattern recognition system for sensor calibration in autonomous vehicles
abstract: An autonomy computing system for sensor calibration in an autonomous vehicle is provided. The autonomy computing system includes a processor and a memory in communication with the processor. The processor is programmed to retrieve reference data indicating at least one baseline parameter, receive sensor data from at least one sensor of the autonomous vehicle during operation of the autonomous vehicle, the sensor data indicating at least one measured parameter, identify at least one calibration error of the at least one sensor by comparing the at least one measured parameter to the at least one baseline parameter, generate a record in the memory including the at least one calibration error, and control operation of the autonomous vehicle based on the at least one calibration error.

title: Method for treating acute ischemic stroke
abstract: The present invention is directed to a method of treating acute ischemic stroke in a human comprising administering one of more low doses of DC009, wherein the dose is about 0.01-0.075 mg/kg/dose. The low dose administration is safe and effective in treating acute ischemic stroke in a human subject.

title: Method for producing carbon nanotube dispersion paste and method for producing mixture paste for lithium ion secondary battery
abstract: A method is for producing a carbon nanotube dispersion paste obtained by mixing and dispersing components including a pigment dispersing resin (A), a carbon nanotube (B), N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone (C), and an amine compound (D), wherein the pigment dispersing resin (A) has at least one polar functional group selected from the group consisting of an amide group, an imide group, a hydroxyl group, a carboxyl group, a sulfonic acid group, a phosphoric acid group, a silanol group, a cyano group, a pyrrolidone group, and an amino group, and the pigment dispersing resin (A) has a polar functional group concentration of 0.3 mmol/g or more and 23 mmol/g or less, and when a boiling point of the N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone (C) is (Xc)° C., and a boiling point of the amine compound (D) is (Xd)° C., (Xc)−10> (Xd) holds.

title: Wireless communication device, wireless communication system, communication control method, and non-transitory computer-readable medium
abstract: A wireless communication device includes a memory configured to store instructions, and a processor configured to execute the instructions to receive an orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) signal from a communication target, estimate an entire spread of a pilot signal of the OTFS signal by using data near a center of the pilot signal, extrapolate a reference signal (CIR-RS) by using a result of the estimation, and perform channel estimation with the extrapolated signal.

title: Image forming apparatus and image forming method
abstract: An image forming apparatus includes a fixing device that fixes toner on a recording medium to form a toner image and processing circuitry. The processing circuitry receives and analyzes print data in a monochrome mode to generate image data. The print data includes a drawing command. The processing circuitry calculates an image area rate per page of the recording medium based on the print data in the monochrome mode, determines that the image area rate is not greater than a predetermined value, determines a preset fixing temperature of the fixing device according to the image area rate, and controls the fixing device to fix the toner on the recording medium according to the image data.

title: Gel compositions and related methods
abstract: Compositions and related methods are described. The composition may include a polysaccharide, a crosslinker, and an imaging agent. For example, the composition may include from about 0.1 wt% to about 25 wt% of an imaging agent, based on a total weight of the composition. The polysaccharide may include chitosan or gellan gum. The imaging agent may include a radiopaque material or an echogenic material. The composition may be biocompatible and formulated as a gel.

title: Methods of diagnosing and treating patients with cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods for predicting the risk of local recurrence and/or metastasis, or both in primary cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC).

title: Unique content descriptors system and method
abstract: A method includes detecting indicators of actions and inactions of a user device communicatively connected to a data communications network, delivering the indicators to a descriptor generator communicatively connected to the data communications network, and transforming the indicators to a prompt of respective unique descriptor for the user device. The transforming may include calculations or decisions by the descriptor generator that relate to behaviors (actions and inactions of the user device, gender or identity of the user of the user device, geographic locale of the user device or user, past and present situation of the user device or user, other indicia, behavioral indicators of similarly postured user devices, other societal experiences and norms indicative of and relevant to the user and user device, and other indicia, and combinations of these). The unique descriptor is prompt to a generative learning engine, to provide contextualized response for display and other output or operations of the user device.

title: Indication methods, apparatuses, device and storage medium
abstract: An indication method is performed by a terminal. The method includes: sending indication information to a network device, wherein the indication information indicates a usage of a transmission occasion (TO) in a specific time window, and the usage includes a used status or an unused status.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Stabilized solid garnet electrolyte and methods thereof
abstract: An air stable solid garnet composition, comprising: a bulk composition and a surface protonated composition on at least a portion of the bulk composition as defined herein, and the protonated surface composition is present on at least a portion of the exterior surface of the bulk composition at a thickness of from 0.1 to 10,000 nm. Also disclosed is a composite electrolyte structure, and methods of making and using the composition and the composite electrolyte structure.

title: Communication method and communication apparatus
abstract: An access network device receives a first protocol data unit (PDU) set, where the first PDU set includes at least two data packet sets, each data packet set includes at least one first data packet and at least one second data packet, and the at least one second data packet is a redundant data packet of the at least one first data packet. The access network device sends the first PDU set when a transmission parameter of each data packet set in the first PDU set is less than a corresponding first threshold. This ensures that redundancy-based integrity transmission of a PDU set can be implemented when the PDU set is in different FEC redundancy addition modes.

title: Semiconductor structure including a guard ring and methods for forming the same
abstract: A semiconductor structure includes a lower redistribution layer (RDL) structure, a lower molded portion including an interconnect die on the lower RDL structure, an upper RDL structure on the lower molded portion, and a guard ring including a lower RDL portion in the lower RDL structure, a lower via portion in the lower molded portion, and an upper RDL portion in the upper RDL structure.

title: Electrode active material, method for preparing the same, electrode plate, and battery
abstract:
Provided are an electrode active material, a method for preparing the electrode active material, an electrode plate, and a battery. The electrode active material includes carbon-coated metal oxide particles. The metal oxide particles satisfy a formula (2): 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     where element A is selected from one or more of alkali metal elements or alkaline earth metal elements; element M is selected from one or more of transition metal elements having a relative atomic mass smaller than 65; and c>0, d>0, and e>0.

title: Wire bonding method and apparatus for electromagnetic interference shielding
abstract: Apparatuses relating generally to a microelectronic package having protection from electromagnetic interference are disclosed. In an apparatus thereof, a platform has an upper surface and a lower surface opposite the upper surface and has a ground plane. A microelectronic device is coupled to the upper surface of the platform. Wire bond wires are coupled to the ground plane with a pitch. The wire bond wires extend away from the upper surface of the platform with upper ends of the wire bond wires extending above an upper surface of the microelectronic device. The wire bond wires are spaced apart from one another to provide a fence-like perimeter to provide an interference shielding cage. A conductive layer is coupled to at least a subset of the upper ends of the wire bond wires for electrical conductivity to provide a conductive shielding layer to cover the interference shielding cage.
