abstract: A wheel for a movable irrigation system includes a center disc mounted for rotation about a wheel axis and a plurality of pads mounted to the center disc at positions on an outer periphery of the center disc. Each pad is mounted to the outer periphery of the center disc so as to enable the pad to pivot about a first pivot axis that is parallel to the wheel axis and to deflect laterally about a second pivot axis that is perpendicular to the wheel axis. In one example, each pivot pad is mounted to the center disc by a pivot pin extending through a pivot tube that enables the pad to pivot about the first pivot axis, and the pivot pin is captured in an elastomeric bushing disposed within the pivot tube that enables the pad to deflect about the second pivot axis.

title: Ferroelectric memory devices and operation methods thereof
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods for manufacturing and operating a ferroelectric memory device are provided. In one aspect, a semiconductor device includes a ferroelectric memory cell, including: a first conductive layer; a dielectric layer in contact with the first conductive layer; a channel layer in contact with the dielectric layer; a ferroelectric layer in contact with the channel layer; and a second conductive layer in contact with the ferroelectric layer, where the channel layer is between the first conductive layer and the second conductive layer, and the ferroelectric layer is between the channel layer and the second conductive layer.

title: Hand-local predictive tactile actuation gate for artificial intelligence (ai) controlled dexterous robotic manipulation
abstract: A robotic hand module includes a host-attachment interface, hand command interface, articulated digits, tactile sensors, finger actuators, finger-actuator interface, and hand local predictive tactile validator. A candidate grasp command from an upstream control system is intercepted before corresponding finger actuation. The validator predicts a tactile consequence based on tactile context, object information, actuator state, calibration data, wear state data, or contact history. A grip release controller compares the predicted tactile consequence with a grip-safety policy and selectively releases, modifies, delays, decomposes, or blocks the command before execution. The module may operate in a centralized humanoid robot or as a vendor-agnostic component, with validation performed locally, at a robot brain or fleet level, or at a remote data center.

title: Antigen binding polypeptides, antigen binding polypeptide complexes and methods of use thereof
abstract: Disclosed are antigen binding polypeptides and antigen binding polypeptide complexes (e.g., antibodies and antigen binding fragments thereof) having certain structural features. Also disclosed are polynucleotides and vectors encoding such polypeptides and polypeptide complexes; host cells; chimeric antigen receptors (CARs); immune cells; pharmaceutical compositions and kits containing such polypeptides and polypeptide complexes; and methods of using such polypeptides and polypeptide complexes.

title: Thrombus removal systems and associated methods
abstract: The present technology relates to systems and methods for removing a thrombus from a blood vessel of a patient. In some embodiments, the present technology is directed to systems including an elongated catheter having a distal portion configured to be positioned within the blood vessel of the patient, a proximal portion configured to be external to the patient, and a lumen extending therebetween. The system can also include an imaging element at the distal portion, an illumination source at the distal portion, a capture element at the distal portion and configured to engage the thrombus, a fluid delivery mechanism within the lumen and configured to apply fluid to (1) at least partially fragment the thrombus and (2) provide an optical path for the imaging element, and an aspiration mechanism fluidly coupled to the lumen and configured to aspirate the fragmented thrombus.

title: Method and apparatus for time-domain resource selection for uplink transmission in-wireless communication
abstract: A first node receives a first information block and first signaling and sends a first signal in a first time sub-window group in a first time pool. The first information block is used to determine a reference time domain resource set. The first signaling indicates scheduling information of the first signal and is used for determining the first time pool. The first time pool includes multiple symbols. A reference symbol group is used for determining the first time sub-window group, and the reference symbol group depends on whether the first time pool and the reference time domain resource set overlap. When the first time pool is orthogonal to the reference time domain resource set, the reference symbol group is a first symbol group. When the first time pool belongs to the reference time domain resource set, the reference symbol group is a second symbol group.

title: Accommodation apparatus for freezing target
abstract: An accommodation apparatus for a freezing target includes an accommodation unit accommodating a freezing target and a shaft member detachably coupled to the accommodation unit, and has a configuration in which, in a state where the shaft member is coupled to the accommodation unit stored in a freezing container, the accommodation unit is put into and taken out from the freezing container by using the shaft member. The accommodation unit includes: a first accommodation unit accommodating a first freezing target and provided with a first coupled portion to which a part of the shaft member is detachably coupled; and a second accommodation unit accommodating a second freezing target, provided with a second coupled portion to which a part of the shaft member is detachably coupled, and arranged above the first accommodation unit in a state of being stored in the freezing container. The accommodation apparatus has a configuration in which, in a state where the second accommodation unit is arranged above the first accommodation unit, the first accommodation unit and the second accommodation unit are taken out collectively by coupling the shaft member to the first coupled portion.

title: Air conditioner
abstract: An air conditioner includes a blowing fan, a housing to accommodate the blowing fan, the housing including a first surface, a second surface, a third surface, a fourth surface, an intake port formed on the first surface, the second surface, the third surface, and the fourth surface, and an electrostatic precipitator accommodated in the housing. The electrostatic precipitator includes a dust collecting electrode configured to capture aerosols from air introduced into the housing by the blowing fan, a discharging electrode configured to generate ions toward the intake port and positioned upstream of the dust collecting electrode, an electric field induction electrode grounded to form an electric field with the discharging electrode and positioned upstream of the discharging electrode, and a grounding electrode positioned downstream of the discharging electrode and upstream of the dust collecting electrode so that the ions are attached thereto.

title: Method of cleaning, support, and cleaning apparatus
abstract: A method of cleaning includes placing a semiconductor device manufacturing tool component made of quartz on a support. A cleaning fluid inlet line is attached to a first open-ended tubular quartz projection extending from an outer main surface of the semiconductor device manufacturing tool component. A cleaning fluid is applied to the semiconductor device manufacturing tool component by introducing the cleaning fluid through the cleaning fluid inlet line and the tubular quartz projection.

title: Light scattering measurement based on multiple light sources
abstract: An apparatus includes first and second light sources, a light detector having a detector output, and a processing circuit having a processing input coupled to the detector output and a processing output. The first light source is configured to generate a first light signal having a first wavelength. The second light source is configured to generate a second light signal having a second wavelength. The light detector is configured to generate a first detection signal at the detector output responsive to the first light signal and a second detection signal at the detector output responsive to the second light signal. The processing circuit is configured to generate a third signal representative of an air quality measurement at the processing output responsive to the first and second detection signals.

title: Semiconductor package and electronic system including the same
abstract: A semiconductor package includes a package substrate including a substrate base, an upper solder resist layer covering the upper surface of the substrate base, and a lower solder resist layer covering the lower surface of the substrate base, at least one semiconductor chip attached onto the package substrate, a molding layer covering the upper surface of the package substrate and surrounding the at least one semiconductor chip, and an electromagnetic wave shielding layer covering the package substrate and the molding layer, in which a lower surface of the lower solder resist layer has a first lower surface region having a first arithmetic average roughness and a second lower surface region having a second arithmetic average roughness that is less than the first arithmetic average roughness.

title: Billiards Pool Cue Chalk Locking Holder
abstract: A billiards chalk holder and holster combination configured with a clip for attachment to a user's belt or waistband, wherein the holder is retained within a five-sided cavity formed by opposing sidewalls, a U-shaped bottom, and top ridges. The holder is releasable in a single upward direction, preventing unintended removal while allowing quick insertion and removal during gameplay.

title: Vortex tube cooling system for data centers
abstract: A cooling system for managing thermal conditions in a data center is disclosed. The system comprises a high-pressure air pipeline integrated into a server rack, at least one vortex tube cooler connected to the high-pressure air pipeline, a cold airflow distribution assembly, and a hot airflow exhaust assembly. The vortex tube cooler is configured to generate a cold airflow and a hot airflow from the supplied compressed air. The cold airflow distribution assembly directs the cold airflow toward the intake fans of servers positioned in the server rack, ensuring efficient and even cooling without direct thermal shock to electronic components. The hot airflow exhaust assembly vents the hot airflow away from the server rack, preventing localized heat buildup.

title: Supply-chain characteristic-vectors merchandising system and methods
abstract: In some configurations, a supply-chain characteristic-vectors merchandising system and a method for an environmental characteristic-vectors of a gas communicating from an upstream amenity to a downstream amenity in a supply-chain may be disclosed. The system may be configured to track oil and/or gas throughout the supply-chain by associating characteristic-vectors (e.g., environmental, operational, physical etc.) of the upstream amenity and the downstream amenity with the energy units of the gas transmitted through the supply-chain.

title: Method for phase tracking reference signal transmission for uplink multi-codeword based operation
abstract: Methods and devices in a wireless network determine one or more of a number of phase tracking reference signals, PT-RS, a time-domain density thereof and PT-RS associated port(s). Control signaling for configuring a multi-codeword transmission of at least one PT-RS is transmitted from a network entity to a UE and includes parameters for identifying one or more ports to be used by the UE for transmitting the PT-RS.

title: Rope restraining and selective release device
abstract: A rope restraining and selective release device is provided that may be incorporated with a carabiner or other device for selective interconnection to an anchor. The device employs a selectively rotatable cam lever with a plurality of teeth and gripping geometry that cooperates with the corresponding geometry in a rope cradle to restrain a rope. Tension in the rope will allow it to pass through the device in one direction, but tension in the opposite direction will prevent rope movement through the device.

title: System for analyzing call data
abstract: The present disclosure is a system that utilizes call data in a telephone service using SIP communication. A metadata collection unit collects metadata such as caller information and call duration of a call in real time, and a speech recognition unit converts speech data of the call into text. A natural language processing unit analyzes the content converted into text and performs keyword extraction and sentiment analysis. A data storage unit securely stores the analysis results, and a visual dashboard unit visualizes the results. An AI processing unit learns from past data and performs customer behavior prediction and suggestion to an operator.

title: Machine learning for period end close for disparate entities
abstract: In an example embodiment, a software solution is provided that automates various aspects of a Period End Close (PEC) process and its evaluation. This provides a proactive and autonomous system that addresses complications that occur with prior art ERP systems involving PEC activities and provides graphical user interfaces for interacting with the system.

title: Method for locating user equipment, network device, user equipment, and storage medium
abstract: A method for locating a UE includes: acquiring a relative location between an assistant UE and a target UE, reported by the assistant UE, and determining a location of the target UE based on a location of the assistant UE and the relative location.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Separator, preparation method thereof and electrochemical device including the same
abstract: A separator according to an aspect of the present disclosure includes a polyolefin-based substrate having a thickness of about 8 μm or less. The polyolefin-based substrate has a maximum pore size of about 150 nm or less.

title: Disposable injection needle
abstract: A disposable injection needle including: a needle seat, a shell, an inner sheath, an inner core, a first spring, a second spring, and a tail sheath. The tail sheath is disposed at a second end of the needle seat and has a tail sheath hole for the needle tube to pass through. The tail sheath includes an extension member extending substantially in an axial direction, and the tail sheath has a first axial position and a second axial position along the axial extension direction. In the first axial position, the second end of the needle tube is exposed from the tail sheath hole, and in the second axial position, the second end of the needle tube is not exposed from the tail sheath hole. The needle provides rear-end protection for the injection needle to prevent the needle tip from being exposed at the rear end of the injection needle.

title: Methods of detecting and quantifying autoantibodies against neuronal antigens
abstract: Disclosed herein is a method of identifying and treating a subject having autoimmune encephalitis (AE). The method includes steps of (1) detecting an autoantibody against a neuronal antigen in a biological sample obtained from the subject, in which the neuronal antigen may be N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR), α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazoleproprionic acid receptor (AMPAR), gamma-aminobutyric acid receptor (GABAR), contactin-associated protein-like 2 (Caspr2), leucine-rich glioma inactivated protein 1 (LGI1), or dipeptidyl-peptidase-like protein 6 (DPPX); and (2) treating the subject by administering solumedrol or immunoglobulin (Ig) to the subject to ameliorate symptoms associated with AE.

title: High-hole-expansion-rate and ultrahigh-plasticity steel and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: The present invention provides a steel with high hole expansion rate and ultrahigh plasticity and a manufacturing method therefor. The steel comprises the following components in percentage by weight: C: 0.10~0.35%, Si: 0.8~2.0%, Mn: 1.0~2.5%, P≤0.02%, S≤0.005%, Al: 0.01~0.1%, N≤0.005%, V: 0.10~0.50%, O≤0.003%, with the balance being Fe and other inevitable impurities. The steel of the present invention has excellent mechanical properties, exhibits a good matching among yield strength, tensile strength, elongation and hole expansion rate, and can be widely applied to components with complex shape requirements, or other parts that require thinning while maintaining high strength, such as those in commercial or passenger vehicles.

title: Inspection system and method for determining the microstructure for a coating
abstract: A method for determining a microstructure of a coating on a component. The method includes projecting at least a first electromagnetic signal in a first plane of polarization onto the coating and a second electromagnetic signal in a second plane of polarization onto the coating. A first and second time delay can be determined. The microstructure of the coating is based on a difference between at least two time delays.

title: Generating and securely transferring aircraft maintenance and operations data
abstract: A computer implemented method including: receiving a history database file and a public key of a public/private key pair from an external server; generating aircraft maintenance and operations data using one or more onboard sensors that are configured to sense one or more characteristics of aircraft maintenance and operations systems; classifying the generated aircraft maintenance and operations data as selected data and unselected data based on a comparison of the sensed aircraft maintenance and operations data with stored aircraft maintenance and operations data of a trained aircraft data model; storing the selected data in the received history database file; encrypting the received history database file using the received public key of the public/private key pair to generate an encrypted history database file including selected data; transmitting the encrypted history database file including the selected data to an external server.

title: Systems and methods for making syngas
abstract: Systems and methods for making syngas using a carbonaceous material, including organic material and/or polymeric material such as ground tire, wood, coal, and the like. The systems and methods may heat the carbonaceous material before syngas formation and be configured to use less oxygen than conventional syngas synthesis systems. Systems and methods including maintaining the mixture of gases at an elevated temperature while flowing gases along a tortuous reaction zone having a nonlinear path downstream of a reaction area.

title: Deployable robotic arm
abstract: A robotic arm system comprising a deployment system or a base, a first joint, and a manipulator coupled to the deployment system or base at the first joint and movable relative to the deployment link or base about the first joint. The manipulator includes a manipulator link, a second joint coupled to the manipulator link distal from the first joint, an elevation linkage coupled to the manipulator link at the second joint, a wrist coupled to the elevation linkage distal from the second joint, and an end effector coupled to the wrist. The end effector can change elevation via the elevation link without changing orientation.

title: Method for preparing foam molded parts with coated particles
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for the preparation of a particle foam molded part comprising fusing coated foam particles by supplying energy at least partially through an electromagnetic field with a frequency in the range from 1 MHz to 100 MHz, wherein the coated foam particles comprise a polymeric coating selected from the group consisting of acrylic polymers, styrene-acrylic polymers, vinylester polymers, ethylene vinylester polymers, styrene butadiene polymers, polyester polymers, polyamide polymers, polyolefin polymers, polyurethane polymers, polyurethane-polyacrylate hybrid polymers and polyurethane-polystyrene-butadiene hybrid polymers. The invention is further directed to the molded part obtained in the process as well as the use thereof in shoe soles, part of shoe soles, shoe intermediate soles shoe insoles, damping elements, cushioning elements, underlays, grips, flooring, mattresses, sporting goods, bicycle saddles, tires and in automotive interiors and exteriors.

title: Systems and methods for vehicle localization using adaptive filtering and a standard map
abstract: Systems, methods, and other embodiments described herein relate to adapting a filter for a particle set using sensor data and localizing vehicle position from the particle set using a standard map. In one embodiment, a method includes sampling a particle set representing vehicle position associated with a vehicle using a distribution model according to a road structure and a map about a road. The method also includes adapting a filter for the particle set from vehicle motion associated with the vehicle using sensor data, the particle set is associated with the road. The method also includes weighting the particle set using the sensor data. The method also includes controlling the vehicle on the road using a localized position derived from the particle set.

title: In-Vehicle Display System
abstract: A display system that is configured for integration into a vehicle comprises a light source and an optical subsystem optically coupled to the light source. The optical subsystem includes a reflector and at least one semi-reflective optic, wherein the optical subsystem is configured to direct light rays to provide a plurality of virtual images that appear to a viewer concurrently at a respective plurality of different optical depths, by causing light of each of the virtual images to travel a different distance within the optical subsystem before exiting the optical subsystem on a path toward eyes of the viewer.

title: Semiconductor Device and Method of Making a Solder Wall for Photonics Protection
abstract: A semiconductor device has a build-up interconnect structure with an opening formed through the build-up interconnect structure. A semiconductor die includes a photonic circuit. A solder wall is formed on the semiconductor die around the photonic circuit. The semiconductor die is disposed over the build-up interconnect structure with the photonic circuit aligned to the opening. An underfill or encapsulant is disposed between the build-up interconnect structure and semiconductor die.

title: Mass spectrometric analysis
abstract: Isotopic mass tags for labelling peptides and other biomolecules are provided as well as methods of detecting an analyte by identifying by mass spectrometry one or more of the mass labels or combinations thereof.

title: Busbar connector with integrated power management
abstract: According to an aspect of the present disclosure, a power management module configured for powering a server tray is provided. In an example embodiment, the power management module includes a housing; a busbar connector extending from a first side of the housing; power management circuitry; and a tray connector accessible via a second side of the housing. The power management circuitry includes at least one fuse component, and is in electrical communication with the busbar connector. The tray connector is configured to provide electrical power to the server tray.

title: Method for reducing chlorophyll degradation in a plant
abstract: A gene regulating chlorophyll degradation and coloration in okra and its applications, in the field of fruit and vegetable preservation. Through transcriptome data analysis of okra with gibberellic acid (GA) treatment, an ERF (Ethylene Response Factors) transcription factor, AeABR1 was identified. Subsequently, by constructing transiently expressed okra and transgenic  Arabidopsis thaliana  lines, it was confirmed that the AeABR1 gene positively regulates chlorophyll degradation in okra. Real-time quantitative fluorescence PCR (RT-qPCR) and dual luciferase assays demonstrated that AeABR1 protein reduces chlorophyll content of okra by down-regulating the expression of chlorophyll degradation gene AeCLH1, thereby participating in post-harvest color regulation. This provides preliminary insights into the molecular mechanism of AeABR1, offering a novel target gene and theoretical foundation for post-harvest preservation of okra.

title: Method, apparatus, and medium for video processing
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a solution for video processing. A method for video processing is proposed. The method comprises: clipping, for a conversion between a current video block of a video and a bitstream of the video, a value of a first sample associated with the current video block by using a clipping operation, at least one parameter for the clipping operation being indicated in the bitstream and the at least one parameter comprising at least one of an upper limit value or a lower limit value; and performing the conversion based on the clipped value.
assignee: Douyin Vision Co., Ltd.; Bytedance Inc.

title: Method of making semiconductor device having a redistribution line
abstract: A method of making a semiconductor device includes depositing a first passivation layer over an interconnect structure. The method further includes forming a post passivation interconnect (PPI) line over the first passivation layer. The method further includes depositing a second passivation layer over the PPI line, wherein the second passivation layer is configured to exert stress on the PPI line to form a top-most portion of the PPI line having a first portion having a convex shape, a second portion having a concave shape, and a third portion having the convex shape.

title: Electrolyte solution for hybrid electrolytic capacitors and hybrid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: The present invention relates to a hybrid electrolytic capacitor electrolyte solution containing an aromatic carboxylic acid (A) having a substituent with two or more carbon atoms, the carboxylic acid (A) having an acid dissociation constant (pKa) of 1.0 to 4.5 as determined by the following measurement method. Measurement method: At 25° C., a 0.1 mol/L methanolic potassium hydroxide solution is added dropwise to a solution consisting of 1 part by weight of the carboxylic acid (A) and 99 parts by weight of methanol to obtain a titration curve having inflection points; among the inflection points, an inflection point at which an amount of titrant added is the smallest is defined as an equivalence point; and a pH at half the amount of titrant added at the equivalence point is defined as the acid dissociation constant (pKa) of the carboxylic acid (A).

title: System and method for operating a digital twin of a communications system
abstract: Provided is a method performed by a computer system, the computer system serving as a host in a communications system and comprising a simulation engine, the method comprising: receiving, from the communications system, operational information related to the communications system; generating, using the operational information, a digital twin, the digital twin representative of the communications system; receiving, from the communications system, network traffic data; and simulating, using the digital twin and the network traffic data, one or more behaviours of the communications system.

title: Electronic device and non-transitory computer readable medium
abstract: A foldable device with a folding portion comprises a processor, a first display, and a second display. The processor is configured control to display different applications on the second display and in response to detecting a contact operation by a user on one of the applications displayed on the second display and detecting a change in a folding angle of the folding portion, control to display, on the first display, a last application of the applications operated by the user before the device is closed.

title: Wireless transmission of samples encoded using spread spectrum video transport
abstract: A wireless transmitter and antenna are provided on the transmit side, and a receiver and an antenna are provided on the receive side. A transmitter receives samples from a video source via media signals, permutes the input samples into input vectors, and encodes each input vector with reference to a set of orthogonal codes to produce analog SSVT signals per encoder. The wireless transmitter modulates the SSVT signals generated by the SSVT transmitter onto one or more carrier frequency signals. Once modulated, the carrier frequency signals are then broadcast by the antenna. On the receive side, the antenna receives the broadcast and provides the modulated carrier signals to the wireless receiver. In response, the wireless receiver demodulates the carrier frequency signals and produces the corresponding analog SSVT signals, which are then decoded into reconstructions of the input media samples into output vectors, which are then permuted into output samples that are sent to a video sink for display.

title: Gradation adjustment method and electronic device
abstract: This application discloses a gradation adjustment method and an electronic device, and relates to the field of display technologies. The method includes: displaying a first window of a first application at a first moment, where a gradation of the electronic device at the first moment is a first gradation; and displaying a second window of a second application at a second moment in response to a first window switching operation input by a user, where the gradation of the electronic device changes to a second gradation after the second window is displayed, and the second gradation is lower than the first gradation. The gradation of the electronic device changes to the first gradation at a third moment that is first duration after the second moment.

title: Pesticidally active heterocyclic derivatives with sulfur containing substituents
abstract: Compounds of the formula (I), wherein the substituents are as defined in claim  1 . Furthermore, the present invention relates to agrochemical compositions which comprise compounds of formula (I), to preparation of these compositions, and to the use of the compounds or compositions in agriculture or horticulture for combating, preventing or controlling animal pests, including arthropods and in particular insects, molluscs, nematodes or representatives of the order Acarina.

title: Power converter with capacitor embedded connector
abstract: A power converter has an inductor unit disposed on a base substrate, and a connector vertically disposed on the base substrate. The inductor unit has an output inductor electrically connected to a switch node formed by a pair of switches. The connector has a substrate which is perpendicular to the base substrate, and a plurality of capacitors attached to the substrate.

title: Optical System
abstract: An optical system includes a lightguide and an image projecting arrangement. The image projecting arrangement includes a polarizing-beam-splitter prism having a diagonal polarizing beam splitter surface reflecting light from an image-generating matrix to reflective collimating optics. A coupling prism is deployed between the polarizing beam splitter surface and a lightguide entrance, providing a coupling surface that is coplanar with, or parallel to, one of the parallel major surfaces of the lightguide. A reference length RL is defined as a distance along the optical axis from a principal plane of the collimating optics to the polarizing beam splitter surface. Both a first light path from the image plane to the principal plane and a second light path from the principal plane to the lightguide entrance have a length less than 3×RL.

title: Automatic root cause and corrective action identification system and method based on incident records
abstract: Disclosed herein is a machine learning based system and method for root cause identification and corrective action recommendation to address various workplace incidents. An example system may include a computing device configured to identify fields included in a received incident record in connection with a set of predetermined field descriptors to generate a textual description of the incident record, instruct LLM(s) to determine at least one root cause and corrective action based least upon the textual description of the incident record and a root cause superset that represents a plurality of root causes, and generate data for a display device to indicate the at least one root cause and corrective action.

title: Coated barrier paper
abstract: The present disclosure provides a coated paper product comprising: —a paper substrate comprising a first and a second side; —a first coating layer on the first side of the paper substrate comprising a binder; and—a second coating layer on the first coating layer, wherein the second coating layer comprises polyvinyl alcohol (PVOH) and/or ethylene vinyl alcohol (EVOH); —a third coating layer on the second coating layer, wherein the third coating layer comprises talc and ethylene-acrylic acid (EAA) or talc and a polyolefin, and wherein the dry weight ratio of EAA or polyolefin to talc in the third coating layer is between 100:5 and 100:70.

title: Systems and methods for alignment of the eye for ocular imaging
abstract: An ocular alignment system for aligning a subject’s eye with an optical axis of an ocular imaging device comprising one or more guide light and one or more baffle configured to mask the one or more guide light from view of the subject such that the one or more guide light is only visible to the subject when the eye of the subject is aligned with the optical axis of an ocular imaging system.

title: Multilayer ceramic electronic component
abstract: A multilayer ceramic electronic component is provided and includes a body including a plurality of dielectric layers and a plurality of internal electrode layers that are alternately laminated along a first axis. The internal electrode layers are drawn outward from both ends of the body along a second axis orthogonal to the first axis. The body includes side margins at both ends of the body along a third axis orthogonal to the first axis and the second axis. At least one of the side margins includes one or more secondary phases connecting an outer surface of a capacitor portion to an outer surface of the at least one of the side margins. The capacitor portion includes the internal electrode layers and the dielectric layers that are alternately laminated.

title: Light emitting element and display device including the same
abstract: A light emitting element includes a light emitting element core including a first area and a second area surrounding the first area. The light emitting element core includes a first semiconductor layer doped with a first dopant, a second semiconductor layer disposed on the first semiconductor layer and doped with a second dopant, an element active layer disposed between the first semiconductor layer and the second semiconductor layer; and a third semiconductor layer disposed between the element active layer and the second semiconductor layer and doped with the second dopant. The second area of the light emitting element core is located on an outer circumference of the light emitting element core and includes an outer surface of the light emitting element core. A doping concentration of the second dopant of the third semiconductor layer is lower than a defect density of the second area of the light emitting element core.

title: Prioritizing records of events detected by a security system
abstract: In some embodiments, a security system may generate a first record including first data about detection of a first person in a first image and a second record including second data about detection of a second person in a second image. The security system may determine, based at least in part on first and second data, priorities for the first and second records, and may determine, based at least in part on the priorities, an order in which to process the first and second records. Based at least in part on the order, the security system may process the first record via a first monitoring application prior to processing the second record via a second monitoring application.

title: Alkaline phosphatase for use in treating acute-on-chronic kidney injury
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the use of alkaline phosphatases, and in particular improved alkaline phosphatases such as RecAP, for the prevention, treatment, cure, or amelioration of the symptoms of acute kidney injury on top of chronic kidney injury. The application relates to alkaline phosphatase for use in methods of preserving renal function, shortening the duration of renal replacement therapy, preserving the creatinine clearance, decreasing the risk of death in subjects with acute kidney injury on top of chronic kidney injury.

title: Torque sensor, sensing method, and stator with reduced crosstalk
abstract: An illustrative stator includes: a first side proximate to a first rotor; and a second side proximate to a second rotor. A first receive coil includes a first main winding positioned on the first side to have a first dominant coupling to the first rotor and a second subordinate coupling to the second rotor, and a first offset winding positioned on the second side to have a second principal coupling to the second rotor to offset the second subordinate coupling. A second receive coil includes a second main winding positioned on the second side to have a second dominant coupling to the second rotor and a first subordinate coupling to the first rotor, and a second offset winding positioned on the first side to have a first principal coupling to the first rotor to offset the first subordinate coupling.

title: Multi-view signal codec
abstract: Embodiments are described which exploit a finding, according to which a higher compression rate or better rate/distortion ratio may be achieved by adopting or predicting second coding parameters used for encoding a second view of the multi-view signal from first coding parameters used in encoding a first view of the multi-view signal. In other words, the inventors found out that the redundancies between views of a multi-view signal are not restricted to the views themselves, such as the video information thereof, but that the coding parameters in parallelly encoding these views show similarities which may be exploited in order to further improve the coding rate.

title: Err modulators
abstract: In one aspect, the present disclosure describes compounds which may be used to modulate the activity of an estrogen receptor-related orphan receptor (EER). Also described are pharmaceutical formulations, methods of synthesis and uses thereof.
assignee: University Of Health Sciences And Pharmacy In St. Louis

title: Immune landscape signatures for ocular inflammation
abstract: The present disclosure relates to gene signatures of AAV-induced inflammatory response useful in gene therapy methods for the identification and treatment of individuals who are candidates to receive, or who have received an rAAV gene therapy treatment, and who have an increased likelihood of AAV-induced inflammation.

title: Seal for a tri-clamp connection, and tri-clamp connection having such a seal
abstract: The present invention relates to a seal for a tri-clamp connection, wherein the tri-clamp connection comprises a first flange of a first conduit end and a second flange of a second conduit end, wherein the seal comprises a sealing body that can be placed onto a first end face of the first flange or onto a second end face of the second flange, wherein the sealing body comprises a fastening portion for the form-fitting connection to the first flange or to the second flange.

title: Power receiving apparatus, power transmitting apparatus, control method, and storage medium
abstract: A power receiving apparatus outputs power wirelessly received from the power transmitting apparatus to a load, and performs processing for updating a parameter used by the power transmitting apparatus for detecting an object different from the power receiving apparatus based on a change in a voltage applied to the load.

title: Model training method and apparatus
abstract: A model training method is provided. The method may be applied to a field of radio access networks. The method includes: receiving model training requirement information sent by a second functional entity, where the model training requirement information includes at least one of the following information: layer quantity information of model training, a maximum value of time used for model training, a data volume used for model training, a maximum value of the data volume used for model training, a minimum value of the data volume used for model training, or a performance threshold for model training; and performing model training based on the model training requirement information. According to the foregoing method, a first functional entity can perform model training based on the model training requirement information in a targeted manner.

title: Stabilizing-focusing motor and application module thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a technical field of camera modules, and in particular to a stabilizing-focusing motor and an application module thereof. The stabilizing-focusing motor includes a stabilizing structure and a focusing structure, where the stabilizing structure includes an outer ball holder, an inner ball holder, balls, a stabilizing magnet, a stabilizing coil, and a stabilizing circuit board; and the focusing structure includes a second magnet holder, a lens carrier, a connecting spring, a focusing magnet, a focusing coil, and a focusing circuit board. The present disclosure can provide a multi-axis degree of freedom (DOF), reduce power consumption and a size of a micro gimbal stabilizer (MGS) camera module, lessen impacts of an attitude error on stabilization performance, make assembly less difficult, and increase a maximum stabilizing angle.

title: Reciprocity-aided interference suppression via eigen beamforming
abstract: A method and network node for reciprocity-aided interference suppression via eigen beamforming are disclosed. According to one aspect, a method includes determining an L×M channel matrix by selecting L rows of an N×M channel matrix or L linear combinations of rows of the N×M channel matrix, M being a number of antennas for downlink transmissions, N being a number of wireless device receiving antennas, L being a number of layers. The method also includes determining an M×M preprocessing matrix based on an eigen-decomposition of an M×M interference covariance matrix. The method further includes determining an M×L RAIT precoder matrix based on an inverse of an L×L matrix, the L×L matrix being based on a first matrix product of the L×M channel matrix, the M×M preprocessing matrix and an M×L Hermitian transpose of the L×M channel matrix.

title: Image capturing apparatuses, processing methods for image capturing apparatuses, and storage mediums
abstract: One or more apparatuses, methods, and storage mediums are provided herein. An image capturing apparatus may include one or more processors that operate to acquire a first timecode generated based on a current time and set the first timecode to a counter; for a predetermined time period or a predetermined number of times, acquire the first timecode which has been generated based on a current time, acquire a second timecode counted by the counter based on the set first timecode, and repeatedly perform processing to compare the first timecode and the second timecode; and add the second timecode counted by the counter to each frame of a captured image, wherein the one or more processors acquire the first timecode generated based on a current time and set the first timecode to the counter according to a result of the comparison performed by the one or more processors.

title: Hybrid amide derivatives of amphotericin b
abstract: Disclosed are C16 amide derivatives of C2′-epi-amphotericin B (C2′epiAmB) and salts thereof, characterized by improved clinical efficacy with reduced toxicity compared to AmB. Also disclosed are pharmaceutical compositions, comprising any of the disclosed compounds or salts thereof, as well as methods of treatment and therapeutic uses of the same.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The University Of Illinois

title: Display device including a touch sensing unit and electronic device using the same
abstract: A display panel displays an image through pixels of a display area. A touch driving circuit detects a touch through a touch sensing unit of the display panel and generates touch coordinate data therefrom. A display driving circuit supplies a data voltage to the pixels of the display area and controls an image display timing of the pixels. A circuit board includes touch lines, ground lines, interface lines, power lines, and option control lines and is electrically in contact with the display panel. A low-resistance film covers an upper surface of the circuit board. The low-resistance film is disposed on an upper surface of the interface lines and corresponds to the interface lines.

title: Pediatric suspension formulation
abstract: The present disclosure relates to storage-stable proton pump inhibitor (PPI) systems comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a PPI or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, such as omeprazole or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, which are constituted with water prior to administration. The present disclosure also relates to oral pharmaceutical suspensions comprising water, a therapeutically effective amount of a PPI or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, such as omeprazole or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and one or more buffering agents.

title: Historical event based determinations
abstract: Various embodiments relate to gaming systems and methods that provide historical event based determinations for game play in a gaming environment. In various such embodiments, the gaming systems and methods provide historical horse race based game play in a gaming environment. In various other embodiments, the gaming systems and methods that provide historical bingo based game play in a gaming environment.

title: Eco base cell structure
abstract: An IC structure includes first through third n-wells aligned in a first direction in a semiconductor substrate, wherein the second n-well is between the first and third n-wells, a first tap structure overlying and electrically connected to the first n-well, second and third tap structures overlying and electrically connected to the second n-well, a fourth tap structure overlying and electrically connected to the third n-well, a first metal segment extending in the first direction, overlying each of the first through fourth tap structures, and electrically connected to each of the first and fourth tap structures, and a second metal segment extending in the first direction and overlying and electrically connected to each of the second and third tap structures
assignee: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Ltd; Tsmc Nanjing Company, Limited

title: Trench cutter
abstract: A trenching device ( 1 ). The trenching device ( 1 ) comprises: a main body ( 11 ); one or more fluid pressurising means; a trench-forming jetting tool ( 14 ) extending from the main body ( 11 ) and comprising one or more primary jetting outlets ( 15 ) along a length of the trench-forming jetting tool ( 14 ); a first fluid flow path ( 41 ) extending between at least one of the one or more fluid pressurising means and the one or more primary jetting outlets ( 15 ); a jetting arm ( 16 ), an end of the jetting arm ( 16 ) being connected to the main body ( 11 ), the jetting arm ( 16 ) comprising one or more secondary jetting outlet ( 165 ); and a second fluid flow path ( 166 ) extending between at least one of the one or more fluid pressurising means and the one or more secondary jetting outlet ( 165 ); The trenching device ( 1 ) has: a primary jetting configuration in which the trenching device ( 1 ) is operable to eject fluid from the one or more primary jetting outlets ( 15 ) at a first pressure, to cut or fluidise material adjacent the trench-forming jetting tool ( 14 ) to form a trench (TR); and a secondary jetting configuration in which the trenching device ( 1 ) is operable to eject fluid from the one or more secondary jetting outlet ( 165 ) at a second pressure, to cut or fluidise material adjacent to the one or more secondary jetting outlet ( 165 ), the second pressure being greater than the first pressure.

title: Sample retrieval tool with compliant retention member
abstract: The embodiments described herein can be used in a variety of sample retrieval, grasping, cutting, and manipulating operations. In some embodiments, an apparatus includes an elongated member and a retention member movably coupled to the elongated member. The elongated member includes a cutting portion configured to cut a target sample when moved, and defines an internal volume within which at least a portion of the target sample can be received. The retention member includes an engagement portion configured to move between a first position and a second position when the retention member is actuated. The engagement portion is configured to extend within the internal volume to exert a force on the target sample within the internal volume when the engagement portion is in the second position.

title: Semiconductor packge
abstract: Provided is a semiconductor package including a first redistribution substrate, a chip stacked structure including a first sub-stack and a second sub-stack arranged on the first sub-stack, wherein the first sub-stack and the second sub-stack includes a plurality of semiconductor chips respectively, a second redistribution substrate arranged on the chip stacked structure, a first sub-stack vertical wiring unit including vertical wires configured to connect each of the semiconductor chips constituting the first sub-stack to the first redistribution substrate and extend to an upper surface of the first redistribution substrate in a vertical direction, and a second sub-stack vertical wiring unit including vertical wires configured to connect each of the semiconductor chips constituting the second sub-stack to the second redistribution substrate and extend to a lower surface of the second redistribution substrate in the vertical direction.

title: Baby carrier
abstract: A baby carrier ( 100 ) that may include a waist belt ( 110 ), a first shoulder strap ( 112 ) and a second shoulder strap ( 114 ). The disclosure may also relate to a harness ( 104 ) for a baby carrier ( 100 ), a main body portion that includes S-shaped opposing lateral edges ( 710 ,  712 ), overlapping panels ( 208 ,  228 ), an adjustable seat panel ( 300 ,  314 ), a buckle arrangement ( 400 ) for a baby carrier ( 100 ), and/or a baby carrier ( 100 ) comprising a shade member ( 540 ).

title: Aerial vehicle with deployable components
abstract: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having wings stowed against a fuselage of the UAV in a first arrangement is disclosed. Methods and systems for deploying the wings into a second arrangement are disclosed. For example, after a launch of the UAV, the UAV monitors for at least one precondition. The at least one pre-condition being a pre-condition associated with deploying wings of the UAV into the second arrangement. Upon detecting the at least one precondition, the wings of the UAV are deployed into a second arrangement. Deploying the wings comprises activating, in response to detecting the at least one precondition associated with the UAV, a gearbox configured to transition the wings from the first arrangement to the second arrangement. Roll control may be maintained throughout launch and deployment.

title: Nitrogenous heterocycles for organic electroluminescent devices
abstract: The present invention relates to nitrogenous heterocycles that are suitable for use in electronic devices, and to electronic devices, in particular organic electroluminescent devices, containing these heterocycles.

title: Methods and compositions for monocot transformation
abstract: Provided herein are polynucleotides encoding recombinant plant transcription factors, the recombinant plant transcription factors, and methods of producing recombinant monocot plants using the recombinant plant transcription factors.

title: Sensor arrays, methods, systems and devices
abstract: A system and method of adding one or more sensors to a road traffic monitoring network includes providing one or more sensor arrays of wireless road-based sensors mounted on, in, or at a surface of a road network, each sensor array including at least three sensors, analysing sensor measurements to determine traffic information including vehicle speed information, identifying from the sensor measurements that one or more sensors have become separated from the road or are otherwise malfunctioning, adding one or more sensors to replace or supplement the one or more sensors that have become separated from the road or are otherwise malfunctioning, and using analysis of received measurements to associate the one or more added sensors with an existing sensor array to restore or maintain redundant operation of the sensor array.

title: Method for controlling a portable computing device in a thermally restricted mode
abstract: A method for controlling a portable computing device is disclosed. The computing device receives an input causing the computing device to start operating in a thermally restricted mode. Upon starting operation in the thermally restricted mode, a temperature difference, ΔT=T dev −T amb , between a surface temperature, T dev , of the computing device and an ambient temperature, T amb , is derived. Computing tasks running on the computing device or scheduled to run on the computing device are prioritized, and for each of the prioritized computing tasks, a thermal impact on the surface temperature, T dev , of the computing device by performing the computing task, is estimated. The computing device is operated by performing computing tasks while taking the priority order of the computing tasks and the thermal impact of the computing tasks into account, and in such a manner that the temperature difference, ΔT, is maintained within a predefined range around zero.

title: Compounds and their use in treating cancer
abstract: A compound of Formula (I): or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein: X 1  is CH or N; p is 0, 1 or 2; where: each R 1  is a substituent on any C atom and is independently selected from F, Cl, C 1-3 alkyl and C 1-3  alkoxy, wherein said C 1-3 alkyl and C 1-3 alkoxy may be independently optionally substituted by one or more F; R N  is selected from H and Me; n is 0, 1 or 2; m is 0 or 1; Q 1  is CH or N; when n & m are both other than 0, Q 2  is CH or N; when n & m are both 0, Q 2  is CH; when n is 0 or 1, Q 3  is CH; when n is 2 and Q 2  is N, Q 3  is CH; when n is 2 and Q 2  is CH, Q 3  is CH or 0; R 2a  and R 2b  are substituents on the same or different C atoms other than at Q 1  or Q 2 , each independently selected from H, F and C 1-3 alkyl, or R 2a  & R 2b  together form a —(CH 2 ) r  group where r is 1, 2 or 3; Q 4  is a single bond or —NR 4 C(═O); R 4  is H or Me; 0, 1 or 2 of Y 1 , Y 2 , Y 3 , Y 4  & Y 5  is/are N, and are otherwise C; each R 3  is a substituent on any C atom at Y 1 , Y 2 , Y 3 , Y 4  & Y 5 , and is independently selected from F, Cl, CN, C 1-3 alkyl and C 1-3  alkoxy, wherein said C 1-3  alkyl and C 1-3  alkoxy may be independently optionally substituted by one or more F; q is 0, 1 or 2; wherein Linker is attached at any available C atom at Y 4  & Y 5 ; Linker is a saturated or a partially or fully unsaturated framework comprising C and H atoms and at least one heteroatom, wherein said framework has end points of attachment ‘a’ and ‘b’ and a length of from 5 to 26 atoms between ‘a’ and ‘b’; wherein said framework may include one or more straight and/or branched chains and/or rings and is optionally substituted on any available C atom(s) by one or more F; and W is an E3 ubiquitin ligase cereblon binder unit.

title: Triangular vivaldi antenna array and antenna system
abstract: Disclosed is an antenna array comprising a plurality of Vivaldi antennas having a respective feed slot and defining a triangular lattice, the antenna array having a feeding side and a radiation side opposite to the feeding side, wherein at least one of the feed slots is open at the feeding side. Also disclosed is an antenna system comprising the antenna array and a feeding unit. The feeding unit comprises a plurality of feeding elements arranged such that, when the feeding unit is arranged in a predefined pose relative to the antenna array, electromagnetic signals can be fed via the plurality of feeding elements into at least one of the plurality of Vivaldi antennas of the antenna array to cause the at least one Vivaldi antenna to emit radio waves.

title: Data Communication Optimizations for Wireless Power Transfer Systems
abstract: A power receiving device can include a wireless power transfer coil configured to receive wireless power from a power transmitting device via inductive coupling between the power transmitting and the power receiving device and can include a data communication transmitter configured to transmit data across the inductive coupling to the power transmitting device in accordance with an amplitude modulation scheme. Data transmission across the inductive coupling can experience variable gain corresponding to a signal frequency of the data transmission. Data transmission across the inductive coupling can be adjusted to accommodate the differences in gain.

title: Cooling device
abstract: A cooling device includes a heat absorbing member, a heat radiating fin provided on the heat absorbing member, and a casing attached to cover the heat radiating fin. The casing includes: an inflow port into which a coolant flows, an outflow port from which the coolant flows out, and a plurality of flow paths, through which the coolant flows. The plurality of flow paths includes at least one downstream flow path communicating with the outflow port and faces the heat radiating fin. The plurality of flow paths is arranged to sandwich the heat radiating fin between the plurality of flow paths.

title: Display panel, method for manufacturing display panel, and electronic device
abstract: The present application discloses a display panel, a method for manufacturing the display panel, and an electronic device. The display panel includes a display layer including a plurality of first light-emitting units which are arranged in an array; one of the plurality of first light-emitting units includes at least one first light-emitting element which emits light of a first color, wherein dominant wavelengths of the plurality of first light-emitting units satisfy: |D 1 −D 2 |>0.
assignee: Tianma Advanced Display Technology Institute (Xiamen) Co., Ltd.

title: Bacterium, composition and method for producing same, and prebiotics composition
abstract: According to the invention, a novel Bifidobacterial strain having an ability of assimilating two or more kinds of HMO is provided. The strain is selected from the group consisting of  Bifidobacterium longum  subspecies  infantis  (NITE BP-03068),  Bifidobacterium bifidum  (NITE BP-03058) and  Bifidobacterium bifidum  (NITE BP-03067).

title: Air suspension system
abstract: The present application discloses an air suspension system, including a frame for mounting a vehicle body, a bridge housing for mounting wheels, and air springs, shock absorbers, a connecting rod frame and a thrust module connected between the frame and the bridge housing. Since the thrust module is standardized, a suitable thrust module can be matched according to different working conditions, thereby making the complex suspension adjustment work lightweight.
assignee: Jilin Weichuang Electromechanical Engineering Co., Ltd.

title: Photovoltaic assembly, photovoltaic power generation device and photovoltaic power generation system
abstract: Please amend as reflected in the following marked-up version of the abstract: photovoltaic assembly, a photovoltaic power generation device and a photovoltaic power generation system are provided. The photovoltaic assembly comprises N cell strings, which are connected in series, wherein a first cell string is not connected in parallel to a bypass module, a second cell string is connected in parallel to a bypass module, there is at least one first cell string that is not provided with a corresponding bypass module, which is connected in parallel thereto, and the total number of cells in the first cell string is not less than the total number of cells in the second cell string, such that an output current of the first cell string is not greater than an output current of the second cell string, and an output voltage of the first cell string is not less than an output voltage of the second cell string.
assignee: Chint New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Satellite-based communication method and apparatus, computer-readable medium, and electronic device
abstract: Embodiments of this application provide a satellite-based communication method performed by an electronic device in a spaceborne base station. The spaceborne base station is deployed on a first satellite and establishes a service link with a user equipment. The electronic device establishes a plurality of communication links between the spaceborne base station and core network elements. In response to a service request from the user equipment via the service link, the electronic device communicates with the core network elements by using a first communication link and when the first communication link is abnormal, communicates with the core network elements by using a second communication link. The technical solutions ensure uninterrupted data transmission between the spaceborne base station and the core network elements, thereby ensuring continuity of key data and services and facilitating construction of a more robust and efficient satellite communication network.

title: Batch processing apparatus, systems, and related methods and structures for epitaxial deposition operations
abstract: The present disclosure relates to batch processing apparatus, systems, and related methods and structures for epitaxial deposition operations. In one implementation, an apparatus for substrate processing includes a cassette. The cassette is at least partially supported by a pedestal assembly. The cassette includes a plurality of levels arranged vertically with respect to each other, each level of the plurality of levels including a support surface configured to support a substrate. A level spacing between adjacent levels of the plurality of levels is 25 mm or higher, and the level spacing is defined between the support surfaces of the adjacent levels.

title: Battery cooling device, battery heat dissipation mechanism, and unmanned aerial vehicle battery charging station
abstract: A battery cooling device includes a liquid storage tank, an atomizer, a battery connecting assembly, and a fan. The liquid storage tank is provided with a liquid storage chamber and an atomization outlet in communication with the liquid storage chamber. The atomizer, disposed in the liquid storage chamber, is configured to atomize liquid in the liquid storage chamber into droplets, so that the droplets flow out through the atomization outlet. The battery connecting assembly is used to carry a battery. The fan is configured to blow the droplets to the battery connecting assembly to cool the battery. Since the droplets vaporize upon contacting the battery in the battery connecting assembly, water vapor is utilized to absorb heat through evaporation.

title: Method of manufacturing welded jointwelded joint, welded joint, method of designing low-temperature liquefied gas tanklow-temperature liquefied gas tank, and low-temperature liquefied gas tank
abstract: A method of manufacturing a welded joint includes: obtaining a thermal stress that occurs in the welded joint due to a difference between a linear expansion coefficient of a weld metal and a linear expansion coefficient of a base metal at a use temperature of a low-temperature liquefied gas tank; obtaining a required CTOD value for preventing the low-temperature liquefied gas tank from undergoing a brittle fracture during an operation of the low-temperature liquefied gas tank by assuming a defect in the welded joint and taking into account an influence of the thermal stress; measuring a CTOD value of a heat-affected zone of the low-temperature liquefied gas tank; and welding the base metal by using a thick steel plate in which the CTOD value of the heat-affected zone is confirmed to be equal to or more than the required CTOD value, as the base metal.

title: Expert-aware retrieval augmented generation
abstract: In various examples, an enhanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system may provide relevant responses to user queries by prioritizing contextually relevant information based on author-related metadata. For instance, the systems and methods of the present disclosure may enrich documents—or portions (e.g., “chunks”) thereof—with metadata indicating an author's role, expertise, or association with a customer or topic. Upon receiving a query, the RAG system may retrieve content using keyword and/or semantic search, and prioritize results based on expert relevance. In some examples, threshold-based filtering or expert relationship graphs may be used to improve retrieval quality and reduce processing costs. Retrieved documents may, in some instances, be broken into smaller parts and summarized in parallel, with intermediate summaries recursively condensed to fit within a language model's context window. A final answer may then be generated using the user query and the refined summary.

title: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device according to the present disclosure includes a semiconductor substrate having an upper surface and a rear surface, a trench being formed in the upper surface; a first gate electrode provided inside the trench; a first insulating film provided between the first gate electrode and a sidewall of the trench; a second gate electrode provided on the first gate electrode inside the trench; a second insulating film provided between the second gate electrode and the sidewall of the trench; and a third insulating film separating the first gate electrode and the second gate electrode, wherein the first insulating film includes an outer insulating film in contact with the semiconductor substrate, and an inner insulating film in contact with the first gate electrode, and a density of interface states of the inner insulating film is higher than a density of interface states of the outer insulating film.

title: Method and apparatus of supporting burst arrival time (bat) reporting
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate to a method and apparatus of supporting burst arrival time (BAT) reporting. An exemplary UE includes: at least one memory; and at least one processor coupled with the at least one memory and configured to cause the UE to: receive, a request of BAT of a QoS flow, from a network side; determine a BAT of the QoS flow, wherein the BAT of the QoS flow is a time value relative to a boundary of a system frame number (SFN); and transmit the determined BAT of the QoS flow to the network side.

title: Identification of grid-invariant operations
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to calculate efficiency metrics associated with performing operations of a software program a first type of processor compared to a second type of processor. In at least one embodiment efficiency metrics associated with performing operations are used to determine whether the operation is to be executed by the first processor type or by the second processor type.

title: Obestatin for use as antineoplastic agent in the treatment of pancreatic cancer
abstract: Obestatin for use as antineoplastic agent in the treatment of pancreatic cancer. The present invention refers to the use obestatin as antineoplastic agent in the treatment of pancreatic cancer.
assignee: Servizo Galego De Saúde; Fundación Pública Galega Instituto De Investigación Sanitaria De Santiago De Compostela; Universidade De Santiago De Compostela

title: Hot Tapping System with Portable Hot Tapping Tools
abstract: A hot tapping system includes a branch pipe portion; a saddle clamp coupled to the pipe portion and to a run line; a valve coupled to the branch pipe portion; and a portable hot tapping tool including a lower housing, intermediate T-housing and upper housing, and a telescoping drive shaft with a drilling bit for selectively breeching the run line and a drive connection, wherein the drive shaft extends longitudinally through the lower housing, intermediate T-housing, and upper housing, with the drive shaft sealed against the upper housing, whereby only the lower housing and intermediate T-housing is pressurized following breeching of the run line; wherein the lower housing is configured to be selectively coupled to the valve, and wherein the intermediate T-housing includes at least a bleed valve for depressurizing the lower housing and intermediate T-housing.

title: Motor drive system, lithography apparatus, and method for manufacturing article
abstract: A motor drive system includes a first driver that receives power from a first power supply and supply power to a first motor, a second driver that receives power from a second power supply and supply power to a second motor, and a setting unit that sets a value of a current supplied from the second power supply to the second driver based on information about driving of the first motor and the second motor.

title: Thermal fluid conveyance manifold and operation thereof
abstract: The disclosed embodiments disclose a thermal-fluid conveyance manifold (TFCM) that includes at least three actuatable valves and a pump that adaptively routes a thermal-energy fluid between a hybrid space-conditioning system (HSCS) and a thermal-energy storage system (TESS) to improve the operation of the HSCS in managing a temperature in a climate-controlled space. During operation, a control mechanism for the TFCM tracks operating characteristics for the HSCS, the TESS, the climate-controlled space, and an environment in proximity to the climate-controlled space that the HSCS uses as a thermal sink and/or a thermal source. The control mechanism uses the tracked operating characteristics and the predicted operating characteristics to adaptively adjust the routing of the thermal-energy fluid through the actuatable valves during the time interval to adaptively transfer energy between the HSCS and the TESS reduce and/or time-shift the watts used by the HSCS to manage the temperature over the time interval.

title: Automated Medical Coding or Electronic Health Record Documentation System Agentic AI
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for automated medical coding by receiving, by a computing system, medical information associated with a patient encounter; analyzing, by the computing system using at least one artificial intelligence model, the medical information to identify clinical concepts present in the medical information; mapping, by the computing system, the identified clinical concepts to one or more standardized medical codes based on at least one coding system; generating, by the computing system, a coding recommendation comprising the one or more standardized medical codes; and storing the one or more standardized medical codes in association with a patient record.

title: Cloud-based laboratory monitoring application
abstract: An embodiment of the present invention is a cloud-based method of laboratory monitoring, comprising: receiving data from one or more gateways to a cloud-based internet application by a Local Area Network, wherein one or more nodes having one or more environmental sensors are connected to the gateway by a Low Power Wide Area Network; displaying, on an electronic display screen, the number of gateways and nodes online; displaying, on an electronic display screen, the locations of gateways and nodes online; displaying, on an electronic display screen, one or more environmental parameters; displaying, on an electronic display screen, one or more alarm indications in the received data; and displaying, on an electronic display screen, one or more door opening indications in the received data.

title: Led spotlight lamp
abstract: An LED spotlight lamp ( 100 ) having a handle ( 130 ) that can be moved or rotated between a folded and an unfolded configuration with respect to a light outputting end of the LED spotlight lamp ( 100 ). When in the unfolded configuration, a gripping portion ( 131 ) of the handle ( 130 ) can be gripped by an individual or person for maneuvering the LED spotlight lamp ( 100 ).

title: Scan driving circuits and electronic devices
abstract: A scan driving circuit of an electronic device includes a first inverter circuit configured to output a first signal to a first node in response to a carry input signal, a first clock signal and a second clock signal, and output a second signal to a second node, the second signal being obtained by inverting the carry input signal, a diode circuit configured to transmit the second signal of the second node to a third node in response to the first signal of the first node, and a second inverter circuit configured to output a scan signal and a carry output signal in response to a third signal of the third node, the scan signal and the carry output signal being complementary signals.

title: Holder for an inhaler article
abstract: A holder for an inhaler article, including: a housing including a housing cavity; a sleeve within the cavity and including a sleeve cavity to receive the article, the sleeve being movable within the housing cavity between first and second positions; a piercing element to pierce the article within the sleeve when the sleeve is moved from the first to second position; a lockout mechanism including first and second lever members of the sleeve and a retaining section of the housing; and a protruding element at a bottom end of the housing cavity, to protrude into a distal end of the article on insertion of the article into the sleeve cavity, the first and second lever members are in a neutral configuration when the article is not in the sleeve, and are to be moved from the neutral into a working configuration when the article is being inserted into the sleeve.

title: Device with flexible communications structure for real-time capable network applications with high data security, in particular automation device, and method for configuration thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a device with a flexible communications structure for real-time capable network applications with high data security, in particular an automation device, and a method for configuration thereof. To support all the market-relevant communications protocols used in automation engineering and enabling single-cycle access at best and kept latency low, the device (AG) has at least one flexible data processing structure integrated in a data controller (DC) and having a cryptography accelerator (KB) and an exchangeable physical interface (PYS) arranged in the device (AG) and connected to communications controller (KC) arranged in a communications processor (KP) via signal lines for transmitting an identification code (ID), control data (ST), receive data (ED) and transmit data (SD) in such a way that processing, filtering and distribution of data streams is implemented with transmission rates in the range from 10 Mbps to 1 Gbps.
assignee: Sebastian Hilscher; Hilscher Gesellschaft für Systemautomation mbH

title: Method for producing hydrogen and apparatus for producing hydrogen
abstract: A method for producing hydrogen comprises providing water and a gaseous substance, the gaseous substance comprising hydrogen atoms and carbon atoms, producing a mixture comprising the water and bubbles comprising the gaseous substance, decreasing a diameter of the bubbles comprising the gaseous substance, and producing gaseous hydrogen by decomposing the gaseous substance in the bubbles having the decreased diameter. An apparatus is configured for producing hydrogen gas.

title: Method for forming metal nitride thin film
abstract: A method for forming a metal nitride thin film according to embodiments includes steps of: introducing a substrate into a process chamber having a processing space formed therein; forming a metal nitride thin film on the substrate by separately supplying a metal precursor gas and a nitrogen-containing gas; performing first surface treatment at least once on the metal nitride thin film by supplying a hydrogen-containing gas to the process chamber and forming a first plasma; and performing second surface treatment at least once on the first surface-treated metal nitride thin film by supplying a nitrogen-containing gas to the process chamber and forming a second plasma.

title: Tile Structures for Multiple Die Tensor Streaming Processors
abstract: Embodiments are directed to an integrated circuit with one or more tile structures. The integrated circuit can include a first die and a second die connected to the first die forming a tile structure. The first die is shifted relative to the second die by a first shift amount along a first dimension and by a second shift amount along a second dimension orthogonal to the first dimension. The integrated circuit can further include an array of tile structures. Each tile structure in the array includes a first die, and a second die connected to the first die in a face-to-face configuration. The first die is shifted relative to the second die by a first shift amount along a first dimension and by a second shift amount along a second dimension orthogonal to the first dimension forming an offset alignment between the first die and the second die.

title: Modular battery tray
abstract: A battery energy storage system can include an enclosure including a panel to provide access to a cavity defined by the enclosure. The battery energy storage system a frame positioned within the cavity. The frame can include a first rail to accommodate a first battery tray coupled with a first battery of a first battery type and a second rail to accommodate a second battery tray coupled with a second battery of a second battery type. A dimension of the first battery type is different than a dimension of the second battery type.

title: Display device and electronic device
