abstract: A display device includes: a light-emitting element connected between a first supply voltage line and a second supply voltage line; a first transistor connected between the light-emitting element and the second supply voltage line, and comprising a gate electrode connected to a first node and a source electrode connected to a second node; a second transistor connected between a data line and a third node; a third transistor connected between the first node and a third supply voltage line; a fourth transistor connected between the third node and the second node; a first capacitor connected between the first node and the third node; and a second capacitor connected between the third node and a first electrode of the light-emitting element.

title: Artificial turf having alloy fibers and the method of manufacture thereof
abstract: An apparatus and a method are described for the present disclosure relating to artificial turf products. The present disclosure includes an artificial turf product comprised of a polyolefin, polyamide, and a binding agent. The three components are mixed together to form a homogenous alloy within an artificial turf fiber. The binding agent allows the polyolefin and the polyamide to combine to create the homogenous alloy. The binding agent may be maleic anhydride, maleic acid, a modified polar star-like high polypropylene, or any other binding agent disclosed herein. To create the homogenous alloy, the unhomogenized mixture of polyolefin, polyamide, and the binding agent is heated. Once the mixture is heated, it may go through an extrusion process. The present disclosure provides a new material in artificial turf products.

title: Tungsten carbide alloy filament and preparation method therefor, and heating device
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of filament cathode materials. Disclosed are a tungsten carbide alloy filament and a preparation method therefor, and a heating device. The tungsten carbide alloy filament comprises a base body ( 100 ) and a carbonization layer ( 200 ) attached to the outer surface of the base body ( 100 ), wherein the grain width of the carbonization layer ( 200 ) is 1.0-15.0 μm; the components of the base body ( 100 ) and the carbonization layer ( 200 ) both comprise tungsten, carbon, oxygen and an M element, the M element being selected from one or a combination of more of La, Y, Sc, Nd, Sm, Lu, Ce, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Pr, Er, Tm, Yb, Eu, Hf and Zr; and the components of the tungsten carbide alloy filament do not contain thorium. The material improves the emission stability of the tungsten alloy filament, and can also reach stable emission capability of a traditional thorium-tungsten filament without adding thorium, thereby solving the problem of relatively poor stable emission capability of an existing thorium-free tungsten filament, and avoiding the radioactive contamination problem of a traditional thorium-tungsten filament.
assignee: Xiamen Honglu Tungsten Molybdenum Industry Co., Ltd.

title: Bone anchor assembly with cannulated screw shank having an annular planar top surface and separate element insertable in receiver
abstract: A bone anchor assembly includes a screw shank with capture portion having a partial spherical shape and an internal drive socket, and an anchor portion configured for fixation to the bone. The assembly also includes a receiver with a channel for receiving a rod and an internal cavity adjacent a bottom opening for receiving the capture portion of the screw shank. The assembly further includes a separate element insertable within the receiver and configured to compressively engage with the capture portion of the screw shank so as to lock the bone anchor assembly with a locking mechanism in a locked configuration. An annular planar top surface on the capture portion of the screw shank is configured to remain spaced apart from the separate element so as to not directly receive a downwardly-directed force from the locking mechanism to result in the locked configuration.

title: Method and apparatus for requesting significant update information from aps within transmission mld in wireless lan system
abstract: Proposed are a method and apparatus for requesting significant update information from APs within a transmission MLD in a wireless LAN system. In detail, a reception MLD transmits a probe request frame to the transmission MLD via a first link. The reception MLD receives a probe response frame from the transmission MLD via the first link. The profile field of the second reception STA includes a first significant update request field. When the first reception STA requests partial information regarding the second link and the first significant update request field is set to 1, the partial information regarding the second link is set as significant update information regarding the second link.

title: Unique and special adjustable radio strap made with nylon webbing or the like and having other features
abstract: A wearable portable radio carrying system includes a radio holster formed from abrasion-resistant and fire-retardant fabric for holding a portable radio, a radio strap with adjustable features including belt sliders, a cobra buckle, mic loops, and spring hooks for quick attachment to the radio holster, and an anti-sway strap with a snap loop and mini cobra buckle to secure the system to a user's belt. The system provides unlimited adjustment, protection from damage, and quick access for first responders. The materials are lightweight, waterproof, mold-resistant, anti-abrasion, and heat-retardant, with optional reflective elements for identification.

title: Design and deployment of multicomponent 1,1-aminosilylation and 1,1-aminoboration reactions
abstract: A process of forming a 1,1-aminosilane includes contacting for a predetermined length of time a mixture comprising an amine, an aldehyde, a sila-borane, and a copper catalyst in a solvent to form the 1,1-aminosilane. Also, a process of forming a 1,1-aminoborane includes contacting for a predetermined length of time a mixture comprising an amine, an aldehyde, bis(pinacolato)diboron (B 2 Pin 2 ), and a copper catalyst in a solvent to form the 1,1-aminoborane.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Collaborative battery pack charging method, device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: A collaborative battery pack charging method, device, and computer-readable storage medium. The method includes: when the battery packs are connected to a charger, calculating charging requirement of the battery packs through state data of the battery packs collected by a charging control module, and obtaining parameter data of the battery packs; when the battery packs are in a normal working state, detecting whether specification data of the battery packs match the parameter data, and when matched, controlling activation of a charging switch for each battery pack according to mutual relationships of respective voltages of the battery packs; detecting and adjusting a total charging current for all battery packs and a charging current for each battery pack according to calculated aggregated current requirement.

title: Printing apparatus, control method, and storage medium
abstract: A printing apparatus, includes: a supply unit configured to supply power to a configuration configured to execute processing to perform printing; and a control unit configured to control power supplied from an external device to be output to the supply unit and a power storage unit configured to be capable of storing power supplied from the external device, wherein, in a case where printing is performed, the control unit is configured to execute outputting of power to the supply unit and the power storage unit in parallel until a predetermined timing in a case where power is supplied from the external device, and outputting of power stored in the power storage unit to the supply unit in a case where supply of power from the external device is stopped, so as to execute predetermined processing in accordance with an amount of power stored in the power storage unit.

title: Screened hooded garments and methods
abstract: A screened hooded garment for protecting a user from insects biting their trunk, shoulders, arms, head, neck, and face. In some forms, the hooded garment is in the form of a pull-over or front zippered shirt or jacket. The hood covers the head of the user and comprises a face port which exposes their face. An insect face screen is secured at the face port as an insect barrier and may be fixed or removeable. In preferred forms, the hooded garment comprises a screen pocket located near the face port having a pocket port that opens towards the face port. The screen pocket can house the deployable insect face screen. The face screen can be stuffed in the screen pocket and remain barely noticeable. When needed, the screen is quickly deployed from the screen pocket and secured to the hood using a face screen binder.

title: Shielded soffit vent assembly
abstract: A soffit vent assembly for fire prone areas. The vent assembly can shut off air flow into an attic should fire storm conditions exist. The vent body is constructed from a fire-resistant polymer matrix and includes attachment tabs extending from a first side of the vent body providing fastenerless installation to a soffit opening. A screen within the vent body is formed from the fire-resistant polymer and sized to allow airflow to pass through but configured to prevent debris and pests from passing. A pair of C-shaped channels are formed in said second side of said vent body. A fire-resistant shield is configured to selectively move between an open position allowing airflow and a closed position to obstruct airflow through the vent openings. The shield can be remotely stored or remain attached to the vent body.

title: System and Method to Identify Programs and Commercials in Video Content via Unsupervised Static Content Identification
abstract: In one aspect, an example method includes (i) determining, by a computing system, a mean image of a set of frames of video content; (ii) extracting, by the computing system, a reference template of static content from the mean image; (iii) identifying, by the computing system, the extracted reference template of static content in a frame of the set of frames of the video content; (iv) labeling a segment within the video content as either a program segment or an advertisement segment based on the identifying of the extracted reference template of static content in the frame of the video content; and (v) generating data identifying the labeled segment.

title: Synthetic estrogen receptor (er)-derived peptide
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a synthetic estrogen receptor alpha peptide, compositions, and methods thereof for the use of enhancing insulin sensitivity and treating and/or preventing diabetes.

title: Battery pack
abstract: A battery pack, comprising a housing providing a cell stack room having a first interior surface and a second interior surface opposite the first interior surface. A cell stack is arranged in the cell stack room between the first and the second interior surfaces. The cell stack comprises a plurality of battery cells arranged in a stack extending in an X axis. The X axis is at least substantially parallel with the first and the second interior surfaces. The cell stack is attached by an adhesive layer to the first interior surface and the second interior surface.

title: Twist-locking lug
abstract: An appliance includes a tub defining a wash chamber for receipt of articles for washing, the tub comprising a sidewall, the sidewall defining a fill hole. The appliance includes a twist-locking lug configured to align with the fill hole. The twist-locking lug includes a body that defines a plurality of apertures arranged circumferentially around the body. The body includes a rim that includes an outer surface that faces away from a center of the twist-locking lug and an inner surface that faces toward the center. The twist-locking lug includes a plurality of bridges coupled with the rim. The plurality of bridges at least partially defines the plurality of apertures, respectively. The plurality of bridges is convex toward the center of the twist-locking lug. The twist-locking lug includes a plurality of flanges coupled with and extending from the plurality bridges, respectively, and at least one torque feature extending from the body.

title: Motorcycle rear radar integration
abstract: A rear lighting assembly for a vehicle may comprise a mount; a cover attached to the mount; a sensing unit attached to the mount and at least partially enclosed by the cover. The sensing unit may be for sensing objects behind the vehicle. A support may be attached to the mount. The support including a main body with a recess for at least partially receiving the cover and a pair of taillight assemblies. The mount may be attached to a rear fender of the vehicle and all wiring to the rear lighting assembly may be provided through a single opening in the fender.

title: Efficient on demand block generation for a sparseness aware file system
abstract: A computer program product, system, and computer implemented method for an approach to provide for efficient on demand block generation for sparseness aware file system. The approaches are discussed in the context of a cluster the uses a distributed storage arrangement that manages objects using entries for snapshots and clones that are managed together. Specifically, the present disclosure provides for an approach where metadata for snapshots and clones of the object (e.g., extent) can be managed using a single set of metadata that intermingles entries for any number of snapshots and clones of the object (or subsets thereof) together. This is further combined with support for variable sized allocation units and tombstones (that represent sparse data using metadata), where those tombstones corresponding to data that can be generated on demand using application or file specific context generation logic to improve storage efficiency and reduce storage requirements.

title: Global navigation satellite system spoofing detection using weather radar data
abstract: A global navigation satellite system spoofing detection system is configured to receive, via a receiver device of the satellite-based navigation system, location data; determine an expected future location of the vehicle based on the location data; receive, from an external computing device via a communication link, first weather data; determine, based on the first weather data, a first weather event for the expected future location; determine, based on second weather data received from a weather radar onboard the vehicle, a second weather event; determine a correlation between the first weather event and the second weather event; and in response to the correlation between the first weather event and the second weather event failing to satisfy a threshold, output an indication that the location data received by the receiver device of the satellite-based navigation system is inaccurate.

title: Compounded turbo power unit with boost combustor
abstract: An aircraft power system includes an internal combustion core engine where an inlet air is mixed with a fuel and ignited to generate shaft power and a primary gas flow, a boost combustor where a portion of the primary gas flow from the core engine is combined with fuel and ignited to generate a boosted gas flow, and a drive turbine that includes a drive output shaft wherein the boosted gas flow is expanded to generate shaft power.

title: Apparatuses and methods for stochastic authentication of temporally variant phenomena
abstract: An apparatus for stochastic authentication of temporally variant phenomena comprises circuitry configured to receive, from a remote device, an authentication packet set, wherein the authentication packet set comprises an identifier associated with the remote device, at least a datum indicating a temporally variant phenomenon, and at least a requested authorization, compute, and the at least a datum, a predicted message from a third-party verification device authenticate, based on the predicted message, the temporally variant phenomenon, and perform, based on the predicted message, an authorization of the at least a requested authorization.

title: Ammonia synthesis system with a solid oxide fuel cell system
abstract: An ammonia synthesis system includes an ammonia reactor configured to convert nitrogen and hydrogen in a first gas stream to ammonia and to output an ammonia reactor output stream and a solid oxide fuel cell system comprising an anode portion configured to receive a residual gas stream separated from ammonia in the ammonia reactor output stream.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: According to embodiments, a semiconductor device comprises: a first electrode; a second electrode positioned above the first electrode; and a semiconductor layer positioned between the first electrode and the second electrode, including: a first semiconductor region of a first conductivity type; a second semiconductor region of a second conductivity type that is provided on the first semiconductor region and that is electrically connected to the second electrode; a third semiconductor region of the first conductivity type that is provided on the second semiconductor region; a fourth semiconductor region of the second conductivity type that is provided on the first semiconductor region and that is electrically connected to the second electrode; a plurality of third electrodes, wherein each of the plurality of third electrodes faces the first semiconductor region, with a plurality of first insulating portions between the plurality of third electrodes and the first semiconductor region; and a fourth electrode.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba; Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation

title: Video processing method, camera device, and image processing device
abstract: In some aspects, the present disclosure provides a camera device. The camera device includes a camera configured to record a target video, a processor, a display coupled to the processor, and a memory in communication with the processor. The memory is configured to store computer instructions. The processor is configured to: during a recording of a target video, generate or mark at least one highlight segment of the target video; after the target video is recorded by the camera, in response to receiving a playback instruction for the target video, control the display to display a playback interface of the target video; and receive and respond to an operation instruction for the at least one highlight segment according to the playback interface.

title: Architectures combining augmented reality and virtual reality or other remote applications to facilitate interactions with the virtual world and physical world
abstract: Architectures combining augmented reality (AR) and remote functionality (such as virtual reality (VR)) facilitate interactions with the virtual world and physical world. A three dimensional (3D) model of the real world is used to enable remote computing system users (e.g., scientists, engineers, etc.) to communicate with AR explorers (e.g., astronauts, divers, etc.) using holograms and/or track their progress.

title: Tire for vehicle wheels and respective tread with self-cleaning function
abstract: A tire for vehicle wheels including a tread portion including a plurality of lugs and a plurality of grooves. Each groove is between contiguous pairs of lugs. Each lug includes at least one upper surface, at least one front surface, at least one rear surface and at least one base surface, which connects each front surface and each rear surface with a respective adjacent groove. Each groove is oriented along a transverse direction and along a longitudinal direction, respectively parallel and perpendicular to an axis of tire rotation. One or more discontinuities are obtained on at least part of the grooves. Each discontinuity crosses the respective groove along a direction substantially parallel to the longitudinal direction and extends on at least part of the base surface, of the front surface and/or of the rear surface of at least one lug adjacent to the groove having this discontinuity.

title: Trash receptacle
abstract: A trash receptacle for securing a garbage bag includes a primary body having a conical configuration portion defining a hollow interior area, and open bottom, and having a top that defines an aperture. The trash receptacle includes a drip tray positioned adjacent the open bottom and being configured to receive drippings from the garbage bag. A pair of handle members extends laterally outwardly from the top of the primary body portion and is configured to receive opposed drawstrings of the garbage bag. The trash receptacle includes an elastic band configured to secure the garbage bag to an exterior surface of the top until the body portion of the garbage bag becomes filled with refuse exceeding a predetermined weight the garbage bag is released by the elastic band and falls via gravity onto the drip tray, the fall causing the drawstrings to engage and close the garbage bag.

title: Rubber composite cleaning head climbing brush
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices include a climbing brush with a rubber composite cleaning head to clean climbing holds. The climbing brush includes a gripping portion and head portion defining a receiving area. The receiving area accommodates a rubber composite block forming a cleaning surface. The rubber composite block is formed of pale crepe rubber (PCR) or sheet rubber (ribbed smoked sheet No. 1/2) and includes a coarse textured surface. Additionally, the head portion includes a protruding lip defining a receiving area to secure the rubber composite block in place. The gripping portion also includes one or more finger grip recesses and a connection hole disposed therethrough. Furthermore, the climbing brush can be configured with a non-linear angle and a tapered head profile to facilitate cleaning holds in tight spaces and at challenging angles. Methods of manufacturing the brush and the rubber composite block are also disclosed.

title: Interpreting Mold Test Results for HVAC Filters
abstract: Interpreting mold test results for HVAC filters is described. In one or more implementations, results of one or more laboratory mold tests are received as conducted on a heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) filter previously installed in an HVAC system of a structure. Changes in ambient pressure are detected by a pressure sensor within an indoor environment of the structure during an installation period of the HVAC filter. The changes are indicative of activation of the HVAC system. Air volume processed by the HVAC filter during the installation period is estimated based on durations of the changes in the ambient pressure. A machine learning model is prompted to generate a mold risk assessment by interpreting the results based on the air volume, and at least a portion of the mold risk assessment is communicated to a client device for output in a user interface.

title: Delivery system having a split distal tip for improved positioning of a transcatheter heart valve
abstract: A delivery system includes a handle, an inner shaft having a distal portion configured to receive the heart valve prosthesis thereon, a push wire slidingly disposed through a lumen of the inner shaft, and an outer sheath configured to cover the heart valve prosthesis during delivery. A split distal tip or nosecone is attached to a distal end of the inner shaft and includes at least one cutout portion formed through a sidewall thereof. A proximal end of the push wire is operatively coupled to an actuator of the handle and a distal end of the push wire is attached to the cutout portion of the nosecone. When the nosecone is in a delivery configuration the cutout portion is substantially flush with the sidewall of the nosecone. When the nosecone is in a deployed configuration the cutout portion is spaced apart from the sidewall of the nosecone.

title: Compact bitcell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to semiconductor structures and, more particularly, to bitcell structures and methods of manufacture. The structure includes: a semiconductor substrate; a plurality of memory gates isolated from the semiconductor substrate by a stack of insulator materials; and a select gate embedded within the semiconductor substrate and shared with the plurality of memory gates.

title: Prebiotic bacteriophage containing composition for treatment of gastrointestinal inflammation
abstract: This disclosure provides a method of treating gastrointestinal inflammation such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBS) with a bacteriophage containing composition. The bacteriophage containing composition can be used as prebiotic supplementation and support of the gastrointestinal microflora. This disclosure relates to compositions that comprise one or more types of bacteriophage and methods of using such bacteriophages as a prebiotic to promote the growth of beneficial bacteria by decreasing harmful bacterial populations and releasing nutrients into the environment for good bacteria in the digestive system of an individual.

title: Network edge deployment of location based applications
abstract: Techniques for deploying location-based applications in a network are discussed herein. Such location-based applications can be installed or implemented in a network node close to the base station and/or the location of the user equipment (UE) using the location-based application in an environment. When a user is within a geofence, area associated with the location-based applications, the UE can present an indication that location-based services are available instead of requiring a user to select an application on their own or thorough an application store. After the exchanging authentication information, the UE can use authentication information to send a request, along with location data or pose data of the UE, to an edge server to render content for presentation on the UE. The edge server can transmit the content to the UE for presenting content at the location in accordance with the location-based application.

title: Ml equalizer devices for de-noising interference based on programming pulse read voltages and post-erasure voltages
abstract: An equalizer device including processing circuitry configured to cause the equalizer device to detect a post-retention voltage of a target memory cell and at least one retention feature, the at least one retention feature including programming pulse read voltages or a post-erasure voltage, the programming pulse read voltages including voltages of the target memory cell detected between a sequence of programming pulses applied to the target memory cell, and the post-erasure voltage being a voltage of the target memory cell detected after the target memory cell is at least partially erased, generate a pre-retention voltage estimate of the target memory cell by inputting the post-retention voltage and the at least one retention feature into a trained machine learning algorithm, and recover data stored to the target memory cell based on the estimated pre-retention voltage.

title: Information processing apparatus and method for determining and displaying relationships between product manufacturing information in three-dimensional model data
abstract: An information processing apparatus includes a processor configured to: determine a relationship between first product manufacturing information and second product manufacturing information included in three-dimensional model data; and generate, on a basis of the determined relationship, information indicating the relationship between the first product manufacturing information and the second product manufacturing information.

title: Systems and methods for monitoring vibration in surgical robots
abstract: A system for monitoring vibration induced in a surgical robot includes an end-effector having a first marker coupled thereto, a human interface device (HID) for actuating the end-effector, and a processor communicatively coupled to the HID. The processor is configured to actuate the end-effector based on an input provided by the HID, and detect an actual position of the first marker attached to the end-effector. In addition, the processor is configured to determine an expected position of the marker based on a kinematic model of the surgical robot and the input provided by the HID, and determine a position error between the actual position of the first marker and the expected position of the first marker.

title: Dissector devices with illumination
abstract: Dissectors for use in dissection during surgical procedures and having adjustable illumination profiles.

title: Fuel mobile battery
abstract: The present invention generally relates to a C-shaped mobile power supply designed primarily for use with powered mobile display device stands for use in locations without available or reliable electrical power, but the invention may be used in other locations as well. The power supply is specifically C-shaped to adapt to many commonly used mobile display stands. The power supply includes a housing set low to the ground for greater stability wherein all the components are housed, comprising a battery, inverter, charger, power input and power output. The battery may be sized to provide power to the display device, as well as additional peripherals. Computer software is optionally included to control and monitor all functionality of the system.

title: Inkjet ink
abstract: An inkjet ink includes: a pigment; a cyclohexylmethacrylate/methacrylic acid block copolymer having an acid value of 200 mg KOH/g or more and 240 mg KOH/g or less; and water. A weight ratio of the cyclohexylmethacrylate/methacrylic acid block copolymer to the pigment is 0.05 or more and 0.1 or less. The inkjet ink has surface tension of 28 mN/m or more and 30 mN/m or less.

title: System and method for enhancing variational quantum imaginary time evolution for graph partitioning with a modified fiduccia-mattheyses algorithm
abstract: A system and method are provided for performing a quantum-classical hybrid approach for graph partitioning. The method comprises converting a graph partitioning problem with a constraint into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) formulation; encoding the QUBO formulation as a cost Hamiltonian for execution on a quantum processing unit (QPU); applying variational quantum imaginary time evolution (VarQITE) to the QUBO formulation to evolve a quantum state representing candidate solutions for the graph partitioning problem; sampling partitions from the quantum state; refining the candidate solutions by inputting the sampled partitions into a modified Fiduccia-Mattheyses (FM) algorithm; and outputting optimized graph partitions from the modified FM algorithm for downstream applications.

title: Carton and carton blank
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to a package, an article carrier or carton for packaging one or more articles and a blank; for forming the carrier. The article carrier comprises a handle wall and a carrying handle. The handle wall comprises a pair of first and second overlapping panels. The carrying handle comprises a first handle flap hingedly connected to the first overlapping panel by a first hinged connection and a second handle flap hingedly connected to the second overlapping panel by a second hinged connection. The first and second handle flaps are disposed in an overlapping arrangement with one another. The first and second handle flaps each have a distal end edge opposing the respective one of the first and second hinged connections. The distal end edges are defined by a severance line extending entirely across the handle wall.

title: Method and apparatus for requesting analytics data in wireless communication network
abstract: The disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data transmission rate. Embodiments herein disclose methods and apparatus for requesting analytics data in a wireless communication network. The method comprises transmitting, by an analytics consumer entity, to a first analytics provider entity, a discovery request message comprising information to be used to get load analytics information from at least one ADAE server, and receiving, by the analytics consumer entity, a discovery response message corresponding to the discovery request message, from the first analytics provider entity, wherein the discovery response message comprises information of one or more discovered AS entities and analytics information corresponding to the one or more discovered AS entities.

title: Modified Cobalt-Free Lithium-Rich Manganese-Based Precursor and Preparation Method Thereof
abstract: A method for preparing a modified cobalt-free lithium-rich manganese-based precursor is provided. The prepared modified cobalt-free lithium-rich manganese-based precursor can reduce the large amount of manganese series oxides adhering among and to surfaces of primary particles, causing the primary particles to be uniform and compact. Meanwhile, a specific surface area of the precursor reaches 40-80 m2/g, and a tap density is greater than 1.3 g/cm3. The precursor prepared by using a method of letting an oxidant solution and a reducing agent solution to flow in parallel into a reaction system in the present disclosure has the characteristics of being low in cost, environment-friendly, and pollution-free. To sum up, the cobalt-free lithium-rich manganese-based precursor prepared using the method can not only guarantee excellent indicators and morphology, but also reduce a manufacturing cost, which is in line with the concept of green and sustainable development.
assignee: Henan Kelong New Energy Co., Ltd

title: Petrophysical interpretation model creation for heterogenous complex reservoirs
abstract: System and methods of petrophysical modeling are disclosed. Measurements of formation parameters along a planned path of a wellbore are received during a current stage of a downhole operation. A correlation coefficient between each of the formation parameters and at least one target parameter for the reservoir formation is determined based on the received measurements. Input parameters are selected from among the formation parameters for a symbolic regression model, based on the correlation coefficient calculated for each formation parameter. A symbolic regression model is trained to generate a target petrophysical model, based on the selected input parameters and the corresponding measurements received from the downhole tool. One or more properties of the formation are estimated for a subsequent stage of the downhole operation, based on the generated petrophysical model. The subsequent stage is performed along the wellbore, based on the one or more estimated properties of the reservoir formation.

title: Sheet heating element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A sheet heating element includes a base film, a heating layer formed on a first surface of the base film, a pair of electrodes disposed on the first surface of the base film with the heating layer therebetween and configured to supply power to the beating layer, and a silicone insulating layer provided to cover the heating layer and the electrodes, wherein the silicone insulating layer is integrally formed with the heating layer through a spray coating process or casting process. Therefore, the sheet heating element may have excellent heat resistance and dielectric strength characteristics.

title: Method and apparatus for performing link reconfiguration between mlds in wireless lan system
abstract: Proposed are a method and apparatus for performing, by reception MLD, link reconfiguration with transmission MLD, in a wireless LAN system. In detail, the reception MLD transmits a link change request frame to the transmission MLD via a first link. The reception MLD receives a link change response frame from the transmission MLD via the first link. The reception MLD configures a second link with the transmission MLD, on the basis of the link change response frame. The transmission MLD comprises a first transmission STA operating in the first link and a second transmission STA operating in the second link. The reception MLD comprises a first reception STA having a link changed from the first link to the second link. The link change response frame comprises information about the first and second links. The information about the second link is updated. The information about the first link is maintained without being reset or deleted.

title: Implantable internal drainage device and system for edemas
abstract: Disclosed are a fluid drainage devices and methods of use for drainage of edematous tissues of a patient. The devices include an inlet catheter comprising a plurality of lumens configured to receive fluid from the edematous tissues, wherein the plurality of lumens run axially parallel in the inlet catheter; an outlet catheter configured to be anchored at a sink; an implantable pump coupled to the inlet catheter and the outlet catheter, the pump having a rotating portion including a permanent magnet, the rotating portion configured to rotate in response to a magnetic force external to the patient to move fluid from the inlet of the inlet catheter to the second end of the outlet catheter; and an external controller configured to transcutaneously couple to the permanent magnet of the rotating portion to apply the magnetic force to the implantable pump.

title: Community Alert System
abstract: A Peer-to-Peer Community Alert System includes an alert device comprising an electrical transmission to identify an originator of the alert and an alarm light and sound indicating a threatening emergency condition. An alert hub triggers the alert based on a personal digital assistant in an originating home and from the originating home's smoke and CO alarms and transmits the alert to another alert hub. The peer-to-peer network includes an alert hub in the originating home in communication with other alert hub(s) in neighboring home(s). The disclosed alert is triggered manually, remotely as single or ganged with other alarms. Community alerts propagate between alert hubs in a direct serial communication from the alerted home to each neighboring home alarmed with an alert hub(s) based on pre-qualified levels of response and/or via a parallel broadcast directly to all alarmed neighboring homes at once.

title: Communication method and apparatus
abstract: A communication method and apparatus are applied to support a next-generation Wi-Fi protocol (for example, 802.11be, Wi-Fi 7, or EHT) of IEEE 802.11ax, a next-generation Wi-Fi protocol (for example, 802.11bn, Wi-Fi 8, or UHR) of IEEE 802.11be, Wi-Fi AI, a millimeter wave (MMW), an ultra-wideband (UWB), sensing, or the like. A first communication apparatus sends a first radio frame, and a second communication apparatus receives the first radio frame. The first radio frame includes first OBSS information. For example, the first OBSS information indicates information about a first OBSS that causes the first communication apparatus to perform non-primary channel transmission. Therefore, the second communication apparatus may learn of the first OBSS information. When receiving a radio frame sent by a first OBSS station, the foregoing two apparatuses may synchronously switch to a non-primary channel, thereby improving communication efficiency.

title: Venturi device with forced induction systems and methods
abstract: A Venturi device with a primary flow path and a secondary flow path introduced into the primary flow path, wherein a flow of one or more flowable mediums in the primary flow path and the secondary flow path creates a vortex generating a suction at an inlet of the Venturi device. A particulate burner system can be used to combust fuel emission byproducts by injecting fuel and air into a housing having a bottom plate with a round bottom opening for burners to inject fuel into a combustion chamber and a top plate with a round top opening for exhausting fuel emissions. A thruster system can be used to propel munition for deep earth penetration by using a thruster system having a transfer cone connected to a munition body.

title: Electronic shelf label holder
abstract: An attachment system includes a rear wall including a front side and a rear side formed on an opposite side from the front side, and a base wall extending from the front side of the rear wall to a front edge and including a top side and a bottom side formed on an opposite side from the top side. The attachment system also includes a lower retaining lip disposed on the base wall and spaced apart from the front side to define a first channel extending along the top side of the base wall, a release tab extending from the base wall, and an upper retaining lip extending from the rear wall and spaced apart from the top side of the base wall to define a second channel extending along the front side of the rear wall.

title: Methods and systems for cooling plasma treatment components
abstract: Methods and systems for uniformly cooling a dome within a plasma treatment system are disclosed. The methods and systems utilize a diffuser including a perforated plate and a cone. The perforated plate includes a center portion and multiple arrays of holes with each array being located circumferentially at a different distance from the center. The cone extends away from the center. The diffuser spreads cooling gas more uniformly across the surface of the dome.

title: Anti-new york esophageal squamous cell carcinoma 1 (ny-eso-1) antigen-binding proteins and methods of use thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides antigen-binding proteins that specifically bind to an HLA-displayed New York esophageal squamous cell carcinoma 1 (NY-ESO-1) peptide, and therapeutic and diagnostic methods of using those binding proteins.

title: Method and electronic device including flexible display
abstract: A method and an electronic device including a flexible display are provided. The electronic device includes a plurality of batteries, a flexible display, a motor configured to drive at least a portion of the flexible display to move, motor driving circuitry connected to the motor, switch circuitry including a plurality of switches, configured to switch between a first state connecting the plurality of batteries in series and a second state connecting the plurality of batteries in parallel, memory including one or more storage media, storing instructions, and at least one processor communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the instructions, when executed by the at least one processor individually or collectively, cause the electronic device to identify an event for switching an electrical connection state of the plurality of batteries, and, based on the identified event, control the switch circuitry to switch the electrical connection state from the first state to the second state or from the second state to the first state.

title: Avatar creation and editing
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to creating and editing user avatars. In some examples, guidance is provided to a user while capturing image data for use in generating a user-specific avatar. In some examples, a user interface allows a user to intuitively customize a user avatar. In some examples, avatars are generated for a messaging session based on an avatar model for a user of the messaging application. In some examples, an avatar editing interface updates a user avatar in response to gestures and based on the type of gesture and the avatar feature that is selected for editing.

title: Fluidics devices for plumbing fixtures
abstract: A toilet assembly includes a toilet body and a fluidic oscillator. The toilet body defines a toilet bowl that is configured to receive a volume of fluid therein. The fluidic oscillator is coupled to the toilet body in a rim area of the toilet bowl. The fluidic oscillator is positioned to direct a fluid onto an inner surface of the toilet bowl. The fluidic oscillator is configured to continuously redirect the flow of fluid to different locations along the inner surface of the toilet bowl.

title: Parcel Locker Pickup with ID Validation
abstract: Methods and systems are provided for determining and confirming the identity of a purported recipient of a parcel delivered to a parcel locker. The parcel locker compares identity information on the purported recipient’s ID to identity information obtained from a carrier, such as via an external API. If the identity information does not exactly match, the parcel locker confirms identity using text comparison techniques to make sure that the purported recipient is the intended recipient of the parcel delivered to the parcel locker.

title: Load carrier transport mechanism
abstract: A transport mechanism for a load carrier includes a frame, a conveyor bed, a traversing unit, a gripping mechanism, and a motor. The frame includes a front end, a rear end, a first side, and a second side. The conveyor bed is coupled to the frame and forms a loading surface with a loading end at the front end of the frame. The traversing unit is movably coupled to the frame and is configured to traverse along the loading surface in a direction of the rear end to the front end of the frame. The gripping mechanism is coupled to the traversing unit and is configured to grip a load carrier. The motor drives the traversing unit towards the front end such that the gripping mechanism is disposed at the loading end of the conveyor bed and retracts the traversing unit towards the rear end of the frame.

title: Focusing method, camera, and storage medium
abstract: The embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a focusing method, a camera, and a computer-readable storage medium. The focusing method includes: acquiring state information corresponding to a target component in a camera; determining, when change in state information are detected, target focusing information corresponding to a current time from a corresponding relationship between associated state information and focusing information based on the change; and adjusting an image plane position of the camera based on the target focusing information to make imaging of the camera clear. The present disclosure can directly calculate and determine the image plane capable of realizing clear imaging, currently based on the working state of the camera itself and the target focusing information.

title: Voltage conversion system and control method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a voltage conversion system and a control method thereof. The voltage conversion system includes a multi-phase voltage converter and a controller. The multi-phase voltage converter is coupled to a load and includes multiple phase circuits. At least one of the phase circuits is in an active state, so that the multi-phase voltage converter provides a load current to the load. The controller is coupled to the multi-phase voltage converter, is used to enable at least one of the phase circuits to be in the active state according to the load current and an activation order of the phase circuits, and is configured to adjust the activation order in response to an activation number of the phase circuits becoming 1, to adjust a first one of the phase circuits from a second priority work item to the highest priority work item.

title: Systems and Methods for Sensing Melatonin and Other Hormones
abstract: An analyte detection system includes an amperometric electrode system including a working electrode, which has a sensing layer and a transduction layer, the sensing layer being chemically linked to the transduction layer and anchored to an anchoring layer to preserve an orientation of the sensing layer, the sensing layer configured to detect an analyte within a fluid medium based on an interaction event between the analyte and the sensing layer when the analyte is oriented consistent with the orientation of the sensing layer. The analyte detection system includes an inlet reservoir from which the fluid medium travels towards the sensing layer; and an inlet channel through which the fluid medium travels from the inlet reservoir towards the sensing layer. The analyte is oriented consistent with the orientation of the sensing layer when a larger diameter end of the sensing layer is oriented towards the inlet channel or the inlet reservoir.

title: Making machine and making method for producing pouches each containing a loose product dose
abstract: A making machine can include a first forming drum having a pocket and a second forming drum coupled to the first forming drum to define a joining zone between the two forming drums; a first feeding unit to feed a first wrapping material web that wraps around part of the periphery of the first forming drum; an inserter device coupled to the first forming drum between the first feeding station and the joining zone to push the first wrapping material web into the pocket; a second feeding unit to feed a second wrapping material web that wraps around part of the periphery of the second forming drum such that the first and second wrapping material webs overlap in the joining zone forming the pouch; and a third feeding unit to feed the loose product dose into the pocket of the first forming drum covered by the first wrapping material web.

title: Image processing device and image processing method
abstract: A reduced second luminance filter has a reduced filter characteristic with respect to a second luminance filter that has a higher filter strength than a first luminance filter, or a reduced first luminance filter having a reduced filter characteristic with respect to the first luminance filter is applied, as a second color-difference filter having a higher filter strength than a first color-difference filter, to a pixel of a color-difference component located around a block boundary in a decoded image. The present technology is applicable to image encoding and decoding, for example.

title: Electronic health record generation systems
abstract: Some aspects include of a computer system or a computer-implemented method for generating a medical chart using a machine learning model. The performance of the machine learning model can be improved by updating the conditioning of the model with updated conditioning instructions. The machine learning model can be improved via the conditioning instructions to output improved charts that are tailored to the user's preferences and requirements, thereby enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of medical documentation. The systems and methods can allow the provider to submit feedback and receive an updated chart incorporating the feedback in real-time (e.g., in response to providing the feedback).

title: System and method for fuel monitoring and spill prevention
abstract: A system, methods, and apparatus for preventing receptacle overfilling are presented. The system can include a sensor member configured to couple with a receptacle and sense a material level within the receptacle, such as via a sight glass of the receptacle. The system can include a controller in operable communication with the sensor member and configured to instantiate the shutoff of material flow from a material dispensing system if a particular material level is detected by the sensor member. The system can include an intermediate member configured to relay communications between the sensor member and the controller. The intermediate member can be coupled to a fluid line and can further act as a holster for the sensor member, such as by facilitating the coupling of the sensor member to the intermediate member and/or the fluid line.

title: User interfaces related to time
abstract: The present disclosure generally describes user interfaces related to time. In accordance with embodiments, user interfaces for displaying and enabling an adjustment of a displayed time zone are described. In accordance with embodiments, user interfaces for initiating a measurement of time are described. In accordance with embodiments, user interfaces for enabling and displaying a user interface using a character are described. In accordance with embodiments, user interfaces for enabling and displaying a user interface that includes an indication of a current time are described. In accordance with embodiments, user interfaces for enabling configuration of a background for a user interface are described. In accordance with embodiments, user interfaces for enabling configuration of displayed applications on a user interface are described.

title: An ultra-high areal loading MnO2 electrode
abstract: In rechargeable batteries having an Mn 2 +/MnO 2  electrode and have an aqueous electrolyte, we discovered that by tuning the operating temperature of battery cycling we can manipulate the deposited phase from ε-MnO 2  with low conductivity to γ-MnO 2  with two orders of magnitude increase in electronic conductivity. We demonstrated that the highly conductive γ-MnO 2  could be effectively exploited for ultrahigh areal loading electrode, and a normalized areal loading of 33 mAh cm −2  was achieved within 3 hours. At a mild temperature of 50° C., cells were cycled with an ultrahigh areal loading of 20 mAh cm −2  (1-2 orders of magnitude higher than previous studies) for over 200 cycles with only 13% capacity loss.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University

title: Draw solute, draw solution, and water treatment method
abstract: The present disclosure provides a draw solute, a draw solution containing the draw solute, and a water treatment method using the draw solution.

title: Sheet conveyance apparatus and image forming apparatus
abstract: Disclosed is a sheet conveyance apparatus including a first conveyance member configured to rotate in contact with a sheet, a second conveyance member disposed at a position different from a position of the first conveyance member in the sheet conveyance direction, a motor, a first rotary member connected to the motor, a second rotary member connected to the first conveyance member, and an elastic member engaged with the first rotary member and the second rotary member, the elastic member being deformable to allow the first conveyance member to rotate in a state where an angular velocity of the first rotary member being driven by the motor differs from an angular velocity of the second rotary member.

title: Job execution apparatus, job execution method, and storage medium
abstract: A job execution apparatus includes a hardware processor that: receives an execution instruction of a job submitted from an external device; determines, based on a time from submission of the job from the external device to reception of a first input from a user, the first input leading to the execution instruction of the job, whether authentication based on a second input from the user is required; and executes the job based on the received execution instruction of the job. When determining that the authentication is required, the hardware processor executes the job after executing the authentication. When determining that the authentication is not required, the hardware processor executes the job without executing the authentication.

title: Work identification device
abstract: A work identification device includes a coordinate acquisition unit, a skeleton model generation unit, a work identification unit, and a holding detection unit. When a detection is made that the worker holds the object by hand, the skeleton model generation unit generates the worker skeleton model by correcting the coordinates of the reference skeleton point according to a ratio of a reference height to a height of the worker for hand-related skeleton points among the plurality of skeleton points to obtain corrected reference coordinates, converting the coordinates of the hand-related skeleton points into relative coordinates with respect to the corrected reference coordinates, and converting the coordinates of other skeleton points excluding the hand-related skeleton points into relative coordinates with respect to the coordinates of the reference skeleton point.

title: Systems and methods for generation of health recommendations
abstract: Disclosed are systems and methods that generate real-time health recommendations by computing higher-order derivatives, including jerk (third derivative), of physiological parameters and composite indices to detect early trend inflections that may indicate changes in health conditions. The systems may include a server with a health recommendation unit, databases, and data models that time-align heterogeneous inputs and optionally smooth signals prior to differentiation. Derivatives may be estimated from irregularly sampled clinical data. Events may be detected using magnitude thresholds, sign changes, and persistence windows, triggering intervention, confirmation, or monitoring-cadence recommendations. Examples include LDL cholesterol trajectories and allostatic load (AL) methods that select, normalize, and weight multi-system physiological parameters to determine an allostatic load index AL(t), followed by computation of one or more derivatives of AL(t) including at least a third derivative. Outputs may used to feed a closed-loop that adapts thresholds, weights, and goal difficulty to personalize future guidance. The approach enables earlier, explainable recommendations than absolute levels alone.

title: Integrated Induction Motor Monitoring and Overload Protection Device
abstract: A system includes a direct-on-line electric motor; a starting contact arranged in series with the electric motor and a power supply; at least one sensor configured to obtain an indication of a state of the electric motor; and a controller arranged in parallel to the electric motor and the power supply. The controller includes a receiver for the at least one sensor and is configured to: receive the indication via the at least one sensor receiver, determine, based on the indication, that a trip state has occurred, and open the starting contact based on determining that the trip state has occurred.

title: Friction-attached childproof latch for cabinets and drawers
abstract: The present disclosure teaches a friction-attached childproof latch for cabinets and drawers. Wherein, each half of the childproof latch includes a C-shaped frame with one top surface and two side surfaces, and a jaw is placed between the side surfaces, and connected to one of the side surfaces via a screw. The jaw may move with regard to the frame along the screw by tightening or loosening the screw. A panel of a cabinet or drawer may be friction-attached between the jaw and an opposite side surface of the frame. A first connector may be placed onto any surface of the frame, or connected to the frame via an extension piece. Wherein, the first connector may removably connect to a second connector placed on the other half of the latch. These connectors may take various forms, such as a hook and staple, a tether connection, or a snap fastener.

title: Package method and package system
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to the semiconductor field, and provide a package method and a package system. The package method includes the following: A first wafer is provided. The first wafer includes multiple chips and a scribe line located between adjacent ones of the chips, and a first bonding surface is formed on front surfaces of the chips. The first wafer is diced along the scribe line to divide the first wafer into the multiple chips. A second wafer is provided. A second bonding surface is formed on a front surface of the second wafer. The second wafer is fixed above the multiple chips, so that the second bonding surface is disposed opposite to the first bonding surface. A bonding process is performed, to bond the second bonding surface of the second wafer to the first bonding surface of the multiple chips.

title: Sodium secondary battery and electrical apparatus
abstract: The present application provides a sodium secondary battery and an electrical apparatus. The sodium secondary battery includes a negative electrode plate and an electrolyte solution; the negative electrode plate includes a negative electrode film layer; the negative electrode film layer contains a silicon element; and the electrolyte solution includes a first component, and the first component is fluorinated carbonate compound.

title: Process for converting olefins to jet fuel
abstract: A process for dimerizing and oligomerizing olefins to distillate fuels which subjects oligomerized product to hydrocracking and hydroisomerization in a single reactor to convert heavier oligomers to jet fuel range oligomers. A jet fuel product stream may be taken from a side of a stripping column which produces a heavy drag stream from a bottom of the stripping column to ensure an end point boiling specification is achieved.

title: Read margin health evaluations for memory systems
abstract: A memory system may evaluate a read margin health for a set of memory cells (e.g., a page of memory cells, a block of memory cells) based on quantities of memory cells that activate in response to applying voltages to the set of memory cells. For example, the memory system may determine, for a pair of bias voltages between a first nominal voltage associated with a first logic state and a second nominal voltage associated with a second logic state, a respective quantity of memory cells of the set of memory cells that are activated in response to biasing the set of memory cells with each of the pair of voltages. Based on the quantities of activated memory cells, the memory system may determine whether to refresh the set of memory cells.

title: Accessible debris separator for high pressure turbine outside diameter fed static components
abstract: An accessible debris separator for a gas turbine engine is provided. The accessible debris separator including a chamber formed by a entrance wall, an exit wall, an inner wall, and an outer wall; a plurality of inlet openings in the entrance wall; a plurality of outlet openings in the exit wall; and a component within the chamber, the component forcing cooling air with debris particulates entering the chamber via an inlet opening of the plurality of inlet openings to take a circuitous path thereby separating the debris particulates from the cooling air prior to the cooling air exiting the chamber via an outlet opening of the plurality of outlet openings.

title: Fracturing Hot Rock
abstract: A system and method for harnessing geothermal energy using fracturing of hot rock. The system has at least a first well and a second well. The method involves introducing an alkali metal downhole in a first well. A solution is also introduced into the first well. The solution produces an exothermic reaction with the alkali metal. The gas and heat fracture the hot rock producing fractures. The fractures fluidly connects the first well to the second well. A solution, such as water, can be pumped through the first well, through the fractures, and into the second well. The hot rock passes geothermal energy to the water which can then be utilized.

title: Display panel and display device including the same
abstract: A display panel includes pixels, each including a light emitting element and a pixel circuit connected to the light emitting element, data lines arranged in a plurality of columns, where the data lines supply data signals to the pixel circuit, data pads connected to the data lines, a first protection circuit connected between a first data line among the data lines and a first gate power line to which a first gate power voltage is applied, and a second protection circuit connected between a second data line among the data lines and a second gate power line to which a second gate power voltage is applied.

title: System and method for distributed system and method of ransomware detection and recovery
abstract: A distributed system for ransomware detection and recovery includes a first processor programmed to utilize a circuit to collect power measurements from one or more side-channel measurements of one or more devices, a second processor located at a detection agent and in communication with the first processor via a first secure communication channel, wherein the second processor is programmed to output results indicating ransomware associated with the one or more side-channel measurements, and a third processor located at an attestation agent and in communication with the second processor via a second secure communication channel, wherein the third processor is programmed to allow authorized access of the results from the second processor.

title: Independently randomly generated different features associated with different activators and different enhancements
abstract: Gaming systems and methods configured to display pots respectively associated with different wheel features that each include a wheel and an associated quantity of pointers, and enhancements to the wheel features that each include an increase to an initial quantity of pointers associated with one or more of the wheels for a play of a game based on an enhancement triggering event for that play of the game.

title: Permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance motor
abstract: Disclosed herein are a permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance motor. The permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance motor includes a stator structure and a rotor structure. The stator structure is sleeved outside the rotor structure and forms an air gap with the rotor structure. The rotor structure includes a rotor core. The stator structure includes a stator core having uniformly distributed thereon a plurality of alternately arranged stator teeth and stator slots. When any d-axis centerline of the rotor structure is aligned with a stator tooth centerline of the stator structure, a d-axis centerline adjacent to the d-axis centerline is aligned with a stator slot centerline, and a q-axis centerline adjacent to the d-axis centerline is staggered with the stator tooth centerline or the stator slot centerline.
assignee: Gree Electric Appliances, Inc. Of Zhuhai

title: Separation and purification of chemicals using ion-exchange resins
abstract: Systems and methods for separation and purification of chemicals using ion-exchange resins are provided.
assignee: Materials Engineering and Technical Support Services

title: Gas sensor and gas sensor array comprising the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gas sensor including a first oxide layer, a second oxide layer disposed on the first oxide layer, an inactive electrode formed at an interface of the first oxide layer and the second oxide layer, and an active electrode disposed on the second oxide layer, the inactive electrode includes a two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) layer, and a metal filament which connects the active electrode and the inactive electrode and is derived from the active electrode is included in the second oxide layer.
assignee: Ajou University Industry-Academic Cooperation Foundation; Industry-University Cooperation Foundation Hanyang University Erica Campus

title: Circuit board, circuit board assembly and device including the same
abstract: Discussed is a circuit board, a circuit board assembly, and a device. The circuit board assembly may include a circuit board including a first outer surface and a second outer surface, which face each other, and a semiconductor package disposed on the first outer surface of the circuit board, wherein the circuit board may include at least one opening disposed adjacent to at least a portion of an edge of the semiconductor package and provided in a form of a groove or a hole, and a filling member filled into the at least one opening.

title: Image display apparatus, method, and program
abstract: A processor is configured to: display at least one medical image on a touch-type display screen; receive a touch operation by a user on the medical image; derive an auxiliary image including a touch position at which the touch operation is performed in the medical image from the medical image; and display the auxiliary image at a position different from the touch position on the display screen.

title: Collagen-infused dental pet chew
abstract: A process and a product for preparing a collagen-infused dental pet chew are disclosed. In some embodiments, the disclosed collagen-infused dental pet chew includes a hard, optionally ridged, exterior with a soft toothpaste center. Collagen is infused in the disclosed collagen-infused dental pet chew (e.g., in a single mixture for the chew, in an exterior mixture of the chew, or in an exterior mixture and interior mixture of the chew). The collagen supports dental, bone, and skin health for pets (e.g., canines).

title: Apparatus for self-watering plants
abstract: A self-watering system for potted plants includes a saucer with a deep water reservoir, raised support structures to elevate the plant container, and one or more wicking devices that draw water from the reservoir into the container. The design prevents overflow by containing excess water and positioning the plant container such that roots are not constantly submerged. The wicking devices, which may include slow-release fertilizers, are easily inserted through the container's drainage holes. An optional set of adjustable hooks allows adaptation for hanging baskets. This invention converts virtually any standard pot into a self-watering container, reducing watering frequency and preventing damage to underlying surfaces.

title: Transcritical refrigeration pressure exchanger
abstract: A pressure exchanger (PX) includes a rotor configured to receive a first fluid, receive a second fluid, and exchange pressure between the first fluid and the second fluid, where the rotor forms a plurality of ducts. The PX further includes a first end cover fluidly coupled with the rotor, the first end cover forming a first kidney, where a kidney angular extent of the first kidney is substantially an integer multiple of a duct angular spacing between at least two adjacent ducts of the plurality of ducts, where the kidney angular extent is an angular distance between an opening edge and a closing edge of the first kidney and the duct angular spacing is an angular distance between corresponding centers of the at least two adjacent ducts.

title: Navigation system for uncrewed aircraft systems at vertiports
abstract: A system comprises a vision sensor on a vehicle; an onboard IMU that produces inertial measurements; an onboard strapdown INS that receives the inertial measurements; an onboard first processor coupled to the vision sensor; and an onboard second processor coupled to the strapdown INS and the first processor. The first processor hosts a first set of program modules that extract landing marker information and comprise computer vision and machine learning modules that operate in parallel to perform a method that comprises, receiving image data from the vision sensor, the image data corresponding a marker in a landing zone; extracting corner points for the marker; resolving the corner points in a landing zone frame; computing vehicle position statistics with respect to the corner points; and associating the marker with a marker ID in a marker library. The second processor hosts a second set of program modules providing filter and association functions.

title: Deck Extension System
abstract: A deck extension system for expanding the walkable deck space of a watercraft has a deck portion and a set of support arms that extend from the deck portion to form a watercraft cradle. The deck portion is an inflatable platform that stabilizes the motion of an anchored watercraft to which it is attached. The support arms extend to either side of the watercraft to create a cradle that enables the deck extension system to remain affixed to the stern portion of the watercraft.

title: Systems and methods for machine learning based access class barring
abstract: A system, comprises circuitry configured to implement a base station for wirelessly communicating with user equipment in a cell of a radio access network; wherein the circuitry is further configured to: receive time data, traffic data, and location data; predict at least one predicted barring parameter for the base station based on the time data, the traffic data, and the location data; adjust at least one of a barring factor or a barring time in an information message based on the at least one predicted barring parameter for the base station to generate at least one of an adjusted barring factor or an adjusted barring time; and send the information message with the at least one of the adjusted barring factor or the adjusted barring time to the user equipment in the cell.

title: Optometry device for testing the eyes of an individual, associated method and computer program product
abstract: An optometry device for testing eyes of an individual, including a computer with one or more processors programmed to perform a sequence of subjective tests including at least a first and a second predetermined subjective test, leading to determination of values of one or more refractive features of one or more of the eyes of the individual. The one or more processors are programmed to a) perform the first predetermined subjective test, thereby determining a provisory value of a first refraction feature of the eye of the individual, b) at the end of the first predetermined subjective test, perform a verification test for detecting a potential error in the provisory value of the first refraction feature determined in step a), and c) based on the result of the verification test, determine a next subjective test to be performed or ending the sequence of subjective tests.

title: Optical coupling device and optical transmission unit
abstract: An optical coupling device includes a base and a plurality of lens elements. The base includes a bottom board, two side portions disposed on opposite ends of the bottom board, a main wall disposed between the two side portions and defining a plurality of positioning holes, and at least one front groove located between the two side portions and facing a front of the positioning holes. The lens elements are arranged on the bottom board in the at least one front groove. Each of the lens elements is positioned in alignment with a corresponding one of the positioning holes. An optical cable is positioned to and detachably connected to the side portions of the base such that a plurality of optical fibers included in the optical cable are optically aligned with the lens elements respectively.

title: Cell reselection methods and apparatuses, communication apparatus and storage medium
abstract: A method for cell reselection, including: performing the cell reselection according to first slice information corresponding to mobile originated (MO) traffic.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Air purifying and deodorizing device incorporating fragrance diffusion
abstract: The present disclosure provides an air fragrance purifying and deodorizing device incorporating fragrance diffusion. The air fragrance purifying and deodorizing device incorporating fragrance diffusion includes: a front middle frame and a rear middle frame coupled to the front middle frame. The front middle frame is provided a front shell mounted on an outer side of the front middle frame, and the rear middle frame is provided a rear shell mounted on an outer side of the rear middle frame. Two sides of each of the front middle frame and the rear middle frame are respectively equipped with a filter, a motor, and a fan wheel. Upper ends of the front middle frame and the rear middle frame are provided with a top cover. Lower ends of the front middle frame and the rear middle frame are provided with a bottom shell.

title: Optical imaging lens
abstract: An optical imaging lens may include a first lens element, a second lens element, a third lens element, a fourth lens element, a fifth lens element and a sixth lens element positioned in an order from an object side to an image side. Through designing concave and/or convex surfaces of the lens elements and an inequality, the optical imaging lens may increase field of view, shrink volume and provide well image quality.

title: Plants with beneficial heritable traits
abstract: The present invention is directed towards plants and methods of producing plants exhibiting one or more useful traits such as increased yield, increased biomass, drought tolerance, salinity tolerance, increased lignin production, biotic stress resistance, abiotic stress resistance, enhanced growth rate, or beneficial root architecture. In particular, the present invention is directed to plants, plant cells, leaves, stems, flowers, and seeds without genetic modification exhibiting useful traits that can confer one or more useful traits to successive generations including cells, leaves, stems, flowers, and seeds, methods of producing and using the plants and plant parts, and products of those plant and plant parts, including processed products such as foodstuffs, feed or meal.

title: Systems and methods for enhancing cybersecurity
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed configured to receive a first document comprising cybersecurity policies, a second document comprising cybersecurity procedures, and a third document comprising a cybersecurity standard comprising cybersecurity categories. Gaps may be identified between the cybersecurity policies and/or procedures and the cybersecurity standard. Based on the identified gaps, a determination is made as to whether recommendations for cybersecurity remediation techniques are to be generated. In response to determining that cybersecurity remediation techniques are to be recommended, cybersecurity remediation technique recommendations are generated and the cybersecurity remediation techniques may be implemented.

title: Container taking and conveying assembly, loading and unloading device, and picking system
abstract: A container taking and conveying assembly includes: a base; a bearing assembly configured to bear a container and defining an accommodating space for accommodating the container; a taking and placing assembly configured to take out the container from a first target position and load the container onto the bearing assembly, or unload the container from the bearing assembly and place the container at a second target position; a moving assembly configured to drive the taking and placing assembly to move in a first movement trajectory where the moving assembly is configured to drive the taking and placing assembly to move in the accommodating space to load or unload the container; and a positioning system configured to acquire position information of a container position on a goods shelf, and determine a position deviation between the container taking and conveying assembly and the container position.

title: Machine learning-based constellation shaping in wireless communication network
