The data are analyzed to identify a first set of sites at which the parents are homozygous for different alleles, and a second set at which at least one of the parents has a mutation. For each site of the first set, a probability that a respective portion of the maternal cfDNA data is derived from the fetus is determined. Each site of the second set is classified according to the determined probabilities as being either fetal or maternal to genotype the fetus.

title: Generating configuration rules using machine learning
abstract: A system and method for access control in a computerize system comprise generating configuration rules using machine learning. Configuration data of a computerized system is organized into matrices representing entity attributes and entitlements, and is used to train a machine-learning model to generate configuration rules. The model predicts entity entitlement probabilities based on entity attributes. The generated rules include quality metrics and can be used to configure access control for new or existing entities in the system.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device includes a backplate, a plastic frame, some clamping pieces, some fastening pieces and a display panel. The backplate includes a wall and a base having some fastening holes. The wall has oppositely a first end and a second end. The first end connects the base. The plastic frame includes an abutting portion, a supporting portion and a clamped portion. The abutting portion is located outside the backplate and abuts against the wall. The supporting portion is connected with the abutting portion and rests on the second end. The clamped portion connects the abutting portion. Each clamping piece abuts against the base and clamps the clamped portion. Each clamping piece has a through hole aligned with a corresponding fastening hole. The fastening pieces penetrate through the through holes and are fastened into the fastening holes. The display panel connects the supporting portion.

title: Automatically applying adhesive for three-dimensional printing
abstract: In some implementations, a computer system may receive a digital model of an object to be printed on a three-dimensional printer that includes a print bed, and may analyze the digital model to determine a footprint of the object on the print bed. The computer system may cause the three-dimensional printer to apply a first layer of adhesive on the footprint, and may cause the three-dimensional printer to print a layer of filament material above the first layer of adhesive. The computer system may analyze the digital model to identify a stress point, and may cause the three-dimensional printer to apply a second layer of adhesive at the stress point based on identifying the stress point.

title: Amplifier with common-mode voltage setting circuit
abstract: In described examples, a device includes first and second voltage sensors, first and second error amplifiers, and a fully differential amplifier (FDA). A first input of the first error amplifier (EA 1 ) is coupled to the output of the first voltage sensor (VS 1 ). A first input of the second error amplifier (EA 2 ) is coupled to the output of the second voltage sensor (VS 2 ). A first input of the FDA is coupled to a first input of VS 1 . A second input of the FDA is coupled to the second input of VS 1 . A third input of the FDA is coupled to an output of EA 2 . A first output of the FDA is coupled to a first input of the VS 2  and an output of EA 1 . A second output of the FDA is coupled to a second input of the VS 2  and the output of EA 1.

title: PERIPHERAL COMPONENT INTERCONNECT EXPRESS (PCIe) SYSTEM PERFORMING LOW POWER MANAGEMENT AND METHOD OF OPERATING THE SAME
abstract: The present technology relates to an electronic device. A  computing system may include a host and a peripheral component interconnect express (PCIe) device connected the host through a link. The host comprises a host memory and a storage device driver. The host memory may store information on a first target command to be executed in the PCIe device. The storage device driver may provide the first target command to the host memory and a notification message indicating that the first target command is stored in the host memory to the PCIe device. The PCIe device may request the host memory to register an address of the host memory in which a second target command to be executed in the PCIe device is stored through a preset protocol.

title: Container testing equipment
abstract: The present disclosure provides a container testing equipment, specifically related to the field of analysis and testing, which includes: a conveying mechanism, and a rejection mechanism, a testing mechanism, and a driving mechanism provided on the conveying mechanism; the conveying mechanism for conveying containers to be tested; the rejection mechanism includes a container pushing device and a container holding device disposed opposite each other on both sides of the conveying mechanism, and the container pushing device is used to push the containers to be tested on the conveying mechanism into the container holding device when the working circuit is on. The present disclosure improves the efficiency and accuracy of container testing and greatly reduces the possibility of damage to the analyzing instrument due to over-high containers.

title: Methods for treating infections caused by neisseria gonorrhoeae
abstract: The present invention relates to a novel treatment method for the treatment of an infection caused by  Neisseria gonorrhoeae , comprising administering gepotidacin or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof to a human in need thereof, in accordance with a treatment regimen as defined herein.

title: Data analysis support system, analysis support device, and data analysis support method
abstract: A data analysis support system includes site analysis support devices installed at multiple sites and an upper-level analysis support device. The upper-level device receives prompt information including question content, generates site prompt information using a large language model that allows each site device to answer based on the question content, and transmits it to the site devices. Each site device generates site answer information according to the site question content using a large language model based on information in its site database, and transmits the answer to the upper-level device. The upper-level device integrates site answer information from multiple site devices, generates final answer information for the question content from the user terminal, and transmits it to the user terminal. Accordingly, the AI-driven architecture significantly supports rapid decision making while reducing data transfer and protecting data confidentiality.

title: Horn, terminal component, and secondary battery
abstract: A horn disclosed herein is a horn that transmits ultrasonic vibration to workpiece to be joined and includes a base portion and a tip end portion that protrudes from the base portion and is pressed against the workpiece. At least a portion of the tip end portion is a frame-like raised portion formed into substantially a frame shape. The frame-like raised portion may be formed into a rectangular shape. As a portion of the tip end portion, an inner raised portion may be provided inside the frame-like raised portion.
assignee: Prime Planet Energy & Solutions, Inc.; Fukui Byora Co., Ltd.

title: Arrangement for Connecting Components
abstract: An arrangement for connecting components comprises a screw bolt and a pair of wedge lock washers having at least two wedge lock washers with respective recesses for the passage of the screw bolt. An adhesive is located in an annular gap formed between the pair of wedge lock washers and the screw bolt inserted into the recess of the wedge lock washers.

title: Face authentication method
abstract: A face authentication device  100  of the present invention includes an extraction means  121  for extracting a plurality of face images in a captured image, a determination means  122  for determining, on the basis of at least one of the face images, determining whether or not the person of the face image satisfies an exclusion condition of a face authentication process, and an authentication means  123  for excluding the face image of the person satisfying the exclusion condition, and performing the face authentication process on another face image to authenticate whether or not the person of the other face image is a registered person.

title: Manufacturing apparatus of battery cell, manufacturing method thereof, and master block
abstract: A manufacturing apparatus of a battery cell is disclosed. The manufacturing apparatus of a battery cell includes: a cell transfer part including a carrier; a folding apparatus including a plurality of folding process parts; a master block mounted on the carrier and used to adjust a reference origin; a storage part storing a working position; and a controller controlling driving of the cell transfer part and the plurality of folding process parts, with positions of the plurality of folding process parts set to a respective working positions, wherein the working position is set by the reference origin and a preset offset value, and the reference origin is set by moving each folding process part toward the master block and bringing each folding process part into contact with the master block.

title: Inline electro-coalescer multi-treater
abstract: Systems and methods for separating components of a processing fluid by an inline electro-coalescer (IEC) multi-treater are disclosed. In some embodiments, a processing fluid is received in a processing fluid line of an oil and gas well system, by an oil and gas processing plant, by an oil treatment plant, by an oil refinery, or by other facilities requiring (bulk) oil dehydration and/or oil desalting. Demulsifiers may be injected into the process fluid and the process fluid is provided into a processing chamber for treatment by a combination of providing heat to the process fluid, providing an electric field to the process fluid, and controlling the flow of the process fluid by the geometry of the processing chamber. Furthermore, the process fluid may flow into a separating chamber configured to separate components (e.g., oil and water) of the process fluid.

title: Determination of altitude of access point
abstract: In implementations of the present disclosure, a solution for determining an altitude of an access point (AP) is provided. The AP may obtain an air pressure, a location, a temperature and a humidity associated with the AP. The AP may further calibrate a gravitational acceleration at the AP based on a gravitational acceleration on an equatorial surface and the location, calibrate a Molar mass of air at the AP based on the humidity, and the temperature, and calibrate the temperature associated with the AP based on a temperature at sea level and the location. The AP may determine an altitude of the AP based on the calibrated gravitational acceleration at the AP, the calibrated Molar mass of air at the AP, the calibrated temperature associated with the AP, and the air pressure associated with the AP.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: Carriers are prevented from flowing into an IGBT region from a diode region so as to become concentrated in a boundary portion, thereby causing element breakage, during diode recovery. In a semiconductor device having an IGBT region, a diode region, and a wiring region in the same chip, the wiring region has a gate runner for supplying a gate potential to a trench gate electrode, a well layer having a deeper impurity diffusion depth than a trench, and a plurality of first contact regions that electrically connect the well layer and an emitter electrode. An area of the first contact region in a boundary portion vicinity near a boundary portion between the IGBT region and the diode region is greater than an area of the first contact region in a position far from the boundary portion vicinity.

title: Propulsion unit for an aircraft
abstract: A propulsion unit for an aircraft includes an engine pylon, a turbine engine fixed to the engine pylon, and a cowling. The turbine engine includes a fluidic system, and the cowling has at least one panel that is pivotably connected to the engine pylon and carries at least one surface heat exchanger. The surface heat exchanger includes a fluidic circuit connected to the fluidic system by at least one telescopic link.

title: Single-bolt quick-install nut
abstract: A single-bolt quick-install nut includes a sleeve housing having an engaging ring and a first urging portion that are formed at an interval along a central axis. A screwing member passes into the sleeve housing. The screwing member has an engaging hook for hooking onto the engaging ring. A partial threaded portion is provided inside the screwing member and a lateral channel penetrates through a portion of the screwing member adjacent to the partial threaded portion. An actuated hole is formed at an end of the screwing member. A pressing member that could return to an original position is slidably disposed on the lateral channel. The pressing member has a second urging portion that is slidable along the first urging portion in a direction oblique to the central axis.

title: Alaska Native and Native American Culturally Sensitive Artificial Intelligence Model to Preserve Indigenous Knowledge Systems
abstract: Disclosed herein introduces a culturally sensitive artificial intelligence (AI) model tailored for Alaska Native and Native American Indigenous cultures. Designed to complement the Culturally Sensitive Language Translation System, the AI model ensures ethical, context-aware language processing and Indigenous Knowledge System preservation. It incorporates Indigenous epistemologies, oral traditions, and community-driven AI governance, fostering an inclusive digital environment. The model prioritizes accuracy, respect, and sovereignty, supporting applications in education, governance, and digital storytelling. By leveraging Indigenous-designed datasets and AI ethics frameworks, this invention strengthens language revitalization, historical preservation, and contemporary cultural expression. It empowers Indigenous communities with AI tools that reflect their values, ensuring equitable technological representation.

title: Valve device
abstract: A valve device is provided with a nozzle that has a flow hole through which a fluid flows; a support member that supports the nozzle; a valve body that has a piezoelectric element and opens and closes an opening of the flow hole by driving of the piezoelectric element; and a position adjustment mechanism for adjusting the position of the nozzle with respect to the valve body. The position adjustment mechanism has an urging member for urging the nozzle toward the valve body; and a stopper member for preventing movement of the nozzle due to the urging member by coming into contact with the nozzle.

title: Camera-enabled lock system
abstract: A lock system includes a receptacle, a sensor, and one or more processing circuits. The receptacle includes a storage compartment defining a storage volume and a lock transitionable between a locked configuration and an unlocked configuration. The sensor is configured to acquire sensor data regarding contents added to or removed from the storage volume by a user. The one or more processing circuits are configured to acquire the sensor data from an access event associated with the receptacle, identify, based on the sensor data, at least one item of the contents added to or removed from the storage volume during the access event, determine, based on the sensor data and the at least one item, whether the access event is associated with an anomaly condition, and generate an alert signal in response to determining that the access event is associated with the anomaly condition.

title: Method of Providing a Deformation-Resistant Substrate, Method of Growing a Layer Using the Deformation-Resistant Substrate, and a Batch Comprising a Plurality of Monocrystalline Substrates
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of providing a deformation-resistant substrate for growing a layer in a direction of growth (Y) in a reactor on the deformation-resistant substrate, the method comprising the steps of: measuring an internal stress value of a monocrystalline raw substrate in a radial direction (r) perpendicular to the direction of growth (Y); determining, based on the measured internal stress value, a radial size (d_substrate) for the deformation-resistant substrate in the radial direction (r) and an axial size (t_substrate) for the deformation-resistant substrate in the direction of growth (Y); and providing the deformation-resistant substrate by selecting a deformation-resistant substrate with the determined radial size (d_substrate) and the determined axial size (t_substrate).

title: Machine learning based medical data checker
abstract: A method of verifying multi-modal medical data is proposed. The method comprises: accessing multi-modal medical data of a subject, the multi-modal medical data comprising a medical image of a specimen slide, wherein a specimen in the specimen slide was collected from the subject; generating a prediction pertaining to a biological attribute of the medical image based on the medical image; determining a degree of consistency between the biological attribute of the medical image and other modalities of the multi-modal medical data; and outputting, based on the degree of consistency, an indication of whether the multi-modal medical data contain inconsistency.

title: Gravity based dialysis system and device and method for therapy prescription optimisation
abstract: Apparatus and methods are provided for performing continuous ambulatory peritoneal dialysis (CAPD) on a patient using a device ( 10 ) with a user interface ( 28 ) and programmable circuitry on which prescription data is entered. Information according to the prescription is provided to the patient on the user interface ( 28 ), and treatment data relating to administered CAPD are gathered and communicated to a healthcare provider. Multiple parameters of the treatment data are aggregated for multiple patients, along with outcomes data and expected likely outcomes of CAPD treatment are modelled as a function of said multiple parameters of treatment data, to provide to assist in prescription optimisation and patient centric treatment.

title: Display Panel and Display Module
abstract: A display panel includes a display area and a peripheral area. The peripheral area includes a first signal line arrangement region including first signal lines and a second signal line arrangement region including second signal lines. First lead-out lines are led out from the first lead-out positions included in a border of the first signal line arrangement region and are connected to the first signal lines. A first lead-out line is connected to a data line. A first reference signal line is led out from a first reference lead-out position and connected to a first reference data line. Second lead-out lines are led out from second lead-out positions included in a border of the second signal line arrangement region, and are electrically connected to the second signal lines; a second lead-out line is electrically connected to a gate line.
assignee: Fuzhou Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: System and Method for AI Contribution Analysis, Transparency, and Accreditation
abstract: A system and method for analyzing and verifying the respective contributions of artificial intelligence (AI) and human users within digital content creation, decision-making workflows, and collaborative environments. The invention comprises a contribution analysis engine that attributes authorship by evaluating idea origination, structural modification, contextual influence, and decision impact. A real-time interaction logging module captures inputs and outputs, while a composite influence score quantifies the degree of AI involvement versus human contribution. The system includes a secure certification mechanism that generates traceable validation links for independently verifying content origin and authorship. Designed for deployment across academic, corporate, legal, and government sectors, the framework supports ethical Al integration, authorship transparency, and regulatory compliance. It enables digital trust by validating intellectual input at scale without persistent data retention. This system may further include cryptographic safeguards, audit trails, and privacy-compliant verification protocols to ensure authenticity and protect the integrity of AI-assisted outputs across diverse information ecosystems.

title: Solar cell and preparation method thereof
abstract: A solar cell includes silicon substrate and stack structure. stack structure is provided on rear surface of silicon substrate along thickness direction of solar cell. Silicon substrate and stacked structure contain antimony element. Stack structure at least includes first oxide layer, first doped polycrystalline silicon layer, second oxide layer and second doped polycrystalline silicon layer which are sequentially stacked along thickness direction of solar cell. Antimony doping concentration in second oxide layer is higher than antimony doping concentration in first doped polycrystalline silicon layer. Antimony element in stack structure can be bonded with silicon element, thereby effectively improving passivation effect, solving problem of low conductivity of carriers, and thus enhancing working efficiency of solar cell. Stack structure has certain concentration gradient characteristic along thickness direction of solar cell, which can improve conductivity of carriers in stack structure, and thereby reducing series resistance of solar cell.

title: Carbon-intelligent network reselection
abstract: A method of network reselection includes maintaining, by user equipment (UE), a first 3GPP network, maintaining, by UE, a network list having a plurality of 3GPP networks with Eco-Ratings, and selecting, by UE, from the plurality of 3GPP networks, a second 3GPP network with a highest original priority having an Eco-Rating greater than or equal to an Eco-Rating threshold. The original priorities of the 3GPP networks are defined according to one or more automatic network selection procedures.

title: Bracket for modular outdoor structure and method of forming bracket for modular outdoor structure
abstract: A method for forming a bracket includes steps of receiving a tube and defining one or more apertures in peripheral walls of the tube. The steps also include defining a 90 degree notch in the peripheral walls at an intermediate portion of the tube between a first end and a second end of the tube. The steps further include folding the first end of the tube toward the second end of the tube at the 90 degree notch and coupling the peripheral walls of the tube at the intermediate portion.

title: Lens barrel with via for adjusting tunable lens
abstract: An imaging device includes a lens barrel configured to hold a tunable lens. A conductive via runs through lens barrel so an electrical signal can adjust an optical power of the tunable lens held by the lens barrel.

title: Concurrently supporting internet protocol version 6 (ipv6) and internet protocol version 4 (ipv4) in a cloud-managed wireless telecommunication network
abstract: Example embodiments are directed towards concurrently supporting IPv6 and IPv4 in a cloud-managed wireless telecommunication network. This may include electronically providing support for internet Protocol IPv4 network traffic of user equipment (UEs) in a cloud-native, O-RAN, 5G NR cellular telecommunication network, and also electronically providing support for IPv6 network traffic of UEs in the cloud-native, O-RAN, 5G NR cellular telecommunication network while concurrently providing the support IPv4 network traffic. the wireless telecommunication service provider that is an MNO of the cloud-native, O-RAN, 5G NR cellular telecommunication network controls routing of the IPv6 network traffic within a cloud computing service provider cloud in which the cloud-native, O-RAN, 5G NR cellular telecommunication network operates.

title: Device and method for adaptive brain-inspired memory based continual learning
abstract: The adaptive brain-inspired memory-based continual learning method and device may include a brain-inspired memory unit including an episodic memory unit and a semantic memory unit, an artificial intelligence model unit that directly learns and updates input data, a task change analysis unit that detects a time point when a task of the input data is changed and analyzes a level of the change, an adaptive multi-layer knowledge distillation unit that distills knowledge stored in the brain-inspired memory unit and reflects the same on the update of the artificial intelligence model unit, and an adaptive memory update unit that reflects the updated artificial intelligence model unit on the brain-inspired memory unit when the update of the artificial intelligence model unit is completed.

title: Photovoltaic (pv) panel simulation system and measurement tool calibration
abstract: A photovoltaic (PV) panel simulator includes a high-side linear current source and an output circuit. The high-side linear current source includes a voltage source and a feedback loop in which an operational amplifier controls the generation of source current in response to a reference signal received from a controller and a feedback signal received via the feedback loop. The output circuit produces an output current, and includes one or more components with configurable electrical parameters which, in combination, simulate electrical characteristics of a PV panel. In response to connection of a load of an IV curve tracer, the PV panel simulator produces an output current produced at a magnitude that settles from an initial state to approximately a steady state within a settling time period. The settling time period precedes a measurement time period during which the IV curve tracer measures the output current and voltage in the steady state.

title: Rotary grinding tool
abstract: A rotary grinding tool includes a first housing and a second housing. The first housing includes a final output shaft on which a tip tool is mounted and a drive unit that rotates the final output shaft. The second housing includes a handle portion. The tip tool that rotates together with the final output shaft has a grinding surface capable of grinding a workpiece. The first housing is connected to the second housing in a relatively movable manner in a direction intersecting with the grinding surface, and is elastically held by an elastic body interposed between the first housing and the second housing at least in the intersecting direction.

title: Controlling robot using multi-model force tracking
abstract: A system and method for force-aware motion control in a robot utilizing probabilistic force estimation and adaptive control strategies. The system employs an Interacting Multiple-Model (IMM) Kalman Filter to estimate external forces acting on the robot by processing force pseudo-measurements derived from joint encoder data and robot dynamics. The IMM filter utilizes multiple probabilistic filters, each corresponding to a distinct motion mode—swing, stance, or collision—and updates mode probabilities by integrating force pseudo-measurements and robot dynamics to refine external force estimation. The estimated forces are used to refine contact mode classification and dynamically adjust the robot's trajectory in response to disturbances. The controller integrates reflex motion control and admittance motion control, wherein reflex motion control generates real-time corrective actions to counteract unexpected external disturbances, while admittance motion control applies an admittance model to regulate the robot's motion in compliance with external forces.

title: Performing a closed-loop prediction based on behavior of a network in response to a control policy
abstract: A first network node, in a communications network that includes a second network node, can receive an identifier of a control policy from the second network node. The first network node can determine a prediction model to use based on the identifier of the control policy. The first network node can determine a predicted future state of the communications network using the prediction model. The first network node can transmit a message to the second network node. The message can include an indication of the predicted future state of the communications network.

title: Application and/or Virtual Machine Migration based on Source Sizing and Target Shaping
abstract: Embodiments plan, schedule, and execute digital element migration between a source system and a target system. For example, a source system can include a number of source assets that operate digital elements, such as applications and/or virtual machines. Implementations can perform digital element migration using digital element sizing and target architecture shaping. For example, the digital elements can be sized to determine resource requirements for the digital elements. The sized digital elements can then support shaping of virtual machine instances for the target system, mapping of the digital elements to the virtual machine instances for the target system, and migration scheduling. Embodiments include a dynamic process manager that provides an extensible framework for migration workflows.

title: Memory device for performing target refresh operation, and operation method thereof
abstract: A memory device includes a refresh latch configured to generate a first aggressive address by latching an address input with a refresh management command; a detection circuit configured to sequentially store the first aggressive address as a plurality of first candidate addresses, and generate a detection signal according to a number of duplicated addresses among the plurality of the first candidate addresses; an address sampling circuit configured to generate a second aggressive address by collecting information on rows subjected to a row-hammer attack; and an output control circuit configured to output, as a target address, the first aggressive address or the second aggressive address according to the refresh management command and the detection signal.

title: Hot stamping component and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: A hot stamping component according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes a steel sheet, a plating layer located on the steel sheet and including Zn, and a surface layer located on the plating layer, wherein the surface layer includes a post-treatment layer including an Si-based inorganic post-treatment agent, a Zn oxide layer located on a same layer as the post-treatment layer on the plating layer, and an inter-diffusion layer located between the plating layer and at least one of the post-treatment layer and the Zn oxide layer to overlap at least one of the post-treatment layer and the Zn oxide layer, the inter-diffusion layer including at least one of Si, Mn, O, Fe, Zn, and SiO, wherein a tensile strength of the steel sheet is 1680 MPa or more.

title: Snapshots for distributed object-based datastores
abstract: Snapshot or point-in-time image functionality improves the use of object-based datastores. An example system includes an object-based datastore and a metadata datastore associated with the object-based datastore. Instances of the metadata datastore each identify the distributed data blocks that respectively store the objects included in the object-based datastore. An instance of the metadata datastore is used as a snapshot image of a set of objects of the object-based datastore based on identifying the distributed data blocks that were mapped to the set of objects during a point in time. A different instance of the metadata datastore is dynamically updated to reflect present mappings of distributed data blocks to objects in the object-based datastore. Different instances of the metadata datastore are used to read objects from previous timepoints, restore the object-based datastore to a previous snapshot image, enable intelligent deletion of objects of the object-based data store, and more.

title: Quality of service–based data transmission method and apparatus
abstract: A quality of service-based data transmission method and an apparatus are provided, so that a terminal can better support QoS-based data transmission, thereby improving service performance and user experience. The method includes: reporting, by a terminal to a radio access network (RAN) node, information indicating at least one candidate quality of service (QoS) and an activation duration corresponding to each candidate QoS, where the at least one candidate QoS includes a first QoS, and the activation duration corresponding to each candidate QoS includes an activation duration corresponding to the first QoS; obtaining, by the RAN node, the at least one candidate QoS and the activation duration corresponding to the candidate QoS, and sending, by the RAN node to the terminal, first information indicating the first QoS; and performing, by the terminal and the RAN node after the terminal receives the first information, data transmission based on the first QoS during the activation duration corresponding to the first QoS.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device includes an array substrate having a first display area and a second display area adjacent to the first display area. The array substrate includes first pixel rows and second pixel rows disposed in the first display area and the second display area in a first direction, respectively. Each first pixel row and each second pixel row include first pixels and second pixels disposed in a second direction, respectively. The width of each second pixel in the second direction is the same as the width of each first pixel in the second direction, and the display medium of each second pixel is different from the display medium of each first pixel. The display medium of each second pixel includes first, second and third micro-LEDs, and in each second pixel, two of the first, second and third micro-LEDs overlap in the first direction.

title: Light detection device and electronic device
abstract: A light detection device capable of securing an arrangement space of pixel transistors, even when pixels are miniaturized, is provided. The light detection device includes a semiconductor layer, an inter-pixel separation part, and a plurality of pixel transistors. The semiconductor layer has a first surface part and a second surface part positioned on sides opposite to each other in a thickness direction, and plurality of pixels generating electric charge through photoelectric conversion based on light incident in the first surface part are formed in a matrix pattern in a plan view. The inter-pixel separation part has an upper surface port positioned on the second surface part side of the semiconductor layer, extends in the thickness direction of the semiconductor layer, and separates the pixels adjacent to each other. At least one of the plurality of pixel transistors has a gate electrode crossing two or more pixels adjacent to each other across an upper surface part of the inter-pixel separation part in a plan view.

title: Cloud print server system, information processing system, control method for cloud print server system, and storage medium
abstract: A cloud print server system which is connected to a first cloud print server system and provides a cloud print service, the cloud print server system acquires a first print job including first print setting information supported by a standard print function of an operating system; and converts the first print setting information included in the first print job that is acquired into second print setting information defined by a predetermined protocol for using the cloud print service, wherein the cloud print server converts third print setting information into fourth print setting information defined by the predetermined protocol in a case where the first print job further includes the third print setting information that extends the standard print function.

title: Method for the inspection of an ophthalmic lens for semi-opaque defects
abstract: A method for inspecting an ophthalmic lens for the presence of an unacceptable semi-opaque defect in a lens body thereof comprises the steps of: illuminating the lens body with laser light in an area bounded by an edge of the lens body; detecting the intensity of laser light scattered by the illuminated lens body in a predetermined detection direction which is different from a direction of reflection; comparing the detected intensity of the scattered laser light with a predetermined threshold intensity; determining a size of at least one coherent area in which the detected intensity of the scattered laser light is higher than the predetermined threshold intensity; determining whether the size of the at least one coherent area is larger than a predetermined threshold size, and rejecting the ophthalmic lens in case the size of the at least one coherent area is larger than the predetermined threshold size.

title: Accelerated Start Cow Treatment
abstract: An aqueous nutritional composition is administered to a dairy cow following calving to accelerate recovery and milk production readiness. The composition comprises propylene glycol, calcium, phosphorus, magnesium, potassium, copper, zinc, manganese, cobalt, and a comprehensive blend of vitamins including A, D, E, and B-complex, formulated in a water-based liquid that she rapidly absorbs. The composition is administered from a bottle containing a one-pint dose (440 ml) at calving and at 12-hour intervals for two to three days. The composition restores appetite, normalizes calcium and glucose levels, and addresses multiple post-calving deficiencies such as milk fever and ketosis. The treatment method provides a faster response and recovery compared to conventional treatments, and delivers complete mineral and vitgamin supplementation in a single product.

title: Fluid Resistant Treatment And Garments Treated Therewith
abstract: In one aspect, fabric materials are disclosed that have been treated with a fluid resistant treatment containing a water resistant composition and an oil resistant composition. The fluid resistant treatment may be substantially fluorocarbon free. Fire service garments can be made from the fabric materials that provide resistance to water and/or oil.

title: Memory controller and operating method thereof
abstract: A memory controller according to the present disclosure may be configured to receive a trim command from a host, the trim command instructing to read range data corresponding to a plurality of logical block address ranges, and to sequentially invalidate mapping information corresponding to the plurality of logical block address ranges based on priority information included in the range data.

title: Electric compressor
abstract: An electric compressor includes an electric motor, a compression mechanism configured to be driven by the electric motor, an inverter configured to drive the electric motor, a motor housing configured to accommodate the electric motor, and an inverter case abutting on and fixed to the motor housing, the inverter case being configured to accommodate the inverter. The motor housing includes a tubular main body portion, and a first protruding portion provided on an outer peripheral surface of the main body portion. The inverter case includes an end wall, and an outer surface of the end wall includes an abutment portion that abuts on one end surface of the main body portion, and an exposed portion exposed to the outside. The exposed portion is provided with a second protruding portion. The first protruding portion is directly or indirectly fixed to the second protruding portion.

title: Printing device and operation unit
abstract: A printing device includes a display panel including a display region that displays a touch key; a power saving operation switch that switches a power saving mode; and a support housing that supports the display panel so that the display panel is visible on a support surface having a first side and a second side facing the first side, wherein when the user is positioned at an operation position where the user operates the display panel, the first side is arranged at a position closer to the user than the second side and the power saving operation switch is arranged on a side of the first side with respect to the display region.

title: Systems and methods for detecting abnormal flowback
abstract: A method of analyzing flowback of a downhole system includes generating active flowback data by monitoring an active flowback from a wellbore. Historic flowback data for historic flowback from the wellbore is used to determine a flowback cluster. The flowback cluster is selected based on comparing the active flowback data to the historic flowback data and determining one or more data instances of the historic flowback data that have features that are similar to that of the active flowback data. Based on the flowback cluster, one or more thresholds may be determined in order to generate an alert when the active flowback data exceeds the thresholds.

title: Display panel and manufacturing method therefor, and display device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a display panel, including: an array substrate; and a light-emitting layer located on a side of the array substrate and including a plurality of light-emitting units, wherein each light-emitting unit includes an anode block, a light-emitting functional layer, and a cathode block stacked in sequence in a direction away from the array substrate; wherein the light-emitting layer includes a cathode layer, and the cathode layer includes a plurality of cathode blocks distributed at intervals.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Heater plate with different emissivity for temperature uniformity
abstract: A semiconductor device processing system having a heater plate with different emissivities is described. A process for varying the emissivity of the heater plate is also described. In some examples, the emissivity of the heater plate may be varied by modifying the surface roughness of selected regions of the heater plate. The surface roughness of the selected regions may be modified by various techniques including, for instance, blasting, abrading, plating, painting, and/or anodizing. The heater plate may be part of a cluster-type semiconductor processing platform, located in a load lock, and/or located in individual process modules. One example of the method for modifying the surface roughness includes modeling and adjusting the surface roughness. Another example of the method includes testing and modifying the surface roughness.

title: Batting mat systems and methods
abstract: Techniques are disclosed for systems and methods to provide reversible sporting equipment assemblies. A reversible sporting equipment assembly includes a sporting equipment base mat with a cavity configured receive a reversible play indicator insert. The reversible play indicator insert includes a top surface configured to indicate a direction of play relative to the sporting equipment base mat.

title: Information processing apparatus, control method of information processing apparatus, and storage medium
abstract: An information processing apparatus connectable to a plurality of networks includes: an obtaining unit configured to obtain information on a logged-in user; and a display control unit configured to perform display control of displaying information on the plurality of networks in a first mode in a case where the information on the user obtained by the obtaining unit is first user information, and displaying the information on the plurality of networks in a second mode different from the first mode in a case where the information on the user obtained by the obtaining unit is second user information different from the first user information.

title: Fragment registration and associated methods for repairing fractured bones
abstract: Bone fractures may be associated with one or more fragments separated from a bone. The fractured bone may be captured with an imaging device. The disclosed systems may be configured to predict or otherwise determine a position of the fragments prior to occurrence of the bone fracture. The determined position may be utilized to position and secure the fragments during a surgical procedure. Methods for determining the pre-fracture position of bone fragments are also disclosed.

title: Using sequence identifiers to identify sequential touches in a capacitive sensing system
abstract: A technique for reducing power consumption in a sensor application while maintaining functionality that distinguishes between consecutive touches of a sensor and a continuous touch of the sensor includes configuring a processor in a low-power state of operation, assigning a sequence identifier to each traversal of the sensors for updated sensor signals, and storing sensor data including a corresponding sequence identifier in a storage element for each touch detected. The sequence identifier counter increments for each traversal of the sensors for updated sensor signals. Digital logic includes a state machine that awakens the processor from the low-power state in response to a predetermined amount of the storage element being filled. The processor moves sensor data from the storage element into a memory. The processor distinguishes between consecutive touches of the sensor and a continuous touch of the sensor based on corresponding sequence identifiers.

title: Apparatus, method and computer readable storage medium for communication
abstract: Embodiments of the present application provide apparatus, method and computer readable storage medium for communication. In an example method, a mission management (MM) network element determines that a processing service function (PSF) network element meets a re-location condition. The MM network element may then instruct a task control function (TCF) network element managing the PSF network element, to switch the sub-task executed on the PSF network element to another PSF network element for execution by sending a re-location request.

title: Structural-body molding method and joined structural body
abstract: In a structural-body molding method, first and second pre-pregs ( 11   f ,  11   s ) are set in a cavity (C) of a first mold ( 43 ) such that first and second carbon fibers ( 11   b ) of the first and second pre-pregs extend in first and second directions, respectively. The first and second pre-pregs overlap in a third direction that is orthogonal to the first and second directions. The first mold and a second mold ( 45 ) are clamped and the first and second pre-pregs are pressurized in the cavity to unite them. A needle ( 27 ) is pierced through an overlapping portion of the first and second pre-pregs to form a connecting hole ( 51   a ) therethrough. While the needle is piercing through, or has already pierced through, and is disposed in the connecting hole, an injection material ( 39 ) is injected into the cavity to join with the first and second-pregs and form a structural body ( 55 ).

title: Semiconductor device including interconnection structure
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a lower structure; an intermediate insulating structure on the lower structure; an intermediate interconnection structure penetrating through the intermediate insulating structure; an upper insulating structure on the intermediate insulating structure and the intermediate interconnection structure; and an upper conductive pattern penetrating through the upper insulating structure and electrically connected to the intermediate interconnection structure, wherein the intermediate insulating structure includes an intermediate etch-stop layer and an intermediate insulating layer thereon, the intermediate insulating layer includes first and second intermediate material layers, the second intermediate material layer having an upper surface coplanar with an upper surface of the first intermediate material layer, the intermediate interconnection structure penetrates through the first intermediate material layer and the intermediate etch-stop layer, and a material of the first intermediate material layer has a dielectric constant that is higher than a dielectric constant of a material of the second intermediate material layer.

title: Recognition model building method, bank card number recognition method, and related products thereof
abstract: A recognition model building method includes acquiring an initial bank card dataset and a background dataset, performing data enhancement on the initial bank card dataset with the background dataset to obtain a bank card dataset, and building a multitask recognition model from the bank card dataset. Data enhancement is performed on the initial bank card dataset with the background dataset to obtain a bank card dataset with abundant and diverse samples.
assignee: Nanjing Xiyin Ecommerce Co., Ltd.; Guangzhou Xiyin International Import and Export Co., Ltd.; Shenzhen Xiyin Information Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Byte stream processing pipeline for a hardware integrated circuit
abstract: Methods and systems, including computer-readable media, are described for a byte stream processing pipeline using an instruction set architecture for a hardware integrated circuit. The byte stream pipeline is used to access memory banks of a compute tile of the circuit based on an instruction executed at the tile. An opcode is identified in the instruction. The opcode indicates an operation to access memory banks of a memory at the tile. From the opcode, a byte addressing sequence is generated to access different lengths of contiguous bytes that are stored at the banks. Based on the byte addressing sequence, multiple byte-addressable memory accesses are performed at the memory to obtain a plurality of input vectors from the memory banks.

title: Emulsification devices and methods for crystalline lens removal
abstract: This disclosure relates to thermal fluid emulsification systems and methods for cataract removal. The thermal fluid emulsification systems can deliver heated fluid to the crystalline lens within the capsular bag of the eye, resulting in the emulsification of the crystalline lens. The emulsified crystalline lens can be aspirated from the capsular bag of the eye. The thermal fluid emulsification systems can include tips configured to localize heat to avoid unintentional damage to other ocular components and cellular structures of the eye.

title: Manufacturing method of semiconductor structure
abstract: A manufacturing method of a semiconductor structure includes forming a memory structure including two bitlines, a dielectric layer stack between the two bitlines, an isolation structure in contact with the dielectric layer stack and a sacrificial layer in contact with the isolation structure and the dielectric layer stack, an active area is under a bottom of the dielectric layer stack. The sacrificial layer is removed to form an opening in the dielectric layer stack. A lining layer is formed along the sidewall of the opening. Portions of the lining layer at the sidewall of the dielectric layer stack are removed, and a remaining portion of the lining layer remains at a sharp corner defined by the isolation structure and the dielectric layer stack. The bottom of the dielectric layer is removed to expose the active area. A contact is formed in the opening.

title: Driving assistance apparatus, driving assistance method, and non-transitory storage medium storing program thereof
abstract: The driving assistance apparatus generates fusion object information by fusing radar object information including a radar ground speed of an object present ahead of a host vehicle and camera object information including a type and a camera ground speed of the object. The apparatus includes a controller configured to perform driving assistance control to reduce a collision risk between an object and the host vehicle based on the fusion object information. The controller performs the driving assistance control as necessary in a case where a specific situation is occurring with respect to a specific object whose fusion object information has been generated. The specific situation is a situation in which the radar ground speed of the specific object is within a first range including 0 and the camera ground speed of the specific object included in the camera object information is within a second range including 0.
assignee: Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha; Denso Corporation

title: Immune cells defective for suv39h1
abstract: The present invention relates to an engineered immune cell defective for Suv39h1. Preferably, said engineered immune cell further comprises a genetically engineered antigen receptor that specifically binds a target antigen. The present invention also relates to a method for obtaining a genetically engineered immune cell comprising a step consisting in inhibiting the expression and/or activity of Suv39h1 in the immune cell; and further optionally comprising a step consisting in introducing in the said immune cell a genetically engineered antigen receptor that specifically binds to a target antigen. The invention also encompasses said engineered immune cell for their use in adoptive therapy, notably for the treatment of cancer.
assignee: Institut Curie; Institut National De La Sante Et De La Recherche Medicale; Centre National De La Recherche Scientifique (Cnrs)

title: Backlight module
abstract: A backlight module includes at least one light bar structure. The light bar structure is disposed on a side of a metal structure. The light bar structure includes a printed circuit board, a positive contact pad, a negative heat spreader, a plurality of light sources and a connector. The printed circuit board has a plurality of first openings. The positive contact pad is disposed on the printed circuit board. The negative heat spreader is disposed on the printed circuit board and has a plurality of first bending portions. The first bending portions at least partially penetrate through the first openings and contact with the side of the metal structure. The light sources are respectively and electrically connected with the negative heat spreader and the positive contact pad. The connector is electrically connected with the negative heat spreader and the positive contact pad.

title: System for actuation of a thrust reverser unit of a jet engine of an aircraft
abstract: A system for actuation of a thrust reverser unit of a jet engine of an aircraft. The actuation system includes one actuator associated with (at least) one electric motor to set the thrust reverser unit in motion from a stowed position to a deployed position (in an extension phase) or vice versa (in a retraction phase). The electric motor is of the dissipative type and configured to dissipate at least part of the energy generated thereby when it counterbalances a tensile load to which the actuation system is subjected during the extension phase. The use of a dissipative electric motor makes it possible to require neither a resistor bank nor mechanical energy dissipation means, and therefore to preserve the reliability of the electronics for controlling the electric motor while at the same time limiting the cost, weight and bulk of the actuation system.

title: Image encoding method/device, image decoding method/device, and recording medium in which bitstream is stored
abstract: The present invention provides an image encoding method and an image decoding method. The image encoding method of the present invention comprises: a first dividing step of dividing a current image into a plurality of blocks; and a second dividing step of dividing, into a plurality of sub blocks, a block, which is to be divided and includes a boundary of the current image, among the plurality of blocks, wherein the second dividing step is recursively performed by setting a sub block including the boundary of the current images as the block to be divided, until the sub block including the boundary of the current image does not exist among the sub blocks.
assignee: Industry Academy Cooperation Foundation Of Sejong University

title: User equipment (ue)
abstract: A UE stores certain S-NSSAI in partially allowed NSSAI, and deletes the S-NSSAI from the partially allowed NSSAI stored in a storage unit in a case that the UE receives allowed NSSAI including the S-NSSAI.

title: Device control method and apparatus, grasping device, and storage medium
abstract: A control method is provided. The method includes: obtaining target position information of at least one preset position obtained by the grasping device contacting a target object from a plurality of directions, and target pressure information corresponding to the target position information; determining target point cloud data of the target object based on the target position information and the target pressure information corresponding to the target position information; and determining a point cloud data model of the target object based on the target point cloud data, so as to identify a grasping object of the grasping device based on the point cloud data model. A control apparatus, a grasping device, and a storage medium are also provided.

title: Heat exchanger density ion injection and reclaim system
abstract: An ion gas injection and reclamation system including a heat exchanger fluidly coupled with at least one flow passage; a re-valence/recirculator fluidly coupled with the at least one flow passage; an ion fluid reclaimer fluidly coupled with the re-valence/recirculator; and an injection gas comprising at least one ion fluid constituent fluidly coupled with at least one of the re-valence/recirculator, the ion gas reclaimer and the at least one flow passage.

title: Attribute Authority Delegation In Data Storage Environments
abstract: The disclosure describes systems, devices, and methods for managing multi-part files and attributes thereof in data storage environments. In an example implementation, a method of operating multiple storage controllers in a data storage environment is provided. In performing the method, a data element of a storage controller of the multiple storage controllers receives an input/output request from a network element of a one of the multiple storage controllers corresponding to data to a multi-part file stored across multiple storage devices in the data storage environment. The input/output request includes current attributes of the multi-part file. The data element executes the input/output request with respect to a part of the multi-part file corresponding to the storage controller and determines whether to delegate attribute authority to the network element based on a set of criteria.

title: Printing control device, printing control method, and program
abstract: A printing control device, includes: a print data generation module configured to generate print data; a printing speed analysis module configured to perform analysis of a printing speed with respect to the print data line by line; a printing speed calculation module configured to calculate the printing speed based on a result of the analysis performed by the printing speed analysis module and on a printing misalignment inhibition condition for inhibiting printing misalignment; and a print data transmission module configured to transmit a speed setting command indicating the printing speed and the print data to a printing device.

title: Charged particle beam device
abstract: A charged particle beam device according to some implementations of the present disclosure comprises: a plurality of columns, a plurality of shielding covers, a chamber, and a detector. Each of the plurality of columns is configured to scan an electron beam on a sample. Each of the plurality of shielding covers surrounds a respective one of the plurality of columns. The chamber is coupled to the plurality of columns, and includes a stage that supports the sample and is disposed apart from ends of the plurality of columns. The detector is configured to detect electrons emitted from the sample. Each of the plurality of columns has a polygonal shape in a plan view.

title: Stabilization system and method for imaging scenes having apparent motion
abstract: Systems, methods and devices for imaging scenes in apparent motion are provided, specifically, an apparatus comprising: at least one area imaging device; at least one stabilizing optical element configured to receive light and reflect at least part of the received light; a positioning mechanism configured to move at least one of the at least one area imaging device along a first tracking axis or the at least one stabilizing optical element along a second tracking axis; and a control module configured to control the positioning mechanism to move at least one of the at least one area imaging device along the first tracking axis or the at least one stabilizing optical element along the second tracking axis.

title: Systems and methods for compressed data offloading for llm inference
abstract: An apparatus and method for efficiently performing efficient data storage and data transfer of machine learning (ML) data. In various implementations, a host processing circuit of a computing system executes an ML application. The application includes a computational graph that provides the computational order of the ML nodes, layers and stages of the ML model. The host processing circuit translates function calls in the application to commands particular to an accelerator circuit. When data storage capacity of the local memory of the accelerator circuit exceeds a threshold, the accelerator circuit compress one or more of the weights and intermediate data prior to offloading this data from the local memory based on completion of execution of a corresponding ML layer and a compression ratio being greater than a ratio based on decompression throughput and data transfer rates between levels of a memory hierarchy.
assignee: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; Ati Technologies Ulc

title: Optical sensor device for fault detection in mechanical weed controllers and subsoilers
abstract: An optical sensor device for detecting faults in mechanical weeders and subsoilers supported by a support bracket attached to the frame, The optical sensor device ( 8 ) includes a tubular housing with an infrared guide ( 10 ), inside which an electronic circuit ( 13 ) connected to a transmitting infrared LED ( 15 ) and a receiving phototransistor ( 16 ) arranged in parallel is housed. The tubular housing with the infrared guide ( 10 ) is protected by a polycarbonate protective lens ( 14 ) and closed with a cap ( 11 ), where the mentioned optical sensor device ( 8 ) is fixed by a mounting base ( 9 ) and connected through a power and data cable ( 12 ), which is integrated into a LIN network linking it to the operator's control panel.

title: Connection assembly, housing as well as antenna
abstract: A connection assembly has a first structural component, a second structural component and a contacting element. A first connection section and a second connection section of the structural components face each other, forming a slot between them. The first structural component comprises a groove in the first connection section, the groove being confined at least by two straight walls. The contacting element comprises a contacting portion being a helix, the contacting portion being in physical contact with the second connection section of the second structural component and with the straight walls of the first structural component. Further, a housing and an antenna are shown.

title: Dynamic adaptation of identity related user interface
abstract: An Account Booking Location (ABL) is computed from a login request to access an account of a user. The ABL corresponds to an asset of a partner entity that initiated the account. A UI element corresponding to the ABL is pushed from a repository to a cache for a UI rendering and a rendering service composes a rendering instruction using the cached data to cause a brand-specific UI to be rendered on a device of the user. When a second login request from a second user also corresponds to the ABL, the cached data is reused to compose a second rendering instruction such that the second rendering instruction causes the brand-specific UI to be rendered on a second device. When a control mechanism is configured to cause a feature to be rendered in an ABL agnostic manner, the rendering instruction is modified to include the feature on the brand-specific UI.

title: Cathode active material and lithium-ion battery
abstract: The present disclosure provides a cathode active material for use in a lithium-ion battery. The cathode active material includes crystalline primary particles containing Li, Ni, Mn, and O. The cathode active material is a single-crystal active material formed of the primary particles. The primary particles have, as a main phase, a crystal structure belonging to the space group R-3m. When observed with a transmission electron microscope, the primary particles have a first exposed surface of a (003) plane. The amount of Mn in a surface region of the first exposed surface is defined as X and the amount of Mn in a bulk region located closer to the center of the primary particle than the surface region is defined as Y, and X and Y satisfy 1.1≤X/Y.

title: Display device with touch detection function
abstract: A display device with is touch detection function is provided and includes display area where electrodes are arranged in matrix having first and second directions crossing above substrate; common electrodes provided so as to face pixel electrodes; pixel signal lines each coupled to pixel electrodes, extending in first direction; control device for performing image display control and including drive signal generator and source driver; single first wire to which both display drive voltage and touch drive signal are supplied from drive signal generator, and selection switches for selecting common electrodes, wherein the drive signal generator includes first and second voltage generators for generating first and second voltages, and switching circuit for switching between first and second voltages, and wherein selection switches each coupled to single first wire via first coupling conductor and coupled to common electrode via second coupling conductor are arranged in frame area along single first wire, and are overlapped by single first wire that is supplied with display drive voltage from drive signal generator and that is supplied with touch drive signal from drive signal generator.

title: Variant-capture minimal residual disease panels
abstract: Described herein are compositions for detecting genomic variants associated with minimal residual disease (MRD). The compositions include libraries comprising a plurality of polynucleotides comprising at least one variant associated with minimal residual disease (MRD). Further described herein are methods of preparing such polynucleotide libraries, and methods of detecting MRD in a sample using such polynucleotide libraries.

title: Beam scheduling for network-controlled repeaters
abstract: The present application relates to devices and components, including apparatus, systems, and methods for allocating time domain resources to transmission beams at a network-controlled repeater.

title: Methods of synthesizing vinylamine-containing polymer solutions and vinylamine-containing polymer solutions synthesized through the methods
abstract: Methods for producing a vinylamine-containing polymer solution, and vinylamine-containing polymer solutions produced through the methods, are provided herein. In an embodiment, a method includes polymerizing N-vinylcarboxamide monomers in a reaction mixture, hydrolyzing a resulting intermediate polymer formulation, providing a pH value associated with the reaction mixture, setting a value for one or more viscosity-affecting process parameters based on the provided pH, and implementing the value for the one or more viscosity-affecting process parameters during the reacting and/or hydrolyzing step. In an embodiment, the pH associated with the reaction mixture is changed by no more than +/−0.3 as a direct result of the implementing step.

title: Machine learning system for assessing heart valves and surrounding cardiovascular tracts
abstract: A machine learning system for evaluating at least one characteristic of a heart valve, an inflow tract, an outflow tract or a combination thereof may include a training mode and a production mode. The training mode may be configured to train a computer and construct a transformation function to predict an unknown anatomical characteristic and/or an unknown physiological characteristic of a heart valve, inflow tract and/or outflow tract, using a known anatomical characteristic and/or a known physiological characteristic the heart valve, inflow tract and/or outflow tract. The production mode may be configured to use the transformation function to predict the unknown anatomical characteristic and/or the unknown physiological characteristic of the heart valve, inflow tract and/or outflow tract, based on the known anatomical characteristic and/or the known physiological characteristic of the heart valve, inflow tract and/or outflow tract.

title: Process for mixing a fluid meltflow stream
abstract: The present disclosure provides a process. In an embodiment, the process includes providing an apparatus. The apparatus includes (A) a passageway with an interior for receiving a first flow stream (FFS 1 ), the passageway having an inflow end and an opposing outflow end. The apparatus includes (B) a gear pump assembly having (i) a housing, (ii) a gear chamber in the housing, (iii) an inlet placing the passageway outflow end in fluid communication with the gear chamber, the inlet having a width (l w ), (iv) a plurality of intermeshing gears mounted for rotation in the gear chamber, the gears having teeth which engage with each other in the chamber, and (v) an outlet in fluid communication with the gear chamber. The apparatus includes (C) one or more injectors upstream of the gear pump assembly for adding a second fluid into the first flow stream. The injectors are located a distance of at least one-half of a gear diameter upstream of the inlet, each injector having an elongated conduit extending into the passageway interior. The process includes introducing the second fluid from each respective elongated conduit into the FFS 1  at a location at least one-half of a gear diameter upstream of the inlet, feeding the FFS 1  and the second fluid into the inlet. The process includes mixing, in the gear chamber, the second fluid with FFS 1  to form a mixed fluid flowstream (mFFS), and discharging the mFFS from the outlet.

title: Anion-binding aromatic oligoamide macrocycles and methods of making and using same
abstract: Provided are compounds having the following structure (I) or (II) The compounds may be used to sequester one or more hydrogen-bond acceptors and/or ions. Also provided are methods for making the compounds and methods for using the compounds for treating individuals diagnosed with or suspected of having an extracellular and/or intracellular anion imbalances and/or cystic fibrosis.
assignee: The Research Foundation For The State University Of New York

title: Architectural panel system and method of use
abstract: A system and related methods for affixing a plurality of architectural siding panels as the exterior or on the exterior of a structure, such as, but not limited to, a home, a residence, or a light commercial office building. The siding panels are of various sizes, typically rectilinear in shape, with a groove or slot running lengthwise in the panel edges. The panels are mounted on the walls, stud walls or studs by a combination of lightweight aluminum extrusions, hangers, and metal clips which engage the panel edges and/or grooves, as well as each other. The extrusions hold the siding panels away from and off of the structural or stud wall, thereby providing an integrated rainscreen and eliminating the need for “face-fastening” the siding panels. Corresponding solar panels may be used to substitute for one or more siding panels.

title: Seat belt retractor
abstract: A seat belt retractor includes a pretensioning component and a winding component connected to the pretensioning component. The pretensioning component has a stop wheel and a ball gear which is sleeved on the stop wheel in an anti-torsion manner. The stop wheel is provided with a first curved surface, and the ball gear is provided with a second curved surface. The first curved surface and the second curved surface enclose a ball chamber together, the ball chamber is used for accommodating a pretensioning ball. Centers of a plurality of ball chambers are located on a preset plane together. A portion of the second curved surface and the first curved surface are located on one side of the preset plane, and the other portion of the second curved surface is located on the other side of the preset plane.
assignee: Yanfeng International Automotive Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Integrated circuit structures with trench contact depopulation structure
abstract: Integrated circuit structures having trench contact depopulation structures, and methods of fabricating integrated circuit structures having trench contact depopulation structures, are described. For example, an integrated circuit structure includes a vertical stack of horizontal nanowires. A gate stack is over the vertical stack of horizontal nanowires. A dielectric trench structure is adjacent to the gate stack. A dielectric sidewall spacer is between the gate stack and the dielectric trench structure. A dielectric gate cut plug is extending through the gate stack, the dielectric sidewall spacer, and the dielectric trench structure.

title: Magnetic sensor device, rotation detection system including the same, and magnetic field generation device
abstract: A hollow shaft is formed of a ferromagnetic body, and holds a refrigerant at an inner circumferential side. A magnet is positioned at an outer circumferential side of the hollow shaft, and includes N pole and S pole adjacent in a circumferential direction of the hollow shaft. A magnetic sensor detects a magnetic field of the magnet. The hollow shaft and the magnet are configured so that a first function relating to a shape and characteristics of the hollow shaft and a second function relating to a shape and characteristics of the magnet satisfy a condition for reducing a leakage magnetic field from the magnet from the outer circumferential side to the inner circumferential side of the hollow shaft.

title: Automated calling number verification
abstract: An example may include verifying a call number to be used by an enterprise entity by selecting an enterprise number to verify from a database of one or more enterprise numbers assigned to a particular enterprise entity, initiating an outbound call destined to the enterprise number from an origination number known to an enterprise platform, receiving a return call to the origination number from the enterprise number, determining whether the return call was received within a defined time interval, and updating the enterprise number status in memory as a verified enterprise number when the return call was received within the defined time interval.

title: Firefighting System and Method
abstract: Firefighting systems use a gas exchange module to infuse CO 2  into water to produce carbonic acid, which is then applied to a fire by conventional means. The carbonic acid solution extinguishes a fire more effectively than water alone. The gas exchange system may be integrated into existing platforms, such as water tankers, pumpers, and firefighting aircraft. Alternatively, it may be a mobile, free-standing system placed between a fire hydrant and a pumper or tanker truck to supply carbonic acid to the pumper or tanker. The carbonic acid solution may further contain firefighting chemical additives as are known in the art. Related methods are also disclosed.
assignee: Stephen Crabbe; Lewis Malone; Shane Sauceman; Robert Lauf

title: System and method for a bunionectomy via bone cutting and fixation of a metatarsal in the foot
abstract: A system and method for a ROSE-Reverdin/DARE osteotomy obviates severe deformities having a high intermetatarsal angle and which require closure via osteotomy (bone cut) of the first and/or fifth metatarsal in the midshaft or proximal aspect of the bone. The ROSE osteotomy is utilized to achieve this correction and is performed without need for fusion of the first metatarsal cuneiform joint. The ROSE osteotomy achieves correction of the intermetatarsal angle via rotation of the first and/or fifth metatarsal about a proximal based axis point. The Reverdin/DARE osteotomy is required to correct a deviated articular cartilage deformity at the head of the first metatarsal and/or additional slight correction of the IM angle. The Reverdin/DARE osteotomy achieves correction by wedging of the cut to realign cartilage and translation of the head of the first metatarsal for further IM correction. A unique jig and plate is used to achieve this cut and fixation.

title: Method for filling gap
abstract: A method for filling a gap includes: filling a dielectric layer in the gap so that a seam is formed in the dielectric layer, the dielectric layer including two surface portions at two opposite sides of the seam, respectively; introducing a surface modification agent into the seam such that each of the two surface portions has first functional groups and second functional groups; forming a stress layer on the dielectric layer to cover the seam, the stress layer including a material different from that of the dielectric layer; and applying an energy field to permit the two surface portions to bond with each other through reaction between the first functional groups and the second functional groups.

title: Apparatus, battery pack, and battery-cell determination method
abstract: An apparatus according to the present technology includes a specification section and a determination section. The specification section specifies a difference in voltage on an open circuit voltage (OCV) curve of a battery cell. The determination section determines whether the battery cell is authentic or non-authentic, on the basis of the difference in voltage.

title: Method and system for oral imaging
abstract: Disclosed are a system and a method for oral imaging. The system includes a hand piece, an optical arrangement, and a sensor. The hand piece includes a distal optical passage and a proximal optical passage. The distal optical passage is located at a distal end of the hand piece configured to be located within a patient's mouth.
