Furthermore, email metadata is utilized to perform weighting of terms and evaluate the employee's influence. A comparison unit compares the extracted terms with those of other employees to identify employees with specific skills. Finally, a generation unit automatically generates an introductory text for the employee using GPT.

title: Authentication control apparatus, authentication control method, and non-transitory computer readable medium
abstract: An authentication control apparatus according to the present disclosure includes a first detection unit that detects first detection information including at least one of a motion of a terminal apparatus of a user and an action of the user with respect to the terminal apparatus, a second detection unit that detects second detection information that is information related to the first detection information and includes at least one of the motion of the terminal apparatus and the action of the user with respect to the terminal apparatus by a method different from that of the first detection unit, and an authentication control unit that controls authentication processing of the terminal apparatus of the user by collating the first detection information with the second detection information.

title: Electrical switch
abstract: An electrical switch is disclosed herein that includes a stationary contact assembly including a stationary contact; a moving contact assembly adapted to be switched between a closed position and an open position relative to the stationary contact assembly, the moving contact assembly having a moving contact; an arc extinguishing chamber having a first group of arc extinguishing grids and a second group of arc extinguishing grids with the first group of arc extinguishing grids being closer to the stationary contact than the second group of arc extinguishing grids; and a pair of arc striking pieces. The electrical switch can further include a first arc striking piece of the pair of arc striking pieces that is adjacent to the stationary contact and a second arc striking piece of the pair of arc striking pieces that is adjacent to the moving contact when the moving contact assembly is in the open position.

title: Perforated inhalation mask
abstract: A nebulizer mask includes a body defining an interior chamber for receiving aerosolized medication, the body having an interior surface and an exterior surface. The nebulizer mask also includes a connector interface, at a tip of the mask, for attaching the nebulizer mask to a nebulizer device. The nebulizer mask further includes a group of perforations on the body, each perforation penetrating the interior surface and the exterior surface.

title: Housing
abstract: A housing is adapted to install an electronic device and includes an outer housing which the electronic device disposed in, a water drop sensing module located in the outer housing and including a first water drop sensor, and a control device electrically connected to the first water drop sensor and the electronic device. An outer surface of the outer housing has a sensing area. The water drop sensing module is disposed on an inner surface of the outer housing corresponding to the sensing area. When a water drop touches the sensing area corresponding to the first water drop sensor, the first water drop sensor outputs a first sensing signal to the control device. The control device transmits a first notifying signal to the electronic device according to the first sensing signal. The electronic device adjusts at least one device parameter according to the first notifying signal.

title: Communication control device, base station, and communication control method
abstract: There is provided a communication control device capable of preventing or suppressing radio wave interference between base stations when a plurality of base stations uses the same wireless communication resource. The communication control device includes: a reception unit that receives information regarding priority of a first base station and a second base station; a determination unit that determines priority between the first base station and the second base station on the basis of the information regarding the priority; a calculation unit that calculates radio wave areas of the first base station and the second base station on the basis of the priority; a decision unit that decides a wireless parameter of at least one of the first base station or the second base station on the basis of the radio wave areas; and a first transmission unit that transmits the wireless parameter to a corresponding base station.

title: Low-power signaling for medical devices and medical device personnel
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure are directed toward apparatuses, systems, and methods that include at least one medical device having a device transceiver configured to wirelessly broadcast a device signal including at least unique identifier data and an information system is configured to maintain an active list of medical device inventory associated with a particular emergency response vehicle, and the processor is configured to automatically determine presence of the at least one medical device.

title: Article
abstract: An article for an aerosol provision device, the article comprising: aerosol generating material; a first resistive heating layer comprising a first resistive heating element configured to heat the aerosol generating material; the aerosol generating material being on the first resistive heating layer; a second resistive heating layer comprising a second resistive heating element configured to heat the aerosol generating material to generate an aerosol; and the aerosol generating material being on the second resistive heating layer; wherein each resistive heating element is at least a portion of an electrically conductive path between a first type of electrical contact and a second type of electrical contact.

title: Information processing system and non-transitory computer readable medium
abstract: An information processing system includes a processor configured to: associate attribute information with each page of an album including a plurality of pages; select and present recommended images from images having attribute information associated with each page among a plurality of previously stored images; receive selection of images to be arranged on a corresponding page of the album from the recommended images; and arrange the selected images on the corresponding page of the album.

title: Visitor reception system and visitor reception method
abstract: A visitor reception system for a financial facility including a plurality of customer service areas includes: a visitor reception device disposed at the financial facility and configured to receive an operation from a customer; a computer configured to determine at least one of a purpose of a visit of the customer and attribute information of the customer in response to the operation; and a staff terminal operable by an employee of the financial facility.

title: Navigation of autonomous vehicles
abstract: A computer system to navigate an autonomous vehicle is provided. The processing circuitry is configured to acquire a map of an area in which the vehicle is to be navigated, the map indicating one or more sub-areas where at least one of a first localization device and a second localization device of the vehicle provides unreliable vehicle location data utilized for locating the vehicle on the map, localize the vehicle by collecting vehicle location data from the first and the second localization device, and in response to any one of the first and second localization devices being determined to provide unreliable vehicle location data: navigate in a first navigation mode in response to the vehicle being determined to be located in a sub-area as indicated on the map where it is expected that said any one of the first and second localization devices provides unreliable vehicle location data, and navigate in a second navigation mode in response to the vehicle being determined to be located outside of said one or more sub-areas on the map where it is expected that the first and second localization devices provide reliable vehicle location data.

title: Traditional chinese medicine composition for treating lung inflammation related diseases and its uses
abstract: The present disclosure provides a traditional Chinese medicine composition for treating lung inflammation related diseases, comprising glycyrrhizic acid, baicalein and 6-shogaol. The traditional Chinese medicine composition of the present disclosure is based on the combination of multiple active ingredients of traditional Chinese medicine, which can exert synergistic effects with multiple targets and at multiple levels. The multi-ingredient combination can overcome the limited efficacy, adverse reactions and drug resistance of single-ingredient treatment, and has no toxic and side effects in the effective dose range, which can ensure the safety of clinical medication, especially for patients who are not suitable for hormones, expanding the scope of clinical application. In addition, the present disclosure is a composition of active ingredients of traditional Chinese medicine with clear ingredients and clear interactions among ingredients, and its efficacy and safety are higher than those of traditional Chinese medicine compound prescriptions with complex ingredients.
assignee: Xiyuan Hospital, China Academy Of Chinese Medical Sciences; Nicm Health Research Institute, Western Sydney University, Australia

title: Material for chemical vapor deposition, film production method, and film
abstract: The present invention provides a material for chemical vapor deposition, a film production method, and a film which are novel. Provided is a material for chemical vapor deposition represented by formula (1). (In the formula, E an is an oxygen atom, a sulfur atom, a selenium atom, or a tellurium atom. R 1 , R 2 , and R 3 , are each independently a hydrogen atom or a linear, branched, or cyclic C1-7 organic group, and at least one of R 1 , R 2 , and R 3  includes a fluorine atom. A case where R 1 , R 2 , and R 3  are all a hydrogen atom is excluded.
assignee: L'Air Liquide, Société Anonyme Pour l'Etude et l'Etude et l'Exploitation des Procédés Georges claude

title: Negative electrode for lithium ion secondary battery
abstract: A battery comprises an electrode current collector and an electrode active material layer disposed on at least one surface of the electrode current collector, wherein the electrode active material layer comprises a lower layer disposed on the at least one surface of the electrode current collector and an upper layer disposed on the lower layer, each of the lower layer and the upper layer independently includes an electrode mixture containing an electrode active material, a conductive material and a binder, and the electrode active material includes an electrode active material a and an electrode active material b, the electrode active material a comprises graphite with at least one surface coated with a carbonaceous material, the electrode active material b comprises graphite having a surface that is not coated with carbonaceous material, and the upper layer has a higher weight percentage of the negative electrode active material a than a weight percentage of the negative electrode active material a in the lower layer.

title: Seamless roaming preparation with multiple target access point multi-link devices
abstract: Seamless roaming preparation for a STA to multiple target AP MLDs. An AP MLD that the STA is connected to can receive multiple roaming preparation requests from the STA for different target AP MLDs. The AP MLD transmits the roaming preparation requests to the different target AP MLDs and receives a response from the different target AP MLDs indicating whether each of the different target AP MLDs accepted the roaming preparation request. The AP MLD transmits the responses back to the STA along with roaming information for at least one target AP MLD.

title: Communication method executed in image forming apparatus
abstract: An image forming apparatus comprises a plurality of control devices including at least a first control device and a second control device, and a communication line for communication between the plurality of control devices. The first control device includes a first communication unit configured to, in a first communication mode, transmit a control instruction to the second control device or receive information from the second control device, and, in a second communication mode, communicate time information for synchronizing a time that serves as a reference for execution timing of the control instruction in the second control device, and a first timer configured to indicate a time that serves as a reference for time-based synchronization in the second communication mode.

title: Package comprising substrate with improved solder resist layer configuration
abstract: A package comprising a substrate comprising at least one dielectric layer; a plurality of interconnects; and a solder resist layer coupled to a surface of the at least one dielectric layer, wherein the solder resist layer comprises a first portion comprising a first thickness; and a second portion comprising a second thickness. The package further comprises a passive device coupled to the substrate, wherein the passive device vertically overlaps with the first portion of the solder resist layer.

title: Through-hole electrode substrate, mems device, manufacturing method of mems device, and multilayered device
abstract: A through-hole electrode substrate includes a substrate including a first surface and a second surface on a side opposite to the first surface, at least one electrode extending from the first surface to the second surface, and an insulating film including a first part extending along the at least one electrode and contacting with the at least one electrode, a second part extending along the first part and being adjacent to the first part, and a boundary surface between the first part and the second part.

title: Context-Aware Verbal and Non-Verbal Cue Detection
abstract: An agent of a system receives a voice input from a user during a real-time conversation between the agent and user. The system generates an input to a machine learning (ML) model. The input includes a user utterance in the voice input, conversation history, currently executed skill by the agent, and one or more parameters associated with the currently executed skill. The system applies the ML model to the generated input to generate an expected action for the agent. The system trains the ML model by accessing a training dataset of training examples, applying the ML model to each training example, and receiving the expected action for each respective training example, where the expected action indicates whether to interrupt the conversation based on the user utterance and contextual information. The system receives an output from the ML model and generates a response to the voice input based on the output.

title: Energy storage system
abstract: An energy storage system includes an energy storage box, a battery cluster, and an exhaust assembly. The energy storage box includes a battery compartment and an auxiliary compartment, where a partition wall is provided between the battery compartment and the auxiliary compartment, and the partition wall is formed with a ventilation opening communicating with the battery compartment. The battery cluster is mounted in the battery compartment, where the battery cluster includes a plurality of battery modules electrically connected to each other. The exhaust assembly has an air duct, the exhaust assembly is provided at the auxiliary compartment, the exhaust assembly is configured to discharge a gas discharged from the ventilation opening out of the energy storage box through the air duct.

title: Rotor stage containment structure for gas turbine engine
abstract: An annular containment structure for a rotor stage of a gas turbine engine is provided that includes an outer radial panel, a plurality of contact members, and a deformable structure. The outer radial panel has an inner radial surface and an outer radial surface. The contact members are distributed around a circumference of the containment structure. The deformable structure is engaged with the inner radial surface of the outer radial panel and the plurality of contact members. The deformable structure is configured to dissipate energy by plastically deforming. Each contact member includes an interior segment and an inner perimeter segment that are connected to one another. The inner perimeter segments form at least a portion of an inner radial surface of the containment structure.

title: Thermal protector
abstract: A thermal protector includes a base member and a cover member which are formed of a resin, a stationary contact and a movable contact which are provided in a housing space, a fixing member provided with the stationary contact, a movable member provided with the movable contact, and a thermally actuated element. The thermally actuated element performs a deformation operation by receiving heat, and exerts force in a direction, in which the movable contact moves apart from the stationary contact, on the movable member. The base member has a protrusion portion. The cover member has a through hole portion through which the protrusion portion passes. The base member and the cover member are fixed to each other by formation of a thermal caulking portion in a protruding portion. The protruding portion passes through the through hole portion and protrudes to an outside of the cover member.

title: System and method for real-time cybersecurity observation
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system and method for real-time cybersecurity observation configured to provide continuous, multi-layer monitoring of computing devices and cyber-physical machines through integrated telemetry acquisition, structural behavioral modeling, anomaly inference, and tamper-resistant evidence preservation. The system acquires heterogeneous telemetry including process activity, system calls, memory transactions, firmware execution signals, hardware interrupts, and network communication metadata, and transforms the telemetry into harmonized structured event records. A dynamic interaction graph is constructed within sliding temporal windows to represent relationships among system entities, and structural and temporal characteristics of the graph are encoded into behavioral fingerprints. The fingerprints are compared with trusted behavioral profiles to compute deviation metrics and generate threat confidence values based on structural divergence and reconstructed causal interaction sequences.
assignee: Rana Veer Samara Sihman Bharattej RUPAVATH

title: Apparel with controllable displacement system
abstract: A support garment can include a textile layer forming a supportive region and configured to adjustably permit or inhibit displacement of a body part of the wearer that is positioned adjacent or proximate the supportive region. The garment can include an electroadhesive clutch device to help control displacement. In an example, the garment includes an underwear garment or a portion thereof.

title: Managing crypto deposits via a non-custodial escrow
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for data management are described. According to techniques described herein, a non-custodial escrow may manage the transfer of crypto tokens to one or more user accounts based on whether the crypto tokens are included in a first set of crypto tokens supported by a custodial token platform or a second set of crypto tokens that is not supported by the custodial token platform. For example, a smart contract may be configured to receive crypto tokens to be transferred to a user account. The smart contract may include a first function associated with the first set of crypto tokens that may cause transfer of the crypto tokens to the custodial token platform and a second function associated with the second set of crypto tokens that may cause transfer of the crypto tokens to an external destination address.

title: Blade outer air seal (boas) assembly for a gas turbine engine
abstract: An air-cooled turbine component includes a body extending between and to a first radial surface and a second radial surface relative to a centerline axis. The body includes an outer passage wall and an inner passage wall forming an internal cooling passage between the first radial surface and the second radial surface. The internal cooling passage extends lengthwise through the body between and to an upstream end of the internal cooling passage and a downstream end of the internal cooling passage along a lengthwise axis of the internal cooling passage. The body forms a flow augmentation feature assembly at the inner passage wall within the internal cooling passage. The flow augmentation feature assembly includes a plurality of trip strips arranged in a tread pattern along the inner passage wall.

title: Dci triggered ssb adaptation
abstract: Apparatuses and methods for downlink control information (DCI) triggered synchronization signal block (SSB) adaptation. A method of a user equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system includes receiving a set of higher layer parameters and receiving a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) providing a DCI format in a slot with index m of a first serving cell and on an active downlink bandwidth part (BWP) of the first serving cell. The method further includes determining a change of a periodicity for the SS/PBCH blocks, based on an indication of the periodicity for the SS/PBCH blocks in the DCI format, determining that transmission of the SS/PBCH blocks according to the indicated periodicity on a second serving cell starts from a slot on the second serving cell, based on a first transmitted SS/PBCH block index, and receiving the SS/PBCH blocks.

title: Systems and methods for authenticating access to a service by a mobile device
abstract: There is provided a system for authentication of a subscriber for accessing a service hosted by an application server using a mobile device, comprising: a processor(s) of an authentication server executing a code for: obtaining an authentication request for authenticating a unique identifier of circuitry installed in a mobile device from an application server hosting a service, the authentication request including the unique identifier, and a call back network address of the application server, and using the unique identifier as a destination address for sending a message to activate an applet for triggering validation of the unique identifier, the applet located in a storage component of the circuitry installed in the mobile device, wherein the applet sends an outcome of the validation to the application server using the call back network address.

title: Steering column for vehicle and vehicle
abstract: Provided are a steering column for a vehicle and a vehicle. The steering column includes a first mounting plate, an adjustment plate, an upper column, and an adjustment mechanism. The adjustment plate is movably connected to the first mounting plate in a first direction. The upper column is fixed to the adjustment plate. The adjustment mechanism includes a drive portion and a first adjustment portion. The drive portion is fixed to the first mounting plate and configured to drive the first adjustment portion to move in the first direction. The first adjustment portion is configured to drive the adjustment plate to move relative to the first mounting plate in the first direction, to adjust a position of the upper column.
assignee: Zhejiang Zeekr Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.; Zhejiang Geely Holding Group Co., Ltd.

title: Pan-substructural hierarchical algorithm for extensive chemical space analysis
abstract: A method for improving synthetic accessibility analysis of molecular structures may be implemented. A hierarchical library of molecule substructures representing possible molecular fragments may be generated. Statistics on substructure occurrences in reference chemical datasets may be collected. Synthetically irrelevant substructures may be identified based on the occurrence statistics, wherein low occurrence statistics may indicate the synthetically irrelevant substructures. The library of irrelevant substructures may be clustered and optimized. A group of molecular structures may be filtered using a hierarchical algorithm to identify those containing irrelevant substructures. The molecular structures containing irrelevant substructures may be removed from the group of molecular structures. A filtered set of molecular structures may be obtained by removing molecular structures having synthetically irrelevant substructures.
assignee: Insilico Medicine Ip Limited; Insilico Medicine Ai Limited

title: Method and apparatus for trigger-based resource adaptive transmission in wireless lan system
abstract: Disclosed are a method and apparatus for a resource adaptive transmission operation related to a trigger-based transmission in a wireless LAN system. The method by which a station (STA) transmits a physical layer protocol data unit (PPDU) in a wireless LAN system, according to an embodiment of the present disclosure, comprises the steps of: receiving, from an access point (AP), trigger information including information regarding a first resource region being allocated for the STA; and transmitting, on the basis of the AP having a specific capability, a trigger-based (TB) PPDU to the AP on a second resource region, wherein the second resource region may correspond to a portion of the first resource region.

title: Configurations for channel state information reporting
abstract: Techniques are described for configuring channel state information (CSI) reporting in wireless communication systems. The disclosed methods and systems enable reporting CSI for both a single frequency network (SFN) and coherent joint transmission (CJT). An example wireless communication method includes receiving, by a wireless device from a network node, a channel state information (CSI) reporting configuration. In this example method, the CSI reporting configuration configures at least one CSI-RS (reference signal) resource in at least one CSI-RS resource set or group. The method continues with the wireless device determining, based on the CSI reporting configuration, a number of CSI processing units (CPUs), and performing, based on the number of CPUs, a CSI reporting procedure.

title: Contactor lifetime prediction apparatus and method, and battery pack
abstract: A contactor lifetime prediction apparatus includes a measurement circuit configured to measure a current flowing in a contactor, and a processor configured to calculate a number of cycles of the contactor based on the current measured by the measurement circuit when the contactor is turned on or off, to accumulate the calculated number of cycles, and to predict a lifetime of the contactor.

title: Brake System For All-Terrain Vehicle
abstract: A hydraulic brake valve in an ATV brake system has rear and front pistons slidable within a valve body. The front piston divides a chamber of the valve body into a front chamber area and an intermediate chamber area between the pistons. When depressing a brake pedal moves the rear piston through a foot control rod, brake fluid from the intermediate chamber area activates rear-wheel brake assemblies, and the intermediate spring moves the front piston so brake fluid from the front chamber area activates the front-wheel brake assemblies. Pressing of the handbrake lever when the brake pedal is not being pressed controls only the front-wheel brake assemblies.

title: Variable dielectric based antenna with hydraulic knock system
abstract: Natural response time for domains to assume their natural relaxed state is accelerated by forcing the domains to assume the natural state using hydraulic knock. The hydraulic knock may be implemented by causing VDC material flow within the VDC plate. Flow can be achieved by forming inlet ports and outlet ports in the VDC plate, and controlling VDC fluid flow into the inlet port using an inlet valve and fluid flow out of the outlet port using an outlet valve. Pressure differential is maintained upstream of the inlet valve and downstream of the outlet valve. By controlling the opening duration and amount of the inlet and outlet valve, flow of VDC material within the VDC plate can be induced. This flow is believed to knock the domains out of alignment to thereby accelerate the relaxation time of the domains.

title: Generating tokens using one or more neural networks
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to cause one or more neural networks to perform one or more prefill operations on a token of a set of tokens before the set of tokens is completely generated. In at least one embodiment, a processor comprises circuitry to cause one or more first neural networks to begin generating a set of tokens and cause one or more second neural networks to perform one or more prefill operations on a token of the set of tokens before the set of tokens is completely generated.

title: Saddled electric vehicle
abstract: Provided is a saddle-type electric vehicle that allows for smooth connecting of a charging plug to a charging connector and is capable of enhancing convenience in charge. A saddle-type electric vehicle ( 1 ) includes: a charging connector ( 50 ) via which a power storage (B) is charged; a front cover ( 7 ) that covers a front portion of a vehicle body and has an opening (H); and a lid ( 40 ) that is of an openable/closeable type and covers the opening (H). The lid (40) is a plate-shaped member having an upper portion ( 40   t ) and a lower portion ( 40   b ) in a closed state, the charging connector ( 50 ) is disposed at a location where the charging connector ( 50 ) faces outward through the opening (H), and when the lid ( 40 ) is in an open state, the upper portion ( 40   t ) is positioned rearward of the front cover ( 7 ) in a vehicle front-rear direction.

title: Decorative Article with Multilayered Porosity Base
abstract: The present disclosure provides an improved decorative article that may be used as a decorative flooring panel. The decorative article comprises a laminated structure having a core layer and a top layer. The core layer includes separate upper and lower sections with different compressibility resistances, such that the upper section of the core layer exhibits a lower compressibility resistance than the compressibility resistance of the lower section. In some embodiments, for example, the upper and lower sections of the core layer may be foamed layers having different porosities and densities. In some disclosed embodiments, the top layer above the core layer may comprise a coating, a wear layer, and a decor layer. According to some embodiments, a plurality of holes may extend through the top layer, or through only a portion of the top layer, to further improve acoustic performance of the decorative article.

title: Ophthalmological Patient Interface
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an ophthalmological patient interface for application to an eye of a person, the ophthalmological patient interface comprising a coupling portion configured to be arranged on an application head of an ophthalmological laser treatment system, wherein the ophthalmological patient interface further comprises an eye fixation portion configured to be arranged on the eye, wherein the eye fixation portion comprises a cornea contacting element, configured to contact at least partially the cornea of the eye, and a sclera contacting element, configured to contact at least partially the sclera of the eye, wherein the cornea contacting element and the sclera contacting element define a rotationally asymmetric contact surface configured to contact the eye.

title: Recreational surface vessel
abstract: A surface vessel for carrying people comprising at least one hull separable from a planar first deck. The planar deck portion includes an enclosed structure fixedly secured to a top surface of the first planar deck. A second planar deck is disposed atop the enclosed structure. At least one stairway operably connects the first planar deck with the second planar deck. At least one engine is operably connected to a stern portion of the surface vessel. At least one side thruster may be operably connected to a front portion of the planar first deck. Embodiments may include at least a partial kitchen assembly within the enclosed structure. Embodiments may include a bathroom assembly within the enclosed structure. Embodiments may include a water purification system. Embodiments may include at least one fuel pod insertable into the at least one hull. Panels may be made from polycarbonate.

title: Article of Fabric or Cloth Having a Design Transferred from a Multiple-Layered Print Structure
abstract: A multiple layered print structure and apparatus to apply a design or image to fabric or cloth is disclosed. The structure may include one or more print layers printed on a substrate and an adhesive layer deposited on the print layer(s). The one or more print layer(s) and adhesive or resin layer may be deposited on the substrate in a pre-set pattern to form the shape profile for the design or image. The print layer(s) include inks or dyes for printing the print features and/or background color(s) of the image or design. The ink may be combined with a binder material to form the print layer(s). In some embodiments, the process includes the step of printing the multiple layered print structure using a combination of digital printing processes simplify the process for printing a design or image on fabric or cloth.

title: Soybean variety '3379006'
abstract: New soybean variety designated ‘3379006’ is a soybean variety exhibiting stability and uniformity.

title: Graph cuts for video object centric representation learning
abstract: Techniques and systems are provided for image processing. For instance, a process can include obtaining, from one or more image sensors, a first image and a second image; determining local motion between the first image and the second image for features of the first image and the second image; generating motion vectors based on the local motion; and identifying an object based on the motion vectors.

title: Outdoor power equipment machine with presence detection
abstract: A mobile outdoor power equipment machine for performing a controlled task within a work area includes a drive system for providing movement of the machine, a working apparatus for performing the task, and a scanning system for scanning an area surrounding the machine. The scanning system is configured to provide detection of physical elements in the environment to aid in navigation of the machine. In an embodiment, the scanning system and a control system are configured to scan the area, determine the presence of a physical element in the area, determine that the physical element is located within the work area, determine the proximity of the physical element to the machine, and direct a behavior of the machine.

title: Fully automated factory for solar plant
abstract: A large solar farm comprises one or more solar arrays, each with hundreds of rows of solar modules. Construction of a solar farm is a process that typically involves labor-intensive work that requires a large amount of human effort for solar table assembling and installation. The present invention discloses fully automatic factory embodiments to improve centralized solar table assembling efficiency for large solar plants. An automatic factory may comprise a panel conveyor, a torque tube dispenser, a table assembly station, a conveyor stage, and a table transfer stage for automatic solar table assembling, dispatching, and offloading. The application of the described embodiments may improve efficiency and safety for solar table assembling and solar table offloading from assembly line afterwards such that the overall construction process for large solar plants may be completed efficiently and safely with high quality.

title: Apparatus and method for e2 node control in wireless communication system
abstract: A method performed by performed by a near-real time (RT) radio access network (RAN) intelligent controller (RIC) is provided. The method includes transmitting, to a E2 node, an RIC control request message including information on a control action identity (ID), and receiving, from the E2 node, an RIC control acknowledge message or an RIC control failure message in response to the RIC control request message, wherein the RIC control acknowledge message or the RIC control failure message includes information on an RIC control outcome, wherein the information on the RIC control outcome includes at least one set of RAN parameter, wherein each of the at least one set of RAN parameter includes a RAN parameter ID and a RAN parameter value.

title: Semiconductor Device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes: a plurality of semiconductor modules each incorporating a power semiconductor element and having a heat dissipation surface; a radiator in thermal contact with the heat dissipation surfaces of the plurality of semiconductor modules arrayed in a line; and a fixing member that fixes the radiator so as to press the radiator against the heat dissipation surfaces, in which the radiator includes a heat dissipation base portion pressed against the heat dissipation surfaces of the semiconductor modules, and a plurality of fixing flange portions each having a cantilever shape formed along a direction of the array integrally with the heat dissipation base portion and having flexural rigidity smaller than flexural rigidity of the heat dissipation base, and the fixing member fixes the radiator so as to elastically deform the fixing flange portion and press the heat dissipation base portion against the heat dissipation surfaces of the semiconductor modules by an elastic force of the fixing flange portion.

title: Speech transformation method for defense against voice cloning attack
abstract: An operation method of an electronic device for preventing synthetic voice attacks according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes: extracting feature information of an original voice through an encoder module; converting the feature information into a first feature vector through at least one transformer module; generating a second feature vector by applying a perturbation to the first feature vector based on at least one other target voice different from the original voice; and generating a protected voice for the original voice based on the second feature vector through a decoder module.

title: Stylus to host synchronization using a magnetic field
abstract: A system and method for synchronizing a stylus to a capacitive sense array. The system including a capacitive sense array which includes a plurality of electrodes. A magnetic field is generated using the plurality of electrodes. The magnetic field is used to synchronize the operation of the stylus and the capacitive sense array.

title: In-situ prediction of part quality in additive manufacturing using sensor and simulation fusion
abstract: In-situ sensor data acquired from a plurality of sensors during fabrication of a part by an additive manufacturing process is processed to extract sensor-derived features on a layer-by-layer basis. A physics-based thermal model predicts thermal history quantifiers for the part. The sensor-derived features and the thermal history quantifiers are spatially aligned on a layer-by-layer basis and combined as inputs to a hierarchical machine learning model trained on ground-truth characterization data. A first echelon of the hierarchical machine learning model classifies a presence or absence of a fabrication defect. For portions of the part classified as absence of the fabrication defect, a second echelon predicts a microstructure characteristic, such as a meltpool depth, a grain size, or a microhardness. The combination of sensor-derived features and simulation-derived thermal history quantifiers provides a digital twin of the fabrication process enabling in-situ quality assessment.
assignee: Virginia Tech Intellectual Properties, Inc.; Nutech Ventures

title: Tablet for supporting one or more objects and chair structure including the tablet
abstract: A tablet for supporting objects includes a shelf; an articulation for the selective rotation of the shelf; a support element connected to the articulation and to a chair or armchair structure; and constraints for selectively promoting a locking and unlocking of the shelf in the operating position, which include a pin connected to the support element and a seat formed in the articulation for receiving the pin. The seat includes a first portion for receiving the pin with reduced clearance so as to define a rotational constraint for the articulation and lock the shelf in position, and a second portion for receiving the pin and rotating selectively around a longitudinal axis of rotation and the pin during rotation of the articulation and allow the insertion of the pin into the second portion. An actuation system enables the controlled movement of the articulation and/or the pin.

title: Electronic device for processing authentication for second event provided when subscribiing to membership for first event, and operating method therefor
abstract: Disclosed is an operating method for an electronic device for processing, on the basis of resource location identification information included in an authentication code obtained from a manager terminal, authentication for a second event selected by a user from one or more second events related to a first event.

title: Systems and methods for resuming video recording
abstract: Systems and methods for inserting a new video recording of a live scene previewed by a camera into a preexisting video are described. When a detection is made that a camera is previewing a live scene, the system automatically analyzes the live scene, obtains its attributes, and uses them to identify a matching preexisting video, from a plurality of stored preexisting videos. Upon identifying the matching preexisting video, the system automatically identifies a point of insertion in the preexisting video based on one or more factors. The system then downloads specific frames and content surrounding the frames from the matching preexisting video and uses them as references to encode and insert at least a portion of the new video recording of the live scene. Once inserted, the system generates a single continuous video that includes both the matching preexisting video and the new video recording of the live scene.

title: Device for measuring the electrical resistance of an element
abstract: The present invention relates to a device ( 1 ) for measuring the resistance of an element ( 2 ), in particular an aircraft structural element, characterised in that the device ( 1 ) comprises:—a digital control circuit ( 5 ) configured, on the one hand, to control the value of a measurement current (IR) to be injected into the element to be tested ( 2 ) and, on the other hand, to determine, from the voltage value (VR) generated by the measurement current (IR), the resistance value of the element ( 2 ) being tested;—a digital-to-analogue conversion stage ( 8 ) configured to convert a digital signal into an analogue signal and vice versa;—an analogue measurement circuit ( 7 ) connected to the digital control circuit ( 5 ) via the converters and configured to: —generate a measurement current (IR) from a digital setpoint (Cm) originating from the digital control circuit ( 5 ); ·measure an analogue value of the voltage (VR) generated by the measurement current (IR); characterised in that the device ( 1 ) comprises a reference voltage source ( 3 ) connected to the conversion stage ( 8 ), the conversion stage ( 8 ) being configured to use the voltage value (Vref) generated by the reference source ( 3 ) for the conversion:—of digital signals (Cm), such as the digital setpoint (Cm) that controls the generation of a measurement current (IR) by the analogue measurement circuit ( 7 ), originating from the digital control circuit ( 5 ), into analogue signals (VC) intended for the analogue measurement circuit ( 7 ); and—of analogue signals (VR»), such as the voltage value (VR) measured across the terminals of the element ( 2 ) being tested, originating from the measurement circuit ( 7 ), into digital signals (LUext) intended for the digital control circuit ( 5 ).

title: Method for Automatically Finishing a Cable, Cable Processing Center, Trajectory Detection Device and Inspection System
abstract: The invention relates to a method for automatically finishing a wire, a wire processing center, a trajectory detection device and an inspection system for a wire processing center of this type.

title: Vehicle control system and method using collaborative driving technology
abstract: A vehicle control system and method using collaborative driving technology are provided. The system includes a sensing device, a communication circuit and a control circuit. The sensing circuit is configured to provide sensing data of a user's vehicle. The communication circuit is configured to receive compressed data of vehicles surrounding the user's vehicle. The control circuit is configured to receive the sensing data and the compressed data, and control the user's vehicle. In another embodiment, the system includes driving-oriented feature encoder circuits. A multi view feature joint decoder circuit and a control circuit. The method includes: compressing driving-oriented feature data by using the encoder circuit to obtain compressed data; decompressing the compressed data and calculating fused feature data by using the decoder circuit; and inputting the fused feature data into a vehicle driving model to obtain vehicle-driving signals.
assignee: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.; Foxconn Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: System, method, and apparatus for providing dynamic, prioritized spectrum management and utilization
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing dynamic, prioritized spectrum utilization management. The system includes at least one monitoring sensor, at least one data analysis engine, at least one application, a semantic engine, a programmable rules and policy editor, a tip and cue server, and/or a control panel. The tip and cue server is operable utilize the environmental awareness from the data processed by the at least one data analysis engine in combination with additional information to create actionable data.

title: Advanced manufacturing facility for humanoid robots
abstract: A method of manufacturing a robot includes obtaining a baseline measurement of an operational parameter of an actuated joint, installing a cover over the robot proximate the joint, causing the joint to execute a movement after installation, obtaining a post-installation measurement, determining a difference between the measurements, and evaluating the difference to assess whether the cover has introduced interference with the joint. A method of manufacturing a robot using a computer system includes confirming that a first component has satisfied upstream process conditions prior to testing, performing a component-level test, integrating the first component with a second component, and performing a system-level test on the integrated assembly, with test results from both levels stored in a unified record. A method of manufacturing a robot includes initiating a burn-in sequence on a component, monitoring a performance metric, computing a stability indicator based on variation across operational cycles, and terminating the burn-in upon convergence.

title: Systems and Methods for Duty Cycle Measurement
abstract: Systems, methods, and circuits for determining a duty cycle of a periodic input signal are provided. A delay element is configured to delay the periodic input signal based on a digital control word. A digital circuit is configured to generate a first digital control word used to delay the periodic input signal a first amount of time corresponding to a period of the periodic input signal, generate a second digital control word used to delay the periodic input signal a second amount of time corresponding to a portion of the periodic input signal having a logic-level high value, and generate a third digital control word used to delay the periodic input signal a third amount of time corresponding to a portion of the periodic input signal having a logic-level low value. A controller is configured to determine the duty cycle based on the first, second, and third digital control words.

title: Image capturing element and image capturing apparatus
abstract: An image capturing element includes a first substrate having a plurality of pixel blocks including at least one pixel, the plurality of pixel blocks being arranged to be aligned in a row direction and a column direction, and a second substrate having a plurality of control blocks including a conversion unit which converts a signal output from the pixel into a digital signal and a through electrode unit configured to output the signal converted into the digital signal by the conversion unit, the plurality of control blocks being arranged to be aligned in the row direction and the column direction.

title: Computational medical guidelines and connected knowledge graph for diagnosis and treatment using stored prior traversals
abstract: A computational platform includes a clinical knowledge graph having medical condition nodes to which are linked factor nodes and investigation nodes. Medical guideline nodes linked to a medical condition represent a computational guideline. Observation nodes and laboratory test nodes within the guideline link to factor nodes or investigation nodes. Therapy ingredient nodes represent drugs with a guideline. A patient is diagnosed or treated by traversing the guideline nodes associated with a particular condition. Probabilities annotated upon edges facilitate predicting a future patient state. Use cases include queries from a clinician, an insurance claims database, or an LLM, generation of FHIR value sets, and generation of executable CQL for a medical guideline. The knowledge graph receives a medical query, executes it and outputs a result. A medical condition ontology with factors and investigations connects to an ontology representing a computational medical guideline. Elemental therapeutic intervention nodes represent drug or nondrug therapies.

title: Test positioning method, device, storage medium, and target image
abstract: The present disclosure provides a test positioning method for a display. A target image with a plurality of first positioning points and a plurality of second positioning points having different shapes and/or dimensions, with second points at predetermined positions is displayed and captured. The second positioning points in the first captured image are determined by a homography matrix based on their predetermined and actual positions. The positioning points are transformed using the matrix to obtain a mapping point set, thereby improving test positioning accuracy and user experience. The present disclosure also provides a test positioning device for a display.

title: Flexible paper selection for printing operations using attributes or settings having multiple values
abstract: A printing system includes a printing device having one or more paper trays. A print job is received for the printing device having at least one attribute. A digital front end (DFE) of the printing device parses a print ticket for the print job to determine the attribute. One or more media definitions for papers within the printing system are determined based on the attribute. The media definitions are compared to a paper catalog for the printing device. A list of papers is generated from the paper catalog that supports the media definitions. The DFE determines whether a paper of the list of papers is assigned to a paper tray. The print job is matched to the paper tray and the paper related to the media definitions. The print job is processed using the paper in the paper tray.

title: System for and method of monitoring a gas component
abstract: Described is a method ( 900 ) of measuring a small concentration of a target gas component in an environmental gas sample by increasing the small concentration to a larger measurable concentration. The method comprises isolating and concentrating ( 930 ) the target gas component using a concentrator ( 106 ), by capturing the target gas component and releasing the captured target gas component to a sensor ( 108 ). Isolating the target gas component comprises increasing a concentration of the target gas component so that the concentration of the target gas component is measurable by the sensor. The method also comprises measuring ( 940 ), using the sensor ( 108 ), the captured target gas component concentration. Before isolating the target gas component, the method comprises heating the concentrator to release a baseline gas, and measuring, using the sensor ( 108 ), a baseline gas component concentration ( 920 ). After measuring the captured target gas component concentration, the method comprises determining ( 950 ), with a processor ( 112, 202 ), an accurate target gas component concentration by comparing the baseline gas component concentration and the measured target gas component concentration.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to receive, via an input unit, system state data input on a daily basis, store the input system state data in a database unit and learn normal operating patterns based on the stored system state data, receive, via a failure input unit, detailed failure information input at a time of occurrence of a system failure, compare the input failure information, by using a matching unit, with past failure data stored in a failure database and with known failure patterns, and present an optimal response procedure based on a result of the comparison, and analyze daily input data, by using a prediction notification unit, predict potential problems based on the analysis, and notify an operator of the potential problems.

title: Creating and Using Special Contacts for Direct-to-Cell Satellite Coverage
abstract: Creating and using special contacts for direct-to-cell satellite coverage can include obtaining identity data that identifies the user device and connection data that indicates that the user device currently has limited network connectivity and is connected to a direct-to-cell satellite network connection; obtaining a record associated with the user device, the record being stored in a user database and including special contacts information that identifies a special contact for the user device. The special contact can be updated when the user device has limited network connectivity and is connected to the direct-to-cell satellite network connection. Notification preferences for the user device can be determined from a record, the preferences defining how the special contact is to be updated when the user device has limited network connectivity. Communications with a special contact device can be managed based on the notification preferences.
assignee: At&T Mobility Ii Llc; At&T Intellectual Property I, L.P.

title: Antisense oligonucleotides for the treatment of liver disease
abstract: The present invention relates to antisense oligonucleotides (AONs) that can mediate RNA editing by binding to a target RNA nucleic acid molecule, preferably an RNA transcript molecule, in a cell and recruiting an endogenous deaminating enzyme in the cell to deaminate one or more target adenosine nucleotides in the target RNA molecule to an inosine. The target RNA molecule is a transcript molecule form the SLC10A1 gene that encodes the Na/Taurocholate Co-transporting Polypeptide (NTCP). The RNA editing of the one or more target adenosines will result in a loss-of-function of the NTCP protein, which will result in lowered uptake of bile acids from the portal circulation into the liver, thereby lowering the risk of suffering from disorders related to bile accumulation in the liver.

title: Integrated Frequency Modulated Optical Parametric Oscillator Frequency Combs and Optical Spectroscopy using same
abstract: Improved optical comb generation from an integrated photonic device is obtained by intracavity optical modulation of a photonic integrated circuit optical parametric oscillator. The resulting device is referred to an FM-OPO. The comb spectrum from an FM-OPO is much broader than obtained from conventional integrated comb generators relying on the electro-optic or Kerr effects. There is also no mode-locking or pulse formation in an FM-OPO. Mid-IR spectroscopy is one of the most promising applications of FM-OPOs.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University

title: Humanized monoclonal antibodies and methods of use for the diagnosis and treatment of colon and pancreas cancer
abstract: This invention relates to humanized antibodies that selectively bind the 31.1 epitope on the A33 protein differentially expressed in cancers including, lung cancer, ovarian cancer, pancreas cancer, breast cancer, and colon cancer, and diagnostic and therapeutic usages.

title: Horizontal machine tool
abstract: A horizontal machine tool includes a B-axis rotary assembly ( 1 ), the B-axis rotary assembly ( 1 ) has a machining surface ( 2 ) and a tool magazine surface ( 3 ) oriented in different directions, the machining surface ( 2 ) and the tool magazine surface ( 3 ) are both parallel to a B-axis and configured to rotate simultaneously about the B-axis, a tool magazine ( 4 ) is provided on the tool magazine surface ( 3 ), an axis of a tool within the tool magazine ( 4 ) is perpendicular to the tool magazine surface ( 3 ), the machining surface ( 2 ) is provided with a worktable ( 5 ), and a rotational axis of the worktable ( 5 ) is perpendicular to the machining surface ( 2 ). The worktable ( 5 ) and the tool magazine ( 4 ) share the B-axis for rotation. This design results in a compact machine configuration, which effectively reduces the installation space required for the equipment. The worktable ( 5 ) and the tool magazine ( 4 ) do not require separately provided drive devices, which, on one hand, saves the installation space for the drive devices, and on the other hand, avoids the possibility of motion interference that may occur when separate drive devices are provided. By sharing the B-axis, the worktable ( 5 ) and the tool magazine ( 4 ) can be driven to rotate simultaneously, which improves the convenience of controlling the worktable and the tool magazine, reduces manufacturing costs and operating costs, and enhances the workpiece machining efficiency.

title: Automatically Generating a Report using Audio Data
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices are provided for automatically generating a report for an incident or event. The report may be automatically generated by a generative computing device. The report may be automatically generated in response to a prompt. The prompt may include one or more sample reports. The prompt may be automatically generated. The prompt may include predetermined instructions for generating the report. The prompt may include a transcript. The transcript may be generated by transcribing audio data captured at an event. The automatically generated report may be provided for display. Providing the report for display may include linking portions of the generated report to audio data upon which the report is generated. Providing the report may include inserting verification information in the automatically generated report.

title: Structured lipid-antioxidant-biotic matrix for functional food applications with dual-site oral and gastrointestinal modulation
abstract: A food composition comprising a lipid phase comprising one or more plant-derived lipids selected from cocoa butter, mango butter, shea butter, cocoa butter equivalents, medium chain triglycerides, and coconut oil. The composition further comprises an antioxidant-rich botanical phase comprising one or more materials selected from cacao-derived materials, pomegranate pomace, carob, and mesquite. The composition further comprises a biotic component comprising one or more of prebiotics, probiotics, postbiotics, and low-glycemic sweeteners. The antioxidant-rich botanical phase and the biotic component are homogeneously dispersed within the lipid phase without microencapsulation. The composition is formulated in a solid and/or non-solid form selected from syrups, gels, pastes, spreads, and direct-to-mouth compositions, and provides antioxidant activity, microbiome modulation, and delivery of bioactive compounds. The composition is configured to provide dual-site functional support along an oral-to-gastrointestinal pathway, modulating the oral microenvironment during oral cavity exposure and supporting gut microbiome composition during gastrointestinal transit.

title: Distributed retrodirective array of mobile tethered elements
abstract: A system includes an input configured to receive a plurality of detected scattered signals from a target. The system also includes a common ground station configured to receive the detected scattered signals, determine phase conjugations of the detected scattered signals, and generate phase-conjugated signals. The system further includes an output configured to provide the phase-conjugated signals from the common ground station to each of a plurality of array elements of a distributed retrodirective array. The phase conjugations of the detected demodulated scattered signals enable the phase-conjugated signals to arrive at the target having substantially a same phase.

title: Backoff mechanism for channel state information (csi) reporting using connectionless uplink transmission
abstract: A method of connectionless uplink (CLUL) wireless communication, at a user equipment (UE) includes selecting a first resource from a first resource pool based on a backoff value corresponding to a change in channel state information (CSI). The method also includes transmitting a CSI report on the first resource, without receiving an explicit uplink grant for the first resource.

title: New e3 ubiquitin ligase ligand, protein degradation agent and use thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides compounds of Formula (I) and (II) or salts, enantiomers, stereoisomers, solvates, isotopically enriched analogs, prodrugs, or polymorphs thereof, and uses thereof. The present disclosure also provides pharmaceutical compositions comprising, as an active ingredient, the compounds of Formula (I) or salts, enantiomers, stereoisomers, solvates, isotopically enriched analogs, prodrugs, or polymorphs thereof, and uses thereof.

title: Communication apparatus, method of controlling communication apparatus, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
abstract: A communication apparatus operable to act as a master-AP in a multi-AP (access point) coordination configuration that supports an IEEE802.11 series standard, selects a sounding method which is a method for transmitting a sounding packet for receiving a CSI report as feedback from a terminal apparatus in accordance with a CSI (channel state information) calculation capability in the terminal apparatus that is connected to the communication apparatus.

title: Coaxial electrical connector and electrical connector assembly
abstract: A resilient body can apply a resilient force adapted to bring a coupling member to a neutral position between an advanced position and a retracted position to a front pressure-applying portion and rear pressure-applying portion; the coupling member has an intermediate protrusion protruding from the inner peripheral surface of said coupling member and forms a front space forwardly of the intermediate protrusion between itself and the outer peripheral surface of a shell member while forming a rear space rearwardly of the intermediate protrusion between itself and the outer peripheral surface of the shell member; and ball members are restricted in movement in the front-rear direction by the inner peripheral edges of holes while being movable in the radial direction of the connector, and are capable of lockingly engaging a locking engagement portion provided in a counterpart connector via portions protruding radially inwardly from the holes.

title: Method for the Ordinal Classification of a Microscope Image and Microscopy System
abstract: A computer-implemented method for the ordinal classification of at least one microscope image calculates a classification into one of a plurality of classes which form an order with respect to an image property. The microscope image is input into a machine-learned model for ordinal classification. The model comprises binary classifiers which calculate estimates regarding whether the microscope image belongs to cumulative auxiliary classes, which combine different numbers of the classes which follow each other in the order. The estimates can be combined so as to form a total score, wherein the classification occurs by comparing the total score with threshold values which can be defined in a variable manner depending on the application, or interval limits of the classes can be defined so that the classes form intervals of different widths. The model for ordinal classification can also comprise further binary classifiers for inverse auxiliary classes.

title: Driving assistance device and driving assistance method
abstract: A driving assistance device for a mobile object, the mobile object including a first sensor that detects a target present in the surroundings of the mobile object, the driving assistance device includes: a collision prediction unit configured to predict presence or absence of a collision between the target and the mobile object; and a braking instruction unit configured to cause a braking force to act on the mobile object in response to the collision between the target and the mobile object being predicted; and cause the braking force to continuously act on the mobile object until a position of the target becomes at a rear of the mobile object in response to the target detected becoming undetectable by the first sensor in a predetermined region near the first sensor.
assignee: Denso Corporation; Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha; J-QuAD DYNAMICS INC.

title: Low gravity simulator
abstract: A low gravity simulator configured to place an object under a simulated low gravity force is disclosed. The low gravity simulator comprises: a substantially vertically extending support column, wherein the support column comprises an air bearing; a boom, wherein the boom is mounted to the support column, and wherein the boom is rotatable about a vertical axis; a carriage, the carriage translatably mounted on the boom so that the carriage is, in use, movable backwards and forwards along the boom; a cable supported by the carriage and connectable at one end, in use, to the object; and a counterweight attached to the cable at an opposing end to apply a biasing force to the cable. The counterweight is restrained by the support column and the air bearing is configured to facilitate the motion of the counterweight with respect to the support column.

title: Desiccant heat recovery systems for clothes dryers
abstract: A dryer includes an exhaust air chamber, an intake air chamber, and a heater configured to heat supply air expelled from a supply air port and expel the heated supply air. The dryer also includes a drum configured to receive the heated supply air expelled from the heater and expel the heated supply air as return air. The dryer further includes a desiccant bed configured to adsorb moisture from the return air and release heat into the return air during a constant rate period of a drying process of the dryer and release adsorbed moisture into the return air during a falling rate period of the drying process of the dryer. The exhaust air chamber is configured to receive the return air from a return air port, transfer heat from the return air into the intake air chamber, and expel the return air from an exhaust port.

title: Information processing method, computer program, and information processing apparatus
abstract: An information processing method includes: inputting, into a language generation model, a request for generating related data including a question sentence with respect to target data relating to a specific apparatus or system, a summary of the target data, or a question sentence with respect to the summary, and acquiring the related data output by the language generation model, storing, in a database, the target data and the related data in association with each other, acquiring a question relating to the apparatus or the system, retrieving the related data from the database based on the question, extracting the target data associated with the retrieved related data from the database, inputting the question and the extracted target data into the language generation model, and acquiring an answer to the question output by the language generation model, and outputting the acquired answer.

title: Security management and control method for cloud desktop, and device, storage medium and system
abstract: A cloud desktop security management and control method, and a device, a storage medium and a system are provided. The system includes: a management and control server, configured to configure a first cloud desktop and a second cloud desktop for a target user, configure a first security policy for the first cloud desktop, and configure a second security policy for the second cloud desktop; a client, respectively communicatively connected to the first cloud desktop and the second cloud desktop, wherein a display screen corresponding to the client includes a first screen corresponding to the first cloud desktop and a second screen corresponding to the second cloud desktop; and a target cloud desktop, configured to obtain an operation behavior triggered by the target user through a target screen, and respond to the operation behavior according to a security policy corresponding to the target cloud desktop.
assignee: Cloud Intelligence Assets Holding (Singapore) Private Limited

title: Automated entity name canonicalization via vector transformation using a database system
abstract: A computing system may process entity name variations. The entity name variations may be transformed into vector representations. The vector representations may be stored in a database. The entity name variations may be clustered into groups of similar entity name variations based on a similarity metric between the vector representations. A canonical identifier for each group of similar entity name variations may be stored in the database. Each canonical identifier identifying a distinct entity.

title: Manipulating Trading Tools
abstract: Trading tools may be manipulated by allowing assembly, disassembly, and configuration of different trading tools. The assembly of different trading tools may generate combined trading tools. The combined trading tools may enable interoperability between the trading tools therein. Customization of the combined trading tools may be enabled by enabling a user to rearrange predefined areas displayed within the trading tools within the combined trading tools. The customization of the combined trading tools may enable customization of different functionality within the combined trading tools. The trading tools within a combined trading tool may include a tab tool for enabling multiple instances of another trading tool to which the tab tool is attached. Each instance of a trading tool may be associated with a respective tab for enabling a user to toggle between the multiple instances of the trading tool.

title: Eis measurement for batteries under load with multidimensional probability distribution
abstract: Various examples are directed to systems and methods for operating a battery. An Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) circuit may apply an alternating current (AC) excitation signal to a battery at a first frequency. The EIS circuit may measure a first impedance of the battery at a first time during application of the AC excitation signal and determining at least one condition of the battery at the first time. The EIS circuit may compare the first impedance of the battery and the at least one condition of the battery at the first time to a multidimensional probability distribution. Based on the comparing, EIS circuit May determine that the first impedance is an outlier.

title: Hash function and address bit selection
abstract: This disclosure provides systems, devices, apparatus, and methods, including computer programs encoded on storage media, for XOR-based hash function and address bit-selection. A graphics processor may determine a selected hash function, of a set of hash functions, having a highest number of value changes during an execution thereof over hashed memory address bits across concurrent fibers for a subgroup of a workgroup during respective executions for the set of hash functions. The hashed memory address bits are associated with accesses to a memory bank of a memory. The graphics processor may execute, in association with the memory bank, the selected hash function for a set of remaining instructions of the workgroup.

title: Pyrido[3,4-d]pyrimidinone and pyrimdllne aryl hydrocarbon receptor antagonists and uses thereof
abstract: Disclosed herein are compounds which can act as modulators of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR). Further disclosed herein are methods for treating diseases and disorders, such as cancer and viral infections, using the compounds disclosed herein.
assignee: Allianthera (Suzhou) Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.; Allianthera Boston Inc.

title: 3d printer add-on for enhanced 3d object creation
abstract: A modular, automated tool-changing system for an additive manufacturing machine is disclosed. The system comprises a print head assembly, a plurality of interchangeable tool holders, a docking system, and an automated tool changer carriage for transporting the tool holders between the docking system and the print head. The print head assembly includes articulating clamp arms that function as integrated, actively-cooled heatsinks, providing both secure mechanical clamping and direct thermal management to a seated tool holder. The tool changer carriage utilizes a multi-function cylindrical cam and a flexible interlocking rack gear to perform the complex movements required to retrieve, transport, and deposit tool holders. A control system non-invasively utilizes the host machine's extruder (‘E’) stepper channel, toggling the signal to drive either the tool changer carriage or the print head's extruder motor, with the system's state determined by the physical position of the print head.

title: Ecu power cable fault detection
abstract: An electronic control unit (ECU) includes a housing, a circuit board disposed in the housing, and a power terminal conductively coupled with the circuit board and accessible from an exterior of the housing. A power cable is operatively coupled with the power terminal and one of a power supply and a load. The power cable includes a terminal connector crimped about a jacketed conductor and conductively coupled with the power terminal. A first temperature sensor is configured to sense a first temperature. A second temperature sensor configured to sense a second temperature. A diagnostic circuit is configured to indicate presence or absence of a fault of the power cable in response to the first temperature and the second temperature. A controller is configured to change operation of the ECU in response to output of the second comparator.

title: Image processing device
abstract: An image processing device capable of calculating an accurate disparity is provided. An image processing device includes: a disparity calculation unit that calculates a disparity between images taken by a plurality of cameras; a labeling unit that classifies a subject appearing in the images and that assigns a label to each of pixels of the subject classified, the label corresponding to a type of the subject classified; a confidence calculation unit that calculates confidence in the disparity for each label assigned; and a disparity correction unit that corrects the disparity according to the confidence calculated.

title: Text to image system with enhanced text adherence, residual block modulation for model training, and adaptive text encoding
abstract: A system may access input text that describes an image to be generated. The system may generate a plurality of text tokens based on the input text. The system may transform, in a first transformer layer of the text2image model, the plurality of text tokens based on self-attention in which an importance of a text token is weighted relative to other ones of the plurality of text tokens. The system may transform, in a second transformer layer of the text2image model, a plurality of image tokens based on self-attention in which an importance of an image token is weighted relative to other ones of the plurality of image tokens. The system may perform cross-attention between the transformed plurality of text tokens and the transformed plurality of image tokens. The system may generate an output image based on the cross-attention.

title: Independently randomly generated different features associated with different activators and different enhancements
abstract: Gaming systems and methods configured to display pots respectively associated with different wheel features that each include a wheel and an associated quantity of pointers, and enhancements to the wheel features that each include an increase to an initial quantity of pointers associated with one or more of the wheels for a play of a game based on an enhancement triggering event for that play of the game.

title: Tray for holding pipette tips and combination of a tray and at least one pipette tip
abstract: A tray has a holding area with openings that are adapted to the shape of the pipette tips to be inserted in order to hold them in a specific position. The (cylindrical) openings may, for example, be bounded by sleeves. Internal projections, e.g. webs, extend perpendicularly from a lower end of the sleeves and project substantially in the direction of the central axis of an inserted pipette tip. The inner projections rest against the outer wall of the pipette tip and fix it in a predetermined position.

title: Semiconductor element mounting substrate
abstract: A semiconductor element mounting substrate includes a base formed of a metal, an electrode to be connected to a semiconductor element, and a protective layer disposed between the base and the electrode and formed of a material that is harder than the metal forming the base.

title: Access control system, registration apparatus, reference apparatus, access control method, and computer readable medium
