abstract: A registration apparatus encrypts a content identifier that identifies content using a group common key for a group that is configured of a plurality of members who are granted access to the content, and registers an encrypted content identifier. A reference apparatus obtains the encrypted content identifier, decrypts the content identifier from the encrypted content identifier using the group common key, and obtains the content using the content identifier.

title: Leadframe mounting with lead insertion for lead wall bonding
abstract: A semiconductor device package may include a substrate having an insulating layer with a patterned conductive layer formed thereon, the patterned conductive layer including at least a first pattern portion and a second pattern portion. The semiconductor device package may include a leadframe having a lead that is soldered to the substrate with solder provided in an opening between the first pattern portion and the second pattern portion and with the lead inserted into the opening.

title: Method and System for Autonomous Inventory Monitoring and Control
abstract: A system and method for autonomously managing inventory in a warehouse environment is disclosed. The method includes accessing, via a plurality of sensor devices, data indicative of inventory within a warehouse. The method includes accessing, from a database, a multi-dimensional model of the warehouse. The method includes generating an updated multi-dimensional model of the warehouse based on the data indicative of the inventory within the warehouse. The method includes determining, using one or more machine-learned models (MLMs) and based on the updated multi-dimensional model of the warehouse, an action associated with the inventory of the warehouse. The method includes transmitting, over a network, instructions to a computing device to implement the action associated with the inventory of the warehouse.

title: Battery cell, battery, and electric device
abstract: A battery cell, a battery, and an electric device. The battery cell includes a housing, a shielding member, and a pressing member, where the housing is provided with a first wall, the first wall being provided with a weak part; the shielding member is disposed in the housing, and in the direction of the thickness h of the first wall, the shielding member covers at least part of the weak part; the pressing member is located on the side of the shielding member facing away from the first wall, the pressing member pressing against the shielding member.

title: Improvements in or relating to organic compounds
abstract: The present invention relates to an encapsulated composition comprising at least one core-shell microcapsule, wherein the at least one core-shell microcapsule comprises a core comprising at least one benefit agent and a shell surrounding the core, wherein the shell comprises a cross-linked-protein coacervate, wherein the cross-linker is dihydroxyacetone. The invention also relates to methods of making such a composition, to consumer products comprising such a composition and to the use of such a composition to enhance the performance of a benefit agent in a consumer product.

title: Ingestion and segmentation of real-time event data
abstract: The techniques may include accessing a plurality of subsets of instances. In addition, the techniques may include identifying a net capacity change for each of the subsets of instances, the net capacity change of a respective subset of instances based at least in part on a capacity change of each event instance in the respective subset of instances. The techniques may include generating feature vectors for the subsets of instances. Moreover, the techniques may include adding the feature vectors to a set of training vectors in a data store. Also, the techniques may include training a machine learning model to output a predicted net capacity change for a particular entity by: accessing a subset of the set of training vectors that are associated with the particular entity; and training the machine learning model to output the predicted net capacity change for the particular entity at an input time period.

title: High capacity lateral overturning restraint
abstract: A light frame construction building and a method for constructing such a building employ tie rods configured to act in series to resist overturning forces, such as experienced in seismic or high wind conditions. The tie rods are secured to different stories of the building so that they resist only dedicated parts of the total load from the overturning force.

title: Trim cooling system with a power generation mode
abstract: A cooling system (CS) includes a first heat exchanger (HE) having a first inlet and a first outlet and configured to be coupled to a facility-cooling loop; a second HE having a second inlet and a second outlet; an expansion valve (EV) having an EV inlet and an EV outlet; a pump having a pump inlet and a pump outlet; and an expander having a first flow terminal (FT) and a second FT, wherein in a first CS operating mode, the pump inlet is coupled to the first outlet, the pump outlet is coupled to the second inlet, the first FT is coupled to the second outlet, the second FT is coupled to the first inlet, and the expander is configured to convert heat into electric power, and in a second CS operating mode, the EV inlet is coupled to the first outlet, the EV outlet is coupled to the second inlet, the first FT is coupled to the first inlet, the second FT is coupled to the second outlet, and the expander is configured to operate as a compressor to provide cooling.

title: Knowledge-based platform for efficient query processing in human capital management
abstract: The present disclosure provides a knowledge-based platform and process for efficient query processing in human capital management. The system leverages artificial intelligence modules to interpret user intent, traverse heterogeneous data sources, and refine responses through human feedback, enabling accurate and context-aware support for workforce-related queries. The platform includes a user interface for receiving and enhancing queries, a vectorized knowledge store, and processors for query rewriting, context retrieval, reinforcement learning from human feedback, and response generation using retrieval-augmented generation. Principal uses include applications in payroll, compliance, human resources, and tax knowledge management.

title: Portable Food Storage Apparatus Utilizing Available On-Site Battery Power for Heating Food
abstract: A food storage apparatus is proposed that is portable and uses an available, on-site external power supply (e.g., rechargeable high-voltage battery, such as that used with common power tools) to energize a heating element disposed within the body of the food storage apparatus. The apparatus is configured to include a socket for accepting a conventional battery source. A container for the food may be removably positioned within a recessed compartment of the apparatus so as to be centered over the heating element. An external power switch, connecting the socket to the heating element, is controlled by an individual to initiate (or stop) the heating process. An indicator device (e.g., LED) may be included and used by the individual to determine when the heating is completed.

title: Communication method and communication apparatus
abstract:
A communication method and a communication apparatus. The method includes determining a first sequence, which is the same as the sequence obtained by performing Manchester coding on a base sequence. title: Battery Module and Battery Pack Including the Same
abstract: A battery module according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes a battery cell stack in which a plurality of battery cells is stacked, a module case for accommodating the battery cell stack, a busbar frame disposed on one side of the battery cell stack, one or more busbars disposed in the busbar frame, and one or more reinforcing members disposed in the busbar frame.

title: System and/or method for autonomous detection of emergengy vehicles
abstract: A method and system for operating an autonomous vehicle, comprising collecting perceptual measurements and audio measurements from sensors arranged at different positions on the autonomous vehicle; determining a world representation comprising detections of world agents from the perceptual measurements; determining auditory flags from the audio measurements, each comprising a direction estimate of an audio-emitting world agent; tracking world agent tracks by associating auditory flags with world agent detections; determining vehicle controls based on the tracks; and operating the vehicle accordingly. The auditory flags can be generated by a trained convolutional neural network processing log-mel spectrograms of the audio measurements, with siren signal isolation via frequency masking enabling direction-of-arrival estimation through time-difference-of-arrival computation across microphone pairs.

title: Computer-Implemented Method for Determining a Power Flow in a Power Network
abstract: A method for determining a power flow in a physical power network having first and second nodes connected via a physical edge includes constructing a virtual network comprising at least one virtual edge between the nodes, and wherein at least one virtual power flow is flowing over said at least virtual edge; determining a transmission constraint parameter by determining a sum of all virtual power flows; determining the physical power flow for the physical edge based on the determined at least one transmission constraint parameter for the at least one virtual edge, wherein the determined physical power flow on the at least one physical edge represents the sum of determined virtual power flows on the at least one virtual edge that corresponds to the at least physical edge.

title: Method of forming a composition and the composition formed therefrom
abstract: In an aspect, a method of making a composition, comprising forming a solvent mixture comprising a polymer and a solvent; precipitating the solvent mixture with a non-solvent to form the composition comprising the filler in a fibrillated polymer matrix, wherein the composition is in the form of a particulate and at least one of the solvent and the non-solvent comprises a filler; and separating the composition from the solvent and the non-solvent to isolate the composition. In another aspect, a porous material wherein the filler particles are mechanically bonded together by the polymer and wherein the polymer is present as filaments adhering to and connecting the filler particles across interstitial spaces between the filler particles. In another aspect, a precipitated polymer solution produced by a phase inversion where the majority of the liquids can be mechanically removed.

title: Hydrogen fueling communication method and device for error and emergency handling
abstract: A method according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: detecting errors that occur during communication for preparing the supply of hydrogen fuel between a mobility and a dispenser that supplies hydrogen fuel to the mobility, or during the supplying of hydrogen fuel by the dispenser to the mobility; with respect to the detected errors, determining whether the communication or the supplying of hydrogen fuel stops; and performing follow-up processes defined on the basis of the detected errors.
assignee: Hyundai Motor Company; Kia Corporation; Myongji University Industry And Academia Cooperation Foundation

title: Clothing treating device and method for controlling clothing treating device
abstract: A clothing treating device of the present disclosure relates to a clothing treating device in which a circulation duct or a heat exchanger is washed using at least one of condensed water and direct water which is supplied from an external water source, and to a control method therefor. The clothing treating device of the present disclosure comprises: a circulation duct provided to guide air discharged from a drum into the drum; a heat exchanger disposed inside the circulation duct to cool the air to condense moisture and to heat the air; a circulation washing unit that washes the heat exchanger with water collected in the water collection unit; and a direct water washing unit that is provided independently of the circulation washing unit and receives water from an external water source and supplies the water into the circulation duct to wash the inside of the circulation duct.

title: Antibody formulation
abstract: This invention relates to a pharmaceutical formulation of an alpha synuclein antibody.

title: Clip for removably attaching a first vehicle part to a second vehicle part, first vehicle part, assembly, and method for disengaging an assembly of a first vehicle part and of a second vehicle part
abstract: A clip for removably attaching a first vehicle part to a second vehicle part. The second part includes a stud having a finned and/or a threaded lateral surface. The clip includes a base part with an opening for receiving the stud. At least two hooks are arranged on a circumference of the opening. Each of the at least two hooks include a bendable leg portion and an engagement portion for engaging the lateral surface of the stud. Each of the at least two hooks include a release interface for disengaging the hook from the stud using a release tool. Each of the release interfaces includes a thrust surface having a surface normal with a component of extension along a middle axis of the opening and with a component of extension perpendicular to the middle axis of the opening.

title: System for processing anonymized data using generative ai
abstract: A system for processing anonymized data reduces the risk of leakage of personal information and confidential corporate information when using generative AI. This system includes an input unit, a specifying unit, an anonymization unit, a transmission unit, a reception unit, a decryption unit, and a user interface unit. The input unit receives data from a user, and the specifying unit specifies personal information using natural language processing technology. The anonymization unit replaces the specified information with general labels, and the transmission unit transmits the data to the generative AI. The generative AI generates a response based on the anonymized data, and the reception unit receives this. The decryption unit restores the response to the original information and provides it to the user through the user interface unit.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, program, image processing apparatus, and image processing method
abstract: An information processing apparatus estimates a sensor input that is spectral information of input light to a spectral sensor on a basis of spectral reflectance information of a target subject and spectral information of a target light source; estimates a sensor output that is spectral information output by the spectral sensor according to the sensor input on a basis of spectral sensitivity information of the spectral sensor and the sensor input; and obtains an arithmetic algorithm that minimizes error between a wavelength characteristic indicated by post-narrow-band spectral information obtained by performing narrow-band processing based on the sensor output and a wavelength characteristic indicated by the sensor input as an arithmetic algorithm of the narrow-band processing that is processing of estimating spectral information on a larger number of wavelengths than a number of output wavelengths of the spectral sensor on a basis of the output spectral information of the spectral sensor.

title: Extensible object modeling using object type as context
abstract: Devices, methods, and systems for extensible object modeling using object type as context are described herein. One method includes receiving, via an interface, a request by a client for object data in an object modeling platform, determining an object type corresponding to the request, authorizing and validating the request using authorization and validation functionalities nonspecific to any object type, selecting a particular business logic, of a plurality of business logics, based on the determined object type and sending, to the client, the requested object data according to the particular business logic responsive to authorizing and validating the request.

title: Coil component
abstract: A coil component is provided. The coil component includes: a coil formed by connecting multiple U-shaped members and I-shaped members each having a thickness of 5 mm or more; a mounting bracket made of a metal member and fixing the coil component to an installation target surface; and an insulating member disposed between the coil and the mounting bracket. The U-shaped members and the I-shaped members are not covered around their peripheries with an insulating coating, and a fitting hole is formed in the mounting bracket. The insulating member includes: coil supporting portions into which respective turns of the coil are inserted and which fit with the respective turns, and a protruding portion that fits in the fitting hole and fixes the insulating member to the mounting bracket.
assignee: Tamura Corporation; Tamura Corporation Of China Limited

title: Magnetic compass interlock vessel detection and vessel recognition device
abstract: A food processing appliance includes a base configured to selectively receive a plurality of vessel types. At least one of the plurality of vessel types includes a first magnetic key that includes at least one magnet disposed in a first arrangement of magnets along at least two axes. A magnetic compass assembly that is located on the base is configured to detect a reading that includes a presence and location of magnets on the at least two axes. The food processing appliance also includes a processor and a memory. The memory includes instructions that, when executed by the processor, cause the processor to receive the reading from the magnetic compass assembly and identify the at least one vessel type from the plurality of vessel types based on the first arrangement of the at least one magnet.

title: Modular animal-mounted container distribution system
abstract: An animal-mounted container distribution system comprises an animal-worn support structure secured to an animal and a plurality of resilient engagement members mounted along at least one lateral region thereof. Each resilient engagement member comprises a resilient body defining an open gap and a curved receiving region configured to flex or deflect upon insertion of a portion of a container and return to partially encircle and releasably retain the container portion in an exposed position in which at least a portion of the container is visible and manually graspable without opening a flap, cover, closure, pouch, pocket, or enclosure. The engagement members are mounted along rigid or semi-rigid support members, with upper and lower support members on each lateral side interconnected by flexible coupling members. An adjustable strap suspension mechanism permits tool-free vertical adjustment and selective removal of the lower support member. Modular decorative panels are interchangeable with the container assembly.

title: Atomization apparatus
abstract: This application relates to the technical field of atomization apparatuses, and specifically, to an atomization apparatus that uses e-liquid atomization. In the atomization apparatus, a locking structure is configured to keep an atomization module in a to-be-activated state. When the atomization apparatus needs to be used, the locking structure is unlocked, and an elastic member applies an elastic force to a pushing member, so that the atomization module moves to an activated state. In this case, an atomization space is in communication with an e-liquid storage space, and normal atomization can be performed. When the atomization module is in the to-be-activated state, the atomization space is isolated from the e-liquid storage space.

title: Pressure-preserved coring tool, use method, and reservoir analysis method
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of drilling coring devices. Disclosed are a pressure-preserved coring tool, a use method, and a reservoir analysis method. The pressure-preserved coring tool comprises an outer cylinder ( 1 ), a differential assembly ( 2 ), a pressure-preserving inner cylinder assembly ( 4 ), and a seal assembly ( 5 ). The differential assembly is configured to be able to drive the pressure-pre-serving inner cylinder assembly to move upwards relative to the seal assembly, so that the seal assembly seals the inner cylinder assembly for accommodating a rock core ( 8 ). Therefore, in the process of taking out a drilled rock core to the ground, the pressure state of the rock core in an in-situ formation can be preserved in the inner cylinder assembly, so that important information, such as physical properties and fluid distribution characteristics of reservoirs under in-situ formation conditions, is obtained by means of, for example, a nuclear magnetic resonance-based analysis and test method, thereby supporting efficient exploration and development of oil and gas resources.
assignee: China National Petroleum Corporation; Cnpc Greatwall Drilling Company

title: Methods and apparatuses for a mro mechanism for a fast mcg link recovery procedure and an unbalanced ul and dl coverage scenario
abstract: Embodiments of the present application relate to methods and apparatuses for a mobility robustness optimization (MRO) mechanism for a fast master cell group (MCG) link recovery procedure and an unbalanced uplink (UL) and downlink (DL) coverage scenario. A method can include: receiving configuration information regarding a fast master cell group (MCG) link recovery procedure for a user equipment (UE); in response to an occurrence of a radio link failure (RLF) on a MCG, performing the fast MCG link recovery procedure and starting a timer associated with fast MCG link recovery; storing information associated with the fast MCG link recovery procedure in response to successfully completing the fast MCG link recovery procedure or in response to failing to complete the fast MCG link recovery procedure; and in response to the UE accessing a base station (BS), reporting the stored information to the BS.

title: Refrigerator with ice cream maker
abstract: A refrigerator including a refrigeration compartment and a freezer compartment, where a freezer drawer is configured for selectively accessing the freezer compartment. The refrigerator further includes an ice cream maker mounted within the freezer compartment. The ice cream maker includes a motor positioned rearward of the freezer drawer, and a drive shaft movably connected to the motor and extending at least partially within the freezer drawer. The drive shaft engages with the motor when the freezer drawer is in a first position and disengages with the motor when the freezer drawer is in a second position.

title: Technique for sharing a digital key
abstract: A method for sharing a digital key includes receiving a request for key sharing; in response to receiving the request, checking a current context of the digital key; and sending an acknowledgement for the request based on the checking.

title: User Detection For Physical Conference Space Check-In
abstract: User detection is performed to check a physical conference space in for use during a video conference. In response to detecting a person within a physical conference space based on sensor output, an identification operation is performed to authenticate an identity of the detected user. For example, the identification operation may include one of a facial recognition process or a speech recognition process. The system determines a name of the person based on the identification operation and automatically compares same against a participant list for the video conference for which the physical conference space is reserved. Where a match is determined, the system automatically checks the physical conference space in for the video conference.

title: Intermittent-Catheter Assembly and Methods Thereof
abstract: An intermittent-catheter assembly can include an intermittent catheter and a catheter housing. The intermittent catheter includes a funnel and a catheter tube fluidly coupled to the funnel. The catheter housing can include the intermittent catheter disposed in the catheter housing while in a packaged state of the intermittent-catheter assembly. The catheter housing can include an inner sleeve and an outer sleeve. The inner sleeve can include a longitudinal cavity containing a majority of the intermittent catheter in the packaged state of the intermittent-catheter assembly. The outer sleeve can be slidably disposed over the inner sleeve. The catheter housing can be configured to expose the intermittent catheter for removal from the catheter housing when the outer sleeve is grasped and slid toward an exposed end of the inner sleeve in opposition to a force applied to the exposed end of the inner sleeve.

title: Systems and Methods for Dynamic Control of Machine Learning Parameters
abstract: Systems and methods for dynamic control of machine learning parameters, allowing for modification of weights for input values and vectors during processing. Implementations of these systems provide greater flexibility without requiring extensive retraining of a model, and may improve accuracy of classifications for diagnostic systems or other analyzers.

title: Electrostatic chuck with conductive mesh
abstract: The present disclosure describes a filter assembly for a heater line of a processing chamber. The filter assembly includes a first impedance producing element, a first air core inductor, and a second air core inductor. The first impedance producing element includes a first conductive lead and a second conductive lead wound around a first toroid shaped core. A first end of the first conductive lead and a first end of the second conductive lead are coupled to an output of an electric device. The first air core inductor is electrically connected with the first conductive lead. The second air core inductor is electrically connected with the second conductive lead.

title: Estimating Loudspeaker Elevation
abstract: In one embodiment, a method includes emitting, by each of multiple discrete loudspeakers, an excitation stimulus; and measuring, by each of multiple microphones, a response at that microphone due to the stimuli. Each of the discrete loudspeakers is proximal with at least one microphone in the set of microphones, and the microphones include at least two microphones separated by a predetermined distance. The method further includes determining, by deconvolving the microphone measurements, a set of loudspeaker room impulse responses; determining, from the set of loudspeaker room impulse responses, a distance between each discrete loudspeaker and each microphone; and estimating, based on the determined distances, an elevation angle of each of the discrete loudspeakers.

title: Bipolar electrode recycling method
abstract: A bipolar electrode recycling method includes ultrasonic stripping of each of a current collector, a first electrode active material layer, and a second electrode active material layer, of a bipolar electrode, using ultrasonic waves from an ultrasonic horn, in which the ultrasonic stripping includes bringing an emission face of the ultrasonic horn that emits ultrasonic waves into contact with the bipolar electrode, and applying vibrations to the bipolar electrode in a thickness direction of the bipolar electrode, and bringing the emission face of the ultrasonic horn that emits ultrasonic waves into contact with a side face of the second electrode active material layer, and applying vibrations to the second electrode active material layer in a direction along the other face of the current collector.

title: Artificial intelligence-based generation of application state keys for content streaming systems and application
abstract: In various examples, generative artificial intelligence (AI) models may be used to automatically generate state keys (or “identifiers”) associated with an interactive application. For instance, the systems and methods of the present disclosure may use the AI models to generate the state keys corresponding to essential features of an application. The generated state keys may be structured as key-value pairs, enabling automated application state tracking by mapping values of the essential features to their respective state identifier keys during application runtime. In some examples, the systems and methods of the present disclosure may generate the state keys in a number of ways, such as by using a pretrained AI model with intrinsic knowledge of the application, using a generic AI model to infer the essential features by analyzing a plurality of screenshots captured during application runtime and/or by processing application documentation, wikis, or manuals.

title: Non-intrusive fault detection for sensor cables of physiological monitors
abstract: A compact, economical circuit assembly may detect and diagnose a variety of sensor cable faults in medical monitoring systems. The fault detection may continuously provide real-time information while consuming only minimal extra power. A dedicated local processor in the circuit assembly may communicate with a main processor of the medical monitor for more detailed analysis, long-term logging, and optional adaptive prediction, of short circuits, open circuits, and ground faults. The fault detector is suitable for adding on to existing medical monitors as well as building into new ones. A programmable portion of the circuit may be updated over a network to support new test algorithms and new types of cables and sensors.

title: Extreme ultraviolet (euv) radiation source apparatus, euv lithography system, and method for generating extreme ultraviolet radiation
abstract: An EUV radiation source apparatus includes an EUV source vessel; a tin layer disposed in the EUV source vessel; a chamber disposed adjacent to the EUV source vessel; and a first filter disposed in the chamber, wherein the first filter includes a membrane and a mesh disposed on the membrane, and the membrane and the mesh are integrally formed. A method for generating EUV radiation includes: forming a first filter including a membrane and a mesh integrally formed with the membrane; disposing the first filter in a chamber adjacent to an EUV source vessel; and collecting fuel debris on the first filter in the chamber.

title: Rotary system having a fluid flow path
abstract: A rotary system includes a rotor that defines a fluid flow passage. A first end cap is disposed at a first axial end of the rotor. The first end cap defines an access opening that is aligned with the fluid flow passage defined by the rotor and defines an annular channel. A rotor shaft defines an aperture that extends from an interior surface of the rotor shaft to an exterior surface of the rotor shaft. The rotor and the rotor shaft are coupled, such that the rotor and rotor shaft are operable to rotate about an axis together at a common rate of rotation. Rotation of the rotor and rotor shaft about the axis is configured to propel fluid from an interior volume of the rotor shaft, through the aperture, through the access opening, and into the fluid flow passage.

title: Radar signal processing device, radar signal processing method, and radar device
abstract: A radar signal processing device includes processing circuitry configured to: acquire a reception signal of each of a plurality of reception antennas; calculate an initial value of a two-dimensional spectrum representing a direction in which a target is present and a velocity of the target on a basis of the acquired reception signals; and update the two-dimensional spectrum on a basis of a non-linear component included in a velocity spectrum in the two-dimensional spectrum and a positional error of the reception antennas included in an angular spectrum in the two-dimensional spectrum.

title: Roundnet apparatus with rim-impact indicator, adjustable net tension, and foldable rim assembly
abstract: A roundnet apparatus includes a foldable rim assembly, a net coupled to the rim by an adjustable elastic coupling system, a rim-impact indicator assembly, and, in some embodiments, overload-releasable leg assemblies. The rim assembly may include rim segments joined by hinges having overlapping geometry that promotes coplanar alignment in a deployed configuration and pinch-reducing surfaces that reduce pinch points during folding and unfolding. The net may include apertures receiving an elastic cord selectively engageable with discrete engagement features of retention members to set installed net tension while permitting the net to remain coupled during folding. The net may comprise a coated woven mesh, such as PVC-coated woven polyester mesh. The rim-impact indicator assembly may generate an audible, visual, tactile, or recorded output in response to a ball striking the rim, distinguishable from contact with the net. In some embodiments, leg couplings retain during normal play and release under overload.

title: Mobile Engine-Generator Vehicle
abstract: A mobile engine-generator vehicle that uses the same motor system for mobility as it does for electrical power generation. The mobile engine-generator vehicle is configured to provide electrical power to an external load via an electrical outlet mounted to the vehicle.

title: Method and apparatus for encapsulating and parsing a media file comprising neural network based post filter information
abstract: The present invention concerns a method of encapsulating media data into an ISOBMFF based media file, the media data comprising media data units and at least one post filter data unit, the method comprising: generating a first track encapsulating a sequence of samples, each samples comprising at least one of the media data units, the at least one post filter data unit applying to at least one of the samples of the first track; generating a data part of an entity comprising at least a part of one of said post filter data unit; generating post filter information describing the at least one post filter data unit; and encapsulating the first track, the entity and the post filter information in the media file, the post filter information being encapsulated in a metadata part of the media file.

title: Training neural networks using linear companion nodes to mitigate gradient attenuation
abstract: A system and method for controlling a nodal network. The method includes estimating an effect on the objective caused by the existence or non-existence of a direct connection between a pair of nodes and changing a structure of the nodal network based at least in part on the estimate of the effect. A nodal network includes a strict partially ordered set, a weighted directed acyclic graph, an artificial neural network, and/or a layered feed-forward neural network.

title: Aerosol generator
abstract: An aerosol generator is provided. The aerosol generator comprises aerosol generating material, a resistive heating layer configured to heat the aerosol generating material, and a support layer comprising a support. The resistive heating layer is on a first side of the support. The resistive heating layer comprises at least one of a first type of electrical contact and at least one of a second type of electrical contact. At least one of the first type of electrical contact and the second type of electrical contact is accessible from a second side of the support.

title: Semiconductor processing system and method for operating the same
abstract: A method for operating a semiconductor processing system is provided. The method includes performing a semiconductor process by a semiconductor fabrication apparatus, wherein the semiconductor fabrication apparatus comprises a plurality of load ports arranged substantially along a first direction in a top view; moving a stage between a first region and a second region substantially along a second direction intersecting the first direction in the top view, wherein the stage supports a transfer robot, and the first region is nearer to the load ports than the second region is; using the transfer robot, transferring a wafer carrier between a stocker apparatus and a semiconductor fabrication apparatus when the stage is at the first region; and performing a maintenance process to the semiconductor fabrication apparatus when the stage is at the second region.
assignee: Tsmc China Company Limited; Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Ltd.

title: System and method for operating a thermal reactor
abstract: The method can include receiving a baseline signal curve, operating a thermal reactor, measuring a signal, optionally determining a state (e.g., state of health) of the thermal reactor, and controlling the thermal reactor based on the signal. The method can include receiving (e.g., determining, measuring, etc.) a resistance-temperature and/or resistance-time curve; operating a thermal reactor comprising resistively heating a porous catalytic element; measuring an electrical signal (e.g., resistance, current, voltage, etc.) of the thermal reactor; optionally inferring a temperature of the thermal reactor based on the electrical signal and the resistance-temperature; and controlling the thermal reactor based on the electrical signal. The system can include one or more of a reaction module (e.g., an electrical coupler or electrode and catalytic element, etc.), inlet and outlet valves, power source, electrical feedthroughs (e.g., leads, supports, etc.), sensors, and computing system (e.g. controller).

title: Asymmetric common source inductances to reduce turn-off overvoltage in mosfets
abstract: A circuit includes a metal-oxide semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET) having a gate, a source, and a drain. The circuit further includes a first inductor and a second inductor. The first inductor has a small inductance value that is less than a larger inductance value of the second inductor. The circuit further includes a switch configured to include the first inductor in a current path shared by a gate loop and a source loop of the MOSFET when the MOSFET is turning on, and to include the second inductor in the current path shared by the gate loop and the source loop when the MOSFET is turning off.

title: System and method for reconfiguration of an entertainment system controlling device
abstract: An entertainment device initiates a configuration process of a controlling device in response to a change in an audio visual entertainment system configuration in which at least one of a plurality devices is connected to the entertainment device as an audio and/or visual source and at least one of the plurality of devices is connected to the entertainment device as an audio and/or visual output destination for the entertainment device.

title: Awning
abstract: An awning having a rotatably mounted fabric roller, an awning fabric, a drop bar and at least one driven, multi-segment telescopic arm. The awning fabric is connected to the fabric roller in a region of an inner fabric edge and to the drop bar in a region of an opposite outer fabric edge. Between an inner wall of a first arm segment and an outer wall of a second arm segment, at least one sliding part is arranged, which has at least one locking finger that is formed integrally with the sliding part and that carries a locking projection which engages in a locking recess of the first arm segment or the second arm segment such that the sliding part is locked to the first arm segment or the second arm segment.

title: Skid structure
abstract: A skid structure includes a mini skid and a support structure. The mini skid is configured to be removably coupled to a main skid. The mini skid includes a pair of opposed longitudinal rails and a plurality of beams extending in a transverse direction relative to the main skid and coupling the pair of opposed longitudinal rails. The support structure is secured to the mini skid and is configured to support a plurality of vehicle components. The support structure includes first mounting features configured to support a first vehicle component of the plurality of vehicle components and second mounting features configured to support a second vehicle component of the plurality of vehicle components.

title: Ultrasonic sensor for identifying material of object and operating method thereof
abstract: An ultrasonic sensor includes an ultrasonic transmitter transmitting ultrasonic waves toward an object according to a control signal; an ultrasonic receiver receiving a plurality of reflected waves generated by being reflected from a surface of the object; and a control circuit controlling the ultrasonic transmitter and the ultrasonic receiver, wherein the control circuit identifies a material of the object using amplitudes and arrival times of the plurality of reflected waves.

title: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for collection, receiving and utilizing data and enabling gameplay
abstract: The embodiments include various methods, systems, and apparatuses for enabling, providing, transmitting and displaying data. In some embodiments, the methods, systems, and apparatuses may be further related to the collection of data from one or more sources or sensors and transmission and manipulation of that data. The data can be sourced from a variety of sources, including sporting events, and may be processed, manipulated and transmitted in substantially real time depending on the embodiment.

title: Cognitive function-improving agent and pharmaceutical composition for treating or preventing cognitive dysfunction
abstract: A cognitive function-improving agent including an agonist for peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha (PPARα). A pharmaceutical composition for treating or preventing cognitive dysfunction containing the cognitive function-improving agent.

title: Method for controlling the operating parameters of a turbomolecular vacuum pump
abstract: A method controls the operating parameters of a turbomolecular vacuum pump including a stator, a rotor, a motor to drive the rotor in rotation in the stator, an internal heating device on the gas flow path of the vacuum pump to heat the rotor, a temperature sensor to measure the temperature of the rotor, and an external heating device to heat the stator. The control method includes a nominal operating mode in which the rotor is heated by the internal heating device as long as the measured temperature of the rotor is below a temperature threshold for a given parameter representative of the power consumed by the motor, and a boost operating mode in which the internal heating of the rotor is cut off when the measured temperature of the rotor is above or equal to the temperature threshold.

title: Damper assembly
abstract: A damper assembly includes an outer cylinder, an inner cylinder positioned at least partially within the outer cylinder, a cap coupled to the inner cylinder, and a plunger positioned radially inward from the inner cylinder and coupled to a rod. The plunger, the cap, and an interior of the inner cylinder at least partially define a first chamber. The suspension system further includes a passage extending through the rod and fluidly coupled with the first chamber, a piston coupled to the inner cylinder and extending radially outward toward the outer cylinder, a first port in fluid communication with the plunger, the cap, and the inner cylinder through the passage, and a second port in fluid communication with the piston, the inner cylinder, and the outer cylinder. The piston, an exterior surface of the inner cylinder, and the outer cylinder at least partially define a second chamber.

title: Mobile imaging device, imaging system, imaging arrangement, and imaging method for imaging a cut edge
abstract: A mobile imaging device location-independently generates at least one image of a cut edge of a workpiece. The imaging device includes a main body with a cut-edge stop, which is located or formed on the main body and configured to be placed arranged or formed on the main body, for placing the main body against the workpiece having the cut edge to be imaged; and an imaging unit, which is located in or on the main body and configured to image the cut edge. The cut-edge stop forms a predetermined edge distance to the imaging unit along an optical imaging axis of the imaging unit. The predetermined edge distance causes a constant imaging distance of the imaging unit to the cut edge when the imaging device is placed on the workpiece.

title: Pyrido[4,3-d]pyrimidine derivatives as mutant kras g12c inhibitors for the treatment of cancer
abstract: The present disclosure provides compounds of the formulae (I), (II) or (III) for use in the treatment and suppression of cancer, for example, useful for treating or suppressing cancers characterized by KRAS G12C. Also provided are pharmaceutical formulations containing such compounds and processes for preparing such compounds.

title: Braking device and vehicle driving device including the same
abstract: A braking device including: a support member; an output member that is rotatable with respect to the support member; and an engagement mechanism that engages and disengages the support member and the output member, wherein a direction along an output axis, which is a rotation axis of the output member, is defined as an axial direction, and the engagement mechanism includes a pair of engagement elements that is arranged to face each other in the axial direction, a pressing member that presses and releases the pair of engagement elements in the axial direction, and a driving device that drives the pressing member.

title: PVD Device with Adjustable Rotation Radius of Magnetron and Source Power Applied to Planar Target and Application Method Thereof
abstract: A PVD device with adjustable rotation radius of a magnetron and source power applied to a planar target and an application method thereof are disclosed. The device includes: a magnetron rotating assembly including a magnetron slidably connected to a bracket via a guide rail and a slider for the magnetron, and a projection area of the magnetron is smaller than that of the planar target on a horizontal plane; a drive mechanism including a first drive unit configured to drive the magnetron to rotate along a circumferential trajectory and a second drive unit configured to drive the magnetron to move radially relative to the magnetron bracket, thereby adjusting the radius of the circumferential trajectory; and a controller configured to perform at least one of the following: control the second drive unit to drive the magnetron to move radially; or control a source power applied to the planar target.

title: Privacy preserving logging
abstract: A server system implemented by a service provider may store health data of a user according to a multi-node data structure, which may be accessed from a computer system. Responsive to a request for health data stored by the service provider, the service provider may provide node information for an encrypted node. A transaction record may be generated that represents requests for access to the encrypted node. Records associated with a patient and accessed by a user (e.g., medical professional) can be logged and shared to track access.

title: Toothed Belt and Manufacturing Method Therefor
abstract: Provided is a toothed belt including a back portion in which a tension member is embedded and a plurality of tooth portions, in which the toothed belt includes a first rubber layer and a second rubber layer that are formed on a belt inner circumferential side with respect to the tension member, an elastic modulus of the first rubber layer is larger than an elastic modulus of the second rubber layer, the first rubber layer includes a first crosslinked rubber composition including a first rubber component and a first short fiber oriented in a belt longitudinal direction along a contour of the tooth portion, a proportion of the first short fiber is 5 parts by mass to 60 parts by mass with respect to 100 parts by mass of the first rubber component, and the tension member includes a high elastic modulus fiber.

title: Extracellular vesicle, preparation method, pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract: The disclosure provides an extracellular vesicle, a preparation method, a pharmaceutical composition, and application thereof. The preparation method includes generating squeezing effects on extracellular vesicles, to load exogenous nucleic acids into the extracellular vesicles; purifying the extracellular vesicles loaded with the exogenous nucleic acids, to obtain the extracellular vesicles with high levels of the exogenous nucleic acids for diagnosis and treatment; and quantifying the exogenous nucleic acids of the extracellular vesicles with high levels of the exogenous nucleic acids for diagnosis and treatment. The disclosure loads the exogenous nucleic acids having diagnosis and treatment properties into the extracellular vesicles by a high-throughput physical squeezing method.
assignee: Shenzhen Institutes Of Advanced Technology Chinese Academy Of Sciences

title: Cup lid and thermal insulation container
abstract: A cup lid and a thermal insulation container are related to the field of thermal insulation containers. The cup lid includes an outer lid configured to be fastened to an opening of a cup body and seal the cup body. The cup lid further includes a thermal insulation assembly. A mounting space is formed on a bottom side of the outer lid, and the thermal insulation assembly is disposed in the mounting space. A preset gap is formed between a bottom side of the thermal insulation assembly and a bottom surface of the outer lid. The thermal insulation assembly includes a thermal insulation layer, and the thermal insulation layer faces a top surface of the outer lid. The cup lid and the thermal insulation container may improve the thermal insulation effect of the thermal insulation container.

title: Swellable clay containing water-based barrier coating and method of making the same
abstract: An aqueous barrier coating for paper products can include a chemically unmodified swellable clay dispersed in a binder, wherein the swellable clay is dispersed under high shear conditions such that the swellable clay is present in the form of tactoids.

title: Material processing by turbo burst ultrafast laser pulse
abstract: A system for scribing a transparent material includes a laser and a lens assembly. The laser is configured to output laser pulses at one or more pulse repetition rates in a range from 1 MHz to 1000 GHz. The lens assembly is positionable across a top surface of the transparent material and is configured to focus the laser pulses into the transparent material. The focused laser pulses induce optical breakdown of the transparent material in a region within the transparent material that overlaps a bottom surface of the transparent material, thereby facilitating scribing of the transparent material.

title: Fire shaver
abstract: A fire shaver including a shaver assembly, a striker, and a spark rod. The shaver assembly is configured to produce tinder and includes a blade and an opening to receive shaving items. The striker may be stored either externally on the fire shaver or internally within it and is configured to produce a spark when stricken against the spark rod. The fire shaver may include a center cavity section to mate and store components.

title: Ferroelectric memory devices and operation methods thereof
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods for manufacturing and operating a ferroelectric memory device are provided. In one aspect, a method of operating a ferroelectric memory device includes: performing a program operation on a first ferroelectric memory cell, including: applying a program voltage to a first word line coupled to the first ferroelectric memory cell; applying a pass voltage to a second word line coupled to a second ferroelectric memory cell; applying a first voltage to a selected top select gate (TSG); and applying a second voltage greater than the first voltage to an unselected TSG.

title: Bodipy compound, and temperature-sensitive fluorescent sensor of cell organelles comprising same
abstract: The present invention relates to a BODIPY compound, and a temperature-sensitive fluorescent sensor of cell organelles comprising same. A BODIPY compound according to one aspect can quickly detect minute temperature changes with high sensitivity and accurately target various cell organelles and has no cytotoxicity. That is, the BODIPY compound according to one aspect can visualize the temperature for each cell organelle and is expected to be useful as a temperature-sensitive fluorescent sensor of cell organelles.
assignee: Institute For Basic Science; Postech Academy-Industry Foundation; National University Corporation Kanazawa University

title: Systems and methods for making a lignin paper pouch, container, or sealing structure
abstract: A pouch made of plant-based materials includes a body defining a left side, a right side, a bottom side, and a mouth at an upper end thereof that provides access into a cavity of the pouch, and a sealing structure that is configured to allow access into the cavity of the pouch in an open configuration and to prevent access into the cavity of the pouch in a closed configuration. The sealing structure includes at least 85% repulpable, plant-based material, and a remaining percentage of the sealing structure consists of a water-insoluble polymer.

title: Method for surface treatment of a substrate and method for bonding such a substrate to a further substrate, and a device for carrying out such methods
abstract: A method for surface treatment of a substrate (B), in particular as a preparatory step for a method for bonding the substrate to a further substrate, including: —providing the substrate (B) having a bonding surface provided for the bonding, —treating ( 100 ) the substrate (B) at least in a portion of the bonding surface to form an amorphous layer (C) having a first thickness (D 1 ), a primary particle radiation preferably being used for forming the amorphous layer (C), and —reducing ( 200 ) the layer thickness of the amorphous layer (C), preferably to a second thickness (D 2 ).

title: Direct-From-Vial Medication Infusion System
abstract: A medication transfer device for use with a vial includes a first interface, a second interface, and one or more piercing elements. The first interface can be on a first end have a shape and size to couple to an infusion pump. The second interface can be on a second end and have a shape and size to secure the vial. The one or more piercing elements can define both at least a portion of (i) an inlet channel in fluid communication with a pressure source generated by the infusion pump when the first interface is coupled to the infusion pump and (ii) an outlet channel in direct fluid communication with an infusion set delivering medication from the vial to a patient.

title: Schema Transformation For Managing An Application Build
abstract: Techniques for generating a schema transformation for application data to monitor and manage the application in a runtime environment are disclosed. A system runs an application plugin in a runtime environment to identify data generated by application modules in one or both of an application build process and an application execution process. The application plugin is a software program executed together with the application build process. The application plugin identifies a source schema associated with application data. The application plugin identifies a target schema associated with an analysis program or machine learning model. The application plugin generates a schema transformation to convert application runtime data into a target data set. The system applies the target data set to an analysis program, such as a machine learning model, to generate output analysis data associated with the application.

title: Devices and methods for a multi-mode training device
abstract: A multi-mode training device may include a base frame and an interface frame. A multi-mode training device may include a support frame fixed to the base frame and hingedly coupled to the interface frame. A multi-mode training device may include an arcuate track, wherein adjusting the angle manipulates an orientation of the interface frame with respect to the base frame.

title: Topcon solar cell, cell assembly, and photovoltaic system
abstract: A Topcon solar cell includes a first tunneling oxide layer, a first polarity doped layer, and a first passivation layer, sequentially stacked on a first surface of a substrate. A second polarity doped layer and a second passivation layer are sequentially stacked on a second surface of the substrate. In an extension direction of a first metal electrode that is arranged on the first passivation layer, a plurality of first barrier isolation layers arranged at intervals are located below the first metal electrode. At a position corresponding to the first barrier isolation layer, the first metal electrode burns through the first passivation layer to be in contact with the first barrier isolation layer, and between adjacent first barrier isolation layers, the first metal electrode burns through the first passivation layer to be in contact with the first polarity doped layer.
assignee: Zhejiang Aiko Solar Energy Technology Co., Ltd.; Tianjin Aiko Solar Energy Technology Co., Ltd.; Zhuhai Fushan Aiko Solar Energy Technology Co., Ltd.; Guangdong Aiko Solar Energy Technology Co., Ltd.; Shenzhen Aiko Digital Energy Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Firmware updating method and electronic device, electronic system using the firmware updating method
abstract: A firmware updating method, applied to a host, comprising: the host transmitting a transmitting sequence for a sub device of a target device, wherein the transmitting sequence is for updating a firmware of the sub device; the host or the target device initiating a monitor procedure to identify whether transmission of the transmitting sequence is finished or interrupted; the host or the target device terminating the monitor procedure if the transmission is finished; and the monitor procedure providing a notice signal to the target device or the host if the transmission is interrupted. By this way, the host or the target device can be notified of the firmware update interrupting, and the host or the target device can operate correspondingly.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method and non-transitory computer readable medium
abstract: An information processing apparatus includes: a processor; and a memory storing a program which, when executed by the processor, causes the information processing apparatus to: generate a moving image file which includes a first area storing therein captured moving image data, and a second area storing therein management information for managing the moving image data; and set any one of a first shooting mode, in which the moving image file is generated without adding information for proving authenticity of the moving image file, and a second shooting mode, in which the moving image file is generated by adding the information for proving the authenticity of the moving image file to the moving image file, wherein arrangement of the first area and the second area in the moving image file is changed based on the shooting mode.

title: Semiconductor structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A method includes providing a stacked structure of alternating two-dimensional (2D) material layers and dielectric layers; selectively removing first portions of the dielectric layers around source/drain regions of the 2D material layers; forming contact layers wrapping around the source/drain regions of the 2D material layers; forming source/drain metals over the contact layers; selectively removing second portions of the dielectric layers around channel regions of the 2D material layers; forming a gate electrode wrapping around the channel region of the 2D material layers, wherein the gate electrode is positioned laterally between the source/drain metals.

title: Transport System and Method for Controlling a Linear-Motor-Based Transport System
abstract: A method for controlling at least one linear motor for a transport system, wherein the transport system includes a transport rotor which, on at least one side, has a plurality of magnets, where at least two magnets have different magnetic polarity, and which has a return element, the control device controls the at least one linear motor such that a longitudinal force is exerted on the transport rotor in a longitudinal direction of the linear motor to effect a linear movement of the transport rotor in the longitudinal direction and controls the at least one linear motor such that a transverse force that is perpendicular to the longitudinal force is exerted on the transport rotor so as to effect a transverse movement of the transport rotor toward the coils or away from the coils, and a field-varying current is zero when the transverse movement of the transport rotor is effected.

title: Tapered Magnetic Main Pole Structure With Variable Peg Gap For Heat-Assisted Magnetic Recording Technology
abstract: Writer head products for heat-assisted magnetic recording devices and methods of making the same are disclosed. The writer heads include multiple layers including a waveguide blocking layer, a waveguide layer, a near-field transducer layer, a heat sink layer, and a peg layer. The peg layer may comprise a small triangular section that extends from an air-bearing surface into the optical component. The writer heads further include a main magnetic pole adjacent to the optical component.

title: Microparticle sampling and chemical treatment
abstract: Systems and methods in which microparticles, including microparticles of plastic, are sampled and provided with a chemical treatment are described. A device for microparticle sample collection and chemical treatment may include a microparticle sample collection chamber including a first filter bed enclosed in the microparticle sample collection chamber and a first microparticle filter, a microparticle chemical treatment chamber including a second filter bed enclosed in the microparticle chemical treatment chamber and a second microparticle filter disposed within the second filter bed configured to receive the microparticles at a surface of the second microparticle filter for a chemical treatment of the microparticles; and a microparticle outflow transport system configured to transport the microparticles from the third outlet from the microparticle chemical treatment chamber without removal of the microparticles from the device. Methods of operation, including techniques for microparticle filtering, treatment, and transportation are also disclosed.
assignee: Hong Kong Applied Science And Technology Research Institute Co., Ltd.

title: Spring array frame and related methods
abstract: A frame assembly having a body and a plurality of prongs extending from an elongated edge or surface of the body. A canted coil spring length is located on one of the prongs and optionally each prong has a canted coil spring length located thereon. The prong can position the spring length at a neutral position or with a turning angle without a spring groove. The frame assembly can be used to conduct heat, transfer electricity, shield RF and EMI, and to test the spring length without a spring groove.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A semiconductor device and a manufacturing method thereof are provided. The semiconductor device includes first semiconductor channel layers, second semiconductor channel layers, a dielectric wall, a gate structure, a source/drain electrode and an inner spacer. The first semiconductor channel layers are stacked vertically apart along a first direction over a substrate. The second semiconductor channel layers are stacked vertically apart along the first direction over the substrate. The dielectric wall is disposed between and separates the first semiconductor channel layers and the second first semiconductor channel layers, wherein the dielectric wall comprises a liner and a dielectric wall material disposed over the liner. The gate structure extends along a second direction perpendicular to the first direction disposed crossing over a channel region of the first fin structure and a channel region of the second fin structure. The source/drain electrode is in contact with the first semiconductor channel layers. The inner spacer is enclosed by the first semiconductor channel layers, the gate structure, the dielectric wall and the source/drain electrode, wherein the inner spacer is in contact with the dielectric wall material of the dielectric wall.

title: Method and device for harq-ack feedback in wireless communication with frequency band resource configuration change
abstract: A UE includes a processor and a transceiver operatively coupled to the processor. The processor receives a signal that includes information identifying a first slot during which the UE is to transmit a PUCCH and information defining at least one first type of configuration change associated with an active BWP. The first type of configuration change includes a change of a frequency band resource within the active BWP and defines a first change occasion corresponding to a time period over which the first type of configuration change occurs. The processor transmits the PUCCH in the first slot. The PUCCH carries a target HARQ-ACK bit block that is determined based on a chronological order among the first slot, a target slot, and the first change occasion. The target slot is a downlink slot.

title: Aircraft body section with multilayer electrically conductive structure and methods of fabrication
abstract: An aircraft body section comprises a first layer of composite material, a first group of conductive traces, a second layer of composite material, and a first group of conductive connectors. The first layer of composite material has an upper surface and a lower surface, with the lower surface forming an exterior surface of a body of the aircraft. The first group of conductive traces are formed on the upper surface of the first layer of composite material. The second layer of composite material is positioned on the first layer of composite material and has an upper surface and a lower surface, with the upper surface forming an interior surface of a body of the aircraft. The first group of conductive connectors is formed on the upper surface of the second layer of composite material and is configured to provide electrical connection from external conductors to the conductive traces.

title: Noisy quantum channel error mitigation
abstract: Systems and methods for implementing noisy quantum channel error mitigation are described. For example, a method can include providing to a machine learning model, input data indicative of an original quantum state of a quantum system that is modified by an amount of noise added by a non-unitary quantum communication channel. The machine learning model is trained to predict the original quantum state in order to perform error mitigation by simulating an inverse of the non-unitary quantum communication channel to reverse one or more errors caused by the non-unitary quantum communication channel. The method can further include obtaining, from the machine learning model, output data indicative of the original quantum state, and causing a quantum computing system to perform at least one quantum computing operation, involving at least one of error mitigation or quantum state preparation, based on the output data.

title: Performing modulation operations in a memory sub-system
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed including a memory device and a processing device, operatively coupled with the memory device, to perform operations comprising: receiving a write command to store data on the memory device; identifying a number of bits of an address referenced by the write command; generating a seed value by performing one or more first operations on a subset of bits comprising the identified number of bits of the address; generating an output sequence using the seed value; generating modulated data by performing one or more second operations on the output sequence and the data; and storing, in the memory device, the modulated data.

title: Integrated routing assembly and system using same
abstract: An example routing assembly includes a plurality of connector ports, a plurality of cables, and a substrate. Each cable among the plurality of cables includes a pair of conductors extending between a first end and a second end. The first end of a cable among the cables is connected to a first connector in a first connector port, and the second end of the cable is connected to a second connector. The substrate includes a chip package, a plurality of signal contacts, and a plurality of ground contacts. The plurality of signal contacts and the plurality of ground contacts are connected to the chip package through the substrate. The second connector is connected to signal and ground contacts among the plurality of signal contacts and the plurality of ground contacts.

title: Quality metrics
abstract: An apparatus comprising: at least one processor: and at least one memory storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, cause the apparatus at least to perform: defining or generating an information message for enabling a region-based signaling of quality metric: and when the region-based signaling of the quality metric is enabled, signaling one or more of following: a number of regions in a picture: type of regions: region index method indicator for the regions: a region index for each region: or a measure or value for each quality metric and/or each color component of the each region.

title: Diagnosis of dental conditions from patient images
abstract: Systems and methods for identifying a dental condition from a patient image are provided, including: accessing a 2D image depicting a patient's teeth; determining a segmentation mask for the 2D image, the segmentation mask including a plurality of tooth masks corresponding to a plurality of individual teeth of the patient's teeth; measuring at least one spatial parameter using the segmentation mask, where the at least one spatial parameter comprises one or more of a shape of an object feature in an intraoral cavity of the patient or a spatial relationship between two or more object features in the intraoral cavity of the patient; and identifying a dental condition for the patient's teeth based on the at least one spatial parameter.

title: High speed spatial light modulator
abstract: A high speed spatial light modulators are described. In one non-limiting example, an optical switching device, comprises a first photonic crystal slab (PCS) layer, a second PCS layer, a graphene layer, a reflector, and a readout integrated circuit. The second PCS layer includes a silicon layer and the graphene layer is positioned in a cavity between the first PCS layer and the second PCS layer. The reflector is deposited on the silicon layer of the second PCS layer. The readout integrated circuit is attached to the reflector. The optical switching device is configured to modulate a surface of the optical switching device to switch between reflection and absorption of an interrogating beam according to an electrical modulated signal.
assignee: Board Of Regents, The University Of Texas System

title: Display Substrate and Display Device
abstract: A display substrate and a display device are provided. In the display substrate, the shift register unit includes a charge pump circuit, the charge pump circuit includes a first capacitor and a first transistor, the charge pump circuit is electrically connected with a first input node and a first node, respectively; a first electrode plate of the first capacitor is connected with the first clock signal line, a second electrode plate of the first capacitor is connected with the first input node, a gate electrode of the first transistor is connected with a first electrode of the first transistor, the second electrode plate of the first capacitor is provided with a first portion, the first portion of the second electrode plate of the first capacitor and the gate electrode of the first transistor have an integral structure, an active layer of the first transistor extends in a second direction.

title: High speed dynamic compartor
abstract: A comparator is disclosed. The comparator includes an amplifier circuit, a latch circuit, and a boost circuit. The amplifier is configured to amplify a difference between the first and second differential inputs during an active phase of the comparator. The latch circuit includes first and second transistors, respectively coupled to first and second differential amplifier outputs, and configured to respectively drive first and second legs of the latch circuit during the active phase. The boost circuit includes first and second boost transistors respectively coupled to the first and second differential amplifier outputs, and configured to respectively provide a first supplemental current to the first differential output of the latch circuit and a second supplemental current to the second differential output of the latch circuit.

title: Recycled push water system for corn removal
abstract: A system for recycling water in a cooking system is provided. The system includes a set of soak tanks, a washer, a skimmer tank, a pump, and a debris removal tank. The set of soak tanks is configured to hydrate a cooked food product and discharge the hydrated cooked food product to the washer via an outlet pipe. The washer is configured to separate the food product and the water and deliver the water to the skimmer tank. The pump delivers the water to the debris removal tank. The debris removal tank is configured to separate debris from the water and deliver the water to the outlet pipe to transfer a hydrated cooked food product to the washer.

title: Memory device and repair method of the memory device
abstract: A memory device includes: a first cell region provided in a first layer, the first cell region including a first word line and a first redundant word line; a second cell region provided in a second layer, the second cell region including a second word line and a second redundant word line; a peripheral region provided in a third layer, the peripheral region including first decoder circuits respectively connected to the first word line and the second word line, and a second decoder circuit commonly connected to the first redundant word line and the second redundant word line; and a control circuit configured to: based on the first word line being identified as defective, replace the first word line with the first redundant word line; and based on the second word line being identified as defective, replace the second word line with the second redundant word line.

title: Electronic apparatus and control method thereof
abstract: An electronic apparatus includes a sensor, memory storing instructions, a projector configured to output light to a projection surface, and at least one processor, where the instructions, when executed by the at least one processor individually or collectively, cause the electronic apparatus to identify a first projection position according to an environmental illuminance value based on first data obtained through the sensor and a first brightness value of the projection surface, obtain a second brightness value corresponding to a brightness of a projection image output through the projector at the first projection position, obtain a third brightness value corresponding to a brightness of a projection area based on second data obtained through the sensor while the projection image is being output, and control the projector such that the projection image is output at a second projection position that is determined based on the second and third brightness values.

title: Lift and tilt device for a power wheelchair
abstract: A lift and tilt device ( 1 ) for manoeuvring a seat of a power wheelchair, comprising: an upper beam ( 3 ) having a proximal end ( 3   a ) and a distal end ( 3   b ), a first linear actuator arranged along the upper beam ( 3 ) comprising a first carrier unit configured to run along the upper beam ( 3 ) from a distal position towards the proximal end ( 3   a ) to a proximal position, and from the proximal position to the distal position, a lower beam ( 5 ), a second linear actuator arranged along the lower beam ( 5 ) comprising a second carrier unit configured to run along the lower beam ( 5 ) between a first position and a second position, a main arm ( 7 ) pivotally connected to the proximal end ( 3   a ) of the upper beam ( 3 ) and to the second carrier unit, an upper arm ( 9 ) pivotally connected to the main arm ( 7 ) and to the first carrier unit, a mounting structure ( 13 ) fixedly arranged relative to the lower beam ( 5 ), and a lower arm ( 11 ) pivotally connected to the main arm ( 7 ) and to the mounting structure ( 13 ).

title: Oral Care Compositions Comprising Hops Beta Acid And Amino Acid
abstract: Oral care compositions with an anticaries or anticavity effect. Oral care compositions that have one or more hops beta acids, such as from an extract from a species in the  Humulus  family, and one or more amino acids. Oral care compositions having one or more amino acids and an extract from  Humulus lupulus . Methods of use of the disclosed compositions to disrupt biofilm in the oral cavity of a patient in need of treatment.

title: Information processing system and information processing method
abstract: An information processing system transforms a voice of a user to a voice of another person different from the user. The system includes a memory and a processor. The memory stores a program. The processor executes the program to cause a processor configured to execute a program that causes the processor to carry out accepting impression information representing an impression of the voice of another person as desired by the user. The program also causes the processor to carry out setting, from among two or more previously prepared and registered voices, one registered voice meeting the impression information, as the voice of another person.

title: Information provision method, information provision system, and recording medium
