The crosslinker may be a divalent metal ion donor such as a metal salt (e.g., calcium salt or a zinc salt, for example, calcium carbonate or zinc carbonate or mixtures). A void-forming agent of 0.3% to 0.9% w/w and 4% to 10% w/w of a resilience-enhancing modifier are added to provide mechanical properties similar to those of commercial polyurethane foams. The resilient bacterial nanocellulose foam has a density of 30 to 182 kg/m 3 , a tensile strength of 98 to 1195 kPa, and a resilience of 18 to 39%. The TEMPO-oxidized bacterial nanocellulose has a degree of polymerization (DP) of at least 700.
assignee: Nano And Advanced Materials Institute Limited

title: Information processing apparatus and information processing method
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an information processing apparatus and an information processing method. A controller of the information processing apparatus is configured to execute setting, when detection is made that a camera is capturing an image of a user in a vehicle, a luminance of a display that presents information to the user to a value that is predetermined.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: Provided is a semiconductor device comprising a semiconductor substrate having an upper surface and a drift region, trench portions provided inwardly from the upper surface of the semiconductor substrate, mesa portions each being a region sandwiched between two of the trench portions; an emitter electrode, and an interlayer dielectric film with a contact hole formed, wherein the mesa portions include a channel mesa portion having a first conductivity type emitter region and a second conductivity type base region on the upper surface and connected to the emitter electrode by the contact hole, and a hole-extraction mesa portion with no channel formed and connected to the emitter electrode by the contact hole, and a first conductivity type first trench bottom region having a higher concentration than the drift region is provided at a lower end of at least one of the trench portions sandwiching the hole-extraction mesa portion.

title: Processing apparatus, method, and non-transitory computer-readable medium
abstract: A processing apparatus for which a normal environment and a secured environment are provided, includes a validity check processing unit configured to operate in the normal environment and receive a revocation check request for a public key certificate, a validity management unit configured to operate in the normal environment and output information about validity of a public key certificate corresponding to the received revocation check request, and an inspection unit configured to operate in the secured environment and inspect normality of the validity management unit.

title: Safety network of things
abstract: An apparatus includes a network interface and a processing unit. The network interface receives a device registration request identifying an identity of a client device, an Internet address of the client device, and a physical location of the client device. The processing unit determines an identity of at least one sensor of the client device, at least in part based on the identity of the client device. The network interface transmits, to an Internet address of a server, the identity of the client device, the physical location of the client device, and the identity of the at least one sensor of the client device. The network interface receives data from the at least one sensor of the client device.

title: Restimulation of cryopreserved tumor infiltrating lymphocytes
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods for re-stimulating TIL populations that lead to improved phenotype and increased metabolic health of the TILs and provides methods of assaying for TIL populations to determine suitability for more efficacious infusion after re-stimulation.

title: System and method for determining constitution of detected vehicle as auxiliary or separate vehicle
abstract: A system and a method are recited. One or more rear images within a field of view of an image capturing device are captured. The image capturing device face an environment behind a vehicle system. The environment has a route traveled by the vehicle system. Based at least in part on the one or more rear image and one or more reference images, a vehicle on the route behind the vehicle system is detected, and whether the detected vehicle constitutes an auxiliary vehicle or a separate vehicle is determined.

title: Text generation method, computer device, and storage medium
abstract: The present disclosure provides a text generation method, a computer device, and a storage medium. The method includes: obtaining an initial text; performing information retrieval according to the initial text to obtain at least one piece of reference content; performing information extraction on the at least one piece of reference content using a first language model to generate at least one piece of extracted information; and in response to receiving a selection operation for the at least one piece of extracted information, generating a text outline according to selected extracted information, and performing text generation using a second language model according to the initial text and the text outline to obtain a target text.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Downlink synchronization enhancement in enhanced non-terrestrial network handover
abstract: A network device including a transceiver and a processor is disclosed. The processor is configured to determine a status of a target cell for handover of a user equipment (UE) from a serving network device in a serving cell to a target network device in the target cell. The serving cell and the target cell are in a non-terrestrial network (NTN). In accordance with the determined status of the target status, the processor is configured to determine whether the UE requires a downlink (DL) synchronization with the target cell, and determine a start time of scheduling the UE in the target cell without the UE performing random access channel (RACH) procedure during handover of the UE. The processor is configured to transmit, via the transceiver to the UE, and based on the determined start time of scheduling the UE in the target cell, instructions for performing the DL synchronization.

title: Multilayer substrate and electronic device
abstract: A multilayer substrate includes a multilayer body including resin layers stacked in a Z-axis direction, a signal conductor layer, and one or more through conductors passing through a first resin layer in the Z-axis direction. A first main surface of the first resin layer includes one or more hollow portions not in contact with the signal conductor layer and overlapping the signal conductor layer when viewed in the Z-axis direction. Each of the one or more hollow portions and the one or more through conductors includes a tapered region in which each of a cross-sectional area of the one or more hollow portions orthogonal to the Z-axis direction and a cross-sectional area of the one or more through conductors orthogonal to the Z-axis direction increases toward the first main surface. The tapered region is in contact with the first main surface of the first resin layer.

title: Ai-based conversion of a legacy application into a converted application using a schema
abstract: Techniques are described herein that are capable of causing an AI system to convert a legacy application into a converted application using a schema. An AI system is caused to generate a schema that defines functional blocks of a legacy application and logical relationships therebetween based on documentation describing the functional blocks and the logical relationships. The AI system is caused to perform a conversion of the legacy application into a converted application based on the schema and the legacy application. Performing the conversion includes converting the functional blocks, which are configured to have respective functionalities and are written in a first programming language, into code blocks, which are configured to have the respective functionalities and are written in a second programming language. Performing the conversion further includes configuring the code blocks to have the logical relationships. The converted application is defined by the code blocks and the logical relationships.

title: Metadata-driven automated fraud trend detection and risk rules generation for online transactions
abstract: Some aspects relate to technologies for leveraging metadata to automatically detect fraudulent trends in online transactions and to generate risk rules based on the fraudulent trends. In accordance with some aspects, event data related to online transactions on an online transaction platform is collected. The event data is collected and enriched using a first set of metadata from a metadata store to provide enriched data. A fraudulent trend is detected by analyzing the enriched data using one or more clustering and/or predictive algorithms guided by a second set of metadata from the metadata store. A risk rule is then generated based on the fraudulent trend using a third set of metadata from the metadata store. The risk rule is deployed to an online fraud detection system to identify fraudulent transactions on the online transaction platform.

title: Use of heterocyclic compound in treatment of interstitial pneumonia
abstract: A heterocyclic compound having a hedgehog pathway antagonist activity, especially a compound having a structure of formula A or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, solvate, hydrate, stereoisomer, tautomer and prodrug thereof. The compound can effectively block the Shh signaling pathway, can down-regulate the expression of the pulmonary fibrosis-related protein α-SMA protein, and can significantly inhibit the progression of pulmonary fibrosis lesions.

title: Generating intelligent meeting insights for upcoming video calls
abstract: The present disclosure is directed toward systems, methods, and non-transitory computer readable media for generating and providing intelligent insights for video calls and other virtual meetings. In some embodiments, the disclosed systems analyze stored meeting data from past video calls and other virtual meetings to generate intelligent insights for an upcoming video call. The disclosed systems also generate and provide intelligent insights or coaching tools for ongoing video calls. As part of the intelligent coaching tools for ongoing video calls, the disclosed systems can generate predictions for accomplishing target goals for the video calls. Further, the disclosed systems can generate intelligent insights or coaching tools after video calls take place.

title: User equipment (ue) provisioning over a cellular network
abstract: Technology embodied in a method that includes retrieving, from a subscriber identification module (SIM) associated with the UE, identification of a cellular network and uniform resource locators (URLs) associated with the cellular network, wherein the SIM is preconfigured with the cellular network and the one or more URLs. The method also includes retrieving identification of a data network or an access point name (APN) usable by the UE to establish a Protocol Data Unit (PDU) or a Packet Data Network (PDN) session in the cellular network, and transmitting to one or more resources associated with the URLs and over the PDU or PDN session established between the UE and the data network, information pertaining to provisioning a subscriber-account associated with the SIM. The method further includes receiving, from the one or more resources associated with the URLs, information configured to provision the UE to access the cellular network.

title: Workstation for microgravity environments
abstract: A workstation for microgravity environments is provided that prevents objects from floating around inside a spacecraft. The workstation includes a downdraft table that has a plenum chamber with an inlet and an outlet. A fan is disposed in the plenum chamber for drawing air into the plenum via the inlet, and exhausting air from the plenum via the outlet. A metal grate is disposed across the inlet, and an air resistive stack is disposed on an outer side of the metal grate. The air resistive stack includes an inner resistive layer disposed on the metal grate and an outer resistive layer disposed on the inner layer. The workstation improves a user's ability to perform many activities in a microgravity environment.

title: Semiconductor chip
abstract: A semiconductor chip including a semiconductor body with a first semiconductor layer of a first conductivity type, a second semiconductor layer of a second conductivity type different from the first conductivity type, and an active region configured to emit radiation, the active region being arranged between the first semiconductor layer and the second semiconductor layer, wherein: the first semiconductor layer is electrically connected to a first contact structure comprising at least one first contact finger; the at least one first contact finger includes a contact layer and a current distribution layer; the contact layer is arranged on the first semiconductor layer; a dielectric mirror is arranged in regions between the contact layer and the current distribution layer; the dielectric mirror includes at least one opening; and the current distribution layer extends through the at least one opening and directly adjoins the contact layer.

title: Inductor element and inductor component
abstract: An inductor element includes a magnetic layer provided along a first imaginary plane and having uniaxial magnetic anisotropy, and an inductor wire spaced apart from the first imaginary plane in a first direction that intersects the first imaginary plane. The inductor wire is provided along a second imaginary plane that is parallel to the first imaginary plane. A roughness of a planar portion of the magnetic layer located on the first imaginary plane is greater than or equal to 3 nm and less than or equal to 10 nm (i.e., from 3 nm to 10 nm).

title: Methods and apparatuses for using sidelink reserved resources to determine one or more rb sets for ssb transmission
abstract: A WTRU may monitor sidelink transmissions from one or more other WTRUs during a resource sensing window, and determine reserved sidelink resources prior to or after sidelink synchronization signal block (S-SSB) slots based on the monitored sidelink transmissions during the resource sensing window. The S-S-SSB slots may include a plurality of RB sets, and at least one RB set of the plurality of RB sets may be configured as a default RB set. The WTRU may determine one or more other WTRUs reserving the reserved sidelink resources, for example, based on identification information associated with the one or more other WTRUs. The WTRU may transmit the S-SSB information on at least one RB set other than the default RB set based on at least one of the one or more other WTRUs reserving the reserved sidelink resources on a slot prior to or after the S-SSB slots.

title: Ultraviolet-curable composition, method for producing cured product, cured product, ultraviolet-curable ink, method for producing printed matter, and printed matter
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an ultraviolet-curable composition containing at least a radically polymerizable compound, a polymerization initiator, and a solvent.

title: Switching device
abstract: In an embodiment a switching device includes a movable contact in a switching chamber and at least two auxiliary contacts, two spring contacts and a contact plate in the switching chamber, wherein the switching chamber has side wall parts, wherein each of the spring contacts includes a first contact region and a second contact region, wherein the first contact region and the second contact region are connected via a connection region, wherein a side wall part is arranged between the connection region of each of the spring contacts and the movable contact, and wherein the contact plate is movable together with the movable contact.

title: Memory transaction timing compensation
abstract: A memory subsystem with timing compensation for bandwidth recovery is disclosed. The memory subsystem includes a memory having and a memory controller coupled thereto via a memory bus. The memory controller is configured perform a write transaction that includes writing data to the memory circuit during ones of a plurality of write slots and determine, while performing the write transaction and based on an operating frequency of the memory bus, a number of idle write slots of the plurality of write slot during which data is not written to the memory. The memory controller is further configured to add a number of read slots corresponding to the number of idle write slots to a total number of read slots for a read transaction, and perform, upon completing the write transaction, a read transaction that includes reading data from the memory circuit during the total number of read slots.

title: Patient Safety Device
abstract: A patient safety device for alerting a caregiver that a patient with limited mobility is standing up includes a pad. A weight sensor is positioned within the pad to detect a weight of a user positioned on the pad. The weight sensor monitors the weight of the user, detecting reductions in the weight to detect when the user is moving off of the pad. A processor and a transmitter are in communication with the weight sensor wherein the processor is designed to signal the transmitter when the weight sensor detects that the user is moving off of the pad. A computer network is in wireless communication with the transmitter. The transmitter sends a notification to the computer network when the processor signals the transmitter whereby the computer network is designed to notify a caregiver that the user is moving off of the pad.

title: Method and apparatus for using virtual throwable item, device, and storage medium
abstract: This application discloses a method for operating a virtual throwable item in a virtual environment performed by a computer device. The method includes: displaying a first virtual object and a release control of a virtual throwable item; displaying an auxiliary control of the virtual throwable item in response to a pre-trigger operation for the release control; changing an aiming direction of the virtual throwable item from a first direction to a second direction in response to a first trigger operation for the auxiliary control, the second direction being a direction from the first virtual object to a second virtual object in the virtual environment; and causing the first virtual object to throw the virtual throwable item in the second direction in response to a second trigger operation for the release control.

title: Oral biodelivery platform
abstract: The present disclosure provides a biodelivery platform for the oral administration of molecular cargo.

title: Memory subsystem supported quality of service levels for virtualized storage
abstract: Memory subsystem supported quality of service (QoS) levels for virtualized storage can be provided by advertising, by the memory subsystem coupled to a host, QoS levels supported by the memory subsystem. Examples of such QoS levels can include a function level, a process address space identifier (PASID) level, and a submission queue level. The memory subsystem can receive from the host a definition of QoS parameters for at least one QoS level. The memory subsystem can provide input/output virtualized (IOV) storage while enforcing the QoS parameters via hardware of the memory subsystem.

title: Method and system for verifying user authorization using zero-proof verification
abstract: A system includes a memory storing an evaluation algorithm configured to determine eligibility for performing a data interaction based on an eligibility criteria, and a processor communicatively coupled to the memory. The processor is configured to receive, from a computing node associated with a user, a first request to determine eligibility of the user to perform the data interaction; prompt for eligibility information; receive the eligibility information; and determine an eligibility result by inputting the eligibility information into the evaluation algorithm. In response to determining that the user is eligible, the processor transmits an indication of eligibility to the computing node and generates a zero-knowledge proof of the eligibility that does not include the received eligibility information. Upon verifying the zero-knowledge proof by running a verification algorithm and determining the proof is valid, the processor initiates the requested data interaction.

title: High density, high speed electrical connector
abstract: A dense, high-speed interconnection may be formed with a mating header and receptacle connector. The header connector may have groups of mating contact portions extending from the connector housing. Structural projections may extend from the housing adjacent some or all of the groups of mating contact portions. The groups of mating contact portions may be signal and ground mating contact portions associated with a signal pair. The groups may be arranged in an array and the structural projections may be arranged in an array intercalated with the array of the groups of mating contact portions. A receptacle connector may include an array of apertures configured to receive the structural projections. The structural projections may be shaped and positioned to reduce damage to the mating contact portions of the header connector, enable reliable manufacture, and to provide a high-density mating interface.

title: Target range anchoring device and method
abstract: A target range anchoring device and method are provided. The device scans a to-be-judged image based on a first moving window to determine whether a first quick response code among at least one candidate quick response code is detected. In response to the first quick response code being detected, the device calculates first position information of the first quick response code to generate a transformation relationship corresponding to the first position information. The device calculates at least one target range corresponding to the first quick response code based on the transformation relationship corresponding to the first position information and the spatial position relationship between the first quick response code and a plurality of corner points.

title: Genetic engneering of b cell receptors and uses thereof in antigen-induced antibody secretion
abstract: The present disclosure provides nucleic acid cassettes for engineering B cells to express transgenic B cell receptor (BCR), the nucleic acid cassettes comprising a splice donor site and nucleic acid sequences of interest that encode an antibody of interest, wherein the nucleic acid sequences of interest are targeted to insert at a target site located downstream to the last J region of an immunoglobulin heavy chain (IgH) locus and upstream to an enhancer region of the IgH locus.

title: Basket assembly, spines, and electrodes for a catheter, and methods of the same
abstract: The disclosed technology includes a spine member for an end effector, the spine member extending along a longitudinal axis from a proximal end to a distal end. The spine member includes a unidirectional proximal stop member to allow an electrode to slide in a direction distally but not proximally and a distal stop member to prevent an electrode from sliding past.

title: Systems and methods to selectively connect antennas to communicate via radio frequency signals
abstract: Systems and methods to selectively attach and control antennas via diodes. In one embodiment, a system includes: a reader having a plurality of reader antennas of different polarizations to transmit radio frequency signals; and at least one radio frequency device. The radio frequency device includes: a plurality of tag antennas of different polarizations; a plurality of diodes coupled to the plurality of tag antennas respectively; a receiver coupled to the plurality of diodes to receive the radio frequency signals from the tag antennas when the diodes are forward biased; and a set of one or more current controllers coupled to the plurality of diodes. In a receiving mode the controllers selectively forward bias the diodes to receive the signals from the reader. In a transmitting mode the controllers selectively change the state of the tag antennas to transmit data via backscattering the radio frequency signals.

title: Sigma-1 receptor ligands and use thereof
abstract: A compound has the following formula (I), an isomer thereof, or a pharmaceutical acceptable solvate thereof. The compound of formula (I) is a potent and selective sigma-1 receptor ligand, and can treat Sigma-1 receptor related disorders or diseases.

title: Module location reporting
abstract: Certain aspects of the disclosure provide systems and methods for detecting coupling of multiple infusion devices and determining a connection position of the coupled infusion devices relative to one another. Coupling data may be used to indicate usage, or overuse, of the connection position. Such usage information may be used to determine when the infusion device is ready for maintenance, cleaning, repair, and/or maintenance. Further, such usage information may be used to generate a configuration recommendation to balance and distribute usage across various connection positions of the infusion device.

title: Laminate, composite lens, display device, and virtual reality display device
abstract: The present invention provides a laminate, a composite lens, a display device, and a virtual reality display device, in which color unevenness is less likely to occur in a case of being applied to a display device (particularly, a virtual reality display device) and being visually recognized. A laminate according to the present invention is a laminate including: a light absorption anisotropic film; and a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer disposed adjacent to the light absorption anisotropic film, in which the light absorption anisotropic film contains an organic dichroic coloring agent, and a total of a surface free energy E1 of a surface of the light absorption anisotropic film on a pressure-sensitive adhesive layer side and a surface free energy E2 of a surface of the pressure-sensitive adhesive layer on a light absorption anisotropic film side is 54.0 mNm −1  or more.

title: Dynamic block interleaver selection
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may receive an indication of a dynamic block interleaver selection from a finite set of candidate block interleavers for a virtual resource block to physical resource block mapping in a frequency domain. The UE may perform a communication based at least in part on the dynamic block interleaver selection. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Lidar and carrier
abstract: This disclosure provides a LiDAR, including: an optical transceiver module and a scanner module, where the optical transceiver module includes: an transmitter unit; a transmitting lens unit, configured to transmit detection light; a receiver lens unit, separated from the transmitting lens unit, and configured to transmit echo light generated by reflection of the detection light from an object. In a LiDAR with the scanner module of this disclosure, using the two-dimensional array detector can reduce a receiving field of view corresponding to each detector in the LiDAR, which is conducive to improving an optical resolution of an optical system of the LiDAR. Moreover, the separately provided transmitting lens unit and receiving lens unit help improve aberrations of the transmitting lens unit and the receiving lens unit, facilitate mass production, and can also reduce area requirements for the two-dimensional array detector.

title: Hockey goalie leg pad with toe bridge member for engaging a goal post
abstract: A hockey goalie leg pad has a front pad member securable to a lower leg, and a toe bridge member depending downwardly, for example by at least 1.5 inches, from a bottom of the front pad member such that an intermediate front face portion of the toe bridge member is recessed from the front bottom edge by a prescribed offset distance of at least one inch, thereby defining a pocket to partly recess a goal post therein. The increased rearward offset of the toe bridge member together with increased height of the toe bridge member, and an optional concave front face on the toe bridge member, collectively contribute to a deep C-shaped profile receiving a substantial portion of the goal post nested therein, for example 130 or more degrees of the circular boundary. This improves anchoring relative to a post to minimize post gaps and pushing off the post.

title: Isoindoline derivative, benzoindole derivative and use thereof
abstract: The present application belongs to the technical field of biomedicine, and specifically relates to a compound as shown in formula (I), a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, a deuterated compound thereof, a stereoisomer thereof, a tautomer thereof, or a mixture thereof, and the use of the compound as an immunomodulator for IKZF1 and IKZF3 double targets.

title: Printing system and printing method
abstract: A printing system includes a printer to print image data to output a printed material; an inspection apparatus including a reader to read the printed material output from the printer to acquire an inspection target image; and circuitry configured to detect defects, according to multiple defect detection levels, from the inspection target image on the printed material based on the inspection target image and a master image to be compared with the inspection target image; determine, for each of the defects, one of the multiple defect detection levels; and display, on the inspection target image, a mark indicating a position of each of the defects in the inspection target image on the printed material and having a color changed according to the one of the multiple defect detection levels determined.

title: Radiation detection method and system
abstract: A method of detecting radiation from a target object is described that makes use of a radiation detector module including a collimator having a plurality of apertures having a spread angle for emergent radiation. The method exploits this by: associating a target object with an internal radiation source such that radiation emergent from the target object is caused to pass through the collimator to be incident upon a detector; receiving a plurality of responses each being a response to an interaction with incident radiation occurring within the detector; determining, for each of the plurality of responses, a position of each interaction within the detector in three dimensions comprising two area dimensions and a depth dimension; processing the said plurality of responses by simultaneously processing position data in such manner as to obtain information about parts of the target object within an effective field of view that is not directly congruent with the primary field of view.

title: Method and system for real time image tracking
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system and a method for adaptive image tracking. The system includes one or more processors and a non-transitory memory for storing instructions. The instructions, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the system to receive, using a receiving module, a target image and a query image of a physical environment. The system detects, using a keypoint detection module, a plurality of keypoints in the target image, and generates, using a descriptor generation module, one or more descriptor distributions defining pixel-pair intensity relationships. The system computes binary descriptors, re-identifies keypoints of the target image in the query image, and evaluates the descriptor distributions to determine a suitability score. The system selects an optimal descriptor distribution and tracks the target image across frames for stable and illumination-robust mixed reality rendering.

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: An image forming apparatus includes an apparatus body to which a cartridge including an accommodating portion and a memory, and a control unit configured to acquire reuse information, toner information, and life information stored in the memory of the cartridge. The toner information includes first toner information. The life information includes first life information corresponding to the first toner information. The control unit is configured to (i) in a case where the reuse information is acquired from the memory, acquire second toner information related to an amount of toner of the cartridge that has been reused, (ii) in a case where the first toner information is different from the second toner information, set second life information, and store the second life information in the memory, and (iii) control a timing at which replacement of the cartridge is prompted based on the second life information stored in the memory.

title: Devices, methods and apparatuses for improving channel state information measurement and reporting
abstract: Exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure relate to improvement of channel state information (CSI) reporting. The terminal device receives information indicative of at least two spatial settings configured at the network device, wherein the information is to be used by the terminal device for at least one of following associated with a single CSI report configuration: channel state information (CSI) measurement, or CSI reporting. The terminal device performs, based on the information, one or more measurements associated with at least one spatial setting of the at least two spatial settings. The terminal device transmits at least one CSI report related to the one or more measurements. The CSI reporting as provided in the present disclosure may support dynamic spatial adaptation.

title: Intelligent dynamic bitrate configuration in daisy chained ethernet cameras
abstract: A system of a plurality of ethernet cameras controlled by a microcontroller based computing device having an associated server, each ethernet camera comprises a first ethernet port, a second ethernet port, and an interconnection switch, the interconnection switch selectively transmits the control communication packet received from the first ethernet port to the second ethernet port or to its RTSP server, and transmits the video data and control communication packet received from the second ethernet port to the first ethernet port, the plurality of ethernet cameras electrically and electronically connected in a daisy chain configuration, a system computer program residing in the microcontroller based computing device is configured to dynamically control cumulative bitrate of video communication, within a prescribed bitrate limit, captured by the plurality of ethernet cameras, based on real-time assessment of priority, motion, situation and illumination of each ethernet camera, avoiding network congestion and loss of quality.

title: Multilayer ceramic capacitor and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A multilayer ceramic capacitor includes a capacitor body including a dielectric layer and an internal electrode layer, and an external electrode located on the outside of the capacitor body, wherein the dielectric layer includes a plurality of dielectric grains, at least one of the plurality of dielectric grains includes Ca, Sr, Zr, and Ti, at least one of the plurality of dielectric grains has a core-shell structure including a core portion and a shell portion disposed on at least a portion of the core portion, a content of Ti included in the shell is 5 mol % to 10 mol % based on a total amount of Zr and Ti included in the shell portion, and a content of Sr included in the shell portion is 32 mol % to 65 mol % based on a total amount of Ca and Sr included in the shell portion.

title: Three-dimensional user interfaces
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to providing and/or displaying three-dimensional user interfaces.

title: Shared power footer circuit
abstract: A device includes a first power rail for a first power domain and a second power rail for a second power domain. A first circuit block is connected to the first power rail and a second circuit block is connected to the second power rail. The first and second circuit blocks are both connected to a virtual VSS terminal. A footer circuit is connected between the virtual VSS terminal and a ground terminal, and the footer circuit is configured to selectively control a connection between the virtual VSS terminal and the ground terminal.

title: Memory system that performs error correction using metric array and method of controlling the same
abstract: A memory system includes a non-volatile memory and a memory controller. The memory controller is configured to read data from the non-volatile memory, obtain a plurality of decoded words based on a syndrome calculated from a soft decision input data based on the read data, calculate a plurality of metrics for the plurality of decoded words, generate a metric array using the calculated metrics. Further, the memory controller is configured to, based on a relationship of each value of the metric array with a smallest one of the metrics and a second smallest one of the metrics, obtain a soft decision output data corresponding to the soft decision input data.

title: Systems and methods for electrical noise monitoring of an appliance
abstract: An electrical noise monitoring system for an appliance is disclosed. The system includes at least a sensor configured to detect voltage data associated with an electrical circuit. The system includes a noise detection circuit configured to: identify noise data by processing the voltage data using a Fast Fourier Transformation (FFT); and compare the noise data to a noise threshold associated with an appliance. The system includes a control circuit configured to: determine one or more operations of the appliance based on the comparison; and execute the one or more operations of the appliance based on the determination.

title: Substrate processing
abstract: A method for processing a substrate, the method including: providing a substrate on a support; measuring a property of the substrate and/or of a rinsing liquid; controlling the addition of one or more additives to the rinsing liquid based on the measurement, to adjust the pH value and/or the conductivity of the rinsing liquid to a predetermined value; and providing the rinsing liquid to a surface of the substrate via one or more nozzles. There is also provided a system for processing a substrate, and a method for manufacturing a device.

title: Compositions of il-1r1 antibodies and methods of producing and using the same
abstract: The instant invention relates to compositions comprising a protein, e.g., an antibody, or antigen-binding portion thereof, e.g., an anti-IL-1R1 antibody or antigen binding portion thereof, and methods, e.g., cell culture and protein purification methods, for producing such compositions.

title: Video generation method and apparatus, electronic device, storage medium, and program product
abstract: A video generation method includes displaying at least one video generation control on a video generation interface, the at least one video generation control being configured for generating videos of at least two video types, displaying, based on the at least one video generation control associated with a target video type among the at least two video types being in a selected state, a content input region corresponding to the target video type, displaying inputted target content based on a content input operation being performed in the content input region, and displaying, based on a video generation instruction, a first video of the target video type that is generated based on the inputted target content.

title: Method for determining rotation parameters of a rotation angle, and electric motor
abstract: A method for determining rotation parameters of at least one variable rotation angle (γ) of a rotor of an electric motor, said angle dependent on a rotational speed (ω), the method comprising the following steps: determining a first phase voltage (u d ) and a first phase current (i d ) each with respect to a d-direction, and a second phase voltage (u q ) and a second phase current (i q ) each with respect to a q-direction of the rotor-fixed dq-coordinate system; applying a calculation algorithm with an iterative calculation of the rotational speed (ω) as the calculated rotational speed (ω i ) and the rotational angle (γ) as the calculated rotational angle (γ i ); outputting the calculated rotational angle (γ i ) as the output calculated rotation angle (γ r ); and calculating the rotational speed (ω) as the output calculated rotational speed (ω r ) from the output calculated rotation angle (γ r ), without directly calculating the calculated rotational speed (ω i ).

title: Reinforcing composite material
abstract: The reinforcing composite material includes at least one sheet made of a flexible material and a plurality of reinforcing composite strips each including a covering capsule surrounding a plurality of longitudinal channels developing parallel to a longitudinal development direction of the reinforcing composite strip and arranged in sequence between opposite side ends of the reinforcing composite strip, and a plurality of longitudinal reinforcing fibers arranged within the longitudinal channels. The reinforcing composite strips are coupled to the sheet at the respective lower surfaces of the covering capsules so that their respective longitudinal development directions are parallel. On an upper surface of each covering capsule, opposite to the lower surface coupled to the sheet, surface reliefs are made having prevailing development directions that are parallel to the longitudinal development direction of the reinforcing composite strip, each surface relief extending at least partially between opposite terminal ends of the reinforcing composite strip.

title: Polarization state monitoring apparatus, polarization state monitoring method, and non-transitory computer-readable medium
abstract: A polarization state monitoring apparatus acquires a sample data sequence. The sample data sequence indicates, for each of a plurality of frames of an optical reception signal, sample data representing the polarization state. The polarization state monitoring apparatus maps each of the plurality of pieces of sample data to a corresponding point in a Stokes space, and calculates a plane that fits the plurality of corresponding points. The polarization state monitoring apparatus detects an abnormality in the polarization state of the optical reception signal by using the calculated plane.

title: Erosion Measurement System for Turbine Blade
abstract: Disclosed is an erosion measurement system for a turbine blade, including: a light illumination device for irradiating light to generate a brightness difference to distinguish a measurement region when inspecting a turbine blade; an optical image acquisition device for creating an image optically photographing a blade surface; and an image analysis and erosion amount calculation device for analyzing an image photographed by the optical image acquisition device and calculating an erosion amount of a blade, and the light illumination device and the optical image acquisition device are fixed to face each other with a target blade disposed at a center and photographing a target blade while moving relatively in a circumferential direction of a turbine, and the image analysis and erosion amount calculation device may calculate an erosion amount in a manner accumulating an erosion amount at a plurality of measurement locations located inside a blade.
assignee: Korea Electric Power Corporation; Korea South-East Power Co., Ltd.; Korea Midland Power Co., Ltd.; Korea Western Power Co., Ltd.; Korea South Power Co., Ltd.; Korea East-West Power Co., Ltd.

title: Mode switching between touchless pointer operation and typing activities using a computer device
abstract: The present invention concerns a method ( 500 ) for touchless control of a computer device ( 102 ), wherein the computer device ( 102 ) comprises and/or is communicatively coupled to display means ( 104 ) and/or sensor means ( 108 ) and, optionally, a keyboard ( 106 ). The sensor means ( 108 ) is configured for observing an interaction space ( 110 ) arranged at least partially above an interaction surface, such as a surface of the keyboard ( 106 ), a tabletop and/or a lap of a user. The method comprises entering ( 504 ) a gesture mode in response to detecting ( 502 ) a gesture mode activation event. The method comprises, in the gesture mode, determining ( 506 ), based at least partially on sensor data captured using the sensor means ( 108 ), a movement of at least one finger ( 202 ), preferably of the fingertip of the at least one finger ( 202 ), of the user while the user's hands are arranged at least partially above interaction surface. The method comprises, in the gesture mode, generating ( 508 ) at least one control command configured for manipulating content displayed on the display means ( 104 ) in accordance with the movement of the at least one finger ( 202 ).

title: Optimizing Roaming to Mitigate Sticky Clients Via Machine Learning
abstract: Devices, systems, methods, and processes for tackling the problem of sticky clients in wireless networks using machine learning processes are described herein. Thresholds related to data rates and/or Received Signal Strength Indicators (RSSI), for Access Points (APs) in a network are identified. These thresholds are configured to dynamically adjust, either based on the time of day or real-time roaming patterns, with the aim of mitigating sticky clients and enhancing overall network performance. Advanced machine learning techniques such as Graph Neural Networks are implemented within the domain of deep learning to significantly alleviate sticky client concerns and promote seamless connectivity for all users.

title: Communications Support for Connected Vehicles
abstract: Concepts and technologies disclosed herein are directed to communication support for connected vehicles. According to one aspect disclosed herein, a vehicle communication support system can receive data from a connected vehicle operating in communication with a network. The vehicle communication support system can determine whether the connected vehicle has experienced a network degradation. In response to determining that the connected vehicle has experienced network degradation, the vehicle communication support system can instruct at least one network component to change at least one aspect of the network to overcome the network degradation.

title: Systems and methods for connecting uhpc structural elements
abstract: Systems and methods for connecting (and/or splicing) ultra-high-performance concrete (UHPC) precast elements are provided, as well as the finished connected UHPC elements after connection. The UHPC precast elements can be designed for applications in building construction and/or civil engineering. Overhang connection structures and spar connection structures are provided. In either case, holes can be created in one UHPC beam segment (e.g., by casting or drilling) to accommodate dowel bars from a corresponding UHPC segment.
assignee: The Florida International University Board Of Trustees

title: Policy-based inter-agent communication control
abstract: A system may receive a query via a first agent, where agents are associated with large language model (LLM) prompt templates corresponding with a plurality of operational domains, and where agents are configured to access one or more data stores comprising tagged data. The system may transmit, from the first agent to a second agent a message indicating an operational domain and a requested operation involving first tagged data. The system may verify whether the requested operation is permitted by an agent access policy that indicates a plurality of tags and one or more permitted operations associated with each respective tag. The system may transmit, from the second agent to the first agent, a reply to the message that is in accordance with the agent access policy. The system may transmit a response to the query based on the reply to the message.

title: Method for producing lithium sulfide in a circulating bed reactor
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for preparing lithium sulfide (Li 2 S) from lithium hydroxide (LiOH) and hydrogen sulfide (H 2 S), characterised in that the lithium hydroxide is sulfided in a reaction zone ( 9 ) comprising at least one moving bed tubular reactor ( 9   a ) having the configuration of an ascending vibrating spiral in which the lithium hydroxide ( 4 ) flows in countercurrent to an anhydrous gas mixture ( 10 ) containing hydrogen sulfide and at least one inert gas.

title: Camera module
abstract: A camera module according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first body including a lens; a second body coupled to the first body; first to third substrates disposed between the first body and the second body; and a first support member and a second support member for spacing the first to third substrates in the optical axis direction, wherein the first support member includes a hole formed in a sidewall thereof, and the second support member includes a protrusion part inserted into the groove of the first support member.

title: Separator for Power Storage Devices, and Power Storage Device
abstract: The present invention provides a separator for power storage devices, the separator having a microporous membrane in which a microporous layer (A) containing a polypropylene as a main component and a microporous layer (B) containing a polypropylene as a main component are superposed upon each other, or alternatively, at least one of the microporous layer (A) and the microporous layer (B) is contained. With respect to this separator for power storage devices, the trunk height as calculated from the analysis of an SEM image of an MD-ND cross-section of the microporous membrane is 500 nm to 1,000 nm (inclusive).

title: Data security for data sequences
abstract: Data security for data sequences is disclosed, including: receiving, over a network, a first sketch corresponding to a first file, wherein the first sketch was determined from hash values generated from a data sequence associated with the first file; determining that the first sketch and a second sketch corresponding to a second file at least partially overlap; and determining whether a data security policy is violated based at least in part on the determination that the first sketch and the second sketch at least partially overlap.

title: Non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing a program, data processing apparatus, and data processing method
abstract: According to one embodiment, a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing a program that causes a processing circuitry to execute operations includes comparing a first commit and a second commit for a first variation branch branching from a development branch at a first timing, and extracting the second commit as a commit for a first variation when there is a difference between the first commit and the second commit, wherein the first commit and the second commit are programs described in a source code and are registered in a configuration management tool, and the first commit and the second commit are registered in a development branch of the configuration management tool after the first timing.

title: Method and system for estimating energetic hemodynamic parameters and computer readable medium thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method for estimating energetic hemodynamic parameters, including: an ultrasound device obtaining a vascular diameter and a blood flow waveform from a subject; obtaining a blood flow velocity of the subject; a processor providing a volumetric flow rate, a pulse wave velocity (PWV), and a blood pressure waveform of the subject; and a processor obtaining the energetic hemodynamic parameters. The present disclosure further provides a system for estimating energetic hemodynamic parameters, including: an ultrasound device having an ultrasound probe and used to obtain a vascular diameter and a blood flow waveform from a subject; and a processor coupled to the ultrasound device and used to perform the method of the present disclosure. The present disclosure still further provides a computer readable medium storing a computer executable code, upon executed, the computer executable code implements the method of the present disclosure.
assignee: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

title: High temperature gravel packing fluid system
abstract: A high density carrier fluid for use in placing a gravel pack within a wellbore includes a modified starch, a magnesium oxide, and a nano-crystalline-cellulose having a median diameter of about 20 nanometers or less. The carrier fluid includes an aqueous base fluid and dissolved salts. Related methods include methods of making and using the carrier fluids.

title: Construction element for buildings, in particular houses
abstract: The invention relates to a construction element for buildings comprising two panels (P 1 , P 2 ), parallel relative to each other and connected together by at least one spacer (E 1 , E 2 ), each panel (P 1 , P 2 ) comprising at least one lower edge ( 4 ), said lower edge ( 4 ) comprising a cutout ( 8 ) so that the construction element cooperates by interlocking with one or more construction elements of a lower row or a sill plate, said cutouts ( 8 ) comprising at least one bore ( 12 ) intended to be aligned with a bore of another construction element or a sill plate, said bore ( 12 ) being configured for the installation of a stud ( 15 ) or a screw.

title: Replay protected memory block data frame
abstract: Devices and techniques are disclosed herein for providing an improved Replay Protected Memory Block (RPMB) data frame and command queue for communication between a host device and a memory device.

title: Determination of progestogens non-invasively in animals
abstract: The present disclosure relates to 5α-pregnane-3,6,20-triol isomer or 5α-pregnane-3,6,20-triol in a glucuronidated form in determination of progestogen or progestogens in a sample from a non-human animal. The present disclosure also relates to an in vitro method of determining progestogen or progestogens in a sample from a non-human animal.

title: Rotating electric machine
abstract: A rotating electric machine is provided that has a variable flux mechanism allowing relative movement between a stator and a rotor, and that is small in thickness and diameter and allows a cooling path to be readily provided. The rotating electric machine includes: a rotary shaft; a rotor that includes a permanent magnet, provides torque to the rotary shaft, and is attached to the rotary shaft to be movable along an axis; a moving mechanism that moves the rotor along the axis; a stator that includes a coil and is disposed with a radial gap between the stator and an outer circumference of the rotor; and a rotation prevention device that prevents rotation of the moving mechanism. The moving mechanism includes: a screw shaft member that rotates together with the rotor and has an outer circumference with a helical screw groove and an inner circumference through which the rotary shaft is located; and a screw nut member screwed into the screw groove on the screw shaft member. The rotation prevention device includes: a guide on the screw shaft member; and a slider on a housing.

title: Systems and methods of table processing for retrieval-augmented generation
abstract: A computer-implemented method includes: identifying a plurality of tables in a data source; storing data corresponding to one or more data fields shared by the tables in a first format; receiving a user input at a system having one or more trained language models; determining, using at least one trained language model, based on the user input, whether a set of criteria for searching data in the first format are satisfied; in accordance with determining that the set of criteria are satisfied, identifying, using a trained language model, one or more filtering parameters based on the user input; in accordance with determining that the set of criteria are satisfied, searching, by the system, data stored in the first format using the one or more filtering parameters; receiving the data stored in the first format; and generating an output by a trained language model based on the received data.

title: Bwp determining method, dci sending method, apparatus, terminal, and network-side device
abstract: A bandwidth part (BWP) determining method, a download control information (DCI) sending method, an apparatus, a terminal, and a network-side device are disclosed in the field of communication technologies. The BWP determining method in embodiments of this application includes: receiving, by a terminal, first DCI, where the first DCI includes a BWP indicator; and determining, by the terminal, a target BWP based on at least one of the BWP indicator or a dormancy indicator in a case that the first DCI satisfies an enabling condition of the dormancy indicator.

title: Training of a machine learning model for use in medical imaging applications based on combinations of incomplete sample sets and sample images simulated therefrom
abstract: A solution is proposed for training a machine learning model ( 305 ) for use in medical imaging applications. A corresponding method ( 400 ) comprises providing ( 403 - 410 ) incomplete sample sets for each imaging procedure, each comprising a sample target image (or more) for a sample target-dose of a contrast agent and a sample baseline image (or more). A sample source image (or more) is simulated ( 411 - 445; 450 - 456 ) from each of the incomplete sample sets (or a part thereof) to mimic the contrast agent at a sample source-dose lower than the sample target-dose. One or more complete sample sets are generated ( 446; 457 ) for each imaging procedure by combining the incomplete sample sets with the sample source images that have been simulated from other incomplete sample sets. The machine learning model ( 305 ) is then trained ( 458 - 473 ) using the complete sample sets. In addition, a method of using the machine learning model in a medical imaging application is proposed. A computer programs ( 300 ) and a computer program products for implementing the method ( 400 ) are proposed. Moreover, a computing system ( 130 ) for performing the method ( 400 ) is proposed. A corresponding medical method is further proposed.

title: Electric power conversion apparatus
abstract: An electric power conversion apparatus includes: two input terminals; two output terminals; a transformer; an inverter circuit including first and second main switches and first and second clamp switches, a clamp capacitor, and first and second coupling lines; a rectifying circuit; a smoothing circuit; and a control circuit. In the inverter circuit, the first main switch and the first clamp switch are disposed on the first coupling line in series and in this order; the second main switch and the second clamp switch are disposed on the second coupling line in series and in an order reverse to that on the first coupling line; and the clamp capacitor is disposed on a first or second end side of the first clamp switch on the first coupling line, or disposed on a first or second end side of the second clamp switch on the second coupling line.

title: Resin composition, cover window including the same, and display apparatusincluding the cover window
abstract:
A resin composition includes a (meth)acrylate copolymer, wherein a content of a first repeat unit derived from a first monomer represented by Formula 1 in the (meth)acrylate copolymer is about 20 wt % to about 80 wt % with respect to a total amount 100 wt % of monomeric units present in the (meth)acrylate copolymer, 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
         
         
           
             where R 1  a C 1  to C 6  alkylene group, C 1  to C 6  alkyl group with one or more oxygen, or an aromatic group, 
             R 2  is a C 1  to C 6  alkyl group, C 1  to C 6  alkyl group with one or more oxygen, or an aromatic group, and 
             at least one of R 1  or R 2  includes an aromatic group.

title: Performance optimization for a datacenter
abstract: Embodiments provide for monitoring one or more datacenter performance metrics of a datacenter during a plurality of maintenance events, determining one or more actions using an artificial intelligence model to improve at least one datacenter performance metric, and initiating the one or more actions using a robotic mechanism at a defined location within the datacenter.

title: Steel sheet and method of production of same
abstract: Provided are a steel sheet having a predetermined chemical composition, and a microstructure comprising, by area %, martensite: 90.0% or more and retained austenite: 3.0% or less, wherein a mean particle size of prior austenite grains is 30.0 μm or less, and a standard deviation in particle size of prior austenite grains is 4.0 μm or more, and a method of production of the same.

title: Battery
abstract: A battery ( 30 ) including: a cup-shaped bottom container ( 1 ) to accommodate an electrode assembly ( 4 ), the bottom container ( 1 ) comprising a base ( 2 ) and an upstanding sidewall ( 3 ) along an outer circumference of the base ( 2 ), and a lid ( 10 ) including: an inner electrically conductive portion ( 11 ), an intermediate insulating portion ( 13 ) surrounding the inner electrically conductive portion ( 11 ), and  a peripheral adapter portion ( 12 ,  15 ) forming or constituting an outer peripheral edge portion ( 26 ) of the lid ( 10 ) and fixable to the sidewall ( 3 ) of the bottom container ( 1 ) via the outer peripheral edge portion ( 26 ), wherein the peripheral adapter portion ( 12 ,  15 ) is sized, shaped and/or configured to bridge a gap between an outer edge ( 28 ) of the intermediate portion ( 13 ) and an inside perimeter of the sidewall ( 3 ).

title: Cost-efficient operation of a DRI system and of additional sub-systems of an overall system
abstract: An overall system that includes, as sub-systems, a DRI system, an electrolysis system, a hydrogen store and a supply device. The DRI system and the electrolysis system are connected to an electricity-supply network for receiving electricity. The DRI system, the electrolysis system and the hydrogen store are interconnected for transferring hydrogen, and the DRI system and the supply device are interconnected for supplying the DRI system with natural gas and/or ammonia. A controller calculates operating modes (B 1 , B 4 , B 6 , B 7 ) for the sub-systems for a forecast horizon (PH) and determines final states (Z 1 ′, Z 4 ′, Z 6 ′, Z 7 ′) that can be expected for the sub-systems on the basis of the current states (Z 1 , Z 4 , Z 6 , Z 7 ) and the operating modes (B 1 , B 4 , B 6 , B 7 ). The controller varies the final states (Z 1 ′, Z 4 ′, Z 6 ′, Z 7 ′) that can be expected so as to minimize a cost function (K).
assignee: Primetals Technologies Germany Gmbh; Primetals Technologies Austria GmbH

title: Method and memory used for reducing program disturbance by adjusting voltage of dummy word line
abstract: A method for operating a memory device is disclosed. The memory device includes a first word line, a second word line, a first dummy word line, and a second dummy word line. The first dummy word line and the second dummy word line are between the first word line and the second word line. A first pass voltage is applied to the first dummy word line in a program operation and a second pass voltage is applied to the second dummy word line in the program operation, wherein the first pass voltage is different from the second pass voltage.

title: Pegboard Assembly
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a pegboard assembly, including at least one pegboard body, wherein the pegboard body is provided with several hanging holes and at least one connecting portion, and a connecting plate and a button are connected to the connecting portion; the connecting plate is in buckling connection with the connecting portion on the rear side of the pegboard body, and the connecting plate is used for installing the pegboard body on a wall or a door panel; and the button is connected with the connecting portion on the front side of the pegboard body, and the buckling connection between the connecting plate and the connecting portion may be released by pressing the button. In the present disclosure, the pegboard body can be conveniently installed, and the pegboard body can also be conveniently disassembled.

title: Intra user equipment prioritization for data delay
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate to intra user equipment (UE) prioritization for data delay. A UE may receive uplink resource assignments, where each uplink resource assignment schedules an uplink transmission of a medium access control (MAC) protocol data unit (PDU). The UE may determine a priority of the uplink resource assignments for uplink resources that overlap in time based on a logical channel prioritization (LCP) that uses priorities of logical channels that have data to be multiplexed in a corresponding MAC PDU. A network equipment (NE) may determine the uplink resource assignments. The NE may transmit, to the UE, the uplink resource assignments and an indication of intra-UE prioritization of the uplink resource assignments for the uplink resources that overlap in time.

title: Evaporation unit
abstract: An evaporation unit for processing a metallic evaporation material includes an evaporation crucible within an evaporation chamber and a melting crucible outside the chamber fluidically connected to the evaporation crucible. The melting crucible defines a cavity configured to melt, store, and/or heat molten metallic material. A measuring arrangement coupled to the melting crucible quantitatively determines at least one of a fill level of molten material in the cavity and a mass of molten material in the melting crucible, and generates a corresponding measurement signal. A controller receives the measurement signal and determines a fill level of molten material within the evaporation crucible based on the measured parameter. This configuration enables controlled delivery of molten material to the evaporation crucible to maintain a desired fill level during operation, improving stability and process consistency.

title: Optimized recovery of compressed or liquid gas refueling heat energy
abstract: A method to recover heat energy associated with a refueling process in a vehicle having a compressed hydrogen or natural gas (CNG or H2) fuel tank includes activating a heat energy recovery system to recover heat energy associated with the refueling process. The method includes directing recovered heat energy to at least one vehicle component in preparation of vehicle starting. The method includes deactivating the heat energy recovery system responsive to the pressure in the CNG or H2 fuel tank reaching a maximum pressure limit.

title: Timepiece, control method for timepiece, and control program for timepiece
abstract: A timepiece that achieves low current consumption is provided. The timepiece includes: a battery; a time display function; a measurement display function different from the time display function; a first motor configured to operate with the electric power of the battery, the first motor corresponding to the time display function; a second motor configured to operate with the electric power of the battery, the second motor corresponding to the measurement display function; and a control unit configured to control operations of the first motor and the second motor, in which the control unit, when the time display function and the measurement display function are both in operation, causes the first motor to operate in a fixed pulse method of outputting a predetermined pulse in a hand movement cycle of 1 Hz, causes the second motor to operate in the correction drive method in a hand movement cycle shorter than 1 Hz, and adjusts an output timing so that timings of pulse for driving the first motor and the second motor do not overlap.
assignee: Seiko Watch Kabushiki Kaisha (trading as Seiko Watch Corporation)

title: Image encoding/decoding method and apparatus, and recording medium having bitstream stored therein
abstract: An image encoding method and apparatus according to the present disclosure can: receive a video picture to be encoded; generate a compressed video picture by encoding the received video picture; generate encoder optimization information; and generate a bitstream including the compressed video picture and the encoder optimization information. Here, the encoder optimization information may include a spatial resampling type flag for identifying a type of spatial resampling applied.

title: Distributed sensing for augmented reality headsets
abstract: A distributed imaging system for augmented reality devices is disclosed. The system includes a computing module in communication with a plurality of spatially distributed sensing devices. The computing module is configured to process input images from the sensing devices based on performing a local feature matching computation to generate corresponding first output images. The computing module is further configured to process the input images based on performing an optical flow correspondence computation to generate corresponding second output images. The computing module is further configured to computationally combine first and second output images to generate third output images.

title: Nozzles for vehicle drying apparatus for car wash facility and methods of use
abstract: The present invention is a drying system for a car wash facility. In various aspects, the drying apparatus according to the system may include a plurality of nozzles, with each nozzle emanating a jet of air that impacts an upper surface of a vehicle with the jets arranged to successively force water on the upper surface laterally with respect to a vehicle centerline toward sides of the vehicle. In various aspects, the methods of use of the drying apparatus may include the step of receiving a vehicle in the drying apparatus, and the step of successively forcing water on the upper surface of the vehicle laterally with respect to the vehicle centerline toward sides of the vehicle by impacting the upper surface of the vehicle with a plurality of jets of air emanating from a corresponding plurality of nozzles.

title: User equipment and method executed by user equipment
abstract: Provided in the present disclosure are a user equipment and a method executed by a user equipment. The user equipment (UE) includes a processor configured to: receive an RRC release message, wherein the RRC release message is used to configure, by including configuration information of an MBS multicast session, the MBS multicast session to be received by the UE in RRC_INACTIVE; and indicate a mapping between a TMGI and a G-RNTI for the MBS multicast session in the RRC release message.

title: Dynamic Pedal and Display
abstract: A small (smartphone-sized or tablet-sized), foot-enabled, flat, tiltable, rotatable, dynamic touch screen pedal and controller that uses a tilt mechanism to toggle between and select different audio (or other) functions and effects that are displayed on the attached display. The tilt of the device as well as optional tapping sequences activate different functions in predetermined function locations. Specific audio effects, audio effect presets, loops, songs, and controller functions can each be assigned to different touch screen locations, pedal buttons, and/or tilt directions.

title: Radiative cooling paints comprising different sized baso4 particles
abstract: A radiative cooling paint for passive cooling comprises barium sulfate powder, binder and water. The BaSO 4  powder includes particles in different hydrodynamic size distributions, with an assortment of average particle sizes in the range of about 45 nm to about 1650 nm. Surfaces coated with these paints have a maximum solar reflectance of about 98% and have temperatures as low as 29° C. when exposed to solar radiation for a period of 1 hour. A method for preparation of radiative cooling paints is further described, wherein BaSO 4  particles in different hydrodynamic size distributions are obtained by ball milling process.
assignee: King Fahd University Of Petroleum And Minerals

title: Antisense oligonucleotides for preventing kcnq2 misplicing
abstract: Provided herein are antisense oligonucleotides comprising, consisting of, or consisting essentially of 10 to 30 nucleotides, wherein the ASO binds to a target region comprising an intronic sequence between exons 4 and 6 of a nucleic acid molecule encoding a human KCNQ2 protein.

title: Method of processing substrate, method of manufacturing semiconductor device, recording medium, and substrate processing apparatus
abstract: A technique includes forming a film on a substrate by performing a cycle a predetermined number of times, the cycle including: forming a layer on the substrate by performing a process, which includes: (a) supplying a precursor gas containing a halogen element to the substrate; and (b) supplying a reaction gas to the substrate, wherein the cycle is performed under a formation condition set based on a predetermined relationship between an amount of the halogen element contained in the layer and a proportion of crystallites oriented in a predetermined crystal plane in the film.

title: Method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: A method of manufacturing a semiconductor device (MD) includes the steps of: alternately stacking a first layer ( 161 ) mainly composed of a component whose extinction coefficient in an infrared region is greater than that of silicon and a second layer ( 162 ) mainly composed of silicon oxide on a first wafer (SS), and thereby forming a stacked portion ( 160 ); forming a first element (MCA) and a first bonding electrode (P I1 ) in the first wafer; forming a second element (Tr) and a second bonding electrode (P I2 ) in a second wafer (SB); bonding the first wafer and the second wafer via the first bonding electrode and the second bonding electrode; and transmitting a laser light through a first substrate ( 150 ) to irradiate the stacked portion with the laser light, and thereby induce cleavage in the stacked portion.

title: Surface covering and fasteners for same
abstract: A surface covering includes a plurality of panels, longitudinal profiles and fastening elements. The panels are arranged on the profiles, the profiles face a bottom face of the panels, so that areas of intersection are generated between panels where the fastening elements fit, in which the fastening element has an elastic body that is connected to the head by a neck of smaller dimensions than the head, the elasticity of the elastic body allows it to pass through the groove corresponding to the profile cavity and also allows the elastic body to slide inside the cavity of the profile.

title: Photodetection device and electronic apparatus
abstract: A photodetection device that includes a plurality of pixels that performs exposure at the same timing. Each of the plurality of pixels includes: a photoelectric conversion element that stores charge corresponding to a light amount of incident light; a first retention unit that retains the charge stored in the photoelectric conversion element; a charge-voltage conversion unit that converts the charge retained in the first retention unit into a voltage; a second retention unit that retains charge overflowing from the photoelectric conversion element; a first transfer path that transfers charge from the photoelectric conversion element to the first retention unit; a second transfer path that transfers charge from the photoelectric conversion element to the second retention unit; and a first transistor that switches whether or not to supply the charge retained in the second retention unit to the charge-voltage conversion unit together with the charge retained in the first retention unit.

title: Control device, control system, control method, and storage medium
abstract: A control device includes an attachment portion where a sensor is attached to a main body controlled by a control device, an acquisition unit configured to acquire position information of a position to which the attachment portion is attached and sensor identification information of the sensor attached to the attachment portion, an extraction unit configured to extract sensor specification information based on the sensor identification information from a sensor specification database that stores specification information of the sensor, and a reflection unit configured to reflect the sensor specification information and the position information of the position to which the sensor is attached to a control parameter.

title: Method and Apparatus for Maintaining a Resilient VPN Connection
abstract: Maintaining a resilient VPN connection includes routing, by a VPN client device, via a previously established VPN connection to a VPN service provider system, packets from the VPN client device to a target device outside the VPN service provider system, wherein the previously established VPN connection includes a limited command exchange channel between the VPN client and an administrative server of the VPN service provider system, wherein the limited command exchange channel is a first component of the previously established VPN connection, and a data channel between the VPN client and a data server of the VPN service provider system, wherein the data channel is a second component of the previously established VPN connection, and the routing includes routing the packets via the data channel.

title: System and method for controlling a smart gripping apparatus
abstract: A gripper system and method or gripping an object using the gripper system for a robotic manipulator system are provided. The gripper system comprises: a chamber compartment comprising a deformable membrane wall, and at least one chamber compartment wall; a suction compartment delimited by a suction compartment wall; at least one pressure mechanism configured to modulate the pressure in the chamber compartment and a pressure in the suction compartment; at least one actuator for modulating a position of the at least one chamber compartment wall; at least one on-gripper sensor; at least one controller; and at least one image sensor configured to capture a geometry of an object to be picked. The method comprising the steps of using a captured geometry and a learning algorithm to determine a gripping configuration of the object to be picked.

title: Container installation apparatus and container
