abstract: A welding device according to embodiments of the present disclosure includes a laser configured to irradiate laser beam having a first wavelength toward a welding object, a lighting configured to irradiate light having a second wavelength different from the first wavelength onto a laser irradiation area of the welding object, a first camera configured to receive the light having the second wavelength, which is reflected from the welding object, so as to generate a first image, and a second camera configured to receive the light having the second wavelength, which is reflected from the welding object, so as to generate a second image, wherein a generation period of the first image and a generation period of the second image intersect each other.

title: Context-aware browser feature recommendations
abstract: The present systems and methods enable a web browser to recommend or present features to a user based on the content of a web page. The features, which may include various actions that can be taken and different display configurations for viewing the content of the web page, may be specific to the type(s) of content that are present on the web page. Furthermore, such features may be presented to the user upon detection of a trigger that indicates an intent to arrange or configure a tab of the browser. Such features may be presented as transient graphical elements that illustrate the feature.

title: Electric grid load forecasts with distributed photovoltaic generation
abstract: In the context of an electrical utility system, changing cloud conditions may cause a customer having solar panels to greatly increase or decrease electrical demand in a difficult-to-predict manner. Accordingly, a spinning reserve maintained by an electric utility company must be larger, and is therefore more expensive. In an example, the spinning reserve may be managed by: calculating a stable sequence of forecasts of smoothed real-time consumption, wherein the calculating is based at least in part on smoothed estimates of consumption data. A stable sequence of forecasts of real-time measured load may be calculated by subtracting forecasts of real-time distributed solar photovoltaic (PV) generation data from the stable sequence of forecasts of smoothed real-time consumption. The spinning reserve of the electricity system may be controlled based at least in part on the stable sequence of forecasts of real-time measured load.

title: High efficiency cooling for compute systems
abstract: A high-efficiency cooling system for a compute system comprises a compute tray cooling system and a switch tray cooling system. The compute tray cooling system comprises a plurality of fans and a T-shaped heat sink bank secured to a substrate of the compute tray. The switch tray cooling system comprises an external fan bank to direct air flow through a plurality of switch trays. The compute tray cooling system and the switch tray cooling system operate in tandem to provide optimal cooling for the compute system, which may selectively active the switch tray cooling system depending on whether compute resources within the switch tray are active.

title: Control device and control method
abstract: A control device includes a target state setting unit configured to set a target state of an object, an acquisition unit configured to acquire a current state of the object, a prediction unit configured to predict a future state of the object in a case where a difference vector between the target state and the current state is applied, and a motion generation unit configured to aggregate the current state, information on directionality from the current state to the target state, a joint angle state of the device, and a prediction result of the future state into a latent space, generate a shape change direction up to the target state, and obtain a joint angle of the device from the shape change direction.

title: Methods And Apparatus For PDCCH Coverage Improvement In Mobile Communications
abstract: Various solutions for improving physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) coverage are described. A network node may determine at least one of a maximum resource amount of a control resource set (CORESET) and CORESET repetitions for a PDCCH transmission, include parameters of the at least one of the maximum resource amount of the CORESET and the CORESET repetitions in a configuration, and transmit the configuration to the UE. The UE may receive the configuration and determine at least one of the maximum resource amount of the CORESET and the CORESET repetitions according to the configuration. The network node may perform the PDCCH transmission based on the configuration. The UE may determine a PDCCH according to at least one of the maximum resource amount of the CORESET and the CORESET repetitions and receive a downlink transmission on the PDCCH.

title: Grooved microneedles for passive and active drug delivery
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for delivering a fluid containing a drug solution to a region of interest of a subject. The system includes a patch including at least one microneedle coupled thereto, a reservoir coupled to the patch and retaining a fluid containing a drug solution therein, and a pump coupled to the reservoir. The at least one grooved microneedle defines a fluid channel therein, and the pump is configured to direct the fluid containing the drug solution from the reservoir, through the fluid channel of the microneedle, and to a region of interest of a subject.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium
abstract: An information processing device accesses a lesson professional information management table that stores, in association with each other, a lesson professional ID, lesson professional information including the name of the lesson professional, and evaluation information for each predetermined item of attribute information, and in which, among the predetermined items of attribute information, evaluation information provided by a user who has taken a lesson from the lesson professional is registered in an item of attribute information that is the same as an attribute information of the user. The device also acquires attribute information of a target user; extractis, based on evaluation information corresponding to attribute information that is the same as the acquired attribute information and stored in the lesson professional information management table, a lesson professional ID of a lesson professional having a high evaluation; and outputs lesson professional information associated with the extracted lesson professional ID.

title: Automated Detection of Plug and Perforate Completions, Wellheads and Wellsite Operation Status
abstract: Methods determine a state of a well and comprise: receiving a set of well operations data comprising at least some measured well operations data; determining the occurrence of a well operations event based on the received data; evaluating one or more possible state transitions from a current well operations state to one or more possible new well operations states, the current state and the possible new states selected from a configurable plurality of well operations states, wherein evaluating the one or more possible state transitions is based on the current state, the determined event and the received data and wherein evaluating the one or more possible state transitions comprises determining a confidence level associated with each of the possible new states; and determining one of the possible new states to be a new predicted well operations state according to whichever possible new state has a highest confidence level.

title: Liquid ejecting head and liquid ejecting apparatus
abstract: A liquid ejecting head includes a piezoelectric substrate that includes a plurality of piezoelectric elements for ejecting a liquid, a wiring substrate, and a flexible substrate that electrically couples the piezoelectric substrate and the wiring substrate, in which the flexible substrate includes a base film that has a mounting surface, a plurality of wirings disposed on the mounting surface, an insulating cover film that covers the plurality of wirings so as to interpose the plurality of wirings between the cover film and the mounting surface, and a detection wiring disposed on the mounting surface at a position not covered with the cover film, and for detecting that the liquid is adhered to the detection wiring.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to receive, as user information, at least one of a postal code and an address, and information regarding an age of a user, a family structure of the user, and individual needs, acquire regional information including seismic intensity and a damage situation of a target region based on the postal code or the address, evaluate a degree of danger representing a risk level of a residence of the user based on the regional information, provide action guidance including specific actions to be taken by the user according to the evaluated degree of danger, display an optimal evacuation route from a current location of the user by using photographs and augmented reality technology, provide guidance on places where relief distributions are being carried out, and provide guidance on places where communication is relatively easy.

title: Graphene coated metallic surfaces, devices and method of manufacture thereof
abstract: A method for coating a metallic surface by a graphene layer by depositing a graphene molecular precursor comprising a compound having an aromatic hydrocarbon component that is derivatized by a tethering group. The tethering groups react with the metallic surface to form a covalent bond between the compound of the graphene molecular precursor and the non-metallic surface, and the graphene molecular precursor is transformed into a graphene interfacial layer which is covalently bound to the non-metallic surface.

title: Positive displacement pump
abstract: An apparatus can include a central member between a first fluid section and a second fluid section, wherein the central member, first fluid section, and second fluid section define a longitudinal axis thereon, at least one first fluid section driving member in mechanical communication with the central member, at least one second fluid section driving member in mechanical communication with the central member, an oscillating member in mechanical communication with the central member configured to oscillate the central member along the longitudinal axis, a pump inlet in fluid communication with a fluid source, and a pump outlet.

title: Dual shaft delivery device
abstract: A delivery device ( 40 ) includes a first handle portion and a second handle portion. The first handle portion includes an inner shaft deflection mechanism ( 44 ). An inner shaft ( 46 ) is coupled to the first handle portion. The inner shaft is configured to deflect in a first deflection plane in response to actuation of the inner shaft deflection mechanism. The second handle portion includes an outer shaft deflection mechanism. The second handle portion is configured to rotate relative to the first handle portion. An outer shaft is coupled to the second handle portion. The outer shaft surrounds at least a portion of the inner shaft. The outer shaft is configured to deflect in a second deflection plane in response to actuation of the outer shaft deflection mechanism. Rotation of the second handle portion relative to the first handle portion causes the second deflection plane to rotate relative to the first deflection plane.

title: System and technique for controlling cleaning behavior and managing prohibited actions interfering with cleanliness in a cleanroom environment
abstract: This disclosure is directed to a system for detecting when an individual performs a prohibited action during a cleaning event. A wearable computing device that is worn by an individual performing cleaning in an environment detects movement associated with the wearable device during a cleaning event. One or more processors determines, based at least in part on the movement associated with the wearable computing device detected during the cleaning event, whether the individual has performed a prohibited action during the cleaning event. Responsive to determining that the individual performed the prohibited action during the cleaning event, the one or more processors may perform an operation.

title: Heat transfer suppression sheet and battery pack
abstract: A heat transfer suppression sheet contains a matrix containing inorganic particles, an inorganic fiber dispersed in the matrix, and an organic fiber. The organic fiber and the inorganic fiber are entangled with each other to form a three-dimensional web structure. The matrix may have an air layer in a periphery of the inorganic fiber. The organic fiber may have a fused portion that covers at least a part of a surface of the organic fiber, and at least a part of the inorganic fiber may be fused to the organic fiber by the fused portion.

title: Aircraft tug attachment and detachment system
abstract: Presented here are embodiments of an innovative aircraft tug attachment and detachment system. Embodiments may include a vertically translatable platform, an azimuth-rotatable cradle, and one or more rotatable latch arms. The cradle's lateral opening aligns with the platform's opening to create an entry path for the aircraft's nose landing gear (NLG). Once the NLG is positioned within the cradle, the cradle may be rotated, and the platform may be lifted off the ground to support the NLG. The rotatable latch arm may then be actuated to secure the NLG. Embodiments provide several advantages, including but not limited to, reducing the number of moving parts, making the system more reliable and easier to maintain, making it easier and faster to use, and minimizing wear on the aircraft's steering system by maintaining a fixed steering position during towing.

title: Nonvolatile semiconductor memory device
abstract: When selectively erasing one sub-block, a control circuit applies, in a first sub-block, a first voltage to bit lines and a source line, and applies a second voltage smaller than the first voltage to the word lines. Then, the control circuit applies a third voltage lower than the first voltage by a certain value to a drain-side select gate line and a source-side select gate line, thereby performing the erase operation in the first sub-block. The control circuit applies, in a second sub-block existing in an identical memory block to the selected sub-block, a fourth voltage substantially identical to the first voltage to the drain side select gate line and the source side select gate line, thereby not performing the erase operation in the second sub-block.

title: Systems and methods for detecting a presence of a floating neutral condition
abstract: Systems and methods for detecting the presence of a floating neutral condition are disclosed. The system includes a control circuit communicatively connected to a plurality of appliances. The control circuit is configured to instruct each appliance of the plurality of appliances to: record a first set of voltage data corresponding to at least one terminal of the electrical circuit; apply a load on the electrical circuit; record a second set of voltage data corresponding to the at least one terminal after the load is applied; and transmit the first and second sets of voltage data to the control circuit. The control circuit is further configured to: analyze the first and second sets of voltage data to detect a presence of a floating neutral condition; and instruct at least one appliance of the plurality of appliances to execute one or more operations based on the presence of the floating neutral condition.

title: Self-unloading container
abstract: The invention relates to agricultural equipment. The container includes a rectangular base with two container half-bodies turnably attached to its inner lateral sides. The base sides have vertical holes housing movable rods, to which an upper crossarm and a lower crossarm are attached. The upper crossarm is equipped with load clamps and a locking mechanism for locking the upper crossarm to the base. The lateral sides of half-bodies adjacent to the base are equipped with stops.

title: Utility Assembly and Coupling Mechanism
abstract: The present disclosure concerns a coupling mechanism for detachably attaching two or more utility modules to one another, utility assembles, mobile carriers and other attachable modules and articles.
assignee: Milwaukee Electric Tool Corporation; Keter Plastic Ltd.

title: Low-profile parasitically-coupled patch antenna
abstract: A parasitically-coupled dual-band patch antenna is described. The antenna includes an inner conductor having one or more feed holes. The antenna also includes an outer conductor surrounding the inner conductor in a radial direction. The antenna further includes one or more feeds each having a vertical portion that passes through the feed holes and a horizontal portion that extends in an outward direction from the feed holes toward the outer conductor. The feeds are conductively connected to the outer conductor. The horizontal portion of each of the feeds is separated from and is conductively disconnected from a top surface of the inner conductor.

title: Test tray and battery production device
abstract: A test tray includes a tray body, two sets of clamp assemblies and two compressing bodies. The two sets of clamp assemblies are spaced apart from each other in a first direction, and the clamp assemblies are movably disposed on the tray body in the first direction to clamp a battery cell. The two compressing bodies are spaced apart from each other in a second direction, and the compressing bodies are disposed on the tray body; each of the compressing bodies includes a flexible compressing part, and the flexible compressing part is configured to be in contact with the battery cell to compress the battery cell. The second direction intersects with the first direction.
assignee: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited; Contemporary Amperex Runzhi Software Technology

title: Multimodal-based human-computer interaction method and system thereof
abstract: A voice feature, an environmental feature and a facial feature are respectively obtained based on receiving a user voice input, collecting environmental information and capturing a user facial expression. A pre-trained emotion recognition model is used to generate a user emotional feature, and meanwhile a pre-trained user behavior model is used to generate a behavior feature according to current operation information of the user. After obtaining the above features, respective first weights and second weights are dynamically adjusted and weighted feature fusion is performed to obtain a comprehensive feature. A plurality of candidate responses is generated based on the comprehensive feature, and a final response is selected by using a preset scoring mechanism and output the final response.
assignee: Guangzhou Dazzle View Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Floor covering consisting of identically constructed panels, and panel
abstract: The disclosure relates to a floor covering having a plurality of identically constructed panels with two long side edges and two short side edges, wherein each panel is glued to a substrate and, in addition, the panels that are adjacent to one another along their long side edges are mechanically connected to each other via a first guide rail provided on only one long side edge.

title: Reflective traffic pole cover
abstract: A traffic sign add-on includes a front layer made of a first fabric having one or more reflective sections and a back layer made of a second fabric having a slot extending along a long dimension of the back layer from a bottom end to a top end with a zipper in the slot. The zipper is capable of closing to seal the slot. The front layer and the back layer are connected along peripheral longitudinal edges and form a substantially flat form. Further, the front layer and the back layer are configured to accommodate a circumference of a pole of a traffic sign coaxially with the long dimension of the back layer and are substantially co-dimensional when the slot is sealed with the zipper.

title: Model unlearning for machine learning models by delineating underlying data
abstract: A computer-implemented method is provided. A processor set identifies a dataset for model learning for a number of machine learning models. The processor set delineates a subset of data in the dataset. Data entries from the subset of data are relevant to context of subject matter to be removed from the model learning for the number of machine learning models. The processor set labels a portion of data from the subset of data. Data entries from the portion of data are associated with metric scores that indicate removal of the data will not prevent the number of machine learning models from performing tasks. The processor set modifies the portion of data from the dataset to form an updated dataset. The portion of data from the dataset is not used for the model learning for the number of machine learning models.

title: Electronic device and method for controlling electronic device
abstract: An electronic device includes: a processor; and a memory storing a program which, when executed by the processor, causes the electronic device to: switch between a first screen that displays a VR image individually and a second screen that displays a plurality of images including the VR image; and control a change in a display area of the VR image, wherein on the first screen, the display area of the VR image is changed based on a predetermined operation for changing the display area of the VR image, and on the second screen, the display area of the VR image is not changed based on the predetermined operation.

title: Apparatus and method for securing web application server source code
abstract: Systems, related methods and other means for providing the securing of web site source code are provided herein. The system and methods poll a client device and/or determine whether a debugging console is active on a client device and deny access to the source code if and while the debugging console is active. Additionally or alternatively, the system and methods may receive a request to access the source code form a client device, and may determine whether the request is from a trusted referrer and whether and while the debugging console is active. When the request is from an untrusted referrer, and/or when the debugging console is active the system and method can deny access to the source code.

title: Method for cleaning high-pressure gas container
abstract: A method for cleaning a high-pressure gas container includes a depressurization step of reducing the pressure in a high-pressure gas container until the internal pressure reaches 5 Pa or less and a cleaning step of cleaning the inside of the high-pressure gas container after the depressurization step. The cleaning step includes a hydrogen halide supply stage of supplying a hydrogen halide to the high-pressure gas container after the depressurization step, a metal oxide removal stage of reacting, in the high-pressure gas container after the hydrogen halide supply stage, a metal oxide on the inner face of the high-pressure gas container with the hydrogen halide supplied in the hydrogen halide supply stage to form water, and a discharge stage of discharging the water formed in the metal oxide removal stage and the hydrogen halide supplied in the hydrogen halide supply stage from the high-pressure gas container.

title: Additive manufacturing of multilayered structures
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices relating to an additively manufactured multilayered structure. The additively manufactured multilayered structure may be provided by unspooling a material roll of laminate material using a roller system. A welding device may be used to apply welds between layers of the laminate material to distribute a loading between the layers during use.

title: Manufacturable diffractive structures with smoothly varying properties
abstract: A waveguide includes a first region with a plurality of first diffractive structures and a second region with a plurality of second diffractive structures. The first and second diffractive structures have first and second values of a first physical property giving rise to a first and second values of an optical property in the respective regions. The waveguide also includes at least one interstitial region located between the first region and the second region, with a plurality of interstitial diffractive structures. Each interstitial diffractive structure has a value of at least one additional physical property giving rise to an intermediate value of the optical property in the at least one interstitial region that is between the first value and the second value of the optical property.

title: Temperature compensation for dynamic wordline start voltage in a memory device
abstract: A memory device includes a memory array with a plurality of blocks and control logic to receive a request to perform a program operation on the memory array, determine an operating temperature of the memory device, modify a previously determined calibrated wordline start voltage based on the operating temperature to form a modified start voltage, and cause the modified start voltage to be applied to the memory array during the program operation.

title: Etching method and plasma processing apparatus
abstract: An etching method includes: (a) providing a substrate including a base film and a mask having an opening and formed on the base film; (b) etching the base film using plasma; and (c) supplying hydrogen fluoride to the substrate under a pressure of 13.3 Pa or higher.

title: Fuel tank system
abstract: A fuel system is disclosed. The fuel system includes a tank defining an interior volume, the tank having a neck with an opening in the neck through which the interior volume is accessible. The fuel system also includes a direct fill assembly inserted into the neck of the tank, the direct fill assembly having an upper end and a lower end, wherein the direct fill assembly includes a first venting channel and a second venting channel, the first venting channel extending between the lower end and the upper end and venting gas accumulating proximate to the lower end, the second venting channel connected to an internal venting conduit that extends through the interior volume of the tank and provides venting from a distal end of the internal venting conduit.

title: Semiconductor package and methods for forming the same
abstract: A semiconductor package including a lid having a “pre-buckled” configuration. The lid includes a sidewall portion attached to a package substrate and laterally surrounding a package structure including semiconductor die(s), a central portion in thermal contact with the package structure, and a plurality of connecting arms extending between the sidewall portion and the central portion of the lid. The central portion is vertically recessed relative to the sidewall portion and the connecting arms extend in an oblique vertically downward direction between the sidewall portion and the central portion of the lid. Accordingly, during high-temperature conditions, thermal expansion of the connecting arms occurs along a vertically downward direction to displace the central portion towards the package structure. Effective thermal contact between the lid and the package structure may thereby be maintained during high-temperature conditions.

title: Rotating rack assembly
abstract: A dishwasher rack is able to rotate with respect to the dishwasher to permit access to all areas of the dishwasher rack from one side of the dishwasher. A skid plate is positioned between the dishwasher rack and a mounting frame to prevent the tines of the dishwasher rack from contacting the tines of the mounting frame. A rotatable member can be used between the dishwasher rack and the mounting frame. The rotatable member has an inner race, an outer race, and a ball bearing assembly positioned between the races. A handle can be coupled to the dishwasher rack.

title: Intravascular Lithoplasty System With Improved Durability, Efficiency and Pressure Output Variability
abstract: A catheter and segmented balloon system for an intravascular lithotripsy system having improved accommodation for curved configurations to prevent damage to the balloon during electrical arcing of electrode pairs. The catheter can include an elongate member with alternating flexibility regions wherein stiffer regions are configured to support at least one spaced-apart electrode pair, and wherein more flexible regions are disposed on either side of each stiffer region. This configuration allows the elongate member to curve more easily in the region of the electrodes, which are located within a balloon, or segmented balloon system. The balloon can include balloon segments with interposed sections between each of the segmented balloons wherein the outer diameter of an inflated balloon segment is larger than the outer diameter of the interposed section.

title: Distinguishing headland and in-field passes to generate a path plan of a machine
abstract: Obtaining positions of an agricultural machine along a path of travel of the agricultural machine within a field. Determining whether each of the positions is a headland position or an in-field position based upon whether each of the positions is located within a headland of the field. Identifying passes of the agricultural machine within the field along the path of travel. Determining whether each of the passes is a headland pass or an in-field pass based upon the headland positions and the in-field positions. Deriving a map based upon the passes. The map includes the passes and each of the passes is identified as a headland pass or an in-field pass.

title: Interconnect isolation system and method for isolating interconnect
abstract: An interconnect isolation system includes a shared memory, at least one processing circuit, and an interconnect. The at least one processing circuit is arranged to execute a plurality of virtual machines (VMs). The interconnect is shared by the plurality of VMs, and includes at least one interconnect node and a timeout detector. The at least one interconnect node includes at least one transmission circuit, wherein each of the at least one transmission circuit comprises a plurality of virtual links, the plurality of VMs are mapped to the plurality of virtual links, and each of the plurality of VMs transmits a transaction to the shared memory through a mapped virtual link. The timeout detector is arranged to generate a trigger signal according to timeout information, wherein the timeout information indicates one of the plurality of virtual links is at an error state.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor member includes a first semiconductor region, a second semiconductor region, and a third semiconductor region aligned from a first side to a second side. The first semiconductor region is electrically connected to a source electrode. At least a part of the second semiconductor region faces a gate electrode in a second direction perpendicular to a first direction. The first semiconductor region has a plurality of first divisions and a plurality of second divisions when seen in the first direction. The first divisions are provided from a surface to a position of a first depth. The second divisions are provided from the surface to a position of a second depth greater than the first depth. The second semiconductor region is provided from lower ends of the first divisions and lower ends of the second divisions to a position of a third depth.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba; Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation

title: Image forming apparatus, setting assistance method and computer-readable recording medium encoded with setting assistance program
abstract: An image forming apparatus includes a hardware processor, wherein the hardware processor sets a type of a recording medium, detects the type of a recording medium on which an image is to be formed, determines, in a first mode, an image formation condition based on the set type, and determines, in a second mode, the image forming condition based on the detected type, sets a work mode to either the first mode or the second mode, and in a case of, with the first mode being set, a specific state where the set type is different from the detected type, prompts switching of the work mode.

title: Sensor With Long-Term Stability
abstract: Various embodiments of the teachings herein include a sensor for estimating an oxygen concentration. An example includes: a reference terminal; a pump and sense terminal; a first sensor disk; a boundary member including a second sensor disk; one or more spacers; a heater; a pair of electric terminals galvanically connected to the heater; a temperature sensing element and a plurality of electric terminals connected to the temperature sensing element; an electric supply connected to the heater via the pair of electric terminals; and an electric circuit connected to the temperature sensing element via the plurality of electric terminals. The boundary member, the one or more spacers, and the reference terminal enclose a sealed chamber. The boundary member is interposed between the heater and the sealed chamber. The electric circuit is galvanically isolated from the electric supply.

title: Sealing Device and Method for the Production Thereof and Pipeline System
abstract: A sealing device for sealing a pipeline arrangement, a method for the production of a sealing device, and a pipeline system including a sealing device and a pipeline arrangement. The sealing device includes a seal and a data medium assigned to the seal with electronic data memory to which seal-specific information can be or is written.

title: Lighting device for a motor vehicle
abstract: A lighting device for a motor vehicle is provided. The lighting device includes a light source and a planar light guide having two large surfaces opposite one another and a plurality of narrow end faces. The light guide has an entry surface that is formed on one of the end faces, and first and second exit surfaces that are formed on the large surfaces and lie opposite one another. The lighting device further includes a first optical component configured to be reflective. Light generated by the light source enters the light guide at through the entry surface, exits at least partially from the first exit surface, is at least partially reflected by the first optical component, the reflected light re-enters the light guide at least partially through the first exit surface, and the light that has re-entered the light guide exits at least partially from the second exit surface.

title: Isolating garbage collection read operations in a memory sub-system
abstract: A system comprises a plurality of memory devices. A processing device is coupled to the plurality of memory devices. The processing device retrieves a physical-to-logical (P2L) replay output from a P2L replay operation wherein the P2L replay output corresponds to a memory device of the plurality of memory devices. The processing device inserts the P2L replay output into a queue of a plurality of queues, wherein the queue corresponds to the memory device, and wherein each queue corresponds to one of the plurality of memory devices. The processing device determines whether the plurality of queues satisfies a P2L replay output aggregation threshold criterion. Responsive to determining that the plurality of queues satisfies the P2L replay output aggregation threshold criterion, the processing device selects an inactive memory device of the plurality of memory devices. The processing device performs a media management read operation on the selected inactive memory device.

title: Sound-absorbing acoustic panel
abstract: Acoustic panel, comprising a layer comprising wood wool and at least one binding agent, and a liner comprising a nonwoven based on glass fiber, characterized in that the nonwoven based on glass fibers has an airflow resistivity σ (ISO 9053-1:2018) of at least 5.00·10 5  Pa-s/m 2

title: Display substrate, preparation method therefor, and display apparatus
abstract: Proposed are a display substrate and a preparation method therefor, and a display apparatus. The display substrate includes a drive circuit layer disposed on a substrate and a light emitting structure layer disposed at a side of the drive circuit layer away from the substrate, the drive circuit layer includes a plurality of circuit units, the light emitting structure layer includes a plurality of light emitting devices; at least one circuit unit includes a first power supply line, an initial signal line including a first initial signal line extending in a first direction and a second initial signal line extending in a second direction, and a pixel drive circuit; the first direction intersects the second direction, and an orthographic projection of the second initial signal line on the substrate overlaps at least partially with an orthographic projection of the first power supply line on the substrate.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Devices and methods for frequency hopping for prach repetition
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to devices, methods, and a non-transitory computer readable medium for frequency hopping of PRACH repetition. A terminal device receives, via a transceiver, a configuration for Physical Random Access Channel (PRACH) repetition. The terminal device performs a frequency hopping operation of the PRACH repetition for each of Synchronization Signal and Physical Broadcast Channel Block (SSB) to Random Access Channel Occasion (RO) mapping units based on the configuration, wherein each of the SSB to RO mapping units comprises at least one SSB to RO mapping cycle including a set of ROs associated with SSBs. In this way, ROs for the PRACH repetition are configured in different frequency positions, and thus the detection performance of a signal transmitted with PRACH repetition is improved.

title: Semiconductor device, electronic device, and vehicle
abstract: A semiconductor device includes: an output transistor configured to have a control terminal; a protection circuit configured to limit a terminal-to-terminal voltage across the output transistor; a delay circuit configured to generate a delayed trigger according to whether the terminal-to-terminal voltage across the output transistor is higher than a predetermined threshold voltage; and a controller configured to modulate an on resistance of the output transistor at a timing of the delayed trigger relative to a transition of an electrical state of the output transistor.

title: Valve apparatus
abstract: A valve including a movable poppet positioned within a valve cartridge and having valve member that is configured to contact a valve seat. A first diaphragm is provided between a first portion of the movable poppet and a first retainer ring, and a second diaphragm provided between a second portion of the movable poppet and a second retainer ring, wherein a fluid flow path that connects an inlet port and an outlet port of the valve cartridge is provided between the first diaphragm and the second diaphragm, and wherein bearing surfaces of the movable poppet that orient the movable poppet relative to the valve cartridge are positioned outside of the fluid flow path such that the bearing surfaces are not exposed to a fluid in the fluid flow path.

title: Wallet
abstract: A wallet includes a first shell with one or more openings on a shell perimeter adapted to clip one or more objects to the one or more openings; and a second shell coupled to the first shell, the second shell including a storage compartment; and first and second rails on each side of the second metal shell to slideably receive one or more cards in the storage compartment.

title: Supporting leg assembly, supporting leg telescopic mechanism and carrier
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a supporting leg assembly, which includes: an indicator, disposed at the indicating end and capable of moving between a first position and a second position, so as to indicate whether the supporting leg contacts a surface; a driving element, movably disposed in the contacting end; a traction element, including a first end of the traction element connected to the indicator and a second end of the traction element connected to the contacting end; a holding sleeve, sleeved on the traction element and prevents at least a part of the traction element from bending; when the contacting end contacts the surface, the driving element driving the traction element to slide relative to the holding sleeve, and the traction element further driving the indicator. The present disclosure also discloses a supporting leg and a carrier.

title: Binder for nonaqueous secondary battery electrode, binder composition for nonaqueous secondary battery electrode, slurry for nonaqueous secondary battery electrode, nonaqueous secondary battery electrode, and nonaqueous secondary battery
abstract: Provided is a binder for a nonaqueous secondary battery electrode in which a copolymer having 4.0 to 75.0 mol % of a structural unit derived from a monomer represented by Formula (I) (R 1  represents a hydrogen atom or a methyl group, R 2  represents a hydrogen atom or a hydroxy group, and m and n each represent 0 or 1), and 25.0 to 96.0 mol % of a structural unit derived from a monomer represented by Formula (II) (R 3  represents a hydrogen atom, a methyl group, or CH 2 COOX 2 , and X 1  and X 2  each represent a hydrogen atom, an alkali metal, or NH 4 ) is contained.

title: Carousel machine for a treatment station
abstract: Provided are a carousel machine and methods for creating a vacuum in a container that is to be treated by the carousel machine. The machine includes at least one treatment station having at least one evacuation volume and a plurality of pressure sources. The evacuation volume is placed, successively and for a predetermined duration, in fluidic communication with each pressure source via at least one associated pipe associated with each pressure source and an airtight rotary coupling. The pressure in the evacuation volume is progressively reduced by establishing successive fluidic communications. The predetermined duration of fluidic communication between the evacuation volume and at least one associated pipe is substantially less than or is equal to the time taken for equilibrium between the pressure in the evacuation volume and the pressure in the associated pipe to become established.

title: Method and apparatus for extended local area data network information management in mobile communications
abstract: Various solutions for extended local area data network (LADN) information management with respect to user equipment in mobile communications are described. An apparatus may receive a message including an extended LADN information from a network node. The extended LADN information may be associated with at least one network slicing information. The apparatus may store the extended LADN information carried by the received message. The apparatus may delete the extended LADN information in an event that the apparatus moves to a deregistered state.

title: Controller for an Autonomous Emergency Braking System, and Method for Controlling an Autonomous Emergency Braking System
abstract: A controller for an autonomous emergency braking system that is configured to receive, while an automated emergency braking operation is performed, information about an actuation of an accelerator pedal of the vehicle; to determine, on the basis of the information, whether the actuation of the accelerator pedal satisfies a termination criterion; and to terminate the emergency braking operation if the actuation of the accelerator pedal satisfies a termination criterion. In the process, a first termination criterion is used as termination criterion if a speed limiter of the vehicle is not active. However, if the speed limiter is active, a second termination criterion is used which differs from the a first termination criterion.

title: Backpack
abstract: A backpack can include a left shoulder strap and a right shoulder strap; a front panel; a back panel; vertical side assemblies that support the front panel and the back panel; a horizontal panel disposed between the vertical side assemblies to define an upper compartment and a lower compartment, where the horizontal panel includes a nose portion, a shelf portion, and a top flap coupled to the shelf portion by a hinge; and a sleeve disposed in the lower compartment, where the sleeve includes an upper opening accessible via hinged movement of the top flap of the horizontal panel.
assignee: Yasmin Elrada Dakhlallah; Dalia Jamal El-Mokadem

title: Delivery tote with lid
abstract: A nestable tote includes a base with product retention features protruding from an upper surface to define recesses for retaining items, such as jars, without interfering with nesting of identical totes. Variations include ribs, cross-ribs, segmented ribs, flexible straps, interlocking dividers, or grids with diamond intersections. A system includes the tote and a lid with a recess for stacking, configured to center the tote on an ASRS tray to prevent misalignment. Another system includes a pallet assembly with a top deck having recesses to securely receive totes or lidded totes, enabling multi-layer stacking. A method involves placing totes in the pallet recesses and transporting via pallet handling equipment.

title: Systems and methods for notifying a user when activity exceeds an authorization level
abstract:
Systems and methods for generating a notification when activity exceeds an authorization level are provided. A determination is made as to whether content currently being presented to a first user exceeds an authorization level associated with the first user. 
     In response to determining that the content exceeds the authorization level, the content being presented is monitored to determine whether the content meets a criterion. An amount of time the content being presented meets the criterion is measured. In response to determining that the amount of time exceeds a threshold, a communication is transmitted to a second user indicating that the content currently being presented to the first user exceeds the authorization level.

title: Hydrogen sulfide detecting agent
abstract: A hydrogen sulfide detecting agent includes a polymer material that is a base, a coloring agent configured to develop a color by contact with hydrogen sulfide, and a color development accelerator configured to accelerate color development of the coloring agent.

title: Graph-based models with interface nodes
abstract: An overlay system is provided that includes a storage element and processing circuitry coupled thereto. The storage element stores an executable graph-based model having a plurality of active nodes, a plurality of interface nodes, and a plurality of overlay nodes. Each overlay node extends functionality of at least one interface node that defines a reusable structure for two or more active nodes. The processing circuitry receives a stimulus and identifies a first plurality of active nodes. The processing circuitry determines, based on the first plurality of active nodes, a first interface node defining a reusable structure for the first plurality of active nodes. The processing circuitry determines a first overlay node associated with the first interface node. The processing circuitry executes an operation associated with the stimulus based on the first plurality of active nodes, the first interface node, and the first overlay node.

title: A consumable and a non-combustible aerosol provision system
abstract: A consumable for use with an aerosol provision device. The consumable comprises an open airflow channel that extends between open ends of the consumable and an aerosol generating section configured to generate an aerosol in at least a portion of the open airflow channel during use. The pressure drop across the consumable is greater than about 50 mmWg at a volumetric flow rate of about 17.5 ml/s. Also disclosed is a non-combustible aerosol provision system comprising such a consumable.

title: Electrode plate detection method and system
abstract: An electrode plate detection method and a system, applied to a camera system are described. The method includess: obtaining, before an electrode plate is wound, a first image of a first surface of the electrode plate and a second image of a second surface of the electrode plate acquired by an image acquisition element; determining, according to the first image, a dimensional parameter of a detection target on the first surface in the electrode plate, and determining, according to the second image, a dimensional parameter of a detection target on the second surface in the electrode plate, where the detection target at least comprises a calibration block corresponding to the electrode plate, and the calibration block is configured to determine whether the image acquisition element is offset; and determining, based on the dimensional parameters of the first surface and the second surface, a detection result of the electrode plate.

title: Method and apparatus for reporting time information of conditional handover (cho)
abstract: Embodiments of the present application are directed to a method and apparatus for reporting time information of conditional handover (CHO). In an embodiment of the present application, the method includes: receiving configuration information on CHO, and transmitting time information of CHO in response to at least one failure that occurs during a CHO procedure.

title: Trifunctional constructs with tunable pharmacokinetics useful in imaging and anti-tumor therapies
abstract:
The present technology provides compounds, as well as compositions including such compounds, useful for imaging and/or treatment of a glioma, a breast cancer, an adrenal cortical cancer, a cervical carcinoma, a vulvar carcinoma, an endometrial carcinoma, a primary ovarian carcinoma, a metastatic ovarian carcinoma, a non-small cell lung cancer, a small cell lung cancer, a bladder cancer, a colon cancer, a primary, gastric adenocarcinoma, a primary colorectal adenocarcinoma, a renal cell carcinoma, and/or a prostate cancer. The compounds are represented by the following formula

title: Semiconductor package and method for manufacturing the same
abstract: A semiconductor package according to embodiments includes a first semiconductor die and a second semiconductor die on the first semiconductor die, the first semiconductor die comprising: a first die base; a first bonding dielectric layer on a back side of the first die base; a plurality of first key patterns penetrating the first bonding dielectric layer; and a plurality of second key patterns penetrating the first bonding dielectric layer, each second key pattern surrounding a corresponding first key pattern of the plurality of first key patterns, the second semiconductor die comprising: a second die base; a second bonding dielectric layer disposed on a front side of the second die base and bonded to the first bonding dielectric layer; a plurality of third key patterns penetrating the second bonding dielectric layer, each third key pattern bonding to a corresponding first key pattern of the plurality of first key patterns; and a plurality of fourth key patterns penetrating the second bonding dielectric layer, each fourth key pattern surrounding a corresponding third key pattern of the plurality of third key patterns and bonding to a corresponding second key pattern of the plurality of second key patterns, wherein: each of the plurality of first key patterns has a first width in a horizontal direction, each of the plurality of second key patterns has a second width in the horizontal direction, each of the plurality of third key patterns has a third width in the horizontal direction, each of the plurality of fourth key patterns has a fourth width in the horizontal direction, the first width is smaller than the third width, and the second width is larger than the fourth width.

title: Nlrp3 modulators
abstract: Described herein are NLRP3 modulators and methods of utilizing NLRP3 modulators in the treatment of diseases, disorders or conditions. Also described herein are pharmaceutical compositions containing such compounds.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: According to one embodiment, a semiconductor device includes: a substrate; a first transistor and a second transistor provided in the substrate; a first wiring provided in the substrate and contacting each of a source electrode of the first transistor and a source electrode of the second transistor; and a photocoupler provided on an upper surface of the substrate and configured to control states of the first transistor and the second transistor.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba; Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation

title: Portable Air Compressor
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for a portable air compressor comprising an electric battery, an electric motor, a piston, and an air hose. The electric motor is powered by the electric battery. The piston is coupled to and driven by the electric motor. The piston is configured to compress air within a piston cylinder. The air hose has a first end attachable to an air outlet of the piston cylinder and a second end attachable to an inflatable object. The portable air pump is configured to inflate the inflatable object to a target air pressure. When the target air pressure is below a predetermined pressure threshold, the portable air pump inflates the inflatable object at a first inflation rate. When the target air pressure is above the predetermined pressure threshold, the portable air pump inflates the inflatable object at a second inflation rate greater than the first inflation rate.

title: Plugging device deployment in subterranean wells
abstract: A method of deploying plugging devices into a subterranean well can include conveying a bottom hole assembly into the well, the bottom hole assembly including a plug deployment tool, and actuating the plug deployment tool, thereby gradually dispensing the plugging devices from an interior of the plug deployment tool into the well. The plugging devices may be dispensed from the plug deployment tool all at once, or in discrete intervals.

title: Exercise device
abstract: An exercise machine may include a frame, a resistance mechanism supported by the frame, first and second pull cables supported by the frame and linked to the resistance mechanism, a power rack attached to the frame, first and second handles selectively attachable to the first and second pull cable, and first and second pulleys. The power rack includes upright posts configured to have barbell holders adjustably attached thereto such that the barbell holders are configured to be adjusted in various positions between highest positions and lowest positions on the upright posts. The pulleys are configured to selectively receive the pull cables to enable the pull cables to be selectively attached to a barbell to assist or hinder a user in lifting the barbell in a combined cable and free weight workout, the pull cables decoupled from the pulleys for cable workouts.

title: Lubricating oil composition
abstract: This invention provides a lubricating oil composition comprising at least 80 wt %, based on the overall weight of the lubricating oil composition, of base oil, wherein the base oil is selected from Group II, Group III and Fischer-Tropsch derived base oils and mixtures thereof, one or more additives, other than citric acid, selected from the group consisting of anti-wear additives, rust and corrosion inhibitors, dispersants, extreme pressure additives, friction modifiers, viscosity index improvers, pour point depressants, anti-oxidants, and one or more of citric acid and a derivative thereof.

title: Method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: A method of manufacturing a semiconductor device is provided. A laminated stack of alternately stacked mold sacrificial layers and single crystal semiconductor layers is formed on an interface area of a substrate having a cell array area. First holes are formed through a cover insulating layer, and the mold sacrificial layers are removed to create first gaps. A first liner surrounds the single crystal semiconductor layers, and a second liner fills the first gaps. A gap fill insulating layer is formed, second holes are opened, and portions of the liners and single crystal semiconductor layers facing the holes are removed. A pad layer is formed at the removal location, and the second holes are filled with insulating material. The pad layer has a step-like structure parallel to the substrate surface, a constant width in a perpendicular direction, and is connected to a word line in the cell array area.

title: Prediction Method for Hot Working Condition and Non-Transitory Computer Readable Medium
abstract:
The object of the present invention is to provide a prediction method capable of highly accurately predicting a hot working condition under which cracks occur and suppressing the occurrence of cracks in actual hot working. 
     Provided is a prediction method for a hot working condition for predicting a hot working condition of a material subjected to hot working having a decarburization layer on a surface layer, comprising: a hot working property acquisition process of acquiring a hot working property at a part of a two-phase region of ferrite+austenite in the decarburization layer formed on the surface layer of the material subjected to hot working; a first analysis process of performing a plastic deformation analysis by simulation using the acquired hot working property as an input value and deriving a fracture threshold; a second analysis process of performing a plastic working analysis by simulation simulating actual hot working and deriving a fracture parameter corresponding to an amount of deformation of a material subjected to hot working; and a working condition derivation process of deriving a working condition threshold at a time of performing hot working in an actual machine based on the fracture threshold and the fracture parameter.

title: Valve operating system
abstract: A valve operating system includes a rocker arm that converts rotational motion of a camshaft into motion in the opening/closing direction, a shaft member having an end portion in an axial direction that pushes an intake/exhaust valve and a central portion in the axial direction connected to an action point side of the rocker arm, a magnet that is provided at the other end portion of the shaft member in the axial direction, a magnetic member that is provided at a position so as to cover at least a part of the magnet when the intake/exhaust valve is closed, the magnetic member having a coil wound therearound, and a control device that controls a current corresponding to a rotational speed of the engine to flow through the coil.

title: Method for characterizing cells
abstract: The disclosure provides methods for characterizing cells. The methods of the disclosure comprise combining the cells with a growth media to form a sample mixture, partitioning the sample mixture into a plurality of volume partitions, arranging the plurality of volume partitions on at least one array, incubating the volume partitions, monitoring the neighboring volume partitions for one or more characteristics, and thereby characterizing the cells in the sample.

title: Using Magnetic-Sensor Data to Correct for INS Drift
abstract: In one embodiment, a method includes accessing a magnetic-field map of a region, wherein the magnetic-field map comprises a plurality of map points that correspond to locations in the region and are associated with magnetic-field values corresponding to the locations in the region. The method also includes accessing a trajectory comprising a plurality of trajectory points that correspond to a path and are associated with magnetic-field values measured along the path. The method further includes comparing the magnetic-field values associated with the trajectory points with the magnetic-field values associated with the map points, identifying one or more of the trajectory points that approximately magnetically coincide with one or more of the map points, adjusting one or more of the trajectory points to be approximately colocated with one or more of the map points, and incorporating the trajectory points and the magnetic-field values associated with them as adjusted into the magnetic-field map. One or more computer-readable non-transitory storage media may embody software that is operable when executed to perform the method. A system may include one or more processors and one or more computer-readable non-transitory storage media coupled to one or more of the processors and comprising instructions operable when executed by one or more of the processors to cause the system to perform the method.

title: Thermal barrier coating for edge component
abstract: A ceramic matric composite (CMC) component for a gas turbine engine, such as blade outer air seal (BOAS), may be shielded from thermal stress. The CMC component includes a first surface configured for exposure to a hot gas stream, a second surface configured for exposure to a cold gas stream, an edge surface of the CMC component disposed between and connecting the first and second surfaces. At least one coating layer is disposed on the first surface and wrapped over the edge surface and the second surface, wherein the at least one coating layer disposed on the second surface has a lower thermal conductivity than the CMC component so as to reduce a thermal gradient between the cooled first surface and the heated second surface.

title: Assembly for replacing the tricuspid atrioventricular valve
abstract: An assembly for the tricuspid orifice of a human heart has an external frame connected to an internal stent carrying a tricuspid valve bioprosthesis and a sealing skirt. The external frame is configured to hold its position in the native tricuspid annulus. The internal stent is connected to the external frame by one or more fixing strands. The sealing skirt covers the interstitial space existing between the external frame and the internal stent. Developments are described which include the use of a deformable region of the frame, various alternative embodiments of the sealing skirt, the use of a frame composed of multiple sub-sections, the use of fixing strands between the stent and the frame and of fixing elements for fixing the assembly to the native tissue, the use of sensors and/or actuators, and also the use of a stent in the inferior vena cava. Method aspects are also described.

title: Anisotropic graphite composite and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: An object is to provide an anisotropic graphite composite having superior heat transfer efficiency. The object is attained by an anisotropic graphite composite ( 100 ) in which (a) anisotropic graphite ( 10 ) having graphite layers whose respective crystal orientation planes ( 11 ) are parallel to an X-Y plane, and a (b) bonding layer ( 20 ) containing a metal and/or a resin are alternately stacked in a Z-axis direction, and are bonded to each other, the composite ( 100 ) having a thermal resistance value of not more than 10 mm 2 K/W measured on a surface parallel to an X-Z plane or a Y-Z plane.

title: Methods and apparatus for beam management in mobile communications
abstract: Various solutions for beam management with respect to user equipment and network node in mobile communications are described. An apparatus may receive at least one reference signal from a network node. The apparatus may transmit a beam report to the network node. The beam report may indicate at least one beam which has been synchronized by the apparatus.

title: Shoe Component, Cushion Member, and Method of Making Same
abstract: A shoe component with a composition comprising: thermoplastic polyester elastomer (TPEE), styrene ethylene butylene styrene (SEBS), hydrogenated active resin, metallocene polyethylene, polyol-based styrene block copolymers, and ethylene vinyl acetate (EVA) copolymer.

title: Image and video coding and decoding
abstract: Improvements to the processing of partitioning data for image and video data are described. A Image data is encoded or decoded into or from a bitstream. The bitstream includes data indicating a partitioning of the image data into a plurality of blocks according to a coding tree, wherein blocks in the coding tree may be partitioned according to one or more types of split. For a current block to be decoded, a parameter indicating a maximum partitioning depth of at least one split type is obtained using at least one other parameter associated with the image data.

title: Wound treatment composition
abstract: The present disclosure provides a composition for a treatment for a wound, and the like. N-({2-[4-(difluoromethoxy)-3-(propan-2-yloxy)phenyl]-1,3-oxazol-4-yl}methyl)-2-ethoxybenzamide or its salt is useful as an active ingredient of a composition for a treatment for a wound.

title: Lightweight flood panel and flood barrier system using same
abstract: A lightweight flood panel includes a frame defining a central void, a lightweight core (e.g., hexagonal cell honeycomb or fiber-reinforced closed cell foam) disposed in the void, and fiberglass sides covering the assembly. The frame provides perimeter support and includes holes for fastening units. A method of manufacture involves adhesively assembling the components under vacuum. A flood barrier system uses multiple such panels secured in series with gaskets and fastening units, each fastening unit including a bolt, adjustment knob, washer, and rivet nut or anchor for water-tight installation across gaps between structures to resist hydrostatic pressure and impacts.

title: Waste material discharge device for 3d printer and 3d printer
abstract: A waste material discharge device includes a material bin, a trigger connecting rod, and a material blocking plate, and a cavity is formed in the material bin, a material inlet and a material outlet are formed in the material bin, the material inlet, the cavity, and the material outlet are sequentially communicated to form a material discharge channel, the material inlet is used for the entry of waste materials of a 3D printer, and the material outlet is configured to communicate with an outside of the  3 D printer to enable the waste materials to be discharged to the outside of the  3 D printer along the material discharge channel. A first end of the trigger connecting rod rotates under the push of a printing head, when the trigger connecting rod rotates, a second end thereof pushes the material blocking plate in the material bin to rotate.

title: Positive electrode active material, positive electrode, and secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material includes first lithium composite oxide particles in a single particle form, and second lithium composite oxide particles in a secondary particle form. In a volume-based particle size distribution obtained by laser diffraction/scattering, when the particle diameter at which the cumulative frequency becomes 10% is 10% particle diameter (D10), the particle diameter at which the cumulative frequency becomes 50% is 50% particle diameter (D50), and the particle diameter at which the cumulative frequency becomes 90% is 90% particle diameter (D90), then the 50% particle diameter (D50) of the first lithium composite oxide particles is smaller than the 50% particle diameter (D50) of the second lithium composite oxide particles and a particle size distribution width expressed by (D90−D10)/D50 of the first lithium composite oxide particles is 1.20 or less. The particle breaking strength of the second lithium composite oxide particles is 200 MPa or less.

title: Lens device and imaging apparatus
abstract: The lens device includes an optical system, a support member that supports the optical system, a movable member that is disposed along an outer periphery of the support member and that is movably supported with respect to the support member, and an engagement mechanism that engages with the movable member, in which the engagement mechanism is inclined with respect to a direction of an optical axis.

title: Secured intelligent identity verification through blockchain
abstract: The following generally relates to distributed ledger and artificial intelligence (AI) technology, and more particularly relates to identity verification through distributed ledger and/or AI technology. In some embodiments, one or more processors: receive, from a user device of a user, user-provided identity information; scrape, from a website, data of the user; add the scraped data of the user to a distributed ledger; and attempt to authenticate the user by inputting, into a smart contract stored on the distributed ledger: (i) the user-provided identity information, and (ii) the scraped data of the user added to the distributed ledger.
assignee: Teachers Insurance And Annuity Association Of America

title: Methods and systems for generating virtual content display with a virtual or augmented reality apparatus
abstract: Several unique configurations for interferometric recording of volumetric phase diffractive elements with relatively high angle diffraction for use in waveguides are disclosed. Separate layer EPE and OPE structures produced by various methods may be integrated in side-by-side or overlaid constructs, and multiple such EPE and OPE structures may be combined or multiplexed to exhibit EPE/OPE functionality in a single, spatially-coincident layer. Multiplexed structures reduce the total number of layers of materials within a stack of eyepiece optics, each of which may be responsible for displaying a given focal depth range of a volumetric image. Volumetric phase type diffractive elements are used to offer properties including spectral bandwidth selectivity that may enable registered multi-color diffracted fields, angular multiplexing capability to facilitate tiling and field-of-view expansion without crosstalk, and all-optical, relatively simple prototyping compared to other diffractive element forms, enabling rapid design iteration.

title: Wireless connection method which can simplify screen mirroring procedure
abstract: A wireless connection method, applied to a wireless communication system comprising a first host device, comprising: (a) detecting if a first dongle is plugged into a first device by the first dongle; (b) connecting the first dongle with the first host device, to establish a first wireless connection between the first device and the first host device; and (c) automatically receiving connection information of a second wireless connection from the first host device via the first wireless connection and automatically providing the connection information to the first device, by the first dongle. By using the disclosed methods, screen mirroring steps can be simplified and only dongles which have simple architectures are needed. Accordingly, the hardware cost can also be reduced.

title: Automated property inspection system with multimodal data processing and semantic defect clustering
abstract: A property intelligence system includes a data collection module configured to gather property data from sensors and external databases. The system includes a unified viewfinder configured to simultaneously capture voice data, optical character recognition data, and visual data during property inspection. The system includes a quad-track multimodal processing architecture configured to process captured data through parallel processing tracks, including a system detection track to identify property components and a defect indicators track to detect anomalies and damage. The system includes an automated visual annotation engine configured to generate annotated evidence by burning graphical overlays into pixels of presentation copies using bounding box coordinates. The system includes a semantic ownership resolver configured to route detected defects to correct locations within a hierarchical schema. The system includes a reporting module configured to generate automated inspection reports.
