assignee: Iowa State University Research Foundation, Inc.

title: Clock transmission device and operation method thereof
abstract: A clock transmission device and an operation method thereof are provided. The clock transmission device may be applied to a three-dimensional NAND flash memory with high capacity and high performance. The clock transmission device includes a clock transmission circuit and a jitter suppression circuit. The clock transmission circuit generates an output clock based on an input clock. The jitter suppression circuit supplies a power current to the clock transmission circuit based on a power voltage. The jitter suppression circuit adaptively adjusts the power current in response to a power supply noise of the power voltage to suppress the power noise induced jitter of the output clock.

title: Methods and apparatuses for encoding and decoding an image or a video
abstract: A method and an apparatus for encoding or decoding an image or a video are provided. Responsive to a determination that an image block is encoded using an intra block copy coding mode, a block predictor is determined for the image block based on one or more candidate block vector predictors, wherein the one or more candidate block vector predictors comprises at least one candidate block vector predictor determined using an intra template matching coding mode. The image block is encoded or decoded using the determined block predictor.

title: Electrolyte, sodium secondary battery, and electric apparatus
abstract: An electrolyte, a sodium secondary battery, and an electric apparatus. The electrolyte includes a first additive, a second additive, and a third additive, where the first additive includes a cyclic ester compound containing a sulfate group and/or a sulfite group, the second additive includes difluoro(oxalato)borate, and the third additive includes a fluorinated cyclic carbonate compound.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device includes, in a display area: a plurality of light-emitting elements; a plurality of pixel circuits; and connection wires. The connection wires include a plurality of partial wires formed in mutually different layers via a first organic insulation film of an organic insulating material. The first organic insulation film and a partial wire including the plurality of partial wires are alternately stacked to provide a multilayered structural portion. A second organic insulation film of an organic insulating material is provided on the multilayered structural portion. The display device further includes, in a frame area: a wall body configured to form a groove-shaped depression; and a first wiring line and a second wiring line exposed on a bottom of the depression. The wall body is made of a same material, and provided in a same layer, as the second organic insulation film.

title: Systems, methods, and devices for access control
abstract: An access control system may include a reader configured to receive credential data from a credential using a non-NFC communication protocol when the credential is within a first distance of the reader; verify that the credential is valid based on the credential data; provide the credential with a first access token using the non-NFC communication protocol; and receive, using the non-NFC communication protocol, a command from the credential corresponding to an access control decision for the credential based on a comparison of the first access token with a second access token. The system may also include an NFC tag configured to provide the credential with the second access token using an NFC protocol when the credential is within a second distance of the NFC tag, the second distance shorter than the first distance.

title: Lidar and Vehicle
abstract: A first housing and a second housing of a lidar of a vehicle define an enclosed cavity, and an internal lidar module is located in the cavity. A window region of the first housing is configured to allow laser light emitted or received by the lidar to pass through. The first housing has a continuous curved surface, and an included angle between a tangent plane of any point in the window region and a horizontal plane of the vehicle is less than 45°, so that the lidar has smooth exterior lines. When mounted on a vehicle, the lidar does not significantly protrude from an exterior of the vehicle, and can be integrated with the appearance of the vehicle.

title: Post-plasma clean infrared image inspection for oxideless bonding and apparatus for effecting the same
abstract: A bonded assembly may be formed by performing a chip plasma clean process on a semiconductor chip; generating at least one chip infrared image of a cleaned side of the semiconductor chip; measuring an average emissivity of at least one metallic region in the at least one chip infrared image; performing a subsequent processing step selected from a bonding step and an alternative processing step based on the measured average emissivity. The bonding step is performed if the measured average emissivity is less than a predetermined emissivity threshold value. The alternative processing step is performed if the measured average emissivity is greater than the predetermined emissivity threshold value. The alternative processing step may be selected from an additional clean step and an additional inspection step.

title: Screen Printed Electrodes For An Electrocardiogram Article
abstract: A wearable diagnostic electrocardiogram (ECG) garment is disclosed herein. The wearable diagnostic ECG garment comprises a garment body, screen-printed electrodes positioned on the body, and screen-printed wires positioned in the garment body, each of the screen-printed wires connected from a central connector module to a screen-printed electrode.

title: Semiconductor device packages and methods of formation
abstract: A system on chip (SoC) die package is attached to a redistribution structure of a semiconductor device package such that a top surface of the SoC die package is above a top surface of an adjacent memory die package. This may be achieved through the use of various attachment structures that increase the height of the SoC die package. After encapsulating the memory die package and the SoC die package in an encapsulation layer, the encapsulation layer is grinded down. The top surface of the SoC die package being above the top surface of the adjacent memory die package results in the top surface of the SoC die package being exposed through the encapsulation layer after the grinding operation. This enables heat to be dissipated through the top surface of the SoC die package.

title: Adaptive cooking method and apparatus
abstract: The present invention provides an apparatus and a method for optimizing cooking processes through adaptive temperature control, real-time monitoring, and innovative design features. The methods dynamically adjust cooking temperatures based on food properties, such as size, shape, and density, using predictive algorithms and real-time feedback from infrared cameras and thermometers. Multi-stage cooking processes allow simultaneous preparation of meals with varied food groups, using temperature adjustments to ensure optimal doneness while preventing overcooking. A multi-zone cooking system creates temperature gradients within the cooking chamber, enabling precise and efficient preparation of foods requiring different heat levels. The apparatus features halogen lamps operating within a controlled wavelength range for precise searing and includes integrated cameras to analyze food properties and adjust heating parameters dynamically. Additional enhancements, such as angled fins for air circulation and high-powered fans, improve heat distribution, ensuring even cooking, reduced cooking times, and enhanced food quality.

title: Screen creation support device, screen operation support device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: Provided is a screen creation support device that displays an operation screen of a control device on the basis of a screen configuration of an operation screen of a control device for controlling the industrial machine and a property of a component of the operation screen, detects, from a property of a component of the operation screen, a trigger that is an event accompanied by a user operation, an action caused by the trigger, and an operation target component affected by the action, creates help information in which a display state of the control device, an operation state of the industrial machine, propriety of execution of the trigger, an action, and the operation target component are associated with each other, refers to the help information, and displays the operation content to be a trigger superimposed on the operation target component of the operation screen in the currently displayed operation screen.

title: Click-to-install genome editing
abstract: Here we describe click editing, a series of genome editing approaches that combine DNA nickases (including but not limited to RNA-programmable CRISPR nickases) with DNA ligases or DNA polymerases to perform a range of different genomic edits. The edit of interest is encoded on a nucleic acid template or substrate (optionally a ‘click nucleic acid’ (clkNA) or ‘click DNA’ (clkDNA) as described herein), which can be provided in trans or preferentially recruited to the target site via a variety of nucleic acid tethering methods (optionally HUH-family endonucleases (HUHes), Telomere Binding Proteins (TBPs), or DNA- or RNA-binding proteins).

title: Fully homomorphic encryption bootstrapping system and method
abstract: A fully homomorphic encryption bootstrapping system and method are proposed. The method includes the following steps performed by a computing device: performing a large-number decomposition on an original ciphertext to generate two first ciphertexts, wherein a coefficient of the two first ciphertexts is smaller than a coefficient corresponding to the original ciphertext, sequentially performing a gadget decomposition, a fast Fourier transform, a polynomial operation, and an inverse fast Fourier transform on the two first ciphertexts to generate two second ciphertexts; and merging the two second ciphertexts to generate an output result, wherein a coefficient range of any one of the two second ciphertexts is smaller than a coefficient range of the output result.

title: Adaptive video streaming frames per second based on appliance status
abstract: A cooking appliance includes a body defining a cooking chamber and a door moveable between a closed position and an open position. A camera module is configured to capture images of the cooking chamber. A control system is configured to receive the images from the camera module, monitor the cooking appliance or a foodstuff within the cooking chamber for a presence of a condition, and, if the presence of the condition is detected, generate a signal to modify a frame rate of the camera module.

title: Optical module with unlock warning function and use methodthereof
abstract: Disclosed are an optical module with an unlock warning function and a method of use thereof. A lever is provided on a base of the optical module, with an inclined groove formed. A handle for controlling the optical module to be inserted and unplugged matches the inclined groove to control a chamfer on the lever to rise or descend by controlling the movement of the handle relative to the base, and the chamfer is configured to match a slot of a metal shielding cage to fix and unlock the optical module, such that the optical module is controlled to be fixed and unlocked by controlling the handle. A contact point is arranged at a lower end of the chamfer, and when the chamfer descends, the contact point becomes electrically connected to a PCB in the optical module, whereby unlock warning is transmitted before the optical module is completely unplugged, preventing signal loss caused by its mistaken extraction.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device includes: a display panel including first and second surfaces, which are opposite to each other, an elastic member disposed on the first surface, a first rigid member disposed on the elastic member, and a panel support member disposed on the second surface, wherein the first rigid member includes at least one of polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polyimide, and ultra-thin glass (UTG), and the elastic member includes at least one of a dilatant, polyether block amide (PEBA), and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU).

title: Semiconductor Device and Method of Forming AIP Module with Embedded Substrate
abstract: A semiconductor device has a substrate made of glass and a first electrical component disposed within a cavity in the substrate. An interconnect structure is formed over a first surface of the substrate and the first electrical component. An antenna structure is formed over a second surface of the substrate opposite the first surface of the substrate. A conductive via is formed through the substrate between the interconnect substrate and antenna structure. A second electrical component is disposed over the interconnect structure. An encapsulant is deposited over the second electrical component. A shielding layer is disposed over and around the encapsulant. An electrical connector is disposed over the interconnect structure.

title: Plasma-enabled Liquid Filtration and Decontamination
abstract: A method includes providing a reaction chamber having a filter. A hollow tube electrode and a solid electrode extend into the reaction chamber. A liquid flows through the reaction chamber. A gas introduced into the reaction chamber. A voltage is applied to generate a plasma volume from the gas. The liquid surrounds the plasma volume as it flows through the reaction chamber. The liquid passes through the filter situated between the plasma volume and an outlet from the reaction chamber. The plasma causes parent species contaminant molecules in the liquid to break apart into daughter products. The parent species and daughter products are adsorbed by the filter before the liquid is output from the reaction chamber via the outlet, or the plasma passes through the filter, which causes contaminant molecules adsorbed by the filter to be desorbed from the filter and output from the reaction chamber.
assignee: The Government Of The United States Of America, As Represented By The Secretary Of The Navy

title: Smoking substitute system
abstract: A system includes a smoking substitute device for heating a consumable according to a consumable cycle. The smoking substitute device comprises a measurement means for measuring a usage of the device by a user during the consumable cycle, and a controller configured to determine an exhaustion level of the consumable during the consumable cycle based on the usage. The controller is further configured to control an aspect of the operation of the smoking substitute device during the consumable operating cycle based on the exhaustion level.

title: Assisting user(s) in interactions with large language model(s)
abstract: Implementations relate to a method implemented by one or more processors, the method including: receiving an input prompt for a large language model (LLM); generating first LLM output that is usable to generate a set of user interface (UI) each associated with a corresponding sub-prompt of the input prompt; causing, based on the first LLM output, the set of UI elements to be rendered at a user device; receiving further user input based on user interactions with one or more of the UI elements of the set of UI elements; and in response to determining that one or more termination conditions are satisfied: generating a final response to the input prompt based on generating second LLM output that is usable to generate the final response; and causing the final response to be rendered at the user device.

title: Coil structure and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: The present application relates to a new type coil structure and a manufacturing method therefor. The new type coil structure comprises an inner coil, an insulating cylinder layer, an outer coil, and first angular rings, wherein the inner coil is arranged at an inner side of the insulating cylinder layer in a surrounding manner; the outer coil is arranged at an outer side of the insulating cylinder layer in a surrounding manner; and two first angular rings are provided in such a way that annular structures are formed by means of insulating tapes being wound around the two first angular rings and the two first angular rings are respectively positioned at two ends of the outer coil. By means of the first angular rings being respectively arranged at the two ends of the outer coil, the electric field intensity at the end portions of the outer coil can be reduced, such that the electric insulation performance of the new type coil structure is improved. In addition, since the first angular rings are directly formed by means of winding the insulating tapes, the phenomenon of a reduction in the insulation performance of the first angular rings due to same prone to being dampened is avoided, such that the overall electrical insulation performance of the new type coil structure is relatively stable, and the reliability of the insulation performance is thus higher.
assignee: Tritype Electric Co., Ltd.; Haihong Electric Co., Ltd.

title: Tool-to-tool charging
abstract: One embodiment provides a power tool including an interface for receiving a power tool battery pack, a port, a port controller connected to the port, and a controller coupled to the interface and the port controller. The port controller is configured to set the port in one of a source mode and a sink mode. The controller is configured to determine that a power device is connected via the port, negotiate power transfer between the power tool and the power device, and set, using the port controller, the port in one of the source mode and the sink mode based on the power transfer.

title: System and method for emergency supervision of tunnel traffic in smart cities based on internet of things large model
abstract: Provided is a system and a method for emergency supervision of tunnel traffic in smart cities based on an Internet of Things (IoT) large model. The method comprises: constructing a fusion feature vector of a vehicle in a target tunnel based on multi-dimensional data of the target tunnel; determining an abnormal event based on the fusion feature vector and congestion data of the target tunnel; predicting an upstream congestion condition of the target tunnel based on the abnormal event, the congestion data, and peripheral traffic flow data of the target tunnel; and generating a signal regulation instruction including a passage duration according to the upstream congestion condition, the signal regulation instruction being configured to control a target signal light to maintain a target state for the passage duration, and the target signal light being a signal light on a key road section in a direction toward the target tunnel.
assignee: Chengdu Qinchuan Iot Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Vulnerability Remediation Using an Autonomous Artificial-Intelligence Application
abstract: A system and method for training a remediation engine to fine-tune already-captured vulnerability solutions available in a remediation engine database is disclosed. The method comprises storing a remediation solution script in a remediation database, determining whether an alternate solution is available in the database for a particular vulnerability addressed by the remediation solution script, if no alternate solution is available, sending the remediation solution script to a bot with a query for an improved solution script, and saving a revised solution script to the remediation database for the particular vulnerability.

title: Safety valve employing radially coupled magnetic targets and a magnetic assembly axially coupled to a magnetic target
abstract: Provided is a safety valve, a well system, and a method. The safety valve, in one aspect, includes a first portion, the first portion including a safety valve sub having a magnetic assembly, one or more radial outer magnetic targets, and a magnetic target located therein. The safety valve, according to this aspect, further includes a second portion. The safety valve, according to this aspect, further includes a third portion, the third portion including a mechanical connecting apparatus having one or more radial inner magnetic targets associated therewith and configured to magnetically engage with the one or more radial outer magnetic targets, wherein at least one of the one or more radial inner magnetic targets or the one or more radial inner magnetic targets are one or more permanent magnets.

title: System, method, and apparatus for a beverage producing and dispensing apparatus including automatic scheduling
abstract: A brewer includes a brewing assembly that dispenses a brewed beverage into one or more reservoirs, an intelligent scheduler, and a refill controller. The intelligent scheduler uses one or more machine learning models to generate a hold volume schedule based on historical brew event data, the hold volume schedule specifying a target volume of brewed beverage to maintain in the reservoirs across multiple time intervals. The machine learning models also predict beverage waste and customer wait time, with model weights tunable based on user-adjustable goal criteria that set relative priorities between minimizing waste and reducing wait times. The refill controller initiates brewing based on the hold volume schedule to fill the reservoirs to the target volume. The intelligent scheduler periodically updates the hold volume schedule using updated historical brew event data. The system is also applicable to general beverage producing and dispensing systems.

title: Electronic avionics equipment with receiving port(s) using authentication of origin, related avionics communication installation
abstract: Electronic avionics equipment is configured to be onboard an aircraft, the equipment including a set of communication port(s) for transmission, called transmitter port(s), and communication port(s) for receipt, called receiver port(s). At least one receiver port is switchable between a blocked state, wherein the data received by the port is automatically erased, and an unblocked state, wherein the data received by the port is stored for later processing. The equipment includes a security module configured to switch a respective receiver port from its blocked state to its unblocked state for a predefined transmitter equipment group after receiving a valid authentication message issued by the transmitter equipment group in response to an authentication request sent to the group by the security module.
assignee: Thales; Université De Bordeaux; Institut Polytechnique De Bordeaux; Centre National De La Recherche Scientifique

title: Control of Message Processing Based on Recoverability of Received TCP RST Error
abstract: In a device having a protocol stack including a TCP layer and a higher layer, an example method includes (i) passing data from the higher layer to the TCP layer for processing, (ii) receiving at the higher layer, from the TCP layer, a notification that the TCP layer has received a TCP RST message defining a TCP RST error, (iii) responsive to the notification, passing from the higher layer to the TCP layer a query requesting an indication of whether the TCP RST error is recoverable, (iv) receiving at the higher layer, from the TCP layer, based on testing by the TCP layer of whether the TCP RST error is recoverable, the indication of whether the TCP RST error is recoverable, and (v) using the indication as a basis to control whether to re-pass the data from the higher layer to the TCP layer for processing.

title: Method and device for selecting nodes using reference signals in wireless communication
abstract: The present application provides a method and a device in a node for wireless communications. A first node transmits a first signal; receives a first signaling in a first resource block; and monitors a first-type signaling in a first resource block subset after a first time using a spatial parameter of a target reference signal. The first signal indicates a first reference signal out of M reference signals; a transmitter of at least one reference signal among the M reference signals is a first cell, the first cell not being added by the first node; time-domain resource occupied by the first signaling is used to determine the first time. The method above makes quick cross-cell beam handover possible and enhances the performance of cell-boundary users as well as avoids the ping-pong effect with service quality fully-guaranteed.

title: Sensor bracket and sensor attachment method
abstract: The sensor bracket is a resin member in which the sensor fixing portion, the base portion, and the integral hinge portion are integrally molded. When the sensor fixing portion rotates around the integral hinge portion, the sensor is accommodated in the base portion, and the engaging claw engages with the engaging hole to assemble the sensor fixing portion to the base portion. The sensor bracket is disposed between the peripheral edge of the engagement hole of the base portion and the engagement arm and includes a rib plate whose thickness is adjustable.

title: Phototherapy apparatus for treating alzheimer's disease and associated conditions
abstract: A phototherapy apparatus for treating Alzheimer's disease and associated conditions includes a support mechanism forming an accommodation space and an array of near-infrared irradiation units. The near-infrared light delivered to the subject's head satisfies a coordinated irradiation condition involving an irradiated surface area ratio and a delivered radiant power level. This ratio, ranging from 30% to 65% or more, is determined relative to a reference calvarial region. The surface area of the reference calvarial region is the external surface area of the subject's head within a total boundary line extending from a Glabella point along supraorbital ridges, passes through preauricular points on both sides, curves posteriorly around the head to pass between the inion and the electrode positions O 1 , OZ, and O 2  of the international 10-10 standard system, and then converges, and the irradiated surface area ratio is in the range of 30% to 65% or more.
assignee: Danyang Huichuang Medical Equipment Co., Ltd.

title: Reducing errors in using compressed channel state information reports or indications
abstract:
Methods, systems, and techniques are disclosed for reducing errors in using compressed channel quality reports or indications. An example method includes receiving ( 304 ) by a user equipment (UE) from a network entity a channel state information (CSI) report configuration that includes information associated with a mismatch between compression and decompression of CSI. The UE receives ( 310 ), from the network entity, multiple reference signals for generating a CSI report based on the CSI report configuration. The UE transmits ( 312 ), to the network entity, the CSI report including the information associated with the mismatch between the compression and decompression of the precoder matrix in the CSI. As such, the network entity uses the information to decompress the CSI report with improved accuracy or fidelity. 
     WO

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device is provided which includes a display panel including light emitting pixels, a first protective layer positioned on a rear surface of the display panel, and a first adhesive layer positioned between the display panel and the first protective layer, wherein the first adhesive layer includes a non-conductive film (NCF).

title: Method and Apparatus for Constructing Through Flight, Electronic Device and Storage Medium”.
abstract: Provided are a method and apparatus for constructing a through flight, an electronic device and a storage medium. In the method for constructing a through flight, through flight information issued by each airline is acquired, where the through flight information includes a through flight route information and a through flight code sharing relation. Then, data of the through flight information is verified to obtain valid through flight information. Then, direct flight information is searched out from a pre-constructed direct flight information base based on the valid through flight information. Finally, the through flight is constructed based on the direct flight information, and stored into a through flight information base. Thus, according to the method of the disclosure, the direct flight information can be searched out according to the acquired through flight information issued by each airline, thereby constructing the through flight.

title: Vacuum pump
abstract: A vacuum pump comprising: a stator, the stator comprising one or more stator walls defining a pumping chamber; and a heat transfer device coupled to the one or more stator walls, the heat transfer device comprising: a thermally conductive body; and a conduit through the thermally conductive body and through which, in use, a purge gas is passed whereby to heat the purge gas.

title: In-Situ Measurement of Gas Entrainment in a Multi-Phase Fluid
abstract: A method of measuring gas entrainment of a gas within a multi-phase fluid (a gas within a liquid) contained in a passageway, vessel, or other container. An open-ended coaxial probe is installed though a wall of the passageway such that an open end of the probe is flush or nearly flush with the inner wall. The probe is then used to measure permittivity of the multi-phase fluid. The volume fraction of the gas within the fluid is calculated, based on a mixing function that expresses permittivity as a function of the pure gas permittivity and the pure liquid permittivity.

title: Transducer apparatuses with electrode element spacing to reduce edge effect in delivering tumor treating fields to a subject’s body
abstract: A transducer apparatus for delivering tumor treating fields to a subject's body, the transducer apparatus including: a plurality of electrode elements; wherein the plurality of electrode elements comprises a first electrode element and a second electrode element, wherein the first electrode element and the second electrode element are substantially located in a plane of the transducer apparatus; and when viewed from a direction perpendicular to the plane, the first electrode element and the second electrode element have edges located adjacent each other without any other electrodes between them, wherein the edges of the first electrode element and the second electrode element extend parallel to each other along their length.

abstract:
