abstract: A cathode active material for a lithium secondary battery according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a lithium-transition metal oxide particle. The lithium-transition metal oxide particle has a FWHM ratio measured by an in-situ X-ray Diffraction spectroscopy (XRD) and defined by Equation 1 of 400% or less. Life-span properties of a lithium secondary battery can be improved by preventing deformation of a lattice structure and/or a crystal structure in the lithium-transition metal composite oxide particles.
assignee: Sk On Co., Ltd.; Sk Innovation Co., Ltd.

title: Smart Micro Fulfillment Centers Powered by Machine Learning Based Clusters
abstract: A system and method are disclosed for determining inventory to stock at a supply chain site. The method includes determining a set of inventory clusters identifying inventory items that have been purchased together, ranking the set of inventory clusters based on a number of times each cluster of inventory items was purchased together, determining an amount of shelf space needed for each of the set of inventory clusters, ranking any inventory clusters that were purchased an equal number of times based on the amount of shelf space needed to generate a cluster ranking, and determining inventory to stock at the supply chain site based on the cluster ranking. The method further includes generating an inventory stocking plan based on the determined inventory to stock, and implementing the inventory stocking plan at the supply chain site based on the inventory stocking plan using one or more pieces of automated stocking machinery.

title: Degradable hyaluronic acid hydrogels
abstract: The present invention relates to conjugates comprising crosslinked hyaluronic acid to which a plurality of drug moieties are covalently and reversibly conjugated, wherein the hyaluronic acid exhibits a certain degree of modification and comprises degradable crosslinker moieties. It also relates to their use as medicaments and their use in the diagnosis, prevention and treatment of diseases.

title: Foldable device
abstract: A foldable device may include: a flexible display including a first portion, a second portion, and a third portion disposed between the first portion and the second portion; a first body including: a first fixed portion to support the first portion of the flexible display; and a first support portion to partially support the third portion of the flexible display; a second body including: a second fixed portion to support the second portion of the flexible display; and a second support portion to partially support the third portion of the flexible display; and a hinge unit including: a first hinge shaft coupled to the first body; and a second hinge shaft coupled to the second body.

title: Recognition-Enhanced Material Design System: Methods and Computational Systems for Predicting and Optimizing Novel Materials Using Recognition Science
abstract: A recognition-enhanced material design system is disclosed for evaluating, predicting, screening, ranking, and optimizing candidate materials using a recognition-based computational framework. Candidate-material inputs are received and processed to generate one or more recognition-compatible metrics. A recognition coverage function is applied to at least one metric to produce recognition-weighted outputs, including structure-, property-, composition-, and stability-related outputs. In some embodiments, outputs from multiple subsystems are combined to determine an overall material score and to generate ranking, screening, prediction, optimization, or prioritization results. The framework can interface with external computational platforms, including first-principles simulation, molecular dynamics, machine-learning, and database platforms, to support candidate-material discovery across multiple material classes.

title: Brillouin gain analyzer and brillouin gain analysis method
abstract:
An object of the present invention is to provide a Brillouin gain analysis device and a Brillouin gain analysis method capable of measuring a high-speed strain change of an optical fiber in a distributed manner. 
     According to the present invention, a Brillouin gain analysis device  301  includes a laser  11  that outputs continuous light having a single frequency, a pulse generator  12  that pulses the continuous light from the laser and enters the pulsed light into one end of an optical fiber  50  to be measured, an ASE light source  13  that generates continuous light having a frequency component broader than the frequency of the continuous light output from the laser  11  and enters the generated continuous light into another end of the optical fiber  50 , a modulator  14  that generates local light obtained by shifting the frequency of the continuous light from the laser  11  by any frequency, and a detector  15  that heterodyne-detects Brillouin scattered light generated by the optical fiber and the local light.

title: Monetized Artificial Intelligence Voice Activated Commands for Interactive Business Promotion
abstract: The present invention relates to a monetized artificial intelligence voice activated commands system for interactive business promotion system. It discloses a voice-based digital assistant system for displaying live business deals, offers or promotions to the customers and empowering businesses for the voice-activated revolution. The monetized artificial intelligence voice activated commands system for interactive business promotion system for displaying live business deals, offers, or promotions to customers is comprised of a multi-prolonged solution, voice-activated commands, smart television integration modules, and API integration modules. The system is designed to enable viewers to speak directly to their smart televisions and their remotes, wherein the voice software is added to all remotes, including universal remotes.

title: Method for haptic feedback for ostomy leakage detection system
abstract: A method for haptic feedback for an ostomy leakage detection system can include a wearable device to obtain leakage data. The leakage data may include leakage detected on at least one ring of a sensing accessory. The wearable device can also determine a leakage level based on the leakage data. The leakage level can indicate information about the leakage detected. The wearable device can further output a haptic feedback leak level alert based on the leakage level. The haptic feedback leak level alert can discreetly notify a user about the leakage detected.

title: Interaction method and apparatus, device and medium
abstract: An interaction method and apparatus, a device and a medium are provided. The method includes: displaying an interaction panel in an extended reality scene; and controlling the interaction panel to perform a first preset operation in response to a first operation on the interaction panel, where the first preset operation includes: being displayed around a target model and moving with the target model, and the target model is a virtual model of a controller corresponding to the extended reality scene.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Hybrid ai-powered digital clone for real-time health monitoring and legacy preservation
abstract: The Hybrid AI-Powered Digital Clone integrates real-time health monitoring with dynamic legacy preservation. It utilizes biometric sensors, AI-driven predictive analytics, and multimedia archiving to create an evolving digital representation of an individual. The system includes modules for health monitoring and memory archiving, employing advanced machine learning and meta-learning techniques for personalized insights. It ensures user control while providing predictive health recommendations and posthumous interaction capabilities, setting a new standard in personalized healthcare and digital legacy services.

title: Voltage detector
abstract: A voltage detector includes a comparator, a voltage divider, a reference voltage generating circuit and a start-up circuit. The output terminal of the comparator generates a detection signal. The voltage divider receives an input voltage and generates a divided voltage and a control signal. The divided voltage is transmitted to the first input terminal of the comparator. The reference voltage generating circuit receives the input voltage and a start signal and generates a reference voltage and a stop signal. The reference voltage is transmitted to the second input terminal of the comparator. The start-up circuit receives the input voltage, the control signal and the stop signal. When the start-up circuit is enabled, the start signal is activated. Consequently, the reference voltage is generated. After receiving the start signal, the reference voltage generating circuit generates the stop signal, and the start-up circuit stops activating the start signal.

title: Guidance query for cache system
abstract: A device may be configured to determine whether an audio file is a first type of audio file that is capable of being processed to recognize the voice query based on a characteristic of the audio file itself or a second type of audio file that may require speech recognition processing in order to recognize the voice query associated with the audio file. In determining whether the audio file is a first type of audio file or a second type of audio file, a query filter associated with the device may be configured to access one or more guidance queries. Using the one or more guidance queries, the device may classify the audio file as a first type of audio file or a second type of audio file based on receiving only a portion of the audio file, thereby improving the speed at which the audio file can be processed.

title: Non-invasive assay for detecting and monitoring systemic inflammation
abstract: The invention provides assays and methods for detecting and monitoring systemic inflammation. Particularly, the invention in embodiments thereof relates to the use of urinary biomarkers for non-invasive determination of the level of inflammation.
assignee: Ichilov Tech Ltd.; Yeda Research And Development Co. Ltd.

title: 3H-PYRAZOLO[4.3:f] QUINOLINE-BASED COMPOUNDS AS STING ANTAGONISTS
abstract: 3H-pyrazolo[4,3-f]quinoline-based compounds that inhibit Stimulator of interferon genes (STING); compositions comprising same; and their use for treating STING-driven diseases such as STING-driven inflammatory diseases, autoimmune diseases, diabetes, cancer, traumatic brain injury, and fibrosis.

title: Electronic pen
abstract: The present application relates to the technical field of terminals, and discloses an electronic pen, including: a pen barrel, provided with a first accommodating cavity; where one end of the pen barrel is provided with an opening, and the opening is communicated with the first accommodating cavity; a pen tip, located at a side of the opening; a first electrode, inserted into the first accommodating cavity; where the pen tip is detachably connected to the first electrode through the opening; and a second electrode, fixedly connected with the pen barrel; where at least part of the second electrode is inserted into the first accommodating cavity; the second electrode is sleeved outside the first electrode and is spaced apart from the first electrode.
assignee: Shenzhen Xinwei Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd

title: Payload-based diversity switching for satellite optical feeder-links
abstract: Techniques are described for implementing space-frequency diversity in a satellite network system using an optical feeder-link band. Embodiments enable very rapid diversity switching among RF Gateway sites by placing the diversity switching decision and implementation within the satellite payload. Some space-frequency diversity implementations described herein can provide additional diversity, such as time diversity, angle diversity, and/or site diversity. Techniques described herein can be applied to millimeter-wave RF bands, such as E-band and higher.

title: Compositions of immersion fluids with contaminants
abstract: Disclosed is a hydrofluoroolefin working fluid including: a dielectric fluid selected from E-HFO-153-10mczz and/or E-HFO-153-10mzzy; and water dissolved within the dielectric fluid at a concentration of from 10 to about 145 ppm of and/or a plasticizer or plasticizer mixture dissolved within the dielectric fluid at a concentration of from about 10 to about 7341 ppm. The hydrofluoroolefin working fluid is useful for immersion cooling of an electronic component.

title: Catalyst for producing unsaturated carboxylic acid
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a catalyst for producing an unsaturated carboxylic acid having a catalytically active component having a composition represented by the following formula (1) in which the value of the surface roughness S obtained by measuring the surface roughness with a non-contact shape measuring laser microscope is 11.7 μm or more and 25.0 μm or less. (Mo) 12 (V) a (W) b (Cu) c (Sb) d (X) e (Y) f (Z) g (O) h ( 1 )

title: Computer system having a pivoting vertical panel
abstract: A computer system capable of generating heat including—a box, —a water circuit capable of being connected at the inlet and at the outlet to an external water network, the water circuit includes metal pipes inside the box, —at least one panel that is kept vertically upright inside the box, the panel including a vertically upright metal pipe loop and at least one electronic board pressed vertically onto a portion of the loop, the electronic board being provided with at least one electronic component capable of generating heat towards the metal pipe, —a communication interface enabling an external computer system to access the at least one electronic component as a resource, —a control interface for regulating a quantity of energy to be generated by the at least one electronic component, —at least one power supply is disclosed.

title: Systems and methods for detecting tissue contact by an ultrasound probe
abstract: A computer-assisted surgical system includes a manipulator arm configured to be coupled to an ultrasound probe and to position the ultrasound probe within a patient and one or more processors configured to perform a process comprising: generating an ultrasound image based on sound waves detected by the ultrasound probe while located within the patient; determining, based on an analysis of the ultrasound image, a contact state of the ultrasound probe, the contact state indicating whether the ultrasound probe is in operative physical contact with tissue of the patient; and controlling, based on the contact state, a positioning of the ultrasound probe.

title: Schizophrenia biomarker and method of diagnosis and kit of parts
abstract: A method is disclosed for detecting schizophrenia, at any stage, which comprises the steps of determining the gene expression of ZNF560 in a biological sample from a subject and comparing it with the ones of a healthy individual as a control sample, wherein the subject of the biological sample is diagnosed as having schizophrenia the gene ZNF560 is overexpressed in the biological sample in comparison to the control. Also disclosed is a kit of parts to diagnose schizophrenia from a biological sample and the use of the kit of parts as a detection agent useful to diagnose schizophrenia, wherein schizophrenia could be at prodromal, acute, residual, or chronic stage.
assignee: Universidad Andrés Bello; Universidad De Chile

title: Electronic image stabilization with image extrapolation
abstract: A method for electronic image stabilization (EIS) includes obtaining a frame image with first field of view (FOV) from an image sensor, obtaining motion data associated with the frame image, extrapolating pixels around borders of the frame image to obtain an extended field of view of the frame image, analyzing the motion data to determine a stabilization correction based on an extended electronic image stabilization (EIS) margin, and applying the stabilization correction to the frame image with the extended field of view to generate a stabilized frame image. The extended EIS margin is derived from the extended field of view.

title: Semiconductor device and methods of formation
abstract: A capacitor structure included in a semiconductor device may include one or more electrode layers that contain materials that have low hydrogen absorption properties to achieve a low concentration of hydrogen in the capacitor structure. These materials enable the capacitor structure to be formed by low-temperature processes that are compatible with layers and/or structures of the semiconductor device, while enabling fast charging and discharging speeds to be achieved for the capacitor structure. Additionally and/or alternatively, one or more of the electrode layers of the capacitor structure may contain metal materials that have a high band gap, which reduces the likelihood of (and/or amount of) charge carrier tunneling. This enables a low current leakage to be achieved for the capacitor structure, which enables the capacitor structure to retain charge for longer durations with fewer charge refreshes (which reduces power consumption of the semiconductor device).

title: Light source apparatus
abstract: A light source apparatus according to one embodiment of the present disclosure includes: a light source unit that divides excitation light into a plurality of light beams and outputs the plurality of light beams; a light guide member including, on an inner side thereof, a hollow light guide path having a first opening and a second opening on a side opposite to the first opening, the light guide member having a plurality of wavelength converters provided on at least a portion of a side surface of the light guide path, the plurality of wavelength converters being configured to emit light beams having wavelength bands different from each other; and a light condenser device that guides each of the plurality of light beams output from the light source unit to a corresponding one of the plurality of wavelength converters.

title: Manufacturing method of high-density three-dimensional memory device with low-resistance interconnection
abstract: A manufacturing method of a high-density three-dimensional memory device with low-resistance interconnection is provided. The method includes: forming a base structure by alternately stacking first conductive medium layers and insulating medium layers; forming a curved division trench penetrating through the base structure from a top layer to a bottom layer so as to divide the base structure into two dendritic structures, each dendritic structure including at least one trunk and at least three branches connected to and extending perpendicular to the trunk; and forming a sequence of pillar-shaped memory bodies in the curved division trench, wherein adjacent pillar-shaped memory bodies are isolated from each other by an insulating material, and each pillar-shaped memory body includes a vertical electrode perpendicular to a bottom face of the base structure and a storage medium surrounding the vertical electrode.

title: Radio access network sharing using a transparent proxy function
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. An access and mobility management function (AMF) proxy may establish a first communication link between the AMF proxy and a first radio access network (RAN) associated with a first network operator, a second communication link between the AMF proxy and a first AMF associated with the first network operator, and a third communication link between the AMF proxy and a second AMF associated with a second network operator. The AMF proxy may the receive a message from the first RAN that includes a source identifier (ID) associated with a network entity of the first RAN and a target AMF ID. Following, the AMF proxy may transmit the message to the first AMF or transmit the message to the second AMF, based on the target AMF ID corresponding to the first AMF or the target AMF ID corresponding to the second AMF.

title: Thermoplastic and thermoset foam nucleation additive
abstract: A thermoplastic and thermoset foam nucleation additive, which is added to a foamed material, includes a gas absorbent and a nano-compound, wherein the nano-compound and the gas absorbent are mixed to form the thermoplastic and thermoset foam nucleation additive. The gas absorbent includes a central structure and a short chain structure, wherein a first chemical bond is formed between the short chain structure and the central structure. The nano-compound includes a base structure and a long chain structure, wherein a second chemical bond is formed between the long chain structure and the base structure. A number of carbon atoms in the short chain structure is not less than 8, and a molecular weight of the long chain structure is higher than 10000 g/mole.
assignee: Formosa Plastics Corporation; The Texas A&M University System

title: Antibodies
abstract: The present invention is concerned with methods of producing antibodies specific against  Legionella pneumophila  SG (serogroups) 2-15, isolated and purified anti- Legionella pneumophila  SG2-15 antibodies from same, and the antibodies for use in the detection of  Legionella pneumophila  (including in lateral flow and solid support tests). Also provided are the antibodies together with anti- Legionella pneumophila  SG1 antibodies, the combined anti-SG1 and SG2-15 (i.e. SG1-15) antibodies for use in the detection of  Legionella pneumophila , and methods of detection of  Legionella pneumophila  SG2-15 and SG1-15. Also provided are test kits for detecting the presence of  Legionella pneumophila  SG2-15 and  Legionella pneumophila  SG1-15.

title: Out of memory management
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure include techniques for improving out of memory management. In one embodiment, an out of memory (OOM) reserve buffer is used to store data pages when a page buffer is out of memory. The OOM reserve buffer includes a counter that counts a number of data pages in the OOM reserve buffer where both (i) a particular data page in the OOM reserve buffer has zero pointers directed at it and (ii) the particular data page has been sent to a write component to be written to the persistent memory. A request to add a new data page to the OOM reserve buffer is denied if the counter is zero, but if the counter is greater than zero, the system automatically waits a time period and then adds the new data page.

title: Short-wave infrared pixels based on non-scattering nanostructures
abstract: Provided are systems, methods, and apparatuses for short-wave infrared pixels based on non-scattering nanostructures. In one or more examples, the systems, devices, and methods include forming a back reflector on a substrate, the back reflector being configured to reflect electromagnetic radiation; forming a first doped region of a first semiconductor adjacent to the back reflector; forming an absorption region of a second semiconductor adjacent to at least a portion of the first doped region, the absorption region being configured as a photodetector; forming a second doped region of the first semiconductor adjacent to the absorption region; and forming a nanostructure adjacent to the second doped region, the nanostructure configured to allow light incident on the pixel to pass through the nanostructure and to steer a portion of the light reflected off the back reflector towards the absorption region.

title: Internet of things (iot) systems, methods, and storage media for smart city overheight and overload emergency early warning
abstract: A method, an IoT system, and a storage medium for smart city overheight and overload emergency early warning are provided. The method includes: obtaining vehicle sensing data of an upstream road section of a target road section; determining a risk vehicle; and in response to an estimated arrival time of the risk vehicle at the target road section satisfying a preset condition: predicting a time at which the risk vehicle arrives at a target traffic signal light; determining a first control parameter, which includes a start time at which the target traffic signal light is switched to a target state; sending a first control instruction to the target traffic signal light; and controlling the target traffic signal light to trigger a sub-clock at the start time, and controlling a relay group to switch on a first lamp bead unit, to drive the first lamp bead unit to emit light.
assignee: Chengdu Qinchuan Iot Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Base station antennas having metal tuning elements that move in response to changes in a remote electronic tilt setting
abstract: A base station comprises a reflector, remote electronic tilt actuator, an array of radiating elements, the radiating elements mounted to extend forwardly from the reflector, and a first metal tuning element that is at least partly positioned in front of the reflector. The first metal tuning element is configured to move when a remote electronic downtilt setting for the array of radiating elements is changed.

title: Detecting protocol impersonation with network intelligence
abstract: Adversaries can use evasive software or techniques to evade detection by network tools, resulting in vulnerabilities to the network. The described techniques provide a detection system that can be implemented by a cloud service provider and a network device. The detection system provides processes for detecting protocol impersonation on the initial data packets of a network connection, which allows the system to enforce network policies before the network connection is established. The techniques look for protocol inconsistencies in the initial data packet and/or initial data packets. Accordingly, the techniques may provide a more accurate and less resource intensive way to perform in-line detection of protocol impersonation, thereby reducing the number of false positives reported and improving security of the network.

title: Method and apparatus for extrication of lawnmower robot, and storage medium therefor
abstract: A method includes: identifying an obstacle within a predetermined range of the lawnmower robot in a case where it is detected that positioning information of the lawnmower robot is lost; determining a first vector according to a first projection point of a first reference point of the obstacle on a ground and a second projection point of a second reference point of the lawnmower robot on the ground; wherein a starting point of the first vector is the first projection point, and an ending point of the first vector is the second projection point; and controlling, based on a posture of the lawnmower robot and the first vector, the lawnmower robot to move such that the lawnmower robot is extricated. In a case where the positioning information of the lawnmower robot is lost, the lawnmower robot can obtain a positioning signal and is extricated.

title: Scheduling Tasks Using Work Fullness Counter
abstract: A method of activating scheduling instructions within a parallel processing unit includes checking if an ALU targeted by a decoded instruction is full by checking a value of an ALU work fullness counter stored in the instruction controller and associated with the targeted ALU. If the targeted ALU is not full, the decoded instruction is sent to the targeted ALU for execution and the ALU work fullness counter associated with the targeted ALU is updated. If, however, the targeted ALU is full, a scheduler is triggered to de-activate the scheduled task by changing the scheduled task from the active state to a non-active state. When an ALU changes from being full to not being full, the scheduler is triggered to re-activate an oldest scheduled task waiting for the ALU by removing the oldest scheduled task from the non-active state.

title: Conductive medical components
abstract: A device  1  according to the invention for holding pipette tips  2  has a tray  10  comprising a holding area  100  and openings or cutouts  101  formed in the holding area  100 . Furthermore, the device  1  has a carrier  11  comprising four legs  110  extending downward from the tray  10 . A standing surface  111  is formed on the underside of each of the legs  110 . The device  1  (i.e., tray  10  and carrier  11 ) is made of electrically conductive plastic in order to establish an electrical connection between the pipette tips  2  and the standing surface  111  of the device  1.

title: Supporting multiple controller circuits on a multiplexed communication bus
abstract: A system includes a plurality of controller circuits. The system includes a plurality of target circuits. The system includes a communication bus communicatively linking the plurality of controller circuits with the plurality of target circuits. The communication bus includes a plurality of switches. Each switch of the plurality of switches is connected to a different one of the plurality of controller circuits.

title: Optical fiber positioning device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an optical fiber positioning device and, more particularly, to an optical fiber positioning device and a method for attaching a fiber optic array to a photonic integrated circuit (PIC). A structure includes: a body having a first end and a second end; at least one reflective surface provided on an upper surface of the body; a light source configured to emit light onto the at least one reflective surface; at least one sensor configured to sense the light reflected from the at least one reflective surface and convert the light into a signal; and a control system configured to receive the signal from the at least one sensor.

title: Storage medium storing conference support program, conference support method, and conference support system
abstract: A medium storing a conference support program capable of allowing a user to easily understand a content of a conference. The program causes a computer to execute a step of obtaining a video image and a speech of a conference as conference information, a step of extracting a topic of the conference from the conference information, a step of identifying image regions included in the video image as attention regions based on the extracted topic, a step of extracting related items related to the attention regions from the speech within a playback time range of the attention regions and contents in the image regions, a step of generating correspondence entities by associating the attention regions and the related items, and a step of generating a group by collecting the correspondence entities including the attention regions having a predetermined similarity or more based on contents included in the extracted related items.

title: Method, user equipment and access network node
abstract: A communication system is disclosed in which a candidate access network node, performing an initial access procedure with an access network node, without using a random access channel, at a configured timing.

title: Multi-antenna mounting arrangement
abstract: The present disclosure refers to a multi-antenna mounting arrangement for configuring the spacing between two spatially separated antenna arrangements. The multi-antenna mounting arrangement includes the two antenna arrangements and a controllable adjustment arrangement to which the antenna arrangements are arranged. Respective antenna arrangement includes an antenna and a radio unit, the radio unit being collocated with, and connected to, the antenna, and the adjustment arrangement enabling controlling the spatial separation (d) between the two antenna arrangements. The present disclosure also refers to a multi-antenna mast arrangement includes an antenna mast and a multi-antenna mounting arrangement.

title: Electrode and power storage device
abstract: An electrode includes solid electrolyte particles and an active material. The electrode contains the particles in an amount of 0.1 vol % or more and 30 vol % or less. The electrode contains the active material in an amount of 70 vol % or more and 99.9 vol % or less. The electrode has an average inter-particle distance in a region in which 6 or more of the particles appear within an area of 400 μm 2  in a cross-section of the electrode is 1 μm or more.

title: Cable connector and connector assembly with improved structural strength
abstract: A cable connector includes an accommodating housing, a cable module and a first retaining bar. The accommodating housing defines accommodating space. The cable module is at least partially received in the accommodating space. The cable module includes a cable block, a metal shield enclosure at least partially sleeved on the cable block, and a fixing block fixed to the cable block and the metal shield enclosure. The first retaining bar is inserted into the accommodating housing. The first retaining bar abuts against the cable module and is configured to prevent the cable module from being disengaged from the accommodating housing. A connector assembly including the cable connector is also disclosed.

title: Electronic device and method for manufacturing thereof
abstract: An electronic device, having: an element main body including; a multilayer body having an internal electrode layer and a dielectric layer, both being substantially parallel to a plane including a first axis and a second axis perpendicular to the first axis, and stacked along a direction of a third axis perpendicular to the plane including the first axis and the second axis, and a gap part formed toa side surface disposed at an end in a direction of the first axis of the multilayer body; and an external electrode electrically connected to the internal electrode layer; wherein a boundary part between the multilayer body and the gap part exposed on an end surface being disposed at an end in a direction of the second axis of the element main body is at least partially covered by an end surface covering part, an area ratio of the end surface covering part is between 20% or greater and 50% or less with respect to 100% of an area of the end surface, and the external electrode covers at least part of the end surface and at least part of the end surface covering part.

title: Robustness/performance improvement for deep learning based speech enhancement against artifacts and distortion
abstract: Described is a method of processing an audio signal. The method includes a first step for applying enhancement to a first component of the audio signal and/or applying suppression to a second component of the audio signal relative to the first component, and a second step of modifying an output of the first step by applying a deep learning based model to the output of the first step, for perceptually improving the first component of the audio signal. Also described is an apparatus for carrying out the method, as well as corresponding programs and computer-readable storage media.

title: Rack enabling configurable domain architecture
abstract: A server rack is provided that includes a plurality of tray support structures each configured to support a tray. Each support structure accommodates a selected one of air cooling or liquid cooling of the tray supported by the support structure.

title: Security Fence System
abstract: A security fence includes a first lateral panel forms a perimeter defining an interior, the perimeter including a first sidewall, a second sidewall, a top wall, and a bottom wall each of which has a trough between flanges that extend outward from a web relative to the interior, a second lateral panel forms a perimeter defining an interior, the perimeter including a third sidewall, a fourth sidewall, a top wall, and a bottom wall each of which has a trough between flanges that extend outward from a web relative to the interior, and a post disposed in the trough of the second sidewall and in the trough of the third sidewall, where the post is substantially enclosed inside the troughs of the second and third sidewalls.

title: Compositions and methods for treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
abstract: The present disclosure relates to AAVs encoding a SOD1 targeting polynucleotide which may be used to treat amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and delivery methods for the treatment of spinal cord related disorders including ALS.

title: Battery system
abstract: A battery system includes first to N-th battery modules sequentially connected in a daisy chain configuration; and a master controller connected to the first battery module through an interface IC, selecting at least one target module among the first to N-th battery modules, and transmitting a control command for the target module. The target module unidirectionally transmits the control command received from the master controller, and bidirectionally transmits response data generated in response to the control command. The master controller selects the N-th battery module as the target module first, and selects the first battery module as the target module last.
assignee: Sk On Co., Ltd.; Autosilicon Inc.

title: Reducing object tracking noise with pose smoothing
abstract: Examples in the present disclosure relate to systems and methods for reducing noise in object tracking data. Images of an object are obtained via one or more cameras. The images are processed to obtain first pose data indicative of a pose of the object over time. The first pose data is represented in a camera space. The first pose data is transformed to second pose data represented in a world space. The second pose data is filtered using a smoothing filter to generate filtered pose data. The filtering includes, for each pose data item in a time series of the second pose data, using a rotation transformation between the world space and camera space to apply one or more camera space-specific filter parameters to the pose data item that is represented in the world space. The pose of the object is dynamically tracked based on the filtered pose data.

title: Fault aggregation and remapping in an electronic system
abstract: An electronic system includes a network-on-chip (NoC) and a fault aggregation circuit. The NoC includes a plurality of NoC components that generate faults. The fault aggregation circuit is configured to receive the faults from the NoC components and aggregate and remap the faults into a few alarm levels.

title: Neuromorphic architectures, actuators, and related methods
abstract: A neuromorphic architecture is formed from a laminate of non-woven carbon fiber reinforced polymer layers arranged in a plurality of different directions. A plurality of distributed nodes are formed through the laminate via transverse voids, and an encapsulant encapsulates an electrochemical fluid or gel such that the electrochemical fluid or gel may flow within the nodes and around the laminate. Electrical current flowing through the architecture creates reversible metal deposits at various nodes, depending on the path developed through the architecture, with a complexity sufficient for neuromorphic processing, and providing a writable and erasable memory. A neuromorphic actuator may be formed by combining shape memory materials with such a neuromorphic architecture, which may provide desired surface contours and/or actuations based on current in the neuromorphic architecture. Such neuromorphic architectures and actuators may be trained according to various methods, using feed-forward and/or feedback techniques.

title: Continuously variable transmission
abstract: A vehicle may include a continuously variable transmission which requires non-recycled air. The continuously variable transmission may provide non-recycled air to a first number of sheaves of the continuously variable transmission with a second number of air supply conduits, the second number being less than the first number. A cover of the continuously variable transmission may have a unitary body.

title: Pressure valve for cooking apparatus
abstract: The present invention introduces an apparatus and method for cooking the foodstuff in a pressurized steam oven with the foodstuff being steam cooked in the first stage and seared in the next stage. Various pressure cooking valve configurations are presented to enhance safety and cooking efficiency. In one configuration, a valve on the cooking apparatus lid is designed to protect the seal from extreme searing temperatures. Another configuration involves positioning the valve slightly apart from the cooking apparatus using an elongated metal pipe. This pipe, equipped with evenly distributed fins, enables swift cooling of hot steam, ensuring the safety of the valve and the steam or air pumps responsible for managing airflow situated behind it.

title: Pull-strap connector with first limiting protrusion and second limiting protrusion
abstract: A pull strap connector includes a body portion, an unlocking elastic piece and a pull strap. The unlocking elastic piece includes a first elastic arm and a second elastic arm. The pull strap is fastened to the unlocking elastic piece to drive the first elastic arm and the second elastic arm to undergo elastic deformation. The pull-strap connector further includes a first limiting protrusion and a second limiting protrusion. The first limiting protrusion is provided with a first limiting surface facing the second limiting protrusion. The second limiting protrusion is provided with a second limiting surface facing the first limiting protrusion. The pull strap is disposed adjacent to the first limiting surface and the second limiting surface. The pull strap is limited between the first limiting surface and the second limiting surface.

title: White fat and adipose organoid modulation and therapeutic transplantation
abstract: Methods and compositions for controlling fat cell phenotypes are provided.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Multi-speed power tool with electronic clutch
abstract: A power tool and a method of operating a power tool including a motor, a clutch collar including a plurality of settings, a wireless transceiver operable to form a wireless connection with a remote device, and a processor coupled to the clutch collar and the wireless transceiver. The processor receives, via the wireless transceiver, a mapping including a plurality of torque levels corresponding to the plurality of settings. The processor detects that the clutch collar is set to a setting of the plurality of settings. The processor determines the torque level for the setting from the mapping and detects, during the operation of the power tool, that a torque of the power tool exceeds the torque level. The processor is also configured to generate an indication that the torque exceeds the torque level. The indication may include flashing a light, ratcheting the motor, and stopping the motor.

title: Charging an Electric Vehicle at a Charging Point of a Property
abstract: A method for charging an electric vehicle coupled to a charging point of a property is provided. First charging information, including at least an expected departure time and a desired target SoC of the electric vehicle at the departure time, is transmitted to an energy management system assigned to the property with second charging information, which is selected from a maximum number of wake-up events of the electric vehicle, a maximum frequency of wake-up events of the electric vehicle, and a maximum energy throughput between charging point and electric vehicle. A charging plan for the electric vehicle is generated by the energy management system, based on the first charging information, the second charging information, predicted tariff information of an energy supplier relevant to the property, and projected consumption information of the property. The electric vehicle is charged at the charging point according to the charging plan.

title: Methods For Augmenting A Vertebra With A Device Including An Expandable Implant And Anchoring Elements For Anchoring The Device Within A Vertebral Pedicle
abstract: Methods for augmenting a vertebra with a device including an expandable implant and a pedicle anchor. The pedicle anchor includes at least one anchoring element movably coupled to an anchor body. An actuator is movable within the anchor body to deploy the anchoring element into engagement with a vertebral pedicle. The anchoring element may be deployed in a same plane as a tissue support ski of the expandable implant. The actuator may be a rod including a knuckle or a cam. The tissue support ski may be recessed from an outer profile of the device. Struts of the expandable implant may be angled towards the tissue support ski in an insertion configuration. The device may be oval-shaped and provide means for rotating the expandable implant relative to the pedicle anchor, and for blocking the expandable implant in a predetermined orientation.

title: Calibration methods for oil based mud imager tools
abstract: A method and assembly for calibrating downhole imaging tools includes a calibrator mechanism with a known electromagnetic response, whereby the calibrator mechanism is simultaneously engaged with a plurality of injector electrodes and the at least one return electrode carried on a pad of the downhole imaging tool. A current is injected into the calibrator mechanism by the injector electrodes and the response of the tool is measured. The calibrator mechanism if formed of a homogenous material or fluid so that the electromagnetic response is uniform throughout. The measured electromagnetic response can be compared to the known electromagnetic response and a calibration adjustment can be determined. The calibration adjustment can then be applied to future downhole measurements obtained during an imaging operation.

title: Power conversion device, overcurrent detection circuit, and semiconductor module
abstract: A power conversion device capable of detecting a load short circuit at high accuracy with a simple circuit configuration comprises an upper-arm switching element, a lower-arm switching element, a high potential-side terminal P, a low potential-side terminal N, an output terminal AC, a first detecting terminal, a second detecting terminal, a high potential-side detection inductance Ldp electromagnetically coupled to a high potential-side wiring inductance Lp between the high potential-side terminal P and the upper-arm switching element, an output-side detection inductance Ldac electromagnetically coupled to an output-side wiring inductance Lac between an upper-lower arm connection node and the output terminal AC, and an overcurrent detection unit that detects an overcurrent based on a potential difference between the first detecting terminal and the second detecting terminal. The high potential-side detection inductance Ldp and the output-side detection inductance Ldac are connected in series between the first and second detecting terminals.

title: Uniform multi-layer silica coated porous/mesoporus magnetic beads, methods of making and uses thereof
abstract: Methods for preparing of uniform spherical magnetic beads between 50 nm to 5 microns. This involves the formation of a uniform emulsion of hydrophobically coated nanoparticles dispensed in volatile organic solvent in an aqueous solution contains thickening agent and surfactant. Control of the chemical and physical parameters of emulsification enables adjustment of bead size. Methods for coating a silica layer on the spherical magnetic beads including: 1) a continuous silicate layer around the iron oxide core; and 2) a porous silica layer that has a defined pore size between 1 and 200 nm and thickness between 1 and 10,000 nm. The silica layer can be functionalized with chemical groups, including amine or carboxyl, or coated with a range of biochemical compounds, including peptides, proteins, or DNA, to facilitate separation and/or reaction. Kits for performing size selective separation and/or reaction including the extraction of specific size nucleic acids, proteins and macromolecules.

title: Tracking method for tongue and its rehabilitation system for tongue muscle
abstract: The present invention provides a tracking method for tongue and a rehabilitation system for tongue muscle, wherein the tracking method for tongue comprises: placing a tongue suction device on a tongue, wherein the tongue suction device is configured with a tracking point; acquiring a first tongue muscle exercise image of the tongue; converting a color space of the first tongue muscle exercise image; filtering a color value in color space to generate a filtering result; performing image analysis based on the filtering result to generate regional image shapes; determining the regional image shapes to generate a target object corresponding to the tracking point; drawing a contour information corresponding to the target object; identifying a coordinate value of the contour information; and calculating the coordinate value to generate a first position information corresponding to the tongue. By integrating with the tongue muscle rehabilitation system, the efficiency in rehabilitation is significantly enhanced.
assignee: National Kaohsiung University Of Science And Technology; Kaohsiung Medical University

title: Confined backside contact
abstract: A semiconductor integrated circuit (IC) devices are described. The IC devices include a confined backside contact that includes and upper portion and a lower portion in direct contact with the upper portion. The confined backside contact may be formed by processes which may result in the formation of the upper portion and lower portion. The processes may ease possible masking, photolithography, feature placement and/or alignment challenges in the formation of backside contacts and may reduce backside contact shorting failures, thereby increasing yield of the IC devices.

title: System and method for forming protrusions in a substrate used to manufacture absorbent articles
abstract: A method is presented for altering a portion of a substrate. The method includes providing a first device including an outer surface and a second device including a source of vibration energy. The method also includes forming a nip between the source of vibration energy and the outer surface. The method also includes conveying the substrate through the nip and intermittently altering the portion of the substrate in the nip to create a pattern of altered areas forming a shape. The altered areas have a pattern balance that includes one or more of: an average area of the substrate altered in the nip is within a threshold range across the portion of the substrate; and a simple area of integral areas within the altered areas is within a threshold range across the portion of the substrate.

title: Internet of things end-to-end service layer quality of service management
abstract: Methods, system, and apparatuses may support end-to-end (E2E) quality of service (QoS) through the use of service layer (SL) sessions. For example, an application can communicate with a targeted device based on application specified schedule, latency, jitter, error rate, throughput, level of security, and cost requirements.

title: System and method for ensemble learning
abstract: A system for ensemble learning is provided. The system includes a plurality of slave computing devices and a master computing device. Each slave computing device is configured to use a weak classifier to obtain a classification result. The master computing device is configured to receive the classification results and output a final classification result based on the classification results.

title: Ignitor canister for a turbine glow plug
abstract: An ignitor canister for accommodating a glow plug in a turbine includes an elongated housing having a cavity configured to receive a tip and shaft of the glow plug therein. A base of the housing has an open end to receive the tip and shaft of the glow plug therethrough and engage a base of the glow plug. The housing has a window formed at a first end that exposes a tip of the glow plug. A fuel passageway of the housing injects fuel to the tip of the glow plug. The ignitor canister may include air flow pathways to keep the glow plug cool during operation.

title: Prediction apparatus and prediction method
abstract: A computer acquires a parameter value set including values of a plurality of parameters each categorized into at least one of a plurality of factors affecting crystal generation. The computer performs prediction related to generation of crystal forms that a substance is able to take by inputting the parameter value set to a crystal generation model. The crystal generation model is a model that represents a crystal generation process and includes an elapsed time as an element. The computer outputs prediction result information which is information related to a result of the prediction.

title: Partition symbol context models for image and video coding
abstract: Decoding using partition symbol context models includes obtaining reconstructed block data by accessing entropy coded block partition data, obtaining a left binary value indicating whether a location in a vertical line buffer for entropy coding context data for block partition signaling indicates a block partition boundary, obtaining an above binary value indicating whether a location in a horizontal line buffer for entropy coding context data for block partition signaling indicates a block partition boundary, determining a context model index value in accordance with the left binary value and the above binary value, obtaining decoded block partition data for the current block by entropy decoding the entropy coded block partition data in accordance with an entropy coding context model indicated by the context model index value, and generating the reconstructed block data in accordance with the decoded block partition data.

title: Nested Permissions Policy Generation
abstract: Techniques for generating permissions policies for nested sets of software artifacts are disclosed. A system detects a selection of a target action and a target software artifact. The system identifies an entity associated with the selection. The system analyzes permissions metadata of the target software artifact to identify user-defined permission configuration rules specifying one or more additional software artifacts and one or more additional actions associated with the additional software artifacts. The system performs an iterative analysis of permissions metadata in the nested software artifacts to generate a composite permissions policy for the entity that combines the permissions specified in the user-defined permission configuration rules for the set of nested software artifacts.

title: Semiconductor device and method for making the same
abstract: A method for making a semiconductor device is provided. The method includes: providing a package including: a substrate including a first surface and a second surface; a first electronic component mounted on the first surface of the substrate; a second electronic component mounted on the second surface of the substrate; a contact pad formed on the second surface of the substrate, wherein the contact pad is outside of a projection of the second electronic component on the second surface of the substrate; and a first encapsulant disposed on the first surface of the substrate and covering the first electronic component; forming a second encapsulant over and around the second electronic component, wherein the contact pad is not covered by the second encapsulant; planarizing the second encapsulant to expose the second electronic component; and forming a bump on the contact pad of the second surface of the substrate.

title: Ai-based supplier management system
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI)-based system and associated method for supplier management. The method includes obtaining a specification including one or more needs associated with a project and extracting requirements for the project based on the specification. The requirements include a type of service or product, a quantity of the type of service or project, and a delivery schedule. The method further includes determining a supplier list with at least one potential supplier based on the requirements and supplier data and generating, using a questionnaire generator, a questionnaire based on the requirements and questionnaire response history. The method further includes transmitting the questionnaire to, and receiving a response from, each of the at least one potential suppliers and determining a predicted performance for each of the at least one potential suppliers. The method further includes selecting a supplier from the at least one potential suppliers based on the predicted performance.

title: Volume mounting and access method, device, and storage medium
abstract: Embodiments of the present application provide a volume mounting and access method, a device, and a storage medium. In the embodiments, for a volume that is bound to an application instance, the volume is mounted to a host machine directory tree in a sub-tree mounting manner. That is, the host machine directory tree includes a root mount point of the volume and a child mount point that points to the root mount point, so that the application instance can access the volume through the root mount point on the host machine directory tree, thereby achieving the purpose of using, by means of the volume, a storage system of the host machine as a storage facility for realizing data sharing and persistence of the application instance. Further, the plurality of application instances all access the volume by using the root mount point, thereby saving memory resources of the host machine.
assignee: Cloud Intelligence Assets Holding (Singapore) Private Limited

title: External lint filtering device, washing system and control method
abstract: An external lint filtering device, a washing system, and a control method. The lint filtering device includes: a filter module for receiving water to be filtered for filtering; the lint filtering device has a water inlet in communication with the filter module for connecting to an external pipe; and a detection module for detecting whether the water inlet is connected to the external pipe. The external lint filtering device can be directly connected to a washing equipment to achieve a filtering function while not occupying the internal space of the washing equipment. By providing the detection module, the problem of the lint filtering device leaking at the water inlet when the water inlet is not connected to the external pipe, thereby failing to perform an effective filtering function, can be avoided.
assignee: Qingdao Haier Washing Machine Co., Ltd.; Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd.

title: Tumor fraction and outcome association in a real-world non-small cell lung cancer (nsclc) cohort using a methylation-based circulating tumor dna (ctdna) assay
abstract: Provided herein are methods of determining a molecular response score for use in predictive models, including scoring based on epigenetic methylation based detection of mutant allele fraction. The molecular response score may be used to monitor and guide administration of treatment to a subject.

title: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for test case generation
abstract: A method, an apparatus, a device and a storage medium for test case generation are provided. The method includes: receiving a test case generation request for at least one functional block in an application; obtaining a data structure declaration related to a test case of the at least one functional block in response to the test case generation request; and generating, using a model, a plurality of test cases for the at least one functional block at least based on the data structure declaration and logical architecture information of the at least one functional block.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.; Lemon Inc.

title: System and method for automated dynamic characterization of hybrid switches and busbar for use therewith
abstract: In accordance with various embodiments of the present disclosure, a system for dynamically characterizing switching behavior of power semiconductors is provided. In some embodiments, the system comprises a storage device for different sets of test parameters to be tested on a first power semiconductor switch of a first type and a second power semiconductor switch of a second type, each set of test parameters comprising a gate turn-on order, a gate turn-off order, a delay on duration, and a delay off duration; a processing element to retrieve the different sets of test parameters one at a time; gate drivers to, for each of the different sets of test parameters, receive signals corresponding to a retrieved set of test parameters and turning the first and second power semiconductor switches on and off accordingly; and a data capture device to capture data as the power semiconductor switches turn on and off.

title: Touch enabled graphical user interfaces and systems for distributing real time content
abstract: Systems and methods are described for generating and presenting a distilled feedback for an entity. In response to receiving a prompt identifying an entity, a system generates an entity identifier and retrieval parameters, executes a multi-tier retrieval cascade to obtain feedback items, and terminates the cascade upon satisfaction of a sufficiency gate. The system normalizes feedback items, generates classification outputs including polarity and intensity, selects strong feedback items, and computes a distilled sentiment ratio indicating positive and negative proportions. A client application renders an interactive user interface element indicating the ratio and, in response to user selection, presents supporting citations corresponding to positive or negative feedback, ordered based on ranking signals. For at least one citation, the system serves a cached rendered video citation when available and otherwise presents a non-video citation representation while asynchronously generating the rendered video citation and replacing the non-video citation representation after completion.

title: Power control method and device for transmitting inter-terminal physical shared channel in shared resource pool
abstract: An operating method of a first device ( 100 ) in a wireless communication system is presented. The method comprises the steps of: determining, on the basis of a use of inter-device physical shared channel transmission, a first transmission power for first inter-device physical shared channel transmission to be performed using a first resource in a shared spectrum; and performing the first inter-device physical shared channel transmission on the basis of the first transmission power and the first resource, wherein the first transmission power can be determined on the basis of power control parameters set for each use of the inter-device physical shared channel transmission.

title: Foldable bassinet, bassinet lock, and bassinet release
abstract: A foldable bassinet including a center tube, at least two frames, and at least two frame connectors. Each frame connector is disposed on a corresponding frame. The center tube is connected between the at least two frame connectors. At least one of the frame connectors includes a bassinet lock, a first tube and a second tube. The bassinet lock includes a first hinge fixed to the first tube, a second hinge fixed to the second tube and rotatably connected to the first hinge, and a locking hub disposed on the center tube and slidably located between the first hinge and the second hinge. When the bassinet lock is unlocked, the center tube is movable in an upward direction and the foldable bassinet is movable from an unfolded position to a folded position.

title: Kneeling support system
abstract: A kneeling support system is disclosed for supporting a user on framing members, such as joists, during construction or maintenance activities. The system includes one or more kneeling support devices wearable on a user's legs and a plurality of platform assemblies configured for removable placement on individual framing members. Each platform assembly includes a platform, a saddle defining a channel sized to receive the framing member, retention teeth disposed within the channel, and brace ribs coupling the platform to the saddle. Carry apertures facilitate manual placement and removal of the platform assemblies. The platform assemblies are manually positionable to provide localized and distributed support surfaces that cooperate with the kneeling support devices to transfer user load to the framing members, improve stability, and permit safe traversal and work without requiring fixed bridging structures or continuous spanning between framing members.

title: Image processing device
abstract: An image processing device includes an arithmetic operation device. The arithmetic operation device detects an object for each of a plurality of images imaged by a plurality of cameras, estimates a distance to the object for each of the plurality of images, determines a feature point that can be acquired in any of the plurality of images among feature points of the object using the estimated distance to the object for each of the plurality of images and camera parameters of the plurality of cameras, obtains a feature amount around the determined feature point for each of the plurality of images, collates feature amounts of the plurality of images, and measures the distance to the object based on a result of collating the feature amounts.

title: Fc containing polypeptides with altered glycosylation and reduced effector function
abstract: Provided are binding polypeptides (e.g., antibodies), and drug conjugates thereof, comprising an Fc domain with an altered glycosylation profile and reduced effector function. In particular embodiment, the Fc domain comprises: an asparagine residue at amino acid position 298, according to EU numbering; and a serine or threonine residue at amino acid position 300, according to EU numbering. Also provided are nucleic acids encoding the antigen-binding polypeptides, recombinant expression vectors and host cells for making such antigen-binding polypeptides. Methods of using the antigen-binding polypeptides disclosed herein to treat disease are also provided.

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: The present invention aims at avoiding a situation where convenience of a user is impaired while securing an effect of power-saving control. When a plurality of target devices are in a normal state, a control portion ( 51 ) causes an organic electro-luminescence display panel ( 3   b ) to display a first menu screen that includes a first background image in a color other than black and a plurality of first icon images provided on the first background image (S 102 ). Further, when the plurality of target devices are shifted from the normal state to a pause state, the control portion ( 51 ) causes the organic electro-luminescence display panel ( 3   b ) to display a second menu screen that includes a second background image in black and a plurality of second icon images provided on the second background image (S 110 ).

title: 1300-mpa-grade-or-higher cold-rolled steel sheet and manufacturing method therefor
abstract: Disclosed in the present invention are a 1300-MPa-grade-or-higher cold-rolled steel sheet and a manufacturing method therefor. The cold-rolled steel sheet comprises Fe and inevitable impurity elements, and further comprises the following chemical elements in percentages by mass: 0.10-0.30% of C, 0.1-0.5% of Si, 0.8-2.5% of Mn, 0.01-0.03% of Al, 0.001-0.003% of B, and 0-0.05% of Ti, wherein the mass percentage contents of C and Mn satisfy: C+Mn/6≥0.35%. By means of a reasonable chemical component design and a reasonable manufacturing process, the 1300-MPa-grade-or-higher cold-rolled steel sheet has an ultrahigh strength, and also has good resistance to delayed cracking and good bending performance.

title: Memory disaggregation method, computing system implementing the method
abstract: Disclosed is a memory disaggregation computing system including a host server and a memory device connected through a compute express link (CXL) network, in which a computing complex of the host server is connected to a memory resource of the memory device through a CXL packet transmitted through the CXL network, and executes an application program by using the memory resource.
assignee: Korea Advanced Institute Of Science And Technology

title: Battery cell classification control apparatus and method of controlling the same
abstract: A battery cell classification control apparatus includes a communication circuit configured to receive thickness data from a measurement device that is configured to measure a thickness of a battery cell; and a processor configured to calculate a predicted thickness by predicting a final thickness of the battery cell to be packaged based on the thickness data, to set a grade of each battery cell based on the predicted thickness, and when the battery cell is packaged, to control the battery cell to be classified according to the grade.

title: Nestable and stackable storage bins
abstract: Nestable and stackable storage bins have bump-ins formed in their sidewalls such that the storage bins are rotationally non-symmetric. The bump-ins are configured and located such that a top storage bin can nest within a bottom storage bin when the two storage bins are oriented in the same direction. On the other hand, the top storage bin rests on interior support columns formed by the bump-ins when the top storage bin is rotated to a different orientation relative to the bottom storage bin, thus allowing the support storage bins to be stacked on top of each other. A disclosed storage bin is rectangular with two long sidewalls and two short sides; bump-ins at two adjacent corners where a short sidewall of the storage bin meets the two long sidewalls of the storage bin; and another bump-in in the middle of the opposite short sidewall of the storage bin.

title: Hybrid electric engine oil tank with heat exchange capability
abstract: An aircraft propulsion system includes a core engine that is configured to drive a propulsive fan, at least one electric machine that generates thermal energy during operation, a thermal management system that is configured to generate a lubricant flow that accepts the thermal energy generated from the at least one electric machine, an oil tank that is configured to supply and store lubricant from the thermal management system, the oil tank includes a heat exchange surface in thermal communication with a cooling flow for cooling lubricant stored within the oil tank, and a passage that is configured to direct the cooling flow to the heat exchange surface of the oil tank.

title: Interplay between in-loop filtering and video tiles
abstract: Methods, apparatus and systems for processing video are described. One example method includes performing a conversion between a video comprising a video unit and a bitstream of the video, wherein the bitstream conforms to a format rule, and wherein the format rule specifies that a first syntax element indicating whether an in-loop filtering operation is performed across slice boundaries is conditionally included in the bitstream responsive to whether or how the video unit is partitioned into slices.
assignee: Beijing Bytedance Network Technology Co., Ltd.; Bytedance Inc.

title: Carrier frequency planning and sounding result reuse in beamforming
abstract: A system and a method are disclosed for carrier frequency planning in beamforming. The method comprises transmitting, with a first access point (AP 1 ), an AP1 frequency reference frame at an AP1 carrier frequency f c1  and obtaining, with a second access point (AP 2 ), a synchronized AP 2  carrier frequency f c2  based on the AP1 carrier frequency f c1 . The method further comprises transmitting, with the AP 2 , an AP 2  frequency alignment frame using the synchronized AP 2  carrier frequency f c2 . Also disclosed are system and methods for sounding results reuse.

title: Material search support device, method, and program
abstract: A material search support device: acquires product information collected from documents on the internet for each of a plurality of products, the product information including basic configuration information of the products, blending ratios of materials included in the products, and specific information including at least one of physical properties of the products, biomass content of the products, and process conditions during use of the products; estimates one or more candidates for material blending ratios and specific information with respect to the basic configuration information of a designated product using an estimation model trained to estimate material blending ratios and specific information with respect to the basic configuration information of the products based on the acquired product information; calculates, for each of the estimated candidates, environmental impact indicators based on the material blending ratios and the specific information represented by each of the candidates; and outputs support information that associates each of the candidates with the environmental impact indicators calculated by the calculation unit.

title: Methods for delivering agents with pre-filled syringes to minimize intraocular inflammation
abstract: A method of treating an eye disorder in a patient that may include administering a medicament to the patient with a prefilled syringe, wherein the administration of the medicament with the prefilled syringe is configured to treat the eye disorder and decrease a rate of likelihood of an ocular infection to the patient's eye.

title: Toilet
abstract: A toilet including a toilet body having a bowl portion with a rear outflow, a water chamber provided in the rear region of the toilet body, at least a first water-outlet opening that opens horizontally and tangentially relative to a surface of the bowl portion, and a second water-outlet opening that opens in the downward direction in the rear region of the bowl portion. Both water-outlet openings communicate with the water chamber. Relative to the longitudinal center plane of the bowl portion, the second water-outlet opening is arranged eccentrically and with an offset toward the same side as the first water-outlet opening and communicates with the water chamber via a channel portion that runs at an angle >0° relative to the longitudinal center plane such that water flowing out of the second opening contacts a rear surface-area portion of the bowl portion that delimits outflow at the rear.

title: Systems and methods for sealing food containers
abstract: A sealing system for food containers is disclosed. The sealing system comprises a frame and a conveyor system for conveying food containers through the sealing system, wherein the conveyor system is supported by the frame. A sealing unit is configured to receive food containers from the conveyor system, wherein the sealing unit comprises a first sealing tool and a second sealing tool configured to be pressed together in order to seal each food container positioned therebetween, wherein the sealing unit is supported by the frame, and wherein the conveyor system is further configured to convey sealed food containers away from the sealing unit. A power monitoring unit is configured to measure or estimate a power consumption of at least the sealing unit of the sealing system. A control unit is configured to calculate an energy consumption per sealed food container based on the power consumption and the number of sealing operations performed per unit time, and output an indication derived from the calculated energy consumption per sealed food container.

title: Transistor device and method for forming a recess for a trench gate electrode
abstract: A method includes: forming a trench in a major surface of a semiconductor substrate, the trench having a side wall extending from a base to the major surface; forming a first insulating layer on the base, side wall and major surface; inserting a first conductive material in the trench that at least partially covers the first insulation layer and forms a field plate in a lower portion of the trench; removing the first insulating layer from the major surface and side wall at an upper portion of the trench, exposing semiconductor material of the semiconductor substrate; forming a second insulating layer on the major surface and that fills the trench and covers the conductive material; removing the second insulating layer from the major surface; and partially removing the second insulating layer from the trench to form a recess for a gate electrode in the second insulating layer in the trench.

title: CYSTEAMINE FOR THE TREATMENT, MITIGATION AND PREVENTION OF CORONAVIRAL, E.G., SARS-CoV-2, INFECTIONS
abstract: Provided herein are methods for the treatment, mitigation, and prevention of viral infections (e.g., coronavirus infections (e.g., severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), etc.), etc.) and diseases (e.g., Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)) associated therewith by the administration of cysteamine or derivatives thereof to a subject.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of Michigan

title: Systems and Methods for Processing Tissue
abstract: Embodiments of the present specification provide systems and methods for holding one or more tissues, such as veins, such that the tissue remains open in a chamber while undergoing orbital shaking with various solutions and to allow uniform treatment during a decellularization process. A frame is held on a stand to which the tissues are attached and comprises a tension inducing mechanism to cause the tissues to controllably stretch. The frame is removed from the stand, with the tissue attached to it, and placed in a decellularization chamber for uniform treatment of the tissue.

title: Clevis pin arrangement for a hydraulic tool
abstract: A power tool includes a tool body having a user input and a controller to control operation in response to a first signal from the user input, a yoke coupled to the tool body with a first leg defining a first aperture and a second leg defining a second aperture, and a clevis. The clevis includes a pin insertable into the apertures and rotatable relative to the yoke to transition between locked and unlocked configurations to removably couple a jaw assembly to the yoke, and a lever at a second end of the pin positioned external to the yoke. A sensor is coupled to the tool body, yoke, or housing to sense the clevis configuration, sending a second signal to the controller to provide an indication to a user.

title: Systems and methods for battery-assisted cooking in an oven range appliance
abstract: A cooking appliance including a cabinet defining a cooking chamber having one or more chamber heaters, a main power connection to a main supply of electrical power at a first voltage, an auxiliary power connection to a battery supply of electrical power at a second voltage, a power switching system, and a controller.
