abstract: An intermediate assembly of a liquid medicine administration device includes: a first unit comprising a hollow cylindrical housing configured to house a syringe filled with a liquid medicine, the housing comprising a fixing portion; and a second unit attached to the fixing portion of the housing, the second unit comprising a drive unit configured to bias a gasket of the syringe toward a distal end of the housing, wherein at least a part of the second unit is housed in the housing of the first unit. The first unit and the second unit are configured to be placed in a provisional fixing state in which the second unit is fixed to the fixing portion of the first unit in a first configuration, and in a main fixing state in which the second unit is fixed to the first unit in a second configuration different from the first configuration.

title: Manufacturing method of semiconductor structure
abstract: A manufacturing method of a semiconductor structure including the following steps is provided. A wafer structure is provided. A first wafer is bonded to the wafer structure. The first wafer includes a first substrate and a first device layer located on the first substrate. After the first wafer is bonded to the wafer structure, a first opening is formed in the first substrate. The first opening exposes the first device layer. A dielectric layer is formed on the first substrate and in the first opening. A first through-substrate via (TSV) passing through the first opening is formed in the dielectric layer. The first TSV extends into the first device layer.

title: Particulate nutritional composition
abstract: The invention relates to a particulate nutritional composition for infants with less powder segregation, wherein the particulate nutritional composition comprises milk formula particles and probiotic particles, which differ in particle size. The invention further relates to a process for producing the particulate nutritional composition and to a use of the particulate nutritional composition.

title: Electronic component
abstract: An extended portion of an electronic component includes a first rectangular portion, a second rectangular portion, and a coupling portion. The first rectangular portion is coupled to a first external electrode and has a rectangular shape. The second rectangular portion is coupled to a main body portion and has a rectangular shape. The coupling portion couples the first rectangular portion and the second rectangular portion. In a third direction intersecting first and second directions, the width of the first rectangular portion is smaller than the width of the main body portion. In the third direction, the width of the second rectangular portion is larger than the width of the first rectangular portion. The width of the coupling portion in the third direction is formed to be narrower toward the first rectangular portion.

title: Method of forming a semiconductor device with air gaps for low capacitance interconnects
abstract: A method of forming a semiconductor device with air gaps for low capacitance interconnects. The method includes providing a substrate containing raised metal features with a top area and a sidewall, and a void between the raised metal features, filling the void with a sacrificial fill material, and selectively depositing a blocking layer on the sacrificial fill material. The method further includes depositing a cap layer on the top area of the raised metal features, where the cap layer has an overhang that extends past the sidewall, removing the blocking layer and the sacrificial fill material between the raised metal features, and depositing a dielectric film, where the dielectric film forms an air gap between the raised metal features below the overhang.

title: Real-time damping control method for advanced driving assistance system steering
abstract: A computer-implemented method includes operating a motor of a steering system of a vehicle as the vehicle travels relative to a planned path to execute a first torque command. The first torque command causes the steering system of the vehicle to guide the vehicle toward the planned path. Responsive to operating the motor to execute the first torque command, and based on measured feedback from the vehicle, the method includes adjusting a parameter set of a feedforward control command function. Responsive to adjusting the parameter set of the feedforward control command function, the method includes generating a second torque command using the feedforward control command function having the adjusted parameter set. The method includes operating the motor of the steering system to execute the second torque command to cause the steering system of the vehicle to guide the vehicle toward the planned path.

title: Telescopic conveyor
abstract: A telescopic conveyor including: a base section in which each of a first side frame member and a second side frame member includes a first cam roller support assembly coupled to the base frame and including a first cam roller assembly and a second cam roller assembly; and an extensible section movable relative to the base section and including a first side frame member and a second side frame member opposite the first side frame member; wherein as the extensible section moves relative to the base section between a retracted position and an extended position, the first cam roller assembly of the first cam roller support assembly engages a lower flange of the first side frame member of the extensible section and the second cam roller assembly of the first cam roller support assembly engages a lower flange of the second side frame member of the extensible section.

title: Low Offset Drive Motor Assembly for a Pool Cover
abstract: A low-offset drive motor system for a pool cover including an in-line torque limiter assembly dimensioned and configured to be positioned substantially within the rope reel of the drive motor system.

title: Method for the manufacture of a catalyst-containing electrode layer
abstract:
The present disclosure is directed to a method for producing a catalyst-containing electrode layer on a substrate, in particular a catalyst layer for fuel cells, electrolysers, or other chemical or electrochemical reactors. The method comprises the following steps:
         (A) generating an electrode layer on the substrate, wherein the electrode layer contains support particles for the catalyst to be generated thereon;   and simultaneously or subsequently:   (B) generating the catalyst on at least one part of the support particles present in the electrode layer generated according to step (A) with decomposition of a catalyst precursor present in the electrode layer and not merely at the surface,   wherein the support particles and/or the catalyst precursor is/are applied on the substrate via a two-dimensional, film-like application method.

title: Vehicle
abstract: A remotely operated vehicle for moving on a rail system includes a first set of wheels, a second set of wheels, a wheel displacement assembly, and a wheel drive assembly. The rail system includes a first set of parallel rails and a second set of parallel rails arranged perpendicular to the first set of rails. The first set of wheels includes a first pair of wheels and a second pair of wheels, the first and second pairs of wheels arranged on opposite sides of a vehicle frame, allowing movement of the vehicle along a first direction on the rail system during use. The second set of wheels includes a third pair of wheels and a fourth pair of wheels, the third and fourth pairs of wheels arranged on opposite sides of the vehicle frame, allowing movement of the vehicle along a second direction on the rail system during use. The second direction is perpendicular to the first direction. The wheel displacement assembly is mounted to the vehicle frame and arranged to move the second set of wheels in a vertical direction relative to the vehicle frame between a first position. The first set of wheels allows movement of the vehicle along the first direction, and a second position. The second set of wheels allows movement of the vehicle along the second direction. The wheel drive assembly includes a first motor, a drive band, and a band drive wheel. The first motor is operatively connected to rotate the band drive wheel. The drive band interconnects the band drive wheel and the third pair of wheels. The third pair of wheels and the first motor are mounted to a cross-plate which extends horizontally and is arranged to move vertically as part of the wheel displacement assembly. The third pair of wheels and the band drive wheel are attached to the cross-plate such that the cross-plate supports the third pair of wheels and the band drive wheel are in a fixed spatial configuration where each wheel of the third pair of wheels is located at an end portion of the cross-plate and the band drive wheel is positioned at a central portion of the cross-plate.

title: Systems and methods for power distribution in electric aircraft
abstract: An aircraft includes a flight controller; a plurality of battery packs, at least some of which are located in one or more wings of the aircraft; a plurality of power distribution buses that are electrically isolated from each other; and six electric propulsion units electrically coupled to the battery packs via the power distribution buses and a plurality of contactors or fuses. Each of the battery packs is configured to provide power to three of the electric propulsion units. At least one of the electric propulsion units is configured to, after loss of one of the other electric propulsion units, increase an operating power to at least partially compensate for the loss.

title: Power supply circuit, power supply device, and power supply system
abstract: Provided are a power supply circuit, a power supply device, and a power supply system. The circuit includes: a bus; a first branch having a first end electrically connected to the bus, and a second end electrically connected to a first port; a second branch having a first end electrically connected to the bus, and a second end electrically connected to a second port; a plurality of third branches each having a first end electrically connected to the bus, and a second end electrically connected to a corresponding power port, each of the plurality of third branches being provided with a first switch; and a control circuit configured to control the first switch. Each of the first and second ports is configured to be connected to a load or an inverter. Each of the power ports is configured to be connected to a power grid or a power source.
assignee: Shanghai Sigeyuan Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Cross-Document Intelligent Authoring and Processing
abstract: Machine learning, artificial intelligence, and other computer-implemented methods are used to identify various semantically important chunks in documents, automatically label them with appropriate datatypes and semantic roles, and use this enhanced information to assist authors and to support downstream processes. Chunk locations, datatypes, and semantic roles can often be automatically determined from what is here called “context”, to wit, the combination of their formatting, structure, and content; those of adjacent or nearby content; overall patterns of occurrence in a document, and similarities of all these things across documents (mainly but not exclusively among documents in the same document set). Similarity is not limited to exact or fuzzy string or property comparisons, but may include similarity of natural language grammatical structure, ML (machine learning) techniques such as measuring similarity of word, chunk, and other embeddings, and the datatypes and semantic roles of previously-identified chunks.

title: Expandable hose and hose component
abstract: An expandable hose and a hose component are provided. The expandable hose includes at least one layer of elastic inner hose having a drainage channel therein and being configured to axially extend and undergo a radial elastic geometric deformation and to axially retract and radially recover; an elastic braided layer tightly sleeving the elastic inner hose, the elastic inner hose and the elastic braided layer is in an interference fit state, and the elastic braided layer is configured to be driven by the elastic inner hose to axially extend and retract and to restrict a radial expansion of the elastic inner hose when the elastic inner hose undergoes a radial elastic geometric deformation; an elastic outer layer tightly sleeving the elastic braided layer and spaced apart from the elastic inner hose, the elastic outer layer is configured to deform synchronously with the elastic braided layer.
assignee: Yangjiang New Sports Technology Products Co., Ltd.

title: Transmodal input fusion for a wearable system
abstract: A method of transmodal input fusion for a wearable system. The method is performed under control of a hardware processor of a wearable system. The method includes identifying a transmodal fixation point, defining an extended region of interest (ROI) based on a transmodal fixation time or a predicted dwell time near the transmodal fixation point, determining that the ROI intersects with a rendering element, determining a rendering augmentation that is compatible with the ROI, the transmodal fixation time, or the predicted dwell time, and activating the rendering augmentation.

title: A-Frame Brace
abstract: A portable A-frame type merchandising sign has an adjustable locking mechanism for securing the frame. A center portion consisting of an interior and exterior sleeve where the elongated portion of the adjustable interior sleeve can slide in and out of the Exterior Sleeve and be locked in place by a particular locking method. The adjustable interior sleeve also comprises a support end block that acts as the resting spot for the leg portion of the A-frame. This adjustable feature increases the ability to display the A-frame in a wider variety of locations. The securing-of-the legs feature increases the stability of the A-frame when in its upright position.

title: Laser wafer with an array of active regions having different reflectivities created using a focused ion beam tool
abstract: A system and method for creating a laser wafer with an array of active regions having different reflectivities created using a focused ion beam tool are disclosed. The semiconductor wafer may include a substrate, a first distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) formed on the substrate, a first active region formed on the first DBR, a second active region formed on the first DBR, a second DBR formed on the first and second active regions, and a contact layer formed on the second DBR. The first active region may include a base material and a first concentration of a doped material introduced by a focused ion beam tool to reflect at a first wavelength. The second active region may include the base material and a second concentration of the doped material introduced by the focused ion beam tool to reflect at a second wavelength.

title: Ulk1 inhibitor, preparation method therefor and use thereof
abstract: Provided are a ULK1 inhibitor, a preparation method therefor and a use thereof. Specifically, provided are a compound of formula 1 or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, a stereoisomer, a tautomer, a polymorph, a solvate, a hydrate, an N-oxide, an isotope labeled compound, a metabolite, an ester or a prodrug thereof, wherein X 1 , X 2 , X 3 , R 1 , R 2 , R 3 , R are as defined herein. Also provided are a pharmaceutical composition containing the compound, a treatment method using the compound, and a method for preparing the compound.

title: Managing work units using a dynamic locking data structure
abstract: Systems and methods for work unit management using a locking data structure include one or more computing resources and a plurality of processing units executing a plurality of threads to perform operations associated with the one or more computing resources, wherein a first thread of the plurality of threads is configured to: receive a work unit to be executed by the first thread of the plurality of threads, wherein the work unit is associated with a data structure comprising a queue of work units associated with a target resource of the one or more computing resources; determine, based on the data structure, that there is contention for the target resource among a plurality of work units received by the plurality of processing units; identify an owner thread of the plurality of threads that owns the data structure; and add the work unit to the queue of the data structure.

title: Real-time geo-locked content delivery network tokens
abstract: Techniques for providing streaming content include receiving, from a first user and at a first point in time, a first request for a link to streaming content. These techniques further include determining a geographic location of the first user based on the first request, generating a geo-specific token describing the geographic location of the first user, where the geo-specific token is periodically re-evaluated, and transmitting the link to the content to the first user, the link including the token. The techniques further include receiving, from the first user at a second point in time subsequent to the first point in time, a second request for the streaming content comprising the token, determining a current geographic location of the first user based on the second request, and in response to determining that the current geographic location does not satisfy a geographic access condition associated with the token, denying the second request.

title: Silicon carbide semiconductor device
abstract: A method of manufacturing a trench-type silicon carbide semiconductor device that includes a drift layer of a first conductivity type, a base layer of a second conductivity type formed on the drift layer, and a plurality of trenches penetrating through the base layer and reaching the drift layer. The method includes forming a co-doped region of the first conductivity type by introducing a first impurity of the first conductivity type and a second impurity of the second conductivity type into a portion of the drift layer between two of the plurality of trenches.

title: Cognitive query interpreter engine in a security management system
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer storage media for providing cognitive query interpretation using a cognitive query interpreter engine of a security management system are described. Cognitive query interpretation refers to the ability of the cognitive query interpretation engine to understand and process queries in a way that mimics human cognitive reasoning. This involves interpreting natural language inputs, identifying the user's intent, and dynamically selecting and querying appropriate data sources—such as logs, APIs, and threat intelligence databases—across different systems and technologies. The cognitive query interpretation engine interprets the query contextually, taking into account factors like user preferences, historical interactions, and the specific security scenario, to provide actionable responses. It leverages contextual analysis and neuro-symbolic reasoning to ensure actionable insights from complex datasets, transforming how users interact with and extract data. This not only enhances the user experience but ensures that users can continue their investigation or analysis with minimal friction.

title: System for multi-user collaboration within a virtual reality environment
abstract: Real-world users of an event simulation system can playback a digital representation of an event that is mapped onto a virtual model of a real-world venue to simulate the event being presented at a real-world venue. As the real-world users are viewing this virtual event, these users can virtually interact with the virtual event, for example, move around the virtual event to view the virtual event at various locations and/or modify parameters, characteristics, and/or attributes of the virtual event. Thereafter, the event simulation system can propagate these modifications across multiple real-world users of the event simulation system to allow these real-world users to collaboratively interact with the virtual event.

title: Systems, methods, and storage media for sensor remote firmware updating based on internet of things (iot) large models
abstract: A system, a method, and a storage medium for sensor remote firmware updating based on a IoT large model are provided. The method comprises: determining a plurality of sensor update groups according to data characteristics of a plurality of sensors and geographic locations of the sensors in an industrial grid region; determining an update priority of each of the sensor update groups according to task characteristics and transmission characteristics of the sensor update groups; determining update parameters of the sensor update groups according to the update priority, firmware characteristics, and a channel state distribution; generating update instructions and a firmware update package according to the update parameters; and sending the update instructions and the firmware update package to a perception control platform, and controlling the plurality of sensors in the sensor update groups to perform firmware updating based on the update instructions.
assignee: Chengdu Qinchuan Iot Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Anti-il-2 antibody combinations and methods of use thereof
abstract: Described herein are therapeutic methods for subjects having an unresectable locally advanced or metastatic cancer. The method includes administration of engineered anti-IL-2 antibodies in combination with an initial low dose of IL-2 and further include administration of at least one booster low doses of IL-2. Also described herein are combination therapies comprising engineered anti-IL-2 antibodies in combination with an immune checkpoint inhibitor such as nivolumab and an initial low dose of IL-2 and related therapeutic methods for subjects having an unresectable locally advanced or metastatic cancer, for example but not limited to cutaneous melanoma.

title: Image encoding/decoding method and apparatus, and recording medium storing bitstreams
abstract: An image decoding method and apparatus according to the present disclosure may comprise: obtaining residual information from a bitstream; deriving transform coefficients of a current block on the basis of the residual information; performing at least one of inverse quantization or inverse transform on the transform coefficients of the current block and deriving residual samples of the current block; and reconstructing the current block on the basis of the residual samples of the current block. In this case, the inverse transform is performed on the basis of a non-separable primary transform, and the non-separable primary transform may be applied on the basis of at least one of the size of a current block, a tree type, and a component type.

title: Systems and Methods for Brain-Based Detection of Late Talking
abstract: Systems and methods for diagnostic assessment of language development in accordance with embodiments of the invention are illustrated. One embodiment includes a method for assessing language development. The method includes steps for obtaining a set of low-level neurological measurements based on a first set of stimuli, wherein the set of low-level neurological measurements includes an onset response latency measurement, obtaining a set of high-level neurological measurements based on a second set of stimuli, wherein the set of high-level neurological measurements are based on a temporal response function (TRF) method, obtaining a set of developmental measurements based on at least a set of behavioral screening assessments, and computing a predicted developmental trajectory based on a combination of the set of low-level neurological measurements, the set of high-level neurological measurements, and the set of developmental measurements.

title: Bleeding control device
abstract: Bleeding control devices, systems and methods for mitigating bleeding from a wound of a patient. The bleeding control device includes a housing and inflatable balloon. The housing defines a tool opening that allows for insertion of a tool of the bleeding control system from one side of the housing to extend through the housing and beyond a second, opposite side of the housing and into the inflatable balloon. A user of a rod tool or inflation tube tool (or catheter) can manipulate the tool within the inflatable balloon to navigate the inflatable balloon within a wound of a patient before, during and/or after inflation of the inflatable balloon in order to mitigate bleeding of the patient. A strap for use with a bleeding control device that is configured to provide external pressure on an abdomen of the patient while the bleeding control device provides pressure internally within the abdomen.

title: Clean Room Generation for Data Collaboration and Executing Clean Room Task in Data Processing Pipeline
abstract: A data processing service facilitates the creation and processing of data processing pipelines that process data processing jobs defined with respect to a set of tasks in a sequence and with data dependencies associated with each separate task such that the output from one task is used as input for a subsequent task. In various embodiments, the set of tasks include at least one cleanroom task that is executed in a cleanroom station and at least one non-cleanroom task executed in an execution environment of a user where each task is configured to read one or more input datasets and transform the one or more input datasets into one or more output datasets.

title: Bacteriophages as a tool to manipulate gut commensal immune-modulation activity
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the microbiome field. More specifically, the present disclosure relates to bacteriophages as a tool to manipulate gut immune-modulatory activity and uses thereof for therapy. More specifically, the present disclosure provides methods and tools for modulating an immune response in a subject in need thereof, by applying bacteriophage that modulates the phenotype of at least one bacteria in a subject.

title: Porous carbon material and preparation method thereof, silicon-carbon material, and applications thereof
abstract: A porous carbon material having a sphericity of a, where 0.7≤a≤0.97; the porous carbon material includes potassium element; and based on a mass of the porous carbon material, a mass proportion of the potassium element is b ppm, where 1≤b≤2998.

title: System and method for detecting object in generalized way based on lidar and artificial intelligence
abstract: A system for performing artificial-intelligence (AI)-based object recognition using sensor data obtained from a LiDAR sensor. The system includes a processor and a memory storing instructions that, when executed, converts “N” LiDAR points constituting point cloud data into a voxel image including “M” voxels, extracts features for object recognition from the voxel image using a backbone network, generates Bird's Eye View (BEV)-based voxel features from the extracted features, and recognizes an object via an inference network based on voxel-level vision-language embedding features obtained by inputting the BEV-based voxel features into an MLP (Multi-layer Perceptron) neural network with a unified single head.
assignee: Hyundai Motor Company; Kia Corporation; Seoul National University R&Db Foundation

title: Mega-constellation business device
abstract: A satellite constellation forming system forms a satellite constellation which is composed of a satellite group and in which the satellite group cooperatively provides a service. The satellite constellation has a plurality of orbital planes in each of which a plurality of satellites fly at the same nominal orbital altitude. A satellite constellation forming unit continues providing the service while avoiding a collision between satellites by both or one of control of an orbital altitude and control of a passage timing of a satellite group flying in a region where the plurality of orbital planes intersect.

title: Model training method, multimedia data classification method, and related apparatus
abstract: A model training method is disclosed. The model training method includes separately inputting extracted multimedia data into a teacher network and a student network. The student network is trained based on a difference between a feature output by the teacher network and a feature output by the student network. The student network can output a feature that is similar to an output feature of the teacher network when processing non-AI-generated multimedia data. The student network can output a feature that is greatly different from an output feature of the teacher network when processing AI-generated multimedia data.

title: Substrate processing apparatus, substrate processing method and method of fabricating semiconductor device
abstract: A substrate processing apparatus includes: a chamber body; a substrate support provided in the chamber body; a gas supplier configured to supply a process gas into the chamber body; a plasma generator configured to generate plasma from the process gas; a showerhead configured to supply, onto a substrate, a process etchant generated from the plasma, the process etchant including a first etchant and a second etchant; a first analyzer which is connected to the chamber body and configured to measure a composition rate of the process etchant; and a controller which is connected to at least one of the chamber body, the gas supplier, the plasma generator, and the showerhead, and configured to perform a process control based on a process result according to the composition rate of the process etchant measured by the first analyzer.

title: Vehicle control method and device, remote control terminal, and storage medium
abstract: A vehicle control method includes: acquiring first data within a preset time period, where the first data is configured to characterize data generated in response to a user performing vehicle remote control related operations on the remote control terminal; determining a wake-up timing based on the first data; and in response to the wake-up timing arriving, waking up a vehicle-to-everything terminal in the vehicle.
assignee: Zhejiang Zeekr Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.; Zhejiang Geely Holding Group Co., Ltd.

title: Pump and domestic appliance having such a pump
abstract: A pump for a washing machine has a pump chamber with an inflow, with an outflow and with a pump chamber bottom, an impeller for conveying water inside the pump chamber, and optionally several flow guide vanes radially outside the impeller which are fixedly arranged and extend helically towards the pump chamber bottom. The pump is designed as a centrifugal pump. In accordance with the invention, at least one arched or curved guide blade is arranged either on at least one flow guide vane or on a support ring below of impeller.

title: Measuring apparatus, measured data utilization system, and acquisition method of measured data
abstract: A measuring apparatus for acquiring measurement data obtained by measuring a maintenance work for a semiconductor manufacturing device by a worker by using a 3D sensor mounted in a space where the maintenance work is performed. The measuring apparatus includes an object identifying unit for identifying an object included in an image of raw data acquired from the 3D sensor; a coordinate transforming unit for obtaining a position in the space of the identification object; a work determining unit for determining a work process executed by the worker on the basis of movements of one or more identified objects; a region setting unit for setting a region which is permitted/prohibited to be output in accordance with the work process; and a data limiting unit for generating limited data obtained by making a region which is prohibited to be output invisible in the image of the raw data.

title: Ai based recipe generation by integrating ingredient pairing score determined from flavor spaces
abstract: A method and system for Al based recipe generation by integrating ingredient pairing score determined from flavor spaces is disclosed. Current available recipe generation systems do not focus on creating recipes optimized for the specific nutritional needs associated with various health conditions. The method disclosed incorporates nutritional and flavor profiles for pairing suitable ingredients and generating recipes. The method identifies a primary ingredient based on conditional nutrient-based filtering technique. Based on the selected primary ingredient the method employs flavor compound-based embeddings to assess flavor compatibility between this primary ingredient and other potential ingredients, identifying suitable secondary ingredients for the recipe. The secondary ingredients are determined by determining ingredient pairing score using directional similarity measure, orientation factor and spatial proximity measure from molecular embedding matrices represented as flavor spaces of the primary ingredient and the secondary ingredients. The method generates personalized recipes used to manage various lifestyle related diseases.

title: Flighted belt conveyor and scraper
abstract: Conveyor systems with scraper assemblies to scrape bulk products and residue adhering to the outer conveying surfaces and the faces of the flights of conveyor belts. The scraper assemblies include a scraping element and an adjustment mechanism to move the scraping element along the conveyor belt's outer conveying surface and up the flights to scrape off material adhering to the conveying surface and the faces of the flights.

title: Medical device data platform
abstract: Example medical device data platforms are disclosed herein. In an example, the platform may include at least one integration device to obtain information originating from a plurality of implantable medical devices manufactured by a plurality of manufacturers and implanted in a plurality of patients. The system may also include an actionability evaluator to process the accessed information and generate provider-oriented information.

title: Tiled collimator array
abstract: A tiled collimator array is disclosed. The tiled collimator array includes, a plurality of endcaps each being connected to an optical fiber at a back end, wherein the endcaps are selected from hexagonal endcaps and quadrangular endcaps; and an adhesive gluing the endcaps to each other, wherein the endcaps are stacked together in a compacted structure.

title: High-Definition Distributed Fiber Optic Sensing (HD-DFOS) for Smart Intersection and Road Conditions Diagnostics
abstract: A high-definition distributed fiber optic sensing (HD-DFOS) system and method for traffic monitoring and road condition diagnostics. The system utilizes optical fibers deployed along roadsides to capture high-temporal-resolution vibrational signals, capturing thousands of frames per second to clearly identify ground vibration wavefronts. A high-performance, multi-process computational platform utilizing shared memory converts 16-bit multi-channel transient traces into pseudo-color RGB images. A “You Only Look Once” (YOLO) object detection model is applied to the pseudo-color images to classify the sources of mechanical disturbances, distinguishing between vehicle-induced vibrations, ambient ground disturbances, and impacts with surface defects like potholes or cracks in real-time

title: Image forming method and image forming apparatus
abstract: An image forming method is provided that includes discharging a pretreatment liquid and an ink onto a recording medium by an inkjet method to form an image. The pretreatment liquid includes an aggregating agent, a landing time difference between a droplet of the pretreatment liquid and a droplet of the ink is 0.05 seconds or more and 2.0 seconds or less, and −5.0 mN/m≤σ1−σ2≤5.0 mN/m is satisfied, where σ1 is a dynamic surface tension of the pretreatment liquid and σ2 is a dynamic surface tension of the ink as measured at 25° C. and a lifetime of 150 ms.

title: Signaling designs enabling unequal modulation transmission on spatial streams in wireless communications
abstract: Techniques pertaining to signaling designs to enable unequal modulation (UEQM) transmission on spatial streams in wireless communications are described. An apparatus (e.g., a station (STA)) performs a wireless communication with a physical-layer protocol data unit (PPDU) by either: (a) generating and transmitting the PPDU; or (b) receiving and processing the PPDU. The wireless communication is performed with signaling indicating information of the UEQM over multiple spatial streams with respect to a transmission of the PPDU.

title: Breaker Lockout with Pivoting Clamping Surface
abstract: A breaker lockout device for a circuit breaker is provided. The breaker lockout device includes a body positionable on the circuit breaker when a toggle of the circuit breaker is in an OFF position and a first securing mechanism to engage the body with the circuit breaker. The breaker lockout device further includes a second securing mechanism to lock the toggle in the OFF position. The breaker lockout device further includes a pivoting clamping member within the body, configured to adjust to the toggle's angle and engage a lower surface of the toggle with full-surface contact during locking.

title: Anode active material, method for preparing same, and lithium secondary battery including same
abstract: Proposed are an anode active material, a method for preparing the same, an electrode including the anode active material, and a secondary battery including the same, in which when a charge curve of a charge-discharge cycle measured by incremental capacity analysis (ICA) performed on a half-cell is converted into a differential capacity versus voltage curve (dQ/dV) by normalizing the charge curve with respect to the total charge capacity of each cell, the maximum peak height (Peak A) observed in a voltage region of 0.4 to 0.5 V is equal to or greater than 3.5 V −1 .

title: Method for performing a pore size test on a mesh wick
abstract: Disclosed is a device and method for performing pore size testing on a mesh wick. The device includes a housing and a tube positioned through the housing. The housing includes an internal surface. The tube includes an exterior surface. The exterior surface of the tube and the internal surface of the housing cooperatively define an internal cavity therebetween. The device further includes an inlet pipe extending from the housing. The inlet pipe connects to the internal cavity to allow a fluid to enter the internal cavity through the inlet pipe. The device further includes an expandable bladder positioned around a portion of the housing. The expandable bladder includes a first end and a second end. The portion of the housing is to allow the fluid to exit the internal cavity through the housing into the expandable bladder which causes the expandable bladder to expand.

title: Stator for rotating electric machine
abstract: A stator for a rotating electric machine according to the present invention includes: a stator core including a plurality of slots, each of which extends in a radial direction, and which are aligned in a circumferential direction; and a coil, which includes a plurality of parallel coils for every phase, and which is wound in the circumferential direction to pass through a plurality of turns in the plurality of slots. The slot includes a first slot in which a first parallel coil is wound in a first turn on an inner diameter side and a second parallel coil is wound in a second turn on the inner diameter side, and a second slot in which the second parallel coil is wound in the first turn on the inner diameter side and the first parallel coil is wound in the second turn on the inner diameter side.

title: Recursive manufacturing facility for humanoid robots
abstract: A manufacturing system in which robots produced by the system are authorized to join a recursive workforce that performs manufacturing operations on subsequently produced robots. A genealogy store maintains, for each robot, a record identifying constituent components and the agents—including specific robots of the recursive workforce—that performed each manufacturing operation, encoding a multi-generational graph linking manufactured robots to the robots that manufactured them. Newly manufactured robots autonomously perform completion operations on themselves, including self-calibration using onboard perception without external measurement equipment, application of physical coverings to their own bodies, stress-testing through self-directed physical movement, and self-positioning within shipping containers. A production management system interfaces with vision-language-action models executing on the robots to transmit task specifications, receive manufacturing outcome data, and maintain traceability records, enabling the robots to perform assembly, quality inspection, and adaptive manipulation within the production facility.

title: Bendable shapeable heat plate structure
abstract: A bendable shapeable heat plate structure includes an inner bending plate, an outer bending plate, and a capillary structure. The inner bending plate has an inner concave portion with a surrounding inner sealing edge and includes first and second inner plate sections connected by an inner bending section. The outer bending plate is stacked with the inner bending plate and has an outer concave portion facing the inner concave portion and an outer sealing edge at its periphery, along with first and second outer plate sections connected by an outer bending section. The capillary structure is attached to the inner concave portion. At least one strip-shaped support structure is integrally formed on the outer concave portion, extends within the outer bending section toward the first and second outer plate sections, and abuts an inner surface of the inner bending section.

title: Fluoroalcohols as co-solvents for chemical synthesis and methods for producing the same
abstract: In one aspect, the disclosure relates to a method for the synthesis of penatfluoroisopropanols having a range of solubilities, acidity, basicity, and other physical properties. The method also allows the production of pentafluoroisopropanols having a chiral center. In some aspects, racemic mixtures of pentafluoroisopropanol derivatives can be separated by chiral chromatography or another method in order to isolate pure enantiomers. In one aspect, the disclosed method is compatible with a variety of pentafluoro-gem-diols and can be conducted under mild conditions with high yields. Also disclosed herein are pentafluoroisopropanols generated by the disclosed method and methods of using the pentafluoroisopropanols as solvents and co-solvents for organic synthesis, metal catalyzed reactions, asymmetric processes, carbohydrate chemistry, and medicinal chemistry.

title: Method and system for automatic determination of registration accuracy
abstract: Automatic determination of registration accuracy between a first image of a first object and a second image of the first object. Identifying a first image element in the first object by scanning the first image sequentially by image unit, and identifying a second image element in the first object by scanning the second image sequentially by the image unit. Registering the first image element to the second image element in a shared background coordinate space. Determining an accuracy of the registering by relating the first image element and the second image element to the shared background coordinate space, calculating a first distance between the first image element and a nearest point in the shared background coordinate space, and calculating a second distance between the second image element and the nearest point in the shared background coordinate space. Calculating a difference between the first distance and the second distance.

title: Method for power mode management of an interconnection protocol in an electronic device and electronic device
abstract: Method for power mode management of an interconnection protocol in an electronic device and an electronic device configured to communicate with another electronic device using an interconnection protocol are provided. The method comprises a plurality of steps as follows. A power mode for a forward link is determined by the electronic device, based on version information of the interconnection protocol of another electronic device, wherein the version information of the interconnection protocol of the another electronic device is obtained in a first stage of link initialization. The electronic device operates in the power mode for the forward link for a second stage of the link initialization following the first stage of the link initialization.

title: Slat wall bracket device
abstract: A slat wall bracket device includes a bracket wall and an arm coupled to an end of the bracket wall. The arm projects perpendicular from the end of the bracket wall. A jaw is coupled to the bracket wall. The jaw is spaced from the arm, aligned linearly with the arm, movable from a first position to a second position, and configured to secure a first wall slat between a surface of the jaw and a surface of the arm with the jaw in the second position. A hook projects outward from a front surface of the bracket wall.

title: System and method for prioritising maintenance actions in electric power grids
abstract: Disclosed is a computer-implemented method and a system for prioritizing maintenance actions in an electric power grid. The method includes receiving precursor event data associated with a plurality of locations in the electric power grid; computing, for each location, a plurality of independent priority dimensions comprising a confidence metric computed based on signal quality and statistical distribution characteristics, an urgency metric computed based on a rate of change of an event frequency and an energy trajectory, and an impact metric determined based on a topology of the electric power grid and an estimated loss of electrical load; combining the confidence metric, the urgency metric, and the impact metric to generate a composite priority score; and generating a ranked list of the plurality of locations based on the composite priority score.

title: Multi-Item Food Vending Machinery & Methods
abstract: Food vending machinery and methods involving the dispensing of multiple items, most especially restaurant-quality meals which, to optimize quality and value to the consumer, comprise both hot and cold (or warm) components.

title: Engineering tool, program editing method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
abstract: A user program of a programmable logic controller can be easily edited. An input assisting unit of an engineering tool determines whether an input text is a command or an operand, and if the text is an operand, presents an operand candidate corresponding to the text based on the text, a built-in information stored in a memory, and setting information, related to structure member or array variable, set by a user input. Each information is information indicating a correspondence relationship between a program element used for a user program and a comment corresponding to the program element. The input assisting unit presents the corresponding structure member or array variable as an operand candidate when any one of a variable name of a structure type and a comment associated with the structure member or array variable is received as the text.

title: Feed for larvae of aquatic animals
abstract:
The present invention relates to a feed for aquatic animals, comprising preserved eggs and/or trochophores of  Bivalvia . The invention further relates to use of preserved eggs and/or trochophores of  Bivalvia  as feed for aquatic animal consumption, wherein the feed is given to the farmed aquatic animal from 0 to 10 days after hatch. The invention further relates to a method for harvesting eggs from  Bivalvia , comprising steps for
         arranging living  Bivalvia  in water in a container,   stressing and/or triggering the  Bivalvia  to release eggs, and   separating the eggs from the water.       

     The invention further relates to a method for preserving eggs and/or trochophores of  Bivalvia , comprising the following steps:
         heating seawater to 50-100 degrees Celsius,   adding eggs and/or trochophores to seawater,   keeping the eggs and/or trochophores in the water for 1-60 seconds, and   separating water from eggs and/or trochophores.

title: Electrophysiology mapping using catheter splines deflection modeling
abstract: A system includes an expandable distal-end assembly and a processor. The expandable distal-end assembly is coupled to a distal end of a shaft for insertion into a cavity of an organ of a patient, the assembly including one or more electrodes. The processor is configured to (i) receive location signals from each of a distal and proximal location of the distal-end assembly, (ii) receive location signals indicative of a relative orientational angle from one or more sensors that are located at the distal-end assembly and configured to output signals indicative of the change in the relative orientation, (iii) estimate angular position in the azimuthal plane of each of a plurality of splines extending from the proximal to distal end of the distal-end assembly, and (iv) estimate respective locations of one or more of the electrodes in three dimensional space based on the estimated angular position of each of the splines.

title: Pump device and program for pump device
abstract: A pump device includes a first pump and a second pump. The pump device also includes a driver and a controller. The first pump and the second pump are connected in parallel with each other on an electric power supply path from the driver. The controller is capable of acquiring an impedance value of the first pump and an impedance value of the second pump, and identifying, as a specific pump, a pump having a minimum impedance value from among the first pump and the second pump. The controller is capable of controlling the driver such that a drive current to be supplied to the first pump and the second pump has a value less than or equal to a prescribed current value.

title: Multi-renderer and computation data in scene description
abstract: Some embodiments of a method may include obtaining information indicating interaction with one or more handlers used in handling a three-dimensional ( 3 D) scene. For some embodiments, the method may further include identifying handler data, object data, and component data associated with at least one respective handler of the one or more handlers used. Some embodiments of the method may further include responsive to determining handler data is global scene data, adding, at a scene-level, handler data to a dedicated structure for the respective handler. For some embodiments, the method may further include adding, at a node-level, for at least one node associated with the respective handler, object data to the dedicated structure for the respective handler. Some embodiments of the method may further include adding, at a component-level, for at least one component associated with the respective node, component data to the dedicated structure for the respective handler.

title: Laser Patterned Solid-State Batteries, And Methods of Making and Using the Same
abstract: A method of making solid-state battery cells using laser patterning, and a solid-state battery cell made by the method are disclosed. The method includes forming a patterned insulator on a cathode layer on a substrate, blanket-depositing a solid-state electrolyte layer on the cathode layer and the patterned insulator, blanket-depositing an anode current collector (ACC) layer on the solid-state electrolyte layer, laser-patterning the ACC layer over the patterned insulator to form a plurality of anode current collectors (ACCs), and cutting or dicing the solid-state electrolyte layer, the patterned insulator and the cathode layer to form the battery cells. The patterned insulator defines a border or boundary between adjacent cells, and each ACC is in a corresponding cell. The cell includes these structures, plus an encapsulant on the ACC and an ACC sidewall of the cell, and a redistribution layer on the encapsulant and along the ACC sidewall, electrically contacting the ACC.

title: Interior Fitting for a Vehicle
abstract: An interior trim part for a vehicle, such as an air vent, includes a multi-component molded structure with a first region that can be electroplated and a second region that is transparent and guides light. The transparent region is formed from a high temperature copolyester with a heat deflection temperature above 80° C. and strong resistance to chemicals that may cause stress cracking, including hand creams. The material does not accept electroplating, which allows selective plating of only the first region during a two-component injection molding process. As a result, the transparent region remains free of metal while the adjacent region receives a chrome finish. The design supports efficient manufacturing and produces a durable interior component that combines a metallic decorative appearance with integrated illumination.

title: Restraint system for patient support apparatus
abstract: A patient support may include a deck and a mattress supportable on the deck. The mattress may include a head end, a foot end, and two opposed sides, and the mattress may include an electrical system configured to at least one of 1) receive power from a power source and 2) include a communication interface for communicating data between the mattress and another device. The patient support may include a support side coupler operably to facilitate restraining the mattress from moving in at least one direction relative to the deck.

title: Image encoding method/device, image decoding method/device, and recording medium in which bitstream is stored
abstract: The present invention provides an image encoding method and an image decoding method. The image encoding method of the present invention comprises: a first dividing step of dividing a current image into a plurality of blocks; and a second dividing step of dividing, into a plurality of sub blocks, a block, which is to be divided and includes a boundary of the current image, among the plurality of blocks, wherein the second dividing step is recursively performed by setting a sub block including the boundary of the current images as the block to be divided, until the sub block including the boundary of the current image does not exist among the sub blocks.
assignee: Industry Academy Cooperation Foundation Of Sejong University

title: Stretching apparatus
abstract: A stretching apparatus includes: a planar body changing between a stretched state of being drawn out and planarly stretched and a storage state of being wound, and a pantograph mechanism being disposed on a back side of the planar body, expanded in the stretched state of the planar body and folded in the storage state of the planar body. The pantograph mechanism includes a set of first arms, a set of second arms rotatably connected to the set of first arms on a side of a drawing direction of the planar body and supporting an edge of the planar body in the drawing direction. At least one of the set of first arms and the set of second arms has a set of partial arms, and a rotation mechanism rotatably connecting the set of partial arms via a rotation shaft parallel to the planar body in the stretched state.

title: Systems and Methods for Locating a UAV on a Holding System
abstract: A method includes navigating, by a UAV, onto a first track of a UAV holding system, where the first track has a length sufficient to hold a plurality of UAVs. The method also includes determining, by the UAV, a location of the UAV along the first track based on a locating component associated with the UAV holding system. The method also includes performing, by the UAV, a control operation based on the determined location of the UAV along the first track.

title: Leading indicator for overall plant health using process data augmented with natural language processing from multiple sources
abstract: A method may include receiving binary data associated with one or more pieces of equipment in a manufacturing plant, the binary data indicating whether one or more performance variables associated with the one or more pieces of equipment were outside of a predetermined range; receiving text data associated with the one or more pieces of equipment in the manufacturing plant; performing a vectorization of the text data using natural language processing techniques to obtain vectorized data; receiving unplanned event data indicating unplanned events and associated pre-failure periods; and using the binary data, the vectorized data, and the unplanned event data to train a machine learning model to classify a state of the manufacturing plant between a normal operating period and a pre-failure period.

title: Polymeric materials with improved resistance through untrasonic treatment and dental appliances and other articles formed thereby
abstract: A method of treating a polymeric material includes exposing the polymeric material to ultrasonic energy in a liquid medium at a temperature below a glass transition temperature of the polymeric material for a time sufficient to modify one or more properties, or to reduce surface or internal stress, of the polymeric material, the one or more properties including stress relaxation, shape recovery, glass transition temperature, and crystallinity.

title: Ceramic particles for use in a solar power tower
abstract: Ceramic particles for use in a solar power tower and methods for making and using the ceramic particles are disclosed. The ceramic particle can include a sintered ceramic material formed from a mixture of a ceramic raw material and a darkening component comprising MnO as Mn 2+ . The ceramic particle can have a size from about 8 mesh to about 170 mesh and a density of less than 4 g/cc.

title: Ocular Hydrogel Compositions
abstract: Provided are shear-thinning ocular hydrogel compositions that comprise 0.1 to 5.0 wt. % (e.g. 0.1 to 3.5 wt. % or 0.1 to 2.5 wt. %) of a microgel particle-forming polymer; and 0.5 to 100 mM of a monovalent and/or polyvalent metal ion salt as a cross-linking agent; dispersed in an aqueous vehicle. The hydrogel compositions have a pH within the range of 3 to 8 and the viscosity of the gel composition reduces when the gel is exposed to shear. The compositions comprise decorin. The may also comprise an antibiotic, such as gentamicin, and an anti-inflammatory steroid, such as prednisolone. The compositions are suitable for medical use in the treatment of the eye. For example, the compositions are suitable for use in the inhibition of scarring and/or the prevention or treatment of microbial keratitis.

title: Liquid pumping cassettes and associated pressure distribution manifold and related methods
abstract: A blood circuit assembly with a vial holder for a blood pump cassette with a circular receiver and pads to center the vial holder. A blood circuit assembly may include a single, unitary member that defines portions of a pair of blood pumps, control valves, channels to accurately position flexible tubing for an occluder, an air trap support, and/or other portions of the assembly. The occluder door interaction with the unitary member provides added safety checks. A blood circuit assembly engagement device may assist with retaining a blood circuit assembly on the dialysis unit, and/or with removal of the assembly. A dialysate circuit assembly includes a balance pod with a stiffening elements to improve durability.

title: Multilayer piezoelectric body and method for producing same
abstract: A laminated piezoelectric body includes a piezoelectric film containing a fluorine-based resin as a main component, an antistatic layer disposed on at least one surface of the piezoelectric film and having a thickness of 10 nm or more and 250 nm or less, and a hard coat layer disposed on the antistatic layer and having a maximum surface height Rz of 40 nm or more and 150 nm or less. The laminated piezoelectric body has a surface resistivity measured on the hard coat layer of 1.0×10 6  Ω/sq. or more and 1.0×10 12  Ω/sq. or less, a total light transmittance of 85% or more, and a piezoelectric constant d 33  of 7 pC/N or more and 40 pC/N or less.

title: Sliding Door Device
abstract: A sliding door device comprises a support profile and a runner mounted rollably therein and configured for suspending therefrom a door leaf. The runner comprises at least two wheels manufactured by an injection moulding process. Each wheel comprises a core part; a rim part; spokes between the core part and the rim part; and an intermediate part between the core part and the rim part, in which the intermediate part is manufactured from a softer material than the core part and the rim part and encloses the spokes. The softer intermediate part dampens vibrations generated by the rolling of the wheels along the support profile and thus dampens the transmission of vibrations between the rim part and the door leaf such that noise is dampened. The hard rim part reduces the risk of deformation of the rim due to the weight of the door leaf. The spokes provide a mechanical connection between the core part and the rim part as well as mechanical anchoring of the intermediate part.

title: Strap-type mobile device holder
abstract: A strap-type mobile device holder including a holder body, a first elastic strap and a second elastic strap. The holder body is provided with a secure structure configured to secure the mobile device. The first elastic strap includes a first solid section and a first perforated section. The first solid section is provided with a first buckle portion. The first perforated section is provided with a first perforation and a first buckle hole. The second elastic strap includes a second solid section and a second perforated section. The second solid section is provided with a second buckle portion. The second perforated section is provided with a second perforation and a second buckle hole. When fastening the strap-type mobile device holder secured with the mobile device onto a carrier, the first elastic strap passes through the second perforation or the second elastic strap passes through the first perforation.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing system, and information processing method
abstract: An information processing apparatus is communicable with a user terminal operated by a user. The information processing apparatus includes a memory and circuitry. The memory is configured to store an URL associated with a virtual screen representing a display device. The virtual screen is displayed in a virtual space. The circuity is configured to: transmit, to the user terminal, virtual space data according to which the user terminal displays the virtual space, the virtual space being configured to display the virtual screen; acquire, according to a user operation of the virtual screen in the virtual space, data through the URL associated with the virtual screen; and cause the user terminal to display content based on the data acquired through the URL on the virtual screen displayed in the virtual space.

title: System for predicting weather changes
abstract: An automatic protection system for protecting agricultural crops by collecting weather data in real time, predicting guerrilla heavy rains and local climate changes with high accuracy using artificial intelligence. A data collection unit acquires data from weather satellites and ground-based observation stations, and a prediction analysis unit performs analysis using a machine learning algorithm. Based on the prediction results, a protection execution unit activates a robot that automatically stacks sandbags to form a protective wall to protect crops. Furthermore, a monitoring unit monitors the situation at the site and adjusts the protective measures as necessary. A feedback unit evaluates the effect of the executed measures and collects data for improving the accuracy of the prediction model.

title: Reduced EMI Inverter Dead Time Compensator System and Method Thereof
abstract: A reduced common mode voltage inverter comprising: an energy source, the energy source being electrically coupled to multiple half-bridge circuits; each of the multiple half-bridge circuits having an output and each output being electrically coupled to one or more phase loads; a control circuit being electrically coupled to multiple transistors of each of the multiple half-bridge circuits; and a dead time compensator, the dead time compensator configured to delay commutation of the multiple half-bridge circuits.
assignee: The United States Navy, as Represented by the Secretary of the Navy

title: Acupuncture apparatus for blind method
abstract: The present disclosure belongs to the technical field of acupuncture apparatuses and discloses an acupuncture apparatus for a blind method. The acupuncture apparatus includes a treatment needle kit. The treatment needle kit includes a first needle tube and a first descending control component as well as a first depth adjustment component, a first descending component and a treatment needle which are arranged in the first needle tube in sequence from top to bottom. The first descending component drives the treatment needle to move downwards in the first needle tube. The first descending control component is configured to adjust a position of the first descending component in the first needle tube so as to control a descending distance of the treatment needle. The treatment needle kit of the present disclosure can control the descending distance of the treatment needle, so as to achieve controlling over a depth of acupuncture.

title: Method and Apparatus of Temporal Candidates for Cross-Component Model Merge Mode in Video Coding System
abstract: A method and apparatus for deriving a motion vector from a neighboring block to determine a temporal candidate and inheriting cross-component models from two or more previous coded pictures for cross-component prediction. According to one method, a target motion vector is determined based on a neighbouring block and a temporal candidate is determined based on the target motion vector for inclusion in a candidate list. According to another method, a plurality of collocated pictures for the current block is determined and a temporal candidate is determined based on two or more collocated pictures.

title: Method for preparing non-electrically conductive antimicrobial articles
abstract: A non-electrically antimicrobial conductive article can be prepared by: A) providing a non-electrically conductive substrate with first and second opposing surfaces; B) disposing a pattern of a catalytic ink, having unconnected features, on the first opposing surface of the non-electrically conductive substrate, and drying, curing, or drying and curing the pattern of catalytic ink to form an intermediate article; C) electrolessly plating copper metal in registration with the pattern of catalytic ink, to provide a pattern of unconnected copper metal features in registration with the pattern of catalytic ink, to form the non-electrically conductive antimicrobial article, and D) optionally passivating the pattern having unconnected copper metal features. The prepared antimicrobial article can provide antimicrobial properties when applied to various surfaces that are frequently touched, to inhibit or reduce the transmission of various microorganisms from one person to another.

title: Method and apparatus for sidelink resource determination
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods and apparatuses for sidelink resource determination over an unlicensed spectrum. According to some embodiments of the disclosure, a first user equipment (UE) may: transmit, to a second UE or a BS, a first indicator indicating a first channel access duration or a first contention window size (CWS) for the first UE to perform a channel access procedure on a channel; perform the channel access procedure on the channel before a first slot, wherein the first slot is reserved by the first UE for a sidelink transmission on the channel or the first slot is assigned by the BS to the first UE for the sidelink transmission on the channel; and perform the sidelink transmission on the channel in the first slot in response to the channel access procedure being successful.

title: Information processing apparatus, work support method, and medium - enabling ai-based decision making for optimal cart assignment
abstract: An information processing apparatus includes a specifying unit that specifies a target article that is an article as a target to be transported to a predetermined transport destination, and an assignment unit that decides a cart to be used for transport of the target article based on transport destination information indicating a transport destination of the target article and a transport destination of another article loaded on the cart. According to the information processing apparatus, it is also possible to optimize a cart used for transport work.

title: Optical measurement method and optical measurement device
abstract: Provided are an optical measurement method and an optical measurement device that accurately measure a particle diameter and a particle size distribution of particles contained in a dispersion liquid containing the particles. An optical measurement method of a dispersion liquid containing particles, the method including: an acquisition step of acquiring a plurality of images of the particles obtained by causing incident light to be incident on the dispersion liquid with a changed intensity, continuously in time for each intensity of the incident light; a measurement step of measuring a moving average distance of the particles for each intensity of the incident light, from the plurality of images acquired continuously in time for each intensity of the incident light, the plurality of images being obtained in the acquisition step; and a calculation step of calculating an apparent particle diameter of the particles for each intensity of the incident light, from the moving average distance of the particles for each intensity of the incident light obtained in the measurement step, to obtain a true particle diameter of the particles from the apparent particle diameter of the particles for each intensity of the incident light.

title: Putt Tracker
abstract: A putt tracker including a putt tracking device wire or wirelessly connected to a computing device including a processor communicatively coupled to a non-transitory computer-readable medium containing a program code adapted or configured to receive putt roll characteristics from the putt tracking device at current time and depict in a graphical user interface the corresponding putt roll on a golf green at current time.

title: Continuous conjugate fiber, continuous conjugate fiber production device, and continuous conjugate fiber production method
abstract: A conjugate material includes: a plurality of fibrous materials; and a plurality of carbon nanotube fibers which consists of carbon nanotubes and arranged to surround the plurality of fibrous materials.

title: End-to-end management of authenticated communications
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for providing mobile call authentication. For instance, a token indicative of a call request can be received from a calling party. The token can include a called party number and a time of the request. A subscriber database can be accessed to determine identifying information associated with the calling party based at least in part on the token. The token can be authenticated based at least in part on the identifying information and using one or more predefined authentication protocols. The token can be stored in a call session registry storing data indicative of a plurality of active telephone call events. A verification request for the call request can be received from the called party. The call request can be verified based at least in part on the token. The called party can be notified that the call request has been verified.

title: Golf Swing Training Club and Method
abstract: A golf clubhead having a pair of light lasers disposed within the blade and oriented to emit a pair of spaced-apart linear beams of visible light through the sole, centered around the sweet spot, and spaced apart about a diameter of a golf ball. The pair of spaced-apart linear beams lie within a light beam plane that is parallel with a plane of the clubface. The blade has a cavity opposite the ball-striking clubface, and a power and control module is secured within the cavity, to provide power and control to the heel and toe light lasers. The power and control module has a rechargeable battery, a charging port, and a controller.

title: Power storage device, electrode terminal unit, and exterior body set
abstract: A power storage device including an electrode body, an exterior body, and an electrode terminal. The exterior body seals electrode body. The electrode terminal has one end part and another end part arranged along a first direction, one end part being connected to electrode body, other end part projecting to outside exterior body, and electrode terminal being composed of a first material. The exterior body has a fixing member that is fixed to electrode terminal along a second direction intersecting first direction between one end part and other end part of electrode terminal, fixing member being composed of a second material that is different from first material.

title: Conductive via structures for gate contact or trench contact
abstract: Conductive via structures for gate contact or trench contact are described. In an example, an integrated circuit structure includes a plurality of gate structures. A plurality of dielectric spacers has an uppermost surface co-planar with an uppermost surface of a plurality of gate structures and co-planar with an uppermost surface of a plurality of conductive trench contact structures. A dielectric layer is over the plurality of gate structures, over the plurality of conductive trench contact structures, and over the plurality of dielectric spacers. The dielectric layer has a planar uppermost surface. An opening is in the dielectric layer, the opening exposing one of the plurality of gate structures or one of the plurality of conductive trench contact structures. A conductive via is in the opening. The conductive via has an uppermost surface co-planar with the planar uppermost surface of the dielectric layer.

title: Dynamic road speed limiter and method
abstract: A dynamic road speed limiter is provided for limiting road speed operational parameters for vehicles demonstrating triggering conditions. The dynamic road speed limiter may include a dynamic road speed limiter, electronic control unit (ECU), triggering detection component and torque management control aspect to control torque output to maintain the dynamic limiting speed. A method for limiting road speed operational parameters for vehicles demonstrating triggering conditions using the dynamic road speed limiter is also provided.
assignee: International Truck Intellectual Property Company, Llc

title: Interactive tangible gaming system
abstract: In some embodiments, an interactive tangible gaming system is presented. An interactive tangible gaming system may include a smart gaming surface comprising a digital display having a capacitive layer and a processor in communication with the digital display and the capacitive layer. The system may further include a gaming object configured to interact with the smart gaming surface and comprising a capacitive element having a capacitive signature. Upon interaction between the gaming object and the smart gaming surface, the processor may be configured to obtain the capacitive signature via the capacitive layer and cause the digital display to display one or more graphical elements based on the capacitive signature.

title: Methods and apparatuses relating to determining a transmission start time for an uplink signal
abstract: This specification describes a terminal device comprising: means for receiving first configuration information which includes an indication that a first downlink reference signal shall be used by the terminal device as a time reference for application of a timing advance value when transmitting uplink signals in accordance with a first transmission configuration indicator, TCI, state; means for receiving the first downlink reference signal; means for determining, based on a time of receipt of the first downlink reference signal and the timing advance value, a transmission start time for an uplink signal that is to be transmitted in accordance with the first TCI state; and means for transmitting the uplink signal in accordance with the transmission start time and the first TCI state.

title: High protein flakes and methods of processing thereof
abstract: A method of producing high-protein flakes by preparing a first mixture by combining flour, water, pea protein nuggets, and a flavor batch. The method further includes cooking the first mixture for a first period of time. A second mixture is prepared by combining at least the first mixture and a flour batch. The flour batch includes a protein isolate, vital wheat gluten, and lentil protein. The method further includes forming protein pellets by combining the second mixture, a sweetener, and water using a cold forming extrusion process. The protein pellets are tempered and toasted to form the high-protein flakes.

title: System, method, and apparatus for providing optimized network resources
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing optimization of network resources. The system is operable to monitor the electromagnetic environment, analyze the electromagnetic environment, and extract environmental awareness of the electromagnetic environment. The system extracts the environmental awareness of the electromagnetic environment by including customer goals. The system is operable to use the environmental awareness with the customer goals and/or user defined policies and rules to extract actionable information to help the customer optimize the network resources.

title: Energy Supply System Having Battery Modules, and Method for Operating an Energy Supply System
abstract: An energy supply system that includes battery modules which can be controllably connected in series to provide different voltages at a power supply connection. Each of the battery modules has an input connection and an output connection, a battery unit for providing a module voltage, a switching device for selectively switching the module voltage to the input connection and to the output connection, and a control input for receiving a control input signal.
