abstract: A multi-piece implantable joint prosthesis includes an adapter to which at least two pieces are coupled, where the adapter has a coupler for coupling to a first piece and a different coupler for coupling to a second piece, where at least one piece, e.g., the first piece, may contain an electronic component such as a sensor that detects and measures movement of the prosthesis when the prosthesis is implanted in a patient, and can thus monitor the kinematic movement of the patient in real life situations, where the electronic component may also include a memory to store the data obtained by the sensor, and a communication interface to transmit the data to an external location where it may be analyzed, and a power source to provide power to the sensor, memory and communication interface.

title: Method and apparatus for designing low frequency non-seperable transform
abstract: According to the disclosure of the present disclosure: an LFNST set index for a current block may be derived on the basis of an intra prediction mode; on the basis of the intra prediction mode for the current block being a WAIP mode, the LFNST set index may be derived as predetermined one value; and on the basis of the intra prediction mode for the current block being an NAIP mode, the LFNST set index may be derived as one of predetermined N values. Accordingly, it is possible to maximize the coding performance that can be brought about by LFNST within the implementation complexity allowed by a next standard.

title: Cd38 targeted peptides for cancer imaging
abstract: The present teachings include compositions, methods of synthesis, and methods of use for an imaging agent that preferentially binds to CD38, including but not limited to a peptide or peptidomimetic ligand radiolabeled for use in PET imaging to identify multiple myeloma, help select treatments for multiple myeloma, and monitor relapse in multiple myeloma patients after therapy.
assignee: Washington University; University Of Virginia Patent Foundation

title: Reinforced bulk bag and method of construction
abstract: A bag for carrying a load of solid particulate materials and a method of constructing the same. The bag includes a first member produced from a flexible sheet material, such as a woven fabric, and is generally circular in cross-section. The first member is transformed into a second member which is generally square in cross-section. The first member is woven as a tube defining a bore therethrough. In order to transform the first member to the second member, four longitudinally-extending reinforced regions are woven into the fabric of the tube. A longitudinally-extending fold is formed in each reinforced region to create a pleat. A lift belt is secured along each pleat so that a loop of the lift belt extends beyond a first end of the tube. A second end of the tube is closed off to transform the bore therein into the cavity for receiving the load.

title: Pharmaceutical formulations of ivacaftor
abstract: The present invention relates to a solid oral pharmaceutical composition comprising ivacaftor or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, as well as methods for making and using such compositions. Compositions comprised Micronized ivacaftor having D90 not more than 25 μm and D50 not more than 15 μm for tablets and for Granules/mini tablets D90 not more than 5 μm

title: Experience issue demarcation method, apparatus, and system
abstract: An experience issue demarcation method, an apparatus, and a system, relating to the field of communication technologies. The method includes: A cross-domain management data analytics service (MDAS) that obtains first information indicating information about an experience degradation event, a service access amount, and a service topology of the experience degradation event, performs experience issue demarcation based on the first information, determines an issue object and a root cause of the issue object, and then sends an analytics report to a subscription consumer. The root cause of the issue object is determined by a single-domain MDAS based on second information, and then the single-domain MDAS sends the root cause of the issue object to the cross-domain MDAS. The solutions of this application can be widely applied to the field of communication technologies, artificial intelligence, Internet of vehicles, Internet of smart home, and the like.

title: Method to Correct Glass Window to SCE Measurement
abstract: This disclosure describes a color measurement system for improved specular component excluded (SCE) measurements. The system incorporates an integrating sphere with an SCE sensor and light source, with a transparent window placed between the SCE sensor and the sample. A processor activates the light source, receives sensor values from reflected light off a sample, and obtains a measurement calibration factor. The system corrects SCE measurements using this calibration factor. The measurement calibration factor can include at least the transparent window's transmittance value, allowing for accurate color readings by compensating for the transparent material's influence on light transmission.

title: Fuel cell system
abstract: A fuel cell system includes: an FC stack;, a compressor having an air bearing; a battery; a valve; and a controller. When fuel supply to the FC stack is stopped because a state of charge of the battery is equal to or higher than a predetermined state of charge, the controller executes a stack protection control in which less air is supplied to the FC stack than when fuel is being supplied. The stack protection control includes: a first control in which the compressor is rotated at a rotational speed lower than a floating rotational speed of the air bearing and the valve is fixed at a predetermined opening degree; and a second control in which the compressor is rotated at a rotational speed equal to or higher than the floating rotational speed and the valve is adjusted to an opening degree smaller than the predetermined opening degree.

title: Sensing data feedback method and apparatus
abstract: This application provides a method comprising: A first communication apparatus receives first indication information from a second communication apparatus, where the first indication information indicates an environmental geometric structure in a first sensing region and a scanned region on the environmental geometric structure; compresses, based on the first indication information, a sensing data point corresponding to a sensing geometric structure in the first sensing region, to obtain compressed data, where a compression mode or a compression level of the sensing data point is determined based on at least one of whether the sensing geometric structure matches the environmental geometric structure or whether the sensing data point matches the scanned region on the environmental geometric structure; and sends the compressed data to the second communication apparatus.

title: Mobile device holder assembly using limiting member for assisted engagement
abstract: A mobile device holder assembly using a limiting member for assisted engagement includes a carrier base, snap base, and a securing element. The carrier base includes a carrier portion configured to carry a mobile device and at least one snap portion. The snap base includes a base body provided with a snap groove, a limiting member, an unlock member, and an elastic member. The snap groove has an edge that includes at least one snap area and at least one passage area configured to allow the snap portion to insert into the passage area and engage with the snap groove after rotating into the snap area. The limiting member is configured to, when in a limiting position, extend partially into the passage area for assisted engagement, and is configured to, when in an unlock position, retract partially from the passage area to release the assisted engagement.

title: Food data access and delivery system
abstract: An improved system for accessing food data and tracking a user's food intake includes a nutrition information system and a mobile PDA or smartphone-based tag reading system. The two systems are configured to communication. The mobile tag reading system includes a tag capture device for reading the nutritional tag, and a decoder for decoding the header or visual effects included in the nutritional tag to identify the predetermined profile. The decoder is also configured to decode the nutritional tag to generate the subset of the dietary product descriptions and associated nutritional values based upon the predetermined profile. A tracking log is included for storing the associated nutritional values or the modified associated nutritional values based upon input from the user.

title: Scaled-capacity embodiment of a material-driven thermal management architecture
abstract: A portable temperature controlled enclosure comprises an external enclosure defining a thermally managed payload volume, an internal aluminum cooling chamber disposed within the external enclosure and configured to receive a payload, a cooling loop thermally coupled to the internal aluminum cooling chamber at a cooling interface region, and a fan assembly arranged to drive airflow across a heat exchange region of the cooling loop to reject heat to ambient. The internal aluminum cooling chamber includes a non-uniform geometry comprising geometric variations disposed along bottom portions and side portions of the internal aluminum cooling chamber. The non-uniform geometry is configured to establish differential cooling zones in which a first region of the internal aluminum cooling chamber cools at a first rate and a second region of the internal aluminum cooling chamber cools at a second rate during a cooldown interval.

title: Heat management of semiconductor devices using substantially two-dimensional materials
abstract: In various embodiments, heat-managed (HM) devices, arrays of HM devices, and method for fabricating HM devices are provided. An HM device of an example embodiment includes a semiconductor device comprising III-V semiconductor material; and a film of a thermally conductive material disposed directly in thermal communication with semiconductor material of the semiconductor device. Operation of the semiconductor device generates heat and the film provides a thermal path for transporting thermal energy away from the semiconductor device.

title: Wiring conductor and coil component
abstract: A wiring conductor includes a main body portion. The main body portion includes a first surface and a second surface connecting both edges of the first surface. The second surface is a curved surface, and the aspect ratio that is a ratio of a height of the main body portion from the first surface to a width of the first surface is 0.4 to 1.4.

title: Image sensor and image capture apparatus
abstract: Disclosed is an image sensor that comprises a plurality of pixels configured to output pulses in response to photon incidence and a plurality of counters provided in one-to-one correspondence to the plurality of pixels and configured to count pulses output by the corresponding pixel. The plurality of pixels includes a focus pixel.

title: Ranked successive detection and decoding method and receiver based on sparse code multiple access
abstract: A ranked successive detection and decoding (R-SDD) method based on Sparse Code Multiple Access (SCMA) includes following steps: external iterations are performed successively according to an initial confidence order based on received signals of a plurality of users and initialized posteriori log-likelihood ratios; an external iteration count is updated; decoding verification is performed on output first posteriori log-likelihood ratios; if there is an unsuccessfully decoded user and the external iteration count has not reached a threshold, a next external iteration is performed successively according to the received signal and a first priori log-likelihood ratio of each unsuccessfully decoded user; the external iteration count is updated; decoding verification is performed based on output second posteriori log-likelihood ratios; and when it is determined that there is no unsuccessfully decoded user or the external iteration count reaches the threshold, a decoded bit sequence is output. A R-SDD receiver is also provided.

title: Update system, computer implemented update method, and non-transitory recording medium
abstract: This update system determines whether the data format of moving-body device data is a predetermined data format, and, in cases where it is determined that the data format of the moving-body device data is not the predetermined data format, corrects the data format of the moving-body device data to the predetermined data format. The update system extracts feature information relating to the moving-body device from moving-body device data in the predetermined data format, and estimates the state of the moving-body device using the feature information. The update system calculates an optimized parameter used by each control device on the basis of the moving-body device data and the state information, and updates the parameter.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device includes: a display panel having first and second emission regions, each of the first and second emission regions configured to emit a first source light having a first color and a second source light having a second color; a first partition wall on the display panel and corresponding to the first emission region; a sub-partition wall dividing a region inside the first partition wall into a main region and a sub region in a plane view; a first light conversion pattern inside the main region, the first light conversion pattern configured to convert the first source light into a light having the second color; and a first color filter on the first partition wall and the sub-partition wall, the first color filter being transparent to the second source light that passes through the sub region and to the converted light having the second color.

title: Borderless board print product and method of making the same
abstract: A printable substrate comprising a printable board including a front surface defined by a first side edge; an opposite second side edge; a third side edge including first and second ends, wherein the first and second side edges intersect the first and second ends of the third side edge at first and second points, respectively; and a fourth side edge opposite of the third side edge, wherein the fourth side edge includes first and second ends, wherein the first and second side edges intersect the first and second ends of the fourth side edge at third and fourth points, respectively. The printable board including a border having an outer peripheral edge removably coupled to the first, second, third, and fourth side edges using perforations, and an extended perforation portion extending a distance from the first point, into the border, toward the outer peripheral edge, without reaching the outer peripheral edge.

title: Molecule enrichment using spatially non-uniform alternating current electric field
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure pertain to methods of enriching one or more molecules in a medium by applying a spatially non-uniform alternating current electric field (AC electric field) to the medium, where the AC electric field enriches the molecules in the medium through initiating electromigration of the molecules. The methods may also include steps of sensing and/or purifying the molecules. Additional embodiments of the present disclosure pertain to systems for enriching one or more molecules, where the system includes a housing unit operational to house a medium that includes the molecules to be enriched, and an electrode operational to be electrically connected to the medium and apply an AC electric field to the medium.

title: Method of manufacturing granules and granules thus obtained
abstract: A method of manufacturing of granules of microporous material is provided. It comprises the steps of: (1) providing a powder of microporous material, comprising an insulation powder such as pyrogenic silica, an opacifier and optionally a filler, (2) granulating the powder into granules, and (3) treating said granules with an aqueous composition of a silicic acid material, such as waterglass. The microporous powder composition suitably comprises the opacifier in an amount of 10-50 wt %, the insulation powder in an amount of 40-80 wt % and said filler in an amount of 0-50 wt %.

title: Method, apparatus, device, medium, and program product for notification message push
abstract: According to embodiments of the disclosure, a method, an appratus, a device, a medium and a program product for notification message push are provided. The method includes: determining, in response to a trigger for message display, whether a notification message is cached, the cached notification message remaining undisplayed for a target display period; determining, in response to determining that one or more notification message are cached, whether at least one of the one or more cached notification message satisfies a corresponding display rule; and performing push of the at least one notification message in response to determining that the at least one notification message satisfies the corresponding display rule.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Methods, architectures, apparatuses and systems for leveraging direct links to improve federated learning training process in future wireless
abstract: Procedures, apparatuses, and computer program products that leverage direct links to improve FL training processes in wireless networks are provided. One method may include sending, to a network node, a request for other WTRU(s) to serve as a relay WTRU for the first WTRU, and receiving information on one or more candidate relay WTRUs in proximity of the first WTRU. Based at least on the received information, the method may include selecting at least one of the candidate relay WTRUs to serve as the relay WTRU, performing a discovery procedure with the selected relay WTRU(s), sending a direct communication request to the selected relay WTRU(s), performing the current local training round to generate a new local model update, and sending, to the selected relay WTRU(s), at least a portion of the new local model update and/or an identifier of a FL task associated with the new local model update.

title: High breakdown voltage hemt device and driving method thereof
abstract: A high breakdown voltage HEMT device includes: a multilayer body material layer; a source electrode and a drain electrode stacked with the multilayer body material layer, a first gate electrode, and a second gate electrode. Along a first direction, the source electrode and the drain electrode are respectively located on opposite sides of the multilayer body material layer, or, the source electrode and the drain electrode are located on the same side of the multilayer body material layer and respectively disposed on different mesas. The first gate electrode is located on the same side of the multilayer body material layer as the source electrode and is adjacent to the source electrode. The second gate electrode is located on the same side of the multilayer body material layer as the first gate electrode, the first gate electrode is located between the second gate electrode and the source electrode.

title: Iron with sole slot
abstract: A golf club head having a slot in the sole filled with an insert in which the slot is positioned close to the striking face. The slot can be a uniform distance from the striking face or the slot can curve away from the striking face in the toe region. The insert can have a uniform height or a non-uniform height. Inserts with uniform heights can have a low height profile. Inserts with non-uniform heights can have a lower height in a central portion of the insert compared to an edge portion or a perimeter portion of the insert. The insert can also have flanges or protrusions for installation into the slot. The resulting golf club head improves performance, as the sole slot with insert allows the striking face to have a profile that meets the needs at that location.

title: Bonded assembly with laterally shifted connections and methods for forming the same
abstract: A semiconductor structure includes a first memory die including an alternating stack of insulating layers and electrically conductive layers, memory stack structures vertically extending through the alternating stack, a set of memory-die metal interconnect structures embedded within a set of memory-die dielectric material layers, memory-die intra-assembly bonding pads located in a connection region, and memory-die inter-assembly bonding pads located in the connection region; and a first logic die including a memory controller circuit, a set of logic-die metal interconnect structures embedded within a set of logic-die dielectric material layers, logic-die intra-assembly bonding pads that are bonded to the memory-die intra-assembly bonding pads, and logic-die inter-assembly bonding pads located in the connection region. A first memory-die inter-assembly bonding pad is electrically connected to a second logic-die inter-assembly bonding pad that does not have any areal overlap with the first memory-die inter-assembly bonding pad in a plan view.

title: Ocular feedback system and method
abstract: An ocular feedback apparatus and method are disclosed herein. An ocular feedback apparatus includes a wearable support structure carrying at least one inwardly directed camera configured to capture images of at least one eye of a user. A memory stores a library of eye movement patterns correlated with respective emotional states and population data. A processor extracts eye movement features from the images and generates user eye movement data. The processor compares the user eye movement data with the stored eye movement patterns using the outcome population data and determines a predicted emotional state based on the comparison. In certain embodiments, the predicted emotional state is updated in real time as images are captured. The apparatus may output the predicted emotional state to a display, transmit the predicted emotional state to an external device, or correlate the predicted emotional state with environmental data.

title: Electrode assembly, manufacturing method thereof, and cylindrical secondary battery including the same
abstract: An electrode assembly includes a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a separator interposed therebetween in a thickness direction and wound in a length direction with respect to a winding center, wherein the positive electrode includes a positive electrode uncoated portion protruding at one width-directional end portion, the electrode assembly includes a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer at one width-directional end portion, the first adhesive layer is disposed between the positive electrode uncoated portion and the separator, and the second adhesive layer is disposed between one width-directional end portion of the negative electrode and the separator.

title: Electronic game gift purchase, delivery, and return systems and methods for gaming environments
abstract: Electronic game gift purchase, delivery, and return systems and methods for gaming environments. In various embodiments, the systems and methods enable a gift buyer to buy an electronic game gift, cause the electronic game gift to be sent to a gift receiver, enable the gift receiver to receive and use electronic game gift, and if the gift receiver is unable to receive or use the electronic game gift, return the electronic game gift or the purchase price thereof to the gift buyer.

title: Methods for polymer materials
abstract: A method to produce a polysilazane prepreg can include producing a resin system comprising a blend of polysilazane polymer with silazane oligomer, said oligomer acting as a reactive diluent to tune the resin system to the desired viscosity to use as a prepreg, optionally comprising fillers, said system allowing the processing of polysilazane into ceramic matrix composite parts using suitable manufacturing techniques to process standard polymer composites and to allow the manufacture of composite parts with high temperature resistance wherein the reactive diluent comprises any oligomer of lower viscosity than the polysilazane and capable of reacting with said polysilazane to form a cross linked polymer network. Also provided are composites and articles prepared according to a method in accordance with the disclosed subject matter.

title: Sensor package structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A sensor package structure and a manufacturing method thereof. The sensor package structure includes a substrate, a sensor chip and a package cover. The substrate has first and second substrate surfaces that are opposite to each other. The sensor chip is disposed on the first substrate surface and has a sensing area. The package cover includes a molding layer, a supporting layer and a light-transmitting layer. The molding layer surrounds the sensing area and is disposed on the first substrate surface. The supporting layer surrounds the sensing area and is disposed on the molding layer. The light-transmitting layer is disposed on the supporting layer and covers the substrate, the sensor chip, the molding layer and the supporting layer. The light-transmitting layer, the supporting layer, and the molding layer are formed to surround an enclosed space, and the sensing area is located in the enclosed space.

title: Integrated Circuit and Preparation Method Therefor, and Electronic Device
abstract: An integrated circuit includes a power delivery network, a semiconductor structure, a gate line, a first electrode, a power supply connection part, a first electrode contact part, a second electrode contact part, and an isolation layer. The power supply connection part is located between two adjacent semiconductor structures and is in contact with the power delivery network. The power supply connection part divides the gate line into a first sub-gate line and a second sub-gate line. The first electrode contact part and the second electrode contact part are located on two opposite sides of the power supply connection part. Both the first electrode contact part and the second electrode contact part are in contact with the first electrode.

title: Sequential feedback ensemble model for multilabel classification
abstract: A sequential feedback prediction system predicts a risk of an event associated with a set of potential outcomes. The system receives training data including data records that have information associated with risk factors. Each data record may be labeled with outcomes that have inherent sequential dependencies. The system trains sub-models, each sub-model predicting risks for a respective outcome using a set of risk factors. For each sub-model, the system may determine a subset of sub-models whose results are used as input for the sub-model. The system determines an order to run the set of sub-models such that prediction results for preceding sub-models may be used as inputs for subsequent sub-models. The system may determine a number of rounds to run the ordered sequence of sub-models until the performance of the ensemble model meets a predetermined threshold. The system may generate a risk score for each of the set of outcomes.

title: Concatenating on-demand ssb in half frame
abstract: Apparatuses and methods for concatenating an on-demand synchronization signal block (SSB) in a half frame A method performed by a user equipment includes receiving a set of higher layer parameters, the set of higher layer parameters including a time offset, a first configuration for a first SSB, and a second configuration for a second SSB, and determining, based on the first configuration, a first set of candidate SSB occasions in a half frame for the first SSB. The method further includes determining, based on the second configuration, a second set of candidate SSB occasions in the half frame for the second SSB, wherein the second set of candidate SSB occasions occurs after the first set of candidate SSB occasions with respect to the time offset and receiving a SSB based on the first and second sets of candidate SSB occasions.

title: Golf club heads and methods to manufacture golf club heads
abstract: Embodiments of golf club heads and methods to manufacture golf club heads are generally described herein. In one example, a golf club head includes a body portion, a hosel portion, and a center of gravity located on an axis defined by an intersection between a horizontal plane and a vertical plane. The horizontal plane is parallel to a ground plane and perpendicular to a center longitudinal plane bisecting the body portion to define a toe portion and a heel portion. The vertical plane is perpendicular to the horizontal plane and the center longitudinal plane. The hosel portion is configured to attach to a golf shaft and direct a shaft axis of the golf shaft above and forward of the center of gravity prior to intersecting the axis at an intersection point that is offset from the center of gravity. Other examples and embodiments may be described and claimed.

title: Display device, manufacturing method of light emitting element, and manufacturing method of display device including light emitting element manufactured thereby
abstract: A display device includes a first electrode and a second electrode that are disposed on a substrate, a light emitting element disposed on the first electrode and the second electrode, a first contact electrode electrically connecting the first electrode and the light emitting element to each other, and a second contact electrode electrically connecting the second electrode and the light emitting element to each other. The light emitting element includes a first semiconductor layer including a semiconductor of a first type, a second semiconductor layer including a semiconductor of a second type, and an active layer disposed between the first semiconductor layer and the second semiconductor layer. The first semiconductor layer includes a doped semiconductor layer including a porous structure.

title: Sealed ortho-grid laser and imaging director with a multistage seal
abstract: A gimbal and a pressure vessel with a multi-stage seal between the gimbal and the pressure vessel to protect optical equipment housed in the pressure vessel from the environment in a stowed position.
assignee: United States Of America, Department Of The Navy

title: Methods and Systems for Controlling Gear Shifts based on Future Trajectory Information
abstract: Example embodiments relate to controlling gear shifts based on future trajectory information. A vehicle computing system may receive sensor data representing an environment of the vehicle during autonomous navigation of a path and determine, based on the sensor data, the vehicle is approaching a predefined situation positioned along the path. The computing system may then estimate a future acceleration or speed associated with navigation of the predefined situation by the vehicle. The computing system may determine, based on the future acceleration or speed and a current acceleration of the vehicle, whether to perform a gear shift prior to navigation of the predefined situation by the vehicle, and control the vehicle based on determining whether to perform the gear shift prior to navigation of the predefined situation.

title: Processing queued tasks in a multi-tenant system
abstract: A method may include receiving task metadata that may include an identifier of a task to be performed by a processing unit. The method may involve retrieving operational data associated with the task metadata from a database including sets of operational data corresponding to tasks for performance. The method may include attempting performance of the task based on the operational data and determining whether performance of the task is completed within a threshold amount of time. When the task is be completed within the threshold amount of time, the method may include deleting the operational data for the task from the database. When performing the task is not completed within the threshold amount of time, the method may involve discontinuing the performance of the task and discarding the task metadata and the operational data from the processing unit without removing the operational data from the database.

title: Live attenuated leishmania parasite vaccines with enhanced safety characteristics
abstract: Disclosed herein are modified  Leishmania  species and compositions thereof, such as live, attenuated organisms, immunogenic compositions, vaccines, and pharmaceutical compositions. Further disclosed are methods related to the modified  Leishmania  species, such as methods of production and methods of use.
assignee: The U.S.A., As Represented By The Secretary, Department Of Health And Human Services; Ohio State Innovation Foundation

title: System and method for selectively re-stocking inventory structures with stock of product from back-of-store inventory
abstract: One variation of a method includes: receiving a first image captured by a mobile device in a back-of-store inventory region of a store; identifying a product type represented in the first image; accessing a second image of an inventory structure in a customer region of the store, the second image captured by a mobile robotic system traversing aisles of the store during a scan cycle; based on features extracted from the second image and the set of point-of-sale data, predicting a first quantity of product units of the product type loaded in the slot; and, in response to the first quantity of product units falling below a threshold quantity, generating a prompt to deliver a second quantity of product units from the back-of-store inventory structure to the slot in the inventory structure in the customer region of the store; and transmitting the prompt to the mobile device.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes: a semiconductor layer including a semiconductor substrate of a first conductivity type and a low-concentration impurity layer of the first conductivity type, the semiconductor substrate containing a first concentration of an impurity, the low-concentration impurity layer being in contact with a top surface of the semiconductor substrate and containing a second concentration of an impurity, the second concentration being lower than the first concentration; a first vertical metal-oxide-semiconductor (MOS) transistor and a second vertical MOS transistor that share the semiconductor substrate as a common drain region; and a first Schottky barrier diode that is connected in parallel with a body diode of the first vertical MOS transistor in a same forward direction, the low-concentration impurity layer serving as a cathode of the first Schottky barrier diode when the first conductivity type is n-type, and as an anode when the first conductivity type is p-type.

title: Spark ignition engine and method for operating spark ignition engine
abstract: To ensure combustion stability even when a large amount of exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) gas is recirculated into a cylinder, a spark ignition engine includes a first ignition plug and a second ignition plug, each of which is attached to an engine body and forcibly ignites an air-fuel mixture in a cylinder during a compression stroke or an expansion stroke. The first ignition plug and the second ignition plug are spaced apart in a predetermined direction. With ascent of a piston during the compression stroke, in the cylinder around compression top dead center, two vortex flows of the air-fuel mixture are formed in alignment in the predetermined direction with a center of the cylinder being interposed therebetween and in opposite directions from each other. The first ignition plug and the second ignition plug forcibly ignite the air-fuel mixture at a timing around the compression top dead center.

title: Virtual assistant multi-modal functionality
abstract: A system can be provided for multi-modal interactions. For example, the system may receive a first modality input from a first user device associated with a user and in a first communication mode. The system may then adjust a transaction service schema based on the first modality input and transmit, to the first user device, a first output derived from the transaction service schema. The system may further receive a second modality input from a second user device associated with the user, the second modality input being in a second communication mode that is different from the first communication mode. Additionally, the system may adjust the transaction service schema based on the second modality input and transmit, to the second user device associated with the user, a second output derived from the transaction service schema.

title: Unitary coupling apparatus
abstract: The Unitary Coupling Apparatus is a novel device designed to streamline the production of Unitary Coupling Assembly Closures. The Unitary Coupling Apparatus efficiently couples specially designed corks and specially designed cylindrical cap bodies, resulting in the production of the Unitary Coupling Assembly Closure, thus, offering a more efficient and sustainable alternative to traditional closure methods. The Unitary Coupling Apparatus incorporates safety features, minimizes environmental impact, and provides a user-friendly experience, making it a valuable asset for the wine, spirits, and any other industry that utilizes corks and screw caps to seal and protect bottled or container contents.

title: Semiconductor device and method for manufacturing same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a first electrode, a first semiconductor layer, a second semiconductor layer, a third semiconductor layer, a fourth semiconductor layer and a second electrode. The first semiconductor layer is connected to the first electrode. The second semiconductor layer contacts the first semiconductor layer. An impurity concentration of the second semiconductor layer is less than it of the first semiconductor layer. A defect density of the second semiconductor layer is greater than it of the first semiconductor layer. The third semiconductor layer contacts the second semiconductor layer. An impurity concentration of the third semiconductor layer is less than it of the second semiconductor layer. A defect density of the third semiconductor layer is less than it of the second semiconductor layer. The fourth semiconductor layer contacts the third semiconductor layer. The second electrode is connected to the fourth semiconductor layer.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba; Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation

title: Electrode composition for lithium secondary battery, electrode slurry, electrode, and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrode composition for a lithium secondary battery, including an electrode active material, a conductive material, and a binder, in which the binder is a copolymer of a (meth)acrylamide monomer, a (meth)acrylic acid monomer, an acrylonitrile monomer, and a metal-substituted (meth)acrylic acid monomer, and satisfies specified equations, an electrode slurry including the same, an electrode, and a lithium secondary battery. Accordingly, it is possible to solve the problem of volume expansion during repeated charging and discharging.

title: Aeronautical propulsion unit with improved acoustics
abstract: An aeronautical propulsion unit having a longitudinal axis and an upstream rotor row and a downstream stator row of unducted blades. In the downstream state row, at least two stator blades are at different axial positions relative to one another along the longitudinal axis of the propulsion unit.

title: Package comprising a bridge with a bridge alignment structure
abstract: A package comprising a metallization portion comprising at least one dielectric layer; and a plurality of metallization interconnects; a bridge comprising a bridge alignment structure, wherein the bridge is located at least partially in the metallization portion; a first integrated device coupled to the bridge and the metallization portion; and a second integrated device coupled to the bridge and the metallization portion.

title: Sheet-type device and system
abstract: A sheet-type device that can be arranged under a user, the sheet-type device including: a plurality of first sensors configured to acquire a weight of the user,  a second sensor configured to acquire biological information of the user, and  a controller configured to acquire values acquired from the first sensors and to determine a state of the user, wherein the first sensors and the second sensor are arranged in one line along a right-left direction of the user, and the second sensor is arranged between the first sensors.

title: Detection device
abstract: A detection device includes a housing, a transmitting module, a receiving module and a camera module. The transmitting module includes a transmitting plate and a transmitting lens spaced apart in a first predetermined direction, the transmitting plate being used for transmitting a detecting laser so as to cause the detecting laser to be projected outside of the detecting device through the transmitting lens for detecting a target object. The receiving module includes a first receiving plate spaced apart along the first predetermined direction and a first receiving lens, the first receiving lens being used for receiving an echo light and outputting it so as to cause the echo light to be directed to the first receiving plate. The detection device makes the LiDAR function module and the vision function module integrated together, meeting the demand for miniaturization of the movable equipment.

title: Method for controlling electric flight vehicle
abstract: Provided is a method for controlling an electric flight vehicle that comprises: an airframe; a central propulsor disposed in a region including the position of the center of gravity of the airframe; a manifold connected to an outlet of the central propulsor and splitting an airflow into a plurality of directions; a thrust vectoring unit for thrust-vectoring the airflow at outlets of the manifold; a thrust vectoring actuator unit for controlling the attitude of the thrust vectoring unit; and a plurality of peripheral propulsors provided to the airframe so as to surround the central propulsor from the outer peripheral side. The method for controlling the electric flight vehicle includes: a step for starting the central propulsor until reaching a rated rotational speed; and a step for causing the airframe to take off by driving the plurality of peripheral propulsors after the central propulsor has reached the rated rotational speed.

title: 2d van der waals transistors gated with spin crossover/ferroelectric layers for memory applications
abstract: Van der Waals transistors gated with spin crossover/ferroelectric layers for memory applications are described. In certain embodiments, the transistors include a van der Waals material adjacent to a spin crossover molecular material, which is adjacent to a ferroelectric layer. In some embodiments, the van der Waals transistors are used for a thin film molecular memory that satisfies the criteria needed to make a molecular spintronic device, based on spin crossover complexes, competitive with silicon technology. In certain embodiments, the 2D material layer and the spin crossover molecular layer are a heterostructure that reduces impedance compared to a similar memory device lacking the 2D material layer.
assignee: Board Of Regents Of The University Of Nebraska; The Trustees Of Indiana University

title: Sustainable preparation of hexamethylene diisocyanate for the production of polyurethane
abstract: A method of preparing hexamethylene diisocyanate and of preparing polyurethane from hexamethylene diisocyanate is provided. Methanol is used in the method as a raw material for the build-up of the hexamethylene moiety of the hexamethylene diisocyanate.

title: Display panel
abstract: A display panel includes a plurality of first reset signal lines extending along a first direction, respectively; a plurality of second reset signal lines extending along a second direction intersecting the first direction, respectively; and a plurality of second low voltage signal lines extending along the second direction, respectively. The plurality of first reset signal lines and the plurality of second reset signal lines are electrically connected to form an interconnected network. The plurality of first reset signal lines are at least partially in a semiconductor material layer. A total of three data lines are between two most adjacent second reset signal lines of the plurality of second reset signal lines.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Control system for multi-fuel generator set and control method thereof, and generator set
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a control system for a multi-fuel generator set and a control method thereof, and a generator set. The control system includes a fuel switching switch, an engine start switch, a carburetor, a gas supply electric control valve, a signal detection module, an ignition device and a control device; the fuel switching switch and the engine start switch are respectively connected to the signal detection module, and the carburetor, the gas supply electric control valve, the signal detection module, and the ignition device are respectively connected to the control device; the signal detection module is configured to detect a working state signal of the multi-fuel engine and send the detected working state signal to the control device.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor configured to present, via a generative artificial intelligence module, questions to a user regarding food preferences, allergies, ingredient preferences, or meal purposes, and to obtain user responses. The processor analyzes the responses to identify user needs and generates, using an image generation module, a visual image of a dish based on the identified needs. The processor generates, using a three-dimensional food printer module, a cooking command based on the visual image and the identified needs, the cooking command specifying ingredients, ingredient amounts, a cooking method, and a cooking time. A cooking unit of the three-dimensional food printer module processes the ingredients in accordance with the cooking command to physically create a dish matching the user's preferences.

title: Insect trap device
abstract: A removable substrate for an insect attractant device includes a body having at least one surface, an upper region, and a lower region below the upper region. The upper region is configured for handling or positioning the body. The lower region includes at least one first lateral region having a first internal lateral edge and a first external lateral edge, and at least one second lateral region having a second internal lateral edge and a second external lateral edge. A gap is defined between the first and second internal lateral edges. A spacing between the first internal lateral edge and the first external lateral edge defines a first width. A spacing between the second internal lateral edge and the second external lateral edge defines a second width. The gap differs from at least one of the first width and the second width. An adhesive is disposed on the body.

title: Methods and systems for automated simulation activity and synthetic data generation
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques for automated activity simulation and synthetic data generation are provided. A first action associated with an asset in an environment in accordance with a simulation of the asset in the environment is detected. Short-term historical data associated with the asset is identified. The short-term historical data includes first prior simulation events of the simulation and associated with the asset that occurred during a first time period. Second prior simulation events of the simulation and associated with at least one of the first action or an additional asset in the environment is determined based on long-term historical data including simulation events associated with assets of the environment that occurred during a second time period. A simulation command for a second action associated with the asset in accordance with the simulation is generated based on the first prior simulation events and the second prior simulation events.

title: Macro alignment reticle sight system
abstract: An aiming device is provided including an illumination device and an optical element wherein the illumination device projects a primary dot and at least one secondary alignment dot distal from the primary dot to aid a user in obtaining a view of the primary dot when the aiming device is in an aligned mode, the primary dot is visible within a field of view of the user, but the secondary alignment dot is not visible. When the aiming device is in a misaligned mode, the secondary alignment dot is visible to the user, but the primary dot is not. The secondary alignment dot provides instruction to the user to realign the aiming device relative to the field of view of the user so that the aiming device transitions to the aligned mode. A related method of operation is provided.

title: Magnetic sensor
abstract: A magnetic sensor comprises a magnetic body and a first magnetic field sensing element that has a magnetic field sensing direction in a first direction. In the first direction, the center of the magnetic body is at a position different from the center of the first magnetic field sensing element. The magnetic body is located apart from the first magnetic field sensing element in a second direction which is the direction of thickness of the first magnetic field sensing element. The magnetic body includes a soft magnetic layer and a first fixed magnetization portion whose magnetization direction is fixed with respect to an external magnetic field. In a plan view from a third direction that is orthogonal to each of the first and second directions, the first fixed magnetization portion is closer to the first magnetic field sensing element than is the center of the magnetic body.

title: Composition and method for improving dietary supplement solubility and bioavailability via liposomal delivery
abstract: A powdered composition and method are provided to enhance the delivery and bioavailability of supplemental nutrients, metabolites, bioactive compounds, therapeutic agents, and/or combinations of the same as dietary supplements through liposomal encapsulation. The method comprises mixing such supplemental nutrients with inactive ingredients such as anti-caking agents, preservatives, stabilizers, and/or emulsifiers and, to the mixture, adding and further blending a phospholipid material such as sunflower lecithin to liposomally encapsulate the supplemental nutrient particles. The resulting composition improves texture, shelf life, and even dispersion in liquid. By encapsulating dietary supplements, the liposomal blend protects the dietary supplements from degradation in the digestive system, enhancing absorption and facilitating the passage of encapsulated dietary supplements across the intestinal wall and into the bloodstream, improving systemic delivery to target regions in the body.

title: Hat
abstract: A hat in which a brim portion is provided at the lower end of the front panel portion of the crown. The front panel portion of the crown of the hat includes: an outer fabric forming the outer face of the crown; an interlining overlapping the outer fabric on the inner face of the outer fabric; and a stretchable film bonded to the inner face of the interlining.

title: Lettuce variety svld1140
abstract: The invention provides seed and plants of the lettuce line SVLD1140. The invention thus relates to the plants, seeds, and tissue cultures of lettuce line SVLD1140, and to methods for producing a lettuce plant produced by crossing a plant of lettuce line SVLD1140 with itself or with another lettuce plant, such as a plant of another genotype. The invention further relates to seeds and plants produced by such crossing. The invention further relates to parts of a plant of lettuce line SVLD1140, including the gametes of such plants.

title: Sulfate mineral trim and/or molding
abstract: The system and method for a sulfate mineral trim and/or molding. The sulfate mineral trim and/or molding having an outer layer and an inner core. The inner core may comprise paper. The inner core may comprise calcium sulphate dihydrate, with or without additional additives. The sulfate mineral trim and/or molding having one or more attached adhesive strips for mounting to a surface. The sulfate mineral trim and/or molding being configured to be cut to size and shape without the use of power tools.

title: Vehicle control apparatus and method thereof
abstract: An apparatus for a vehicle may comprise a processor and a memory storing at least one instruction that, when executed by the processor communicating with the memory, is configured to cause the apparatus to activate at least one sensor of a plurality of sensors of the vehicle, determine, based on the sensing data of the at least one activated sensor, that a warning condition associated with the vehicle is satisfied, generate image data associated with the warning condition and transmit, to a node, the image data in real time, wherein the image data corresponds to an interior image of the vehicle, adjust, based on a detected external environment of the vehicle, at least one configurable parameter associated with a warning signal, and output the warning signal.

title: Terminal and measurement method for requesting channel state information
abstract: In one aspect, a terminal includes a receiver that receives a request for channel state information from a base station; a processor that identifies a reference signal and a predetermined period to be used for measurement, based on the request, and receives one or more shared channels including the reference signal to measure the channel state information; and a transmitter that transmits a report associated with the measured channel state information to the base station within the predetermined period. In another aspect, a measurement method implemented by a terminal is also disclosed.

title: Device for Displaying in Response to a Sensed Motion
abstract: A device including a visual or audible signaling means and a motion sensor, and logic for activating or controlling the signaling means in response to a sensed motion according to an embedded logic is disclosed. The device may be used as a toy for amusement, and may be shaped like a play ball or as a handheld unit. The device may be powered from a battery, which may be charged from an AC power directly or contactless by using induction or by converting electrical energy from harvested kinetic energy. The embedded logic may activate or control the signaling means, predictably or randomly, in response to the sensed acceleration magnitude or direction, such as sensing the crossing a preset threshold or sensing the peak value. The visual means may be a numeric display for displaying a value associated with the count of the number of times the threshold has been exceeded or the peak magnitude of the acceleration sensed.

title: Air circulation system for rotor assembly
abstract: An air circulation system for a rotor assembly includes a fan and a rotor housing including a plurality of walls. The plurality of walls define a rotor chamber. At least one of the plurality of walls defines at least one cavity. The air circulation system further includes a duct assembly adapted to, at least in part, provide fluid communication between the rotor chamber and the fan of the work machine. The duct assembly includes at least one first duct coupled with at least one of the plurality of walls at the at least one cavity. The at least one first duct provides fluid communication between the rotor chamber and the fan of the work machine via the at least one cavity. Based on an operation of the fan, a fresh airflow is drawn within the rotor chamber to reduce a temperature and improve an air quality within the rotor chamber.

title: User-initiated end-of-delivery confirmation
abstract: A method for user-initiated end of delivery confirmation. A method and technique comprises causing display of a first interactive element on a user device in response to a vehicle carrying a payload approaching a destination; receiving a first user input comprising a first user interaction with the first interactive element; in response to receiving the first user input, causing a vehicle management component communicatively coupled to the vehicle to enable access to the payload in the vehicle and causing display of a second interactive element on the user device; receiving a second user input from the user device, the second user input comprising a second user interaction with the second interactive element; determining a retrieval status associated with the payload based on the second user interaction; and causing display of a confirmation on the user device based on retrieval status, the confirmation indicating that the payload has been retrieved.

title: Tamper protecton
abstract: A hardware security module device comprises a sensor assembly comprising a sensor and a processing component. It further includes an enclosure comprising a cover and a base, the cover and base being mutually spaced apart in a spacing direction and sandwiching the sensor assembly. The sensor is configured to trigger the processing component when the cover is moved away from the sensor. The device includes a structure attached to the cover and projecting from the cover towards the base. The structure is configured to impact the sensor assembly upon lateral movement of the cover with respect to the base, so that lateral movement of the cover with respect to the base is obstructed.

title: Motherboard integrated ransomware intrusion detector
abstract: A motherboard-based ransomware intrusion detector is disclosed. The intrusion detector incudes a measurement circuit to measure power provided to a primary processor and other devices (e.g., storage, network, etc.) on the motherboard and to quantize the measurements into digital signals. The digital signals are provided to a secondary processor that executes a ransomware detection model stored on a non-volatile memory. The measurement circuit, the secondary processor, and the non-volatile memory are also implemented on the motherboard. Using the digital signals and the ransomware detection model, the secondary processor determines if a program executing on the computer system is ransomware. In response to detecting ransomware, the secondary processor causes one or more corrective actions to be taken.

title: Method for establishing boundary of working area of lawnmower, computer readable storage medium and lawnmower
abstract: A method for establishing a boundary of a working area of a lawnmower, non-transitory computer readable storage medium and a lawnmower are provided. The method acquires a first to-be-processed boundary of a working area, and expands the first to-be-processed boundary outward by a preset distance as a second to-be-processed boundary; control the lawnmower to move along the second to-be-processed boundary, acquire environmental information of the lawnmower within the second to-be-processed boundary with a sensor of the lawnmower, to determine a boundary of a non-working area in the environmental information; control the lawnmower to move along the boundary of the non-working area to acquire a third to-be-processed boundary; and establish the boundary of the working area of the lawnmower based on the second and the third to-be-processed boundaries.

title: High-precision tunable laser control system based on pulse width regulation
abstract: The present invention provides a high-precision tunable laser control system based on pulse width regulation, relating to the field of electrical digital data processing. The system includes a pulse width regulation module, a laser drive module, an optical tuning module, a feedback control module, and a man-machine interaction module. The pulse width regulation module is configured to dynamically regulate a pulse width, the laser drive module is configured to drive and generate laser, the optical tuning module is configured to regulate the wavelength of the laser, the feedback control module is configured to monitor the output laser and perform feedback regulation, and the man-machine interaction module is configured to set laser parameters. The system enables analysis and computation based on real-time errors, and feeds back analysis results to a control component for regulation, thereby achieving high-precision laser output.
assignee: Hefei Institutes of Physical Science, CAS

title: Membrane electrode assembly and method for producing same, fuel cell, and electrolysis cell
abstract: A membrane electrode assembly with an anode, a cathode and a hydrocarbon membrane lying between the anode and the cathode. The membrane electrode assembly further includes a protective layer, which is arranged between the anode and the hydrocarbon membrane and/or between the cathode and the hydrocarbon membrane, wherein the protective layer includes at least one ceramic material and one fluorine-containing ionomer, wherein the ceramic material is dispersed in the fluorine-containing ionomer.

title: Glass plate manufacturing method and manufacturing apparatus
abstract: Provided is a manufacturing method for a glass sheet, the method including a breaking step (P 2 ) of breaking a glass sheet (G) being in a vertical orientation and having a scribe line(S) formed on a front surface (Ga) and extending in a vertical direction, to separate a first region (G 1 ) and a second region (G 2 ) which are adjacent to each other in a horizontal direction across the scribe line(S) as a boundary. The method further includes a preparation step (P 1 ) of curving the glass sheet (G) before breaking such that the front surface (Ga) is shaped into a convex curved surface in a cross section parallel to the horizontal direction. After the preparation step (P 1 ), the breaking step (P 2 ) is conducted on the glass sheet (G) in a curved state.

title: Apparatus and method for automatically filling and capping containers
abstract: Apparatus ( 10 ;  10 ′) for automatically filling and capping containers (C), comprising a driving surface ( 17 ,  17 ′,  17 ′'), a first transport member ( 21 ) which is movable on the first driving surface ( 17 ) in a contactless manner by means of magnetic interaction between a first rotor magnetic field of said first transport member ( 21 ) and a first stator magnetic fields generated by first electric means associated to said first driving surface ( 17 ), so that a selective energization of said first electric means allows a movement of the first transport member ( 21 ) relative to the first driving surface ( 17 ). Each transport member ( 21 ) is configured to support at least one closure element (T) and at least one container (C) so as to transport them in a filling station ( 15 ) and in a capping station ( 16 ).

title: Insertion tool for an eye disease treatment device
abstract: Described herein are insertion tools for inserting a treatment device into a pocket formed between two layers of tissue of a patient's eye for treating high intraocular pressure and glaucoma. An insertion tool includes a scissoring mechanism or an expandable mechanism that is configured to expand a pocket formed between the two layers of the tissue of the patient's eye. The scissoring mechanism or the expandable mechanism is also configured to unfurl a treatment device within the pocket.

title: Wearable device for monitoring the health and supervision of a supervised being and related systems and methods
abstract: Systems and methods for aiding, supplementing, and/or increasing the monitoring capabilities of responsible persons over a supervised person are disclosed herein. In some implementations, the system includes one or more controlling persons, one or more supervising persons, a supervised person, and a cloud server. Each of the controlling persons and the supervising persons can have a personal electronic device. The supervised person can have a wearable electronic device. The electronic devices allow the controlling persons and the supervising persons to actively communicate with the cloud server to upload data related to the supervised person that is accessibly stored in the cloud server. In turn, the wearable device can include one or more sensors to measure and communicate various bioindicators to the cloud server. The system allows the controlling persons to monitor the health of, development of, and/or current control over the supervised person.

title: Mitigating errors in measurements from a quantum system by defining regions of trust
abstract: A method, system and computer program product for mitigating errors in measurements from a quantum system. A discriminator is trained to classify the measurement results of the quantum states of qubits as corresponding to a first quantum state (e.g., quantum state of 0) or a second quantum state (e.g., quantum state of 1). A first region of trust (corresponding to trusted measurements of a first quantum state) with a first discriminator boundary and a second region of trust (corresponding to trusted measurements of a second quantum state) with a second discriminator boundary are defined using the trained discriminator. If a shot-to-shot measurement result of a qubit state falls outside such regions of trust, the measurement result is rejected. In this manner, measurement errors from a quantum system are effectively mitigated, including measurement errors involving shot-to-shot measurement results of the quantum states read from the execution of the quantum circuits.

title: Read voltage level bin selection
abstract: A command is received to execute a set of read operations at a plurality of read voltage levels corresponding to a programming distribution associated with a memory device. A set of memory bit counts is determined, wherein each memory bit count corresponds to a respective bin of a set of bins associated with the plurality of read voltage levels of the set of read operations. A valley center bin having a minimum memory bit count of the set of memory bit counts is identified. A data refresh operation is performed on the memory device in response to determining the minimum memory bit count of the valley center bin is greater than or equal to a valley margin threshold.

title: Electronic device and method for identifying the motion of a target object
abstract: An electronic device includes a radar antenna configured to transmit and receive an RF signal, and a processor configured to identify motion of a target object based on a signal received through the radar antenna. The processor configured to obtain a Doppler velocity of the target object, and power of a tone signal obtained in an operation of detecting the target object during a measurement time, obtain a power distribution of the tone signal according to the Doppler velocity, calculate a first correlation value between the power distribution and a first reference distribution corresponding to first motion of the target object, and a second correlation value between the power distribution and a second reference distribution corresponding to second motion of the target object, and determine the motion of the target object as the first motion in response to the first correlation value being greater than the second correlation value.

title: Customizable charge status indicator systems
abstract: Customizable charge status indicator systems are provided for electrified vehicle charge port assemblies. An exemplary charge status indicator system may include a charge port lighting module and a removable insert panel that can be secured over the charge port lighting module. The removable insert panel may include a customized feature for personalizing the charge status indicator system. The charge port lighting module may be configured to produce lighting effects for indicating a charge status of the vehicle, and these lighting effects may be synchronized with sounds provided by an acoustic vehicle alerting system (AVAS) and/or with additional lighting effects provided by a vehicle lighting system.

title: Integrated cooling module
abstract: The present invention discloses an integrated cooling module in which heat exchange components are integrated into a single module by installing a heat exchanger and a valve in a central refrigerant manifold, and the valve is disposed opposite to the heat exchanger, thereby improving packaging efficiency and refrigerant flow characteristics.

title: System and method for a drop-in cantilever seismic brace
abstract: A drop-in cantilever brace system is provided. The drop-in cantilever brace system includes an embedded structural element configured to be flush with a concrete slab, partially embedded in the concrete slab, or fully embedded in the concrete slab and configured to extend from a bottom of the concrete slab. The drop-in cantilever brace system also including an alignment and anchor plate configured to be embedded in a concrete slab. The embedded structural element is configured to support a suspension system configured to support non-structural components of buildings without any lateral bracing.

title: Face-recognition methods and systems for determining user behavioural response
abstract: Systems and methods for determining user behavioural response during media content consumption are provided. Such methods comprise: obtaining response data including one or more video streams depicting facial images of a user; using a facial recognition protocol to obtain an identifier tag for the user based on the facial images depicted in the one or more video streams; associating the facial images of the user with the identifier tag; and determining a behavioural response of the user to the consumed media content based on the identified one or more facial features of the user and the associated tag. The tag can be used as a unique identification label indicative of the user's identity. The determined behavioural response of the user is determined as a behavioural response data stream that is associated with the tag. Such systems comprise: a collection module communicatively linked via a network to a plurality of client devices; and an analysis module communicatively linked to the collection module. Said system is configured to implement the methods disclosed herein.

title: Battery Module, and Battery Pack and Vehicle Including Same
abstract: A battery module includes: a plurality of battery cells and a compression member disposed between the plurality of battery cells. The compression member is filled with a fluid so that the fluid moves therein, and the compression member is configured to be partially deformed in shape by external pressure. A battery pack and a vehicle comprising the battery module are also provided.

title: X-ray detector for non-destructive inspection
abstract: The present invention relates to an x-ray detector for non-destructive inspection, comprising: a scintillator for converting incident x-rays into visible light; a photoelectric converter disposed under the scintillator film to convert the visible light into electrical signals; a lead-free x-ray-absorbing film disposed under the photoelectric converter; a flexible magnetic sheet disposed under the lead-free x-ray-absorbing film.

title: Fabrication method combining laser direct imaging (ldi) and photomask processing
abstract: A method of forming an IC package device is provided. A first IC device is arranged adjacent a second IC device on a substrate, the first IC device including first circuitry and a plurality of first pads and the second IC device including second circuitry and a plurality of second pads, wherein the second IC device is misaligned relative to a target position, such that the second pads are misaligned relative to target positions for the second pads. Laser direct imaging (LDI) processing is used to form (a) substitute second pads at positions corresponding with the target positions for the second pads and (b) second pad connections between the misaligned second pads and the substitute second pads, and a photomask imaging process is used to form IC device interconnections to connect the substitute second pads to first circuitry of the first IC device.

title: Compositions, kits, and methods for silver staining
abstract: The present disclosure provides for a silver buffer composition for the staining of biological samples, where the disclosed silver buffer compositions are free from borax. In some embodiments, the silver buffer compositions include water, isopropyl alcohol, triethanolamine, and DABCO, wherein the composition has a pH ranging from about 9.3 to about 9.9. Also disclosed are methods of staining a biological sample using the disclosed silver buffer compositions.

title: Rollable baseball cap
abstract: A cap includes a crown; and a bill comprising one of a bistable spring sheet or a plurality of bistable springs, the bistable spring sheet or each of the plurality of bistable springs configurable in a first stable state and a second stable state; wherein, in a first position of the cap, the one of the bistable spring sheet or each of the plurality of bistable springs are unrolled in the first stable state and the bill is in an extended configuration, and in a second position of the cap, the one of the bistable spring sheet or each of the plurality of bistable springs are rolled up in the second stable state and the bill is in a rolled configuration; and wherein, in the second position of the cap, a front edge of the bill is rolled towards a back edge of the bill.

title: Method and device for automation of chemical synthesis
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a chemical synthesizer ( 1 ) and a method for performing a chemical synthesis on a chemical synthesizer ( 1 ), the chemical synthesizer comprising an automated chemical reactor ( 12 ), a communication module ( 13 ), and a control module ( 11 ), the method comprising receiving, in the control module ( 11 ) using the communication module ( 13 ), a recipe message from a blockchain platform, the recipe message comprising an encrypted chemical synthesis recipe; decrypting, in the control module ( 11 ), the encrypted chemical synthesis recipe using a cryptographic key securely stored in the control module ( 11 ); and performing, in the automated chemical reactor ( 12 ), the chemical synthesis according to the chemical synthesis recipe.

title: Heating control method for electronic atomizer and electronic device
abstract: A heating control method for an electronic atomizer and an electronic device are provided. The heating control method includes obtaining locking information. The electronic atomizer is set to a locked state based on the locking information. A first inhalation information is obtained. Stop heating information is generated when a heating level corresponding to the first inhalation information is greater than a heating level threshold corresponding to the locked state.

title: Artificial intelligence determination of environmental impact and optimization of a design plan
abstract: Methods and apparatus operative to quantify building metrics using artificial assessment of an environmental impact, such as climate change and/or carbon control practices. A design plan is represented using multiple dynamic components. Each dynamic component may include a parameter changeable via the user interactive interface. The dynamic components may be arranged in a user interactive interface to form a first set of boundaries, including a respective length and area, and defining at least a portion of a first unit. AI may determine a materials list, methods of construction, distance form a supply source to a job site, supply chain variables, and other variables that are included in an environmental impact analysis. The AI may assess whether a building described in the design plans complies with a relevant environmental impact objective, such, for example, objectives relating to carbon footprint and/or climate change.

title: Method for manufacturing a segmented tubular tower, segmented tubular tower and wind turbine
abstract:
A method for manufacturing a segmented tubular tower section is provided. The method includes the following steps:
         Providing at least two steel sheets at a manufacturing site;   drilling two pairs of parallel rows of holes along each of the two vertical division lines of each of the two steel sheets, whereas each pair of the two parallel rows is drilled such that each corresponding vertical division line is arranged between the corresponding pair of the two parallel rows;   cutting the at least two steel sheets along the two vertical division lines to form two vertical segments; and   connecting the two vertical segments with one another to rebuild each of the two vertical division lines between the two vertical segments at a building site using a plurality of connectors to form the segmented tubular tower section.
assignee: Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy Innovation & Technology, S.L.

title: Mechanism for small data transmission
abstract: Example embodiments of the present disclosure related to configuration small data transmission (SDT). A terminal device transmits, to a network device, information indicating a set of radio bearers applicable to be configured in at least one small data transmission configuration. In this way, the network device is able to properly configure the radio bear(s) for the SDT.

title: Devices and methods for manufacturing detachable co-packaged connectors
abstract: Some embodiments of the present disclosure are directed to a method for manufacturing detachable electronic modules. The method may include providing a fine alignment element, receiving the fine alignment element in a cavity of a positioning tool, aligning the positioning tool with a planar body of a mounting element or a coupling surface of an attachment element while maintaining the fine alignment element in the cavity of the positioning tool, disposing the fine alignment element in a concavity of the mounting element or the attachment element using the positioning tool, and maintaining the fine alignment element in the concavity using the positioning tool while bonding the fine alignment element within the concavity. Some embodiments of the present disclosure are directed to a positioning tool, which may include a base member defining a plurality of cavities, where each cavity includes a vacuum port in communication with a vacuum source.

title: Resonant encoded memory (rem)
