abstract: The Resonant Encoded Memory (REM) system utilizes Electromagnetic Holography (EmH) and comprises a Quantum Transceiver Antenna (QTA) with layered antenna pixels and toroidal geometries. The QTA captures multidimensional EM wave-states—including spin, position, superposition, and particle-wave relationships—storing them as spatial voxels in superconductive meta-material substrates as Resonant Encoded Memory (REM). The system supports read/write operations, additive and subtractive memory functions, and encodes frequency markers within each EmH for rapid categorization, search, parsing, retrieval, and secure transmission. A Transceiver Discriminator (TD) with AI-driven difference engine enables near-instantaneous secure data transfer, pattern-based analysis, non-destructive processing, and computation of historical progressions via cumulative subtractive differences of stored EmH for temporal evolution analysis. Optionally powered by a Q-Tricity Flash Capacitor harvesting ambient quantum digital electricity from living organisms and signals without interference, the REM integrates into an Electromagnetic Imaging Device (EMID) and deploys across portable, terrestrial, sub-ground, aerial, satellite, and space-based platforms for imaging, identification, authentication, secure communications, fraud detection, and analytics.

title: Electro-Photonic Network For Machine Learning
abstract: Electro-photonic networks, including a plurality of processing elements connected by bidirectional photonic channels, suited for implementing neural-network models. Weights of the model may be preloaded into memory of the processing elements based on assignments of neural nodes to processing elements implementing them, and routers of the processing elements can be configured to stream activations between the processing elements based on a predetermined flow of activations in the model.

title: Quantum resource estimation using a re-parameterization method
abstract: Systems, computer-implemented methods, and computer program products to facilitate estimation of quantum resources to calculate an expectation value of a stochastic process using a re-parameterization method are provided. According to an embodiment, a system can comprise a processor that executes computer executable components stored in memory. The computer executable components can comprise a re-parameterization component that applies a quantum fault-tolerant operation to a variationally prepared quantum state corresponding to a probability distribution to produce a quantum state corresponding to a target probability distribution. The computer executable components can further comprise an estimation component that estimates at least one defined criterion of a quantum computer to be used to compute an expectation value of a stochastic process associated with the target probability distribution.
assignee: International Business Machines Corporation; Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC

title: Heat transfer unit, apparatus and associated method
abstract: A heat transfer unit adapted to be applied to a human face in order to transfer heat to/from the human face comprises a first flexible material layer and a second flexible material layer defining a fluid chamber therebetween, allowing a heat transfer fluid to flow through the fluid chamber. The first and second flexible material layers are connected to one another at a plurality of connection locations. The heat transfer unit is dimensioned such that, when applied to a human face, it can cover at least 70% of the surface of the human face. The heat transfer unit can be used to heat or cool a human face, in particular in a thermal therapy treatment of a human face, and in particular in the treatment of tissue damage after surgical interventions, injuries or inflammations.

title: Subband configuration
abstract: A method includes a base station indicating to a UE at least one frequency resource for at least one subband, wherein the at least one subband comprises at least one of a Downlink (DL) subband, an Uplink (UL) subband, or a guard band.

title: Common-mode voltage cancellation circuit and method of forming
abstract: A common-mode voltage cancellation (CMVC) circuit and method of forming is disclosed. The CMVC circuit includes a set of input lines configured to receive a respective input phase voltage, each respective input phase voltage including a common-mode voltage component, and a set of output lines configured to provide a respective output phase voltage. The CMVC circuit also includes a set of first capacitors electrically coupled between a respective input line and a node, and a coupled inductor, having a primary winding and at least one secondary winding, the at least one secondary winding electrically coupled in series between a respective input line and a respective output line. A first resistor and the primary winding are electrically coupled in series between the node and an electrical ground.

title: Ceramic and metal materials with controlled microstructures, and systems and methods for fabrication and use thereof
abstract: The microstructure of metallic and/or ceramic layers is controlled based on heating/cooling parameters of the fabrication process. The heating/cooling parameters can be selected to generate materials completely in the glass phase, having a hybrid construction (e.g., glass/crystalline) with different lattice microstructures, or having a polycrystalline microstructure with aligned crystal grains. Such materials with controlled microstructures can be used as solid-state electrolytes (SSEs), as cathodes in solid-state batteries, or as structural materials. When employed as SSEs, the glass phase portions of the fabricated materials can function as an interphase layer that blocks ion penetration and/or dendrite formation, while still retaining good ionic conductivity.

title: Method and apparatus for generating harq-ack information associated with sidelink transmission for pucch transmission
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to method and apparatus for generating HARQ-ACK information associated with sidelink transmission for PUCCH transmission. According to some embodiments of the disclosure, a first UE may: receive, from a BS, a DCI format for scheduling a resource or activating a configured grant for transmitting a PSSCH; transmit, to a second UE, the PSSCH based on the DCI format, wherein sidelink HARQ-ACK feedback for the PSSCH is to be transmitted by the second UE in a plurality of candidate PSFCH transmission occasions; detect the sidelink HARQ-ACK feedback for the PSSCH in one or more of the plurality of candidate PSFCH transmission occasions; and determine, based on the detected sidelink HARQ-ACK feedback or an absence of the sidelink HARQ-ACK feedback in the one or more of the plurality of candidate PSFCH transmission occasions, HARQ-ACK information corresponding to the PSSCH to be transmitted to the BS in a first PUCCH transmission occasion of a plurality of PUCCH transmission occasions.

title: Battery assembly
abstract: A battery assembly includes a first endplate, a second endplate, a cell stack disposed between the first endplate and the second endplate, a fluid circuit, and at least one piston disposed between the endplates and operable with the fluid circuit to compress the cell stack.

title: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells for treating cancer
abstract: A method for treating and/or preventing cancer in a subject. The method includes administering to the subject a therapeutically effective amount of a population of plasmacytoid dendritic cells. The therapeutically effective amount of population of plasmacytoid dendritic cells is at least 5 million cells. The administration may be done 1 to 10 times daily.

title: Systems and methods for progressive text zoom
abstract: The technology provides a dynamic, scalable way to adjust the verbosity of text content of electronic documents and other digital materials. The technology applies a scaling concept for text, which can numerically measure the level of verbosity or detail in a document. This beneficially enables users to “zoom” in and out of the text via a user interface while reading. The amount of detail is readily adjustable to provide either less or more detail than the original content, which enhances readers'ability to efficiently navigate and comprehend large documents. The verbosity level of a document as a whole, or even for a specific section of a document can by adjusted. A verbosity level classifier is trained for use in a summarizer. The system can provide a dynamic, scalable approach to adjust the verbosity of the content.

title: Hinge mechanism and electronic device
abstract: A hinge mechanism includes a first rotation module, a second rotation module, and a main shaft. The first rotation module and the second rotation module are disposed on two opposite sides of the main shaft. The first rotation module includes a first door plate and a first arc arm, at least a part of the first arc arm is disposed on a surface that is of the first door plate and that is away from a flexible display, and the first arc arm is rotatably connected to the main shaft. The first door plate is provided with at least two first limiting holes, a first connecting piece is disposed in the first limiting hole, and the first connecting piece is fastened to the first arc arm.

title: Semiconductor package warpage and alignment management
abstract: An integrated circuit is attached to a substrate by separating them using one or more spacers and by a plurality of solder balls, and aligning them using at least one alignment element. A clamping mechanism biases the integrated circuit and substrate toward one another and coplanar to one another, and the integrated circuit, the substrate, and the clamping mechanism are heated to reflow the plurality of solder balls. The heat is removed, causing the plurality of reflowed solder balls to solidify, and the clamping mechanism is removed. The plurality of solder balls is underfilled, further securing the integrated circuit to the substrate.

title: Fire suppressant device and method
abstract: The invention relates to a fire suppression device and method, in particular a device for delivering free-flowing granular fire suppressant media to a fire or potential fire emergency, in particular one caused by Li-ion battery failure, comprising a media reservoir adapted to supply an auger housed in a tubular barrel and mechanism for rotating the auger so as to deliver the fire suppressant media to the fire or potential fire emergency, and a method of using same to combat a fire or potential fire emergency by suppressing and/or extinguishing the fire.
assignee: Anthony Cosimano; Lisa A. Sasse; John M. Lordy

title: An aerosol-generating system and method for controlling power provided to a heater
abstract: An aerosol-generating system is provided, including: a DC power supply to generate a DC supply voltage; and control circuitry to control a supply of electrical power from the power supply to a heater to aerosolize a liquid aerosol-forming substrate, the control circuitry including: a DC/DC voltage converter to receive the supply voltage as an input and to output an output voltage to power the heater, and a controller to control the voltage converter to adjust the output voltage based on a predetermined power profile for the heater, the profile including: a first time period of a user puff during which a substantially constant first power value is supplied to the heater, and a second time period of the user puff after the first time period during which a substantially constant second power value is supplied to the heater, and the second power value being less than the first power value.

title: Systems and Methods for Improved Data Access Speed
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for a memory device. A memory device includes a memory array, a column selection circuit coupled to the memory array, where the column selection circuit is configured to generate a column selection signal, and a sense amplifier configured to receive data signals from the memory array. An enable signal generating circuit is configured to generate a first enable signal and a second enable signal. The column selection circuit generates the column selection signal based on the first enable signal, and the sense amplifier is configured to receive a data signal from the memory array in response to the second enable signal.

title: Inductive Power Couplings for Pool and Spa Equipment
abstract: A cable swivel for inductive power couplings for powering pool or spa components is provided. A swivel component allows a power cable to a pool or spa component, such as an electric pool cleaner, to swivel when the inductive power couplings are coupled together. The couplings include a first inductive coupling that can be positioned within and/or mounted into a wall fitting, a second inductive coupling that inductively couples with the first inductive coupling, and a swivel component attached to the second inductive coupling for allowing the second coupling to swivel with respect to the first inductive coupling. A retainer ring engages with the wall fitting and retains the first and second couplings and the swivel component in position within the wall fitting.

title: Systems and methods for metallic deionization
abstract: In some embodiments, the present disclosure relates to a method. The method includes determining a first metal ion concentration of a tank solution within a tank at a first time. A first iteration of remediation to the tank solution is performed in response to a first determination that the first metal ion concentration is greater than a threshold value. A second metal ion concentration of the tank solution within the tank is determined at a second time after performing the first iteration of remediation. A second iteration of remediation to the tank solution is performed in response to a second determination that the second metal ion concentration is greater than the threshold value.

title: Climbing stick
abstract: An injection-molded climbing stick includes a first step, a second step, and a post extending from the first step to the second step along a length of the post and comprising a plurality of fibers that includes every fiber that is disposed within the post. The plurality of fibers includes a sub-plurality of fibers. Each fiber in the sub-plurality of fibers is elongated in a lengthwise direction of the fiber and oriented such that the lengthwise direction is substantially parallel to the length of the post, and the sub-plurality of fibers includes a majority of the fibers in the plurality of fibers.

title: Glass-ceramic with low phase volume and high optical extinction in NUV/VIS/NIR
abstract: An electromagnetic radiation absorbing element with a glass-ceramic with an Ilmenite solid solution with crystallites of the formula (Fe x Mn y Mg z )TiO 3  in the crystal phase and a low volume fraction of the crystalline phase (also referred to as low crystalline phase volume) and very high optical extinction coefficient (extinction/path length) in the near ultraviolet (NUV), visible (VIS) and near infrared (NIR) spectral range. The glass-ceramic can be produced and processed with standard glass processing methods such as melting, hot forming, bending, drawing, and/or toughening (thermal and chemical). A method of producing the glass-ceramic and the use of the glass-ceramic is also provided.
assignee: Schott Ag; Schott North America, Inc.

title: Biological neural network system and methods
abstract: Techniques for using a biological and artificial neural network (BANN) system to generate a neural-based embedding of an input signal. The BANN system comprises a multi-electrode array (MEA); a biological neural network (BNN) comprising neurons arranged on the MEA, an artificial neural network; and at least one processor. The method comprises using the BANN system to stimulate the BNN by using the MEA to generate electrical signals in accordance with a stimulation pattern generated based on the input signal; measure, using the MEA, a response of the BNN responsive to the stimulating by deriving from the response of the BNN, multiple features of the at least one response; and process the multiple features derived from the response of the BNN with the ANN to generate the neural-based embedding, wherein the ANN is trained to process the multiple features derived from the response of the BNN.

title: A device, system, computer program and method for outputting a control signal
abstract: According to embodiments of the disclosure, there is provided a device comprising: processing circuitry configured to: receive a plurality of polarised light images of an object made at least in part from a polarising material, the polarising material being glass or PET plastic, wherein each of the plurality of polarised light images has a different polarisation; calculate a degree of polarisation associated with the object based on the plurality of polarised light images; determine, based on the degree of polarisation, whether the polarising material is glass or PET plastic; and output a control signal indicating the result of the determination.

title: Composition comprising an associative thickener
abstract: The invention deals with a thickener composition comprising at least one anionic surfactant, and at least one associative thickener, wherein the associative thickener comprises at least one polyether segment, and at least one hydrophobic segment according to formula (I) where R 4  is independent of each occurrence hydrogen, alkyl, cycloalkyl, aryl or arylalkyl.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to convert, by an audio recognition unit, an audio signal received via a telephone line into digital data and convert the digital data into text data, analyze, by a natural language processing unit, the text data generated by the audio recognition unit and generate a summary of a conversation, compare, by a fraud determination unit, the summary generated by the natural language processing unit with predetermined fraud determination conditions and determine a possibility of fraud, and issue, by a warning notification unit, a warning to a user when the fraud determination unit determines that there is the possibility of fraud, and transmit a notification to a registered related person when necessary.

title: An orally rapidly disintegrating tablet of propranolol and its process of preparation
abstract: The present invention relates to an Orally rapidly disintegrating tablet comprising Propranolol or pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, at least one disintegrant, at least one diluent, a lubricant, a sweetener, and a flavoring agent. The present invention is based on enhancing disintegration and dissolution, which is beneficial in the treatment of hypertension, angina, atrial fibrillation, myocardial infarction, migraine, essential tremor, hypertrophic subaortic stenosis, pheochromocytoma, proliferating infantile hemangioma and very convenient for administration for solid dosage form without swallowing difficulties, thereby increasing patient compliance.

title: Method and device for transmitting pc5 rrc message, of multi-carrier-supporting terminal
abstract: Provided are a method for a first device performing wireless communication, and a device supporting same. The method may comprise the steps of: acquiring configuration information related to a plurality of carriers; acquiring logical channel data; and transmitting a PC5 radio resource control (RRC) message to a second device. For example, the PC5 RRC message may be transmitted on the basis of a first carrier included among one or more carriers related to the logical channel data, among the plurality of carriers.

title: Eyeglass lens and eyeglasses
abstract: The visual appearance of an eyeglass lens that allows a wearer to visually recognize light having a predetermined peak wavelength is improved. The eyeglass lens includes: a lens portion; and a light extraction portion disposed on a wearer side of the lens portion or a side opposite to the wearer side. The light extraction portion is configured to extract light having a predetermined wavelength to the wearer side, the light having been guided through an inside of the lens portion.

title: Method and system for determining a pattern deviation value of a visible surface of a panel
abstract: The invention relates to a method and system for determining a pattern deviation value of a top surface of a panel, in particular a top surface of a floor panel or wall panel. The method and system enable the calculation of a pattern deviation value based upon a determined pattern value and the at least one selected standard pattern value.

title: Functional fabric
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to a functional fabric for use in a garment. The functional fabric comprises first hydrophobic yarns and second hydrophilic yarns arranged to form a composite fabric layer. The composite fabric layer includes a user facing side and an outer facing side. The outer facing side of the composite fabric layer includes a substantially liquid-impermeable barrier.

title: Linker and use thereof in ligand drug conjugate
abstract: A linker and a use thereof in a ligand drug conjugate. Provided is a compound as represented by formula (III), or a mesomer, a racemate, an enantiomer, a diastereomer or a mixture form thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, or a solvate thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of a solvate thereof. The linker can be selectively coupled with thiols in biomacromolecules, has extremely high coupling efficiency and high drug loading capacity; and also shows high chemical stability.

title: Hub system, method and device with adjustable deadband
abstract: A freewheel hub having a non-zero deadband distance in order to reduce or eliminate pedal kickback. The deadband distance is able to have or be adjusted to a desired length including lengths that enable silent freewheeling operation where the pawls of the freewheel body do not engage or contact the teeth of the ratchet gear thereby eliminating any contact-based freewheeling sound.

title: Memory devices and operating methods thereof, memory systems, word line voltage control circuits
abstract: The present disclosure provides memory devices, operating methods thereof, memory systems, and word line voltage control circuits. A disclosed memory device comprises an array of memory cells, a plurality of word lines coupled with the memory cells, and a peripheral circuit coupled to the memory cells through the word lines. The peripheral circuit is configured to reduce a first voltage on a non-selected word line adjacent to a selected word line to a second voltage, provide a pre-charge voltage to the selected word line, increase the second voltage on the non-selected word line to a third voltage, and float the selected word line.

title: Garden bean variety 'corvette'
abstract: A new variety of garden bean ( Phaseolus vulgaris  L.) designated ‘Corvette’ is provided. Garden bean variety ‘Corvette’ is characterized by its dark fleshy pods, uniform pod setting, and resistance to Anthracnose ( Colletotrichum lindemuthianum ) and Halo Blight ( Pseudomonas syringe  pv.  phaseolicola ).

title: Terminal device and method for destination selection for sidelink transmission
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a terminal device and a method for destination selection for sidelink transmission. A terminal device receives, via the transceiver, channel occupancy time (COT) sharing information. The terminal device determines whether there is at least one destination fulfilling a COT requirement associated with the COT sharing information among one or more destinations to which the terminal device has data to transmit. The terminal device selects, from the one or more destinations, a destination for a sidelink transmission based on a result of the determination. In this way, the reliability and efficiency of sidelink communication may be improved

title: Methods, Entities, and Computer Readable Media for Error Handling
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods, entities and computer readable storage media for error handling. The method at a first entity includes: determining, based on a policy decision provisioned by a second entity, that an error in at least one of: reference of a session rule and/or a Policy and Charging Control, PCC, rule to the policy decision, or an attribute in the policy decision; and transmitting, to the second entity, a notification of the error.

title: Compounds and compositions including phosphorothioated oligodeoxynucleotide, and methods of use thereof
abstract: Isolated compounds, including a phosphorothioated oligodeoxynucleotide sequence conjugated to a short-activating RNA or an antisense oligonucleotide sequence, and compositions of such compounds, can be used in the treatment of cancer and autoimmune diseases, immune stimulation, activating CEBPA, and reducing activity of STAT transcription factor. Exemplary short-activating include CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein-α short-activating RNA, p21 short-activating RNA, and p53 short-activating RNA

title: Acoustic wave device, filter, and multiplexer
abstract: An acoustic wave device includes a substrate, a piezoelectric layer provided on the substrate, and a pair of interdigitated electrodes provided on the piezoelectric layer, each of the interdigitated electrodes including a plurality of electrode fingers that excite an acoustic wave and a busbar to which the plurality of electrode fingers are connected. An anisotropic coefficient γ represented by k x   2 +γk y   2 =k 0   2  is equal to or more than 1.7, where k x  is a wavenumber of the acoustic wave in an arrangement direction of the plurality of fingers, k y  is a wavenumber of the acoustic wave in a longitudinal direction of the plurality of fingers, and k 0  is a wavenumber of the acoustic wave in a direction inclined from the arrangement direction toward the longitudinal direction.

title: Image decoding method and apparatus using intra prediction, and image encoding method and apparatus using intra prediction
abstract: An image decoding method includes: identifying a first sample set and a second sample set reconstructed before the current block; performing intra prediction by using one of the first sample set or the second sample set as a reference sample set according to each directional mode of a plurality of directional modes to obtain a plurality of prediction sample sets corresponding to the other one of the first sample set or the second sample set; determining a directional mode for the current block, from among the plurality of directional modes, based on cost values corresponding to comparison results between each prediction sample set of the plurality of prediction sample sets and the other one of the first sample set or the second sample set; and reconstructing the current block by performing intra prediction on the current block according to the directional mode for the current block.

title: Systems and methods for dynamically generating groups of received textual data for collective labeling
abstract: System and methods disclosed herein are for generating labels for dynamically received textual data based on similarity with previously-labeled datasets. The system may receive first textual data. The system may determine a first timestamp at which the first textual data was received. The system may determine a first receipt range for the first textual data based on the first timestamp. The system may retrieve a plurality of datasets. The system may select a first dataset from the plurality of datasets. The system may retrieve second textual data from the first dataset. The system may determine a first similarity metric between the first textual data and the first dataset. The system may compare the first similarity metric to a threshold similarity metric. The system may determine to assign a label for the second textual data to the first textual data.

title: Rack for supporting electronic devices
abstract: A support rack for supporting electronic devices, comprising a base, two legs, and at least one compliant assembly with elastically biased fins that support the electronic device(s). The rack accommodates electronic devices of different sizes while preventing unwanted movement.

title: Method and apparatus for reading data stored in flash memory by referring to binary digit distribution characteristics of bit sequences read from flash memory
abstract: A method for reading data stored in a flash memory includes at least the following steps: controlling the flash memory to perform a plurality of read operations upon a plurality of memory cells included in the flash memory; obtaining a plurality of bit sequences read from the memory cells, respectively, wherein the read operations read bits of a predetermined bit order from the memory cells by utilizing different control gate voltage settings; and determining readout information of the memory cells according to binary digit distribution characteristics of the bit sequences.

title: Fat composition comprising tributyrin and its use in calf milk replacers
abstract: The present invention provides a fat composition comprising a) at least 0.7 wt % tributyrin; b) 25-60 wt % fats, e.g., vegetable and/or animal fats; c) 18-75 wt % protein, e.g., milk protein and optionally vegetable protein; and d) optionally, carbohydrates such as lactose, as well as the use thereof in a composition for feeding young farming mammals, in particular to improve their performance and gastrointestinal development.

title: Cloud printing services
abstract: Apparatus, method, and software for a cloud printing service. In an embodiment, a print job manager of a cloud printing service is configured to receive print job information submitted by a user over a communication network, and perform a job approval procedure to interact with the user by operating a machine-learning model trained to generate a recommendation to modify the print job information in order to improve a production variable regarding printing of a print file at one or more print devices, providing an approval request to the user indicating the recommendation, and receiving an approval response from the user approving the recommendation. The print job manager is configured to generate a print job based on the print job information modified according to the recommendation approved by the user, and provide the print job to a destination.

title: Control device, power supply system, and control method
abstract: A control device is equipped with a current value determination unit that determines whether a current value acquired using a current sensor that detects a charging/discharging current of a power storage device is less than or equal to a determination threshold value used for determining whether charging or discharging is occurring, a control unit which, if the current value determination unit has determined that the current value acquired by the current sensor is less than or equal to the determination threshold value, carries out a control in order to make the current value greater than the determination threshold value, and a disconnection determination unit which determines, if, despite the control being carried out by the control unit, the current value acquired using the current sensor is less than or equal to the determination threshold value, that a disconnection has occurred in a wiring connected to the power storage device.

title: Integrated cat's-eye tunable laser spectroscopy system and method
abstract: A spectroscopy system comprises a tunable laser including a gain chip, a collimating lens for collimating light from the gain chip, an end reflector, a focusing lens for focusing the collimated light on the end reflector, a thin film bandpass filter between the collimating lens and the focusing lens, and an angle control actuator for changing the angle of the thin film filter to the collimated light. The light from the laser is coupled into a sample cell providing a sample. An amplitude detector detects light from the tunable laser prior to passing into the sample cell and a sample detector detecting light from the tunable laser after passing through the sample cell. A processor controls the angle control actuator and monitors a time response of the sample detector and the amplitude detector to resolve an absorption spectra of the sample.

title: Wireless measurement device and wireless measurement method
abstract: A wireless measurement device includes a setting unit that sets the number of samples, an input level range, and an attenuation change amount of a transmission signal as first measurement conditions, a cross correlation EVM calculation unit that calculates error vectors from the pieces of IQ data, performs a cross correlation calculation using the calculated error vectors, and averages results of the cross correlation calculation to calculate a cross correlation EVM, and a display unit that displays a graph showing the calculated cross correlation EVM and the input level, in which an appropriate input level is selected based on the cross correlation EVM and the input level.

title: Provenance authentication framework for artificial intelligence system
abstract: A system, method, and non-transitory computer-readable medium trace repurposing of targeted artificial intelligence systems. Storage media hold a training dataset sourced at least in part from a target artist, where a target artist configuration characterizes the artist's work, together with a provenance wrapper containing a provenance vault accessible by a provenance private key, the vault holding a creator's list. One or more processors train an artificial intelligence system on the dataset to produce a trained version that constructs outputs satisfying the target artist configuration, make the trained version available, provide access to it, and validate that new outputs from repurposing it satisfy the configuration. The creator's list authenticates the new outputs. A parent non-fungible token assigned to the trained version traces back from offspring tokens of downstream digital assets, including outputs of further-trained versions combining additional artist configurations and outputs deployed via a blockchain network.

title: Ultrasound diagnostic system
abstract: An ultrasound diagnostic system comprises a processor configured to execute determination processing and output suggestion information. The determination processing determines, from ultrasound images such as a vascular image or a blood flow waveform obtained in a current examination, an imaging scene and a lesion state represented by the ultrasound images. The determination processing is constructed by machine learning using, for example, an ultrasound image as input and information on an imaging scene and a lesion state corresponding to the ultrasound image as labeled data. The suggestion information suggests an additional examination or measurement based on a combination of the imaging scene and the lesion state determined by the determination processing. The suggestion information is generated, for example, by referring to a look-up table in which the combination of the imaging scene and the lesion state and the additional examination or measurement corresponding to the combination are registered.

title: Wind turbine blade manufacturing using intelligent imaging
abstract: A manufacturing system for a process of manufacturing a wind turbine blade part, such as a blade half or a segment for a blade half, e.g. a composite fibre wind turbine blade. An imaging system with cameras (CM) arranged at an elevated position to capture images of an area of manufacturing (A_M). A processor system (PS) is arranged to process (IA) captured images from the imaging system to analyze the captured images at least with respect to texture and/or contrast. Based on the image analysis, to detect (AD) an anomaly on a part of the wind turbine blade during the manufacturing process, to classify (ACL) the anomaly as one of a plurality of predetermined types of anomalies according to the analysis of the texture, and to further determine (AL) localization of the classified anomaly on the wind turbine blade, e.g. both span-wise and chord-wise position. A user interface is connected to the processor system to communicate an anomaly type and a localization on the wind turbine blade part in real-time to an operator of the manufacturing process.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to receive a message input by a user, translate the message into a specified language, and transmit the translated message to a recipient.

title: Visualization of reflectors in intraluminal ultrasound images and associated systems, methods, and devices
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices for visualizing a reflector in a lumen of a patient are provided. In one embodiment, a system for visualizing a reflector includes an intraluminal ultrasound imaging catheter in communication with a processor circuit. The processor circuit is configured to receive, from the intraluminal ultrasound imaging catheter, ultrasound image signals representative of the lumen and the reflector, generate first ultrasound image data based on the ultrasound image signals, generate second ultrasound image data based on a portion of the ultrasound image signals associated with a second frequency different from the transmit frequency, and output a visualization based on the first and second ultrasound image data to a display. In some aspects, the visualization may serve to identify and distinguish nonlinear reflectors from linear reflectors in the combined image.

title: Systems and methods for switch driver for power converter for electric vehicle
abstract: A system includes a power converter, wherein the power converter includes: a switch; and one or more controllers configured to control an operation of the switch based on a dual-loop feedback control profile.

title: Absorbent composite materials, absorbent articles comprising absorbent composite materials, and methods of making thereof
abstract: Disclosed herein are absorbent composite materials, absorbent articles comprising said absorbent composite materials, and methods of making thereof. The absorbent composite materials comprising: a superabsorbent material; and a cooling agent; wherein the cooling agent is physically encapsulated within the superabsorbent material. Also disclosed herein are absorbent articles comprising said absorbent composite materials, methods of making the absorbent composite materials, and methods of making the absorbent articles comprising the absorbent composite materials.

title: Offline digital asset generation and provisioning
abstract: A system for offline generation of digital assets includes: a security credential management system (SCMS) that is operable to generate and conditionally transmit digital assets; and a certificate authority communicatively connected to the SCMS by a communication network, the certificate authority being operable to receive the digital assets from the SCMS. The certificate authority is operable to securely provision a plurality of computerized devices based on the received digital assets, the certificate authority intermittently connects to the SCMS to receive the digital assets, the certificate authority is operable to securely provision the plurality of computerized devices while disconnected from the SCMS, and the provisioning by the certificate authority while disconnected from the SCMS is limited by a policy associated with the certificate authority.

title: Display panel and display device
abstract: Provided are a display panel and a display device. The display panel includes a pixel circuit and a light-emitting element. The pixel circuit includes a drive module, a data write module, a compensation module and a reset module. The drive module includes a drive transistor; the data write module is connected to a first electrode of the drive transistor; the compensation module is connected between a gate of the drive transistor and a second electrode of the drive transistor; and the reset module is connected to the gate of the drive transistor or the second electrode of the drive transistor. The working process of the pixel circuit includes a first bias adjustment stage, and the first bias adjustment stage includes a first stage; and in the first stage, the data write module and the reset module are turned off, and the compensation module is turned on.
assignee: Xiamen Tianma Display Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Semiconductor devices
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a wiring line on a substrate, a first line portion having a line shape in a first direction, a head hammer pattern connected to an end of the first line portion in the first direction; a second wiring line spaced from the first wiring line in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction, the second wiring line including a second line portion parallel to the first line portion; a first contact plug electrically connecting the first line portion and the second line portion, the first contact plug being positioned adjacent to the first end of the first line portion and a second end of the second line portion in the first direction. The first contact plug has a bottom surface higher than a bottom surface of the first and second wiring lines. The upper surface of the first head hammer pattern contacts an insulation material.

title: Diene rubber composition comprising a polynitrone
abstract:
A rubber composition comprising a diene elastomer, a reinforcing filler and a compound which is of formula (I) or (II):

             n is an integer ranging from 2 to 4, 
             n′ is an integer ranging from 1 to 3, 
             m is an integer greater than or equal to 2, 
             R 1  is a group of valency m connecting the furan aromatic rings of the compound of formula (II), and 
             R 2  is a hydrocarbon group which can be interrupted by one or more heteroatoms, is provided.

title: Drive system for a utility vehicle
abstract: A utility vehicle having a chassis frame extending along a centerline axis, the chassis frame including a first side frame member and a second side frame member opposing one another about the centerline axis. A first drive mechanism is supported by the first frame member, and a second drive mechanism is supported by the second frame member. A first gearset assembly is coupled to the first drive mechanism, and a second gearset assembly is coupled to the second drive mechanism. A first axial flux electric motor is coupled to the first gearset and positioned between the first frame member and the first gearset, and a second axial flux electric motor is coupled to the second gearset and positioned between the second frame member and the second gearset. The first gearset and the second gearset are spaced apart from one another on opposite sides of the centerline axis.

title: Device and system including a security hologram and a prophylaxis for delivering a gratuity
abstract: A device including a security hologram and a prophylaxis and a system for providing a gratuity is disclosed. The system includes a mobile computing device including one or more processors and memory holding computer program instructions executable by the one or more processors. The computer-implemented program instructions reads a machine-readable code in a hotel room and transmits the machine-readable code and an indication of a gratuity amount including a gratuity sender source of funds account to a service provider.

title: Re-routing autonomous vehicles using dynamic routing and memory management
abstract: The invention relates to a system and method for navigating an autonomous driving vehicle (ADV) that utilizes ADV an-onboard computer and/or one or more ADV control system nodes in an ADV network platform. The on-board computer receives sensor data concerning one or more occupants occupying an ADV and/or the ADV itself and, upon a detection of an event, automatically initiates a dynamic routing algorithm that utilizes artificial intelligence to re-route the ADV to another destination, for example a healthcare facility. One or more embodiment of the system and method include an ADV on-board computer and/or one or more ADV network platform nodes that utilize in-memory processing to aid in the generation of routing, health and navigational information to advantageously navigate an ADV.

title: Care Provider Coverage Filter for Communication Devices
abstract: Embodiments include methods, devices, systems, and non-transitory process-readable storage media for managing care provider coverage in a medical communication system. Some embodiments may include receiving from a first communication device associated with a first user a coverage request defining a coverage period and requesting that a second user associated with a second communication device provide care coverage for the first user, sending a notification of the coverage request to the second communication device including the coverage period and requesting agreement to provide care coverage for the first user, receiving from the second communication device an acceptance of the coverage request, and directing to the second communication device a message sent to the first communication device during the coverage period in response to receiving the acceptance of the coverage request.

title: Sodium secondary battery and electric device
abstract: A sodium secondary battery and an electric device are provided. The sodium secondary battery includes a negative electrode plate and an electrolytic solution. The negative electrode plate includes a negative electrode active material having an actual discharge-specific capacity measured by a three-stage stepwise discharge method relative to a total discharge-specific capacity defining a ratio a. The electrolytic solution includes a compound represented by formula I, having a mass content b based on a total mass of the electrolytic solution. The parameters a and b satisfy 0.45≤a+b≤1.5. The sodium secondary battery exhibits reduced volume expansion after high-temperature storage and improved low-temperature charging performance and cycling stability.

title: Systems and methods for hypothermic transport of an organ
abstract: A transport container and methods for preserving an organ at a hypothermic temperature. The transport container can maintain the organ at a temperature of 6-8° C. for improved results after transplantation. The preservation of the organ within this range can improve transplantation outcomes.

title: Soap dispenser housing
abstract: A soap dispenser housing is provided, relating to the field of soap dispensers. The soap dispenser housing includes a housing, the housing includes a front housing and a rear housing. A bottom end of the front housing is rotatably connected to a bottom end of the rear housing. A connecting mechanism is disposed between an upper end of the front housing and an upper end of the rear housing to quickly open or close the housing. The upper end of the front housing and the upper end of the rear housing are provided with a connecting port. A supporting structure is disposed on an inner chamber of the rear housing to support a liquid storage bag of a press pump head of the soap dispenser. The press pump head can cooperate with the liquid storage bag to facilitate users effectively change liquid soap in the soap dispenser.

title: Trailer sled
abstract: An automated trailer sled for moving semi-trailers within a yard without active human supervision. The trailer sled comprises a propulsion unit and a rear bogie connected via a linkage mechanism. The propulsion unit engages with and lifts the front of a trailer. The rear bogie travels underneath the trailer to the rear tires and lifts them using lift units comprising front and rear arms that compress against the tires. The rear bogie may include powered rollers, a scissor-jack mechanism, or a pivoting arm to assist with the lift.

title: Controlled flight of a multicopter experiencing a failure affecting an effector
abstract: According to a first aspect of the invention, there is provided a method for operating a multicopter experiencing a failure during flight, the multicopter comprising a body, and at least four effectors attached to the body, each operable to produce both a torque and a thrust force which can cause the multicopter to fly when not experiencing said failure. The method may comprise the step of identifying a failure wherein the failure affects the torque and/or thrust force produced by an effector, and in response to identifying a failure carrying out the following steps, (1) computing an estimate of the orientation of a primary axis of said body with respect to a predefined reference frame, wherein said primary axis is an axis about which said multicopter rotates when flying, (2) computing an estimate of the angular velocity of said multicopter, (3) controlling one or more of said at least four effectors based on said estimate of the orientation of the primary axis of said body with respect to said predefined reference frame and said estimate of the angular velocity of the multicopter. The step of controlling one or more of said at least four effectors may be performed such that (a) said one or more effectors collectively produce a torque along said primary axis and a torque perpendicular to said primary axis, wherein (i) the torque along said primary axis causes said multicopter to rotate about said primary axis, and (ii) the torque perpendicular to said primary axis causes said multicopter to move such that the orientation of said primary axis converges to a target orientation with respect to said predefined reference frame, and (b) such that said one or more effectors individually produce a thrust force along said primary axis.

title: Modified antibodies and uses thereof
abstract: A new class of antibody fragments (AFs) which are fused to stabilization motifs, their uses in medicine and the process for their production.

title: User conversion prediction using a multi-task model
abstract: The systems and techniques described herein relate to predicting user conversions in online advertising. Input data associated with user and advertisement features may be processed through neural networks to generate embedding representations or feature cross representations. A multi-task layer calculates probabilities associated with multiple user actions like clicks, page views, sign-ups, or purchases. Click-through and view-through conversion probabilities may be calculated to generate a score. The systems and techniques described herein perform predictions on multiple types of user actions despite data sparsity and negative transfer challenges, enhancing advertisement targeting and improving conversion metrics.

title: Nickel-base alloy
abstract: A gamma-prime strengthened nickel-based alloy includes, in weight percentages based on total weight of the nickel-base alloy: 15% to 18% chromium; 16% to 19% cobalt; 2% to 4% molybdenum; 1.5% to 5% tungsten; 0 to 2% niobium; 1% to 3% aluminum; 2% to 5% titanium; 0 to 2% tantalum; 0 to 4% iron; 0 to 0.5% hafnium; 0 to 0.2% carbon; 0 to 0.02% boron; 0 to 0.1% zirconium; and nickel, where the nickel-based alloy has a Ti eq /Al eq  ratio of 0.9 to 1.25, and Ti eq  of 2.0 to 7.15, and the nickel-based alloy has 25-40% gamma-prime as measured at 1500° F. Also disclosed is a method of forming a component that includes providing a powder comprising the nickel-base alloy; additively manufacturing the component from the powder; and heat treating the additively manufactured component.

title: Hard disk drive cover and environmental control module
abstract: Systems, methods, and devices include a hard disk drive with an environmental control module (or ECM) positioned between two covers of a hard disk drive. The environmental control module can include a desiccant and/or a filter that help control environmental conditions within an internal cavity of the hard disk drive.

title: Luma to chroma quantization parameter table signaling
abstract: Compression technology comprises deriving chroma quantization parameter (Qpc) based on luma Qp using luma-to-chroma Qp mapping table. Such a table may be shared by the encoder and the decoder. However, in some cases, signaling such a table in the data stream instead of having it fixed by a standard may be advantageous. The syntax used to encode, signal and decode this table has a cost in terms of bitrate. The present principles propose to signaling of a luma-to-chroma mapping table in the data stream according to different embodiments.

title: Genomic Intelligence for Digital Clones
abstract: A biologically inspired system for disease prediction using DNA sequence data is disclosed. The invention integrates dendritic spiking neural encoding (DSLA), graph-based gene modeling (GraphSAGE), and meta-learning (MAML) within a personalized Digital Clone framework. Genomic inputs are transformed into memory-efficient embeddings and processed to predict disease risk, even from few-shot or novel mutations. A holographic interface allows real-time interaction, displaying health metrics, genomic visualizations, and adaptive recommendations. The system supports dynamic updates from new genetic or behavioral inputs, enabling continuous, individualized health forecasting across a wide range of conditions including tumors, neurological, and chronic diseases.

title: Engagement mechanism and connector unit
abstract: An engagement mechanism is capable of switching between engagement and disengagement with an engagement target. The engagement mechanism includes an engagement portion disposed at an engagement position where the engagement portion is engaged with the engagement target and a disengagement position where the engagement portion is not engaged with the engagement target; a drive portion operating to dispose the engagement portion at the engagement position or the disengagement position; an elastic portion provided between the drive portion and the engagement portion, transmitting the operation of the drive portion to the engagement portion, and elastically deformable; and an operation portion that executes a release operation of moving the engagement portion at the engagement position toward the disengagement position while elastically deforming the elastic portion, independently of the operation of the drive portion.

title: Group-based person re-identification
abstract: A group-based person re-identification technique is provided in the present disclosure. A user group is created for related users. Each user group is tracked and trajectory data indicative of a path traveled by each user of the user group is generated. When users are detected in an area (e.g., in any camera view), the trajectory data is utilized to determine which user groups are predicted to be present in that area, and the detected users are compared with users of these user groups predicted to be present in the area. Based on this comparison, some of the detected users are re-identified to be part of one user group. Further, the remaining users of the same user group are re-identified using camera streams of neighboring areas. The initial user group is thus split into multiple sub-groups, with one sub-group including users present (e.g., re-identified) in one area.

title: Semiconductor storage device
abstract: A semiconductor storage device includes a case, a movable body, a position support member, and a plate spring. The movable body is movable between a first position at which the connector is accommodated inside the case and a second position at which the connector protrudes outward from an opening of the case. The position support member engages with the case or the movable body and holds the movable body at the second position when the movable body is pushed and moved from the first position in a direction from the first position to the second position, and releases engagement when the movable body held at the second position is pushed from the second position in the direction. The plate spring moves the movable body toward the first position when the engagement of the position support member with the case or the movable body is released.

title: Discrete cells and emboss elements
abstract: Belts and fibrous structures of the present disclosure may comprise a discrete cell comprising a non-linear side and an emboss element comprising a linear side.

title: Enhanced Environment-Adaptive Control Architecture for Computer Numerical Control Operations
abstract: A system and method for enhancing computer numerical control (CNC) operations through comprehensive environmental adaptation capabilities. The system combines multi-modal environmental sensing with compensation mechanisms, real-time control adaptation, and adaptive control strategies to optimize CNC performance under dynamic operating conditions. The architecture implements distributed sensor arrays for monitoring temperature, electromagnetic, pressure, gravity, and vibration effects, enabling precise characterization of local environmental conditions. Advanced physics-based compensation algorithms integrate with neural network-based prediction to enable real-time adaptation of manufacturing parameters. The system maintains dynamic models of environmental effects on machine behavior, material properties, and process outcomes. Predictive control strategies enable proactive compensation for environmental variations while maintaining manufacturing precision. The system supports integration with existing CNC platforms while providing comprehensive monitoring and documentation of environmental conditions and compensation actions.

title: System and method for separation of organics and liquids from waste material
abstract: A waste processing system and method for improving compaction and/or separating organics and liquids from waste material. An elongated extrusion screw and/or an adjustable compression gate may be provided to improve the compression of waste material. An improved extraction tube may also be provided to facilitate separation and removal of organics and other liquids from the compressed material. At least one sensor may be provided for sensing an increasing accumulation of waste material awaiting to be processed. An exemplary embodiment may also be adapted to add dry fraction to a waste load that is wet with organics or other liquids to improve compressibility. A system and method may also be adapted to automatically adjust to improve compression of the material and facilitate more efficient production.

title: PLL Lock Detector Circuit
abstract: A lock-detection circuit for a phase-locked loop (PLL) or delay-locked loop (DLL) includes a first signal-duration filter that receives an up signal (UP) and outputs a filtered UP signal containing only pulses exceeding a minimum duration, and a second signal-duration filter that receives a down signal (DN) and outputs a filtered DN signal containing only pulses exceeding the minimum duration. A filter logic circuit, coupled with outputs of both filters, asserts a filter logic circuit output when the filtered UP signal or the filtered DN signal is asserted. A first timer, coupled with the filter logic output, asserts a LOCK detected signal a wait time after the filter logic output was most recently asserted. The minimum duration exceeds jitter-broadened spikes in the UP and DN signals and exceeds the expected duration of a phase-error correcting pulse when the PLL or DLL is in lock.

title: Handle Holder of Blade Tool
abstract: A handle holder is configured not only as a handle of a blade tool but also provides a gravity-telescopic configuration for retracting a blade to be concealed in a blade cavity of the handle holder and extending the blade out of the blade cavity for use due to gravity. The handle holder includes a locker device, a first holder member and a second holder member pivotally connected with the first holder member to define a blade cavity therebetween for receiving a blade holder slidably therein between a locking position, an unlocking position and a detaching position. The locker device is configured to selectively lock relative positions of the first holder member and the second holder member with respect to each other so as to selectively lock the handle holder in the enclosing condition and the operable condition

title: Sound direction sensor-based acoustic camera and related systems and methods
abstract: Disclosed herein are sound direction sensor-based acoustic cameras and related systems and methods. In one example, a system comprising a memory having instructions that, when executed by a processor, causes the processor to display on a display device a source location of an acoustic wave on an image captured by a camera sensor using information from capacitively coupled circuits that are in communication with transducers disposed adjacent to the camera sensor.
assignee: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing North America, Inc.; Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha

title: Cooking system and heat exchanger with combustion chamber
abstract: A heat exchanger for a cooking system is provided. The heat exchanger includes a central axis and a combustion chamber. The combustion chamber includes a central flow path, an inlet manifold, and an outlet manifold axially spaced from the inlet manifold. The inlet manifold and the outlet manifold extend annularly about the central flow path. A plurality of outer walls extend axially between the inlet manifold and the outlet manifold, wherein the plurality of outer walls are arranged about a radially outer perimeter of the central flow path. A burner assembly includes one or more burners that are configured to emit a combusted air/fuel mixture into the central flow path.

title: Self-heating nand for recovery at end of life
abstract: Technology for recovery of NAND memory from excessive wear. The recovery may be performed when the NAND memory is at or near its end of life. An aspect includes creating a current through the NAND channel of one or more victim NAND strings in a memory structure to heat a region of the memory structure having target NAND strings. The current through the NAND channel of the one or more victim NAND strings is regulated to maintain the temperature of the region of the memory structure having the target NAND strings to a target range of temperatures for a period of time to remove trapped charges from the memory cells on the target NAND strings.

title: Improved biotechnological process to produce guanidinoacetic acid (gaa) by targeted introduction or by increasing the activity of a transmembrane exporter protein
abstract: A microorganism has at least one gene coding for a protein having the function of a L-arginine:glycine amidinotransferase and having an increased activity of a transmembrane exporter protein. A method for the fermentative production of guanidino acetic acid (GAA) as well as a method for the fermentative production of creatine employ such microorganism.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and program
abstract: The present technology relates to an information processing apparatus, an information processing method, and a program adapted to provide content more advantageously. An information processing apparatus according to the present technology includes a detection part configured to detect a trigger and a video control part configured to cause, upon occurrence of the trigger, a virtual object to be displayed on a wearable device displaying a video of a real space corresponding to a field of view of a user. The present technology may be applied to a head-mounted display, for example.

title: Robotic system with independently controllable higher derivatives
abstract: A robotic system with independently controllable higher derivatives is disclosed. An indication is received of a trajectory through which an end effector comprising a robotic arm is to be moved. A plan is determined to use a combination of one or more motors and one or more energy removal devices to move one or more elements comprising the robotic arm in a manner that will result in the end effector being moved through the trajectory, including by using the one or more motors to apply torque to said one or more elements comprising the robotic arm during a first interval and using the one or more energy removal devices to remove energy from one or more of said elements during a second interval that starts after the start of the first interval. Commands to implement the plan are sent via a communication interface.

title: Display driving device and display driving method thereof
abstract: The embodiment of the present disclosure relates to a display driving device and a display driving method. The display driving device comprises: a processor; a memory storing instructions which, when executed by the processor, configure the display driving device to: generate control data and input display data having a first frequency, wherein the input display data comprises first display data and second display data; perform a first format conversion on each of at least one first display data to generate at least one converted first display data; perform a second format conversion on each of at least one second display data to generate at least one converted second display data; combine the at least one converted first display data and the at least one converted second display data to generate output display data having the second frequency; and provide the output display data to the display screen for display.

title: Method for finding optimal image contrast when using a laser phase plate
abstract: Phase contrast imaging in charged particle beam (CPB) systems is controlled by adjusting an undeviated component of a CPB to be at a predetermined location in a diffraction plane in which a phase plate such as a laser phase plate is situated. By scanning the undeviated CPB component in the diffraction plane and assessing image contrast or image spectra, alignment corresponding to the phase at the predetermined phase location can be confirmed and/or offsets corrected.

title: Method, apparatus, device and medium for object reconstruction
abstract: Embodiments of this disclosure relate to a method, apparatus, device and medium for object reconstruction, and the method includes: obtaining a to-be-processed image, wherein the to-be-processed image includes a to-be-reconstructed target object; obtaining three-dimensional reconstruction mesh information of a target object corresponding to the to-be-processed image through a pre-trained information prediction model, wherein the three-dimensional reconstruction mesh information includes vertex information of a three-dimensional reconstruction mesh and a specified parameter for constructing the three-dimensional reconstruction mesh, the specified parameter is configured to constrain the vertex information; and constructing, based on the vertex information of the three-dimensional reconstruction mesh, a three-dimensional reconstruction mesh of the target object. According to the embodiments of this disclosure, the object reconstruction effect can be effectively improved.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Method for communication in a communication network
abstract: A method for communication of a telephone service provider in a communication network including a data network and a telephone network. A recording being carried out by a recording device; an analysis of generated audio recordings with respect to a conversation parameter; a process of ascertaining time-based data connection parameter values in response to the conversation parameter; a simultaneous analysis of the telephone calls, which are transmitted to the telephone service provider via telephone connections, between employees and respective subscriber with respect to the conversation parameter; and a process of ascertaining time-based telephone connection parameter values in response to the conversation parameter and on the basis of a comparison of the time-based telephone connection parameter values with the time-based data connection parameter values.

title: Monitoring system of clean room
abstract: A monitoring system may include: a detection tape disposed on upper surfaces of some or all of floor tiles surrounding the substrate processing apparatus, the detection tape extending across a plurality of floor tiles and comprising a conductive layer disposed along a longitudinal direction of the tape; and a controller configured to generate an alarm based on electrical continuity in the conductive layer.

title: Microcode program offloading method and apparatus, and related product
abstract: A microcode program offloading method and a related product are disclosed. An embodiment of this application provides a first static microcode program in firmware of a DPU, and the first static microcode program is used to dynamically offload any microcode program of a host to the DPU. An association relationship between the first static microcode program and first indication information is extended. Correspondingly, the host is configured with a corresponding user-oriented first interface, and a user may trigger offloading of a microcode program through the first interface. Based on this, the host can dynamically offload a microcode program to the DPU during operation of the DPU only by including the first indication information and the to-be-offloaded microcode program in a packet. Therefore, in embodiments of this application, a microcode program can be dynamically offloaded to a DPU during operation of the DPU.

title: Call-source-dependent control of an elevator display device
abstract: An elevator system having an elevator controller and elevator display devices assigned to an elevator car on floors. The elevator controller receives an elevator call originating from an elevator operating device, as a first call source, on a call entry floor via a communication network. The elevator controller receives an elevator call originating from a mobile communication device, as a second call source, on a call entry floor via a communication interface device. The elevator controller generates a control signal for the elevator display device which is assigned to the elevator car serving the elevator call on the call entry floor. The control signal indicates whether the elevator call originates from the first or the second call source. Upon receipt of the control signal, the elevator display device communicates an indicator perceptible on the call entry floor which identifies the first or second call source.

title: Cache based memory access tracking
abstract: An apparatus for executing a software program, comprising: a processing unit; a plurality of memory components, each connected to the processing unit and mapped to at least one range of memory addresses of a plurality of memory address ranges of the processing unit; and at least one memory tracking circuitry connected to the processing unit and to the at least one memory component. The memory tracking circuitry is configured for: in each iteration of a plurality of iterations, updating at least one statistical counter of a plurality of statistical counters in response to receiving a memory access command from the processing unit; and providing one or more of the plurality of statistical counters to a memory management component for the purpose of mapping application memory of the software program to the at least one memory component.

title: Systems and methods for gaming using historical data
abstract: Methods and systems are described herein for gaming using historical performance data. A listing of entities is provided to a user. A selection of entities is received from the user. Historical performance data for each of the selected. entities during a given performance period is compared to a performance benchmark. A payout is provided based on the number of selected entities that met the performance benchmark during their respective performance period.

title: Glider Seating Unit Between Stationary Arms
abstract: A glider seating unit is provided. The glider seating unit includes a base frame with a pair of armrests and a seating unit movably supported by the base frame between the pair of armrests. The base frame is configured to support the glider seating unit on a support surface and the seating unit is operatively connected to the base frame with a glide assembly that permits the seating unit to glide in a forward direction and in a backward direction relative to the base frame. The glide assembly includes at least one glide bracket rigidly attached to the seating unit and at least one swing link that extends between a first end and an opposite second end. The first end of the at least one swing link is movably attached to the at least one glide bracket and the second end of the at least one swing link is movably attached to the base frame such that the glide bracket is movable relative to the base frame.

title: Three-dimensional printing with dihydrazide antioxidants
abstract: The present disclosure describes multi-fluid kits for three-dimensional printing, three-dimensional printing kits, and methods of making three-dimensional printed articles. In one example, a multi-fluid kit for three-dimensional printing can include a fusing agent and a second fluid agent. The fusing agent can include water and a radiation absorber. The radiation absorber can absorb radiation energy and convert the radiation energy to heat. The fusing agent or the second fluid agent can include a water-soluble or water-dispersible dihydrazide antioxidant.

title: Process for producing iron chloride from iron phosphate compounds
abstract:
Process for producing iron chloride, characterized in that it comprises
         i) reacting a material containing at least one iron phosphate compound with at least one alkali metal chloride and/or at least one alkaline earth metal chloride at a temperature of 200° C. to 1100° C. in an inert gas atmosphere and   ii) withdrawing and isolating the formed iron chloride in the offgas stream.

title: Tropane Alkaloid (TA) Producing Non-Plant Host Cells, and Methods of Making and Using the Same
abstract: Provided herein, among other things, is an engineered non-plant cell that produces a tropane alkaloid product, a precursor of a tropane alkaloid product, or a derivative of a tropane alkaloid product. A method for producing a tropane alkaloid, a precursor of a tropane alkaloid product, or a derivative of a tropane alkaloid product that makes use of the cell is also described.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University

title: Physics-Based Design for Automatic Assembly
abstract: A method of providing a design for automated assembly (DFAA) system comprising receiving a model of a component and a part for insertion into the component, identifying an assembly process for assembling the component and the part, and evaluating the component, the part, and the assembly process using a multi-phase evaluation including a geometric, a spatial, and a physics-based evaluation. The method further comprises outputting results of the calculations for assessment of the design for assembly. The assessment in some embodiments may include assessment for efficient assembly (manual & automated) and/or manufacturing at scale.

title: Semiconductor storage device
abstract: A semiconductor storage device includes first and second laminates, a memory pillar, first and second contacts, and first and second dividing portions. The first laminate includes first wiring layers and first insulator layers on the same layers as the first wiring layers. The second laminate includes second wiring layers and second insulator layers on the same layers as the second wiring layers, and is above the first laminate. The memory pillar penetrates the first wiring layers and the second wiring layers. The first contact penetrates the second laminate and is connected to one of the first wiring layers. The first dividing portion divides the first wiring layers. The second contact is connected to one of the second wiring layers. The second dividing portion divides the second wiring layers. The second dividing portion does not overlap with the first dividing portion.

title: Recognition-state quantum informational encryption (rsqie) for quantum-resistant secure digital communication and data protection
abstract: A recognition-state quantum informational encryption (RSQIE) system and method provide quantum-resistant secure digital communication and data protection. Digital information is encoded into recognition-coherence scalars using a recognition mapping in which a recognition scalar R is computed as R=x/(x+X_opt), where x is a positive parameter associated with a symbol and X_opt is a predetermined constant. One or more quantum states are prepared based on the recognition scalars and encrypted using an encryption transformation derived from a recognition-coupled interaction that depends on message-associated and key-associated recognition operators. A corresponding inverse transformation decrypts the encrypted representation to recover the digital information. In some embodiments, verification includes computing a coherence deviation deltaR=abs(R_expected−R_measured) and triggering a responsive action when deltaR, or a windowed statistic derived from deltaR, exceeds a threshold, thereby providing breach indication in disturbance-sensitive implementations.

title: Method for Automated Folder Creation and Categorization in Email Systems Based on Logical Rule Attribution
abstract: A method for organizing electronic communications within an email system based on user-defined rules. Each rule comprises one or more conditions involving predefined communication attributes and logical connectors. The system parses each rule into a logical expression and automatically creates a corresponding folder. Incoming communications are scanned for matching attributes, evaluated against the expression, and, if matching, automatically stored in the associated folder. The invention provides dynamic, rule-based organization of messages without requiring user intervention for sorting.
assignee: Ivan M Alexandrovich; Alexander M Alexandrovich

title: Fungicidal combinations, mixtures and compositions and uses thereof
abstract:
The present invention provides fungicidal combination comprising: (i) an amount of a compound of Formula I 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     and (ii) an amount of at least one fungicide (A) selected from the group consisting of benzanilide, carbamate, conazole, oxazole, picolinamide, pyrazolecarboxamide, pyridazine, pyridine, quinoline, tetrazole, thiazole, chloroinconazide and dipymetitrone.

title: Communication method and communication apparatus
