abstract: The present invention relates to a smoke generator ( 10 ;  10   a ;  10   b ) comprising a housing ( 15 ) with a condensate inlet ( 11 ) for receiving a smoke condensate and a steam inlet ( 12 ) for receiving overheated water steam, wherein the smoke condensate is converted to smoke particles when the smoke condensate interacts with the overheated water steam, and the smoke particles are accessible at a smoke outlet ( 13 ). The invention also relates to a system for feeding smoke particles to a smoke cabinet ( 23 ).

title: Image reading apparatus
abstract: A first reference portion includes a lower surface of a first color. A second reference portion, adjacent to the first portion in a first direction, includes a lower surface of a second color. An end reference portion, arranged in an end portion of a movable region for a scanning unit, is adjacent to the first portion in a second direction. The end reference portion includes a lower surface of specific colors aligned in a primary scanning direction. One of the specific colors is a third color. A data processing section determines a color for reference pixel data included in line image data and corresponding to a reference region. A driving apparatus positions the scanning unit at a home position, by successively selecting from a plurality of trial drive operations according to  the determined color, and the scanning unit is moved a different distance or direction in each trial operation.

title: Enhanced Telemetry for Memory Access Latency
abstract: A method and system for determining, providing, and utilizing enhanced telemetry data in a computer system or network. The enhanced telemetry data includes access latency for a region or subregion of memory and information about the memory type, memory access type, and memory distance of a operation utilizing that region or subregion of memory. The enhanced telemetry data is transmitted in an expanded acknowledgement packet used by commutation protocols such as the UET protocol. The enhanced telemetry data provides increased detail and valuable information regarding that takes into account the varying access and performance times of different operations and locations to improve system commutations, task management, and troubleshooting. In particular, the enhanced telemetry data allows for the selection of delivery contexts between two nodes to avoid head of line blocking.

title: Mobile object management system
abstract: A system including a plurality of first devices and a mobile object including a second device, the system including a distance calculator that calculates a distance between each of the plurality of first devices and the second device based on a propagation time of information or a signal between each of the plurality of first devices and the second device; and a position specifier that specifies a position of the second device based on the calculated distance between each of the plurality of first devices and the second device.
assignee: The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc.

title: Cross key module and game controller
abstract: Disclosed are a cross key module and a game controller. The cross key module includes a key cap, a face shell, a circuit board, and a joystick structure. The face shell is provided with a through hole. The key cap and the circuit board are respectively located on two sides of the face shell, and the circuit board is provided with contacts. The joystick structure is rotatably connected to the face shell, and the joystick structure is provided with a connection rod and a trigger portion connected to the connection rod. One end of the connection rod passes through the through hole and is connected to the key cap. The trigger portion is configured to trigger the contacts. Pressing the key cap causes the key cap to drive the trigger portion to rotate relative to the face shell through the connection rod, and the trigger portion triggers the contacts.

title: Method and kit for the diagnosis of oral carcinoma
abstract: A method and kit are used to analyze the protein levels of EGFR, p53, B7H6, PdL1 in a sample from a subject and estimate the presence of oral squamous cell carcinoma in the subject. The method and kit compare the protein levels in the sample with levels of corresponding proteins in samples isolated from control individuals and/or with levels recorded in reference databases.
assignee: Riccardo MOFFA; Angelo Simone PARODI; Emanuela Marcenaro

title: Interleukin-18 variants and methods of use
abstract: The present disclosure provides compositions and methods comprising stabilized IL-18 polypeptides for use in therapeutic and non-therapeutic applications. In some cases, the stabilized IL-18 proteins provide IL-18 signaling activity even in the presence of an inhibitory molecule such as IL-18BP. Also provide are methods of administration and methods for making active polypeptides.

title: Devices and methods for stimulating neural tissue
abstract: In some implementations, the device may include a neural stimulation system having: an implantable closed-loop neural stimulation device for controllably delivering neural stimuli via one or more stimulus electrodes, the device having the one or more stimulus electrodes and a feedback controller configured to adjust a stimulus intensity parameter so as to maintain a measured neural response intensity at a target response intensity; and a processor configured to: estimate an out-of-compliance current limit for each of the one or more stimulus electrodes; estimate a closed-loop current requirement for the implantable closed-loop neural stimulation device; compare the out-of-compliance current limit for each of the one or more stimulus electrodes to the closed-loop current requirement; and take a mitigating action based on the comparison.

title: Photoresist composition and method of manufacturing a semiconductor device
abstract: A method of manufacturing a semiconductor device includes forming a photoresist layer over a substrate. The photoresist layer includes a photoresist composition includes a polymer. The polymer includes a monomer unit having a pendant sensitizer and crosslinking group, and a monomer unit having a pendant acid labile group. The photoresist layer is selectively exposed to actinic radiation, and the selectively exposed photoresist layer is developed.

title: Cable Tensioning Assembly and Method of Using Same
abstract: A cable tensioning assembly for securing at least one elongate member, comprising: a case having a first side and an opposing second side with a first and a second curved cavity, respectively; a first and second gripping arrangement in the first and the second curved cavity, respectively, each of the gripping arrangements having a clamp; a central cavity with a connector disposed within said central cavity, wherein each of the gripping arrangement clamps are adapted to secure the at least one elongate member against the case by activating the connector.

title: Multi-receptor natural killer cells
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure include methods and compositions in which NK cells are modified by the hand of man to express a heterologous a) polypeptide comprising a CD16 Fc binding domain, b) a T Cell Receptor (TCR, e.g., an invariant T Cell Receptor (iTCR)), and c) a CD3 co-receptor on NK cells that do not naturally express them. Such modified NK cells work effectively with monospecific, bispecific, and/or multi-specific antibodies, that may have modified or non-modified Fc domains.
assignee: Board Of Regents, The University Of Texas System

title: Setting management system, non-transitory computer readable medium and control method
abstract: A setting management system includes an information processing system; a management server that manages setting information on the information processing system; and a user terminal that is able to communicate with the information processing system and the management server; wherein a processor in the user terminal is configured to: acquire device information from the information processing system by communicating with the information processing system; transmit to the management server the device information that is acquired; acquire the setting information corresponding to the device information from the management server; and transmit to the information processing system the setting information that is acquired.

title: Hydrogen leak detector and method for detecting hydrogen leaks
abstract: A hydrogen leak detector for detecting leaks in hydrogen gas conducting components includes a hydrogen gas detector to measure hydrogen gas concentration in a gas conduction path. A first gas sensor is hydrogen selective and adapted to react to hydrogen concentrations within a first range below a first threshold. A second gas sensor is sensitive to hydrogen and a secondary gas different from hydrogen, and is adapted to react to hydrogen concentrations within a second range above the first threshold. The detector calibrates the second sensor for low hydrogen concentrations present in the ambient atmosphere by comparing measurements from the first and second sensors and assigning the signal of the second sensor to correspond to a non-leak concentration when the first sensor indicates a hydrogen concentration below a predetermined value. A leak is indicated when the second sensor measures a concentration above a second threshold.

title: Method and apparatus for performing channel sounding using transparent pseudo random noise
abstract: Methods and devices for performing channel sounding, including: receiving a channel sounding signal generated based on a sounding sequence and an artificial noise symbol from the second electronic device; subtracting the artificial noise symbol from the channel sounding signal to reconstruct the sounding sequence; calculating a travel time between the first electronic device and the second electronic device based on the sounding sequence; and determining a distance between the first electronic device and the second electronic device based on the travel time.

title: Tethered interleukin-15 and interleukin-21
abstract: Disclosed are nucleic acids and polypeptides which provide the co-expression of interleukin (IL)-21 and IL-15 by a host cell, each interleukin being bound to the cell membrane by a cell membrane anchor moiety. Also disclosed are related recombinant expression vectors, host cells, populations of cells, pharmaceutical compositions, and methods of treating or preventing cancer.
assignee: The United States Of America, As Represented By The Secretary, Department Of Health And Human Servi

title: Suspension unit having camber and/or toe adjustment mechanism for suspending a wheel and tire assembly from a vehicle frame
abstract: A suspension unit for suspending a wheel and tire assembly from a vehicle frame includes a hanger, a control arm, a spindle assembly, a jounce spring, a rebound spring, a camber adjustment mechanism, and a toe adjustment mechanism. The spindle assembly is connected to an upper wall top surface of the control arm at an upper wall terminal end. The jounce spring is positioned between the upper wall top surface and a top wall bottom surface of the hanger. The rebound spring is positioned between a forward wall outer surface of the control arm and a front wall inner surface of the hanger. A mounting bolt connects the control arm to the hanger. The camber adjustment mechanism is configured to change a first position of a mounting bolt first end of the mounting bolt along a y-axis relative to a second position of a mounting bolt second end along the y-axis. The toe adjustment mechanism is configured to change a third position of the mounting bolt first end or the mounting bolt second end along an x-axis relative to a fourth position of an opposing mounting bolt end along the x-axis.

title: Second read initialization on latch-limited memory device
abstract: A second read command to read second data from an array of memory cells is detected. An initial voltage to be applied to at least one wordline coupled to at least a subset of the array of memory cells is caused prior to releasing a first data associated with a first read command stored in a page buffer. The initial voltage to increase to a target value is caused. The page buffer to sense the second data from a bitline coupled to a page of the subset of the array of memory cells is caused. The sensed second data out of the bitline into the page buffer is read responsive to determining that the first data has been released from the page buffer.

title: Lever apparatus with a display module for supplementing a main display of a gaming machine
abstract: An EGM includes a cabinet having a main display. The main display has a transverse plane and is configured to present a set of reels each having a plurality of symbols. The EGM further includes a lever apparatus having an arm mounted to the cabinet and configured to move between a first position and a second position. The lever apparatus further has a display module including a supplemental display having a center. Responsive to the supplemental display being supported by the arm in the first position, the supplemental display is located relative to the main display such that the center of the supplemental display is spaced up to one inch from the transverse plane of the main display. Responsive to the arm being moved from the first position to the second position, the supplemental display presents one or more symbols along a first payline continued from the main display.

title: Epi barrier aligned backside contact
abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein include semiconductor devices and methods of forming such devices. In an embodiment, a semiconductor device comprises a vertical stack of semiconductor channels, a source on a first side of the vertical stack of semiconductor channels, and a drain on a second side of the vertical stack of semiconductor channels, In an embodiment, a metal is below the source and in direct contact with the source, where a centerline of the metal is substantially aligned with a centerline of the source.

title: Golf bag with fold out crush zone
abstract: Described herein are embodiments of a carry golf bag, comprising: a divider top, a base, a flat comprising a crush zone, a stay, a stand assembly, and a divider sleeve comprising two or more reinforcement panels. The divider top and the base attach to opposite ends of the flat to form a hollow interior for receiving golf clubs. The divider sleeve top attaches to the divider top and the divider sleeve bottom attaches to the base. The reinforcement panels are positioned near the middle of the divider sleeve in a top to bottom direction. The golf bag can be placed in an upright position or a deployed position.

title: Production method for processed vegetable protein-containing liquid composition
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a processing technology that improves the solubility and/or digestibility of a protein in a plant protein-containing liquid composition. The solubility, digestibility, and/or mineral solubility of a protein in a plant protein-containing liquid composition can be improved by treating the plant protein-containing liquid composition with a protein deamidase and a cellulase.

title: Automatic distance display
abstract: In one implementation, a method of displaying distances between objects is performed by a device including one or more processors and non-transitory memory. The method includes displaying a plurality of objects. The method includes receiving an input to display a plurality of indications of distances between the plurality of objects. The method includes, in response to receiving the input, displaying an indication of a first distance between a first set of two of the plurality of objects at a location between the first set of the two of the plurality of objects and displaying an indication of a second distance between a second set of two of the plurality of objects at a location between the second set of the two of the plurality of objects.

title: Image forming apparatus
abstract: An image forming apparatus includes first and second frame bodies disposed adjacent to each other, an image forming member disposed on the first frame body, a driving unit disposed on the first frame body and configured to drive the image forming member, a power supply unit disposed on the second frame body, and a conduction connection portion configured to electrically connect the image forming member and the power supply unit. The conduction connection portion includes a first member disposed on the first frame body and including a first contact that is connected to the image forming member, the first member extending toward a side of the power supply unit, and a second member including a second contact that is electrically connected to the first member, the second member being configured to electrically connect the power supply unit and the first member.

title: High speed laser processes for marking on articles
abstract: Laser marked articles having a predetermined feature marked onto a wall that is either user readable, machine readable, or both. Also, methods of making the marked articles by laser marking.

title: Method and device for transmitting/receiving signal in wireless communication system
abstract: A method by which a terminal transmits a signal in a wireless communication system, according to at least one from among embodiments disclosed in the present specification, comprises: receiving downlink control information (DCI) for uplink scheduling; mapping, on the basis of the DCI, each layer of an uplink to at least one from among partially coherent antennas of the terminal; and transmitting an uplink signal on the basis of the mapping of each layer, wherein a plurality of antenna groups are configured on the basis of the partially coherent antennas, the DCI includes antenna-group-specific information provided individually for each antenna group, and the size of each antenna-group-specific information can be related to, from among a plurality of layer split combinations for splitting layers for the plurality of antenna groups, the layer split combination in which a precoding codebook having the largest size is used.

title: Systems, methods, and techniques for safely controlling devices using eye gaze control
abstract: Methods, systems, and techniques for controlling actuators by using eye gaze technology such as in a wheelchair or bed, are provided. Example embodiments provide an Eye Gaze Actuator Control System (“EGACS”) which enables people with advanced motor neuron diseases or disabilities like amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or muscular dystrophy to use eye gaze technologies to control their actuators that control seating, bed positioning, and movement of motor-controlled devices. In one embodiment, the example EGACS comprises a display device, eye gaze sensor, eye gaze control application, and device interface(s) to one or more other devices that control aspects of a powered wheelchair, bed, vehicle, or other device. These components cooperate to control the powered wheelchair, bed, or vehicle using eye gaze technology as opposed to by manual control.

title: Heuristic based caching pictures for video coding
abstract: A method includes determining a picture type of a current picture, determining, based on the picture type of the current picture, whether to write the current picture in a dedicated chip memory or whether to write the current picture in a non-dedicated system memory, and writing the current picture in the dedicated chip memory or the non-dedicated system memory based on the determining of whether to write the current picture in the dedicated chip memory or whether to write the current picture in the non-dedicated system memory.

title: Sports ecosystem platform
abstract: A digital platform is provided to connect players, teams, sponsors, agents, and/or supporters within a sports ecosystem. Players can create detailed profiles showcasing their skills, statistics, and multimedia content, while teams and other stakeholders can register and interact based on tailored criteria using, for instance, an AI-powered matching algorithm. The platform preferably offers advanced privacy controls, facilitates efficient communication, and monetizes through targeted advertising, premium features, and connection fees.

title: Resource protection and verification with bidirectional notification architecture
abstract: A method of verifying resource protection statuses for resources for address-based resources may include receiving a request for verification of resource protection from a client device for an address-based resource. The request includes an address of a resource. The intermediate system is programmed to receive resource protection verification requests from a plurality of client devices, and to receive resource protection verifications from a plurality of resource protection systems that are in communication with the intermediate system. The method also includes determining that none of the resource protection systems in the plurality of resource protection systems currently protect the resource; retrieving information that is securely stored for the resource and a user associated with the request; and sending the information to one or more of the plurality of resource protection systems as a request to protect the resource.

title: System apparatus and method of generating physical activity training plan
abstract: A system, device, and method for generating a training plan based on the biomechanical qualities of a trainee. The method includes activating an image sensor to record a video of a predefined movement by a sports trainee in a specified plane using a camera from the user device to produce a video clip. In the video clip, two or more keypoints are marked on two or more predetermined points on the body of the sports trainee. The coordinates of these keypoints are extracted using a first artificial intelligence (AI) model, and two or more points of interest (POI) are detected from the coordinates. The detected POIs are validated against the predetermined points at the beginning part of the validation process, and two or more key performance indicators (KPIs) are calculated based on this validation. Metrics of the KPIs are computed using one or more rules provided by a metrics rule engine. A grading process is then applied to the KPIs based on rules set forth by a grading rule engine, resulting in a biomechanical report of the sports trainee. Additionally, a biomechanical model of the sports trainee is generated alongside a practice plan that includes one or more exercises tailored by a second AI model. These exercises are designed to fit the biomechanical model of the sports trainee to mitigate the risk of injuries.

title: Symbolic Compilation for Reconfigurable Processors
abstract: A method for compiling a computation graph for execution on a reconfigurable processor comprising one or more configurable compute units. The method may include compiling the computation graph having one or more symbolic dimensions with values unresolved at compile time, where the compiling includes tracking symbolic expressions as functions of the symbolic dimensions. The method may further include producing a compiled configuration for the reconfigurable processor, where the compiled configuration includes one or more configuration parameters derived from the tracked symbolic expressions, the configuration parameters being settable at runtime based on runtime values of the symbolic dimensions.

title: Cloud data partitioning for a communication platform
abstract: Techniques described include configuring an instance of a communication management application (e.g., an org) to utilize a non-default partition of a cloud data storage system, where the non-default partition may store data associated with user entities corresponding to the org. Techniques described herein also include configuring an org with multiple business units that each correspond to a respective partition. A user of an org may create one or more non-default partitions and may configure the org to utilize the non-default partition instead of a default partition. The user may also create one or more business units within the org and may cause each business unit to be configured to utilize a respective partition, such that data associated with user entities corresponding to each business unit may be stored in the respective partition. A user may also create a data object and assign the data object to a business unit.

title: Image sensor, and method of operating image sensor
abstract: An image sensor is provided. The image sensor includes: a pixel array with pixels. At least one of the pixels includes: a photo detecting circuit configured to output a pixel signal corresponding to a signal level and a reset level based on a received optical signal; an ADC configured to receive the pixel signal, generate a reset value and a signal value by converting the pixel signal into an analog-to-digital converted signal; and a clamping circuit configured to provide a clamping signal to the input terminal of the ADC during an auto-zero period; a clamping correction circuit configured to generate a corrected reset value by correcting the reset value provided from the pixel array based on a threshold value; and a digital CDS circuit configured to generate pixel data based on the corrected reset value and the signal value provided from the pixel array.

title: System and method for managing a fleet of vehicles including electric vehicles
abstract: A method, device, and system for managing a fleet of vehicles is disclosed. The method includes providing a telematics device for an electric vehicle of the fleet of vehicles, the telematics device being capable of obtaining data from the electric vehicle; using the telematics device to identify the electric vehicle based on the data obtained from the electric vehicle; providing a data definition set for the electric vehicle to the telematics device; and using the telematics device and the data definition set to determine whether the electric vehicle is in a vehicle mode based on the data obtained from the electric vehicle and the data definition set. The vehicle mode of the electric vehicle can be at least one of a charging mode, a driving mode, and a parked mode.

title: Improved lidar imaging device
abstract: A LIDAR device imaging a three dimensional environment includes a laser source emitting an incident laser beam presenting a wavelength λ and illuminating the three dimensional environment forming a reflected laser beam; an array of N>1 metalenses (ML1-MLN), each collecting a sub-beam of the reflected laser beam and focusing onto a same focal plane; a photodetector in the focal plane to detect the sub-beams and including at least N pixels noted P_1 to P_N, each i-th metalens (MLi), i=1 . . . N focuses the respective sub-beam (SBi) onto a respective pixel P_i only when the respective sub beam is incident onto said metalens within a predetermined range of incident angles centered on a respective pair of optimal incident angle different from and not overlapping with the predetermined ranges of optimal incident angle associated to other metalenses; a scanning element; and a processing unit connected to the photodetector and the scanning element.
assignee: Centre National De La Recherche Scientifique

title: Video conferencing system, and method and apparatus for automatically restoring linkage for device thereof
abstract: The present application discloses a video conferencing system, and a method and an apparatus for automatically restoring linkage for a device thereof. In the method, after a video conferencing accessory loses connection with a video conferencing host, it searches for broadcast messages through BLE, parses relevant network information of host, and compares a parsed MAC address with a MAC address of the original host saved in the accessory. If they are the same, the accessory checks its current network topology. If it's direct wired connection or LAN connection, a TCP connection can be directly established between them; if it's AP connection, the accessory needs to connect to the hot spot of the host before establishing the TCP connection between them, thereby restoring the linkage between them. The present application enables the automatic and rapid restoration of a paired connection without manual intervention when the host and accessory lose connection.

title: New integrated analytical platform for the assessment of the quality of complex natural products
abstract: The present invention provides a new integrated platform that allows the validation of production processes, the standardization and the evaluation of complex natural products, allowing the characterization of the complex mixture contained within products with a therapeutic and/or healthy effect based on or consisting of from natural substances “as an entire system”, without limiting their characterization to a reductionistic chemical approach aimed at a single marker, but rather integrating qualitative-quantitative data and fingerprint characterization metabolomics of the mixture with physical and biophysical activity data thus providing a characterization of the product which is the basis of the validation process of the production process which allows to guarantee reproducibility between different batches of this product in terms of efficacy and safety. The analytical platform described here allows us to guarantee the complex natural product as a whole, taking into consideration all its quality and efficacy properties in order to guarantee the reproducibility of the effect and safety through a multidimensional analytical approach.

title: Force sensor, sensor module, and robot hand
abstract: Provided is a force sensor capable of obtaining a wide dynamic range and high sensitivity. The force sensor includes a light receiving unit group, a reflection unit provided above the light receiving unit group, and an elastic body provided between the reflection unit and the light receiving unit group. The light receiving unit group includes four or more first light receiving units arranged in a first direction and four or more second light receiving units arranged in a second direction orthogonal to the first direction.

title: Fviii fusion protein conjugate having extended half-life and use thereof
abstract: Provided in the present disclosure are a blood coagulation factor VII-Fc fusion protein conjugated to polyethylene glycol and having an extended cyclic half-life, a preparation method therefor, and the use thereof.

title: Information processing system, information processing method, and non-transitory computer readable medium
abstract: An information processing system includes a processor configured to: cause one operation item to be displayed in a first area of a display screen; cause another operation item different from the one operation item to be displayed in a second area different from the first area of the display screen; and upon accepting acquisition of information pertaining to the other operation item, cause information pertaining to the other operation item to be displayed in the second area while maintaining the display state of the one operation item in the first area.

title: Preparation device and method for propylene terpolyme
abstract: The present application pertains to the field of chemical engineering and discloses a preparation device and method for propylene terpolymer. The device includes: a catalyst pre-filming unit, a polymerization unit, a degassing and deactivation unit, a powder drying unit, a recovery unit, a propylene feeding pipe, an ethylene feeding pipe, a butene feeding pipe, a catalyst feeding pipe, and a polypropylene discharging pipe. The device designed in the present application involves flexible and convenient operation, is safe and reliable, has a high degree of automation, has few moving apparatuses, has a short device construction period and a compact layout, and can use modular construction, thus greatly reducing the investment costs; the device can produce multiple grades with better product performance, is more suitable for producing high-end polyolefin products and taking the high-end production route, and can achieve a multi-capacity device layout of 50,000 to 480,000 tons/year.
assignee: Tianhua Instiute Of Chemical Machinery & Automation Co., Ltd.; Tianhua Institute (Nanjing) Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

title: Method for producing welded joint by gas-shielded arc welding of steel plate
abstract: A method for producing a narrow-gap welded joint with high strength and low-temperature impact toughness without welding defects in a steel plate with a thickness of 50 mm or more by gas-shielded arc welding. Each layer excluding first and outermost layers has a width W of 5.0 to 0.4 T mm. The ratio A/p of weld metal cross-sectional area to number of layers is ≤120.0 mm 2 /layer, and p/T ratio is ≤0.40 layers/mm. Multiple electrode welding uses first and second electrodes on parallel distinct weld lines, with opposite polarities. Distance between electrode tips is 5-16 mm, with angle α≤60° relative to perpendicular. A welding wire containing REM is used for the positive polarity electrode.

title: Resin molded article
abstract: A resin molded article includes a glass flake and a matrix resin. The glass flakes included in the resin molded article have an average particle size of 0.1 μm or more and 40 μm or less and an average thickness of 0.05 μm or more and 7 μm or less. A surface of the glass flake is at least partially coated with a surface treatment agent. When a value of mechanical strength of the resin molded article is 100, a relative value S N  of the mechanical strength of the resin molded article satisfies S N ≥100−2N, the relative value S N  being measured after a recycle simulation test is performed N times (N is at least one integer from 1 to 4) using an extruder. The mechanical strength includes at least one selected from the group consisting of maximum tensile strength, maximum flexural strength, and notched Izod impact strength.

title: Earphone
abstract: The present disclosure discloses an earphone. The earphone may include a hook-shaped component, a connecting component, and a holding component. When the earphone is in a wearing state, the hook-shaped component may be configured to hang between a rear side of an ear of a user and a head of the user. The holding component may be configured to contact a front side of the ear. The connecting component may be configured to connect the hook-shaped component and the holding component and extend from the head to an outside of the head to cooperate with the hook-shaped component to provide the holding component with a pressing force on the front side of the ear.

title: Solidly-mounted acoustic biosensor
abstract: A solidly-mounted lateral field excitation sensor is described. The sensor includes a relatively thin layer of lithium niobate layered on a solid substrate (such as a silicon substrate). The sensor also includes a row of interdigital metallic fingers formed on the layer of lithium niobate. An active region of the sensor includes the row of interdigital metallic fingers and lithium niobate underlying the metallic fingers.

title: Connector for beverage dispense line
abstract: A connector for connecting a beverage dispensing line to a beverage container, the connector including a central passageway; a flange; an annular first wall extending from a central portion of the flange; and a first ring extending from the first wall and configured to provide a fluid-tight interlocking connection with a corresponding annular apron of a closure of the beverage container when the connector and the closure are pushed together along the central axis. An annular skirt extends from the peripheral portion of the flange and surrounds the first wall and the first ring for providing protection and grasping surface for removing the connector from the closure.

title: Block status parity data in memory
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and methods for block status parity data are described. An example method includes storing block status data associated with at least one block of a non-volatile memory that indicates a status of the at least one block of memory within a controller. The example method further comprises storing parity data that corresponds to the block status data. The example method further comprises prior to writing the block status data to the non-volatile memory, comparing the stored block status data to the parity data.

title: Channel Estimation by Utilizing Cyclic Redundancy Check Proof Data
abstract: A system can, after initializing current symbols as the reference symbols, perform at least one iteration of, performing channel estimation over the current symbols, to produce a current channel estimation, decoding new data symbols of the data symbols that satisfy a proximity criterion with respect to the current symbols based on the current channel estimation, and to produce decoded new data symbols, wherein an iteration of the at least one iteration has not yet been performed for the new data symbols, and based on determining that a cyclic redundancy check for the decoded new data symbols passes, and based on determining that there are still symbols for which channel estimation has not yet been performed, setting the current symbols to be the decoded new data symbols, and performing another iteration. The system can adapt broadband cellular transmission parameters based on the cumulative channel estimation.

title: Ozone converters and methods of producing the same by additive manufaturing
abstract: Ozone converters for an aircraft and methods of producing the same are provided. The ozone converters include a header assembly configured to receive a gas in an inlet thereof and expel the gas at an outlet thereof, and a core disposed therein. The core includes a network structure having passage walls that define passages configured to receive the gas. A catalyst material is disposed on surfaces of the passage walls configured to react to reduce a concentration of ozone in the gas. The core is produced by an additive manufacturing process that deposits a material layer-by-layer to form the passage walls have a three-dimensional (3D) self-supporting geometry. The passage walls include concentric primary walls disposed about a common central axis of the core. Adjacent pairs of the primary walls define a fluid domain therebetween. The primary walls have varying diameters between ends of the network structure.

title: Cooling apparatus for multi-chip/multi-module heat dissipation
abstract: A cooling apparatus for multi-chip/multi-module heat dissipation is provided. The cooling apparatus includes a plurality of liquid cooling assemblies, a first liquid distributor, and a second liquid distributor. Each liquid cooling assembly includes a heat exchange unit, a liquid inlet pipe, and a liquid outlet pipe, the heat exchange unit covers a corresponding computing module to exchange heat with the corresponding computing module, the liquid inlet pipe is connected to the heat exchange unit to supply a low-temperature cooling liquid to the heat exchange unit, and the liquid outlet pipe is connected to the heat exchange unit to return a heated cooling liquid. The first liquid distributor is disposed on a case and connected to the liquid inlet pipe of each liquid cooling assembly. The second liquid distributor is disposed on the case and connected to the liquid outlet pipe of each liquid cooling assembly.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Methods for Deploying Bladed Spinal Fusion Implants
abstract: A fusion implant which already has a cephalad anchor blade and a caudal anchor blade which are both held in a delivery position for delivery between a cephalad vertebra and a caudal vertebra. Positioning the fusion implant between the cephalad vertebra and the caudal vertebra while the cephalad anchor blade and the caudal anchor blade are both held in the delivery position. Advancing the anchor blades to engage the vertebrae. Using a cephalad locking cam to lock the cephalad anchor blade in the deployed position and using a caudal locking cam to lock the caudal anchor blade in the deployed position. The cephalad locking cam and caudal locking cam can be parts of a dual locking cam.

title: Communication method and apparatus
abstract: This application discloses a communication method and apparatus. The method includes: An access network device receives configuration information of a QoS flow, where the configuration information of the QoS flow includes a first value and a second value of each of M QoS parameters; and transmits a data packet in the QoS flow based on a third value of each of the M QoS parameters, where a transmission requirement corresponding to the third value of each of the M QoS parameters is lower than or equal to a transmission requirement corresponding to the first value of the QoS parameter, and higher than or equal to a transmission requirement corresponding to the second value of the QoS parameter.

title: Digital Verification of Users Based On Real-time Video Stream
abstract: Techniques are disclosed relating to receiving, by a computer system from a user, a request to authorize the user. The technique may further include receiving, by the computer system, a live video stream of the user, and requesting, by the computer system, the user to submit an identification document from a list of authorized identification documents. While the user submits the identification document, the technique may also include detecting liveliness of the user in the live video stream by using a gesture recognition operation. Additionally, the technique may include determining, using the submitted identification document and the detected liveliness, whether to proceed with the request to authorize the user.

title: Aseptic apparatus and process for filling and closing cans
abstract: An aseptic apparatus for filling and closing cans, the aseptic apparatus comprises a filling unit and a lid sterilizing unit configured to sterilize lids and comprising a rotating star-wheel. The lid sterilizing unit is configured to lower each of the sterilized lids on a corresponding can laying on a conveyor in a closing station and to place and press the sterilized lid on the corresponding can. An isolating unit houses the filling unit and the sterilizing unit. The aseptic apparatus also includes a seaming unit downstream from the closing station so as to receive the cans with lids applied thereon. The seaming unit is located outside the isolating unit.

title: Correlation-enhanced objective function for improved machine learning-based energy forecasting
abstract: A computing device may include a memory having computer readable instructions stored thereon, and processing circuitry configured to execute the computer readable instructions to, obtain historical energy data, generate a correlation-enhanced energy forecast using a machine learning model based on the historical energy data, and output energy storage recommendation information corresponding to a desired future time period based on the correlation-enhanced energy forecast.

title: Combination therapy with antibody-drug conjugates and hyaluronidases
abstract: Provided are combination dosing regimens comprising administering an antibody-drug conjugate and hyaluronidase. Combinations and compositions containing the antibody-drug conjugate and hyaluronidase are provided. The dosing regimens and combinations are for treating or preventing cancer.

title: Resource calling method and apparatus
abstract: A resource invocation method and electronic device are provided. The method comprises: in response to a resource invocation request initiated by a first user for a target resource, determining a first user sandbox corresponding to the first user, wherein different users respectively correspond to different user sandboxes, and any user sandbox records address information of an callable resource for a corresponding user; and according to resource description information of the target resource, querying target address information of the target resource from address information of a first callable resource recorded in the first user sandbox, and performing resource invocation according to the target address information.
assignee: Cloud Intelligence Assets Holding (Singapore) Private Limited

title: Managed transportation communication authorization, governance, accessibility, multimodal communication synchronization, and network resource control system
abstract: A transportation-provider-managed communication system configured to selectively authorize, synchronize, govern, prioritize, monetize, monitor, revoke, suspend, terminate, interpret, render, process, synchronize, optimize, allocate, meter, or control multimodal communication sessions and accessibility communication sessions operating within transportation-provider-managed communication environments. The system comprises onboard wireless communication infrastructures, communication authorization systems, transportation-provider-managed communication governance systems, accessibility communication rendering systems, interpreted speech systems, synchronized caption systems, distributed rehabilitation systems, conferencing systems, browser-based communication systems, network resource allocation systems, and passenger-operated portable electronic communication devices. Communication sessions may comprise Voice over Internet Protocol communication sessions, conferencing sessions, collaboration sessions, browser communication sessions, telehealth sessions, accessibility communication sessions, synchronized communication sessions, or combinations thereof.

title: Chemically modified antisense oligonucleotides for use in rna editing
abstract: The invention relates to the field of RNA editing using antisense oligonucleotides (AONs) that comprise at least one non-naturally occurring internucleoside linkage modification. The RNA editing is directed at deaminating target adenosines in endogenously present RNA nucleic acid molecules, such as pre-mRNA and mRNA transcript products, using deaminating enzymes such as ADAR1 and ADAR2 that are preferably endogenously present in the cell. The non-natural internucleoside linkage modification is a phosphoramidate linkage, preferably a mesyl phosphoramidate (PNms) linkage.

title: High Density Polyethylene and Basalt Powder Composition and Methods Related Thereto
abstract: The present disclosure provides a polymer blend composition, and non-pressure pipes produced therefrom, comprising high density polyethylene and basalt powder coated with methacryloxy functional trimethoxy silane.

title: Network power optimization
abstract: In one embodiment, a system for network power optimization includes a plurality of network planes, a plurality of network-enabled devices, each of the network-enabled devices being connected to each of the network planes, and a controller to select a subset of the plurality of network planes for at least one network-enabled device of the plurality of network-enabled devices to send traffic over, allowing at least one unused network plane to enter a lower power mode.

title: Rotating electric machine and method of assembling rotating electric machine
abstract: A rotating electric machine includes a stator, a stator holding member that holds the stator, and a conduit member disposed between the stator and the stator holding member. A first recess is provided in a surface of the stator that faces the stator holding member. A second recess facing the first recess is provided in the stator holding member. The conduit member is disposed in an arrangement hole formed by the first recess and the second recess.

title: Compositions and methods for detecting group b streptococcus nucleic acid
abstract: Disclosed are nucleic acid oligomers, including amplification oligomers and detection probes, for detection of Group B  Streptococcus  (GBS;  Streptococcus agalactiae ) nucleic acid. Also disclosed are methods of specific nucleic acid amplification and detection using the disclosed oligomers, as well as corresponding reaction mixtures and kits.

title: Photonic integrated circuit and method of manufacturing a photonic integrated circuit
abstract: In an embodiment a photonic integrated circuit includes a substrate with a first surface, a first cladding layer with a second surface and at least one first waveguide provided on the first and second surfaces, wherein the first surface is partially covered by the first cladding layer, wherein the first cladding layer includes a transition area with a sloped surface, wherein the first waveguide is extended from the first surface to the second surface via the sloped surface of the transition area, and wherein a width of the first waveguide on the sloped surface of the transition area is greater than the width of the first waveguide on the first and/or second surfaces.

title: System and method to detect the presence and progression of diseases characterized by systemic changes in the state of the vasculature
abstract: This invention provides a system and method that employs multiple measurements of various, relevant tissue states of a patient to detect and predict OH and similar conditions. These multianatomic measurements are transformed by a multivariate algorithm to outputs that convey the diagnostic and prognostic risk of the disease of interest. This novel, multiple-measurement technique avoids use of a single measurement, which is generally unlikely to adequately extract sufficient information to drive a clinically useful test in the setting of complex system disease. The system and method herein thereby allows automated monitoring of currently stable patients who, are known or suspected to have OH and/or similar internal conditions on a substantially continuous basis.
assignee: The Trustees Of Dartmouth College; Mary Hitchcock Memorial Hospital, For Itself And On Behalf Of Dartmouth-Hitchcock Clinic

title: System for managing lost item
abstract: A lost item management system using a wireless chip. The system has a function of identifying the location of an item and notifying an alert by a user terminal receiving a signal from a wireless chip attached to the item. When a user loses an item, the location of the item can be quickly confirmed by inputting the features of the item through a dedicated application and collating them with a database on a server. When an item is delivered to a store, the features of the item are extracted using image recognition technology and registered in the database. Furthermore, the system is provided with an advertisement display function, displays advertisements for products related to the user, and obtains advertising revenue, thereby realizing a Win-Win model that provides services to the user for free.

title: Apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium and article of aerosolizable medium
abstract: An apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium, the apparatus including a housing; and a chamber for receiving an article. The article includes an aerosolizable medium; and a marker arrangement including a first marker and a second marker. The apparatus includes a sensor arrangement configured to operate in a first mode and a second mode. In the first mode the sensor arrangement monitors non-continuously for the presence of the first marker. In the second mode the sensor arrangement is configured to read identification information from the second marker. The sensor arrangement operates in the second mode responsive to the detection of the presence of the first marker in the first mode.

title: Fuel cell control system
abstract: A fuel cell control system that improves the durability of a fuel cell by adaptation to the actual way the fuel cell is used. This fuel cell control system includes: a PM control model that generates an FC power generation command value for causing a fuel cell to output the power necessary for traveling a target endurance distance; a correction unit that, if there is more than a prescribed divergence between an actually measured voltage value of the fuel cell and an estimated voltage value obtained using an IV performance model, corrects parameters that form the IV performance model; an endurance distance prediction model that calculates a predicted endurance distance of a vehicle using the IV performance model with the corrected parameters; and a PM control parameter correction unit that, if the predicted endurance distance does not reach the target endurance distance, corrects parameters of the PM control model.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toyota Chuo Kenkyusho; Denso Corporation

title: Blended energy implant
abstract: Ion implantation systems and methods implant varying energies of an ion beam across a workpiece in a serial single-workpiece end station, where electrodes of an acceleration / deceleration stage, bend electrode and/or energy filter control a final energy or path of the ion beam to the workpiece. The bend electrode or an energy filter can form part of the acceleration / deceleration stage or can be positioned downstream. A scanning apparatus scans the ion beam and/or the workpiece, and a power source provides varied electrical bias signals to the electrodes. A controller selectively varies the electrical bias signals concurrent with the scanning of the ion beam and/or workpiece through the ion beam based on a desired ion beam energy at the workpiece. A waveform generator can provide the variation and synchronize the electrical bias signals supplied to the acceleration / deceleration stage, bend electrode and/or energy filter.

title: Anode active material composition for lithium secondary battery and anode electrode and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: An anode active material composition for a lithium secondary battery includes a carbon-based anode active material and a silicon-based anode active material, wherein the carbon-based anode active material has an orientation (I 004 /I 110 , here, I 004  is a peak intensity of the (004) plane when measuring X-ray diffraction (XRD) of the carbon-based anode active material, and I 110  is a peak intensity of the (110) plane when measuring XRD of the carbon-based anode active material) of 2.85 or less measured by XRD.

title: Display device and electronic device
abstract: Disclosed herein are a display device and an electronic device in which short-channel effects can be reduced or prevented while ensuring a high driving speed of a driving circuit, the display device including a substrate having a display area and a non-display area, a first transistor and a second transistor at the display area, at least one of which including an oxide semiconductor transistor, a first electrode above the second transistor, a pixel-defining layer above the first electrode, a light-emitting layer above the pixel-defining layer to be connected to the first electrode, a second electrode above the light-emitting layer, and a third transistor including a field effect transistor at the non-display area.

title: Circuit routing in immersion-cooled battery
abstract: Immersion-cooled battery assemblies and systems with circuitry routed away from cooling channels are provided herein. In one example approach, a battery assembly is provided that comprises: a battery cell stack having a top surface, a bottom surface, a first side surface and a second side surface; a first endplate covering the first side surface and a second endplate covering the second side surface; and sensing circuitry routed along the first endplate or the second endplate, the sensing circuitry positioned in a first grooved path in the first endplate or a second grooved path in the second endplate.

title: Decision rules of cross-component model propagation based on block vectors and motion vectors
abstract: A method of performing cross-component prediction for coding pixel blocks is provided. A current block has a first-color block and a second-color block. A video coder generates a reconstruction for the first-color block. The video coder inherits a cross-component model from a reference block, where the cross-component model is propagated to the reference block based on cross-component prediction information of two or more further reference blocks of the reference block by e.g., selecting one reference block from the more than one further reference blocks to provide the cross-component model for the current block. The more than one further reference blocks may be located by motion vectors or block vectors of the reference block. The video coder applies the inherited cross-component model to the reconstruction of the first-color block to generate a cross-component prediction of the second-color block. The video coder uses the generated cross-component prediction to encode or decode the current block.

title: Solid-state imaging device
abstract: A solid-state imaging device includes pixels arranged in a plurality of arrays in a first direction and in a second direction, a first color filter disposed over a plurality of light receiving pixels arranged in the first direction and having a first color, a second color filter disposed over a plurality of light receiving pixels arranged in the first direction and having a second color different from the first color, a first inter-waveguide light shielding wall between the first color filter and the second color filter at an image height center of the pixel region, and and a second inter-waveguide light shielding wall between the first color filter and the second color filter at an image height periphery located away from the image height center of the pixel region and has a width greater than a width of the first inter-waveguide light shielding wall in the same direction.

title: Biomarkers of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and uses thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to biomarkers and uses thereof in methods for selecting a patient diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) for an ALS therapy. The present disclosure further relates to methods for identifying the severity of ALS in a patient, treating an ALS patient, and monitoring efficacy of an ALS treatment.
assignee: The Methodist Hospital; Coya Therapeutics, Inc.

title: Transport robot, surgical robot system including the same, and method
abstract: A transport robot, a surgical robot system including the transport robot, and a method are provided. More particularly, a surgical robot system including a surgical robot used in laparoscopic surgery or various other surgeries and a transport robot configured to transport the surgical robot is provided, and a method of transporting and placing the surgical robot using the transport robot is provided. The surgical robot system includes a surgical robot including at least one arm unit, a transport robot operable to transport the surgical robot, and a master robot including a manipulation member configured to control a motion of the transport robot, wherein the transport robot moves toward the surgical robot in response to a received signal and places the surgical robot at a position corresponding to the received signal.

title: Non-invasive neural interface and method of making the same
abstract: A surface EMG sensor and method of making the same includes a substrate and an electrode array disposed on the substrate. The electrode array has a conductive polymer, an ionic liquid (IL), a water-based polyurethane matrix (WPU) forming interconnects and sensing pad. An encapsulation layer is disposed on the interconnects of the electrode array. The electrode array is formed of PEDOT:PSS.
assignee: Board Of Trustees Of Michigan State University

title: Rgb camera scanned illumination
abstract: An inspection system for inspecting objects passing through an inspection area, which inspection area comprises at least a first elongated inspection zone having a longitudinal extension. The inspection system comprises an irradiation arrangement, a camera configured to provide a sequence of images of said at least a first inspection zone, a polygon mirror configured to rotate around a rotation axis and comprising a plurality of reflective surfaces arranged one after another around said rotation axis, wherein each reflective surface of said polygon mirror is configured to redirect optical radiation originating from said irradiation arrangement towards a portion only of said inspection area, which irradiated portion moves along said longitudinal extension of said at least a first elongated inspection zone from a first irradiated end to a second irradiated end of said at least a first elongated inspection zone once per reflective surface and revolution of said polygon mirror.

title: Partially connected sleeve for an endoluminal device having an unconnected portion for portal access of an implantable device
abstract: An endoluminal device includes an implantable device and a constraining sleeve. The implantable device is transitionable between a collapsed, delivery configuration, an expanded, deployed configuration, and a partially deployed configuration between the collapsed, delivery configuration and the expanded, deployed configuration, and the implantable device has at least one opening providing access to an inner lumen of the implantable device. The constraining sleeve is removably disposed around and constraining the implantable device in the partially deployed configuration. The constraining sleeve has a first connected portion including a distal portion of the sleeve, a second connected portion including a proximal portion of the sleeve, and an unconnected portion located between the first and second connected portions providing access to the at least one opening.

title: Gas Collection Device and Gas Analysis Device Using Same
abstract: A gas collection device includes a lower jig part having a battery penetration defined therein, a sealing part having a close loop shape located above the lower jig part, and an upper jig part having a battery insertion groove defined therein and a gas diffusion space. The upper jig part is coupled to the lower jig part and the sealing part is located in between the lower jig part and the upper jig part. Both ends parts of the lower jig part are open. The gas collection device is configured to collect in real time, gas generated in a cylindrical secondary battery. A gas analysis device using the gas collection device is also provided.

title: Reaction influencer synthesis using in-context learning and bayesian optimization
abstract: Techniques described herein pertain to using in-context learning and Bayesian optimization for identifying procedure specifications for synthesizing and testing reaction influencers. A procedure that includes a procedure specification and a label such as yield is used to generate input information for a machine learning model. The input information includes a natural language description of the procedure and a query that includes the label and a normal random variable. A natural language description of a reaction influencer and a procedure for synthesizing and testing the reaction influencer is predicted for the input information using the machine learning model. The machine learning model is then used to predict a set of results including a certainty factor for additional example procedures. Bayesian optimization is performed on the additional example procedures using the certainty factors in an acquisition function to select a candidate example procedure for synthesizing a reaction influencer.

title: Refrigerated wild game cooler bag and method of use
abstract: The present disclosure provides a system for cooling an animal carcass in the field and a method for using the same. The system includes an insulated bag, a portable refrigeration unit, and a tubular connector linking the two to facilitate the transport of cold air into the insulated bag. The system further comprises a series of channels into which ice or other cold material may be inserted to facilitate cooling. Associated straps, hooks, and loops facilitate the use of the system. A four-layer insulated lining with suggested materials makes up the bulk of the insulated bag. The method of using said system involves wrapping an animal carcass in the unfolded bag, zipping it closed, securing the bag about the animal by use of straps, and either hanging or transporting the bag with the secured carcass.

title: Switching regulator
abstract: The switching regulator includes a voltage regulator configured to supply an internal power supply voltage to a switching control circuit, a depletion type first transistor having a drain connected to an output terminal, a second transistor having a drain connected to a source of the first transistor and a source connected to the voltage regulator, and a comparison circuit comparing a source voltage of the first transistor with an output voltage of the voltage regulator. In response to detecting that the source voltage of the first transistor has become higher than the internal power supply voltage, control is performed so that the second transistor is turned on.

title: Thermal management system, battery pack, and vehicle
abstract: A thermal management system includes a main liquid inlet pipe, a main liquid outlet pipe, and at least two liquid cooling plates. A main liquid inlet and at least two liquid inlets are spaced apart and disposed on the main liquid inlet pipe in sequence. A main liquid outlet and at least two liquid outlets are spaced apart and disposed on the main liquid outlet pipe in sequence. The at least two liquid cooling plates are spaced apart along a preset direction. The cross-sectional area of a liquid inlet closer to the main liquid inlet is smaller than the cross-sectional area of a liquid inlet farther from the main liquid inlet, or the liquid flow space inside a liquid cooling plate closer to the main liquid inlet is smaller than the liquid flow space inside a liquid cooling plate farther from the main liquid inlet.

title: Ai/ml control method and apparatus
abstract: An AI/ML control apparatus, configured in a terminal equipment, includes: a transmitter configured to report information on one or more applicable or preferred or selected or candidate or recommend AI/ML functionalities/models to a network device via a radio resource control (RRC) message, wherein the radio resource control (RRC) message is a RRC reconfiguration complete message or a UE assistance information (UAI) message.

title: Architecture for offering a service of a first cloud service provider via a second cloud service provider
abstract: An architecture for offering a service of a first cloud service provider via a second cloud service provider is disclosed. A method describes receiving, by one or more processors of a first cloud service provider (CSP) environment, a request for a cloud operation from a management component of a second CSP environment; identifying a second CSP identifier included in the request that is associated with the second CSP; translating the second CSP identifier into a first CSP identifier that is associated with the first CSP environment; obtaining a first CSP identity based on the first CSP identifier; and executing the cloud operation using the first CSP identity.

title: Transmission arrangement for a vehicle
abstract:
A transmission arrangement for a vehicle, comprising:
         an input component,   a planetary gear system comprising a sun gearwheel, a ring gearwheel, and a planet carrier rotationally connected to an output component,   a crawler unit selectively drivingly connecting the ring gearwheel to the output component, wherein the rotational connection of a gear member of the crawler unit to a stationary member causes the ring gearwheel to rotate in an opposite direction compared to the planet carrier,   a first sleeve movable between a first position and a second position, rotationally connecting the sun gearwheel to the stationary member and to the input component, respectively,   a second sleeve movable between a first position, rotationally connected to the input component, and a second position, rotationally connected to the stationary member, and   a third sleeve movable between a first position, rotationally connected to the ring gearwheel, and a second position, rotationally connected to the gear member of the crawler unit,   the second and third sleeves being mutually coaxial, rotationally interconnected, and axially displaceable relative one another.

title: Coverage Management Interfaces for Direct-To-Cell Satellite Coverage
abstract: Coverage management interfaces for direct-to-cell satellite coverage can be created by obtaining device data generated by the user device; determining, based on the device data, an expected geographic location of the user device at a future time; determining, based on the expected geographic location, the future time, and network data obtained from a network control, network connections that are expected to be available at the expected geographic location at the future time, the network connections including a direct-to-cell satellite network connection; generating, based on the network connections determined, coverage data that represents the network connections that are expected to be available at the geographic location at the future time; and providing the coverage data to the user device. The user device can generate a user interface based on the coverage data, the user interface including a representation of the direct-to-cell satellite network connection.
assignee: At&T Mobility Ii Llc; At&T Intellectual Property I, L.P.

title: Actuator assembly for an electromechanical vehicle brake
abstract: An actuator assembly for an electromechanical vehicle brake has a brake calliper, a spindle drive, which has a spindle sleeve, a spindle nut and a drive shaft, driven by an electric motor, for adjusting the spindle nut in the axial direction via the spindle sleeve, a brake housing, which forms the brake calliper and inside which the spindle drive is arranged, and an actuator housing, which is connected to the brake housing. The drive shaft is coupled on the one hand to the spindle sleeve via a reduction gear mechanism and on the other hand to a motor shaft of an electric motor via a gear unit with spur gears, wherein all the spur gears are arranged in a common plane. Furthermore, the gear unit is arranged inside the actuator housing.

title: Nuclear instrument removal system for use with processing a nuclear instrument, associated feed and cut module, and method of processing a nuclear instrument
abstract: A nuclear instrument removal system (NIRS) for use with processing a nuclear instrument is provided. The NIRS includes a control system and an instrument processing system configured for use with the control system. The instrument processing system includes a counter module configured to receive the nuclear instrument, a feed and cut module removably coupled to the counter module and configured to receive the nuclear instrument after passing through the counter module, and a spool module removably coupled to the feed and cut module and configured to be mounted to a cask assembly. The spool module includes a spool canister and a drive shaft associated with the canister. The drive shaft is configured to rotate about an axis in order to spool a cold portion of the nuclear instrument within the canister.

title: Slot Closure Device for an Electrical Machine, Method for Closing a Slot of an Electrical Machine, Electrical Machine, and Motor Vehicle
abstract: A slot closure device for an electrical machine includes wing parts connected to one another and spaced from one another at a straight slit of a slot closure body. The slit includes a first bracing bar seat arranged on the slit base and a smaller, second bracing bar seat, and a straight bracing bar. By moving the bracing bar from one of the bracing bar seats to the other, it is possible to adjust the slot closure device between a mounting position, in which the wing parts are relaxed due to the bracing bar sitting in the first bracing bar seat with a form fit, and a bracing position, in which the wing parts are braced laterally apart from one another by the bracing bar sitting in the second bracing bar seat with a form fit.

title: Low dropout voltage regulator including power supply noise suppression circuit
abstract: An apparatus, including: an upper voltage rail; a lower voltage rail; a low dropout (LDO) voltage regulator configured to generate a regulated output voltage at an output coupled between the upper voltage rail and the lower voltage rail while transferring noise from the upper voltage rail to the output; and an auxiliary noise suppression circuit configured to transfer noise from the upper voltage rail to the output of the LDO voltage regulator with a phase substantially opposite to a phase of the noise transferred to the output by the LDO voltage regulator such that noise suppression or reduction occurs at the output of the LDO voltage regulator.

title: Tire foam and tire shine aerosol
abstract: The present disclosure describes compositions for providing shine and durability to various surfaces. The compositions of the present disclosure include: water; one or more thickeners; one or more wetting agents; one or more corrosion inhibitors; one or more pH adjusters; and one or more gloss enhancers or a combination of gloss enhancers and silicone solvent. The compositions can optionally include one or more preservatives, and/or one or more propellants. In embodiments, when the gloss enhancers have a viscosity of greater than about 500 cSt, a silicone solvent is added. In embodiments, if foaming is desired, the compositions can include one or more surfactants.

title: Method and server for providing response message to message transmission request
abstract: Disclosed are a method including: receiving, by a telecommunications company server, from a transmission terminal, an outgoing call request for transmitting a plurality of voice messages to a reception terminal; determining, by the telecommunications company server, whether a receiver account corresponding to the reception terminal is subscribed to an overseas notification service upon receiving the outgoing call request; routing, by the telecommunications company server, a line connection between the reception terminal and the transmission terminal to pass through a service server when the receiver account is subscribed to the overseas notification service; providing, by the service server, a first response message corresponding to a first voice message, which is any one of the plurality of voice messages, to the transmission terminal; and providing a second response message corresponding to a second voice message.

title: Computer-Based Method and Apparatus for Personal Assistance, Collaboration, Networking, and Providing Marketplaces
abstract: A method and apparatus to selectively allow communication and information exchange between a user and an ally in a networked communication system that includes mobile devices, laptop computers, and computers. The user selects from a list of relationship descriptors, and trust levels are designated responsive to the relationship descriptors. The list of relationship descriptors may include one or more high level group descriptors and lower-level descriptors. The user may select a privacy level, and responsive to the trust level and the privacy level, communication and information sharing are selectively allowed. The information shared may include user profile information, an ally list, favorites, shared interests, and calendars. A social fabric diagram may be created from which the user may view ally relationships.

title: Power storage device and method for manufacturing same
abstract: A power storage device includes an electrode body, an exterior film, a seal part, and a seal reinforcement part. The exterior film wraps the electrode body so as to form an opening and has a first seal region. A lid body is disposed in the opening and has a second seal region facing the first seal region. The seal part is formed between the first seal region and the second seal region, and at least partially seals a portion between the first seal region and the second seal region. The seal reinforcement part reinforces sealing by the seal part.

title: Sump pump systems, controllers, and methods for operating thereof
abstract: A sump pump system includes a central unit having a water accumulation reservoir, a vacuum/compressor system, a water discharge port, and a controller. The reservoir includes a first port adjacent its lower end, a second port above the first port in fluid communication with one or more water intake assemblies, and a third port above the second port in fluid communication with the vacuum/compressor system. The vacuum/compressor system operates alternately in a vacuum mode to aspirate water or air into the reservoir and in a pressure mode to discharge accumulated water through the water discharge port. The controller activates the system on a predetermined time schedule without user intervention, achieving water removal and air ventilation to produce complete dryness of the surface being drained. In a multi-compartment boat embodiment, individual water intake assemblies are placed in respective isolated hull compartments and connected to the central unit through sequentially activated solenoid valves controlled by the controller.

title: System, method, and apparatus for providing dynamic, prioritized spectrum management and utilization
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing dynamic, prioritized spectrum utilization management. The system includes at least one monitoring sensor, at least one data analysis engine, at least one application, a semantic engine, a programmable rules and policy editor, a tip and cue server, and/or a control panel. The tip and cue server is operable utilize the environmental awareness from the data processed by the at least one data analysis engine in combination with additional information to create actionable data.

title: State estimation apparatus and state estimation method
abstract: A state estimation apparatus includes: a target state setting unit that sets a target state of a target object; an acquisition unit that acquires image information representing the target object; a meshing unit that meshes the image information; a graph representation generation unit that represents a meshed image with nodes and edges, assigns information relating to positions of nodes to the nodes, and assigns information indicating relationships between the nodes to edges; a modeling unit that inputs information of an entire mesh into a GNN and models distance dependencies and interactions of the entire mesh with an Attention mechanism; and an estimation unit that estimates region changes of the target object from time-series changes.

title: Data communications network and method to assist managing network marketing relationships
