abstract: The invention relates to a method for demi-permanent hair colouring and the relative compositions.

title: Sliding member
abstract: A sliding member includes a back metal portion; and a sliding alloy portion provided on one surface of the back metal portion and having a sliding surface opposite to the back metal portion. The sliding alloy portion includes a matrix consisting of a Cu-based alloy containing 5 to 15% by mass of Sn, with the remainder including an unavoidable impurity; 0.5 to 3% by mass of graphite particles; and additive particles formed of 0.1 to 20% by mass of one selected from Co, Mo, Cr, and W, or an alloy thereof, and having a hardness of 200 HV to 500 HV. The graphite particles satisfy S1:S2=1:1.5 to 2.5, wherein S1 represents an area of a first surface in a thickness direction perpendicular to the sliding surface, and S2 represents an area of a second surface parallel to the sliding surface perpendicular to the first surface.

title: Versatile suspension fitness device for both indoor and outdoor use
abstract: A versatile suspension fitness device includes: a metal hook, a soft rubber door anchor, a connecting strap, and a main body. The metal hook defines an annular connecting portion integrally formed at a bottom of the metal hook. The soft rubber door anchor is disposed at a lower end of the annular connecting portion. The connecting strap is provided on the annular connecting portion outside the soft rubber door anchor. The connecting strap passes through the annular connecting portion, extends bilaterally to wrap around the soft rubber door anchor, and is then sewn to form a closed loop. The main body of the versatile suspension fitness device is disposed below the connecting strap.

title: Environmentally friendly and healthy mattress
abstract: An environmentally friendly and healthy mattress, includes from top to bottom a fabric layer, a comfort layer, a spacer layer, a mattress body, and a base cloth. The comfort layer includes a fiber rebound layer made from flame-retardant fibers. The mattress body includes a plurality of individually pocketed springs. Pockets of the plurality of individually pocketed springs are made from flame-retardant fibers, and adjacent pockets are connected through hot-melt adhesive. Compared to traditional spongy matrix layer and the latex layer in the prior art, the comfort layer including the fiber rebound layer demonstrates more advantages in aging resistance, flame retardancy, breathability, comfort, and longer service life, and also overcomes the defects including bacterial proliferation caused by aging and moisture absorption of sponge and latex, as well as difficulty of recycling. The mattress possesses overall superior fire resistance, operational safety, aging resistance, breathability, comfort, and longer service life.
assignee: Jiahe Xingwang (Huizhou) Textile Technology Co., Ltd.

title: System and method for anonymous, license-plate based vehicle-to-everything (v2x) communication
abstract: A method includes receiving, from a user device, data representing a geographic position of a first vehicle. The method further includes identifying one or more proximate vehicles located within a predetermined proximity of the first vehicle. The method further includes obtaining an anonymized identifier (AID) for each proximate vehicle determined to be contactable. The method further includes transmitting, to the user device, map overlay data including the AID and location data for each contactable proximate vehicle to cause the first vehicle to display the map overlay data. The method further includes receiving, from the user device, a request to establish a communication session with a second vehicle. The method further includes using a routing token to deliver the request to another user device within the second vehicle. The method further includes establishing the communication session between the user device and the other user device to permit anonymous communication.

title: Adaptable liquid coolant flow loop for a server
abstract: A server includes heat-generating components and a flow loop providing a liquid coolant to cold plates in thermal communication with the heat-generating components. The flow loop includes, for each cold plate, one or more fluid flow segments for delivering the liquid coolant to and from the cold plate, wherein each fluid flow segment includes an electrically controllable upstream valve and an electrically controllable downstream valve. The apparatus further includes a plurality of liquid detection sensors, each sensor being co-located with a fluid flow segment. A controller included in the server is connected to each sensor and each valve. The controller executes program instructions to perform various operations, including receiving a positive liquid detection signal indicating liquid has contacted a specific sensor and sending a valve control signal to close the valves in the fluid flow segment that has a leak.

title: Connector assembly with improved heat dissipation effect
abstract: A connector assembly includes an electrical connector, a cage and a board. The electrical connector includes a body and a number of conductive terminals. The cage includes a receiving chamber configured to receive a mating connector along a first direction. The first direction is perpendicular to the board. The board includes a heat dissipation slot. The heat dissipation slot is configured to achieve better heat dissipation for the mating connector.

title: Containment connector
abstract: A containment connector comprising: a. at least one female part, each having a coupling end for hermetically coupling the respective female part to one of the at least one first pipe, and a female mating end having an internal thread for mating with one of at least one male part; b. each of said at least one male part having a coupling end, and a male mating end having an external thread for mating with one of said at least one female part; c. means for sealing the connector by forcing male mating end, and/or a circular groove in each male mating end and an opposite female mating end; d. a space between an interior of the connector and at least a portion of an external surface of the joint; and eat least one port allowing connecting the space with an exterior of the connector.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR IMPROVED TOTAL SPECTRAL EFFICIENCY USING MULTIPLE TRANSMISSION AND RECEPTION POINT (mTRP) WITH COHERENT JOINT TRANSMISSION (CJT)
abstract: Aspects of the subject disclosure may include, for example, a system, comprising a multiple transmission and reception point (mTRP) configuration including multiple TRPs that provide coherent joint transmission (CJT), wherein the mTRP configuration is arranged to span or provide coverage for a particular sector, and wherein the multiple TRPs are positioned in respective orientations that are directed away from one another. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title: Compact, stable pulse filter and delay circuit
abstract: An example circuit, method, and electronic device configured to filter pulses below a minimum threshold pulse width and provide delays that exhibit low variance to changes in temperature, voltage, and technology processes, are provided. The example circuit includes a first flip/flop, a second flip/flop, and a charge detector. The first flip/flop generates a first out signal and a first inverse signal based on an input signal and a first clocking signal. The second flip/flop generates an output signal and a second out signal based on the first out signal, the first inverse signal, and a second clocking signal, wherein the second clocking signal is an inverse of the first clocking signal. The charge detector circuit includes a charging capacitor to generate a charge signal based on a change in the input signal, such that pulses are filtered based on a capacitance value of the charging capacitor and a reference voltage.

title: Trigger pumps
abstract: The invention relates to a trigger pump dispenser comprising—a main body, comprising—a pump chamber—an inlet port in communication with said pump chamber—an outlet port in communication with said pump chamber—an inlet valve seated between the pump chamber and the inlet port—a outlet valve seated between the pump chamber and the outlet port—a piston, seated in the pump chamber, for defining a variable volume in said pump chamber and movable between a retracted position of larger chamber volume and an inserted position of lesser chamber volume,—wherein the pump chamber has a conical shape.

title: Input objective-based wing assembly pitch adjustments
abstract: Systems, methods, and other embodiments described herein relate to improving lift and efficiency in an aircraft by adjusting the pitch of a wing assembly in a variable incidence wing aircraft. In one embodiment, a method includes determining, based on an input objective, a target wing assembly pitch for a wing assembly of an aircraft. The wing assembly of the aircraft rotates about a pitch axis of the fuselage via action of a tilt actuator. The method also includes measuring a wing assembly pitch of the wing assembly. The method also includes altering an angle of the wing assembly based on a difference between the target wing assembly pitch and the wing assembly pitch.
assignee: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing North America, Inc.; Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha

title: Vehicle steering apparatus and vehicle including the same
abstract: A vehicle steering apparatus and a vehicle include a ball nut coupled to a rack bar by means of a ball and configured to linearly move or slide the rack bar in an axial direction by rotation of the ball nut, first and second nut pulleys provided on an outer peripheral surface of the ball nut, a first motor pulley provided on a first motor and operably connected to the first nut pulley through a first belt, a second motor pulley provided on a second motor and operably connected to the second nut pulley through a second belt, and a rotation prevention member arranged to support an outer peripheral surface of the rack bar, supported by an inner peripheral surface of a rack housing and configured to prevent rotation of the rack bar.

title: Satellite communication system utilizing customized highly elliptical orbits
abstract: A method of applying enhanced communication security in a satellite communication environment may include communicating with a satellite having a highly elliptical orbit from a satellite controller at a ground station, determining an orbital modification to apply to the satellite, communicating a command instruction to the satellite for thrusters of the satellite to provide a micro-orbit adjustment, and monitoring communications after the micro-orbit adjustment to determine malicious actors based on a timing adjustment associated with the micro-orbit adjustment.

title: Determining prach spatial tx filter and tx power in multi-trp transmissions
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for determining a transmit power for Physical Random Access Channel (PRACH) for a multi-Transmission and Reception Point (TRP) transmission. In one embodiment, a method performed by a User Equipment (UE) comprises receiving a configuration of a first and second time advance group (TAG) identity (ID), a first control resource set (CORESET) with a first CORESET pool index value, and a second CORESET with a second CORESET pool index value in a serving cell. The method further comprises receiving a request in the serving cell to transmit a Physical Random Access Channel (PRACH) preamble, the request comprising a PRACH preamble index, information about a downlink reference signal (RS), and information about a Physical Cell Identity (PCI) associated with the downlink RS. The method further comprises determining, based on the request, a transmit power for transmission of the PRACH preamble, and transmitting the PRACH preamble accordingly.

title: Shopping Cart with Forward-Positioned Rear Wheels
abstract: A smart shopping cart includes a pair of front wheels and a pair of forward-positioned rear wheels. The front wheels are swivel wheels and the rear wheels are fixed wheels. The rear wheels are forward positioned in that the rear wheels are positioned substantially in front of the handlebars of the smart shopping cart. For example, whereas the rear wheels of traditional shopping carts are generally close to or to the rear of the handlebars of the shopping cart, the rear wheels of the described smart shopping cart are substantially in front of the handlebars. By moving the rear wheels closer to the center of mass of the smart shopping cart, the smart shopping cart becomes easier to turn relative to traditional shopping carts.

title: Magnetic sensor and magnetic recording device
abstract: According to one embodiment, a magnetic sensor includes first, second, third, and fourth conductive portions, a sensor portion, and a controller. A second direction from the third conductive portion to the fourth conductive portion crosses a first direction from the first conductive portion to the second conductive portion. The sensor portion is provided between the first and second conductive portions and between the third and fourth conductive portions. The sensor portion includes a first magnetic member and a first non-magnetic member. The first non-magnetic member is provided between the third conductive portion and the first magnetic member. The controller is configured to supply a first current between the first conductive portion and the second conductive portion and to detect a first signal generated between the first conductive portion and the second conductive portion and a second signal generated between the third conductive portion and the fourth conductive portion.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba; Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation

title: Silicon based detection device which detects the short-wave infrared (swir) wavelengths
abstract: A system and method for frequency conversion of a Short-Wave Infrared (SWIR) signal utilizing a three-dimensional resonant optical structure are disclosed. The system comprises a silicon layer exhibiting third-order nonlinearity (χ(3)) positioned within a Fabry-Pérot cavity formed by dielectric reflectors. A pump wave and an input SWIR signal undergo Four-Wave Mixing (FWM) within the cavity, generating an idler wave at a converted wavelength. The idler wave is detected via a silicon electro-optical detector using two-photon absorption or free carrier absorption. The technology is applicable to SWIR imaging and optical communication, offering enhanced detection sensitivity in the infrared range while leveraging cost-effective silicon-based photonics.

title: Universal linear intensity transformations using spatially-incoherent diffractive processors
abstract: Under spatially-coherent light, a diffractive optical network or processor composed of structured surfaces can be designed to perform any arbitrary complex-valued linear transformation between its input and output fields-of-view (FOVs) if the total number (N) of optimizable phase-only diffractive features is ≥~2N i N o , where N i  and N o  refer to the number of useful pixels at the input and the output FOVs, respectively. Here, a spatially-incoherent diffractive optical processor is disclosed that can approximate any arbitrary linear transformation in time-averaged intensity between its input and output FOVs. In other embodiments, the diffractive optical network or processor executes complex-valued information processing for executing arbitrary complex-valued linear transformations using spatially incoherent light. Spatially-incoherent diffractive networks will be broadly useful for designing all-optical visual processors that can work with incoherent, under natural light.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Miniature modular detachable image-observation base device
abstract: The present invention is a miniature modular detachable image-observation base device including a wearable optical base and a high-precision composite lens unit placed in the wearable optical base. The base's curved surface matches the natural curvature of a mouse's skull, allowing the composite lens unit to be firmly fixed to the mouse's head. The composite lens unit can be replaced with others to accommodate observation applications at different depths to not only overcome limitations of shallow brain regions but also provide a miniaturized gradient-index lens being slender and thus able to pierce the mouse's brain to reach deep brain regions thereof, so as to steadily perform functional imaging monitoring of neuronal activity in the deep brain regions during numerous sessions over prolonged periods.

title: Connector device
abstract: A connector device ( 1 ) includes a first connector ( 10 ) including a plurality of first terminal fittings ( 18 ) and a second connector ( 20 ) connectable to the first connector ( 10 ). The second connector ( 20 ) includes a holder ( 22 ), a plurality of sub-connectors ( 33, 34 ) mounted in the holder ( 22 ) and a plurality of second terminal fittings ( 45 ) mounted in the sub-connectors ( 33, 34 ). The plurality of sub-connectors ( 33, 34 ) mounted in the holder ( 22 ) are individually movable from an initial position to a connection position where the first terminal fittings ( 18 ) and the second terminal fittings ( 45 ) are connected.
assignee: Autonetworks Technologies, Ltd.; Sumitomo Wiring Systems, Ltd.; Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd.

title: Circuit and method for improving sensing accuracy
abstract: A processing circuit includes a delay circuit for outputting a delayed signal according to a first path delay coefficient; a control circuit for determining a clock phase sampling time according to a second path delay coefficient and outputting a controlled signal according to the clock phase sampling time; a transforming circuit for transforming the controlled signal to a transformed signal; a mixing circuit for mixing the delayed signal and the transformed signal, to generate a mixed signal; a removing circuit for removing a direct current (DC) component of the mixed signal, to generate a removed signal; a computing circuit for computing the first path delay coefficient, the second path delay coefficient and a signal power according to the removed signal; an amplifying circuit for amplifying an amplitude of the removed signal, to generate an amplified signal; and a combining circuit for combining a plurality of chirps in the amplified signal.

title: User equipment and base station involved in monitoring of a control channel
abstract: A user equipment (UE) includes a transmitter, which, in operation, transmits a capability indication indicating a capability of the UE involving: a first capability condition regarding a minimum span time gap between two consecutive time spans having a span length of one or more consecutive symbols, wherein each time span contains one or more monitoring occasions for a downlink control channel for receiving a downlink control information message, and a second capability condition regarding a minimum group time gap between two consecutive groups of time spans within a grouping window having a length of one or more slots. The UE includes a receiver, which, in operation, receives, from a base station, configuration information for configuring one or more monitoring occasions. The UE includes a processor, which, in operation, monitors the downlink control channel.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Corporation Of America

title: Variable Optical Attenuator with Shutter Type MEMS
abstract: In a variable optical attenuator (VOA) and a method of variably optically attenuating a light beam, a input lens receives an input light beam and an output lens outputs an output light beam. A mirror reflects the input light beam as the output light beam. The mirror or a moveable element is movable in a manner to block, pass, and/or reflect at least a portion of the light included in the input light beam and the output light beam, whereupon the output light beam has reduced or increased brightness or intensity versus the input light beam.

title: Display apparatus and electronic apparatus including the same
abstract: A display apparatus may include a substrate including a component area, which includes a sub-display area and a transmission area, and a main display area at least partially around (e.g., surrounding) the component area, a display layer including a main light-emitting element in the main display area and a sub-light-emitting element in the sub-display area, and a light control layer on the display layer, including a first light-blocking layer and a second light-blocking layer under the first light-blocking layer, wherein the first light-blocking layer includes a plurality of first light-blocking lines extending in a first direction and including a first light-blocking material, and the second light-blocking layer includes a plurality of second light-blocking lines extending in the first direction and including a second light-blocking material, wherein an infrared light transmittance of the first light-blocking material is higher than an infrared light transmittance of the second light-blocking material.

title: Deposition device and deposition method
abstract: According to one embodiment, a deposition device includes a stage, a deposition head opposed to the stage, and a chamber accommodating the stage and the deposition head. The deposition head comprises a deposition source heating a material and generating vapor, a nozzle connected to the deposition source to emit the vapor generated by the deposition source, a control plate comprising a sleeve surrounding the nozzle, and a movement mechanism moving the control plate along an extension direction of the sleeve.

title: Display panel and display device
abstract: A display panel includes a display area and a non-display area. The display area includes sub-pixels and control signal lines. Each sub-pixel includes a pixel circuit.. The pixel circuit includes a light-emitting device, a driving transistor, a data writing circuit and a pixel control circuit. The pixel control circuit is configured to control the driving transistor to generate a driving current for driving the light-emitting device to emit light. Pixel circuits in at least one row of sub-pixels are coupled to one control signal line. Control signal lines corresponding to at least two adjacent rows of sub-pixels are coupled to each other. The non-display area includes a drive control circuit including shift register units. Control signal lines coupled to each other are coupled to one shift register unit. The shift register unit is configured to transmit a signal to pixel circuits through the control signal lines.
assignee: Chengdu Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.; Beijing Boe Technology Development Co., Ltd.

title: Multi-layer sheets with flow channels
abstract: A cooling panel for a battery system includes a first sheet, a second sheet, and an additional sheet that overlaps to create a multi-layer sheet. The first sheet, the second sheet, and the additional sheet have hole patterns that partially overlap to create a flow channel through the multi-layer sheet. The fluid flows through the flow channel of the multi-layer sheet that is in contact with a battery module. The fluid absorbs heat from the battery module facilitating a safe operating environment for the battery modules. The first sheet, the second sheet, and the additional sheet are made of nonwoven material that is flexible and porous. The multi-layer sheet can be on one side of the battery cells or surround the battery cells of the battery module of the electric vehicle.

title: Deployable eletromagnetic waveguides
abstract: Embodiments relate to a deployable and/or reconfigurable waveguide and waveguide-based components that can be configured to various states of length along a longitudinal axis such that the waveguide is an expandable structure. The waveguide can be expanded or unfolded to an expanded (or deployed) state, and the waveguide can be compressed or folded to a compressed state. The deployable waveguide comprises a hollow tube extending in a longitudinal direction. The hollow tube may be folded according to various different origami-inspired folding patterns.

title: Display device and electronic device including the same
abstract: Provided a display device comprises a substrate comprising a display area in which emission areas are arranged; a circuit layer located on the substrate; and an element layer located on the circuit layer. The element layer comprises light emitting elements arranged in the emission areas. The circuit layer comprises a first power line that extends in a first direction, light emitting pixel drivers that receive a first power from the first power line and respectively transmit a driving current to the light emitting elements, the light emitting pixel drivers including a first light emitting pixel driver and a second light emitting pixel driver that are adjacent to each other in a second direction that crosses the first direction; and a power connection transistor electrically connected to the first light emitting pixel driver, the second light emitting pixel driver, and the first power line.

title: Refrigerator
abstract: A refrigerator comprises: a cabinet that has a storage space formed therein and an inlet formed on the front surface; a door that is rotatably coupled to the cabinet and opens and closes the inlet; and an accessory that is detachably coupled to the door. The door includes: a guide that is located on one surface facing the storage space and supports the accessory; and a plurality of guide fastening portions provided in the guide along the height direction of the door. The accessory includes: an accessory body that forms the outer shape; and an accessory fastening portion that is provided on one surface of the accessory body and coupled to at least one of the plurality of guide fastening portions.

title: Directed differentiation protocols to derive bone fide spinal sensory interneurons
abstract: Methods for deriving dorsal interneurons (dIs) of all types, dI1-dI6, and for producing dIs in large quantities without changing their identity, are described. A method for producing dIs in vitro comprises contacting neuromesodermal progenitor cells (NMPs) with specific factors following two variations on a protocol. The methods described herein provide a disease model for sensory processing disorders, such as fibromyalgia, and autism. Cells can be obtained from an individual subject using a skin biopsy to develop the stem cells that can then be used for study and testing that is tailored to the individual subject.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Matchless RF Plasma Systems for Capacitively Coupled Plasmas
abstract: A matchless RF generator is disclosed that does not require a matching network (or the like) between the RF generator and the plasma. Plasmas have variable inductance or capacitance value during the plasma life cycle. For example, prior to ignition, the plasma chamber may have a first inductance and/or a first capacitance; during ignition, the plasma chamber may have a second inductance and/or a second capacitance; while the plasma is active, the plasma chamber with the plasma may have a third inductance and/or a third capacitance; and during a change in the plasma density, plasma chemistry, plasma brightness, constituent flow rate, plasma voltage, and plasma electric field the plasma chamber with the plasma may have a fourth inductance and/or fourth capacitance.

title: Curable potting composition free of substances of very high concern
abstract: The present invention relates to a curable potting composition based on acetoacetate, and to its use in electronic devices. In particular, the present invention relates to a curable potting composition based on multifunctional acetoacetate and multifunctional (meth)acrylate.

title: Machine Learning Based Robust Voice Communication Via Head-Worn Device
abstract: A method includes receiving, from a microphone, an audio signal that represents vibrations of an ambient medium induced by (i) an utterance of a user and (ii) ambient noise. The method also includes receiving, from a vibration sensor in contact with a head of the user, an inertial signal that represents vibrations of the head induced by the utterance. The method additionally includes obtaining a voice embedding that represents a voice of the user. The method further includes generating, by a machine learning model and based on (i) the audio signal, (ii) the inertial signal, and (iii) the voice embedding, a synthesized waveform that represents the utterance in the voice of the user and independently of the ambient noise. The method yet further includes outputting the synthesized waveform.

title: Method and device for capturing images of micro- and/or nanostructures
abstract:
A method for capturing images of micro-and/or nanostructures, and to a device designed for carrying out these methods. 
     The method uses an image capturing unit comprising at least two image capturing sensors arranged in such a way that, from an object guided past the image capturing unit at a constant speed in a predefined direction in the image region, by use of the image capturing sensors, they each successively capture the same region of the surface of the object, wherein the image capturing sensors are controlled by a temporal offset resulting from the speed by use of a predefined factor in such a way that a group of images captured by the individual image capturing sensors in each case image the same region of the surface of the object and can be additively superimposed, comprising:
         determining a variable characteristic of the position correspondence of the captured images of the same region in the images of a group captured by the individual image capturing sensors;   if the characteristic variable determined is not optimal: adapting the predefined factor according to the characteristic variable determined.       

     The device is suitably designed for carrying out this method.

title: Image processing system, control method of image processing system, and program
abstract: An image processing system includes a processor, in which the processor is configured to acquire a plurality of first-form images in which each pixel is any one of three channels, select one image among the plurality of first-form images as a reference image and one or more other images, each of the one or more other images being a composite target image, convert the reference image and the composite target image from the first-form image to a second-form image, acquire information on a positional relationship between the reference image and the composite target image based on the second-form image, perform registration between the reference image and the composite target image in a first form based on the information on the positional relationship, and output information on imaging control in accordance with a ratio of a pixel region, in which the three channels are aligned, to an entire pixel region.

title: Solar table mobile transport with sideshift
abstract: A solar table mobile transport with sideshift capability is described that moves a solar table to a point of installation. The solar table mobile transport comprises multiple motors that allow movement within a three-dimensional coordinate system as well as provide angular controls of pitch, yaw and roll. Extended horizontal movement of the solar table is provided by a sideshift element that extends the solar table beyond an edge of a transport component of the solar table mobile transport.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor and method of manufacturing solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor according to one embodiment of the present disclosure may include a stacked body having a plurality of stacked solid electrolytic capacitor elements being stacked, a first side electrode arranged on a first side surface of the stacked body, and a second side electrode arranged on a second side surface of the stacked body. Each of the solid electrolytic capacitor elements may include an anode electrode layer, a dielectric layer, a cathode electrode layer, a solid electrolyte layer, and an insulating region arranged on the anode electrode layer and adjacent to a side of the solid electrolyte layer. The first distance between the anode electrode layer and the second side electrode may be smaller than the second distance between the insulating region and the second side electrode.

title: Method and apparatus for automatic turning with recording
abstract: Provided is an automatic module for a power equipment device, comprising a user input; a first computer; and a steering controller. The user input may be configured for receiving an turn command related to turning. The first computer may be coupled to the user input, configured to access a stored record of operator turn command data, configured to create the emulation, and configured to output the emulation. The steering controller may be coupled to the computer and configured to receive the emulation. The steering controller may comprise a computer configured for generating a series of turning signals based on the emulation and causing a steering apparatus of the power equipment device to move the power equipment device to execute a turn corresponding to the turn command.

title: Catalysts for electrocatalytically converting carbon dioxide to formate
abstract: Methods and catalysts for electrocatalytically converting carbon dioxide to formate, which may then be used to produce formic acid. The catalyst is a mononuclear M(diimine)(CO) 2 XY complex (where M is Mo or W, and X and Y are CO or X and Y are Cl and η 3 -CH 2 C(CH 3 )CH 2 ) of diimine ligands that contain a pyrazinyl moiety. A method of converting carbon dioxide to formate includes forming a mixture of the catalyst, water, and carbon dioxide, and electrocatalyzing the mixture to reduce the carbon dioxide to formate.

title: Emergency Response Incident Handling
abstract: There is disclosed a system for monitoring an emergency response incident. The system comprises one or more wearable devices of a network. The one or more wearable devices are deployed at the emergency response incident. The system comprises a plurality of network nodes of the network. The plurality of network nodes is deployed at the emergency response incident. The plurality of network nodes is configured to provide network coverage in a first geographical area of the emergency response incident. Each network node of the plurality of network nodes is configured to obtain information indicative of at least one environmental condition associated with a bounding region of the network node. The first geographical area comprises the bounding region. Each network node of the plurality of network nodes is configured to, if the obtained information meets a first criterion, initiate transmission of an alert towards at least one wearable device of the one or more wearable devices.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR BLOCKCHAIN BASED AnLF CONSENSUS OVER A DISTRIBUTED UPF NETWORK FOR 6G AND PROCEDURE THEREOF
abstract: The present invention discloses a method for implementing blockchain-based User Plane Function (UPF) consensus (BlockAnLF) to achieve distributed fail-safe access of Analytics and Logical Function (AnLF) output policies of Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) among the said UPFs in a 6G network core user plane. The method comprising the steps of duplication of the AnLF output action policies which are in the form of if-then executables within a blockchain distributed over a network of the UPFs involving each of the UPFs to act as miners in the blockchain and possessing a local copy of the blockchain with itself, where the blockchain consists of a chain of individual blocks with each block consisting of a sequence of the AnLF output policies in encoded format, ensuring a consensus among the UPFs for the blocks of the blockchain involving hash coding of the blocks and validation of such hash codes and involving the UPFs for immediately referring to its local blockchain for retrieving any action policy in case the root AnLF or master AnLF within the NWDAF becomes unresponsive or unavailable.

title: Information processing apparatus, application creation method, and application creation system
abstract: An information processing apparatus communicably connected with a terminal apparatus and a generative artificial intelligence (AI) system via a network, including circuitry that displays an application creation screen that receives a user operation to arrange a plurality of components for an application to be created; displays a chat screen for receiving the assistance by the AI in response to reception of an operation on the button in the application creation screen; receives a chat message input on the chat screen; transmits, to the generative AI system, the received chat message and an instruction to generate parameters related to creation of the application; receives a request generated by the generative AI system based on the instruction, including the parameters; creates the application based on the received parameters; and displays an updated application creation screen including the plurality of components of the created application.

title: Inductor
abstract: An inductor comprising a body including a resin that includes first magnetic metal particles having a first diameter, a first coil and a second coil inside the body, and a first portion in the body between the first coil and the second coil in a stacking direction of the first coil and the second coil. The first portion extends between the first coil and the second coil along a first direction which is transverse to the stacking direction. The first portion includes second magnetic metal particles having a second diameter that is smaller than the first diameter. A border area where the first portion and a second portion of the body meet includes extending areas where the first portion extends further into the second portion of the body along the first direction than other areas of the first portion in the border area such that the first portion and the second portion mesh with each other.

title: Processing device, network node, client device, and methods thereof
abstract: This disclosure relates to techniques for synchronization signals. The synchronization signal comprise a primary synchronization signal (PSS) generated based on a PSS sequence and a secondary synchronization signal (SSS) generated based on an SSS sequence. The SSS sequence may be generated based on a first sequence corresponding to a first cyclic shift and a second sequence corresponding to a second cyclic shift. The first cyclic shift and the second cyclic shift are associated with a Cell ID. The PSS sequence may be generated based on one of the first and the second sequences.

title: Distributed vehicle route planning
abstract: THE TECHNIQUES DESCRIBED HEREIN RELATE TO CONTROLLING AND/OR INFLUENCING THE ROUTES DRIVEN BY VEHICLES, AUTONOMOUS OR OTHERWISE, SUCH AS VEHICLES IN A FLEET OF VEHICLES MANAGED BY A FLEET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM. IN SOME CASES, THE TECHNIQUES DESCRIBED HEREIN RELATE TO CENTRALLY GENERATING ROAD WEIGHTS USING A REMOTE SYSTEM SUCH AS A FLEET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND PROVIDING THOSE PRE-CALCULATED WEIGHTS TO VEHICLES TO SIMPLIFY ONBOARD ROUTE PLANNING. RATHER THAN TRANSMITTING LARGE AMOUNTS OF RAW TRAFFIC, ROAD CONDITION, AND OTHER DATA TO EACH VEHICLE, THE REMOTE SYSTEM PRE-PROCESSES THE DATA INTO CONDENSED ROAD WEIGHTS OPTIMIZED FOR ROUTE PLANNING. THIS ARCHITECTURE PROVIDES VARIOUS TECHNICAL ADVANTAGES SUCH AS REDUCED DATA TRANSMISSION, DECREASED COMPUTATIONAL LOAD ON VEHICLES, AND DECENTRALIZED CONTROL OF FLEET-WIDE ROUTING.

title: Polymer monitoring device and method using terahertz waves
abstract: A polymer monitoring device using terahertz waves is provided. The polymer monitoring device using terahertz waves may comprise: an emitter which emits terahertz waves toward a polymer thin film coated on a target substrate; a detector which detects terahertz waves emitted from the emitter and reflected from a surface of the target substrate or terahertz waves penetrating the polymer thin film and the target substrate; and a monitoring unit which, during curing of the polymer thin film, acquires thickness and refractive index information of the polymer thin film in real time through the terahertz waves detected by the detector.

title: In-vehicle communication device that processes packets based on acl (access control list) and udf (user defined field)
abstract: An in-vehicle communication device that processes packets based on an Access Control List (ACL) and a User Defined Field (UDF), includes a CPU subsystem configured with a plurality of high-performance cores that are electrically isolated from each other, a communication interface including a plurality of Ethernet communication ports, and an Ethernet Packet Processing Engine (EPP) that performs a routing function between the plurality of Ethernet communication ports. The Ethernet Packet Processing Engine (EPP) performs at least one of security inspection, filtering, forwarding, VLAN tagging, and mirroring of an input packet based on a plurality of ACL entry tables and a plurality of UDF entry tables.

title: Communication device, communication method, and image sensor
abstract: A plurality of signal processing units each of which outputs an output clock signal and output data that is based on input data and synchronized with the output clock signal to a corresponding lane among a plurality of lanes, and a first selection circuit that selects, according to a reference lane selection signal to select a reference lane from the plurality of lanes, an output clock signal corresponding to the reference lane among the output clock signals respectively output from the plurality of signal processing units, and performs an output thereof to each of the plurality of signal processing units are included. Each of the plurality of signal processing units aligns and outputs the output clock signal and the output data on the basis of either a reference clock signal or the output clock signal output from another signal processing unit among the plurality of signal processing units.

title: Exception list compression for logical-to-physical tables
abstract: In some implementations, a memory apparatus may compress a physical page table associated with a logical-to-physical (L 2 P) table, to obtain a compressed version of the physical page table, wherein the physical page table is associated with logical block address (LBA) and physical address pairs, wherein the compressed version is associated with a set of groups of LBAs and an exception list, and wherein the compressed version includes an indication of physical addresses associated with respective starting LBAs included in the set of groups and includes sequentiality indications for respective groups from the set of groups. The memory apparatus may receive, from a host system, a command indicating an LBA that is associated with the physical page table. The memory apparatus may perform a lookup operation using the compressed version of the physical page table to identify a physical address associated with the LBA.

title: Battery module
abstract: A battery module comprising: an exterior case; a battery assembly accommodated in the exterior case; an inflow port provided in an end wall of the exterior case; a fan that is attached to an inner surface of the end wall and blows air suctioned through the inflow port to an inside of the exterior case; an upright wall portion that is disposed between the battery assembly and the fan, and has an opposing surface facing the fan; and a liquid leakage sensor disposed below the opposing surface.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: Powder Supply System
abstract: The powder supply system includes a hopper, a powder supply unit, a pressure adjustment unit, and an on-off valve. The hopper stores powder to be supplied to a film deposition apparatus. The powder supply unit is connected to the hopper, and supplies the powder to the hopper while maintaining a constant pressure difference with respect to the hopper. The pressure adjustment unit that adjusts an internal pressure of the hopper and an internal pressure of the powder supply unit so as to maintain the internal pressure of the hopper and the internal pressure of the powder supply unit constant. The on-off valve is provided on a member that connects the hopper and the powder supply unit.
assignee: Tatsuta Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd.

title: Computer-assisted filling of verification codes from messages
abstract: Techniques involve determining, in response to receiving a request to locate a verification code sent to a user's email account as part of an authentication process for accessing a resource, identifying a message associated with a resource on an email server. Once this message has been identified, a model such as a generative model is used to analyze the message and provide an indication of whether or not the message includes the verification code and, when the message likely includes the verification code, to provide the verification code. In response to determining that the analysis indicates that the message includes the verification code, the verification code is sent to the client device.

title: Process for the acetylation of wood and acetylated wood
abstract: A process for acetylation of wood having a density of above 400 kg/m 3 , particularly, of Southern Yellow Pine, allows the production of acetylated wood having higher acetylation levels, such as an acetyl content of at least 20% by weight. The acetylated wood has also a low residual acetic acid content, in particular, lower than 1% by weight. The invention is particularly useful for acetylation on industrial scale of pieces of solid wood, preferably, of wood beams.

title: Packing seal locking assembly for pumps and associated methods
abstract: A pump including a fluid end having at least one plunger that reciprocates along a plunger bore includes a packing seal received along the plunger bore between the plunger and another component of the fluid end to provide a fluid seal between the plunger and additional component of the fluid end. A locking system, assembly, apparatus is provided to secure the packing seal within the plunger bore, and includes a retainer that can be coupled to the fluid end and an anti-rotation.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes a substrate; a first power supply line extending in a first direction in plan view on a first surface of the substrate; a first semiconductor layer and a second semiconductor layer provided on a second surface of the substrate opposite to the first surface and arranged side by side in the first direction overlapping the first power supply line in plan view; a first through via formed in the substrate and connecting the first power supply line and the second semiconductor layer; a third semiconductor layer formed above the first semiconductor layer; a fourth semiconductor layer formed above the second semiconductor layer; a first gate formed between the first semiconductor layer and the second semiconductor layer and between the third semiconductor layer and the fourth semiconductor layer; and a first transistor having the first semiconductor layer, the second semiconductor layer, and the first gate.

title: Device and method for releasing catheters from cardiac structures
abstract: Devices, systems, and methods for releasing a catheter from an implant may include a catheter comprising first and second elongate elements, first and second elongate element lumens, a tissue anchor lumen, apertures corresponding to each of the lumens, and retaining portions between adjacent apertures. The first elongate element may extend out of its lumen through the first elongate element aperture, across the retaining portion transversely with respect to a longitudinal axis, and towards the second elongate element aperture. The first elongate element may then extend into the second elongate element aperture, loop over the second elongate element, and extend back across the retaining portion and into the first elongate element lumen. In some instances, the second elongate element is retracted to uncouple the first and second elongate elements from each other and to open a channel for the release of tethered tissue anchors.

title: Display apparatus
abstract: A display apparatus includes an optical device, and defining a first area overlapping the optical device and a second area surrounding at least a portion of the first area therein. The display apparatus includes a pixel defining layer defining a first opening and an auxiliary opening arranged in the first area, and a second opening arranged in the second area; a first emission layer arranged in the first opening and which emits light of a first color; a second emission layer arranged in the second opening and which emits light of the first color; and a conductive layer comprising, in a plan view, a first mesh pattern defining a first hole overlapping the first opening and the auxiliary opening, and a second mesh pattern defining a second hole overlapping the second opening.

title: Unified natural language model with segmented and aggregate attention
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for training and using a novel unified language foundation model. An encoder-decoder natural language model is obtained and various training data is obtained and used for training. The training process integrates a combination of replaced token detection, corrupted span reconstruction, and disentangled attention methodologies to produce a unified encoder-decoder model. The trained model is trained for performing both natural language understanding (NLU) tasks and natural language generation (NLG) tasks. Attention applied to the model is applied discretely to segmented chunks of encoded data during processing to improve the efficiency of applying attention by the model.

title: Image editing using delta denoising scores
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for editing images using delta denoising scores.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device includes a panel and a backlight module. The backlight module is arranged below the panel and includes a light guide plate, a first optical element, a second optical element and a third optical element. The first optical element is disposed on the light guide plate and includes a first prism structure and an optical structure, wherein the first prism structure faces the light guide plate, and the optical structure faces the panel. The second optical element is disposed on the first optical element and includes a second prism structure facing the panel, wherein a vertex angle of the second prism structure is greater than or equal to 120 degrees and smaller than or equal to 170 degrees. The third optical element is disposed on the second optical element and includes a third prism structure facing the panel.

title: Real-time broadcasting sponsorship server based on automatic action recognition and operation method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a real-time broadcast sponsorship server and an operation method thereof. The real-time broadcast sponsorship server according to the present invention comprises: a sponsorship management unit that collects deposited donation information and information on a mission given by a viewer of an Internet broadcast to an Internet broadcaster, and when the mission is complete, pays the donation; an action recognition unit that recognizes the action of the broadcaster on the basis of at least one of the video and speech of the broadcaster, and generates an action recognition result; and a mission completion determination unit that compares the action recognition result and the information on the mission to determine whether the mission is complete.

title: Multi-mode up-down shade
abstract: A multi-mode up-down shade includes a roller, a cord fabric, an adjusting rod, a falling element, and a pair of positioning elements. The cord fabric, including at least one light-transmitting and one light-tight section, is wound around the roller with its head end fixed. The adjusting rod, connected to the fabric's tail end, has a slot through which the fabric's middle part is threaded. The falling element, slidably mounted on this part below the rod, folds the fabric into a double-layer structure. The positioning elements slide vertically between limits and can stop anywhere to define a stopping position for the rod. When raised, the falling element abuts and rises with the rod. When lowered, both descend until the positioning elements arrest the rod, after which the falling element continues descending.

title: Movement-history management device, movement-history management method, and recording medium
abstract: A movement-history management device according to the present invention is provided with: a position detection unit for detecting the position of an RFID tag on the basis of a signal received from the RFID tag; a movement detection unit for detecting the movement of the RFID tag on the basis of the history of the position of the RFID tag; and a management unit for associating, as a group of movement histories, the history of the position of the RFID tag for which movement has been detected and the history of the position of another RFID tag for which movement similar to the detected movement of the aforementioned RFID tag has been detected.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and information processing program
abstract: An information processing apparatus extracts, from a first directed acyclic graph in which element information related to an element constituting an optimization problem to be solved corresponds to a node and an order relationship between the elements corresponds to an edge, an execution-required node group including nodes satisfying a condition corresponding to an execution priority of the element, and generates a second directed acyclic graph in which a node group other than the execution-required node group is removed from the first directed acyclic graph, based on the extracted execution-required node group.

title: Methods and apparatuses for ue-server co-inference in wireless system
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods and apparatuses for user equipment (UE)-server co-inference in a wireless system. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a server can include: a transceiver; and a processor coupled to the transceiver and configured to cause the server to: determine a first model configuration for a UE, wherein the first model configuration includes a sparsification scheme, a parameter that reflects a weight of a communication delay in a loss function, or a UE-side model; and transmit, to the UE, information indicating the first model configuration.

title: Assembly for a mechanical reducer of an aircraft
abstract: An assembly, including planet gears and a planet carrier, for a splash-lubricated mechanical reducer, in particular of an aircraft, this assembly having an annular shape about a longitudinal axis, the planet carrier having an annular shape about the axis and comprising-including recesses for receiving the planet gears that are delimited by two lateral partitions, wherein the assembly further includes oil scoops which are rigidly connected to the planet carrier and which are regularly distributed about the axis and positioned between the planet gears, each of these scoops including at least one curved cup, the concavity of which extends partly around one of the planet gears and is separated from this planet gear by one of the partitions.

title: Method and device for supporting uplink scheduling in consideration of transmission delay of tethered device
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting higher data transmission rates. The present disclosure provides a method of a session management function (SMF) entity for supporting uplink scheduling of a terminal using a tethered device, the method comprising the operations of: receiving a protocol data unit (PDU) session-related session management (SM) message including at least one of a tethered device support indicator and tethered device jitter information from an access management function (AMF) entity; and in response to the PDU session-related SM message, transmitting N 2  SM information including at least one of the tethered device support indicator and the tethered device jitter information to an access node (AN) through the AMF entity.

title: Method for secure processing of input data from a plurality of terminals
abstract: A method for secure processing of input data, comprising: obtaining a first data corresponding to an input data padded with a predefined padding block and homomorphically encrypted; for each first data, calculating a plurality of third data corresponding to the sum with a homomorphically encrypted random mask; for each third data, calculating a plurality of fourth data, each corresponding to the result of an attempt at homomorphic decryption of the third data with each decryption key, homomorphically re-encrypted; for each fourth data, calculating at least one fifth data corresponding to the difference with one of the random masks homomorphically re-encrypted; identification of the fifth data comprising a padding block coinciding with said predefined padding block; and application in the encrypted domain of a function corresponding to the desired processing from the fifth identified data.
assignee: Commissariat à l'Energie Atomique et aux Energies Alternatives

title: Self-Training Audiovisual Anomaly Detection and Interoperability System
abstract: The invention pertains to systems and non-transitory computer-readable media for extrinsic monitoring and interoperability assistance of automation systems. An audiovisual capture apparatus, data stores, anomaly manager, logic engine, and alert module cooperate to process nominal operation data, train an unsupervised machine learning model, monitor real-time image, audio, audiovisual, or energy-consumption data, and detect expectation violations. Responsive to an expectation violation, contrastive media retrieved from the data stores is generated and transmitted to an end user. Additional embodiments provide XR-viewable spatial representations, configuration and integration annotations, proxy communication channels between non-integrated systems, and autonomous or user-authorized remedial actions. The disclosed embodiments support visual, audible, audiovisual, energy-monitoring, and system-to-system interoperability workflows for diagnosing automation anomalies.
assignee: University Of Central Florida Research Foundation, Inc.

title: PHENOLIC COMPOUNDS BLOCKING Nav 1.7 AND/OR Nav 1.8, PROCESSES FOR THE PREPARATION THEREOF, COMPOSITIONS, USES, METHODS OF TREATMENT USING SAME AND KITS
abstract: The present invention relates to phenolic compounds blocking Nav 1.7 and/or Nav 1.8. More specifically, the present invention is related to phenols comprising Formula (I), in which the substituents R 1  to R 12  are selected independently of the groups defined in the specification, as well as their processes of preparation, compositions comprising at least one of these compounds, uses, treatment methods for treating or preventing pain-related pathologies and kits. The present invention belongs to the fields of medicinal chemistry, organic synthesis, as well as to the treatment of pain-related diseases.
assignee: Eurofarma Laboratórios S.A.; Universidade Federal Do Rio De Janeiro - Ufrj

title: Norepinephrine compositions and methods therefor
abstract: The inventive subject matter is directed to compositions and methods for ready-to-inject norepinephrine compositions with improved stability. Most preferably, compositions presented herein are substantially antioxidant free and exhibit less than 10% isomerization of R-norepinephrine and exhibit less than 5% degradation of total norepinephrine.

title: Acoustic wave device with tilted interdigital transducer electrode
abstract: Acoustic wave device is disclosed. the acoustic wave device can include a piezoelectric layer and an interdigital transducer electrode over the piezoelectric layer. The interdigital transducer electrode has a non-zero tilt angle. The non-zero tilt angle can between 5° to 15°. A thickness of the interdigital transducer electrode is at least 40% of a thickness of the piezoelectric layer, 400 nm , or 0.08λ where λ is the wavelength generated by the acoustic wave device.

title: Methods and Systems for Extracting Sport-Related Information from Digital Video Frames
abstract: A computing system automatically extracting, from a digital video frame, scoreboard information including a first team name, a second team name, a first score, and a second score. The computing system (a) detects, within the digital video frame, a plurality of frame regions based on each detected frame region depicting text; (b) selects, from the detected frame regions, a set of frame regions based on the frame regions of the selected set cooperatively having a geometric arrangement that corresponds with a candidate geometric arrangement of the scoreboard information; (c) recognizes characters respectively within each of the frame regions of the selected set of frame regions; (d) based at least on the recognized characters in the frame regions of the selected set, detects the scoreboard information; and (e) records the detected scoreboard information.

title: Perovskite light-emitting device and its manufacturing method
abstract: A perovskite light-emitting device includes an anode, a perovskite light-emitting layer formed on the anode, and a cathode formed on the perovskite light-emitting layer, wherein the perovskite light-emitting layer comprises perovskite particles in which a portion of A-site is doped with a Cs dopant. A method of manufacturing the perovskite light-emitting device is also provided.

title: Delta based task analysis for ci systems
abstract: Systems and methods for a delta based task analysis in CI systems are disclosed. The systems and methods analyze a first job, which includes multiple first tasks, and a second job, which includes multiple second tasks. The systems and methods identify a set of different tasks between the first tasks and the second tasks. The systems and methods then create a third job based on the set of different tasks, which includes metadata corresponding to the first job and the second job. The systems and method execute the first job and the third job, which completes the second job based on the metadata included in the third job.

title: Vehicle driving assist apparatus
abstract: The vehicle driving assist apparatus can execute at least one of an acceleration/deceleration control as a driving assist control to automatically accelerate and decelerate an own vehicle and a steering control as the driving assist control to automatically steer the own vehicle. The vehicle driving assist apparatus includes a driving assist restart switch operated by a driver of the own vehicle to restart the driving assist control. The vehicle driving assist apparatus does not restart the acceleration/deceleration control even when the driving assist restart switch is operated after stopping the acceleration/deceleration control in response to the driver performing an automatic acceleration/deceleration rejection operation. The vehicle driving assist apparatus does not restart the steering control even when the driving assist restart switch is operated after stopping the steering control in response to the driver performing an automatic steering rejection operation.

title: Systems and methods of communicating through visual overlay for surgical medical systems
abstract: A surgical system can include a master controller for controlling one or more surgical tools. The system can also include an input on the master controller configured to change the master controller from a first mode into a second mode. The first mode can be a teleoperation mode and the second mode can be a virtual marking mode. In the virtual marking mode, a user is capable of communicating a virtual marker to other staff.

title: Method for receiving downlink signal and channel in wireless communication system, and device therefor
abstract: A method, performed by a terminal, for receiving a downlink signal and channel in a wireless communication system comprises the steps of: receiving a synchronization signals and PBCH block (SSB) from a base station; and transmitting an uplink channel to the base station on the basis of the SSB.
assignee: Wilus Institute Of Standards And Technology Inc.

title: Detection of analytes in cells and tissues
abstract: Disclosed herein, inter alia, are compositions and methods for improved multiplexed detection of biomolecules in cells and tissues.

title: System for performing cloud migration assessment
abstract: A system for performing cloud migration assessment includes a communication unit for communicating with a user terminal device, a storage device storing a pre-migration questionnaire, and a processor that is connected to the communication unit and the storage device, and that communicates with the user terminal device via the communication unit. The processor provides the user terminal device with the pre-migration questionnaire for a user of the user terminal device to respond to the pre-migration questionnaire with response data, generates a pre-migration assessment report based on the response data, generates an evaluation table based on the response data and the pre-migration assessment report, and generates a data-visualization dashboard based on the response data, the pre-migration assessment report and the evaluation table.

title: Foldable trailer with a locking system
abstract: A foldable trailer design with an incorporated locking system for enhanced portability and storage efficiency. The trailer features a primary frame with a platform and a secondary frame with a platform, where the secondary frame is hinged to fold onto the primary frame. A locking support structure secures the trailer in its folded position and provides support when the trailer is upright. Two embodiments of the locking support structure utilize pins or other mechanisms to lock/unlock the secondary frame. The design may incorporate caster wheels for maneuverability when folded and features like wheel chocks for securing transported vehicles. The disclosed foldable trailer offers a practical solution for space-saving storage and convenient transportation of various cargo.

title: Fluid couplings with in-line flow valve
abstract: Some fluid couplings, as described in this document, have an actuatable valve. In some examples, the actuatable valves provide an unobstructed flow path when switched to the “open” position and a closed flow path when switched to the “closed” position.

title: Image encoding method/device, image decoding method/device, and recording medium in which bitstream is stored
abstract: The present invention provides an image encoding method and an image decoding method. The image encoding method of the present invention comprises: a first dividing step of dividing a current image into a plurality of blocks; and a second dividing step of dividing, into a plurality of sub blocks, a block, which is to be divided and includes a boundary of the current image, among the plurality of blocks, wherein the second dividing step is recursively performed by setting a sub block including the boundary of the current images as the block to be divided, until the sub block including the boundary of the current image does not exist among the sub blocks.
assignee: Industry Academy Cooperation Foundation Of Sejong University

title: Autonomous artificial intelligence (ai) agent control of multitier ai inference disaggregation
abstract: A distributed artificial-intelligence inference system includes a master autonomous AI agent configured to control disaggregation of inference across multiple execution tiers. An input is received at an edge tier, and the master autonomous AI agent generates a plurality of candidate plans or branch continuations and instantiates corresponding sub-agents. The system identifies a shared inherited state common to multiple branches and branch-specific state corresponding to suffix portions after divergence. A promotion policy selects a promoted subset of branches for continuation at a data-center tier while maintaining a non-promoted subset at the edge tier. The promotion policy may evaluate branch score, local resource cost, transfer efficiency of shared-prefix state, model compatibility between source-tier and destination-tier models, branch type, network condition, and quality-related factors. A promotion package is generated including a shared-prefix reusable inference-state portion and separate branch-specific suffix portions for respective promoted branches. The data-center tier continues execution of the promoted subset using the promotion package. In some embodiments, the data-center tier further disaggregates inference among compute-dense, memory-centric, and persistence-oriented clusters. In some embodiments, an inference processor reconfigures an on-chip memory array between scratchpad mode and cache mode according to neural-network layer type.

title: Automated systems for removing tissue samples from seeds, and related methods
abstract: A seed sampling system includes an automated seed loading assembly, having a seed bin configured to singulate seeds from a plurality of seeds within the seed bin, a diverter configured to receive the singulated seeds from the seed bin, multiple elevator units, and multiple transport tubes extending between the diverter and the elevator units for delivering the singulated seeds from the seed bin to the elevator units. In addition, the diverter is configured to rotate relative to the transport tubes to deliver individual ones of the singulated seeds to select ones of the transport tubes. The system also includes an automated seed transport assembly including multiple retention members configured to receive the singulated seeds from the elevator units, and an automated seed sampling assembly configured to receive the singulated seeds from the retention members of the seed transport assembly and remove tissue from the singulated seeds.

title: Method Of Cleaning Liquid Ejection Head And Liquid Ejection Apparatus
abstract: A method of cleaning a liquid ejection head include filling an inside of a cap disposed to face an ejection surface of a nozzle plate with the liquid by driving a first piezoelectric element stacked on a diaphragm constituting a part of a pressure chamber communicating with a plurality of nozzle to eject the liquid from the nozzle, introducing air into the nozzle by driving the first piezoelectric element with a second drive signal different from the first drive signal after the filling, bringing the ejection surface into contact with the liquid in the cap after the filling, transmitting an ultrasonic wave to the liquid in the cap by driving a second piezoelectric element provided to the cap with a third drive signal after the introducing, and sucking the liquid in the cap by driving a suction pump configured to suck the liquid in the cap after the bringing.

title: Techniques for categorizing and delivering queries to an artificially-intelligent agent about a user group using customized semantic index bundles
abstract: An example method includes obtaining a textual prompt at a user interface associated with a productivity application. The method includes identifying a query based on content of the textual prompt. The method includes, based on analyzing the query, determining whether the query is a detail-seeking query, requesting data currently available within multiple data sources associated with the productivity application, or a panoptic query requesting another set of data that is not currently available within the productivity application and requires aggregation of multiple data sources. The method includes, based on a first determination that the query is the detail-seeking query, providing the set of data to a large-language model. The method includes identifying another query within the textual prompt. The method includes, when a second determination that the other query is the panoptic query, providing data from the multiple data sources to another LLM to perform an analytical function.

title: Associating key-value pair sets with leaf nodes
abstract: In some implementations, a memory device may identify a key-value pair set associated with a root node, wherein the key-value pair set includes a plurality of key-value pairs, and wherein the root node is associated with a log-structured merge-tree. The memory device may determine that a plurality of keys in the key-value pair set are associated with a leaf node based on the plurality of keys corresponding to an edge key associated with the leaf node, wherein the leaf node is associated with the log-structured merge-tree. The memory device may associate the key-value pair set with the leaf node based on a metadata update of the key-value pair set, wherein the key-value pair set becomes decoupled from the root node.

title: Systems and Methods for Incorporating into a Treatment Plan to Optimize the User's Recovery Via the Use of AI-Driven Interventions Associated with Reinforcement Learning that Rely on Evidence-Based Experiments
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media for generating and managing personalized treatment plans using artificial intelligence. The method includes receiving data associated with a plurality of users having a similar medical condition and, based on the data, generating at least two treatment plans using a machine learning engine. Each treatment plan includes user-specific instructions and controls operation of an associated electromechanical rehabilitation device. The system receives subsequent user data to retrain one or more computer-implemented models using reinforcement learning and dynamically modifies the treatment plans in response to user progress. When subsequent data satisfies an emergency threshold, the system performs preventative actions, including halting device operation. The disclosed system enables adaptive and autonomous treatment plan optimization to improve rehabilitation outcomes, user safety, and long-term compliance through real-time machine learning analysis and individualized device control.

title: Devices, systems, and methods for validating drilling equipment
abstract: A validation engine may receive first drilling equipment properties for a first plurality of drilling equipment used in a section of a wellbore. A validation engine may, based on the first drilling equipment properties, identifying first wellbore properties for the section of the wellbore. A validation engine may receive second drilling equipment properties for a second plurality of drilling equipment used in the section of the wellbore. A validation engine may validate that the second plurality of drilling equipment is usable in the section of the wellbore based at least in part on a comparison between the second drilling equipment properties and the first wellbore properties.

title: String management of an instrument to prepare and safely place an intra-uterine device
abstract: An instrument ( 10 ) to prepare and safely place an intra-uterine device ( 30 ) in uterus ( 50 ) of a woman, comprising a dynamic stopper ( 20 ), a string management arrangement ( 110 ) whereby a string ( 31 ) of an IUD ( 30 ) is in one of a locked condition or an unlocked condition, wherein the dynamic stopper ( 20 ) slidably resides in the base ( 70 ) and can slide by the sliding length ( 23 ), the string ( 31 ) of the IUD ( 30 ) provided with an obstruction means ( 31 A), a graduated tube ( 16 ) engulfs arms ( 34 ) of the IUD ( 30 ) till an inner edge ( 11 A) of the graduated tube ( 16 ) obstructs and stops dome shaped ends ( 36 ) of the arms ( 34 ) at a position when the inner chamfer ( 11 B) constrains the faces ( 36 A) to butt mutually against each other.

title: Electrode Cell and Method for Manufacturing the Same
abstract: An electrode assembly including a first electrode having a first body portion coated with a first electrode active material and a first tab portion extending outward from an edge of the first body portion; a second electrode including a second body portion stacked on one surface of the first body portion and coated with a second electrode active material, and an uncoated portion provided on an edge of the second body portion and overlapping the edge of the first body portion; and a separator interposed between the first electrode and the second electrode is provided. The first electrode may further include an extension portion provided on the edge of the first body portion and protruding outward from the uncoated portion.

title: Furniture
abstract: A furniture piece includes a first panel assembly, a second panel assembly, a third panel assembly, and a connecting assembly. The first and third panel assemblies are arranged opposite to each other, with the second panel assembly positioned therebetween. The first panel assembly includes a first joining surface. The second panel assembly includes a second joining surface and an opposite third joining surface. The third panel assembly includes a fourth joining surface. The first and second joining surfaces are in contact, and the third and fourth joining surfaces are in contact. The connecting assembly includes a connecting rod and a mating member. The connecting rod has a head and an opposite connecting end extending through the fourth, third, and second joining surfaces into the third panel assembly. The mating member is embedded in the first joining surface and engages the connecting end, while the head abuts the third panel assembly.

title: Chlorosulfonated polyolefin latex
abstract:
Provided is a means for producing a dip-molded article comprising a chlorosulfonated polyolefin without using sodium alginate or the like. 
     More specifically, provided is a chlorosulfonated polyolefin latex comprising:
         (A) a chlorosulfonated polyolefin;   (B) a surfactant having an anionic moiety and a nonionic moiety, the nonionic moiety containing a polyoxyalkylene chain, and the anionic moiety containing a carboxylic acid salt, a sulfonic acid salt, a carbonic acid ester salt, a sulfuric acid ester salt, or a phosphoric acid ester salt;   (C) at least one surfactant selected from the group consisting of an amino acid-based surfactant, an alkyl aryl sulfonic acid-based surfactant, an alkyl sulfuric acid-based surfactant, and a sulfosuccinic acid-based surfactant; and   (D) an aqueous dispersion medium.

title: Aluminum hydrocarbon coated pins plate
