abstract: A method of compliance testing comprising receiving, a request to check compliance of a content collection package comprising a plurality of content items and a compliance ruleset, transmitting an instruction to classify the plurality of content items based on a classification ruleset, iteratively processing, the plurality of content items by identifying, a type of the given content item, a content item field set comprising each field on the given content item, and a content item field attribute set for each field in the field set, and accessing, from a structure profile database, a structure profile field set and a structure profile field attribute set for each field in the structure profile field set; iteratively processing each field in the structure profile field set for generating a compliance audit package and a compliance determination dataset models, and displaying an output on a user interface based on the compliance determination dataset.

title: Electrostatic chuck device
abstract: Provided is an electrostatic chuck device including: an electrostatic chuck plate including a dielectric substrate having a placement surface on which a sample is mounted, and an adsorption electrode located inside the dielectric substrate; and a base that supports the electrostatic chuck plate from a side opposite to the placement surface, in which the electrostatic chuck plate has a gas hole passing through the electrostatic chuck plate in a thickness direction of the electrostatic chuck plate, a gas hole member allowing a gas to pass is provided in the gas hole, and volume resistivity of a material of the gas hole member is 1.0×10 3  Ω·cm or more and 1.0×10 10  Ω·cm or less.

title: Image processing apparatus, image processing method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
abstract: There is provided with an image processing apparatus for performing class classification of an image. A generation unit generates, for each class, a feature of an image group belonging to the class based on classification information for classifying each of a plurality of images to one of a plurality of classes in accordance with an object contained in an image. A determination unit determines, using the feature of each class, a possibility that the image group belonging to the class includes an image containing another object different from the object corresponding to the class.

title: Substrate Processing Apparatus and Method of Operating Substrate Processing Apparatus
abstract: There is a substrate processing apparatus includes a processing module, a transfer module, and a controller. The processing module includes a placing table on which a substrate is placed, and a processing chamber that accommodates the placing table. The processing module is configured to perform processing on the substrate placed on the placing table. The transfer module includes a transfer mechanism configured to transfer the substrate onto the placing table. The controller controls the transfer mechanism to place a cover member on the placing table when an idle time period, during which processing on the substrate is not performed in the processing module, exceeds a first time period.

title: Pneumatic support structure for flexible display devices
abstract: According to an embodiment, it is a hinge structure, comprising a pneumatically actuated structural layer configurable between a compliant state and a rigid state; an elastic metallic backbone layer coupled to the pneumatically actuated structural layer, wherein the elastic metallic backbone layer comprises an amorphous material; wherein pressurization of the pneumatically actuated structural layer by an internal pressure increases an effective bending stiffness of the hinge structure by at least an order of magnitude relative to an unpressurized state; and wherein the hinge structure is part of a foldable electronic device.

title: Ultrasound probe, ultrasonic endoscope, and ultrasound diagnostic system
abstract:
Provided is an ultrasound probe that can suppress deterioration of a piezoelectric element caused by a gas used for sterilization. 
     An ultrasound probe includes: a support member that includes an outer peripheral surface having a cylindrical shape; a plurality of piezoelectric elements arranged on the outer peripheral surface in a circumferential direction of the outer peripheral surface; an acoustic lens that is disposed outside the plurality of piezoelectric elements in a radial direction of the outer peripheral surface and that covers the plurality of piezoelectric elements; and a gas barrier layer that is disposed between the plurality of piezoelectric elements and the acoustic lens, in which a permeation rate of a hydrogen peroxide gas or an ethylene oxide gas in the gas barrier layer is lower than a permeation rate of the hydrogen peroxide gas or the ethylene oxide gas in the acoustic lens, and, in the radial direction, the gas barrier layer is thinner than the acoustic lens.

title: Skid plate
abstract: A skid plate for a robotic lawnmower includes an approximately circular plate with a central opening, for a hub, and means of attachment. The skid plate is attachable to the robotic lawnmower. An edge portion of the circular plate is bent to extend transversally to a main plane of the circular plate. An outer peripheral edge thereof extends in a single plane. A robotic lawn mower includes an electric motor connected to a rotatable cutting head. The cutting head is connected to a cutting disk with at least one knife at its periphery. A skid plate as above is arranged below the cutting disk.

title: Multi-objective ultraviolet radiation exposure management system
abstract: An apparatus, system, and method for dynamically managing UV radiation exposure using multi-objective threshold determination, dual-output dose calculation, and biomarker-calibrated benefit tracking are disclosed. The system includes a wearable UV sensor assembly, a processor, and storage media. A dynamic user model is configured to maintain a continuous fractional photosensitivity score derived from weighted inputs and updateable over time. An effective UV exposure value is processed through a first calculation pathway applying an erythemal action spectrum to produce a burn-prevention output and a second calculation pathway applying a synthesis efficacy curve to produce a Vitamin D synthesis output simultaneously. A multi-objective evaluator module is configured to compare both outputs against exposure-related thresholds including a risk threshold associated with erythemal damage and a synthesis target calibrated based on serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D level. A conflict detector module is configured to identify threshold inconsistencies, and an optimization logic module is configured to resolve conflict. The system integrates clinician-prescribed parameters, escalating notifications, activity-adaptive body mapping, angular correction, and longitudinal synthesis tracking.

title: A/d converter fault detection device, power supply device comprising same, and a/d converter fault detection method
abstract: An A/D converter-failure detection device includes a second IC including a second A/D converter configured to converts a second analog value of a reference signal detected at a second reference terminal into a second digital signal at a second resolution, with the second analog value being acquired, and a second communication terminal connected to a first communication terminal and configured to communicate with the first communication terminal. A first IC configured to transmit a first digital signal from the first communication terminal to the second communication terminal. A first A/D converter configured to A/D-convert a first analog value of the reference signal detected by a first reference terminal into the first digital signal. The second IC is configured to compare the second digital signal with the first digital signal received at the second communication terminal to obtain a difference between the signals. The second digital signal is obtained by A/D-converting the second analog value of the reference signal detected by the second reference terminal at the second resolution by the second A/D converter. The second IC is configured to determine an occurrence of a failure when the difference exceeds a predetermined reference value.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: Crane assembly for a forestry vehicle
abstract: The disclosed system for a work vehicle is adapted to realize a movement of a boom assembly during a feed process of the work vehicle. The vehicle comprises a boom assembly having a slewing device, a boom tip having a rotator and an extension boom. The boom assembly is adapted to rotate a connected working device around a vertical axis, wherein the working device is a harvester tool. The system controlling the boom assembly comprises movement of the stem through the harvester tool during feeding over the ground and is at least partly compensated by movement of the boom tip, wherein the movement is in a direction of a longitudinal axis of the stem.

title: Optical sensor cover and optical sensor
abstract:
An optical sensor cover comprises an optically-transparent substrate and a linear heating element provided in the substrate. The heating element comprises a plurality of wiring segments arranged in an in-plane direction of the substrate and partitioned by a plurality of imaginary square lattice cells each having one side of 10 mm. The plurality of wiring segments include a first and a second wiring segment. The first wiring segment is a wiring segment including a position where a distance from an edge of the substrate is ≤20 mm. 
     The second wiring segment is a wiring segment including no position where a distance from the edge is ≤20 mm, or, if none exists, a wiring segment including a position farthest from the edge. L′n/Ln and L′m/Lm are lower than 1.2. Rn/Ln of 50% or more of all first wiring segments is lower than Rm/Lm of the second wiring segment.

title: Global functional module, semiconductor device comprising the same, and method for fabricating the same
abstract: The present application discloses a global functional module, a semiconductor device including the global functional module, and a method for fabricating the semiconductor device with the global functional module. The global functional module includes a plurality of first-type interface sub-modules and at least two second-type sub-modules and at least two second-type sub-modules communicated with the plurality of first-type interface sub-modules.

title: Separation of fission products in a molten salt reactor via adsorbent frameworks
abstract: An extraction system includes an absorbent framework configured to withstand the harsh environment of a molten salt reactor system and capture fission products found in the molten salt of such systems. The extraction system further includes means for removing the absorbent framework from the flow of molten salt, such that the absorbent framework may be processed to harvest the fission products. The absorbent framework may include a temperature resistant cartridge configured to house an absorbent composition. The present invention contemplates multiple absorbent compositions including metal-organic frameworks with unique structures to provide thermal stability, carbon nanotubes, and absorbent microspheres. The metal-organic frameworks may be synthesized by a variety of techniques to impart particular characteristics advantageous for use in a molten salt reactor system.

title: Separation membrane
abstract: The present invention provides a new separation membrane suitable for a membrane separation device (particularly a spiral membrane element). The separation membrane includes: a separation functional layer; a porous support member supporting the separation functional layer; and an intermediate layer disposed between the separation functional layer and the porous support member. The porous support member has a surface facing the intermediate layer. A load area ratio Smr(c 1 ) of the surface determined by a test below is less than 80%. Test: The surface of the porous support member is subjected to a three-dimensional analysis to obtain a load curve prescribed in JIS B0681-2:2018. On the load curve, a height c 1  whose difference from a height co at a load area ratio of 0% is equal to a thickness of the intermediate layer is determined. A load area ratio corresponding to the height c 1  is read and determined as Smr(c 1 ).

title: Device and method for diffusing volatile substances
abstract: The device for diffusing volatile substances comprises a container ( 1 ) containing a liquid with volatile substances, a wick ( 2 ) partially housed in the container ( 1 ), which is impregnated with the liquid with volatile substances contained in the container ( 1 ); and a heater ( 3 ), which heats the wick ( 2 ) to promote diffusion of the volatile substances, the heater ( 3 ) comprising a plurality of heating elements ( 31 ) arranged around the wick ( 2 ). It provides a device and a method for diffusing volatile substances, whereby the user perceives the fragrance from a short period of time after switching on the device, due to the low thermal inertia of the heater.

title: Cross-scale neutronic-thermal-material coupling simulation method for pressurized water reactor corrosion-related unidentified deposits (crud)
abstract: A pressurized water reactor oxidation corrosion product cross-scale neutronic-thermal-material coupling simulation method comprises the following steps: in the first stage, obtaining a supercooled boiling position through mutual loop iteration simulation of a neutronics model and a thermal hydraulic model; and in the second stage, multiphysics field coupling simulation is carried out through an oxidation corrosion product (CRUD) model, a neutronics model and a thermal hydraulic model, and high-resolution simulation under the pressurized water reactor neutronic-thermal-material coupling condition is obtained. According to the method, a scene in which the thickness range of the oxidation corrosion product is 20-200 microns is considered, multiphysical fields such as pressurized water reactor neutron physics, flow heat transfer and oxidation corrosion product deposition are calculated and analyzed, and the complex physical process can be captured more accurately.

title: Stable liquid bortezomib formulations
abstract: Described herein are liquid pharmaceutical compositions comprising bortezomib, a polyol comprising mannitol, and an aqueous carrier, wherein the compositions are suitable for intravenous or subcutaneous administration. In certain embodiments, the compositions are substantially free of organic solvents and comprise controlled levels of impurities, including not more than 1.0% of each of Impurity E, Impurity L, Impurity J, Impurity F, Impurity I, and Impurity U, and not more than 3.0% total impurities. The compositions are prepared under controlled process conditions, including control of temperature, dissolved oxygen, and headspace oxygen, to reduce impurity formation and improve stability during storage. In certain embodiments, the compositions exhibit extended stability under refrigerated conditions. The disclosure further relates to methods of preparing such compositions and to dosage configurations aligned with clinically administered doses to improve dose matching and reduce residual drug following administration.

title: Apparatus and method of manufacturing electrode
abstract: An apparatus for manufacturing an electrode including a coated portion and a non-coated portion, includes a heater heating the non-coated portion by irradiating a laser, and a rolling roller rolling the coated portion by pressing the coated portion. In a width direction of the electrode, the non-coated portion includes an inner region disposed adjacently to the coated portion and an outer region located farther from the coated portion than the inner region, the heater irradiates the outer region and the inner region with lasers having different average powers, and an average power per unit length of the laser irradiated to the outer region by the heater has a value greater than an average power per unit length of the laser irradiated to the inner region.

title: Systems and methods to curate notifications from unsubscribed social media accounts
abstract: Methods and systems for curating notifications from unfollowed accounts are described herein. The system tracks that a first account previously followed a second account and subsequently unfollowed the second account. The system identifies an interest of the first account and monitors the activities of the second account for activity that matches the interest. If there is a match between the interest and an activity of the second account, the system notifies the first account of the activity. These methods and systems provide the user with relevant information from unfollowed accounts.

title: Heterogeneous thermal inertia architectures for controlled enclosures
abstract: A portable temperature-controlled storage system comprises a multi-component layered thermal management assembly integrating specialized components for thermal performance. The system includes an aluminum payload chamber with thermally conductive walls configured to receive temperature-sensitive materials. An aluminum grill structure in thermal communication with tetradecane TCM absorbs thermal energy during active cooling cycles through phase transition and releases stored energy during passive maintenance cycles. At least one copper thermal conductor block facilitates heat transfer between the aluminum grill structure and the aluminum payload chamber, functioning as a metallic thermal buffer TCM. Gasket layers disposed at component interfaces provide thermal isolation, sealing, and accommodation of thermal expansion. A thermoelectric device thermally coupled to the aluminum payload chamber actively transfers thermal energy without mechanical compressors. The aluminum grill structure, copper thermal conductor block, and aluminum payload chamber operate as distinct TCM types serving complementary functions. An outer housing with top-loading access configuration and integrated handles encapsulates the assembly for manual transport.

title: Augmented reality virtual reality ray tracing sensory enhancement system, apparatus and method
abstract: Systems, apparatuses and methods may provide away to render augmented reality (AR) and/or virtual reality (VR) sensory enhancements using ray tracing. More particularly, systems, apparatuses and methods may provide a way to normalize environment information captured by multiple capture devices, and calculate, for an observer, the sound sources or sensed events vector paths. The systems, apparatuses and methods may detect and/or manage one or more capture devices and assign one or more the capture devices based on one or more conditions to provide observer an immersive VR/AR experience.

title: Method and apparatus for monitoring wireless link in wireless communication system
abstract: A method and an apparatus for monitoring a wireless link in a wireless communication system are disclosed. A method performed by means of a UE in the wireless communication system, according to one embodiment of the present disclosure, may comprise the steps of: receiving first configuration information and second configuration information from a base station, the first configuration information including information related to cell DTX, and the second configuration information including information about one or more RLM RSs; and monitoring wireless link quality for the one or more RLM RSs.

title: Methods and systems for selectively activating led groups
abstract: Systems, apparatus and methods for selectively activating and/or deactivating one or more groups of light-emitting diodes (LEDs) of a luminaire. In an embodiment, a multi-LED luminaire includes a detection and control circuit, a first light emitting diode (LED) Group, a second LED Group connected in series to the first LED Group, and a first switch operably connected across the second LED Group. The detection and control circuit detects either a power sequence or a dimming sequence and, in response to detection of the power sequence or to the dimming sequence, operates to close the first switch to short-out the second LED Group such that no light is emitted from the second LED Group, operate to open the first switch to power the second LED Group to emit light along with the first LED Group, or operate the switch in a manner to alter the light output of at least one of the first LED Group and the second LED Group.

title: Interface Display Method and Apparatus, Device, and Storage Medium
abstract: An interface display method and apparatus, a device, and a storage medium, relating to the field of computer technologies is provided. The method and apparatus provide for displaying a virtual environment, where the virtual environment including a virtual shooting prop) and detecting interaction with the virtual shooting prop. In response to detecting the operation on the virtual shooting prop, the method and apparatus provide for controlling the virtual shooting prop to release at least one projectile into the virtual environment. When a first projectile among the at least one projectile collides with a virtual item in the virtual environment, and the virtual item satisfies a ricochet condition, a ricochet effect of the first projectile on the virtual item is generated and displayed. The ricochet condition may be a condition for generating the ricochet effect. The foregoing approach enriches forms of human-computer interaction.

title: Apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium and article of aerosolizable medium
abstract: An apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium, the apparatus including a housing; and a chamber for receiving an article. The article includes an aerosolizable medium; and a marker arrangement including a first marker and a second marker. The apparatus includes a sensor arrangement configured to operate in a first mode and a second mode. In the first mode the sensor arrangement monitors non-continuously for the presence of the first marker. In the second mode the sensor arrangement is configured to read identification information from the second marker. The sensor arrangement operates in the second mode responsive to the detection of the presence of the first marker in the first mode.

title: Semiconductor package
abstract: A semiconductor package may include a first logic chip, and a second logic chip overlapping with the first logic chip. The first logic chip may include a first lower channel structure, a first lower source/drain pattern connected to the first lower channel structure, a first upper channel structure overlapping with the first lower channel structure, and a first upper source/drain pattern connected to the first upper channel structure. The second logic chip may include a second lower channel structure, a second lower source/drain pattern connected to the second lower channel structure, a second upper channel structure overlapping with the second lower channel structure, and a second upper source/drain pattern connected to the second upper channel structure.

title: Multi-mode laser measurement device and laser distance measurement method
abstract: Provided is a multi-mode laser measurement device. A first emitter in the laser measurement assembly is configured to emit a first emitted laser beam having a first wavelength to a target object, where the first emitted laser beam is reflected by the target object into a first reflected laser beam. A second emitter is configured to emit a second emitted laser beam having a second wavelength to the target object, where the second emitted laser beam is reflected by the target object into a second reflected laser beam which is different from the first wavelength. A receiving module is configured to receive a reflected laser beam, where the reflected laser beam includes the first reflected laser beam and/or the second reflected laser beam. A photosensitive element in the receiving module can detect laser light of the first wavelength and the second wavelength during operation.

title: Method and apparatus of syntax design for cross-component models in video coding system
abstract: A method and apparatus for video coding are disclosed. According to this method, for a current second-colour block is coded in a cross-component Liner Model (LM)-related mode, a most probable LM mode list comprising one or more most probable LM candidates selected from a candidate list is generated. Mode-selection information associated with the most probable LM mode list is signalled or parsed. The current second-colour block is encoded or decoded by using a target candidate selected from the most probable LM mode list according to the mode-selection information, wherein prediction data for the current second-colour block is generated by applying current linear model associated with the target candidate to the current first-colour block.

title: User plane interruption time monitoring
abstract: A method comprising: creating, for transmission, a radio resource control reconfiguration (RRCReconfiguration) message for a user equipment (UE), wherein the RRCReconfiguration message comprises a configuration for monitoring, at the UE, user plane interruption time relating to a primary secondary cell (PSCell) change during a dual connectivity session, wherein the configuration comprises an at least one indication of which one or more of a plurality of options one or more parameters for monitoring user plane interruption time associated with a dual connectivity split bearer are to be used, at the UE, for monitoring user plane interruption time associated with the a dual connectivity split bearer.

title: Accessory apparatus and electronic device
abstract: An accessory apparatus includes a body, a first support plate, a second support plate, and a third support plate. The first support plate includes a first plate edge and a second plate edge that are disposed opposite to each other, the second support plate includes a third plate edge and a fourth plate edge that are disposed opposite to each other, the first plate edge is rotatably connected to the third plate edge, the second plate edge is rotatably connected to an end portion of the body, the fourth plate edge is rotatably connected to the third support plate, and the third support plate may be configured to be detachably connected to a host of the electronic device.

title: Laundry detergent article
abstract: The present disclosure provides cleaning articles. The articles can be formed of a detergent composition and a film former, and a foam stabilizer. The detergent composition can comprise at least one surfactant. The cleaning article can be configured as a substantially solid foam structure that is soluble in aqueous liquid and substantially non-flowing at a temperature of about 80° C. or less when out of contact with the aqueous liquid. The surfactant can include a relatively high concentration of non-ionic surfactants that do not lessen the integrity of the cleaning article. The surfactants can particularly comprise C 16  or greater non-ionic surfactants, such as C 16  or greater alcohol ethoxylates.

title: Organic compound and organic electroluminescent device using same
abstract: The present invention relates to: a novel compound having excellent carrier transport ability, light-emitting ability, and thermal stability; and an organic electroluminescent device comprising the novel compound in one or more organic layers and thus having improved properties of luminous efficiency, driving voltage, lifespan, etc.

title: Automatic deployment of a multi-region cloud fleet
abstract: Methods, apparatuses, and products for automatic deployment of a multi-region cloud fleet, including: receiving a request to generate a cloud fleet in a cloud computing environment, wherein the request comprises: data indicating a plurality of selectable regions for the cloud fleet and a resource allocation indicating an amount of computational resources to be allocated for the cloud fleet; determining, based at least on a capacity of the plurality of selectable regions, a cloud computing instance distribution across at least one region of the plurality of selectable regions and satisfying the resource allocation, wherein the cloud computing instance distribution describes, for each region of the at least one region, a corresponding group of cloud computing instances to be created for the cloud fleet; and creating, in each region of the at least one region, the corresponding group of cloud computing instances described in the cloud computing instance distribution.

title: Deformation Bonded and Hermetically Sealed Vacuum MEMS Cells with Stopping Layer
abstract: A micro-vacuum cell comprising at least one vacuum enclosure with a lid of a first material and a base of a second material, the first and second material having a different coefficients of thermal expansion, where the vacuum enclosure is formed above a portion of the base; a cold weld compression seal attaches the lid to the base along a periphery of said portion of the base; wherein the cold weld compression seal comprises a peripheral knife-edge wall with a foot being attached to one of the lid and the base and a tip that penetrates seal layer arranged on the other of the lid and the base; and a stop structure, shorter than the knife edge wall, with a foot attached to the same surface as the knife-edge wall and a tip that forms a compression bond with the seal layer.

title: Sound conversion device
abstract: A sound conversion device includes a sound acquisition circuit that acquires the operation sound including abnormal sound as a sound pressure time signal that is a signal indicating a change in sound pressure intensity over time, a signal conversion circuit that converts a signal corresponding to the sound pressure time signal into a frequency characteristic indicating an intensity of sound pressure for each frequency including a human inaudible frequency band, obtains audible signal in which the frequency of the abnormal sound signal indicating the intensity of the sound pressure of the abnormal sound in the inaudible frequency band is changed to a human audible frequency band in the signal corresponding to the frequency characteristic, and output the audible signal as an audible sound signal that is a signal indicating a change in sound pressure intensity over time, and a speaker that generates sound based on the audible sound signal.

title: Auto segmentation of thalamic nuclei using track density images
abstract: A computer-implemented method for training an artificial intelligence model for segmenting a thalamic nucleus in a radiology image, comprises: obtaining a plurality of radiology images including a representation of thalamic nuclei; preprocessing the plurality of radiology images, wherein the preprocessing includes generating a plurality of track density images based on the plurality of radiology images; and training the artificial intelligence model based on at least a first portion of the plurality of track density images.

title: Dhnt monomers and polymer dyes with modified photophysical properties
abstract: The present disclosure relates to dihydronaphthothiophene (DHNT), dihydrobenzo dithiophene (DHBDT), and dihydronapthothienothiophene (DHNTT) monomer units and fluorescent polymers and co-polymers thereof. DHNT, DHNTT, and/or DHBDT containing water-soluble fluorescent co-polymers, water-soluble tandem fluorescent co-polymers, water-soluble fluorescent co-polymer complexes, water-soluble tandem fluorescent co-polymer complexes, and their use in methods for detecting analytes in a biological sample are also provided.

title: Hybrid drive stack with end-to-end learning for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines and applications
abstract: In various examples, a hybrid control stack may be implemented with classical and E2E signal paths that share a common feature extractor or backbone network. In a first training step, a robust feature extractor or backbone network may be pre-trained by co-training the network sequentially using the different types of training data for each detection head and the neural planner—without the classical refinement algorithms. In a second training step, the neural planner may be fine-tuned with the common feature extractor or backbone network frozen. As such, the present techniques may be used to transition from a decomposed control stack to an end-to-end control stack, adapt an existing decomposed control stack into a hybrid control stack, train the hybrid control stack, and/or control navigation of autonomous vehicles, semi-autonomous vehicles, robots, and/or other object or machine types.

title: Processing haptic information
abstract: In a method for processing haptic information, a media file that includes a haptic experience dataset is obtained, and a bit stream corresponding to the haptic experience dataset is obtained from the media file, the bit stream including one or more data units, and each one of the one or more data units including one or more data packets and a syntax structure that includes (i) a data unit type indicator indicating a type of the data unit and (ii) a unit-level timestamp indicating an offset time of the data unit from a start time of the haptic experience dataset. In the method, the bit stream is decoded into a piece of text-based interchange format data indicating haptic information of the haptic experience dataset, and one or more haptic devices are driven based on the piece of text-based interchange format data.

title: Light shielding unit and lens barrel equipped with the same
abstract: An aperture unit includes a base plate, a cover, a plurality of movable blades, a drive ring, a drive motor, and rotation shafts. The movable blades are disposed between the base plate and the cover, and adjust the amount of light passing through by varying the size of the opening by opening and closing operations. The drive ring is disposed between the base plate and the cover, is rotationally driven when the movable blades are opened and closed, and has a plurality of cam pins that move along cam grooves in the movable blades . The cover has protrusions that protrude toward the movable blades along the optical axis direction and restrict the movement of the movable blades in the optical axis direction.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: Preserving Cell Group Addition/Change Configuration on Handover
abstract: A method performed by a source master node performing a handover of a wireless device to a target node includes receiving, from a source secondary node, a first message comprising the secondary node configuration and a conditional reconfiguration. The source master node transmits, to the target node, a handover request message that includes an indication that the wireless device is configured with the conditional reconfiguration. The source master node receives, from the target node, a handover acknowledgement message indicating that the wireless device is to keep, modify, and/or release the conditional reconfiguration.

title: Methods and systems for generating training data for use in malware detection
abstract: In an embodiment, a method for automated generation of training data in a malware detection system includes acquiring metadata from one or more data sources for a plurality of malware samples, applying a coarse filtering function to the metadata to produce a first subset of malware samples, and performing a granular selection for the first subset by extracting features from the plurality of malware samples and grouping the malware samples based on feature similarities to form at least one cluster. A second subset of malware samples representing diverse malware families and threat categories is generated from the at least one cluster and is compared to a predefined threshold indicating at least one of a minimum number of new malware samples or a target threat distribution. Upon determining that the second subset satisfies the predefined threshold, a machine learning model is trained using the second subset for malware detection.

title: Carbon-intelligent quality-of-service mechanism
abstract: A method of selecting quality-of-service (QoS) profile (QP) includes setting at least one usage for a user equipment (UE), determining a first list of QoS profiles associated with a first Eco-Rating, and a second list of QoS profiles associated with a second Eco-Rating, and selecting a first QP or the second QP of a UE according to the first Eco-Rating, the second Eco-Rating and the at least one set usage. The first list of QPs includes the first QP, and the first QP includes a first set of QoS parameters. The second list of QPs includes the second QP, and the second QP includes a second set of QoS parameters. The second Eco-Rating is higher than the first Eco-Rating. The UE is subscribed to a green subscription.

title: Systems and methods associated with redundant steering mode and mobility over an access leg
abstract: Disclosed herein are systems, methods and instrumentalities associated with the traffic duplication. A wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) may receive, from a network node, a first message that may indicate that traffic duplication is suspended. Responsive to receiving the first message, the WTRU may suspend traffic duplication in a first access ieg while continue with data transmission or data reception in a second access leg. The WTRU may subsequently determine to resume traffic duplication and may—transmit a second message to a network node, wherein the second message may include a request to resume traffic dupiication and a cause for the request. The WTRU may receive a third message from the network node subsequent to the transmission of the second message, wherein the third message may indicate that the WTRU should use at least one of the first access leg or the second access leg for data transmission or data reception.

title: Grain-oriented electrical steel sheet and method for forming insulating coating
abstract: This grain-oriented electrical steel sheet is a grain-oriented electrical steel sheet including a base steel sheet and an insulating coating formed on a surface of the base steel sheet, in which the base steel sheet includes a flat surface part and a groove part extending in a direction of 45 to 135° with respect to a rolling direction, the groove part has a depth of 10 to 30 μm and a width of 10 to 200 μm, the insulating coating includes an intermediate layer formed on a side of the base steel sheet, containing a crystalline metal phosphate, and having a thickness of 0.1 to 15.0 μm, and a tension coating layer formed on a surface side of the insulating coating, and the base steel sheet is covered with the insulating coating including the tension coating layer and the intermediate layer having a thickness of 0.1 to 9.0 μm in 50% or more of the groove part in terms of area ratio.

title: Finger Mounted Controller And a Power Replenishment Device
abstract: A finger mounted controller and a power replenishment device are provided. The controller includes an outer shell, an upper cover, and a circuit board, a joystick control key is provided on the circuit board. A user only needs to insert his finger into a finger ring and easily operate the joystick control key by flipping a joystick key cap to trigger a corresponding function. Compared with traditional button operation methods, this joystick control method of the present disclosure is more convenient and flexible, improving the accuracy of operation and user experience. At the same time, the joystick design conforms to ergonomic principles, reducing a burden on fingers and allowing the user to use it comfortably for a long time. Besides that, the controller is further provided with a power replenishment device to provide power support for the finger mounted controller, ensuring that the controller can continue to work stably.

title: Foam sports ball
abstract: A foam basketball having a size and weight comparable to a traditional inflated regulation basketball. The foam basketball is formed from a dense polymeric foam, such as polyurethane. In some embodiments, the foam has a density of between 80 and 90 kg/m 3 . The foam basketball may have a weight between about 350 grams and about 650 grams, inclusive, and a circumference between about 20 inches and about 30 inches, inclusive.

title: Systems and methods for log analysis using large language models and quantum computational techniques
abstract: Embodiments may provide a quantum-assisted system for analyzing log data and clustering errors based on frequency and semantic similarity. The system processes log data from CSV files, vectorizes error messages using SpaCy, stores embeddings in Chroma Database (optional), and applies quantum computation to optimize clustering with centroids. By identifying the top errors within each cluster, the system offers advanced insights for troubleshooting. An orchestration subsystem may automatically execute an action determined based on the advanced insights in the target environment.

title: Heater, heating device, and image forming apparatus
abstract: A heater includes: a substrate; an insulating layer that is provided on the substrate; and a heat generating element that is provided on the insulating layer, and in a case where a region including a center of the substrate is defined as a first region, a region on a side closer to one end portion than the first region is defined as a second region, and a region on a side closer to the other end portion than the first region is defined as a third region in a transverse direction that is orthogonal to a longitudinal direction of a surface of the substrate on which the insulating layer is provided, the first region is a plane, and the second region and the third region are bent from the first region in a thickness direction of the substrate that is orthogonal to the longitudinal direction and the transverse direction.

title: Fully automated perforating gun
abstract: Implementations of a perforating gun, a system, and a method are disclosed herein. In one implementation, a perforating gun comprises a gun body having a first end and a second end, a single detonator housed within the gun body and accessible via the first end of the gun body, a detonator receptacle disposed within the gun body at the second end of the gun body, and one or more explosive charges housed within the gun body between the single detonator and the detonator receptacle, wherein the detonator receptacle is configured to receive a detonator from a second perforating gun, wherein a detonation cord is accessible via the detonator receptacle, and wherein the perforating gun is configured to transition from an unarmed state to an armed state without movement of any internal component within the gun body.

title: Method for screening therapeutic agent for muscle weakness-related diseases
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for screening a therapeutic agent for muscle weakness-related diseases, the method including: (1) a step for treating a myotube with a mitomycin; (2) a step for treating the mitomycin-treated myotube with a candidate substance; and (3) a step for measuring the levels of muscle weakness-related parameters in the cells treated with the candidate substance.

title: Systems and methods for bonded and vetted phone transmissions
abstract: Systems and methods for screening and rejecting unwanted phone calls are provided. A user may designate a list of phone numbers as being preauthorized. A phone call from any of these numbers will be put through automatically to the user device. If an incoming phone call is not from any of these preauthorized phone numbers, the user device may send information to the calling device about securing a bond before the phone call is put through. If the caller purchases the bond, the user device verifies this and allows the call to be connected to the user device. If the bond is not purchased, the call is denied. In other instances, the user may designate calls originating from within certain geographic areas or area in proximity to one or more preauthorized vehicles to be allowed, even if the incoming phone number is not part of the preauthorized list of phone numbers.

title: Transceiver interface with power detection
abstract: An apparatus for wireless communications includes a power amplifier, a low-noise amplifier, a power detector, and a transformer. The transformer includes a first inductor coupled to an output of the power amplifier, and a second inductor coupled to an antenna, wherein the second inductor is magnetically coupled with the first inductor. The transformer also includes a third inductor coupled to an input of the low-noise amplifier, wherein the third inductor is magnetically coupled with the second inductor. The transformer also includes a coupling inductor coupled to an input of the power detector, wherein the coupling inductor is magnetically coupled with at least one of the first inductor and the second inductor.

title: Wave energy extraction systems and methods including floating wave energy converters
abstract: A floating wave energy converter (WEC) includes a floating housing defined by an interior, a fluid channel positioned in the interior and configured to hold a working fluid, and a turbine positioned along the fluid channel to contact the working fluid when the working fluid is held in the fluid channel, and wherein in response to a movement in a water column external the WEC, motion is induced in the working fluid to operate the turbine and generate electrical energy.

title: Artificial intelligence (ai) and machine learning (ml) for beam management
abstract: A user equipment (UE) that communicates with a base station apparatus is described. The UE may include receiving circuitry configured to receive a radio resource control (RRC) message comprising first information used for indicating a first list of Transmission Configuration Indicator (TCI) state(s) and to receive an RRC message comprising second information used for indicating a second list of TCI state(s). The receiving circuitry may also be configured to receive a first media access control (MAC) Control Element (CE) message comprising third information used for indicating a first set of TCI state(s) from the first list and to receive a second MAC CE message comprising fourth information used for indicating a set of TCI state(s) from the second list. The receiving circuitry may also receive downlink transmission according to the measurements and the third information. The UE may also include processing circuitry to measure beams according to the fourth information.

title: Method and device for determining the particle size in a flowing sample
abstract: A method and a device for determining the average particle size of particles in a flowing liquid medium by means of dynamic light scattering (DLS). The medium is conveyed through an optically transparent channel during which time the medium is irradiated with laser light, scattered laser light is detected in a two-dimensional spatially resolved manner, wherein two images forming an image pair are generated in succession with a specific delay time τ and wherein at least two image pairs with different delay times τ are generated, the scattered light patterns of the images of each image pair are brought into coincidence with each other by means of relative displacement, wherein a maximum correlation value and a displacement amount s are respectively determined, a displacement velocity v is determined from at least one of the displacement amount s and from the associated delay time τ, a coefficient of a correlation function g 2 (τ) that is dependent on the delay time τ is determined from the correlation values of the at least two image pairs, and a value for the average particle size is derived from the at least one coefficient, wherein a correction is made as a function of the determined displacement velocity v.
assignee: Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der angewandten Forschung e.V.

title: Method and apparatus for multi-cell scheduling enhancement
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods and apparatuses for multi-cell scheduling enhancement in the CA scenario. According to some embodiments of the disclosure, a UE may: receive, from a BS, a first DCI format including information for decoding a second DCI format; decode the second DCI format based on the information for decoding the second DCI format; and based on the first DCI format, the second DCI format or both, receive downlink data channel(s) from the BS on one or more cells among a plurality of cells configured for the UE by the BS when the first DCI format or the second DCI format schedules downlink transmission, or transmit uplink data channel(s) to the BS on one or more cells among the plurality of cells when the first DCI format or the second DCI format schedules uplink transmission.

title: Integrated optical circuit having switch devices electrically connected by through-substrate via
abstract: The present disclosure is directed to integrated optical switch circuits and packages. An optical switch circuit includes a substrate having formed thereover a fixed waveguide layer comprising a first bus optical waveguide, a second bus optical waveguide and first bias electrode regions, a suspended waveguide layer formed over the fixed waveguide layer and comprising a first shunt optical waveguide and second bias electrode regions electrically isolated from the first bias electrode regions. The optical switch circuit includes a through-substrate via (TSV) formed through the substrate to electrically connect to the first bias electrode regions, where upon application of a voltage across the first and second bias electrode regions, at least one end region of the first shunt waveguide mechanically bends toward the first bus optical waveguide or the second bus optical waveguide, thereby redirecting light from the first bus optical waveguide to the second bus optical waveguide.

title: Issuing Remote Commands to Tracking Devices
abstract: In one embodiment, a method implemented by a computing device includes receiving, by a tracking system server, an instruction from a first computing device relating to a tracking device, wherein the tracking device is not in communication with the tracking system server, requesting, by the tracking system server, a notification from a second computing device that the second computing device has received a tracking signal from the tracking device, and in response to receiving the notification that the second computing device has received the tracking signal from the tracking device: authenticating, by the tracking system server, a relationship between the first computing device and the tracking device and transmitting, by the tracking system server, and to the second computing device, the instruction relating to the tracking device, wherein the second computing device is configured to transmit the instruction relating to the tracking device to the tracking device.

title: Methods and compositions for treating autoimmune diseases
abstract: The invention relates generally to methods of treating autoimmune disease, comprising administering a preconditioning regimen comprising a dose of cyclophosphamide and a dose of fludarabine to a subject, and subsequently administering a T cell therapy.

title: Electronic apparatus and controlling method thereof
abstract: An electronic apparatus according to the disclosure includes a camera, a projector for projecting an image onto a projection area, memory, and at least one processor configured to obtain an image of the projection area captured by the camera, identify an external electronic apparatus and at least one object within the projection area based on the image, identify, within the projection area, a first area including the external electronic apparatus and a second area including the at least one object based on the obtained image, identity a third area of the projection area excluding the first area and the second area, identify a fourth area, in the third area, in which a user input is detectable based on light output from the external electronic apparatus, and project a projection image onto at least a partial area of the fourth area.

title: Textured driver tip device and methods
abstract: A driver has improved “stick fit” with a head of a bone screw. The driver may include a tip portion defining a central axis and may include an external surface. At least a portion of the external surface may be symmetrical about the central axis. The tip portion may include at least one ridge extending from the external surface. The at least one ridge may provide an interference fit with an internal recess of a screw.

title: Cyclohexyl or heterocycloalkyl beta-hydroxy alkyl amines for use in the treatment of hyperglycaemia and disorders characterised by hyperglycaemia
abstract: There are herein provided compounds of formula (I) wherein Q 1  to Q 5 , R 1 , ring A, Z and n have meanings as provided in the description. Medical uses thereof are also provided herein.

title: Transparent display device
abstract: A transparent display device is provided. The transparent display device includes a first transparent display, and has a non-transmitting region and multiple transmitting regions, wherein the transmitting regions are separated from each other by the non-transmitting region. The first transparent display includes a substrate having a first edge and multiple pixels. The pixels are disposed on the substrate and include a first pixel and a second pixel, wherein the pixels correspond to the non-transmitting region. The transmitting regions include a first transmitting region and a second transmitting region, at least a portion of the first transmitting region is disposed between the first pixel and the first edge, and the second transmitting region is disposed between the first pixel and the second pixel. The first transmitting region has a first area, the second transmitting region has a second area, and the first area is smaller than the second area.

title: Display module and electronic device including thereof
abstract: A display module includes a base layer in which first to third light-emitting regions are defined, an input-sensing layer including reflection patterns respectively overlapping the light-emitting regions, and a light control layer including light-shielding patterns above the input-sensing layer and respectively overlapping the reflection patterns, color filters respectively covering the light-shielding patterns, and first to third refracting portions above the color filters and respectively at the first to third light-emitting regions, wherein a first distance from an end of the first refracting portion to an end of a first light-shielding pattern overlapping the first refracting portion, a second distance from an end of the second refracting portion to an end of a second light-shielding pattern overlapping the second refracting portion, and a third distance from an end of the third refractive portion to an end of a third light-shielding pattern overlapping the third refractive portion are different.

title: Electric junction box mount apparatus
abstract: An electrical junction box mount apparatus including a base for mounting to a mounting surface and a lid sized to seal against the base. The base includes a mounting portion having a penetration area. A periphery of the penetration area is circumscribed via a groove formed into a bottom surface of the base such that upon placing the base on a mounting surface, the groove encloses empty space within the groove against the mounting surface.

title: Electrosurgical devices and methods
abstract: A bipolar electrosurgical devices and methods of use for coagulation and ablation of tissue in a fluid-immersed working space is disclosed.The bipolar electrosurgical device can comprise a handle and an elongated shaft coupled to the handle. The bipolar electrosurgical device can further comprise a bipolar electrode arrangement and a return electrode. The bipolar electrode arrangement and the return electrode can be electrically insulated from one another. The bipolar electrosurgical device can further comprise an adjusting member carried by the elongated shaft. Movement of the adjusting member from a first position toward a second position can contemporaneously increase an effective surface area of the active electrode and decrease an effective surface area of the return electrode.

title: A process for preparing 2,2-dimethoxypropane
abstract: A process for preparing 2,2-dimethoxypropane includes the steps of reacting acetone with methanol in a molar ratio ranging between 1:2 to 1:6 in the presence of a catalyst at a reaction temperature in the range of −50° C. to −80° C., followed by allowing acetone and methanol to react at the reaction temperature in the range of −50° C. to −80° C. for a time period in the range of about 12 hours to 7 days to obtain a reaction mixture including crystals of 2,2-dimethoxypropane; quenching the reaction mixture including crystals of 2,2-dimethoxypropane with a base to obtain a slurry including crystals of 2,2-dimethoxypropane. The slurry including crystals of 2,2-dimethoxypropane is treated to obtain 2,2-dimethoxypropane in a liquid form.

title: Catalysts for room temperature vulcanisable (rtv) silicone compositions
abstract: This relates to new cerium (IV) organometallic compounds, to methods for making said cerium (IV) organometallic compounds and to their uses as condensation catalysts e.g., for curing room temperature vulcanisable (RTV) silicone compositions comprising a polyorganosiloxane polymer having at least two hydroxy or hydrolysable groups per molecule, together with a suitable condensation curable cross-linker. Such compositions can include various additives and can be stored in one-part or multiple part compositions. This disclosure also relates to silicone elastomers and cured silicone sealants and/or adhesives prepared by curing said compositions using the cerium (IV) organometallic compounds as the catalysts.
assignee: Dow Silicones Corporatiion; Dow Global Technologies Llc

title: Selective Isolation of Interconnectable Cooling System Modules
abstract: Techniques for selectively isolating interconnectable modules in a coolant system are disclosed. A system directs a flow of coolant liquid through coolant pipe assembly racks mounted in a data center pod. The racks store heat-generating computing devices. The coolant pipe assembly may be configured as a loop-shaped structure. One side of the loop may supply coolant liquid to one row of racks, and another side of the loop may supply coolant liquid to another row of racks. The system closes a set of valves along a coolant pipe to isolate a set of target racks from the flow of coolant liquid. Due to the loop structure of the coolant pipe assembly, the system continues to direct coolant liquid to other racks in the same row of the loop-shaped structure as the isolated target racks.

title: Electromagnetic stopper, in particular for stopping, separating, positioning and holding objects on a transport route
abstract: An electromagnetic stopper includes a housing and a first lever arm and a third lever arm arranged on the housing so as to be pivotable via a first joint and a third joint, respectively. A second lever arm is arranged on the first lever arm so as to be pivotable via a first connecting joint and is arranged on the third lever arm so as to be pivotable via a third connecting joint. An actuator is mechanically connected to the first lever arm or the second lever arm, and can be moved between a stop position and an open position. A stop element arranged on the third lever arm protrudes at least partially from the housing in the stop position. The third joint has a third joint axis and the third connecting joint has a third connecting joint axis spaced apart from the third joint axis.

title: Saddled vehicle
abstract: A saddled vehicle ( 1 ) includes: a front wheel (WF); leg shields ( 40 ) each provided on a side portion of a vehicle body at a position above and rearward of the front wheel (WF); and air release ports ( 50 ) configured to release vehicle-induced airflow (W) introduced into the inside of the leg shields ( 40 ). Each of the leg shields ( 40 ) includes a streamlining plate ( 60 ) extending along an edge of a corresponding one of the air release ports ( 50 ) at a position inward of the air release port ( 50 ) in a vehicle width direction. Each of the leg shields ( 40 ) includes a base cowl ( 41 ) and an outer cover ( 42 ) mounted on an outer side of the base cowl ( 41 ) in the vehicle width direction. The streamlining plates ( 60 ) are provided on the respective base cowls ( 41 ). The air release ports ( 50 ) are provided in the respective outer covers ( 42 ).

title: A stacked-design multi-mode conformable epidermal sensor
abstract: A stacked-design multi-mode conformable epidermal sensor that, when worn on an epidermis of a human proximate the heart (e.g., chest), is capable of synchronously/continuously monitoring electrical activity and mechano-acoustic activity of a cardiovascular system.
assignee: Board Of Regents, The University Of Texas System

title: Apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium and article of aerosolizable medium
abstract: An apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium, the apparatus including a housing; and a chamber for receiving an article. The article includes an aerosolizable medium; and a marker arrangement including a first marker and a second marker. The apparatus includes a sensor arrangement configured to operate in a first mode and a second mode. In the first mode the sensor arrangement monitors non-continuously for the presence of the first marker. In the second mode the sensor arrangement is configured to read identification information from the second marker. The sensor arrangement operates in the second mode responsive to the detection of the presence of the first marker in the first mode.

title: Clutch control device
abstract: The clutch control device ( 40 A) is provided with a clutch device ( 26 ), a clutch actuator ( 50 ), and a control unit ( 40 ), wherein the control unit ( 40 ) has an automatic control mode (M 1 ) in which the clutch device ( 26 ) is automatically operated by driving the clutch actuator ( 50 ) and a manual control mode (M 2 ) in which the clutch device ( 26 ) is manually operated by operation input to a clutch operator ( 4   b ) operated by a driver, and the control unit ( 40 ) shifts to a forced manual control mode in which only the manual control mode (M 2 ) can be selected according to the wear state of the clutch device ( 26 ).

title: Two part milling and running tool employing a body lock ring
abstract: Provided is a two part milling and running tool, a well system, and a method. The two part milling and running tool, in one aspect, includes a conveyance, a smaller assembly coupled to an end of the conveyance, and a larger bit assembly slidably coupled to the conveyance, the smaller assembly and larger bit assembly configured to slidingly engage one another downhole to form a combined bit assembly, the larger bit assembly having a body lock ring in an interior thereof, the body lock ring configured to allow the smaller assembly to slide toward the larger bit assembly but prevent the smaller assembly from sliding away from the larger bit assembly.

title: Estimating network performance based on application synchronization signals
abstract: A method performed by a processing system including at least one processor includes monitoring, over a defined period of time, a plurality of application synchronization signals exchanged between an application server and a user endpoint device in a communications network, measuring, for each application synchronization signal of the plurality of application synchronization signals, a value of a network performance metric, to produce a plurality of network performance metric values, plotting a distribution of the plurality of network performance metric values, calculating a percentage of the plurality of network performance metric values for which the value of the network performance metric fails to meet a threshold that is defined relative to the distribution, and classifying a performance of the communications network from a perspective of the user endpoint device, based on the percentage.

title: Electronic stethoscope
abstract: An electronic stethoscope according to the present disclosure is an electronic stethoscope that captures biometric sound. The electronic stethoscope includes a sensor element that captures biometric sound, and a first housing that accommodates the sensor element, that has a pipe shape having a first end and a second end, and that receives a shielding member at the first end. The first housing includes a first flow path that extends through the first housing and that connects a side of an inner wall and a side of an outer wall of the first housing to each other. Around the sensor element, a NULL area in which sensitivity of the sensor element is reduced by greater than or equal to a predetermined value with respect to a maximum gain at which the sensitivity of the sensor element is maximum is defined.

title: Light-emitting diode and display device comprising same
abstract: A light-emitting element including: a first semiconductor layer doped with a first type of dopant; a second semiconductor layer doped with a second type of dopant that is different from the first type of dopant; and an active layer between the first semiconductor layer and the second semiconductor layer, wherein a length of the light-emitting element measured in a first direction, which may be a direction in which the first semiconductor layer, the active layer, and the second semiconductor layer may be arranged, may be shorter than the width measured in a second direction that is perpendicular to the first direction.

title: Mattresses including stacked elastomeric layers and related methods for same
abstract: A cushion assembly includes a plurality of layers, including a plurality of buckling layers, arranged in a stack. The cushion assembly includes a first intermediate layer; a first buckling layer having a first plurality of voids; a second intermediate layer disposed above the first buckling layer; and a microgrid layer disposed over the second intermediate layer. The microgrid layer includes a second plurality of voids. The second plurality of voids are smaller in thickness and width than the first plurality of voids.

title: Communicating structure and commmunictaing method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure provides a communicating structure including a first body and a second body, and a communicating method thereof. The first body includes a first flow path, a first block body and a communicating portion. The second body includes a second flow path and a second block body. The first block body can be rotated, turned, moved laterally or moved to communicate the communicating portion with the first flow path, for a fluid to flow through the first flow path and the communicating portion to push the second block body, and for the second block body to open the second flow path for the fluid to flow in the first flow path and the second flow path. Thus, a required fluid is enabled to flow stably in the first body and the second body.

title: Riding apparatus for mowing and pressure surface cleaning
abstract: A riding apparatus and a method for mowing and pressure surface cleaning. The riding apparatus is similar to a riding lawn mower having a chassis, body, chair, and controls. A mower deck is mounted to the chassis. A spindle mounted is mounted to the mower deck. The spindle allows connecting the mower blade, water supply, and nozzles for pressure surface cleaning. The shaft of the spindle has a vertical hole and a horizontal hole forming a T-shape path for the water supply. A swivel is coupled to the top end of the spindle and connects to a high-pressure hose. Two L-shaped pipes extend from two openings of the horizontal hole and provide attachment for the nozzles. A high-pressure pump can supply water or steam. When not used for cleaning, the nozzles and the hose from the swivel can be removed and the riding apparatus can be used for mowing.

title: Thin film transistor substrate
abstract: The present disclosure provides a thin-film transistor substrate including a substrate, a first gate on the substrate and including a fist side and a second side, a semiconductor layer on the first gate, a second gate on the semiconductor layer and including a third side and a fourth side, a source on the semiconductor layer and adjacent to the first side and the third side, and a drain on the semiconductor layer and adjacent to the second side and the fourth side. The second gate overlaps with the first gate. The first side is distance from the second side by a first distance, the second side is distance from the fourth side by a second distance, and an absolute value of a difference between the first distance and the second distance is greater than or equal to 0 µm and is smaller than or equal to 3 µm.

title: Electro-magnetic launch systemsand methods using high force magnetic levitation
abstract: An electrodynamic launching system includes a vehicle having at least one electrically conductive coil arranged to interact with at least one track of ultra-conducting material in a guideway as the vehicle is moved through the guideway. A drive device drives the vehicle at a velocity that induces electrical current in the tracks sufficient to levitate the vehicle and to inhibit collision of the vehicle with the guideway and the tracks by electrodynamic suspension as the vehicle is moved along the tracks, and drives the vehicle at a launch velocity to launch the vehicle from the guideway. The launch velocity is at least as great as the first velocity. A controller controls a release mechanism to release the payload from the vehicle to launch the vehicle from the guideway while the at least one drive device drives the vehicle at a launch velocity.

title: Video generation
abstract: There are provided a video generation method and apparatus, a device, and a storage medium. The method includes: determining, based on at least one reference image of a target object, an appearance feature representation indicative of an appearance of the target object; extracting, based on a driving video corresponding to a driving object, a posture feature representation sequence; extracting, based on facial state information indicative of a facial state of the driving object, a facial state feature representation sequence; and generating, based on the appearance feature representation, the posture feature representation sequence, and the facial state feature representation sequence and using a trained video generation model, a target video, the target video including the target object, and a body posture and a facial state of the target object in the target video corresponding to the driving video and the facial state information, respectively.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Fluid reservoir for a paint spray gun with screw cap and screw cap or material container of such a fluid reservoir
abstract: A fluid reservoir for a paint spray gun has a material outlet which is designed for direct and/or indirect connection to a paint spray gun and a material container with a screw cap which closes the material container. When the material container and screw cap are connected in a releasable and fluid-tight manner, thereby forming a screw connection, an upper rim region of the material container is to be arranged in a receiving groove on the screw cap. The upper rim region of the material container has a projecting circumferential sealing element which is brought into planar sealing contact with a sealing surface of the screw cap.

title: Source driver performing eye margin test for signal quality visualization and operating method thereof
abstract: An example display device includes a display panel having a plurality of pixels and data lines, a timing controller for providing image data and an eye margin test signal, and a source driver for performing an eye margin test on the received data to generate and output data signals. The source driver generates eye margin test result data and corresponding data signals based on the test. Accordingly, the display device can visually verify interface signal integrity and optimize display driving characteristics in real time.

title: Leveling device with load control
abstract:
The present invention refers to a heavy-duty levelling device, of a type used for example in shipyards. 
     In particular, the invention concerns a heavy-duty support device ( 1 ) comprising a first and a second wedge support element ( 2 ,  3 ), a first and a second wedge regulating element ( 4 ,  5 ), and an organ regulating ( 6 ) the reciprocal distance between these first and second regulating wedge elements ( 4 ,  5 ), characterized by the fact that the support device ( 1 ) includes a sensor device for determining the load applied to the upper face ( 2   a ) of the support wedge element ( 2 ).

title: Production and purification of natural vanillin using new strains of amycolatopsis
abstract: A composition includes a biologically pure culture of  Amycolatopsis tucumanensis  LGM 24814, a mutant thereof, or an enzyme extracted thereof, ferulic acid, and a carbon source. Also disclosed is a process for preparing vanillin that includes subjecting ferulic acid to  Amycolatopsis tucumanensis  LGM 24814, a mutant thereof, or an isolated enzyme thereof for a period of time sufficient to convert the ferulic acid to vanillin, converting at least a portion of the ferulic acid to vanillin, and recovering the vanillin.

title: Turn-over structure linking wheels upon folding a stroller
abstract: A turn-over structure linking wheels upon folding a stroller includes a pair of side bar, and lower bar, a carrying frame, and a pair of side bottom bar. A tail end of the lower bar is pivoted to the side bottom bar, two side bars and a pair of support handle are pivoted to the carrying frame, a front side and a rear side of the side bottom bars are pivoted to a front wheel set and a rear wheel set respectively, and the lower bar and the support handle form an intersection state in an X-shape. Each one of two movable rods passes through and moves in the side bottom bar; whereas when folding the stroller, the movable rod is linked and pulled backward altogether, and the backward movement of the movable rod drives the front wheel set and the rear wheel set to flip inward for collection.

title: Clinical trial proposal device and clinical trial proposal method
abstract: A clinical trial proposal device according to the invention includes: a reception unit configured to receive a clinical trial condition including a plurality of items required of a subject of a clinical trial, and patient information including the plurality of items about a plurality of patients who may be the subject; an extraction unit configured to extract, if a value for some item included in the patient information does not exist, a candidate of the subject from the patient information by comparing values for other items existing in the patient information with values for other items in the clinical trial condition, and display the extracted candidate of the subject on a screen; and a proposal unit configured to propose the clinical trial for the extracted candidate.

title: Statistical application of rfid technology in authenticating a capsule
abstract: Various example embodiments relate to an aerosol generating device, system, method, and/or non-transitory computer readable medium for authenticating capsules compatible with the aerosol generating device using statistical analysis of security tags. The aerosol generating device may include a housing configured to receive a capsule, the capsule containing an aerosol-forming substrate; a heating element configured to heat the aerosol-forming substrate to generate an aerosol; and control circuitry configured to, determine whether the capsule includes a security tag using a security sensor, increment a counter based on results of the determining whether the capsule includes the security tag, and determine a statistical probability of authenticity of the capsule based on a count of the counter and a first desired threshold value.

title: Getting-out assistance apparatus
abstract: A getting-out assistance apparatus performs a moving object warning for informing an occupant of a host vehicle that there exists a moving object that may come into contact with a door panel opened laterally outward from the host vehicle. The apparatus does not perform the moving object warning when an obstacle exists between a predicted movement path and the door panel in a lateral direction of the host vehicle in a case where the predicted movement path passes through a predetermined lateral region. The predicted movement path is a path predicted as a path on which the moving object moves. The predetermined lateral region is a region within a predetermined distance laterally outward from a side wall of the host vehicle.

title: Liquid alkylated phenyl-alpha-naphthylamine with reduced aquatic toxicity
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a liquid additive comprising an amine of the formula (1) where the method comprises the steps of alkylating phenyl-alpha-naphthylamine with an olefin selected from linear or branched C8-C12 alkenes to obtain a first raw product comprising the amine of the formula (1); distilling off unreacted olefin from the first raw product to obtain a second raw product; and distilling off unreacted phenyl-alpha-naphthylamine from the second raw product to obtain the liquid additive. The invention also relates to a liquid additive comprising an amine of the formula (1) and phenyl-alpha-naphthylamine, where the liquid additive comprises at least 95 wt % of the amine of the formula (1), and where the concentration of the phenyl-alpha-naphthylamine in the liquid additive is below 0.2 wt %, preferably below 0.1 wt %. It further relates to a use of the liquid additive as in lubricants.

title: Loading calculation
abstract: A system and method for determining loads throughout a power distribution network having a plurality of switching devices provided along a feeder. The method includes measuring the current and/or voltage on one or both sides of the switching devices and calculating a power flowing through each of the switching devices and a load in each section using the current and/or voltage measurements at predetermined sample times. The method further includes storing a plurality of recorded current/voltage measurements or calculated powers flowing through each device for consecutive sample times.
