The method then determines a median load from the measurements and power flows and calculates a load in each of network sections.

title: Time slot configuration method and apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract: Provided are a slot configuration method and apparatus, and a computer-readable storage medium. The slot configuration method includes: configuring a slot, where a number of symbols in the slot is a multiple of 15, the slot includes at least one pilot symbol and an even number of data symbols, and data transmitted by a pair of data symbols in the even number of data symbols in an order are identical.

title: Threshold determination for triggering message repetitions
abstract: There is provided an apparatus comprising means for means for receiving, at a user equipment, a threshold for triggering a request for repetitions of a third message of a random access procedure and means for determining at least one threshold for triggering repetitions of a first message of the random access procedure based on the received threshold.

title: System and method for determining locations for recoverable mineral in a stockpile
abstract: The method may comprise receiving historical data (e.g., mineralogy data, irrigation data, raffinate data, heat data, lift height data, geographic data on ore placement and/or blower data); training a predictive model using the historical data to create a trained predictive model; adding future assumption data to the trained predictive model; running the forecast engine for a plurality of parameters to obtain forecast data for a mining production target; comparing the forecast data for the mining production target to the actual data for the mining production target; determining deviations between the forecast data and the actual data, based on the comparing; and changing each of the plurality of parameters from the forecast data to the actual data to determine a contribution to the deviations for each of the plurality of parameters.

title: Obstacle Detection Method and Device for Assisting Vehicle in Driving
abstract: An obstacle detection method for assisting in vehicle driving includes (i) obtaining ultrasonic echo data captured during vehicle movement, (ii) obtaining information associated with echo intersections based on the ultrasonic echo data, (iii) providing at least part of the ultrasonic echo data and the information associated with the echo intersections as feature data to a machine learning model to obtain detection information for an obstacle, wherein the machine learning model employs at least one of a classification algorithm or a regression algorithm, and (iv) assisting in vehicle driving based on the detection information for the obstacle.

title: Linear conveyance system
abstract: A linear conveyance system of the present disclosure includes a mover having a magnet disposed on side faces thereof, and a conveyance path in which a first module having a plurality of coils and configured to move the mover by an electromagnetic force of the plurality of coils and a second module formed of a magnetic material without coils are arranged along a traveling direction of the mover. The conveyance path includes a non-branching portion in which the first module is disposed on one side of the side faces of the mover, and a branching portion in which the first module is disposed on one side of the side faces of the mover and the second module is disposed on the other side thereof.

title: Display panel and display apparatus
abstract: The present application discloses a display panel and a display apparatus. The display panel comprises a plurality of pixel areas, a pixel area of the pixel areas comprising a circuit area and a transparent area. The display panel comprises a pixel area, the pixel area comprising a circuit area and a transparent area, the display panel comprising a first area and a second area distributed along a first direction, the first area and the second area comprises the pixel area, the pixel area of the first area comprises a first transparent area, the pixel area of the second area comprises a second transparent area, wherein an area of the first transparent area is less than an area of the second transparent area.
assignee: Tianma Advanced Display Technology Institute (Xiamen) Co., Ltd.

title: Non-hydrogenated vegetable fat composition
abstract: A non-hydrogenated fat composition comprising a liquid oil and a hardstock fat and the preparation process thereof. The liquid oil is present in an amount of 25 to 75 wt. %, 25 to 70 wt. %, or 35 to 45 wt. %, and the hardstock fat is present in an amount of 25 to 75 wt. %, 30 to 75 wt. %, or 55 to 65 wt. %, based upon total weight of the fat composition. Also disclosed is a food product comprising a food ingredient different from a fat, and a non-hydrogenated vegetable fat composition, and a use of a non-hydrogenated vegetable fat composition to reduce oil leakage from a food product.

title: Fastening Device for Fastening in Particular a Cable, a Cable Harness or a Line to an Edge or Rib of a Base Part
abstract: A fastening apparatus ( 1 ) for fastening a cable to a rib ( 100 ) of a base part. The fastening apparatus ( 1 ) includes a base body ( 2 ), which can be fitted onto the rib ( 100 ). The fastening apparatus ( 1 ) further includes a clip ( 4 ) operatively connected to the base body ( 2 ), wherein at least one bar area ( 5 ) of the clip ( 4 ) projects into a receiving area ( 3 ) of the base body ( 2 ) such that, in a state of the rib ( 100 ) being received into the receiving area ( 3 ), the base body ( 2 ) is clamped to the rib ( 100 ). According to the disclosure, it is particularly provided that the base body ( 2 ) includes a screw boss area ( 6 ) with a screw channel ( 7 ), wherein the screw channel ( 7 ) is connected to the receiving area ( 3 ) via a window area ( 8 ), so that the rib ( 100 ) partially projects into the screw channel ( 7 ). When a screw ( 9 ) is screwed into the screw channel ( 7 ), it firstly forms a form-fitting connection with the screw boss area ( 6 ), and secondly forms such a connection with the area of the rib ( 100 ) of the base part projecting into the screw channel ( 7 ) on the other hand.

title: Buckling beams for underwater and terrestrial autonomous vehicles
abstract: A mechanical system includes a curved beam and a motor coupled to the curved beam. The curved beam is configured to buckle at two different locations along the positive and negative portions of its load/displacement curve, corresponding to opposite and equal sense bending directions. The motor is configured to impart a flapping motion to the curved beam.
assignee: Daniel Aukes; Mohammad SHARIFZADEH; Yuhao JIANG

title: System and method of simulating seismic wave propagation
abstract: A method of simulating seismic wave propagation in media, the method implemented by a computer comprising a processor and a memory, the method comprising: modelling, using an earth model having a grid, a medium as a set of elastic tensors, wherein respective elastic tensors of the set thereof have tilted orientations relative to the grid; and simulating seismic wave propagation in the medium using a wave-equation operator, wherein the wave-equation operator is invariant to orientation changes of the respective elastic tensors of the set thereof.

title: Bio-based curable epoxy composition
abstract: A curable composition includes at least one polyamine; an epoxy resin; and a silane-modified biosilica material. The silane-modified biosilica material is derived from rice husk and is present in the curable composition at a concentration of 0.01 to 10 wt. %, based on the total weight of the curable composition. The silane-modified biosilica material has an average particle size of 1 to 10 micrometers (μm). A method of making a cured composite material from the curable composition.

title: Method, product, and system for regulating facility temperature using real-time procedural state analysis
abstract: Disclosed is a computer-implemented method, a computer program product, and/or a system for automated temperature control. A stream of timestamped clinical workflow events may be received from a clinical source. A stored event definition database may be accessed to classify at least one clinical workflow milestone within the stream of timestamped clinical workflow events. A current procedural phase of an operating room may be resolved by evaluating a first clinical workflow milestone against stored procedural state model. A control data structure correlating defined procedural phases with at least one corresponding temperature control may be accessed. A first target temperature may be derived from the parameter associated with the resolved current procedural phase. A second target temperature may be derived in response to a second clinical workflow milestone. Temperature control commands encoding the target temperatures may be transmitted to a facility management controller associated with the operating room.

title: Suture retrieval device
abstract: A device comprising a trocar may include a trocar body having a channel formed therein; a first opening at a first end of the channel, and an end cap at a second end of the channel. The end cap may include an end cap body at least partially enclosing the channel at the second end of the channel, an opening formed in the end cap body at the second end of the channel allowing passage of a mechanical feature through the first opening and through the second opening, and a tongue extending substantially perpendicularly from a surface of the end cap internal to the channel such that the tongue and at least one wall of the channel defines a groove.
assignee: Board Of Regents, The University Of Texas System

title: Additive manufacturing of pressure containment vessels
abstract: Systems and methods for additive manufacturing of pressure containment vessels in undersea oil and gas systems are disclosed. A primary pressure vessel comprising at a primary fluid conduit and valves configured to control a flow of fluid in the primary pressure vessel may be provided. The primary pressure vessel may be operable as a primary valve block in an undersea oil and gas system. Furthermore, an additively manufactured secondary pressure vessel can be integrally coupled to the primary pressure vessel. The secondary pressure vessel includes a secondary conduit in fluid communication with the primary fluid conduit and valve cavities configured to house secondary valves for controlling the flow of the fluid through the secondary pressure vessel. The secondary pressure vessel may be operable as an external valve block integrally coupled to the primary pressure vessel.

title: Autonomous identification of electrical signatures with iot-enabled monitors
abstract: An industrial IoT electrical monitor (IIEM) is accessed. The IIEM is coupled to one or more industrial devices within one or more environments. Electrical data associated with the one or more industrial devices is recorded by the IIEM. The recording is based on a sampling frequency. One or more anomalous events associated with an industrial device within the one or more industrial devices are identified by a language model. The identifying is based on the electrical data that was recorded. The identifying is further based on contextual information. The one or more anomalous events that were identified are reported to a user. The one or more anomalous events are based on the electrical data that was recorded. The contextual information includes a plurality of historical events. Each historical event within the plurality of historical events is associated with one or more signatures.

title: Ventilation system
abstract: A first PCV valve opens when a pressure of an intake passage at a downstream side of a compressor becomes lower than or equal to a first specified pressure, which is lower than the atmospheric pressure. When a logical conjunction including a condition that discharging of a battery is permitted and a condition that the pressure of the intake passage at the downstream side of the compressor is higher than or equal to a first threshold value and lower than or equal to a second threshold value remains satisfied for a predetermined period, a vehicle controller executes a ventilation process. The ventilation process includes driving a hydrogen engine so that the pressure of the intake passage at the downstream side of the compressor becomes lower than or equal to the first specified pressure. The ventilation process includes assisting in output of the hydrogen engine with a motor-generator.

title: Methods for treating hepatitis
abstract: Provided herein are methods for treating HBV and/or HDV infections by administering one or more ADAR inhibitors to a subject in need thereof.

title: Information Processing Method, Non-Transitory Computer-Readable Storage Medium and Information Processing Apparatus
abstract: An information processing method includes: causing a computer to execute processing of acquiring orbital information of a specific artificial satellite that has reserved communication with a specific ground station in a time slot starting from a specific time, among a plurality of artificial satellites placed in a predetermined orbit, and orbital information and communication speeds of other artificial satellites other than the specific artificial satellite that have completed communication with the specific ground station before the specific time; causing the computer to execute processing of deriving a correlation between orbital information and a communication speed of an artificial satellite based on the orbital information and the communication speeds of the other artificial satellites; causing the computer to execute processing of calculating a communication speed of the specific artificial satellite based on the derived correlation and the orbital information of the specific artificial satellite; and causing the computer to execute processing of transmitting the calculated communication speed to the specific artificial satellite.

title: Display device
abstract: A display device includes a display panel and an external circuit component. The display panel has a display area and a peripheral area, and includes pixels in the display area and trances in the peripheral area. In a bonding area of the peripheral area, one of the trances includes a strip part and an oblique part connecting to the strip part. The extending direction of the strip part is parallel to an edge of the display panel, and an obtuse angle is formed between the oblique part and the strip part. The external circuit component includes pads disposed on the trances and electrically connected to the trances. One of the pads includes a beveled part and a straight part connecting to the beveled part. In the normal line of the display panel, the beveled part overlaps the oblique part, and the straight part overlaps the strip part.

title: Inline mounting/junction box for inverter use with highbay fixtures
abstract: A junction box is disclosed that permits inline mounting of an l electrical device, such as an inverter, to a highbay light fixture. The junction box of the present invention allows a standard inverter, meant to mount flat to a mounting surface, to be mounted inline on a chain or cable while providing an enclosed space for making wiring connections.

title: System and a method for enabling wifi extender in a user environment
abstract: A method for enabling one or more Wireless-Fidelity (Wi-Fi) extenders in a user environment. The method comprises determining signal quality of one or more areas in the user environment, identifying, boundary coordinates of one or more sub-areas around one or more weak strength devices, detecting one or more strong strength devices located in the proximity of the identified boundary coordinates of the one or more sub-areas, identifying one or more candidate strong strength devices from the detected one or more strong strength devices and enabling the identified one or more candidate strong-strength devices to operate as the one or more Wi-Fi extenders

title: Sidelink discovery associated with nr relays
abstract: Systems, methods, and instrumentalities are described herein for sidelink discovery, for example, associated with relays, e.g., NR relays. Discovery data may be transmitted, for example, to initialize communication between devices. Discovery data may be transmitted alone or multiplexed with other data (e.g., sidelink data). Discovery data with a high priority may be transmitted alone. Discovery data with a low priority may be multiplexed with other data (e.g., other data received within a duration of time). Discovery data may be multiplexed with other data that share the same destination identity. Resource allocation may be performed, for example, based on whether the discovery data is transmitted alone or multiplexed with other data.

title: Three-way ball valve, electric vehicle, opening degree control method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract: Disclosed are a three-way ball valve, an electric vehicle, an opening degree control method, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The three-way ball valve includes: a valve body; and a spherical valve core rotatably disposed in the valve body, and including a first flow channel and a second flow channel with unequal cross-sectional areas. A cross-sectional area of the first flow channel is greater than that of the second flow channel, the first and second flow channels are distributed around a rotation axis of the spherical valve core, the spherical valve core includes an initial position, in which an opening degree of the three-way ball valve is 50%, in the initial position, a medium inlet is in communication with a first medium outlet and a second medium outlet, and the spherical valve core is controlled to rotate to adjust the opening degree of the three-way ball valve.
assignee: Zhejiang Zeekr Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.; Zhejiang Geely Holding Group Co., Ltd.

title: Pneumatic automation device, maintenance assembly, pneumatic system, and method
abstract: A pneumatic automation device including a guide section for guiding compressed air, and an acceleration sensor vibration-coupled to the guide section for providing an acceleration signal that represents vibrations of the guide section caused by a flow of the compressed air, and a computing unit configured to calculate both a pressure value related to the compressed air and a flow value related to the compressed air based on the acceleration signal and using a machine learning model.

title: Insulation monitoring apparatus, and insulation monitoring method
abstract: An insulation monitoring apparatus monitors a leakage current relating to a switching device that controls power supplied to a load. A leakage current detection unit provided in at least one of between the switching device and the load, and between the switching device and a primary side detects a leakage current. A primary side voltage acquisition unit acquires a power supply voltage value of the power supply, and a period identifying unit identifies an on period in which power is supplied to the load by the switching device. A period in which the power is not supplied to the load by the switching device is defined as an off period. The insulation monitoring apparatus further estimates a normalized leakage current value when the on period is 100% with reference to the power supply voltage value, based on the leakage current value in the on period.
assignee: Hitachi Industrial Equipment Systems Co., Ltd.; Chino Corporation

title: Material inspection and testing process using a radio opaque penetrant
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to a method for inspecting and testing parts using a radio opaque penetrant formulation. The method may comprise the steps of providing a part for inspecting and testing, applying a radio opaque penetrant formulation to a part to be tested, waiting a period of time to allow the radio opaque penetrant formulation to penetrate into the part, and scanning the part using an X-ray CT scanner. The radio opaque penetrant formulation may comprise a penetrating liquid and a radio opaque material. The penetrating liquid may be fluorescent or non-fluorescent.

title: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for generating animation paths for augmented reality
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for generating animation paths for virtual characters in outdoor augmented reality environments are described. A trained prediction model analyzes a three-dimensional representation of an environment to identify suitable locations for performing character actions in the environment. Waypoints are selected within the three-dimensional representation based on the identified locations, with each waypoint corresponding to a location where the virtual character performs a storyline action. An animation path connecting the selected waypoints is synthesized and optimized based on visibility from a user perspective, distance from the user, and path smoothness.

title: Tennis ball retriever and system
abstract: A system for collecting a tennis ball on a tennis court and for controllably releasing the ball toward a target includes a mobile retriever and a remote control. The retriever includes a receiver, an on-board power supply, a camera, a processor-controller, a ball collector section with an opening for ball transit therethrough, a ball proximity sensor, and a detent operated by the controller-processor for ball collections and releases. The processor-controller is programmed to direct the retriever when activated and direct it to a user-selected on or off-court area that may conform to a programmed grid. The system can further include a heuristic learning algorithm for initiating and/or conducting retrievals automatically. The retriever may also include a horizontal and/or a vertical ball ejector for expanded ball delivery capability.

title: Tire Deflation Device
abstract: A tactical tire deflation device has a cylindrical volume closed at one end by a cap, and defined by a plurality of resilient wall segments. The segments each have inwardly disposed friction ridges, and each segment is spaced from the others by a slot running longitudinally in the cylindrical volume.

title: Information processing device, storage medium, and information processing method
abstract: An information processing device includes: an obtaining section that obtains electroencephalogram data indicative of an electroencephalogram of a user; a first estimation section that estimates, by using a model for estimating an activity state of a brain network, the activity state of the brain network from the electroencephalogram data; and a second estimation section that estimates whether or not a thought state of the user is a deliberation state, on the basis of a probability that the activity state of the brain network switches.

title: Flexible display and foldable electronic device
abstract: The disclosure provides a flexible display and a foldable electronic device. The foldable electronic device includes a housing, and a flexible display that includes a cover plate and a display layer that are stacked. The display layer includes a bending area and a non-bending area. The cover plate includes a flexible part and a rigid part. The flexible part corresponds to the bending area, the rigid part corresponds to the non-bending area, and the rigid part is fastened to the housing.

title: User borne device type identification
abstract: A user borne device for use with a digital device that incorporates a plurality of magnetometers, wherein the user borne device includes: an elongate body defining a longitudinal axis of the user borne device, a first magnetically responsive component immovably disposed at, or near to, the proximal end of the elongate body; and a second magnetically responsive component disposed along at least a portion of the longitudinal axis of the user borne device in-between the first magnetically responsive component and the distal end of the elongate body; wherein the second magnetically responsive component is configured to move translationally with respect to the first magnetically responsive component and/or to move rotationally with respect to the longitudinal axis of the user borne device.

title: Semiconductor memory device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A semiconductor memory device includes a first one of a plurality of word lines. The first word line, in a cross-section, includes an end surface with a center portion and an end portion. A first insulating layer, a second insulating layer, a third insulating layer, and a semiconductor layer are provided in such an order from the end surface of the first word line in a lateral direction. A first thickness of the first insulating layer corresponding to the end portion of the first word line and a second thickness of the first insulating layer corresponding to the center portion of the first word line are different, while the second insulating layer, the third insulating layer, and the semiconductor layer each have a sidewall linearly extending in a vertical direction.

title: Electric cylinder device and brake fluid pressure control device
abstract: As an example, an electric cylinder device according to an embodiment includes a housing provided with a cylinder, a piston disposed inside the cylinder, a rotating member that rotates about a rotational axis, a linear motion member attached to the rotating member so as to move in a first direction along the rotational axis or a second direction opposite to the first direction according to rotation of the rotating member, the linear motion member pushing the piston so as to reduce a volume of a liquid chamber of the cylinder by moving in the first direction, and a first engaging portion provided at the piston, a second engaging portion that is provided at the linear motion member and contacts the first engaging portion to restrict a separation of the linear motion member from the piston in the second direction.

title: Sla-driven orchestration of software containers
abstract: Described herein is An apparatus for controlling a plurality of working nodes on which applications providing services are running, said apparatus comprising a network orchestration unit, a detection and prediction unit and a migration handling unit, wherein: said network orchestration unit is configured to monitor said plurality of working nodes and configure network resources for said plurality of working nodes; said detection and prediction unit is configured to detect or predict a Service Level Agreement, SLA, violation at a target node comprised in said plurality of working nodes; and said migration handling unit is configured to trigger migration of a target service provided by a target application running on said target node to a destination node, in a case where a time to violation related to said predicted or detected SLA violation is less than a duration of a migration sensitive window related to said migration.

title: System and Method for Podcast Repetitive Content Detection
abstract: In one aspect, a method includes detecting a fingerprint match between query fingerprint data representing at least one audio segment within podcast content and reference fingerprint data representing known repetitive content within other podcast content, detecting a feature match between a set of audio features across multiple time-windows of the podcast content, and detecting a text match between at least one query text sentences from a transcript of the podcast content and reference text sentences, the reference text sentences comprising text sentences from the known repetitive content within the other podcast content. The method also includes responsive to the detections, generating sets of labels identifying potential repetitive content within the podcast content. The method also includes selecting, from the sets of labels, a consolidated set of labels identifying segments of repetitive content within the podcast content, and responsive to selecting the consolidated set of labels, performing an action.

title: Systems and methods for estimating a crypto-agility score of a network of computing assets
abstract: Systems, apparatuses, methods, and computer program products are disclosed for estimating a crypto-agility score of a network of computing assets. An example method includes receiving a network graph and a set of expert-determined importance weights and selecting a first network node from a set of network nodes. The example method further includes computing an upgrade cost for the first network node based on a set of dependency network nodes and applying an expert-determined importance weight to the upgrade cost for the first network node to determine a weighted upgrade cost for the first network node. The example method further includes adding the weighted upgrade cost for the first network node to a set of weighted upgrade costs and summing, by the graph circuitry, each weighted upgrade cost from the set of weighted full upgrade costs to determine the crypto-agility score for the network of computer assets.

title: Memory system
abstract: According to one embodiment, a memory system includes a memory device and a memory controller. The memory device includes a first and a second memory cells, a word line coupled to the first and second memory cells, a first bit line coupled to the first memory cell, a second bit line coupled to the second memory cell, a sense amplifier module including a first and a second latch circuit, and a data register. In a first read operation, the first latch circuit stores first data corresponding to the first bit line, the second latch circuit stores second data corresponding to the second bit line, and the data register stores data of the first memory cell based on an operation result using the first data, and stores data of the second memory cell based on an operation result using the second data.

title: Integrated circuit with electrostatic discharge structure
abstract: An integrated circuit is provided and includes a header circuit coupled to a first voltage terminal providing a first supply voltage and configured to provide a second supply voltage at a second voltage terminal; a receiver/transmitter circuit coupled between the second voltage terminal and a third voltage terminal providing a third supply voltage smaller than the second supply voltage; and an electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection circuit coupled to a pad and the receiver/transmitter circuit, and further coupled between the first voltage terminal and the third voltage terminal.
assignee: Tsmc China Company Limited; Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Ltd.

title: Customized wearable saliva biosensor for real-time continuous health monitoring
abstract: A customized wearable saliva biosensor system for continuous, real-time, in-situ monitoring of biochemical markers in human saliva. The system integrates a multi-gate organic electrochemical transistor biosensor employing an organic semiconductor channel with enzyme-functionalized gate electrodes, a compact wireless integrated circuit with Bluetooth data transmission, a power subsystem optionally incorporating piezoelectric and/or triboelectric nanogenerators, and a custom-fitted wearable substrate fabricated from a three-dimensional scan of the user's dental anatomy. The system is positioned within the oral cavity in proximity to the sublingual glands for direct detection of fresh saliva at the point of secretion. A differential measurement architecture comparing an enzyme gate to a control gate provides selective, real-time detection of target biomarkers including glucose, lactate, and uric acid. Measured data is wirelessly transmitted to a companion mobile application for display to the user.

title: Fermenting pharmaceuticals to reduce adduct risks coupled with functional enzyme metrics
abstract: Disclosed are kits, methods, systems, and devices for reducing mutagen-related biomolecular adduct risk during pharmacotherapy. A therapeutic agent comprising an active pharmaceutical ingredient or a therapeutic supplement is combined with one or more adjunct components selected from probiotics, antioxidants, buffering agents, chelators, plant-derived materials, algae-derived materials, enzymes, vitamins, and combinations thereof to form a mixture that is fermented prior to oral or topical administration. Biomarker data comprising one or more adductomic endpoints is obtained from a subject and compared with functional protein metrics and comparator data, thus subsequent preparation cycles are adjusted by modifying one or more fermentation parameters including duration, temperature, pH, light exposure, concentration, and/or order of adjunct addition. Clinical, pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, and/or functional protein metrics are used to guide adjustment. System embodiments include one or more kits, compositions, vessels, and instructions configured to output updated preparation instructions while maintaining intended therapeutic efficacy.

title: Capacitor bank controller
abstract: A capacitor bank control enclosure including an outer housing having an inner door assembly that separates an interior of the outer housing into forward and rearward portions. The inner door assembly selectively blocks access to the rearward portion of the interior. At least a modular PCB closure is mounted in the rearward portion. The modular PCB closure is removable from the outer housing as a unit without disassembling the modular PCB closure. In various examples, a radio, antenna connections, input cables, and other components also can be mounted within the rearward portion of the interior. An electronic display can be carried by the inner door assembly.

title: Method and apparatus for resource re-evaluation and pre-emption using cot sharing
abstract: Methods and apparatus are described. A wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) includes a processor and a transceiver that reserve a first channel occupancy time (COT) for a transmission and detect whether a second COT reservation exists for another WTRU that starts from a slot within the first COT. The processor and the transceiver perform listen-before-talk (LBT) and send the transmission in the first COT in a channel based on the processor and the transceiver determining that the second COT reservation exists. The transmission includes an identifier for the other WTRU. The identifier is an indication for the other WTRU to N Second COT Y share the COT.

title: Systems and methods for preserving and manipulating acute otomies
abstract: Various types of otomy control devices that secure a periphery and/or adjacent tissue of a target otomy site and maintain the size of an otomy through a single wall of a vessel, organ, or lumen within the body. Among other things, this can reduce unintentional trauma, dilation, contraction, or locomotion of an otomy during a surgical procedure. They also can serve a beneficial purpose of allowing immediate communication between lumens before the complete creation of A permanent anastomosis. In some embodiments, magnetic compression anastomosis devices and/or other devices can be deployed through a channel of the otomy control device such as for deployment in a distal lumen.

title: Natural gas reforming system and process thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a natural gas reforming system capable of reducing, by using a co-electrolysis device, the emission amount of carbon dioxide produced by reforming natural gas, of supplying heat to a reformer through syngas produced by the co-electrolysis, and of producing additional hydrogen, and a process thereof.

title: Display method and apparatus for head-mounted device, and device, system and medium
abstract: A display method and apparatus for a head-mounted device, and a device, a system and a medium are disclosed. The display method is applied to a first electronic device, and includes: acquiring service requirement information of at least one head-mounted device; in response to determining that each head-mounted device requires a first target service among first services and a second target service among second services according to the service requirement information, acquiring first image data of the first target service, and acquiring second image data of the second target service from a second electronic device; synthesizing the first and second image data to obtain synthesized image data; and sending it to the head-mounted device, the head-mounted device displays it, image display being highly limited due to that the head-mounted device can display only image data of a service executing on a data processing unit can be solved.

title: Red teaming ai agent to generate exploits for testing code
abstract: An Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent described herein operates in at least one of a white box role or a black box role. In the white box role, the AI agent receives notification of a source code vulnerability, generates an exploit code for the vulnerability based on the source code and on at least one of context from past operations, large language model (LLM) predefined templates, or an embedding from an exploit code database, and provides that exploit code for testing on a patched code. In the black box role, the AI agent receives an indication of a target compiled code, generates an exploit code based on the target compiled code and on at least one of the context from past operations, the LLM predefined templates, or the embedding from the exploit code database, and provides that exploit code for testing on the target compiled code.

title: Output private distributed vrfs and application to blockchains
abstract: This disclosure relates generally to a method of generating a blinded random output, including executing a randomness request by a requester; sharing fractions of a key with a committee to generate partial evaluations of a random output, the partial evaluations being blinded; aggregating the partial evaluations of the random output, the partial evaluations of the random output also being blinded; generating a blinded public output corresponding to the randomness request; and sending the blinded public output to the requester, such that the requester may obtain the private random output.

title: Battery Cell Including Electrode Tab Having Stress Relief Portion
abstract: A battery cell including an electrode assembly including a plurality of electrode plates and at least one separator interposed between the plurality of electrode plates, a case configured to receive the electrode assembly, electrode tabs formed at the electrode plates so as to protrude and extend therefrom, and an electrode lead joined to the electrode tabs while being electrically connected to the outside is provided. Each of the electrode tabs includes a first tab portion connected to a corresponding one of the electrode plates and a second tab portion extending from the first tab portion, the electrode lead being joined to the second tab portion, and the first tab portion is provided with a stress relief portion configured to reduce stress in the electrode tab.

title: Stowable vehicle seat assembly and vehicle with open midgate configuration
abstract: Vehicles and adjustable seat assemblies are disclosed herein. In an embodiment, a vehicle seat assembly includes a seat bottom, a seat backrest and a plurality of support linkages. The seat backrest is pivotally attached to the seat bottom. The support linkages are configured to support the seat bottom above a vehicle floor. The support linkages each have a first end and a second end. The first end is configured to pivotally attach to the vehicle floor, and the second end is pivotally attached to the seat bottom. The support linkages are configured to simultaneously pivot at the first and second ends to move the seat bottom towards the vehicle floor when the seat bottom moves from an upright configuration to a stowed configuration and to move the seat bottom away from the vehicle floor when the seat bottom moves from the stowed configuration to the upright configuration.

title: Frac dart
abstract: A fracturing dart configured to seal the internal bore of a fracturing plug within a wellbore may comprise a body with a lower tapered section, a central shoulder section, and an upper cylindrical section. The fracturing dart may also comprise a first sealing assembly disposed on the lower tapered portion of the body and configured to engage an inner surface of the internal bore of the fracturing plug. The fracturing dart may also comprise a second sealing assembly disposed proximate to the central shoulder section and configured to engage a seat formed in the internal bore. The fracturing dart may also comprise one or more shear pins that engage the upper cylindrical section of the body and are configured to shear upon the application of a predetermined force in a downhole direction within the wellbore.

title: Method of forming a chiplet device prototype
abstract: A method includes (a) forming a first device including first bond pads, and first function circuitry located in a partial footprint of the first device, (b) forming a second device including second bond pads, and second function circuitry located in a partial footprint of the second device, (c) forming first relocated bond pads within the partial footprint of the first IC device, and forming redistribution layer (RDL) structures to connect respective first bond pads with respective first relocated bond pads, (d) forming second relocated bond pads within the partial footprint of the second IC device, and forming RDL structures to connect respective second bond pads with respective second relocated bond pads, and (e) forming RDL interconnection structures to connect first relocated bond pads with second relocated bond pads.

title: Fiber optic module
abstract: The present invention relates to a fiber optic module ( 102 ) having a base unit ( 104 ) defined by a base ( 200 ) and at least two opposing side walls ( 202 ) such that the base ( 200 ) and the at least two opposing side walls ( 202 ) forms a zone ( 204 ), a top plate ( 106 ) removably engaged with the base unit ( 104 ), and a single piece integrated adapter ( 108 ) removably engaged at the first end ( 104   a ) of the base unit ( 104 ). In particular, the base unit ( 104 ) has a first end ( 104   a ) and a second end ( 104   b ). Further, the top plate ( 106 ) and the base unit ( 104 ) define one or more openings ( 228   a - 228   b ) when the top plate ( 106 ) is attached to the base unit ( 104 ).

title: Piezoelectric laminate, piezoelectric element, and method for manufacturing piezoelectric laminate
abstract: A piezoelectric laminate, including: a substrate; and a laminated film provided on at least one surface of the substrate, in which the laminated film includes, in order from a substrate side, an electrode layer, a base layer, and a piezoelectric thin film, the base layer and the piezoelectric thin film are in contact with each other, the base layer contains a nitrogen compound containing at least one element selected from the group consisting of Group III to VI elements, and the piezoelectric thin film has an absolute value |e 31   f | of a piezoelectric constant of 0.5 C/m 2  or more.

title: Composite ammonium diuranate gel particles with a phenolic resin phase, and methods of making the same
abstract: Composite gel particles with an ammonium diuranate matrix phase and a phenolic resin phase incorporated within the ammonium diuranate matrix phase are produced from a first solution comprising uranyl nitrate, a phenol, and optionally formaldehyde; and a second solution comprising hexamethylenetetramine and urea. The uranyl nitrate and the phenol are present in a ratio ranging from 2:1 to 25:1 The first solution and the second solution are mixed, and drops of the resulting mixture into a heated second liquid which is immiscible with the mixed solution. Heat from the second liquid causes the hexamethylenetetramine to decompose to form ammonia, which reacts with the uranyl nitrate to cause each of the drops to form an ammonium diuranate gel particle. The ammonium diuranate gel particles include the phenolic resin phase within the ammonium diuranate matrix phase.

title: Method for generating new gene in organism and use thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical fields of genetic engineering and bioinformatics, in particular, to a method for creating a new gene in an organism in the absence of an artificial DNA template, and a use thereof. The method comprises simultaneously generating DNA breaks at two or more different specific sites in the organism's genome, wherein the specific sites are genomic sites capable of separating different genetic elements or different protein domains, and the DNA breaks are ligated to each other through non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) or homologous repair to generate a new combination of the different gene elements or different protein domains that is different from the original genome sequence, thereby creating a new gene. The new gene of the invention can change the growth, development, resistance, yield and other traits of the organism, and has great value in application.
assignee: Qingdao Kingagroot Chemical Compound Co., Ltd.

title: Surgical specimen mapping mechanism
abstract: The herein disclosed invention constitutes a surgical specimen margin orientation marking mechanism comprising a plurality of surgical specimen margin markers configured to provide a mapping between a tumor mass and surrounding tissue, wherein the improvement comprises each surgical specimen margin marker comprising sutures placed on tissue to identify one or more locations at which tissue is to be removed or surrounding tissue.

title: Mineral crystallizer systems and methods for solids separation
abstract: Mineral Crystallizers systems and methods for solidifying dissolved minerals including a ball mill evaporator. The systems and methods include wetting heated media with a brine solution. The ball mill evaporator transports and agitates the heated media to disengage salt scale adhered to the heated media. The systems and methods enhance the transfer of heat into a brine and continuously remove salt scale as brine concentration approaches solid cake.

title: Basket catheter with cloverleaf structure to prevent buckling and retention feature for electrodes
abstract: A medical probe is presented including an expandable basket assembly coupled to a distal end of a tubular shaft. The basket assembly includes a cloverleaf cutout structure at its distal end and spines extending proximally from the cloverleaf structure and coupling to the tubular shaft. The cloverleaf structure includes a sinusoidal-like member extending from one spine to an adjacent spine in a direction around the longitudinal axis. The sinusoidal-like member meanders around a first, second and third virtual circle such that the first and third virtual circles are approximately the same distance from a longitudinal axis of the medical probe and approximately the same size and the second virtual circle is between the first and second virtual circles, closer to the longitudinal axis, and having approximately 90% of the first open area of the first and third virtual circles.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor configured to acquire surrounding conversation in real time via a microphone and generate corresponding audio data. The processor converts the audio data into text using a speech recognition engine and analyzes the text using a natural language processing engine to extract at least a conversation theme, emotion, and intention. The processor accesses a user profile database including interests, concerns, conversation history, and personality traits, and generates conversation topics using a machine learning or rule-based model based on the analysis result and user profile information. The processor monitors conversation flow to determine a timing to introduce the generated topics and converts the topics into synthesized speech for output from a device worn by the user.

title: Real estate information system
abstract: A real estate information system is provided. The system operates to provide interaction regarding homes for sale allowing users to obtain information regarding a property that is geo-based for that property and engage is immediate obtaining information and/or viewing of the property through standard messaging applications.

title: Mosfet transistor
abstract: A method of forming a MOSFET transistor includes forming, on a semiconductor layer, a stack of a gate insulator and a gate region on the gate insulator. The gate region is etched to include a first gate portion and a second gate portion between the first gate portion and the gate insulator. The etching defines the first gate portion with a first length in a first lateral direction of the transistor, and defines the second gate portion with a second length in the first lateral direction that is shorter than the first length.

title: Method, device and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium for detecting deepfake of face video
abstract: A method, a device and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium for detecting deepfake in face video, the method first performing a frame-splitting process on the video to be detected, and performing face recognition on each frame image after the frame-splitting process to obtain a recognized face and a face region. Next, extract the region covered by an edge of the face region in the consecutive frame images, and detect a still region from the covered region. Extract feature blocks in the still region, and determine whether the recognized face is a real face based on the changing state of the RGB value of each pixel in the feature blocks.
assignee: Nanning FuLain FuGui Precision Industrial Co., Ltd.

title: Method for the compression of genome sequence data
abstract: The invention relates to a reference-based method for the compression of genome sequence data produced by a sequencing machine. A read record is determined to correspond to a read that is imperfectly mapped to a reference sequence and then selectively encoded based on a number of mismatches of the imperfectly mapped read and a predetermined byte size, where the encoding selectively uses offset-based encoding or another encoding method depending on whether the number of mismatches exceeds a predetermined threshold number.

title: Electrode assembly and rechargeable battery including the same
abstract: An electrode assembly and a battery including the same are disclosed. The electrode assembly includes a first electrode plate, a second electrode plate, and a separator interposed between the first electrode plate and the second electrode plate. An overhang portion of the separator relative to the first electrode plate and the second electrode plate is folded in a plurality of layers in a thickness direction of the separator.

title: Survival Belt No. 18
abstract:
The invention provides a Survival Belt No. 18 that straps across the waistline worn as a belt. The structure is made up of varies fabrics, nylons or leather. The belt features eighteen compartments for items: double pocket cell phones, guns, knife, hammer, flashlight, nails, rope, and bullets slots. The Survival Belt No. 18 provides emergency and disaster equipment readily and available in times for safety. Security is a major safety issue whether on the go or at home or camping out will sustain a consumer's life. Natural disasters are on the rise, protecting and supporting is vital for families to survive emergency. The Survival Belt No. 18 will also be used in tactical training law enforcement with additional items. With the increasing crime rates, the public will be forced to defend themselves in order to survive. 
     Having vital items during an earthquake, blackouts, and emergencies will determine one's safety.

title: Read head for a turntable
abstract: A read head comprising an electromechanical microsystem comprising: a stylus to engage with the microgroove of the LP record, a primary microbeam at a first of which the stylus is mounted, a first electromechanical transduction device extending from a second end of the primary microbeam, opposite the first end, and a second electromechanical transduction device extending from the second end of the primary microbeam. The first and second electromechanical transduction devices making it possible to convert a movement of the stylus into a first electric signal and a second electric signal, respectively for a first audio channel and a second audio channel.
assignee: Commissariat A L'energie Atomique Et Aux Energies Alternatives

title: Carrier and/or fork board with weight measurement for a lifting device, lifting device provided therewith and method therefor
abstract: The invention relates to a carrier for loads, such as a fork for a lifting device, and a fork board and/or lifting device provided with such a carrier and associated method. The carrier according to the invention comprises:—coupling means configured to couple the carrier to the lifting device;—a carrier part for carrying loads,—an optical fiber cable arranged in or on the carrier part; and—an optical fiber controller which is operatively connectable to the optical fiber cable and is configured to perform a measurement with the optical fiber cable, such that the weight of the load or loads on the carrier can be determined.

title: Electrical debonding adhesive sheet, joined body, and method for separating joined body
abstract: An electrical debonding adhesive sheet includes a substrate for voltage application having a conductive layer. The electrical debonding adhesive sheet also includes a first adhesive layer. The first adhesive layer includes an electrically debondable adhesive. The first adhesive layer is on the conductive layer of the substrate for voltage application. The electrical debonding adhesive sheet further includes a second adhesive layer on a surface of the substrate for voltage application opposite to the first adhesive layer. The electrical debonding adhesive sheet has, on at least one surface of the electrical debonding adhesive sheet, an electrode contact portion, which is a portion to which an adherend is not attached. A surface of the electrode contact portion to which the adherend is not attached has a portion where the conductive layer is not exposed in at least a part of the surface of the electrode contact portion.

title: Multiplex assay reader and microfluidic test cartridge
abstract: A card reading system in which electrical contacts between the assay card and the card reader are made through vertical actuation of a card interface relative to the assay card. In one embodiment, the assay card reading system comprises: (a) a card reader comprising at least one card interface, the card interface having a plurality of card interface contacts; (b) an assay card having card contacts; (c) a vertical actuation mechanism for causing relative vertical movement between the assay card and the card interface to contact at least a portion of the card interface contacts with the card contacts.

title: Transferrin receptor binding molecule conjugates for delivery of oligonucleotides to cells
abstract: Provided herein are conjugates comprising: an anti-TfR antibody antigen binding domain that binds to a transferrin receptor and an oligonucleotide(s). The conjugates can be used to deliver an oligonucleotide to a cell that expresses the transferrin receptor. Delivering the oligonucleotide to a cell can be used to modulate expression of a target gene or sequence in the cell.

title: Coaxial drive system with dual wheel-side motors for left and right wheels of battery electric vehicle
abstract: Disclosed is a coaxial drive system with dual wheel-side motors for left and right wheels of a battery electric vehicle, including a first motor and a second motor located on two sides of a wheel hub. The first motor includes a motor housing and a reducer housing. A motor rotating shaft is arranged in the motor housing. A reduction mechanism is arranged in the reducer housing. The motor rotating shaft is connected to the reduction mechanism. The reduction mechanism is connected to a wheel hub rotating shaft. The second motor has the same structure as the first motor, and a clutch mechanism is arranged between a reduction mechanism and a wheel hub rotating shaft in the second motor.
assignee: Zhejiang Xin Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.

title: Method of commissioning an elevator system, elevator system and method of providing power to a landing operating panel
abstract: A method of commissioning an elevator system is described. The method includes sensing for a presence of an elevator car in front of a landing door at a landing of the elevator system and upon detecting the presence of the elevator car in front of the landing door: switching on a power transmitter; wirelessly providing power from the power transmitter to a power receiver provided in a landing door operating panel mounted on a movable door panel of the landing door; bringing a wireless connector of the landing door operating panel into an operation mode for pairing; bringing a further wireless connector of the landing door controller into an operation mode for pairing; and pairing the landing door operating panel with the landing door controller by establishing a wireless connection between the wireless connector and the further wireless connector.

title: Belief space management for digital artifacts
abstract: A system for facilitating belief space management for digital artifacts is provided. The system includes a storage element and processing circuitry coupled thereto. The storage element stores a set of digital artifacts and a set of belief spaces associated with the set of digital artifacts. The processing circuitry detects an event associated with a digital artifact. The processing circuitry accesses, based on the detection of the event, a belief space associated with the digital artifact. The processing circuitry determines a plurality of attribute values for a plurality of attributes associated with the digital artifact. The processing circuitry identifies, from the belief space, a subset of belief types associated with the digital artifact. The subset of belief types is associated with a subset of belief states. The processing circuitry updates, based on the plurality of attribute values, the subset of belief states for the subset of belief types.

title: Immunoglobulin single variable domains targeting pd-1
abstract: The present technology provides polypeptides that binds to PD-1. The present technology also provides nucleic acids, vectors and compositions. Also provided are multispecific binding proteins (e.g., bispecific binding proteins) that targeting a TNF receptor superfamily (TNFRSF) receptor (e.g., GITR) and an immune checkpoint protein (e.g., PD-1).

title: Swimming pool cover
abstract: A swimming pool cover includes a flexible cover layer, a hanging lug, and a first tightening rope body. The flexible cover layer includes a middle part and a peripheral part. The peripheral part is connected to the middle part. The middle part is used for covering a swimming pool opening of a swimming pool. The peripheral part is used for surrounding an outer side wall of the swimming pool. The peripheral part is provided with a first outer edge. The hanging lug is connected to the covering layer. The hanging lug is positioned on the peripheral part. A spacing is defined between the hanging lug and the first outer edge. The hanging lug is provided with a first rope threading opening. The first tightening rope body is threaded through the first rope threading opening. A spacing is defined between the first tightening rope body and the first outer edge.

title: Method and system for creating a stitched design file
abstract: A system, software application, and method for optical device metrology of optical device patterns formed from lithography stitching are provided. In one example, the method includes creating a stitched design file comprising images of a plurality of masks; defining target coordinates for each of the plurality of masks in the stitched design file; defining an alignment mark for the stitched design file; capturing images of an optical device pattern at each of the target coordinates; comparing the captured images of the optical device pattern at each of the target coordinates to virtual images of the stitched design file at each of the target coordinates; and determining whether the optical device pattern at each of the target coordinates meets a threshold value.

title: Video image rendering based on motion vector prediction
abstract: A computer implemented method of generating updated video data for use in a computer game is disclosed. The method comprises partially rendering (S 17 ) an updated video frame based on previous motion vectors and/or previous controller inputs (S 16 ) and at least one existing frame of video data (S 13 ). The method also comprises receiving (S 18 ) real updated video data from a remote server, and completing (S 19 ) rendering of the updated video frame.

title: Process and system for simultaneous nitrification and denitrification
abstract: Disclosed are a process and system for simultaneous nitrification and denitrification of wastewater. The process comprises: (i) subjecting mixed liquor to treatment within at least one membrane aerated bioreactor (MABR), to provide a MABR effluent; (ii) treating said MABR effluent within at least one aeration tank to provide treated mixed liquor, wherein treating said MABR effluent within the at least one aeration tank comprises controlling dissolved oxygen (DO) concentration to be within a concentration range that supports simultaneous nitrification and denitrification within said at least one aeration tank; and (iii) discharging said treated mixed liquor; wherein said is under conditions to provide simultaneous nitrification and denitrification without circulation of mixed liquor. The system also comprises sensors for nitrogen species and a control interface configured for maintaining dissolved oxygen (DO) concentration in the at least one aeration tank according to data from the sensors, and the DO concentration being limited within a range that supports simultaneous nitrification and denitrification.
assignee: Fluence Water Products And Innovation Ltd

title: System and Method for Displaying Computational Chemistry Information using a Data Pipeline and AI Language Models
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for presenting computational chemistry and molecular modeling information within an interactive conversational interface. A backend data pipeline generates and stores computational artifacts associated with molecules and/or molecule-receptor complexes, including structural representations and visualization assets. A conversational agent comprising an AI language model generates a natural-language response that includes one or more machine-interpretable visualization directives embedded in the response, each visualization directive comprising a directive type and an artifact reference corresponding to a respective artifact. A client application parses the response, identifies the visualization directives, resolves the artifact references to obtain renderable representations or resource locators, and renders corresponding 2D and/or 3D visualizations inline within the conversational interface, including within tabular content. In some embodiments, resolution is performed by a resolver service that returns a renderable resource locator, such as a signed URL or a streaming endpoint, and rendering metadata and enforces authorization and artifact-type restrictions. The disclosed approach improves reliability, scalability, and usability of conversational scientific interfaces by deterministically binding narrative text to specific computational artifacts.

title: Vertically biased cutters with pulsating valve assemblies
abstract: Vascular cutter devices, systems, and methods are provided to effectively cut and remove all types of thrombus and atheroma tissue, whether soft, tough, or hard, and can do so with a reduced risk of suffering vessel injuries while avoiding an undesirable volume of blood loss during procedures. Thrombectomy systems having curved tubular cutting devices, and methods of using them, are provided. These systems, devices, and methods can (i) effectively cut and remove a variety of thrombus tissue from blood vessels, including soft, tough, and hard tissue; (ii) safely self-collect and remove tissue particles to avoid release of emboli; (iii) effectively treat a blood vessel with a reduced risk of suffering vessel injuries that can lead to increased stenosis; and (iv) effectively reduce blood loss during a procedure.

title: Stacked power modules and method of manufacturing
abstract: An electronic component includes a first assembly and a second assembly. The first assembly includes a first power overlay (POL) that provides electrical connections to at least one semiconductor device included in the first subassembly. The second subassembly includes a second POL that provides electrical connections to at least one semiconductor device included in the second subassembly. The second subassembly is stacked on the first subassembly with electrical connections between the first and second subassemblies that form a power module.

title: Non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing data transmission program and method of creating color embroidery
abstract: A set of program instructions, when executed, causes a data transmission apparatus to perform generating embroidery data for sewing a first pattern on a sewing workpiece. The first pattern is a pattern indicated by a plurality of stitches of a first color arranged in a region enclosed by a contour line of a particular shape. The set of program instructions causes the data transmission apparatus to perform generating print data for printing a second pattern on a print medium. The second pattern is obtained by horizontally flipping an original pattern. The original pattern is a pattern in which the region is filled with a plurality of colors including a second color different from the first color. The set of program instructions causes the data transmission apparatus to perform transmitting the embroidery data to a sewing machine, and transmitting the print data to a printer.

title: System and Method for Treating a Patient by Applying an Electric Field
abstract: A bioelectric device for treating a patient comprises a flexible substrate with strategically placed zinc reservoirs functioning as half-cells of a battery when contacting skin. The device operates through zinc's negative potential driving oxidation when exposed to perspiration and oxygen, generating therapeutic microcurrents without external power. Zinc particles are embedded rather than encapsulated, maintaining exposure while ensuring structural integrity. Clinical applications include moisture control, muscle fatigue relief, accelerated purpura resolution, skin health improvement, anti-aging benefits, enhanced iontophoresis, wound healing, and muscle stimulation. The device, implementable as wearable garments, maintains effectiveness through 40+ washing cycles, providing a self-sustaining approach to pain management, tissue regeneration, and dermatological treatment without requiring batteries, electronics, or professional supervision.

title: Automated ai model optimization for microcontrollers
abstract: A method of AI model optimization is disclosed. The method can include obtaining a hardware profile of a microcontroller unit (MCU); deriving a plurality of constraints based on the hardware profile; training a baseline AI model using a training dataset, to produce a trained model; performing a first pruning on the trained model, to produce a first pruned model; retraining the first pruned model using the training dataset, to produce a retrained pruned model; performing a second pruning on the retrained pruned model, to produce a second pruned model; and retraining the second pruned model to produce a quantized pruned model.

title: System and method for playing a game of chance
abstract: A method for playing a game of chance includes providing a graphical user interface that has an upper segment and a lower segment. The method also includes displaying one of a plurality of upper reels on the upper segment, or a plurality of lower reels on the lower segment. The method also includes displaying the one of the upper reels or the lower reels spinning in response to activation of an input device, and displaying a first randomized arrangement of indicia on the one of the upper or lower reels. The method also includes identifying a presence of a special indicia among the first randomized arrangement of indicia. The method also includes displaying the other of the upper reels or the lower reels in response to the identification of the special indicia as a mirror image of the other.

title: Heater cartridge and hot air device
abstract: A heater cartridge is disclosed including a first pipe having a connector to be coupled to an electrical contact provided on the handle, a heater electrically connected to the connector, a second pipe having an inner space for housing the heater and a front end which is opened, a large diameter portion positioned between the first pipe and the second pipe, the large diameter portion having an external shape with diameter larger than the outer diameters of both the first pipe and the second pipe. The large diameter portion is formed with a connection-through space communicating with the inner space of the second pipe, and with an introduction passage mutually communicating with the outside of the large diameter portion and the connection-through space. When the heater cartridge is placed within the insertion hole of the handle, gas supplied into the insertion hole flows into the connection-through space via the introduction passage.

title: System, apparatus and kit for thematic game-based learning
abstract: System, apparatus and kit for thematic game-based learning is disclosed. In one embodiment, a thematic game-based learning system includes a server, and user devices communicatively coupled to the server via a network. The server includes a theme-based learning module is configured to generate a virtual game board having a plurality of spaces. The plurality of spaces includes a start space, an end space, one or more spaces having icons of different types corresponding to a knowledge-based learning sub-theme. The server is configured to generate stacks of virtual cards corresponding to unique knowledge-based learning sub-themes. Each virtual card includes a theme-based learning challenge. The server is configured to dynamically select a virtual card from a stack of virtual cards corresponding to a type of icon on which the virtual game piece is positioned, and display a theme-based learning challenge on the selected virtual card on the respective user devices.

title: Eddy current devices and methods for fuel channel inspection
abstract: Devices and methods for eddy current inspection of fuel channels. An eddy current inspection device includes an array of eddy current sensors positioned around the outer circumference of a non-rotating section. The device is inserted into the interior of a pressure tube, the active coils of the eddy current sensors are driven in an activation pattern, and data is collected from the reference coils of the eddy current sensors in a collection pattern. The relative placement of the eddy current sensors, the relative placement of the active and reference coils of each eddy current sensor, the activation pattern, and the collection pattern may be configured to mitigate cross-talk and/or maximize sensor coverage of pressure tube regions in between adjacent eddy current sensors.

title: Automatic Rescue System for Swimming Pools
abstract: An automatic rescue system for swimming pools includes a floor-spanning net secured to high-tensile ropes that are wound around reversible drive shafts mounted along opposed longitudinal pool walls. Deflection pulleys guide the ropes so the net can be moved synchronously from the pool bottom to a position at or above the water surface. A control unit monitors at least one of pressure/weight, motion, hydro-acoustic, ultrasonic or radio-tag sensors; when a person, animal or object in distress is detected, the unit energizes geared motors at both ends of each shaft to lift the net. A mechanical or electromagnetic brake prevents unintended descent, particularly during power loss. The net is made of chlorine- and UV-resistant high-strength polymer fibers. Wearable RFID, BLE or UWB tags identify authorized swimmers, and absence of a tag initiates an alarm. All active components meet at least IP- 68  ingress protection. A manually or externally triggered variant omits the sensor and control features.

title: Treatment compositions
abstract: The present disclosure relates to liquid fabric treatment compositions comprising, based upon total composition weight from about 0.01% to about 2% of a MMW polymer derived from the polymerization of from about 5 to 100 mole percent of a cationic vinyl addition monomer, from about 0 to 95 mole percent of a non-ionic vinyl addition monomer, wherein the molecular weight of the MMW polymer is from about 400,000 to about 1,800,000 Daltons, and from about 1% to about 25% of a fabric softener active material.

title: Bupropion as a modulator of drug activity
abstract: This disclosure relates to administration of a combination of: 1) about 100-110 mg, about 104-106 mg, or about 105 mg or less of bupropion hydrochloride, or a molar equivalent amount of the free base form or another salt form of bupropion; and 2) about 40-50 mg, about 44-46 mg, or about 45 mg or less of dextromethorphan hydrobromide, or a molar equivalent amount of the free base form or another salt form of dextromethorphan in human patients for treating neurological and psychiatric conditions, such as agitation associated Alzheimer's disease and/or reducing relapse of agitation in Alzheimer's disease.

title: Method and Apparatus for Determining Maintenance of DC Busbar Filtering Electrolytic Capacitor
abstract: Various embodiments include methods for determining maintenance of a DC busbar filtering electrolytic capacitor. An example includes: recording a DC busbar voltage of a capacitor in a driving circuit of a driving motor during charging capacitor, wherein the is the difference between voltages at two ends of the capacitor; determining a charging starting time point and a charging ending time point according to the recorded DC busbar voltages, and selecting a time point from time points between the charging starting time point and the charging ending time point; calculating a time constant according to a starting voltage corresponding to the charging starting time point, an ending voltage corresponding to the charging ending time point, the selected time point and the voltage corresponding to the selected time point; and determining whether it is necessary to perform maintenance for the capacitor based on the time constant.

title: Systems and methods for executing electronic transactions using secure identity data
abstract: The invention relates generally to secure data entry devices and methods of using such devices. A secure data entry device is provided that includes an integrated imaging device arranged such that it captures at least one image of a user during a transaction. The at least one image is processed in order to generate a biometric pattern. In one embodiment the at least one image includes a user's face and the processing involves applying a facial recognition algorithm to the at least one image to generate the biometric pattern. In some embodiments the biometric pattern is compared to a trusted biometric pattern in order to determine whether to approve or decline the

title: Systems and methods for conducting a multi-part lottery game
abstract: An instant gaming ticket comprises multiple play areas with each play area providing a set of values for play in a primary lottery-type game defined by gameplay rules and one or more winning conditions. A winning value satisfying one of the winning conditions of a primary game in a certain play area may be dependent on the set of values assigned to another primary game in another play area. The instant gaming ticket may optionally support secondary games. A winning value satisfying one of the winning conditions of a secondary game may be dependent on one or more sets of assigned values for the primary games.

title: Water discharge device
abstract: A water discharge device includes a switcher and a control circuit unit. The switcher switches between a first discharge state of discharging supplied water and a second discharge state of discharging a fluid obtained by mixing an additive into supplied water, through electrical operation. The control circuit unit controls switching by the switcher based on operation input from a user. When the second discharge state has been selected by operation input and when a certain time has elapsed from the start of discharge in the second discharge state, the control circuit unit switches the operating state to the first discharge state.

title: Digital-to-analog circuit calibration for a successive approximation register analog-to-digital converter
abstract: An analog-to-digital converter includes a first capacitive digital-to-analog converter (DAC) having a first plurality of binary weighted capacitors, a first calibration DAC having a first plurality of variable capacitors, each variable capacitor being configured to be coupled in parallel with a corresponding capacitor in the first plurality of binary weighted capacitors, a second capacitive DAC having a second plurality of binary weighted capacitors, a second calibration DAC having a second plurality of variable capacitors, each variable capacitor being configured for coupling in parallel with a corresponding capacitor in the second plurality of binary weighted capacitors, and calibration logic configured to provide control signals that select a capacitance for each of the first plurality of variable capacitors and the second plurality of variable capacitors based on a calibration signal that is representative of differences between outputs of the first capacitive DAC and the second capacitive DAC.

title: Virus-inactivating liquid agent and virus-inactivating article
abstract: A method for inactivating a virus is provided. The method includes contacting the virus with a virus-inactivating liquid agent. The virus-inactivating liquid agent includes a liquid medium; and particles of a layered material including one or plural layers, wherein the one or plural layers include a layer body represented by M m X n . Mis at least one first metal of Group 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7, X is a carbon atom, a nitrogen atom, or a combination thereof, n is 1 to 4, and m is more than n and 5 or less.
