A modifier or terminal T exists on a surface of the layer body, and T is at least one selected from the group consisting of a hydroxyl group, a fluorine atom, a chlorine atom, or an oxygen atom. Moreover, an average value of thicknesses of the particles is 10 nm or less.

title: Surgeon swap control
abstract: An aspect includes a computer-implemented method that associates surgical data with a first surgeon of the surgical team and detects a selection of a surgeon swap control through a user interface during the surgical procedure. An association of the surgical data to a second surgeon of the surgical team is created for subsequently collected surgical data based on the selection. The surgical data captured during the surgical procedure with the associations can be provided to an analytics engine to determine surgical analytics for each of the first surgeon and the second surgeon.

title: Recombinant strain of n-acyl-homoserine lactonase aio6 without resistance selection marker and use thereof
abstract: A recombinant strain of N-acyl-homoserine lactonase AIO6 without resistance selection marker and its application are provided. The method for constructing a recombinant  Escherichia coli  strain without resistance selection marker includes introducing the coding gene of N-acyl-homoserine lactonase AIO6 into recipient  Escherichia coli , followed by screening without antibiotic resistance markers to obtain the recombinant  E. coli . The construction of this recombinant strain of N-acyl-homoserine lactonase AIO6 without resistance selection marker significantly enhances the application of AIO6 in production. Moreover, compared to previously reported AIO6 strains, the N-acyl-homoserine lactonase activity of this strain has been further improved.
assignee: Institute of Feed Research of Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences

title: Messaging integration in map-based platform interfaces
abstract: A map-based graphical user interface (GUI) for a social media platform displays an interactive map populated with user representations positioned at respective geographic locations of respective users. Upon user selection of a user representation on the interactive map, a target user associated with the selected representation is identified and a communication mechanism is caused to be displayed that enables initiation of direct communication with the target user from within the map-based GUI. In one embodiment, a friend panel is launched at a bottom portion of the display screen over the interactive map, the friend panel including the communication mechanism alongside identifying information about the target user. The communication mechanism enables composition and transmission of text-based messages directly to the target user without navigating outside the map-based GUI.

title: Systems and Methods for Producing an Architecture of a Pyramid Layer
abstract: A computing system for producing an architecture of a pyramid layer is disclosed. The computing system can include a controller model configured to generate new architectures for a pyramid layer that receives a plurality of input feature representations output by a backbone model and, in response, outputs a plurality of output feature representations. The plurality of input feature representations can have a plurality of different input resolutions, and the plurality of output feature representations can have a plurality of different output resolutions. The computing system can be configured to perform a plurality of iterations. For each iteration, the computing system can receive a new pyramid layer architecture as an output of the controller model and evaluate one or more performance characteristics of a machine-learned pyramidal feature model that includes the backbone model and one or more pyramid layers that have the new pyramid layer architecture.

title: Shutter glasses-based system for massive spherical display
abstract: An apparatus includes processors executing memory-stored instructions to receive data related to presentation of a first content on a massive display, and identify a location of a headset in relation to the massive display. Based on the data and location, the processors actuate the headset to let light through a transparent display of the headset according to a first frequency for the massive display to present a second content at the headset in relation to the first content. The second content may be related to extended reality (XR) objects, and the processors further actuate the headset to present the XR objects in relation to the first content presented on the massive display. The second content may be adjusted at the headset according to the angle of view from the headset toward an object in the first content.

title: Comprehensive Record Integrity Assurance with Message Digest and Digital Signature Validation
abstract: A method includes determining a first message digest based on a plurality of related records associated with a workflow. The method includes storing the first message digest and the plurality of related records at a database and receiving a request to execute the workflow. Based on receiving the request to execute the workflow, the method includes determining a second message digest based on the plurality of related records stored at the database, validating the workflow based on the first message digest and the second message digest, and executing the workflow based on validating the workflow.

title: Cone crusher with skewed axis
abstract: The invention relates to a cone crusher ( 1 ) for comminuting lumpy feed material (material to be crushed), with a crushing cone ( 6 ) supported on an axial bearing, inclined to the axis of rotation (R) and driven by an eccentric bushing ( 12 ), wherein the eccentric bushing ( 12 ) rotates in radial guidance around a fixed axle journal ( 10 ). The invention is characterized in that a central axis (Z) of the crushing cone ( 6 ) is aligned skewed to the axis of rotation (R) of the eccentric bushing ( 12 ). The invention further relates to an eccentric bushing ( 12 ) and a method.

title: Oral composition comprising l-theanine
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an oral product, a process for producing the oral product, as well as to uses of said oral product. The oral product includes L-theanine, ginseng, vitamin C, Echinacea, and optionally vitamin D or selenium.

title: Medical electrode and system thereof
abstract: Medical electrode devices configured to be worn for long period (e.g., more than an hour) in a moving patient without significantly decreasing electrical signal. In particular described herein are fetal monitoring electrodes comprising: an electrolyte; an absorbent material being in contact with the electrolyte, said absorbent material comprising a plurality of strands such that each strand is infused with the electrolyte; a pressing means being in contact with the absorbent material, said pressing means comprising a plurality of protrusions to push the strands of the absorbent material through the stratum corneum of a target skin area on a patient; and an electrically conductive means located adjacent to the pressing means, said electrically conductive means being in contact with the absorbent material. The instant medical electrode system achieves reduction of skin impedance at the site where the electrode is placed and generates low baseline noise, enabling accurate measurement of small or weak signals.

title: Multi-voice conferencing device soundbar test system and method
abstract: A system is provided herein comprising: a host audio testing device (HATD) adapted to generate one or more uniquely addressed audio test signals and transmit each generated audio test signal, and which is further adapted to receive audio test data from a bi-directional audio transceiver device (soundbar) device under test (DUT) that can be used in two or more remotely located conference rooms to perform teleconferencing between the remotely located conference rooms; and one or more remote audio generating devices (RATD), each of which is adapted to receive a generated uniquely addressed one or more audio test signals and broadcast the same to the soundbar, wherein each of the RATDs can be located at the same or different distances from the soundbar, the same or different heights with respect to the soundbar, and at the same or different angular placements with respect to the soundbar, and wherein, the HATD is further adapted to store and process the received audio test data from the DUT and generate audio test data reports.

title: Forward error correction (fec) capability propagation method, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract: Forward error correction (FEC) capability propagation method includes: determining an FEC capability of a first node, the FEC capability including an encoding algorithm set indicating a set of supported encoding algorithms, a maximum packet duration indicating a maximum duration for receiving a single group of data, and a maximum protection level indicating a maximum value of supported protection levels, and the FEC capability of the first node including a first encoding algorithm set, a first maximum packet duration, and a first maximum protection level; performing encapsulation based on the first encoding algorithm set, the first maximum packet duration, and the first maximum protection level, to obtain a first capability message; and transmitting the first capability message to a downstream node that is connected to and adjacent to the first node to cause the downstream node to determine the FEC capability propagated from the first node.

title: Resin for extracting lithium from lithium precipitation mother liquor, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract:
The present disclosure provides a resin for extracting lithium from lithium precipitation mother liquor, a preparation method and application thereof. The resin is an amino resin in which an amino functional group is substituted by at least one group (P) as shown below.

     The resin provided by the present disclosure significantly enhances the absorption capacity for lithium ions under alkaline conditions and in the presence of high-concentration sodium ions. Using this resin, a high concentration of lithium ions can be obtained in the desorbed solution, making it suitable for extracting lithium ions from aqueous solutions, particularly from lithium-containing mother liquor and carbonate-type brine. The resin exhibits high commercial application potential. In addition, the preparation method of the resin disclosed by the disclosure is the one-pot synthesis method, featuring high reaction efficiency, stable synthesis, and simple operation, making it suitable for large-scale industrial production.
assignee: Xi'an Lanshen New Material Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Personal cooling device
abstract: A personal cooling device includes a housing and a belt coupled to the housing which is wearable around a waist of the user. A first outlet is integrated into the housing and a second outlet is integrated into the housing. A cooling unit is positioned in the housing which receives a cooling medium. An air hose is removably attachable to each of the first outlet and the second outlet and the air hose is wearable over shoulders of the user. The air hose receives air which is cooled by the cooling medium from each of the first outlet and the second outlet. The air hose has a plurality of holes to release the air cooled by the cooling medium onto the user to cool the user.

title: Direct-From-Vial Medication Transfer Device
abstract: A medication transfer device for use with a medication container such as a vial includes a first interface, a second interface, and one or more piercing elements. The first interface can be on a first end have a shape and size to couple to an infusion pump. The second interface can be on a second end and have a shape and size to secure the vial. The one or more piercing elements can define both at least a portion of (i) an inlet channel in fluid communication with a pressure source generated by the infusion pump when the first interface is coupled to the infusion pump and (ii) an outlet channel in direct fluid communication with an infusion set delivering medication from the vial to a patient.

title: Hybrid two-dimensional steering lidar
abstract: An optical emitter device includes an emitter array comprising a plurality of end-fire tapers, each end-fire taper configured to selectively emit a respective beam of light. A lens system is configured to shape and direct each beam of light based on a position of the respective end-fire taper relative to an optical axis of the lens system. A rotating reflector, including an axis of rotation perpendicular to the optical axis of the lens system, is configured to redirect and scan the beams of light through a scanning range.

title: Synergistic agrochemical combination
abstract: The present invention relates to a novel and synergistic agrochemical combination. The present invention provides agrochemical combination comprising a synergist and an herbicide or a fungicide and compositions thereof especially for controlling weeds and fungi.

title: Side sill structure of automobile
abstract: A side sill structure of an automobile includes: a side sill including a closed sectional space; a partition member vertically passing through the closed sectional space in the side sill, the partition member being configured to partition the closed sectional space into two closed sectional spaces in a vehicle width direction; an impact absorption structure including a pair of sectionally groove-shaped members joined to the partition member in a state of sandwiching the partition member from both sides and forming closed sectional spaces respectively with the partition member in the closed sectional spaces, and bulkheads provided respectively in the closed sectional spaces in the vehicle width direction to partition the closed sectional spaces and provided at a plurality of positions at intervals in a vehicle front-rear direction in the closed sectional spaces.

title: Method of automatically searching for leakage current path
abstract: A computer implemented method of automatically searching for one or more leakage current paths in an electronic circuit comprising receiving a circuit design description of the electronic circuit, analyzing the circuit description to identify a first power rail terminal, searching, starting from the first power rail terminal, for one or more current paths to a second power rail terminal via one or more circuit components, reporting, for at least one current path between the first power rail terminal and the second power rail terminal via the one or more circuit components, a leakage current path, and/or reporting that there are no leakage current paths if no current paths between the first power rail terminal and the second power rail terminal are identified.

title: Degradable extruded netting made from polymer blend compositions
abstract: Degradable extruded nettings are provided. Degradable extruded nettings may include a plurality of interconnected strands, at least some of the strands being made from a polymeric blend, the polymeric blend including a polylactic acid polymer composition, polybutylene succinate, and a degradation additive, the degradation additive including a degrader in a carrier resin are provided. Grass sod and methods for preparing grass sod using such degradable extruded nettings are also provided.

title: Synergistic approach to develop resilient cement systems for long term wellbore integrity of oil, gas and geothermal wells
abstract: A cement slurry includes water, a cement precursor, a sliding ring polymer, and an additional polymer. A cured cement composition, such as a cement sheath, can be prepared from the cement slurry. A method for providing a cement sheath in a wellbore includes introducing the cement slurry to an area between a casing and a formation rock of the wellbore and curing the cement slurry injected to the area between the casing and the formation rock of the wellbore, thereby forming the cement sheath in the wellbore.

title: Sealing system for hvac&r system
abstract: A compressor system includes a housing having an impeller disposed therein, a motor disposed within the housing, and a sealing system disposed within the housing. The motor includes a rotor shaft coupled to the impeller, and the motor is configured to drive rotation of the rotor shaft and the impeller. The sealing system includes a sealing element circumferentially disposed around the rotor shaft and configured to bias against a surface of the rotor shaft in a first configuration. The housing includes an injection port formed therein, the injection port is configured to direct a pressurized fluid into the housing to impinge against the sealing element to transition the sealing element from the first configuration to a second configuration, and the sealing element is lifted away from the surface of the rotor shaft in the second configuration.

title: Vent valve and manufacturing method therefor, battery cell, battery, and electric device
abstract: A vent valve, a battery cell, a battery, and an electric device. The vent valve includes: a metal sheet, the metal sheet at least including a first through hole; a connecting member, the connecting member including at least one second through hole, where the connecting member is arranged on the metal sheet, and the first through hole is communicated with the second through hole; and a breathable membrane, the breathable membrane being arranged on the connecting member and covering the second through hole. By providing the connecting member, deformation of the breathable membrane during processing can be reduced, further preventing the deterioration of gas permeability caused by the deformation, thereby enhancing the structural stability of the vent valve, prolonging the service life of the vent valve, while also helping improve the sealing performance of the vent valve and broadening the selection range of the breathable membrane materials.

title: Methods and apparatus for navigation based on tracking orientations
abstract: Methods and apparatus for navigation based on tracking orientations are disclosed. An example apparatus includes interface circuitry communicatively coupled to an aiming device and an image sensor carried by an aircraft, machine-readable instructions, and at least one processor circuit to be programmed by the machine-readable instructions to determine orientations of the aiming device as the image sensor tracks a target via the aiming device, determine navigation information of the aircraft based on the orientations and flight sensor data corresponding to the tracking of the target with the image sensor, and guide movement of the aircraft based on the navigation information.
assignee: InSitu, Inc., a subsidiary of the Boeing Company

title: Pin junction waveguides for handling high optical power
abstract: An optical device includes a semiconductor waveguide. The semiconductor waveguide includes waveguide core, a first semiconductor region at a first side of the waveguide core, a second semiconductor region at a second side of the waveguide core opposite the first side. The optical device also includes wiring that electrically connects the first semiconductor region to the second semiconductor region.

title: Memory system and control method
abstract: According to one embodiment, a memory system includes a nonvolatile memory and a controller. The controller manages a degree of wear-out of the nonvolatile memory for each wear management unit that includes P access units among access units in the nonvolatile memory, and manages first data into which one or more addresses are converted. The one or more addresses respectively indicate one or more access units accessed among the P access units in a first wear management unit. The controller accesses an access unit in a first wear management unit and converts an address indicating the access unit into second data. The controller makes a determination as to whether there is a possibility that the one or more addresses include the address by using the first and second data.

title: User equipment (ue) communication resource prediction for determining uplink receive beams
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to enhanced signaling designs used to support beam prediction by a user equipment (UE) as part of determining a set of uplink receive beams to be used by a network entity to receive communications from the UE. A method includes receiving one or more signals communicated in a first set of communication resources associated with a first set of beams of a network entity and sending one or more identifiers of a second set of communication resources associated with a second set of beams of the network entity, wherein the second set of communication resources are predicted based on measuring the one or more signals, and wherein the one or more identifiers of the second set of communication resources are associated with a set of uplink receive beams of the network entity.

title: Working machine
abstract: To maintain driving force over a long period of time in a working machine. A fastener driving machine includes a tubular cylinder, an accumulator container closing an upper end portion of the cylinder in an up-down direction, a piston unit defining a pressure chamber in cooperation with the cylinder and the accumulator container and applying striking force to a fastener, and a nut partitioning an internal space of the cylinder and an internal space of the accumulator container from each other. Grease is applied to an inner wall of the cylinder, and the nut has a through-hole communicating with the internal space of the cylinder and the internal space of the accumulator container and directing a passing air flow toward the inner wall of the cylinder.

title: Vehicle wheel provided with pressure sensor
abstract: A vehicle wheel extends along an axis and has a rim with an outer annular wall radially defined by an inner face and by an outer face, opposite each other; a tire delimits, together with the inner face, a chamber which is filled with air and can be pressurized; a pressure monitoring device is provided to detect and transmit data related to the pressure in the chamber; the pressure monitoring device has a casing fixed with respect to the rim, a pressure sensor having a surface on which the air pressure of the chamber acts, an antenna, and a battery housed in a compartment of the casing; the latter is arranged on the outside of the chamber, whereas the outer annular wall has a seat which houses at least partially the pressure sensor and communicates with the chamber.

title: Inspection device
abstract: An inspection device includes: a surface defect detection system including an illumination device including an illumination laser light source device and a reflection observation device including a reflection sensor; and a photoluminescence detection system including a UV irradiation device including an excitation laser light source device and a fluorescence observation device including a fluorescence sensor, in which measurement light is acquired by the reflection observation device and fluorescence is acquired by the fluorescence observation device while irradiating an object with illumination light by the illumination laser light source device and irradiating the object with excitation light by the excitation laser light source device.

title: Method and system for disturbance tracking and localization
abstract: Aspects of the subject disclosure may include, for example, obtaining phase estimates associated with groups of known symbols in an optical signal that is received over an optical fiber, wherein the groups of known symbols are transmitted at known locations in the optical signal, and performing calculations using the phase estimates to facilitate detection or localization of a disturbance to the optical fiber, wherein the calculations decouple an effect of the disturbance on the phase estimates from effects of one or more of transmitter-related phase noise and receiver-related phase noise on the phase estimates. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title: Medication support system
abstract: A medication support system includes a medicine dispensing apparatus and an external medicine-dispensing control system. The medicine dispensing apparatus includes a container, a medicine dispensing tray, a conveying device, and a pack data reader. The external medicine-dispensing control system manages the medicine dispensing apparatus, and includes processing circuitry to identify a specific destination of a picked-up one of a plurality of medicine packs in the medicine dispensing tray based on medication-related information of the medicine pack and medicine dispensing data added to the medicine dispensing tray, and change the medicine dispensing data of the specific destination.

title: Multi-ply tissue products and methods of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed are through-air dried multi-ply tissue products having two or more tissue plies. The tissue products have a first surface and a second surface, wherein the first and second surfaces are outer surfaces of the tissue product. At least the first surface comprises a three-dimensional surface topography, and the surface topography comprises a plurality of discrete dome-shaped protrusions extending outwardly from the first surface. Each protrusion has a length:width ratio of 1:1 to 4:1. A footprint area of the protrusions covers at least about 15% of a total footprint area of the first surface, and the tissue product has a Stiffness Index of about 10 or less.

title: Hexagonal boron nitride powder and production method therefor
abstract: Provided is hexagonal boron nitride powder that makes it possible to easily provide a cosmetic providing both airy, light texture and moist feel sensed in spreading thereof. Hexagonal boron nitride powder having a tap bulk density of not more than 0.08 g/cm 3  and a shearing cohesion of not less than 3.5 kPa can attain the object, the shearing cohesion being calculated from a powder yield locus obtained through a powder bed shear stress analyzing test. The hexagonal boron nitride powder can be easily produced by a method for producing hexagonal boron nitride powder including a heating step of filling, with raw material powder containing coarse hexagonal boron nitride powder, a heating container so that a bulk density thereof becomes 0.16 g/cm 3  to 0.23 g/cm 3  and heating the raw material powder at a maximum temperature of 1700° C. to 2100° C. for not less than 3 hours under a nitrogen atmosphere, the coarse hexagonal boron nitride powder having a specific surface area of 12 m 2 /g to 30 m 2 /g and an eluted boron content of 1% to 15%.

title: Utilization Of 3D Modeling Application Data For Model-To-Machine Operation Of Cutting And Bending Fabrication Machines
abstract: A method includes generating, based at least in part on three-dimensional model data: an enhanced bend list including x,y,z positional information usable by a bending machine control application of or associated with a bending machine and capable of directing operation of the bending machine to bend a work piece of a to-be-fabricated part or assembly at least once, and a printing routine capable of causing a printer to print computer-readable bend instructions including the x,y,z positional information. The method includes transmitting the printing routine to at least one of the printer and a computer device associated therewith to enable use by the printer or the computer device associated therewith to direct the printer to print a graphic encoding the computer-readable bend instructions for use by the bending machine control application to direct the bending machine to bend the work piece at least once in accordance with the enhanced bend list.

title: Lighting device with embedded electronics
abstract: In an embodiment a lighting device includes a semiconductor light source arrangement arranged on a carrier, electronics configured for operating the semiconductor light source arrangement, a heat sink configured for cooling the semiconductor light source arrangement, an electrical connection element configured for supplying power to the semiconductor light source arrangement, a thermally conductive layer, and a holder, wherein the carrier is arranged in a first recess of the holder, wherein the heat sink forms at least one surface in the first recess, which is substantially parallel to the carrier, and wherein the electronics are arranged on a side of the carrier opposite the semiconductor light source arrangement and are embedded in the thermally conductive layer between the carrier and the holder and/or the heat sink in the first recess.

title: Combination therapies
abstract: The present invention relates to novel combination therapies or pharmaceutical compositions and their use in the treatment of cancers, particularly cancers expressing carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA).

title: Method of bonding a die to a die bonding site in the presence of a liquid and a system adapted to perform the method
abstract: A method can include dispensing a liquid onto a die bonding site of a substrate and modulating a die held by a die chuck and bringing the die into contact with the liquid. In an implementation, the method can further include bringing the die into contact with the liquid, while the peripheral edge of the die is not in contact with the die bonding site; and demodulating the die such that an outer region of the die is brought into contact with the die bonding site while a liquid is over a center of the die. In another implementation, bringing the die into contact with the liquid can cause a film to form, where the film becomes starved before the outer region of the die contacts the die bonding site. A system can be adapted to carry out the method.

title: Combination treatment for ovarian cancer
abstract: Provided are methods for treating patients having ovarian cancer. The methods comprise administering a combined effective amount of SBP-101 and either doxorubicin or eflornithine.

title: Thyrocytes and uses thereof
abstract: The present invention provides a thyrocyte product comprising viable thyrocytes isolated from one or more thyroid tissues, wherein the isolated thyrocytes have been cryopreserved. Also provided is a method for preparing a thyrocyte product. Further provided is a method for preparing a thyrocyte culture, comprising (a) seeding thyrocytes onto a surface in a culture vessel, wherein the thyrocytes are isolated from one or more thyroid tissues and have been cryopreserved; and (b) growing the thyrocytes in a growth medium, whereby a thyrocyte culture comprising cultured thyrocytes is prepared. The thyrocytes may form microtissues attached to the surface in a 3D culture. The cultured thyrocytes may form a monolayer in direct contact with the surface in a 2D culture. A method of testing drugs and other molecules for thyroid bioactivity is also provided.

title: Separation method and apparatus for separating far-field and near-field voice and wearable device
abstract: The present application provides a far-field and near-field voice separation method and apparatus and a wearable device. The method includes: obtaining a near-field beamforming signal and a far-field beamforming signal according to microphone array signal obtained by first microphones in a target scenario and a beamforming algorithm; calculating a near-field voice masking matrix and a far-field voice masking matrix according to the near-field beamforming signal, the far-field beamforming signal and a bone conduction microphone signal; outputting a near-field voice according to the near-field beamforming signal and the near-field voice masking matrix; and outputting a far-field voice according to the far-field beamforming signal and the far-field voice masking matrix. In the present application, the near-field voice and the far-field voice can be effectively separated by fusing the bone conduction microphone signal and the traditional microphone array signal, so that the wearer voice and the far-field voice are obtained.

title: Double-sided plush fabric
abstract: A double-sided plush fabric knitted by a circular knitting machine includes a basic structure and two plush structures. The two plush structures are respectively positioned on two opposite sides of the basic structure. Length of the cut-loop piles is from 3.5 mm to 15 mm. One of the two plush structures includes first cut pile yarn segments, and each of the first cut pile yarn segments sequentially forms one cut-loop pile, at least continuous two arcuate yarn segments knitted with the basic structure knitted with the basic structure, and one cut-loop pile. The other one of the two plush structures includes second cut pile yarn segments, and each of the second cut pile yarn segments sequentially forms one cut-loop pile, one arcuate yarn segment knitted with the basic structure knitted with the basic structure, and one cut-loop pile.
assignee: Pai Lung Machinery Mill Co., Ltd.

title: Power tool including a cold-start operation
abstract: Breakers and related power tools with a cold-start feature and methods for controlling the same. A breaker comprising a housing, a motor within the housing, and an electronic controller. The electronic controller is electronically connected to the motor. The electronic controller is configured to initiate a first start-up operation (e.g., a normal start) of the motor by increasing a speed of the motor according to a first start-up profile, the first start-up profile defining a start-up rate of the motor for reaching an ending speed over a first time period. The electronic controller is further configured to detect an overcurrent event during the first start-up operation, and in response to detecting the overcurrent event, initiate a second start-up operation (e.g., cold start) of the motor according to a second start-up profile, the second start-up profile different from the first start-up profile.

title: Ferrite composition and magnetic core comprising same
abstract: A magnetic core, according to the present invention, comprises: a main composition including a manganese (Mn) component with an atomic ratio in the range of 0.74 to 0.76, a zinc (Zn) component with an atomic ratio in the range of 0.15 to 0.17, an iron (Fe) component with an atomic ratio in the range of 2.08 to 2.09, and a cobalt (Co) component with an atomic ratio in the range of 0.005 to 0.010; a magnetic ionic agent; and a non-magnetic additive, wherein the magnetic core has a core loss of 300 mW/cc or less at 80° C. to 100° C. under the conditions of 100 kHz frequency and a maximum magnetic flux density of 200 mT.

title: System for automatic detection, measurement, and elimination of air from a fluid pathway
abstract: A system for detecting, measuring, and removing gas from a medical fluid pathway includes a fluid delivery path that conveys therapeutic liquid from a source toward a patient and an Active Air Management (AAM) subassembly. The AAM subassembly includes a fluid chamber that receives the therapeutic liquid and entrained gas, and a pneumatic chamber separated from the fluid chamber by a gas-selective membrane that permits gas transfer while retaining liquid. A pressure controller is fluidly coupled to the pneumatic chamber and configured to impose a controlled negative pressure differential to extract gas across the membrane. A valve selectively isolates the pneumatic chamber to create a sealed measurement volume, and a pressure sensor measures pressure changes within the sealed volume. A controller determines a quantity of gas based on the measured pressure change and, when the change meets or exceeds a threshold, commands the pressure controller to re-establish or adjust the negative pressure differential to continue gas removal.

title: Renewal planning apparatus, renewal planning method, and computer readable medium
abstract: A plan creation unit ( 21 ) creates a renewal plan that indicates renewal timing of each of a plurality of parts that configure equipment for each of combinations of each of a plurality of upper limit ratios and each of a plurality of lower limit ratios. The plan creation unit ( 21 ), with each of the plurality of parts as a target part, creates a renewal plan to which renewal timing of the target part is set in a period less than or equal to a usage upper limit that is obtained by multiplying a lifespan of the target part by an upper limit ratio in a target combination, and that is more than or equal to a usage lower limit that is obtained by multiplying the lifespan of the target part by a lower limit ratio in the target combination. A presentation unit ( 24 ) presents, for each of the combinations, the renewal plan that is created.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device is provided with: a first switching element; a driver positioned so as to be displaced with respect to the first switching element in the z-direction, the driver driving the first switching element; a first resin layer for encapsulating the first switching element; and a first control via conductor extending through the first resin layer in the z-direction and electrically connecting the first switching element and the driver.

title: Systems and methods for updating the configuration of a cloud service
abstract: The present disclosure facilitates improving the operation of a cloud service by updating its configuration information and its resource requirements. The resource utilization of the cloud service can be monitored, and a decision logic module can determine whether action is required. When action is required, an update can be prepared and applied, and notifications can be generated about the condition and its resolution. Resolutions can require correlation of multiple cloud services to provide real-time access to information that is not otherwise available to a single entity. Resolutions can be learned and predicted in a number of ways using a predictive engine.

title: Headings based chunking strategy for specifications documents
abstract: A method and system provide the ability to process a construction domain query. A construction specification document that has textual content organized under multiple headings is obtained. The multiple headings in the textual content are identified. Each of the identified multiple headings is treated as a chunk and heading embeddings are generated and stored for each chunk. A user query is obtained. Based on the stored heading embeddings, the user query is performed within each of the chunks to retrieve relevant textual content from each chunk. The relevant textual content from each of the chunks is consolidated into a query response.

title: Detector apparatus and method for operating a detector apparatus
abstract: A detector apparatus. The detector apparatus includes a laser device that generates a laser beam. The detector apparatus includes a beam-splitting device that generates a plurality of non-collinear measurement laser beams from the laser beam and emits the measurement laser beams in predefined directions. A receiving device receives the measurement laser beams scattered by particles in the surroundings of the detector apparatus and generates a measurement signal. An evaluation device evaluates the measurement signal. The detector apparatus can be provided for two-dimensional detection. The plurality of measurement laser beams then comprises at least three measurement laser beams. The detector apparatus can be provided for three-dimensional detection, and the plurality of measurement laser beams then includes at least six measurement laser beams.

title: Leakage prevention in multi-vendor smf solution deployment
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for mitigating revenue leakage in a multi-vendor session management function (SMF) solution deployment. In N40-based converged charging implementation, a quota management indicator (QMI) is used to distinguish between online and offline packet data unit (PDU) sessions. Online sessions include QMI, while offline sessions do not. In a multi-vendor SMF solution, any one of the SMF solutions may not comply with 3GPP standards regarding utilizing QMI (i.e., QMI is included by default regardless of session type). This can lead to revenue leakage in offline billing since the offline sessions are not correctly identified. The present disclosure provides a mediation server that processes call data records (CDRs) based on a source identifier rather than QMI. Specifically, the mediation server can ignore logic instructing discarding CDRs having QMI (as it does normally) and, instead, process the CDRs having QMI. This reduces the risk of revenue leakage.

title: Method and system for evaluating spherical perfectness of plasmonic nanoparticle
abstract: Embodiments relate to a method and system that can quantitatively evaluate the spherical perfection of plasmonic nanoparticles. The system for evaluating spherical perfection of nanoparticles according to an embodiment includes: a light output unit configured to emit light polarized in one direction to the nanoparticles; a spectroscopic unit configured to generate first and second scattering spectra by controlling a polarization direction of light scattered from the nanoparticles into one direction and another direction and measuring the polarization-controlled light; and a processor configured to determine sphericity of the nanoparticles on the basis of values of the first and second scattering spectra corresponding to a peak wavelength of the first scattering spectrum.
assignee: GIST(Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology)

title: Battery apparatus, method for controlling battery apparatus, and vehicle
abstract: An apparatus according to one embodiment, includes a battery module that includes secondary batteries; a temperature detector that detects a temperature of at least one of the secondary batteries; a current detector that detects a charge/discharge current of the battery module; a cooler that cools the battery module; and a processor that periodically acquires values of detected temperature and current; compares a temperature value of the secondary battery with a threshold value; and stops the cooler and outputs a signal requesting the charge current of the battery module to a host control apparatus in a case where the battery module is discharged and the temperature value of the secondary battery becomes less than the threshold value.

title: Cobalt catalyzed hydroformylation of vinyl-functional polyorganosiloxanes
abstract: A process for preparing a propanal-functional polyorganosiloxane includes contacting carbon monoxide and hydrogen gas and a vinyl-functional polyorganosiloxane with at least 4 siloxane units per molecule in the presence of a cobalt carbonyl catalyst with heating at less than 90° C. and pressure of greater than 150 psi to 700 psi.

title: Methods and apparatus for wtru member selection using observed service experience filtering criteria
abstract: Techniques for member selection include sending, to a network node, a request for wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) selection assistance for federated learning operations. The request includes an indication of a first list of candidate WTRUs, an indication of at least one filtering criteria, and an indication of a contribution weight for each WTRU indicated in the first list. A notification is received from the network node. The notification includes a second list of a subset of the candidate WTRUs. The second list is based on a service experience metric, weighted based on the contribution weight, that meets the at least one filtering criteria.

title: Connection system, in particular plug-in connection system, for induc-tively contactlessly transmitting data and/or power supply signals and combination
abstract: A connection system ( 1 ), in particular plug-in connection system, for inductively contactlessly transmitting data and/or power supply signals between a sensor device and base unit in a measurement and transmission system, includes a sensor-side connection element ( 2 ) with a first coil winding ( 5 ), a base-side connection element ( 6 ) with a second coil winding ( 10 ). The base-side connection element ( 6 ) can be engaged with the sensor-side connection element ( 2 ) for magnetic coupling for data and/or energy transmission. A short-circuit winding element made of an electrically conductive material surrounds the engagement area (E) between the sensor-side connection element ( 2 ) and the base-side connection element ( 6 ). A combination ( 17 ) includes the connection system ( 1 ) and a support unit ( 18 ), in particular an immersion fitting, which can be engaged with the connection system ( 1 ). A measurement combination includes the connection system ( 1 ) or the combination ( 17 ) and the sensor device.
assignee: Knick Elektronische Messgeräte GmbH & Co. KG

title: Method for cleaning high-pressure gas container
abstract: A method for cleaning a high-pressure gas container includes a vacuum accumulation purging step and a cleaning step. The vacuum accumulation purging step includes a depressurization stage of reducing the pressure in the high-pressure gas container and an inert gas supply stage of supplying an inert gas to the high-pressure gas container. The cleaning step includes a hydrogen halide supply stage of supplying a hydrogen halide to the high-pressure gas container after the vacuum accumulation purging step, a metal oxide removal stage of reacting, in the high-pressure gas container after the hydrogen halide supply stage, a metal oxide on the inner face of the high-pressure gas container with the hydrogen halide to form water, and a discharge stage of discharging the water formed in the metal oxide removal stage and the hydrogen halide from the high-pressure gas container.

title: Liquid Cooling System With Buffer Tank
abstract: Techniques for using a buffer tank in a liquid cooling system are disclosed. A cooling system circulates coolant through pipes to cool devices. The cooling system returns heated coolant to a cooling unit via ingress pipes. The cooling unit cools the coolant to recirculate the coolant through the pipes. The system includes a buffer tank positioned between the cooling unit and ingress pipes. The buffer tank stores a reservoir of coolant liquid. As heated exhaust coolant enters the buffer tank, the heated exhaust coolant mixes with the reservoir of coolant liquid. The resulting mixed coolant is directed to the cooling unit to be cooled and recirculated through the system.

title: Composite graphite material, method for preparing same, negative electrode sheet, secondary battery, battery module, battery pack, and electrical apparatus
abstract: Disclosed are a composite graphite material, a method for preparing the same, a negative electrode sheet, a secondary battery, a battery module, a battery pack, and an electrical apparatus. The composite graphite material comprises a bulk particle and a cladding layer located on at least a partial surface of the bulk particle, the bulk particle is a secondary particle formed by aggregation of more than two primary particles, the bulk particle comprises artificial graphite, the cladding layer comprises amorphous carbon, and an air oxidation temperature T 0  of the composite graphite material is from 630° C. to 730° C. The composite graphite material in the present application can enable the secondary battery to not only have a high energy density, but also have significantly improved fast charging performance and low-temperature power performance.

title: Automated validation content generation corresponding to a defined validation protocol
abstract: Automated validation content generation corresponding to a defined validation protocol is presented herein. A system obtains a document template comprising defined validation criteria of a defined validation process. In response to a group of validation documents that have been stored in the system being determined not to correspond to the document template, the system extracts, based on respective validation document scores that have been assigned to the validation documents via a sequence matching-based large language learning model (LLM), respective extracted content from validation document(s) that have been determined to comprise at least a portion of the defined validation criteria. The system populates, via a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based LLM, empty section(s) of the document template with the respective extracted content to obtain a validation document.

title: System and method for controlled heat exchanger swapping
abstract: A method includes detecting a threshold reduction in performance of at least one heat exchanger of a discrete plurality of heat exchangers coupled to an exhaust circuit of a reciprocating engine. The discrete plurality of heat exchangers is disposed in a first unique arrangement of coupling to the exhaust circuit, wherein each of the plurality of heat exchangers include the same connectors to couple to the exhaust circuit. The method also includes generating an output indicative of a second unique arrangement of the discrete plurality of heat exchangers of coupling to the exhaust circuit. The second unique arrangement of the discrete plurality of heat exchangers has a greater predicted remaining useful life than the first unique arrangement of the discrete plurality of heat exchangers.

title: Portable road block
abstract: A folding, collapsible portable roadblock is disclosed which has a bottom base and an upright (or back) that hingedly coupled or coupled in a foldable arrangement about an axis.

title: Techniques for evaluating communications using a large language model
abstract: Techniques for generating structured evaluation on communication effectiveness are presented. The method includes ingesting input data that includes processed textual data and a user question policy, wherein the user question policy has a question parameter and at least one output structure; generating a prompt based on the ingested input data; applying a language model to the generated prompt to output an evaluation of textual data of the processed textual data, wherein the evaluation is a response to the question parameter that is formatted according to the at least one output structure, wherein the evaluation describes a communication effectiveness; and associating the evaluation with textual data of the processed textual data.

title: Mounting bracket
abstract: An internal combustion engine-side mounting bracket ( 6 ) is made of metal, and has a plurality of mounting portions ( 10 ). Each mounting portion ( 10 ) is formed by a bulging portion having a semi-cylindrical cross section that protrudes forward with respect to an end surface, located at one end side, of an internal combustion engine ( 1 ). Since the internal combustion engine-side mounting bracket ( 6 ) has the plurality of mounting portions ( 10 ), it is possible to form the internal combustion engine-side mounting bracket ( 6 ) to be highly rigid and compact without having to form cross-sectional shapes of the plurality of mounting portions ( 10 ) to be large. Mountability into a vehicle can therefore be improved.

title: Push-button arrangement for a gaming machine and a gaming machine
abstract: The push-button arrangement for a gaming machine includes a push-button panel including an opening for receiving a push-button, a push-button arranged in the opening and having a rest position and a pushed position, a push detector configured to detect moving of the push-button to the pushed position, and at least two bendable spring elements having a fixed end attached to the push-button panel and a free end, where a force exerted on the free end causes bending of the spring element. The arrangement is configured such that pushing of the push-button from the rest position to the pushed position exerts a force on the free ends of the spring elements, and the spring elements are configured to push the push-button back to the rest position when the push-button is released.

title: Semiconductor device with semiconductor layers
abstract: A device includes a plurality of first semiconductor layers extending from a first source region to a first drain region, a plurality of second semiconductor layers extending from a second source region to a second drain region, and a gate structure. The first semiconductor layers are spaced apart from the second semiconductor layers by the gate structure. The gate structure includes first lateral gate extensions interleaving with the first semiconductor layers, and second lateral gate extensions interleaving with the second semiconductor layers. One of the first lateral gate extensions has a width different from a width of one of the first semiconductor layers. One of the second lateral gate extensions has a width different from a width of one of the second semiconductor layers.
assignee: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Ltd.; National Taiwan University

title: Moving peak processor power limit
abstract: A processor power limit control scheme that controls the processor power limit value based on a monitored system power for a compute platform that includes the processor.

title: Ergonomic adjustments for a physician console
abstract: A physician console includes a base, a pillar coupled to the base, and a viewer coupled to the pillar. The viewer includes a viewer housing, a display within the viewer housing, and a control knob coupled to the viewer housing. Rotation of the control knob causes rotation of the viewer relative to the base.

title: Crystal evaluation method
abstract: In one embodiment, a crystal evaluation method includes forming, above a first substrate, a semiconductor layer that includes an amorphous layer containing metal atoms, the semiconductor layer including a first portion and a second portion. The method further includes crystallizing the first portion from the amorphous layer into a crystalline layer. The method further includes treating the semiconductor layer with a chemical liquid that dissolves at least a part of the first portion or the second portion. The method further includes determining a crystallization state of the semiconductor layer after the treatment.

title: Image decoding device, image decoding method, and program
abstract: An image decoding device includes a decoding part configured to control whether or not to decode, in a unit of sequence to be decoded, a first syntax for specifying whether or not to apply second intra-frame prediction using two or more block vector, a first intra-frame predicting part configured to generate first predicted pixels based on decoded pixels and control information, a second intra-frame predicting part configured to generate second predicted pixels from the two or more block vectors based on the decoded pixels and the control information, a storing part configured to store the decoded pixels, an inter-frame predicting part configured to generate third predicted pixels based on the stored decoded pixels and the control information and an adder configured to add the prediction residual and the first predicted pixels to the third predicted pixels to derive the decoded pixels.

title: System and method for unstructured data automation
abstract: According to some embodiments, systems and methods are provided including receiving, from a user of a remote device via a distributed communication network, an indication of a selected data file; retrieving, from an incoming unstructured data content file data store, information about the selected data file; based on the retrieved information, automatically validating at least some of the associated optical character recognition information, natural language processing information, and video content analysis information for the selected data file; and automatically assigning a workflow to the selected data file in accordance with the validated information and logic. Numerous other aspects are provided.
assignee: Jonathan David Humpherys; Jacqueline E. Teach; Mark DiPaola; Emma C. Walker; Samuel Asante Buahin; Kunal Prakash Chaudhari

title: Lighting device with current self-balancing function
abstract: A lighting device includes an input module, a first light-emitting module, a second light-emitting module, a current adjusting module and a ripple suppression module. The input module includes a first input terminal and a second input terminal. One end of the first light-emitting module is connected to the first input terminal. One end of the second light-emitting module is connected to the first input terminal. The current adjusting module includes a first switch and a second switch connected to each other. The other end of the first light-emitting module is connected to a first node via the first switch, and the other end of the second light-emitting module is connected to the first node via the second switch. The two ends of the ripple suppression module are connected to the first node and the second node respectively. The second node is connected to the second input terminal.

title: Random access (ra)-related transmissions
abstract: Example embodiments of the present disclosure relate to applying timing advance during random access procedure. A first apparatus receives, from a second apparatus, first message indicating a first timing advance group (TAG) corresponding to a first timing advance (TA) and a second TAG corresponding to a second TA, the first and second TAGs associated with a serving cell of the first apparatus. The first apparatus further receives, during a random access (RA) procedure a second message comprising a timing advance command (TAC) indicating a third TA. Then, first apparatus performs RA-related transmissions.

title: Treatment of retinitis pigmentosa and retinitis pigmentosa associated with usher syndrome with n-acetylcysteine amide
abstract: Provided herein are methods for the treatment of retinitis pigmentosa in a human that comprises administering to the human a therapeutically effective amount of N-acetylcysteine amide (NACA).

title: Memory circuit and method of operating the same
abstract: A memory circuit includes a first memory cell array configured to store data and coupled to a first and second set of bit lines, and an adder circuit. The adder circuit is coupled to the first memory cell array, and configured as a first or second logic circuit in response to a first set of control signals. The first logic circuit is configured to perform a first logic function on a first set of data signals based on a second set of control signals. The second logic circuit is configured to perform a second logic function on the first set of data signals based on the second set of control signals. The first set of data signals is part of the data stored in the first memory cell array. The first memory cell array and the adder circuit are embedded in a same memory cell array.

title: Systems and methods for identifying waveguide defects
abstract: Systems and methods are described herein for waveguide defect detection. In some examples, a statistical value of pixels of a number of image locations in one or more images of the waveguide can be computed. An extremity matrix can be generated based on an anomaly detector model and statistical pixel data that includes statistical values computed for respective image locations in the one or more images of the waveguide. A decision can be made to determine whether the waveguide is a conforming or a non-conforming waveguide based on the extremity matrix and a set of thresholds. In some examples, the statistical value is a mean intensity value or an average intensity value.

title: Method and system for orchestrating a point-of-sale (pos) payment transaction across a plurality of payment gateway providers
abstract: A system and method for orchestrating a point-of-sale (PoS) payment transaction across a plurality of payment gateway providers is provided. The method comprising: receiving, at the PoS device, a selection, by a user, of a payment method from a plurality of payment methods for a payment transaction; determining a first payment gateway provider from a ranked list of payment gateway providers eligible to process the selected payment method; transmitting a first transaction request to the first payment gateway provider causing the first payment gateway provider to transmit a response to the PoS device; in response to the response meeting a predetermined condition, selecting a second payment gateway provider from the ranked list of gateway providers; and re-initiating the payment transaction by transmitting a second transaction request to the second payment gateway provider.

title: Battery Pack and Electric Vehicle Including the Same
abstract: A battery pack including a cell block with a plurality of battery cells, and a pack housing accommodating the cell block and including a cooling plate connected to the cell block, in which the cooling plate includes a first cooling channel spaced a first distance from the cell block and configured to allow a first cooling fluid to flow therethrough, and a second cooling channel spaced a second distance, which is greater than the first distance, from the cell block and configured to allow a second cooling fluid to flow therethrough is provided The first cooling fluid and the second cooling fluid are different from each other.

title: Safety control algorithms for surgical devices, including safety control algorithms for surgical stapler devices, and associated systems, devices, and methods
abstract: Safety control algorithms for surgical devices, including safety control algorithms for surgical stapler devices, and associated systems, devices, and methods. In one embodiment, a method of operating a surgical stapler comprises tracking a position of a distal end of a blade assembly of a reloadable cartridge assembly of the surgical stapler as the distal end of the blade assembly is moved, via actuation of a motor and a corresponding drivetrain, along a stroke of the blade assembly. The method can further comprise adjusting a current limit for current levels in the drivetrain based on the position of the distal end of the blade assembly along the stroke.

title: Feed-forward device fabrication
abstract: A method includes: forming an opening in a mask layer; measuring a feature size associated with a dimension of the opening; based on the feature size, determining a fabrication parameter; and forming a second layer in the opening. Forming the second layer is based on the fabrication parameter. A fabrication system includes a lithography system; a measurement system; a physical vapor deposition system; an oxidation system; and a control system. The control system is configured to control a feed-forward fabrication process.

title: Systems and methods for analyzing the eye
abstract: Medical devices and methods of use are disclosed to exam an eye of a patient. A medical device may include a digital projector as part of an illumination system. A medical device may include one or more cameras as part of an observation system to capture reflected light from the eye. The observation system may include one or more adjustable optical systems. The digital projector may produce a slit of light to be projected onto the eye. The slit of light and the observation system may be focused at a plurality of focal depths within the eye.

title: LiDAR APPARATUS AND DRIVING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: A LiDAR apparatus and a method of operating the same are disclosed. A SPAD (Single Photon Avalanche Diode)-based LiDAR apparatus according to at least one of various embodiments of the present disclosure may include a light emitting unit configured to transmit a laser pulse; a sensor array configured to receive reflected light reflected from an object by the laser pulse; a histogram generator configured to generate a histogram based on the reflected light; a histogram quality analyzer configured to analyze a change in a shape of the histogram and determine a storage time point before histogram distortion occurs; a storage timing controller configured to control storing of a histogram corresponding to the storage time point during histogram accumulation; and a distance calculator configured to calculate distance information using the stored histogram.

title: Memory device and operating method of the same
abstract: An operating method of a memory device includes receiving a first read command, providing a read voltage to a first memory cell based on the first read command, determining whether the first memory cell is in a set state, and providing a backward pulse to the first memory cell that has been determined to be in the set state.

title: Assembly comprising at least one composite part and attachment means
abstract: A fastening with a first composite part, the part is secured, near an attachment zone, to a second part, a bearing edge of the part contacts a bearing edge of the second part. The fastening attaches the first part to the second part. Near the attachment zone, the first part is composed by a drape made of a superposition of unidirectional layers with angles of orientation of fibers that are different between two adjacent layers. Near the attachment zone, at least one cavity is laid out in the first part, parallel to the contact surface and along a direction perpendicular to the direction of the unidirectional layers, and at least one hole perpendicular to the contact surface, where the hole starts from its bearing edge and opens in the cavity, and receives a threaded element.

title: Protective packaging products and methods of making the same
abstract: A protective packaging product includes a first panel having a first sheet, a second sheet, a first protective layer disposed between the first and second sheets, a first end, and a second end. The protective packaging product also includes a second panel having a third sheet, a fourth sheet, a second protective layer disposed between the third and fourth sheets, a third end attached to the first end of the first panel, and a fourth end attached to the second end of the first panel. The first and second panels are configured to respectively fold along a first and second internal crease line, thereby transitioning the protective packaging product from a first orientation to a second orientation.

title: Cryogenic removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere
abstract: Cryogenic removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere, or CryoDAC (Cryogenic Direct Air Capture), uses extremely low temperatures to convert atmospheric CO 2  into a frozen solid while other components of air such as oxygen and nitrogen remain as gases. Air from the atmosphere is passed through a recuperative heat exchanger to cool the air to a temperature slightly above the deposition point of CO 2 . The cooled air is then passed over a deposition surface chilled to a temperature below the deposition point of CO 2 . Carbon dioxide in the air transitions from gas to solid form upon contact with the deposition surface. The frozen CO 2  is collected and stored. The cold air with CO 2  removed is passed back through the recuperative heat exchanger to cool incoming air and is then returned to the atmosphere. The deposition surface may be cooled by a cryogenic refrigerator.

title: Optimized processing for reducing channels of a stereophonic audio signal
abstract: A method for downmixing a stereophonic signal in order to obtain a monophonic signal comprising, for a current frame. The method includes: a first step of selecting a downmixing operation from two procedures which use filtering of the stereophonic signal and rephasing of the signals, the selection being made according to a phase indicator, representative of a measure of a degree of phase opposition between the frequency components of the channels of the stereo signal; and a second step of selection between one of the two procedures, selected at the end of the first selection step, and a downmixing procedure without rephasing, the selection being made according to the value of an energy ratio between the channels of the stereo signal.

title: Electric vehicle charging control apparatus and system
abstract: An electric vehicle charging control apparatus according to the present disclosure comprises a first power conversion unit configured to convert AC power supplied from a grid into DC power; a second power conversion unit configured to convert the DC power output from the first power conversion unit into charging power; and a relay configured to control the charging power output from the second power conversion unit to be supplied to a battery. The second power conversion unit is configured to receive a power application control signal, and when the second power conversion unit receives the power application control signal, the first power conversion unit and the relay may be driven in parallel.

title: Flare gas capture apparatus, control, and associated methods
abstract: Example flare gas capture apparatus, control, and associated methods are disclosed herein. An example apparatus includes a fluid evacuation system operatively coupled to a gas flare line to evacuate gas from the gas flare line, and a valve operatively coupled to the gas flare line downstream of the fluid evacuation system and upstream of a vent of the gas flare line, the valve movable between a first position and a second position based on a pressure of the gas, the valve to restrict flow of the gas to the vent in the first position, the valve to enable the flow of the gas to the vent in the second position.

title: Automated prompt optimization for generative language models
abstract: Techniques for generating optimized input prompts for generative language models combines automated prompt refinement with intelligent context retrieval. A prompt optimization service automatically refines initial prompt instructions through controlled mutation and evaluation cycles using multiple generative language models. A context management service maintains a vector database of historical examples pre-encoded as embedding vectors, enabling efficient retrieval of semantically similar examples for new tasks. A dynamic prompt generator assembles optimized prompts by combining refined instructions with relevant historical examples and task context. The system supports deployment with both large language models and smaller fine-tuned models, enabling efficient operation across diverse applications. Configurable parameters allow balancing optimization quality against computational costs. The system maintains efficiency through single-call mutations, fast vector similarity search, and support for compact fine-tuned models that reduce resource requirements while preserving response quality.

title: Systems and methods for repurposing software applications, modules, and/ or code functionality based on dynamic code analysis
abstract: Systems, computer program products, and methods are described herein for repurposing software applications, modules, and/or code functionality based on dynamic code analysis. The present disclosure is configured to receive an application implementation request and extract application request data and determine an application requirement set based on the application request data. The present disclosure is also configured to initiate a generative artificial intelligence (AI) agent for executing an application domain protocol; query one or more application repositories based on the application domain protocol and retrieve query results; and execute, via an AI engine, a traceability determination based on the query results. In addition, the present disclosure is configured to generate, via an AI engine, one or more application recommendations based on the traceability determination; and transmit the one or more application recommendations to a network device.

title: Valve system for use in a wellbore
abstract: A valve system for use in a wellbore, the valve system comprising a side pocket mandrel having a main bore for alignment with a tubular in the wellbore, a laterally offset side pocket bore which is en­closed by a side pocket wall, and first and second ports which each extend through the side pocket wall into the side pocket bore, the valve system further comprising first valve assembly which is operable to control flow of fluid from the exterior of the side pocket bore to the first port, and a second valve assembly which is located in the side pocket bore to close the second port and which is operable to control flow of fluid from the first port to the main bore of the side pocket mandrel.

title: Method of manufacturing panels and panels manufactured according to same
abstract: Described herein is a method of manufacturing a panel for a building wherein a wood-grain image is printed on a scrim, the scrim is joined to a panel body, and an edge portion of the panel body is coated. Panels manufactured according to this method may incorporate a variety of different wood-grain images, allowing an aesthetic appearance which matches the rest of the room in which the panel is installed. The image may be located on a printed layer which is on top of or penetrates into the scrim.

title: Resolution of domain-specific issues
abstract: Resolution of domain-specific issues is provided and includes receiving response data for a plurality of queries. The plurality of queries is associated with an issue in a specific domain. A set of queries from the plurality of queries is identified and domain-specific data is retrieved from a set of knowledge bases associated with the specific domain. A set of responses is generated for the identified set of queries based on the retrieved domain-specific data. A first ML model is applied to the response data, the set of responses, and the plurality of queries. A set of solutions is generated to resolve the issue and an execution of at least a first solution of the generated set of solutions is controlled. The set of solutions is generated based on the application of the first ML model to the response data, the set of responses, and the plurality of queries.

title: Substrate processing method and substrate processing apparatus
abstract: A substrate processing method includes preparing a substrate having a first main surface and a second main surface opposite to the first main surface, the first main surface having waviness, and performing a laser processing of the first main surface of the substrate. The substrate processing method includes acquiring map data of the waviness of the first main surface before the laser processing; creating map data of a processing amount for the laser processing based on the map data of the waviness; creating n (n is an integer equal to or greater than 2) layers by dividing the map data of the processing amount according to heights thereof; setting a processing area for each layer; and moving a radiation point of a laser beam in the processing area for each layer.

title: Gpr52 modulator compounds
abstract:
The disclosures herein relate to novel compounds of Formula (1): 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     and salts thereof, wherein X, Y, R 1 , R 2 , R 3  and R 4  are defined herein, and their use in treating, preventing, ameliorating, controlling or reducing the risk of disorders associated with GPR52 receptors.

title: Aerial floating video display apparatus
abstract: In an aerial floating video display apparatus, a video light emitted from a display passes through a polarization separator, a λ/4 plate, and a retroreflection plate, thereby forming an aerial floating video which is a real image at a predetermined position in air, the aerial floating video is formed as aerial floating videos in front and rear two layers in a depth direction, the aerial floating video in the front layer being a first aerial floating image and the aerial floating video in the rear layer being a second aerial floating image, a first object image is displayed in the first aerial floating image, and when an aerial operation of a user on the first object image in the first aerial floating image is detected, control is performed such that a display content of the first object image in the first aerial floating image is changed.

title: Abnormality determination system, abnormality determination method, and program
abstract:
Please replace the abstract in the specification as filed with the below paragraph as follows: 
     Provided are an abnormality determination system, an abnormality determination method, and a program that make it possible to more accurately determine the presence or absence of an abnormality. An abnormality determination system comprises: an HUD placement device for placing a test HUD device; a light irradiation control unit for performing control to cause the test HUD device to emit display light; cameras for outputting video data by imaging the display light; a prediction model for outputting prediction data, which is predicted next video data, when the video data is inputted; and an abnormality determination unit for determining whether or not there is an abnormality in the display light through comparison between the prediction data and actual measurement data. The prediction model is a model trained through machine learning using, as training data, normal video data obtained by imaging the display light emitted by a normal HUD device having no abnormality.

title: Utility Assembly and Coupling Mechanism
abstract: The present disclosure concerns a coupling mechanism for detachably attaching two or more utility modules to one another, utility assembles, mobile carriers and other attachable modules and articles.
assignee: Milwaukee Electric Tool Corporation; Keter Plastic Ltd.

title: Blending containers with reduced open end
abstract: Described are blending containers having a reduced open end, e.g., blending containers comprising a rim with a geometry that prevents access by items having a certain diameter or width, while still allowing one or more of portability, cleanability, pourability of blended foodstuff, and the like. The blending containers may be used in a blending system. The blending system may include frothers, foamers, aerators, and the like. The blending system may include a container selectively attachable to a motor base and including a frothing device. The blending system may include firmware logic and sensors to sense ingredients. The blending system may sense ingredients as they are added to the container, and may prevent blending until all ingredients or the certain quantity of ingredients have been added to the container. The blending system may provide more consistent and duplicable blends and may minimize user judgment or error.

title: Similarity information in skip lists
abstract: Techniques are disclosed that relate to skip lists. A computer system maintains a skip list having towers of varying depths and entries storing pointers to other towers.
