A first tower includes an entry at a particular depth storing a pointer to access an entry of a second tower. The pointer includes first similarity information indicating an amount of similarity between a key of the first tower and a key of the second tower. The computer system performs a traversal of the skip list for a search key. The computer system generates second similarity information indicating an amount of similarity between the first tower’s key and the search key. Based on a comparison involving the first and second similarity information and without accessing the second tower to obtain information about its key, the computer system determines whether to traverse to the second tower using the pointer or descend the first tower.

title: Output phase current reduction system for electric vehicle
abstract: An output phase current reduction system for an electric vehicle can include a controller. The electric vehicle including a battery pack, a plurality of wheels, and an electric motor that is configured to drive at least one of the wheels with electric power from the battery pack. The controller can be configured to: be in electrical communication with the electric motor and the battery pack during operation of the vehicle in a first driving direction; and operate the electric motor in a phase current reduction mode by gradually reducing a phase current output to the electric motor from a present value to zero such that an acceleration of the electric vehicle in a direction opposed to the first driving direction is less than a predetermined threshold.

title: Methods and systems for quantum operation execution including flux field stabilization engine
abstract: A quantum computing system includes a quantum processor including a quantum circuit including qubits, and a qubit flux field stabilization engine. The qubit flux field stabilization engine is configured to model a flux coherence field for each qubit and adjust at least one parameter of the quantum circuit to manipulate an operating status of the qubits based on the flux coherence fields around the qubits to at least one of reduce interference among the flux coherence fields, reduce noise, or reduce power consumption of the quantum processor.

title: Press die device, upper die fixture having the same, and press apparatus
abstract: A press die device includes a connecting assembly and a press assembly. The connecting assembly includes an axial rod, a bushing sleeved on the axial rod, and at least one key connection structure connecting the axial rod and the bushing. The press assembly is mounted to a bottom end of the axial rod, and includes a press die adapted to press a to-be-pressed object.

title: Passive waveguides for high optical power applications
abstract: A waveguide includes an inner rib comprising a core of the waveguide. The waveguide further includes first and second outer ribs having at least one structural feature different from the inner rib.

title: Fastening assembly for screw-free and theft-proof fastening of an external attachment to a motor vehicle
abstract: A fastening assembly for screw-free and theft-proof fastening of an external attachment to a motor vehicle. The external attachment includes multiple fixing elements which are intended to engage behind an opening edge of a fastening opening formed on the motor vehicle. The external attachment can be fastened from the outside by placing it on the fastening opening. The fixing elements engage in the fastening opening, and then displacing it, so the fixing elements engage behind the opening edge. The external attachment includes a locking element that prevents the fastened external attachment from being pushed back and is only unlockable from the inside.

title: Outsourcing computations using blockchain
abstract: A computer-implemented method for outsourcing a computation using a blockchain, comprising: obtaining one or more respective secondary computations, wherein each respective secondary computation is based on a respective part of a primary computation and a respective verification algorithm, and wherein executing each respective secondary computation with a respective input generates a respective result of the respective part of the primary computation and a respective verification output of the respective verification algorithm; obtaining a plurality of respective inputs to the primary computation; and for each respective secondary computation: generating a respective outsourcing transaction, wherein the respective outsourcing transaction is locked to a respective locking value based on the respective verification output; making the respective outsourcing transaction available to a respective computing party; and making both the respective secondary computation, or an encrypted version thereof, and the respective input, or an encrypted version thereof, available to the respective computing party.

title: Shared pixel circuits
abstract: The invention discloses an optoelectronic system may include an array of pixel circuits connected to optoelectronic devices. There can be different types of optoelectronic devices (for example, red, green and blue). These devices can be sensors, or light emitting devices or other types of devices. These devices may be optimized differently and to program the pixel circuits, a configuration of dataline for columns and address lines for rows is used.

title: Vehicle headlight
abstract: A vehicle headlight includes: a plurality of light sources disposed in a left-right direction; a light-source-side lens disposed in front of the light sources and emitting light forward; and a projection lens disposed in front of the light-source-side lens and emitting, in front of a vehicle, the light emitted from the light-source-side lens. The light-source-side lens includes an incident surface through which light from the light sources enters. The incident surface includes at least one groove portion disposed at a position offset from an optical axis of the projection lens in the left-right direction and extending in an up-down direction. The groove portion includes an inclined portion that refracts the light from the light sources toward a side closer to the optical axis.

title: Terminal, radio communication method, and base station
abstract: A terminal according to one aspect of the present disclosure includes a receiving section that receives downlink control information (DCI) for scheduling a physical uplink shared channel (PUSCH), and a control section that determines, based on a specific field included in the DCI, whether the PUSCH is a plurality of PUSCHs to be transmitted in at least a same time domain using a single frequency network (SFN) or a PUSCH for a single transmission/reception point. According to one aspect of the present disclosure, it is possible to appropriately perform UL transmission using a plurality of panels.

title: Video encoding and video decoding
abstract: Some aspects of the disclosure provide a video decoding method. For example, a reconstructed block of a first color component for a current block in a current video frame is acquired according to a reference block of the current block. A mapping relationship for the first color component of the current block and a second color component of the current block is fitted according to the first color component and the second color component of a reference region associated with the current block. According to the reconstructed block of the first color component of the current block and the mapping relationship, a predicted block of the second color component for the current block is generated. Apparatus and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium counterpart embodiments are also contemplated.

title: Method of operating an optoelectronic component, method of manufacturing an optoelectronic component, optoelectronic component, and illumination device
abstract: The invention relates an optoelectronic-component having a pixel array with a plurality of optoelectronic semiconductor emitters/chips, a temperature sensor, and a driving circuit. A temperature is read out, using the sensor. An operation parameter of the pixel array is determined. Based on the operation parameter and a model of the pixel array, a temperature difference between the temperature read-out from the temperature sensor and a junction temperature of the pixel array is established. The temperature difference is different for at least two values of the operation parameter. The temperature of the temperature sensor is added to the temperature difference. The sum of the temperature of the temperature sensor and the temperature difference is compared to a maximum junction temperature. A power of the pixel array is reduced when the sum of the temperature of the temperature sensor and the temperature difference exceeds the maximum junction temperature.

title: Polarization based dual-mode optical transceiver
abstract: An optical sensor that employs either a polarization-dependent or a polarization-independent transceiver, where the transceiver receives a portion of an input light signal of a linear polarization mode (e.g. TE mode), and transmits into space, toward a target, a light signal of that linear polarization modes. The transceiver receives a back-scattered light from the target that contains both the linear polarization mode of the input light (e.g. TE mode) and an orthogonal linear polarization mode (e.g. TM mode). The orthogonal linear polarization mode of the back-scattered signal is sent to a photonic mixer to be mixed with another portion of the input light signal to generate a mixed signal for detection. No polarization-altering elements is present between the transceiver and the target to convert the linear polarizations to circular polarizations.

title: Method of Additive Manufacturing
abstract: A method may include: forming a sample part with an additive manufacturing (AM) machine based on build parameters (BPs) describing operation of the AM machine at points of a point field (PF) of the sample part; determining a metric including information describing an aspect of the forming at the points in the PF; inspecting the sample part to find a feature as a function of the PF; creating a training field including the PF, the BPs, the determined metric (DM), and the found feature as a single co-registered PF; training the BPs and the DM, with the found feature as the training field using an AI model; and forming a part based on the trained BPs and the trained DM, so the found feature is absent from the formed part and/or detecting a probability of the found feature being present based on the AI model inspecting an as-built data set.
assignee: United States Of America As Represented By The Administrator Of Nasa

title: Enabling weak memory dies to meet product requirements
abstract: A processing device in a memory sub-system initiates a plurality of write operations on a plurality of memory devices based on received write commands, the plurality of memory devices including at least one memory device having lower endurance characteristics than a remainder of the plurality of memory devices, and the plurality of write operations utilizing a host write cursor and a media management write cursor. The processing device permits the host write cursor to utilize segments on any of the plurality of memory devices including the at least one memory device having the lower endurance characteristics and prevents the media management write cursor from utilizing the at least one memory device having the lower endurance characteristics for at least a subset of the plurality of write operations.

title: Transceiver including programmable self-interference canceller for full-duplex and time division duplex modes
abstract: A wireless communication apparatus comprising: a power amplifier (PA); a transmit coupler including a first input port coupled to an output of the PA, a first coupled port, and a first isolated port; a self-interference (SI) canceller; a first switching device coupled between the first coupled port of the transmit coupler and an input of the SI canceller; a low noise amplifier (LNA); a receive coupler including a transmitted port coupled to an input of the LNA, a coupled port, and an isolated port; and a second switching device coupled between an output of the SI canceller and the coupled port of the receive coupler.

title: Dci triggered harq-ack codebook retransmission
abstract: A user equipment (UE) configured for Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request Acknowledgement (HARQ-ACK) codebook determination in a fifth-generation (5G) new radio (NR) network may decode a downlink control information (DCI) format received from a generation Node B (gNB). When the DCI format triggers HARQ-ACK codebook retransmission, the UE may determine a HARQ-ACK codebook to be retransmitted based on a time-offset indicated in the DCI format. To determine the HARQ-ACK codebook to be retransmitted, the UE may determine an uplink (UL) slot that included an initial transmission of the HARQ-ACK codebook based on subtracting the time-offset from the DL slot that included the DCI. The UE may also encode a physical uplink control channel (PUCCH) to include the HARQ-ACK codebook determined to be retransmitted in a UL slot based on a slot offset.

title: Laser chamber, gas laser device, and electronic device manufacturing method
abstract: A laser chamber includes a container configured to accommodate a laser gas; a discharge electrode configured of a pair of electrodes arranged in the container; a cross flow fan including a fan body configured to cause the laser gas to circulate in the container, and a rotary shaft protruding from both sides of the fan body; and a pair of first guides arranged opposite to each other in an axis direction of the rotary shaft so as to sandwich at least a part of the fan body, and configured to rectify the laser gas toward a discharge space between the pair of electrodes.

title: Transdermal systems having polyisobutylene and methods of making and using them
abstract: Transdermal systems, methods of use and making them are provided, the transdermal systems comprise a backing layer, a release liner, and a matrix disposed between the backing layer and the release liner, the matrix comprising an adhesive, the adhesive comprising a medium molecular weight polyisobutylene having an average molecular weight of 55,000 to 100,000, a high molecular weight polyisobutylene having an average molecular weight of 500,000 to 1,400,000 or both a medium molecular weight polyisobutylene having an average molecular weight of 55,000 to 100,000 and a high molecular weight polyisobutylene having an average molecular weight of 500,000 to 1,500,000.

title: Cutting mechanism with constant-force retraction and bailout
abstract: A method includes positioning a surgical tool adjacent a patient, the surgical tool including a drive housing, a drive input rotatably mounted to a bottom of the drive housing, a capstan assembly arranged within the drive housing and including a drive gear operatively coupled to the drive input, and a longitudinally driven gear arranged within the drive housing and engageable with the drive gear to translate in response to actuation of the drive gear. The method further includes biasing the longitudinally driven member toward a proximal position within the drive housing with a biasing member coupled to at least one of the capstan assembly and the longitudinally driven gear, rotating the drive input to actuate the capstan assembly and thereby translating the longitudinally driven gear in a distal direction, and resisting distal movement of the longitudinally driven gear with a constant force provided by the biasing member.

title: Neurogenesis
abstract: Methods and compositions for increasing neurogenesis and for preventing or treating diseases, disorders or conditions associated with neurodegeneration, are provided herein.

title: Mitigation of coupling noise in distributed acoustic sensing (das) vertical seismic profiling (vsp) data using machine learning
abstract: Systems and techniques are provided for processing wellbore data to generate denoised seismic data where a coupling noise is eliminated. An example method can include receiving wellbore data comprising one or more seismic measurements; generating a seismic input image based on seismic measurements; processing the seismic input image to remove a zigzag noise in the seismic input image. The zigzag noise represents noise in the corresponding seismic measurements. The example method can further include outputting a denoised seismic image. Systems and machine-readable media are also provided.

title: System and method for controlling oxygen-enrichment therapy based on microvascular resistance feedback
abstract: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for controlling gas-enrichment, e.g., oxygen-enrichment, therapy. One or more sensors and/or one or more imaging systems may be used to measure or determine one or more physiological parameters of the patient. Feedback regarding one or more physiological parameters or microvascular resistance may be provided for titrating or controlling the gas-enrichment therapy.

title: Method and device for generating light detection and ranging point cloud map of large-scale outdoor scene
abstract: A method for generating LiDAR point cloud map of an outdoor scene includes steps as follows. An initial segmentation result of a target LiDAR point cloud map is obtained based on a region growing segmentation approach, and boundary point optimization is performed on the initial segmentation result to acquire a target planar segmentation result of the target LiDAR point cloud map. Target normal vectors of segmented planes in the target planar segmentation result are calculated, and planar point cloud refinement is performed on the target planar segmentation result to generate a refined point cloud map. Planar segmentation is performed on the refined point cloud map to obtain a new target planar segmentation result, target wall corner structures of the new target planar segmentation result are determined, and noise points from wall corner points in the target wall corner structures are removed to generate a refined outdoor LiDAR point cloud map.

title: Recycling facility and recycling method for magnesium alloy
abstract: Provided is a recycling facility for a magnesium alloy that can reduce the amount of flame-retardant gas used when melting the magnesium alloy and that is superior in terms of environmental aspects, safety aspects, and cost aspects. Disclosed herein is a recycling facility for a magnesium alloy, the recycling facility including: a melting means for melting magnesium alloy scrap in the presence of an incombustible metal that is a major element other than magnesium constituting the magnesium alloy and that is incombustible when magnesium is melted.

title: Broadcast transmission power modification based on advertisement packet feedback
abstract: A user equipment (UE) broadcasts packets of an audio stream on isochronous channels based on a transmission power profile. Concurrently with broadcasting these packets, the UE listens for advertisement packets each indicating corresponding link quality data from a receiver device subscribed to the audio stream. Using the link quality data from the advertisement packets, the UE determines a respective link quality over a moving period of time between the UE and the receiver devices subscribed to the audio stream. The UE then selects an updated transmission power profile based on the determined link qualities.

title: Compound helicopter with lateral booms
abstract: A compound helicopter comprising a fuselage, a main rotor arranged at an upper fuselage section of the fuselage for generating lift in operation, two cantilever wings arranged within a main rotor disc defined by the main rotor, two lateral booms respectively connected to the two cantilever wings, and a pusher propeller arranged within the main rotor disc. The two cantilever wings are attached to a rear fuselage section of the fuselage and laterally extending on each side of the fuselage. The lateral booms are extending rearwardly beyond a rear fuselage end of the fuselage in a longitudinal direction. The pusher propeller for generating forward thrust in operation is attached to the rear fuselage end between the two lateral booms.

title: Display thermal strap film
abstract: The disclosed display system may include a housing having an inner surface, and one or more display devices housed within the housing. The display system may also include a flexible heat spreader coupled to a surface of one of the display devices and the inner surface of the housing to thermally couple the display device to the housing. Various other methods, systems, and computer-readable media are also disclosed.

title: Decentralized medical device network
abstract: A computer-implemented method of sharing data between medical devices associated with a patient includes forming a decentralized network by the medical devices. Each medical device includes a network communications driver, at least one device configured to gather patient data from the patient, and a processor configured to generate a network message including device capabilities of a respective medical device. The method further includes publishing the network message to the decentralized network, ranking the device capabilities of first medical devices by a second medical device, selecting a desired source for patient data based on the ranking, publishing a request for the patient data, subscribing to the desired source, in response, publishing the patient data to the decentralized network by the desired source, routing the patient data to the second medical device by the decentralized network, and consuming the patient data from the desired source by the second medical device.

title: Intelligent fishing reel control system and method
abstract: Disclosed are an intelligent fishing reel control system and method, including a host, a sensing module, a motor, a switch module, and a rod-jerking recognition module, where the host is connected to the sensing module, the motor, the switch module, and the rod-jerking recognition module to manage each module. The switch module is configured to activate and switch fishing modes, regulate the motor to operate in different manners in different fishing modes, and supply power to the fishing reel body for line retrieval, line release, and trolling. The sensing module detects hand-applied pressure and regulates the motor to operate at variable rotational speeds or torques. The rod-jerking recognition module is configured to identify a rod-lifting posture and amplitude of a fishing rod, and the module controls the motor to output a first torque for line retrieval, line release, and trolling of the electric fishing reel to attract fish.

title: Conductive particle having phosphoric acids for positive or negative electrode
abstract: A conductive particle having phosphoric acids for a positive or negative electrode is used in a solid-state or semi-solid battery. The conductive particle includes a ceramic particle serving to guiding lithium ion passing the electrode to cause that the electrode has uniformly distributed lithium ion channels. An amorphous carbon layer is coated on an outer surface of the ceramic particle. The amorphous carbon layer has a specific conductivity to inhibit an over-expansion of a volume of the ceramic particle. A plurality of graphene sheet layers are mixed within the amorphous carbon layer. A plurality of first carbon nanotubes (CNT) are mixed within the amorphous carbon layer. The first carbon nanotube are used as bridges between the graphene sheet layers and the ceramic particle.

title: Lightweight flying discs
abstract: Lightweight flying discs for playing flying disc games and sports, such as Frisbee™ golf and ultimate Frisbee™, for example, are provided. The discs comprise a flight plate portion and a rim portion surrounding the flight plate portion. At least the flight plate portion is formed from a lightweight and resilient material. The lightweight material can be a foam, including a polyurethane foam, for example.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor configured to learn data regarding technical information and security vulnerabilities and to analyze the data using natural language processing techniques and machine learning algorithms applied to existing attack methods. The processor generates new attack patterns based on the analyzed data and methods, identifies characteristics and weaknesses represented by the generated attack patterns, and updates rule sets of an intrusion detection system, optimizes firewall settings, and generates vulnerability patches based on the identified characteristics and weaknesses. The processor executes virtual attacks in a simulation environment to verify effectiveness of the updated rule sets, optimized firewall settings, and generated patches, improves defense measures based on simulation results, and maintains security software in a state capable of responding to latest threats using the improved defense measures.

title: Method and apparatus for dictionary learning and for reconstructing images using a dictionary
abstract: We describe a method of providing a dictionary by sparse dictionary learning of N-dimensional image data, wherein N is a natural number greater than or equal to 3 and the method is implemented by a computer comprising a processor and a memory. The method comprises defining an N-dimensional patch for the N-dimensional image data; extracting N batch  data sub-regions from the N-dimensional image data, using the defined N-dimensional patch; and providing the dictionary by dictionary learning using the extracted N batch  data sub-regions. We also describe a method of reconstructing images from sparse N-dimensional image data using such a dictionary.

title: Semiconductor device and method for fabricating the same
abstract: A method for fabricating a semiconductor device includes the steps of providing a substrate having a medium-voltage (MV) region and a low-voltage (LV) region, forming fin-shaped structures on the LV region, forming an insulating layer between the fin-shaped structures, forming a hard mask on the LV region, and then performing a thermal oxidation process to form a gate dielectric layer on the MV region. Preferably, a hump is formed on the substrate surface of the MV region after the hard mask is removed, in which the hump further includes a first hump adjacent to one side of the substrate on the MV region and a second hump adjacent to another side of the substrate on the MV region.

title: Lignin based biodegradable polymers and methods of making the same
abstract: Disclosed are biodegradable polyester polymers comprising lignin-containing segments and vegetable-oil based segments. Also disclosed herein are methods of making biodegradable polyester polymers and the articles made from these polymers.
assignee: The Florida State University Research Foundation, Inc.

title: Liquid Ejecting Head
abstract: A liquid ejecting head includes a nozzle that ejects liquid, in which the nozzle includes a first nozzle portion that ejects the liquid, the first nozzle portion includes a plurality of protrusion portions that protrude toward a central axis of the nozzle with respect to an inner side surface that is a part of a side surface along an ejection direction as a direction in which the liquid is ejected from the first nozzle portion, and a scalloped structure having a plurality of convex portions and a plurality of concave portions on the inner side surface. Wettability of at least one of the plurality of convex portions is higher than wettability of at least one of the plurality of concave portions.

title: Window system with integrated blinds
abstract: Various window jamb and window jamb assemblies are provided. An example window jamb assembly includes a clipping mechanism attachable to a window jamb. The clipping mechanism includes a first receiving channel and a second receiving channel. The example window jamb assembly also includes a blind bracket removably coupled to the clipping mechanism. The blind bracket includes a first protrusion extending from an attachment side of the blind bracket and a second protrusion extending laterally from the attachment side of the blind bracket. The first protrusion engages the first receiving channel and the second protrusion engages the second receiving channel. The first protrusion and the second protrusion provide a holding force to maintain the coupling of the blind bracket to the clipping mechanism.

title: Anti-counterfeit systems and methods
abstract: An anti-counterfeit system including a dual-functional security ink composition exhibiting both near-infrared (NIR) absorption and visible coloration, characterized by a viscosity of 10-1,250 cP and a pH of 6-8, is provided. The system includes a security feature printing module for producing a machine-readable security feature detectable under visible light and NIR illumination at 700-1,000 nm. An image acquisition device, incorporating a portable NIR imaging camera or scanner and an optical camera, is used to capture corresponding NIR and optical images of the security feature. A computer system processes the captured NIR image through a multi-stage enhancement pipeline.
assignee: Nano And Advanced Materials Institute Limited

title: Sofa-type massage apparatus
abstract: The present invention relates to a massage apparatus, and more specifically, a sofa-type massage apparatus is disclosed. The sofa-type massage apparatus, according to one aspect of the present invention, comprises: a support part which has a first support surface for supporting the body of a user; a withdrawal/insertion part which has a second support surface for supporting the body of the user, and has a massage module moving along the longitudinal direction so as to massage the body of the user who is lying down on the second support surface; and a controller which controls the operation of the massage module, wherein the withdrawal/insertion part is disposed inside an accommodation space formed in the support part and may be provided so as to be withdrawable or insertable along the width direction so as to enable the second support surface to be selectively exposed to the outside.

title: Modular structural enclosure for a roof top hvac unit
abstract: A roof top unit (RTU) including heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) components and an exterior casing disposed around the HVAC components. The exterior casing includes a plurality of detachable modular components configured to protect the HVAC components from environmental conditions. At least one of the detachable modular components includes a Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PPR) intermediate layer, a first protective layer bonded to a first side of the PPR intermediate layer, and a second protective layer bonded to an opposite second side of the PPR intermediate layer to form a sandwich structure. The modular components may include detachable panels, snap-fit or interlocking mechanisms, interchangeable sizes and shapes, thermal insulation, hydrophobic coatings, reflective materials, and configurable air intake, exhaust, or service panel layouts. The structural enclosure may include an arcuate tubular shell defining an interior volume for receiving the HVAC components.

title: Method for obtaining circumferential mechanical property parameters of pipe
abstract: The present invention provides a method for obtaining circumferential mechanical property parameters of a pipe, and belongs to the field of manufacturing engineering/digital information. The present invention adopts a flexible tensile test fixture to conduct a tensile test on a circumferential tensile test sample of a pipe. During the tensile test, it is necessary to use a non-contact video extensometer and a universal tensile testing machine to obtain tensile measurement data of the pipe; then the tensile measurement data of the pipe is preprocessed, true stress-true strain data of the circumferential tensile test sample of the pipe is obtained by calculation using the preprocessed data, and a strength coefficient and a strain hardening index in a plastic section are obtained by calculation through a method of linear regression fitting by setting starting and ending strains of the plastic section.

title: Thermally optimized aluminum heat-rejection block with integrated fluidic dissipation architecture
abstract: An aluminum cooling block assembly for heat dissipation is disclosed. The assembly includes an aluminum bottom plate having a planar thermal interface surface configured for direct thermal contact with a heat-generating component and a plurality of fins integrally formed with the bottom plate and extending into an internal fluid volume. An aluminum top plate is coupled to the aluminum bottom plate, with the top plate and bottom plate collectively defining the internal fluid volume. An elastomeric gasket is positioned between the top plate and the bottom plate to define a sealed perimeter of the internal fluid volume. A plurality of distributed mechanical fasteners extend through corresponding openings of the top plate and bottom plate and apply compressive force sufficient to seal the elastomeric gasket and maintain continuous thermal coupling during thermal cycling. First and second fluid fittings are coupled to the top plate and define an inlet and an outlet in fluid communication with the internal fluid volume. The fins are arranged to enhance convective heat exchange while controlling coolant pressure drop, and the planar thermal interface surface includes a polished finish configured to reduce thermal interface resistance.

title: Oscillating axle for lift device
abstract: A lift machine includes a chassis, a boom assembly, an axle, and an actuator. The chassis defines a longitudinal center axis. The chassis has an axle housing with (a) a first sidewall defining a first notch and (b) a second sidewall opposite the first sidewall and defining a second notch. The boom assembly is pivotable relative to the chassis. The axle is pivotally coupled to the axle housing. The axle is configured to pivot about the longitudinal center axis relative to the axle housing such that portions of the axle move within the first notch and the second notch. The actuator is positioned on a first lateral side of the longitudinal center axis. The actuator is positioned to facilitate selective oscillation of the axle.

title: Actuator assembly
abstract: An actuator assembly for a vehicle brake is specified, with a brake calliper in which a gap for a brake rotor is formed, wherein arranged in the gap is a brake pad which can be applied to the brake rotor, a spindle drive which has a spindle nut and a spindle, driven by an electric motor, for axially moving the spindle nut, wherein the spindle nut can be shifted by axial displacement between a retracted and an extended position and presses against the brake pad in the extended position, wherein the spindle is supported radially and axially via a spherical roller bearing on the brake calliper or on a housing fastened to the brake calliper.

title: Transmitting method, receiving method, transmitting device and receiving device
abstract: A transmitting method according to one aspect of the present disclosure includes: encoding a video signal and generating encoded data including a plurality of access units; storing the plurality of access units in a packet in a unit that defines one access unit as one unit or in a unit defined by dividing one access unit, and generating a packet group; transmitting the generated packet group as data; generating first information and second information, the first information indicating a presentation time of a first access unit that is presented first among the plurality of access units, and the second information being used to calculate a decoding time of the plurality of access units; and transmitting the first information and the second information as control information.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Corporation Of America

title: Method, device, and medium for unsupported rfsp index recovery service
abstract: A method, a network device, and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium are described in relation to a unsupported RFSP index recovery service. The unsupported RFSP index recovery service may enable recovery of a network procedure that fails due to an unsupported RFSP index. The unsupported RFSP index recovery service may include an RFSP index failure trigger. The unsupported RFSP index recovery service may include obtaining a supported RFSP index from a radio access network device to which the failed network procedure pertains. The unsupported RFSP index recovery service may include obtaining an updated RFSP index and reperforming the failed network procedure with the updated RFSP index.

title: Methods and systems for image quality assessment
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provides a method and a system for image quality assessment. The method may include obtaining a first image of a target video, wherein the first image may be determined based on a target video frame in the target video; and determining a target image quality of the target video frame based on at least one of a first parameter and a second parameter of the first image, wherein, the first parameter may be determined based on an effective region in the first image, the second parameter may be determined based on a first similarity parameter between the first image and a second image, and the second image may be determined based on a video frame other than the target video frame in the target video.

title: Memory device, operating method therefor, and memory system
abstract: Implementations of the present disclosure provide a memory device, a memory system, and an operating method for the memory device. The memory device includes a memory cell array and a peripheral circuit coupled to the memory cell array. The peripheral circuit is configured to: perform a first read operation and a first read restore operation in sequence in response to receiving a first read command; receive a second read command in response to completing the first read operation; and perform a second read operation in response to receiving the second read command.

title: Coherent optical receiver for selectively supporting single and dual polarization mode and an operating method of the coherent optical receiver
abstract: A coherent optical receiver is provided. The coherent optical receiver supports both a single-polarization mode and a dual-polarization mode, thereby providing a flexible solution in which the coherent optical receiver operates in the single-polarization mode in a P2MP environment of a coherent optical access network to reduce cost and power consumption and operates in the dual-polarization mode in a P2P environment to guarantee high-speed data transmission.

title: Inspection system, inspection method, and method of manufacturing mobile body
abstract: Provided are an inspection system, an inspection method, and a method for manufacturing a mobile body each adapted to improve uniformity of inspection conditions. According to the present disclosure, an inspection system includes a vehicle control unit, a recorded data acquisition unit, and an anomalous sound detection unit. The vehicle control unit is configured to control the traveling operation of the vehicle. The recorded data acquisition unit is configured to acquire recorded data recorded inside a vehicle that is traveling based on control performed by the vehicle control unit. An anomalous sound detection unit is configured to detect an abnormal sound, which is a sound associated with an abnormality of the vehicle from the recorded data.

title: System for unified entitlement calculation of cross-platform distributed resources
abstract: A system for unified entitlement calculation of cross-platform distributed resources establishes binding relationships between multiple users and resource accounts on multiple resource exchange platforms, thereby breaking limitations of entitlement accounting confined to a single platform and a single account and adapting to cross-platform distributed resource transaction scenarios. By creating an internal resource record carrier, the system realizes standardized and unified measurement of different resource types. Based on a unified strategy, the system generates and executes resource allocation instructions, without performing any actual resource transfer between resource accounts. The system further performs separate and precise calculation of actual resource holding variation and rule-determined resource variation of each user. By adjusting the internal resource record carrier based on a difference between the actual resource holding variation and the rule-determined resource variation of each user, without modifying actual resource holding amounts of the resource accounts, the system achieves precise balancing of entitlements.

title: Systems and methods for electronic gaming with persistence aspects
abstract: An electronic gaming system including a processor and a memory is described. The processor is configured to determine an output amount and randomly select a presentation from a set of presentations. The processor is also configured to cause display of a first display area including a plurality of stacks of symbols and cause display of a second display area including a plurality of reels. The processor is further configured to, for each of a plurality of spins, cause one or more symbols from the plurality of stacks of symbols to transition to the second display area and, based upon a symbol landing in a symbol position associated with persistence, cause the symbol to remain in the symbol position associated with persistence for at least one of i) each remaining spin of the plurality of spins or ii) until the symbol is replaced by another symbol.

title: Pex expansion tool
abstract: A power tool includes a motor, a mandrel movable along a mandrel axis, and a rotation collar that defines an opening that receives the mandrel. The rotation collar is rotatable about the mandrel axis. The power tool also includes a drive system coupled to the motor to cause the mandrel to move along the mandrel axis so that the mandrel causes the rotation collar to rotate about the mandrel axis.

title: Light-emitting device and projection apparatus
abstract: A light-emitting device and a projection apparatus are provided. The light-emitting device includes a plurality of light-emitting chips and a collimating lens. The collimating lens includes a first collimating portion and a second collimating portion. The first collimating portion is configured to: reduce a divergence angle of a laser beam exiting from the first collimating portion in a first direction to 0°, reduce a divergence angle of the laser beam exiting from the first collimating portion in a second direction, and the divergence angle of the laser beam exiting from the first collimating portion in the second direction is greater than 0°. The second collimating portion is configured to reduce a divergence angle of a laser beam exiting from the second collimating portion in the second direction to 0°.

title: Windshield debris wiper
abstract: A debris removal system for a window of a vehicle comprises a wiper assembly and a rotatable brushing assembly. The wiper assembly includes a wiper arm that traverses a wiping path along the window and a wiper blade operably coupled with the wiper arm. The rotatable brushing assembly includes an elongated brush having a longitudinal axis and a motor operably coupled with a portion of the elongated brush. The motor rotates the elongated brush about the longitudinal axis. At least a portion of the elongated brush traverses the wiping path along the window.
assignee: International Truck Intellectual Property Company, Llc

title: Photosensitive resin composition, photosensitive element, method for forming resist pattern, and method for producing printed wiring board
abstract: A photosensitive resin composition according to an aspect of the present disclosure contains a binder polymer, a photopolymerizable compound, a photopolymerization initiator, and a sensitizer, in which the binder polymer has a structural unit derived from acrylic acid, and the sensitizer includes an anthracene compound.

title: Salt and solid forms of a cdk inhibitor
abstract: Various salt forms and free base of Compound (I) represented by the following formula are disclosed.

title: Ultrapure water production facility
abstract: An ultrapure water manufacturing facility includes: a supply line connected to a pure water storage tank and in which a plurality of pure water treatment devices are sequentially arranged; a branch line branched downstream of the supply line and connected to the pure water storage tank; and a first automatic valve connected to the branch line and configured to be actuated by a double-acting actuator.

title: 3d computing devices and structures with memory arrays
abstract: A computing device including: a substrate level including at least one interconnect layer, which includes at least one first metal layer; a first level disposed on top of the substrate level and includes first transistors and at least one second metal layer; a second level including at least four independently controlled first memory arrays and includes second transistors; a third level disposed on top of the second level, where the third level includes second memory arrays; a fourth level disposed on top of the third level, where the fourth level includes fourth transistors and at least one third metal layer, where the fourth level includes third memory arrays; where the fourth level is bonded to the third level, where the bonded includes metal-to-metal bonding regions, where the first level includes at least one SRAM memory array, and where the substrate includes an area larger than 2,000 mm 2 .

title: Modular Water Quality System with Wifi and Variable Power Sources
abstract: This water quality monitoring system uses a microcontroller connected to interchangeable sensors that simultaneously measure pH, turbidity, dissolved solids, temperature, water level, flow rate, oxidation-reduction potential, and soil moisture. It automatically detects and bypasses faulty sensors without disrupting overall operation. Raw data is filtered and calibrated, then converted into practical indicators like a Water Quality Index, corrosion risk, sediment runoff risk, and algae growth potential. A GPS module tags each reading with location and timestamp. Data is accessible three ways: an LCD screen, SD card (CSV format), and a wireless web server with remote update support. Color-coded alerts and audible warnings make results easy to interpret for non-experts. The system runs on solar, battery, or AC power for remote deployment. One-button calibration and a single-unit design cut costs to roughly one-tenth of comparable commercial systems.

title: Wiring board and head-mounted display
abstract: A wiring board includes a substrate that is transparent, and a mesh wiring layer that is disposed on the substrate. The wiring board has an electromagnetic wave transceiver function. The mesh wiring layer is configured to be a transceiver portion for an electromagnetic wave and includes a wiring line. A planar shape of the wiring line has multiple curves that are connected to each other. The curves are arcs or elliptical arcs.

title: Agentic workflow framework
abstract: A system and method including receiving a signal to initiate execution of a modeled workflow including at least one artificial intelligence (AI) task to perform at least one activity towards a specified result and the AI task being assigned to an artificial intelligence (AI) agent; determining a current context for the modeled workflow; determining to call the AI agent to execute the AI task; determining by the AI agent, based in part on the current context, to call a large language model (LLM) to execute the at least one activity of the AI task, a prompt for the LLM model being derived from at least attributes of the AI task and the AI agent; and determining by the AI agent, based in part on a result of the call to the LLM model, at least one next action to perform towards an achievement of the result.

title: Microwave heating apparatus
abstract: Disclosed is a microwave heating apparatus. The microwave heating apparatus comprises a cavity configured for microwaves to resonate; a first waveguide connected to one side of the cavity and supplying microwaves; and a second waveguide connected to the other side of the cavity and supplying microwaves, the first waveguide and the second waveguide being arranged such that respective central axes thereof are spaced apart from each other by at least a predetermined distance, and microwaves incident from the first and second waveguides generating constructive interference and destructive interference inside the cavity to form a uniform distribution of an electric field.
assignee: POSTECH Research and Business Development Foundation

title: Adsorbent Material, Adsorption System, and Adsorption Process For Hydrogen Recovery
abstract: An adsorption system having at least one adsorber retaining a bed of adsorbent material can be configured to provide enhanced purification of fees having relatively low concentrations of hydrogen or helium. Embodiments can utilize an activated carbon layer between at least one upstream layer and at least one downstream layer. The activate carbon layer can include activated carbon can have a pre-selected surface area (SA), bulk density, total open pore volume (TOPV), and/or ratio of TOPV to surface area (TOPV/SA).

title: Method for producing a bearing arrangement for an implantable blood pump, bearing arrangement and implantable blood pump
abstract: A method is provided for producing a bearing arrangement for an implantable blood pump. A bearing arrangement and an implantable blood pump are also provided. In the method, a rotor may be provided having one or more drive magnets. The rotor has a conveying element. In addition, a stator having stator windings is provided. Furthermore, the rotor is arranged in a flow channel formed by an inside wall of the stator. A rotor rotation is then driven. While the rotor rotation is driven, a deflection of the rotor is determined. In addition, the deflection of the rotor may be corrected by applying, removing, magnetizing and/or demagnetizing magnetically active material on the stator and/or on the rotor in a non-rotationally symmetrical manner.

title: Sensor enabled interbody implants and methods for manufacturing same
abstract: A sensor enabled implant is disclosed. The sensor-enabled implant includes two endplates that are separated via a low stiffness body. A sensor is disposed within the implant body along the loading direction of the implant such that it measures the load applied to a loadbearing endplate of the implant.

title: High Band Frequency PUCCH Configurations
abstract: A base station configures a physical uplink control channel (PUCCH) for a user equipment (UE) operating in a frequency band above 52.6 GHz. The base station allocates a predetermined number of resource blocks (RBs) for a physical uplink control channel (PUCCH) transmission, wherein the predetermined number of RBs is greater than one RB, transmits a PUCCH configuration including the predetermined number of RBs to the UE and receives a PUCCH transmission based on the PUCCH configuration and including a data sequence and a DMRS sequence, wherein the PUCCH configuration results in a multiplexing of a plurality of UEs based on a plurality of demodulated reference signal (DMRS) sequences.

title: Uplink transmission repetition for full-duplex and non full-duplex sets of symbols
abstract: A user equipment (UE) may receive configuration information that configures a first sounding reference signal (SRS) resource set including one or more SRS resources associated with a full duplex (FD) set of symbols, and a second SRS resource set including one or more SRS resources associated with a non-FD set of symbols. The UE may receive at least one of a radio resource control (RRC) communication or a downlink control information (DCI) communication indicating that the first SRS resource set is to be associated with an uplink transmission repetition, the first SRS resource set and the second SRS resource set are to be associated with the uplink transmission repetition, or the second SRS resource set is to be associated with the uplink transmission repetition. The UE may transmit the uplink transmission repetition based at least in part on the at least one of the RRC communication or the DCI communication.

title: Rotatable sensory ball
abstract: Provided is a rotatable sensory ball, which includes a ball body composed of several rotating bodies stacked vertically, and a rotating component provided between adjacent stacked rotating bodies. The rotating bodies can achieve relative rotational motion between the rotating bodies through the rotating component between them. The rotating component includes a winding column member connected between the rotating bodies. The winding column member is located at a position where the two rotating bodies deviate from the axis. The two adjacent stacked rotating bodies can perform circumferential rotation around the winding column member. At another node relative to the winding column member, the adjacent stacked rotating bodies are equipped with magnetic attraction members that mutually attract each other. This node is a reset node. By utilizing the magnetic effect of the reset node, the stacked rotating bodies can stably form a complete spherical shape and maintain their structural stability.

title: Techniques for spatial quasi co-location relationship for analog beamforming with discrete antennas
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may transmit, to a network node, signaling indicating an analog beamforming capability associated with the UE. The UE may receive, from the network node, a reference signal configuration in accordance with the analog beamforming capability associated with the UE, wherein the reference signal configuration indicates a spatial quasi co-location (QCL) relationship between one or more reference signals for learning beam weights and one or more transmissions that use the beam weights. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Apparatus for supporting a component
abstract: An apparatus for supporting a component to aid manufacturing, assembly, maintenance or repair operations. The apparatus includes a platform. The apparatus also includes a first support structure mounted on the platform and configured to support a first end of the component. The first support structure includes a first pedestal including a first pedestal body disposed on the platform. The first pedestal further includes a pair of first transverse members spaced apart from each other and extending from the first pedestal body towards a direction away from the platform. Each first transverse member from the pair of first transverse members  includes at least two first openings. The first openings in the spaced apart first transverse members are aligned with each other.

title: Sensorized shipping container geofencing systems and methods
abstract: Systems and methods for tracking a shipment can include a data logger and a location sensor located onboard a shipping container. The data logger can have one or more Geofences stored thereon that allows the data logger to detect Geofence activity violations and send updates to a remote monitoring unit (e.g., a fleet management server system or the like) depending on the shipping container's detected location with respect to the one or more Geofences. The Geofence can have an entry radius and an exit radius. An entry into the Geofence boundary can be detected in response to the shipping container crossing the Geofence entry radius. An exit out of the Geofence boundary can be detected in response to the shipping container crossing the Geofence exit radius. The entry radius can be different from the exit radius.

title: Generative and adaptive mediator for real-time interactions with conversational agents
abstract: A generative mediator engine can perform a requested interaction with a conversational agent of a target entity on behalf of a user. An internal conversational platform can identify intents for the requested interaction. An external artificial intelligence engine can perform intent discovery when an intent is not identified above a confidence threshold. A discovered intent unknown to the generative mediator engine can be received from the external artificial intelligence engine and used, with input requirements determined by the generative mediator for the requested interaction, by a dialog generator to generate a sample dialog for the requested interaction. User feedback can be received after review of action items and expected inputs identified from the sample dialog. The generative mediator engine can perform the requested interaction with the conversational agent on behalf of the user and without receiving user intervention during the requested interaction.

title: Processor cluster energy management circuits and methods of managing energy of a processor cluster
abstract: In contrast to integrated circuits (ICs) having uniform clusters of homogeneous processor cores, the task of dividing a total IC power budget is more complicated in ICs having heterogeneous clusters and processing circuits with various activity levels. In a processor cluster including a plurality of processing circuits, which includes at least a first type processing circuit and at least a second type processing circuit, a cluster power management circuit receives a cluster energy credit and generates processor energy credits for the plurality of processing circuits. The processor energy credits for each of the processing circuits are based on a weight corresponding to the processing circuit applied to the cluster energy credits, and on signals configured to suspend provision of the processor energy credits to the processing circuit. Weights for the processing circuits may be stored in programmable storage circuits. Suspended energy credits of a processing circuit may be reallocated.

title: Foldable lap tray for carrying food and beverages
abstract: A foldable lap tray having a platform area for carrying personal items on a lap of a user is provided. The lap tray can include a base portion forming the platform area, a back rail projecting upward from the base portion, and a stand portion articulable along a distal edge of the base portion. In a deployed configuration, the platform area can be unfolded along a base portion crease and the stand portion can be positioned underneath the base portion. In a folded configuration, the base portion can be folded along the base portion crease toward the back rail, the stand portion can be folded along the distal edge of the base portion and along stand portion creases such that the stand portion extends from the distal edge of the base portion, around the back rail, and to the base portion crease, at least partially enclosing the back rail therein.

title: Control devices with injection/aspiration syringes
abstract: A mounting device for coupling an accessory device to a handle of an endoscope may include a coupling member configured to be releasably secured to the handle of the endoscope and a port assembly connected to the coupling member. The port assembly may include a first port defining a first lumen and extending along a first longitudinal axis, and a second port defining a second lumen and extending along a second longitudinal axis. The second longitudinal axis may extend at a non-parallel angle relative to the first longitudinal axis.

title: Electronic apparatus and fixing structure
abstract: An electronic apparatus includes: a substrate; and an electronic module fixed to the substrate. The electronic apparatus has a bracket that is provided along an edge portion forming one end of the electronic module, a screw that is rotatably provided on the bracket and configured to fix the edge portion of the electronic module to the substrate, and a sheet that protrudes from the bracket to a side opposite to the electronic module.

title: Neural network training using corrective distillation
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to perform training and finetuning to increase accuracy of neural networks. In at least one embodiment, a processor performs a neural network training by generating a clone of the neural network to generate training data through minifinetuning which may then be used to train the neural network, facilitating an increase in domain-specific knowledge while also preventing degeneralization.

title: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A semiconductor device and a forming method thereof are provided. The semiconductor device includes a first semiconductor die having a stepped sidewall and a second semiconductor die. The first semiconductor die includes a first dielectric layer and a first bonding pad at a bonding side of the first semiconductor die. The second semiconductor die includes a second dielectric layer bonded to the first dielectric layer of the first semiconductor die and a second bonding pad engaging the first bonding pad of the first semiconductor die, where sidewalls of the first bonding pad are offset from sidewalls of the second bonding pad.

title: Soybean variety '21850684 '
abstract: New soybean variety designated ‘21850684’ is described. ‘21850684’ is a soybean variety exhibiting stability and uniformity.

title: Mounting structure for electronic component
abstract: A mounting configuration includes a pair of lands on a substrate, an electronic component including a component main body and a pair of external electrodes, each external electrode having an extension portion, and solder connecting the external electrodes to the lands. When a direction in which a pair of lands are aligned is defined as an X direction, a direction in which the pair of lands are spaced apart is defined as a spacing direction, and a direction in which the pair of lands are opposed to each other is defined as an opposing direction, an opposing direction end portion of solder is located in the X direction at a position between an opposing direction end portion of the extension portion and a spacing direction end portion of a corresponding external electrode or at the spacing direction end portion of the corresponding external electrode.

title: Operation of agents in a communication network
abstract: According to an aspect, there is provided a computer-implemented method of managing operations of a plurality of agents. Each agent is for adjusting values of one or more parameters in a respective network part of the communication network. The method comprises obtaining configuration information for the plurality of network parts; for each part of the plurality of network parts, determining a respective exploration policy to be used by an agent to determine adjustments to the values of the one or more parameters in the respective network part, wherein the exploration policy is determined based on the received configuration information for the plurality of network parts; and deploying the respective determined exploration policy or an exploratory action determined from the respective determined exploration policy to the respective network part.

title: Display substrate, display apparatus, and method of fabricating display substrate
abstract: A display substrate includes an anode material layer extending at least partially across multiple subpixels. The anode material layer includes a first anode portion at least partially in subpixel regions and a second anode portion at least partially in an inter-subpixel region. The first anode portion includes a doped anode impurity. The first anode portion and the second anode portion include at least one material in common. A weight percentage of the doped anode impurity in the first anode portion is higher than a weight percentage of the doped anode impurity in the second portion. A weight ratio of the doped anode impurity to the at least one material in common in the first anode portion is higher than a weight ratio of the doped anode impurity to the at least one material in common in the second anode portion. The second anode portion spaces apart adjacent subpixels.

title: Electronic circuitry, power converter, and driving method
abstract: An electronic circuitry includes a voltage detection circuit configured to detect an output voltage of a switching element controlled in accordance with a control signal instructing a turn-off operation or a turn-on operation; a controller configured to compare, in a transition period of the turn-off operation or the turn-on operation, the output voltage with a first reference voltage determined in accordance with a power voltage, and determine, based on a comparison result, a first current value or a second current value having an absolute value smaller than an absolute value of the first current value and a direction same as a direction of the first current value; and a current supply circuit configured to supply a drive current to the switching element based on the first current value or the second current value determined by the controller.

title: Metal etching stop layer in magnetic tunnel junction memory cells
abstract: A method of forming integrated circuits includes forming Magnetic Tunnel Junction (MTJ) stack layers, depositing a conductive etch stop layer over the MTJ stack layers, depositing a conductive hard mask over the conductive etch stop layer, and patterning the conductive hard mask to form etching masks. The patterning is stopped by the conductive etch stop layer. The method further includes etching the conducive etch stop layer using the etching masks to define patterns, and etching the MTJ stack layers to form MTJ stacks.

title: Terminal assembly and liquid-cooled charging system
abstract: Provided are a terminal assembly and a liquid-cooled charging system. The terminal assembly includes a conductive terminal, a cable, and a cooling cavity body. The conductive terminal has a plug-in end and a connecting end. The cable is electrically connected to the connecting end. The cooling cavity body has a cooling inlet, one end of the cooling cavity body is sealingly sleeved on the connecting end, and the other end of the cooling cavity body is sealingly sleeved on an end of the cable for connecting the connecting end. The conductive terminal, the cable, and the cooling cavity body mate with one another to form a cooling cavity communicating with the cooling inlet, and a cooling medium is disposed in the cooling cavity.

title: Remote console for bare metal machines in a cloud computing platform
abstract: A cloud computing platform provides a service that enables the user to access and control their bare metal machine via an out-of-band channel. The user invokes this service by connecting to a session server in a data center in the computing platform. The session server connects to the correct bare metal machine for the authenticated user. It provides the user with a persistent, virtualized session to the serial port of the user's bare metal machine. The solution may be implemented with use of a terminal server that multiplexes a local area network connection from the session server to the serial ports of each bare metal machine. Via this link, the device provides the user with the aforementioned access and control services, enabling the user to configure their bare metal machine even if it is inaccessible through network ports.

title: Substrate Processing Apparatus and Maintenance Method
abstract: A substrate processing apparatus has a correction mechanism that corrects warping of a substrate on a substrate support  by bringing a correction member into contact with an upper surface of the substrate, by raising or lowering at least one of a correcting/supporting part and the substrate support while the correction member remains in a correction posture facing the substrate support. The correcting/supporting part is provided so as to be swingable about a first swing shaft extending in a first horizontal direction. The correcting/supporting part is  switchable between the correction posture and a separation posture. In separation posture, the correction member is spaced upward from the substrate support with the opening opened by opening the lid part. Hence, a maintenance operation can be performed by accessing an internal space of the substrate processing apparatus without removing the correction mechanism from the apparatus.

title: Method for displaying alternative navigation route, and navigation device
abstract: A navigation device according to an embodiment may comprise: a user interface receiving an input from a user and displaying a route; and a control unit configured to control the user interface to display a route to a destination entered by the user as an existing route, and, when receiving, from the user, an avoidance trigger input corresponding to a guided action on a road traveled by a vehicle, determine at least one alternative route including at least one alternative action different from the guided action, and control the user interface to display the at least one alternative route.

title: Method and system for automating task processing
abstract: A method for automating task processing may include providing information about a task knowledge, comprising a screen snapshot image of a first user device which corresponds to each action included in a task, to a generative artificial intelligence (AI) model, providing a snapshot image of a current screen of a second user device to the generative AI model, obtaining action information to be executed on the current screen from the generative AI model as a response to the provision of the snapshot image, controlling the second user device to automatically execute an action corresponding to the action information on the current screen and repeating the providing of the snapshot image of the current screen to the generative AI model, the obtaining of the action information and the controlling of the second user device to automatically execute the action corresponding to the action information until processing of the task is terminated.

title: Trop2-binding proteins and uses thereof
abstract: Provided herein are antigen-binding protein constructs (ABPCs) that bind TROP2 and uses of the same.

title: Single control scheme for two autonomous driving modes using model predictive control envelope
abstract: Systems and methods of using a common control scheme to autonomously control a vehicle during semi-autonomous and fully autonomous driving modes are provided. In particular, embodiments of the presently disclosed technology incorporate reference tracking for driving input and vehicle state into this common control scheme. In some embodiments, this common control scheme may be implemented using Model Predictive Control (“MPC”).

title: Integrated scoop fuel injection
abstract: A combustor system for an aerial vehicle includes an outer case with a first end and a second end, an inner combustor case contained within the outer case, the inner combustor case defining an outer periphery of a central combustor chamber. The inner combustor case further includes a first lumen extending into the central combustor chamber a first air flow path extending between and defined by the outer case and the inner combustor case. The system further includes an integrated air scoop attached to the inner combustor case at the first lumen and configured to direct air from the first air flow path into the central combustor chamber, a fuel manifold with a fuel orifice within the integrated air scoop, and a splash plate with a first face and a second face, the splash plate extending through the first lumen into the central combustor chamber.

title: Intraoperative and phantom-less calibration of registration of imaging system with intraoperative imaging to reference imaging
abstract: A method of registering intraoperative medical images to reference medical images includes: generating early-intraoperative medical images with an intraoperative medical imaging system; registering the reference medical images to the early-intraoperative medical images while computing a transform between coordinates of corresponding features in the reference medical images and the early-intraoperative medical images, the transform using location of the intraoperative medical imaging system as determined by a tracker; obtaining later intraoperative medical images; and applying the transform to register the reference medical images to the later intraoperative medical images. A system for generating and displaying reference and intraoperative medical images has a tracker attached to the intraoperative imaging machine and a registration machine configured to register the reference medical images to early-intraoperative medical images while recording a transform and to use that transform when registering later intraoperative medical images to the reference medical images.

title: Method for identifying playing actions and playing frets of stringed instrument
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method for identifying a playing action and a playing fret of a stringed instrument, which comprises the following steps: collecting an electrical signal generated by cutting magnetic lines of a strong magnetic magnetic magnet when a string vibrates and outputting an analog signal; filtering, amplifying and biasing the analog signal to output a DC signal; sampling the DC signal and converting the DC signal into a digital signal; operating the digital signal and the outputting a detection result, and sending the detection result to a terminal.

title: Generating credit capacity estimates
abstract: One or more computer processors are used to generate an estimate of a credit capacity of a client. Financial data relating to the client is received. The financial data is input to one or more trained machine learning models. The one or more trained machine learning models are used to generate, based on the financial data, the estimate of the credit capacity.

title: Pressurizing Device
abstract: The pressurizing device includes a syringe configured to store a fluid, a plunger for discharging the fluid to the outside of the syringe when the plunger moves to one side in a first direction, a regulating member configured to move in a second direction intersecting the first direction, between a separated position of being separated from the plunger and a contact position of being in contact with the plunger, a lever configured to move the regulating member from the contact position to the separated position, and a rotation mechanism provided at a position overlapping with the regulating member in the second direction, configured to move in the second direction in accordance with rotation of the lever, and configured to move, when moving to one side in the second direction, the regulating member from the contact position to the separated position.

title: Radiation shield assembly
abstract: A radiation shield assembly is described, configured to block radiation emanating from a radiation source from reaching a user. Two shields are supported by a support arm, and are configured to rotate and translate relative to one another about the support arm's longitudinal axis. This allows the shield to be easily configured and reconfigured as necessary to visualize various parts of a patient's body via radiography.

title: Magnetic detection system
abstract: To provide a magnetic detection system capable of detecting a metallic foreign object with high sensitivity. A magnetic detection system includes: a signal generation circuit that generates an excitation signal; an excitation coil to which the excitation signal is supplied; a buffer circuit that is connected between the signal generation circuit and the excitation coil; magnetic sensors that are disposed on opposite sides of the excitation coil along the coil axis direction; a sample stage that holds a sample between the excitation coil and the first magnetic sensor; and a detection circuit that generates a detection signal based on the difference between output signals from the magnetic sensors. With this configuration, the buffer circuit suppresses waveform distortion of the excitation signal, thereby enabling detection of a metallic foreign object with high sensitivity.

title: Scheduling for task processing
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosure provide a solution for task scheduling. A method includes: obtaining a workflow for processing a task, the workflow comprising a plurality of nodes connected in an order, a node in the plurality of nodes being configured to perform a subtask of the task based on configuration information of the node; in response to a first node of the plurality of nodes being scheduled for processing, extracting first input information for the first node from context information associated with the workflow, the context information being accessible to the plurality of nodes; causing a first subtask to be processed by the first node at least based on the first input information, to obtain a response of the first subtask; and updating the context information based on the response of the first subtask.

title: Dispute Resolution in Billing Information
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclose provide a method ( 400 ) for dispute resolution in billing information generated for communication services. The method ( 400 ) being performed by a computing device ( 104 ). The method ( 400 ) comprises receiving ( 402 ) a request message for a credit amount to be refunded to the customer account, said request message comprising the billing information related to a customer. The method ( 400 ) comprises determining ( 404 ) whether or not to refund the credit amount to the customer account based on an evaluation of the billing information. In response to the determination, the method ( 400 ) comprises initiating ( 406 ) credit refund to the customer account, altering the billing information or denying the request message. Corresponding computing device, billing dispute resolution system, and computer program products are also disclosed.

title: Image-based circular plot recognition and interpretation
abstract: A device includes software instructions for a circular plot analysis agent and at least one circular plot definition. The circular plot analysis agent obtains a digital image of a circular plot, detects a perimeter of the circular plot within the digital image, detects a plurality of edges within the perimeter, identifies a set of endpoints on the perimeter as a function of the plurality of edges, generates a plot descriptor from the set of endpoints, and initiates a transaction with a second device as a function of the plot descriptor.
