The portion of the spring units is spaced apart from the force-bearing ends of the spring units by at least ¼ of a length of the springs, and the connection portions are a part of the flexible sleeves or connectors assembled on peripheral sides of the flexible sleeves. At least one layer of the connection portions is disposed in a height direction of the spring unit.

title: Computer-based infrastructure providing an integration engine for digital asset transactions
abstract: A exemplary method for providing a digital asset transaction workflow within a client application provided by a client system comprises: causing display of one or more user controls, within one or more graphical user interfaces of the client application, for specifying a plurality of parameters of a transaction by a user; sending a request to a remote integration engine; receiving, from the remote integration engine, an encoded URL link generated based on the request; based on the encoded URL link, causing display of one or more user controls for entering authentication information for the one or more providers; transmitting the authentication information to the one or more providers; receiving, from the remote integration engine, an ordered sequence of sub-transactions; and causing display of the ordered sequence of sub-transactions and a status indicating performance of each sub-transaction in the ordered sequence of sub-transactions by the one or more providers.

title: User interfaces for managing sharing of content in three-dimensional environments
abstract: A computer system optionally displays a user interface object that reveals content based on whether the content is private or shared. A computer system optionally displays a user interface object that includes shared content based on whether participants have entitlement to the content. A computer system optionally displays a sharing indicator that indicates that the respective content is shared with one or more other participants.

title: 1-thioxo-2,4-dihydrothieno[2,3-e] [1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a]pyrimidin-5(1h)-one derivatives as allosteric inhibitors of the polo-like kinase 1 (plk1) polo box domain (pbd) for the treatment of cancer
abstract: Disclosed are allosteric inhibitors of the Plk1 Polo Box Domain (PBD), which are useful in treating cancers by inducing mitotic block of the cancer cells. Examples of such inhibitors include compounds of formula (I) and (II), as well as pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, wherein X, R 1 , R 2 , and R 3  are as defined. Also disclosed are pharmaceutical compositions containing a compound or salt thereof and a method of treating cancer in an animal by administering to the animal an effective amount of the compound or the pharmaceutical composition.
assignee: The United States Of America, As Represented By The Secretary, Department Of Health And Human Servic

title: Method of high-quality video scaling with real-time x-model/plus-model filter on field programmable gate array(fpga)
abstract: A method of obtaining X-Model/Plus-Model filter by combining and then mathematical reducing SSF (Sharpening Spatial Filter) and CF (Clamp Filter) and scaling high quality video with this filter in real time on field programmable gate array (FPGA) is provided. With the method, the developed X-Model/Plus-Model filter was applied before the application of interpolation to increase the quality of the scaled video. The said filter is applied in real time with advantages such as low computational complexity, low memory requirement, low power and low resource consumption, and high operating frequency.
assignee: Aselsan Elektronik Sanayi Ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi

title: Method for processing identification result and maintenance system
abstract: Disclosed are a method for processing an identification result and a related device. A method for processing an identification result includes: obtaining an image from a user, the image including a plant in a scene; identifying plant feature information and scene feature information of the image; extracting content information from a content database according to the plant feature information; inputting the content information and the scene feature information to a large language model to generate an identification result page from the content information based on the scene feature information; and displaying the generated identification result page on a user interface.

title: Epoxy resin composition, varnish, inorganic composite sheet, and metal-based substrate
abstract: Provided is an epoxy resin composition containing an epoxy resin (A), alumina (B), and aggregated boron nitride (C), wherein the alumina (B) is a polyhedron with 14 or more faces.

title: Curable composition, cured film using same and display device including cured film
abstract: Provided are a curable composition including (A) quantum dots; (B) a polymerizable compound; and (C) an electrolyte, and having an electrical conductivity of 0.1 μS/cm to 2.5 μS/cm, a cured layer produced using the same, and a display device including the cured layer.

title: Device wake-up method and communication apparatus
abstract: Embodiments of this application relate to the field of communication technologies, and provide a communication method and apparatus. In the method, a first network device sends first indication information to a terminal device, where the first indication information indicates information about a first time segment, a second time segment, and a third time segment, the first time segment and the second time segment respectively occupy a time segment in a first period, and the third time segment includes at least a part of each second time segment in a plurality of first periods. In this way, more resources can be scheduled at a time, a target with a higher sensing velocity can be sensed for the sensing signal, thereby improving a sensing capability.

title: Virtual IT and Cybersecurity Administrator Utilizing AI-Powered Playbooks
abstract: A unified, AI-powered multi-tenant virtual IT and cybersecurity administrator for managing and securing multiple IT domains through intelligent playbook-based workflows. The system utilizes machine learning to recommend and generate playbooks based on organizational needs, automates response actions through script execution and ticket creation, and provides continuous optimization through event collection and analysis. The system supports multiple organizations while maintaining data isolation and enabling shared learning benefits.

title: Systems and Methods for Recognition-Based Natural Language Processing
abstract: A recognition-based natural language processing system receives outputs from a pre-trained language model or base language model and applies a shared recognition coverage function F_cov(r)=r/(r+X_opt), where X_opt=phi/pi, to improve semantic prediction and language understanding. The system can generate recognition-enhanced embeddings from context-derived semantic distance, compute contextual coherence from pairwise embedding relationships weighted by positional distance, compute confidence-weighted sentiment outputs from raw sentiment scores and classifier confidence values, and compute recognition-based reranking weights for tokens, passages, documents, or other candidates. In some embodiments, the system combines multiple recognition-derived quantities into a bounded combined score used to rank or select outputs for classification, retrieval, generation, segmentation, moderation, or related natural language processing tasks. The disclosed architecture operates as a model-agnostic post-processing framework compatible with existing language-model pipelines.

title: A method, an apparatus and a computer program product for neural network complementary representations
abstract: The embodiments relate to method for encoding and decoding. The method for decoding comprises deploying a first neural network representation with a first number of bits; receiving at least some of the parameters of a second neural network representation with a second number of bits and information relating to the second neural network representation; decoding from the information an indication that the second neural network representation is to be processed to complement the first neural network representation; creating a third neural network representation according to the first neural network representation and said at least some of the parameters of the second neural network representation; and deploying the third neural network representation. The embodiments also relate to technical equipment for implementing the methods.

title: Diffusion bonded tungsten containing target to titanium or titanium alloy backing plate
abstract: A sputtering target assembly comprises a tungsten containing sputtering target, a titanium containing backing plate attached to the tungsten containing sputtering target and an interlayer positioned between and diffusion bonding the tungsten containing sputtering target and the titanium containing backing plate. The interlayer includes a nickel layer immediately adjacent to the tungsten containing sputtering target and a copper layer immediately adjacent to the nickel layer.

title: Methods for selectively depositing nano- or microscopic plugs in membranes for electrochemical applications
abstract: Crossover through submicron thick SiO 2  membranes can be mitigated by selectively depositing oxide, e.g., carbon-containing silicon oxide (SiO x C y ) “nanoplugs” into the pinholes and cracks of the membranes. Defect-containing membranes are contacted with a deposition solution including hydrolysable precursors, e.g., metal alkoxides like tetraethyl orthosilicate (TEOS), and a nanoplug directing agent, e.g., tetramethylammonium bromide (TMAB). Current is applied to the defect-containing membranes in pulses, including a shorter “on” phase where current is applied and a longer “off phase” where current is not applied. The SiO x C y  nanoplugs are deposited to the structural defects during the “on” phase. The longer “off phase” enables reactants to diffuse back to the structural defects for deposition of additional nanoplugs during the next “on” phase, as well as prevent deposition of SiO x C y  on non-defective regions. Treatment of plugged SiO 2  membranes reduced H 2  permeation rates by 5-6 orders of magnitude compared to unmodified SiO 2  and 1-2 orders of magnitude compared to Nafion-117 membranes.
assignee: The Trustees Of Columbia University In The City Of New York

title: Dielectric, capacitor including same, and device comprising capacitor
abstract: A dielectric contains a tantalum compound. The tantalum compound contains oxygen, and a first element other than oxygen and tantalum. The first element contains an atom having a valance electron number of four or less, and is capable of being a tetravalent positive ion in an ionic state.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: Surface coated cutting tool
abstract: A surface coated cutting tool with high durability in high feed cutting of austenitic stainless steel includes an A layer, a B layer, and a C layer on a substrate; the sum of the average thicknesses of these layers ranges from 0.7 to 21.0 μm; the A layer contains nitride or carbonitride of Ti; the B layer has an average composition (Al XC Ti 1-XC )(C YC N 1-YC ) (0.65≤XC≤0.90, 0.00≤YC<0.05), and contains at least 30 area % crystal grains having a wurtzite-type hexagonal crystal structure and the balance being crystal grains having a NaCl-type face-centered cubic crystal structure; and the C layer has an average composition (Al XC Ti 1-XC )(C YC N 1-YC ) (0.65≤XC≤0.90, 0.00≤YC<0.05), and contains 5 to 25 area % crystal grains having a wurtzite-type hexagonal crystal structure and the balance being crystal grains having a NaCl type face-centered cubic crystal structure.

title: Refrigerator appliance with icemaker and water reservoir system
abstract: A refrigerator appliance includes a valve system including a plurality of flow control devices, a filter fluidly coupled to the valve system, a first water supply conduit configured to provide water to the valve system through the filter, and an ice maker appliance configured to receive water from the valve system. The refrigerator appliance also includes a water collection reservoir positioned to receive fluid from a return conduit fluidly coupling the water collection reservoir to the first water supply conduit. A controller is operably coupled to the valve system. The controller is configured to receive and transmit signals operative of at least one of the plurality of flow control devices to selectively permit and inhibit flow of water therethrough.

title: Pharmaceutical compositions and methods for treating or preventing bacterial infections in humans and in animals
abstract: A pharmaceutical composition having antibiotic qualities is disclosed. The pharmaceutical composition includes a plurality of leaves and stems of the plant  Justicia secunda , wherein the plurality of leaves and stems dried and pulverized to form a coarse powder; and an organic solvent, the coarse powder combined with the organic solvent for one to ten days, but preferably seven days, to form an organic solvent extract that yields a powder composition under column chromatography.

title: Proactive control of task execution in a hyperscaler
abstract: A system includes obtaining a set of tasks designated for execution within a hyperscaler, collecting data on an operational readiness of operational resources required by the designated tasks, estimating a future success metric for a task of the designated tasks based on the operational readiness of the required operational resources, comparing the estimated future success metric to a minimum acceptable success threshold, in response to determining that the likelihood of successful completion is below the minimum acceptable success threshold, queuing the task for deferred execution, and in response to determining that the likelihood of successful completion is not below the minimum acceptable success threshold, passing the task to a scheduling mechanism of the hyperscaler for execution.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and program
abstract: The present technology relates to an information processing apparatus, an information processing method, and a program capable of suppressing deterioration in quality of user experience due to quality of a transmission path for transmitting information corresponding to displacement information regardless of a type of processing performed on the basis of the displacement information. The transmission control unit of the client apparatus performs control such that displacement information indicating displacement of an operation button that is displaced in accordance with a user's operation and presents a force sensation to the user is transmitted to a server  13  via the transmission path. The control unit controls presentation of a force sensation by the operation button on the basis of the quality of the transmission path. The present technology can be applied to, for example, a game streaming system or the like including a client apparatus, a controller apparatus connected to the client apparatus in a wired or wireless manner, and a server connected to the client apparatus via the Internet or the like.

title: An optimization to improve performance and power-saving for dl sps with ue tx interruption
abstract: A method for wireless communication at a user equipment (UE) and related apparatus are provided. In the method, the UE obtains a configuration for downlink (DL) semi-persistent scheduling (SPS), and activates the DL SPS for the reception of DL data at a periodicity. The UE further monitors for one or more transmissions associated with the DL SPS based on the periodicity, and deactivates the DL SPS based on the one or more transmissions. The method improves performance in DL SPS and reduces power consumption by eliminating unnecessary UL transmissions and PDSCH decoding when DL SPS status is misaligned between UE and the network.

title: Autostereoscopic display systems and methods for using the same
abstract: An autostereoscopic display system may determine a stereoscopic pair of images, the stereoscopic pair of images including a left eye image and a right eye image. The autostereoscopic display system may determine first lighting parameters for a first subset of subpixels for forming the left eye image and second lighting parameters for a second subset of subpixels for forming the right eye image, wherein the first lighting parameters include a first intensity profile that includes a reduced intensity at a periphery of the first subset of subpixels to thereby reduce crosstalk.

title: Battery pack
abstract:
A battery pack having a plurality of battery blocks is manufactured at a low cost. 
     One example of a specific configuration of the present invention is as described below. A battery pack in which a first battery block having a configuration in which a plurality of first batteries and a plurality of first spacers are alternately arranged in a first direction and a second battery block having a configuration in which a plurality of second batteries and a plurality of second spacers are alternately arranged in the first direction are disposed in a direction at a right angle to the first direction, in which the first spacers and the second spacers are integrally formed through first linking portions, and inter-block side rails that commonly press the first battery block and the second battery block in the first direction are disposed in the first linking portions.

title: Multipart ground screw collar device, assembly, system, and method
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a collar device for a multi-part ground screw assembly. A ground screw device and an installed racking system are also both provided. A method of installing the racking system is provided as well. The collar device includes an annular main body with at least one aperture having a hexagonal shape. The collar device further includes at least one fastener assembly, comprising a fastener with a head and a threaded post, a locking washer, and a hexnut washer. The collar device is coupled to the ground screw device and the racking device. Advantageously, the collar device is easy to transport for on-site installation of a solar racking system and provides an efficient system capable of easily removing the collar device from the solar racking system as well.

title: Imaging element cleaning apparatus with single hand operability
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosures made herein are directed to providing an effective and reliable approach for cleaning an exposed surface of an imaging element (e.g., a lens) of apparatuses including but not limited to medical imaging instruments such as endoscopes and laparoscopes and the like. In the case of medical imaging instruments, cleaning apparatuses configured in accordance with embodiments the disclosures made herein can be cleaned while the distal end portion of the endoscope is in vivo. Such apparatuses have a cleaning member incorporated therein (e.g., a resilient polymeric wiper, a sponge, an absorbent pad or the like) that is used for cleaning the exposed surface of the imaging element. The apparatus is preferably adapted for being mounted on imaging apparatus but can also be entirely or partially integral with one or more components of the imaging apparatus or system of which it is a component.

title: Reticle container with directed purge flow
abstract: A reticle container includes an outer pod and an inner pod, the inner pod configured to contain a reticle. The outer pod includes a pod door including a purge port, and a pod dome including one or more channels configured to receive a purge gas from the purge port and direct the purge gas to particular locations within the outer pod. The channels can direct the purge gas to one or more filters of the inner pod. The channels can direct the purge gas such that there is a pressure differential between the pressure at a first filter and the pressure at the second filter. The inner pod can include deflectors or channels to further direct the purge flow through the inner pod to purge the area surrounding the reticle.

title: System and method of using a knowledge representation for features in a machine learning classifier
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for classifying at least one unlabeled content item with a machine-learning classifier. A knowledge representation synthesized based on an object of interest is used as a source of features for which training data is evaluated. The machine learning classifier is trained based on features based on the attributes and the training data.

title: Method for counting sl consistent lbt failures, and communication apparatus
abstract: A method for counting sidelink (SL) consistent listen-before-talk (LBT) failure times is performed by a terminal. The method includes: in a case of sending SL data on an SL unlicensed frequency band, counting, according to an LBT failure indication of a resource block (RB) set belonging to a resource pool, LBT failure times of the resource pool.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Firearm suppressor with gas recirculation and modular components
abstract: The present disclosure provides a firearm suppressor comprising a proximal end configured to attach to a firearm barrel, a distal end, and a housing disposed between the proximal and distal ends. The housing may include a gas recirculation system that includes return tubes configured to redirect gas from the central chamber to the peripheral chamber, and injection tubes in fluid communication with the peripheral chamber and a receiving baffle to extend gas dwell time. The housing may include, in combination or separately, a helical path assembly. Other innovative aspects, such as an identification plate system, baffle features, support lattice, etc., are also disclosed.

title: Methods of using il-18 fusion proteins
abstract: Described herein are method of using fusion proteins composed of elements such as one or more proteins/polypeptides capable of translocating into an endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and an interleukin 18 (IL-18) or a fragment or variant of IL-18. The proteins/polypeptides capable of translocating into the ER include but are not limited to an immunoglobular protein such as Fc region, VHH antibody, and scFv, and a globular protein such as serum albumin. The IL-18 may be a precursor IL-18 that resembles the natural pro-cytokine in which IL-18 is fused to the C-terminus of its propeptide or a propeptide variant. These fusion proteins can be used in methods of treating cancer or fibrosis by activating an IL-18 receptor complex (RC) signal on a cell, releasing or exposing mature IL-18 in a tumor microenviromnent or adjacent to a tumor and/or increasing memory CD8 +  T cell proliferation.

title: Information display for patients
abstract: A system for automated information display may include at least one display associated with a room. The system may also include a content database including digital content. The digital content may include one or more videos and descriptions related to a procedure. The system may further include a subscriber system that may be operable to access a subset of the digital content in the content database. The subscriber system may also be operable to obtain first digital content from the content database based on a first profile associated with a first patient. The subscriber system may further be operable to direct the first digital content to be displayed on the at least one display corresponding to the room where the first patient may be located.

title: Dust collection apparatus, resin molding apparatus, and method for manufacturing resin molded product
abstract: The present invention is to reduce a power consumption amount of a dust collection apparatus used in a resin molding apparatus, and is a dust collection apparatus that collects dust from one or a plurality of dust collection ports provided in a resin molding apparatus, including an air blower driven by a motor, and an inverter that controls a rotation speed of the motor. The inverter controls the rotation speed of the motor to a first rotation speed, and in a case of lowering the rotation speed from the first rotation speed, the inverter releases an electrical connection to the motor and makes the motor to rotate by inertia.

title: System, method, and apparatus for providing optimized network resources
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing optimization of network resources. The system is operable to monitor the electromagnetic environment, analyze the electromagnetic environment, and extract environmental awareness of the electromagnetic environment. The system extracts the environmental awareness of the electromagnetic environment by including customer goals. The system is operable to use the environmental awareness with the customer goals and/or user defined policies and rules to extract actionable information to help the customer optimize the network resources.

title: Agentic Generative AI for Predictive Modelling of Reimbursement Decisions and Health Technology Assessment
abstract: A computer-implemented method for predictive modelling of reimbursement decisions for a health technology includes receiving input data that defines a health technology and parameters of a target Health Technology Assessment (HTA) scenario. The input data is analyzed by a generative artificial intelligence (AI) model trained on historical HTA decision data to produce a structured scenario profile. Contextual data relevant to the structured scenario profile is retrieved from multiple databases, including a historical HTA decision database, a clinical evidence database, and a health economic evidence database. A deliberation process is simulated using multiple AI agents, each representing a distinct HTA expert perspective, engaging in iterative interactions to determine a simulated reimbursement decision outcome. The method generates recommendations for modifying an HTA submission dossier to increase the likelihood of an affirmative reimbursement decision. The simulated reimbursement decision outcome and recommendations are provided to the user device.

title: Nonwoven Nanofiber Mat
abstract: Nonwoven nanofiber mats for use in radiative cooling applications must have high emissivity in the atmospheric window (where the atmosphere is relative transparent to EM radiation), and relatively lower emissivity elsewhere. Materials with this emissive property are referred to as selective emitters (SEs). Materials used in nanofiber nonwoven mats used for SEs should have low absorbance to solar radiation, so they are not heated by incident solar irradiation. Properties of the mat are chosen to exploit Mie scattering to achieve high reflectance to solar radiation. A coating can be applied to the top layer of the SE to enhance its emissivity, and to mechanically bind fibers in the layer. Emissivity enhancing particles can be added to the coating to improve emissivity.

title: Hybrid liquid crystal lens and method for driving thereof
abstract: A hybrid liquid crystal lens including: index-matching LC lens; Gradient Refractive Index (GRIN) LC lens; first driving circuit (DC) ( 106 ) configured to drive index-matching LC lens to produce first optical power (OP); second DC configured to drive GRIN LC lens to produce second OP(s); and controller configured to: generate first and second drive signals for first and second DCs; determine third OP(s) by processing eye-tracking data collected by eye-tracking means to determine optical depth at which user of hybrid LC lens is looking; select third OP(s); determine whether third OP(s) is equal to or greater than maximum OP producible by index-matching LC lens; and when so determined, determine first OP equal to maximum OP producible by index-matching LC lens and second OP(s) equal to difference between third OP(s) and maximum OP producible by index-matching LC lens.

title: Photocurable resin for high-resolution 3-d printing
abstract: Provided are photocurable resins comprising a poly(siloxane)-based copolymer together with a photoinitiator, and other optional ingredients such as a photocurable diluent, a photoabsorber, a photosensitizer, or a hydrophillic additive. Also provided are methods of stereolithographically printing a 3-D object from a disclosed resin. Also provided is an improved method for stereolithographically printing a 3-D object, the improvement comprising the use of a disclosed photocurable resin. Further provided is a 3-D microfluidic device such as an artificial lung prepared from a disclosed photocurable resin.
assignee: The United States Government As Represented By The Department Of Veterans Affairs

title: System and method of transposed matrix-vector multiplication
abstract: A system including a memory and hardware compute logic is described. The memory includes memory cells storing weights corresponding to a matrix. Hardware compute logic is coupled with the memory cells. The hardware compute logic is configured to perform a vector-matrix multiplication (VMM) for the matrix and for a matrix transpose for the weights being stationary for the memory cells.

title: Dosing Valve
abstract: A dosing valve is provided with a valve body having an inlet opening and an outlet opening which extend from a common overflow chamber in the valve body, and a diaphragm which delimits in sections the overflow chamber and is movable between an open and a closed position. In the closed position, the diaphragm rests on at least one valve seat in the overflow chamber and prevents flow from the inlet opening to the outlet opening, wherein the diaphragm is clamped between the valve body and a retaining part and a single-arm actuating lever is provided, which is pivotably mounted on the valve body or the retaining part via a bearing pin and to which the diaphragm is attached and which moves the diaphragm between the positions onto and away from the at least one valve seat.

title: Multi-output direct current (dc) voltage circuit
abstract: A multi-output direct current (DC) voltage circuit is disclosed. Herein, various embodiments are disclosed to help reduce solution size of the multi-output DC voltage circuit. In one aspect, a switched voltage booster circuit is configured to generate a boosted voltage based on a voltage booster duty cycle to drive multiple switched voltage output circuits, each of which will output a respective output voltage based on a respective output voltage duty cycle shorter than or equal to the voltage booster duty cycle. In another aspect, each of the switched voltage booster circuit and the switched voltage output circuits is configured to utilize lightly doped field-effect transistors (LDFETs) as switches whenever possible. By sharing the switched voltage booster circuit among the switched voltage output circuits and utilizing LDFETs as switches, it is possible to reduce the solution size of the multi-output DC voltage circuit for potential use in space constrained wireless devices.

title: Off-system telemetry transmission in a multi-application environment
abstract: An embodiment receives, from a first application, a first data transmission request comprising a destination information handling system, a first data identifier, and a first data portion, the first application executing on a first information handling system. An embodiment determines that the first data identifier is present in a transmission record of data identifiers transmitted from the first information handling system. An embodiment deletes, responsive to determining that the first data identifier is present in the transmission record, the first data portion from the first data transmission request, the deleting resulting in a modified first data transmission request. An embodiment transmits the modified first data transmission request from the first information handling system to the destination information handling system.

title: Laser source transmission system and manufacturing method of the same
abstract: An external laser source transmission system includes multiple external laser source transmission modules, a system substrate and multiple optical connecting elements. The system substrate is configured to carry the external laser source transmission modules. Each external laser source transmission module includes a light emitting assembly, a polarization-maintaining fiber assembly and an adaptor. The light emitting assembly includes a substrate and a molding element used to mold a laser, a lens, an isolator and the substrate. The polarization-maintaining fiber assembly is engaged with the light emitting assembly, and the polarization-maintaining fiber assembly includes a polarization-maintaining fiber and a cylindrical enclosing member. The adaptor is engaged with the light emitting assembly and the cylindrical enclosing member. The cylindrical enclosing member rotates relative to the adaptor to optimize polarization extinction ratio. The optical connecting elements are coupled to the polarization-maintaining fibers of the multiple external laser source transmission modules.

title: Free-fall protection assembly for elevator system and method of operation thereof
abstract: This disclosure relates to a free-fall prevention assembly, elevator assembly, and method of operation. The free-fall prevention assembly includes a magnetic element positioned underneath the elevator car that is configured to generate a first magnetic field. The free-fall prevention assembly further includes a copper bucket positioned in an elevator pit configured to generate a second magnetic field in response to an eddy current induced therein. The eddy current is induced in response to a passage of the first magnetic field through the copper bucket as the magnetic element of the elevator car moves relative to the copper bucket in the elevator pit. The second magnetic field repels the first magnetic field to reduce a descent speed of the elevator car under a free-fall condition, thereby preventing a free-fall of the elevator car.

title: Electrode tab support
abstract: An electrode tab support is provided. The electrode tab support includes a body portion; and a tab receptacle formed in the body portion and configured to receive an electrode tab, the tab receptacle including a first tab receptacle disposed on a first side of the body portion and a second tab receptacle disposed on a second side of the body portion, and the first tab receptacle and the second tab receptacle being spaced apart from each other at a predetermined distance in a thickness direction of the body portion, and staggered from each other and not in line with each other in a length direction of the body portion.

title: Method for managing air intake temperature in a vehicle
abstract: A method for managing engine air intake temperature of a turbocharged vehicle. The method includes sensing, by a temperature sensor, a temperature of fluid within an air intake flow path, the air intake flow path being defined from air entering the vehicle, passing through a turbocharger and into the engine; determining, by a controller, an estimated piston temperature of a piston of the engine based on at least the temperature of fluid; and in response to at least one of the estimated piston temperature being above a threshold piston temperature and the temperature of the fluid being above a threshold fluid temperature, causing, by the controller, an amount of cooling liquid to flow from a coolant container to the air intake flow path.

title: Compact container having a dual mesh structure
abstract: A compact container including a dual mesh structure is described. The compact container can include: a container body having an inner wall and a ledge, where the inner wall forms a holding space, and the ledge extends inward from an upper portion of the inner wall along an edge of an opening to the holding space; a mesh ring coupled to an upper portion of the container body; an application mesh fabricated from a porous material, where the application mesh includes an edge portion that is secured between the container body and the mesh ring and a center portion that covers the opening at an upper portion of the ledge; and a filter mesh fabricated from a porous material, where the filter mesh includes an edge portion that is secured to the container body and a center portion that covers the opening at a lower upper portion of the ledge.

title: Control of a household appliance
abstract: A system contains a household appliance which can be controlled on the basis of a function parameter. The household appliance is configured to store first function parameters, and an external location is configured to store first and second function parameters. The first function parameters of the household appliance and the second function parameters can be edited by an application connected to the external location. In the process, the first function parameters are transmitted from the household appliance to the external location.

title: Patterning material including carbon-containing layer andmethod for semiconductor device fabrication
abstract: In one exemplary aspect, the present disclosure is directed to a method for lithography patterning. The method includes providing a substrate and forming a target layer over the substrate. A patterning layer is formed by depositing a first layer having an organic composition having a composition including at least 50 atomic percentage carbon; depositing a second layer including silicon; and depositing a photosensitive layer on the second layer. In some implementations, the first layer is deposited by ALD, CVD, or PVD processes.

title: Structural health monitoring of cryogenic fuel tanks
abstract: A fuel system for an aircraft includes a cryogenic storage system for hydrogen fuel having an inner tank configured for direct contact with cryogenic hydrogen therein and an outer tank surrounding the inner tank and defined by a load-bearing element of the aircraft. The outer tank is spaced apart from the inner tank by an insulation gap. A first guided wave sensor array is coupled to the outer tank.

title: Failure indication system
abstract: In one or more arrangements, a failure indication system is provided having a light assembly, a heating mat assembly and a control circuit. The light assembly is configured to project a wavelength of light that is visible to animals and that illuminates the heating mat assembly to attract an animal to the heating mat. The control circuit is configured to detect when a fault has occurred with the heating mat assembly. When the control circuit detects that a fault has occurred with the heating mat assembly, the control circuit causes the light assembly to indicate the heating mat assembly is not functioning properly.

title: Storing data on multi-level cell memory cells
abstract: This disclosure is directed to a system for high efficiency storage in high capacity non-volatile solid state applications. The system includes a memory device and a processing device operatively coupled to the memory device. The processing device performs operations including receiving a request to program data, storing the data by default in a first type of storage with multi-level memory cells having a first number of levels, and bypassing a second type of storage with fewer levels. Upon detecting a condition, the processing device transfers the data to a third type of storage with a greater number of levels than the first type. This method optimizes storage efficiency and performance by dynamically managing data storage based on the portion of user logical block addresses that contain user data.

title: Systems and methods for verifying remote device proximity in rfid systems
abstract: Systems and methods for verifying remote device proximity in RFID systems are described. To reduce the risk of relay attacks, a terminal may determine a distance of a remote device from the terminal. The terminal may send a computational challenge to the remote device and determine whether a latency of the response is within a maximum acceptable latency, indicating that the remote device is within a maximum acceptable distance. The maximum acceptable latency may be dynamically determined based on context information, such as a time of day, that may be correlated with a likelihood of attempted unauthorized accesses. The terminal may determine whether to perform an action associated with the remote device based on whether the response was received within the maximum acceptable latency.

title: Method for detecting flood and apparatus and system for the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for detecting a flood and an apparatus and a system for the same. A system for detecting a flood according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may include a camera array including N (N is an integer greater than or equal to  1 ) cameras; and a flood detection processing apparatus that generates flood information by applying a neural network model in a video classification method based on N sample video data acquired from the camera array.

title: Context-based prompt generation
abstract: Context-based prompt generation techniques for generative machine-learning models are described. In one or more examples, a user interface (UI) selection of a UI element of first digital content is received. A processing device captures contextual information associated with the UI selection. A machine-learning model generates a prompt based on the UI selection and the contextual information. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) generates second digital content based on the prompt. The generative AI is implemented using one or more machine-learning models. The processing device then presents the second digital content for display in a user interface.

title: Method for detecting presence of an electric arc and associated device
abstract: A computer-implemented method for detecting the presence of an electric arc on a power line using a machine learning algorithm, carried out using a time-correlated measurement of the arc voltage V arc , of the current I and of the source voltage V source  and also a knowledge model for linking the arc voltage V arc  and the current I to constants depending on the knowledge model, implemented after a learning phase that involves adjusting a learning model that takes the current I and the source voltage V source  at input and provides the voltage V arc  and the constants of the knowledge model at output; the method including continuously detecting the presence of an arc using a decision function depending on a cost function used in the learning phase.
assignee: Safran; Centre National De La Recherche Scientifique; Ecole Superieure De Physique Et De Chimie Industrielle De La Ville De Paris; Sorbonne Universite

title: Dummy pattern structure for reducing dishing
abstract: A semiconductor package includes: a  first die , a second die and a bonding member arranged between the first and second die, wherein the bonding member is configured to facilitate a bonding between the first and second die and comprises a first area and a second area. The first area is configured with a first set of bonding pads configured to provide electrical connections between the first and second dies. The second area is configured with a second set of bonding pads configured to provide electrical connections between the first and second die, wherein a quantity of bonding pads in the first set is larger than a quantity of bonding pads in the second set. The second area is configured with a dummy structure in one or more spaces where a bonding pad is not present in the second area, the dummy structure not providing an electrical connection.

title: Tablet formulation comprising a glp-1 peptide and a delivery agent
abstract: The present invention relates to solid compositions comprising a GLP-1 peptide and a delivery agent, such as SNAC, as well as uses thereof.

title: CD3-Targeting Antibody, Bispecific Antibody And Use Thereof
abstract: Disclosed are a CD3-targeting antibody, a bispecific antibody and the use thereof. The CD3-targeting antibody reduces the toxicity caused by cytokine release syndrome, and the bispecific antibody prepared therefrom is stable and has the ability to bind to T cells, and also reduces the difficulty of producing.

title: Method and system for thermal control of devices in an electronics tester
abstract: A tester apparatus is provided. Slot assemblies are removably mounted to a frame. Each slot assembly allows for individual heating and temperature control of a respective cartridge that is inserted into the slot assembly. A closed loop air path is defined by the frame and a heater and cooler are located in the closed loop air path to cool or heat the cartridge with air. Individual cartridges can be inserted or be removed while other cartridges are in various stages of being tested or in various stages of temperature ramps.

title: Organic electroluminescent devices
abstract: Embodiments of the disclosed subject matter provide a device having one or more pixels. A first pixel of the one or more pixels may include a first sub-pixel and a second sub-pixel. The first sub-pixel of the first pixel may be at least 30% transparent across a portion of a wavelength spectrum, where the wavelength spectrum is from 400 nm to 1500 nm. The second sub-pixel of the first pixel may be less than 10% transparent across the portion of the wavelength spectrum.

title: Nano-Probe Thermoreflectance Microscopy
abstract: A nano-probe thermoreflectance microscope (NTM) can measure the thermal resistance of a GaN transistor or other device or sample with micron-scale spatial resolution. An NTM includes an atomic force microscopy (ATM) probe whose tip touches the sample. Either the ATM probe or the sample is heated, causing heat to flow between the sample and the ATM probe. This causes the temperature of the ATM probe to fluctuate. These temperature fluctuations cause the ATM probe's thermoreflectance to fluctuate in turn. An NTM measures the thermoreflectance fluctuations with a probe laser beam. If desired, a lock-in amplifier can modulate the heat flux between the ATM probe and sample, e.g., by modulating a stage that pushes the sample against the ATM probe, by modulating the amplitude of a pump laser beam focused on the ATM probe, or by modulating the drive current of the device under test, producing an amplitude modulation of the reflected probe laser beam at the same frequency.

title: Multi-port sram structure with gate-all-around transistors
abstract: A method of forming a memory cell includes forming a first active region providing first nano-structures for a write-port pass-gate transistor, forming a second active region providing second nano-structures for a write-port pull-up transistor, and forming a third active region providing third nano-structures for a read-port pull-down transistor. The first active region has a first width, the second active region has a second width, and the third active region has a third width. The third width is larger than the first width, and the first width is larger than the second width.

title: Method for forming three-dimensional wood grain on board surface, resulting board, and applications
abstract: A method for forming three-dimensional (3D) embossed wood grain on the surface of a panel, comprising at least the following steps: applying a resin solution onto at least a portion of an ink layer surface and curing it to form a wood grain base layer; covering at least a portion of the wood grain base layer surface with at least one layer of resin solution; applying an embossing liquid onto at least a portion of the resin surface along the wood grain pattern of the ink layer to form an embossing layer; curing the areas of the resin solution other than the embossing layer and then removing the embossing layer, thereby forming a three-dimensional wood grain layer on the surface of the wood grain base layer.
assignee: Hangzhou Print Flooring Technology Co., Ltd.

title: A method and system for caller risk scoring using stir/shaken data
abstract: Methods, systems, and non-transitory computer-readable medium are provided for caller risk scoring using STIR/SHAKEN data. A network fraud detection engine receives attestation and verification status data from a real-time telephony network signaling system and retrieves historical STIR/SHAKEN data from a call authentication database. Attestation-verification pairings are categorized into predefined resolved values, and a caller risk score is computed based on frequency, recency, and contiguity analysis. A weighted risk model applies an appropriate decay function and amplifies contiguous spans of directionally similar values. The computed caller risk score is then transmitted to a service platform for call handling, fraud detection, and routing decisions. The system dynamically adjusts thresholds using machine learning-driven fraud pattern recognition, ensuring adaptive real-time filtering of high-risk inbound calls. This solution enhances telephony security while reducing false positives for legitimate calls.

title: Management of prioritized edca
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatuses are described herein for managing high priority Enhanced Distributed Channel Access (HP EDCA). In some embodiments, a Station (STA) sends, to an access point (AP), a request to use HP EDCA. The STA may receive, from the AP, a response to the request to use the HP EDCA. The response may indicate acceptance of use of the HP EDCA by the STA, or rejection of use of the HP EDCA by the STA.

title: Communication control method
abstract: A method for communication control, performed by a network device, including: allocating a frequency domain resource block (RB) for a physical downlink shared channel (PDSCH) to a user equipment (UE), wherein the PDSCH is used for carrying a multicast traffic channel (MTCH).
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Atom trap devices including structured electrode layers
abstract: A device for controlling trapped atoms includes a structured electrode layer having a plurality of electrodes of an atom trap configured to trap atoms in a zone above the structured electrode layer. The electrodes includes a first RF electrode and a second RF electrode extending in a first direction. The first and second RF electrodes are arranged on different sides of an axis extending in the first direction. A plurality of DC electrodes is arranged between the first RF electrode and the second RF electrode. The plurality of DC electrodes includes a first DC electrode having a first portion and a second portion. The first portion and the second portion are arranged symmetrically to each other with respect to the axis. The axis extends between the first portion and the second portion. A second DC electrode is arranged symmetrically to the axis. The axis extends through the second DC electrode.

title: Systems and methods for manufacturing vent frames with integrated screens
abstract: Systems and methods for manufacturing vent frames with integrated screen are disclosed. A method may include: providing a lower portion of a mold for a frame to a machine, the lower portion of the mold having an opening; providing a screen for the frame over the opening in the lower portion of the mold and temporarily holding the screen in place; providing an upper portion of the mold over the lower portion of the mold and the screen; injecting a hot material into the mold; separating the upper portion of the mold from the lower portion of the mold; and removing the frame from the mold, wherein the screen is integrated into the frame.

title: Dual inhibitor trypsin antibodies and uses thereof
abstract: Aspects of the application provide dual inhibitor anti-trypsin 1/trypsin 2 antibodies and methods of using the same for treating pancreatitis.

title: Compliant nozzle system and method for fluid jet impulse
abstract: An exemplary squid-inspired soft nozzle device that is designed to boost the performance of rotary marine propulsors, such as ship or underwater vehicle propellers. A fluid jet system comprises a fluid inlet; an actuator operatively coupled to the fluid inlet, the actuator configured, via a control signal from a controller, to deliver a time-varying flow to generate a jet pulse having an acceleration phase and a deceleration phase; and a compliant nozzle in fluid communication with the actuator, the compliant nozzle comprising an elastically deformable wall that terminates at a nozzle outlet, wherein the compliant nozzle is configured such that the elastically deformable wall expands during at least a portion of the acceleration phase to store elastic strain energy and recoils during at least a portion of the deceleration phase to release at least a portion of the stored elastic strain energy to the jet through the nozzle outlet.

title: Automatic incident compilation system
abstract: An automatic incident compilation system includes a media facilitator configured to receive a plurality of media files related to an incident. An application server is communicatively coupled to the media facilitator and includes a processor and memory containing instructions that, when executed, cause the processor to provide a storyboard application to a user. The storyboard application includes a storyboard creation user interface that is configured to allow a user to generate a user-customized display of the incident based on the plurality of media files. The processor is also configured to cause the storyboard application to change time information of one of the plurality of media files based on time information of another of the plurality of media files.

title: Knowledge market server and operating method thereof
abstract: A method of operating a knowledge market performed by a knowledge market server may include acquiring knowledge information from knowledge suppliers, the knowledge information including details of knowledge that a knowledge supplier has, a personal profile of the knowledge supplier, and a cost associated with providing the knowledge information. The method may also include acquiring an initial query regarding knowledge demand from a knowledge demander; and recommending, to the knowledge demander, the knowledge suppliers using a well-defined query, the well-defined query clarifying the knowledge demand obtained from a response that is acquired by making a request for the acquired knowledge information from knowledge suppliers and initial query on the knowledge demander or a detailed request for the initial query, to the knowledge demander. Information usable for recognizing identification of the knowledge suppliers or the knowledge demander may be processed to be blinded to prevent exposure.

title: Filtering System for a Storm Water Catch Basin
abstract: A filter system for screening, filtering and treating storm water is designed to be employed within a storm water catch basin. Forming a part of the filter system is a rigid filter panel with an array of openings and designed to be mounted adjacent the outlet of the catch basin. Further, the filter system includes a permeable sock containing filter media that is designed to be disposed adjacent the bottom of the catch basin and generally below an upper portion of the rigid filter panel. Hence, the rigid filter panel and the filter media within the permeable sock screened filter the storm water passing into and through the catch basin.

title: Breakstem Blind Rivet and Method for Producing an Electrically Conductive Riveted Connection
abstract: A breakstem blind rivet for the electrically conductive riveting of a first component to a second component, includes a sleeve having a head and a shank, and a tension mandrel having a mandrel head. The shank and/or the mandrel head have at least one scraping element, which is arranged on the outer circumferential surface of the shank or mandrel head and is intended, during insertion of the sleeve into a rivet hole provided for this purpose, to scrape along the wall of the hole and to remove paint buildup or contaminants. A method for producing an electrically conductive riveted connection utilizes such a breakstem blind rivet.

title: Devices and methods for communication
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a solution for query and response in Internet of Things (IoT). In a solution, a communication device comprising: transmitting, to one or more terminal devices, a first command for scheduling a first transmission, the first command indicating a first set of time periods; receiving, from a first terminal device of the one or more terminal devices, first information of the first terminal device during a first time period of the first set of time periods; transmitting, to the first terminal device, a second command for scheduling a second transmission, the second command indicating a second set of time periods different from the first set of time periods; and receiving, from the first terminal device, second information of the first terminal device during a second time period of the second set of time periods.

title: Image generation method and apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract: An image generation method, performed by a computer device, includes: obtaining a real biometric image of a target object ( 201 ); performing, on the real biometric image, a plurality of image transformations with an identity feature of the target object retained, to obtain transformed images respectively corresponding to the plurality of image transformations ( 202 ); performing feature extraction on the transformed images respectively corresponding to the plurality of image transformations, to obtain image features of the transformed images ( 203 ); generating, based on the image features of the transformed images, a general feature of the target object ( 204 ); separately extracting, from the image features of the transformed images, an image transformation feature irrelevant to the identity feature of the target object ( 205 ); fusing the general feature with the image transformation feature, to obtain a fused feature ( 206 ); and generating, based on the fused feature, a simulated biometric image of the target object ( 207 ).

title: Dual-lock support assembly and photography support frame
abstract: The present disclosure provides a dual-lock support assembly and a photography support frame. The dual-lock support assembly includes a telescopic tube assembly including an outer tube, a first inner tube and a second inner tube being capable of sliding relative to the outer tube, and the second inner tube is capable of sliding relative to the first inner tube. The support assembly further includes a first locking assembly which includes a first connecting member connected to the outer tube; a locking sleeve sleeved with the first connecting member, the locking sleeve is arranged with a first abutting portion, an inner wall of the first abutting portion abuts against the second inner tube, a gap is formed between the first abutting portion and the locking sleeve; and a second connecting member connected to the first inner tube, a side wall of the second connecting member extends into the gap.

title: Water-absorbent resin particles and production method therefor, absorbent body, and absorbent article
abstract:
A production method for water-absorbent resin particles containing a crosslinked polymer includes a preparation step of preparing a polymer solution that contains a polymer and a solvent, and a crosslinking step of crosslinking the polymer through a covalent bond to form the crosslinked polymer. The water-absorbent resin particles have a dissolution component index of 2×10 −3  to 6×10 −3 , which is represented by the following equation. 
       dissolution component index=dissolved matter ( g/g )/ CRC  ( g/g ).

title: Power provision device and method thereof
abstract: A power provision device including: a load element; a power supply plane configured to provide current to the load element; a plurality of power supply elements configured to provide current to the power supply plane; wherein each power supply element of the plurality of power supply elements is configured to supply a current to the power supply plane via an individual power connection; wherein each power supply element comprises a voltage feedback connection between the power supply element and the power supply plane; and wherein each voltage feedback connection is configured to provide a feedback signal from the power supply plane to the corresponding power supply element, the feedback signal indicating a supplied voltage.

title: Nad(p) depot for nad(p)-dependent enzyme-based sensors
abstract: The present disclosure provides analyte sensors including one or more NAD(P)-dependent enzymes and an internal supply of NAD(P) for the detection of an analyte. The present disclosure further provides methods of using such analyte sensors for detecting one or more analytes present in a biological sample of a subject, and methods of manufacturing said analyte sensors.

title: Resource prediction for quantum advantage on the usage of gated quantum computers
abstract: One example method includes selecting a set of classical computing algorithms, solving, using the classical computing algorithms, respective problem instances of a problem to obtain a set of executions, where respective ML (machine learning) models were trained using the executions of the problem instances to predict a respective amount of classical computing resources needed to execute a respective one of the problem instances by each of the classical computing algorithms, in a loop, using an ensemble ML model to predict the classical resources needed to solve the problem, and when the predicted classical resources exceed defined classical resource limits, ending the loop, constructing a quantum circuit that comprises, as among a respective set of gates and qubits of quantum algorithms in a group of quantum algorithms, a smallest set of gates and qubits, and determining minimum requirements of quantum hardware needed to run the quantum circuit with a specified fidelity.

title: Terminal and cable assembly and charging gun
abstract: Provided are a terminal and cable assembly and a charging gun. The terminal and cable assembly includes a conductive terminal, a cooling chamber, a joint structure, and a liquid-cooled cable, an end of the cooling chamber is hermetically sleeved on the conductive terminal, and the connecting end of the conductive terminal is located in the cooling chamber; the joint structure is connected hermetically to the other end of the cooling chamber; the liquid-cooled cable includes a cable conductor and a cable jacket surrounding the cable conductor to form a cable cooling channel communicating with the interior of the cooling chamber via the joint structure, an end of the cable conductor penetrates through the joint structure and is electrically connected to the connecting end, the cable jacket is hermetically connected to the joint structure, and a cooling medium is contained in the cable cooling channel and the cooling chamber.

title: Spinal fixation system with visualization aperture and sliding pin engagement for vertebral stabilization
abstract: A spinal fixation system includes implantable plates designed to enhance anterior lumbar surgical procedures through optimized vertebral stabilization architecture. The system employs advanced plate geometries including: a rectangular plate configuration featuring strategically positioned bone screw holes for robust vertebral fixation, an H-shaped plate design enabling efficient multi-level construct assembly, and a D-shaped plate geometry facilitating acentric mounting for complex spinal alignments. Each plate configuration incorporates precision-engineered visualization apertures positioned to enable direct operative site observation while maintaining structural integrity. The plates feature spherical bone screw interfaces enabling variable angle screw placement to accommodate patient-specific anatomy. The system's multi-level capability is achieved through complementary plate geometries that create parallel visualization corridors when assembled in series.

title: Laboratory monitoring devices and systems
abstract: An embodiment of the present invention is a laboratory environmental monitoring system, comprising: a gateway; and one or more nodes having at least one environmental sensor, wherein: the gateway is connected to a cloud-based internet application by a 3 stage internet solution (LAN, Wifi, Sim card); and the one or more nodes are connected to the gateway by a Low Power Wide Area Network.

title: Combination for and method of suppressing sarcoma or carcinoma malignancies
abstract: A method for treating carcinoma and sarcoma tumors includes administration of a composition including  64 Zn e (Asp) or  63 Cu e (Asp) in a therapeutically effective amount. The method may be used once a day or more than once a day. Other identified amino acids may be bound to  64 Zn e  and  63 Cu e  instead of L-Aspartate (Asp), provided that such amino acids are enriched for the L-enantiomer to at least 90%. The composition is suitable for a parenteral injection or infusion. The method may be used for suppressing growth of carcinoma and sarcoma, including preventing the development of metastases.

title: Telephony devices for public safety answering points
abstract: An apparatus includes a shaft extending in an axial direction thereof; a U-shaped member at a distal end of the shaft, the U-shaped member constructed to hold a telephonic handset; a switchhook button that disconnects a connection of the telephonic handset; and a base at a proximal end of the shaft.

title: Coating for Head-Up Display
abstract: Coated articles, laminates, and windshields having enhanced p-polarized radiation reflecting properties are provided. The coated articles, laminates, and windshields include a functional coating positioned over at least a portion of a substrate. The functional coating includes a first dielectric layer comprising a first film and a second film, a first metallic layer, a second dielectric layer, a second metallic layer, and a third dielectric layer. The functional coating is configured to reflect at least 10% of p-polarized radiation that contacts the functional coating at an incident angle of 60° relative to normal of the coated article, laminate, or windshield. Also provided herein are a method of projecting an image in a head-up display, a vehicle head-up display system, and a vehicle including the head-up display system.

title: A multi-stage devolatilization apparatus comprising at least one static mixer
abstract: A devolatilization apparatus for devolatilizing a composition including a volatile component includes an inlet for the composition to be devolatilized and two vessels arranged in series, each including a distributor, an outlet line for devolatilized composition and an outlet for gas. The distributor of the first, most upstream of the two vessels includes at an upstream end an inlet and at a downstream end an outlet. A static mixer is arranged directly upstream of the inlet or downstream of the inlet but upstream of the outlet of the distributor. The inlet is connected with the static mixer, and the outlet line for devolatilized composition of the first, most upstream of the at least two vessels is connected with a recirculation line leading into the static mixer, with which the inlet for the composition to be devolatilized is connected.

title: Battery apparatus and power consuming device
abstract: The battery apparatus includes: a box body; at least two mounting members connected to the box body; and a first sealing assembly disposed on at least one of the mounting members and having a connection end and a protrusion end, where the connection end is connected to a connection surface of the corresponding mounting member, the protrusion end protrudes from the connection surface of the corresponding mounting member, and the protrusion end is sealed between the at least two mounting members. The first sealing assembly is integrated onto the at least one mounting member, so that the first sealing assembly and the corresponding mounting member are formed into an integral structure, which can simplify a mounting and sealing structure. The protrusion end of the first sealing assembly can be better clamped between two structures that require sealing, for example, clamped between two mounting members.

title: Electrode Lead and Method for Pain Block using Ionic Direct Current
abstract: Electrical neuromodulation uses electric current to interfere with nociceptive (pain-related) signals. Delivery of novel ionic direct current (iDC) to peripheral nerves can block nociceptive signal conduction without interfering with non-painful tactile or proprioceptive signals. A cuff lead for delivering iDC is disclosed for blocking action potential (AP) propagation in a neuron. The cuff lead delivers iDC to a nerve via a microfluidic lead filled with conductive media such as a gel. The cuff lead can take the form of a tripolar nerve cuff configured to contact a surface of a peripheral nerve. The cuff lead delivering iDC to the nerve according to the present invention has been shown to block AP propagation in a rat sciatic nerve and can be used as a treatment for blocking pathological pain.
assignee: The Johns Hopkins University; Newsouth Innovations Pty Limited

title: Sound system for a vehicle
abstract: A sound system for a vehicle includes an input, a storage device, a speaker system, a sensor system, a CAN, and an electronic controller. The input enables a user to select a sound package from a plurality of sound packages. The storage device stores the sound package. The sensor system senses a parameter pertaining to the vehicle. The CAN receives an electronic signal from the sensor system, the electronic signal pertaining to the parameter. The electronic controller determines a corresponding sound from the sound package based on the electronic signal received by the CAN and operates the speaker system to play the sound.

title: Systems, Media, and Methods for Identifying and Correcting Retailer Phantom Inventory
abstract: A method includes calculating model probabilities and a ranked list of locations and receiving a selection of a plurality of the ranked locations. The method also includes receiving actual item count data from at least a subset of the selected locations and comparing the actual item count data to a corresponding inventory record. The method further includes outputting a discrepancy indication based upon a discrepancy between the actual item count data and the corresponding inventory record.

title: Charging device and method for operating the charging device
abstract: A charging device for a vehicle, wherein the charging device ( 500 ) has an input-side input terminal unit ( 100 ) for connecting a single-phase or three-phase alternating voltage, a PFC stage ( 200 ) for providing a direct voltage to an intermediate terminal ( 300 ) and a bipolar alternating voltage terminal ( 400 ) for providing an alternating voltage.

title: Manual pull-out bed
abstract: The present invention discloses a manual pull-out bed, including a base, a movable support portion, a first back frame, a second back frame, and a seat frame, where a bottom portion of the first back frame is hinged to a rear side of the base, a top portion of the first back frame is hinged to a first end, close to the first back frame, of the second back frame, and a second end, close to the seat frame, of the second back frame is hinged to a third end of the seat frame; left and right sides of the base are provided with a first sliding rail in a horizontal direction, respectively; an end, close to the base, of the movable support portion is fixedly provided with a sliding block of the first sliding rail at left and right heads, respectively.
assignee: Guangdong Jackwell Smart Furniture Co., Ltd.

title: Dynamic performance control using half duplex arrays
abstract: A communication terminal is disclosed that uses multiple half-duplex (HDX) apertures to provide enhanced performance, flexibility, and reliability. This system can improve on the performance of a full-duplex (FDX) terminal by dynamically allocating time for transmitting (TX) and receiving (RX) across the various HDX apertures according to demand. Such a configuration can improve overall performance, such as by allowing for significantly more data throughput compared to a traditional FDX terminal with dedicated apertures. Furthermore, the use of multiple HDX apertures can create a more robust system; if one aperture fails, the remaining apertures can continue to operate, preventing a total loss of communication and merely reducing total bandwidth.

title: Chromatography medium and process
abstract: A chromatography medium for separating an analyte in a solution is provided, the chromatography medium comprising a matrix material having a mean flow pore size of 0.1-2.0 μm, wherein the matrix material is functionalized with a thiophilic aromatic ligand to a ligand concentration up to 1500 μmol/g matrix material. Provided are also processes of separating an analyte in a solution using the chromatography medium. The invention is useful for separating different isoforms of plasmid DNA.

title: Systems and methods for detecting lane crossings and classifying lane changes
abstract: A device may receive forward facing video data associated with a vehicle, and may process the forward facing video data, with neural network models, to detect lane lines and to determine classifications for the lane lines. The device may utilize the forward facing video data to generate a histogram of horizontal positions of the vehicle, and may fit probability density functions on the histogram to calculate a mean and a standard deviation. The device may utilize the mean and the standard deviation to identify a crossing interval, and may classify the forward facing video data as a lane crossing or a lane change based on the crossing interval. The device may calculate a lane crossing score or may calculate a lane change score. The device may perform actions based on the lane crossing score or the lane change score.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to acquire meteorological information as weather information from at least one external source, acquire sensor data from at least one sensor, analyze the weather information and the sensor data to generate an analysis result, predict an occurrence of a natural disaster based on the analysis result, generate an alert relating to the predicted natural disaster, and notify the alert to related organizations and residents.

title: Timepiece
abstract: An object is to reduce, in a timepiece including an operation portion that rotates an inner rotating ring only in one direction, a load applied to a component that transmits a torque of the operation portion to the inner rotating ring. A timepiece includes a timepiece case, an inner rotating ring that is accommodated in the timepiece case and that is rotatable in a second circumferential direction, an engagement gear that engages with the inner rotating ring and that rotates in synchronization with the inner rotating ring, a rotation operation portion that includes a head portion disposed outside the timepiece case and that is provided to be rotatable about an axis with respect to the timepiece case, and a rotation transmission portion that transmits clockwise rotation of the rotation operation portion to the engagement gear and that causes the rotation operation portion to idle counterclockwise.
assignee: Seiko Watch Kabushiki Kaisha (trading as Seiko Watch Corporation)

title: Two-part capsule connector
abstract: A heating assembly for an aerosol-generating product may include a primary cap component defining a first aperture and a plurality of second apertures; a heating element configured to extend through the first aperture; and a secondary cap component configured to engage with the primary cap component so as to retain the heating element.

title: Peripherally restricted lpar1 antagonists and uses thereof
abstract: Described herein, inter alia, are peripherally restricted LPAR1 antagonists and uses thereof.

title: Pool Robot
abstract: This application provides a pool robot, including a housing provided with a first water outlet hole, a handle, and an accommodation cavity that is provided with a filter box and a second water outlet hole; and a filter drive structure configured to drive water in a pool to enter the filter box. When the pool robot is in a cleaning mode, the filter box, the accommodation cavity, and the filter drive structure are sequentially in fluid communication to form a first water path used for cleaning the water. When the pool robot is in a water exit mode, the handle is lifted, the pool robot tilts, and the filter box, the accommodation cavity, the second water outlet hole, and the first water outlet hole are sequentially in fluid communication to form a second water path used for water in the housing to be quickly drained from the housing.

title: Traction battery pack thermal management system with coolant redirection
abstract: A battery pack thermal management system includes a traction battery pack including one or more battery arrays within an enclosure assembly. The battery arrays each include battery cells. The system further includes an immersion thermal management system that communicates a liquid coolant through the enclosure assembly along a first path. The immersion thermal management system is configured to transition in response to an event to redirect the liquid coolant through the enclosure assembly along a second path instead of the first path. The second path is different than the first path.

title: Data transmission system and device with high transmission security
abstract: There is provided a data transmission system including a human input device and a host. Before transmitting data to the host, the human input device checks whether there is any previously paired key device nearby. If there is no previously paired key device appearing close to the human input device, the human input device is arranged not to transmit data or to transmit non-dedicated data to the host.

title: Medical device and method of assembling
abstract: A medical device for detecting at least one physiological parameter of a user has an electronics unit and an analytical sensor configured for transdermal insertion into body tissue of a user. The sensor has an insertable portion configured for at least partially being inserted into the body tissue and an electrical connection portion electrically connected to the electronics unit. A housing made of a housing material receives the electronics unit and at least the insertable portion protrudes from an opening in the housing. A guide at least partially made of a guiding material softer than the housing material at least partially surrounds the analytical sensor at the opening.
