The turbine engine includes a flowpath, a compressor section, a combustor section and a turbine section. The flowpath extends through the compressor section, the combustor section and the turbine section from a flowpath inlet to a flowpath exhaust. The flowpath inlet is disposed axially downstream of the open propulsor rotor and is fluidly coupled to an external environment. The heat exchanger is disposed radially outboard of the flowpath. At least a portion of the heat exchanger is disposed axially between the flowpath inlet and the open guide vanes. The heat exchanger is configured to transfer heat energy between air and a liquid working fluid.

title: Ink composition and ink jet printing process
abstract: The present invention relates to an aqueous ink composition with improved storage stability and to an inkjet printing process employing such an ink composition.

title: Block-wise knowledge distillation for post-training quantization
abstract: Techniques for generating content are described. In an example, a device includes a memory and a processor coupled to the memory. The processor may be configured to obtain unquantized weights associated with one or more blocks of a trained machine learning model and process the unquantized weights to generate quantized weights. Each quantized weight of the quantized weights may be a function of a quantization step size, a corresponding unquantized weight, one or more weight-clipping threshold values, a weight-scaling matrix, and/or a weight-scaling factor. The processor is configured to process, using the trained machine learning model with the quantized weights, input data to generate output content.

title: Real-time gameplay accessibility outputs
abstract: A computer-implemented include determining, based at least in part on an execution of a game application, a first media content of the game application to be presented at a user interface to a user and causing, while the execution of the game application continues, a second media content to be generated based on an accessibility status of the user. An artificial intelligence engine generates the second media content in real-time relative to the execution of the game application based at least in part on the engine receiving at least a portion of the first media content as an input and the engine is trained to generate the second media content based at least in part on accessibility information associated with one or more accessibility statuses. The method also includes causing the second media content to be outputted in lieu of the first media content at the user interface.

title: Broadcast information processing method and apparatus, communication device, and storage medium
abstract: The present application discloses a broadcast information processing method, a broadcast information processing apparatus, a communication device, and a storage medium, and pertains to the field of communication technologies. The broadcast information processing method in embodiments of the present application includes: acquiring, by a first device, broadcast information; where the broadcast information is used to indicate at least one of the following: access control information; frequency domain location indication information of a synchronization raster or channel raster; inventory or paging monitoring indication information; frequency domain related information of ambient Internet of Things communication; and rate matching indication information.

title: Vector generation and indexing system
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for generating and storing vector embeddings for each set of data of the sets of data in respective table of a plurality of tables and storing, for each table, a model type and version corresponding to a model used to generate the vector embeddings stored in each respective table of the plurality of tables. The systems and methods further generate a response to a query by generating vector embeddings for the query with a same model type and version as the model type and version used to generate vector embeddings for one or more tables with relevant data to the query.

title: Device designation of playback and network microphone device arrangements
abstract: Example techniques relate to device spaces and default designations in a media playback system. A device space may create an association between a networked microphone device and one or more playback devices such that certain voice commands (e.g., playback commands) received by the networked microphone device are used to control the one or more playback devices (unless otherwise designated in the voice command). Furthermore, in bonded pairs and bonded groups of playback devices that include at least one NMD, certain playback devices within the bonded pair or group may be designated as default so as to avoid multiple responses to a voice input.

title: Air bag device
abstract: An air bag device includes an airbag cushion to be deployed in a shape covering a side and a front of an occupant, and a front tether connected to the airbag cushion and passing over an upper shoulder area of the occupant between the airbag cushion and a seat back, and to be deployed by being filled with gas at an interior thereof.

title: Optical modulator
abstract: To prevent deterioration in an extinction ratio due to asymmetry between a pair of optical waveguides. An optical modulator has a Mach-Zehnder optical waveguide including mutually parallel first and second waveguides and a signal electrode for controlling the phase of light propagating in the Mach-Zehnder optical waveguide. The first and second waveguides have a first section in which the second waveguide has a line width smaller than that of the first waveguide and a second section in which the first waveguide has a line width smaller than that of the second waveguide. The first section and the second section are replaced with each other in curved parts.

title: Compounds and methods useful for stabilizing phenylalanine hydroxylase mutations
abstract:
The disclosure relates to compounds of Formula I, or tautomer thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of the compound or the tautomer, wherein, R 1  and R 2  are defined herein, and pharmaceutical compositions comprising compounds of Formula I, or tautomer thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of the compound or tautomer. 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     These compounds and pharmaceutical compositions are useful in methods for stabilizing a mutant PAH protein or reducing blood phenylalanine concentration in a subject suffering from phenylketonuria. In some embodiments, the mutant PAH protein contains at least one R408W, R261Q, R243Q, Y414C, L48S, A403V, I65T, R241C, L348V, R408Q, or V388M mutation. In other embodiments, the mutant PAH protein contains at least one R408W, Y414C, I65T, F39L, R408Q, L348V, R261Q, A300S, or L48S mutation.

title: System and method for automatic load transfer between automated guided vehicles
abstract: Systems and methods for automatic transfer of a load between a carrier automated guided vehicle (AGV) carrying the load and a receiver AGV. During the transfer process, the carrier AGV is positioned within proximity of the receiver AGV. A handshake is initiated between the AGV pair, causing one of the AGVs to become stationary. Portions of the bumper field of each AGV can be disabled to permit positioning of the AGVs close together without initiating obstacle avoidance maneuvers of the AGVs. During the handshake, while one AGV moves toward the other AGV, the respective bumper fields together form an enlarged bumper field surrounding at least a majority of a combined perimeter of the AGV pair, providing intact obstacle detection while transferring the load between AGVs. After the load is transferred, the handshake can be terminated and the receiver AGV can deliver the received load to a location within the warehouse.

title: Low latency cloud-based debugging using predicted debugging operations
abstract: Circuits, methods, and code can reduce latency from a cloud server system to a developer by pre-processing and caching a number of possible outcomes. For example, a method performed by a cloud server system executing a gaming application can include determining that a remote client device is executing an integrated development environment in a debugging mode for code associated with the gaming application. In response, the method can include determining a set of available debugging steps for the code in the debugging mode. The method can include generating, for each debugging step in the set of available debugging steps, an output by executing an associated portion of the code. The method can include detecting, from the remote client device, a selected debugging step from the set of available debugging steps. The method can include, responsive to detecting the selected debugging step, providing the associated output to the remote client device.

title: Method for providing notification and electronic device therefor
abstract: A method and an electronic device are provided. The method includes a display, a communication module, memory, including one or more storage media, storing instructions, and at least one processor communicatively coupled to the display, the communication module, and the memory, wherein the instructions, when executed by the at least one processor individually or collectively, cause the electronic device to receive a first notification through the communication module and display the first notification, identify a second notification capable of being grouped with the first notification, transmit the first notification and the second notification to a server through the communication module, acquire, from the server, a summary notification generated based on the first notification and the second notification, and display the generated summary notification on the display.

title: Protamine conjugations for trace nucleic acid capture and multi-analyte recovery
abstract: A method for multi-analyte recovery from a single tissue sample includes lysing a tissue sample in a lysis buffer. The method also includes adding protamine conjugates including protamine conjugated to a solid support matrix to a lysate of the lysed tissue sample. The method further includes incubating the lysate in the presence of the protamine conjugates in a binding buffer in a reaction mixture to bind nucleic acid to the protamine conjugates. The method even further includes removing a supernatant from the reaction mixture containing intact protein and metabolites. The method further includes eluting the nucleic acid from the protamine conjugates.

title: Compact laser beam homogenizer
abstract: A compact and cost-efficient laser beam homogenizer apparatus for high power lighting entertainment applications of at least 100 W rated input power has a light source, a light pipe for receiving and homogenizing light from the light source, and a focusing lens for coupling light into the light pipe, wherein the length (L) of the light pipe is at least  10  times its aperture (A) .

title: Performance monitoring for ai-beam management
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for performance monitoring for artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning (ML) beam management. A base station generates test data including input data corresponding to a plurality of first downlink (DL) beams at first time instances and output data corresponding to one or more second DL beams at one or more second time instances. The base station determines selected beams from the plurality of first DL beams and the one or more second DL beams, transmits an indication of the selected beams and the test data corresponding to the selected beams, and receives a test result of the model for beam management based on the test data. The test data may be provided before beam management inference is activated or after the UE reports a performance metric of the model.

title: Devices and methods for relaying power to an electronic device
abstract: A wireless power relay for wirelessly relaying power to an electronic device includes a power receiver configured to wirelessly receive power; a power transmitter configured to wirelessly transmit power; and a power converter operatively coupled between the power receiver and the power transmitter, the power converter being configured to convert first power at a first frequency wirelessly received by the power receiver, and to apply the converted power to the power transmitter such that the power transmitter wirelessly transmits second power at a second frequency different from the first frequency.
assignee: The Alfred E. Mann Foundation For Scientific Research

title: Rechargeable lithium batteries
abstract: Disclosed is a rechargeable lithium battery, including an electrode current collector, a tab portion extending from the electrode current collector, an electrode active material layer on the electrode current collector, and an insulation layer on the tab portion. The insulation layer includes a binder and an inorganic filler, and the binder includes at least one of polyimide, polyamide, or a combination thereof.

title: Rotating electric machine system
abstract: A rotating electric machine system includes a rotating electric machine and a rotating electric machine housing configured to rotatably support a rotating shaft of the rotating electric machine. The rotating electric machine includes a bus rod as a terminal that is an electric terminal. The rotating electric machine housing is equipped with a bus rod accommodation member. The bus rod accommodation member include an accommodation hole for accommodating the bus rod. The bus rod accommodated in the accommodation hole can be displaced relative to the bus rod accommodation member. The direction of relative displacement of the bus rod is along the axial direction of the bus rod.

title: Device for Rounding Dough Pieces
abstract:
The invention relates to a device for rounding dough pieces, comprising:
         a conveyor with a transport surface for transporting the dough pieces in a transport direction;   A first mould part:
           comprising one or more cups with an opening facing the transport surface,   with a directional component perpendicular to the transport surface, movable between:
               a rounding position in which the first mould part rests on the transport surface; and   a release position in which the first mould part is located at a distance from the transport surface;   
               
           A second mould part:
           comprising one or more cups with an opening facing the transport surface,   movable with a directional component perpendicular to the transport surface, between   a rounding position in which the second mould part is positioned adjacent to the transport surface; and   a release position in which the second mould part is located at a distance from the transport surface;   
           A first drive, for moving the first mould part in at least the rounding position relative to the transport surface in a circle with a radius around a rotation axis extending perpendicularly to the transport surface; and   A second drive, for moving the second mould part in at least the rounding position relative to the transport surface in a second circle with a second variable radius around a rotation axis extending perpendicularly to the transport surface; wherein   The device is configured to keep the orientation of the first and second mould parts, being the direction in which they extend, unchanged during the circular movement relative to the conveyor; characterized in that   The first and second drives are coupled and are arranged to always move the first and second mould parts in a circle with the same radius and at the same speed but mutually in an exactly opposite direction and thus in antiphase.

title: Round and small diameter optical cables with a ribbon-like optical fiber structure
abstract: An optical fiber cable including an optical fiber ribbon in a pipe, wherein the ribbon includes at least two optical fibers arranged side by side, and wherein at least two of the optical fibers arc bonded intermittently along a length of the fibers.

title: Lithium-ion secondary battery and power consuming device
abstract: A lithium-ion secondary battery comprises a positive electrode plate, a negative electrode plate, and an electrolyte. The negative electrode plate comprises a copper foil and a negative electrode active layer provided on a surface on at least one side of the copper foil. The negative electrode active layer comprises a negative electrode active material which comprises a silicon-based material and a carbon-based material, with the silicon-based material having a mass content percentage of A % based on the total mass of the negative electrode active material, where 2≤A≤50. The copper foil comprises a Cr element, in a content of B ppm based on the total mass of the copper foil, where 5≤B≤300. The electrolyte comprises a fluorinated solvent in a mass content percentage of C % based on the total mass of the electrolyte, where 2≤C≤70 and B/C≤50.

title: Reproduction device, reproduction method, and recording medium
abstract: A display device is provided that includes circuitry configured to output brightness capability information of the display device to an external device and receive video data and brightness characteristic information included in data of each frame from the external device. The circuitry further controls display of a video based on the received video data and the brightness characteristic information included in the data of each frame. The received video data is processed based on the brightness capability information by the external device and the received video data is the processed video data. Also, the brightness characteristic information represents a brightness characteristic and includes information of a master high dynamic range video.

title: Control of ue mbs reporting for shared processing
abstract: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for control of user equipment (UE) multicast and broadcast services (MBS) reporting for shared processing. An embodiment operates by receiving a message, from a serving base station (BS), broadcast service (MBS) reporting. Based on a determination that the UE does not have sufficient UE resources to simultaneously receive an MBS transmission from an MBS BS and a first unicast transmission from the serving BS, the embodiment transmits an MBS report to the serving BS. Finally, the embodiment receives a second unicast transmission from the serving BS, wherein a signal resource configuration of the second unicast transmission is determined based on the MBS report.

title: Systems and methods for nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy
abstract: A method can include providing first nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) data. The first NMR data can include a plurality of NMR scans and have a first spectral resolution. The plurality of NMR scans can include a first NMR scan and a second NMR scan. The method can include applying optimization to the plurality of NMR scans to obtain a frequency shift parameter. The frequency shift parameter can include a first frequency shift associated with the first NMR scan and a second frequency shift associated with the second NMR scan. The method can include providing second NMR data. The second NMR data can include the first NMR scan shifted by the first frequency shift and the second NMR scan shifted by the second frequency shift. The second NMR data can have a second spectral resolution greater than the first spectral resolution.
assignee: President And Fellows Of Harvard College

title: System to determine a personalized learning pathway
abstract: An electronic learning system and method for providing at least one recommended personalized learning pathway to a user. The system may include one or more computing devices that communicate input data, and receive output data, over a network with a learning management system. A server may be configured to: provide the learning management system over the network; store data, including user data, education provider data, and/or industry data, on at least one storage device; and implement at least one analytics engine. The analytics engine may be configurable to: analyze the data associated with the learning management system; generate personalized data indicative of a personalized learning pathway that enables a user to build the competencies for a desired career and/or grow an individual's career, the personalized data based at least in part on the analyzed data; and generate at least one recommendation for the user based on the personalized data.

title: Notification display method, electronic device, chip system, and readable storage medium
abstract: This application discloses a notification display method, an electronic device, a chip system, and a readable storage medium, and pertains to the field of terminal technologies. The method includes: The electronic device is in a first state. When the electronic device meets a state switching condition, the electronic device switches from the first state to a second state, and displays a first interface in the second state. A second interface in the second state is displayed when the electronic device does not receive a user input operation in first duration. The electronic device displays a second notification in the second interface after obtaining the second notification. The electronic device displays a third interface in the second state in response to a first operation triggered in the second interface. The third interface includes the first notification and a first notification icon.

title: Event-by-event energy-based scatter estimation
abstract: A framework for event-by-event energy-based scatter estimation. The framework acquires coincidence event data of a target region. The coincidence event data records energy signal data associated with scintillation crystals of a positron emission tomographic (PET) scanner. Scatter content associated with each coincidence event in the coincidence event data may then be estimated.

title: Method for preparing multipod silica nanoparticles and multipod silica nanoparticles
abstract: A one-pot method for producing multipod silica nanoparticles includes the steps of: adding a sodium halide solution to a silica precursor solution; and heat-treating the resulting solution to synthesize silica nanoparticles.
assignee: Industry-University Cooperation Foundation Hanyang University Erica Campus

title: Automatic personal identifiable information removal from audio
abstract: This disclosure describes systems, methods, and devices related to automatic personal identifiable information (PII) removal. A system may detect a sound signal received from a vicinity of a machine during the operation of the machine. The system may perform speech detection to detect a segment of the sound signal that comprises a speech signal. The system may modify the sound signal at the segment of the sound signal by performing a segment replacement mechanism. The system may generate a filtered sound signal to be used for monitoring the operation of the machine.

title: Low Drag Heat Exchanger
abstract: A low drag heat exchanger for an aircraft includes an intake which allows airflow to pass against a heat exchanger disposed within an aircraft wing. After flowing past the heat exchanger, airflow may be released out of the air exit and controlled with an adjustable exhaust door configured to open and close to allow or disallow airflow out of the air exit. The door may be positioned to minimize drag produced when air is released out of the air exit.

title: Airbag device for vehicle
abstract: An airbag device for a vehicle including: a seat mounted to a vehicle body to allow an occupant to sit thereon; a headrest mounted to the seat and configured to support the occupant’s head; a housing disposed at a rear of the seat; and an airbag mounted to the housing to be deployed to protect the occupant’s head or neck in the event of a collision of the vehicle body. The airbag includes: a first chamber to be inflated by fluid supplied from an inflator; a pair of second chambers in communication with the first chamber and disposed on opposing sides of occupant's head; and an aligning tether to connect the pair of second chambers and restrict spacing between the pair of second chambers.

title: Method for Determining and Displaying a Filling Level of a Press Container, Press Container, Computer Programme, and Computer-Readable Medium
abstract: A method for ascertaining and displaying a fill level of a press container is disclosed, in which at least one hydraulically actuatable press ram can be used to compact the contents in an interior of the press container. The method includes a) actuating the at least one hydraulic press ram; b) acquiring at least two operating parameters of the press ram during step a); c) evaluating the at least two operating parameters by comparing them with at least one previously known reference parameter; and d) displaying a fill level of the press container depending on the evaluation in step c). The disclosure also relates to an accordingly configured press container.

title: Method and integrated circuit for wireless power supply system of active stylus
abstract: A method performed by an active stylus having a receiver that receives an uplink signal transmitted from an electronic device, a transmitter that transmits a downlink signal to the electronic device, and a power receiver that receives power wirelessly supplied from the electronic device. The method includes causing the transmitter to transmit the downlink signal in response to the receiver receiving the uplink signal when the power is not being supplied to the power receiver, stopping transmission of the downlink signal by the transmitter in response to detecting that supply of the power to the power receiver has started, and causing the receiver to receive the uplink signal in response to detecting that supply of the power to the power receiver has ended after the stopping transmission of the downlink signal by the transmitter in response to detecting that supply of the power to the power receiver has started.

title: Mouse button structure and mouse device having the same
abstract: A translational mouse button structure and a mouse having the same are provided. The mouse includes a casing and a mouse button structure arranged in the casing. The mouse button structure may include: a button board, a support member, a cross member and a circuit board provided with a pressing switch. The cross member may be bridged between the button board and the support member by means of translational movement, and respectively provided with a first support group, a second support group and a corresponding support group that are pivotally connected. The button board may be inclined relative to the support member and abuts against the pressing switch, allowing translation along with the cross member. Therefore, any point on the button board can be pressed with the same pressing pressure and the same pressing stroke.

title: Method for inspecting an aircraft component
abstract: An apparatus for use in a testing procedure on an object, the apparatus comprising one or more processors configured to: receive an image of the object; obtain a reference image associated with the object, the reference image including a representation of the object divided into a plurality of zones, each zone being associated with a respective testing action of the testing procedure; simultaneously output the received image and the reference image on a display unit; receive an input indicative of a first testing action associated with a first zone being completed; and output, on the display unit, a first indication that the first testing action has been completed for the first zone.

title: Purified labdanum extract, method for producing same, tobacco material, tobacco rod, and flavor inhaler
abstract: Provided is a purified labdanum extract that is effective as a flavor promoter for tobacco. A purified labdanum extract in which, when analysis is performed by GC/MS using a column in which the stationary phase is 95% dimethylpolysiloxane, the sum of peak areas of component groups in which the retention index (RI) is equal to or less than 1399 is 20% or less of the sum of all peak areas.

title: Neuromorphic memory device and method
abstract: Apparatus and methods are disclosed, including memory devices and systems. Example memory devices, systems and methods include a stack of memory dies, a controller die, and a buffer. Example memory devices, systems and methods include one or more neuromorphic layers logically coupled between one or more dies in the stack of memory dies and a host interface of the controller die.

title: Surgical instrument
abstract: A surgical instrument includes a shaft assembly operating device, for example a hand grip and a shaft assembly releasably couplable to the shaft assembly operating device. The shaft assembly includes a shaft and an actuation rod arranged in a longitudinal channel of the shaft. The shaft assembly operating device includes a shaft assembly coupling device to couple the shaft assembly to the shaft assembly operating device, where the shaft assembly coupling device includes a first coupling element to couple the proximal end of the shaft and a second coupling element to couple the proximal end of the actuation rod. The first coupling element and the second coupling element are movable by a single actuation from a shaft locking position to a shaft non-locking position and from an actuation rod locking position to an actuation rod non-locking position, respectively.

title: Molecular design with quantum-computing-based machine learning and optimization
abstract: A method for molecular design includes constructing a structural cost function having first minima that identify molecular species satisfying structural constraints. The method includes generating exploratory molecular species by minimizing the structural cost function to obtain arguments of one of the first minima; creating, based on the arguments, an exploratory feature vector; and evaluating an objective function with the exploratory feature vector, a target range of a molecular property, and parameters of a machine-learning model to obtain an objective-function value. The method includes generating a candidate molecular species by performing regression with the objective-function values to update a surrogate model that approximates the objective function; constructing an error cost function having second minima that identify molecular species that minimize the surrogate model while satisfying the structural constraints; and minimizing, with a quantum computer, the error cost function to identify one of the second minima.

title: Ear shaping kit
abstract: An ear shaping kit for removing deformities from or otherwise reshaping an auricle includes one or more clip members. Each clip member comprises a front jaw and a back jaw which are movably coupled together via a bias hinge. The back jaw is movable alternately toward and away from the front jaw. The front jaw and the back jaw have engagement surfaces which are configured to clamp an auricle therebetween to urge the auricle toward a desired shape. The bias hinge is coupled to and extends between the front jaw and the back jaw. The bias hinge is configured to bias the back jaw toward the front jaw to clamp the auricle between the back jaw and the front jaw. The bias hinge is also shaped to extend around the helix of the auricle during use.

title: Methods and systems for deep learning based interpolation of video frames
abstract: Systems and methods for deep learning based video frame interpolation are disclosed. In some embodiments, a method for interpolating video frames may comprise receiving a series of input video frames including a first higher-resolution frame, a second higher-resolution frame, and a lower-resolution intermediate frame having an intermediate temporal position of the series between the first and second higher-resolution frames. The lower-resolution intermediate frame may be upscaled to create an upscaled intermediate frame, and the first higher-resolution frame, the second higher-resolution frame, and the upscaled intermediate frame may be concatenated to produce a concatenated frame. The concatenated frame may be inputted to a trained video frame interpolation (VFI) model, and an interpolated frame may be outputted from the trained VFI model, the interpolated frame having the intermediate temporal position of the series.

title: Read reference voltage management in flash memory
abstract: A method for performing read reference voltage management on a flash memory includes: managing a first self-learning table based on one or more read retry operations performed using hard-decision decoding; managing a second self-learning table based on one or more read retry operations performed using soft-decision decoding; managing a sticky table based on a read reference voltage level or a read reference voltage level set used in a most recent successful read retry operation, wherein the read reference voltage level or the read reference voltage level set is derived from at least one of the first self-learning table, the second self-learning table, and a read retry operation using soft-decision decoding; and performing a normal read operation based on the sticky table.

title: Vaporizer device
abstract: Apparatus and associated methods relate to a vaporizer device including a logic board operatively coupled to a data store storing a set of operations executable by the logic board, including predetermined tier data defining a plurality of usage tiers and tier-transition operations. Each of the plurality of usage tiers may, for example, include an inhalation limit permitted within a corresponding time period. Additionally, each of the plurality of usage tiers may, for example, include a predetermined time interval during which the logic board prevents operation of the vaporizer device. The logic board may, for example, update the current usage tier to a different usage tier by evaluating monitored inhalation activity and selecting the different usage tier based on whether the monitored inhalation activity satisfies a predetermined tier-transition criterion. Various embodiments may advantageously guide gradual reduction of use of a vaporizer device through adaptive usage tiers.

title: Unified transmission configuration indicator (tci) state indication for multiple downlink control information (dci) based multiple transmission reception point (trp) operation
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. In multiple downlink control information (multi-DCI) based multiple transmission reception point (multi-TRP) operations, a user equipment (UE) may receive respective DCIs from each of the multiple TRPs that schedule a shared channel communication to be performed with the corresponding TRP of the multiple TRPs. A UE may be configured with or activated with unified transmission configuration indicator (TCI) states for one or more channels or signals. A UE may transmit capability information to the network that indicates capabilities of the UE associated with application of the unified TCI state framework to multi-DCI based multi-TRP operation. The network may transmit control signaling indicating parameters for the multi-DCI based multi-TRP operation based on the capability information. The UE may receive multiple DCIs from the multiple TRPs that schedule a multi-TRP operation (e.g., a shared channel communication between the UE and the multiple TRPs).

title: Program creation support device and program product
abstract: A work of adding a comment to a user program such as a ladder program is facilitated. A program creation support device receives, in a ladder program displayed on a first display unit, selection of a range to be converted into a program code in general-purpose programming language, converts the received range into the program code in the general-purpose programming language, generates a prompt in natural language for requesting summarization of the program code and control content of the program code, transmits the prompt to a large language model (LLM), receives a response statement, displays text included in the response statement, and adds, as a comment, at least a part of the text to the ladder program.

title: Text-to-CAD Generation Using Fine-Tuned Large Language Models with Universal Text Representation and Its Encoder and Decoder Tool
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system and method for generating Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models from natural language descriptions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs). A universal text-based representation of CAD models is provided, encoding complete Boundary Representation (B-Rep) information. A pre-trained LLM is fine-tuned using a dataset comprising paired natural language descriptions of CAD model creation processes and corresponding universal text-based representations. The fine-tuned LLM converts natural language descriptions into the universal text-based representations, which are subsequently converted into CAD models. The system incorporates solver-based grounding to ensure geometric and topological accuracy and employs Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to refine model alignment with expert-defined best practices. An encoder/decoder tool facilitates lossless conversion between the text-based representation and native CAD software formats, streamlining CAD model generation with high precision and adaptability.

title: Harmonic rejection upconverter architecture with improved harmonic rejection
abstract: Certain aspects are directed towards a filter circuit. The filter circuit generally includes: a transimpedance amplifier (TIA) configured to generate an in-phase (I) voltage and a complementary I (IB) voltage; a first set of resistive elements coupled to the TIA and configured to perform a weighted combination of the I voltage with an I with a 45° phase offset (I45) voltage and a complementary quadrature with a 45° phase offset (Q45B) voltage to generate an I output signal of the filter circuit; and a second set of resistive elements coupled to the TIA and configured to perform a weighted combination of the IB voltage with a quadrature with a 45 phase offset (Q45) voltage and a complementary I45 (I45B) voltage to generate an IB output signal of the filter circuit.

title: Processing Spatial Descriptors from Higher Order Ambisonics Data
abstract: Encoding, decoding, and processing spatial descriptors (SD) produced from higher order ambisonics (HOA) data for purposes of bitrate reduction is described. Some aspects include encoding an SD by subtracting a mean vector, multiplying a unitary transform matrix, clustering, and/or lossless encoding, and/or decoding an SD by adding a mean vector, multiplying an inverse of the unitary transform matrix, processing clusters, and/or lossless decoding. Other aspects are also described and claimed.

title: Viscosity and surface tension measurement using resonance of levitated droplets
abstract: Various examples are provided related to measurement of viscosity and surface tension in levitated liquid droplets. In one example, a method includes levitating a sample using electrostatic levitation; determining a measured resonance frequency of the sample by an analysis of a plurality of captured images, the measured resonance frequency based upon a maximum response deviation of the levitated sample at a mode of oscillation; determining a decay constant of the sample associated with the measured resonance frequency; and determining a viscosity of the sample based at least in part upon the decay constant of the sample. In another example, a system includes electrodes; a position sensor; and a camera device. A computing device can cause the system to levitate a sample using the method or variations thereof.
assignee: University Of Florida Research Foundation, Inc.

title: Fuel injector device for injecting fuel into a combustion chamber of an internal combustion engine
abstract: A fuel injector device includes a nozzle injector body and a valve needle. The nozzle injector body includes an inner annular surface that defines an injector cavity connected to a sac having an injector orifice. The sac includes a sac surface that defines a sac diameter and a sac volume wherein the sac volume is defined by the sac surface, the relief portion, and the needle tip. The valve needle reciprocates in the injector cavity to control fuel delivery through the injector orifice. The valve needle includes a needle tip portion having a needle seat transition edge positioned between a needle seat portion that extends at a needle seat angle and a relief portion that extends at a relief seat angle. The relief seat angle is greater than the needle seat angle to thereby increase a sac volume when the nozzle seat portion engages the nozzle seat.

title: High linearity transconductance amplifier
abstract: A high linearity transconductance amplifier includes a first transistor, a second transistor, two source resistors, a load, a common mode voltage (VCM) calibration device, and a VCM calibration circuit. The first and second transistors generate a pair of output currents to the load. The source resistors are coupled in series between source electrodes of the first and second transistors. The source electrodes of the first and second transistors have a first source voltage and a second source voltage respectively. The VCM calibration circuit compares an input common mode voltage with a reference voltage and counts based on the comparing result, thereby adjusting the input common mode voltage related to the first and second source voltages. The VCM calibration device provides a bias voltage to the load according to a system high voltage and the counting result of the VCM calibration circuit.

title: Efficient transform signaling for small blocks
abstract: A device includes a memory and a processor. The processor is configured to execute instructions stored in the memory to determine whether a size of a transform block is below a predefined block size. In response to determining that the size is not below the predefined block size and that one of a width or a height of the transform block is equal to a minimum threshold transform dimension size, a default transform type is selected, as a transform type, for the one of the width or the height of the transform block that is equal to the minimum threshold transform dimension size. The transform type is then applied to the transform block.

title: Method and system for arc-flash prevention
abstract: A method is provided for preventing an arc-flash event while an electrically powered accessory disposed on a transport unit is connected to an electrical power source. The method includes obtaining movement data indicating whether the transport unit is moving, and obtaining electrical power data indicating whether the electrically powered accessory is receiving electrical power from the electrical power source. The method also includes determining that the transport unit is moving, and determining that the electrically powered accessory is connected to the electrical power source. Also, the method includes deenergizing a connection that supplies power from the electrical power source to one or more loads of the electrically powered accessory upon detecting both that the transport unit is moving and that the electrically powered accessory is connected to the electrical power source.

title: Network devices for collecting ue related measurement in dual connectivity
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a solution for collecting UE related measurement in dual connectivity. In a solution in accordance with the embodiments of the present disclosure, a network device comprises a processor and a transceiver coupled to the processor. The processor is configured to: transmit, via the transceiver, a first message to request user equipment (UE) related measurement; transmit, via the transceiver, a second message as a part of a dual connectivity procedure for UE to trigger a provision of the UE related measurement for the UE; and in response to completion of the dual connectivity procedure, receive, via the transceiver, a third message that includes the requested UE related measurement related to the dual connectivity procedure. Therefore, the UE related measurement for the UE may be collected in the dual connectivity. The UE related measurement may be provided to the network device to improve network operations.

title: Method of processing substrate and substrate processing apparatus
abstract: A method of processing a substrate includes: holding the substrate; and dispensing a processing liquid from a plurality of outlets of an elongated nozzle toward a main surface of the substrate while the substrate is rotated and the elongated nozzle is moved along a longitudinal direction, the elongated nozzle extending along the longitudinal direction, the plurality of outlets being aligned along the longitudinal direction.

title: Kraft lignin and method for producing same
abstract: A problem of the present invention is to provide a cosmetic, an ink, a printed matter, a paint, an automotive paint, a coating, a plastic, a fiber, a film, a black matrix resist, a photo spacer resist and a cured material thereof containing a kraft lignin which cuts absorption in the ultraviolet region and which has absorption ability in the ultraviolet region and the like. It was found that, because a kraft lignin having specific peaks in an infrared absorption spectrum measured with a Fourier transform infrared spectrophotometer having an ATR unit has high ultraviolet-cutting ability and has a high L* value in color measurement with a spectrophotometer, the kraft lignin can be preferably used especially for cosmetic uses, and the problem could be thus solved.

title: Systems and methods for an artificial intelligence health coach with biometric data integration and personalized health intervention generation
abstract: A method uses an artificial intelligence health coach system that includes receiving a voice input from a user, interpreting the voice input with natural language processing performed by an artificial intelligence model, which includes a large language model, and receiving a glucose level from a continuous glucose monitor. The method further includes receiving an insulin level from a database, calculating a Homeostatic Model Assessment of Insulin Resistance score from the glucose level and the insulin level, comparing the score to historical scores associated with the user, and identifying a predicted risk of a hyperglycemic episode. The method also includes generating a preventative health recommendation modified based on whether the score has changed over time, requesting additional health information from the user, modifying the recommendation based on the additional information, and outputting the modified recommendation to the user. The method maintains persistent user data as contextual memory across interactions.

title: Photo-bio-electrochemical cell
abstract: The invention generally concerns photo-electrochemical cells for generating electric currents from organic materials.

title: Intraoral scanner
abstract: The present intraoral scanner includes: a housing; a light source unit configured to emit light inside the housing; a first optical system configured to reflect light emitted from the light source unit so as to be moved along a first optical path; a second optical system configured to reflect the light reflected from the first optical system toward an object; a third optical system forming a pair of second optical paths with the second optical system, the third optical system being configured to reflect light, which is reflected from the object to the second optical system and moved along the pair of second optical paths, to an image sensor unit; and a heat dissipation fan configured to cause air to flow for heat dissipation inside the housing .

title: Cho cells with optimized ecm profile
abstract: The present invention relates to a CHO cell with a modified extracellular matrix (ECM) profile and to methods for identifying such profiles. The present invention also relates to a method for the production of at least one modified CHO cell according to the present invention. Furthermore, the present invention also relates to method for the production of at least one recombinant protein of interest. Moreover, the present invention relates to the use of at least one modified CHO cell according to the present invention for the production of at least one pharmaceutical drug. Additionally, the present invention relates to a kit comprising at least one modified CHO cell according to the present invention.

title: Determining a refractive index for infrared wavelength ranges
abstract: In some implementations, a system may comprise a measurement device and a computing device. The measurement device may determine a wavevector associated with the light entering a prism, determine an air gap between a bottom surface of the prism and a medium, determine an entrance angle of the light entering the prism, determine a reflection angle of reflection between interfaces associated with the prism, and determine an interface angle between the prism and an interface. The computing device may determine a refractive index of the medium based on the wavevector, the air gap, the entrance angle, the reflection angle, and the interface angle, and perform an action using the medium based on the refractive index of the medium.
assignee: University Of Central Florida Research Foundation, Inc.

title: Base, base assembly, and clothes treatment device
abstract: A base includes a bottom plate and a structural support assembly arranged above the bottom plate. The structural support assembly and the bottom plate enclose to form an accommodation space, and an access opening is provided at a front side of the accommodation space. The bottom plate is formed with a first area and a second area at a side of the first area. A surface at a side of the second area facing away from the accommodation space and a surface at a side of the first area facing away from the accommodation space are at different heights, such that a passage is formed below the second area.
assignee: Wuxi Little Swan Electric Co., Ltd.

title: Q-sense: a quantum sensor system for all communications and public safety
abstract: Q-SENSE: A Quantum Sensor System comprising a Quantum Transceiver Antenna (QTA) having a layered matrix of antenna pixels and toroidal geometries is disclosed. The Sensor may be configured as a smart module to instruct the QTA. Establishing communications integrated or coupled with independent sensor functionality for any kind of situational awareness or public safety, including real-time material signature identification. The QTA renders solid materials—including rock, buildings, underground structures, and Faraday cages—effectively invisible, providing both communications and situational awareness where traditional radios, mobile communications, cameras and sensors fail. Using quantum principles, including quantum tunneling, the QTA operates broadband and far exceeds Chu-Harrington limitations as an electrically small radiator from below 20 Hz through low-IR to high-IR and new quantum-derived spectra to beyond 1 THz. The Quantum Sensor System allows configurations to simultaneously function as an all-in-one smoke, fire, gas, CO, CO 2 , explosive, and organic-materials sensor, connectivity router, camera, and three-dimensional (X, Y, Z including altitude) GNSS asset-tracking device. Thin-film metamaterial fabrication, artificial-intelligence-driven analysis, and quantum digital power harvesting enable portable, wearable, vehicle-mounted, satellite, spacecraft, and drone-deployed operation for first-responder safety, Smart City, industrial monitoring, resource mapping, medical diagnostics, meteorology, and astronomical observations.

title: Rubber composition comprising a specific plasticizing system
abstract: A rubber composition is based on at least: an elastomer matrix consisting of an SBR or of a mixture of one SBR and at least one other SBR, a reinforcing filler comprising silica, a plasticizing system comprising 2 to 50 phr of a liquid plasticizer, and 10 phr to 80 phr of a terpene resin selected from alpha-pinene homopolymers, beta-pinene homopolymers, copolymers of alpha-pinene and beta-pinene, and mixtures thereof, the weight ratio of the resin to the liquid plasticizer being greater than or equal to 2/1, and a crosslinking system. The use of the rubber composition for the manufacture of tires not only affords an excellent compromise between rolling resistance and wet grip while providing a good level of tread block tear strength, it also makes it possible to respond to a desire to increase the content of sustainable materials in tires.

title: Multi-compartment bags
abstract: A multi-compartment bag includes a top end portion and an opposing bottom end portion, a front wall and an opposing rear wall, a first lateral side and an opposing second lateral side coupling the front and rear walls to one another, and a sealable closure positioned between the top and bottom end portions and separating the multi-compartment bag into a first compartment, and a second compartment. The sealable closure is configured to isolate the first and second compartments from one another and to selectively open to allow for communication between the first and second compartments. A flap configured for securing a label thereto includes a first end portion fixedly secured to the front wall, and a free second end portion configured to separate from the front wall.

title: Orthotic device for controlling foot motion
abstract: An ankle and foot orthotic device biases the foot of a user into dorsiflexion to control drop foot and other conditions caused by neurological or muscular impairment; allowing a user to stand, walk, and participate in desired activities with greater ease and balance. The device resists rapid motions of the foot and assists the user in many aspects of walking including controlling the drop of the foot front after heel strike, stabilizing standing in a neutral position, and strengthening the ability to push off of the toes at the end of the stride.

title: Phone call to patient from within video call
abstract: A system and method are described that includes initiating an online video call between a healthcare provider device and a patient device. The method also includes receiving a request to place a phone call, separate from the online video call, from the healthcare provider device to the patient device from within the online video call. The method further includes initiating the phone call between the healthcare provider device and the patient device from within the online video call without disconnecting the healthcare provider device from the online video call.

title: Data processing
abstract: Applications often run multiple tasks that need to share data with each other. When these tasks run repeatedly—like in a loop or across multiple iterations—keeping track of which data belongs to which iteration can be challenging. This disclosure describes techniques for using timestamps to help coordinate data between tasks. For example, when a first task generates data, that data gets tagged with a timestamp. Later, when a second task needs to use data from the first task, the second task may look at the timestamps to help it identify and use data from the matching iteration. This timestamp-based approach may help tasks stay synchronized even when running on different processors or computing platforms.

title: Dosing valve
abstract: A dosing valve comprises a valve body having an inlet opening and an outlet opening which extend from a common overflow chamber. This overflow chamber is delimited on one side by the valve body and on the other side by the diaphragm. The diaphragm has a coupling area at the rear, with which it is fastened to an actuating lever. A retaining part clamps the diaphragm between itself and the valve body at the edge. When the valve is opened, the diaphragm is tilted by the actuating lever and then rests on a rotationally asymmetrical supporting surface on the retaining part in the open position.

title: Process for making a recyclable compostable paper bag
abstract:
The present invention is directed to a produce bag. More specifically, the present invention is directed to a completely recyclable and compostable grocery-type bag for use with produce and other goods. Ideally, the bag is a calendared single-ply paper with heat-sealed seams that is resistant to destruction from moisture. While produce is contemplated, the bag can be used to contain virtually any product. Preferably, such a bag would have a window or an opening so that produce can be viewed and readily identified. 
     The present invention is further directed to a process for creating and filling the above bag. Using a standard printing machine, the adhesive is printed onto the paper in register to desired locations on the paper to form the seams of the bag and, optionally border a window area to be cut out of the paper. If the bag is to include a window opening, the window opening is cut out within the area of applied heat-activated adhesive and a screen cover to the window such that the border of the screen cover is applied to overlap the heat-activated adhesive. Optionally, a recyclable and compostable patch can be placed around the window such that the patch covers the edge of the screen and the heat-activated adhesive to form a border for the window. The patch and screen cover to the window, if present, are adhesively sealed to the paper by heat activation. One method of assembling the bag includes forming the adhesive applied paper to create a tube of paper such that the heat-activated adhesive overlaps the paper, heat sealing the paper into a tube, automatedly filling the tube with product, heat sealing the bottom edge and top edge of the product-filled tube to form an enclosed bag with product therein. The forming and filling can be accomplished on already existing automated forming and filling machines manufactured for use with plastic bags and plastic lined paper bags. Thusly creating a sealed, filled paper bag that is a single ply unlined paper with a mesh covering attached to the paper without the need for reinforcement that can withstand the moisture released from the contents and is 100% recyclable and compostable.

title: Media data processing method and media data processing device
abstract: A media data processing method according to embodiments may comprise the steps of: generating media data; generating a service list for the media data; and transmitting the media data and the service list on the basis of a network. A media data processing method according to embodiments may comprise the steps of: receiving media data and a service list for the media data on the basis of a network; and processing the media data on the basis of the service list.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and recording medium
abstract: An information processing device includes, at least one memory storing instructions, and at least one processor configured to execute the instructions to, acquire one or a plurality of endoscopic images, detect a polyp candidate from the endoscopic image, calculate a first type score indicating a polyp likelihood regarding the polyp candidate, store an image of the polyp candidate and the first type score in a storage unit, determine whether the polyp candidate is identical to one or a plurality of other polyp candidates stored in the storage unit; and calculate a first type integrated score by integrating the first type score and a first type score related to one or a plurality of the other polyp candidates stored in the storage unit when the candidates are determined identical to each other.

title: Etching method, etching apparatus, and method of manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: A method for semiconductor device manufacturing and the like incorporates a high etch rate etching process. According to one embodiment, an etching method includes introducing a gas into a chamber comprising a first substance with hydrogen or a halogen component and a second substance comprising a hydroxy group. A plasma is generated in the chamber while a molecular density ratio of HF to H 2 O in the chamber is kept at 0.3 or higher. A workpiece is then plasma etched while being cooled to a temperature of 0° C. or less.

title: Formulations for Oligonucleotide Delivery
abstract: The disclosure relates to compositions and methods for delivery of nucleic acid therapeutics, particularly iRNA agents to target locations and genes residing in the central nervous system (CNS) of a subject.

title: Method and system for producing coconut water beverages
abstract: In accordance with the described techniques, a method for producing a coconut water beverage includes steeping coconut solids in water to extract coconut flavor. The water and extracted coconut flavor are filtered from the coconut solids to provide a filtered liquid. The filtered liquid is then pasteurized or sterilized to produce the coconut water beverage. The method may further include adjusting the water pH, rinsing the coconut solids with additional heated water, adding salt, and packaging the final beverage.

title: Apparatus and method for treatment of a target area
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for treatment of a target area of a patient by an energy beam. The apparatus comprises means for receiving at least one 3D image of the target area; means for delivering the energy beam to at least a portion of the target area and means for automatically moving the energy beam, preferably by moving at least a portion of the means for delivering the energy beam, such that energy is delivered essentially uniformly across the target area. In particular, the apparatus is adapted to control, during the moving of the energy beam, an effective distance of the means for delivering the energy beam and/or an orientation of the energy beam relative to the target area, at least in part based on the at least one 3D image of the target area.

title: Collagen peptide-based medicament compositions and devices and methods of production and use thereof
abstract: The present invention is in the fields of medicinal chemistry, biotechnology and pharmaceuticals. The invention provides compositions comprising one or more collagen mimetic peptides, optionally attached to one or more therapeutic compounds or one or more imaging compounds, for use in methods of treating, preventing, ameliorating, curing and diagnosing certain diseases and physical disorders in humans and veterinary animals, as well as methods of manufacturing such composition. The invention also provides medical devices comprising one or more such compositions of the invention. The invention also provides methods of use of such compositions and devices in treating and diagnosing certain diseases and physical disorders in humans and veterinary animals, including ocular diseases or disorders, skin diseases or disorders, certain cancers, particularly intraluminal cancers, gastrointestinal diseases or disorders, genitourinary tract diseases or disorders, fibrotic diseases/disorders and rheumatic diseases/disorders.

title: Method for evaluating text-to-image generation, electronic device and storage medium
abstract: Provided is a method for evaluating text-to-image generation, an electronic device and a storage medium, relating to the field of computer technology, and in particular to the fields of artificial intelligence, generative search, knowledge graph, text-to-image generation and others. The method includes: receiving an evaluation request instruction described in natural language and a target image to be evaluated, wherein the target image is an image correspondingly generated based on a text described in the natural language; when parsing the evaluation request instruction, decomposing the natural language description into multiple pieces of structured semantic information based on intent analysis; obtaining a set of visual question answering tasks for evaluation and verification based on the multiple pieces of structured semantic information in combination with visual analysis of the target image; and performing multi-dimensional evaluation according to the visual question answering tasks to obtain a quantitative evaluation result.
assignee: Beijing Baidu Netcom Science Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Sheet conveyance apparatus, image forming apparatus and image forming system
abstract: In a case where an edge portion of a sheet is positioned within a detection range of a single sensor chip in a state where a reference position of the sheet is moved to a first target value, a control unit is configured to move the reference position of the sheet toward the first target value. In a case where an edge portion of a sheet is not positioned within a detection range of a single sensor chip in a state where a reference position of the sheet is moved to the first target value, the control unit is configured to move the reference position of the sheet toward a second target position offset from the first target. The second target position is a position where the edge portion of the sheet is positioned within the detection range of a single sensor chip.

title: Hybrid switching scheme for a capacitor digital-to-analog circuit in a successive approximation register analog-to-digital converter
abstract: An analog-to-digital converter includes first switches configured to selectively couple the first terminal of a first capacitor in a first capacitive digital-to-analog converter (DAC) to one of three voltages, second switches configured to switch the first terminal of a second capacitor in the first capacitive DAC between two of the three voltages, third switches configured to selectively couple the first terminal of a first capacitor in a second capacitive DAC to one of the three voltages, and fourth switches configured to switch the first terminal of a second capacitor in the second capacitive DAC between two of the three voltages. The first and third switches may be controlled based on values of respective ternary numbers. The second and fourth switches may be controlled based on values of respective binary numbers.

title: Automation Process and Risk Assessment
abstract: A method implemented on a vehicle sales device for providing determining risk associated with a potential vehicle transaction is disclosed. The method may include receiving a set of information associated with a potential vehicle buyer, wherein the set of information includes at least one financial metric and at least one biographical information. The method may include determining a set of criteria for a risk assessment for the potential vehicle buyer based on the set of information. The method may include determining a risk profile based on the set of criteria as applied to the set of information. The method may include determining whether the risk profile is within a threshold. The method may include upon a determination that the risk profile is within the threshold, initiate a process to complete a transaction associated with the potential vehicle buyer and the vehicle.

title: Ferromagnetic rotors for agitating the liquid in a microwell
abstract: Introduced here are rotors that can be placed inside of microplate wells that include liquid samples. Each rotor can be comprised of a ferromagnetic material. Accordingly, when a rotor is subjected to an external rotational magnetic field, the rotor spins and agitates the liquid sample inside the corresponding well. The spin speed may be adjusted by changing the rotation speed, direction, and/or orientation of the external rotational magnetic field. The rotor typically includes a central cavity within which a probe can be suspended during the biochemical test.

title: Communication method and related apparatus
abstract: The present disclosure relates to communication methods and devices. One example method includes receiving a service flow identification model of a target service, receiving service data from a terminal, identifying, from the service data based on the service flow identification model, first service data of the target service and/or second service data of a non-target service, and forwarding the first service data to a first processing network element, and/or forwarding the second service data to an anchor network element. The first processing network element is configured to process the first service data based on a function image of the target service, and the anchor network element is configured to forward the second service data to an application server of the second service data, or is configured to process the second service data.

title: Photovoltaic module and production method for the same
abstract: Provided is a photovoltaic module including at least one cell string. A respective cell string includes a plurality of solar cells. A respective solar cell has an overlapping area to be overlapped with a neighboring solar cell. The overlapping area includes first areas and second areas, the first areas being welding areas that allow the respective solar cell to be welded to the neighboring solar cell through the plurality of welding strips, and a respective first area of the first areas being between respective two adjacent second areas of the second areas. The respective solar cell has adhesive applied to the second areas.

title: Application performance automation system
abstract: A system and method for autonomous application performance optimization are disclosed. The system collects telemetry data about an application running in a production environment and analyzes this data to detect performance inefficiencies. Based on the detected inefficiencies, the system identifies a potential intervention and deploys it to the application in a sandbox environment for validation. It then collects telemetry data with the intervention applied in the sandbox, analyzes the data to assess the impact, and determines whether the application's performance has improved by at least a predetermined threshold. In response to improvement by at least the predetermined threshold, the system deploys the intervention to the production environment. Otherwise, the system identifies an alternative intervention and repeats the validation process in the sandbox environment.

title: Wafer-on-wafer formed memory and logic
abstract: A wafer-on-wafer formed memory and logic device can enable high bandwidth transmission of data directly between a memory die and a logic die. The memory die can be formed as one of many memory dies on a first semiconductor wafer. The logic die can be formed as one of many logic dies on a second semiconductor wafer. The first and second wafers can be bonded via a wafer-on-wafer bonding process. The memory and logic device can be singulated from the bonded first and second wafers.

title: Inspection apparatus, inspection method, and method for manufacturing semiconductor device
abstract: According to an inspection apparatus of an embodiment, a processor: causes a probe to emit a first ultrasonic wave from a second surface side to a reference point of a substrate; causes the probe to receive a first reflected wave reflected at the reference point; estimates a first time required for reception of a reflected wave reflected by a first cavity defect based on a time from when the first ultrasonic wave is emitted to when the first reflected wave is received, and sets a first detection period based on the first time; and estimates a second time required for reception of a reflected wave reflected by a second cavity defect based on a time from when the first ultrasonic wave is emitted to when the first reflected wave is received, and sets a second detection period based on the second time.

title: Fluid control techniques for arc process operations
abstract: A fluid control system for an arc processing system includes a first line configured to direct a first fluid from a first inlet of the fluid control system toward a torch, a second line configured to direct a second fluid from a second inlet of the fluid control system toward the torch, and a share line fluidly coupled to the first line and the second line. The second line includes a one-way valve configured to enable fluid flow away from the second inlet and block fluid flow toward the second inlet. The share line is configured to direct the first fluid from the first line to the second line and against the one-way valve to urge the one-way valve to close and block flow of the second fluid through the one-way valve and away from the second inlet within the fluid control system.

title: Wireless communication method of ai/ml, ue, and network device
abstract: A wireless communication method of artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) includes configurating, to a user equipment (UE), an AI/ML model specific reference signal configuration. The AI/ML model specific reference signal configuration includes an indication to indicate a reference signal usage of an AI/ML model specific reference signal, and the reference signal usage includes at least one of the following: AI/ML functionality, AI/ML model, AI/ML model procedure, and/or AI/ML scenario.
assignee: Shenzhen Tcl New Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Braking control device
abstract: When operating a braking operation member to stop a vehicle, a processing circuit of a braking control device executes a reduction correction control for applying an instruction braking force that is smaller than a required braking force to the vehicle to prevent an attitude change of the vehicle accompanying the stopping. The processing circuit functions as: an operation amount increase determination unit configured to determine whether the operation amount is increasing while the reduction correction control is being executed; and an instruction value increase unit configured to, when the operation amount increase determination unit determines that the operation amount is increasing, increase the instruction braking force so that a difference between the instruction braking force and the required braking force decreases.

title: Dram device having 4f2 layout comprising bit line with reduced capacitance
abstract: A DRAM device having a 4F2 layout structure, including a plurality of bit lines disposed parallel to each other in a first horizontal direction with a predetermined spacing; a plurality of channel patterns located on the plurality of bit lines and extending in a vertical direction; a plurality of word lines formed on sidewalls of the channel patterns and disposed parallel to each other in a second horizontal direction perpendicular to the first horizontal direction; and a gate insulating pattern located between the plurality of channel patterns and the plurality of word lines; wherein the plurality of bit lines comprises a plurality of first and second bit lines disposed at different heights from each other, and wherein the first and second bit lines are disposed alternately, wherein the plurality of word lines comprises a plurality of first and second word lines disposed at different heights from each other.
assignee: Taesung Environmental Research Institute Co., Ltd.

title: Vapor cell excitation assembly
abstract: A vapor cell excitation assembly includes a cell wall, a first end cap coupled to a first end of the cell wall, and a second end cap coupled to a second end of the cell wall. As such, the cell wall, the first end cap, and the second end cap define a chamber therein. An alkali material is present within the chamber. Additionally, the vapor cell excitation assembly includes an optical fiber configured to transmit light into the cell wall, the first end cap, or the second end cap. In this respect, the light excites the alkali material such that droplets of the alkali material are desorbed from an inner surface of the cell wall, the first end cap, or the second end cap.

title: Code Testing Method and Related System
abstract: A code testing method is applied to a code testing system. During generation of test code, context information of to-be-tested code is extracted, and the test code is generated based on the context information of the to-be-tested code.
assignee: Huawei Cloud Computing Technologies Co., Ltd.

title: Dental modeling device and method
abstract: Various embodiments disclosed relate to imaging and analysis of a patient's dental arch. A 3D model and a selection of correlated 2D images are presented to a practitioner. One or more of the 2D images include highlighted borders to alert the practitioner when an alternate image can be selected to improve information concerning a feature of interest.

title: Golf club head
abstract: A golf club head may include a forward portion including a striking face adapted to impact a golf ball, a first region located near a geometric center of the striking face, the first region including a first thickness, and a second region at least partially extending around the first region, the second region including a second thickness. The second thickness may be thicker than the first thickness. A width to height ratio of the striking face may be between about 1.0 and about 4.0. A golf club head may include a sole including a rear sole portion and a frontal sole portion.

title: System and method for seamlessly correlating cloud assets to infrastructure as code (iac) definitions using state records
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer readable medium are disclosed for identifying infrastructure-as-code (IaC) associated with cloud assets. Identifying lac associated with cloud assets includes locating IAC state data; analyzing the IAC state data to identify attributes of associated provisioned resources, wherein the IAC state data lacks manually introduced tags; accessing the provisioned resources; establishing a first map between the IAC state data and the provisioned resources based on the identified attributes; accessing a set of IAC code definitions; establishing a second map between the IAC state data and the set of IAC code definitions; and based on the first map and the second map, establishing a third map between the set of IAC code definitions and the provisioned resources, thereby mapping the set of IAC code definitions to the provisioned resources without requiring manual tagging of the provisioned resources.

title: Power converter and method of operating
abstract: A power converter includes a first and a second set of switching elements communicatively coupled with a first capacitor and a second capacitor.
