A controller is configured to cyclically command a first operation of the first set of switches to supply an electrical current to the first capacitor for a first duration, followed by a first interval to terminate the electrical current to the first capacitor. The controller is further configured to cyclically command a second operation of the second set of switches to provide the electrical current to the second capacitor for a second duration followed by a second interval to terminate the electrical current to the second capacitor.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor that is configured to receive past image data and geographic information via an input unit, analyze the received data via an analysis unit to extract features from the received data, generate a three-dimensional virtual reality space via a generation unit based on the extracted features, and optimize the generated three-dimensional virtual reality space via an optimization unit and output the optimized three-dimensional virtual reality space in a form in which a user can experience the three-dimensional virtual reality space.

title: Image sensor including vertical gate electrode at center of pixel region and charge pocket region under vertical gate electrode
abstract: An image sensor includes a semiconductor substrate including a pixel region; a vertical gate electrode disposed in the semiconductor substrate at a center of the pixel region; a charge pocket region provided under the vertical gate electrode in the semiconductor substrate, and doped with a first impurity having a first conductivity type; a first impurity region which is spaced apart from the charge pocket region in a vertical direction, doped with a second impurity having a second conductivity type, and surrounded by the vertical gate electrode; and a second impurity region which is provided around the vertical gate electrode and doped with the second impurity

title: Anti-fouling control for marine structures
abstract: A computer system for anti-fouling control for a marine structure, has processing circuitry to obtain potential shift data from a sensor monitoring a control piece mounted to a surface portion of the marine structure that is under the influence of bacterial film formation, wherein the control piece comprises metal being electrically isolated from the surface portion; determine an ultraviolet, UV, light control action based on the potential shift data, the UV light control action comprising one or more of an intensity indicator and an exposure period indicator; and control an UV light source mounted to the marine structure based on the UV light control action, the control causing the UV light source to emit UV light onto the control piece and the surface portion.

title: Ranging device
abstract: A semiconductor device according to an embodiment of the present embodiment includes a stack including a silicon photonics layer and a supporting substrate that are bonded to each other. The silicon photonics layer includes a waveguide through which an optical signal is transmitted and a metal film disposed to be opposed to the supporting substrate with the waveguide interposed therebetween. The metal film includes a heater layer configured to serve as a heater for the waveguide.

title: System
abstract: A system comprising a processor, wherein the processor is configured to: record an operation log of a home appliance, analyze the recorded operation log to determine an operational state of the home appliance, generate a voice signal based on a result of the analysis of the operation log, output the generated voice signal to a user, and communicate with other home appliances to share information with the other home appliances.

title: Composition comprising stewartia pseudocamellia extract as active ingredient for prevention or treatment of dementia
abstract: The present application provides a composition comprising a  Stewartia pseudocamellia  extract as an active ingredient for prevention or treatment of dementia.

title: Probiotic strain with efficacy in improving depression-like symptoms, microecological preparation and uses thereof
abstract: The present disclosure discloses a probiotic strain with efficacy in improving depression-like symptoms, a microecological preparation and uses thereof. The probiotic strain is  Limosilactobacillus fermentum  PC17, which has been deposited under the culture collection number CGMCC No. 33866, the active ingredient of the lactic acid bacteria microecological preparation comprise  Limosilactobacillus fermentum  PC17. The microecological preparation is prepared by inoculating  Limosilactobacillus fermentum  PC17 into a fermentation medium at 1-5% (v/v) to obtain a probiotic microecological preparation. The preparation can be used for the manufacture of antidepressant drugs. The advantages include: promoting the secretion of 5-HT and 5-HTP by RIN14B cells, reducing serum levels of IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, CORT, and ACTH, and increasing serum levels of GABA and BDNF. Furthermore, the depression-like behaviors in a CUMS-induced depression-like mouse model are significantly ameliorated.

title: Plant for the treatment of material containing a caronaceous matrix and its operation method
abstract:
A plant is described for the treatment of waste containing a carbonaceous matrix comprising at least: a treatment station which is configured to receive as input a carbonaceous matrix to be processed and to thermochemically decompose said carbonaceous matrix into a plurality of products in the gaseous, liquid and/or solid state; and a feeding station, which is arranged upstream of the treatment station and is adapted to conveying the carbonaceous matrix to be processed to the treatment station;
         the plant enables large quantities of synthesis gas with high calorific value or large quantities of pyrolysis oil or biofuels to be obtained from waste materials or waste containing a carbonaceous matrix, depending on the calibration of the plant itself.

title: Connector
abstract: A connector includes a housing having a counter connector accommodating portion, a slider disposed on the housing so as to be slidable along a fitting direction, and an elastic member for pushing the slider forward along the fitting direction, the slider including a slider body having a cam groove, a slide arm elastically deformable in a first direction orthogonal to the fitting direction, the housing including a lock arm exposed to the counter connector accommodating portion and elastically deformable in the second direction, a cam projection projecting in the first direction from a side surface of the lock arm, and a slide arm deforming portion which makes contact with the slide arm of the slider retracted in the fitting direction to elastically deform the slide arm in the first direction.

title: Head up display with reduced ghost artifacts
abstract: The application relates to a method for providing image data for a projection on a windscreen, the method comprising at an image processing unit the steps of determining an inverse filter function u to be used to remove ghost artifacts which occur when the image data are projected on the windscreen, determining a first image f to be projected on the windscreen, and determining a ghost function representing the ghost artifacts by which the first image to be projected is distorted when projected on the windscreen. The inverse filter is applied to the first image f in order to generate a filtered image, and the filtered image is provided to a projecting apparatus configured to project the filtered image onto the windscreen.

title: Current assisted photonic demodulator (capd) image capture
abstract: An image sensor system for high dynamic range (HDR) imaging utilizes a current assisted photonic demodulator (CAPD) to address luminance capture challenges in varied lighting conditions. The system includes processing circuitry that modulates voltage at a CAPD sensor's modulation electrode with an adjustable duty cycle, allowing a first photodiode to have a longer integration time than a second photodiode. This configuration enables simultaneous capture of longer and shorter exposures.

title: Channel state information (csi) acquisition for dynamic mimo transmission
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for dynamic switching of reference transmission schemes used by a UE for CSI measurement and reporting.

title: Method for providing alignment scan parameters for a magnetic resonance apparatus
abstract: A method for providing alignment scan parameters for an alignment scan of a magnetic resonance examination of a patient's body part via a magnetic resonance apparatus comprises: capturing a normalization scan, wherein the normalization scan is used to calibrate the magnetic resonance apparatus; determining the position of the body part based on the normalization scan; positioning a local coil of the magnetic resonance apparatus in a patient-receiving region of the magnetic resonance apparatus around the body part; ascertaining alignment scan parameters for an alignment scan based on the position of the body part; and providing the alignment scan parameters.

title: Memory device and operation method thereof
abstract: Example memory devices, memory systems, and methods for reducing program disturb in NAND flash memory are disclosed. One example method includes applying, at a first time, a first voltage to a first select line coupled to a first select gate transistor, where the memory device includes a memory cell array. The memory cell array includes a memory string. The memory string includes the first select gate transistor, multiple memory cells, and a source select gate transistor. The multiple memory cells are positioned between the first select gate transistor and the source select gate transistor. The source select gate transistor is coupled to a source line of the memory cell array. A second voltage is applied at a second time to the first select line, where the second time is after the first time, and the second voltage is larger than the first voltage.

title: Methods of manufacturing semiconductor devices
abstract: Methods of manufacturing semiconductor devices are described. The methods include depositing a molybdenum silicide layer directly on a substrate; depositing an interfacial layer directly on the molybdenum silicide layer; and depositing a metal nitride layer directly on the interfacial layer. The interfacial layer includes a metal silicide having a formula of MSi x , where M is a metal and x is an integer in a range of from 1 to 3 or a metal silicon nitride having a formula MSiN where M is the metal.

title: Surgical pathway processing system, method, device, and storage medium
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a surgical pathway processing system, method, device, and storage medium. The system comprises an image segmentation module configured to obtain a first segmented image by performing image segmentation on a first medical image; an avoidance region determination module configured to determine a region to be avoided based on the first segmented image; and a pathway planning module configured to determine a surgical pathway based on the region to be avoided.
assignee: Wuhan United Imaging Surgical Co., Ltd.

title: Additive for organic conductors
abstract: An additive for an organic conductor has a naphthalene ring, a sulfo group bonded to the naphthalene ring, and a carboxy group bonded to the naphthalene ring. Where the carbon atom of the naphthalene ring to which the sulfo group is bonded and the carbon atom of the naphthalene ring to which the carboxy group is bonded are a first carbon atom and a second carbon atom, respectively, the number n of carbon atoms between the first carbon atom and the second carbon atom is 3 or less. This makes it possible to provide an additive that can remarkably increase moisture resistance of the organic conductor.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: Devices, systems, and methods for generating customized beverages
abstract: Devices, systems, and methods for generating customized beverages. In a method of creating a prepared beverage, the method comprises the steps of receiving a beverage order from an individual via software instruction, instructing the creation of a prepared beverage using a drink creation system based upon the beverage order, the drink creation system comprising a first cart having a plurality of beverage receptacles therein, a beverage dispenser coupled to the plurality of beverage receptacles, and a dispenser controller in communication with the beverage dispenser, selecting a beverage cup based upon the software instruction, dispensing the prepared beverage using the beverage dispenser, and delivering the prepared beverage to a location based upon the software instruction.

title: User equipments and methods
abstract: A user equipment (UE) is described. The UE may comprise a controller, a receiver and a transmitter; wherein if the candidate single-slot resource overlaps with at least one reserved resource for LTE-sidelink UE and if the UE supports the dynamic resource pool sharing for co-channel coexistence for LTE-sidelink and NR-sidelink, the reserved resource and a second threshold value is set based on at least LI priority for a PSSCH.

title: Methods for manufacturing biomaterial-based materials via extrusion
abstract: Fibrous materials that include biomaterials are disclosed, as are methods for making and using such fibrous materials. In some embodiments, a biomaterial-based fibrous material is formed by extruding a deformable mixture comprising the biomaterial into a desired spatial configuration and subsequently treating the deformable mixture to form the fibrous material. In some cases, the fibrous material may be a textile and/or the biomaterial may comprise fungal biomass. The biomaterial-based fibrous materials disclosed herein may have advantageous mechanical and aesthetic properties that make the fibrous materials especially suitable for use, by way of non-limiting example, as leather analog materials.

title: Prach transmission power control based on cell measurements
abstract: A wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) measures a first candidate cell. The WTRU sends a channel state information (CSI) report to a serving cell. The CSI report includes one or more measurements of the first candidate cell. The WTRU receives a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) order to transmit a preamble to the first candidate cell. The WTRU determines a time difference between when the CSI report is sent and when the PDCCH order is received. If the time difference is equal to or greater than a threshold, the WTRU transmits a physical random access channel (PRACH) at a first transmission power value. If the time difference is less than the threshold, the WTRU transmits the PRACH at a second transmit power that is an offset greater than the first transmit power value.

title: Data insight and exploration with natural language queries
abstract: Certain aspects of the disclosure pertain to natural language data exploration. A computing system may manage a data catalog integrating diverse data sources. To facilitate intelligent exploration of this data, the system can utilize a multi-agent architecture. An orchestration agent can obtain a natural language query, interpret a semantic intent, and determine an execution strategy by selecting and sequencing specialized execution agents. The orchestration agent routes execution parameters to the selected agents and combines their analytical results. Furthermore, prior to user presentation, the orchestration agent can intercept retrieved data and transmit the data to a security agent to evaluate user access rights against real-time security conditions. A formulated response is then output based on this evaluation, enabling secure and orchestrated data insights.

title: Substituted pyridine amides
abstract: The present disclosure describes compounds of Formula I, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, pharmaceutical compositions comprising the compounds, methods of preparation, and methods of use. The compounds of the disclosure can inhibit the interaction between SLC15A4 and TASL, and are believed to be useful for treating an autoimmune disease, such as systemic lupus erythematosus, or an inflammatory condition.

title: Stable microbial composition and drying process
abstract: The present invention relates to a microbial composition having fermentation solids embedded in a matrix forming an evaporated suspension, characterized by the features of having: a non-hygroscopic matrix and fermentation solids at a ratio of at least 1:1 by weight; wherein the matrix has a moisture-regulating binder and a detackifier at a ratio of between 1:5 and 5:1 by weight and, optionally, not more than 75% by weight protective stabilizer; wherein the evaporated suspension has a water content of at least 1% and at most 30% water by weight when stored at a relative humidity of 50% and a temperature of 20° C. The present invention also relates to granules and methods for preparing a composition having fermentation solids embedded in a matrix to form an evaporated suspension.

title: Portable automatic microscopy systems for rapid detection of multiple types of microplastics
abstract: A portable automatic microscope system for on-site and real-time detection and classification of plastics and fibers in environmental and industrial water samples is provided. The system includes a sample introduction module for receiving water samples, a filtration module including a membrane holder and at least one membrane filter for retaining plastics and fibers, and a dye application module configured to apply a dye matrix containing at least one lipophilic fluorescent dye and at least one hydrophilic (water-soluble) colorimetric dye. A microscope imaging module includes an optical system with automatic focus adjustment, a controllable visible and ultraviolet illumination source, and a digital camera for capturing images of the retained plastics and fibers. A control module coordinates operation of the system components, while a computing module receives and analyzes the captured images to identify regions of interest, extract color, size, and morphology features, and classify plastics and fibers using image analysis methods.
assignee: The Hong Kong University Of Science And Technology

title: Battery cell, battery and electric device
abstract: Disclosed in the embodiments of the present application are a battery cell, a battery and an electric device. The battery cell comprises: an electrode assembly, wherein the electrode assembly comprises a positive electrode sheet, the positive electrode sheet comprises a positive electrode active material capable of realizing reversible de-intercalation and intercalation of metal ions, and the positive electrode active material comprises a compound containing nickel; and a case, which is used for accommodating the electrode assembly, wherein the melting point of at least some regions of the case is p, and p satisfies: 1200° C.≤p≤2000° C. According to the battery cell, the battery and the electric device in the embodiments of the present application, the reliability of the battery cell can be improved.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and non-transitory computer-readable medium
abstract: An object is to provide an information processing apparatus capable of easily collecting data necessary for risk assessment of surgery. An information processing apparatus according to the present disclosure includes a patient data acquisition unit that acquires patient data that is extracted from an electronic medical record and indicates a condition of a patient, a necessary input item acquisition unit that acquires an input item necessary for risk assessment for surgery of the patient, a necessary data collection unit that collects patient data necessary for the risk assessment based on the necessary input item and the patient data, and a risk assessment request unit that requests the risk assessment by using the collected patient data.
assignee: Nec Corporation; Social Welfare Organization Saiseikai Imperial Gift Foundation, Inc.Saiseikai Kumamoto Hospital

title: Camellia Oleifera Tea Oil Concentrate and Uses Thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a lipid extract of  Camellia oleifera  tea oil concentrated in its unsaponifiable fraction, to a cosmetic, pharmaceutical or dermatological composition comprising a suitable excipient and said lipid extract, and to the uses thereof.

title: Encoding and decoding methods using quantization constrained correction and corresponding apparatuses
abstract: A decoding method is disclosed. An image block is first reconstructed from decoded quantization levels and a prediction block. The reconstructed image block is filtered to obtain a filtered image block. Finally, a correction is applied on said filtered image block so that a quantization level obtained by quantizing a corrected prediction residual transform coefficient is equal to a corresponding decoded quantization level.

title: Slice selection for data traffic routing in a visited network
abstract: A system and method are provided for providing a user equipment with a route selection policy for data traffic routing in a visited network. For that purpose, the system and method may obtain a route selection policy for a home network of the user equipment, and for at least one application which is listed in the said route selection policy and for which application a network slice identified in the home route selection policy is not available for use in the visited network for data traffic of the application, determine a replacement network slice and modify the home route selection policy to include a mapping associating the application with the replacement network slice. The user equipment may be provided with access to the updated route selection policy. This way, the user equipment may be enabled to make use of a replacement network slice in the visited network when the network slice identified in the home route selection policy is not available for use in the visited network for data traffic of the application.
assignee: Koninklijke Kpn N.V.; Nederlandse Organisatie Voor Toegepast-Natuurwetenschappelijk Onderzoek Tno

title: Distribution transformer system and methods thereof
abstract: A distribution transformer system includes a distribution transformer and a distribution transformer monitoring (DTM) device secured to the transformer. The DTM device includes multiple sensors, a controller, and a communication interface. The sensors are configured to monitor at least one of operational parameters, physical conditions, or physical properties of the distribution transformer. Each of the sensors outputs respective sensor data representative of at least one monitored operational parameter, physical condition, or physical property of the distribution transformer. The controller is configured to receive the respective sensor data from each sensor to produce received sensor data. The communications interface is in communication with the controller and configured to communicate the received sensor data to a remote system for use in determining at least one of operational parameters, physical conditions, or physical properties of the distribution transformer. The distribution transformer may be a pole-type, pad-mounted type, or vault type distribution transformer.

title: Methods and Systems for Non-Contact Boring of Tunnels, Shafts, and Trenches
abstract: Described herein are methods and systems for non-contact boring of tunnels, trenches, and/or vertical shafts. A system comprises a chassis, a non-contact boring element, and a boring actuator connecting the non-contact boring element to the chassis and configured to position the non-contact boring element relative to the bore face. These three elements may form an internal subsystem as this subsystem within a tunnel, trench, or shaft. In some examples, a system further comprises an external subsystem, which is positioned away from the tunnel, trench, or shaft. The external subsystem is connected to the internal subsystem using an umbilical cord (e.g., providing power and control signals to the internal subsystem). Furthermore, the system may include an ejecta removal subsystem operationally coupled to the internal and external subsystems. Some examples of a non-contact boring element include a combustor (e.g., a jet turbine, a flame jet) and a plasma torch.

title: Allocating resources in a microservice system
abstract: Systems and methods disclosed herein deploy microservices to a test system, simulate a production environment, and test the microservices to gather data about the actual relative resource consumption and capacities of the microservices. Using the gathered data, a resource allocation to be used for the microservices is determined. The production environment is configured according to the determined resource allocation. An administrator may manually adjust the determined resource allocations.

title: Methods to improve bioproduct production in cyanobacteria
abstract: The present invention relates to methods, compositions, and systems for modulating cellular metabolism in cyanobacteria, particularly  F. diplosiphon , through the administration of nanoparticles including zero-valent iron nanoparticles (nZVIs) and titanium dioxide nanoparticles (n-TiO 2 ), β-lactam antibiotics such as ampicillin, or combinations thereof. The disclosed methods enable controlled alteration of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) concentrations, ATP synthase expression, lactate metabolism, photosynthetic efficiency (Fv/Fm), reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, thylakoid membrane morphology, and monounsaturated fatty acid (MUFA) production. A combination regimen of ampicillin and nZVIs partially rescues ATP levels otherwise depressed by nZVI treatment alone and enhances MUFA production. Administration of n-TiO 2  at optimal concentrations enhances ATP synthase expression, photosynthetic efficiency, and growth in a strain-specific manner. Applications include sustainable biofuel synthesis and bioproduct manufacturing.

title: Soybean varieties '70020032728', '70020032975', and '70020033154'
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of plant breeding. In particular, this invention relates to new soybean,  Glycine max , varieties designated ‘70020032728’, ‘70020032975’, and ‘70020033154’.
assignee: GDM Argentina S.A.; GDM Genética do Brasil S.A.

title: Adaptive routing with endpoint feedback
abstract: Systems, switches, network endpoints, and methods are provided. In one example, a system is described that includes a latency measurement circuit to measure traffic on a network from an endpoint sender to an endpoint receiver across multiple paths. The system also includes a packet marking circuit to provide a routing mark for a packet destined for the endpoint receiver according to a network traffic measurement provided by the latency measurement circuit, where the routing mark provides an indication that supports routing for the packet to reach the endpoint receiver via a chosen path or subset of paths among the multiple paths. The system also includes a routing circuit to route the packet within the network according to the routing mark.

title: Methods of treating ulcerative colitis
abstract: Antibody formulations are described comprising a mixture of an anti-4β7 antibody, an antioxidant or chelator, and at least one free amino acid. The disclosed formulations may have improved stability, reduced aggregate formation, or both. The present invention further provides a safe dosing regimen of these antibody formulations that is easy to follow, and which results in a therapeutically effective amount of the anti-α4β7 antibody in vivo.

title: Liquid ejecting head and liquid ejecting apparatus
abstract: A liquid ejecting head includes: a piezoelectric substrate having a plurality of piezoelectric elements for ejecting a liquid; a wiring substrate; and a flexible substrate provided with a plurality of wirings and electrically coupling the piezoelectric substrate and the wiring substrate, in which the plurality of wirings include a plurality of drive signal wirings respectively coupled to the plurality of piezoelectric elements, and a first dummy wiring and a second dummy wiring that are adjacent to each other for detecting deterioration of the flexible substrate caused by migration and are held at different potentials.

title: Z-shaped steel wire sealed load-bearing detection cable
abstract: Provided is a Z-shaped steel wire sealed load-bearing detection cable including a cable core and armor steel wire layers armored outside the cable core. The armor steel wire layers include an inner layer and an outer layer. The inner layer is formed by armoring circular inner-layer armor steel wires or Z-shaped inner-layer armor steel wires, and the outer layer is formed by armoring Z-shaped outer-layer armor steel wires. The circular inner-layer armor steel wires or the Z-shaped inner-layer armor steel wires are armored outside the cable core, and the Z-shaped outer-layer armor steel wires are armored outside the circular inner-layer armor steel wires or the Z-shaped inner-layer armor steel wires.
assignee: Hebei Huatong Wires & Cables Group Co., Ltd

title: Device for implanting analyte sensor
abstract: This application discloses a device for implanting an analyte sensor, including: an outer housing, provided with an accommodating cavity; a monitoring unit, arranged inside the accommodating cavity and including a first module and a second module, where the first module and the second module are spaced apart; and a driving unit, arranged inside the accommodating cavity and configured to drive the monitoring unit to move along a first direction, where in a process in which the driving unit drives the monitoring unit to move along the first direction, at least one of the first module and the second module moves toward the other of the first module and the second module, to complete assembly between the first module and the second module.
assignee: Jiangsu Yuwell Poctech Biotechnology Co., Ltd.; Jiangsu Yuekai Biotechnology Co., Ltd.; Zhejiang Poctech Co., Ltd.

title: Development in a curtain assembly
abstract: A curtain assembly includes a curtain fabric, an upper assembly mounted on the curtain fabric, a lower assembly mounted below the curtain fabric, and at least one body located in the lower assembly. The body includes a tube made of aluminum, a spring activator connected to the tube, a spring connected to the spring activator, at least one ball bearing connected to the tube, an inner lath and an outer lath, made of plastic, forming the upper assembly.
assignee: Al-Kor Makina Kalip Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.

title: Orchestrating a mixture of experts for conversational ai systems and applications
abstract: In various examples, methods, systems, processors, and/or machine-readable mediums implement a conversational artificial intelligence (AI) that obtains results from other conversational AIs, and generates output based at least on those results. In at least one embodiment, an orchestrator conversational AI receives input(s), and uses one or more strategies to obtain one or more results from one or more expert conversational AIs based in part on one or more inputs received by the orchestrator conversational AI, and determines at least one response to the one or more inputs based at least on a portion of the one or more results.

title: Channel state information reporting method and apparatus
abstract: A channel state information (CSI) reporting method is performed by a terminal. The terminal reports CSI to a network device, wherein the CSI comprises quantized information obtained by processing downlink channel information by a first model corresponding to each layer or a specific rank.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Fabric Data Rate Limiting Proportional to Electrical Current Threshold Violations
abstract: Disclosed techniques relate to limiting a data rate of communications on fabric circuitry proportionally to a violation of a power-related threshold. Toggle rate detector circuitry, measuring a toggle rate between a given interface circuit and the fabric circuitry, may be distributed at interfaces that couple the fabric circuitry and multiple client circuits. Power control circuitry may generate an estimate of electrical current use by a given client circuit based on a toggle rate between the client circuit's interface and the fabric circuitry and based on a communication event. The power control circuitry may detect, based on the estimates of electrical current use, a violation of an electrical current threshold. Additionally, the power control circuitry may limit the data rate of communications on the fabric circuitry, proportionally to a magnitude of the violation. Disclosed techniques may mitigate violations with reduced impacts on performance relative to traditional techniques.

title: Piezoelectric laminate, piezoelectric element, and method for manufacturing piezoelectric laminate
abstract: A piezoelectric laminate, including: a substrate; and a laminated film provided on at least one surface of the substrate, in which the laminated film includes, in order from a substrate side, a first base layer, an electrode layer, and a piezoelectric thin film layer, the first base layer is in contact with the electrode layer, and the first base layer contains a nitrogen compound containing at least one element selected from the group consisting of Group III to VI elements.

title: Fuel cell flexible power conversion module
abstract: A power conversion unit can include a first slot and a second slot. The first slot can guide a first converter module into alignment with a first interface to couple the first converter module with the power conversion unit. The second slot can guide a second converter module into alignment with a second interface to couple the second converter module with the power conversion unit. The first converter module can establish a first bi-directional flow of electrical power between a voltage bus of the power conversion unit and a first power source. The second converter module can electrically couple with a second power source and establish a second bi-directional flow of electrical power between the voltage bus of the power conversion unit and the second power source.

title: Methods and features for coupling ultrasonic surgical instrument components together
abstract: A surgical apparatus comprises a transducer assembly and a shaft assembly. The transducer assembly is operable to convert electrical power into ultrasonic vibrations. The shaft assembly comprises an ultrasonic waveguide, a sheath, a shroud, and a torque transfer assembly. The waveguide is configured to couple with the transducer assembly. The waveguide is disposed within the sheath. The sheath extends through the shroud. The torque transfer assembly is contained within the shroud. The torque transfer assembly is configured to transfer a predetermined range of torque from the shroud to the waveguide to thereby couple the waveguide with the transducer assembly. The torque transfer assembly is further configured to prevent transfer of torque from the shroud to the waveguide beyond an upper limit of the predetermined range.

title: Energy harvesting based access control method based on access enforcement point(s)
abstract: A computer-implemented energy harvesting based access control method is provided. The method includes instruction-polling, by an access enforcement point. Instruction-polling includes repeatedly sending an instruction request by the access enforcement point according to a polling time interval, and receiving, by the access enforcement point, an instruction. The instruction includes an unlock-command to cause unlocking an access point. The access enforcement point is configured to cause operation of the access point according to the instruction. The access enforcement point comprises an energy harvesting including a solar cell and an energy storage. The method further includes: adjusting the polling time interval based on a status of the energy harvesting component.

title: Method, device and storage medium for message communication
abstract: According to embodiments of the disclosure, a method, device, and storage medium for message communication are provided. The method includes: receiving, from a server device via a communication link between a client device and the server device, duration information indicating a duration for which an application in the client device is required to remain in an active state; transmitting, in response to receiving a notification message, the notification message to the server device via the communication link; controlling, in response to the transmitting of the notification message, the application to remain in the active state at least for the indicated duration, where the communication link is maintained while the application is in the active state; and receiving, from the server device via the communication link, a summary message determined based on at least one notification message sent from the client device.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.; Bytedance Technology Ltd.

title: Automating search and personalized messaging from a job description using a large language model
abstract: A method for automating search on a candidate search engine based on a job description to identify a candidate profile having a matching attribute, and generate a personalized message based on the matching attribute are provided. The method includes (i) extracting at least one job requirement and at least one job attribute from the job description in a machine-readable format, (ii) determining at least one suggested keyword associated with the at least one job requirement, (iii) transforming the at least one suggested keyword into at least one substitute term, (iv) generating a search query using at least one of (a) the at least one substitute term or (b) the at least one suggested keyword and execute it to determine at least one matching candidate, (v) determining at least one matching attribute, (vi) extracting the at least one matching candidate preference and (vii) generating and communicating a contextual and personalized message for the at least one matching candidate.

title: Method, program, and apparatus for searching for blood collection candidate
abstract: There are disclosed a method, program, and apparatus for searching for a blood collection candidate according to one embodiment of the present disclosure. The method may include: detecting a blood vessel present in a medical image by using a pre-trained deep learning model; and searching for bounding boxes, including at least a part of the detected blood vessel, based on the workspace of a medical robot, and determining a blood collection candidate.

title: Resistance spot welding method
abstract: A resistance spot welding method for joining two or more steel sheets including at least one zinc-based coated steel sheet includes a first energization step and a second energization step. In the first energization step, welding conditions are controlled to form a nugget having a diameter of 3.0√{square root over (t)} mm to 4.5√{square root over (t)} mm, where t is the thickness of the thinnest sheet. The second energization step uses multistage energization with n stages (n≥2), each stage including a cooling period (10-160 ms) and an energization period (20-200 ms). Current values (I1 to In) in the second energization step increase progressively according to formulas I1≤I2≤ . . . ≤In and I1<In, with I1 being equal to or greater than the first energization step current.

title: Text recognition system and method
abstract: A system and method for obtaining a plurality of image frames from video content during presentation, the plurality of image frames comprising every n th  frame of the content where n is an integer greater than one, identifying, in an obtained image frame, one or more regions in which text may appear, and selectively performing an OCR process in the one or more bounding areas in which the threshold size is exceeded for at least a predetermined number of consecutive frames, and to output recognised text.

title: Methods and systems for detecting and identifying an animal and associated animal behavior relative to a system of pet health issues
abstract: One or more methods for automated animal detection, automated animal identification, automated behavior identification, automated trend and/or pattern identification, and automated notifications. The one or more methods may employ a camera for receiving incoming image signals and converting to a video stream. The video stream may then be converted into image data which may be analyzed by one or more processors and stored in one or more storage mediums. One or more models may be executed on the incoming image data to detect the presence of an animal, an identification of the animal, behavior of the animal, and/or trends of the animal. The methods may be useful with pet health devices, such as litter devices, water dispensers, and feeders.
assignee: Automated Pet Care Products, Llc D/B/A Whisker

title: Methods and compositions for treating and/or preventing a disease or disorder associated with abnormal level and/or activity of the ifp35 family of proteins
abstract: The present invention relates to methods and compositions for treating and/or preventing a disease or disorder associated with abnormally high level of the IFP35 family of proteins, including IFP35 and NMI, methods and compositions for diagnosis, prognosis or treatment monitoring of a disease or disorder associated with abnormally high level of the IFP35 family of proteins, including IFP35 and NMI, and methods and compositions for identifying a modulator of the IFP35 family of proteins, including IFP35 and NMI.
assignee: Guangzhou Inno-Enmai Biomedical Technology Co., Ltd

title: Encapsulated negative magnetic device
abstract: An encapsulated negative magnetic device comprises an encapsulation body and a plurality of first magnetic elements. The encapsulation body is made of a flexible material, and it has an S-pole corresponding surface and an N-pole corresponding surface. The first magnetic elements are encapsulated in the encapsulation body, and each of the first magnetic elements has a first S-pole surface and a first N-pole surface. The first S-pole surfaces are located on the same side of the S-pole corresponding surface, and the first N-pole surfaces are located on the same side of the N-pole corresponding surface. Accordingly, the S-pole corresponding surface is attached to human skin, especially the affected part, so that the negative magnetic effect of the first magnetic elements inside it can provide the affected part with the effects of restoring, alkalizing, relaxing, calming, and resisting pressure.

title: Adeno-associated virus compositions for the treatment of facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy
abstract: The present invention provides novel gene therapy compositions for use in treatment of facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD).

title: Pre-charger circuit of memory device and methods for operating the same
abstract: A memory circuit includes a plurality of first memory cells. The plurality of first memory cells are operatively coupled to a first bit line. The memory circuit further includes a first pre-charge circuit connected to a first end of the first bit line and configured to charge the first bit line to a supply voltage during a first time period prior to any of the first memory cells being accessed. The memory circuit further includes a second pre-charge circuit connected to a second end of the first bit line and also configured to charge the first bit line to the supply voltage during the first time period. The second pre-charge circuit is only activated during a second time period at a beginning of the first time period, while the first pre-charge circuit is activated during a whole of the first time period.

title: Dual antigen-targeting protein complex comprising antibody or antigen- binding fragment thereof and affibody
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a bispecific antigen-targeting protein complex comprising an antibody or an antigen-binding fragment thereof and an affibody. The bispecific antigen-targeting protein complex of the present disclosure, or a composition comprising the same, can effectively prevent or treat cancer.

title: Substrate structure and method for fabricating a substrate structure
abstract: A method for fabricating a substrate structure has: providing a stack structure having a first substrate, a plastically deformable superconductor layer, and a second substrate, the first substrate having a main surface with a topographic structure and the second substrate having a main surface facing the main surface of the first substrate, wherein the first substrate main surface has a structured superconductor metallization and the second substrate main surface has a structured superconductor metallization, wherein the plastically deformable superconductor layer extends between the structured superconductor metallization of the first substrate and the structured superconductor metallization of the second substrate, and—exerting pressure to the first and second substrates for compressing the plastically deformable superconductor layer between the structured superconductor metallizations of the first and second substrates to form a mechanical and electrical superconductor connection between the structured superconductor metallizations of the first and second substrates.
assignee: Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft Zur Foerderung Der Angewandten Forschung E.V.

title: Method of manufacturing display device and electronic device including display device
abstract: In a method of manufacturing a display device, a via insulating layer is formed on a base substrate. A preliminary pixel electrode including a metal layer that has a protrusion is formed on the via insulating layer. A photoresist layer covering the preliminary pixel electrode is formed on the via insulating layer. An upper portion of the photoresist layer is removed to expose an upper portion of the protrusion. The exposed upper portion of the protrusion may be etched to form a pixel electrode including the metal layer in which a height of the protrusion is reduced. A light-emitting portion is formed on the pixel electrode. A counter electrode is formed on the light-emitting portion.

title: Stacked memory devices
abstract: A stacked memory device includes a plurality of core dies stacked over a base die, and a power supply wire stacked over the plurality of core dies. Each of the plurality of core dies includes a core connection circuit including a core interconnection and a through via set, and an isolated connection circuit that is isolated from the core connection circuit and transmits a power supply voltage.

title: Material-conditioned cylindrical thermal flux regulation system with radially distributed conduction geometry
abstract: A portable temperature-controlled enclosure comprises a cylindrical housing, a payload chamber disposed within the cylindrical housing, and a cooling chamber thermally coupled to the payload chamber, wherein the cooling chamber comprises anodized aluminum having a hydrocarbon surface treatment comprising tetradecane. The portable temperature-controlled enclosure further comprises a thermoelectric module thermally coupled to a wall portion of the cooling chamber through a thermal interface material and a controlled-force mounting assembly configured to apply a mounting force to maintain thermal contact at the thermal interface material. The portable temperature-controlled enclosure further comprises a heat rejection assembly thermally coupled to a hot-side of the thermoelectric module, wherein the heat rejection assembly comprises a liquid-cooled cooling block defining internal coolant pathways and a pump configured to circulate a coolant through the internal coolant pathways.

title: Image coding method and apparatus therefor based on block partitioning
abstract: obtaining partition information through a bitstream, deriving partitioning structure of a coding block based on the partition information, deriving a current coding block based on the partitioning structure, and performing a decoding process for the current coding block, wherein the partition information indicates one of a plurality of partitioning candidates based on a block size.

title: Bypassing ike firewall for cloud-managed ipsec keys in sdwan fabric
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for effectuating overlay tunnels between software-defined wide area network (SD-WAN) end-point devices despite the use of IPSec passthrough in one or more network devices, such as modems or routers that exist between the end-point devices. In particular, the Internet Key Exchange (IKE) protocol can be allowed to progress until a modem/router is able to establish an IKE tunnel, after which overlay packets using cloud-managed keys can be allowed to pass through the modem/router. An overlay tunnel may then be established between the end-point devices, and the IKE tunnel can be taken down.

title: Net stand
abstract: A net stand is provided, including locking members, a fixed rod, leg tubes and support members. Specifically, two locking members are provided, which are disposed at two sides of the fixed rod. Each locking member includes a clamp seat; the clamp seat is hinged with the leg tubes on two opposing sides thereof respectively, and the leg tubes extend through both sides of the support members. The fixed rod extends through the clamp seats and have two ends secured to the support members respectively. Each support member includes a support body and a support head; the support body is configured to allow the leg tubes to pass through to achieve folding and unfolding; and the support head is configured to fix a keel supporting a net of the net stand. The technical problem to be solved by the present disclosure is to design a net stand easy to store.

title: Information processing apparatus and information processing method
abstract: An information processing apparatus according to an embodiment includes a control unit that sets the number of lines to be allocated to each call center for a plurality of call centers, based on a call content between an operator of each call center and a customer.

title: Satellite constellation forming system, mega-constellation business device, and ground facility
abstract: A satellite constellation forming system ( 100 ) forms a satellite constellation which is composed of a satellite group and in which the satellite group cooperatively provides a service. The satellite constellation has a plurality of orbital planes in each of which a plurality of satellites fly at the same nominal orbital altitude. A satellite constellation forming unit ( 110 ) continues providing the service while avoiding a collision between satellites by both or one of control of an orbital altitude and control of a passage timing of a satellite group flying in a region where the plurality of orbital planes intersect.

title: Drilling tool including a step drill bit
abstract: A step drill bit including a body with proximal and distal ends and a central bit axis. A wall surrounds the bit axis and extends from the proximal end to the distal end to define a hollow interior cavity through which the bit axis extends. The bit includes axially stacked, progressively sized steps including a first step at the proximal end and a terminal step at the distal end. The bit includes a flute extending from the proximal end to the distal end and defines a cutting edge. The bit includes a shank configured to couple to a power tool and extends from the body along the bit axis. The shank includes first and second ends, the first end being axially closer to the proximal end than the second end. The first and second ends are axially spaced from the hollow interior cavity relative to the bit axis.

title: Hard disk drive holding device, method for mounting a hard disk drive to the same, and method for disassembling a hard disk drive from the same
abstract: A hard disk drive holding device is adapted for holding a hard disk drive. The hard disk drive has a front face, a rear face opposite to the front face, two side faces, and two apertures formed respectively on the side faces. The hard disk drive holding device includes a support frame and a holding member. The support frame includes a front part adapted to abut against the front face, and two side arms connected respectively to two ends of the front part. The holding member is made of flexible material, and includes a connecting part, and two holding arms extending respectively from two ends of the connecting part and connected respectively to rear ends of the two side arms distal from the front part. Each of the holding arms has a projecting portion adapted to engage a respective one of the apertures.

title: Machine learning system
abstract: A machine learning system that evaluates reliability of a prediction result of a machine learning model includes: a machine learning model configured to execute a predetermined task on input data to extract an image feature value from a prediction result and the input data to generate a feature extraction result; a label generation unit configured to segment the feature extraction result into a plurality of segmented regions based on similarity of the image feature value of the input data to generate a generated label; and a determination unit configured to evaluate the machine learning model based on an overlap degree between the prediction result and the generated label. A label generation unit is configured to divide data input into a machine learning model for each neighboring region having a similar feature value and output a generated label.

title: Ensembling embedding models
abstract: Systems and methods for ensembling embeddings generated by multiple neural networks. In particular, the embeddings generated by the neural networks for a given data item are first aligned and then combined to generate a combined embedding of the given data item.

title: Smart light emitting diode system
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart LED system. According to one aspect of the disclosed invention, the smart LED system includes at least one lighting group including at least one smart lighting device, a controller configured to output a control command signal for controlling an operation of the lighting group, a communication Interface provided between the lighting group and the controller and configured to transmit and receive signals between the lighting group and the controller, and a power Interface connected to at least one of the lighting group, the controller, and the communication Interface and configured to supply power from a power supply. The communication Interface may include a transceiver provided between the lighting group and the controller, a first filter element provided between the transceiver and the controller to remove noise, and a second filter element provided between the transceiver and the lighting group to remove noise.

title: Method and plant for making a batch freezing unit and batch freezing unit obtained by such method
abstract: A method for making a batch freezing unit for containing liquid or semiliquid food products is provided. The method includes the steps of: providing a first hollow cylinder, extending along a main axis and having an outer side wall on which one grooved profile defining a continuous circuit is formed; providing a coupling member; arranging the coupling member circumferentially to, and outside, the first cylinder, so as to completely enclose the outer side wall of the first cylinder. The method includes also a step of carrying out a fully penetrating weld of an inner wall of the coupling member to the first cylinder at the grooved profile.

title: Switch device and method for operating a switch device
abstract: A switch device for controlling a flow of electric energy from an energy source to a load has conductor inputs connecting to the energy source, conductor outputs connecting to the load, and conductor current paths which electrically connect the conductor inputs to the conductor outputs in a bijective manner within the switch device. Switch elements arranged in the conductor current paths can switch a current flow through the outer conductor current path. Overvoltage limiting elements are connected in parallel to the switch elements, and a control unit actuates the switch elements. Short-circuiting switches can be actuated by the control unit to a current-conducting state, where they conductively connect the conductor outputs of the switch device a) to each other and/or b) to a ground conductor or a neutral conductor of the energy source.

title: Front part or rear part of a vehicle with at least two wheelhouse elements and at least one cross-member connecting the wheelhouse elements, and method for production
abstract: A front part or rear part of a vehicle with at least two wheelhouse elements and at least one cross-member connecting the wheelhouse elements, which form a main body made of a lightweight metal material. At least one reinforcement element, formed from an expanded metal or a metal blank, is embedded by casting in at least one wheelhouse element and/or in the cross-member. A method for producing such a front part or rear part is also provided.
assignee: Volkswagen Aktiengesellschaft; Man Truck & Bus Se

title: System and method for detecting and mitigating malicious network traffic
abstract: A system for detecting and mitigating anomalous network traffic is disclosed. The system receives traffic data with respect to a computing device and parses the traffic data to identify network attributes from the traffic data. The system generates baseline traffic data based on the network attributes, where the baseline traffic data indicates an expected pattern of network communication of the computing device. The system detects current traffic data with respect to the computing device. The system parses the current traffic data to identify network attributes of the current traffic data. The system determines whether the current traffic data deviates from the baseline traffic data by comparing the network attributes of the baseline with the counterpart network attributes of the current traffic data. If it is determined that the current traffic data deviates from the baseline traffic data, the system determines that the current traffic data is anomalous.

title: Non-oriented electrical steel sheet
abstract: A non-oriented electrical steel sheet has a chemical composition containing, in mass %, C: 0.0050% or less, Si: 2.0 to 5.0%, Mn: 2.0% or less, P: 0.20% or less, S: 0.0050% or less, Al: 2.0% or less, N: 0.0050% or less, Ti: 0.0030% or less, Nb: 0.0010% or less, V: 0.0050% or less, and O: 0.0050% or less, wherein when an alternating-current magnetic field is applied so as to achieve a frequency of 50 Hz and a maximum magnetic flux density B m  of 1.5 T in a rolling direction ( RD ), a sheet width direction ( TD ), and a direction ( DD ) forming an angle of 45° with the rolling direction, in a rolling plane of the steel sheet, and zero-peak values of resulting magnetostrictions in directions parallel to the respective magnetic field directions are represented as λ //H   RD , λ //H   TD , and λ //H   DD , respectively, a magnetostriction in-plane average value λ //H   ave  is 1.0×10 −5  or smaller.

title: Thermochromic paint
abstract: A thermochromic paint for a component. The thermochromic paint comprises: 20 to 40 wt. % of two of more metal oxides selected from aluminium oxide, cobalt oxide, iron oxide, nickel oxide, titanium oxide, and zirconium oxide; 10 to 40 wt. % of an acrylic resin, 5 to 30 wt. % a silicone resin; and 15 to 40 wt. % of a propanol-based solvent.

title: Vehicle energy storage module with independently configurable voltage and capacity
abstract: A modular and scalable energy storage module wherein the energy capacity and voltages outputs are configured to be adjusted independent of one other.

title: Management apparatus, energy storage apparatus and voltage simulation method
abstract: A management apparatus  130  that periodically executes voltage simulation for an energy storage apparatus  50  includes: an arithmetic portion  131 ; and a storage portion  132 . The storage portion  132  stores a discharge pattern P made of time series data for discharge current. The discharge pattern P includes first time series data D 1  and second time series data D 2  for the discharge current, the first time series data D 1  is time series data for the discharge current, for a predetermined time, and the second time series data D 2  is time series data for the discharge current, within a voltage simulation execution period for the energy storage apparatus. The arithmetic portion  131  periodically executes voltage simulation for estimating a voltage change of the energy storage apparatus  50  when the energy storage apparatus discharges in the discharge pattern P, and periodically judges whether the energy storage apparatus can discharge in the discharge pattern P, based on a result of the voltage simulation.

title: Cryogenic fluid cooling and storage device, recuperation device, and related systems and methods
abstract: Cryogenic fluid cooling systems and methods for ablation procedures, including systems having at least one cooling container having a cryogenic fluid cooling unit and an interface detachably coupleable with an ablation device, wherein the cooling container is configured to cool the cryogenic fluid into a liquid state and wherein the system is configured to urge the cryogenic fluid via vapor pressure accumulation from the cooling container into the ablation device when the ablation device is coupled to the interface.

title: Method for modelling an anatomical structure of the human body
abstract: A method for modeling an anatomical structure of the human body in three dimensions that is computer-implemented and that includes the following steps: obtaining a plurality of consecutive images of the anatomical structure using a device for capturing images that is in movement and that bears a light source, identifying anatomical sub-structures of the anatomical structure in the obtained images, carrying out three-dimensional modeling of the anatomical structure based on the obtained images, and comparing the three-dimensional shape of the anatomical sub-structures of the obtained images with models of anatomical sub-structures stored in a database, wherein the step carrying out three-dimensional modeling of the anatomical structure is based on the obtained images comprising predicting the depth of the anatomical structure and predicting the movement of the image-capturing device.
assignee: Université Brest Bretagne Occidentale; Institut National de la Santé et de la Recherche Médicale

title: Allogeneic and xenogeneic subcutaneous adipose tissue and methods for preserving same
abstract: Disclosed herein are embodiments of a processed allogeneic and xenogeneic subcutaneous adipose tissue for reconstruction and cosmetic surgeries and method for preparing allogeneic and xenogeneic subcutaneous adipose tissue for reconstruction and cosmetic surgeries. The preservation method can include the subcutaneous adipose tissue being subjected to a set of physiochemical treatments to prohibit host immunogenic response upon transplantation/implantation.

title: Multi-modal orchestration system for human-animal-robot collaborative task execution
abstract: Disclosed embodiments provide a multi-modal orchestration system that enables coordinated adaptive, context-aware task execution between humans, animals, and robotic agents by leveraging advanced neurosymbolic AI, multi-modal sensor fusion, and reinforcement learning techniques. The system integrates SLAM-based environmental mapping, point cloud processing, and dynamic sensor networks to maintain real-time awareness of all agent positions, movement patterns, and behavior states. The system can utilize learned patterns of leadership and followership (derived from natural systems like octopus-fish hunting groups) to optimize collaborative behaviors, while continuously adapting to changing environmental conditions through a sensor fusion pipeline.

title: Cooking apparatus and method of controlling the same
abstract: A cooking apparatus is provided. The cooking apparatus includes a cooking module configured to perform a cooking operation by heating an object to be heated, a communication module configured to communicate with a user terminal, and at least one processor configured to control the cooking module to perform the cooking operation based on a control command received from the user terminal, and control the cooking module to stop the cooking operation in response to disconnection of communication with the user terminal.

title: Ink replenishment system
abstract: An ink replenishment system includes an ink replenishment container and a printer. The printer includes an ink inlet portion at a tip end of the ink introduction member, the printer includes a sealing cap mounted from a tip end side of the ink introduction member, the sealing cap includes a first seal portion that seals the ink introduction member from an outside of the printer at a first seal position, the ink outlet portion of the ink replenishment container includes a second seal portion that seals the ink introduction member from the outside at a second seal position of the ink introduction member, and a first sealing region from the tip end of the ink introduction member to the first seal position includes a second sealing region from the tip end of the ink introduction member to the second seal position.

title: Apparatus and method for cutting strips of insulation from panels
abstract: An apparatus for cutting panels of substantially rigid insulation into strips of selected widths includes a guide configured to engage an edge of a panel of substantially rigid insulation. The apparatus includes at least one saw blade spaced from the guide a selected distance corresponding to a selected width of the strips. The apparatus includes a shroud positioned about the at least saw blade wherein the shroud includes an entrance for the sheet of substantially rigid insulation and an exit for the strips of insulation, wherein the shroud comprises a port configured to couple to a hose such that a vacuum can be utilized to remove airborne particulate from within the shroud as the at least one saw blade cuts the insulation.

title: Laminate and method for manufacturing laminate
abstract: To achieve both the protection of an optical functional layer having a convex surface and the suppression of a decrease in function of the optical functional layer, provided is a laminate including: an optical functional layer including a first main surface and a second main surface facing each other, the first main surface having protrusions formed thereon; and a low-refractive index layer formed on the first main surface side of the optical functional layer, the low-refractive index layer having a refractive index of 1.30 or less, wherein the laminate has voids formed between the optical functional layer and the low-refractive index layer.

title: Telescoping boom assembly
abstract: A telescoping boom assembly for use with a vehicle comprises an outer tube, a central tube slidably disposed within the outer tube, an inner tube slidably disposed within the central tube, a linear actuator, and a coupling mechanism. The linear actuator has a housing coupled to the proximal end of the outer tube and positioned between the central tube and the inner tube. The linear actuator further has a movable output element coupled to a distal end of the central tube and configured to move the central tube relative to the outer tube. The coupling mechanism operatively connects the central tube to the inner tube and is configured to move the inner tube relative to the central tube in response to movement of the central tube relative to the outer tube.

title: Information processing system, non-transitory computer readable medium storing program, and information processing method
abstract: An information processing system includes a processor mounted on an image forming apparatus using an operation screen that is formed by display of content and enables selection of plural functions, in which the processor is configured to specify, in a case where an acquisition request of the content is received in a case of the content being shared with an information processing apparatus, a transmission source of the acquisition request, and perform processing such that a function other than a function that is executable by the image forming apparatus or the information processing apparatus, serving as a display device that acquires and displays the content, is not selectable in the content to be transmitted to the transmission source of the acquisition request.

title: Ozone supply system and ozone supply method
abstract: An ozone supply system includes an adsorption column in which an adsorption step of adsorbing ozone to an adsorbent and a desorption step of desorbing ozone from the adsorbent are repeated alternately, wherein, in the adsorption step, oxygen gas not adsorbed to the adsorbent is led out from the adsorption column and circulated to the ozone generator, and, in the desorption step, a first carrier gas is introduced from a first supply section into the adsorption column, ozone taken along with the first carrier gas is led to outside of the adsorption column, and the inside of the adsorption column is depressurized to a pressure lower than atmospheric pressure.

title: Printing module and 3d printer
abstract: A printing module, for a 3D printer, includes a printing head mechanism. The printing head mechanism includes: a heat dissipation component; a heating component, disposed at intervals from the heat dissipation component along a first direction; a throat pipe component that successively penetrates through the heat dissipation component and the heating component along the first direction; and an elastic component that is rotatable relative to the heat dissipation component. The elastic component is configured to selectively clamp at least one of the heat dissipation component and the throat pipe component. Alternatively, the elastic component is configured to selectively release at least one of the heat dissipation component and the throat pipe component.

title: Led lighting strip
abstract: A light-emitting diode (LED) lighting strip includes conductive lines and LED modules. The LED module includes LED lighting beads electrically connected with the conductive lines and arranged orderly on the conductive lines to form a strip. One of the conductive lines is a communication conductive line, and the remaining three are power-supplying conductive lines. On the communication conductive line, the LED lighting beads are connected in series. On the power-supplying conductive lines, the LED modules are connected in parallel, and the LED lighting beads of each LED module are connected in series. The LED lighting strip adopts an arrangement of serial-parallel connection for power and serial connection for signal to achieve various application solutions for different power supply voltages, and as a consequence, a serial communication protocol is adopted to control each of the LED lighting beads of the LED lighting strip, in order to realize diversification of lighting effect.

title: Memory management method and apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract: A memory management method includes: identifying that a directive exists in a compilation object; and performing compiler instrumentation on the compilation object to obtain target code. The directive is used to modify a memory variable, to represent that the modified memory variable is a target variable for which multi-modular redundancy memory needs to be applied for. When being run, executable code corresponding to the target code is at least used to apply for N pieces of memory corresponding to the target variable. N≥2. N is an integer.

title: Wound therapy system with blockage and leak detection
abstract: A wound therapy system includes a single conduit fluidly connecting a wound site to a removed fluid canister. A negative pressure circuit is defined by the wound site, the conduit, the removed fluid canister and tubing extending between the removed fluid canister and a pneumatic pump that applies negative pressure to the negative pressure circuit. A method of operating the wound therapy system includes profiling and benchmarking pressure decay within the negative pressure circuit against previous and/or expected pressure decay to identify any new or sudden anomalies that occur during the operation of the wound therapy system. The wound therapy system may additionally alert a user to such anomalous operation of the wound therapy system and/or identify and alert a user to an underlying cause (e.g. blockage and/or leak, etc.) that is responsible for the anomalous readings.

title: Sole and article of footwear having a braking cleat
abstract: An article of footwear including a sole. The sole may include heel cleats positioned in a rearfoot area of the sole, forefoot cleats positioned in a forefoot area of the sole, and a recessed cleat. The recessed cleat may be positioned forward of the heel cleats and rearward of the forefoot cleats. The recessed cleat may be positioned closer to the heel cleats than to the forefoot cleats, and the recessed cleat does not project as far away from the sole as its most closely-adjacent heel cleat. The recessed cleat may have a lateral width greater than a lateral width of any of the heel cleats.

title: Refrigerator
abstract: A refrigerator includes a storage compartment formed inside a main body, a thermoelectric element configured to cool the storage compartment, a heat sink in contact with the thermoelectric element, the heat sink including a sink base and a plurality of fins protruding from one surface of the sink base, and a temperature sensor configured to measure a temperature of the heat sink, the temperature sensor including a sensor member and a wire. The heat sink includes a sensor receiving groove recessed in the one surface of the sink base, and the sensor member is received in the sensor receiving groove.

title: Electrical wiring devices with screwless wire terminals
abstract: Electrical wiring devices that incorporate screwless wire terminal connections are described. The electrical wiring devices include for example, single and duplex blade-type electrical receptacles, blade-type locking electrical receptacles, single or multi-pole electrical switches, combination switches and blade-type receptacles, blade-type plugs for electrical cords, blade-type connectors for electrical cords, male and female inlet connectors and pin-in-sleeve connectors. The electrical wiring devices include a plurality of contact assemblies having a horizontally moving or rotating activating member that permits wires to be inserted into or removed from the contact assemblies.

title: Driving circuit, driving method, and display device
abstract: A driving circuit, a driving method and a display device are provided, which relate to the field of display technology. The driving circuit is used to drive a source driving circuit, and the driving circuit includes: a power switching sub-circuit, electrically connected to a touch power terminal and a display power terminal, where the power switching sub-circuit is configured to output a touch power signal from the touch power terminal or a display power signal from the display power terminal based on a signal output state of the touch power terminal and a signal output state of the display power terminal; and a power control sub-circuit, electrically connected to the power switching sub-circuit and the source driving circuit, where the power control sub-circuit is configured to output a source power signal to the source driving circuit under the drive of the touch power signal or the display power signal.
assignee: Chongqing Boe Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.; Boe Technology Group Co., Ltd.

title: Multi-Tier Management Architecture with Hardware Abstraction for UALink Networks
abstract: In an Ultra Accelerator Link (UALink)-based network, a centralized controller communicates with a first management agent associated with a switch platform via a first management protocol and with a second management agent associated with a system node via a second management protocol different from the first management protocol. The first management agent communicates with switches via a hardware abstraction interface. The centralized controller transmits configuration to, and receives operational state from, the management agents via the respective management protocols. In some implementations, a management agent presents a resource tree describing accelerators and their ports using identifiers, wherein the resource tree remains stable across disconnections, restarts, or configuration changes, enabling the centralized controller to resume management operations upon reconnection using the same identifiers.

title: Systems and methods for efficient binding support function discovery in a wireless network
abstract: A device described herein may maintain one or more policies associated with a particular User Equipment (“UE”); provide, based on maintaining the one or more policies associated with the particular UE and to a Binding Support Function (“BSF”) of a wireless network, an indication associating the device with the particular UE; and provide, to a Unified Data Repository (“UDR”) of the wireless network, an association between the particular UE and the BSF, wherein the UDR provides information associating the particular UE and the BSF to one or more Network Functions (“NFs”) of the wireless network. The device may include a Policy Control Function (“PCF”) of the wireless network. The BSF may be a particular BSF instance out of a set of BSF instances implemented by the wireless network. The BSF may maintain information indicating that the device maintains one or more policies associated with the particular UE.

title: Use of a paper substrate, the barrier-coated paper substrate, a laminated packaging material and packaging container comprising it
abstract: The present invention relates to the use of a paper substrate made from cellulose fibres, for a gas-barrier material in a laminated packaging material for packaging of oxygen sensitive products, and further to coated such paper substrates for increased gas barrier properties. The invention further relates to laminated packaging materials comprising the paper substrates or barrier coated paper substrates, and to packaging containers comprising the laminated packaging material, for packaging of oxygen-sensitive products, such as food products.
