title: Punching machine with replaceable punching core
abstract: A punching machine with a replaceable punching core, including a mounting base, a replaceable punching core, a control handle. The mounting base is configured to carry a sheet material to be punched. The replaceable punching core is detachably mounted on the mounting base, and the replaceable punching core comprises a punching assembly. The control handle is rotatably connected to the mounting base and configured to drive the punching assembly of the replaceable punching core downward, thereby performing a punching operation on the sheet material carried on the mounting base.

title: Detachable cpo connector and associated methods
abstract: Some embodiments of the present disclosure are directed to a detachable connector for a co-packaged optics (CPO) device. The detachable connector may include a kinematic mount, where the kinematic mount includes a first kinematic interface configured to engage a corresponding kinematic interface of the CPO device. In some embodiments, the kinematic mount is configured for repeated detachment and attachment with substantially identical alignment between the detachable connector and the CPO device within a predetermined sub-micron tolerance. Furthermore, in an attached state, the kinematic mount may be configured to provide an optical transmission path between the CPO device and the detachable connector, where a transmission loss along the optical transmission path remains within a predetermined threshold tolerance.

title: Bacteria-responsive particles, methods for preparation, and use in packaging or on surfaces
abstract: Bacteria-responsive particles and a platform for product packaging or for incorporating on surfaces are described, together with uses thereof and methods of preparation. The particles, such as liposomes or lipid nanoparticles, provide a bacteria-responsive platform for release of an agent, which may be antimicrobial, only in the presence of the target bacteria upon release of virulence factors referred to as cholesterol-dependent cytolysins (CDCs) by the bacteria. Common bacteria involved in food poisoning, such as  bacillus, Clostridium, listeria , and  streptococcus , produce CDCs and can be targeted with the particles described. The particles are cholesterol-rich, and comprise surface-exposed cholesterol. The releasable agent is encapsulated within the particles. Interaction of the surface-exposed cholesterol with the CDC released from the target bacteria causes particle porosity and release of the agent encapsulated within the particles, permitting the agent to take effect, such as to deter the target bacteria or indicate its presence.
assignee: Emmanuel Abraham Ho; Chuying FENG; Ethan Joseph WATT

title: Cooling element
abstract: According to an example aspect of the present invention, there is provided a cooling element comprising a profile comprising a fitting end, a sleeve having a leading edge and a trailing edge, wherein an inner diameter of the sleeve is greater at the leading edge than at the trailing edge, and a base comprising a collar defining an aperture, wherein the fitting end of the profile is arranged around the collar, and the sleeve is arranged around the fitting end of the profile and apply radial force thereto.

title: Reverse positioning of access points using multi-technology measurements
abstract: Techniques are provided for positioning wireless devices such as access points and other wireless nodes. An example method for determining a location of an access point includes obtaining positioning measurement results based on radio frequency signals transmitted or received between the access point and a plurality of wireless nodes, obtaining a location estimate for each of the plurality of wireless nodes, determining quality metrics associated with the positioning measurement results, selecting a subset of the positioning measurement results based at least in part on the quality metrics associated with the positioning measurement results, and determining the location of the access point based on the subset of the positioning measurement results and the location estimates for the plurality of wireless nodes associated with the subset of the positioning measurement results.

title: Controlling a joint in a robotic arm
abstract: A controller for controlling the configuration of a joint in a surgical robot, the joint being driven by a drivetrain which transfers power from a drive source to the joint, the controller being configured to receive a drive source configuration signal indicating a configuration of the drive source and receive a joint configuration signal indicating a configuration of the joint. The controller being configured tot determine a configuration error from a difference in configurations indicated by the drive source configuration signal and the joint configuration signal and determine a configuration error limit from a measured joint torque of the joint and a joint stiffness of the joint. The controller being configured to compare the determined configuration error and the determined configuration error limit and output a fault signal where the determined configuration error equals or exceeds the determined configuration error limit.

title: System and Method of Data Verification
abstract: This application is directed to user authentication and data verification. A computing system executes a data verification application for verifying user data of an individual user on behalf of an origin entity in response to a request received from a requester account. The request includes payload data and a payload digital signature, and the payload data further includes the user data and a first digital signature. A requester public key associated with the requester account is extracted from a database and used to decrypt the payload digital signature and verify the payload data and the requester account. Upon verification, a first origin entity is identified based on the payload data, and an origin public key is extracted and used to decrypt the first digital signature and further verify whether the user data as received via the first requester account are issued by the origin entity.

title: System and method for authenticating digital media integrity using backend microdata analysis
abstract: A system and method that authenticates the integrity of digital images and videos by analyzing backend microdata to detect alterations, filters, or AI-generated manipulations. This system provides a comparison of the original and modified states of digital media, assess the authenticity of the content, and confirm the identity of depicted subjects, providing a critical tool against misinformation and unauthorized media manipulation.

title: Semiconductor Device With An Embedded Active Device
abstract: A semiconductor device includes one or more active devices disposed between a processor die and a package substrate. The semiconductor device includes a first layer with a processor die, a second layer with one or more active devices, and a third layer with a package substrate, where the second layer is disposed between the first and third layers. The one or more active devices are semiconductor-based devices, such as voltage regulators, that participate in supplying power to the processor die and are electrically connected to the processor die using various connection configurations. The implementations use short path lengths for improved performance with a compact structure that avoids the use of edge wiring or interposers without occupying processor die space. Implementations include the use of through-silicon vias (TSVs) to provide short path lengths while reducing the number of connection resources used by the one or more power components.

title: Intelligent Labeling and Automatic Sorting Apparatus
abstract: An intelligent labeling and automatic sorting apparatus is disclosed, comprising a conveyor, sensors, barcode scanners, a labeling module, a printing module, a control system, and a sorting mechanism. The apparatus detects parcel size, orientation, and position using light curtains and vision sensors, enabling accurate label placement. The first vision sensor verifies the label and identifies the courier company to direct parcels to the correct chute. Labeling anomalies are automatically sorted into a designated area for review. The system supports real-time adjustment of labeling and sorting parameters via a human-machine interface, ensuring operational flexibility in warehousing and logistics environments.

title: Identification method, identification device, and non-transitory computer readable recording medium
abstract: An identification device acquires connection relationship information indicating a mechanical connection relationship between a plurality of servo motors and a connection mechanism, acquires an abnormality degree of each of the plurality of servo motors, identifies a location of abnormality from among the plurality of servo motors and the connection mechanism based on the abnormality degree of each of the plurality of servo motors and the connection relationship information, and displays the location of abnormality on a display.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: Composite structure comprising a monocrystalline thin film on a polycrystalline silicon carbide support substrate, and associated manufacturing method
abstract:
A composite structure for manufacturing microelectronic components comprises a monocrystalline thin film disposed on a support substrate of polycrystalline silicon carbide, the support substrate having a preferred crystalline orientation, in which:
         a C422 texture coefficient is less than 30%; and   a C220 texture coefficient is greater than 60% or the sum of the C111+C222+C511 texture coefficients is greater than 70%.       

     A method is used for manufacturing such a composite structure.

title: Enhanced encryption for face-related data
abstract: A method includes obtaining a plurality of representative vectors associated with face-related data. The method includes determining an encryption key based on a parameter stored in a record, generating an encrypted vector set by, for each respective vector of the plurality of representative vectors, encrypting the respective vector with a homomorphic encryption operation based on the encryption key, where the encrypted vector set includes a first encrypted vector that is linked to a subset of the face-related data associated with the first plurality of face vectors. The method further includes obtaining an encrypted face search vector using the encryption key to perform homomorphic encryption. The method further includes selecting a first encrypted vector based on the encrypted face search vector and retrieving the subset of the face-related data based on the first encrypted vector.

title: Artificial intelligence device for group-equivariant quantum neural functionals for density functional theory simulation and method thereof
abstract: A method for controlling an artificial intelligence (AI) device can include generating a real-space electron density for a target system, encoding a representation of the real-space electron density into a multi-qubit quantum state, processing the multi-qubit quantum state using a parameterized quantum circuit, in which the parameterized quantum circuit includes a quantum neural network configured to be equivariant to an orthogonal group O(3) or finite subgroups of the orthogonal group O(3), measuring an output of the parameterized quantum circuit to obtain spatial weighting coefficients, calculating an exchange-correlation (XC) energy contribution by combining the spatial weighting coefficients with one or more of analytical primitive energy-density terms, and outputting the exchange-correlation (XC) energy contribution.

title: Information processing apparatus
abstract: An information processing apparatus of the present disclosure includes a prediction unit that predicts a region in another prediction target captured image different from a predetermined prediction target captured image based on information output from a model by inputting information based on a plurality of the prediction target captured image obtained by capturing a prediction target and document information including findings for the predetermined prediction target captured image to the model. The model is machine-learned by using a pair of a first captured image obtained by capturing a predetermined target and first document information including a finding for the first captured image, and a pair of a second captured image obtained by capturing the predetermined target at different timings and first document information. The information processing apparatus of the present disclosure can support decision making of a doctor on medical diagnosis, for example.

title: Secondary battery and electric apparatus
abstract: A secondary battery and an electric apparatus are provided. The secondary battery includes a composite separator and an electrolyte. The composite separator includes a base film and a functional resin layer provided on a surface of the base film. The functional resin layer includes a functional polymer. The functional polymer contains an iminodiacetate group. A cation of the iminodiacetate group include at least one of Li + , Na + , and K + . At 25° C., a conductivity of the electrolyte is greater than or equal to 5 mS/cm.

title: Cardiac implant device
abstract: Provided in the present disclosure is a cardiac implant device. The cardiac implant device comprises: a fixation member, which has a collapsed state in which the fixation member can pass through a created opening in the atrial septum, and an expanded state in which a pair of securing portions formed on two sides of the atrial septum and clamp the atrial septum secure the fixation member to the atrial septum; and a shunt member, which is configured for attaching to the fixation member and passing through the created opening, and is configured to define a shunt channel that passes through the created opening and is in communication with the left atrium and the right atrium of a patient. The fixation member can be reliably secured to the atrial septum, and thus the shunt member attached to the fixation member can be reliably secured to the atrial septum. In addition, since the fixation member has a collapsed state in which the fixation member can pass through the created opening in the atrial septum, during a delivery process, the fixation member can be kept in the collapsed state, so that the fixation member can smoothly pass through a narrow portion in a delivery path and partially pass through the created opening, thereby making the implant process of the shunt member easier.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device including a housing, first and second buttons, first and second circuit boards, an antenna, and a device circuit board. The antenna includes a radiator and a feeding portion, both integrally formed with the housing and fastened together. The buttons, circuit boards, and feeding portion are disposed inside the housing. In a first direction, the first and second circuit boards respectively connect the first and second buttons to the device circuit board. In a perpendicular second direction, the feeding portion is disposed between the spaced-apart first and second buttons, electrically connected to the device circuit board, and spaced apart from both the first and second circuit boards. The antenna does not need to be fitted, and has a strong radiation intensity.

title: Hydrogen aircraft
abstract: A hydrogen aircraft including an engine that generates flight thrust; a fuel tank storing hydrogen fuel in a liquid phase; a fuel supply passage connecting the fuel tank to the engine; a pump that is located in the fuel supply passage and pressurizes the hydrogen fuel from the fuel tank toward the engine; a control valve located downstream of the pump in the fuel supply passage; an auxiliary supply passage communicating with a portion of the fuel supply passage which is located between the pump and the control valve; and a hydrogen consumer connected to the auxiliary supply passage.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: According to an embodiment, a semiconductor device includes a first semiconductor chip and a second semiconductor chip. The first semiconductor chip and the second semiconductor chip each have a first electrode and a second electrode. The first electrode of the first semiconductor chip and the first electrode of the second semiconductor chip face each other and are arranged with a conductive connector sandwiched therebetween. The second electrodes are electrically connected to external electrodes externally exposed and spaced apart from each other.
assignee: Kabushiki Kaisha Toshiba; Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation

title: Series addressing scheme for smart power stages of high current applications
abstract: A semiconductor system includes a plurality of power drivers, a voltage source and a reference potential, and an address signal line electrically coupling the plurality of power driver devices between the voltage source and the reference potential being lower than the voltage source,. Each power driver device is configured to: receive an address-related analog voltage from the address signal line; and derive an address of the power driver device based at least in part on the received analog voltage. The address signal line passes through the plurality of power driver devices.

title: Door body assembly and refrigeration device
abstract: A door body assembly for a refrigeration device includes an enclosure door rotatably connected to an enclosure body to open or close a storage space, a door panel slidably disposed on an outer side of the enclosure door, and a driving sliding door mechanism mounted on the enclosure door. The driving sliding door mechanism is connected to both the enclosure door and the door panel and is configured to drive the door panel to move in the width direction of the enclosure door as the enclosure door is rotated relative to the enclosure body. The door panel is thereby able to slide laterally during the opening or closing process, reducing potential interference with nearby obstacles during operation.
assignee: Hefei Midea Refrigerator Co., Ltd.; Hefei Hualing Co., Ltd.; Midea Group Co., Ltd.

title: Cell tissue culture and transport container
abstract: The invention relates to a cell tissue culture and transport canister comprising: a canister body having an accessible interior and an upper opening; a filter arranged inside the canister body or outside the canister and placing the interior of the canister body in communication with an exterior of the canister body, the filter being configured to allow a gas exchange between the interior and the exterior of the canister body, while preventing contamination of the cell tissue culture; a closure means closing the upper opening of the canister body, the closure means being sealed or slightly permeable with respect to fluids and gases; and at least one aseptic fluid connection through the canister body, the at least one aseptic fluid connection including two fluid inlet connections and one fluid outlet connection.

title: Nano-perforator having improved anti-viral activity
abstract: The present invention relates to improvement in the prevention and treatment of viral infectious diseases through the structural modification or improvement of a nano-perforator. According to the present invention, a nano-perforator, having modified structure, area, shape and membrane scaffold protein characteristics, has improved thermal stability and has maximized anti-viral activity through an increase in the efficiency of perforation activity, an increase in the stability of nano-perforator and the provision of virus specificity, and thus can be usable as a pharmaceutical composition for preventing or treating viral infectious diseases.

title: Steric-suspension-stabilized cosmetic dispersion
abstract: A composition, in particular a cosmetic composition, in the form of a dispersion comprising a dispersed phase in the form of capsules and a continuous aqueous phase, wherein: the capsules represent a volume fraction of between 50% and 70% relative to the total volume of the composition; the capsules comprise a shell and a core comprising at least one fatty phase comprising at least one active agent; the capsules comprise an Ri/Rc ratio of between 0.5 and 0.8, preferably between 0.6 and 0.8, and better still between 0.6 and 0.7, wherein: Ri corresponds to the radius of the core of the capsules; and Rc corresponds to the radius of the capsule.

title: Flexible cutting blade for grass trimmers and rotary mowers
abstract: A cutting blade for a rotating trimmer includes a loading section at a proximal end securable to the rotating trimmer, a flexible hinge section extending from the loading section, and a transition section extending from the flexible hinge section. A cutting section extends from the transition section to a distal end. The transition section and the cutting section are tapered at a taper angle toward the distal end. In some variations, a mass of the transition section is greater than a mass of the cutting section, and a center of gravity based on a mass of the cutting blade may be positioned closer to the loading section than the cutting section.

title: Power sources and transmission networks for auxiliary equipment onboard hydraulic fracturing units and associated methods
abstract: Embodiments of systems and methods disclosed provide a hydraulic fracturing unit that includes a reciprocating plunger pump configured to pump a fracturing fluid and a powertrain configured to power the reciprocating plunger pump. The powertrain includes a prime mover and a drivetrain, the prime mover including a gas turbine engine. The hydraulic fracturing unit also includes auxiliary equipment configured to support operation of the hydraulic fracturing unit including the reciprocating plunger pump and the powertrain. A power system is configured to power the auxiliary equipment. The power system includes a power source and a power network. The power source is configured to generate power for the auxiliary equipment. The power network is coupled to the power source and the auxiliary equipment, and configured to deliver the power generated by the power source to the auxiliary equipment. Associated systems including a plurality of hydraulic fracturing units are also provided.

title: Method for release for use of telematics services, mobile communication device and communication system for performing the method
abstract: Use of telematics services for a vehicle is released using at least one digital vehicle key and an executable app, which executes a telematics service, stored on a mobile communication device. Execution of the app by the mobile communication device causes a provided vehicle to be selected and authentication of the mobile communication device or the to be performed using the at least one digital vehicle key with a vehicle backend assigned to the vehicle. The vehicle backend determines whether the telematic services are released based on the at least one digital vehicle key.

title: Llm-driven iterative vulnerability validation for static code analysis
abstract: In one aspect, large language models (LLMs) are used to evaluate static application security testing (SAST) results from a SAST tool that is run on software under test. A software vulnerability report is then generated based on one or more outputs from the LLM(s), with the outputs indicating levels of confidence in the respective SAST results being actual positives. In this way, false positives from the SAST results can be eliminated or deprioritized, providing technological improvements in pre-deployment software testing and validation.

title: Secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is a secondary battery including: a case open on at least one of a first side or a second side and including an accommodating space formed therein; an electrode assembly accommodated in the accommodating space and including a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a separator disposed between the positive electrode and the negative electrode; and a cap assembly coupled to the case to seal the accommodating space, and including a positive electrode terminal electrically connected to the positive electrode, and a negative electrode terminal electrically connected to the negative electrode, wherein a vent hole is formed in the case or the cap assembly, and a vent, which is configured to rupture upon a pressure in the accommodating space exceeding a predetermined reference pressure, is coupled to the vent hole.

title: Website detection method and apparatus, and electronic device and readable medium
abstract: The present application discloses a website detection method, an apparatus, an electronic device, and a readable medium. The method includes: obtaining website information of a first website in response to a first file with a security protection attribute being sent out from a target browser on an office terminal to the first website; determining, based on the website information of the first website, whether the first website matches a pre-configured website audit strategy, and if the first website matching a pre-configured website, generating an audit result including the website information of the first website, where the audit result is used to indicate that, on the target browser, there exists a behavior with a security risk of sending out the target file with the security protection attribute to the first website.
assignee: Beijing Volcano Engine Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Imprint apparatus, imprint method, article manufacturing method, and non-transitory memory medium storing program
abstract: An imprint apparatus forms a pattern by bringing an imprint material on a partial field of a substrate and a pattern region of a mold into contact with each other and curing the imprint material. The imprint apparatus includes an adjuster configured to adjust a relative position between the substrate and the mold, and a controller configured to control the adjuster so as to bring the imprint material and the pattern region into contact with each other in a state in which the partial field has an offset in an inside direction of the substrate with respect to the pattern region, and then perform alignment between the pattern region and the partial field.

title: Systems and methods for synchronizing workout equipment with video files
abstract: A method for synchronizing exercise equipment with workout video files to reduce latency may include executing a workout video file to display a workout video on a display; retrieving a configuration change command and a configuration change criterion from the workout video file; generating a message comprising the configuration change command and the configuration change criterion; and transmitting, over a communications network, the message to the workout device. The workout device may aggregate the configuration change command and the configuration change criterion into a queue of one or more configuration change commands that is stored in a memory of the workout device; and change operation according to the configuration change command in response to determining the configuration change criterion is satisfied.

title: Surgical instruments with compliant mechanism design
abstract: A surgical instrument includes a first member selectably and removably coupled together with a second member. The first member has an elongated track member having a first handle extending from a proximal end and a first jaw at a distal end. A first biasing member is integrally formed with a bottom end of the first handle. A track extends longitudinally along a length of the elongated track member. The second member has an elongated slide having a second handle extending from a proximal end and a second jaw at a distal end. A second biasing member is integrally formed with a bottom end of the second handle. When coupled together, a top end of the first biasing member and a top end of the second biasing engage each other to bias the first handle and the second handle away from each other.

title: Mechanical energy generation system for sustainable clean energy
abstract: A rotational energy platform may include a rotating assembly comprising a central shaft, one or more vertical airfoils, and one or more horizontal wings. The vertical airfoils may be mounted on radial arms and may be oriented to generate a tangential force that produces torque about the central shaft as the rotating assembly rotates through a fluid. The horizontal wings may be mounted to the rotating assembly and may be configured to generate an axial force along the central shaft. The horizontal wings may be configured as axial-load compensating wings with a positive angle of attack to generate an upward lift force that counteracts a weight of the rotating assembly. Alternatively, the horizontal wings may be configured as downforce-generating wings with a negative angle of attack to generate a downward force. The platform may be configured for various applications, including energy generation, fluid pumping, and propulsion.

title: Systems and methods for vision-language model instruction tuning
abstract: Embodiments described herein provide a method of generating a vision-language task output for a text instruction relating to an input image, the method comprising receiving, via a data interface, the input image and the text instruction comprising an instruction relating to the image. The method further includes encoding, via an image encoder, the image into a first image representation. The method further includes adapting, by a multimodal encoder connected to the image encoder, the first image representation to generate a second image representation compatible with a neural network based language model. The method further includes generating, by the neural network based language model connected to the multimodal encoder, the vision-language task output in response to the text instruction based on an input combining the second image representation and the text instruction.

title: A mechanism system for fully and semi-automatic rifles
abstract: A high-strength mechanism system for fully and semi-automatic rifles which increases the axial and linear operating performance of fully and semi-automatic rifles and provides a long-lasting and high-strength structure. Strength problems, loss of linearity, excess number of parts and high production costs encountered in traditional rail mechanisms are eliminated with the mechanism system. While the mechanism system simplifies the production process by reducing the number of parts, it eliminates reliability problems, especially in long-term and intensive use scenarios. In addition, the assembly process of the rifle has been simplified, its lifespan has been extended and its performance level has been increased.
assignee: Retay Silah Otomotiv Insaat Ve Gida Sanayi Ve Ticaret Limited Sirketi

title: Method for Removing Hydrogen, for Completely Emptying a Liquid-Hydrogen Tank, and Use of Same
abstract: A method for removing hydrogen from a liquid-hydrogen tank having an integrated heating device for evaporating liquid hydrogen and having an emptying line for removing evaporated hydrogen. The method includes supplying heating power for removal of the evaporated hydrogen in order to maintain a tank pressure, detecting a temporal course of the heating power and/or of the tank pressure, and monitoring the temporal course for a sudden change in the heating power and/or a pressure gradient of the tank pressure.

title: System
abstract: A system includes a processor, wherein the processor is configured to control a sensor unit configured to acquire brain wave data from a plurality of electrodes worn on a scalp of a subject and to acquire the brain wave data in real time, analyze brain wave data of the subject by using a brain wave database collected from healthy persons and persons with disabilities, and execute a machine learning algorithm configured to identify an intended action of the subject based on the brain wave data, and control a robot unit including an exoskeleton device or a robotic arm worn on a body of the subject so as to assist a body movement of the subject based on an analysis result of the machine learning algorithm.

title: Phase calibration of radio-frequency fed antenna arrays
abstract: Various examples relate to phase calibration measurements for calibrating an access node.

title: Penetration-free heat transfer system
abstract: A heat transfer system. The heat transfer system has a barrier having a first side and a second side, the first side disposed on a hot side of the heat transfer system and the second side being disposed on the cold side of the heat transfer system. A first plurality of protrusions extends from the first side of the barrier, and a second plurality of protrusions extend from the second side of the barrier. A first heat pipe having a first plurality of flanges is joined on the first side of the barrier by fasteners engaging the first plurality of protrusions. A second heat pipe having a second plurality of flanges is joined to the second plurality of flanges being joined on the second side of the barrier by fasteners engaging the second plurality of protrusions.
assignee: Government Of The United States As Represented By The Secretary Of The Air Force

title: Resin composition, prepreg, film with resin, metal foil with resin, metal-clad laminate, and wiring board
abstract:
One aspect of the present invention is a resin composition containing a maleimide compound (A) having an indane structure represented by the following Formula (1) in a molecule, a benzoxazine compound (B) having an allyl group in a molecule, and a styrenic polymer (C) that is solid at 25° C. 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
     
     In Formula (1), Rb's each independently represent an alkyl group having 1 to 10 carbon atoms, an alkyloxy group having 1 to 10 carbon atoms, an alkylthio group having 1 to 10 carbon atoms, an aryl group having 6 to 10 carbon atoms, an aryloxy group having 6 to 10 carbon atoms, an arylthio group having 6 to 10 carbon atoms, a cycloalkyl group having 3 to 10 carbon atoms, a halogen atom, a nitro group, a hydroxyl group, or a mercapto group, and r represents 0 to 3.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: Method for Producing a Complex Sheet and a Display Panel Comprising the Complex Sheet
abstract: A complex sheet, a method for producing the complex sheet, and a display panel including the complex sheet is disclosed. The complex sheet reduces moisture penetration by forming a side cover that covers an opening included in an edge of a light refracting layer that is included in the complex sheet.

title: Preassembled weakly supervised machine learning
abstract: A computer-implemented method for generation of a machine learning model (e.g., a neural network) using weak supervision includes generating a labeling matrix of labeling function outputs by applying labeling functions to data features, and preassembling the labeling function outputs together with the data features for each data point to generate a training dataset. The machine learning model is trained using the training dataset. The method can be applied to a number of use cases including, but not limited to use cases in digital medicine and automated or personalized healthcare, AI-assisted drug development or vaccine development, material or composition development, smart factories, smart industry, smart districts, market segmentation, recommender systems, predictive maintenance and energy control, to optimize artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) predictions or to support decision making.

title: Weighted multicategory querying
abstract: A weighted multicategory querying (WMQ) tool generates alternates of an initial query through spelling correction, grammar correction, natural language processing, ambiguous term resolution, term normalization, keyword reordering, synonyms, and similar terms. The WMQ tool generates additional queries in different weighted categories such as keyword combination, query programming language (QPL), metadata, or embedding space. Query result individual topic proximity scores are combined with category weights to calculate a combined topic proximity score, which is employed to rank the query result. Embedding space query weight is increased for queries classified as broad. QPL query weight or metadata query weight is increased for queries which contain part or all of a metadata field name. Language models are leveraged for query generation, topic proximity scoring, or both.

title: Violence-reduction program diagnostics system and method
abstract: This invention relates to a method to measure the effectiveness of  violence-reduction programs, comprising enrolling a participant in a violence-reduction program, providing a survey instrument with one or more bipolar adjective pairs and behavioral/situational inquiries to the enrolled participant, obtaining responses to the bipolar adjective pairs inquiries, generating a weighted score based on the responses to the survey instrument, reporting the weighted score, and determining the effectiveness of the violence-reduction program.

title: Hybrid module for a hybrid drive train of a motor vehicle
abstract: A hybrid module ( 3 ) for a hybrid drivetrain ( 2 ) of a motor vehicle ( 1 ) includes a housing (4), an electric machine ( 6 ) arranged in an inside space ( 5 ) of the housing, and a power terminal ( 10 ) for supplying electricity to the electric machine ( 6 ). The housing ( 4 ) has a housing section ( 14 ) for the separation of the inside space ( 5 ) at the front. In this case, the housing section ( 14 ) defines at least one closeable cut-out ( 15 ) for the passage of at least one fastening means ( 16 ), which serves for the fitting of at least one current-carrying component ( 17 ) between the electric machine ( 6 ) and the power terminal ( 10 ) within the inside space ( 5 ).

title: Power tool having a multi-latch battery interface
abstract: This application relates to a cordless power tool system including a set of cordless power tools, a set of rechargeable and removable battery packs, and a set of battery pack chargers.

title: Systems and methods for endoluminal device treatment
abstract: Various concepts relate to treatment systems for medical devices delivered into patients in medical procedures. The treatment system may include a proximal valve configured to receive the endoluminal device, an optional distal valve configured to receive the endoluminal device, and a treatment chamber configured to receive a portion of the endoluminal device.

title: Circuit board and manufacturing method of circuit board
abstract: A circuit board includes an insulating layer having a via hole, a via filling the via hole, a circuit layer disposed on the insulating layer and including a pad connected to the via and a circuit wiring spaced apart from the pad, and a carbon pattern layer disposed between the circuit layer and a surface of the insulating layer.

title: Systems and methods for detecting and preventing damage to pipes
abstract: Systems and methods are described for detecting a leak based upon home telematics data. The method may include: (1) receiving home telematics data from one or more sensors associated with one or more pipes in a structure, wherein the home telematics data is indicative of a frequency with which the one or more pipes are being used; (2) determining, using a trained machine learning algorithm, that the one or more pipes are leaking based upon at least the frequency with which the one or more pipes are being used; (3) initiating one or more preventative actions based upon the determination that the one or more pipes are leaking; and (4) generating, based upon the home telematics data, a structure damage estimate indicative of (i) the determination that the one or more pipes are leaking and (ii) the one or more preventative actions.
assignee: State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company

title: Stormwater management crate assembly with tapered columns and side panels with column bearing components
abstract: Stormwater management systems, methods, and apparatuses for containing and filtering runoff are provided. Disclosed embodiments may include a top plate including a first plurality of side panel attachments and a bottom plate including a second plurality of side panel attachments. Embodiments may include a plurality of support column assemblies between the top plate and the bottom plate. Each support column assembly of the plurality of support column assemblies may include an upper portion and a lower portion and the upper portion and lower portion may be configured to connect at a mating connection. Embodiments may also include one or more side panels. Each of the one or more side panels may include one or more column bearing components. The one or more column bearing components may be configured to contact at least one support column assembly of the plurality of support column assemblies at one or more contact areas. The one or more contact areas may be located above or below the mating connection. Stormwater management crates may be arranged into an array and include side panels of variable heights. The array of stormwater management crates may be further wrapped in sediment impervious material and serve to restrict stormwater flow as part of a stormwater management system.

title: Surveying system
abstract: A surveying system comprises a height measuring device  1  and a high-low deviation measuring device  2 . The high-low deviation measuring device comprises a measurement target  18 , a moving vehicle  15 , and an unevenness measuring device  14  which is mounted on the moving vehicle, wherein a reference level measuring device constituted of the height measuring device and the measurement target detects a reference level. The high-low deviation measuring device comprises a distance measurement sensor which satisfies a predetermined relationship with measurement target and measures a distance to a construction surface, a projecting device  17  which projects high-low information onto a construction surface, and an arithmetic control module  21 , and wherein the arithmetic control module is configured to calculate the high-low information based on the reference level, distance information with respect to the construction surface measured by the distance measurement sensor, and a designed height of a construction finished surface.

title: Eddy current (ec) defect view and defect classification
abstract: A presentation can be generated and displayed indicative of an eddy current (EC) inspection result. For example, an amplitude value or a phase value associated with the eddy current measurement signal can be presented in a graphical manner, such by aligning an indicium of the amplitude value or the phase value with a shape representative of an object under test, the indicium corresponding to a location on or within the shape where the eddy current measurement signal was obtained. In another example, a visual attribute of a displayed indicium of an amplitude value or phase value can be assigned based on a class of defect, such as using different colors corresponding to different defect classes as defined by regions in an impedance plane. Use of attribute to identify defect can be performed either separately, or in combination with alignment of the indicium with the shape.

title: Mitigating interference between satellite and terrestrial cellular networks
abstract: Methods for mitigating interference between satellite networks and terrestrial cellular networks are provided. Interference may occur when a UE uses an extraterrestrial network when a terrestrial network is available. A method of mitigating interference between an extraterrestrial network and a terrestrial network begins with detecting, by an extraterrestrial access point, that at least one terrestrial access point located within a first geographical area is attempting to communicate with the extraterrestrial access point. The extraterrestrial access point then determines that the first geographical area is covered by at least one terrestrial network. The determining that the first geographical area is covered by at least one terrestrial network may use a dataset of terrestrial network access points. Once the first geographical area has been determined to be covered by at least one terrestrial network, the extraterrestrial access point ceases transmissions to the first geographical network.

title: Camera localization using random sampling of image features
abstract: A game server uses a foundation model to predict a pose for an image based on reference images. The game server receives an image from a client device and generates feature tokens using a feature encoder. The game server selects reference images based on an estimated pose associated with the received image and accesses feature tokens for the selected reference images. The game server selects a subset of feature tokens and applies a foundation model to predict a final pose for the image. The foundation model is trained to predict poses based on input feature tokens. The game server may randomly sample feature tokens to create a map representation and incorporate ray encodings representing viewing directions and camera positions. The game server generates AR content based on the image and final pose and transmits the AR content to the client device for display.

title: Carbon Black from Particulate Feedstock Materials
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for the production of carbon black in an entrained flow reactor by using particulate carbon-containing feedstock.
assignee: Orion Engineered Carbons Ip Gmbh & Co. Kg

title: Composition for preventing or treating lung cancer comprising gcc2 inhibitor as active ingredient
abstract: The present invention relates to a composition for preventing or treating lung cancer, comprising a GCC2 inhibitor as an active ingredient, and it has been confirmed through the present invention that the composition inhibits the expression of GCC2, which is secreted in a large amount in a lung cancer-specific manner, and thus can be used as a therapeutic agent for lung cancer, and as a result, the possibility of treating lung cancer was confirmed in vitro and in vivo by inducing invasion, metastasis, loss of the properties of mesenchymal cells, reduced tumorigenicity, and apoptosis of tumor cells.
assignee: Exopert Corporation; Korea University Research And Business Foundation

title: Open-world object detection system
abstract: Methods for training and executing an open-world object detection system are disclosed. An object detection model of the system is executed to output bounding boxes pertaining to known and unknown object classes. The unclassified (e.g., unknown) bounding boxes are organized into clusters and then provided to a user, who subsequently provides one or more text-based pseudo labels for the unclassified bounding boxes. The original set of bounding boxes and the text-based pseudo labels are then used to train a classifier to classify the remaining objects. The use of the object detection model in conjunction with the classifier thus augments a total number of object classes that can be classified by the open-world object detection system.

title: Targeted Content Based on Detected Traits
abstract: Systems, apparatuses, and methods are described for dynamically adjustable content based on detected traits. Dynamically adjustable content (e.g., advertisements, videos, announcements, location-specific information, maps, to name a few non-limiting examples) may be configured based on the determined traits of nearby users by performing character/word analysis of the names of nearby devices to determine likely associated user traits.

title: Integrated conveyor system for efficient and automated handling of particulate materials from belly dump trailers
abstract: A system is provided for unloading particulate material from a belly dump trailer. The system includes a roadway having an integrated grate, a first conveyor positioned beneath the grate to receive and convey particulate material to a discharge end, and a second conveyor positioned to receive material from the first conveyor and convey it to a discharge end. A plurality of containers is arranged to receive particulate material discharged from the second conveyor. The system further includes a rotational mechanism configured to rotate at least a portion of the second conveyor about an axis to selectively position its discharge end over a chosen container.

title: Wearable device for assisting limb movement
abstract: A wearable device for assisting movement of lower limbs comprising an anchor component configured to encircle the torso of a user and be supported by the shoulders through a harness/suspender providing both postural support and proprioceptive input is disclosed. The wearable device may have one or more elastic cords disposed on the anchor component and a means for aligning said cords. Each cord may have a first and second attachment component on each end, which may attach to a first shoe and a second shoe of the user. Lowering the cord end by the attachment component may cause the other cord end to rise. The wearable device may also have a limb elevation assembly comprising a handle attached to a static cord, attached to the lower limb, configured such that the user can induce step initiation and/or dorsiflexion of the lower limb by applying force to the handle.

title: Method of displaying products in a virtual environment
abstract: Methods for displaying a virtual shopping experiences provide for an efficient and intuitive user experience. In some embodiments, a computer-generated environment can include a virtual product display that includes one or more representations of products. In some embodiments, the computer-generated environment can include stations that provide additional information associated with a respective product. In some embodiments, a user is able to customize a respective product, for example, by selecting an accessory and dragging the accessory to a representation of the respective product. In some embodiments, a user is able to preview a product by placing a representation of the product on a representation of a portion of the user's body.

title: Wireless communication method, station device, and access point device
abstract: A wireless communication method, a station device, an access point (AP) device are provided. The wireless communication method includes: an AP transmits first information, the first information being used for sharing some or all of the time domain resources of a TXOP obtained by the AP to multiple STAs. The first information is used for indicating at least one of: address information of the multiple STAs, time duration information of time domain resources corresponding to the multiple STAs, start time domain positions of the time domain resources respectively corresponding to the multiple STAs, and the time domain resources respectively corresponding to the multiple STAs.
assignee: Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd.

title: Electronic device for generating image, and operating method thereof
abstract: An electronic device for generating images includes a processor and a memory for storing instructions that cause the electronic device to, in response to a first command to edit a first image, identifies a second image that is captured within a capture threshold of an acquisition time of the first image or is related to a subject of the first image. In some embodiments, the electronic device obtains, from the second image, feature information for generating an image corresponding to a first portion deleted inside the first image or a second portion to be extended outside the first image. The electronic device performs a painting operation to generate the image corresponding to the first portion or the second portion of the first image. The electronic device generates a third image that includes the first image and the image corresponding to the first portion or the second portion.

title: Rogue ONU Detection
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus for detecting candidate rogue Optical Network Unit (ONU) are disclosed. An Optical Line Terminal (OLT) aggregates, over a specified time period, values of multiple network conditions of a passive optical network (PON) that includes ONUs actively transmitting over the PON. The OLT determines that aggregated values of a given condition (i) have statistically trended in only one direction over the specified time period, and (ii) are currently over a specified threshold value. The OLT classifies a given ONU from among the ONUs as a candidate rogue ONU that is qualified for further analysis based on the determination that the aggregated values of the given ONU (i) have statistically trended in only one direction over the specified time period, and (ii) are currently over the specified threshold value. The OLT triggers a discovery process that further analyzes the candidate rogue ONU based on the classification.

title: Semiconductor production apparatus system
abstract: A semiconductor production apparatus system ( 100 ) according to this disclosure includes a substrate-holding hand ( 30 ); an image capturer ( 60 ) for capturing an image of at least a component of a semiconductor production apparatus ( 103 ); and a controller for detecting an anomaly of the component of the semiconductor production apparatus ( 103 ) based on the captured image captured by the image capturer ( 60 ).

title: Rolling brush for electric motor
abstract: Rolling brushes may provide a rolling contact to transmit current to a rotating slip-ring. The rolling brushes may have reduced wear and heat build-up, as compared to sliding brushes. The rolling brushes may be used in combination with brush holders, springs, and wires to provide radial translation and with an electrical connection. The rolling brushes, brush holders, springs, and wires may be held by inner and outer brush carriers. Pairs of the inner and outer brush carriers may be affixed to opposing axial sides of a housing plate. The wires may couple to pairs of plate rings which may also be affixed to opposing axial sides of a housing plate. The rolling brushes may roll on slip-rings as the slip-rings rotate relative to the housing plate.

title: System and method for growing and installing a plant
abstract: Systems and methods for growing and installing a tree having the roots expand generally radially outward and substantially not down by a horizontal root system planter comprising a base structure and a wall. The horizontal root system planter encourages roots of a tree to grow radially outwardly and substantially not down. In addition to a horizontal root system planter, systems and methods include a tool for tree transporting, digging, and planting operations comprising a box and a blade. The blade is configured for breaking ground and also for supporting a horizontal root system planter.

title: Methods and apparatus for intra coding a block having pixels assigned to groups
abstract: Methods and apparatus are provided for intra coding a block having pixels assigned to groups. An apparatus includes a video encoder for encoding a block in a picture using intra prediction by dividing pixels within the block into at least a first group and a second group and encoding the pixels in the first group prior to encoding the pixels in the second group. A prediction for at least one of the pixels within the second group is obtained by evaluating the pixels within the first group and the second group.

title: Discharge arrangement for discharging lignocellulosic material
abstract: A discharge arrangement for discharging lignocellulosic material includes: a screw conveyor section including an inlet for receiving lignocellulosic material; an outlet section configured to receive lignocellulosic material from the screw conveyor section; a conveyor screw rotatably arranged within the screw conveyor section for transporting the material in a material transport direction from the inlet to the outlet section; and a material spreader rotatably mounted within the outlet section, wherein the material spreader is rotatable in a first rotational direction and an opposite second rotational direction around a rotational axis extending in the material transport direction, which material spreader includes at least one blade configured to rotate around the rotational axis to transport the lignocellulosic material radially outwards and in the first and second rotational directions during rotation of the material spreader.

title: Prosthetic valve with expandable frame and associated systems and methods
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to prosthetic valves having a frame, a frame cover, and a leaflet construct. Some aspects are directed to a diametric taper for the prosthetic valve for achieving enhanced performance of the prosthetic valve under operational conditions, enhanced compressibility and delivery characteristics, and other additional or alternative advantages. Other aspects are directed toward unique assembly and attachment methods for securing leaflet constructs to support structures. Other aspects are directed toward features for interacting with transcatheter delivery systems. Still other aspects are directed to such apparatuses, systems, and methods for valve replacement, such as cardiac valve replacement.

title: Agricultural sampling system and related methods
abstract: An automated computer-controlled sampling system and related methods for collecting, processing, and analyzing agricultural samples for various chemical properties such as plant available nutrients. The sampling system allows multiple samples to be processed and analyzed for different analytes or chemical properties in a simultaneous concurrent or semi-concurrent manner. Advantageously, the system can process soil samples in the “as collected” condition without drying or grinding to produce a sample slurry. The system includes a chemical analysis sub-system which processes and analyzes the prepared slurry for quantifying multiple analytes and/or chemical properties of the sample. The chemical analysis sub-system may be embodied in a multi-layered microfluidic manifold processing substrate comprising microfluidic devices which extract and quantify the concentration of analytes or other chemical parameters associated with the sample. The system can be used to analyze various type of agricultural-related samples including soil, vegetation, manure, milk or other.

title: Beam report and ue capability configuration for ai/ml-based beam management
abstract: In an aspect of the disclosure, a method, a computer-readable medium, and an apparatus are provided. The apparatus may be a UE. The UE receives a beam report configuration for artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) based beam management from a base station, wherein the beam report configuration comprises a configuration parameter set enabling reporting for the AI/ML based beam management. The UE determines a beam set that meets a predetermined performance metric based on the beam report configuration. The UE reports the beam set to the base station.

title: Lithium Secondary Battery
abstract: A means capable of suppressing occurrence of peeling between a solid electrolyte layer and a positive electrode current collector in a lithium secondary battery includes the solid electrolyte layer covering an outer side of a positive electrode active material layer and extending to the positive electrode current collector. In a lithium secondary battery including a solid electrolyte layer covering an outer side of a positive electrode active material layer, a positive electrode current collector has a composite elastic modulus value of 17.0 [GPa] or less as measured by a spherical nanoindentation method for a main surface on a side of the positive electrode active material layer.

title: Image processing mechanism
abstract: A system is disclosed. The system includes a first processor to divide an image into a plurality of stripe image component, determine assignments for each of the plurality of stripe image components to one of a plurality of tile groups, perform a first processing on the stripe image components, assemble the first processed stripe image components into the plurality of tile groups according to the assignments, transmit the plurality of tile groups, receive processed tile groups, assemble the processed tile groups into a processed image; and a second processor to perform a second processing on each of the plurality of tile groups to generate processed tile groups.

title: Processing images of deformed indicia-bearing surfaces
abstract: A method of processing images of deformed indicia-bearing surfaces includes: detecting, within document image of an indicia-bearing surface, a plurality of image fragments, wherein each image fragment of the plurality of image fragments contains a respective sequence of alphabet symbols; generating a map of image angles, the map of image angles comprising, for each pixel of a plurality of pixels of the document image, a corresponding value reflecting an angle of image rotation caused by a deformation of the indicia-bearing surface in a vicinity of the pixel, the angle being measured with respect to a chosen text direction of the document image; defining, based on the map of image angles, a reverse transformation to be applied to the document image in order to remove image distortions caused by deformations of an indicia-bearing surface; and generating an undistorted document image by applying the reverse transformation to the document image.

title: Machine learning model-based image enhancement in video see-through (vst) extended reality (xr) devices or other devices
abstract: A method includes obtaining a plurality of image frames captured over a period of time and detecting image features in a first image frame of the image frames. The first image frame is captured at an earliest time among the image frames. The method also includes aligning remaining image frames in the image frames to the first image frame by tracking changes in the image features in the remaining image frames. The method further includes providing the aligned remaining image frames to a machine learning model to generate a plurality of enhanced image frames. The machine learning model is trained to employ multi-headed graph attention to modify a target pixel at a specified location in a target image frame based on a weighted sum of other pixels in the image frames. In addition, the method includes initiating presentation of the enhanced image frames on at least one display.

title: Method for the production of aav
abstract: The present invention relates to methods for the production of Adeno-associated virus (AAV), comprising steps of providing a stable AAV producer cell line in which at least some or all genes encoding the components necessary for the production of AAV are stably integrated into the cell genome, and culturing said cells in perfusion culture during the AAV production step (i.e., during the N step), wherein said perfusion culture encompasses continuous replacement of spent media with fresh media, and wherein said continuous replacement of spent media with fresh media continues after the induction of AAV production.

title: System and method for calibration of inspection tools
abstract: Systems, apparatuses, and methods for calibration of inspection tools. Systems, apparatuses, and methods may include, after a replaceable reference sample is affixed to a stage of an imaging system: calibrating a parameter of the imaging system based on a scan of the reference sample by the imaging system; and after calibrating the parameter of the imaging system, scanning a sample, wherein the sample comprises a duplicate of a feature of the reference sample.

title: Air secondary battery
abstract: A battery includes a container, and an electrode group housed in the container together with an alkaline electrolyte solution, the electrode group includes an air electrode and a negative electrode stacked with a separator interposed therebetween, the air electrode  1  includes a core and an air electrode mixture, the air electrode mixture contains an oxygen catalyst and a manganese compound, and the separator is a composite formed by laminating a microporous membrane and a nonwoven fabric in a thickness direction.

title: Method of scoring and valuing data for exchange
abstract: A system and method for valuing a plurality of sets of data and similar medium, comprising receiving datasets, creating a first sub-score for each of the datasets, creating a second numerical sub-score for each of the plurality of datasets, the second numerical value varying based on information characteristics, the second sub-score being larger for improved information characteristics characterized by one or more of increased structural quality, increased completeness, increased interconnectivity, increased diversity, decreased redundancy, creating a third sub-score for each of the plurality of datasets, the third subscore comprising a third numerical value being larger for improved meaning characteristics characterized by one or more of increased impact on a community, an increased number of impacted communities, greater veracity, greater relevance to an impacted community, greater scarcity; creating a composite score for each of the plurality of datasets that is a mathematical combination of the first, second, and third sub-scores.

title: Communication method, synchronization method, and communication apparatus
abstract: A communication method, a synchronization method, and a communication apparatus, where the communication method includes: A terminal receives first information, where the first information indicates the terminal to hand over to a first cell, and the first information includes a plurality of sets of ephemeris-related information corresponding to the first cell; the terminal determines to hand over to the first cell and change to first ephemeris-related information corresponding to the first cell, where the first ephemeris-related information is one of the plurality of sets of ephemeris-related information; and the terminal accesses the first cell based on the first ephemeris-related information.

title: Grip apparatus for a golf club
abstract: The golf club grip apparatus disclosed herein includes a body defining a surface configured to engage biasingly only portions of a golfer's palm about a thenar region. The body defines an opposing surface configured to biasingly engage at least in part a handle of a golf club. The body is configured to generally fills at least portions of a thenar space formed as the golfer grips the golf club.

title: Capsule intended for receiving a substance for preparing a beverage
abstract: The invention relates to a capsule ( 1 ) for receiving a substance for preparing a beverage, said capsule comprising a body having a side wall ( 2 ) bordered on either side by a base ( 3 ) and by a rim ( 4 ) surrounding an opening ( 5 ) in said body, the body being formed by moulding a cellulose pulp, and the side wall ( 2 ) of said body being covered with a sealing coating.

title: Abnormality detection device and battery system
abstract: A voltage measurement circuit is configured to measure voltages of cells connected in series to one another. Input resistors are connected to voltage measurement lines, respectively. Capacitors are connected between two lines of the voltage measurement lines. Discharge circuits are connected between the lines at respective nodes closer to a voltage measurement circuit than a low-pass filter. A control circuit is configured to turn off a switch of a certain channel at a predetermined time after turning on the switch of the certain channel. When a voltage of a channel immediately upper than the certain channel exceeds a threshold voltage when a predetermined period of time elapses from the turning off of the switch, the control circuit is configured to determine that an abnormality occurs in a voltage measurement line among the plurality of voltage measurement lines between the certain channel and the channel immediately upper than the certain channel.
assignee: Panasonic Intellectual Property Management Co., Ltd.

title: Connected cards
abstract: Implementations of connected cards comprise an elongated piece of material scored along the material to define sections along the material wherein the material is suitable for marking with an erasable marker for reading and wherein the elongated piece of material is weighted on at least one distal end. In some implementations, a method of using the plurality of connected cards comprise writing indicia a plurality of cards, folding the elongated piece of material along the scores to form a stack of connected cards, displaying each card one at a time; erasing at least some of the written indicia; and after using the cards as intended, forming a stack by folding the elongated piece of material along the scores and storing the cards away.

title: Base station apparatus, terminal apparatus, and communication method
abstract: A terminal apparatus in communication with a base station apparatus includes a higher layer processing unit configured to receive a first parameter set and a second parameter set. Each of the first parameter set and the second parameter set includes the number of symbols of an SL-PRS, information indicating the position of a first symbol of the SL-PRS, a Comb size, and a resource element offset. The first parameter set is a parameter set used for a Dedicated resource pool. The second parameter set is a parameter set used for a Shared resource pool.

title: Liquid Cooling Using PCT Through Holes
abstract: Described herein are devices, systems, methods, and processes for an efficient liquid cooling system for electronic components mounted on a printed circuit board (PCB). The system utilizes PCB through holes to carry a liquid coolant. The cooling system includes a coolant loop through which a pump circulates the coolant. A cooling sub-assembly includes a cooling channel thermally coupled to the component to be cooled. The cooling sub-assembly further includes a coolant supply PCB through hole that carries the cooled coolant from a supply manifold on the bottom side of the PCB to the cooling channel on the top side of the PCB and a coolant return PCB through hole that carries the heated coolant from the cooling channel to the return manifold on the bottom side of the PCB. The cooling system includes a control system for coolant distribution that can react to component temperatures.

title: Carbohydrate-polymer conjugates for tunable protein binding and methods of use
abstract: The present invention relates to a carbohydrate-polymer conjugate comprising a repeat unit, a divalent linker, and a carbohydrate and compositions thereof, wherein the repeat unit comprises, in part, a linker and a carbohydrate, as well as a method of synthesizing a carbohydrate-polymer conjugate using ring-opening metathesis polymerization (ROMP) and a method comprising the step of administering a composition comprising the carbohydrate-polymer conjugate, wherein the composition can bind to a lectin.
assignee: Board Of Regents, The University Of Texas System

title: Wind turbine blade and method for repairing
abstract: A method for repairing a wind turbine blade, wherein the wind turbine blade includes a first layer, a second layer, and an inner core layer between the first layer and the second layer, and the method includes: determining a damaged area of the inner core layer, sequentially removing portions of the second layer and the inner core layer corresponding to the damaged area, forming a repair through-hole in the second layer, and forming a damage removal hole in the inner core layer; applying an adhesive inside the damage removal hole, before arranging one or more repair core members side by side on the adhesive; wet/hand laying-up or bonding a prefabricated glass fiber reinforced plastic plate on a surface of the one or more repair core members in the repair through-hole; and maintaining vacuum pressure, while curing the adhesive at room temperature or by surface heating.

title: Humanizing music sequence
abstract: There is provided improved accuracy for humanizing music sequences. A method for a digital audio workstation (DAW) comprises obtaining, by an digital audio workstation, sparse models of human-played music for humanizing a rhythmic structure of a music sequence (S), said sparse models comprising information indicating timing (t′ 1 , . . . , t′ n ) of sounds (s 1 , . . . , s n ) of a humanized music sequence (S′), selecting, by the digital audio workstation, a model from the obtained sparse models based on at least one of the following: generating for each of the obtained sparse models a score; and selecting the model that has the highest score; or characterizing said obtained sparse models on a user interface of the digital audio workstation, and receiving user input on the user interface indicating the selected model; said method further comprising: adjusting, by the digital audio workstation, based on the selected model, timing information (t i ) of the rhythmic structure of the music sequence (S) to comprise an offset (o i ); and outputting, by the digital audio workstation, the music sequence (S) comprising one or more adjusted times (t i +o i ).

title: Unified distributed memory operations
abstract: In one embodiment, a computer node, includes memory, and at least one processor to execute a user application, a plurality of transfer backends, and a local transfer agent to register memory for data transfers to generate local metadata, receive from the user application a request to perform a memory data transfer with a remote computer node, receive remote metadata from a remote transfer agent of the remote computer node, select a transfer backend to fulfill the memory data transfer based on the remote metadata and the local metadata, and perform the memory data transfer using the selected transfer backend.

title: Semiconductor package and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A semiconductor package includes a first die, a second die, and a redistribution layer structure. The first die and the second die are disposed laterally. The first die includes a first die connector and the second die includes a second die connector. The redistribution layer structure is disposed over and electrically connected to the first die and the second die. The redistribution layer structure includes a polymer layer and a first via embedded in the polymer layer. The first via has an elliptical-like shape from a top view. The first die connector has a circle-like shape from the top view. The second die connector has a circle-like shape from the top view. From the top view, the first via overlaps with two opposite arcs of the first die connector or the first via overlaps with two opposite arcs of the second die connector.

title: Coaxial rotor pair assembly with variable collective pitch rotor / propeller for flight vehicle or drone
abstract: A coaxial rotor pair assembly, e.g., for a flight vehicle or drone, with a fixed-pitch rotor and a variable-pitch rotor that are axially spaced relative to one another on a rotor axis for rotation via rotor shafts. A first motor and a second motor are provided for the rotors to drive the respective rotor about the rotor axis. The first and second motors are each controlled by a speed controller, and speed controllers are controlled by a vehicle flight controller. A collective pitch of the plurality of blades of the variable-pitch rotor is configured to be selectively varied by the vehicle flight controller during rotation of both the fixed-pitch rotor and the variable-pitch rotor about the rotor axis. The plurality of blades of the fixed-pitch rotor are maintained a constant, fixed pitch, e.g., during operation of the flight vehicle.

title: Row-column addressed 2d eddy current array
abstract: Row-column addressing techniques can be applied to eddy current (EC) coil elements to reduce the number of multiplexers in a two-dimensional EC probe. Individual coil elements can then be controlled to provide more robust EC inspection capabilities. Leakage current issues can be addressed by using diodes and biasing techniques.

title: Variable depth blazed waveguide
abstract: Described techniques provide increased output uniformity in an eyebox of a reflective light guide using a reflective structure, such as a periodic reflective structure formed in one or more optical substrates of an optical combiner. The reflective structure includes a series of reflective facets having a respective reflective intensity that varies in accordance with a position of the respective facet along a path of propagation for the light guide, such as to increased reflective intensity for reflective facets positioned further from an incoupling structure of the light guide.

title: Bridge circuit for battery management system
abstract: A bridge circuit for use in an automotive battery management system can include a first communication interface that can be configured to communicate with a control unit using a first bus protocol. The bridge circuit can also include a second communication interface that can be configured to communicate with one or more peripheral battery management devices using a second bus protocol. The bridge circuit can also include a memory storing a plurality of sequences. An individual sequence of the plurality of sequences can include one or more commands for the one or more peripheral battery management devices. The bridge circuit can also include a sequence controller that can be coupled to the memory and can be configured to retrieve one or more commands associated with a selected sequence from the memory, transmit the retrieved one or more commands to the one or more peripheral battery management devices using the second communication interface, and store data received from the one or more peripheral battery management devices in response to a read command in the memory.

title: Three-dimensional (3d) to two-dimensional (2d) bounding box alignment
abstract: Systems and techniques are described herein for three-dimensional (3D) to two-dimensional (2D) alignment.
