A second muffler reaction chamber is disposed on an economizer pipeline, which connects the economizer and a compressor, at a position close to a first muffler reaction chamber, pressure pulsation in the economizer pipeline is mainly caused by a large pressure difference between a refrigerant gas in a compression chamber and a refrigerant gas in the economizer pipeline, by controlling a distance between the second muffler reaction chamber and the first muffler reaction chamber, after the pressure pulsation transmitted from the compression chamber of the compressor passes through the first muffler reaction chamber and the second muffler reaction chamber, good pressure pulsation attenuation can be achieved, an effective pulsation attenuation frequency range can be greatly widened to adapt to pressure pulsation generated by the compressor under different frequency conditions.

title: System, method, and recording medium for controlling work machine
abstract: A control system controls a work machine including a work implement to which a work tool is attachable at a tip end. The control system includes a processor. The processor identifies a virtual wall, which is a surface that prohibits entry of the work implement. The processor determines a revolution angular velocity of the work machine such that the virtual wall does not come into contact with the work machine. The processor varies the revolution angular velocity, depending on a main body weight of the work tool.

title: Current sampling circuit and multi-level converter
abstract: A current sampling circuit for a multi-level DC-DC converter having first and second power switches connected in series, and a first inductor having one terminal coupled to a common node of the first and second power switches, where the current sampling circuit is configured to: receive a first signal representing a current flowing through the first power switch; receive a second signal representing a current flowing through the second power switch; and generate a third signal representing an inductor current flowing through the first inductor according to the first signal and the second signal.

title: Mitigating hallucinations in artificial intelligence chatbots
abstract: Examples described herein provide systems and methods for mitigating hallucinations in artificial intelligence chatbots. Aspects include receiving a prompt from a user, generating, in response to the prompt, an output by a thought generator, where the thought generator is configured to utilize one or more large language models to generate the output, and calculating, by a thought assessor, a confidence score for the output. Aspects also include performing a supplemental review of the prompt and the output, where the supplemental review determines whether the output includes a hallucination, based on a determination that the confidence score of the output does not exceed a threshold value and based on a determination that the output includes the hallucination, fine-tuning the thought generator.

title: Image decoding device, image decoding method, and program
abstract: An image decoding device includes a first intra-frame predicting part configured to generate first predicted pixels based on decoded pixels and control information, a second intra-frame predicting part configured to generate second predicted pixels by blending prediction images of a block to be decoded using reference pixels referred for the one or more block vectors included in the block to be decoded, based on the decoded pixels and the control information, a storing part configured to store the decoded pixels, an inter-frame predicting part configured to generate third predicted pixels based on the stored decoded pixels and the control information and an adder configured to add the prediction residual and the first predicted pixels to the third predicted pixels to derive the decoded pixels.

title: Test pattern forming method, adjustment value determination method, and printing apparatus
abstract: A test pattern includes a plurality of patches arranged in a predetermined direction. The plurality of patches include a plurality of first characteristic patches indicating a characteristic of printing first characteristics of a printing apparatus, and further include a plurality of second characteristic patches indicating a second characteristic of the printing characteristics. A test pattern forming method includes a first step of changing a relative positional relationship between a recording head and a medium, and a second step of ejecting a liquid from the recording head such that the test pattern is formed on the medium in which, in the predetermined direction, the first characteristic patches are not adjacent to each other and the second characteristic patches are not adjacent to each other among the plurality of patches.

title: Methods and systems for imparting tactile sensations having acoustic traitsto tactile regions of a user’s hand or hands
abstract: In accordance with one aspect, a plurality of transducers mechanically coupled to different tactile regions of at least one hand of a user are driven via different channel signals, the different channel signals having acoustic traits evolving independently from the acoustic traits of the other channel signals. In accordance with another aspect, transducers mechanically coupled to tactile regions of the hand of a user can be piezoelectric transducers.
assignee: UNIVERSITé LAVAL; Ecole De Technologie Superieure

title: Method for crystal processing
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method for crystal processing. The method for crystal processing includes: obtaining an initial crystal; determining a processing scheme for the initial crystal; and processing the initial crystal based on the processing scheme.

title: Adjustable rack of wardrobe
abstract: An adjustable rack of a wardrobe includes a frame assembly, two guide rails, anti-separation pieces, and mounting components. The frame assembly includes an outer frame and an inner frame. Both of the outer frame and the inner frame include a supporting wall, two longitudinal side walls, and two transverse side walls. The two guide rails respectively define rail grooves. The two guide rails are respectively fixed to inner sides of the two longitudinal side walls of the outer frame, so that the two longitudinal side walls of the inner frame are respectively and slidably inserted into the rail grooves. Alternatively, the two guide rails are fixed to outer sides of the two longitudinal side walls of the inner frame, so that the two longitudinal side walls of the outer frame are respectively inserted into the rail grooves. Each of the anti-separation pieces includes an abutting portion.
assignee: Shenzhen Autral Technology Innovation Co., Ltd.

title: Hair styling apparatus
abstract: A hair styling apparatus having a barrel and a handle, wherein the barrel has a bend or wave along its length. A method of styling hair includes wrapping a section of hair around a hair styling apparatus barrel in a first direction and then wrapping the section of hair around the hair styling apparatus barrel in a second direction.

title: High-power linear flux-pump system
abstract: One example describes a linear flux-pump system. The system includes a trigger stage configured to generate a pulse train in response to an initialization current. The system also includes a current amplifier stage comprising a plurality of Josephson transmission line (JTL) stages configured to propagate MFQ pulses based on a clock signal in response to the pulse train. The system further includes a flux-pump stage configured to aggregate the MFQ pulses based on the clock signal to generate a DC output current.

title: Method for braking a vehicle for carrying passengers, control unit, and vehicle for carrying passengers
abstract: A method for braking a vehicle with passengers, who are standing and/or not strapped in, in an interior of the vehicle, the method including, in the presence of a trigger criterion, braking the vehicle based on a defined brake profile by a braking system. The brake profile has at least one braking phase with a number of chronologically successive partial braking regions. Within the respective partial braking regions, an actual ego deceleration is defined such that, in the braking phase, the vehicle is braked by the actual ego deceleration, which changes over time. The brake profile is defined by detecting road users located in an environment outside the vehicle and detecting passengers located in the interior of the vehicle. The brake profile is further defined by determining road user information associated with the respectively detected road users, and determining passenger information associated with the respectively detected passengers.

title: Filament cut access panel with concealed seam living hinge
abstract: The disclosed filament cut access panel allows for removal of a concealed access panel on a chassis for a computing device. A filament is placed under the textile covering for the computing device at the time of manufacture. A free end of the filament is pulled to cut the textile covering and allow removal of the access panel so components internal to the device are accessible for repair or replacement. When the filament is pulled to create the access line, a pre-scoring on an underside of the textile covering guides movement of the filament so that the textile covering is cut along a specific path corresponding to a seam between the access panel and the chassis. The access panel may be hinged to the chassis using a living hinge. The living hinge permits relative rotation of the access panel without requiring a visible seam on an exterior surface.

title: Method for recycling ceramic sintered body
abstract: According to one embodiment, a method for recycling a ceramic sintered body includes bringing a ceramic sintered body including at least one metal element selected from the group consisting of a rare earth element, Ti, and Mg into contact with an acidic liquid including at least one selected from the group consisting of hydrochloric acid, nitric acid, and sulfuric acid in a pressure atmosphere at a temperature of from 100° C. to 400° C. to obtain a mixture including a main component of the ceramic sintered body and an ion of the at least one metal element present in the acidic liquid, separating the main component of the ceramic sintered body from the mixture and separating the ion of the at least one metal element from the acidic liquid.

title: Computer system and a method for controlling a vehicle
abstract: A method and a computer system including processing circuitry configured to monitor a first property indicative of an instantaneous normal force between each one of a plurality of driven wheels of a vehicle, such as an articulated hauler, and a ground surface below the driven wheels, detect that the monitored first property indicates a decrease in the instantaneous normal force between a first subset of the driven wheels and the ground surface, and in response thereto control an electric powertrain arrangement of the vehicle to reduce a torque delivered to the first subset of driven wheels, and to optionally increase a torque delivered to a second subset of the driven wheels for which the monitored first property is not indicative of the decrease in the instantaneous normal force.

title: Organic compounds and organic light-emitting device comprising same
abstract: The present invention relates to an organic compound represented by the following [Chemical Formula 1] including the following [Structural Formula 1], and a high-efficiency and long-lifespan organic light-emitting device having significantly improved low-voltage driving, and excellent light-emitting efficiency, long lifespan and the like by employing the same as a host material of a light-emitting layer in the device.

title: Door Lock Actuating Device for Actuating a Door Lock of a Vehicle Door
abstract: A door lock actuation arrangement for a vehicle door, particularly for a flush door handle, includes an actuating element that moves from a flush rest position to an extended operating position through a linkage connected to a fixed support structure. A sensor is integrated directly into a movable part of the linkage, such as a lever arm. The sensor detects mechanical forces acting on the actuating element and distinguishes between pulling and pushing actions. A pulling force signals a request to open the door, while a pushing force indicates a locking request. The sensor may also detect the position of the actuating element through a defined mechanical bias in the rest position. Integrating the sensor in the linkage allows a single component to detect user intent, monitor handle position, and support safety functions such as pinch protection while reducing component count, packaging space, and system complexity.

title: Ai system for enhancing moral and non-moral decision-making
abstract: A computer system for aiding in decision-making in a situation involving one or more users. The system includes an Artificial Intelligence (AI) model trained by existing decision-making data and generalized data made up of relationships between properties and quality of decision-making, configured to accept the inputs from the input devices and responses to one or more written or verbal prompts and generate decision-enhancing suggestions as output.

title: Real-time bidding process for advertisement payload
abstract: A disclosure comprises systems and methods for generating an advertisement payload on a receipt at Point of Sale. The method comprises identifying a transaction at a point of sale (POS) wherein an advertisement payload can be provided to a customer; generating a bid request for an advertisement payload to be integrated in a receipt generated at the POS; transmitting the bid request to a plurality of demand site platforms (DSPs), wherein each DSP is associated with a retailer; receiving at least one bid response from the DSP associated with the retailer; determining a winning bid response from the at least one bid response; in response to determining the winning bid response, procuring an advertisement payload associated with the retailer; and generating the receipt at the point of sale (POS) comprising the advertisement payload.

title: System and method for rendering video stream outputs
abstract: There is described a computer-implemented method for rendering video stream outputs, the method comprising; generating a rendering pipeline comprising a plurality of rendering tasks; determining a first rendering task of the plurality of rendering tasks to be rendered differently dependent on one or more characteristics of a user; and producing a first video stream output to be displayed to a first user having a first characteristic; and amending the first rendering task based on a characteristic of a second user, wherein the characteristic of the second user is different to that of the first user, and producing a second video stream output to be displayed to the second user. There is also described a computer program product and a system.

title: System and method for securely transmitting voice signals
abstract: A method, computer program product, and computing system for securely transmitting voice signals. A speech signal including a content component and a speaker component of a first voice is received at an encoder. The speaker component of the speech signal is processed, using machine learning, to generate a speaker embedding. The content component of the voice signal is processed, using machine learning and based at least on the speaker embedding, to generate a content embedding having minimized speaker information. The content embedding is transmitted to a decoder for restoring the received speech signal.

title: Signaling device for vehicles under emergency conditions
abstract: A signaling device for vehicles under emergency conditions comprising a basic structure; an attachment device/component/unit/element/apparatus or the like (e.g., a magnet) for attaching the basic structure to a canopy of a vehicle; a signaling assembly for signaling the presence of the vehicle to coming vehicles associated with the basic structure; a lighted device adapted to switch on; a projection device/component/unit/element/apparatus or the like (e.g., a projector) adapted to project at least one emergency signal to a predefined distance from the vehicle.

title: Display device and electronic device including the same
abstract: A display device includes a display area. A display device includes a plurality of first power voltage lines each extending in a first direction in the display area and applying a first power voltage to pixels disposed in the display area. The display area includes a first area and a second area sequentially partitioned from each other in the first direction. The plurality of first power voltage lines includes a first-first power voltage line connected only to those pixels disposed in the display area that are disposed in the first area and a first-second power voltage line connected only to those pixels disposed in the display area that are disposed in the second area.

title: Battery cell, battery, and electric apparatus
abstract: A battery cell, a battery, and an electric apparatus are disclosed. The battery cell includes a housing, an electrode assembly, and a pressure relief mechanism. The housing defines an accommodation space with a first wall portion. The electrode assembly, positioned in the accommodation space, has a first tab connected to the first wall portion, dividing the accommodation space into a first subspace and a second subspace. A communication channel is formed in the first wall portion to allow gas exchange between the first and second subspaces for rapid internal pressure balance. The pressure relief mechanism is arranged at the housing and actuates when internal pressure in the first subspace reaches a threshold, thereby releasing the pressure. The configuration enables prompt pressure relief and enhances operational reliability of the battery cell.

title: Streaming multiprocessor allocation
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to allocate resources. In at least one embodiment, an application programming interface (API) is to control a number of streaming multiprocessors (SMs) to be used to perform two or more software threads.

title: Ultrasonic diagnostic apparatus, medical image processing apparatus and non-transitory computer readable storage medium
abstract: An ultrasonic diagnostic apparatus according to an embodiment includes a first acquisition unit, a second acquisition unit, and a generation unit. The first acquisition unit acquires a first image on which surface rendering has been executed on three-dimensional ultrasonic data related to a subject. The second acquisition unit acquires a light attenuation coefficient corresponding to the three-dimensional ultrasonic data. The generation unit generates a rendering image based on the first image and the light attenuation coefficient.

title: Multilayer ceramic capacitor
abstract: A multilayer ceramic capacitor includes a multilayer body including dielectric layers and first and second inner electrode layers, and first to fourth outer electrodes on the multilayer body. Each of the first inner electrode layers includes a first opposing electrode portion facing a respective one of the second inner electrode layers with a respective one of the dielectric layers interposed therebetween, a first extended portion extending from the first opposing electrode portion, and a second extended portion extending from the first opposing electrode portion. Each of the dielectric layers including a respective one of the first inner electrode layers thereon includes a first side portion including the first extended portion, and a second side portion including the second extended portion. The first and second side portions have different Ni contents on opposite sides of the first and second extended portions.

title: Long Carbon Fibers for Boosting Performance of Dry Processed Li-Ion Battery Electrodes
abstract: A method of manufacturing a dry-processed battery electrode is provided. The method includes providing a mixture comprising an electrode active material, a conductive carbon material, a polymer binder, and carbon fibers having an average length of at least 5 mm prior to dry mixing. The mixture is dry mixed under shear conditions and compressed to form an electrode sheet. The electrode sheet may be used as a free-standing electrode or affixed to a metallic current collector. A dry-processed battery electrode is also provided. The dry-processed battery electrode comprises the electrode active material, the conductive carbon material, the fibrillated polymer binder, and carbon fibers dispersed throughout the electrode with an average length of about 20 μm to about 150 μm. The electrode sheet may be used as a free-standing electrode or affixed to a metallic current collector.

title: Application identification for traffic flow prioritization
abstract: This disclosure provides methods, components, devices and systems for providing prioritized traffic flows for latency sensitive applications using application identifications. Some aspects more specifically relate to associating all network traffic or traffic flows from a prioritized application using an application identification (APPID) that is associated to every traffic flow from the prioritized application. In some aspects, all of the APPID associated traffic flows as treated as prioritized traffic flows, when at least one traffic flow from the application is a prioritized network flow or includes prioritized network traffic.

title: Low-stress optical surfacing on reaction bonded silicon carbide
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for low-stress optical surfacing on reaction bonded silicon carbide. A reaction bonded silicon carbide (RB-SiC) based structure may include a substrate, a physical vapor deposition (PVD) or other suitable vacuum deposition (VD) based optical layer on top of the substrate, and optionally one or more PVD (or other suitable vacuum deposition (VD) technique) based tacking layers disposed immediately on the surface of the substrate.

title: Mounter device, tape removal device, substrate transfer apparatus, tape removal method, and substrate transfer method
abstract: A substrate transfer apparatus ( 100 ) includes a tape removal mechanism (RM) for peeling a first adhesive tape (T 1 ) applied to a wafer (W). The tape removal mechanism (RM) is configured to cause a peeling angle (α) to differ between a time when peeling starts and a time when peeling ends. Specifically, the tape removal mechanism (RM) includes a heat seal (RM 5 ) configured to heat a peeling tape (PT) while pressing the peeling tape (PT) against the first adhesive tape (T 1 ), and a peeling tape collection roller (RM 2 ) configured to collect the peeling tape (PT). The peeling tape (PT) heated by the heat seal (RM 5 ) is welded to the first adhesive tape (T 1 ), and the first adhesive tape (T 1 ) is peeled from the wafer (w) by being pulled by the peeling tape (PT) as the peeling tape (PT) is collected by the peeling tape collection roller (RM 2 ).

title: Image identifying system and method
abstract: The present invention provides an image identifying system and method, including an anatomical image module, a contour module, a pixel value module, and a recognition analysis module. The anatomical image module reads anatomical images. The contour module recognizes the body contour based on the anatomical images. The pixel value module sets the first pixel value and the second pixel value, which correspond and filter the first pixel region and the second pixel region within the body contour, respectively. The recognition analysis module expands the first pixel region and the second pixel region outward by a voxel range to form a first expanded region and a second expanded region. The first expanded region is then adjusted by excluding the area of overlap between the first expanded region and the second expanded region to form a preprocessing region.

title: Method for data processing, and communication device
abstract: A method for data processing method and a communication device are provided. The method includes the following operations. First configuration information is acquired. The first configuration information is used for configuring N split modes and a jth part corresponding to an ith split mode among the N split modes. N is an integer greater than or equal to 1, i is greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to N, j is greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to M, and M is an integer greater than 1. The N split modes include a split mode for splitting a data processing model into at least two sub-processing models by presetting a split position.
assignee: Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd.

title: Projectile platform support system
abstract: A clamp for holding firearms by use of a mounting rail system, such as arca or picatinny, where the rail is held securely in the clamp by a sliding jaw tightened with a knob. The clamp is formed from an arm which itself is held securely within a vise that can be mounted to any suitable surface. The use of a cylindrical arm to form the clamp allows the clamp and firearm to be rotated in the vertical plane. Mounting the vise on a swivel allows for rotation in the horizontal plane. Together, this system provides a user with a stable, infinitely adjustable mounting mechanism that does not affect barrel harmonics.

title: Plated steel material
abstract:
The plated steel material includes a steel material and a plated layer disposed on a surface of the steel material, and
         the plated layer has a predetermined chemical composition, and the plated layer has a diffraction intensity obtained from a result of X-ray diffraction measurement, the diffraction intensity satisfying a predetermined formula.

title: Memory-Governed Admissibility System for Command and Control (C2) Behavior Constitution Based on Structured Memory Entity Participation
abstract: A system is provided in which system behavior corresponding to command and control (C2) functions exists through admissible structural participation of structured memory entities within a system memory domain. Representations corresponding to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) mechanisms, artificial intelligence components, and heterogeneous representation sources exist as candidate representations independent of system behavior. A transformation structure exists as a correspondence domain between candidate representations and structured memory entities, and a validation structure exists as an admissibility domain based on stored structural relationships, validated memory states, and structural consistency. Structured memory entities exist as admissible participation units only upon correspondence to admissibility conditions. System behavior exists only as a structural condition corresponding to admissible participation, and representations and candidate representations remain structurally non-constitutive of system behavior irrespective of source, confidence, or inferred relevance absent admissibility correspondence.

title: Systems and methods for direct arrival estimation for marine seismic data
abstract: Systems and methods for direct arrival estimation for marine seismic data are provided. A computer-implemented method for estimating direct-arrival energy in seismic data acquired in a marine environment, the method including: executing, by one or more processors, operations on seismic data that contain up-going and down-going wavefields in which direct-arrival information is not properly or completely recorded, processing the seismic data using a computer-based wavefield-analysis technique to identify water-layer reverberation events within the up-going and down-going wavefields, leveraging, through computer-implemented analysis, stable relationships among water-layer reverberations, computing, by the processors, an estimated direct-arrival signal based on the identified relationships to compensate for missing or improperly recorded direct-arrival information, and producing, using the processors, a direct-arrival estimate configured for use in subsequent seismic-processing operations.

title: Method for forming a confection
abstract: A method for forming a jelly confection includes providing a jelly confection material to a moisture removal system, continuously renewing an exterior surface of the jelly confection material via the moisture removal system, removing moisture from the jelly confection material via the moisture removal system, outputting the jelly confection from the moisture removal system, and forming the jelly confection material into a plurality of pieces of jelly confection.

title: An injectable delivery system for long-acting administration of drugs
abstract: The invention relates to an injectable delivery system for long-acting administration of drugs. The invention includes a compound formed at least partially from a peptide-mimetic molecule. The compound is configured for the attachment of one or more drug molecules, and is further configured to release the one or more drug molecules under physiological conditions. A solution of the compound forms a hydrogel in response to an enzyme that is endogenous to a human or animal. A solution of the compound can be administered to the skin, wherein upon administration it forms a hydrogel, and any drug attached to the compound is then gradually released.

title: Re-routing storage items in a warehouse
abstract: This specification generally discloses a computer-implemented method for re-routing items in a warehouse, comprising designating a first storage location in the warehouse as a destination storage location for an item; sending first instructions to a mechanical conveying system to automatically move the item from a first current position to the first storage location using the mechanical conveying system; determining, while the item is being moved to the first storage location by the mechanical conveying system, that a state of items being moved by the mechanical conveying system satisfies a criterion to change the destination storage location for the item from the first storage location to a second storage location; and sending second instructions to the mechanical conveying system to automatically move the item from a second current position of the item to the second storage location using the mechanical conveying system.

title: Insertable cover assembly
abstract: A cover assembly is provided for temporarily or selectively sealing a wall structure opening and allowing passage of a conduit. The cover assembly comprises an outer wall and a barrier assembly and may comprise an attachment structure or a flange to secure the cover assembly in the opening. The outer wall comprises a length according to the thickness of the wall structure opening. The barrier assembly comprises a barrier and an inner wall that is disposed within the outer wall. The inner wall comprises a frustoconical shape that decreases distally within the hollow interior of the outer wall. The barrier comprises a plurality of adjacently disposed segments. Initially, the plurality of segments is adjacently disposed to one another and collectively define a closed position of the barrier. The plurality of segments expands by severing indentations therebetween to allow passage of the conduit with the barrier in an open position.

title: Fine-tuning classification and domain-specific taxonomical hierarchy in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines
abstract: A computer-implemented method including receiving a query from a user related to legal information. The method also can include performing an initial retrieval of document chunks from a corpus of legal documents. The method additionally can include applying a cross-encoder model to generate relevance scores for the document chunks. The method further can include filtering the document chunks based on a quality threshold. The method additionally can include calculating a combined score for each remaining document chunk of the document chunks based on a respective relevance score of the relevance scores, temporal relevance score, and a document type importance score. The document type importance score can be based on applying an order of authority for legal document types. The method also can include selecting a subset of top-scoring document chunks based on the combined score. The method additionally can include generating a response to the query based on the subset of the top-scoring document chunks. Other embodiments are described.

title: Nuclear reactor loading system and methods of use thereof
abstract: A loading system for a molten salt reactor system includes a slug loading assembly. The slug loading assembly includes an inert chamber having an entry port therein that is configured to receive a solid slug. The loading system further includes a chute having a pipe run extending from the entry port and elevationally below the slug loading assembly. The loading system further includes a terminal sieve fluidically coupled with the pipe run opposite the entry port and configured to receive the solid slug via the pipe run. The terminal sieve is positionable with a flow of a liquid molten salt for dissolution of the solid slug therein.

title: Apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium and article of aerosolizable medium
abstract: An apparatus for generating aerosol from an aerosolizable medium, the apparatus including a housing; and a chamber for receiving an article. The article includes an aerosolizable medium; and a marker arrangement including a first marker and a second marker. The apparatus includes a sensor arrangement configured to operate in a first mode and a second mode. In the first mode the sensor arrangement monitors non-continuously for the presence of the first marker. In the second mode the sensor arrangement is configured to read identification information from the second marker. The sensor arrangement operates in the second mode responsive to the detection of the presence of the first marker in the first mode.

title: Display panel and display apparatus
abstract: A display panel and a display apparatus. The display panel includes light-emitting elements, pixel circuits, and a driving circuit. A pixel circuit includes a driving transistor, and first and second light-emitting control transistors. The pixel circuits include a first pixel circuit in a first area and a second pixel circuit in a second area along a first direction. In a second direction, distances from the first and second light-emitting control transistors to the driving transistor are D 11  and D 12  in the first pixel circuit, and D 21  and D 22  in the second pixel circuit, where |D 11 -D 12 |>|D 21 -D 22 |; or distances between the first and second light-emitting control transistors in first and second directions are D 51  and D 52  in the first pixel circuit, and D 61  and D 62  in the second pixel circuit, where 0≤D 51 <D 61 , and/or D 52 >D 62 ≥0.
assignee: Tianma Advanced Display Technology Institute (Xiamen) Co., Ltd.

title: Shaft Connector Systems and Methods
abstract: A method includes installing an operator on a valve in an operational environment without disassembling the valve, where installing the operator includes disposing a valve shaft and an operator shaft in an end to end arrangement, coupling the valve shaft to the operator shaft via a sleeve including a plurality of shear components extending from an interior wall of the sleeve and into corresponding pre-configured recesses in the valve shaft and the operator shaft, retaining the plurality of shear components in the pre-configured recesses via one or more retaining mechanisms that secure the sleeve to the valve shaft and the operator shaft, and independently aligning the valve shaft and the operator shaft while transmitting torsional, translational, or torsional and translational loading through the plurality of shear components and not through the retaining mechanisms.

title: Systems and methods for manufacturing articles of footwear including a sole structure
abstract: A method of forming a cushioning element. The method including placing a first sheet adjacent to an outer surface of a first mold portion, the first mold portion including a first mold cavity. The method including pressing a portion of the first sheet into the first mold portion and into the first mold cavity with a forming tool, wherein at least a portion of the forming tool is extended into the first mold cavity. The method including applying negative pressure to the first mold cavity to draw the portion of the first sheet into the first mold cavity, and joining a second sheet to the first sheet to form the cushioning element.

title: Optical ground station for satellite communication
abstract: An optical ground station for satellite communication may include a base with a bearing support. An intermediate frame is mounted on the base, the intermediate frame having a circular-arc-shaped guide engaged with the bearing support so as to allow angular motion of the intermediate frame about a first, (substantially) horizontal, axis corresponding to the axis of the circular-arc-shaped guide. A first actuator is configured and arranged to rotate the intermediate frame relative to the base about the first axis. An optical communication terminal is mounted to the intermediate frame through a rotary bearing allowing angular motion of the optical communication terminal about a second axis perpendicular to the first axis. A second actuator is configured and arranged to rotate the optical communication terminal relative to the intermediate frame about the second axis.

title: Laser irradiation system
abstract: Proposed is a laser irradiation system including a mobile application executed on a mobile terminal of a user, a management server for receiving a facial image of the user from the mobile application and analyzing the same so as to determine whether the user is a hypertensive patient, at least one laser irradiator in which a plurality of light-emitting elements for irradiating different parts of a body of the user in a lying position with laser light is arranged, and a controller for controlling the laser irradiator. The controller includes a communication unit for short-range data communication with the mobile application, an information storage unit in which acupuncture point information including acupuncture points for hypertension is stored, and a control unit driving and controlling the light-emitting elements corresponding to the acupuncture points for hypertension so as to irradiate the corresponding acupuncture points with laser light for a hypertensive patient.

title: Modular Skin Treatment Device with Dermabrasion and Light-Treatment Capabilities
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a modular skin treatment device. The modular skin treatment device includes a console with a fluid source and a vacuum source. The console is configured to couple with a dermabrasion handpiece that includes a fluid conduit and a waste conduit. The dermabrasion handpiece is configured to deliver a treatment fluid from the fluid source to a skin surface via the fluid conduit and remove debris from the skin surface to the vacuum source via the waste conduit. The console is also configured to couple with a light-emission handpiece that includes one or more photoelectric components. The light-emission handpiece is configured to emit light to the skin surface using the one or more photoelectric components.

title: Semiconductor device and method of fabricating the same
abstract: A semiconductor device includes first and second sheet patterns spaced apart from each other on a first region of the substrate, a first gate electrode extending between the first and second sheet patterns, third and fourth sheet patterns spaced apart from each other on a second region of the substrate, and a second gate electrode extending between the third and fourth sheet patterns. The first gate electrode includes a first work function controlling film, which is between the first and second sheet patterns, and a first filling conductive film on the first work function controlling film. The second gate electrode includes a second work function controlling film, which is between the third and fourth sheet patterns, and a second filling conductive film on the second work function controlling film. A distance between the third and fourth sheet patterns is greater than a distance between the first and second sheet patterns.

title: Organization hierarchy systems and methods
abstract: This disclosure provides systems, methods, and apparatuses, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for accessing information associated with an organization hierarchy. In one aspect of the disclosure, a method includes transmitting, from a device to a server in which multiple group models are stored, an access request to access a first group model of the multiple group models. Each group model of the multiple group models is associated with a different organization and includes multiple group data structures, multiple group type data structures, and multiple group member data structures. Each group model is associated with group hierarchy information that indicates a hierarchy associated with the multiple group data structures associated with the group model. The method further includes receiving, at the device and based on the access request, first hierarchy information associated with a first group model. Other aspects and features are also claimed and described.

title: Signal receiving method and apparatus, signal sending method and apparatus, and storage medium
abstract: A signal receiving method, performed by a base station, includes: configuring a plurality of sounding reference signal (SRS) resource sets for a terminal; wherein the plurality of SRS resource sets are used by the terminal to perform a simultaneous transmission from multiple panels (STxMP); sending the plurality of SRS resource sets to the terminal; and receiving an SRS sent by the terminal from the plurality of SRS resource sets.
assignee: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.

title: Vehicle battery module comprising power conversion device, and vehicle battery system formed on basis of plurality of vehicle battery modules
abstract: The present invention relates to a vehicle battery module comprising a power conversion device, and a three-phase vehicle battery system formed on the basis of a plurality of vehicle battery modules. The vehicle battery module comprises a battery, a DC/DC converter, and a three-phase alternating current unit for outputting a three-phase alternating current module voltage. The three-phase vehicle battery system comprises: a direct current system output terminal which includes a plurality of vehicle battery modules, and which is formed by connecting, in parallel, the direct current module output terminals included in each of the plurality of vehicle battery modules; and a three-phase alternating current system output terminal formed by serially connecting, by phase, the three-phase alternating current module output terminals included in each of the plurality of vehicle battery modules.

title: Distortion estimation device, receiver, and distortion estimation method
abstract: A receiver receives a polarization multiplexed signal that has been transmitted from a transmitter via a transmission path. An equalization filter performs an equalization process on the received signal to which nonlinear distortion has been applied in at least one of the transmitter, the transmission path, and the receiver. A coefficient update unit adaptively controls respective filter coefficients of an in-receiver distortion compensation filter, a transmission path distortion compensation filter, and an in-transmitter distortion compensation filter. A distortion detection unit, after convergence of the filter coefficients, detects distortion in the receiver on the basis of the filter coefficient of the in-receiver distortion compensation filter and detects distortion in the transmitter on the basis of the filter coefficient of the in-transmitter distortion compensation filter.

title: Universal flexible clamp
abstract: A clamp for adjustable mounting to a ceiling and receiving a structural framing member having a base plate with multiple base plate slots and two side plates extending from the base plate with rows of slots disposed on a first side plate for fastening the framing member, wherein the distance between the side plate corresponds to the width of the structural framing member.

title: Method And Production System For The Manufacture Of Artificial Aglomerate Material Slabs
abstract: The present disclosure is related to a method and a system for manufacturing slabs of artificial agglomerate material with novel aesthetic effects. A slab manufactured by the method is also claimed and may be used for counters, kitchen tops, sinks, shower trays, wall cladding, flooring or the like. The method comprises the following steps: dispensing a first layer of a first mixture onto a surface; creating groove(s) in the first layer; dispensing a second mixture inside the groove(s); dispensing a third mixture inside the groove(s); wherein the first, second and third mixture are all different mixtures, each comprising 85-95% wt of a particulate material and  5 - 15 % wt of a binder; and compacting and hardening the combination of first, second and third mixtures.

title: Low temperature optical waveguide device fabrication method
abstract: The present invention concerns an optical waveguide device ( 1 ) fabrication method comprising providing at least one optical waveguide or optical waveguide core ( 3 ); and depositing at least one silicon dioxide layer or material ( 15 ) onto the at least one optical waveguide or optical waveguide core ( 3 ) to form a cladding or passivation layer of the optical waveguide device ( 1 ). The at least one silicon dioxide layer or material ( 15 ) is deposited by plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition using precursors comprising or consisting of silicon tetrachloride and at least one oxidizer, the plasma being an inductively coupled plasma.

title: Covert Surveillance Using Multi-Modality Sensing
abstract: The present specification discloses a covert mobile inspection vehicle with a backscatter X-ray scanning system that has an X-ray source and detectors for obtaining a radiographic image of an object outside the vehicle. The systems preferably include at least one sensor for determining a distance front at least one of the detectors to points on the surface of the object being scanned, a processor for processing the obtained radiographic image by using the determined distance of the object to obtain an atomic number of each material contained in the object, and one or more sensors to obtain surveillance data from a predefined area surrounding the vehicle.

title: High-Efficiency Rotary Engine with Perpendicular Force Transmission and Compound Energy Recovery System
abstract: A novel rotary engine is disclosed featuring a straight-axis rotor and perpendicular force transmission, significantly improving torque efficiency and reducing mechanical loss. The system utilizes modular sealed combustion chambers, with each module executing a simplified three-stage cycle. Exhaust energy is recovered via a turbocharger and heat exchanger, yielding thermal efficiency exceeding 60%. The multi-module configuration ensures continuous torque output with enhanced durability and reduced complexity.

title: Durable bimetallic heat exchanger for high performance applications
abstract: A heat exchanger including at least one heat exchanger wall comprising a first side integral with a second side, the first side comprising a first material with a first coefficient of thermal expansion and the second side comprising a second material with a second coefficient of thermal expansion, wherein the first side is configured to grow equally to the second side responsive to a temperature gradient between the first side and the second side; and a thermally constrained feature formed adjacent the at least one heat exchanger wall.

title: Methods and systems for providing an interactive platform to generate at least one control pattern to control adult toys
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods and systems for providing an interactive platform for adult entertainment. A system maintains a set of interactive contents associated with at least one control pattern for at least one sexual stimulation device. Each interactive content includes social feature information generated based on interaction inputs of at least one creator of the interactive platform, and the social feature information characterizes control features of the control pattern. The system receives a request from a user to access the interactive contents associated with the control pattern, renders the interactive contents to enable a preview of at least a portion of the control features, and transmits the rendered interactive contents to the user's device for display.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and recording medium
abstract: An information processing apparatus according to the present disclosure includes at least one memory storing instructions; and at least one processor configured to execute the instructions to: receive pieces of information of a plurality of individuals; generate, based on pieces of the information of the plurality of individuals received, a group organization plan using a machine learning model with at least one of age balance, personality compatibility, a movement distance, avoidance of a dangerous spot, a meeting time, and an ability as a constraint condition; and output the group organization plan generated. This apparatus leverages AI-based machine learning to enable reliable and efficient decision making in group formation.

title: Managing resource tag syntax compliance in hybrid cloud computing environments
abstract: A technique includes receiving an API request. The API request includes data representing a candidate tag for a resource associated with a hybrid cloud computing environment. The hybrid cloud computing environment is associated with a plurality of cloud service providers. The technique incudes managing a resource tag syntax compliance, including determining, for each ruleset of a plurality of rulesets, whether the candidate tag complies with the ruleset. Each ruleset is associated with a different cloud service provider. Managing the resource tag syntax compliance includes, based on the determination, providing an API response. The API response represents whether the candidate tag is valid for the hybrid cloud computing environment.

title: System and method for centralized steam cleaning
abstract: Certain examples of the disclosure concern a centralized steam cleaning system which includes a central control unit and a pipe network distributed within a building. The pipe network can include a vacuum pipeline and a water pipeline extending alongside each other.

title: Real-time modification to a shipment plan
abstract: One embodiment provides a method, the method including: generating, utilizing a shipment ordering system, a shipment plan, wherein the shipment plan comprises at least one transportation order for at least one object; receiving, at the shipment ordering system, user input comprising a modification for modifying at least one variable of the shipment plan; validating, using the shipment ordering system, the modification to the shipment plan against information of the shipment ordering system; and tracking, utilizing the shipment ordering system, transportation of the at least one object in view of the shipment plan. Other aspects are claimed and described.

title: Low-density polyethylene/elemental sulfur hybrid composite electrode material for supercapacitors
abstract: A supercapacitor includes an electrode including: a hybrid composite material including a polymer matrix and elemental sulfur dispersed in the polymer matrix, wherein the polymer matrix includes low-density polyethylene (LDPE) homopolymer, and wherein a weight percentage of the elemental sulfur in the hybrid composite material ranges from 10 wt % to 30 wt %; a polymeric binder; and a conductive filler.
assignee: Khalifa University of Science and Technology

title: Multifunctional heteroleptic polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane (poss) and fabrication methods thereof
abstract: A method for fabricating multifunctional heteroleptic polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane (POSS) in a single reaction vessel is introduced. The method involves creating an alkaline environment by adding a first organic solvent, water, and a base, followed by the dropwise introduction of organosilanes at a controlled rate of 0.1-0.5 g per second to prevent rapid gelation. The organosilanes, constituting 15-50% of the solution, undergo hydrolysis and condensation reactions at a defined temperature and duration, converting alkoxy groups to silanol groups and forming siloxane bonds, resulting in POSS cage structures. The reaction mixture is then adjusted to a pH of 3-5 by adding acid to quench condensation, stabilize the POSS, and prevent aggregation, yielding a POSS crude product.
assignee: Nano And Advanced Materials Institute Limited

title: Electronic device including structure for reducing damage to flexible display
abstract: A foldable electronic device is provided. The foldable electronic device includes a housing including a first housing part and a second housing part, a flexible display disposed on the first housing part and the second housing part, the flexible display including a bending region configured to be bent in a folded state of the foldable electronic device, a hinge assembly disposed under the flexible display, the hinge assembly rotatably connecting the second housing part to the first housing part, a support plate coupled to the hinge assembly, the support plate including a recess facing the bending region, wherein a portion of the bending region is disposed in a space provided by the recess in the folded state, and an elastic member disposed between the bending region and the support plate.

title: Methods and Apparatus of Simplified Template Cost Computation for Cross-component Prediction Merge Mode
abstract: A method and apparatus using simplified template cost computation are disclosed. According to this method, a set of CCP (Cross-Component Prediction) candidates for the current block is determined. Model errors associated with the set of CCP candidates are determined based on reconstructed samples and predicted samples of one or more templates of the current block, wherein the predicted samples of one or more templates of the current block for each candidate in the set of CCP candidates are generated using a partial model, partial model parameters, precision-reduced model parameters, or a combination thereof. Member candidates in the set of CCP candidates are reordered according to the model errors to form a set of reordered CCP candidates. A target candidate is selected from the set of reordered CCP candidates. The second-colour block is encoded or decoded by using prediction data comprising cross-colour prediction generated using the target candidate.

title: Schedule management method, and electronic device for supporting same
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a communication module, at least one processor including a processing circuit, and memory for storing at least one storage medium, wherein the at least one storage medium store instructions that, when executed individually or in combination by the at least one processor, cause the electronic device to obtain schedule information based on a user input, determine a start time associated with a schedule based on at least part of the schedule information, set a preparation time for generating of an automatic alarm generation based on the start time, in response to an arrival of the preparation time, determine whether a sleep state of a user is maintained using information received through the communication module, in response to the determining that the sleep state of the user is maintained, determine an alarm occurrence time of the automatic alarm based on the at least part of the schedule information, and generate the automatic alarm based on the automatic alarm occurrence time of the automatic alarm.

title: Alignment Stage and Secondary Battery Manufacturing Apparatus Including the Same
abstract: Disclosed are an alignment stage and a secondary battery manufacturing apparatus including the same. The alignment stage includes a first plate at least partially made of a first material having light transmittance and a second plate at least partially made of a second material having light transmittance, the second plate being disposed on one surface of the first plate, the second plate being provided with a suction surface configured to allow an electrode sheet to be adhered thereto by suction, wherein the second material has higher hardness than the first material.

title: Packet data convergence protocol (pdcp) control upper-layer control protocol data units (pdu) protection
abstract: Systems and techniques are described herein for securing communications. For example, a process for securing communications can include: determining, at a packet data convergence protocol (PDCP) layer, that a received PDCP protocol data unit (PDU) comprises a PDCP control PDU; generating a keystream block for deciphering a payload of the PDCP control PDU based on a count number associated with the PDCP control PDU; and deciphering the payload of the PDCP control PDU using the keystream block.

title: Substrate processing apparatus, processing liquid supply device, substrate processing method and processing liquid supply method
abstract: A substrate processing apparatus includes a plurality of chambers and a processing liquid supply device that supplies a processing liquid to each chamber. The processing liquid supply device includes a storage tank provided below the plurality of chambers and a circulation pipe that causes the processing liquid in the storage tank to circulate. Further, the processing liquid supply device includes a temperature adjuster, a plurality of chamber supply pipes and a chamber collection pipe. The temperature adjuster adjusts a temperature of the circulating processing liquid to a target temperature. Each chamber supply pipe guides the circulating processing liquid to a corresponding chamber. The chamber collection pipe returns the processing liquid used in each chamber to the storage tank. A branch pipe is provided to connect part of the circulation pipe to part of the chamber collection pipe. An adjusting valve is provided in the branch pipe.

title: Monitoring an environment to control an active reflected wave detector
abstract: An environment is monitored to control an active reflected wave detector. It is determined, based on an output from a different device to the active reflected wave detector, whether a person is at an away location that is outside a region of interest during a time period that is after a detected triggering event. In response to a predefined criterion being met, the active reflected wave detector is switched from a first state to operate in a second state in which the active reflected wave detector measures wave reflections from a region of interest. The active reflected wave detector consumes more power in the second state than in the first state. The predefined criterion comprises that the time period has expired. If a condition comprising that a person is at an away location during the time period is satisfied, it is concluded that the predefined criterion is not met.

title: Protocol-data-unit-set-based discarding or processing
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a transmitter may receive a configuration of one or more packet data convergence protocol (PDCP) discard timers for protocol data unit (PDU) sets, the configuration indicating one or more PDU set parameters corresponding to the one or more PDCP discard timers. The transmitter may communicate in accordance with the configuration. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Power electronics component with cooling and a power converter
abstract: A power electronics component, including a first substrate with an upper and lower metallization layer and a semiconductor assembly mounted on the first substrate which has a connection to a first region of the upper metallization layer of the first substrate facing the semiconductor assembly. The power electronics component further includes a first heat sink, a first side of which faces the first substrate and is thermally connected to the lower metallization layer of the first substrate, which faces away from the semiconductor assembly. The power electronics component includes an additional substrate having an upper and lower metallization layer, the additional substrate being attached to a second side of the first heat sink opposite the first side, and the second side of the first heat sink being connected to the upper metallization layer of the additional substrate facing -the first heat sink.

title: Impedance calibration method, electronic device, medium, and product
abstract: This application provides an impedance calibration method, an electronic device, a medium, and a product, and relates to the field of terminal device technologies. The method may be applied to the electronic device and includes: determining whether a state of a sensor satisfies a preset condition; obtaining an impedance point position of a current antenna if it is determined that the state of the sensor satisfies the preset condition; and using the impedance point position of the current antenna as a position of reference impedance if it is determined that an impedance position of the current antenna is in preset free space. According to this application, whether an antenna of the electronic device is in a free space scenario is determined by determining whether the state of the sensor satisfies the preset condition and determining whether the impedance position of the current antenna is in the preset free space.

title: Modular animal collar system with interchangeable attachments
abstract: A modular animal collar system comprising a base collar with a continuous loop-compatible fastening surface and a reusable external attachment having a hook-fastening underside. The attachment features a flush-edge interface that aligns vertically with the collar edge to resist torsional peeling when engaged with the loop-compatible fastening surface of the collar. The attachment includes a rigid terminal tip to facilitate insertion beneath leash-attachment hardware and a multi-functional terminal loop tab. The tab serves as a tactile purchase point for peeling removal and as a mechanical latch to secure the attachment in a compacted storage roll with the hook surface facing outward.

title: Primary latch mechanism for a banknote processing device
abstract: A primary latch mechanism for a banknote processing device includes a first latch component designed to engage with a second latch component. The first latch component features a lever arm with a recess and a guide surface. The second latch component includes an engagement pin and a guide pin. The recess can receive the engagement pin to lock the mechanism. The guide surface contacts the guide pin when the first latch component moves relative to the second latch component, allowing the guide surface to slide along the guide pin. This movement partially releases the engagement pin from the recess, enabling the latch to unlock.

title: Current collector, electrode sheet, secondary battery, electric device, copper foil, and preparation method for copper foil
abstract: A current collector, an electrode sheet, a secondary battery, an electric device, a copper foil, and a preparation method for the copper foil are described. The current collector comprises the copper foil, the average particle size of the crystal grains in the copper foil ranges from 50 nm to 400 nm, and based on the total number of crystal grains in the copper foil, the proportion of the crystal grains of nano twin crystals is greater than or equal to 60%. The combination of the high proportion nano twin crystal structure and the small crystal grain size functions to improve the mechanical strength of the current collector while maintaining the high plasticity of the current collector, thereby providing a material basis for further improvement of the energy density and safety of the battery.

title: Bridge package for wire bonding in stacked semiconductor devices, and associated systems and methods
abstract: Stacked semiconductor devices and associated systems and methods are disclosed herein. A stacked semiconductor device according to the present technology can include a base substrate, a bridge package integrated with the base substrate, and a plurality of dies carried by the base substrate adjacent to the controller die. The bridge package includes an interposer, a controller integrated with a lower surface of the interposer, and a wire bond bridge integrated with an upper surface of the interposer. The controller is coupled to the base substrate and the wire bond bridge via the interposer. The plurality of dies can include a first tier and a second tier carried by the first tier. The first tier includes a plurality of first dies coupled to the active surface via first wire bonds. The second tier includes a plurality of second dies coupled to the wire bond bridge via second wire bonds.

title: Generating insights for software applications and routing customized recommendations for target entities
abstract: One or more configurations associated with a plurality of software applications within a distributed computing infrastructure are obtained. Data associated with a plurality of software applications operating within a distributed computing infrastructure is obtained. First resource data is received from data sources and second resource data is generated in a format different from the first resource data. The second resource data is integrated into a data source using one or more configurations associated with the software applications. An indication of data points corresponding to the second resource data is received. Information identifying a target entity is obtained from the indication or metadata associated with the target entity. A recommendation object generated from a portion of the second resource data is determined.

title: Noise suppressing apparatus, noise suppression method, and program
abstract:
The present disclosure relates to a noise suppressing apparatus, a noise suppression method, and a program that make it possible to appropriately reduce noise. 
     When a sudden sound is sensed on the basis of a sensor signal of a sensor in an FF-scheme NC apparatus, a drive signal to be supplied to an actuator in an FB-scheme NC apparatus is reduced. This can be applied to an NC apparatus.

title: Rotary machine
abstract: The disclosure provides rotary machines that include, in one embodiment, a rotatable shaft defining a central axis A, the shaft having a first end and a second end. The shaft can have a first hub disposed thereon with a plurality of cavities. At least one contour is slidably received into an arcuate cavity in an exterior surface of the hub. The contour has a convex outer surface that cooperates with an inwardly facing curved surface of a housing to form a working volume.

title: Transfer switch with delayed optimal power transfer
abstract: A power distribution apparatus is disclosed. In one embodiment, the power distribution apparatus includes a first power source configured to provide electrical power to a load and a second power source configured to provide electrical power to the load. A transfer switch is configured to switch a source of power to the load between the first power source and the second power source. A control circuit is configured to cause the transfer switch to cause a transfer of power to the load from the first power source to the second power source in response to a user command and to delay the transfer of power to within a specified transfer time window carry out the transfer of power at a time within the transfer time window and based on a phase relationship between power provided by the first power and second power sources.

title: Method for Forming an Interconnect Structure
abstract: There is provided a method for forming an interconnect structure for an integrated circuit device. The method includes forming a workpiece for a second interconnect layer on a sacrificial substrate. The workpiece includes at least a first workpiece metal layer epitaxially grown on a growth surface of the sacrificial substrate. The method further includes bonding the workpiece to an initial interconnect structure of a device wafer. The initial interconnect structure includes a first interconnect layer surrounded by an interlayer dielectric layer. Subsequent to the bonding, the method also includes removing the sacrificial substrate from the first workpiece metal layer. Further, the method includes patterning the workpiece that includes the first workpiece metal layer to form a second interconnect layer over the first interconnect layer.

title: Stormwater management crate assembly with convex side panels
abstract: Stormwater management systems, methods, and apparatus for containing and filtering runoff may be provided. In one implementation, a stormwater management crate for managing stormwater runoff may be provided. The stormwater management crate may include a top plate having a first plurality of support column attachments and one or more support column assemblies located below the top plate; the one or more support column assemblies being affixed to the top plate at the support column attachments. The stormwater management crate may further include an intermediate plate may be located below the top plate and above the bottom plate. The intermediate plate may have a third plurality of support column attachments. The intermediate plate may be lightweight and may weigh less than one or both of the top plate and the bottom plate.

title: Electronic device and human-computer interaction method
abstract: In a human-computer interaction method, a second electronic device receives a first picture and identification information of at least one application that are sent by a first electronic device based on a first operation. The second electronic device displays the first picture and an icon of the at least one application. The second electronic device receives a second operation performed on a first icon, where the first icon is one icon in the icon of the at least one application. In response to the second operation, content of an application window of a first application displayed by the second electronic device is the same as that of an application window of the first application opened on a first interface.

title: Memory system and control method
abstract: A memory system is provided that improves a transfer rate when a host's reception buffer has limited free space. According to one embodiment, the memory system includes a non-volatile memory and a controller. The controller is in communication with the host and controls the non-volatile memory. The controller acquires reception credit information from the host that indicates a size of free space available in the host's reception buffer. Based on the acquired reception credit information, the controller adjusts a size of the packet to be transmitted to the host.

title: Sensor system, sensor device, and ap device
abstract: A sensor system includes: a sensor device; and an application processor (AP) device that uses the sensor device, in which the sensor device includes: a first in-sensor power domain (PD) and a second in-sensor PD of which power-on and power-off can be individually controlled; and a TxIF circuit that is provided across the first in-sensor PD and the second in-sensor PD and transmits data, the AP device includes: a first in-AP PD and a second in-AP PD of which power-on and power-off can be individually controlled; and an RxIF circuit that is provided across the first in-AP PD and the second in-AP PD and receives the data, the first in-sensor PD and the first in-AP PD provide a layer higher than a physical layer, and the second in-sensor PD and the second in-AP PD provide the physical layer.

title: Electrolyte and use thereof in an electrochemical cell
abstract: A gel polymer electrolyte comprises a polymer matrix and a liquid electrolyte that is trapped and retained within the polymer matrix. The polymer matrix is provided by a copolymer that comprises linear polymer chains having a monofunctional repeating unit and crosslinkers that provide a polymeric cross-linking function between the linear chains.

title: Method and apparatus for providing dynamic unavailability information in wireless lan communication system
abstract: A method performed by an access point (AP) for indicating unavailability information in a wireless local area network (WLAN) communication system is provided. The method includes determining dynamic unavailability time information for a period during which the AP is unable to utilize a duration of transmission opportunity and the dynamic unavailability time information includes at least one of a start time of unavailability time slot or a duration of unavailability; indicating the dynamic unavailability time information in a control frame; and transmitting, to at least one non-AP station, the control frame.

title: Composite graphite material, method for preparing same, negative electrode sheet, secondary battery, battery module, battery pack, and electrical apparatus
abstract: Disclosed are a composite graphite material, a method for preparing the same, a negative electrode sheet, a secondary battery, a battery module, a battery pack, and an electrical apparatus. The composite graphite material comprises a bulk particle and a cladding layer located on at least a partial surface of the bulk particle, the bulk particle is a secondary particle formed by aggregation of more than two primary particles, the bulk particle comprises artificial graphite, the cladding layer comprises amorphous carbon, and an air oxidation temperature T 0  of the composite graphite material is from 630° C. to 730° C. The composite graphite material in the present application can enable the secondary battery to not only have a high energy density, but also have significantly improved fast charging performance and low-temperature power performance.

title: Cellulose-based voc barrier
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a layered assembly comprising a VOC-impermeable cellulose-based layer, a method of insulating against VOCs using a VOC-impermeable cellulose-based layer, and a method of preparing a layered assembly comprising a VOC-impermeable cellulose-based layer.

title: Methods and apparatus for matrix multiplication with reinforcement learning
abstract: Technical solutions for matrix multiplication with reinforcement learning are disclosed. An example apparatus includes interface circuitry, machine readable instructions, and programmable circuitry to at least one of instantiate or execute the machine readable instructions to identify matrices to be multiplied, split the matrices into subgroups, determine an initial tiling state based on the subgroups, determine an action to perform on the matrices, transform the initial tiling state by executing the action on the matrices, calculate a tiling state latency based on executing the action on the matrices, and update the initial tiling state based on at least one of the transformed tiling state or the calculated tiling state latency.

title: Concrete pole with energy dissipation mechanism and stabilizing system and its construction method
abstract: Disclosed herein is a concrete pole equipped with an energy-dissipating mechanism and stabilizing system. The disclosed concrete pole consists of several pre-cast parts of hollow reinforced concrete connected to each other and to the pole with two sets of post-tensioning cables in a special order. A group of cables, known as peripheral cables, pass through the pipes embedded in the wall of the parts and pass through all the pre-cast parts together. Another set of cables, known as central cables, pass through the middle of all the parts and are tied at the top of the upper part to connect the pole to the foundation and create stability. The mild steel bars in the lower part of the pole are responsible for energy dissipation and providing ductility during the lateral deformation of the pole caused by the sever earthquakes.

title: Enhanced Microbial Production of Biosurfactants and Other Products, and Uses Thereof
abstract: This present invention relates to compositions and methods of microbial enhanced oil recovery using  Bacillus subtilis  strains. The invention also relates to compositions and methods for performing oil degradation with  Bacillus subtilis  strains. The compositions and methods of the present invention are also used for enhanced commercial biosurfactant and enzyme production.

title: Facilitating user selection of trackable objects in video content
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for facilitating user-selection of trackable objects portrayed in a video are described. In some implementations, a system may obtain video information defining a video with a progress length, including a sequence of frames corresponding to individual moments along the progress length. The system may detect a set of one or more objects in a first frame, determine values of an apparent size parameter and a position parameter for each detected object, and define a first object search area in a second, non-adjacent frame based on the position parameter of a first object. The system may identify candidate objects in the search area, determine their apparent size parameters, and detect the first object in the second frame by matching the apparent size parameter. Responsive to this detection, the system may visually indicate the first object as a trackable object during playback of the video.

title: Identifying, quantifying, and phenotyping vascular calcification in patients
abstract: A method for identifying, quantifying, and phenotyping vascular calcification (VC) in patients includes accessing a set of medical scan images of a vascular tissue sample extracted from the one or more patients, and further inputting the set of medical scan images into one or more machine-learning models trained to segment the set of medical scan images to identify a tissue region, a lipid pool region, and a set of vascular calcifications detectable from the set of medical scan images.
