The method further includes determining, based on the segmented set of medical scan images, one or more feature characteristics corresponding to each of the identified set of vascular calcifications, and identifying each of the identified set of vascular calcifications as corresponding to one or more of a plurality of vascular calcification phenotypes based at least in part on the one or more feature characteristics and the identified lipid pool region.
assignee: University Of Pittsburgh - Of The Commonwealth System Of Higher Education

title: Control device and method for determining allowable output power of battery
abstract: A first voltage drop amount calculation unit calculates a first voltage drop amount of a battery, based on open-circuit voltage based on a current value and a voltage value. An actual discharge voltage calculation unit calculates actual discharge voltage of the battery cell, based on the first voltage drop amount. A second voltage drop amount calculation unit calculates a second voltage drop amount of the battery when it is assumed that predetermined current is flowed for a predetermined time, based on the actual discharge voltage. A virtual discharge voltage calculation unit calculates virtual discharge voltage of the battery, based on the second voltage drop amount. A resistance value calculation unit calculates a virtual resistance value of the battery, based on the virtual discharge voltage. A first allowable output power calculation unit calculates first allowable output power, based on the virtual resistance value.

title: Shortening of service interruption time for llm in ran4
abstract: Described herein is a user equipment, UE, served by a source cell of a first network node that supports distributed unit, DU, functionality and/or a layer  2  protocol processing of a radio access network, RAN, the UE comprising: at least one processor, and at least one memory storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, cause the UE at least to: generate L1 measurements for a plurality of candidate target cells controlled by the first network node, wherein said plurality of candidate target cells are selected based on L3 measurements generated by the UE; determine if said plurality of candidate target cells complies with one or more preset conditions for the UE to execute handover from said serving source cell to at least one of said plurality of candidate target cells for L1L2-triggered mobility, LTM; and transmit, preferably periodically, an L1 measurement report to the first network node, wherein said L1 measurement report is provided by the UE based on said determination relating to said one or more preset conditions, wherein said one or more preset conditions comprise: that Synchronization Signal/PBCH Blocks, SSBs, of said plurality of candidate target cells are detectable, and/or that a first timer has not expired since a first time point indicated by a first timestamp related to an L3 measurement report comprising said L3 measurements, and the UE is further caused to: at a second time point indicated by a second timestamp related to said L1 measurement report, determine if said first timer has expired, wherein said L3 measurement report is the latest L3 measurement report generated by the UE at the time of preparing said L1 measurement report.

title: Customer monitoring assistance device, customer monitoring assistance method, and recording medium
abstract: This customer monitoring assistance device includes, an acquisition unit for acquiring a moving image obtained by imaging the movement of the hands of a customer that operates a self-checkout register; a determination unit for determining, on the basis of the imaged customer hand movement, whether the customer is possibly performing a fraudulent act or is unfamiliar with the operation of the self-checkout register; and an output unit for outputting different contents according to the determination result. If it was determined that there is a possibility that the customer is performing a fraudulent act, the output unit outputs a notification indicating that there is a customer who may be performing a fraudulent act. When it is determined that the customer is unfamiliar with the operation, the output unit outputs an instruction to assist the customer determined to be unfamiliar with the operation.

title: Package comprising elongated landing pad interconnects and/or elongated pillar interconnects
abstract: A package comprising a substrate comprising at least one dielectric layer; and a plurality of interconnects comprising: a first plurality of landing pad interconnects, wherein at least one landing pad interconnect from the first plurality of landing pad interconnects has an elongated planar shape; and a second plurality of landing pad interconnects, wherein at least one landing pad interconnect from the second plurality of landing pad interconnects has an elongated planar shape; and an integrated device coupled to the first plurality of landing pad interconnects and the second plurality of landing pad interconnects.

title: 3d ferroelectric memory device
abstract: Provided is a 3D ferroelectric memory device. The 3D ferroelectric memory device may include a plurality of gate electrodes stacked on a substrate in a first direction; a plurality of ferroelectric layers on the plurality of gate electrodes in a second direction; a plurality of intermediate electrodes on the plurality of ferroelectric layers in the second direction; a first insulating layer between the plurality of gate electrodes and between the plurality of intermediate electrodes; a second insulating layer on the plurality of intermediate electrodes and the first insulating layer; and a channel layer on the second insulating layer.

title: Ai-assisted user input for accessibility
abstract: System and method herein use AI model-generated control outputs to improve game controllers and user's video game experiences. The system is configured receive, from a controller including controls manually actuatable by a user, controls actuation information (e.g., left trigger, left button, left joystick actuation, etc.) associated with a video game, and determine accessibility information of the user that indicates a limitation to manual actuation of the controller (e.g., injury to left causing less than 50% actuation of left controls). A control output is generated by using an artificial intelligence (AI) model. The AI model is trained to assist video game users with controller inputs in association with accessibility limits for using the controllers, and generate control outputs based on the controls actuation information and the accessibility information. The control output can be used to cause control of executing the video game.

title: Fast charging port for dc ups
abstract: An uninterruptible power supply (UPS) is presented. The UPS includes a first input configured to receive first DC power; a second input configured to receive second DC power; an output configured to provide a first output DC power to a load; and a power train including at least one energy-storage interface configured to be coupled to an energy-storage device, the power train being coupled to the first input, the second input, and the output, and being configured to direct at least a portion of the first DC power from the first input to the output to provide the first output DC power to the load, and direct, via the at least one energy-storage interface, the second DC power as a second output DC power to the energy-storage device.

title: Transportable single unit parabolic lighting system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a single unit parabolic lighting system including a lamp housing including an outside surface; an inside surface; a lamp mounting located on the centermost part of the inside surface and comprising a locking lamp support configured to accommodate a plurality of pin spacings; and a quick connection and disconnection mounting system; a molded composite yoke comprising a base and an arm extending away from the base, wherein the arm comprises an arm connector having a motorized drive with inductive position feedback that mechanically connects to the outside surface of the lamp housing and is configured to tilt the lamp housing with respect to the arm connector of the yoke about a 120° range; and a truss attachment base comprising a truss connector and a yoke connector having a motorized drive with inductive position feedback that mechanically connects to the base of the molded composite yoke.

title: Vehicle lamp illumination module and vehicle lamp
abstract: A vehicle lamp illumination module and a vehicle lamp are provided. The vehicle lamp illumination module includes a circuit board, a light source arranged on the circuit board, and a reflective mirror and an optical lens arranged in sequence in the direction of light path transmission, light emitted from the light source is reflected by the reflective mirror and is then projected through the optical lens to form an illumination light pattern; the light source includes a first light source and a second light source which have the same light emission direction; the reflective mirror includes a first reflecting surface corresponding to the first light source and a second reflecting surface corresponding to the second light source; the optical lens includes a first optical lens corresponding to the first reflecting surface and a second optical lens corresponding to the second reflecting surface.

title: Methods, apparatuses and systems for intelligent reflection surface installed user equipment channel estimation
abstract: Methods, apparatuses and systems for intelligent reflection surface (IRS) installed user equipment (UE) channel estimation. In one embodiment, a wireless communication node includes: a transceiver configured to transmit a first signal, a plurality of second signals and a plurality of third signals to a wireless communication device, wherein the first signal comprises a configuration message to instruct the wireless communication device to receive a plurality of second signals and a plurality of third signals; and a receiver configured to receive a plurality of fourth signals generated by an Intelligent Reflecting Surface (IRS) coupled to the wireless communication device, wherein the plurality of fourth signals is generated by the IRS by reflecting the plurality of third signals, and wherein the plurality of fourth signals is used to perform a channel estimation between the wireless communication device and the wireless communication node.

title: Demodulation reference signal patterns for start and length indicator values
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may receive an indication of a start and length indicator value (SLIV) that indicates a time domain resource allocation of more than one slot. The UE may communicate a plurality of demodulation reference signals (DMRSs) in accordance with one or more DMRS patterns associated with one or more time segments including one or more boundaries in the more than one slot. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Efficient management of monitor configuration data in a remote desktop environment
abstract: Methods, computer systems, and computer storage media are provided for facilitating implementation of efficient management of monitor configuration data in a remote desktop environment. In embodiments, a dynamic virtual channel established between a remote desktop client device and a remote desktop server is used to provide a global set of monitor configuration data for a remote desktop session. Thereafter, at the remote desktop client device, an updated set of monitor configuration data is identified during the remote desktop session. The updated set of monitor configuration data for the remote desktop session is provided to the remote desktop server via the dynamic virtual channel.

title: Firmware updating method and electronic device, electronic system using the firmware updating method
abstract: A firmware updating method, applied to a host, comprising: the host transmitting a transmitting sequence for a target device, wherein the transmitting sequence is for updating a firmware of the target device; the host initiating a monitor procedure to identify whether transmission of the transmitting sequence is finished or interrupted; the host terminating the monitor procedure if the transmission is finished; and the monitor procedure providing a notice signal to the target device or the host if the transmission is interrupted. By this way, the host or the target device can be notified of the firmware update interrupting, and the host or the target device can operate correspondingly.

title: High Temperature Superconductors
abstract: This disclosure relates to compounds of formula (I): L n D m (B x B′ 1-x ) r (Z t Z′ 1-t ) q M p A y A′ s  (I), in which n, m, x, r, t, q, p, y, s, L, D, B, B′, Z, Z′, M, A, and A′ are defined in the specification. These compounds can exhibit superconductivity at a high temperature. This disclosure also features a fault current limiter device, including an electrically conducting element including a superconducting material having a superconducting state below a critical current and a normal conductive state above the critical current.

title: Energy storage device and energy storage system
abstract: An energy storage device and an energy storage system is provided and includes an electrode core. A plurality of layers of tabs of the electrode core include a central tab, a first side tab, and a second side tab. A Cartesian coordinate system is established with a root of the second side tab as an origin, a thickness direction of the electrode core as an x-axis, and an extension direction of the tab as a y-axis. A coordinate of the root of any tab is (x, 0). When the plurality of layers of tabs are not bent and the first side surface is not oriented toward the electrode core, a coordinate of a connection position of the first side tab is (a, b). When the first side surface is oriented toward the electrode core, a coordinate of the connection position is (c, d), in which ((a−x) 2 +b 2 )−{(c−x) 2 +d 2 }>0.
assignee: Xiamen Hithium Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Unified constraint systems for vector graphics
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and methods for generating a modified vector graphic for display by propagating a constraint entity. In one or more embodiments, the disclosed systems determine a constraint entity comprising a constraint type defining execution logic for the constraint entity and further comprising a set of constraint objects of the constraint type for a vector graphic. The disclosed systems detect a client device interaction modifying a constraint object within the set of constraint objects defined by the constraint entity. The disclosed systems generate a modified constraint entity in response to the interaction modifying the constraint object by updating the constraint entity according to the constraint type to reflect corresponding modifications to one or more related constraint objects within the set of constraint objects. The disclosed systems generate a modified vector graphic depicting the modified constraint entity for display on the client device.

title: Blockwise quality control of image processing
abstract: A method for encoding or decoding an image is provided. The method comprises obtaining pixel values of pixels included in the image. The method further comprises converting the pixel values into convoluted values using a convolution network that comprises a first convolution layer, wherein the first convolution layer is configured to receive first input values and generate first output values using a convolution operation. The method further comprises obtaining first quality values, and (i) combining the first quality values with the pixel values, thereby generating the first input values or (ii) combining the first quality values with the first output values, thereby generating first combined values.

title: Computer system, sample observation method, and program
abstract: Provided is a technology that can realize preferable image quality quantification regarding a technology of a sample observation apparatus and the like. A computer system in a sample observation apparatus for observing a sample includes at least one processor and at least one memory, and the processor determines a plurality of evaluation partial areas Si in an image  201  captured of the sample, and calculates a plurality of image quality evaluation values Ei for evaluating a plurality of different image quality items by calculating an image quality evaluation value Ei for each evaluation partial area Si on the basis of the plurality of evaluation partial areas Si.

title: Thin quantum barrier with high aluminum content for ultraviolet light emitters
abstract: A laser diode (LD) or light emitting diode (LED) fabricated on an Aluminum Nitride (AlN) template on a sapphire, bulk AlN, or Silicon Carbide (SiC) substrate, wherein the thickness of the quantum barrier is thinner than a conventional design and the Al content of the quantum barrier is higher than the conventional design. Improved crystal quality and radiative efficiency can be achieved by minimizing the strain from the lattice mismatch during the growth. The result is an efficient UV LD/LED with an emission wavelength between 300 nm and 370 nm.
assignee: The Regents Of The University Of California

title: Criteria to identify channel measurement resources for multiple time domain occasions layer 1 report
abstract: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may receive a channel state information (CSI) report configuration associated with reporting Layer 1 (L1) measurements across multiple occasions in a time domain. The UE may select, among a set of candidate channel measurement resources (CMRs) that are associated with L1 measurements across the multiple occasions in the time domain, one or more CMRs based on one or more candidate selection criteria, wherein the one or more candidate selection criteria are based on at least one of a relative strength of the L1 measurements or occasions in which the L1 measurements are obtained. The UE may transmit a CSI report that includes the L1 measurements associated with the one or more CMRs across the multiple occasions in the time domain. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Method for sidelink communication, first terminal, and second terminal
abstract: This disclosure relates to a method for sidelink (SL) communication. The method includes the following. A first terminal shares channel occupancy time (COT) with a second terminal when a first condition is satisfied.
assignee: Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd.

title: Closing device for a sliding door device and sliding door device
abstract: A closing device for a sliding door with at least one sliding door, includes a device body, displaceable first roller set, stationary second roller set, tension spring connected by first and second spring end pieces to the first and second roller sets, and pull rope guided with loops around the first and second roller sets and connecting with a first rope end piece directly or indirectly to the first roller set or the device body and leads out of the closing device with a second rope end piece. The device body includes a holding rail holding a roller carriage with carriage body coupled to the first spring end piece and first mounting shaft whereby the first roller set is supported, the device body connects to a connection device connecting to a drive unit drive body, and the connection device holds a deflection pulley around which the tension spring is guided.

title: Inductor component
abstract: An inductor component that includes an inductor wiring extending along a plane; pad portions at two ends of the inductor wiring; perpendicular wirings extending perpendicularly to the plane from the pad portions; and a first magnetic layer and a second magnetic layer that hold the inductor wiring therebetween. The first magnetic layer and the second magnetic layer have uniaxial magnetic anisotropy axes oriented in the same axial direction, and the inductor wiring extends throughout an entire area in a direction not orthogonal to a first one of the anisotropy axes (X-axis). A magnetic flux caused by the inductor wiring can thus be oriented along a first one of the anisotropy axes, and the effect of a second one of the anisotropy axes can be reduced.

title: Hybrid composite structure and process for forming utilizing high pressure die cast components with structural plastic overmold
abstract: A process, article and assembly for joining a plurality of individual castings into a hybrid composite, including providing a plurality of individual castings and arranging the castings in an arrayed fashion, transporting the arranged castings into an injection molding machine, and injecting a plasticized material between and around the castings for forming a single hybrid structure. Additional steps include the castings being provided as aluminum castings. The step of injecting a plasticized material further includes utilizing a High Pressure Die Casting (HPDC) technology with thermoplastic injection molding or over-molding techniques to form the single hybrid structure. The single hybrid structure further includes forming any of a vehicle frame, chassis or underbody. Alternatively, the step of forming a single hybrid structure can include forming an EV battery tray.

title: System and method for video selection and annotation
abstract: A system and method for improving operation of a physical security event processing system by generating and deploying event-specific alarm response agent applications. The method includes: receiving a human-provided rationale for non-resolution or resolution of an alarm; generating a candidate alarm-response policy using a language model and/or a vision-language model; deriving machine representations from event data including video analytics metadata, embeddings, and/or knowledge graph context; validating reproducibility of the rationale by computing similarity or pattern matches between stored reference representations and representations derived from subsequent events; and controlling an alarm subsystem by suppressing an alarm or creating an alarm when validated reproducibility conditions are satisfied, thereby reducing false alarms and reducing computing and network load.

title: Negative electrode for lithium-free secondary battery and lithium-free secondary battery comprising the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a negative electrode for lithium-free secondary battery which can improve the electrochemical and life time characteristics of a lithium-free secondary battery, a manufacturing method thereof and a lithium-free secondary battery. The negative electrode may include a conductive metal layer; and a lithium electrodeposition induction layer formed on the conductive metal layer and containing an intermetallic compound in which copper and zinc are bonded.
assignee: Lg Energy Solution, Ltd.; Korea Advanced Institute Of Science And Technology

title: Electrochemical system for generating acidic and basic solutions
abstract: An apparatus for producing acid and base solutions from salt solutions is provided. An anode and a cathode are provided. A bipolar component is between the anode and the cathode. A first separator is between the bipolar component and the anode. A second separator is between the bipolar component and the cathode. A first salt solution flow passage is between the anode and the first separator. A second salt solution flow passage is between the first separator and the bipolar component. A third salt solution flow passage is between the bipolar component and the second separator. A fourth salt solution flow passage is between the second separator and the cathode.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University

title: Diagnosis, monitoring or prognosis of type 2 diabetes, impaired glucose tolerance or prediabetes
abstract: The present invention refers to an in vitro method for the diagnosis, monitoring or prognosis of IGT/diabetes or prediabetes; or for screening or selecting patient candidates to be subjected to OGTT, which comprises assessing the amount of a protein, selected from the group consisting of: Retinol-Binding Protein 4 (Rbp), Alpha-1-acid glycoprotein (Agp), fibronectin (FN), and/or Complement factor H (CFH) which is bound to glycosaminoglycans (GAGs).
assignee: Servizo Galego De Saúde; Fundación Pública Galega Instituto De Investigación Sanitaria De Santiago De Compostela; Universidade De Santiago De Compostela

title: Plant-based chickpea milk
abstract: A composition including a source of starch; and chickpea protein isolate, chickpea protein concentrate, or combination thereof is provided. The source of starch may be chickpea flour and/or oat flour. The composition may include a consumable liquid, e.g. water, to provide a chickpea milk that may be used in place of a traditional dairy milk. The composition may be in the form of a dry blend that a consumer can reconstitute with a consumable liquid, e.g. water, to provide a chickpea milk. A method of making the composition is also provided. The method may include a step of combining: a consumable liquid; a source of starch; optionally, at least one edible plant-derived lipid and chickpea protein isolate, chickpea protein concentrate, or combination thereof. The method may include a step of subjecting the composition to enzyme treatment to provide a reduced viscosity composition.

title: Optoelectronic arrangement and method for operating the same
abstract: In an embodiment an optoelectronic arrangement includes a plurality of optoelectronic components, each having a main emission surface attachable to one or more optical fibres, wherein each of the plurality of optoelectronic components includes a semiconductor layer stack, and wherein each semiconductor layer stack has a first layer having a first doping type, a second layer having a second doping type different from the first doping type and an active region arranged in between the first and second layer, the active region configured to emit light of a first wavelength, and a light source configured to emit light of a second wavelength, the second wavelength being shorter than the first wavelength, wherein the light source is configured to illuminate the active regions of each semiconductor layer stack to generate, by the active regions of each semiconductor layer stack, photoluminescent light.

title: Dynamic non-uniform mesh generation for efficient virtual reality frame generation
abstract: An electronic device includes a memory and at least one processing device operatively connected to the memory. The at least one processing device is configured to receive contents to be displayed on a display. The at least one processing device is also configured to receive eye-tracking data from an eye-tracking sensor and lens field of view (FOV) data from the memory. The at least one processing device is also configured to generate a mesh using the eye-tracking data and the lens FOV data, wherein the mesh includes a high density area and a low density area, defined based at least partly on the lens FOV data. The at least one processing device is also configured to perform warping of the contents using the mesh. The at least one processing device is also configured to render the contents based on the warping of the contents.

title: Filter Apparatus
abstract: Disclosed is a filter apparatus with a filter housing comprising at least two housing parts, which can be connected re-releasably to one another by means of a connecting device. The connecting device, designed in the form of a bayonet closure, has individual closure elements on the one housing part, and those are spaced apart from one another such that further closure  70  elements of the other housing part engage at least in part into the spacings, wherein relative movement of the two housing parts causes the closure elements of one housing part and the other housing part to be brought into engagement with one another, or separated from one another, at least in part.

title: Semiconductor structure and method for forming the same
abstract: A semiconductor structure includes a substrate having active regions and  isolation structures, a plurality of  word line disposed in the substrate, extending along a second direction and arranged in parallel along a first direction, wherein the first direction and the second direction are perpendicular, a plurality of conductive plugs and second spacer structures alternately arranged along the first direction, wherein the second spacer structures are disposed on the word lines and have a second width  in the first direction, the conductive plugs are disposed on and electrically connected to the active regions, and a plurality of insulating plugs and first spacer structures alternately arranged along the first direction outside the conductive plugs and the second spacer structures, wherein the first spacer structures have a first width in the first direction, and the second width is smaller than the first width.
assignee: Fujian Jinhua Integrated Circuit Co., Ltd.

title: Combination of recombinant oncolytic virus and checkpoint inhibitor for the treatment of cancer
abstract: A pharmaceutical combination where a checkpoint inhibitor is combined with a recombinant oncolytic virus and the use of said combination for the treatment of cancer.
assignee: Virogin Biotech (Shanghai) Ltd.; Virogin Biotech Canada Ltd.

title: Device Identifier Dependent Operation Processing of Packet Based Data Communication
abstract: Identifier dependent operation processing of packet based data communication is provided. A natural language processor component can parse an input audio signal to identify a request and a trigger keyword. A content selector component can select, based on the request or trigger keyword, a content item. A link generation component can determine whether the client computing device has an account or a record in a database associated with the service provider device. In the absence of the record or account, the link generation device generates and sends a virtual identifier to the service provider device with instructions to generate an account in the database using the virtual identifier. Once the account is created, the service provider device can communicate with the client computing device.

title: Solar cell, method for preparing solar cell, and solar cell production line
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a solar cell, a method for preparing the solar cell, and a solar cell production line. The method includes providing a stack including an N-type silicon substrate having a boron-doped polysilicon layer near a first surface, with a tunneling oxide layer, a phosphorus-doped polysilicon layer, and a mask layer sequentially stacked as stated on an opposite second surface; forming through holes in the mask layer to expose the phosphorus-doped polysilicon layer; forming grooves at the through holes that extend through the phosphorus-doped polysilicon layer and the tunneling oxide layer and partially extend into the N-type silicon substrate, thereby separating a surface of the stack provided with the phosphorus-doped polysilicon layer into spaced emitter regions, and removing the mask layer.
assignee: Laplace Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Air conditioner for vehicle and control method thereof
abstract: An embodiment relates to an air conditioner for a vehicle, the air conditioner comprising: an air conditioning unit for controlling the temperature of air; and a rear seat distribution unit communicating with the air conditioning unit to guide the air of the air conditioning unit to a rear seat. The rear seat distribution unit includes: a housing communicating with the air conditioning unit and including a rear seat outlet; a rear seat blower disposed inside the housing; a main air volume adjustment door unit disposed in front of the rear seat blower; and an auxiliary air volume adjustment door unit disposed at the rear of the blower.

title: Laser-Based Part Manufacturing Method with Reduced Sloshing and Spatter
abstract: A method of laser manufacturing configured to reduce internal and external part imperfections arising from spatter and sloshing comprising a variety of elements including but not limited to a combination of high flux pulsed laser and low flux melting laser, selectively irradiating, and introducing a spatial flux. Placing a high flux pulse laser within the melting laser can ensure spatter free process. This is applicable to area printing and can be potentially applied to other powder bed fusion processes as well.

title: Method, System, and Computer Program Product for Improving Machine Learning Models
abstract: Methods, systems, and computer program products are provided for improving machine learning models which include receiving a data set including data records; inputting the data set to a pre-trained first machine learning model to generate first embeddings; inputting the first embeddings to a second machine learning model to generate second embeddings in a user-specific embedding space; inputting the plurality of second embeddings to a third machine learning model to extract feature data associated with a feature; inputting an output from a machine learning system and the feature data to a fourth machine learning model to generate a relevance score for each entity; determining a subset of entities based on the relevance score; communicating a feedback request to a user; receiving feedback data from the user; and training at least one of the models based on the feedback data.

title: Media and data synchronization and encoding platform
abstract: A first presentation device may transmit a request for a server time and receive a server time indication in response. The first presentation device may calculate a device-specific time delta based on the server time indication and a local time at which the indication was received. The first presentation device may receive content comprising a presentation timestamp and may calculate a device-specific presentation time based on the time delta and the presentation timestamp. Upon the local time matching the device-specific presentation time, the first presentation device may initiate presentation of the content. A second presentation device may perform corresponding operations such that both devices initiate presentation substantially simultaneously. The time delta may be adjusted based on a network round-trip time.

title: Method, System, and Computer Program Product for Calibrating an Actuator
abstract: Disclosed herein are method, system, and computer program product embodiments for calibrating an actuator. For example, the method may include: controlling an electronically commutated motor to drive an actuator member of the actuator away from a mechanical stop until a reference sensor is triggered by the actuator member; determining a position of the electronically commutated motor at which the actuator member of the actuator triggered the reference sensor; controlling the electronically commutated motor to repeatedly reciprocate the actuator member varying search distances from the position toward the mechanical stop and back to triggering the reference sensor until two reciprocated search distances from the position, which are at least a portion of a commutation step of the electronically commutated motor apart, are detected; and determining, based on the two reciprocated search distances, a distance for accurately positioning the actuator member relative to the mechanical stop.

title: Changing area for spa pools, indoor pools, outdoor pools and fitness studios
abstract: A changing area is provided that includes a plurality of changing cubicles arranged in a row, each cubicle having walls with an opening that exposes a storage location for a storage box. A shelf storage is positioned directly behind the cubicles, the shelf storage including multiple storage locations arranged side by side and one above another. The storage locations assigned to the cubicles are integrated into the shelf storage. A manipulator with an effector, configured as an articulated arm robot, is located behind the shelf storage. The effector of the manipulator is capable of accessing all storage locations of the shelf storage, including the storage locations assigned to the cubicles.

title: Blue aleurone and other segregation systems
abstract: The present invention relates to materials and methods for creating and maintaining a cereal plant line for the production of a hybrid cereal plant, that include for example, and not limitation, using the BLue Aleurone (BLA) system.
assignee: KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA; The University Of Sydney; Global Crop Innovations Pty. Ltd.

title: Use of retinoic acid receptor activator and composition thereof in regeneration and repair of mammals
abstract: Provided is use of a retinoic acid receptor activator or a composition containing the retinoic acid receptor activator in preparing a drug or reagent for promoting the regeneration and repair capacity of tissues or complex structures or organs of mammals. The retinoic acid receptor activator comprises one or two or more of all-trans retinoic acid and a selective retinoic acid receptor y agonist. The regeneration and repair refer to promoting the regeneration of tissues or complex structures or organs after tissue or organ resection or damage.
assignee: Institute Of Zoology, Chinese Academy Of Sciences; Beijing Institute For Stem Cell And Regenerative Medicine

title: Control device, control method, and program
abstract: A control device that controls at least temporarily a mobile object which moves autonomously in an area in which another pedestrian walks while leading a leading target person includes a recognition part configured to recognize objects including the leading target person and the other pedestrian, a prediction part configured to predict a future position of the recognized other pedestrian, a path generating part configured to generate a path along which the mobile object is to move in a future, and a drive controller configured to control a drive device attached to the mobile object so that the mobile object moves along the path. The path generating part sets a plurality of path candidates and selects one path candidate as the path while excluding a path candidate in which the other pedestrian is predicted to enter a predetermined area including the mobile object and the leading target person.

title: Devices, systems, and methods for communication with equipment such as automatic swimming pool cleaners
abstract: Devices, systems, and methods may be used for wirelessly communicating underwater (or through air) with equipment such as, but not necessarily limited to, automatic swimming pool cleaners (APCs). Such communication avoids any need for conventional wired communication with the APCs. At least some of the devices may be hand-held and capable of having at least portions immersed in water in normal use. The devices preferably do not use radio frequency (RF) signal to communication with APCs, instead employing light-based or other signal types.

title: Resource allocation method, network device, and terminal device
abstract: The embodiments of the present disclosure provide a resource allocation method. The method includes: obtaining, by a terminal device, first configuration information, the first configuration information being used for configuring sidelink communication resources; obtaining, by the terminal device, a structure of a resource allocation unit according to the first configuration information; and allocating, by the terminal device, one or more resource allocation units for sidelink communication of the terminal device.
assignee: Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd.

title: Use of Thermolatent Catalyst to Improve Properties of Single-Layer Polyurethane Coatings
abstract:
The present invention relates to a process for producing a single-layer polyurethane coated plastic substrate, including of the following steps:
         a) providing a plastic substrate;   b) applying a polyurethane coating system onto the substrate;   c) curing the polyurethane coating system to form the single-layer polyurethane coated plastic substrate;   wherein the polyurethane coating system includes   A) at least one polyisocyanate;   B) at least one NCO-reactive compound;   C) at least one thermally latent catalyst;   D) optionally auxiliaries and/or additives.

title: Improved methods of cell-free synthesis
abstract: Compositions and methods are provided for improved methods of enzymatic, cell-free synthesis. The methods of the disclosure provide improvements in the manipulation of cofactors during the synthesis reactions, including NAD cofactors and Coenzyme A. In an embodiment, metabolic factors, e.g. NAD cofactors, CoA, etc. are synthesized in situ, which increases the production and/or decreases the cost of a desired biomaterial synthesized in the reaction mix. In an embodiment, reducing equivalents NADH and/or NADPH are produced from H 2 . In an embodiment, aberrant NADPH tautomers are detoxified in cell-free reaction mixtures, to increase the production of a desired biomaterial.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University

title: Container with locking features
abstract: A container for holding one or more articles, the container including a lower construct having a plurality of lower panels including a bottom panel and a plurality of lower side panels foldably connected to the bottom panel, an upper construct having a plurality of upper panels, the plurality of upper panels having a flange panel extending at least partially around an opening and at least partially forming a flange of the container, and a plurality of upper side panels foldably connected to the flange panel, a lid panel, and locking features including a locking tab foldably connected to the lid panel and a locking recess at least partially formed along a respective lower side panel of the plurality of lower side panels for at least partially receiving the locking tab to secure the lid panel in locking engagement with the lower construct.

title: Multi-Dimensional Acquisition of Bipolar Signals from a Catheter
abstract: Medical apparatus includes a probe with a basket assembly at its distal end, including a plurality of resilient spines with multiple electrodes arrayed along a length of each of the spines. Processing circuitry is configured to acquire a first bipolar electrical signal from the tissue between first and second electrodes at first and second locations along a first spine of the basket assembly, and to acquire a second bipolar electrical signal from the tissue between the first electrode and a third electrode in a third location on a second spine of the basket assembly, and to interpolate, based on the first and second bipolar electrical signals, a vectorial electrical property of the tissue along an axis that passes through the first location and between the second and third locations.

title: Circuit board and package substrate comprising same
abstract: A circuit board according to an embodiment includes a first insulating layer; a second insulating layer disposed on the first insulating layer and including a cavity; a pad disposed on the first insulating layer and having a top surface exposed through the cavity; wherein the cavity of the second insulating layer includes: a bottom surface positioned higher than the top surface of the first insulating layer; and an inner wall extending from the bottom surface, wherein the inner wall includes: a first inner wall extending from the bottom surface and having a first inclination angle; and a second inner wall extending from the first inner wall and having a second inclination angle different from the first inclination angle.

title: Apparatus for sterilizing containers, apparatus for transporting containers, holding device for containers and method
abstract: An apparatus for treating plastics material preforms includes a transport device, at least one application device for applying a flowable sterilization medium to the plastics material containers transported by the transport device, wherein the transport device has a movable transport carrier that is rotatable about a predefined axis of rotation and on which a plurality of holding devices for holding the plastics material containers. The holding device has a gripping device which for contacting the plastics material containers at least in a first portion of the plastics material containers, and a retaining device for contacting the plastics material containers in a second portion of the plastics material containers, wherein the first portion is spaced apart from the second portion, wherein the gripping device is fixed relative to the transport device and the retaining device is movable relative to the transport device.

title: Elastography for ligament characterization
abstract: Methods and system for characterizing ligament properties using elastography are disclosed. An ultrasound system capable of performing shear wave elasticity imaging and/or supersonic shear imaging may retrieve one or more images from a proposed surgical site. The one or more images may be provided to a surgical planning system that identifies one or more properties of ligaments proximate to the surgical site. Musculoskeletal simulations may be performed using the identified properties to preoperatively identify a surgical plan. Preoperative identification of a surgical plan may enable a surgeon to select from more fine-tuning options for a joint replacement than conventional systems.
assignee: Smith & Nephew, Inc.; Smith & Nephew Asia Pacific Pte. Limited; Smith & Nephew Orthopaedics Ag

title: High-efficiency advanced oxidation process system and method for reducing disinfection by-products in swimming pool water
abstract: An advanced oxidation process (AOP) system for reducing disinfection by-products (DBPs) in swimming pool water. The system comprises an air dryer for removing moisture from ambient air, a feed gas line for transferring the dried air to an UV-based ozone generator, and a treatment conduit with a UV-based ozone generator for treating the swimming pool water. The UV-based ozone generator includes UV lamps emitting UV light to produce ozone and hydroxyl radicals. The treatment conduit receives filtered pool water, treats it with the generated ozone as well as hydroxyl radicals to reduce DBPs below 0.3 ppm, and returns the treated water to the pool. The parallel arrangement of UV lamps in the UV-based ozone generator maximizes ozone production. Flow control valves optimize water flow rate through the treatment conduit. The system efficiently reduces DBPs, improves water quality, and enhances swimmer safety and comfort.

title: Diamond Applicator Tray
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a novel diamond applicator tray provided with a plurality of bumps distributed in a rectangular array. An accommodation space for accommodating diamonds is formed among four bumps adjacent to one another in a peripheral direction. According to the novel diamond applicator tray provided by the present disclosure, the positions of diamonds are limited by the lumps. A plurality of rows of diamonds are fixed by the bumps distributed in a rectangular array. When in use, the size of the fixed diamonds on the diamond applicator tray and the size of embellished diamonds on the painting are designed to be in a one-to-one ratio. A large number of diamonds can be directly stuck with a diamond applicator pan of a square structure, and the plurality of rows of diamond are directly transferred and stuck on the painting in a large area.

title: Remote control box integrated with distribution board for smart farm irrigation
abstract: The present utility model relates to a remote control systems in which electronic components required for wireless communication remote control of an irrigation system of a smart farm are compactly installed together with a power supply distribution board, wherein the distribution board includes a molded case circuit breaker and an earth leakage breaker, and remote control components include a wireless remote relay for controlling an electronic valve, a wireless remote relay for a pump, a transformer for power supply of the electronic valve, and a water level sensing controller for a water tank. By installing the above components in a transparent waterproof box that allows electromagnetic waves to pass through for wireless communication and is waterproof from rain and wind for outdoor installation, reliability and safety are provided. In addition, the remote control systems provides installation convenience by installing a power input plug, a pump power socket, a connector terminal for a water level sensing sensor line, and a connector terminal for an electronic valve power line, thereby easily connecting with external power, pumps, sensors, and electronic valves.

title: Stock optimization system and stock optimization method
abstract: A stock optimization system includes: a weight determination module configured to calculate a total weight, which is a weight of quantitative priority orders of products, based on at least a user input that is evaluation of the products input by a user, from among the user input and a data-driven reference which is a reference obtained through data processing instead of the user input; an optimization module configured to formulate an objective function based on the total weight; and a user interaction module that receives the user input.

title: Link for Industrial Robot, and Industrial Robot
abstract: A link for an industrial robot, the link including a main body for interconnecting a first joint and a second joint of the industrial robot, the main body including an exterior continuous main surface including a planar first surface section and a planar second surface section; a first opening in the first surface section; a second opening in the second surface section; a first cover sealingly closing the first opening and including an exterior planar first cover surface substantially flush with the first surface section; and a second cover sealingly closing the second opening and including an exterior planar second cover surface substantially flush with the second surface section. An industrial robot including a link is also provided.

title: Global illumination using shared lighting contributions for interactions in path tracing
abstract: Disclosed approaches provide for interactions of secondary rays of light transport paths in a virtual environment to share lighting contributions when determining lighting conditions for a light transport path. Interactions may be shared based on similarities in characteristics (e.g., hit locations), which may define a region in which interactions may share lighting condition data. The region may correspond to a texel of a texture map and lighting contribution data for interactions may be accumulated to the texel spatially and/or temporally, then used to compute composite lighting contribution data that estimates radiance at an interaction. Approaches are also provided for reprojecting lighting contributions of interactions to pixels to share lighting contribution data from secondary bounces of light transport paths while avoiding potential over blurring.

title: Bloodstain pattern classification device and method using bloodstain pattern classification algorithm based on bloodstain pattern classification system features
abstract: A bloodstain pattern classification method using a bloodstain pattern classification algorithm based on bloodstain pattern classification system features includes obtaining a bloodstain image, performing first classification to fourth classification of the bloodstain image according to bloodstain pattern features, and outputting a classification result.
assignee: Republic of Korea (National Forensic Service Director Ministry of the Interior and Safety)

title: Method for dimensional transformation of metal-organic framework crystal
abstract: Provided is a method for dimensional transformation of a metal-organic framework (MOF). The method includes: introducing a two-dimensional-layered MOF in a mixed solvent and heating to obtain a three-dimensional MOF; where an organic ligand of the two-dimensional-layered MOF is selected from the group consisting of 1,4-benzenedicarboxylic acid and 2-hydroxyterephthalic acid; a metal ion of the two-dimensional-layered MOF is selected from the group consisting of Zn 2+ , Co 2+ , and Cu 2+ ; and the mixed solvent includes alcohol and N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF).

title: Information processing device
abstract: An information processing device according to the present disclosure includes a control unit. The control unit is configured to: acquire event information indicating an event of a user; analyze the acquired event information and calculate a value for each of a plurality of indicators; calculate an estimated importance level of the event by integrating the calculated values of the indicators; and output the calculated estimated importance level.

title: Semiconductor device
abstract: A semiconductor device of an embodiment has: a wiring board having on a surface a plurality of first electrode pads; and a first semiconductor chip mounted on the wiring board, and having on a surface a plurality of second electrode pads; each of the plurality of first electrode pads has at least in a part thereof a first width in a first direction along a face of the wiring board, is arranged side by side in the first direction at a first pitch, and has on a surface a first bump having a second width in the first direction larger than the first width; the plurality of second electrode pads are arranged side by side in the first direction at the first pitch; and each of a plurality of first bonding wires is connected at one end through the first bump to each of the plurality of first electrode pads, and is connected at another end to each of the plurality of second electrode pads.

title: Centrifugal barrel polishing machine
abstract: A centrifugal barrel polishing machine includes a distance measurement sensor  15 . When a barrel tank  50  is located in a detection area, a controller  10  determines whether a fixed-state distance is measured by a distance measurement sensor  15 , and when the fixed-state distance is not measured, the controller  10  does not permit the rotation of a turret  22.

title: Method for operating a particle beam device, and particle beam device
abstract: A method records an image with high magnification of a structure on a sample using a particle beam microscope. Structure shape information representing a shape of the structure is used to determine an image position of an image representation of the structure in an image of the sample recorded using the particle beam microscope. An operating setting of the particle beam microscope is modified on the basis of the determined image position. The structure shape information is modified on the basis of the determined image position and the recorded image. Subsequently, a new image of the sample is recorded using the modified operating setting. A sequence, which comprises determining the image position, modifying the operating setting, modifying the structure shape information and recording a new image, is performed repeatedly.

title: Privacy-preserving identity verification using blockchain and granular data control
abstract: Approaches are described for secure identity verification using blockchain technology. A configuration record for a user's identity attributes is obtained. The configuration record is used to evaluate and verify various identity elements through cross-referencing with authoritative sources. Based on the configuration record, identity tokens (KYbits) are generated using cryptographic techniques and stored on a blockchain ledger. These KYbits encapsulate verified identity information and can be utilized in verification processes without disclosing sensitive personal data. The identity tokens enable secure and privacy-preserving transactions across various platforms, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations and enhancing user control over personal identity information.

title: Battery cell, battery, and electric device
abstract: A battery cell, a battery, and an electric device. The battery cell has a capacity of C and comprises a casing, and at least a partial region of the casing has a tensile strength of Rm at a temperature of 25° C., wherein Rm and C satisfy: 250 MPa≤Rm≤2000 MPa and 25 Ah≤C≤550 Ah.

title: Apparatus and method for measuring droplet information, and inkjet printing system
abstract: An apparatus for measuring droplet information includes a first light source module configured to emit a first light having a first optical characteristic in an oblique direction with respect to a surface of a substrate on which a droplet is positioned. A second light source module is configured to emit a second light having a second optical characteristic different from the first optical characteristic in a direction perpendicular to the surface of the substrate. A camera is configured to photograph a droplet being illuminated with at least one of the first light and the second light from above the droplet. A control module is configured to analyze at least one image photographed by the camera to acquire droplet information therefrom.

title: Test system of rock mass for seepage coupling and permeability testing under deep complex conditions
abstract: The provided is a test system of a rock mass for seepage coupling and permeability testing under deep complex conditions. The test system includes: a seepage medium supply module, a seepage coupling module, a transient method test module, and a steady-state method test module, where the seepage medium supply module is configured to provide a seepage medium or a purging medium to the test system; the seepage coupling module is a rock mechanics testing machine; the transient method test module is configured to calculate permeability of a specimen by measuring a change in a pressure difference between an inlet and an outlet of a triaxial chamber of the rock mechanics testing machine, and is suitable for a low-permeability medium; and the steady-state method test module is configured to test a flow rate at the outlet of the triaxial chamber of the rock mechanics testing machine based on a steady-state method.

title: Release agent composition for release by irradiation with light, laminate, and method for producing processed semiconductor substrate
abstract: This release agent composition for release by irradiation with light includes a polymer and a solvent, the polymer including a first structure, a second structure, and a third structure, wherein the first structure has a structure that absorbs light to impart releasability to a release agent layer formed from the release agent composition, the second structure has a —Si—O—Si— structure in a main chain of the polymer, and the third structure has an aromatic hydrocarbon ring and/or a heterocyclic ring.

title: Kit and method of using the kit for facilitating correct pronunciation of words and/or letters
abstract: A method of using a kit includes placing at least one sensor detector on at least one mouth part of the user; pronouncing each of at least one letter and/or each of at least one word by the user; a first detection step of detecting each of at least one motion of each of the at least one mouth part via each of the at least one sensor detector; a first determination step of determining if the detected each of the at least one motion of each of the at least one mouth part correspond to each of at least one predetermined correct motion of each of the at least one mouth part; and displaying the detected each of the at least one motion of each of the at least one mouth part in real-time on a touch screen display interface.

title: Method and codec for encoding data symbol chain and decoding encoded symbol chain
abstract: Disclosed is a method and a codec for encoding a data symbol chain and decoding an encoded symbol chain. The method and codec leverage unique mappings between data symbols and encoded symbols, combined with redundant symbols, to ensure reliable decoding. Each data symbol in the data symbol chain maps uniquely to an encoded symbol using identity or negation functions, thereby eliminating random branching during decoding. Each encoded symbol is generated based on a value of a data symbol. The chain header is updated at each instance of generation of an encoded symbol. There is no branching during the decoding because there is no uncertainty regarding a particular source symbol that was used for the generating the encoded symbol. The method prevents collisions by ensuring that no two data symbols map to the same encoded symbol, even in the presence of erasures.

title: Method and apparatus for sliding image preview and terminal device
abstract: The embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a method and an apparatus for sliding image preview and a terminal device. The method includes: acquiring, in response to a slide-to-switch operation for images in an image set being detected, index information of at least one image to be presented corresponding to a switching operation process; extracting a thumbnail corresponding to the index information according to the index information; presenting, in response to the thumbnail being rendered, the thumbnail in a first presentation area in an image preview area; acquiring an original image corresponding to the index information, and decoding and rendering the original image; and switching the thumbnail presented in the first presentation area to the original image for presentation in response to the original image being rendered successfully.
assignee: Beijing Zitiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: System, Method, and Computer Program Product for Feature Similarity-Based Monitoring and Validation of Models
abstract: Systems, methods, and computer program products calculate a historical feature similarity point distribution associated with a first machine learning model, calculate a real-time feature similarity point distribution associated with a second machine learning model, and automatically provide, based on a comparison of the historical feature similarity point distribution to the real-time feature similarity point distribution, an indication of whether the second machine learning model is aligned with the first machine learning model.

title: Spot welding gun
abstract: A spot welding gun comprises an electrode and a pressing mechanism. The electrode contacts a workpiece. The pressing mechanism applies a pressing force to the workpiece by pressing the electrode. The pressing mechanism comprises a pressing rod, at least one link member, and a spring member. The pressing rod has a distal end to which the electrode is coupled and reciprocates in its axial direction. The link member includes a distal and proximal end portions. The distal end portion is coupled to a proximal end side of the pressing rod via a joint member and extends in a direction inclined with respect to the pressing rod so that the proximal end portion becomes more distant from the electrode. The spring member urges the link member toward the distal end portion. An inclination angle of the link member decreases as the pressing rod moves toward the electrode.

title: Pesticidally active bicyclic compounds
abstract: A method for combating and/or controlling an animal pest to (i) reduce damage on a plant, which comprises applying to the pest, to a locus of the pest, or to a plant susceptible to attack by the pest, an effective amount of either compound of formula (I) or formula (II); or (ii) protect plant propagation material, which comprises treating the propagation material or the site, where the propagation material is planted, with an effective amount of either compound of formula (I) or formula (II); wherein the compound of formula (I) and formula (II) are (I) (II) wherein the substituents are as defined in claim  1 , and the agrochemically acceptable salts, stereoisomers, enantiomers, tautomers and N-oxides of those compounds.

title: Crystal of dihydropyridinone derivative or solvate thereof
abstract:
To provide a crystal of a dihydropyridinone derivative or a solvate thereof. The present invention relates to a crystal of a compound represented by Formula: 
     
       
         
         
             
             
         
       
         
         
           
             or a solvate thereof, and a pharmaceutical composition containing the same.

title: Calibration method for emulation of a physical input device for touchless control of a computer device
abstract: According to a first aspect of the present invention, a computer-implemented calibration method, in particular for emulation of a physical input device, for touchless control of a computer device, is provided. The computer device may comprise and/or may be communicatively coupled to sensor means. The computer device may comprise and/or may be communicatively coupled to display means. The computer device may be disposed in a scene, the scene preferably including a plurality of planes. The method may comprise obtaining, using the sensor means, sensor data at least partially including the scene. The method may comprise processing the obtained sensor data to detect a plurality of planes in the scene. The method may comprise selecting at least one calibration plane among the detected plurality of planes. The selection of the at least one calibration plane may be performed based on characteristics of the plurality of planes. The method may comprise determining an interaction space for touchless user input based on the selected at least one calibration plane.

title: Three-dimensional shape measuring device, reference surface position adjustment method therefor, and measurement mode switching method therefor
abstract: A three-dimensional shape measuring device includes a holder that changes the reference light path length in response to temperature change, and a temperature adjusting unit that adjusts a temperature of the holder to a target temperature, so as to make a measurement light path length equal to a reference light path length with high accuracy at low cost regardless of a temperature of an installation environment. A three-dimensional shape measuring device includes a temperature adjusting unit that adjusts the temperature of the holder and a temperature control unit that controls the temperature adjusting unit so as to selectively switch a measurement mode between a first measurement mode in which the reference light path length is made equal to a measurement light path length and a second measurement mode in which the reference light path length is made different from the measurement light path length.

title: Vehicles and methods for routing a plurality of vehicles to a common destination
abstract: In one embodiment, a method for routing a plurality of vehicles includes receiving an input from an input device of a vehicle, wherein the input includes a destination location, a destination date and time, and at least one companion vehicle, receiving, by the vehicle, a companion location for the at least one companion vehicle, generating, by the vehicle, a primary vehicle route for the vehicle and a companion vehicle route for the at least one companion vehicle, and transmitting, using a network interface hardware of the vehicle, one or more control signals to the at least one companion vehicle to at least partially control the at least one companion vehicle such that it arrives at the destination location at the destination date and time.

title: Novel ionizable lipid and lipid nanoparticle composition using same
abstract: The present invention relates to novel ionizable lipids and lipid nanoparticle compositions comprising the same, wherein Lipid nanoparticles includes the novel ionizable lipids exhibit excellent encapsulation efficiency and high intracellular and in vivo gene delivery efficiency, and also exhibit excellent muscle delivery upon local administration, thereby being useful as compositions for drug delivery.

title: Fluid filtration system with single use filter and integrated integrity test device and method of using same
abstract: A fluid filtration system includes a single use filter removably mounted to a cabinet of a workstation. The upstream end of the single use filter is in fluid communication with a pump via a fluid supply conduit that includes a test junction. An integrity test device is supported by the cabinet and is in fluid communication with the upstream end of the single use filter via a test conduit fluidly connected to the single use filter via the test junction of the fluid supply conduit. The integrity test device adapted to be connected to a source of pressurized gas and to selectively direct a flow of pressurized gas through the test conduit and the single use filter to perform a test operation on the single use filter.

title: Acoustic wave device with multilayer piezoelectric substrate for reduced spurious signals
abstract: An acoustic wave resonator is disclosed. The acoustic wave resonator can include a plurality of interdigital transducer electrodes and a multilayer piezoelectric substrate (MPS) adjacent the plurality of interdigital transducer electrodes. The MPS includes a first substrate layer of a piezoelectric material, and a second substrate layer of silicon that is bonded to the first layer. The silicon has a cut direction and/or acoustic wave propagation direction that is different from those of a silicon substrate. The silicon substrate has a cut direction and a propagation direction property defined by the silicon cut angle and the propagation direction.

title: System and methods for a cassette capture mechanism for phacoemulsification surgical applications
abstract: A system and method for detecting and/or capturing a cassette is disclosed. The cassette capture mechanism may be used with a surgical console of a surgical system, wherein the system has a cassette receiving area having at least two alignment sensors and a plurality of capture plungers; and at least two capture hooks which may engage with a cassette, wherein at least one of the at least two alignment sensors produces a signal indicative of the presence of a cassette.

title: Random access method and related apparatus
abstract: This application provides a random access method and apparatus, which help reduce a collision probability of sending a random access preamble in a random access process and improve an access capacity. The method includes: sending, by a network device, configuration information to a terminal device, where the configuration information is used to indicate that an SSB corresponds to a plurality of beams, and each of the plurality of beams corresponds to one or more ROs; receiving, by the terminal device, the configuration information, determining a target beam from the plurality of beams, and sending a random access preamble to the network device on an RO corresponding to the target beam; and receiving, by the network device, the random access preamble.

title: Semiconductor structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: A method includes forming a transistor on a front-side of a substrate, the transistor comprising a channel region, a gate structure surrounding the channel region, and source/drain regions on opposite sides of the gate structure; forming a front-side contact on a first one of the source/drain regions of the transistor; forming a back-side contact on a second one of the source/drain regions of the transistor; forming a back-side capacitor on the back-side contact.

title: SMTC Shifting for Non-Terrestrial Networks
abstract: A user equipment (UE) configured to receive a synchronization signal (SS)/Physical Broadcast Channel (PBCH) block measurement timing information (SMTC) configuration information comprising at least two SMTC windows within an SMTC periodicity, determine an association between a first satellite and a first one of the SMTC windows and a second satellite and a second one of the SMTC windows, receive first SMTC information for the first satellite during the first one of the SMTC windows and second SMTC information for the second satellite during the second one of the SMTC windows and determine a first time shift for the first one of the SMTC windows within the SMTC periodicity based on the first SMTC information and a second time shift for the second one of the SMTC windows within the SMTC periodicity based on the second SMTC information.

title: Enhancements to data radio bearer parameters for ue-to-ue relays
abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communication are described. In some examples, a source user equipment (UE) may receive a control message indicating a set of end-to-end sidelink data radio bearer (DRB) parameters and multiple per-hop sidelink DRB parameters. In such examples, the set of end-to-end sidelink DRB parameters may be associated with communications between the source UE and a destination UE, while the multiple per-hop sidelink DRB parameters may be associated with multiple communication hops, sidelink relay connections, between the source UE and the destination UE. As such, the source UE may transmit, via an end-to-end sidelink interface, control data to the destination UE based on the set of end-to-end sidelink DRB parameters. Further, the source UE may transmit, via a sidelink interface, user data to a relay UE based on a first set of per-hop sidelink DRB parameters, where the user data is intended for the destination UE.

title: Event-driven technical support for a printer
abstract: System, method, and software for event-driven technical support for a printer. In an embodiment, a print monitor device is configured to receive moderated operational data streaming from a printer, monitor the moderated operational data streaming from the printer to detect an error at the printer, and determine whether the error comprises a critical error based on error detection criteria. When the error comprises a critical error based on the error detection criteria, the print monitor device is configured to upload a critical error indication to a cloud-based technical support service over at least one network connection, automatically collect log data from the printer, and automatically upload the log data to the cloud-based technical support service over the at least one network connection.

title: Optimized processing for reducing channels of a stereophonic audio signal
abstract: A method and downmixing device for downmixing a stereophonic signal in order to obtain a monophonic signal. The method includes, for a stereophonic-signal frame, selection between: a first downmixing mode having filtering with rephasing in each of the channels of the stereophonic signal by an angle defined by half the phase difference determined between the two channels of the stereophonic signal; and a second downmixing mode having filtering with rephasing in a single one of the channels of the stereophonic signal by an angle defined by the phase difference determined between the two channels of the stereophonic signal. The selection of the first downmixing mode or of the second downmixing mode is dependent on the value of a phase indicator determined per frame.

title: Modifying designated playing cards employed in electronic table games
abstract: Gaming systems and methods which employ designated playing cards in association with an electronic table game.

title: Variable-bandwidth fdm allocation
abstract: A method for wireless communication at a wireless device and related apparatus are provided. In the method, the wireless device receives a resource indication from a reader device. The resource indication includes a plurality of resource configurations, and each resource configuration of the plurality of resource configurations includes a frequency shift and a corresponding bandwidth. The wireless device further transmits to the reader device a first message for a random access procedure with the reader device using a first resource configuration of the plurality of resource configurations. The first resource configuration is based on a received power on the wireless device or a power variation between the wireless device and a neighboring device.

title: Gene signature
abstract: The invention relates to gene signatures. In particular, the invention relates methods and kits for diagnosing a subject having a disease, by simultaneously discriminating between multiple infectious and inflammatory diseases using a gene signature. The invention also relates to the use of a gene signature as a diagnostic or prognostic biomarker for diseases.

title: Airbag cushion and folding method of airbag cushion
abstract: An airbag cushion includes an airbag to be folded at a seat and to wrap around sides and front of an occupant by being deployed outward from the seat during inflation and then unfolded forward, and capable of bending inward; and a shape retention member having a first end connected to the airbag and a second end connected to the seat, to allow a form of the inflated airbag wrapping the sides and front of the occupant to be maintained. The airbag is folded inward by a first folding amount when the shape retention member is folded inward, and folded outward by a second folding amount, and the shape retention member is folded to wrap the airbag in a direction opposite to a direction in which the airbag is folded by the second folding amount such that the second end of the shape retention member is positioned inward.

title: Pan-Genotypic Agents Against Influenza Virus and Methods of Using the Same
abstract: Methods of inhibiting a respiratory virus, (i.e., a virus associated with a respiratory condition, e.g., influenza A, influenza B, RSV, etc.) in a sample are provided. Aspects of the methods include contacting a sample comprising viral RNA (vRNA) having a target motif with an effective amount of an agent that specifically binds the target motif to inhibit the respiratory virus. Also provided are methods of treating or preventing respiratory virus infection in a subject. Also provided are compounds and pharmaceutical compositions comprising an oligonucleotide sequence complementary to a target vRNA region that find use in the subject methods.
assignee: The Board Of Trustees Of The Leland Stanford Junior University

title: Pluggable chip interposer for photonic chip alignment
abstract: A system for aligning chips, such as chips with photonic devices, includes a first device, such as a laser, on a first chip, a second device, such as a mode converter, on a second chip, and a substrate.
